jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Production
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 at 16h00 (Applications received after the closing date and faxed copies will not be considered).
jobs.summary: Administrative clerk providing registry and data-capture support in the Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division, requiring Grade 12 with no prior experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) or equivalent. No experience. Special requirements (skills needed): Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data and collecting data. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public service. Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Language proficiency in English. Computer operating skills (MS Word, Excel and Power Point) Good interpersonal skills, organising and planning skills, communication skills (written and verbal) Flexibility and Teamwork. Ability to perform routine tasks
jobs.duties: Successful candidate will be responsible to render administrative support services within the establishment of Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division and perform the following key functions: Operating an internal registry system. Ensure configuration control administration. Render an administrative function. Render an office support function to the Directorate Departmental Policy Support.
jobs.enquiries: Ms B.E. Jele 012 335 5501 or Ms K.C. Nkoana 012 355 5507
jobs.applications: Department of Defence, Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division, Private Bag X161, Pretoria, 0001 or hand delivered during office hours to: Armscor Building C/O Nossob and Delmas Ave, Erasmuskloof, Pretoria or email to Elinah.Jele@dod.mil.za or Koena.Nkoana@dod.mil.za
jobs.notes: It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through       the    filling  of     this   posts    with     candidates     whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity in line with the numeric targets as contained in our Employment Equity plan. Applications must be submitted on the prescribed form Z83 (obtainable from any Public Service Department office i.e. effective 01 January 2021 or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/. Should an application be received using incorrect application employment form Z83, it will be disqualified, which must be originally signed and dated by the applicant and which must be accompanied by a detailed CV only (with full particulars of the applicants’ training, qualifications, competencies, knowledge & experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview which should not be older than six months. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in applications being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one post must submit a separate form Z83 (as well as the documentation mentioned above) in respect of each post being applied for. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. Should an application be received where an applicant applies for more than one post on the same applications form, the application will only be considered for the first post indicated on the application and not for any of the other posts. Under no circumstances will Photostat copies or faxed copies of application documents be accepted. The successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks and qualification and employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The level of appointments is dependent upon, qualifications, relevant experience and research output. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The competency assessment will be limited to successful candidates in the interview process only. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (pre-employment screening) which may include social media profiles checks. A successful candidate will have to undergo a full security vetting while in the employ of the department and negative outcome shall nullify employment contract. Failure to submit the required documents will result in your application not being considered. Successful candidates will be required to disclose their financial interests within one (1) month of appointment. Applicants who do not receive confirmation or feedback within 3 (three) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Due to the large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. For more information on the job description(s) please contact the person indicated in the post details. Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POST

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Produksie
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk wat register- en datavasleggingsondersteuning verskaf in die Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division, met 'n vereiste van Grade 12 en geen vorige ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) of gelykwaardig. Geen ervaring. Spesiale vereistes (vaardighede benodig): Kennis van klerklike pligte en praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en data in te samel. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Public service regeer. Kennis van berging en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Taalvaardigheid in Engels. Rekenaarbetrappingsvaardighede (MS Word, Excel en Power Point). Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, organising en beplanningsvaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en mondeling). Buigsaamheid en samewerking. Vermoë om roetine take uit te voer.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees om administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te lewer binne die vestiging van Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division en om die volgende sleutelfunksies uit te voer: Bestuur van 'n interne registerstelsel. Verseker konfigurasiebeheeradministrasie. Lewer 'n administratiewe funksie. Lewer 'n kantoorondersteuningsfunksie aan die Directorate Departmental Policy Support.

zu.title: Iclerk yoBulungu: Ukukhiqiza
zu.summary: Iclerk yolawulo ehlinzeka ngokwesekwa kwalebhu lokubhaliswa kanye nokungena kwemininingwane kuDefence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division, edinga iGrade 12 ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nokuhlukunyezwa.
zu.requirements: Okungenani iGrade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma okulinganayo. Akukho namhlanje. Izidingo ezikhethekile (izikhombi ezidingekayo): Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yabakhandamisa, izindlela kanye nokuqoqwa ngokusebenzisa isu elibukekile kanye nokusuka emadolophini nasemaphethelweni. Isibonakaliso esilula ngemithetho esekela uMnyango Wezokuqinisekisa kwezeMpi. Isibonakaliso esilula ngemithetho yesimo esitholakala esikhathini. Ulwazi ngesikhathi esitholakala kwezinsuku zasendaweni kanye nokuqoqwa kwezinsuku ezitholakala esikhathini somsebenzi okhona. Isibonakaliso esiNgisi. Izindlela zokusuka emkhakheni otholakala kwezinsuku zasendaweni zasemaphethelweni.
zu.duties: Omutsha ophumelelayo uzobe nesibopho sokulekelela ngokulawula izinsizakalo zokusesikhwameni kweDefence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division futhi enze lemisebenzi elandelayo ebalulekile: Ukusebenzisa isiso sokulungiselela okungaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kolawulo kokuqoqwa kwezinto. Hlinzeka ngomswebenzi wolawulo. Hlinzeka ngokwesekwa kweso kuleso sikhulu esibuso ngesiNgisi esisebenzayo esinamandla okusebenza.

xh.title: Iklerka yolawulo: Ukukhiqiza
xh.summary: Iklerka yolawulo ehlinzeka ngokuxhasa kwirejistri nakwingqokelela yedata kwisebe le-Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning, ifuna ibhasi lemfundo le-12 ngaphandle kokuba namava sadluleyo.
xh.requirements: Ubuncinane beGraji 12 (NQF Level 4) okube ngokulinganayo. Akukho mava. Iimfuno ezikhethekileyo (amakhono afunekayo): Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeklerka, iindlela zokwenza njengokunokwazi ukuqokelela idata nokuqokelela idata. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwejaphu lemithetho elawula inkonzo kahulumente. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokugcina nokufetcha ngokomthetho wendawo yokusebenza. Ukuzithiba kolwimi kwesiNgesi. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel and Power Point) Amakhono amahle abantu, ukuhlelwa koluntu nezicwangciso, amakhono othungelwano (okubhalisiweyo nokuThethwa) Ukuguquguquka noBuntu bomsebenzi ngokubambisana. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo
xh.duties: Umuntu ophumeleleyo uya kuba nenkunzi yokuvelisa iinkonzo zoxhaso lolawulo kwisebe le-Defence Policy, Strategy and Planning Division aze azenze ezi nkqubo zilandelayo ezibalulekileyo: Ukusebenzisa inkqubo yangaphakathi yerejistri. Qinisekisa ulawulo loluhlelo lokumisa. Kwenza umsebenzi wolawulo. Kwenza umsebenzi woxhaso behhovisi kwiDirectorate Departmental Policy Support.

jobs.title: Analyst: Economic Modelling and Research
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 at 16h00 (Walk-in) 23h59 (online). NB: It is the sole responsibility of an applicant to ensure that their application reaches the Department on or before the set deadline.
jobs.summary: Analyst position in economic modelling and research at the Department of Electricity and Energy Head Office in Pretoria, requiring a degree and 2-3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A Degree in Economics, Energy Studies, Public Policy, Statistics at NQF level 7 recognised by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Added advantage to those with honours degree or postgraduate diploma in a relevant discipline. PLUS 2-3 years’ work/internship of experience in economic or policy research (preferably in energy, infrastructure, or development sectors). Knowledge of: Economics (macro and micro), including economic policy, growth, inequality and public finance. Energy policy and planning basics, including energy transition, renewables and carbon pricing. Socio-economic development, research methods and the South African policy/economic context (NDP, IRP, JET Framework, Eskom restructuring). Statistical/modelling tools and relevant data sources, including Stats SA, IEA, IMF, World Bank and government database. Skills: Data analysis and visualisation (Excel or similar tools), Statistical programming (e.g. EViews or Stata), basic modelling support (e.g. CGE/input-output models). Structural literature reviews, draft policy briefs, technical reports and presentations, translating complex results into clear summaries and visuals. Communication, stakeholder engagement and multidisciplinary teamwork. Project/time management, documentation and research audit trails. Thinking Demand: Analytical, conceptual and critical thinking. Quantitative reasoning and reasoning and attentive to details. Problem-solving, including addressing data gaps, modelling inconsistencies and stakeholder information needs.
jobs.duties: Conduct data collection and analysis. Provide economic and policy research support. Provide support in economic and energy modelling. Provide support with socio-economic impact assessment. Prepare reports, brief, presentations and data visualisations. Provide stakeholder and projects support, including monitoring implementation progress for strategies such as the Just Energy Transition.

af.title: Analis: Ekonomiese Modellering en Navorsing
af.summary: Analispos in ekonomiese modellering en navorsing by die Department of Electricity and Energy Hoofkantoor in Pretoria, wat 'n graad en 2-3 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad in Economincs, Energy Studies, Public Policy, Statistics op NQF vlak 7 erken deur die South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Dit is 'n bykomende voordeel vir persone met 'n honneursgraad of nagraadse diploma in 'n relevante dissipline. PLUS 2-3 jaar se werk-/internskapservaring in ekonomiese of beleidsonderzoek (verkieslik in die energie-, infrastruktuur- of ontwikkelingsektore). Kennis van: Ekonomie (makro en mikro), insluitend ekonomiese beleid, groei, ongelykheid en openbare finansies. Grondbeginsels van energiebeleid en -beplanning, insluitend energie-oorgang, hernuwbare energie en koolstofprysbepaling. Sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling, navorsingsmetodes en die Suid-Afrikaanse beleids-/ekonomiese konteks (NDP, IRP, JET Framework, Eskom-herstrukturering). Statistiese/modelleringsinstrumente en relevante databronne, insluitend Stats SA, IEA, IMF, World Bank en regeringsdatabasis. Vaardighede: Data-analise en -visualisering (Excel of soortgelyke instrumente), Statistiese programmering (bv. EViews of Stata), basiese modelleringsondersteuning (bv. CGE/inset-afsetmodelle). Strukturele literatuuroorsigte, konseppolisieborings, tegniese verslae en voorleggings, en die vertaling van komplekse resultate in duidelike opsommings en visuele materiaal. Kommunikasie, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en multidissiplinêre spanwerk. Projekt/tydbestuur, dokumentasie en navorsingsouditspore. Denkvereistes: Analitiese, konseptuele en kritiese denke. Kwantitatiewe redenering en besonderhiedeonderoë. Probleemoplossing, insluitend die aanspreek van dataleemtes, modelleringsonbestendighede en inligtingsbehoeftes van belanghebbendes.
af.duties: Voer data-insameling en -analise uit. Verskaf ekonomiese en beleidsondersteuning. Verskaf ondersteuning in ekonomiese en energi modellering. Verskaf ondersteuning met sosio-ekonomiese impakassessment. Berei verslae, briefings, voorleggings en datavisualiserings voor. Verskaf ondersteuning aan belanghebbendes en projekte, insluitend die monitering van implementeringsvordering vir strategieë soos die Just Energy Transition.

zu.title: Isidluli: Ukumodela kwasezoMnozo nokuPhila
zu.summary: Isikhundla sesidluli ekumodeleni kwasezoMnozo nantlola emnyangweni weElectricity and Energy Head Office ePretoria, esifuna isiqu semfundo futhi sidinge iminyaka yama-2-3 yokuqashwa.
zu.requirements: Isiqu kwi-Economics, Energy Studies, Public Policy, Statistics ezingeni le-NQF level 7 esamukelekwa i-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Kuzoba yinto enhle labo abanesiqu seziqu eziphezulu noma idiploma yasemva kweziqu enkoleni ephathelene nendawo yawo. KUNGEZELWA eminyakeni engu-2-3 yokuqashwa/ukukhonzwa emsebenzini wocwaningo kwezomnozo noma inqubomgomo (ikakhulukazi kwizigaba zamandla, insimbi, nentuthuko). Ulwazi mayelana ne: Economics (macro and micro), okuhlanganisa inqubomgomo yezomnozo, ukukhula, ukungalingani nezimali zikahulumeni. Izisekelo zenqubomgomo namaphulani amandla, okuhlanganisa ukushintsha kwamandla, amandla avuselelwayo nentengo yekhabhoni. Intuthuko yomphakathi noma ngokomnozo, izindlela zocwaningo kanye nesimo senqubomgomo/ezomnozo saseNingizimu Afrika (NDP, IRP, JET Framework, Eskom restructuring). Amathuluzi okuzibuka/ukumodela nemithombo yemininingwane ephathelene nayo, okuhlanganisa Stats SA, IEA, IMF, World Bank noma igumbi laloluchwepheshe lekhompyutha. Amakhono: Ukuhlaziya imininingwane kanye nokubuka (Excel noma amathuluzi afanayo), ukulunga okuzibukayo (njenge-EViews noma i-Stata), ukusekela ukumodela okuyisisekelo (njenge-CGE/input-output models). Ukubuka emibhalo yezakhiwo, ukulungula amafayela enqubomgomo, imibiko yezobuchwepheshe kanye nezethulo, ukuguqula imiphumela eqinile kuba yizifinyezo ezicacile kanye nezithombe ezibukwayo. Ukuthintana, ukuxhumana nalabo abathintekayo kanye nomsebenzi wabahlanganisene izinkalo ezahlukene. Uphulabhula/abalule ukuphatha isikhathi, ukubhala imibhalo kanye nokulandela umkhondo wocwaningo. Isidingo sokucabanga: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ngokwemibono nangokuhlakanipha. Ukuthisha ngokwezinani nokucatshelwa ngemibono kanye nokunakela imininingwane. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, okuhlanganisa ukulungisa izikhala zemininingwane, ukungahambelani kokumodela kanye nezidingo zolwazi zalabo abathintekayo.
zu.duties: Qoqa futhi uhlaziye imininingwane. Nikeza inkxaso yokucwaninga ngezomnozo nangenqubomgomo. Nikeza inkxaso ekumodeleni kwomnozo namandla. Nikeza inkxaso ngokuqashwa kokuthinta komphakathi noma ngokomnozo. Lungiselela imibiko, amafayela, izethulo kanye nokubuka imininingwane. Nikeza inkxaso kwabathintekayo nasezinhlotsheni, okuhlanganisa nokubuka inqubo yokuphumelela kwezinqubomgomo ezifana ne-Just Energy Transition.

xh.title: Onyiliishi: Imodeli yezoQoqosho noPhondo
xh.summary: Isithuba sonyiliishi kwimodeli yezoqoqosho nophando kwiSebe leGeze loMbane namandla eNtlu-ntlu kwiPretoria, esifuna isidanga kunye neminyaka 2-3 yamava.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwiQoqosho, iMfundo yeMbane, iNgqungquthela kaZwelonke, iZibalo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 esamkelwe yi-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Kulungile abo banesidanga sobugcisa be-bachelor okanye idiploma yesiquphephile kwizifundo ezifanelekile. KANJALO iminyaka 2-3 yamava emsebenzini/ukwenza isicwangciso sokusebenza kophando lweqoqosho okanye ngqungquthela (ngokukhethwayo kwamasebe amandla, izakhiwo, okanye intsinakalo). Ulwazi ngaku: Iqoqosho (emakhulu namanqwanqwa), kuquka inqungquthela yeQoqosho, ukukhula, ngokungalingani kunye nemali kaZwelonke. Iintsingiselo zephondo lamandla nokuqwalasela, kuquka iyanotshela ngamandla, amandla atsha nokumiswa ixabiso lekarbhu. Intsinakalo yoluntu nentlalo, iindlela zophando nokuqwalasela kwezommandla zangengingqi kunye neqoqosho leMzantsi Afrika (i-NDP, i-IRP, i-JET Framework, ukuqwalaselwa kwe-Eskom). Izixhobo zezibalo/imodeli kunye negunya leedyatha, kuquka i-Stats SA, i-IEA, i-IMF, i-World Bank negunya lolwazi karhulumente. Amakhono: Ukuqwalasela nekubonisa idyatha (i-Excel okanye ezinye izixhobo ezifanayo), ukwenza izinto ngesixhobo sezibalo (umz. i-EViews okanye i-Stata), inkxaso yemodeli esisiseko (umz. iimodeli ze-CGE/input-output). Ukugcina iingqwalasela ezakhiweyo, ukulungisa amacebiso ngqungquthela, iingxelo ezinobuchule nokuqamba amaprezenteyshun, ukuqamba iziphumo ezibucukubhediiba zibe ngamabanga acace gca kunye nezithombe. Unxibelelwano, unxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba nokusebenza ngokomanyano lwezifundo ezahlukeneyo. Ulawulo lweenjini/exesha, ukugcina amaxwebhu kunye neendimbela zophando. Iimfuno zokuqamba: Ukuqwalasela, ukucinga ngeendaba ezithile nokuqamba ngokuphonononga. Imilinganiselo yezibalo nokucinga ngokucinga nokunakela iinkcukacha. Ukuxazulula iingxaki, kuquka ukuphelisa iindawo ezisweleyo kudyatha, ukungahambelani kwimodeli nezidingo zolwazi zabathathi-nxaxheba.
xh.duties: Ukuqokelela nokwahlula idyatha. Ukunika inkxaso yophando lweqoqosho nengqungquthela. Ukunikela inkxaso kwimodeli yeQoqosho namandla. Ukunikela inkxaso ngokuhlolwa kwemveliso yoluntu nentlalo. Ukulungisa iingxelo, amabangi, amaprezenteyshun nekubonisa idyatha. Ukunikela inkxaso kubathathi-nxaxheba noluqwalaselo lweengxelo, kuquka nokubona inkqubela phambili ekuphothenweni kweekhomishoni ezinjengokutshintsha amandla ngokubumbeko.

Iminyaka emine (4) yokuhlola ezokusiza ngokwezempilo nokuphepha ehleziwe kuqondiswa ekuhenyeni kwe-Mechanical Engineering. Ilayisense lesokushayela elisebenzayo. Ulwazi: Izinqumomumo neziqikizi zomnyango, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, I-Public Service Act kanye ne-Regulations, I-OHS Act kanye ne-Regulations, izinga le-OHS, i-COIDA, Isistimu yokuphathwa kwe-OHS. zu.duties: Nikela ngeminikelo ekuhlotsheni kwe-Mechanical Engineering futhi wqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumomumo kanye nesu le-Department of Employment and Labour ngokomthetho we-OHS. Yenza izihloko ezinkulu zokuqondwa zokuphenya kwe-Mechanical Engineering njalo njengokuhlelelwe kwawo wonke umkhakha we-OHS. Hlela ucwaningo lobuchwepheshe mayelana namagama amasha e-Mechanical Engineering ngokwezokuphepha kanye nezempilo ezomsebenzini. Nikeza ngokusekela okuqondiswa enyathelweni lokuphoqa, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela imibiko yezinkantolo ezingekho emthethweni.

xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) yeminyaka emithathu (3)/ Undergraduate bachelor’s degree (NQF7) kwiBunjiniyela Bezinto Eziyimishini. Registration with the relevant, recognized professional body is an advantage but not compulsory. No experience required. af.title: OHS: Inspekteur: Meganiese Ingenieurswese
af.summary: OHS-Inspekteur vir Meganiese Ingenieurswese by Stanger Labour Centre, verantwoordelik vir die uitvoer van nakomingsinspeksies ingevolge die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate plus 'n driejaar-erkende kwalifikasie op NQF 6/7 in die tersaaklike veld, d.w.s. Meganiese Ingenieurswese. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Registrasie by die tersaaklike, erkende professionele liggaam is 'n voordeel maar nie verpligtend nie. Geen ervaring vereis. Kennis: Departementele beleide en 21 prosedures, Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, soos gewysig, Regulasies (21), Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Standarde (Kodes) – geïnkorporeerde Kodes word regulasies, Wet op Vergoeding vir Beroepsbeserings en -siektes, Wet op Werkloosheidsversekering. Vaardighede: Beplanning en Organisering, Kommunikasievaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Fasiliteringsvaardighede, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Konflikhanteringsvaardighede, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Onderhoudvoeringsvaardighede, Voorleggingsvaardighede, Innoveringsvaardighede, Analitiese vaardighede, Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Om inspeksies te beplan en onafhanklik uit te voer met die doel om nakoming van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, Wet 85 van 1993, Regulasies en geïnkorporeerde Standarde te verseker. Om registrasie ingevolge die Wet op Werkloosheidsversekering en die Wet op Vergoeding vir Beroepsbeserings en -siekte te bevestig. Beplan, ondersoek en finaliseer onafhanklik voorvalle en klagtes wat aangemeld is met betrekking tot die OHS-Wet en die tersaaklike regulasies en dwing af soos wanneer nodig, verskyn in die hof as 'n staatsgetuie, beplan en voer toegewysde proaktiewe inspeksies volgens skedule uit om nakoming van die tersaaklike arbeidswetgewing te monitor, insluitend die opstel en konsolideer van verslae wat uit sulke inspeksies voortspruit. Beplan en voer onafhanklik voorligtingsveldtogte oor alle arbeidswetgewing uit, analiseer die impak daarvan, konsolideer en stel verslag op. Dra by op 'n hoër vlak tot beplanning, opstel en instandhouding van streekinspeksieplanne en -verslae, insluitend die uitvoering van analise en die opstel van gekonsolideerde statistiese verslae oor streek- en toegewysde sake.

xh.summary: Isiphenduli se-OHS seNqubo yeMashini eStanger Labour Centre, echaphazelekayo ekwenzeni iinpshonxo zokuqhathanisa ngaphansi koMthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act.
xh.requirements: Senior Certificate kunye nenyani eliqinisekisiweyo lonyaka womthathu kwi-NQF 6/7 kwicala elihambelanayo, oko kukuthi i-Mechanical Engineering. Ilayisensi yokuqeshisa elisebenzayo. Ukubhalisa kumzimba ogunyaziweyo wabangenzi ngochwepheshe lulutyalo oluhle kodwa alinyanzelisi. Akukho nolunye uluhlu lwaphezulu lwamava. Ulwazi: Iimpolisa ze-isebe kwaye i-21 iindlela zokuqhuba, uMthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety, njengoko ulungisiwe, Iimigaqo (21), i-South African National Standards (Iikhowudi) – iikhowudi ezifakiweyo ziba yimigaqo, uMthetho we-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases, uMthetho we-Unemployment Insurance. Amakhono: Ukucwangcisa nokuLungelelanisa, Amakhono eNtetho, Ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha, Amakhono okuQonda, Amakhono oBudlelwane bomntu nomntu, Amakhono oKuphathiswa ngamaxhalaba, Amakhono okuXhumana, Amakhono oKusombulula iingxaki, Amakhono oBuzo, Amakhono oBungeniso, Amakhono oKungenisa izimvo, Amakhono oKuhlola, Amakhono eNtetho eshenxelayo nangokubhaliweyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba icebo kwaye uzodwa ukuqhuba iinpshonxo ngenjongo yoqinisekiso ukuthobela uMthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety, uMthetho 85 ka-1993, Iimigaqo neziMilinganiselo ezifakiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhalisa ngaphansi koMthetho we-Unemployment Insurance noMthetho we-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases. Icebo, iphondo aze afedele uzodwa iinkathazo neengxaki ezibikwe ngokuthinta uMthetho we-OHS namanye amagunya, aze aphinde alawule njengoko kudingeka, avelise enkundleni njengesiguli-mangaliso, aze aqambe aqhube iinpshonxo ezibaluleweyo ngokoqhagamshelwano ngokwemizuzu yokugqitha ukulawula ukuthobela imithetho yabasebenzi ehambelanayo kuquka nokubhala nokuqokelela iingxelo ezisuka kule ntpshonxo. Ukucwangcisa aze aqhube amagatyana okuvakalisa ngemithetho yonke yabasebenzi uzodwa, ahlolisise imiphumela yayo, aze aqokelele abhale ingxelo. Ukuba negalelo kwinqanaba eliphezulu ekucwangciseni, ekubhaleni nasekugcinweni kweeplani zeengingqi nontshukumo yokuqamba nokuqokelelwa kweenani ezimbalwa ngamagatyana ezengingqi.

'n Geldige bestuurslisensie vir 'n motorvoertuig. Unyaka omubili (2) wokuhlangabezana ngokusebenza kule Inspection and Enforcement Services. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela inethimba. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango, Skills Development Act, Labour Relation Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Levies Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, COIDA, NMWA, SABS Codes, Unemployment Insurance Act, UI Contribution Act, Employment Equity Act, Immigration Act. Amakhono: Amakhono okukhuthaza, ukucubungula nokuhlela, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuphatha impixano, amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okubuzisa, amakhono okwethula, ukuba nomqondo oqhamuka kuleyonkathi, ukuhlola ngokulandula kanye nokusebenzisana ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe.
zu.duties: Hlela ngokuzimele futhi wenze ukulolonga okuyisisekelo ngenjongo yokugqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwe yonke imithetho yabasebenzi, okuyilena, Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA), Labour Relations Act (LRA), Employment Equity Act (EEA), Unemployment Insurance Act (UIA), Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA), Occupational Health and Safety (OHS), kanye ne-UI Contribution Act (UCA). Ilayisenisi esebenzayo yokushayela imoto. Ulwazi: Iindlela nezinqubo zesebe, uMthetho woPhuhliso lweakhono, uMthetho weMbano yoMsebenzi, uMthetho weMigaqo eSisiseko yoMsebenzi, uMthetho weeNketho zoPhuhliso lweAkhono, uMthetho woKhuseleko loMsebenzi ngeMpilo, iCOIDA, iNMWA, amakhodi eSABS, uMthetho woMshwalense weNgqalasela loMsebenzi, uMthetho woNgeniso lwaMaveri, uMthetho woLingano kuMsebenzi, uMthetho woNgeno lwamakhaya. Aakhoni: Aakhoni okukhokela, uCwangciso nokuLungiselela, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, aakhoni zokusebenzisana nabantu, aakhoni zokulawula ingxabano, aakhoni zokuxoxisana, aakhoni zokuSombulula iingxaki, aakhoni zokuphendula imibuzo, aakhoni zokubonisa, ukuba nobuchule obutsha, ukwahlulaahlula, aakhoni zokuThetha nokuBhala.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa ukuze wenze ngokuzimela ukhangelo olubanzi ngenjongo yokunyanisekisa ukuthobela yonke imithethonqubo yomsebenzi, ngokwezo, uMthetho weMigaqo eSisiseko yoMsebenzi (BCEA), uMthetho weMbano yoMsebenzi (LRA), uMthetho woLingano kuMsebenzi (EEA), uMthetho woMshwalense weNgqalasela loMsebenzi (UIA), uMthetho woMcelo ngoNaZizonda ekuMsebenzini nasekuGuleni (COIDA), uKhuseleko loMsebenzi ngeMpilo (OHS), noMthetho woNgeniso lwaMaveri (UCA). Cwangcisa ukuze uzibekele iindwendwe ezixelwe ngazimela malunga nokuqhawula imithethonqubo yomsebenzi ukuze uyiphe nkqo xa kufuneka, kuquka ukulungiselela nokubonakaliswa enkundla njengomfaki buknini oburholiwe. Cwangcisa ukuze wenze ukhangelo okungeniswe ngaphambili (iBlitz) njalo ukuze ulawule ukuthobela imithethonqubo yomsebenzi, kuquka ukuqamba nokuqokelela iingxelo ezivela kakhangelo kanjalo. Cwangcisa ukuze wenze ngokuzimela amajelo okukhuthaza ngayo yonke imithethonqubo yomsebenzi, ukuhlaluthe impembelelo yawo, ukuze uqokelele ukuze uqambe ingxelo. Lawula iifayile zokuqediswa kweendwendwe ezifunyenweyo, nangemibuzo eyenzwa ngabalawuli bagangele. Ndla ekucwangcisweni kwaphakathi, ekubhaleni nasekugxileni iindlela zokuqamba ezikwielinye.

jobs.salary_text: Member will be remunerated in accordance with the applicable statutory rates and guidelines as prescribed by the National Treasury.
jobs.summary: Chair the Risk Management Committee for the Department of Employment and Labour, providing oversight on governance, risk, internal controls, compliance and audit across Head Office and provincial offices.
jobs.requirements: A post graduate qualification in Accounting / Risk Management or Auditing such as CRMA/ CIA /CA (SA) or a relevant three- year tertiary or equivalent qualification in Accounting, Risk Management and Auditing. A professional qualification and affiliation to a professional recognised body for appointment as a Chairperson of the Risk Management Committee of the Department of Employment and Labour: Head Office. Applicants should have executive management experience in Governance, Risk Management and Internal Controls environment for more than ten years with exposure in serving in the oversight Committees. A person who has Government interest in delivering a better service to its citizens. Knowledge: Applicants must have exposure in labour, insurance, legal, auditing, finance and extensive experience in Risk Management, Governance, Internal and External Auditing, Applicants should be independent and knowledgeable on the status of their position as Chairperson of the Risk Management Committee, A knowledgeable person who keeps abreast with the developments of Risk Management, Internal and External Audit profession and developmental aspects, Departments Values, Technical Knowledge, DPSA guidelines on National Departments. Skills: Analytical thinking ability and good communication, Courage to challenge answers and ask relevant questions, willing to dedicate time and energy to serve the interest of the public, encourage openness and transparency, healthy scepticism and professional approach, High level of integrity, inquisitiveness and independent judgement, knowledge of the public sector fund’s risk and control, Ability to offer new perspective.
jobs.duties: Fulfil oversight responsibilities with regard to Governance, risk management, internal control, legal and regulatory compliance, external and internal audit, fraud and irregularities. Assist the Accounting Officer/Authority in the effective execution of his/her responsibilities. Help build trust and confidence in how the Department is managed. Regulate and discharge all the responsibilities as contained in the Risk Management Committee Charter.

af.title: Voorsitter van die Risikobestuurskomitee
af.summary: Beklee die posisie as voorsitter van die Risikobestuurskomitee vir die Department of Employment and Labour, en verskaf toesig oor bestuursregering, risiko, interne kontroles, nakoming en oudits oor die hoofkantoor en provinsiale kantore.
af.requirements: Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Rekeningkunde / Risikobestuur of Ouditering soos CRMA/ CIA /CA (SA) of 'n relevante driejaar-tertiêre of ekwivalente kwalifikasie in Rekeningkunde, Risikobestuur en Ouditering. 'n Professionele kwalifikasie en affiliasie met 'n professionele erkende liggaam vir aanstelling as voorsitter van die Risikobestuurskomitee van die Department of Employment and Labour: Hoofkantoor. Aansoekers moet uitvoerende bestuurservaring in 'n omgewing van bestuursregering, Risikobestuur en Interne Kontroles van meer as tien jaar hê met blootstelling in die diens van toesigkomitees. 'n Persoon wat 'n staatsbelang het om 'n beter diens aan burgers te lewer. Kennis: Aansoekers moet blootstelling hê in arbeid, versekering, regte, ouditering, finansies en uitgebreide ervaring in Risikobestuur, bestuursregering, Interne en Eksterne Ouditering; Aansoekers moet onafhanklik wees en kundig oor die status van hul posisie as voorsitter van die Risikobestuurskomitee; 'n Kundige persoon wat op hoogte bly van die ontwikkelings in die Risikobestuur, Interne en Eksterne Ouditeerprofessie en ontwikkelingsaspekte, Departementele Waardes, Tegniese Kennis, DPSA-riglyne oor Nasionale Departemente. Vaardighede: Analitiese denkvermoë en goeie kommunikasie, Moed om antwoorde uit te daag en toepaslike vrae te stel, gewillig om tyd en energie te wy om die belang van die publiek te dien, openheid en deursigtigheid aanmoedig, gesonde skeptisisme en professionele benadering, Hoë vlak van integriteit, nuuskierigheid en onafhanklike oordeel, kennis van die openbare sektor se fondsrisiko en -beheer, Vermoë om 'n nuwe perspektief te bied.
af.duties: Voldoen aan toesigverantwoordelikhede met betrekking tot bestuursregering, risikobestuur, interne beheer, regs- en regulasienakoming, eksterne en interne oudit, bedrog en ongeregtighede. Ondersteun die Rekeningebeampte/Authority in die doeltreffende uitvoering van sy/haar verantwoordelikhede. Help om vertroue en selfvertroue te bou in hoe die departement bestuur word. Reguleer en voer alle verantwoordelikhede soos uiteengesit in die Handves van die Risikobestuurskomitee uit.

zu.title: Isihlalo weKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi
zu.summary: ukuba yisihlalo weKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi kuMnyango weZempilo, unikeza olunye ukuqapha ngokuphathwa, kwezingozi, kolawulo langaphakathi, kokuziphatha kanye nokuhlola kuyo yonke iNdikulu yeNhlangano namaphoyinti amaphovinsi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingaphezulu kwesidiploma ekuBhalweni / ekuphathweni kwezingozi noma ekuHlolweni njengoba CRMA/ CIA /CA (SA) noma isifundo seminyaka emithathu esikhungweni samabanga aphezulu noma esilinganayo ekuBhalweni, ekuphathweni kwezingozi nasekuHlolweni. Isifundo semfundo kanye nokuhlanganiswa nomzimba ongaziwa ngemfundo yokuqashwa njengesihlalo seKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi koMnyango weZempilo: iNdikulu yeNhlangano. Abafaka izicelo kufanele baneNqubo yokuphatha ezenzakalelayo ekuqondweni nasekuhlelweni, ekuphathweni kwezingozi nasekuHlolweni okwangaphakathi isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka eyishumi nokuqashwa kumakomidi okuqapha. Umuntu onentshisekelo ekurhalweni kwabaholi ukunika abantu abangakwazi abantu. Ukwazi: Abafaka izicelo kumele bazuze okokuqapha kumabango, isiqiniseko, umthetho, ukuhlola kwezimali kanye nokuhlolwa okunzulu ekuphathweni kwezingozi, ekuqondweni nasekuHlolweni, Abafaka izicelo kumele babe ezimele bazi kahle isimo sabelo sabo njengesihlalo seKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi, Umuntu oziyo okulandela izinto ezintsha ekuphathweni kwezingozi, ekuhlolweni okungaphakathi nakungaphandle kweNqubo kanye nezinto ezingashintsha, Amagugu eMnyango, Ulwazi lolwazi oluzimele, iziqondiso ze-DPSA kumanyango abantu. Amakhono: ukucabanga ngokuhlukanisa kanye nokukhuluma kahle, isibindi sokuphikisa izimpendulo nekubuze imibuzo ebalulekile, ukuzimisela ukunikela isikhathi namandla ukukhonza okuwumfutho wabantu, ukukhuthaza ukuvuleka nokuthi bungakhali, ukungabaza ngokuphila kanye nokuhamba, ukuphila okuphezulu, ukubuza kanye nesibawo esizimele, ukwazi ngaphezulu kwezimali zomphakathi nolawulo, amandla okunika umbono omusha.
zu.duties: Fezela izibopho zokuqapha ngokuphathwa, ekuqondeni nasekuhlelweni, ekuphathweni kwezingozi, ekulawuleni okungaphakathi, ekuhambeni ngemithetho kanye nokuthobela imithetho, ekufakweni kwangaphandle nangaphakathi nasekuHlolweni. Siza onke amaphoyinti obhalo/sombhalo ekwenzeni izibopho zakhe. Siza ukwakha ukuthembeka nokuzethemba kwindlela elawulwa ngayo iMnyango. Lawula wenze yonke imisebenzi njengoba kushiwo kuHlelo lweKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi.

xh.title: USihlalo weKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko
xh.summary: UKumanela iKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko kwiSebe loMsebenzi nokuSebenza, kunikeza ulawulo kubulungisa, umngcipheko, ulawulo langaphakathi, ukuzithoba kumthetho nokuvakwa ngaphakathi kweNkundla eNkulu kunye neeofisi zamaphondo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo sesiqu sangaphezulu kwi-Akhawuntingi / uLawulo loMngcipheko okanye ukuVakwa njengoko yi-CRMA/ CIA /CA (SA) okanye isifundo esifanayo seminyaka emithathu esikolweni samabanga aphezulu okanye esalinganayo kwi-Akhawuntingi, uLawulo loMngcipheko nokuVakwa. Isifundo sabongcali kwaye ukubhalisa kwisikhululo sabongcali esaziwayo sokuba nguSihlalo weKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko kwiSebe loMsebenzi nokuSebenza: iNkundla eNkulu. Abafakeli kufuneka babe namava obhalo ebukhulu kuBulungisa, uLawulo loMngcipheko nakwindawo yoLawulo Langaphakathi ngaphezu kweminyaka elishumi nokubanzi bokuba namava ekukhonzeni kwiKomiti zoLawulo. Umntu onomdla kaRhulumente eku Nikezeni inkonzo engcono kubemi bakhe. ulwazi: Abafakeli kufuneka babe namava kumsebenzi, inshorensi, ezomthetho, ukuvakwa, izimali kunye namaba amaninzi kuLawulo loMngcipheko, uBulungisa, ukuVakwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle, Abafakeli kufuneka babe zincamathe kwaye bazi isimo sabo njengoSihlalo weKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko, Umntu olwaziyo ogcina elungelelaniswe nokuphuhliswa koLawulo loMngcipheko, ukuVakwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwemisebenzi yabongcali nakwinkalo yophuhliso, ixabiso leeSebe, ulwazi lobuchule, izikhokelo ze-DPSA kumasebe aKawonke. Amandla: Ikhono lokucinga ngokuhlalutyo kunye nokuzethula okuhle, Ikradhu yokuqabela iimpendulo kunye nokubuza imibuzo ehambelana nayo, kulungele ukunikeza ixesha namandla ukukhonza umdla womntu wonke, khuthaza ukuvuleka nokubonwa kwayo konke, ukungalanga ngokwezempilo ekugqibeleni nendlela yobungcali, inqanaba eliphezulu lobuyiqqa, ukubuzela ukubuza umntu nokuzimisela ukwahlulela, ulwazi lomngcipheko wolawulo lwemali yoluntu, Ikhono lokunika umbono omtsha.
xh.duties: Zalisa iimfuno zolawulo ngokuba kuBulungisa, ulawulo lomngcipheko, ulawulo langaphakathi, ukuzithoba ngokomthetho nakomthetho wembuso, ukuvakwa ngaphandle nangaphakathi, ukurhweba ngokungalunganga nokungalunga. Siza noMsebenzisi wee-Akhawunti/uGunya ekuphumezeni ngokusebenza okufanelekileyo iimfuno zakhe. Nceda yakha ithemba nethemba indlela eLawulwa ngayo iSebe. Lawula kwaye uphumeze yonke iimfuno njengoko kucatshulwa kwiQhalo leKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko.

jobs.title: Director: Sector Performance Monitoring and Reporting
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Director needed to lead sector performance monitoring and reporting, managing strategic planning and environmental priority development for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF7) in Business Management / Public Management or relevant qualification within the related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a middle or senior managerial level in the related field. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) must be submitted prior to appointment. Extensive knowledge of strategic management. Good understanding of monitoring and evaluation process. Project and financial management (PFMA and Treasury regulations). Ability to develop and apply policies. Knowledge of government planning process. Strategic capability and leadership. People management and empowerment. Ability to gather and analyse information. Knowledge of administrative and human resource procedures. Good coordination, organisational and planning. Excellent communication (verbal and written), report writing and presentation skills. Sense of responsibility and loyalty. Ability to work long hours.
jobs.duties: Manage and provide strategic planning support on environment sector priorities. Manage the development of environmental priorities. Manage the development and review of the 5-year and annual environment sector plans and Medium-Term Development Plan priorities. Provide leadership on planning support to intergovernmental working groups and sector partners. Monitor and report on the implementation of sector priorities. Manage the development of the 5-year, bi-annual, annual and quarterly performance reports on the implementation of environment sector priorities. Conduct quality review of performance reports. Lead and manage the portfolio of evidence. Conduct assessment/evaluation of environment sector performance. Manage and provide oversight support for provincial planning and reporting. Manage the development and review of the Provincial Uniform Budget Structure on standardised performance measures. Manage the development and review of standardised indicators. Manage the assessment of provincial Annual Performance Plans. Manage the analysis and verification of provincial quarterly performance reports. Manage the assessment/evaluation of the implementation of the Provincial Uniform Budget Structure. Manage the development and implementation of the Environmental Sector Transformation Programme. Manage the development of the Environment Sector Transformation Strategy and annual implementation plan. Manage the development of performance reports on the implementation of Environment Sector Transformation Strategy and annual implementation plan. Manage the coordination of the Gender Forum meetings. Lead and support events to support the Environment Sector Transformation Programmme. Manage the assessment/evaluation of the Environment Sector Transformation Strategy. Manage the coordination of Working Group 3. Manage secretarial function for Working Group 3 meetings. Manage the development of annual Working Group 3 Workplan. Manage the compilation of Working Group 3 performance reports. Conduct quality review of performance reports. Manage the database of Working Group 3 members. Manage the development of monitoring and evaluation systems. Manage the development and implementation of the Environment Sector Standard Operating Procedures. Manage the development and maintenance of reporting systems.

af.title: Direkteur: Sektorprestasie-monitering en verslagdoening
af.summary: Direkteur benodig om sektorprestasie-monitering en verslagdoening te lei, strategiese beplanning en die ontwikkeling van omgewingsprioriteite vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF7) in Besigheidsbestuur / Openbare Bestuur of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of seniorbestuursvlak in die verwante veld. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Senior Management Pre-entry Programme soos deur die National School of Government (NSG) goedgekeur, moet voor aanstelling ingedien word. Uitgebreide kennis van strategiese bestuur. Goeie begrip van die moniterings- en evalueringsproses. Projeks- en finansiële bestuur (PFMA en Treasury-regulasies). Vermoë om belede te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Kennis van die regeringsbeplanningsproses. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Vermoë om inligting te versamel en te ontleed. Kennis van administratiewe en menslike hulpbronprosedures. Goeie koördinering, organisasie en beplanning. Uitstekende kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), verslagskrywing en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit. Vermoë om lang ure te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf strategiese beplanningssteun oor omgewingssektorprioriteite. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van omgewingsprioriteite. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en hersiening van die 5-jaar en jaarlikse omgewingssektorplanne en Medium-Term Development Plan prioriteite. Verskaf leierskap oor beplanningssteun aan interregeringswerkgroepe en sektorvennote. Monitor en rapporteer oor die implementering van sektorprioriteite. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van die 5-jaar, tweemaandelikse, jaarlikse en kwartaalprestasieverslae oor die implementering van omgewingssektorprioriteite. Voer gehaltekontrole van prestasieverslae uit. Lei en bestuur die portefeulje van bewyse. Voer assessering/evaluering van omgewingssektorprestasie uit. Bestuur en verskaf toesigsteun vir provinsiale beplanning en verslagdoening. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en hersiening van die Provincial Uniform Budget Structure oor gestandaardiseerde prestasiemaatstawwe. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en hersiening van gestandaardiseerde aanwysers. Bestuur die assessering van provinsiale Annual Performance Plans. Bestuur die analise en verifikasie van provinsiale kwartaalprestasieverslae. Bestuur die assessering/evaluering van die implementering van die Provincial Uniform Budget Structure. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Environmental Sector Transformation Programme. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van die Environment Sector Transformation Strategy en jaarlikse implementeringsplan. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van prestasieverslae oor die implementering van die Environment Sector Transformation Strategy en jaarlikse implementeringsplan. Bestuur die koördinering van die Gender Forum vergaderings. Lei en ondersteun geleenthede ter ondersteuning van die Environment Sector Transformation Programme. Bestuur die assessering/evaluering van die Environment Sector Transformation Strategy. Bestuur die koördinering van Working Group 3. Bestuur die sekretariaatfunksie vir Working Group 3 vergaderings. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van die jaarlikse Working Group 3 Workplan. Bestuur die opstel van Working Group 3 prestasieverslae. Voer gehaltekontrole van prestasieverslae uit. Bestuur die databasis van Working Group 3 lede. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van moniterings- en evalueringsisteme. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Environment Sector Standard Operating Procedures. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van verslagdoeningstelsels.

zu.title: Umholi: Ukubheka Isimo Sokuqhuba Komkhakha Nokubika
zu.summary: Kudingeka umholi ohozule ukubheka isimo sokuqhuba komkhakha nokubika, ophatha ukuhlelwa okuyisinqumo nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhloso ezithintwe imvelo kuMnyango Wezihlahla, Izinhlanzi Nendalo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikolo esiphakeme (NQF7) ekuPhathweni Kwezabhizinisi / ekuPhathweni Kabezomphakathi noma iziqu ezihambisana nendawo ehlobene njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Uzuvo oluncane lweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi noma ophakeme endaweni ehlobene. Ukuphela ngemfundo ye-Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengoba kunconywa i-National School of Government (NSG) kufanele kunikelwe ngaphambi kokuqashwa. Ulwazi olubanzi ngokuqonda okuyisinqumo. Ukuqonda okuhle kwenqubo yokubheka nokuhlolwa. Ukuphatha imiklamo nezimali (PFMA nemithetho ye-Treasury). Ikono lokuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokuqasha kahulumeni. Ikono lokuhola nokuqonda okuyisinqumo. Ukuphatha abantu nokuqinisa amandla abo. Ikono lokuqoqa nokuhlaziya ulwazi. Ulwazi lwenqubo zokuphatha nokuphatha abantu basebenza. Ukuhlelwa, ukuhlela kabuhle nokuqasha okuhle. Ukuxhumana okuhle (kokukhulunywa nokubhalwayo), ukubhala umbiko namakhono okwethula. Inzwano nomzimba wenu. Ikono lokusebenza ihora elide.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi unikeze ukwesekwa kokuqasha okuyisinqumo ngohlelo lwezinhloso zomkhakha wendalo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhloso zendalo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekeza amaphulani ahleliwe eminyakeni eyi-5 ngayonyaka omkhakha wendalo nezinhloso ze-Medium-Term Development Plan. Nikeza ubuholi ekusekeleni ukuhlelwa kumagumbi omsebenzi ahlangene kahulumeni nabalingani bomkhakha. Bheka futhi ubeke ngomkhakha wokusetshenziswa kwezinhloso zomkhakha. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwemibiko yokusebenza eminyakeni eyi-5, kabangonyaka, kayonyaka neNyanga eyi-3 ngokwenzakala kwezinhloso zomkhakha wendalo. Yenza ukubuyekeza umthamo yemibiko yokusebenza. Hola futhi uphathe iqembu lebuciko. Yenza isilinganiso/isibhejo sokuqhuba komkhakha wendalo. Phatha futhi unikeze ukusekela ukubuka ukuphathwa kwezifundazwe nokubika. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekeza isakhiwo esijwayelekile sezimali zesifundazwe ngokulinganisa ukusebenza okulinganisiwe. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekeza izinkomba ezilinganisiwe. jobs.title: Deputy Director: Monitoring & Surveillance
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director managing compliance and enforcement operations including land, sea and air inspections across key fisheries sectors in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Natural Science, Law Enforcement or relevant qualification within the related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Law Enforcement, administration and management or relevant field of which three (3) years should be at an entry/junior managerial level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). Knowledge of the National Constitution, MLRA and Regulations (Act 18/98), South African Maritime Safety Authority Act: Act 5 of 1998, Environmental Management Act. Knowledge of International Agreements and Conventions UNCLOS, SADC and Regional Fisheries Management Organisations CCAMLR, IOTC, ICCAT, CCSBT. Skills: Project Management, Conflict resolution and Communication skills (written and verbal). Leadership skills (visionary/ operational), Planning and Execution skills and Delegations and empowerment. Ability to work long hours voluntarily. Be able to gather and analyse information, Ability to develop and apply policies. Ability to work under extreme pressure. Ability to work with difficult persons and resolve conflict. Ability to work independently and in a team. Supervisory experience. Must have a valid driving license.
jobs.duties: Manage, plan, coordinate and execute compliance and enforcement measures. Ensure the selection of targeted right holders to be investigated in the 6 key fisheries sectors. Ensure proper reporting on complete investigations to the Chief Directorate. Manage land, sea and air boarder inspections to promote awareness and compliance with the Marine Living Resources Act (MLRA). Identify priority sea, land and ports of entry and exits. Create awareness and sensitize stakeholders and role-players toward the protection and sustainable use of marine living resources. Manage, plan, coordinate and execute compliance and enforcement measures through the execution of anti- poaching operations. Also consult with relevant role-players and stakeholders to facilitate proper planning of operations. Ensure and facilitate logistical arrangements, submissions and approvals. Ensure proper reporting. Manage enforcement efforts and reporting. Ensure that cases and J534 fines in terms of infringements of the Marine Living Resources Act (MLRA) and other relevant marine related legislations are documented correctly. Intervene in matters/ cases of National and International importance by providing enforcement expertise and support.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Monitering en Toesig
af.summary: Onderdirekteur wat nakomings- en handhawingsoperasies bestuur, insluitend land-, see- en luginspeksies oor sleutel-visserie-sektore in Cape Town.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Natuurwetenskap, Regshandhawing of tersaaklike kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Regshandhawing, administrasie en bestuur of tersaaklike veld waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n toegangspoort/junior bestuursvlak (Assistent-direkteurvlak of gelykstaande) moet wees. Kennis van die Nasionale Grondwet, MLRA en Regulasies (Act 18/98), South African Maritime Safety Authority Act: Act 5 of 1998, Environmental Management Act. Kennis van Internasionale Ooreenkomste en Konvensies UNCLOS, SADC en Regional Fisheries Management Organisations CCAMLR, IOTC, ICCAT, CCSBT. Vaardighede: Projektebestuur, konflikoplossing en Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Leierskapsvaardighede (visionêr/operasioneel), Beplanning en Uitvoering vaardighede en Delegering en bemagtiging. Vermoë om lang ure vrywillig te werk. Wees in staat om inligting in te samel en te ontleed; Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Toesighoudende ervaring. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê.
af.duties: Bestuur, beplan, koördineer en voer nakomings- en handhawingsmaatreëls uit. Verseker die seleksie van geteikende regshebbendes wat ondersoek moet word in die 6 sleutel-visserie-sektore. Verseker behoorlike verslagdoening oor voltooide ondersoeke aan die Hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur land-, see- en luggrensinspeksies om bewustheid en nakoming van die Marine Living Resources Act (MLRA) te bevorder. Identifiseer prioriteit-see, -land en -hawens van toegang en uitgang. Skep bewustheid en sensibiliseer belanghebbendes en rolspelers rakende die beskerming en volhoubare gebruik van mariene lewensbronne. Bestuur, beplan, koördineer en voer nakomings- en handhawingsmaatreëls uit deur die uitvoering van anti-strooptogte. Raadpleeg ook tersaaklike rolspelers en belanghebbendes om behoorlike beplanning van operasies te fasiliteer. Verseker en fasiliteer logistiese reëlings, voorleggings en goedkeurings. Verseker behoorlike verslagdoening. Bestuur handhawingspogings en verslagdoening. Verseker dat sake en J534-boetes ter sake van oortredings van die Marine Living Resources Act (MLRA) en ander tersaaklike mariene verwante wetgewing korrek gedokumenteer word. Tree in in sake van nasionale en internasionale belang deur handhawingskundigheid en -ondersteuning te verskaf.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaNhloko ophethe: Ukugadangwa nokubhekwa kwezinto ezibhalwe ngaphansi komthetho
zu.summary: INhloko ophethe ophatha izimiso zokuzelelana nokwesekwa komthetho okuhlanganisa ukuhlola emhlabeni, olwandle nakulelizulu kuleyo minyakazo ebalulekile yokuloba eCape Town.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma leNational (NQF6) kwe-Natural Science, Law Enforcement noma izifundo ezihlobene naleyo ndawo njengoba zidumile ku-SAQA. Okungenani ihlelo leminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yokuhluza komthetho, okuphathwayo nezobuphathi noma endaweni efanayo, lapho kuleminyaka mitathu (3) okufanele kube kwesigaba samabamba/abagcini bensiza (isigaba sikaNkomfani ophethe noma okulingana naleso). Ukwazi umthethosiseko weNgameko, i-MLRA namashejulu walo (Act 18/98), i-South African Maritime Safety Authority Act: Act 5 of 1998, nomthetho we-Environmental Management Act. Ukwazi ngemigomo yomhlaba wonke njengoba kuleminyakazo ye-UNCLOS, i-SADC kanye nezinhlangano ezibheka iminyakazo yokuloba e-SADC, i-CCAMLR, IOTC, ICCAT, CCSBT. Amakhono okuqashwa: ukuphatha imiklamo, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Amakhono okuba ngumholi (okubukela phambili/okusebenzayo), ukwelula amasu nokubhalisa kwabanye kanye nokunika amandla. Ukukwazi ukusebenza isikhathi eside ngokuzithandela. Ukukwazi ukuphatha nokuhlaziya imininingwane, ukukwazi ukubumba nokugcina imigomo ngokuhambiswe nesimo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa umoya ovuthuzayo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kubantu abakhathazayo ukuxazulula izinkinga phakathi kwemva kwabo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza aze ahambiswe nabanye. Ukuhluza emsebenzini wokugadangwa. Kumele abe nelasheja evunyiwe yokushayela.
zu.duties: Ukuphathiswa, ukulungiselelwa, ukuhlanganiswa nokusebenzisa izimiso zokuzelelana nokwesekwa komthetho. Kuqinisekiswe ukuhanjiswa kolwelo kubanini amalungelo abekwe ogqwaneni balolwa ngaleminyakazo eyisithupha ephawulekile yokuloba. Kuqinisekiswe ukubika isiko nangqondo ngemiklamo eyiphelele eNkolweni eNkulu. Ukuphathiswa kokuhlola imithetho emhlabathini, olwandle nakulelizulu ukukhiqiza ukuqonda nokuhlonza ukuthi kuhamba ngokomthetho omusha wamafutha amakhulu nokuxhaswa kolwandle (MLRA). Ukuzimuka kulezindawo eziphambili zolwandle, emhlabeni namagabha lapho kungena khona futhi kuphuma khona. Ukukhiqiza ukuthuthukiswa kokuzwa nokuxhumana kwabasebenzeli ngokubaluleka kokuvikelwa nokusetshenziswa okungapheli kwemithombo yasogwini. Ukuphathiswa, ukulethwa, ukuhlelwa nokusetshenziswa kwezinyanya zokuqinisekisa nokwesekwa umthetho ngokuhambiswe nokuthintwa kokweba emkhosini. Nokwesekwa nokuxoxiswana namalunga abasemkhosini abakhona emsebenzini ukuze kulethwe ukugqama ngokuphumeleliswa kwemikhosi. Kuqinisekiswe futhi kuhlelwe izinto eziyingqayizivele, okuhambiswayo nokuyesabiwe. Kuqinisekiswe ukubika kulo lonke iphepha. Ukuphathiswa amakhono okusekwa umthetho nokubika. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amacala namajwayintu eJ534 mayelana nasemikhawulweni yomthetho wokuphila kolwandle (MLRA) namanye amathambo amahle kwezolwandle ahlelwagqelwe aqinisekisiwe ngokuvuthuzayo. Kungene ngokuqinisekisa amacala abalulekile kwezwe nasemhlabeni onke ngokuqinisekisa ngedlela le-Nhloko ophethe ngokubaluleka kokwesekwa nomxhasi.

xh.title: Mnini-mcabango ongemnye: Ukugcina iliso Nokholisa
xh.summary: Mnini-mcabango ongemnye ophatha izicatshulwa zokwanela umthetho nokuphunyezwa kwawo, kuquka ukuphonononga kwemihlaba, lolwandle nolwezulu kumacandelo abalulekile eentlanzi eCape Town.
xh.requirements: iNational Diploma (NQF6) kwiNatural Science, iLaw Enforcement okanye nesifundo esihambelana nalo kwelina elithintekileyo njengoko kusetyenziswa yiSAQA. Iminyaka yamava engaphezulu kwehlanu (5) kwiLaw Enforcement, ullambo lolawulo nolulawulo okanye elina elihambelana nalo, apho iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba labaphathi abangena/bancinci (inqanaba lomncedisi womsunguli okanye elilingana nalo). Ulwazi ngokuMgaqo-siseko weQonga, iMLRA nakuMiso omthetho (Act 18/98), uMthetho woManyano woKhuseleko loLwandle waseNingizimu Afrika: uMthetho wona ngu-5 ka-1998, uMthetho woLawulo loNdalo. Ulwazi ngeMvumelwano namasiko amazwe ngamazwe iUNCLOS, iSADC nokuBumbi nkqo ngokuLawulo zoLwandle kumacandelo awo onke iCCAMLR, iIOTC, iICCAT, iCCSBT. Amakhono: ukuLawulwa kweProjekthi, ukuxazulula iingxabano namakhono eNkxaso-mali (okubhaliweyo nokuTHethwa). Amakhono okuQuquzelela (umbono/okusebenzayo), ukuCwangcisa nokwenza namagunya azisa namandla okuzimisela. Ikakhulu ukusebenza iiyure ezinde ngokuzithandela. Makakwazi ukuqokelela nokuhlalutya inkcazelo, makakwazi ukuphuhliswa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo. Ukusebenza phantsi komcima onzima ungathwala. Ukusebenza nabantu abanzima nokusombulula iingxabano. Ukusebenza ngokwakhe naphakathi kwethimba. Ulva lokuqhuba abanye. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Lawula, cwangcisa, ungene ngqondweni uze uphunyze izithintelo zokwanela umthetho nokuphunyezwa. Qinisekisa ukukhethwa kwabanikazi abajoliswe konyango lwabo kumacandelo amathandathu (6) abalulekileyo eentlanzi. Qinisekisa ingxelo esemthethweni kumagqabantshintshi apheleleyo kwiChief Directorate. Lawula ukuphonononga kwemida yomhlaba, lolwandle nolwezulu ukukhuthaza ulwazi nokuwanela umthetho woNyamalaza oluselunwandle (MLRA). Chonga izithuba eziphambili zolwandle, komhlaba nakuwo onke amaza ukungena nokuqhwesha. Yila ulwazi nokusenzisela izimvoziimedari abathathi nxaxheba kunye nolawuliweyo olujonge ikhuselo nokusetyenziswa ngokomelela kwezinto eziphila ezisendle. Lawula, cwangcisa, ungene ngqondweni uze uphunyze izithintelo zokwanela umthetho nokuphunyezwa ngokwenza ukusingatha izicatshulwa zokuchasa ukutsalwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni. Kananjalo kwerhele nezimvoziimedari abathathi nxaxheba kunye nolawuliweyo ukuze kwakhiwe ugcino olulungileyo lweplani ezicatshulweni. Qinisekisa kwaye ulungelelanise izicwangciso ezizotyitywa ngakumbi, ezingeniswa nezigunyaziswa. Qinisekisa ingxelo ezilungileyo. Lawula amandla okwanela umthetho neengxelo. Qinisekisa ukuba izigqibo namatyala eJ534 ngokwentsebenzo yezono ngakumbi kumthetho wezinto eziphila eziselunwandle (MLRA) nakuwo onke amanye amathetho ahambelana nolwandle abhalwe ngokuchanekileyo. Ungene ngqondweni kumacala obaluleke okuqondene nezizwe nokwazlwana ngokubonelela ulwazi ngenkxaso-mali yokuwanela umthetho.

jobs.title: Environmental Officer Specialised Production Land-based
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Environmental Officer to regulate effluent discharge into estuaries and coastal waters, supporting coastal pollution initiatives and EIA processes.
jobs.requirements: Honours Degree (NQF Level 8) in Natural or Environmental Management/Sciences or relevant qualification within the related as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a related field. Extensive knowledge of the South African coast, marine and coastal pollution management, integrated coastal management, coastal processes, coastal management principles and national and international coastal policies and legislation. Knowledge of marine water quality and environmental monitoring techniques and management. Knowledge and understanding of data and information management. The ability to interpret and apply coastal and related legislation and policies, including the NEM: ICMA, NEMA, NEM: WA and NEM: BA Regulations, National Water Act, Minerals Act, international treaties and conventions, national and provincial laws, and departmental protocols. Functioning of coastal ecosystems and the impacts of human activity on those systems. Integrated Environmental Management and Environmental Impact Assessment. UNEP commitments, GPA programme, Regional Seas Conventions and related projects. Government administration and financial procedures. Project management. Public Service Regulation and Departmental procedures and prescripts. Background in Physical Sciences, Natural Sciences or Environmental Sciences. Sound organising and planning skills. Project management. Effective communicator. Analytical thinking. Scientific writing & reporting. Computer literacy. Multitasking. Networking and stakeholder engagement. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to meet tight deadlines, while maintaining good work quality. Good communication skills (written, oral and graphic).). Ability to draft, interpret and apply policy and legislation. Ability to formulate solutions through analytical and innovative thinking. Ability to deal tactfully and efficiently with telephonic enquiries from members of the public. Ability to work within a team and individually. Ability to collect and analyse data and information. Good interpersonal skills. Proactive & honest. Conflict resolution. A driving license. Willingness and ability to travel.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible to regulate the discharge of effluent into estuaries and coastal waters. Provide support to Departmental coastal pollution initiatives and other related projects. Represent the Directorate’s interests in EIA processes, relevant consultative forums, and other relevant structures to ensure good governance. Provide technical support to compliance and enforcement processes with specific focus on land-based sources of marine pollution.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Gespesialiseerde Produksie Landgebaseerd
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte om die lozing van uitvloei in getyriviere en kuswaters te reguleer, ter ondersteuning van kusbesoedelingsinisiatiewe en OIA-prosesse.
af.requirements: Honours-graad (NQF-vlak 8) in Natuur- of Omgewingsbestuur/Wetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in 'n verwante veld. Uitgebreide kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse kus, see- en kusbesoedelingsbestuur, geïntegreerde kusbestuur, kusprosesse, kusbestuursbeginsels en nasionale en internasionale kusbeleid en -wetgewing. Kennis van seewaterkwaliteit en omgewingsmoniteringstegnieke en -bestuur. Kennis en begrip van data- en inligtingsbestuur. Die vermoë om kus- en verwante wetgewing en beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas, insluitend die NEM: ICMA, NEMA, NEM: WA en NEM: BA Regulasies, National Water Act, Minerals Act, internasionale verdrae en konvensies, nasionale en provinsiale wette, en departementele protokolle. Werking van kusekosisteme en die impak van menslike aktiwiteit op dié stelsels. Geïntegreerde Omgewingsbestuur en Omgewingsimpak-assesserings. UNEP-verbindnisse, GPA-program, Regional Seas Conventions en verwante projekte. Regeringsadministrasie en finansiële prosedures. Projeksbestuur. Public Service Regulation en departementele prosedures en voorskifte. Agtergrond in Fisiese Wetenskappe, Natuurwetenskappe of Omgewingswetenskappe. Deeglike organiseer- en beplanningsvaardighede. Projeksbestuur. Effektiewe kommunikeerder. Analitiese denke. Wetenskaplike skryfwerk en verslagdoening. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Multitaakverrigting. Netwerking en belanghebbendes-betrokkenheid. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om stywe sperdatums te haal, terwyl goeie werkgehalte gehandhaaf word. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik, mondelings en grafies). Vermoë om beleid en wetgewing op te stel, te interpreteer en toe te pas. Vermoë om oplossings te formuleer deur analitiese en innoverende denke. Vermoë om beleef en doeltreffend met telefoonnavrae van lede van die publiek om te gaan. Vermoë om binne 'n span en individueel te werk. Vermoë om data en inligting te versamel en te ontleed. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Proaktief en eerlik. Konflikoplossing. 'n Bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid en vermoë om te reis.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees om die lozing van uitvloei in getyriviere en kuswaters te reguleer. Ondersteuning verleen aan departementele kusbesoedelingsinisiatiewe en ander verwante projekte. Die Direktoraat se belange in OIA-prosesse, relevante raadpleegingsforums en ander relevante strukture verteenwoordig om goeie bestuur te verseker. Tegniese ondersteuning aan nakomings- en handhawingsprosesse verleen met spesifieke fokus op landgebaseerde bronne van seebesoedeling.

zu.title: Isikhundla somphathi wezemvelo ohlotshaniswe nokukhiqizwa okusemazweni
zu.summary: Umphathi wezemvelo osolela ukukhishwa kwemithombo eyingozi emifuleni ethosa olwandle nasemanzini olwandle, osekela izinhlela zokugcotshwa kolwandle kanye nezinqubo ze-EIA.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Honours (NQF Level 8) kwi-Natural noma i-Environmental Management/Sciences noma izifundo ezihambisana nalezi ezibonakalwe yi-SAQA. Ukuhamba kwesikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) ngokuhlolwa kuleyo minyaka yamakhono. Ukuqonda okubanzi ngaselunyakeni lwaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuphathwa kokugcotshwa kolwandle naselunyakeni, ukuphathwa kolwandle okuhlanganisiwe, izinqobo zolwandle, imigomo yokuphathwa kolwandle kanye nemithetho nemigomo yaselunyakeni yezizwe nakwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi ngemigcothi yamanzi olwandle kanye nezindlela zokuqapha izimo zomzimba kanye nokuphathwa. Ulwazi nokukuqonda ukuphathwa kolwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwenani lemigwaqo. Isipho sokuhumusha nokusebenzisa imithetho nemigomo engahambisana nomumo wolwandle, okuhlanganisa i-NEM: ICMA, i-NEMA, i-NEM: WA kanye nemithetho ye-NEM: BA, i-National Water Act, i-Minerals Act, izivumelwano namasiko amazwe ngamazwe, imithetho yezwe nasemaphethelweni, kanye nemiyalelo yomnyango. Ukusebenza koshintsho olusaselunyakeni kanye nesiphithiphithi somuntu ngamunye kulezo zinhlelo. Ukuphathwa kwe-Integrated Environmental Management kanye ne-Environmental Impact Assessment. Iminikelo ye-UNEP, ihlelo le-GPA, i-Regional Seas Conventions kanye namaphrojekthi ahambisana nayo. Izindlela zokuphathwa kwezikaHulumeni kanye nezindlela zokuphathwa zemali. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Imithetho ye-Public Service Regulation kanye nezinqobo zomnyango kanye nemiyalo. Umlando we-Physical Sciences, i-Natural Sciences noma i-Environmental Sciences. Amakhono okuhlela futhi ucabange ngokusuka. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Ukuqonda ukubonisana kahle. Ukucabanga ngekhompyutha. Ukubhala nokuvela kwezesayensi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukwazi ukwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Uxhumano nokuqapha okuhle kubantu. Isipho sokusebenza ngaphansi kwesivinini. Isipho sokuphumelela emigqeni esiqinile, kuyilawulwe khona ikhwalithi yomsebenzi kahle. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okubhaliwe, okulalelwayo kanye nokubonakalayo).). Isipho sokuhlola, ukuxoxa nokusebenzisa imigomo nemithetho. Isipho sokuxazulula izinkinga ngokucabanga ngokuhlaziywa nokukhiqiza okusha. Isipho sokuphathwa ngobubele neziqu kwezinsiza zemibuzo yocingo evela kubantu bomphakathi. Isipho sokusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba nangabanye. Isipho sokuthola futhi uhlaziye imininingwane. Amakhono amahle wokuqhathaniswa kwabantu. Ukuba munye oqaphile kakhulu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Ukuzithoba kanye nesipho sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Lowo owayekhethiwe uzobe necwembe lokulawula ukukhishwa kokungcolile kumifula ethosa olwandle nasemanzini olwandle. Ukuhlinzeka ngokusekela izinhlela zomnyango zokugcotshwa kolwandle kanye namanye amaphrojekthi ahlobene noku. Umele ihlaya le-Directorate ezinqobweni ze-EIA, emabhodini entshisekelo, kanye nezinye izakhiwo ezihlobene ukuze kutholwe ukuphathwa okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka ngokusekelo ngamathalabulethi kwezinqubo zokuqapha nokuvumela ukusebenza ngokugqamile kokuqamba kokungcolile olwandle ezindaweni zomhlaba.

xh.title: IOfisa yendalo eKukhethwe kuyo iNkqubo yokukhiqiza eKumhlaba
xh.summary: IOfisa yendalo lokulawula ukukhutshwa kweekhemikhali ezithintelwe kumanzi aphakathi kwalwandle nakumanzi okunxweme, ngenkxaso kumashishini okugcina ukungcola kolwandle kunye neenkqubo ze-EIA.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zobuHloma (iNqanaba le-NQF 8) kwiZiNtlu eZidibeneyo okanye kuLawulo/iNzululwazi kwendalo okanye isifundo esihambelana noko njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Amava amabini angamashumi amathathu (3) eminyaka kwintsimu edibeneyo. Ulwazi olubanzi olunxulumene nonxweme lwaseMzantsi Afrika, ulawulo lokungcola kolwandle nakunxweme, ulawulo oludibeneyo lonxweme, iinkqubo zonxweme, iinkqubo zolawulo lonxweme kunye namacebo amazwe aphela kunye nomthetho wonxweme. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwebali lamanzi olwandle kunye neendlela zokuqaphela nokulawula imo yendalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula iinkcukacha nolwazi. Ikhono lokutolika nokusebenzisa umthetho namacebo anxulumene nonxweme, kuquka i-NEM: ICMA, i-NEMA, i-NEM: WA kunye namacebo e-NEM: BA, uMthetho wAmanzi weSizwe, uMthetho weeNcibi, amasivumelwano amazwe aphela namanye amagunya, amacebo namthetho wezwe nakwephondo, namacebo esebe. Ukusebenza kweenkqubo zendalo zolwandle nemithelela yemisebenzi yabantu kwezo nkqubo. ULawulo oluDibeneyo loBomi beNdalo kunye noQeqesho lokulinganisa umthelela weNdalo. Izithembiso ze-UNEP, inkqubo ye-GPA, amaSivumelwano eLwandle loMmandla namaprojekthi ahambelana nazo. Iinkqubo zeentengiso nokuyilwa kurhwebo karhulumente. ULawulo lwaProjekthi. UMyalezo woBusa kaRhulumente kunye neenqobo zesebe namacebo. Isiseko kwiziNzulu zezeNdalo eZidibeneyo okanye iNzululwazi eZidibeneyo okanye iNzulu lwazi zeNdalo. Amakhono obumba nokucwangcisa iindaba. ULawulo lwaProjekthi. UThetha ngokusebenzayo. Ukucinga ngokudibanisa izinto. Ukubhala nokubika ngokwesayensi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukwenza imisebenzi emininzi ngaxeshanye. Ukuzama ukusebenzisana kunye nokuzibandakanya nabathathi-nxaxheba. IKhono lokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo. IKhono lokuphumeza iindibano ezibambe nzima, ngelixa ugcina umgangatho omhle womsebenzi. Amakhono abukhulu mthetho (okubhaliweyo, okuthethwayo kunye nezixhobo ezizayo).). IKhono lokulunga, ukutolika nokusebenzisa umthetho namacebo. IKhono lokuyila izisombulu ngeNdlela yokucinga ngokudibanisa izinto ngeentsiba ezitsha. IKhono lokuphatha ngobundlobo nangokusebenza umbuzo wefowuni koluntu. IKhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela nangabanye. IKhono lokuqokelela nokuqonda iinkcukacha nolwazi. Amakhono obudlelwane obuhle. Ukuba mqhami-ntsebenzo onenyaniso. Umlawulo weempixano. Ilayisenisi yokushayela. Ukuzikhusela nokuNako ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Lowo uza kusebenza kule sithuba uza kuba nawo uxanduva lokulawula ukukhutshwa kweekhemikhali ezithintelwe kumanzi aphakathi kwalwandle nakumanzi okunxweme. Unika inkxaso kumashishini okugcina ukungcola kolwandle kwaSebe nakwezinye iiprojekthi ezihambelana nazo. Kubumba izinto ezindala kwiDirekate kwiinkqubo ze-EIA, iiforam ezithethwayo ezibalulekileyo, nakwezinye iindululo ezibalulekileyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo oluhle. Unika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwiinkqubo zokuzinika umda wokulawula nokuqinisekisa umthetho ngokujunela kwiindawo ezingaphandle zokungcola kwamanzi olwandle.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Kwekerybestuur (VERGROENING en
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig om kwekerybedrywighede te bestuur, insluitend plantproduksie, saadinwinning en voortplanting by Qwaqpa in die Free State.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in Bosbou / Omgewingswetenskap of Natuurlike Hulpbronbestuur of relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Bosbou of verwante veld. Kennis van die National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) en die National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Kennis van Behuisingsbestuur en Bedryfsbestuur. Kennis van die funksie van verskillende departemente en vlakke van regering. Regeringsbesigheidspraktyke en -beleid. Projektebestuur en strategiese beplanning. Belanghebbendes-betrokkenheid. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Goedge verhoudingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en kritiek te hanteer. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om in moeilike situasies te onderhandel en konflik op te los. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Bestuur plantproduksie-aktiwiteite. Ontwikkel en implementeer jaarlikse bedryfsplan. Verseker saadinwinning, -behandeling en -berging. Verseker voortplanting van goeie gehalte saailinge. Verseker versorging en bewatering van plante. Hou toesig oor deurlopende produksie en instandhouding van die kwekery. Verseker instandhouding van die infrastruktuur, oorplanting van saailinge en bemesting en bewatering van plante. Bestuur die implementering van beheerprogramme vir onkruid, insekte, plaes en siektes. Lewer ondersteuning rakende die implementering van die vergroeningsprogram. Verskaf ondersteuning vir die koördinering van aktiwiteite rondom Bosboubewustheidsveldtogte en Bemagtiging. Voer bewustheidsveldtogte en vergroeningsinligtingsessies uit. Versprei bome en promosiemateriaal. Koördineer en monitor die aanplant van bome en monitor die oorlewing van bome. Verskaf algemene administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Benoem, merk en tel al die plante. Verseker inkomsteinvordering in ooreenstem met Standaardbedryfsprosedures. Ontwikkel en onderhou 'n databasis vir boomvoorraad.

zu.title: Umabili Jikelele: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza zeNsimu (GREENING and
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umabili Jikelele ukuphatha izinsiza ezisetshenziswa ezinsimini okuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza izitshalo, ukuqoqa imbewu kanye nokusakaza kwaQwaqpa e-Free State.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF Level 6) ku-Forestry / Environmental Science noma Natural Resources Management noma izifundo ezihambisana nale ndawo njengoba kuhambisana nezindinganiso ze-SAQA. Ukwazi nge-National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) kanye ne-National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Ukwazi nge-Housing Management, kanye ne-Operations Management. Ukwazi ngemisebenzi yeminyango ehlukene kanye namazinga ahlukene kahulumeni. Izinqubo zebhizinisi kahulumeni kanye nezinhlaka zemithetho. I-Project Management kanye ne-strategic planning. Ukuhlangenwe nakho nabathintekile. I-Strategic Capability and Leadership. Isidlulelo sokusebenza ngaphansi kwegansi nokuthola iziyalezo. Isidlulelo sokuqoqa futhi uhlaziye ukwaziswa. Isidlulelo sokuxoxisana ezimeni ezinzima kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. I-Driver's license esemthethweni kanye nokuthanda ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yokukhiqiza izitshalo. Bese futhi usebenzise ihlelo lemisebenzi leminyaka yonke. Qinisekisa ukuqoqa, ukwelashwa kanye nokuqoqelwa kwembewu. Qinisekisa ukukhiqizwa kwezimuncu ezinhle zezitshalo. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa nokunisela izitshalo. Buka ngqo ukukhiqizwa okuqhubekayo kanye nokunakekelwa kweNsimu. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kophahla, ukuthwebula izimuncu zezitshalo kanye nokufaka umanyolo nokunisela izitshalo. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuqapha izitshalo ezibiwe, izinambuzane, izifo kanye nezinyosi. Nikeza inkxaso ekusetshenzweni kohlelo lwe-greening programme. Nikeza inkxaso ekuhlelweni kwemisebenzi ye-Forestry Awareness Campaign kanye ne-Empowerment. Yenza imikhankaso yokwazisa kanye nezinkulumo zamahlelo nge-greening. Yabela izihlahla kanye nezinto zokukhuthaza. Hlela futhi ulandele ukutshalwa kwezihlahla futhi ulandele impilo yezihlahla. Nikeza inkxaso ngokuphathwa kwemibhalo yonke. Thatha igama, uphawule futhi ubale wonke izitshalo. Qinisekisa ukuqoqwa kwemali ngokuhambisana ne-Standard Operating Procedures. Nikeza inkxaso ngesikhathi kubalwa izitshalo kumaNursery. xh.summary: Kufuneka uMlawuli oNcedisayo ophatha imisebenzi yenursery kuquka ukukhiqiza izityalo, ukuqokelela imbewu nokuyahlaza ukhule eQwaqpa kwi-Free State.
