Ukuze kube kukho okungenamathamga amabini (2) eminyakeni yamava kwiMisebenzi yamaHlathi okanye kwindawo ehambelanayo. Ulwazi nokungcamla ngoMthetho weeHlathi zeLizwe, 1998 (uMthetho uNo 84 ka-1998) (NFA) nakoMthetho weVeld namaHlathi noLilo, 1998 (uMthetho uNo 101 ka-1998) (NVFFA). Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamasebe ahlukeneyo neenqanaba zahulumeni. Ulwazi ngezindalo zokubika neenkqubo. Ulwazi ngezindalo zoLawulo loMsebenzi ongundoqo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zoshishino loHulumeni neengqaqamba. uLawulo loMsebenzi weeNkqubo nocwangciso olujoliswe kumaxabiso. uLawulo lweNxulumano. uKuthintana nabantu abathintekayo. uPhando lweNxulumano yoLuntu. Ikhono loQhinga loPezulu noBuntu. uLawulo lweMal iNties. uLawulo lokuTshintsha. uLawulo lweNkqubo yolwazi ngenKonzo eNikwa abantu. Ikhono lokuxoxa ngemiba ezingxamileyo nokusombulula iingxabano. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokubamba iingxelo. Iinxulumano ezilungileyo nabantu nokuzipatha kakuhle ekunxibelelaneni. Ukusebenza ngokululekileyo kwiinkqubo zika-Microsoft. iLayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni nokuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukunciphisa iingozi kumgangatho weendalo nempilo yomntu ngokusebenzisa inkqubo yokuhlaza kwingingqi. Yila inkqubo yokuhlaza uze uyisebenzise ukuqinisekisa ukuzithoba. Yalela uze uxhasa masipala ohlelwe ngowoluntu ngokubambelela kumPhezulu oMhla wokuqajwa kweHlathi eLizini. Hlanganisela iNgxelo yenyanga zayo. Khuthaza umba wezamahlathi oguquliweyo ngokudala amathuba emisebenzi njengoko kumalathisi we-EPWP nendlela eVunyiweyo yoQhinga. Phakamisa inkcitho yamahlathi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwimikhankanyo yesebe ephambili, kweyamahlathi ngenyanga, kweSuku seHlathi lomZwe ngenxa yokuxhasa eminye imikhankanyo yamasebe ahambelana nayo. Nikela inkxaso yobuchwepheshe neenkonzo zokwandiswa kwamathuba okuphila abasakhulayo naba bakhoyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zamahlathi zifakwa kuHulumeni weNgingqi koMmandla.

jobs.title: Senior Occupational Health and Safety Officer
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Enforce occupational health and safety regulations through inspections, reporting and compliance within Departmental facilities in Bisho.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Occupational Health and Safety or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in Occupational Health and Safety. Registration with a relevant OHS body with a certificate from SAIOSH/SACPCMP and must have SAMTRAC. Knowledge and understanding of Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 and Regulations; Code of Practice of South African National Standard and related prescripts and National Building Regulations. Understanding of project management, financial management, supply Chain Management legislation. Good communication (verbal and written), problem solving skills, report writing skills, organising and planning skills. Good analytical thinking. Good computer literacy and use of standard packages. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to work independently and in a team. Willingness to travel long distances and spend time away from home.
jobs.duties: Conduct safety inspections to enforce health and safety regulations within the Departmental facilities. Compile reports to provide recommendations for injury/illness prevention and corrective actions to ensure compliance at the sites. Compile health and safety files and ensure that they updated accordingly. Conduct incidents investigations and determine mitigation measures needed for OHS interventions. Compile and maintain safety-related records. Conduct workplace risk assessments, incident registers, monthly registers, and OHS related statistics. Coordinate emergency evacuation drills and assist in emergency preparedness for the workplace. Coordinate Regional OHS quarterly committee meetings. Develop, coordinate and implement Occupational Health and Safety education and training to enable preparedness for hazards and risks. Develop and review applicable Occupational Health and Safety applicable Statutory Standards, Policies and Procedures for the Departmental facilities.

af.title: Senior Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Handhaaf beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies deur inspeksies, verslagdoening en nakoming binne departementele fasiliteite in Bisho.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Registrasie by 'n relevante OHS-liggaam met 'n sertifikaat van SAIOSH/SACPCMP en moet SAMTRAC hê. Kennis en begrip van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid 85 van 1993 en Regulasies; Kode van Praktyk van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Standaard en verwante voorskrifte en Nasionale Bouregulasies. Begrip van projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, en wetgewing rakende toiotaankoopbestuur. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), probleemoplossingsvaardighede, verslagdoeningsvaardighede, organising en beplanningsvaardighede. Goeie analitiese denke. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid en gebruik van standaard programme. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Bereidwilligheid om lang afstande te reis en tyd weg van die huis deur te bring.
af.duties: Voer veiligheidsinspeksies uit om gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies binne die departementele fasiliteite af te dwing. Stel verslae op om aanbevelings te doen vir die voorkoming van beserings/siektes en korrektiewe maatreëls om nakoming by die terreine te verseker. Stel gesondheids- en veiligheidslêers op en verseker dat dit dienooreenkomstig opgedateer word. Voer voorvalondersoeke uit en bepaal die mitigasiemaatreëls wat vir OHS-intervensies benodig word. Stel veiligheidsverwante rekords op en onderhou dit. Voer werksplek-risiko-assesseringe, voorvalregister, maandelikse registers, en OHS-verwante statistieke uit. Koördineer noodontruimingsoefeninge en help met noodgevalgereedheid vir die werkplek. Koördineer streek-OHS-kwartaalkomiteevergaderings. Ontwikkel, koördineer en implementeer Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsopvoeding en -opleiding om gereedheid vir gevaare en risiko's moontlik te maak. Ontwikkel en hersien toepaslike Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheid-statutêre standaarde, beleide en prosedures vir die departementele fasiliteite.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlezi Ohlonzwe Ngemisebenzi Yokuphephakalise Nezenhlalo Nokuvikela,
zu.summary: Ukuqinisa imithetho yomsebenzi wokuphephakalise nezokuzinza ngokwenza ukubuka, ukubika nokuthobela imithetho ngaphakathi kwemiphakathi yomnyango eBisho.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF6) ekuqashweni kwemisebeni yokuphephakalise nezokuzinza noma iziqu ezihambisana nendawo ehlobene njengoba kudunyiswe yi-SAQA. Okungeqanjwe kusetshenziswa iminyaka emibili (2) kumsebenzi wokuqashwa kokuphephakalise nezokuzinza. Ukuqashwa emzileni othinteka kwe-OHS ngesitifikedi esivela kwi-SAIOSH/SACPCMP futhi kumele abe ne-SAMTRAC. Ulwazi nokuzuva umthetho we-Act 85 ka-1993 we-OHS kanye nemithetho; ikhodi yokwenza imigomo yezwe yakwaNingizimu Afrika kanye nezincwadi ezihlobene kanye nemithetho yokwakha kwezwe. Ukuqonda ukuphatwa kwezinhlelo, ukuphatwa kwezimali, kanye nomthetho wokuphathwa kwezokusampula. Ukuxhumana okuhle (ngomlomo nakubhalwayo), amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuhlela. Ukucabanga okuhlukanisa kahle. Ulwazi oluhle lekhompyutha kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamaphakethe ajwayelekile. Isikhathi sokuthola kanye nohlaziyo lokwaziswa. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi koxhaxha. Isikhathi sokusebenza kodwa kanye naphakathi kwesixuku. Isifiso sokuhamba ibanga elide kanye nokuhlala isikhathi eside kude nendlu.
zu.duties: Yenza izibuko ezokuphepha ukuze kuqinisiswe imithetho yezokuphepha kanye nezempilo ngaphakathi kwemiphakathi yomnyango. Hlanganisa imibiko ukuze unikeze izincomo zokuvinjelwa kokulimala/ukugula kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela emagunjini. Hlanganisa amafayela wezokuphepha nezempilo uze uqinisekise ukuthi abuye abe neminikelo yemibiko. Yenza uphenyo lwezenzakalo kanye nokuhlonza izinyathelo ezingadingeka zokungenelela i-OHS. Hlanganisa kanye nokugcina izibuko ezihlobene nezokuphepha. Yenza ukuqashwa kwezengozi zomsebenzi, izibuko sezenzakalo, izibuko zanyanga zonke, kanye nezibalo ezihlobene ne-OHS. Hlela okuzivocavo kokuqhaqhwa phandle kwesikhathi esibi ngokuphazima kanye nokuqasha ukulungele ukuphazima phandle kolwandle lomsebenzi. Hlela izindima zonke ze-OHS ezindaweni ezinye kabhala minyaka yonke. Bumba, hlela kanye nokusetshenzisa imfundo kanye noqeqesho lwezokuphepha nezempilo kubantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulungele izinkinga kanye nezinyathelo zokuzivikela. Bumba kanye nokuvavanya imithetho ehlobene ne-OHS, imithetho kahulumini kanye nemigomo yokwenza imisebenzi kabhaka komnyango.

xh.title: Umsebenzi ohamba phambili wolawulo loyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi
xh.summary: Ukuze kuqatshwe iimithetho yolawulo loyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi ngokwenza iinkonzo zokuqwalasela, nokubika nokuzithoba ngaphakathi kwezisebe zeDanamini eBisho.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sangeNqanaba lesiSamkela iZidanga ngokwesithandathu kwiNgcali yokwazi kwiNgcali yolawulo loyilo nokhuseleko komsebenzi okanye isidanga elifanelekileyo kwicala elithintekayo njengoko evunywe yiSAQA. Kufuneka abe nenqanaba elingaphantsi kweminyaka emibini (2) yamava kulawulo loyilo nokhuseleko komsebenzi. Kufunek_2 ebhalise kumaziko amalungisa olawulo loyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi onesatifikethi esivela kwiSAIOSH/SACPCMP kwaye kufuneka abe noSAMTRAC. Ulwazi nokuqondakoMthetho woLawulo loyilo noKhuseleko komsebenzi uMthetho wama-85 ka-1993 nemiQathango; iKhowudi yoQeqesho yeeNqanaba zeeSizwe zakwaMzantsi Afrika namagqabantshintshi axelene nayo nemiQathango yoLwakhiwo lwesiZwe. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kweprojekthi, ukulawulwa kwezimali, iMithetho yoLawulo loQhotho loQoqosho. Ikhono lokunxibelelana elihle (lwesinyathelo selityala elityhaliweyo nesibhaliweyo), amakhono oksombulula iingxaki, amakhono okubhaliweyo okubika, amakhono oQoqosho uphuhliso nokuqwalasela. Iinkqubo ezizezokwahlulahlula ngokwengqondo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha elihle nokusetyenziswa kweekqubo zangaphakathi. Ikhono lokuthuthisa nokwahlulahlula ulwazi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngxaki. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nakwindawo yokusebenza ngokubakanyeneyo. Ukulungelelanisa ukuhamba amabal' esithuba esikhulu nokuchitha ixesha kude nasekhaya.
xh.duties: Qwalasela iinkonzo zokuzinza kokhuseleko ukwaz_0 ukuyalela imithetho yokhuseleko komsebenzi kwiSisebe zokhuseleko ezezo zisebe ezikwiDanamini. Hlela iingxelo ukunika iingcebiso ngokuthintela iingozi okanye ukugula nemisebenzi yokulungisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzithoba kwindawo zokusebenza. Hlela iifayile zoyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba zihlaziywe ngokufanelekileyo. Qwalasela iinkonzo zophando zeehlabathi kwaye uqokele iindlela zokunciphisa ezidingekayo kwiinkonzo zolawulo loyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi. Hlela kwaye ulondoloze iirekhodi ezinxulumene nokhuseleko. Qwalasela iinkqubo zokuqwalasela iingozi zendawo yokusebenza, iirejista zeengozi, iirejista zeenyanga, neesethistikha ezinxulumene nolawulo loyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi. Lungiselela iinkonzo zokubaleka okwesimo esiphuthumayo kwaye uncede ekulungiseleleni iimeko ezibuthaka-ntloni zendawo yokusebenza. Lungiselela iinkonko zeNqanaba lesiThathu zobukumkani bahulu bolawulo loyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi zeQela. Phucula, lungiselela kwaye usebenzise ulwazi nokuqeqesha ngeNgcali yolawulo loyilo lokhuseleko komsebenzi ukunik ikholo lokulungiselela iingozi nentsengo. Bala, phucula kwaye uhlole iNgangingozi yoQobo yolawulo loyilo lokhuseleko, iiNgcamango nemiQathango esetyenziswayo kwizisebe zeDanamini.

af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig vir vergroenings- en broodwinningsprogram in Limpopo, vereis Graad 12 en administratiewe vaardighede.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Post-matrikkwalifikasie en relevante ervaring in Administrasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzisi wezokuphathwa kwezomphakathi ohlelweni lwe-greening and livelihoods eLimpopo, ofuna ibanga le-12 namakhono okuphatha izindaba.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi sebanga le-12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Izifundo ezingeza emva kwebanga le-12 namava okusebenza kwezokuphathwa kwezomphakathi kuzoba yinzedbelele. Ulwazi mayelana nezimiso zezinsiza zomphakatha, inqubo yokuthola izinto kanye ne-PFMA Planning. Amakhono ohlelo. Amakhono ekhompyutha namakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono amahle abudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Isikhathi sokuxhumana nabantu kumazinga ahlukene; isikhathi sokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngamunye naphakathi kwethimba. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi koxindezele olwedlulele. Isikhathi sokusebenza nabantu abenzima kanye nesikhathi sokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuba nobudlodlo kanye nokuba nomqondo oqavukayo. Ukuba necoso nokuba nenjongo ezinhle zokusebenza.
zu.duties: Bhala, hlela, gcina, faka futhi ulande ukuxhumana kolwazi kanye nolunye ulwazi. Buyeza imibhalo futhi unikeze izinsiza zokuphathwa kwezomphakathi. zu.title: Oqashiwo be-Administration abaphathwa kwaye baphathwe ngokuphathelene nokukhonza incazelo yokuqashwa kwemisebenzi: Iqembu le-Administration esebenza emnyangweni wezohwebo

Ukwaziswa okuyisisekelo kokulawulwa kwemisebenzi kahulumeni kanye ne-PFMA. Ukwaziswa nganqamula kanjani yokuthenga, ukuhlela kanye nohlehlo. Ulwazi lwesithombe kanye nohlu. Ukhombe wokuxhumana noxhumanilwano nabantu abangamazinga ahlukene. Isikhokelo sokusebenzisa izinqubo mayelana nalokho, isikhokelo ngokusebenzela yedwa kanye naseqenjini. Isikhokelo esihle sokuxhumana nabantu. Isikhokelo ngokusebenza ngaphezu kohlangothi. Isikhokelo sokusebenza noxhumana nenzuzo mayelana nenzuzo. Ukwethula okuhlukile nokuba nobuhlakani. Isikhokelo sokusebenza noxhumano kanye nobuhlakani. Isiphathamandla esihle mayelana noxhumano olungcono. Ubuhlakani bokuxhumana nobuhlakani bezezimali. Ubudlelwano obuhle nobuhlakani bokubuyekeza ubudlelwano bomuntu. Isikhokelo sobuhlakani bokuba nesiqu mayelana noxhumano lobudlelwano bomsebenzi. Isiqu nobudlelwano obuhle bomuntu mayelana nobudlelwano bomsebenzi. Isiqu nobudlelwano bomuntu mayelana nobuhlakani bokusebenza. Ubuhlakani nobudlelwano obuhle bomuntu mayelana noxhumano ngenhloso. Ubuhlakani bomsebenzi nobudlelwano bokusebenza nabantu abanobungozi. Ubuhlakani bomsebenzi nobuhlakani bokusebenza ngokuzethemba nobudlelwano bomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinsizakalo eziyisisekelo eziyisisekelo zokubhala nokulawula; Qopha, hlela, gigca, bathathe futhi bethule uxhumo lwemibhalo kanye nolwazi. Buyekeza izibhalo nikela ngezinsizakalo zokuphatha. Phatha imibuzo evamile, yenze izikhiye ezikopishiwe, amukele noma uthumele imali. Sula imibhalo / amaphakheji kwabahlukene abanomthelela njengoba kudingeka. Gcina isistimu yokugcina amafayela efosini. Bhala imibhalo kanye no / noma olunye uxhumo lapho kudingeka. Gcina futhi uphathe isibalo samafayela asemva naphambili efosini. Hlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubhala eziyisisekelo kuyo yonke ingxenye; Xhumana nabahlakaniphi abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuhlotshaniswa nokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsizakulo. Thola izikhlomelo, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga ukuthenga izimpahla ezijwayelekile zefosini. Gcina futhi uphathe isibalo sezimpahla kuyo yonke ingxenye. Hlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nalokho. Gcina futhi uphathe isibalo senkungatheka, amarekhodi abasebenzi kanye nesibalo sobukhona efosini. Hlela izinto zokuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Hlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphatha izimali kuyo yonke ingxenye, Qopha futhi buyekeza ukuchithwa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukulungile Kokwenza kwezokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsizakalo. Izinselo nokuhamba kwabasebenzi, amadokhumenti wesithuthi bese uyethula kumabamba ukuze avume. Phatha izikhwama zocingo nezimali ezincane zesithili nefosini yasendaweni.

Amandla okuthetha nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo. Amandla okusebenzisa iingqiqo. Amandla okusebenza ngokwendodla nakwindyikitha. Amandla amahle okuhlobana nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo enkulu. Amandla okusebenza nabantu abanzima nendlela yokuzisa uxolo. Amandla okuqala nokudala izinto. Amandla okuzimela kwaye unokuziphatha kakuhle emsebenzini.

Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo, yenza iikopi eziphotsiweyo, amkele okanye uthumele iimeyile. Yahlule ihlathi/iiphakheji kumalungu ahlukeneyo njengoko kuyimfuneko. Gcina indlela yokulungelelanisa amaphepha kwindlu yenkonzo. Chwetheza amaxwebhu nakwezinye iindaba xa kuyimfuneko. Gcina uze ulohlaziye igama elibhalwe kuluhlu lemaxwebhu angenayo naphumayo kwindlu yenkonzo. Zinkele iinkonzo zolulo kumathuba okuzelelwa impahla ngaphakathi kwelungelo loqobo. Thetha namalungu angaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuzelelwa impahla neeNkonzo. Fumana iingxelo zemali, gcwalisa iifom zokuzelelwa ngenjongo yokuthenga izinto ezenza iindlu zokusebenza ezikumgangatho ongqiqiyo. Gcina uze ulohlaziye igama elibhalwe kuluhlu lempahla kwelungelo loqobo. Zinkele iinkonzo zokulawula izinto ezingundoqo zolundo. Gcina uze ulohlaziye amagama abhalwe kuluhlu obhalwe iinkonzo ezikwindlu yenkonzo, iirekhodi zabasebenzi noluhlu lwendlela yokubakho. Hlela ukubhukisha uhambo nendawo yokuhlala. Zinkele iinkonzo zeliso lomanyano lwemali kwelungelo loqobo, bazisa uhlaziye ityala. Qinisekisa ukulunga kwezinto kuzelelwe impahla neeNkonzo. Iingxelo zokuhamba nokutyela zabaphathi, amaxwebhu ezithuthi athunyelwe kubaphathi baze bacelwe ukuba bayamke. Phatha i-akhawunti zefowuni nemali encinci kwelungelo loqobo nakwindlu yenkonzo yommandla.

Ulwazi nge-Marine Living Resource Act nakwezinye izinto ezihlobene. Ulwazi ngokuqubo lokubhala idatha kanye nezimiso zokuphathwa kwezinkampani. Amakhono ohlelo nokuphumeza imisebenzi. Ukusebenzisana noma ukwaziswa ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana (okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwayo) nakwabanye abantu. Ikhono nesifiso sokuqasha ngaphandle kwezimo zezulu ezimbi kanye nokuhlala isikhathi eside kude nasekhaya ngesikhathi kuhamba olwandle/eyensimini. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Ukuletha inkonzo yomsizo abasebenzi bokuNobuchwepheshe naboCwaningo ekuqoqweni kwedatha yohlelo lwocwaningo oluholiswe ekusebenziseni okuhlobene nezinsiza Zasogwini ngokuhlala sisigxobo. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuqoqweni nakucubungulweni idatha yezinhlanzi nabalawuli kanye nokugcwalisa izimiso zedatha ngokuqondene nokubika kweNingizimu Afrika kumacembu aphezulu ePhathi Idatha Yezinhlanzi Emhlabeni. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokulawula izinhlanzi nemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukuloba amasampula okubamba ezindaweni zokuhamba ngenyanga, futhi emafekthri ukuze kutholakale usayizi kanye nohlobo lwezinhlobo eziyiyo zezinhlanzi. Ukusiza ekuleni amasampula wezinhlanzi namashaka kanye namapulose ahlobene nocwaningo. Ukubamba iqhaza kuqhathanisi lwamathuluzi ahleli nakumaseal wamathuluzi kwezinhlanzi kanye nocwaningo lwemvelo yaselwandle. Ukusiza ekulungekiseni, ekusebenzeni kanye ekugcineni amathuluzi ocwaningo. Ukusiza ekuthengeni amathuluzi nezinto ezisetshenziswa ngaphandle. Ukwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yobhalisi kanye namagatsha ohlelo.

xh.title: Umncedi Wezophando ZikaLwandle
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso abasebenzi bezophando ekugqithiseni nasekuqwalaselweni iinkcukacha zamazandla eentlanzi ngolawulo olusasindlekweni kwizibanga eziseduze kwisebe leForestry, Fisheries and the Environment eCape Town.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF level 6), kwiNatural Science okanye isifanekiselo esihambelana nendawo edibene nalo njengoko samkelwa yiSAQA kunye nephelo leminyaka elinye (1) yamava ekuyiweni iisampulu zobioloji, ekuqokelelweni nasekungeniseni iinkcukacha kwindawo edibene nalo. Kulindeleke ukuba umphuli wokuqhuba adlule kuphando lwezonyango kubasebenzi bolwandle ngokwesigaba 101 soMthetho weSAMSA Act 57 of 1951. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weMarine Living Resource Act nangeminye imithetho edibene nalo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokungenisa iinkcukacha neemigaqo yolawulo kwiirekhodi. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuphumeza. Ukuzazi ukusebenza komnqwathi-mfihlo. Indlela elungileyo yoxoxo (ngomlomo nangobhalo) kunye namandla okuhambelana nabantu. Amandla nokuthanda ukusebenza ngaphandle kwemozimo engemihla nemini kwaye uchithe iixa ezide ekhaya Lakho ngelixa usezihambeli zolwandle/emasimini. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukuze ngenise inkonzo yenkxaso kubasebenzi beTechnical nabeResearch ekuqokelelweni kweenkcukacha zenkqubo zophando ezijolise ekusetyenzisweni okusasindlekweni kwezibanga eziseduze. Thatha inxaxheba ekugqithiseni nasekuqwalaselweni iinkcukacha zamazandla eentlanzi nakwisiphuli-mbango kwaye uze uze udale iinkqubo zeenkcukacha ukuba iSouth Africa ichaze kumabanga amazwe ngamazwe. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkalo zolawulo lwezolwandle nokwengamso olwandle, kuquka nokuthatha iisampulu zokubamba kumaziko nasezifabrica ngobungakanani nangokwakhekelwano lobuhlobo. Nceda ekuthabeni iisampulu zobioloji zeentlanzi netswala nezinkqubo ezidibene nophando. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zophando zolwandle nasezihambeli zaselwandle. Nceda nakuqulunqa, ekusebenziseni nasekugcineni izixhobo zophando. Nceda ekuthengeni izixhobo kunye nezinto ezisetyenziswa ngexesha elifutshane. Imisebenzi yentengiso nemiqondo yofise

jobs.title: Groundsman: Greening and Livelihoods Implementation
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 November 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted. FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Groundsman position in the Northern Cape with the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment, requiring Grade 9 qualification and knowledge of gardening and plant maintenance.
jobs.requirements: Grade 9 (NQF level 1) equivalent qualification. Knowledge of plants and gardening. Ability to operate elementary machines and equipment. Knowledge of operating computer. Sound organising and planning skills. Good communication skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to work long hours voluntarily. Ability to work with limited supervision. Ability to work under extreme pressure. Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict.
jobs.duties: Perform routine activities in respect of grounds, irrigate and water plants lawns. Conduct weeding and weed control. Prune and trim plants, performance cutting, seeding and transplanting of plants. Mow lawns, dispose of organic waste, dig compost, dig, spray and maintain flower beds and edges. Perform general routine activities in respect of infrastructure support. Seeds collection. Cleaning of seeds. Seed pre-sowing treatment. Preparation of seedling trays. Sowing of seed. Preparation and sowing of cuttings. Ensure planting and transplanting of seedlings and trees. Filling of planting bags with soil. Prepare space in beds for transplanting. Transplanting of seedling from trays to bags. Transplanting of trees from small to bigger bags. Packing of transplanted trees. Provide general labour in the nursery. Mixing of sand and compost. Manual and chemical weed control. Irrigation of seedlings and trees. Assist with stocktaking. Tagging of plants correctly. Check seedlings and plants for pests and diseases. Assist the customers coming to buy trees. Responsible for the tools allocated. Report any damage in the nursery to the Foreman. Ensure the use, cleaning and basic maintenance of tractor and dumper. Move sand and compost to the tables or beds. Move seedlings, crates and tree. Keep equipment and machinery clean after use.

af.title: Grondwerker: Implementering van Vergroening en Bestaansmiddele
af.summary: Grondwerkerpos in die Northern Cape by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment, wat 'n Graad 9-kwalifikasie en kennis van tuinmaak en plantonderhoud vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 9 (NQF level 1) ekwivalente kwalifikasie. kennis van plante en tuinmaak. Vermoë om elementêre masjiene en toerusting te bedryf. kennis van rekenaargebruik. Soliede organisasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verwantskapvaardighede. Vermoë om vrywillig lang ure te werk. Vermoë om met beperkte toesig te werk. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los.
af.duties: Voer roetine-aktiwiteite ten opsigte van gronde uit, besproei en water plante en gazon. Doen onkruid en onkruidbeheer. Snoei en knip plante, voer snoeiwerk, saai en oorplanting van plante uit. Maai gazon, raak ontslae van organiese afval, grawe kompos, grawe, spuit en onderhou blombeddings en rande. Voer algemene roetine-aktiwiteite ten opsigte van infrastruktuurondersteuning uit. Saadversameling. Skoonmaak van saad. Saad voor-asaai-behandeling. Voorbereiding van saailingbakkies. Saai van saad. Voorbereiding en saai van steggies. Verseker plant en oorplanting van saailinge en bome. Vul plant Sakke met grond. Voorberei ruimte in beddings vir oorplanting. Oorplanting van saailinge van bakkies na sakke. Oorplanting van bome van klein na groter sakke. Verpakking van oorgeplante bome. Verskaf algemene arbeid in die kwekery. Meng van sand en kompos. Handmatige en chemiese onkruidbeheer. Besproeiing van saailinge en bome. Bystand met voorraadopname. Korrekte etikettering van plante. Kontroleer saailinge en plante vir peste en siektes. Bystand aan kliënte wat bome kom koop. Verantwoordelik vir die toegerede gereedskap. Rapporteer enige skade in die kwekery aan die Voorman. Verseker die gebruik, skoonmaak en basiese onderhoud van trekker en dumper. Verskuif sand en kompos na die tafels of beddings. Verskuif saailinge, kratte en bome. Hou toerusting en masjinerie skoon na gebruik.

zu.title: Umlimi wendawo: Ukulinywa kwezihlahla kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza
zu.summary: Isikhundla somlimi wendawo e-Northern Cape ku-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment, sidinga izifundo ze-Grade 9 kanye nolwazi lokulima izinto zezimbalwa kanye nokugcina izitshalo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezalingana ne-Grade 9 (NQF level 1). Ulwazi ngezitshalo nangokulima. Ikono lokusebenzisa amashishino namathuluzi asemgceni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikono elihle lokuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ikono elihle lokuxhumana. Ikono elihle lokwazana nabantu. Ikono lokusebenza amawela amakhulu ngokuzithandela. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokuhlola okuncane. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi ezinkulu. Ikono lokusebenza nabantu abanobunzima kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yansuku zonke mayelana nendawo, chebisela kanye nokunisela izitshalo namashlathi. Khubula futhi lawule ukugezela. Sika izitshalo, yenza ukusika, ukutshala izinkindi kanye nokushintsha izitshalo. Wela amahlathi, lahla izinkungu ezingcolile, hlumba umquba, hlumba, futhi gcina amabhede ezimbali namaphethini. Yenza imisebenzi yansuku zonke ngokwesekwa kolwakhiwo. Qoqa izinkindi. Hlamba izinkindi. Yenza ukwelashwa kwezinkindi ngaphambi kokuzitshala. Lungiselela izitrayi zeziqhumzini. Tshala izinkindi. Lungiselela futhi tshala okusikiwe. Qinisekisa ukutshala kanye nokushintshwa kweziqhumzini nezihlahla. Gcwalisa amasaka okutshala ngomhlabathi. Lungiselela isikhala emabhedeni okushintsha izitshalo. Shintsha iziqhumzini ezisukela ezitrayini aya emasakeni. Shintsha izihlahla ezincane ziya emasakeni amakhulu. Hlela izihlahla ezishintshiwe. Nikeza ngokusebenzela ngesandla esibhedlela lezitshalo. Hlanganisa umhlabathi nomquba. Lawula izigila ngokwesandla nangamakhemikhali. Chebisela iziqhumzini nezihlahla. Siza ukubala izinto. Beka amathegi ezitshalo ngendlela efanele. Hlola iziqhumzini nezitshalo ukuthona zinezinsecti nezifo. Siza abathengi abeza ukuthenga izihlahla. Phendula ngamathuluzi anikwe wona. Mbula nganoma yikuphi ukonakala esibhedlela lezitshalo kumondayi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa, ukucushwa nokugcinwa komshini oshubisa noyophahla. Susa umhlabathi nomquba uya kutafule noma emabhedeni. Siza iziqhumzini, amakhrathi nezihlahla. Gcina amathuluzi namashishino mahle emva kokusebenzisa.

xh.title: Umphi wemizila: Uqaliso lokuLuhlaza nokuPhila
xh.summary: Isithuba somphi wemizila kwingingqi yaseNorthern Cape nesebe lezoBomele, zoLwandle nezeQhinga, esifuna ifom yeNqanaba le-9 (NQF level 1) nolwazi lokulima kunye nokugcina izityalo.
xh.requirements: Ifom ye-Grade 9 (NQF level 1) ezingqongqo. ULwazi ngezityalo nangokulima. Ikhono lokusebenzisa iimoto nezixhobo ezisisiseko. ULwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono elinzulu lokuhlela kunye nokucwangcisa. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana. Ikhono elihle lokwakhiisana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza iiveki ezinde ngokuzithandela. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphandle kolawulo oluninzi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olumandla. Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima kunye nokusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Kwenziwe imisebenzi eqhelekileyo engxangxeni yemizila, kunceliswe kutyuliswe izityalo namasim. Kwenziwe ukutshuba kwaye kulawulwe izitshuba. Kutyutywe kuncetywe izityalo, kwenziwe ukusika, ukubeka imbewu nokuqhawula izityalo. Konyuswe amasim, kutywe iinkqubo eziphilayo, kutsitywe ikomposti, kutywe, kufukuliswe kwaye kugcinwe iibhedi ezinemibala namanxibe. Kwenziwe imisebenzi eqhelekileyo jikelele ngokuxhasa kwezoluntu. Ukuqokelela imbewu. Ukuhlamba imbewu. Unyango lwembewu phambi kokuyityela. Ulungelelwaniselwa lwe tray zembewu. Ukuhlonywa kwembewu. Ulungelelwaniselwa nokuhlonza iindidi ezisikwa. Kuqinisekiswa ukutyala nokuqhawula imbewu namakhaka. Ukuuzela kwee bags zokutyala ngesidaka. Kulungelelaniswa isithuba kwiibhedi ngeqhawulo. Ukuqhawulwa kwembewu ukusuka kwi trays ziyi bags. Ukuqhawulwa kwamakhaka akhutywa abe makhulu. Ukubeka amakhaka aqhawuliweyo. Kunikwa inyanzo njengomsebenzi wesandla kwindalo. Ukuxuba isebense nomhlaba. Ulawulo olusetyenziswa iindlela zesandla nongasemzimbeni ekutshuben. Ukuncelisa imbewu namakhaka. Ukuncedisa ukubala kwakho. Ukubeka iilebhile ezifanelekileyo kuzityalo. Ukujongisisa imbewu nozityalo kubonakalise iintsholongwane namagciwane. Ukuncedisa abathengi abeza kutyala amakhaka. Ukuhlala uyakho konke ngenxa yokuba nawo obekelwe wona amaxhala. Ukubika nalo lonke naonke nayonke nayonke nayonke nayonke nayonke nayonke nayonke nayonke nalulahleko yonke kwindalo ku Foreman. Kuqinisekiswa ukusetyenziswa, ukucocekiswa nokugcinwa okuyimixholo ekwtrace naku dumper. Kuhambiswa isebense nomhlaba kumaza okanye iibhedi. Kuhambiswa imbewu, ikrati namakhaka. Ukuzigcina zicocekile izixhobo ne zindululo emva kokuba zisetyenziswe.

jobs.title: Provincial Director: Northern Cape Provincial Office
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive package), of which 70% will be basic salary and 30% may be structured according to an individual’s needs.
jobs.summary: Lead the GCIS Northern Cape Provincial Office, delivering strategic communication campaigns in support of the Office of the Premier.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Communication / Media Studies / Journalism / Public Relations / Development Communication or related (NQF Level 7) qualification, majoring in Communication / Media Studies/ Journalism/ Public Relations / Development Communication. Successful completion of the Public Service Senior 44 Management Leadership Programme (Nyukela certificate) as endorsed by the National School of Government is a pre-requisite for appointment. Must have a valid driver’s license and be computer literate. At least five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior management level with extensive experience in and knowledge of development communication, proven leadership capabilities, and sound interpersonal and project management skills. Extensive experience in coordinating multi-stakeholders and inter-governmental multi-media communication campaigns. Knowledge: Comprehensive knowledge of the Northern Cape Province, including socio-economic and development dynamics as well of the communication footprint and dynamics of the province, including also at municipal level. Sound knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act. Must have a valid driver’s license and be computer literate. Required Core Competencies: Strategic Capacity and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Change Management, Programme and Project Management.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing strategic leadership and management to the GCIS Provincial Directorate in the Northern Cape Province particularly in support of the provincial communication system headed by the Office of the Premier. Deliver communication campaigns in line with the National Communication Strategic Framework and the Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), and the Provincial MTDP and communication programme. Advocate for the application of the Norms and Standards of Government Communications amongst the communication system in the province and lend support to the Local Government Communication System. Develop and maintain communication partnerships and networks with provincial stakeholders from Government and Civil Society. Participate actively in all communications forums in the province and provide strategic direction on government communication in such forums and when urgent or rapid communication is concerned, to protect and enhance the reputation of government. Operate an effective, and compliant government communication organisation. Identify and review strategic risks, oversee and manage the implementation mitigation plans. Participate in the audit planning process and manage responses to audit queries.

af.title: Provinsiale Direkteur: Noord-Kaap Provinsiale Kantoor
af.summary: Lei die GCIS Noord-Kaap Provinsiale Kantoor en lewer strategiese kommunikasieveldtogte ter ondersteuning van die Kantoor van die Premier.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF vlak 7 soos erken deur SAQA) in Kommunikasie / Mediastudies / Joernalistiek / Openbare Betrekkinge / Ontwikkelingskommunikasie of 'n verwante (NQF vlak 7) kwalifikasie, met Kommunikasie / Mediastudies / Joernalistiek / Openbare Betrekkinge / Ontwikkelingskommunikasie as hoofvakke. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Public Service Senior 44 Management Leadership Programme (Nyukela-sertifikaat) soos deur die National School of Government onderskraag, is 'n voorvereiste vir aanstelling. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê en rekenaarvaardig wees. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak met uitgebreide ervaring in en kennis van ontwikkelingskommunikasie, bewese leierskapsvermoëns, en goeie interpersoonlike en projekbestuursvaardighede. Uitgebreide ervaring in die koördinering van multik-belanghebbendes en intergovernmental multimedia-kommunikasieveldtogte. Kennis: Omvattende kennis van die Noord-Kaap Provinsie, insluitend sosio-ekonomiese en ontwikkelingsdinamika asook die kommunikasievoetspoor en dinamika van die provinsie, insluitend ook op munisipale vlak. Deeglike kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê en rekenaarvaardig wees. Vereiste kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese Kapasiteit en Leierskap, Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Program- en Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees daarvoor om strategiese leierskap en bestuur te verskaf aan die GCIS Provinsiale Direktoraat in die Noord-Kaap Provinsie, veral ter ondersteuning van die provinsiale kommunikasiestelsel gelei deur die Kantoor van die Premier. Lewer kommunikasieveldtogte in ooreenstemming met die National Communication Strategic Framework en die Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), en die Provinsiale MTDP en kommunikasieprogram. Pleitbesorg vir die toepassing van die Norms and Standards of Government Communications onder die kommunikasiestelsel in die provinsie en bied ondersteuning aan die Local Government Communication System. Ontwikkel en handhaaf kommunikasievennootskappe en netwerke met provinsiale belanghebbendes van Regering en Burgerlike Samelewing. Neem aktief deel aan alle kommunikasieforums in die provinsie en verskaf strategiese rigting oor regeringskommunikasie in sulke forums en wanneer dringende of vinnige kommunikasie ter sprake is, om die reputasie van die regering te beskerm en te verbeter. Bedryf 'n doeltreffende en nakomende regeringskommunikasie-organisasie. Identifiseer en hersien strategiese risiko's, hou toesig oor en bestuur die implementering van mitigasieplanne. Neem deel aan die ouditbeplanningsproses en bestuur reaksies op ouditvrae.

zu.title: Umphathi wesifunda: Isikhungo Sesifunda sase Northern Cape
zu.summary: Hola i-GCIS Isikhungo Sesifunda sase Northern Cape, kuqondise imikhankaso yokuxhumana enegqondo yokusebenzela i-Office of the Premier.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor ezifanele (izinga le-NQF 7 njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA) kwi-Communication / Media Studies / Journalism / Public Relations / Development Communication noma iziqu ezihlobene (izinga le-NQF 7), ezibanzi kwi-Communication / Media Studies/ Journalism/ Public Relations / Development Communication. Ukuqedela ngokuphumelele i-Public Service Senior 44 Management Leadership Programme (isitifiketi se-Nyukela) njengoba kuqinisekiswe i-National School of Government kuyisidingo sokuqondiswa ebuchosheni. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile futhi akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yokuhlola ezingeni lolawulo oluphakathi/oluphezulu nokuba nohlonze olunzulu kwezokuxhumana ngokuthuthukisa, amandla obuholi abekiwe, namakhono okuxhumana nabantu nokuqeqesha amaphrojekthi ahle. Uholo olunzulu ekwenzeni kuhlangene izinhlanga eziningi kanye nemikhankaso yokuxhumana kwezinyathelo eziningi phakathi kokuhlangana kahulumeni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubanzi ngesifunda sase Northern Cape, okuhlanganisa ukuziphathe komnotho nentuthuko kanye nesandulela salokuxhumana nezimpilo zesifunda, okuhlanganisa nasezingeni lomkhakha kahulumeni. Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile futhi akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amando abalulekile: Amandla agqonzekayo nobuholi, ulawulu labantu nokuqinisekiswa, ulawulu kwezimali, ulawulo lokushintsha, kanye noqeqesho lwe-programme nephrojekthi.
zu.duties: Ophumelele uzobe nogunya lokunika ubuholi obugqonzekayo nolawulo kwi-GCIS Provincial Directorate esifundeni sase Northern Cape Province ikakhuluzi ukusekela indlela yokuxhumana yesifunda eholwa yi-Office of the Premier. Yenza imikhankaso yokuxhumana ngokuhambisana ne-National Communication Strategic Framework ne-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), kanye ne-Provincial MTDP nenkqubo yokuxhumana. Sola ukusetshenziswa kwama-Norms and Standards of Government Communications kuleyo ndlela yokuxhumana esifundeni futhi unike inkxaso e-Local Government Communication System. Yakha futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano bokuxhumana kanye nexhula labafuyi besifunda abavela kuhulumeni nasemmangweni. Thatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo kunazo zonke izikhungla zokuxhumana esifundeni futhi unike isiqondiso esigqonzekayo sokuxhumana kahulumeni kulezo zikhungla nalapho kudingeka ukuxhumana ngokuphuthumayo noma ngokushesha, ukuvikela futhi ukuphucisa igama lohulumeni. Qondisa ukuxhumana kahulumeni okusebenza kahle futhi okuhambisana nomthetho. Qaphela futhi ubuke izingozi ezibalulekile, ulawule futhi uphathe ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokunciphisa. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni indlela yokuqasha futhi uphathe izimpendulo kumibuzo yokuqasha.

xh.title: Umkhulu wePhondo: Iofisi yaseNtshona Koloni
xh.summary: Yongeza iNtshona Koloni Provincial Office ye-GCIS, ngenxa yokuhambisa iinkampu zokunyanzelwa komthetho wesixeko ekuqwalaselwa iNkundla yePremier.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor esifanelekileyo (NQF level 7 njengokuqatwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Communication / Media Studies / Journalism / Public Relations / Development Communication okanye ezifanayo (NQF Level 7) ezithweswe iidigri, ezikwalwa ngokukhetha kwi-Communication / Media Studies/ Journalism/ Public Relations/ Development Communication. Ukugqibela ngokuphumelelya i-Public Service Senior 44 Management Leadership Programme (Nyukela certificate) njengokuqatwa yi-National School of Government kubalulekile ukwamkelwa. Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi yokushuka ethile futhi abe nalwazi lomthombo osaziwayo. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/laphezulu lokulawula kunye namava amaninzi nolwazi kokunyanzeliswa kokuthetha ngokuthutha kakhulu, amakhono okubumba ngokuthutha, kanye namakhono okubamba abantu nokulawula iinkqubo ezinkulu. Kufuneka abe namava amaninzi ekulungelelaniseni abantu abaninzi kwiinkampu zokunyanzelwa kumazwe aabafakiweyo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olupheleleyo lwe-Northern Cape Province, kuquka ulwazi ngemiba ezinzima ngokuphila kwabantu kanye nobume bomthetho wesixeko, kunye nobume bokubakwa kwemisebenzi yokuqamba-ithetha kwephondo, kuquka kwindalo yomzila weenkqubo. Ulwazi oluqinileyo lomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act. Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi yokushuka ethile futhi abe nalwazi lomthombo osaziwayo. Amakhono okubumba abaphathiweyo: Strategic Capacity and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Change Management, Programme and Project Management.
xh.duties: Umogqwa aphumeleyo uyakuba ngowekhadi lokunika inkokheli ekuqwalaselwa kwaye alawule i-GCIS Provincial Directorate kwiphondo le-Northern Cape Province ngakumbi ngokusekela inkqubo yokunyanzelwa komthetho wesixeko oyakwaziwa yi-Office of the Premier. Ukuhambisa iinkampu zokunyanzelwa ngokulandelwa kwe-National Communication Strategic Framework kwaye nakwi-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), kunye ne-Provincial MTDP nenkqubo yokuqamba-ithetha. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisa i-Norms and Standards of Government Communications kwindalo yokuqamba-ithetha kwephondo nokunikela inkxaso kwi-Local Government Communication System. Ukuqamba kwaye ulondoloze ubudlelwane nobunginqinya bokunyanzelwa kumthetho wesixeko ovela kurhulumente nakuwo wonke umntu. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba ngokukhuthaza kuyo yonke imigquba yomthetho wesixeko, kwaye unikeze inkokheli ngokuchanekileyo kwinkqubo yomthetho wesixeko kumagqiba njengoko kufuneka ngokukhawuleza nangokukhubekileyo ukwenza, ukuyilunga nokomeleza isihloko karhulumente. Ukusebenzela isixeko esisebenzayo, nokukwazi ukulawula urhulumente wokuqamba-ithetha. Ukubonisa kwaye ulungiselele imiba yokulawula, kwaye alawule isixhobo sokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokunceda ekulawuleni. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwindalo yokulungiselela isixhobo sokulawula, kwaye alawule iimpendulo zemibuzo yokuqamba-ithetha.

jobs.title: Director: Financial Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive package), of which 70% will be basic salary and 30% may be structured according to an individual’s needs.
jobs.summary: Director of Financial Management at GCIS in Pretoria, requiring a relevant bachelor's degree and Nyukela certificate, offering R1,317,384 per annum at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Financial Management, Accounting, Auditing, Economics / Financial Economics, Statistics or an equivalent qualification, majoring in Financial Management, Accounting, Auditing, Economics / Financial Economics / Statistics. Successful completion of the Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme (Nyukela certificate) as endorsed by the National School of Government is a pre-requisite for appointment. At least five (5) years’ extensive middle / senior management level experience in managing and facilitating the provision of financial management services in the department. The incumbent must have extensive understanding of the public sector financial statements and budget and project cycles, and managing the provision of public finance support services. Provide guidance and inputs on the formulation and implementation of budget policy for the MTEF budget process. Monitor, evaluation and analysing departments’ spending of the approved budget. Ensure value for money in terms of strategic resourcing. Provide guidance on the formulation and implementation of the adjustment budget. Proven leadership capabilities, people management and sound interpersonal and project management skills. Must have a valid driver’s license and be computer literate. Core Competencies: Strategic Capacity and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Change Management, Programme and Project Management.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible to provide effective, efficient and compliant financial management services, develop and monitor the implementation of financial administration and accounting, policies, systems and processes. Provide management accounting services and monitor and report on expenditure trends. Monitor and report on expenditure trends and compilation of financial statements. Identify, manage and implement risk and risk mitigation plans for the achievement of GCIS objectives. Develop financial reports with internal and external stakeholders. Manage relations with National Treasury and the Auditor-General. Manage expenditure trends and all financial matters. Oversee the process of reviewing departmental financial policies and ensure compliance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and related prescripts. Monitor the issuing of guidelines by National Treasury. Ensure timely settlement of contractual obligations, payment of invoices and quarterly tranches to Public Entities in line with the prescribed period as outline in PFMA, Treasury Regulations and cashflow projections. Oversee the monitoring, clearance and reconciliation of ledger accounts and ensure financial reports are compiled and submitted to the relevant forum. Oversee the processes of the annual budget cycle and ensure all deadlines are met. Oversee operational and personnel costing. Provide statistical reports on expenditure trends against the budget. Report projected under/overspending against the budget to relevant structures. Report proposed funding of ad-hoc activities and proposed virement to fund projected over expenditure. Oversee and review the IYM Report and submit to relevant structures in line with the PFMA. Identify and review strategic risks, oversee and manage the implementation mitigation plans. Participate in the audit planning process and manage responses to audit queries. Oversee the drafting and submission of accurate interim and annual financial statements. Serve as the link between the department and Auditor- General during audit processes and arrange Audit Steering Committee meetings. Ensure that amendments to the financial statements, updates of the Modified Cash Standards and Accounting Manual for Departments are implemented on the GCIS financial statements and accounting processes. Oversee the functions of the BAS System Controller and review reports. Effective management of staff, expose staff to development opportunities and ensure timeous submission of performance agreements and assessments Ensure prudent financial management of the directorate’s resources. Facilitate monthly Financial Control Forum meetings with Finance staff. Identify, manage and implement risk and risk mitigation plans for the achievement of GCIS objectives. When the need arise, the incumbent may be requested to act as Chief Financial Officer in the absence of the Chief Financial Officer.
jobs.applications: Applicants must submit their applications via the link http://erecruitment.gcis.gov.za or hand deliver applications to Tshedimosetso House, 1035 cnr Francis Baard & Festival streets, Hatfield, Pretoria. FOR ATTENTION : Ms P Kgopyane
jobs.notes: It is a pre-requisite for candidates to have the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre Entry Programme certificate to be eligible for appointment. For further details, please             click          on           the          following          link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry-programme/.              For more information regarding the course, visit the NSG website: www.thensg.gov.za. The successful candidate must disclose to the Minister particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign the employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty as well as sign a performance agreement with the relevant Chief Director within three months from the date of assumption of duty and obtain a Top-Secret security clearance. Note: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Please detail courses passed in the CV as per the academic transcript. Suitably qualified People with disabilities will be given preference regardless of Race or Gender. OTHER POSTS Applicants with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The old prescribed application or employment form Z83 was withdrawn with effect from 31 December 2020. As per the Government Gazette No: 43872, any applicant who submits an application on or after 1 January 2021 must do so on the new prescribed Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Failure to submit an application on the new prescribed Z83 form will lead to disqualification. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae. Communication regarding submission of certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from the department. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The successful candidate must disclose to the DG particulars of all registrable financial interests, sign a performance agreement and employment contract with the DG within three months from the date of assumption of duty and obtain a top-secret security clearance. All appointments are subject to the verification of educational qualifications, previous experience, citizenship, reference checks and security vetting. The department reserves the right to fill or not to fill the vacant post. The successful candidates will enter into an employment contract with the GCIS that will be reviewed based on performance expiration. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of section 11 (1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA), for your personal information which you provide to the Government Communication and Information System (“GCIS”) being processed by the GCIS and its employees, agents, cabinet committees, and sub-contractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Finansiële Bestuur by GCIS in Pretoria, wat 'n tersaaklike baccalaureusgraad en Nyukela-sertifikaat vereis, met 'n aanbod van R1,317,384 per annum op SMS-vlak 13.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur SAQA) in Finansiële Bestuur, Rekeningkunde, Oudit, Ekonomie / Finansiële Ekonomie, Statistiek of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie, met Finansiële Bestuur, Rekeningkunde, Oudit, Ekonomie / Finansiële Ekonomie / Statistiek as hoofvakke. Die suksesvolle voltooiing van die Publieke Diens Senior Bestuursleierskapsprogram (Nyukela-sertifikaat) soos goedgekeur deur die Nasionale Skool van Regering is 'n voorvereiste vir aanstelling. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se omvattende midde-/seniorbestuursvlak-ervaring in die bestuur en facilitering van die verskaffing van finansiële bestuursdienste in die departement. Die ampshouer moet 'n omvattende begrip hê van die openbare sektor se finansiële state en begrotings- en projektsiklusse, asook die bestuur van die verskaffing van openbare finansiële ondersteuningsdienste. Voorsien leiding en insetsels oor die formulering en implementering van begrotingsbeleid vir die MTEF-begrotingsproses. Monitor, evaluer en ontleed departemente se besteding van die goedgekeurde begroting. Verseker waarde vir geld ten opsigte van strategiese hulpbronbenutting. Voorsien leiding oor die formulering en implementering van die aanpassingsbegroting. Bewese leierskapsvermoëns, mensebestuur en goeie interpersoonlike en projekbestuursvaardighede. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê en rekenaargaletter wees. Kernteenstellings: Strategiese Kapasiteit en Leierskap, Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Program- en Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees om doeltreffende, doeltreffende en voldoende finansiële bestuursdienste te verskaf, en die implementering van finansiële administrasie en rekeningkunde, beleide, stelsels en prosesse te ontwikkel en te monitor. Verskaf bestuursrekeningkundige dienste en monitor en rapporteer oor bestedingsneigings. Monitor en rapporteer oor bestedingsneigings en samestelling van finansiële state. Identifiseer, bestuur en implementeer risiko- en risikobeperkingsplanne vir die bereiking van GCIS-doelwitte. Ontwikkel finansiële verslae met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Bestuur verhoudings met die Nasionale Tesourie en die Ouditeur-Generaal. Bestuur bestedingsneigings en alle finansiële aangeleenthede. Hou toesig oor die proses om departementele finansiële beleide te hersien en verseker nakoming van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en verwante voorskrifte. Monitor die uitreik van riglyne deur die Nasionale Tesourie. Verseker tydige vereffening van kontraktuele verpligtinge, betaling van fakture en kwartaallikse tranjes aan Publieke Entiteite ooreenkomstig die voorgeskrewe tydperk soos uiteengesit in die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en kontantvloojeks. Hou toesig oor die monitering, klaring en rekonsiliasie van rekeninguittrekkings en verseker dat finansiële verslae opgestel en aan die relevante forum voorgelê word. Hou toesig oor die prosesse van die jaarlikse begrotingsiklus en verseker dat alle sperdatums nagekom word. Hou toesig oor bedryfs- en personeelkoste. Verskaf statistiese verslae oor bestedingsneigings teenoor die begroting. Rapporteer geprojekteerde onder/bo-besteding teenoor die begroting aan relevante strukture. Rapporteer voorgestelde befondsing van ad hoc-aktiwiteite en voorgestelde oorboeking om geprojekteerde bo-besteding te befonds. Hou toesig oor en hersien die IYM-verslag en dien dit aan relevante strukture voor ooreenkomstig die PFMA. Identifiseer en hersien strategiese risiko's, hou toesig oor en bestuur die implementering van mitigasieplanne. Neem deel aan die ouditbeplanningsproses en bestuur response op ouditnavrae. Hou toesig oor die opstel en indien van akkurate tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state. Dien as skakel tussen die departement en die Ouditeur-Generaal tydens ouditprosesse en reël Ouditstuurkomiteevergaderings. Verseker dat wysigings aan die finansiële state, opdaterings van die Modified Cash Standards en Accounting Manual for Departments geïmplementeer word op die GCIS-finansiële state en rekeningkundige prosesse. Hou toesig oor die funksies van die BAS-stelselbeheerder en hersien verslae. Effektiewe bestuur van personeel, blootstelling van personeel aan ontwikkelingsgeleenthede en verseker tydige indiening van prestasieooreenkomste en assesserings. Verseker versigtige finansiële bestuur van die direktoraat se hulpbronne. Fasiliteer maandelikse Finansiële Beheerforum-vergaderings met Finansiespersoneel. Identifiseer, bestuur en implementeer risiko- en risikobeperkingsplanne vir die bereiking van GCIS-doelwitte. Wanneer die behoefte ontstaan, kan van die ampshouer versoek word om as Hoof Finansiële Beampte waar te neem in die afwesigheid van die Hoof Finansiële Beampte.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwezezimali
zu.summary: Umphathi Wokuphathwa Kwezezimali e-GCIS e-Pretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-bachelor's eziyinhloko nesitifiketi se-Nyukela, senikeza i-R1,317,384 ngonyaka e-izingeni le-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's eziyinhloko (NQF level 7 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA) kokuPhathwa Kwezezimali, ukuBala izimali, ukuHlolwa kwezimali, i-Economics / i-Financial Economics, i-Statistics noma isiqu esiyisilinganiso, esigxile kukuPhathwa Kwezezimali, ukuBala izimali, ukuHlolwa kwezimali, i-Economics / i-Financial Economics / i-Statistics. Ukuphumelela kwenkqubo ye-Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme (isitifiketi se-Nyukela) njengokuqashiwe yi-National School of Government kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokumiselwa. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yeminyaka evamile yohlelo lokuphatha okumaphakathi / ephakeme ohleweni lokuphatha nokuqondisa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwezezimali emnyangweni. Umphathi kufanele abe nokugqamisa ukuzuva ngemibhalo yezimali yomphakathi kanye nejikeleza lejabgethi namaphrojekthi, nokuphathwa kokunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokusekela izimali zomphakathi. Nikeza inkulelo nezimomvo ekwakheni nokuphoqa inqubomgomo yejabgethi yenkqubo ye-MTEF budget process. Qapha, hlola futhi uhlaziye ukushajwa kweminyango kwejethi evunyiwe. Qinisekisa inani lemalini ngokwethenja ngezingcezu eziyinhloko. Nikeza inkulelo ekwakheni nokuphoqa i-adjustment budget. Amandla abonakalayo okuholayo, abakhoyo ekuphathweni kwabantu nobukhulu bekhono bokubambisana nabantu nokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi. Kufanele abe ne-licence yokushayela evumelekile futhi akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla Ayingqayizivele: Amandla Nobuhlakahle Bokuhola, Ukuphathwa Kwabantu Nokuguqula, Ukuphathwa Kwezezimali, Ukuphathwa Kokushintsha, Ukuphathwa Kwenkqubo Namaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Umqashi ophumelelayo uzobe nesibopho sokunikeza izinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwezezimali ezisebenzayo, ezihamba kahle futhi ezilandela imithetho, zakhwe futhi ziqhutshwe ukuphathwa kwezezimali kanye nezimali, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo namasistimu. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokubala izimali zokuphatha futhi uqhathe futhi utshele nge-trends zokuHariswa kwemali. Qapha futhi utshele nge-trends zokuHariswa kwemali nokuqoqwa kwemibhalo yezimali. Qapha, phatha futhi uphoqe amaphulani okunciphisa i-risk nokwenza amaphulani okunciphisa i-risk ukuze kufezeke izinjongo ze-GCIS. Butha imibhalo yezimali nabahlangenanyanga bangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Phatha ubudlelwane ne-National Treasury ne-Auditor-General. Phatha i-trends zokuHariswa kwemali nazo zonke izindaba eziphathelene nezimali. Qapha inqubo yokubuyisa kabusha izinqubomgomo zezimali zomnyango futhi uqinisekise ukuzilandela i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations nemiyalo edingekayo. Qapha ukukhishwa kwezinkulelo yi-National Treasury. Qinisekisa ukukhokhwa ngasikhathi sapho isibopho senkontilaka, inkululo kwamafomu kanye namajantjeli ajwayelekile kuma-Public Entities ngokuhambisana nesikhathi esibekiwe njengoba kuchaziwe ku-PFMA, ku-Treasury Regulations nakumaprojekshini ze-cashflow. Qapha, susa futhi uhambisanise ama-ledger accounts futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imibhalo yezimali iqoqwe futhi ithunyelwe eforhamu eliyingqayizivele. Qapha izinqubo zebanga lonke lejabgethi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imikhawulo ihambisana ngasikhathi. Qapha izindleko zokusebenza nezabantu. Nikeza imibhalo ye-statistics nge-trends zokuHariswa kwemali ngokumelana nejabgethi. Tshelela izakhiwo eziyinhloko nge-projection yokunganuki/honga ukushajwa ngaphezulu ngokumelana nejabgethi. Tshelela ngenkulelo yokuxhaswa kwemisebenzi ezezikhathi namakhono ngenkulelo ye-virement yokuxhasa i-projection yokushajwa ngaphezulu kwemali. Qapha futhi ubuyeke i-IYM Report futhi uyithumele kuzakhiwo eziyinhloko ngokuhambisana ne-PFMA. Qapha futhi uhlole i-strategic risks, qapha futhi phatha ukuphoqa kwamaphulani okunciphisa i-risk. Thatha inxaxhema kwinqubo yokuhlela i-audit futhi uphathe izimpendulo kumabuzo e-audit. Qapha ukubhalwa nokuthunyelwa kwemibhalo yezimali yabaphakathi neyabonyakeni obunyene. Yiba yisixhumanisi phakathi komnyango ne-Auditor-General ngesikhathi kwenziwa i-audit futhi uhlele izinkumbe ze-Audit Steering Committee. Qinisekise ukuthi inguquko kwemibhalo yezimali, izinguquko kwi-Modified Cash Standards kanye ne-Accounting Manual for Departments kufakwe kwemibhalo yezimali ye-GCIS nasezinqubweni zobuhlelo. Qapha imisebenzi ye-BAS System Controller futhi uhlole imibalo. Uphathe abantu ngokusebenzayo,vezitsha abantu emathuba abakhulu beseqinisekisa isikhathi esihambisayo sokuthunyelwa kwezinkulelo zobuhlelo nokuhlola. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezezimali ngeqedile yeminyango. Hola izinkumbi ze-Financial Control Forum zanyanga zonke nabasebenzi be-Finance. Qapha, phatha futhi uphoqe amaphulani okunciphisa i-risk nokwenza amaphulani okunciphisa i-risk ukuze kufezeke izinjongo ze-GCIS. Xa kunesidingo, umphathi angacelwa ukuba abe ngu-Acting Chief Financial Officer ekuhambeni kuka-Acting Chief Financial Officer.

xh.title: Um lawuli: ulawulo lweemali
xh.summary: Umlawuli Wolawulo Lweemali kwi-GCIS ePretoria, ofuna isidanga esifanelekileyo se-bachelor kunye nesatifikethi se-Nyukela, enika i-R1,317,384 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-Bachelor (inqanaba le-NQF 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Financial Management, i-Accounting, i-Auditing, i-Economics / i-Financial Economics, i-Statistics okanye izifundo ezingabalinganiswa, ezinegumbi elikhulu kwi-Financial Management, i-Accounting, i-Auditing, i-Economics / i-Financial Economics / i-Statistics. Ukuqeda ngempumelelo i-Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme (isatifikethi se-Nyukela) njengokuqinisekiswa yi-National School of Government ngumfuno wangaphambili wokuqeshwa. Ubuncinane iinyanga ezintlanu (5) zoluhlu lweemfundo ephakathi / ephezulu yolawulo kwinkqubo yolawulo nokuququzelela ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo zolawulo lweemali kwisebe. Umntu oqeshwayo kufuneka abe nokuqonda okubanzi ngemagazini ezeemali zoluntu nako malunga neesikelo kunye neejikqo zephulo, nangolawulo lokunikezela iinkonzo zoxhaso lweemali koluntu. Nikela isikhokelo nezimvo ekusekweni nakuphunyezweni kwemigaqo yesikelo kwinkqubo yesikelo ye-MTEF. Qaphela, hlola nokuhlaziya ukuchithwa kwemali yamasebe kwesikelo esamkelekileyo. Qinisekisa ixabiso lemali malunga nokuzisebenzela ngokweembono ezibalulekileyo. Nikela isikhokelo ekusekweni nakuphunyezweni kwesikelo esilungisiweyo. Iindlela ezibonakalayo zobukhosi abantu abanamandla okuzithabisa, ulawulo labantu, amakhono abantu oyimfama kunye nolawulo lwephulo. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela eseyinyani athi nakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla Aplikayo: Amandla Eplano Nobukhosi, Ulawulo Abantu Nokuzinika Amandla, Ulawulo Lweemali, Ulawulo LokuTshintsha, Ulawulo Lweplano Neprojekthi.
xh.duties: Umama ophumeleleyo uyakuba necwaka lokunika inkonzo yolawulo lweemali esebenzayo, echanekileyo, esebenza ngokomthetho, aphinde ahlakulele aze alawule ukuphunyezwa kweendlela zolawulo nobhalo weemali, iinkqubo, iinkqubo neenkqubo. Nikela iinkonzo zolawulo lobhalo weemali aze alawule axele ngemigangatho yokuchithwa kwemali. Qaphela axele ngemigangatho yokuchithwa kwemali nokuqulunqa iigazini zeemali. Qaphela, lawule aze aphuhlise iingozi neenkqubo zokunciphisa iingozi ukuba kufezwe iinjongo ze-GCIS. Dala iingxelo zeemali kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Lawula ubudlelwane ne-National Treasury ne-Auditor-General. Lawula imigangatho yokuchithwa kwemali nayo yonke imiba yeemali. Lawula inkqubo yokuphonononga iinkqubo zeemali zesebe uze uqiniseke ulandelo lwe-PFMA, iindwendwe zeTreasury nemigaqo ephathelene nayo. Qaphela ukuphumisa iinkqubo ze-National Treasury. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kwexesha lembuyekezo yemisebenzi yokusebenza, intlawulo yee-invoisi nako kuthotho lwenyanga zabathathi-nxaxheba koluntu ngokwexesha elithiweyo njengokuchaziweyo kwi-PFMA, iindwendwe zeTreasury noko kukubhaliswa kwemali. Lawula ukulawula ukucoca nokulinganisa kwama-akhawunti abhalisiweyo uze uqinisekisa ukuba iingxelo zeemali ziqulunqwe kuthunyelwe kwindlu yabalinganiswa. Lawula iinkqubo zomjikelo wesikelo wonyaka uze uqinisekise ukuba onke amaxesha agqitywe. Lawula iindleko zokusebenza nazoabantu. Nikela iingxelo ngeentsingisile malunga nemigangatho yokuchithwa kwemali ngokuchasana nesikelo. Xela ukungaliseleli / ukugqitha kwesikelo malunga nesikelo kumacandelo abalulekileyo. Xela ukusikwa kweemali okunconywayo kwezinye iimisebenzi nakusikwa okunconywayo kokuxhasa ukugqitha okuchaziweyo kwemali. Lawula aze uphondo iingxelo kwindlu yakho malunga nalawulo i-PFMA. Qaphela aze uphondo iingozi ezibalulekileyo, ulawule uze ulawule ukuphunyezwa kweendlela zokunciphisa. Thatha inxaxheba kumanyano okuqamba okwangaphambili ulawule iimpendulo kumabuzo okuhlolwa. Lawula ukubhaliswa nokuthunyelwa kweegazini ezichanekileyo ngeemali ezinganyanga zonyaka nako kuzo zonyaka. Yiba ngumthi nxaxheba phakathi kwisebe ne-Auditor-General phakathi kolawulo ulawulo iinkqubo ulungele iinkqubo zabantu nabahola ulawulo. Qinisekisa ukuba izigqibo kwigazini zeemali, izihlaziyo zama-Magazini wamagama aze idityaniswe kwigazini yendlela yemali kwiinkqubo zolawulo iinkqubo ze-GCIS. Lawula imisebenzi ye-BAS System Controller aze upheondo iingxelo. Ulawulo olusebenzayo labantu, veza abantu kuthuba lokukhula uze uqinisekise ukutyalwa ngexesha kwemigqetho yokuvumelana nokulinganiswa. Qinisekisa ulawulo olucokileyo lweemali zemali yolawulo ngokusebenzisa izixhobo zeemali zodumo. Ququzelela iinkqubo zenyanga zokuqinisekisa ulawulo iinkqubo nabasebenzi bemali. Qaphela, lawule aze Uphuhlise iingozi neendlela zokunciphisa iingozi ukuba kufezwe iinjongo ze-GCIS. Xa kusetyenziswa, umntu oqeshiweyo angacelwa ukuba abe nguChief Financial Officer xaku-ngaleyobungalikhoyo kukaChief Financial Officer.

jobs.reference_number: 3/1/5/1-26/34 Chief Directorate: Strategy and Organisational Performance
jobs.title: Casual Worker: Strategy and Organisational
jobs.salary_text: Hourly rate of R156,40 for a maximum of twenty-four (24) hours per month
jobs.summary: Casual worker sought to assist with coordinating performance plans and operational procedures at GCIS in Pretoria, requiring a diploma or degree in Public Management or Administration.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an appropriate National Diploma (NQF level 6) or Degree (NQF level 7) in Public Management or Administration. No Experience required. Ability to work independently without close supervision. Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and able to work under pressure. The incumbent should be self-driven, creative, innovative, flexible and highly motivated. Excellent co-ordination skills. Ability to work in a team. Client service orientated. Have initiative and pay close attention to detail. Knowledge of the Microsoft packages, i.e. MS word, MS Excel as well as Ms Outlook.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for assisting in Coordinating the development of the Annual Performance Plan (APP) and Annual Operational Plan (AOP);Coordinating the development of the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Service Delivery Mode (SDM) and Service Delivery Improvement Plan (SDIP).verification and analysis of reports (i.e. monthly, quarterly, annual, mid-term and end term reports);development and completion of verification and analysis working papers; capturing of APP and AOP into Organisational Performance and Management System (OPMS); capturing of APP into electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting System (eQPRS); and administration of OPMS. In line with the Directive on the Professionalisation of Human Resource Management and Development in Public Service, all shortlisted candidates will undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine their suitability based on the technical and generic requirements of the post. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Please detail courses passed in the CV as per the academic transcript.
jobs.applications: Applicants must submit their applications via the link http://erecruitment.gcis.gov.za or hand deliver applications to Tshedimosetso House, 1035 cnr Francis Baard & Festival streets, Hatfield, Pretoria. FOR ATTENTION : Ms P Kgopyane
jobs.notes: Applicants with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The old prescribed application or employment form Z83 was withdrawn with effect from 31 December 2020. As per the Government Gazette No: 43872, any applicant who submits an application on or after 1 January 2021 must do so on the new prescribed Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Failure to submit an application on the new prescribed Z83 form will lead to disqualification. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae. Communication regarding submission of certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from the department. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The successful candidate must disclose to the DG particulars of all registrable financial interests, sign a performance agreement and employment contract with the DG within three months from the date of assumption of duty and obtain a top-secret security clearance. All appointments are subject to the verification of educational qualifications, previous experience, citizenship, reference checks and security vetting. The department reserves the right to fill or not to fill the vacant post. The successful candidates will enter into an employment contract with the GCIS that will be reviewed based on performance expiration. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of section 11 (1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA), for your personal information which you provide to the Government Communication and Information System (“GCIS”) being processed by the GCIS and its employees, agents, cabinet committees, and sub-contractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wangesikhathi Esithile: Isu Nokuhleleka Kwenhlangano
zu.summary: Kufunwa umsebenzi wangesikhathi esithile ongasese ekuxhumeni kukahlela izinhlela zokuqonda imigomo nemigomo yokusebenza e GCIS e Pretoria, ofuna idiploma noma idigri ezenzululwazi zokuPhatha Komphakathi nokuQondisa.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma (NQF level 6) noma i-Degree (NQF level 7) efanelekile ku-Public Management nokuAdministration. Akukho mpilo yomsebenzi edingekayo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngodwa ngaphandle kokuphatwa okuseduze. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa kanye nokusebenza ngaphansi kwegesi. Umsebenzi kufanele azinikelo, abe nomqondo obophezelayo, abe ngumuntu osungula izinto ezintsha, athathekele kakhulu anemicabango ephezulu. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumanisa. Ikhono lokusebenza ohlwini. Ukuqondiswe ekukhonzeni abathengi. Aze afake isandla aqaphele kakhulu imininingwane. Ukwazi izinto ze-Microsoft, njengokuthi yi-MS word, MS Excel kanye ne-Ms Outlook.
zu.duties: Umphakeli opumelelayo uzobe nesibopho sokusiza ekuxhumeni kokuhleleka kokuthuthukiswa kwe-Annual Performance Plan (APP) kanye ne-Annual Operational Plan (AOP); Ekuxhumeni kokuthuthukiswa kwe-Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Service Delivery Mode (SDM) kanye ne-Service Delivery Improvement Plan (SDIP). ukugcinwa nokucazulwa kwemibiko (okungukuthi, okunyanga zonke, kwesikhashana, ngomnyaka, phakathi kwesikhathi nasekupheleni kwesikhathi); ukuthuthukiswa kokuqedwa kwamaphepha okusebenza okugcinwa nokucazulwa; ukufaka i-APP ne-AOP ku-Organisational Performance and Management System (OPMS); ukufaka i-APP kulesi sikhulu sokubika ngokusikhathi e-electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting System (eQPRS); nokuqondisa i-OPMS. Ngokuhambisana nomyalo ohlephayo ekubuzweni komsebenzi oqeqeshiwe kokuQondisa nabantu kuPublic Service, bonke abaphakanyiswayo bazozenza isivivinyo sokuhlolwa ngaphambi kokungena njengenye yezindlela zokuqinisekisa ukufaneleka kwabo ngokusekelwe ezidingweni ezihlobene nentando yomsebenzi namagama awo jikelele wesikhundla. Amaphanela okukhetha azobhala amaphuzu emisebenzi yobuchwepheshe njengesinyathelo esingeziwe endleleni yesivivinyo sokukhuluma. Sicela ubhale izifundo edlule kwi-CV njengoba kubhalwe esitsheni samanje.

xh.title: Umsebenzi ongavuyisanga: Iqwesha nokuhlelwa kweMbumba
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umsebenzi ongavuyisanga onceda ekulungelelaniseni iindlela zokuvelisa imveliso nemigaqo yokusebenza kwi-GCIS ePretoria, efunayo idiploma okanye isidanga kokuLawula kuRhengolwazi lokuzele okanye uLawulo.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe ne-National Diploma (NQF level 6) okanye i-Degree (NQF level 7) efanelekileyo kokuLawula kuRhengolwazi lokuzele okanye uLawulo. Akukho Mfuno yenkqubo yokulinga. Ikhono lokusebenza uzimele ngaphandle kolawulo olusondeleyo. Ikhono lokuphatha imisebenzi emininzi ngexesha elinye nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Umntu obole kule sithuba kufuneka azikhethele, angaqamba izinto entsha, afleksibhile anemotiveshini ephezulu. Ikhono elihle lokulungelelanisa izinto. Ikhono lokusebenza kwinqanaba. Uqwalaselo lwalathelo kumthengi. Abakho isigqibo kwaye bachathe ingqalelo kumfanekiso ongakanani. Ulwazi ngeempahla ze-Microsoft, oko kukuthi i-MS word, i-MS Excel naye i-Ms Outlook.
xh.duties: Umntu ofunyenweyo uya kubizwa ngokuba nguwo oncedo ekulungelelaniseni ukuqeqesha iNqanaba lokuQhuba iNkcukacha zeNyanga (APP) neNqanaba lokuSebenza iNkcukacha zeNyanga (AOP);Ekulungelelaniseni ukuqeqesha le miQathango esemthethweni yokusebenza (SOPs), iNqanaba lokuNika iNkonzo (SDM) neNqanaba lokuPhucula iNkonzo yokunikela (SDIP).ukuqinisekisa nokwahlulela iingxelo (oko kukuthi iingxelo zenyanga, zekwikota, zonyaka, zaphakathi kwexesha nangasentsheni kwexesha);ukuqeqesha nokugqiba amaphepha okuqinisekisa nokwahlulela; ukufaka i-APP ne-AOP kwiiNkcukacha zokuQhuba nokulawula iMbumba (OPMS); ukufaka i-APP kwiiNkcukacha zokuQhuba iNgxelo zeKwikota ezibhalwe ngokuqinisekileyo (eQPRS); nokuLawula i-OPMS. Ngokulandela iMiyalelo malunga nokwenza ngobuchule uLawulo lokuzelelwa kweMbumba nokuphuhliswa kwenkqubo yoLawulo kwiNkonzo kaRhengolwazi, bonke abagqibi kwelenqwelo baya kwenza isixhobo sokuzilolonga ngaphambi kokungena njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinga ukumisela ukufaneleka kwabo ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno zobuchwe nezeqonga zale sithuba. Iqela labantu abakhethayo liza kuphawula zombini iindlela zokuqhuba izixhobo zobuchwe njengemigaqo engezwayo kwinkqubo yovavanyo lwemibuzo. Nceda nicheze iimodyule ozipassile kwi-CV njengoko kukhankanyiwe kwirekhode yezemfundo.
