zu.title: Umsebenzi Wesikhashana: Isu Nokuhleleka Kwent_pipe
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi wesikhashana wokubika ngesu nokuhleleka kwent_pipe kuma-GCIS e-Pretoria, okudinga i-National Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-Public Management noma i-Administration.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma (NQF level 6) noma i-Degree (NQF level 7) efanelekileyo kwi-Public Management noma i-Administration. Akukho Experience edingekayo. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa ngaphandle kolawulo oluseduzane. Ikhono lokuphatha imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa nelokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga. Lowo othweswe isikhundla kufanele azimotofuse, abe nomqondo oqhamukayo, abe uyisinhloboshajamakhono, abe noguquguqukayo futhi anemotivesheni ephezulu. Amakhono ohlelo oluhle kakhulu. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini. Uqwalaselo kolwazi oluhle kumthengi. Abe nesibonakaliso futhi anelise imininingwane emincane. Ulwazi nge-Microsoft packages, i.e. MS word, MS Excel kanye ne-Ms Outlook.
zu.duties: Umfakazi ophumelelayo uzobe nephuzu lokuhlolwa kanye nokuqoqwa kohlahlebeke ngezibalo (i.e. ngenyanga, kwezikwethu, njalo ngonyaka, phakathi ngesikhathi nasekupheleni kwesikhathi somsebenzi), ukuthuthukiswa nokwenziwa komsebenzi wezincwadi ezahlukene zokuhlolwa nokweluleka kumzabalazo wokwenza izibalo, ukufaka izibalo zamakhodi ezindaweni ezahlukene zokusetshenziswa, ukubhaliswa kwedatha, ukubhaliswa kwamanye amasu omsebenzi kulesi sitsha sokuhlela; nezibalo ezitholwa lapha kwi-Organisational Performance and Management System (OPMS), ukufakwa kwedatha kulesi sikhala sokubika ngemitholampilo ye-electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting System (eQPRS); kanye nokuphatwa kwe-OPMS. Ngokuhambisana nokuqinisekiswa kokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yeminyuzi yomsebenzi wamakhaladi emkhakheni womsebenzi wawo wonke wonke amakhulu omphakathi, wonke amakhaladi abhaliswe kuhlu bazokwenza isivivinyo somsebenzi wangaphambili njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlolwa ukuze kubonakale ukuthi bangarhweba ngokuhambisana nezidingo zemikhakha eziseduzane nangokuhlelekile kwalesi sikhundla. Amaphaneli okukhetha azokwazi ukusheshelela izivivinyo ezibhaliwe njengoba kunesimanqamulo ngokusekelwa kuzigaba ezihlelekile kohlahlebeke kumkhakha wokusebenza. Sicela ubhale imifundi edlulile kwi-CV njengoba kubhaliwe kwi-academic transcript.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wexesha: IStrategy nokuziphatha kweSebe
xh.summary: Kufunekho umsebenzi wexesha wokubika ngestrategy nokuveliswa okuziphathayo kwisebe kwi-GCIS e-Pretoria, kufunekelo i-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-Public Management okanye i-Administration.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufunekuba nge-National Diploma (NQF level 6) okanye i-Degree (NQF level 7) efanelekileyo kwi-Public Management okanye i-Administration. Akukho phando lifunekayo. Amandla okusebenza kodwa ngaphandle kolawulo olusondelayo. Amandla okuphatha imisebenzi emininzi ngaxaanye kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Umntu ozele kulesi sithuba kufuneka aziqhayise ngokwakhewe, eze ngobuchre, ethe ngqo kwaye enomdla kakhulu. Amandla amaninzi okulungelelanisa. Amandla okusebenza eqeleni. Uqwalaselo kumxhasi. Anengqaqo kwaye atenzele ngakumbi kwiinkcukacha. Ulwazi ngeMicrosoft packages, oko kukuthi i-MS Word, i-MS Excel naka i-Ms Outlook.
xh.duties: Umama ogqibileyo uya kuba ngamandla okuqinisekisa nokuhlohla iireport (oko kukuthi. iireport zenyanga, zesikwere, zenyanga, phakathi nexesha nasekupheleni kwexesha), ukwakha nokugqibezela amaphepha okusebenza okuqinisekiswa nokuhlohlo, ukuthumela i-APP kwaye i-AOPs kwi-Organisational Performance and Management System (OPMS), ukuthumela i-APP kwi-electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting System (eQPRS); nolawulo lwe-OPMS. Ngokulandela i-Directive on the Professionalisation of Human Resource Management and Development in Public Service, bonke abagqibiswe koluhlu baza kwenza umbhalo wangaphambili wokungena njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinganisa ukuze kugqitywe ukufaneleka kwabo ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno ezinzima nangasemva kwesithuba. Iindlu ezikhethiweyo ziya kuphanda ngokulinganisa amandla obugcisa njengenkqubo ekongezelelweyo kwindlela yoxoxo. Nceda ubhalele iindonga adlulileyo kwi-CV njengoko kubhaliwe kwi-academic transcript.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Registration Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Manage student registration administration, including policy development, implementation monitoring and stakeholder workshops at the Department of Higher Education and Training corporate office.
jobs.requirements: Matric / Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Public Management / Public Administration / Business Administration or a relevant qualification. Must have minimum of 3 to 5 years relevant work experience in registration services preferably in the Public Sector or Institutions of Higher Learning of which 2-3 years should be on supervisory level. Must be computer literate. Must have a valid driver’s license. Competencies, Knowledge, And Skills: Knowledge and understanding of the registration processes and procedures. Knowledge of the TVET sector regulations and legislative framework. Knowledge of the Business Management Systems. Knowledge of practice notes, provincial and national policy frameworks relevant to Education, Training and Development. Knowledge of Skills Development Act, PSET Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act. Should have strong administrative, planning, organising, report writing, problem solving, project management and people management skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the administration of the overall student registration: Develop, review and monitor the implementation of policies and procedure in relation to student registration, admission, scheduling and records. Provide workshops on the implementation of policies and procedure in relation to student registration, admission, scheduling and records. Develop and implement student enrolment and registration standard operating procedures which are aligned to those of the Department. Establish and oversee the work of the College Enrolment Committee as well as the Student Selection Committee. Champion online application and registration processes. Advise on marketing strategies to attract new potential students. Manage and update the Management Information System to ensure data validity and integrity. Ensure data verification processes are carried out according to relevant data policies. Manage student registration and ensure proper procedures are followed. Develop and review registration documents for accuracy. Manage the database for new graduates and alumni into the job market. Ensure provisioning of pre-entry support services to student during the registration process in relation to (financial aid, bursaries, student accommodation). Coordinate the provision of guidance and testing of students, regarding choice of and placement within programmes. Develop and implement a filing/recordkeeping system for student records. Conduct monitoring and verification of student records across the delivery system/sites. Implement the Central Application System from DHET. Ensure overall supervision and maintenance of MIS licenses. Maintain and update database of students enrolled within programmes. Ensure that student orientations are conducted in all campuses. Oversee the provision of student financial aid and bursary services support: Ensure that the TVET Bursary Scheme is administered strictly according to the bursary rules and guidelines. Coordinate and chair the financial aid committee meeting and facilitate the awarding of approved college financial assistance programme. Verify compiled data on bursary statistics. Monitoring the tracking of student bursary requirements compliance and implement remedial initiative as required. Identify potential sponsors in recognising academic achievement. Manage the administration of student learning materials: Oversee issuing and collection of textbooks and learning materials.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Hlatshwayo/Mr P Motai Tel No: (011) 692 4004 Ext. 1010/1061/1062
jobs.applications: Please hand deliver your application or email it to asdregistration@westcol.co.za in a pdf format and as one attachment, quoting the relevant reference number to the Principal, Western TVET College, Corporate Office, 42 Johnstone Street, Randfontein, 1760.
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed NEW Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of original documents with academic records/transcripts and other relevant supporting documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR Office. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. If you have not been contacted within six months after the closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Western TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People with disability are encouraged to apply. Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Registrasiedienste
af.summary: Bestuur studentregistrasie-administrasie, insluitend beleidsontwikkeling, implementeringmonitering en belanghebbende-worskusse by die Department of Higher Education and Training korporatiewe kantoor.
af.requirements: Matriek / Graad 12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Openbare Bestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Besigheidsadministrasie of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3 tot 5 jaar tersaaklike werkervaring in registrasiedienste hê, verkieslik in die Openbare Sektor of Instellings van Hoër Onderwys, waarvan 2-3 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, En Vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van die registrasieprosesse en -prosedures. Kennis van die TVET-sektor se regulasies en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis van die Besigheidsbestuurstelsels. Kennis van praktyknotas, provinsiale en nasionale beleidsraamwerke wat relevant is tot Onderwys, Opleiding en Ontwikkeling. Kennis van die Skills Development Act, PSET Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act. Moet sterk administratiewe, beplannings-, organiseer-, verslagskryf-, probleemoplossings-, projekbestuur- en mensebestuursvaardighede hê.
af.duties: Bestuur die administrasie van die algehele studentregistrasie: Ontwikkel, hersien en monitor die implementering van beleid en prosedure met betrekking tot studentregistrasie, toelating, skedulering en rekords. Verskaf werkswinkels oor die implementering van beleid en prosedure met betrekking tot studentregistrasie, toelating, skedulering en rekords. Ontwikkel en implementeer standaardbedryfsprosedures vir studentinskrywing en -registrasie wat in lyn met dié van die departement is. Stig en hou toesig oor die werk van die College Enrolment Committee asook die Student Selection Committee. Beywer jou vir aanlyn toepassing en registrasieprosesse. Adviseer oor bemarkingstrategieë om nuwe potensiële studente aan te trek. Bestuur en werk die Bestuursinligtingstelsel by om data-geldigheid en -integriteit te verseker. Verseker dat dataverifikasieprosesse volgens tersaaklike databeleid uitgevoer word. Bestuur studentregistrasie en verseker dat behoorlike prosedures gevolg word. Ontwikkel en hersien registrasiedokumente vir akkuraatheid. Bestuur die databasis vir nuwe gegradueerdes en oud-studente in die arbeidsmark. Verseker die verskaffing van voor-toetreedondersteuningsdienste aan studente tydens die registrasieproses met betrekking tot (finansiële hulp, beurse, studentakkommodasie). Koördineer die verskaffing van leiding en toetsing van studente aangaande keuse van en plasing binne programme. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n lêer/rekordhou-stelsel vir studentrekords. Voer monitering en verifikasie van studentrekords oor die afleweringsisteem/terreine uit. Implementeer die Central Application System vanaf DHET. Verseker algehele toesig en onderhoud van MIS-lisensies. Onderhou en werk die databasis van studente wat binne programme ingeskryf is, by. Verseker dat studentoriëntasies op alle kampusse uitgevoer word. Hou toesig oor die verskaffing van studentfinansiële hulp en beursdiesteun: Verseker dat die TVET-beurskema streng volgens die beursreëls en -riglyne geadministreer word. Koördineer en voorsit die finansiële hulpkomitee-vergadering en fasiliteer die toekenning van die goedgekeurde kollege-finansiële bystandprogram. Verifieer saamgestelde data oor beursstatistiek. Monitor die naspoor van studentbeursvereiste-nakoming en implementeer regstellende inisiatief soos nodig. Identifiseer potensiële borge ter erkenning van akademiese prestasie. Bestuur die administrasie van studentleermateriaal: Hou toesig oor uitreiking en insameling van handboeke en leermateriaal.

zu.title: Umphathi Omsiza: Amasevisi Okubhalisa
zu.summary: Phatha imimangalo yokubhalisa kwabafundi, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ukulandelelwa ukusetshenziswa kwayo namakilasi abashokobezi ehhovisi lephini le-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric / Grade12 okuhlanganisa ne-Diploma Yezwe eminyaka emi-3 ezuqatshiwe noma i-Degree kwi-Public Management / Public Administration / Business Administration noma isiqu esihambisana nalokho. Kumele ube nokuhlangenwe komsebenzi okuncike ezindaweni ezithile iminyaka engu-3 kuya ku-5 kumasevisi okubhalisa ikakhulukazi kuMmango KaZwelonke noma Ezindaweni zemfundo ephakeme lapho iminyaka engu-2-3 kumele ibe ngaphezulu kulelo zinga lokuqondisa. Kumele ube nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Kumele ube nephesenti elivunyelwe yokushayela. Amandla, Ulwazi, Nobuciko: Ulwazi nokuqonda inqubo nezinqubo zokubhalisa. Ulwazi ngemithetho nongqongoqoqo lwesigaba se-TVET. Ulwazi ngamaphatho ebhizinisi. Ulwazi lwezIQUPHUMO ezithile, yonqongoqoqo zesifundazwe nasezwe ezihambisana nemfundo, ukuqeqesha nentuthuko. Ulwazi ngokuSkills Development Act, PSET Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations kanye noPublic Service Act. Kumele ube namakhono amakhulu omlingiswa, ukwelula, okuhlela, ukubhala ingxoxo, uxazululo lwezinkinga, okuqondisa amaphrojekthi nokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Phatha imimangalo yokubhalisa kabafundi ngokuphelele: Thuthukisa, bufake kabusha ulandelele ukusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo nendlela yokwenza mayelana nokubhaliswa kwabafundi, ukwamukelwa, ukulungiselela izikhathi nokugcina iziqopho. Nikeza amakilasi abashokobezi ngokuqaliswa kwenqubomgomo nendlela yokwenza mayelana nokubhaliswa kwabafundi, ukwamukelwa, ukulungiselela izikhathi nokugcina iziqopho. Thuthukisa futhi uqalise izinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile zokwamukela nokubhalisa abafundi ezihambisana nalezo zoMnyango. Sula futhi uqaphele umsebenzi weKomidi Yokwamukelwa iKholishi kanye neKomidi Yokukhethwa Kwabafundi. Yiba ngumsoli wezinqubo zokufaka izicelo nokubhalisa kwi-intanethi. Nikeza izeluleko ngamaphatho okumaketha okushukumisa abafundi abasha abanamathuba. Phatha futhi uvuselele iNqubo Yokulawula Ulwaze ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi amagama aqinile ayiqiniso. Qinisekisa ukuthi inqubo yokuhlola idatha yenziwa ngokulandelwa kwenqubomgomo yedatha ephilayo. Phatha ukubhaliswa kwabafundi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kulandelwa izinqubo ezifanele. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze amadokhumenti okubhalisa ukuze aqiniseke. Phatha idathhebhesi yeziqu ezintsha neziqu eziphume emsebenzini zisuke zingeniswa emakethini. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwesevisi yokweseka ngaphambi kokungena kwabafudi ngexesha lokubhalisa ngokuhlobene (umsizo wemali, izibursari, indawo yokuhlala yomfundi). Hlanganisa ukunikezwa kolwazi nokuhlolwa kwabafundi, ngokuphathelene nokukhetha kanye nokubekwa endaweni ezinhlelweni. Thuthukisa futhi uqalise isistimu yokugcina iziqopho yeziqopho zabafundi. Yenza ukulandelelwa ukuqinisekiswa kweziqopho zabafundi ezindaweni/zamasayithi okulethwa. Qalisa iCentral Application System esuka kuDHET. Qinisekisa ukuphatha okuphelele kanye nokuqondisa amalayisensi eMIS. Gcina futhi uvuselele idathhebhesi yabafundi ababhalisile ezinhlelweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi isikhathi sokwegcweka kwabafundi senziwa kuyo yonke imikhumzi. Qondisa ukunikezwa komsizo wemali yabafundi nezinkonzo ze-bursary: Qinisekisa ukuthi iSisimu Se-Bursary se-TVET silawulwa ngokuziphothwa ngokusho nemithetho nezinkomba zebhasari. Hlanganisa futhi ubambe iqhaza ukhokhela ikomidi lomsizo wemali futhi uhlose ukukhethwa kwenhlelo evunyiweyo yomsizo wemali wekholidi. Hola idatha ebuthwe ngobungalwe besibalo semali yesibindi. Ukulandelela ukuhlolwa kokuziphenduka kwezidingo zomsizi webhasari yomfundi futhi uqalise umkhankaso wokweluleka njengoko kudingeka. Hlola osponso abanamandla okuqaphela iziqu eziphumelelayo. Phatha imimangalo yezinsiza zokufunda zabafundi: Qaphele ukukhishwa nokuyiqhothwa kwezincwadi zokufunda nezinsiza zokufunda.

xh.title: Umphathi Wokhangelo: Iinkonzo Zokubhalisa
xh.summary: Phatha ulawulo lokubhaliswa kwabafundi, kuquka uphuhliso lweenkqubo, ukulawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo nakwiinkqubo zokusebenzisana nabathintekayo kwindawo enkulu yeSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric / Grade12 esikunye neDiploma yezi-3 zeminyaka eKumthethonkqubo ngokwamagazini okanye iDigra yokuLawula kuRhulumnde / uLawulo lukaRhulumnde / uLawulo lweShishini okanye nesiqwembu esifanelekileyo. Kufuneka kubekho iminyaka eli-3 ukuya kwe-5 yamava wokusebenza afanelekileyo kwinkonzo yokubhalisa ngokukhethwa kuloMmandla woLuntu okanye kwiZiko leMfundo ePhakamileyo apho iminyaka eli-2-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokuqonda. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka ube namalayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono, ulwazi, namava: Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo nezithethantlalo zokubhalisa. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-mthetho nendlela yomthetho wesector ye-TVET. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yoLawulo lweShishini. Ulwazi ngeenqobo zomsebenzi, iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo ngamasiko nengingqi ezithintela uMfundo, uQeqesho nokuPhuhliswa. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweakhoni, uMthetho we-PSET, uMthetho weQumrhuwo loBomi boMsebenzi, iMigaqo yoLuntu kwakunye noMthetho woLuntu. Kufuneka ube namakhono amakhulu olawulo, iplani yokuhlela, ukuqamba amanqaku, ukuzonakalisa iingxaki, ulawulo lweeprojekthi nakulawulo abantu.
xh.duties: Phatha ulawulo ngokubhaliswa kwabafudi ngokubanzi: Phuhlisa, hlola ulandelo lweenkqubo nemigaqo-nkqubo ngokubhaliswa kwabafundi, ukwamkelwa, ukuhlela ishedi negcina amarekhodi. Zenza iinkqubo zokusebenzisana ngokusebenza kweenkqubo nemigaqo ngokubhaliswa kwabafundi, ukwamkelwa, ukuhlela ishedi negcina amarekhodi. Phuhlisa ukuze kusebenze iinkqubo ezikumgangatho ophezulu zokubhalisa nokuqwaleka kwabafundi ezikwalingana nazo eZaseben. Sumba uze ulawule umsebenzi weKomiti yeNkqubo yokuBhalisa yaseKholeji nangeKomiti yokukhethwa kooFundi. Qedela iinkqubo zokufaka isicelo nokuBhalisa ngaphandle kwekhompyutha. Nikela ingcebiso ngeendlela zokuqamba ukuze ufithe abafundi abatsha abanokubakho. Phatha uze uhlaziye iNkqubo yoLawulo loLwazi ukuze uqinisekise ukuba lulwane idatha nangokuqikelelo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa idatha zenziwa ngokulandela iinkqubo zemigaqo-nkqubo. Phatha ukubhaliswa kwabafundi uze uqinisekise ukuba kulandelwa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Phuhlisa uze uhlale iinxholo zokuBhalisa ukuze zibe lulwane. Phatha isiseko sedatha yabafundi abatsha nabanikwe izixhobo abangene eluntwini. Qinisekisa ukubonelela ngkonzo zokuxhasa ngenkqubo yokubhalisa kubafudi malunga (uncedo lweemali, izibonelelo, indawo yokuhlala yabafundi). Hlela ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi nokuviwa kubafundi, malunga nokukhetha nokuBekwa ngaphakathi kweenkqubo. Phuhlisa ukuze kusebenze inkqubo yokugcina iinxholo/ukugcina amarekhodo. Qhuba ukuqwalasela nokuqinisekisa amarekhodo abafudi kuwo wonke amandulo. Susa inkqubo yokubhalisa kwesebe ngokusetyenziswa. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokubanzi nokugcina iilayisensi ze-MIS. Gcina uhlaziye isiseko sedatha yabafundi abanye kunenkqubo yokugcina amarekhodo. Qinisekisa ukubakho kokuzinika kwabafundi kwiziko ngelinye. Lawula ukubonelela ngeemali zokufundela abafundi nongenelelo lwemali: Qinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo yeBhasari ye-TVET ilawulwa ngokukhanya ngokumila nemigaqo. Hlela uze ubambe indibano yekomiti yemali yemfundo uze ukhuthaze ukunikwa kwenkqubo yemali esemthethweni yekholeji. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kolwazi ngokubaluleka kweebhasari. Lawula ulandelelwano lokuzelelwa ngokwemigaqo yamafutshane afana nokusetyenziswa koluntu. Qamba abaxhasi abanokubakho ngokuvakalisa impumelelo yemfundo. Phatha ulawulo ngemifanekiso yokufunda. Lawula ukunikwa nokubuyiswa kweencwadi zokufunda neemifanekiso yemfundo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Partnership and Linkages
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to manage partnerships and linkages strategies, requiring a diploma or degree in Project Management or Marketing with 3 to 5 years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Project Management/Marketing or a relevant qualification. Must have minimum of 3 to 5 years relevant work experience in Project Management or Business Development environment of which 2-3 years should be on supervisory level. Must be computer literate. Must have a valid driver’s license. Competencies, Knowledge, And Skills: Knowledge and understanding of Building partnerships. Must be innovative. Knowledge of Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury regulations and other frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of administration reporting process and procedures. Should have strong marketing and entrepreneur insight, financial Management, mobilising resources, interpretation of statutes, business planning and visibility analysis. Should have strong administrative, planning, organising, report writing, negotiation, problem solving, project management and people management skills.
jobs.duties: Partnerships Management: Provide inputs in developing growth partnership strategies and plans. Establish a database of local business and other linkages. Participate in business forums and identify project opportunities. Develop project proposals and plans for joint initiatives. Facilitate handover with the College managers. Establish, maintain and retain partnership with industry and relevant stakeholders. Business opportunities scanning: Identify opportunities for college income generation. Establish work environment simulation potential. Provide market needs business case rationale for all opportunities. Identify appropriate partner or service provider. Coordinate the submission of tenders and funding proposals. Provide information and reports on programmes, funding and partnership to DHET and other stakeholders. Local and Provincial government relations: Develop and update schedule of local government projects and opportunities. Identify College synergies potential contribution to provincial departments. Build relationships with relevant stakeholders, establish a database of key contacts and participate in meetings as appropriate. Develop proposals for partnering on specific practical opportunities aligned with College core business. Research Management: Conduct feasibility studies for all new and proposed projects. Develop the project and budget. Partner with relevant research organisations. Negotiate and initiate signing of Memorandum of Understandings, service level agreements and or contracts with clients. Provide training and support on SETA and contractual compliance matters. Handover the project to the relevant campus or occupational manger. Oversee and maintain student work placement and Work Integrated Learning (WIL): Ensure that the TVET college student placement and WIL policy is in place and adhered to. Analyse the job market, identify scarce skills and match available opportunities with college programme mix. Ensure that an effective system is in place to assist learners to find job placement. Identify potential partners and networks to benefit and support existing graduates. Negotiate the employment opportunities with the employers. Oversee SETA discretionary and special grant applications. Ensure that they attend the strategic meeting with SETA to negotiate graduate‘s placement and facilitate the signatory of Memorandum of Understandings (MoU’s) and Memorandum of Agreement (MoAs).

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Vennootskappe en Skakelings
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur benodig om vennootskap- en skakelingsstrategieë te bestuur, wat 'n diploma of graad in Projekbestuur of Bemarking met 3 tot 5 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Projekbestuur/Bemarking of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3 tot 5 jaar tersaaklike werkervaring in 'n Projekbestuur of Besigheidsontwikkeling-omgewing hê waarvan 2-3 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, en Vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van die bou van vennootskappe. Moet innoverend wees. Kennis van Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury-regulasies en ander raamwerke. Kennis en begrip van administratiewe verslagdoeningsproses en prosedures. Behoort sterk bemarkings- en entrepreneursinsig, finansiële bestuur, hulpbronne mobilisering, interpretasie van statute, besigheidsbeplanning en sigbaarheidsanalise te hê. Behoort sterk administratiewe, beplannings-, organisatoriese, verslagskryf-, onderhandelings-, probleemoplossings-, projekbestuurs- en mensebestuursvaardighede te hê.
af.duties: Vennootskapsbestuur: Verskaf insette in die ontwikkeling van groei-vennootskapstrategieë en -planne. Stel 'n databasis van plaaslike besighede en ander skakelings op. Neem deel aan besigheidsforums en identifiseer projekgeleenthede. Ontwikkel projekvoorstelle en -planne vir gesamentlike inisiatiewe. Fasiliteer oorhandiging met die Kollegebestuurders. Vestig, handhaaf en behou vennootskap met industrie en tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Besigheidsgeleenthede-skandering: Identifiseer geleenthede vir kollege-inkomstevirwerwing. Stel werklike omgewingsimulasiepotensiaal vas. Verskaf markbehoeftes-besigheidsaak-rasionaal vir alle geleenthede. Identifiseer geskikte vennoot of diensverskaffer. Koördineer die indiening van tenders en befondsingsvoorstelle. Verskaf inligting en verslae oor programme, befondsing en vennootskap aan DHET en ander belanghebbendes. Plaaslike en provinsiale regeringsbetrekkinge: Ontwikkel en dateer skedule van plaaslike regeringsprojekte en -geleenthede op. Identifiseer Kollege-sinergiepotensiaal bydrae tot provinsiale departemente. Bou verhoudings met tersaaklike belanghebbendes, stel 'n databasis van sleutelkontakte op en neem waar toepaslik aan vergaderings deel. Ontwikkel voorstelle vir vennootskap oor spesifieke praktiese geleenthede wat in lyn met Kollege-kernbesigheid is. Navorsingsbestuur: Voer haalbaarheidstudies uit vir alle nuwe en voorgestelde projekte. Ontwikkel die projek en begroting. Werk saam met tersaaklike navorsingsorganisasies. Onderhandel en inisieer ondertekening van Memorandum of Understandings, diensvlakooreenkomste en/of kontrakte met kliënte. Verskaf opleiding en ondersteuning oor SETA- en kontraktuele nakomingsake. Oorhandig die projek aan die tersaaklike kampus of beroepsbestuurder. Hou toesig oor en handhaaf studentewerkplasing en Work Integrated Learning (WIL): Verseker dat die TVET-kollege studenteplasing- en WIL-beleid in plek is en nagekom word. Analiseer die arbeidsmark, identifiseer skaars vaardighede en pas beskikbare geleenthede by kollege-programmengsel aan. Verseker dat 'n doeltreffende stelsel in plek is om leerders te help om werkplasing te vind. Identifiseer potensiële vennote en netwerke om voordeel te trek uit en bestaande afgestudeerdes te ondersteun. Onderhandel die indiensneemingsgeleenthede met die werkgewers. Hou toesig oor SETA-diskresionêre en spesiale toelaagtoepassings. Verseker dat hulle die strategiese vergadering met SETA bywoon om afgestudeerdes se plasing te onderhandel en fasiliteer die ondertekening van Memorandum of Understandings (MoU's) en Memorandum of Agreement (MoA's).

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqhaza: Ubudlelwano Nezixhumisi
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umncedisi Weqhaza ezingeni lomqondisi ongathatha izinqumo ukuphatha izindlela zobudlelwano nezixhumisi, okudinga idiploma noma iziqu ekuqashweni kwezinhlelo noma ekuYizeni njll ngesiphephelo seminyaka engu-3 kuya kwayi-5.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seMatric/Grade12 kanye nediploma yezwe leminyaka engu-3 noma iziqu ekuqashweni kwezinhlelo noma ekuYizeni noma iziqu ezihambisana naleyo. Kumele abe namava emsebenzini afanele eminyakeni engu-3 kuya kwengu-5 ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo noma kwindawo yokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi, lapho kweminyaka engu-2-3 kumele abe ezingeni lokubhekisisa. Kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono, ulwazi, Namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda kokwakha ubudlelwano. Kumele abe nobuhlakani bokusungula okusha. Ulwazi ngeSibaluli Sabelomphakathi, i-PFMA, imithetho yeTreasury kanye nezinye izakhiwo. Ulwazi nokuqonda inqubo nezindlela zokubika zolawulo. Kumele abe nobuhlakani obunamandla bokumaketha nangobuhlakani bokuba ungumuntu oyikhompyutha ngokwengqondo, ukulawula imali, ukwenza ushicilelo, ukuphumeza imithetho, ukucubungula imithetho, ukuyilwa kobulentshisekelo, nokuhlaziya incazelo yangaphandle. Kumele abe namakhono amakhulu okulawula, ukuyiqaqamba, ukuhlela, okokuqamba futhi ahle ukuba nolwazi olubanzi lomsebenzi, isinxaxa ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukuqashwa kwezinhlelo kanye nokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha Ubudlelwano: Nikela ngeminikelo ekuyileni izindlela nezinhlela zokukhula kobudlelwano. Umisa isisekelo senani lezohwebo zendawo kanye nezinye izixhumisi. Thatha inxaxheba kumajetha yezohwebo futhi uphathe amathuba amasha. Baka izinhlela noshicilelo lwezinhlela ezenza ubudlelwano obuphathelene nezinhlelo eziseduze. Hlinzeka ngokusatshalaliswa kubaphathi beKholeji. Umisa, zigcine futhi ugcine ubudlelwano nembona izidakamizwa nabalawuli. Iskena amathuba ezentengo leMakethe: Phatha amathuba okukhiqiza imali ngokudayisa. Misela i-chambers yokuhlonza izidingo zendawo yokufaka imali eqoqweni. Faka izindingo zeziqalo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo. Hlola ngokusobala imithetho yokuhlinzekwa ngemali evela enyakeni. Sika futhi ubhale imininingwane ngaphandle kwegxeko. Tshintshela phansi ukuthunyelwa kwezinsiza ezinkulu ezikufanele kulezinye izinketho. Umise futhi uhlele ukulandelwa kwamaphulani nezinkalo zokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo.

xh.title: Umphathi oncedo: Iindibano nokunxibelelaniswa
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umphathi oncedo ukulawula iindlela zodibano nokunxibelelaniswa, kufuneka afumene idiploma okanye idigri eQondongqondweni lokuLawula amaprojekthi okanye kuMashele nokuSasaza aneminyaka elingu-3 ukuya kweyi-5 yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seMatric/Grade12 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe yeminyaka e-3 evunyiweyo okanye iDigri eQondongqondweni lokuLawula amaprojekthi/okuMashele nokuSasaza okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo. Kufuneka abe nayo inani elifutshane elingu-3 ukuya kweyi-5 leminyaka yamava oluhambelana nomsebenzi ekwindawo yokuLawula amaprojekthi okanye uPhuhliso lweShishini, apho kweminyaka eyi-2-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba labaphathi. Kufuneka azikwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhompetensi, ulwazi, neNkululeko: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuMila koDibano. Kufuneka abe nomtshaka. Ulwazi lomthetho weSebenza kaZwelonke, iPFMA, iimithetho yeNqela leMali nezinye iinkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngenkqubo yokuPhawula yolawulo nemiqathango. Kufuneka abe noluvo olunamandla lokusasaza nakumashishini, uLawulo lweMali, ukwenza amakhaya amacebo, inqanaba lokuphawula iimithetho, ukuCwangcwa kobuShishini nokuqonda okubonakalayo. Kufuneka abe nekhompetensi ezomeleleyo zokulawula, ukucwangcisa, ukulungiselela, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuxoxa, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukulawula amaprojekthi nokuLawula abantu.
xh.duties: ULawulo loDibano: Nikezela ngezimvo ekuyilenzi indela zodibano zokukhula neezicwangciso. Misela isiseko sedatha yamashishini endawo nezinye iindibano. Thatha inxaxheba kumaziko ebhizinisi ukuze uchaze amathuba amaprojekthi. Yenza iinkqubo zamaproposal nezicwangciso zeendaba eziyodibana. Yenza ukudluliselwa kubaphathi beKholeji. Misela, gcina kwaye ulondoloze udibano noshishino nabanomdla. UkuHlola amathuba eBiznisini: Chaza amathuba okwenza imali yiKholeji. Misela amandla okulinganisa indawo yomsebenzi. Nikezela nengcamango yamaphulo eshishini amadingayo onke amathuba. Chaza umqhatshanisi ofanelekileyo okanye umthengisi wenkonzo. Lawula ukungenisa kweenkqubo ezithengiswayo namaproposal emali. Nikezela nolwazi neengxelo kumaxwebhu, imali ngenkqubo nodibano kwi-DHET nabanye abanomdla. Iindibano zoRhulumente weSithili nesoLizwe: Yaza ukuze uvuselele ishedyuli yamaprojekthi norhulumente wendawo namathuba. Chaza amandla eKholeji onika isiseko ngomnikelo kumasebe abarhulumente. Misa iindibano nababanomdla, misa isiseko sedatha yabantu abalulekileyo uthathe inxaxheba kwindibano apho kufuneka khona. Yenza amaproposal okudibana ngamathuba aqhelekileyo ahambelana nomsebenzi weKholeji. ULawulo loPhando: Yenza izifundo zamathuba yonke imisebenzi entsha ephakanyiswayo. Yiza noprojekthi nesitywalwe. Dibana nemimandla yophando. Xoxa kuqalise ukuSayina iMAnyano yeQondiso, izivumelwano zanqanaba le nkonzana namagqabantshashi nabathengi. Nikezela nokuqeqesha nokuNcedisa kwi-SETA nangezinye izivumelwano ezingavumelayo. Dlulisa iProjekthi kumangeki weKholeji ofanelekileyo. Lawula zigcine ukubekwa kwabafundi kwindawo yomsebenzi nokuFunda okudibana noMsebenzi (WIL): Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yokubeka abafundi be-TVET nokusebenzisa i-WIL ikhona yaye igcinwa. Yahlula iNkundla yomsebenzi, chaza amakhono amancinci uqamise amathuba okusebenza ohambelana nemixholo yeKholeji. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo esebenzayo ikhona ukunceda abafundi ukuba bathole indawo yokusebenza. Chaza amanethiwekhi oqeqesho nokubonelela abo baqedileyo. Xoxa malangamathuba emisebenzi noqhwebhulu. Lawula iindlela zokungenisa izicelo ze-SETA ezongezwa ngezinye. Qinisekisa ukuba bathatha inxaxheba kwindibano yeenjongo eziBalulekileyo ne-SETA ukuyoxoxa ngokuBeka abo bapassile kwaye babancedise ukusayina iMAnyano yeQondiso (MoU's) neMAnyano yeQondiso yeNgxelo (MoA's).

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Kurrikulumontwikkeling en
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir kurrikulumontwikkeling en implementeringsondersteuning in die TVET-sektor, wat 'n Onderwyskwalifikasie en vyf jaar se tersaaklike ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric / Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Onderwys of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 5 jaar se werkervaring in die TVET-sektor hê in die aanbieding van akademiese programme. Moet 'n minimum van 3 jaar se tersaaklike werkervaring as 'n Senior Lektor (PL2) of Hoof van Afdeling (PL3) hê. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, en Vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van die registrasieprosesse en -prosedures. Kennis van die TVET-sektor se regulasies en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis en begrip van die PSET-witpapier en CET-Wet. Kennis en begrip van die NDP 2030, Skills Development Act, Employment of Educators Act, Public Service Act, en Labour Relations Act. Kennis van die etiese regulatoriese en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis van praktyknotas, provinsiale en nasionale beleidsraamwerke wat relevant is vir Onderwys, Opleiding en Ontwikkeling. Kennis van Skills Development Act, PSET Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act. Behoort sterk administratiewe, beplannings-, organiserings-, verslagdoenings-, probleemoplossings-, projekbestuurs- en mensebestuursvaardighede te hê.
af.duties: Verskaf kurrikulumverbetering en implementeringsondersteuning vir ministeriële programme in ooreenstem met die strategiese doelwitte. Hou toesig op en doen verslag oor die implementering van IQMS en verskaf lektorontwikkelingsondersteuning. Voer impakassessering uit op opleidingsintervensies en inisiatiewe om student- en lektorprestasie te verbeter. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor akademiese en kurrikulumbeleide. Ondersteun die implementering van nuwe programme, kwalifikasies en kurrikulum. Doen navorsing oor die arbeidsmarkbehoeftes om nuwe vraaggedrewe, relevante en responsiewe programme te identifiseer en aan te beveel. Koördineer die implementering van ICSS-riglyne vir Beroepsprogramme, Report 191 en NC(V). Bestuur die uitfaseringsproses van R191 en NC(V). Ontwikkel beleid/riglyne vir die bestuur van kurrikulum. Verskaf vereiste ondersteuning aan die kollege-eksekutief en toesigliggame. Hou toesig op gekoördineerde kurrikulumlewering by kollege-leweringsplekke. Beplan vir die lewering van gehalte-onderwys en leer. Verskaf ondersteuning en bystand met toelatingsprosesse. Verseker die verskaffing van leiding vir die verbetering van kurrikuluminhoud en -lewering gebaseer op betrokkenheid by openbare en private nywerheidsbelanghebbendes. Beplan, implementeer en monitor die gemengde kurrikulumleweringmodus en aanlynleer oor die verskillende kampusse. Analiseer resultate en implementeer ingrypingplanne vir kritieke vakke. Hou toesig oor die akkreditasie van Beroepsprogramme om vennootskappe te vestig vir werkgeïntegreerde leer. Beplan klassebesoeke vir klaskameronderwys en -leer, ICSS- en ISAT-ondersteuning. Identifiseer leerdermateriaal, toerusting en ander hulpbronvereistes. Koördineer die verskaffing van leermateriaal. Bestuur die menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezondloloba: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwekhurikeyilamu No
zu.summary: Umsizi wezondloloba wokuthuthukiswa kwekhurikeyilamu nokuwesekela ukuphunyulwa kwemisebenzi kwesigaba se-TVET, ofuna iziqu zemfundo kanye neminyaka emihlanu yomlando ofanele.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric / Grade12 kanye ne-National Diploma yeminyaka emi-3 esemthethweni noma i-Degree eMfundeni noma iziqu ezifanele. Kumele ube nomlando womsebenzi ongaphansi kweminyaka eyi-5 kulesigaba se-TVET ekunikela ngezinhlela zemfundo. Kumele ube nomlando womsebenzi ofanele ongaphansi kweminyaka eyi-3 njengengothisha elinganiselwe (PL2) noma njengenhloko yesigaba (PL3). Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele ube nelayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuzakhela, ulwazi, namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezinqubo zokubhalisa nendlela zokwenza izinto. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesigaba se-TVET nomsuka womthetho. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PSET White paper ne-CET Act. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-NDP 2030, i-Skills Development Act, i-Employment of Educators Act, i-Public Service Act, kanye ne-Labour Relations Act. Ulwazi ngomsuka womthetho osekela ukuziphatha kwemithetho. Ulwazi ngemibhalo yokusebenza, izakhiwo zomthetho zasenhlonjhweni nezwe ezihambisana nemfundo, ukuqeqesha nokuqaliswa kwamakhono. Ulwazi nge-Skills Development Act, i-PSET Act, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Public Service Regulations kanye ne-Public Service Act. Kumele ube namakhono amahle okuphatha, ukucubungula, ukuhlela, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, okuphathwa kwephrojekthi nakokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Nika inkuxulu ekuthuthukisweni nasekuwesekeleni ukuphunyulwa kwezinhlela zabaholi ngokuhambisana nezinhlobo ezibalulekile. Qapha ubike ngokuwesekela ukuphunyulwa kwe-IQMS unike nesekelo ekuthuthukisweni kothisha. Yenza ukulinganisa imiphumela kokusebenza kokuqeqesha nezinye izinhlela ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabafundi nabothisha. Yakha, phunyula, uphathe imithetho yesimo semfundo neyekhurikeyilamu. Wekela ukuphunyulwa kwezinhlela ezintsha, iziqu, nekhurikeyilamu. Yenza ucwaningo ngemidingo yasemsebenzini ukuze uthole futhi uphakamise izinhlela ezintsha ezibhekwe emidingweni, ezibalulekile futhi ezijwayelekile. Hlela ukuphunyulwa kwezimiso ze-ICASS ezinhleleni zomsebenzi, i-Report 191 kanye ne-NC(V). Phatha ukusishiywa kwe-R191 ne-NC(V). Yakha imithetho/izindlela zokuphatha ikhurikeyilamu. Nikeza isekelo esidingekayo abaphathi bekholiji namakomidi okuqaphela. Qapha ukukhishwa kwekhurikeyilamu okuhleliwe ezindaweni zokukhishwa kwekholiji. Hlela ukukhishwa kokuqeqesha nokufunda okungcono. Nikeza isekelo nosizo ezinqubweni zokungena. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kolwazi ngokuthuthukiswa okuqukethe ikhurikeyilamu nakokuqaliswa kokukhishwa ngokusekelwe ezinkulumweni namaphoyisa kahulumeni kanye nabangasese bomsebenzi. Hlela, phunyula uphathe indlela yokukhishwa kwekhurikeyilamu edidiywe nokuqeqesha kwe-inthanethi kuzo zonke izikole. Hlaziya imiphumela uphathe izinhlela zokungena izifundo ezibalulekile. Qapha ukumukelwa kwezinhlela zomsebenzi ukuze wakhe izinhlobo zokusebenza ezididiywe hlela ukufunda. Hlela ukuvakashela amakilasi ukufunda nokufundisa, isekelo le-ICASS nele-ISAT. Thola izinto zokufunda zomfundi, izinto zokusebenza, nezinye izidingo zempahla. Hlela ukukhishwa kwezinto zokufunda. Phatha abantu, imali, kanye nezinye zempahla yeqoqo.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: uPhuhliso lweNkqubo yoFundo no
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli wophuhliso nokusekelwa kokusebenzisa inkqubo yofundo kwicandelo le-TVET, elifuna isifundo seMfundo kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric / Grade12 kunye neDiploma yaseRhulumente yeminyaka emi-3 ethathiweyo okanye iDegree kuMfundo okanye isifundo esihambelanayo. Kufuneka kubekho amava omsebenzi angapheli kweminyaka emi-5 kwicandelo le-TVET ekunikezelweni kweenkqubo zemfundo. Kufuneka kubekho amava omsebenzi ahambelanayo angapheli kweminyaka emi-3 njengoTitshala oPhakamileyo (PL2) okanye uNhloko weCandelo (PL3). Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka kubekho ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhompetensi, ulwazi, nakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo neendlela zokuqwalasela. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo yecandelo le-TVET nolwandlalo olumisela inkqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ipepa namhlophe i-PSET kunye nesiTyhala se-CET. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNDP 2030, iSkills Development Act, iEmployment of Educators Act, iPublic Service Act, kunye neLabour Relations Act. Ulwazi ngolwandlalo lweemigaqo-nkqubo yobuzigama. Ulwazi ngamanotsi okuzilolonga, iinkqubo zemigaqo-nkqubo ezisendaweni nakwizizwe ezihambelana noMfundo, uQeqesho noPhuhliso. Ulwazi ngeSkills Development Act, i-PSET Act, iLabour Relations Act, iPublic Service Regulations kunye ne-Public Service Act. Kufuneka kubekho nakhono amakhulu olu lawulo, uqeqesho, ulungiselwano, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ulawulo lweeprojekthi nokulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Bonezela uphuhliso kwenkqubo yofundo nokusekelwa ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zezigqeba ngokwemigqaniselo yemigomo equka iinjongo. Lawula ubuze ngokuphatha nokubika ngokusebenza kwe-IQMS kwaye ugcine ukusekelwa kukaphuhliseko koTitshala. Qwalasela isiphumo sokuvavanywa kweendlela zokuqeqesha nokuqhankqalaza ukuphucula ukusebenza koMfundi noTitshala. Phezula, usebenzise, ulawule iimigaqo-nkqubo yemfundo nenkqubo yofundo. Sekela ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezintsha, iifomality kunye nenkqubo yofundo. Phanda ngemfuno yemizobo yokubakho abasebenzi kwintengiso ukuze ubone kwaye ucebishe ngeenkqubo ezintsha ezibangelwa yimfuno, ezihambelanayo nezibelulekayo. Hlela ekusebenziseni iinkqubo ze-ICASS zazo iinkqubo zomsebenzi, iReport 191 ne-NC(V). Lawula ukuphela kwe-R191 ne-NC(V). Phezula imigaqo-nkqubo/indlela yokulawula inkqubo yofundo. Ziselela ngokufunekayo igadanga lekolishi nangemiqobo. Lawula ngokuhleliweyo ukunikelwa kwenkqubo yofundo kwindawo zokunikezela zekolishi. Cwangcisa ukunikelwa komfundo ophezulu nokufunda. Zisa inkxaso noncedo ngokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokuqaliswa. Qinisekisa ukunikela ngengcebiso ngophuhliso lwesiqulatho senkqubo yofundo nokunikelwa ngokusebenzisana namahlathi obuzwe bengcali nokabucala. Cwangcisa, usebenzise ulawule ukuzinika iinkqubo ezidityanisiweyo zofundo nokuqaliswa kolwazi kumanqwanqwa. Hlaziya iziphumo kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zolungiselelo zamabanga amakhulu. Lawula ukugunyaziswa kweProgramme zomsebenzi ukwakha ubudlelwane bokufunda okuxubeneyo nomsebenzi. Cwangcisa iindwendwe zeklasi yokufundisa nokufunda kumagumbi, i-ICASS nokusekelwa kwe-ISAT. Chonga izinto zokufunda zomfundi, izixhobo, nezinye izinto ezifunekayo. Hlela ngokunika izinto zokufunda. Lawula abantu, imali nezinye izinto zolawulo zale candelo.

jobs.title: ASD: Partnership and Linkages
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Northern Cape Rural TVET College, Central Office Upington
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Develop and manage strategic partnerships with industry, government, SETAs and NGOs at Northern Cape Rural TVET College Central Office in Upington.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate recognized Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or equivalent qualification in Marketing, Business Management, or related field. A minimum of seven years (7) working experience in Business Development, Stakeholder Management, or Partnerships Environment of which at least three (3) years should be at Supervisory level. Registration with a professional body (e.g., SACE or HPCSA) etc. Digital literate and competent in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. A valid driver's license and willingness to travel. Competencies: In-depth understanding of the TVET College sector and the Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) strategic goals. Knowledge of the CET Act, PFMA, and National Skills Development Plan (NSDP). Understanding of SETA landscapes, apprenticeship models, and work-integrated learning (WIL) policies. Familiarity with the BBBEE Act and its implications for corporate social investment and partnerships. Strategic Networking: Ability to build and maintain high-level relationships with industry, government, and NGOs. Negotiation & Persuasion: Proven ability to secure Memoranda of Understanding (MoU’s) and funding. Project Management: Overseeing multiple partnership projects from inception to evaluation. Communication: Excellent verbal and written reporting skills for executive-level presentations. Financial Acumen: Ability to manage budgets and monitor the ROI of various linkages. Proven track record in facilitating placements for students in Work-Integrated Learning (WIL). Experience in resource mobilization and proposal writing for donor funding or grants. Experience in conducting market research to align college programs with local industry needs. Managing formal agreements and ensuring compliance with MoU / MoA terms. A Postgraduate qualification in Business Administration or Management. Experience working specifically within a TVET environment or Higher Education sector. Project Management Certification (e.g., PRINCE2 or PMBOK).
jobs.duties: Strategic Partnership Development and Management: Identify, establish, and maintain strategic alliances with industry partners, government departments, SETAs, and NGOs. This includes the formalization of these relationships through the drafting and management of Memoranda of Understanding (MoU’s) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Student Placement and Work- Integrated Learning (WIL): Facilitate and coordinate the placement of students and lecturers in industry for Work-Integrated Learning and Workplace-Based Experience (WBE). Monitor the quality of placements to ensure they meet the specific requirements of the curriculum and trade test regulations. Resource Mobilization and Fundraising: Lead the identification of external funding opportunities, including SETA grants and private sector sponsorships. Draft and present high-quality funding proposals to secure resources for college projects, infrastructure, and student support services. Industry Liaison and Market Research: Conduct regular market scans and industry research to identify emerging skill demands. Use these insights to advise the College Academic Board on program diversification, ensuring that the college’s offerings remain responsive to the local and national economy. Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting: Represent the College in provincial and national stakeholder forums. Manage the reporting process by compiling comprehensive monthly and quarterly reports on partnership activities, placement statistics, and grant utilization for the College Management Team and DHET. Management of the Partnership Unit: Provide leadership and manage the administrative duties of the Partnerships and Linkages Section. This involves managing the Section’s budget, supervising staff performance, and ensuring all activities align with the College’s Strategic Plan and Annual Operational Plan (APP).
jobs.applications: Apply online at https://ncrz83.ngnscan.co.za/
jobs.notes: Applicants are required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application and must submit a fully signed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be submitted by shortlisted candidates. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: ASD: Vennootskappe en Skakelings
af.summary: Ontwikkel en bestuur strategiese vennootskappe met industrie, regering, SETA's en NRO's by Northern Cape Rural TVET College Sentrale Kantoor in Upington.
af.requirements: Toepaslike erkende Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie in Bemarking, Besigheidsbestuur, of verwante veld. 'n Minimum van sewe jaar (7) werkervaring in Besigheidsontwikkeling, Belanghebbende Bestuur, of Vennootskapsomgewing waarvan ten minste drie (3) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Registrasie by 'n professionele liggaam (bv., SACE of HPCSA) ens. Digitaal geletterd en bevoeg in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede: Diepgaande begrip van die TVET College-sektor en die Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) strategiese doelwitte. Kennis van die CET-wet, PFMA, en National Skills Development Plan (NSDP). Begrip van SETA-landskappe, leerlingmodelle, en werkgeïntegreerde leer (WIL) beleide. Bekendheid met die BBBEE-wet en die implikasies daarvan vir korporatiewe maatskaplike belegging en vennootskappe. Strategiese Netwerkwerk: Vermoë om hoëvlakverhoudings met industrie, regering, en NRO's te bou en te handhaaf. Onderhandeling en Oortuiging: Bewese vermoë om Memoranda of Understanding (MoU's) en befondsing te bekom. Projektbestuur: toesig oor veelvuldige vennootskapsprojekte van konsepsie tot evaluering. Kommunikasie: Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike verslagdoeningsvaardighede vir uitvoerende-vlak aanbiedings. Finansiële insig: Vermoë om begrotings te bestuur en die ROI van verskeie skakelings te monitor. Bewese rekord van die fasilitering van plasings vir studente in Werkgeïntegreerde Leer (WIL). Ervaring in hulpbronmobilisering en voorstelskryf vir skenkerbefondsing of toelaes. Ervaring in die uitvoer van marknavorsing om kollege-programme met plaaslike nywerheidsbehoeftes te belyn. Bestuur van formele ooreenkomste en verseker van nakoming van MoU / MoA-terme. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Besigheidsadministrasie of Bestuur. Ervaring wat spesifiek binne 'n TVET-omgewing of hoëronderwyssektor gewerk het. Projektbestuursertifisering (bv., PRINCE2 of PMBOK).
af.duties: Strategiese Vennootskapsontwikkeling en Bestuur: Identifiseer, vestig, en handhaaf strategiese alliansies met nywerheidsvennote, regeringsdepartemente, SETA's, en NRO's. Dit sluit die formalisering van hierdie verhoudings deur die opstel en bestuur van Memoranda of Understanding (MoU's) en Service Level Agreements (SLA's) in. Studenteplasings en Werkgeïntegreerde Leer (WIL): Fasiliteer en koördineer die plasing van studente en dosente in die industrie vir Werkgeïntegreerde Leer en Workplace-Based Experience (WBE). Monitor die kwaliteit van plasings om te verseker dat dit aan die spesifieke vereistes van die kurrikulum en beroeps toetsregulasies voldoen. Hulpbronmobilisering en Fondsinsameling: Lei die identifisering van eksterne befondsingsgeleenthede, insluitend SETA-toelaes en privatesektorborgskappe. Stel en bied hoë gehalte befondsingsvoorstelle voor om hulpbronne vir kollege-projekte, infrastruktuur, en studenteondersteuningsdienste te verkry. Nywerheidsskakeling en Marknavorsing: Voer gereelde markondersoeke en nywerheidsnavorsing uit om opkomende vaardigheidsbehoeftes te identifiseer. Gebruik hierdie insigte om die Kollege Akademiese Raad oor programdiversifisering te adviseer, om te verseker dat die kollege se aanbiedinge ontvanklik bly vir die plaaslike en nasionale ekonomie. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en Verslagdoening: Verteenwoordig die Kollege in provinsiale en nasionale belanghebbende forums. Bestuur die verslagdoeningsproses deur omvattende maandelikse en kwartaallikse verslae oor vennootskapsaktiwiteite, plasingsstatistieke, en toelaesbenutting vir die Kollege Bestuurspan en DHET op te stel. Bestuur van die Vennootskapseenheid: Verskaf leierskap en bestuur die administratiewe pligte van die Vennootskappe en Skakelings Afdeling. Dit behels die bestuur van die Afdeling se begroting, die toesig oor personeelprestasie, en die verseker dat alle aktiwiteite met die Kollege se Strategiese Plan en Annual Operational Plan (APP) belyn is.

zu.title: ASD: Ubumfihlo nokuhlobana nabantu nomihha
zu.summary: Thuthisa futhi uphathe ubudlelwano obuhle obuphakeme noshibhobho, hurumende, SETAs, kanye ne-NGOs e-Northern Cape Rural TVET College Central Office e-Upington.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zebhalori / i-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ezingamukeleka noma isimo esilingana kwezokuThuthwa kwezimakethe, ezeQondo labantu bakhona, noma esikhundleni esihlobene. Isikhathi esingaphezu kuka-7 iminyaka yomsebenzi ekuQondiswa kwezobhizinisi, ekuPhathweni kwabantu abathintekayo, noma kwesikhathi sobudlelwane okubalulekile. Ukubhalisa emehlweni oMthethonqanga wemisebenzi ( njenge-SACE noma i-HPCSA ) kanye nokuqonda okuqinisekisiwe. Ukuba nokutadisha kwamakhompyutha kanye nokusebenza kahle ngokwabahlinzeki be-Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nothando lokuhamba. Izinkomba zomuntu: ukuqonda okude nokuqinile ngeminyango yamakolishi e-TVET kanye nezigaba eziphakeme zika-Mnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha (DHET). Ulwazi ngo-CET Act, PFMA, kanye ne-National Skills Development Plan (NSDP). Ukuqonda izimo zalezo-SETA, izindlela zokuqeqesha abantu abangenamsebenzi, kanye nezigaba zomsebenzi ocele ukuthi uthuthuke ekhaya (WIL). Ukwazisa i-BBBEE Act kanye nemiphumela yawo ekutshalweni kwezimali zomphakathi nokubambisana nabantu. Ukuxhumana okuphakeme: Isimo esihle sokwakha kanye nokugcina ubuhlobo obuphakeme noshibhobho, hurumende, kanye ne-NGOs. Ukuqinisekisa nokukholwa: Isimo esivezwayo sokuthola izinkumbulo zokuqonda (MoU's) kanye nezimali. Iqondo lokuphatha imigwaqo: Ukubuka imigwaqo eminingi yokubambisana kusuka ekuqaliseni okukhulu layo kuye ekuqinisekisweni. Inhlalo: Isimo esihle sokukhuluma nokubhala ngemibiko yezinto eziyisibonelo kubaphathi bezinga eliphezulu. Isimo sokusebenza nezimali: Isimo sokuphatha imali ezeziwohamba nokulawula inzuzo yazo zonke izindlela ezingatholakala ngayo. Isibonelo esivezwayo sokubamba abafundi ezindaweni zokuthola imisebenzi ecelwa ekhaya (WIL). Isipilipli sokuholela abantu ekutholeni izinsiza kanye nokubhala iziphakamiso ngenhloso yokuthola izimali ezivela kubanikazi noma izibonelelo. Isipilipli ekwenzeni ucwaningo ngemikhakha ukuze kuhambisane izikole namaphuzu asetingeni yemikhakha. Ukuphatha isivumelwano esisemthethweni futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho ye-MoU / MoA. Iziqu ezivele zitholakele okuphezulu kwezobuSobala bezobuSizakalo noma eQondisweni. Isipilipli ngokusebenza ikakhulukazi kolunye uhlobo lwe-TVET noma kweMfundo ePhakeme. Isitifikedi sobuQondisi beMigwaqo ( njenge-PRINCE2 noma i-PMBOK ).
zu.duties: Inhloso yokuQonda nokuphatha ukubambisana: ukubona, ukwakha, futhi kugcinwe ubuhlobo obuphakeme kanye noshibhobho bahlanganyela, iminyango yohurumende, i-SETAs, kanye ne-NGOs. Lokhu kubuye kuhlanganise ukwenza kwalezo zinto zibe semthethweni ngokubhala nokuphatha izinkumbulo zokuqonda (MoU's) kanye nezivumelwano ngenhloso yomsebenzi (SLAs). Ukubekwa kwezintanga ezikoleni neseThuba lokufunda usebenza (WIL): kwaxhaswe futhi kuqondwe ukubeka izintanga nabafundisi kushibhobho ngokufunda usebenza futhi uthole isipilipli ngokusebenza (WBE). Kuqinisekiswe inani elihle lokubeka izintanga ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zomthetho wekharikekhulamu kanye nomthetho wokuvivinya isipilipli. Ukuhlinzeka ngemali nezinsiza nokuxhasa imali: ukuholela ekuboneni izindlela zokuthola imali eceliweyo okubandakanya izibonelelo ze-SETA kanye nezikhwama zangasese. ukubhala futhi kwethulwe iziphakamiso ezihle zokufuna imali ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa izinsiza zomgwaqo wekhampasi, emkhakheni wokuthutha kwabantu, nasezinsizeni zokuxhasa izintanga. Ukuxhumana noshibhobho nokwenza ucwaningo ngemikhakha: kwakha ngeqindamba ucwaningo ngemikhakha ukuze kubonwe izidingo ezintsha zamandla. ukusebenzisa le mininingo ukuze kwelulewe iKhampo leSikhungo samaprofayili ngokubakha imigwaqo emitsha ukuze kubonakale ukuthi imigwaqo yesikhungo ihambelana nobukhulu bomnotho wasekhaya newezwe. Ukubakha ubuhlobo nemibiko: kwakhiwe isikhungo sabakwa-Foramu zabaphathi bakhethwa kumazwe amaningi nganeno. ukuphatha ishidi yokwenza imibiko ngokubhala imibiko eyisipilipli ngayinye ngenyanga nangamakhomu e-3 ngenhloso yokubaluleka isikhungo ngokubakha kanye nokutholakala kwemali eceliweyo kuHlelo lokuQeqesha lweKhampo lweKhampasi kanye na-DHET. Ukuphatha iKhampasi yokubakha: ukunika amathuba okuphatha kanye nokulawula imisebenzi yobuhlakani bokubakha Isikhathi sobuhlobo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuphatha imali yesikhathi, ukuqondisa ukusebenza kwabantu abasebenzayo, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imigwaqo ihlangene noHlelo olukhulu lokuSebenza okuhle kwe-Khampasi noma uHlelo lokuSebenza loNyaka (APP).

xh.title: I-ASD: IziQhoganeki kunye Neqhagamshelo
xh.summary: Phuhlisa ulawulo ngokubambisana nezinqamlezondo eziphambili namashishini, urhulumente, iisetA kunye ne-NGO eNdiro yoMbindi weKholeji ye-TVET yaseMaphakela Koloni eUpington.
xh.requirements: I Degree esemthethweni efanelekileyo / i National Diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye isidanga esilinganayo kwi Marketing, Business Management, okanye elinye ibhalwe elinxulumene nalo. Uphononongo olungakananiweyo lweminyaka yedlula esiixhenye (7) lokusebenza kwi Business Development, Stakeholder Management, okanye kwindlu yeziQhoganeki apho ubuninzi beminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka abe ngoBaphathi. Ukwaziswa kwelinye iqela lezangamagosa (umz., SACE okanye HPCSA) njl. Ukuba nolwazi kwi dyithimali kwaye ukwazi ukusebenzisa i Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Ifayidivha yesitobhi egunyazisiweyo nentembeko yokuhamba. Ikhono: Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo ibhalwe le TVET College nendlela ephilisa iNqanaba lemigangatho eliQhagamshelwa yiNqanaba leZeMfundo ePhakamileyo (DHET). Ulwazi ngeCET Act, PFMA, kunye ne National Skills Development Plan (NSDP). Ukuqonda iindawo ze SETA, iindlela zokuzilolonga, namagunya amabhalwe oLwazi oluNxuluni (WIL). Ukuqonda iBBBEE Act nendlela ethinta ukutyatyelwa koluntu ngokwamashishini nokuQhagamshelwa. Uqhagamshelo oluphambili: Isakhono sokwakha nokuzeza iindibaniselwano ezingangangazo namashishini, urhulumente, ne-NGO. Ikhonono nokuzindya: Isakhono esibonwayo sokuzuzisa iMemoranda of Understanding (MoU's) netyala. uLawulo loMnxeba: Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo iinkqubo ezininzi ezinamanxulume ukusuka ekuqaliseni ukuya kokuqokelelwa. Unxibelelwano: Isakhono sokubalisa ngemile nemibhalo ngokwemigaqo yamanqanaba oorhulumente. ukuQonda uMvuzo: Isakhono sokulawula imirholo nokuqonda i ROI yokuqhagamshela kwezinto ezahlukeneyo. Isikhundla esibonakalisa ukubeka abafundi kwindlu yoLwazi oluNxuluni (WIL). Isiphumo sokufumana izixhobo nokubhala izicelo setyala okanye imali eziswa kubani nikela. Isiphumo sokucanda uphando kolwazi ukulungelelanisa iinkqubo zekholeji nomfuno walowo nawuphi na ushishino. Ukulawula iinkqubo ezichaza ukubhala ngokusemthethweni nokuqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho ye MoU / MoA. Isidanga sesisibini kwinkqubo yoLawulo lwe Bizinesi okanye ulawulo. Isiphumo ngqo kwinkqubo y TVET okanye kwinkqubo yeNqanaba leMfundo ePhakamileyo. Isatifikethi soLawulo loMnxeba (umz., PRINCE2 okanye PMBOK).
xh.duties: uQhagamshelo ngokuSebenzisa iNqanaba eliPhambili noLawulo lwalo: Ukuqaphela, ukwakha, nokuzigcina iindibaniselwano eziphambili namashishini, nangamasebe karhulumente, nama SETA, nemiqulu yamaphatho e-NGO. Oku kuquka ukwenza le ndibaniselwano ibe ngumthetho ngokuyilola nokuqulunqa iinkqubo ze Memoranda of Understanding (MoU's) ne Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Ukuqhayiswa kwabaFundi nokuFunda kuQhagamshelo (WIL): Ukwenza kulunge nokuhlanganisa ukubeka abafundi nabafundisi kumashishini ukuze bafunde ku Qhagamshelo loLwazi nokuQonda imisebenzi ngokuchaneka (WBE). Ukuqonda ukuthanda ukubeka abantu ukuyiqinisekisa ukuba idibana nemfuno ngokwemigaqo yokufunda nemithetho yokugqiba izihluzo. ukuFumana iSisixhobo nokuQokelela iMali: Ukuba ngumlawuli ekubeni iqhakamshela imimiselwano yolawulo lwetyala, nentshenkqubo ye SETA nognqina weluntu. Ukulayisha kunye nokubhala iincwadi ezinamandla ngokomnikezela ukuze zigcinelwe izixhobo ezingazange zibhengezwa ngeenkqubo zekholeji, ezoYilika, zokuxhasa abafundi. uQhagamshelo namaShishini nokoQondisisa iNdlela yokukhangela iMiso: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulandela imihla ngemihla uqondisiso lolwazi ngamashishini, ukuze kuqondwe imfuno entsha yamakhono abantu. Ukusetyenzisa oku ukuze kusikelwe isiphakamiso kuBhalwe loMthetho weKholeji ngokwahlula iinkqubo ngeenqanaba, qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zekholeji zihlala zixhasa umnqba wendalo ehlala ecel nakuwo wonke amazwe. uQhagamshelo nabantu buBanjwa bemiQulu nokuBika: Ukumela iKholeji kwindawo yeprovinsi nakuwo wonke amazwe. Ukulawula iinkqubo ngokubhala iimbalas ezichanekileyo ezinyanga nangonyaka malunga neNqanaba ngokuQhagamshela, ngokubakwa kwabanikwa iindawo, nokusetyenziswa kwetyala ukuya kuQhagamshelo nokuLawula ngeNqanaba lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo. uLawulo lweNqanaba ngoQhagamshelo lokusebenzisa iziXhobo: Ukubonelela ngolawulo kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yokuQhagamshela nokubhala imibhalo ekuyiyona kuphela. Oku kuquka ukulawula imirholo yesigqeba, ukuqaphela ukusebenza kwamaphatho, nokuqinisekisa ukuzonkelela iinkqubo kunye noMgaqo weNqanaba eliPhambili ne Migaqo yoLawulo lomYaka (APP).

zu.title: Ongezwayo Wezinsiza Zokusekela Izifundi: Izinsiza Zokusekela Izifundi

zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ezifanele ezivunyiwe noma iziqu ezalinganayo kwi-Psychology noma i-Social Work. Ukuqashwa kumzimba wezempilo ohloniphekile (isb., SACE noma HPCSA) njll. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nokuba nobuchule ku-Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Ilayisenisi yokuqasha ehambisana nomthetho nokuthanda ukuhamba. Ikhono: Ukuqonda okujulile koMthetho we-CET (Continuing Education and Training Act) kanye neSu Lwezwe Lokusekela Abafundi. Ulwazi ngezinkambiso zokufaneleka kwi-NSFAS kanye nenqubo yokuphatha. Ukuqonda isikhundla sezikhungo ze-TVET College kanye namapholisi we-Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET). Ukuqonda umthethosisekelo we-Student Governance (SRC) kanye nenqubo yakhokho yokhetho. Ulwazi ngamaphandle wokuqapha nokuhlola impumelelo yabafundi. Ukuholo Okuhleliwe: Ikono lokuphatha amaqembu ahlukene nokuphoqa imiyalelo yomnyango. Ukuphatha Imali: Amandla okweluleka inani nokulawula ukuchithwa kwemali. Ukuhlaziya Iminininingwane: Amandla okuhlaziya iminininingwane yokusebenza kanye nempilo yomzimba yomfundi ukuyosiza ekwenzeni okufanele. Isithombe esihle sokuphatha iphothifoliyo ye-Student Financial Aid. Isipiliwoni sokubhekisa abafundi ekhethweni le-Student Representative Council (SRC) nokuqeqesha abaphathi. Ukuphatha imiklamo yempilo kanye nokuphila kahle komfundi (i-HIV/AIDS, ukwelulekwa, kanye nokusekela abantu abakhubazekile). Isipiliwoni sokuhlanganisa imiklamo ezingaphandle (ezemidlalo, ubuciko, kanye namasiko). Isipiliwoni sokuphatha inqubo yesigwegwe nokuziphatha kwabafundi. Iziqu eziphezulu zokuphatha imfundo noma imfundo ephakeme. Isitifikedi sokuphatha imiklamo. Ukuqeqeshwa okukhethekile ekwelulekeni kwabafundi noma ekubhekiseleni abafundi emisebenzini. Isipiliwoni sokusebenza ngosimisi we-COLTECH.
zu.duties: Qapha inqubo yesebe lezinsiza zokusekela izifundi. Phatha ukwelulekwa kwabafundi kulo lonke ikhampasi. Nikeza abafundi ngokubhekisela emisebenzini, ukwelulekwa kanye nokusekela kwemfundo. Qapha futhi zigcine imiklamo yezemidlalo, ukuzilibazisa, ubuciko namasiko kubafundi. Siza abafundi ekubuseni nasekuphathweni kobuholo babo. Phatha ukufaka kubafundi izindaba zobulili kanye nobunkhubazekile. Phatha onke amandla abantu, imali, kanye nezinye izinsiza zesebe.

Implementeer stelsels vir behoorlike bate- en voorraadbestuur in die Campus. Versewerk die uitvoering van gereelde voorraad- en bate-inspeksies en -verifikasies. Keur alle bateoordragte en -uitruilings tussen Campuses goed volgens voorgeskrewe beleid en prosedures. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n risikobestuurplan om geïdentifiseerde risiko's te versag. Begin, onderhou en bestuur finansiële volhoubaarheid by die sentrum. Ontwikkel 'n konsep sentrumbegroting in ooreenstemming met sentrale kantoor riglyne. Monitor werklike finansiële prestasie van die sentrum teen begroting. Implementeer en bestuur die goedgekeurde begroting en hou toesig oor die daaglikse klein kontant gebruik by die sentrum. Onderteken alle Campus verkrygings voorleggings in ooreenstemming met die SCM beleid. Verseker volle nakoming van nasionale beleide, standaard bedryfsprosedures, riglyne en bestuursplanne deur nakoming van alle assesseringsaktiwiteite by die sentrum en ook afleweringpunte binne die Campus te verseker. Verseker doeltreffendheid en doeltreffenheid van die sentrum Assesserings Komitee. Verseker implementering van ICT beleide. Oudit aantal sentrum infrastruktuur en fasiliteite. Rapporteer oor % benutting van infrastruktuur en fasiliteite. Voldoen aan DHET en College beleide en prosedures.
