xh.title: Umsekeli weNkulumbuso: Ukuqaliswa kweNkqubo yokuFunda
xh.summary: Umsekeli wenkulumbuso wokuqaliswa kwenkqubo yokufunda e-Ekurhuleni East TVET College, efunwa idiploma yobunjineli, isilumkiso sobugcisa beza nenyanga emvula ixesha elingamnyaka usixhenxe ngamava okuphucula amakhono.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. Idiploma yezwe leNgingqi / ibakala lobugcisa kubunjineli okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Isilumkiso sobugcisa kwezokuhamba nokuba namava njengomququzeleli wamagcisa, umlingisi nolawuli kuyimfuno ebalulekileyo. Isiqinisekiso kwiNtengiso yokuLawula kuquka nokulawula amaprojekthi kuyongezo lomonde. I7 nyaka yamava okusebenza kwicala lokuphucula amakhono, nengaphantsi konyaka othathu amava kwinqanaba lolawulo. Ukubonisa ukuqonda nokuba namava ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zonke zokufunda, ngakumbi kumagcisa nolwazi lwezobugcisa kwimeko ye-SETA kufuneka. Ulwazi nokuqonda nge-SETA, i-NSDS nomthetho olawula ukuqaliswa kweenkqubo zophuhliso lwamagcisa. Ulwazi loMthetho woPhuculo lwaMakhono, 1998. Ulwazi loMthetho weeMali zoPhuculo lwaMakhono (SDLA), Ulwazi loMthetho weSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), 1995. Ulwazi loMthetho weOccupational Health and Safety (OHS). Ukubakho bubuchwepheshe bekhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuqonda iingxaki zoguquko nemisebenzi yokwakha amandla kwicala le-TVET. Ulwazi loMthetho weCET. Amakhono olawulo nolawulelo, amakhono olawulo amaprojekthi nokuqukuqela kuquka namakhono okubonisa. UPhuculo lwaBantu a basebenzayo kuquka noLawulo oluPhethe ngaphantsi. UPhuhliso lweNkqubo kuquka noMthetho ohambelana nawo. Amakhono obudala. Amakhono amahlulu ehlelokunceda ekusombulula iingxaki ezinzulu. Umda wokusebenza ngapantsi kwexinzelelo nokugqiba ngemini. Umda wokusebenza kodwa nangokwakho nakuqela. Amakhono oCandelo, ukuHlela, ukuBeka ngaphambili noLawulo. Amakhono oPhando, ukubhala iingxelo, okubonisa okutsha namagosa.
xh.duties: UkuCwangcisa ukuFikelela kwa BaFundi: Cwangcisa ulawulo lwezicelo ngokwemigqaliso efunyenweyo yeenjongo ze-APP. Qinisekisa inkqubo ehambayo yezicelo nokwamkelwa kwabafundi. Zibandakanye ekusundeni ikhwalithi ukuze ngeniswe idatha yokuqeqesha abafundi. Qinisekisa ukuba inani eligcwaliswe le-NSFAS lisebenziswa ngokupheleleyo. Ngenisa idatha yokubhalisa. ULawulo loku Fundisa noku Funda: Cwangcisa ukuze kusebenze inkqubo yokufunda nokufundisa njengoko kuchazwe ngurhulumente ngamanyathelo abekwe ngokwawo. Cwangcisa ukuze kusebenze inkqubo enkxaso abafundi ngokwemiqathango yentsika yentsika. Qinisekisa iinkqubo zangaphakathi nolawulo ekuxhaseni abafundi ekuphuculweni kwenkqubo yokufunda nokufundisa. Qinisekisa ukuba abafundi nabafundisi bayabakhona emaklasi njengoko becwangcisile. Qamba ungenise idatha yokufunda nokufundisa. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nephangi leKomiti yeSikolo samabanga aphakamileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba basebenzi nabafundi babekelwe kumsebenzi woPhuculo olusebenzayo (WIL) naku-WBE. Zibandakanye neKomiti elimele iSikolo. ULawulo lweNkqubo eQondiswa ngomSebenzi: Qalisa ukuqeqesha kwamagcisa njengengxenye ye-PQM. Zenzela ii-workshops isixhobo sophuhliso esitsha esihambelana noshishino nendalo. Fumana isiqinisekiso kuzo zonke iinkqubo ezihambelana namagcisa. Bhalisa ii-workshops njengeziko levavayo lomsebenzi wobugcisa. ULawulo lweZiko: Lawula zonke imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla eZikweni. Yenza iingxelo zokuqonda ngemisebenzi, chwetheza iindawo ezingasebenzi kakuhle uze usebenzise iinkqubo zophuhliso zobuntu nokwakhwa kwamandla kubo bonke abasebenzi. Lawule ulandele isivumelwano ngeentengiso zokhuseleko kwinqanaba leSikolo. Lawula ngokuchanekileyo ugcine zonke izixhobo ezibonakalayo eSikolo uthi usebenzise iNkqubo yeKhuseleko lokuSebenza nokuQonda. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo lwesixhobo nokulondoloza iimpahla eSikolo. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa rhoqo kwezibonelo nokutshintsha kweempahla. Vumela zonke izicelo zokudluliselwa nokutshintshwa kweempahla phakathi kweeSikolo ngokwelisu nolawulo olumiselweyo. Phiha uze usebenzise iNkqubo yoLawulo lweengozi ukunciphisa iingozi ezifunyenweyo. Qalisa, gcina uze ulawule inkxaso-mali ephila eZikweni. Cwangcisa isicwangciso seMbalelo yezimali eZikweni ngokweeliso zekomkhulu. Landela inkqubo yangempela yemali eZikweni ngokuchasene nembalelo. Sebenzisa ulawule embalelo emisiweyo uze ulawule ukusetyenziswa kwemali yemihla ngemihla eZikweni. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kuzo zonke izicelo zentshiso eSikolo ngokuchasene nenkqubo ye-SCM. Qinisekisa ulandelo ngokupheleleyo kumagosa amanyathelo abekwe ngokwawo, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo ezimiselweyo, iingcebiso nemiqathalo yolawulo ngokuqinisekisa ulandelo kumanyathelo okulinganisa wonke eZikweni nakumagunya okulawula ecaleni kwabo eSikolo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nephangi leKomiti yeZiko eLinganisa. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa iNkqubo ye-ICT. Linganisa inani leZiko lemiba ezikho namagunya. Yenza ingxelo ngamaphesenti omsebenziso wemiba namagunya. Landela iNkqubo nolawulo loMthetho ka-DHET naseSikolo.

jobs.title: Curriculum Implementation (MINISTERIAL Programmes)
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Lead and manage curriculum implementation and monitor teaching and learning support at Ekurhuleni East TVET College.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. A National Diploma / Degree in Education. 3-5 years in Education/Teaching and Learning environment or related field. A valid driver’s licence. Computer Literacy. Extensive knowledge of Teaching and learning Plan Framework will be an added advantage. Knowledge of Public Service legislations and policies. Knowledge of PSET. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/ CET Administration. Understanding of the Higher Education sector. An understanding of DHET’s strategic vision and priorities. A thorough knowledge of all policies and legislation governing TVET Colleges in South Africa. In respect to vocational education and training thorough knowledge of the student/information management system. Planning and Organising. Problem solving. Research skills. Analytical skills. Report writing skills. Interpersonal relations. Verbal and written communication. Good Communication skills (written and verbal). Presentation Skills and Leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor and evaluate the teaching and learning support: To lead and manage Curriculum towards the achievement of improved student’s performance: Consolidate, manage, monitor and evaluate the implementation of the DHET Teaching and Learning Plan. Ensure standardisation of curriculum services across campuses, e.g., timetables, workshops. Report on the Monitoring the availability of lecturer workloads and class timetables. Ensure consolidation and coordination of functions between all college curriculum structures, sub- structures and campuses to facilitate proper operational and management reporting. Liaise with all curriculum staff on curriculum related issues. Develop, monitor and evaluate the college intervention strategies for effective curriculum delivery. Review curriculum policies and standard operating procedures. Lead, coordinate, and facilitate the implementation of new curriculum and PQM. Ensure the provision of guidance for the improvement curriculum content and delivery based on with public and private industry stakeholders. Monitor the procurement of textbooks and teaching and learning resources. Monitoring and evaluating of the curriculum coverage. Plan class visit as part of support for the ICASS. Build a strong network of contacts with other institutions and industries. Management of Teaching and Learning Support: To lead and manage classroom, part-time classes and Blended learning: Ensure the implementation of policy on classroom, part time, and blended learning. Reporting on classroom, part time and blended learning. Take lead on the planning of workshop, meetings, academic visits in Teaching and Learning. Ensuring that Part-time classes are treated no less favourably than full-time classes as they contribute towards the college certification and pass rate. Report on Teaching and learning infrastructure per programme at every site of learning in place and functional (e.g. internet connectivity, broadband, software, network connections, workshops, kitchens, simulation rooms, computer rooms etc.) - Observations in venues/Physical inspection of teaching and learning venues (All programmes). LMS and LSS Coordinator at the college: Plan and report on the LMS and LSS training. Ensure lecturers are registered and use the LMS and LSS across the Programmes. Report on the implementation of LMS and LSS activities by campuses to the College Academic Board Members. Accountable and responsible for LMS and LSS at the College. Manage the college operations including the administration of lecturers for imparting quality programme delivery to students. Ensure that day to day operations of all programmes at campuses are effectively and efficiently coordinated. Implement, monitor digitalisation of teaching and learning across all the Programmes. Coordinate the lecturers’ Training and Development on the content: Implement the lecturers’ Training Development program as stipulated on the College Training Plan. Develop the subject content training intervention plan in consultation with the Training Providers. Identify the facilitators for both internal and external content trainings. Coordinate the compilation of the training materials. Compile and submit report on the conducted subject content training across the Programmes. Improving student performance and development: Manage the achievement of the requisite pass rates through monitoring of attendance and student retention. Monitoring the adherence to curriculum policies. Ensuring the formation of subjects’ committee meeting at campuses. Coordinate and chair the College Curriculum meetings. Monitor and report on the provision of classroom teaching and support. Ensuring that programmes providing skills for the digital economy are offered in the college. Ensuring that the college participation in activities related to promoting skills for the 4IR. Comply with Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College Policies and Procedures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. LK Boikhutso Tel No: (011) 730 6600 / Mr. T Matsaba Tel No: (011) 730
jobs.applications: must be submitted to recruitment@eec.edu.za OR hand delivered at Ekurhuleni East TVET College: Central Office, Sam Ngema Road, Kwa – Thema. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Please forward your application, quoting the reference number to: The Assistant Director: Human Resource Management & Development. Ekurhuleni East TVET College, Sam Ngema Road, Kwa - Thema or Posted to Private Bag X52, Springs, 1560.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on Z83 Form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/Documents and must be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (with three contactable references). A Fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A user guide and ‘how to’ videos will assist in how to complete for the form and digital signature. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in term s of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action. The appointment will be done in line with the approved Employment Equity Plan. Persons with disability are encouraged to apply. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: Kurrikulumimplementering (MINISTERIËLE Programme)
af.summary: Lei en bestuur kurrikulumimplementering en monitor ondersteuning vir onderrig en leer aan Ekurhuleni East TVET College.
af.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. 'n Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Onderwys. 3-5 jaar in 'n Onderwys-/Onderrig-en-Leeromgewing of verwante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenvaardigheid. Uitgebreide kennis van die Raamwerk vir die Onderrig-en-Leerplan sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing en beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van TVET-/CET-administrasie. Begrip van die hoëronderwyssektor. 'n Begrip van DHET se strategiese visie en prioriteite. Deeglike kennis van alle beleide en wetgewing wat TVET-kolleges in South Africa regeer. Met betrekking tot beroepsonderwys en -opleiding, deeglike kennis van die student/inligtingbestuurstelsel. Beplanning en organisasie. Probleemoplossing. Navorsingsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Aanbiedingsvaardighede en leierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor en evalueer die ondersteuning vir onderrig en leer: Lei en bestuur Kurrikulum tot die bereiking van verbeterde studenteprestasie: Konsolideer, bestuur, monitor en evalueer die implementering van die DHET Onderrig-en-Leerplan. Verseker standaardisering van kurrikulumdienste oor kampanje, bv. tydskedules, werkswinkels. Rapporteer oor die monitering van die beskikbaarheid van doseerders se werklading en klastydskedules. Verseker konsolidasie en koördinasie van funksies tussen alle kollege-kurrikulumstrukture, substrukture en kampanje om behoorlike operasionele en bestuursverslagdoening te fasiliteer. Skakel met alle kurrikulumpersoneel oor kurrikulumverwante kwessies. Ontwikkel, monitor en evalueer die kollege se ingrypingsstrategieë vir effektiewe kurrikulumaflewering. Hersien kurrikulumbeliede en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Lei, koördineer en fasiliteer die implementering van nuwe kurrikulum en PQM. Verseker die verskaffing van leiding vir die verbetering van kurrikuluminhoud en -aflewering in oorleg met openbare en privaat bedryfsbelanghebbendes. Monitor die verkryging van handboeke en onderrig-en-leerbronne. Monitering en evaluering van kurrikulumdekking. Beplan klassebesoek as deel van ondersteuning vir die ICASS. Bou 'n sterk netwerk van kontakte met ander instellings en bedrywe. Bestuur van Onderrig-en-Leerondersteuning: Lei en bestuur klaskamer, deeltydse klasse en gemengde leer: Verseker die implementering van beleid oor klaskamer, deeltyd en gemengde leer. Rapportering oor klaskamer, deeltyd en gemengde leer. Neem die leiding by die beplanning van werkswinkels, vergaderings, akademiese besoeke in Onderrig en Leer. Verseker dat Deeltydse klasse nie minder gunstig behandel word as voltydse klasse nie aangesien hulle bydra tot die kollege se sertifisering en slaagsyfer. Rapporteer oor Onderrig-en-leerinfrastruktuur per programma by elke leerplek wat in plek en funksioneel is (bv. internetkonnektiwiteit, breedband, sagteware, netwerkverbindings, werkswinkels, kombuisse, simulasiekamers, rekenaarkamers ens.) - Waarnemings in sale/Fisiese inspeksie van onderrig-en-leersale (Alle programme). LMS- en LSS-koördineerder by die kollege: Beplan en rapporteer oor die LMS- en LSS-opleiding. Verseker dat doseerders geregistreer is en die LMS en LSS oor die Programme gebruik. Rapporteer oor die implementering van LMS- en LSS-aktiwiteite deur kampanje aan die Lede van die Kollege Akademiese Raad. Verantwoordelik en aanspreeklik vir LMS en LSS by die Kollege. Bestuur die kollege se bedrywighede insluitend die administrasie van doseerders om gehalteprogramaflewering aan studente te verseker. Verseker dat die daaglikse bedrywighede van alle programme by kampanje doeltreffend en doeltreffend gekoördineer word. Implementeer, monitor digitalisering van onderrig en leer oor al die Programme. Koördineer die doseerders se Opleiding en Ontwikkeling oor die inhoud: Implementeer die doseerders se Opleidingsontwikkelingsprogram soos uiteengesit in die Kollege Opleidingsplan. Ontwikkel die ingrypingsplan vir vakinhoudopleiding in oorleg met die Opleidingverskaffers. Identifiseer die fasiliteerders vir beide interne en eksterne inhoudsopleiding. Koördineer die samestelling van die opleidingsmateriaal. Stel 'n verslag op en doen verslag oor die uitgevoerde vakinhoudopleiding oor die Programme. Verbetering van studenteprestasie en -ontwikkeling: Bestuur die bereiking van die vereiste slaagsyfers deur monitering van bywoning en studentbehoud. Monitering van die nakoming van kurrikulumbeliede. Verseker die vorming van vakkomiteevergaderings by kampanje. Koördineer en sit die Kollege Kurrikulumvergaderings voor. Monitor en rapporteer oor die verskaffing van klaskameronderrig en -ondersteuning. Verseker dat programme wat vaardighede vir die digitale ekonomie bied by die kollege aangebied word. Verseker dat die kollege deelneem aan aktiwiteite verbonde aan die bevordering van vaardighede vir die 4IR. Voldoen aan Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en Kollegebeleide en -prosedures.

zu.title: Ukuqashwa kweCurriculum (Izinhlelo ze-MINISTERIAL)
zu.summary: Qondisa futhi uphathe ukuqashwa kwe-curriculum bese ubheka ukusekelwa ekufundiseni nasekufundeni e-Ekurhuleni East TVET College.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-National Diploma / Degree e-Education. Ukuqashwa kweminyaka engu-3-5 kumazinga e-Education/Teaching and Learning noma inkambu ehlobene nayo. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekileyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olubanzi mayelana ne-Teaching and Learning Plan Framework kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nemigomo yenqubo yomphakathi. Ulwazi nge-PSET. Ulwazi kokuqonda ukuphatwa kwe-TVET/CET. Ukuqonda ingxenye ye-High Education. Ukuqonda izinhloso kanye ne-strategic vision ye-DHET. Ulwazi oluphelele ngazo zonke imigomo kanye nemithetho ephatha ama-TVET Colleges e-South Africa. Mayelana ne-vocational education and training, ulwazi oluphelele ngokusistimu yokuqashwa kwabafundi/ulwazi. Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono ocwaningo. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Iziqu zomuntu nomuntu. Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nakubhalwe. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (okubhalwe nangomlomo). Amakhono okubukisa kanye namakhono okuba ngumholi.
zu.duties: Buka futhi uhlole ukusekelwa ekufundiseni nasekufundeni: Qondisa futhi uphathe i-Curriculum ukuze kufinyelelwe ekwenzeni kube ngcono iziphumelelo zabafundi: Hlanganisa, phatha, buka futhi uhlôle ukuqashwa kwe-DHET Teaching and Learning Plan. Qinisekisa ukulinganisela okufanayo kwezinsiza ze-curriculum kuzo zonke i-campuses, njengama-timetables, ama-workshops. Binga ngokubuka ukutholakala kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi zabafundisi kanye nama-timetables akilasi. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa nokuhlelwa kwemisebenzi phakathi kwazo zonke izakhiwo ze-curriculum kwa-college, izakhiwo ezincane kanye nama-campuses ukuthuthukisa ukubika okulungele ngokusebenza nokuphatha. Xhumana nabasebenzi bonke be-curriculum ngemibuzo ehlobene ne-curriculum. Bumba, buka futhi uhlôle izindlela zokungenelela kwa-college ukuze kuqashwe i-curriculum ngempumelelo. Buyekeza imigomo ye-curriculum kanye nama-standard operating procedures. Qondisa, hlela, futhi wenze kube lula ukuqashwa kwe-curriculum entsha kanye ne-PQM. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kokuqondiswa ekwenzeni ngcono okuqukethwe yi-curriculum nokuqashwa ngokusekelwa iziphoqezwi zomphakathi kanye nezangasese. Buka ukutholwa kwezincwadi zokufunda kanye nezinsiza zokufundisa nokufunda. Ukubuka nokuhlola ukuvaleka kwe-curriculum. Hlela ukuvakasha kwikilasi njengengxenye yekusekelwa kwe-ICASS. Akha inethiwekhi enamandla yoxhumo namanye amasikhungo kanye nezimboni. Ukuphathwa kokusekelwa ekufundiseni nasekufundeni: Qondisa futhi uphathe amakilasi, amakilasi ohamba ngesikhathi esingajwayelekile kanye ne-Blended learning: Qinisekisa ukuqashwa kwegagasi ngekilasi, isikhathi esingajwayelekile, kanye ne-blended learning. Ukubinga ngamakilasi, isikhathi esingajwayelekile kanye ne-blended learning. Yiba ngumholi ekuhleleni kwe-workshop, imihlangano, ukuvakasha kwemfundo ekufundiseni nasekufundeni. Qinisekisa ukuthi amakilasi ohamba ngesikhathi esingajwayelekile aphathwa kabi kune-amakilasi agcwele njengoba anenqonyiswa ekutholeni izitifiketi kwa-college kanye nizinga lokudlula. Binga ngokulawulwa kwensiza yokufundisa nokufunda ngakho ngakunye ngohlelo kuzo zonke izindawo zokufunda ukuthi zitholakale futhi zisebenza (njengokuqhathaniswa kwe-internet, i-broadband, isoftware, izixhumanisi zenethiwekhi, ama-workshops, amakishi, izigodi zokulingisa, amakilasi ekhompyutha njll.) - Ukuqaphela kuzendawo/ukuhlola ngokomzimba izindawo zokufundisa nokufunda (Wonke amahlelo). I-LMS kanye ne-LSS Coordinator kwa-college: Hlela bese ubinga nge-LMS kanye nokolunyukiwe kwe-LSS. Qinisekisa ukuthi abafundisi babhalisile futhi basebenzisa i-LMS kanye ne-LSS kuwo wonke ama-Programmes. Binga nokuqashwa kwezinkomba ze-LMS kanye ne-LSS ngama-campuses kubaluleki be-College Academic Board Members. Umyalezo kanye nobunzima nge-LMS kanye ne-LSS kwa-College. Phatha izinkomba kwa-college okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwabafundisi ekuletheni izinhlelo zobuningi zabafundi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkomba zansuku zonke zamahlelo atholakala ngama-campuses zihlelwe ngempumelelo nangokusebenza. Qasha, buke ukwenza kwe-digital kwesikhathi esiphakathi nakuso sonke isikhathi kwezinkomba ezinkulu namancane. Hlela ukolunyukiwe kwabafundisi ngokuqukethwe: Qasha uhlelo lokolunyukiwe abafundisi njengoba kuvezwe ekuhlelweni kwe-College Training Plan. Bumba icebo lokungenelela ekolunyukiwe nokuqukethwe okungalolunyukiwe kuxhumana nalabo abanikeza ukolunyukiwe. Qaphela labo abaqondisa kolunyukiwe langaphakathi nangaphandle. Hlela ukuhlanganiswa kolunyukiwe. Hlela bese uthumela umbiko ngezinhlelo ezinikelwe ekolunyukiwe kokungeniswa kolunyukiwe kwabafundisi kolunyukiwe. Ukwenza ngcono iziphumelelo kanye nokuqashwa kwabafundi: Phatha ukufinyelela kwamazinga okudlula ngokuqashwa kokuhamba kanye nokugcina kwabafundi. Ukubuka ukulandela imigomo ye-curriculum. Qinisekisa ukwakheka kwezinhlela zokuhlangana kwabafundi ngamakhilasi. Hlela bese uba ngusihlalo wemihlangano ye-College Curriculum. Buka bese ubinga ngokuqashelwa kokufundisa nokusekelwa ekilasini. Qinisekisa ukuthi amahlelo anikeza amakhono obunjingalwane bokulawula e-digital anikwa kwa-college. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwa-college kuyathathwa inhlalo ezinkundeni ezihlobene nokuqashwa kwamakhono abalingiswa. Landela imigomo kanye nama-Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) kanye nama-College Policies and Procedures.

xh.title: Uphumezo lweNkqubo yokufunda (iinkqubo zeNgxowaMoya)
xh.summary: ukuba ngumphathi wokuphumeza inkqubo yokufunda kwaye ulawule nokuba negunya lokulawula inkxaso yokufunda nokufundisa kwiKholeji yeTVET yaseEkurhuleni East.
xh.requirements: Isatifiketi seBanga le-12 / iMatrik / inqanaba 4. IDiploma yezwe / Isidanga kwiZemfundo. Iyure ezingama-3-5 kwindawo yeMfundo / Yokufundisa nokufunda okanye kwilawula ehambelana nayo. ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukuzazi ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga neSiseko seNkqubo yoCwangciso lokuFundisa nokufunda kuya kuba lusipho. Ulwazi ngemithetho neenkqazo zeNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngePSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNkqubo yolawulo yeTVET / CET. Ukuqonda i candelo leMfundo ePhakamileyo. Ukuqonda imbono ebalulekileyo neengqalelo eziphambili zeDHET. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga neenkqazo zonke namathetho alawula iiKholeji zeTVET eMzantsi Afrika. Ukuqonda ulwazi olubanzi malunga nonxibelelwano lowasemfundo / inkqubo yolawulo lwolwazi ngenxa yemfundo nesikolo. Ukucazela nokuhlela. Ukuxazula iingxaki. Amakhono ephando. Amakhono okuhlalutya. Amakhono okubhala ingxelo. Ubumiane nabantu. Unxibelelwano ngemilomo nangokubhaliweyo. Amakhono abalulekileyo eNxibelelwano (abhalwe nengomlomo). Amakhono okubonisa kwaye nabaphathi.
xh.duties: Qaphela kwaye uhlonze inkxaso yokufundisa nokufunda: ukuba ngumphathi wolawulo loPhumezo lweNkqubo yokufunda ngenjongo yokuphucula ukuphumelela kwabafundi: qhoboshela, lawula, qaphela kwaye uhlonze ukuphunyezwa kweCwangciso lokuFundisa nokufunda leDHET. Qinisekisa ukuzalaniswa kolwazi ngenkqubo yokufunda kuzo zonke iindawo zokufunda, umz., iinkqubo zexesha, iirhafu. Wenze ingxelo malunga nokuphola ukubakho kwezixhobo zokusebenza zabathisha nokubakho kweNkqubo yexesha lokufundisa. Qinisekisa ukuqhoboshela nokuhlanganisa imisebenzi phakathi kwezakhiwo zonke ezingalawulwa zinkqubo zefundo kwikholeji, izakhiwo ezincinci nezindawo zokufunda ukuze kwenzeke ukwenza ingxelo yokuqhuba nokuyilawula idlelane. Thetha noLawuli wenkqubo yemfundo malunga nezinto ezingomgama wenkqubo yemfundo. Phucula, qaphela kwaye uhlonze iindlela zokungenelela kwikholeji ukuqinisekisa ukuphumeza kweNkqubo yemfundo. Phinda ubuke iinkqazo zenkqubo yemfundo neenkqubo zokusebenza ezingagqibekanga. Yala, yamanze, kwaye uncandise ukuphumeza kwenkqubo entsha yokufunda kwaye nePQM. Qinisekisa ukunikelwa kolwazi malunga nokuphucula okuqulethwe kwenkqubo yokufunda nokuqhutywa phakathi kwabashwankathelo beholidephile nabangasese. Qaphela ukuthengwa kwezincwadi zokufunda nolwazi lwezixhobo zokufunda nokufundisa. Qaphela kwaye uhlonze ulwazi olunikezelwayo ngokufundisa nokufunda. Cwangcisa ukutyelelwa kwabathisha endaweni yokufundisa njengenxalenye yenkxaso ye ICASS. Yakha ukudibanisa okuqinileyo koluntu nabanye oogunyathiswa boluntu nemishini yobugcisa. Ulawulo olubekekileyo lweNkqubo yokufundisa nokufunda: Yala ulawulo lwegumbi lokufunda, amakilasi yesikhathi esingapheliyo nokufunda kuhlakanipho: Qinisekisa ukuphunyezwa kwenkqubo kwigumbi lokufunda, ixesha lokungezelela nokufunda okuhlakaniphileyo. Ukwenza ingxelo malunga negumbi lokufunda, ixesha lokungezelela nokufunda okuhlakaniphileyo. Yala ukucwangcisa korhafu, amadebe, iindwendwe zemfundo ekuFundiseni nasekuFundeni. Qinisekisa ukuba amakilasi angeziweyo abe mncinci ngokulingana namakilasi amnqamlezo njengoko onegalelo ekuqinisekisweni nokugqithiseni ibanga lekolishi. Yenza ingxelo malunga nolwazi lokufunda nokufundisa kolawulo ngokuphiwe okuthile kwindawo nganye yokufunda ekhoyo isebenza (umz. ukuqhagamshelana kwi-intanethi, i-broadband, isoftware, ukuqhagamshelana koluntu, iirhafu, iikhitshi, iindawo zokulinganisa, iindawo zekhompyutha, njl.) - Ukuqaphela iindawo / ukuqaphela ngokuzenzela kolwazi lokufundisa nokufunda kwizikrongco (azonke iinkqubo). IsiQapheli seLMS neLSS kwikholeji: Cwangcisa kwaye wenze ingxelo ngokulungiselelwa iLMS neLSS. Qinisekisa ukuba abatshinga babhalisiwe kwaye basebenzise iLMS neLSS kuyo yonke iinkqubo. Yenza ingxelo malunga nokuphunyezwa kweenkqubo iLMS neLSS ngamaziko ukuya kuba liLungu leNkundla kaRulumende yeeNkcitho zeKholeji. Nxibelelanisa kwaye ube negunya lokulawula iLMS neLSS kwikholeji. Lawula izicelo zekholeji eziquka ulawulo abatshingi ukuphumeza ngokuhamba kwexesha ukunika abafundi ulwazi olulinganayo. Qinisekisa izicelo zemihla ngemihla kuzo zonke iinkqubo kwiiKholeji zibe zihambelana kolunye. Lawula, qaphela ukuqhutywa kwamanani okulinganisa ekuFundiseni nakokuFunda nakuzo zonke iinkqubo. Yala abatshingi ngokulungiselelwa kunye nokuqonda nge nkqubo: Lawula abatshingi iNkqubo yokulungiselelwa njengoko kucetyisiwe kwiNkqubo yoLungiselelwa lokuqeqesha iKholeji. Cwangcisa i nkqubo yokulungiselelwa i nkqubo ngolwazi ngokubonisana nabo balela imfundo. Phatha abavelisi abadibanisa i nkqubo yoqeqesho lwangaphakathi nangaphandle. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kolwazi ngokulungiselelwa. Qokelela kwaye ufake ingxelo kwi nkqubo yokulungiselelwa ngolwazi iya kwazo zonke iinkqubo. Ukuphucula ukuphucuka nokuphuhliswa kwabafundi: Lawula ukuphumelela okulinganileyo okulindelekileyo ngokuqaphela ukubakho kwexesha lokufunda nokugcina abafundi. Qaphela ukuzigqiba kwemithetho y nkqubo yokufunda. Qinisekisa ukudityaniswa kwekomiti yokubonisana ngezinto ezifundwayo kwiiKholeji. Yamanza kwaye u yale iNkqubo yoqhagamshelwano yamagosa e mfundo kwi Koleji. Qaphela kwaye wenze ingxelo ngenkxaso yokufundisa nokufunda. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ezinika amakhono obuchwepheshe bokulawula i-intanethi zikhankanywe kwikoleji. Qinisekisa ukuba iKoleji ithatha inxaxheba kwi nkqubo ezinxulumene nokuphucula amakhono e-4IR. Yahluleka ngokulawula iNkqubo yeNdawo yePhakamileyo yoQeqesho & ukuQeqesha (DHET) neenkqazo zeKoleji.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Partnership and Linkages
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role at Ekurhuleni East TVET College to form and manage partnerships with industry stakeholders and develop joint project proposals.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate, 3-year Diploma / Degree in Project Management or Marketing. 3-5 Years’ experience working in Project Management or Business development environment. Valid driver’s licence. Computer Literacy. Knowledge of Public Service Act, PFMA, Building partnerships. Innovation. Marketing and entrepreneur insight. Financial Management. Mobilising resources. Interpretation of statutes, Treasury regulations and other frameworks. Business planning. Visibility analysis. Knowledge and understanding of administration reporting process and procedures. Negotiation skills. Communication. Presentation skill. Academic Process and moderation procedures. Administrative skill. Planning and organising skills. Financial management. Skills. Report writing skills. Communication and interpersonal skill. Problem solving skill. Analytical skill. Client oriented skill. Project management skill. Team leadership skill. Planning and organizing skill.
jobs.duties: Form and manage partnership with industry and relevant stakeholders. Build a database of local business and other linkages. Participate in business forums and identify project opportunities. Develop project proposals and plans for joint initiatives. Facilitate handover with the College managers. Business opportunities scanning. Identify opportunities for College income generation. Establish work environment simulation potential. Provide market needs business case rationale for all opportunities. Identify appropriate partner or service provider. Coordinate the submission of tenders and funding proposals. Provide information and reports on programmes, funding and partnership to DHET and other stakeholders. Local and Provincial government relations. Develop and update schedule of local government projects and opportunities. Identify College synergies potential contribution to provincial departments. Build relationships with relevant officials, establish a database of key contacts and participate in meetings as appropriate. Develop proposals for partnering on specific practical opportunities aligned with College core business. Research Management. Conduct visibility studies for all new and proposed projects. Develop the project and budget. Partner with relevant research organisations. Negotiate and sign service level agreements and or contracts with clients. Provide training and support to LPU and campus staff members on SETA and contractual compliance matters. Coordinate accreditation and application for new programme approvals. Handover the project to the relevant campus or occupational manger. Oversee and maintain student work placement and Work Integrated Learning (WIL). Ensure that the TVET college student placement and WIL policy is in place and adhered to. Analyse the job market, identify scarce skills and match available opportunities with college programme mix. Ensure that an effective system is in place to assist learners to find job placement. Identify potential partners and networks to benefit and support existing graduates. Negotiate the employment opportunities with the employers and promote ex-graduate for vacancies. Ensure that they attend the strategic meeting with SETA to negotiate graduate‘s placement and facilitate the signatory of Memorandum of Understandings (MoU’s). Comply with Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College Policies and Procedures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. LK Boikhutso Tel No: (011) 730 6600 / Mr. T Matsaba Tel No: (011) 730
jobs.applications: must be submitted to recruitment@eec.edu.za OR hand delivered at Ekurhuleni East TVET College: Central Office, Sam Ngema Road, Kwa – Thema. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Please forward your application, quoting the reference number to: The Assistant Director: Human Resource Management & Development. Ekurhuleni East TVET College, Sam Ngema Road, Kwa - Thema or Posted to Private Bag X52, Springs, 1560.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on Z83 Form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents and must be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (with three contactable references). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A user guide and ‘how to’ videos will assist in how to complete for the form and digital signature. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action. The appointment will be done in line with the approved Employment Equity Plan. Persons with disability are encouraged to apply. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Vennootskappe en Skakelings
af.summary: Assistent-direkteurpos by Ekurhuleni East TVET College om vennootskappe met nywerheidsbelanghebbendes te vorm en te bestuur en gesamentlike projekvoorstelle te ontwikkel.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 / Matriek / Vlak 4-sertifikaat, 3-jaar Diploma / Graad in Projektbestuur of Bemarking. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in 'n projektbestuur- of besigheidsontwikkelingsomgewing. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kennis van die Public Service Act, PFMA, die bou van vennootskappe. Innovering. Bemarkings- en entrepreneurskapinsig. Finansiële bestuur. Mobilisering van hulpbronne. Interpretasie van statute, Tesourie-regulasies en ander raamwerke. Besigheidsbeplanning. Sigbaarheidsanalise. Kennis en begrip van die administratiewe verslagdoeningsproses en -prosedures. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Kommunikasie. Aanbiedingsvaardigheid. Akademiese proses en moderasieprosedures. Administratiewe vaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuur. Vaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardigheid. Probleemoplossingsvaardigheid. Analitiese vaardigheid. Kliëntgerigte vaardigheid. Projektbestuursvaardigheid. Spanleierskapsvaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardigheid.
af.duties: Vorm en bestuur vennootskappe met die nywerheid en tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Bou 'n databasis van plaaslike besighede en ander skakelings. Neem deel aan besigheidsforums en identifiseer projekgeleenthede. Ontwikkel projekvoorstelle en -planne vir gesamentlike inisiatiewe. Fasiliteer oorhandiging met die Kollege-bestuurders. Skandering van besigheidsgeleenthede. Identifiseer geleenthede vir inkomste-generering deur die Kollege. Vestig die potensiaal vir werklikheidsgetroue werkomgewingsimulasie. Verskaf 'n markbehoeftesaklikkegrondslag vir alle geleenthede. Identifiseer toepaslike vennote of diensverskaffers. Koördineer die indiening van tenders en befondsingsvoorstelle. Verskaf inligting en verslae oor programme, befondsing en vennootskappe aan DHET en ander belanghebbendes. Plaaslike en provinsiale regeringsbetrekkinge. Ontwikkel en werk 'n skedule van plaaslike regeringsprojekte en -geleenthede by. Identifiseer die Kollege se sinergiepotensiaalbydrae tot provinsiale departemente. Bou verhoudings met tersaaklike amptenare, vestig 'n databasis van sleutelkontakte en neem waar toepaslik deel aan vergaderings. Ontwikkel voorstelle om op spesifieke praktiese geleenthede wat met die Kollege se kernbesigheid ooreenstem, te vennoteer. Navorsingsbestuur. Voer sigbaarheidstudies uit vir alle nuwe en voorgestelde projekte. Ontwikkel die projek en begroting. Vennoteer met tersaaklike navorsingsorganisasies. Onderhandel en onderteken diensvlakooreenkomste en/of kontrakte met kliënte. Verskaf opleiding en ondersteuning aan LPU en kampuspersoneellede oor SETA- en kontraktuele nakomingsake. Koördineer akkreditasie en aansoek om nuwe programgoedkeurings. Handig die projek oor aan die tersaaklike kampus- of beroepsbestuurder. Hou toesig oor en handhaaf studentewerkplasing en Werkgeïntegreerde Leer (WIL). Verseker dat die beleid vir TVET-kollegestudenteplasing en WIL in plek is en nagekom word. Analiseer die arbeidsmark, identifiseer skaarsvaardighede en pas beskikbare geleenthede by die Kollege se programmengsel aan. Verseker dat 'n doeltreffende stelsel in plek is om leerders te help om werkplasing te vind. Identifiseer potensiële vennote en netwerke om voordeel te trek uit en bestaande gegradueerdes te ondersteun. Onderhandel werksgeleenthede met werkgewers en bevorder eks-gegradueerdes vir vakatures. Verseker dat hulle die strategiese vergadering met SETA bywoon om plasing van gegradueerdes te onderhandel en die ondertekening van Memoranda van Verstandhouding (MoU's) te fasiliteer. Voldoen aan Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en Kollegebeleide en -prosedures.

zu.title: Umphathi Osongiwe: Ubumanye Nophumo, Izinhlobonhlobo, Imibhoshobhosho Ephethwe Kahle
zu.summary: Indima yesikhundla sokuba ngumPhathi oPhethwe Isikhundla esikI-Ekurhuleni East TVET College ukwakha futhi aphathe ubuhlobo nabaphathi bembona nezinhlobo zaba khona bakha, futhi adale ukwakhiwa kwephrojekthi ehlukene nabakhokheli bomphakathi jikelele ngokusobala ngokusemthethweni nokuzinza kwezidingo, ukuhlela futhi axhumise nezinkinga ezibukhoheli.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Gra 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate; i-Diploma / Degree yeminyaka eyi-3 kwi-Project Management noma i-Marketing. Okungenani unamava eminyaka engu-3-5 wokusebenza kwemvelo yokuphatha amaphrojekthi (Project Management) noma kokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi (Business development). Ilaysensi yokushayela egunyaziwe. Ukuhlola ikhakhomputha. Ukuqonda umthetho we-Public Service Act, i-PFMA, kanye nokwakha ubuhlobo. Ukuba nobuhlakani bokuzihlanganisa nokuthuthukisa izinto. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa nokuqhakaza kwezentengiso. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuqoqa izinsiza. Ukutolikwa komthetho, izimiso ze-Treasury namanye amasimu. Ukuhlela imisebenzi. Isibhejo sokwaziswa kwembona. Ulwazi nokuzwisisa inqubo nemiyalo yokubika ngokuphathwa kanzima. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Unxibelelwano. Ikhono lokubukhon'isibonelo. Inqubo yokufunda nokulinganisa iziqu. Ikhono lokuphatha izinto ngokwesibhengezo. Amakhono ekuhleleni noku-organisa. Ukuphathwa kwemali. Amakhono amancane. Amakhono okubhaliweyo.
zu.duties: Kufanele kwakhiwe futhi kuphatwe ubuhlobo nembona nezinhlangano ezihlobene ngqo; kwakhiwe isisekelo sezinto ngokwenza uhlu lwamabhizinisi asendaweni namanye amakhon' i-anđe; kuthathwe inxaxheba kumafomamakhula emisebenzi futhi kubonwe amathuba okwenza amaphrojekthi; kucutshungulwe amacebo okuqamba izinhloso ezibandakanya i-Collège namaphoyisa ehlala; kwabelane ngokulalela nokugqamisa ngokuphatha i-Collège; kwenziwe uphenyo nolwazi lokuhlola izinhloso zamathuba okusebenza; kubonwe amathuba okwenz' i-Collège iphumelele ngokuzinza imali kumabhizinisi; kuhlolwe ubunkosi bokwenza ukuthi iphrojekthi ibe yisbangelo esibucayi; kuboniswe ngamaphoyisa wezinsizakalo abafanele; kuhlehlwe izicelo ezifakiwe ngokuzinza izinkulumo-mbono nezeziqinisekile; kubhalwe ngamabhalana ngokwenziwa, izimali nokubamba izandla kubaphathi be-DHET nezenkolo; kwakhiwe ubudlelwano nohulumeni wedolobha lesvini; kulandelwe isikhathi sikaDolobha ekwenzeni amaphrojekthi nezenzo; kuchazwe ukuthi i-Collège inganikeza isandla esingakanani emaphoyisa abangangezwe; kwakhiwe ubuhlobo nabasebenzi abalawulayo, kwakhiwe uhlu lwabantu abaphawulekayo, bathathwe inxaxheba kwemihlangano lapho kufanele khona; kwakhiwe amaphrojekthi okubamba izandla ezingeni elithize, ehlobene ngqo nomsebenzi oyindlamu we-Collège; kuphathwe izophulo; kwenziwe upheny' olubheka kabanzi kumaphrojekthi amasha abukhali; kwakhiwe amaphrojekthi kanye nezimali zokwenza, abahlobana nabo bemenywa; kubekiwe izinkulumo zokwamukela imithetho yesikhathi, nezinkinobho zamafa; kwaziswe ngamaphrojekthi kubantu bemvovo esilinganisweni; kumiswe ulwazi kubangemva; kuyilwe izinkomba ukuze kubhalwe ngokwesibhengezo; kwabelwe abasebenzi bomphakathi besebenzisa izifundo ezinhle kulezo zincwadi; kwaziwe ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhambisa imithetho yebango; kulawulwe izinto ezihlukene; kwenziwe isiphithiphithi sokugqiba kwamaphrojekthi.

xh.title: Umqathi ongumncedisi: Ubugatho neNtsebenziswano
xh.summary: Indima kaMqathi ongumncedisi eEkurhuleni East TVET College yokuyila ubugatho nababanomdla kwishishini nokulawula kunye nokuphuhlisa iiproposals zeprojekthi ehlangeneyo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4, iDiploma yeminyaka emi-3 / iNqanaba lesidanga kwinkqubo yoLawulo lweProjekthi okanye ekuThengiseni. Ulwazi lweminyaka engama-3-5 lusebenzweni lokuLawula iiprojekthi okanye kwindawo yophuhliso lwehwebo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazinge-mlando ngoMthetho wokuSebenza koLuntu, iPFMA, ukuYila ubugatho. Intsingiselo eutsha. Ukuqonda ukuthengisa nangabaphuhlisi bashishino. Ukulawula iimali. Ukuqokelela izixhobo zokuqhuba phambili. Ukucazulula imithetho, iimithetho yesikwele nezinye iinkqubo ezisezantsi. Ulwazi lokucwangcisa ibhizinisi. Ukuhlolwa kolwazi. Ulwazi nokuqonda inkcitha yokwenza iingxelo ngenkqubo nangendlela eziyiswa. Amabhalo athengisa. Unxibelelwano. Isiphiro sokuvelisa. Inkqubo yezemfundo nendlela zokulinganisa. Isiphiro sokulawula. Isiphiro sokucwangcisa nokuqamba. Ukulawula iimali. Amabhalo. Isiphiro sobhalo lweengxelo. Isiphiro sonxibelelwano nabantu. Isiphiro sokuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki. Isiphiro sokuhlaziya. Isiphiro seklhiyenti. Isiphiro solawulo lweProject. Isiphiro sobunkokeli bqela. Isiphiro sokucwangcisa nokuhlela.
xh.duties: Yila ulawule ubugatho nababanomdla kwishishini kwaye nabanomdla abafanelekileyo. Yakha isiseko seenkcukacha zoshishino lwendawo nezinye iindlela zoxhumanisano. Thatha inxaxheba kwiindaba zoshishino yaye ufumane ithuba leeprojekthi. Phuhlisa iiproposals zeeprojekthi neenkqubo zemizamo ehlangeneyo. Yenza iindlela zokuqhuba phambili nabaqathi bakwaKholeji. Hlola amathuba ehwebo. Fumanisa amathuba okuzuzisa imali ukuba igqitha iNqanaba leKholeji. Sika isithuba sokulinganisa imo yomsebenzi. Nikezela ngesizathu soshishino sazo zonke iziseko ezifanelekileyo. Fumanisa umqathi ongumncedisi okanye umphathi weziseko zoshishino. Lawula ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi ngeendleko zokuNikela ngeengcamango zemali. Nikezela iingxelo ngeenkqubo, imali nobugatho kubakwaDHET nabanomdla. Unxibelelwano noorhululu karhulumente weNdawo noBukiwa. Phuhlisa aze ahlaziye izicwangciso zeendawo zikarhulumente nakuphi na amathuba eprojekthi. Fumanisa ixabiso elincedisayo leKholeji kumasebe karhulumente abukiwa. Yakha ubudlelwane nabasebenzi abafanelekileyo, baseke isiseko seengxelo zomntu ogciniweyo aze athabathe inxaxheba kwindibano njengoko kufunekile. Phuhlisa iingcamango zokubamba iqhaza ngokusetyenziswa kwamathuba ahambelana nekhowudi leKholeji. Ulawulo loPhando. Yenza izifundo zokuqonda zonke iiprojekthi ezintsha neziyiyo. Phuhlisa iprojekthi nembuyekezo yemali. Qamba ubudlelwane nabaphandi abafanelekileyo. Thetha usayine iinkqubo ezingangqamana nemigqalisweni nabadlali bekontrakthi. Nikezela uqeqesho nencedo kubasebenzi bakwaLPU nakwiikhampasi ngezindaba zokuhanjiswa kwaSETA ngezidingo zezenkonzo. Lawula izaziso nokuqeqesha iinkqubo ezintsha. Nikela ngeprojekthi kumlawuli wekhampasi okanye umphathi webhizinisi. Qaphela ugcine ukubekwa kwabafundi kwindawo yokusebenza nokufunda eNdiwo zoPhuhliso loBuncwadi. Qinisekisa ukuba isakhelo seNqanaba se-TVET saseKholeji i-WIL sikho saze sabanjwe. Hlola imarike yomsebenzi, fumanisa amabhalo alahlekileyo ulinganise namathuba akho ngenkqubo yesixhobo seKholeji. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho inkqubo ekhoyo yokunceda abafundi ukuba bafumane ukubekwa emsebenzini. Fumanisa abaqathi abanokunceda aze axhasa abafundi abagqithisiweyo. Thetha ngamathuba omsebenzi noqeshile uze uxhasa abafundi abagqithisiweyo kumathuba abafunwa. Qinisekisa ukuba batyelela indibano ebalulekileyo yo SETA ukuyithetha ngobeko loGqithisiweyo baze balawule ukuSayina kwezaziso zoQondisiso. Landela uMthetho woGqatso lweMfundo ePhakamileyo & uQeqesho (DHET) namaNqamleshwa neziNkqubo zoBuchule beKholeji.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Labour Relations
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Labour Relations at Ekurhuleni East TVET College, requiring a diploma or degree in HR Management and 3 to 5 years' labour relations experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate National Diploma / Degree in Human Resource Management. 3 – 5 years’ experience in Labour practice environment. 2 years Supervisory experience. Computer literacy. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge of Labour Relation Act. Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Public Service Act. Skills Development. Basic Conditions of Employment. Collective Agreements (Resolutions) at GPSSBC, ELRC and the PSCBC including any other related legislation. Good Written and verbal communication skills. Good problem-solving skills, research skills, Planning & Organising, analytical skills, report writing skills, Leadership skills, Presentation and Facilitation skills.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the implementation of labour relations related to the conditions of services. Ensure that all employment related legislation; policies and collective agreements are implemented and adhered to by both management and staff. Investigate discipline, grievance and dispute cases. Compile discipline, disputes and grievance reports. Participate in disciplinary hearing sittings and provide case management services. Represent the College in all disputes referred to the CCMA/Bargaining Council. Facilitate the implementation of Code of Conduct in the College. Provide statistical information relating to the Code of Conduct and update database. Provide advice workshops to management and staff on labour relations issues. Counsel and/or directs supervisory and management responses on potential problems/issues to reflect fair and reasonable resolutions before such issues become grievances and /or disputes. Administer the management of strikes and any other form of industrial action. Take minutes during meetings with employer and employee/employee representatives. Comply with Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College Policies and Procedures.

'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Menslikehulpbronbestuur. 3 – 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n arbeidspraktyk-omgewing. 2 jaar se toesigervaring. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Labour Relation Act. Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Public Service Act. Skills Development. Basic Conditions of Employment. Kollektiewe ooreenkomste (Resolusies) by GPSSBC, ELRC en die PSCBC insluitend enige ander verwante wetgewing. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie probleemoplossingsvaardighede, navorsingsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, analitiese vaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die implementering van arbeidsverhoudinge wat verband hou met diensvoorwaardes. Verseker dat alle diensverwante wetgewing; beleide en kollektiewe ooreenkomste geïmplementeer en deur beide bestuur en personeel nagekom word. Ondersoek dissiplinêre, klagte- en geskilgevalle. Stel dissiplinêre, geskil- en klagteverslae op. Neem deel aan dissiplinêre verhore en verskaf saakbestuursdienste. Verteenwoordig die College in alle geskille wat na die CCMA/Bargaining Council verwys is. Fasiliteer die implementering van die Gedragskode by die College. Verskaf statistiese inligting rakende die Gedragskode en werk die databasis by. Verskaf advieswerkswinkels aan bestuur en personeel oor arbeidsverhoudingsake. Raad gee en/of toesighoudende en bestuursresponse op potensiële probleme/kwessies rig om billike en redelike resolusies te weerspieël voordat sulke kwessies klagtes en/of geskille word. Administreer die bestuur van stakings en enige ander vorm van nywerheidsaksie. Neem notule tydens vergaderings met werkgewer en werknemer/werknemerverteeenwoordigers. Voldoen aan Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en College-beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Umncedisikhulu: Izindaba zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Umncedisikhulu: Izindaba zabasebenzi e-Ekurhuleni East TVET College, ofuna idiploma noma iziqu kwi-HR Management nobhonane wezinyanga ezi-3 kuya kwezi-5 kumsebenzi wezindaba zabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-National Diploma / Degree efanele kwi-Human Resource Management. Minyaka eli-3 – 5 wobhonane emhlabeni wokwenza umsebenzi wezindaba zabasebenzi. Minyaka emi-2 yobhonana ohlakeni labaphathi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi nge-Labour Relation Act. I-Employment Equity Act. I-Public Service Regulations. I-Public Service Act. I-Skills Development. I-Basic Conditions of Employment. Izivumelwano (Izinqumo) ku-GPSSBC, ELRC kanye ne-PSCBC kuhlanganize nanoma yisiphi esinye isisetshenziswa somthetho esihlobene. Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma kahle. Amakhono amahle okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okucwaninga, Ukuhlela & Ukuhlelela, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono obuholo, amakhono okubhukuda nokuhola izingqungqutha.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindaba zabasebenzi ezihlobene nezimo zokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imithetho ehlobene nokusebenza; izinqubomgomo nezivumelwano zisetshenziswa futhi zilandelwa kokubili abaphathi nabasebenzi. Phenya icala lokuxwayisa, izingxabano nezinkinga. Hlela imibiko yokuqinisa inhlalo, izingxabano nezingxabano. Thatha inxaxheba kuzikhathi zokuqinisa inhlalo futhi nikeza izinkonzo zokuqondisa icala. Mele i-College kuzo zonke izingxabano ezithunyelwe e-CCMA/Bargaining Council. Qondisa ukusetshenziswa kwekhodi yokuziphatha e-College. Nikeza ulwazi olunesibalo oluhlobene nekhodi yokuziphatha futhi uvuselele idathabhesi. Nikeza amawokshopho weseluleko abaphathi nabasebenzi ngezindaba zabasebenzi. Luleka futhi/noma uqondise izimpendulo zabalawuli nabaphathi ezinkinga ezithubeki/izindaba ukuthi zibonakaliswe ngendlela efanele futhi ehambisana nolwazi ngaphambi kokuba lezo zindaba zibe yizingxabano kanye/noma izingxabano. Phatha ukulawula izitriki nanoma yiphi enye indlela yokuqhuma kwabasebenzi. Bhala amaminithi ngesikhathi kwezinkhulumomphakathi nomqashi kanye nomsebenzi/abamele abasebenzi. Hambisana ne-Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) kanye nezinqubomgomo nezinqubo ze-College.

Iivumelwano zoBumbano (iSigqibo) kwi GPSSBC, ELRC ne PSCBC kuquka naluphi na olunye ulwizo lomthetho. Amandla okuxelela ngokubhalwayo nangokuthethwayo. Amandla aphezulu okusombulula iingxaki, amandla okuphand, uCwangciso noLungelelaniso, amandla ochokoza, amandla okubala iingxelo, amandla okuba nguMphathi, namandla okubonisa nokuqonda izinto.

Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imithetho enxulumene noqesho; iinkqazo neevumelwano zombumbano ziyasebenziswa kwaye zihlonelwe ngabaphathi nangabasebenzi. Phanda iimeko zolawulo, iingxaki namanxaxheba. Hlaza iingxelo ngolawulo, iinxaxheba neengxaki. Thatha inxaxheba kwisikhululo seemo zolawulo kwaye unike iinkonzo zolawulo lweemo. Mela iKholeji kuzo zonke iinxaxheba ezirejistiwe kwi CCMA/Bargaining Council. Qondisa ukusebenziswa koBumthetho bokuziphatha eKholeji. Nikezela ulwazi lwesibalo ngokuLungiselelwa koBumthetho bokuziphatha kwaye uhlazije isiseko seenkcukacha. Nikezela iindonga zelwazi kubaphathi nasebasebenzini ngeendaba zobuse basemsebenzini. Lula kwaye okanye uqondise iimpendulo zabalawuli nabaphathi kwiingxaki ezinokubakho/ezo nkqubo ukubonisa izigqibo ezifanelekileyo neentshiseko ngaphambi kokuba le ngxaki iba yingxaki okanye inxaxheba. Lawula ulawulo lwezitreyiki nanayo nanina enye indlela yentluso yabasebenzi. Tsala amanqaku kwangaphakathi kwiintlanganiso phakathi komqeshi nomsebenzisi/oomele abasebenzisi. Zithobe kwemiQathango nemiQathango yeDipartimende yoQeqesho loMgangatho ophezulu & uQeqesho (DHET) kunye neKholeji.

Begrip van die hoëronderwyssektor. Begrip van korporatiewe bestuur. Begrip van kostesentrum se begrotings-, bestedings- en kontantvloei-bestuur. Werkkansgelykheidswet, Openbare Diensregulasies en Openbare Dienswet, Arbeidsverhoudingswet en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardigheid. Verslagskryfvaardigheid. Kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardigheid. Rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardigheid. Analitiese vaardigheid. Kliëntgerigte vaardigheid. Projekbestuursvaardigheid. Spanleierskapsvaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. En mensebestuursvaardigheid. Kliëntediensfokus. Integriteit. Toegewyd. Proaktief. Integriteit.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe/uitvoerende steundiensste in die kantoor van die Prinsipaal: Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van die kollege, insluitend die bestuur van die werkstroom in die kantoor van die Prinsipaal. Doen navorsing en verskaf deskundige administratiewe advies aan die Prinsipaal en ander amptenare by die kollege. Doen kwaliteitskontrolering van briewe, memoranda en voorleggings. Hou toesig oor en monitor die begroting in die kantoor van die Prinsipaal. Koördineer kollege-invoere vir jaarlikse, kwartaallikse, maandelikse verslae en kontantvloei_state. Stel effektiewe rekord- en dokumentbestuurstelsels in die kantoor van die Prinsipaal in werking en implementeer dit. Volg vordering_verslae oor die implementering van die besluite op en stel dit saam. Koördineer verslae/voorleggings aan alle forums wat bygewoon word deur die kantoor van die kollege. Verskaf sekretariaatsteun aan die Kollege-raad, Raadkomitees, Akademiese Raad, Senior Bestuur en ander eksterne belanghebbendes: Onderhou die kalenderplan vir die skedulering en reël van vergaderings en kommunikeer met alle lede van bogenoemde strukture. Koördineer en reël alle vergaderings, verrigtinge en aktiwiteite van bogenoemde strukture. Verskaf tegniese steun tydens vergaderings, verrigtinge en aktiwiteite van bogenoemde strukture. Stel agenda, notules, verslae en ander rekords van bogenoemde strukture op. Verspreiding van relevante dokumente vir vergaderings van bogenoemde strukture. Hou 'n register van besluite en ondersteun alle tersaaklike Raadslede/Bestuurders/Amptenare deur voortdurende korrespondensie om hulle te herinner aan wat gedoen moet word. Verseker dat goedgekeurde notules onderteken en veilig bewaar word. Berei alle voorleggings, toesprake en verslae van die Prinsipaal en Raadkomitees met betrekking tot vergaderings van bogenoemde strukture voor. Verskaf strategiese bestuurs-, moniterings- en evalueringsdienste: Fasiliteer en koördineer die operasionele en strategiese beplanningsproses. Koördineer en stel strategiese en operasionele planne op. Stel die navorsingsagenda. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en implementering van dienslewering_verbeteringsplanne en inisiatiewe. Fasiliteer, koördineer en ondersteun die implementering van prioriteitsprogramme/projekte. Koördineer en stel institusionele prestasie- en strategiese verslae op. Doen 'n assessering van die kollege se doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit in die ondersteuning van die bereiking van dienslewering_doelwitte. Fasiliteer die implementering van die produktiwiteitsmetingsraamwerk (maatstaf van hoe doeltreffend en effektief insette soos arbeid, finansiële hulpbronne en infrastruktuur) omgeskakel word in uitsette (goedere en dienste). Voldoen aan Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en Kollegebeleid en -prosedures

zu.title: Assistant Director: Office of the Principal
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Assistant Director esinika isekelo lokuphathwa kokubalulekile kwe-ofisi lomqashi we-Ekurhuleni East TVET College, kanti kudinga i-diploma noma i-degree kanye neminyaka engu-3-5 yohluvo oluhambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-diploma / i-degree ehambisana nesimo se-Public Management / Business Management / Office Management and Technology noma nomaesidingo ahambisana nalawa. 3-5 years relevant experience in strategic planning and administration environment. Okungasenani iminyaka engu-2 yokuba nguqeqebu /umphathi ongagqamisa izisebenzi ezingathathwa ngqo ngabasebenzi abathile. I license yomshayeli egunyaziwe. Ulwazi ngomthetho kanye nemithetho kahulumeni kazwelonke (Public Service Act neLabour Relations Act) ukuqonda nemithetho ephathelene nenhlelo zokusebenza kahulumeni kwezolimo kolwazi oluthile kanye nemithetho yekolishi iphakeme kakhulu kakhulu, imithetho yokuphathwa kwezimali ekolishi kanti futhi nemithetho ehlobene. Ulwazi lwezimali kahulumeni nezinye izigaba zendlela yokusebenza kahle kwamamanyuvesi nasemabandla abasha; ukucutshungula imithetho yokusebenza kwezimali kahulumeni evela kwikhosulu kakhulu ekolishi ukuqonda imithetho esebenza kahle mayelana nokubhuka nokugcina amanye eminye imithetho kahulumeni aphakeme kulo lonke iqhaza laphakanyiswe. Imithetho yokuhamba kwamabhunga wamanyuvesi nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza kahle kwekolishi nasekuqondeni imisebenzi yekolishi. Ulwazi ngomthetho kahulumeni kanye noqeqesho ebandla eliphusile lokuhlela izindingo ezinhle ukuqonda imisebenzi yekolishi kanti futhi kuhle futhi esebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo eziyisisekelo zomphakathi nokuphathwa kanzima.
zu.duties: Nika amasevisi okusekela okuphathwa / abasebeki ohlakeni lwe-ofisi ye-Principal. Qiniseka ukuphathwa kwekolishi okusebenza kahle nangokusebenza kakhulu okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwequbu ngqo ohlakeni lwe-Principal. Yenza ucwaningo bese unika iprinsi nephini labanye abaphathi okholijini iseluleko esingingqi sokuphathwa. Hlola ngemigomo uthi imibhalo, memoranda nokubhaliswa kwemibhalo equkethwe ngemibuzo noma izindaba ezihambisana nomnyango / izindaba ezibekiwe ukuba zisize kanti futhi zihlanganiswe kahle. Qapha bese ulawula ama-budget ohlakeni lwe-Principal. Hlanganisa imibhalo yekoliji yeminyaka yonke, yesikhashana, yenyanga zonke, nezitatimende zokuqhuma kwegazi. Qamba futhi usebenzise okusebenza kahle kwindlela yokugcina imibhalo namafayela ohlakeni lwe-Principal. Landelela bese uhlanganisa imibiko engqondweni ngeze ofiswa phezulu nokuxazulula izindaba ezithintekayo ezigaxekile kanti futhi nokuthi oyedwa nohlohludzo kwezimiso njengomthetho ozokwaziswa. Landelela imibalo yezinhlelo zekhasho kanye nezinye izindaba ezidlanzwe. Landelela bese uhlela imibhalo / imibhalo yokwaziswa kuyo yonke imihlangano le ngena i-office yekolishi.

xh.title: UmLawuli oNcedisayo: i-Ofisi kaSikhululu
xh.summary: Um lawuli oncedisayo onika inkxaso ngokuphatha nangolawulo olubanzi kuSikhululu eKoleji ye-TVET i-Ekurhuleni East, ofuna idiploma okanye isidanga eneminyaka engama-3-5 yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / iMatric / inqanaba 4. Isidanga seNqanaba lesiZwe / iNqanaba kwiLawulo loWoLuntu / uLawulo lweShishini / uLawulo lwe-Ofisi neTekhnoloji okanye isigqibo esinxulumeneyo. Iminyaka ye-3-5 yamava ahambelanayo kwimeko yokucinga ngokusetyenziswa nangokulawulwa kwento. Okokuqala ubuncinane i-2 iminyaka yamava okulawula abanye. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemithetho nengqongo-mgama yeNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngePSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda oluLawulo lwe-TVET / CET. Ukuqonda ummandla weMfundo ePhakamileyo. Ukuqonda uLawulo loLawulo ngokubanzi. Ukuqonda ukulawula kwesixhobo seexesha, ukusebenzisa imali kwaye ulawule iinkcitho zemali. UMthetho weNtsyanekiso kumSebenzi, Imigaqo yeNkonzo kaRhulumente noMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho weNxulumano maSebenzi nalomnye umthetho onxulumene nalo. Amandla okucwangcisa nangokulungelelanisa. Amandla eLawulo leMali. Amandla eNkqubo yokubhala iimveliso. Amandla okuthetha nabaninim-ba abanye. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki. Amandla ekusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Amandla ohlalutyo. Amandla okukhuthaza abakhuseli. Amandla okulawula amaphulo. Amandla okukhokela iqela. Amandla okucwangcisa nangokulungelelanisa. Kwaye amandla okulawula abantu. Ukuzinikela ngokumzisa inkonzo kubakhuseli. Ukuzithoba. Ukuzinika. Ukuba nodaka. Ukuzithoba.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zolawulo / zesikhululo kwiofisi yeSikhululu: Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lekholeji kuquka ulawulo lwokuqhuba kwindawo olusebenza kuyo ofisi yeSikhululu. Yenza ucando lwemibuzo kwaye unikezelana ngengcebiso yolawulo enobuchwepheshe kwiSikhululu nakubanye abasebenzi bekholeji. Hlola ngomgangatho iileta, iimemoranda kunye nokuhanjiswa. Lungelelanisa kwaye ulawule umgangatho we-ofisi yeSikhululu. Hlanganisa izimvo zekholeji ziimveliso ezimali ngonyaka, ngekhota,nyanga ngezinyanga, kunye nemibhalo yeentsalu zemali. Lulungelelanise kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zolawulo lwemibhalo nemiqathango kwiofisi yeSikhululu. Landela kwaye uqokelele iimveliso zengqambo kwinto esenziwayo yemigqaliswo. Lawula iimveliso/iinkcazelo kuzo zonke iindawo ezihamba kuzo i-ofisi yekholeji. Nikeza inkxaso yomabhalane kuBhunga leKholeji, kumagatya aBhunga, kwiBhodi eYiziNzululwazi, kwiBaphathi Abakhulu kunye nabanye abahlotyisi bangaphandle: Yigcine iceba lelithuba lokulungiselela nokumisa iindibano kwaye uxabe nabahlangelayo bonke abalilandelayo. Lawula ulungelelwanise kwaye ulungelelanise zonke iindibano, iinkqubo kunye nemisebenzi yalaba bantu. Nikeza inkxako ngamandla ngexesha leendibano, iinkqubo kunye nomsebenzi walaba bantu. Lungelelanisa izigqibo, iimizuzu, iimveliso nakunye namagatya alowo mntu. Sasaza amaxwebhu afanelekileyo kwindibano zalabo bantu bolttyibe. Lulungelelanise irejista yemigqaliswo kwaye uxhasa bonke abalawuli beBhunga / ootixhobo / abasebenzi ngokusasazwa okuqhubekekayo ukubakhumbuza into emelwao ukuyenziswa. Qinisekisa ukuba iimizuzu eyanemvume iyatyikitywa igcinwe ngokhuselekileyo. Lulungelelanise yonke iinkcazelo, iinkulumo zamagqwethe, iimveliso zeSikhululu namagatya eBhunga ezinxulumene neendibano zalaba bantu. Nikeza inkxaso ebalulekileyo ngokusetyenziswa kolawulo: Lungelelanisa kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuqhatha ngokwemisebenzi kunye neenkqubo zangaphambili. Hlanganisa kwaye ulungelelanise iindaba ngokubalulela nangendlela ekusebenza kuyo. Misela umba wophando. Lungelelanisa iinkqubo kwaye uqokelele izicwangciso ezibalulekileyo kwaye kwezisebenzayo zokuphucula inkonzo ekuyiwa kuyo. Yenza, ulungelelanise uxhase ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo eziphambili / amaphulo. Lungelelanisa kwaye ulungelelanise iimveliso zekholeji ngokwemisebenzi kwaye ebalulekileyo. Yenza isilinganiselo ngobuchwepheshe nangokusebenza kwekholeji ekuxhaseni ukufeza iinjongo zokulethwa kwenkonzo. Lungelelanisa ukusetyenziswa kwesakhelo esilinganisayo ukubona ukuba imigaqo (ukumisela ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle kweemfuno, amathuba emali, nezakhiwo) ihlazululwa njani abantu abayenza imisebenzi (izinto neenkonzo). Zithobele iNkqubo yeMfundo ePhakamileyo & uQeqesho (DHET) ngeNkqubo neenkqubo zeKholeji

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Reporting
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for financial reporting at Ekurhuleni East TVET College, responsible for budget management and financial statements, requiring a diploma or degree in financial management.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate National Diploma / Degree in Financial Management/Accounting. 3-5 years’ experience in relevant field. At least 2 years management experience. Computer literacy. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge of the Public Finance and Management Act (PFMA). Treasury regulations. Policy analysis/development. Knowledge of GRAP and IAS-IFRS and including any other related legislation. Good Written and verbal communication skills. Good problem-solving skills, research skills, Planning & Organising, Research skills, Analytical skills, Report writing skills, Leadership skills, Presentation and Facilitation skills.
jobs.duties: Prepare and manage the College budget. Monitor the budget on monthly basis. Compile a consolidated budget report for approval by the Deputy Principal (CFO). Assist in the preparation of financial statements for the College. Implement policies and procedures as well as internal control. Generate income statement, balance sheet and cash flow as per regulatory standards. Monitor payments made to SARS. Improve the working capital by managing the cash, debtors and creditors. Ensure all balance sheet control accounts are reconciled monthly. Manage turn-around times for payments and receipts. Prepare and submit working capital performance measurement reports. Review the payroll related payments. Ensure that all EMP201 (SARS related payments) are reconciled monthly. Prepare reports by compiling summaries of earning, taxes, deductions, leave, disability and non-taxable wages. Prepare a year-end audit for the College. Complete and distribute audit management plan to all relevant staff. Ensure that all reconciliation files are signed and updated. Minimize the previous year’s audit findings. Ensure trial balance. Comply with Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College Policies and Procedures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. LK Boikhutso Tel No: (011) 730 6600 / Mr. T Matsaba Tel No: (011) 730
jobs.applications: must be submitted to recruitment@eec.edu.za OR hand delivered at Ekurhuleni East TVET College: Central Office, Sam Ngema Road, Kwa – Thema. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Please forward your application, quoting the reference number to: The Assistant Director: Human Resource Management & Development. Ekurhuleni East TVET College, Sam Ngema Road, Kwa - Thema or Posted to Private Bag X52, Springs, 1560
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on Z83 Form Obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents and must be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (with three contactable references). A Fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A user guide and ‘how to’ videos will assist in how to complete for the form and digital signature. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in term s of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action. The appointment will be done in line with the approved Employment Equity Plan. Persons with disability are encouraged to apply. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Verslagdoening
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir finansiële verslagdoening by Ekurhuleni East TVET College, verantwoordelik vir begrotingsbestuur en finansiële state, wat 'n diploma of graad in finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 / Matriek / Vlak 4-sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Finansiële Bestuur/Rekeningkunde. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in 'n relevante veld. Ten minste 2 jaar bestuurservaring. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van die Public Finance and Management Act (PFMA). Tesourie-regulasies. Beleidsontleding/-ontwikkeling. Kennis van GRAP en IAS-IFRS en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie probleemoplossingsvaardighede, navorsingsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, navorsingsvaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Berei en bestuur die Kollege se begroting voor. Monitor die begroting op 'n maandelikse basis. Stel 'n gekonsolideerde begrotingsverslag op vir goedkeuring deur die Adjunk-prinsipaal (CFO). Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding van finansiële state vir die Kollege. Implementeer beleide en prosedures asook interne beheer. Genereer inkomstate, balansstaat en kontevloei volgens regulasie-standaarde. Monitor betalings aan SARS. Verbeter die bedryfskapitaal deur die kontant, skuldenaars en skuldeisers te bestuur. Verseker dat alle balansstaatbeheerrekenings maandeliks gereconcilieer word. Bestuur draaitye vir betalings en kwitansies. Berei en dien verslae oor die meting van bedryfskapitaalprestasie in. Hersien betaalverwante betalings. Verseker dat alle EMP201 (SARS-verwante betalings) maandeliks gereconcilieer word. Berei verslae voor deur opsommings van verdienste, belasting, aftrekkings, verlof, gestremdheid en nie-belasbare lone saam te stel. Berei 'n jaareind-oudit vir die Kollege voor. Voltooi en versprei die ouditbestuursplan aan alle relevante personeel. Verseker dat alle gerekoncilieerde lêers geteken en opgedateer word. Minimaliseer die vorige jaar se ouditbevindings. Verseker proefbalans. Voldoen aan die Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en Kollege-beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Umncedisikhulu: Ukubika ngezimali
zu.summary: Umncedisikhulu wokubika ngezimali e-Ekurhuleni East TVET College, onesibopho sokuphatha isabelo semali nokubika ngezimali, edinga idiploma noma iziqu ezenza ngokuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. Idiploma yezwe / Iziqu kumaphathwa kwezimali / ezezimali. Ukwazi ukusebenza iminyaka engu-3-5 enkundleni ehambisana naleyo. Okungenani eminyaka engu-2 yokuhola isiphoqi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance and Management Act (PFMA). Imithetho ye-Treasury. Ukuhlaziya noma ukwakha izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi lwe-GRAP ne-IAS-IFRS kuhile nayo yonke eminye imithetho ehlobene nalesi. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokukhuluma. Amakhono amahle okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okucwaninga, ukwelana nokuhlela, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okuhlola, amakhono okubonisa nokuqondisa.
zu.duties: Lungisa uphinde ulawule isabelo semali se-College. Hlola isabelo semali njenyanga zonke. Hlanganisa umbiko ohlanganisiwe wesabelo semali ukuze uvunywe yi-Deputy Principal (CFO). Siza ekulungiseni imibiko yezimali ye-College. Faka isiqubomgomo nemigomo kanye nolawulo langaphakathi. Khiqiza umbiko wemali oyingenayo, ibhalansi kanye nezimali ezihamba njengemithetho. Hlola imali ehlawuliswa i-SARS.uthuthukisa inkulumo-mali esebenzayo ngokuphatha imali, abanikimali kanye nabangowimali. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke iminikelo ebalansi ihlola njengenyanga zonke. Lawula isikhathi sokulinda imali ehlawuliswa kanye naleyo etholwa. Lungisa uphinde uthumele imibiko yokulinganisa inkulumo-mali esebenzayo. Hlola imali ehlobene nomholo. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke imali ephathelene ne-EMP201 (SARS) ihlolwa njengenyanga. Lungisa imibiko ngokuqoqa okufingqiwe kwemali engenayo, izintela, okukhishiwe, ukulalelwa kwesikhathi, ukungakwazi kanye nomholo ongahlanzwa intela. Lungisa ukuhlolwa kosuku lokugcina kweminyaka ye-College. Qedela uphindle wabel imibiko yokuqondisa ukuhlolwa komnyango kubo bonke abasebenzi abahlobene nalokhu. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke amafayela okuqinisekisa ukuhambisana asayiniwe uphinde abe sesimweni. Yehlisa okutholakele ekuzuzweni kweminyaka edlule. Qiniseka ibhalansi yesilinganiso. Landela imigomo kanye nemigomo yoMnyango we-Higher Education & Training (DHET) ne-College.

xh.title: Umncedi weNgqalela: Iingxelo zeMali
xh.summary: Umncedi weNgqalela wemingxengo yemali kwi-Ekurhuleni East TVET College, onoxanduva lokulawula umgangatho wemali nemiqathango yemali, ofuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwilawulo lemali.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seBanga le-12 / Isatifikethi seMatric / Isatifikethi seBanga le-4. Idiploma yesiZwe / Isidanga esifanelekileyo kwiLawulo leMali / ukuBala. Iminyaka ye-3-5 yamava kwicala elinxulumene nalo.Ubuncinane kuminyaka emi-2 yamava kolawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezeMali noLawulo kaRhulumente (PFMA). Iimithetho yeTreasury. Uhlalutyo / ukuqamba iindlela zomgaqo. Ulwazi lwe-GRAP nase-IAS-IFRS kuquka nawo nawuphi na omnye umthetho ongxulumene nalo. Amandla amaninzi ekubhaleni nasekuthetheni. Amandla amaninzi okuxazula iingxaki, amandla okuphanda, ukuCwangcisa & ukuQamba, amandla okuphanda, amandla ekuhlalutyi, amandla okubhala iingxelo, amandla abakhoki, amandla okubonisa nokwenza iindibano.
xh.duties: Lungiselela ulawule umgangatho wemali weKholeji. Qaphela umgangatho wemali nyanga nganye. Hlanganisa ingxelo ehlanganiselayo yomgangatho wemali ukugunyaziswa nguSekela iPrincipala (CFO). Ndiza ekulungiseleleni imiqathango yemali yeKholeji. Zisebenzisa iimigaqo nemiqatho njengoko kunokulawula ngaphakathi. Velisa ingxelo yemali, ibhalansi yeenkonzo kunye nokucotha kwemali njengoko kumiselwa ngemigaqo. Qaphela imalingxiselo ezenzelwa i-SARS. Phucula inkqubo yemali ngokulawula imali, abatywelelwa kumabala nababanikazi bemali. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iiaKhawundi zokuLawula iBhalansi zihambelaniswa nyanga nganye.
