af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Inligting en Kommunikasie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Inligting en Kommunikasie by Ekurhuleni East TVET College, wat 'n IT-diploma of -graad vereis met 3 tot 5 jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: An appropriate Grade 12 / Matric Certificate, an appropriate 3-year Diploma / Bachelor's degree (NQF 6) in Information Technology or related qualification, 3-5 years working experience in IT environment. A valid driver's license. Knowledge of computer hardware, software and programmes. Knowledge of policies and governance environment of TVET Colleges including knowledge of the annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education Institutions, Knowledge and understanding of Corporate ICT principles, Knowledge and understanding of the monitoring of performance management system, Knowledge and understanding of the ICT policies and relevant legislation. Administer computer hardware, software and network, Administrative, Planning and organizing, financial management, Report writing, Communication and interpersonal, Problem solving, Computer literacy, Analytical, Client oriented, Project management, Team leadership, Planning and organizing, People management. Client service focus, Integrity, Committed, Proactive, loyal.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling, hersiening en monitering van die implementering van Inligtings- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IKT)-beleide; Doen navorsing oor nasionale en provinsiale beleidsraamwerke, wetgewing, kollektiewe ooreenkomste, die internet, relevante leesstof ens. Verseker die raadplegingsproses van konsepbeleide met alle relevante belanghebbendes, verseker dat alle nuwe IKT-beleide aan alle personeel gekommunikeer word. Verseker die ontwikkeling en instelling van toepaslike E-bestaansbestuur en IKT-beleide, raamwerke en standaarde. Implementeer, handhaaf en verseker nakoming van IT-beleide en prosedures op alle kampusse. Verseker dat toepaslike beleide en prosesse vir risikobestuur in plek gestel word. Inligtingstelselbestuur; Administreer en monitor IT-veiligheid en elektroniese toegang, stel stelsels op om hardeware en data te beskerm, voer stelselrugsteune uit. Netwerkbestuur en instandhouding; Doen navorsing en ontwikkel spesifikasies vir LAN- en WAN-tegnologieë volgens die college se vereistes, verkry LAN- en WAN-tegnologieë, verskaf LAN- en WAN-toegang aan studente en personeel volgens collegebeleid en behoeftes, stel WAN, LAN, E-pos en internetverbindings op, bestuur en onderhou dit by al die kolleges. Oplossing, oplossing en dokumentering van alle IKT-verwante probleme. IKT-sagteware en hardeware instandhouding; Doen navorsing en ontwikkel planne vir sagteware- en hardewareprodukte wat benodig word vir tegnologieë en stelsels wat die college se kernbesigheid, ondersteuningsfunksies en programme sal moontlik maak, gee advies oor die verkryging van college-sagteware en -hardeware volgens die college se behoeftes, versprei sagteware en hardeware vir gebruik deur studente en personeel volgens die college se beleid en behoeftes, onderhou en monitor die sagteware- en hardewarestelsel, doen verslag oortollige hardeware en sagteware en gee advies oor opdaterings. Bly op hoogte van die jongste ontwikkelings van hardeware en sagteware in die onderwys. Bestuur alle lisensiëring van sagteware wat die college gebruik en verseker dat dit geldig en toepaslik is. Verskaffing van intranet- en netwerkdienste; Bystand met die verkryging van intranet- en internetprodukte en -dienste volgens die college se behoeftes. Verseker toegang tot intranet en internet by die kolleges. Verseker dat die college se webwerf deurlopend met huidige inligting bygewerk word. Bestuur van alle menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid. Voldoen aan Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en die College se beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Umcedisi weNkululele ngokwaziswa nokuThumela imiyalezo
zu.summary: Umcedisi weNkululele ngokwaziswa nokuThumela imiyalezo osekuwo Esikhungweni semfundo yamakhono e-Ekurhuleni East TVET College, ofuna idiploma noma iziqu ze-IT ahambisana namaphakathi amathathu kuya kwayisihlanu weminyaka yokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele samabanga alikhulu / somatric, idiploma yamaphakathi amathathu / iziqu zabaphakamile (NQF 6) ezenzululwazi lwamakhompyutha noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Ukuhlangenwe nakho okuyiminyaka engu-3 kuya kwengasiyisihlanu ekusebenzeni emkhakheni we-IT. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi mayelana nehharewe, isofthiwe namaphroghremu ekhompyutha. Ulwazi mayelana namapholisi nendawo yokuphathwa kwezomthetho emikhakheni yamakhono e-TVET, okuhlanganisa nokwazi ngemithesho yokuvela kwemibiko ngamaphakathi emisizini yemfundo ephakeme. Ulwazi nokuqonda izimiso ze-Corporate ICT. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukugqamisa uhlelo lokuphathwa kokusebenza kolunye. Ulwazi nokuqonda amapholisi we-ICT nomthetho ohambisanayo. Ukuphatha ihharewe, isofthiwe nethilikha ekhompyutha. Amakhono okubusa, ukulungelela nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlakaniphwa, ukugxila kukhasimeli, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukubusa iqembu, ukulungelela nokuhlela, nokuphatha abantu. Ukugxila ekuhlinzweni ngabathengi, ukuzithiba, ukuzinikela, ukuba sebhoqweni, nokuqotho.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa, ukubuyekeza nokugqamisa ukuphatwa kwamapholisi obuchwepheshe bokwaziswa nokuThumela imiyalezo (ICT). Ukwenza uphando malunga nobuqhingqisi bezizwe kanye namapholisi esifundazwe, umthetho, izivumelwano ngokuhlangana, i-intanethi, okufundekayo, njll. Qinisekisa inqubo yokuqondana mayelana namapholisi abhalwayo kuzo zonke iziphathimandla ezithintekayo, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amapholisi ama-ICT amasha axhumwe kuyo yonke imisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusekwa kwamapholisi afanele we-E-governance nama-ICT, uhlaka nemigomo. Phefumulelisa, qinisekisa futhi uphoqe ukuthi amapholisi nendlela ye-IT kuhambiswe nawo emakhasini. Qinisekisa ukuthi amapholisi noma amaqiniso abekwe endaweni yokulawula ubungozi. Ukuphathwa kweSystem yokwaziswa. Lawula futhi uqaphele ukuvikelwa kwe-IT nokuNgena nge-Elekthroniki, sekela amasistimu ukuze agcobe ihharewe nedatha, yenze ukulondolozwa kwesistimu. Ukuphathwa kokulungiselelwa kweNethiwekhi. Yenza uphando uthuthukise izinto ezichaziwe kumatheknoloji afana ne-LAN ne-WAN njengoba kudingwa ikholishi. Thenga amatheknoloji e-LAN ne-WAN. Yabelabe ngokufikelela kwi-LAN ne-WAN abafundi kanye nabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwekholishi ngokwezidingo. Misela, lawula futhi ulondoloze imixhulu ye-WAN, i-LAN, i-Email kanye nokuxhumana kwe-intanethi kuyo yonke amakholeji. Ukuxazulula, ukulungisa nokubhala ngazo zonke izinkinga ezihlobene ne-ICT. Ukulungiselelwa kwe-Csoftware ne-hharewe ye-ICT. Yenza uphando uthuthukise izinhlelo zamaphrojukhi wesofthiwe nehharewe ahambisana nama-theknoloji namasistimu angasiza ikholishi ukufeza imigomo yayo ebalulekile. Luletha ngokuthenga isofthiwe nehharewe yekholishi njengoba kudingeka ikholishi. Sula isofthiwe nehharewe ukuthi asetshenziswe abafundi nabasebenzi njengoba kulingene noma ngemithetho yekholishi. Gcina futhi ulawule amasistimu wehharewe nesofthiwe, ive imibiko yehharewe nesofthiwe edlulelwe isikhathi futhi Welule ngemibhali yamaphilishi. Hlala ulwazi ngemikhuba emisha yehharewe nesofthiwe emfundweni. Lawula yonke imivumelwano yesofthiwe yamaphilishi, uqinisekile ukuthi iyona nayo iphilayo. Ukunikezwa kophiko lwangaphakathi kweNethiwekhi; Siza ngokuthenga imikhiqizo nesevizi yophiko olungangaphakathi nangenaphandle, njengoba kudingwa ikholishi. Qinisekisa ukuthi uphiko olungaphakathi nangenaphandle kuyatholakala ezikhungweni zemfundo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukubhalwa kwamaphilishi ezikole kuhlale kubhaliwe ngokwemibiko esanda kulungiswa. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nabantu, kanye namanye amaphakathi angenzansi. Hambisana nemithetho nemikhakha kahulumeni weNyuvesi (DHET) nemithetho yezikole.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Ulwazi nokuNxibelelana
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso woLwazi nokuNxibelelana e-Ekurhuleni East TVET College, ofuna idiploma okanye isidanga se-IT nonyaka wokuSebenza o-3 ukusa ku-5.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo se-Grade 12 / Matric, idiploma yeminyaka eyi-3 okanye isidanga se-Bachelor (NQF 6) kwInkonzo yolwazi lobuchwepheshe okanye ngesiNGQINISO esinxulumeneyo, unyaka wokuSebenza o-3-5 kwindawo ye-IT. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemachibi ekhompyutha, isoftware namaprogram. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendalo yolawulo yamakolishi e-TVET kuquka noLwazi ngemfuno yokubika ngonyaka ngenkqubo zeZiko loMfundo loPhakamileyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimVISIS zeQhinga eliNgqongweni le-ICT, ulwazi nokuqonda okuPHEZULU kokuqwalasela inkqubo yolawulo yemigaqo, ulwazi nokuqonda iimVISIS ze-ICT nalomgaqo-ndawo ongqinelana nayo. Ukulawula imachibi ekhompyutha, isoftware nosenzo, uLawulo oluBhalwe phantsi, uQeqesho lokuCwangcisa nokuBumba, uLawulo lweMali, ukuBaliwe kweNgxelo, uNxibelelwano nokuXhumana nabantu, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuSebenzela iikhompyutha, uQwalaselo, ukugxila kuKhuseli, uLawulo loBuchwepheshe bokulinganisa iNkcitha, uLawulo loMthetho weQela, uLawulo lweNkxaso, uLawulo lweSikhokelo seNqanaba, uQeqesho kwaye uXhobe, uLawulo lwabaPhathi abasemagunyeni. Ukwanceda abathengi kumva ndawoni, inyanisekile, zinzileyo, ngokusuka qhuba, kwaye ithembekile.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba, ukuqwalasela ngokuqwalasela nokudlula eyona nkqubo kwiMigaqo yobuchwepheshe nokuBamba ulwazi (i-ICT); ukwenza uphando ngenkqubomphakama yemigaqo, umthetho nemigqalisela iquka ekhaya nakwamanye amazwe, iintlangano ezahlukeneyo, i-intanethi nangaphezulu kweminye imifuno. Kuqinisekisa isicwangciso sokubonisana kwemigaqo esekwa apha kubaxhasi abanegalelo, kuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iimVISIS ezintsha ze-ICT zisixelelwa kubasebenzi bonke. Kuqinisekisa ukuqhuba, ukuqala, kwaye kusetyenziswa iMigaqo ye-E-Governance ne-ICT ezifanelekileyo, iNkqubomphakama namazinga okusebenza. Ukusebenzisa, ukuzisa umthetho, ukuqinisekisa ukuzigcina ugcine imigaqo ye-IT nakwiNkqubo zonke iindawo. Kuqinisekisa ukuba kuye kubekho imigaqo neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokulawula ingozi. uLawulo lweNkqubo yoLwazi; ukulawula nokubeka iliso eNkqubo yiQhinga ekuNxibelelaneni nokuNgena ngeKhompyutha, ukwakha iNkqubo zokuSindisa imachibi nolwazi, ukubeka eceleni inkqubo yoxhaso. uLawulo nokuGCINA iNkqubo yoXhobo lwamaxhesho; ukwenza uphando nokukhulisa iNkqubo zokuSebenzisa i-LAN ne-WAN ngokweemfuno zekhobhu, ukuthenga i-LAN ne-WAN, ukusasaza i-LAN ne-WAN kubafundi nabasebenzi ngakumbi ngokomthetho wakwaNkulumbuso, ukubeka, ukulawula nokugcina i-WAN, i-LAN, i-imeyile nokuNxibelelana nge-intanethi zonke iikhobhu. UkuSombulula iingxaki, ukwenza isigqibo nokubhala zonke iingxaki ezinxulumene ne-ICT. uKugcina i-software namachibi eKhompyutha; ukwenza uphando neenkqubo zokuSebenzisa i-software nokuQamba iMveliso ezifuna iNkqubo yamachibi neesistem eziza kuSukuza iQela lakwaNkulumbuso kwinkalozo enkulu, inkxaso iinkqubo. ukunikela iSixeko ngokuthenga i-software nokuQamba iNkqubo yekhobhu ngeeMfuno zekhobhu ukuya ngemfuno yawo wonke umntu, ukwakha nokuLawula i-software namachibi abantu ngokuxhomekeke kwinkqubo yamanyathelo neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo nezoqobo, ukugcina nokubeka iliso kwi-software noma inkcitha yamachibi yekhompyutha, nokubika ngemiba ekhoyo apha ekhoyo ukuze abancedise abasemagunyeni bavuselele.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Bestuursrekenkunde
af.summary: Bestuur rekenkunde, risiko-identifikasie en ouditbevindings by Ekurhuleni East TVET College onder die Department of Higher Education and Training.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Finansiële Bestuur / Rekenkunde. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in finansies. Drie jaar SAICE-artikels sal 'n voordeel wees. Ten minste 2 jaar toesigervaring. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Public Finance and Management Act (PFMA). Tesourie-regulasies. Beleidsontleding/-ontwikkeling. Kennis van GRAP en IAS-IFRS en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Begrip van oudit- en risikobestuur. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie probleemoplossingsvaardighede, navorsingsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, analitiese vaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Ondersteun bestuur met die identifikasie en bestuur van risiko's binne die finansiële departement. Bestuur van beide interne en eksterne ouditbevindings. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van die jaarlikse ouditplan. Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van alle ouditaanbevelings deur personeel. Verantwoordelik vir die begrotingsimplementering oor alle kampusse. Verseker dat alle toepaslike vereffenings uitgevoer word en aan die verslagriglyne voldoen. Verantwoordelik vir die voorraad- en batebestuur binne die College. Monitor streng die fondse wat van NSFAS, SETAs, NSF en ander borgskappers vir studente ontvang word. Bestuur ad hoc-projekte soos deur bestuur vereis. Versamel data, ontleed en interpreteer finansiële inligting vir besluitneming. Voldoen aan die Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en College se beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Umneluleki weNduna: I-Accounting yoNolawulo
zu.summary: Phatha i-accounting, ukubona imingozi kanye nemithelela yokuhlola e-Ekurhuleni East TVET College ngaphansi kwe-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma / Degree elifanele kwi-Financial Management / Accounting. 3-5 unyaka wemfundo ngeminye yemali. 3 unyaka we-SAICA articles kuzoba nenzuzo. Okungenani 2 unyaka wemfundo yokuhlola abantu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile. Ulwazi le-Public Finance and Management Act (PFMA). Iminqubo ye-Treasury. Ukuhlazulwa/kuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi lwe-GRAP ne-IAS-IFRS kuhlanganise nomthetho ohlobene nawo nawunye owodwa. Ukuqonda ukuhlola nokuphathwa kwemingozi. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuqhathanisa ngokwenomsindo. Amakhono amahle okuxazulula izinkinga, ukucwaninga, Ukuhlela & Ukuqamba, ukuhlaziya, ukubhala imibiko, ukuba nguMholi, ukubhenteza nokubaluleka, nokubhangeza.
zu.duties: Siza iNkundla yokubona nokuphatha imingozi ngaphakathi komnyango wezemali. Ukuphathwa kwemithelela yokuqamba yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukubamabiza ekuthuthukisweni kwehlelo lokuhlola unyaka wonke. Thutha ukutholakala kwemiyalelo emibili nguMphathi nokulandela imiyalelo yokulandelwa imithetho nguMphathi. Ukwazi ukuhlehlela ngokutholakala kwemali egameni lomanyuzo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuvumelana okufanele okwenziwa ngokuvumelana nemiyalelo emibili. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali evunyelwe eNyuvesi namathol'omuntu asemthethweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali evela ku-NSFAS, SETAs, kanye neminye imibhalo ekude ibhekiswe kumfundi ngaphakathi kolwan'olunelisa imingqibela. Ikhompyutha ukuthi imiklamo yokuthumela imibhalo esebenzayo njengokulinde. Ikhompyutha imali efakiwe ngesigameko esisha sokuqoqa imininingwane, ukuhlaziya nokutolikwa imininingwane yezimali ngenhlon'ukwamukela izinqumo. Ikhompyutha imali efakiwe ngokuqoqwa kwemali yaminyuzo yon' emnyuzo ngenkomba yaminyuzo nemali yaminyuzo ukuze kutholakale imali eqoqiwe ngenhlon' yokuhlinzeka ngamanye amakhulu.

xh.title: Isikhulu esiNcedisa: UkuLungelelanisa koMphathi
xh.summary: Ukulawula ukulungelelanisa, ukuqonda iingozi nemiphumela yokuhlola kwikholeji yase-Ekurhuleni East TVET ngaphansi kweSebe leMfundo eNgesiNqanaba ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha.
xh.requirements: iNational Diploma / iDegree ehambelana noMphathi wezeMali / ukuLungelelanisa. 3-5 iminyaka yamava kumazinga obugcisa. Iminyaka emithathu yamagama e-SAISA kuya kuba lusizo. Akhe enze okungenamva kweminyaka emi-2 njengengcebiso. Ulwazi ngesixhobo sokusebenza. Isatifikethi esithembiswayo ngokusetyenziswa kolwimi oluqulunqwe. Ukuba namava ekubonakaliseni izinto ezingajelwe phantsi kwesiNxibelelanisi sezeMfundo iSabanoza yabantu (PFMA). Iintsiba eziphakamisayo kwiNgqungquthela yeGazethi. Umthetho weNkqubo yokucwangcisa / uyilwa. Ulwazi ngolu yemfundo yamagama eGIPF / IAS-IFRS nakuwo nawaphina na nayunye na nayiphi na iNkqubo. Ukuqonda isixhobo seNkqubo yolawulo lweNkqubo yeMfuno yoluntu. Iimpawu ezibalaseleyo zokubhalwa nokuthethwa. Iimpawu ezibalaseleyo zokuziphatha nzima, ukupapasha, ukuCwangcisa & ukuQamba, iimpawu zoBuntu, iimpawu zokuBhala iMibiko, iimpawu zoBukhosi, iimpawu zokuBukela nokuNika.
xh.duties: Kuncede uBukhosi ngokuQonda nokulawula iingozi ngaphakathi kwesebe lezeMali. Ukulawula kokubili imiphumela yokuhloba yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ngenxaxheba ekuyileni iNkqubo yokuhlola yonyaka. Yila uze ulawule ukuSetyenziswa kwezindaba zonke iNkqubo yokuhloba ngumsebenzi wonke oqatshiweyo ngabemi baphakathi kwamaza. Nceda namkene inqanaba lokwenza imfuno yemali ngokulungelelanisa noMhlal'iwebo onke amaza. Qinisekisa ukuba ukukhululwa okufanelekileyo kwenziwa kwaye kuqonda ngokwemigaqo yokuBika. Ngumsebenzi wokulawula iinkqubo zemali ehambelana netekhnoloji yamaza angaphakathi nangaphandle kweKholeji. Lawula ngokuchanekileyo iMali efumaneka kwiNSFAS, ISETA, INSF noko nababomelezi ngabafundi abanamaza angakumbi. Phatha amaprojekthi ashuthshiswa njengoko kufunwa nguBukhosi. Qokelela iNkcazelo yokubakuhle, yahlulele kwaye uchaze ulwazi ngemali kwizigqibo ezithunyelwe. Ngumsebenzi wokuLungiselela iNkcazelo ngemali yonyaka ngokuhambelana namaGazethi weGIPF nemfuno yiNkqubo yeCET Act. Ukukhokela abasebenzi. Landela iNkqubo zeSebe leMfundo eNgesiNqanaba ePhakamileyo & uQeqesha (DHET) neNkqubo zeKholeji.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Northern Cape Rural TVET College, Central Office Upington
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Manage supply chain operations including procurement, demand and acquisition management at Northern Cape Rural TVET College Central Office in Upington.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate recognised Bachelor's degree/National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or equivalent qualification in Supply Chain Management or related field. A minimum of five years (5) working experience in a Supply Chain Management environment. At least 3 years relevant Supervisory experience. Digital literate and competent in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. A valid driver's license and willingness to travel. Competencies: Legislative Frameworks: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, and the PPPFA. Sourcing Strategies: Demand management, acquisition management, and contract management. Public Sector Procurement: Working knowledge of the Central Supplier Database (CSD) and e-Tender portals. Asset Management: Knowledge of GRAP standards regarding asset registers and disposal. Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret complex financial data and procurement trends. Negotiation: Proven ability to manage Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and vendor relations. Communication: High-level verbal and written reporting skills for council and internal Section and Unit presentations. Computer Literacy: Proficiency in MS Office (Advanced Excel) and relevant ERP systems (e.g., COLTECH). Leadership: Strong team management and conflict resolution capabilities. Extensive experience in bid committee administration (specification, evaluation, and adjudication). Proven track record in inventory control management. Experience in internal audit coordination, specifically addressing SCM findings. Experience in the development and implementation of SCM policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). A Postgraduate qualification (Honours or BCom Hons) in Supply Chain or Finance. Completion of the National Treasury Public SCM Municipal Minimum Competency levels. Experience specifically within the TVET or Higher Education sector. In-depth knowledge of the CET Act (Continuing Education and Training Act). Registration with a relevant professional body (e.g., CIPS).
jobs.duties: Demand and Acquisition Management: The manager must ensure that the procurement of all goods and services aligns with the College’s Annual Procurement Plan. Key Tasks: Overseeing the specifications process, managing the quotation system for lower-threshold purchases, and ensuring all acquisitions are competitive and cost-effective. Performance Indicator: 100% execution of the approved procurement plan within budget. Logistics and Inventory Management: This area focuses on the physical movement and storage of goods across various campuses. Key Tasks: Managing the central stores, overseeing the distribution of textbooks and consumables to satellite campuses, and maintaining optimal stock levels to prevent over-purchasing or stock-outs. Performance Indicator: Accuracy of inventory records and reduction in stock loss/wastage. Bid Committee Secretariat and Administration: The SCM Manager acts as the custodian of the formal bidding process. Key Tasks: Facilitating the Bid Specification, Evaluation, and Adjudication Committees. Ensuring that all bids are advertised, opened, and awarded in strict accordance with the PPPFA (Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act). Performance Indicator: Zero successful appeals or legal challenges against awarded tenders due to procedural non-compliance. Contract and Supplier Performance Management: Once a service provider is appointed, the SCM Manager must ensure value for money is realised. Key Tasks: Monitoring the performance of service providers against Service Level Agreements (SLAs), managing contract renewals/terminations, and maintaining an updated and compliant database on the Central Supplier Database (CSD). Performance Indicator: Timely delivery of services and documented quarterly supplier performance reviews. Asset and Disposal Management: Responsible for the lifecycle of the College’s movable assets, from acquisition to retirement. Key Tasks: Maintaining a GRAP-compliant asset register, ensuring all assets are barcoded and tracked across campuses, and managing the disposal of redundant or obsolete assets through auctions or transfers. Performance Indicator: Successful reconciliation between the asset register and the general ledger during annual audits. Compliance, Risk Management, and Audit Support: Ensuring the SCM unit always remains “audit-ready”. Key Tasks: Developing and implementing internal SCM controls to prevent irregular, fruitless, and wasteful expenditure. Preparing all necessary documentation and "audit trails" for the Auditor-General (AG) or internal auditors. Performance Indicator: Achievement of a "clean audit" outcome for the Supply Chain Management unit.
jobs.applications: Apply online at https://ncrz83.ngnscan.co.za/
jobs.notes: Applicants are required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application and must submit a fully signed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be submitted by shortlisted candidates. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Voorraadkettingbestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur voorraadkettingbedrywighede insluitend verkryging, vraag- en verkrygingsbestuur by Northern Cape Rural TVET College Central Office in Upington.
af.requirements: Toepaslike erkennde Bachelorsgraad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie in Voorraadkettingbestuur of verwante veld. 'n Minimum van vyf jaar (5) werkservaring in 'n Voorraadkettingbestuursomgewing. Ten minste 3 jaar relevante toesighoudende ervaring. Digitaal geletterd en bevoeg in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede: Wetgewende raamwerke: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, en die PPPFA. Bemarkingsstrategieë: Vraagbestuur, verkrygingsbestuur en kontrakbestuur. Openbare sektorverkryging: Werkende kennis van die Central Supplier Database (CSD) en e-Tender-portale. Batebestuur: Kennis van GRAP-standaarde rakende bateregisters en beskikking. Analitiese denke: Vermoë om komplekse finansiële data en verkrygingstendense te interpreteer. Onderhandeling: Bewese vermoë om Service Level Agreements (SLAs) en verskafferbetrekkinge te bestuur. Kommunikasie: Hoëvlak mondelinge en skriftelike verslagdoeningsvaardighede vir raad- en interne Afdeling- en Eenheid-voorleggings. Rekenaargeletterdheid: Bedrewe in MS Office (Advanced Excel) en relevante ERP-stelsels (bv. COLTECH). Leierskap: Sterk spanbestuurs- en konflikoplossingsvermoëns. Uitgebreide ervaring in biedkomitee-administrasie (spesifikasie, evaluering en toekenning). Bewese rekord in voorraadbeheerbestuur. Ervaring in interne ouditkoördinering, spesifiek om SCM-bevindings aan te spreek. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling en implementering van SCM-beleide en standaard bedryfsprosedures (SOPs). 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (Honours of BCom Hons) in Voorraadketting of Finansies. Voltooiing van die National Treasury Public SCM Municipal Minimum Competency levels. Ervaring spesifiek binne die TVET- of Hoër Onderwyssektor. Diepgaande kennis van die CET Act (Continuing Education and Training Act). Registrasie by 'n relevante professionele liggaam (bv. CIPS).
af.duties: Vraag- en verkrygingsbestuur: Die bestuurder moet verseker dat die verkryging van alle goedere en dienste ooreenstem met die Kollege se Jaarlikse Verkrygingsplan. Sleuteltake: Oorsig oor die spesifikasieproses, bestuur van die kwotasiestelsel vir laedrempelaankope, en verseker dat alle verkrygings mededingend en kostedoeltreffend is. Prestasie-aanwyser: 100% uitvoering van die goedgekeurde verkrygingsplan binne begroting. Logistiek en voorraadbestuur: Hierdie area fokus op die fisiese beweging en berging van goedere oor verskeie kampusse. Sleuteltake: Bestuur van die sentrale voorraad, oorsig oor die verspreiding van handboeke en verbruikbare items na satellietkampusse, en die handhawing van optimale voorraadvlakke om ooraankope of voorraadtekorte te voorkom. Prestasie-aanwyser: Akkuraatheid van voorraadrekords en vermindering in voorraadverlies/vermorsing. Biedkomitee-sekretariaat en administrasie: Die SCM-bestuurder tree op as die bewaarder van die formele biedproses. Sleuteltake: Fasiliteer van die Biedspesifikasie-, Evaluering- en Toekenningkomitees. Verseker dat alle biee geadverteer, geopen en toegeken word in streng ooreenstemming met die PPPFA (Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act). Prestasie-aanwyser: Nul suksesvolle appèlle of regsgedinge teen toegekende tenders weens prosedurale nie-nakoming. Kontrak- en verskafferprestasiebestuur: Sodra 'n diensverskaffer aangestel is, moet die SCM-bestuurder verseker dat waarde vir geld gerealiseer word. Sleuteltake: Monitering van die prestasie van diensverskaffers teenoor Diensvlakooreenkomste (SLAs), bestuur van kontrakvernuwings/beëindigings, en die handhawing van 'n opgedateerde en nakomende databasis op die Sentrale Verskafferdatabasis (CSD). Prestasie-aanwyser: Tydige levering van dienste en gedokumenteerde kwartaallikse verskafferprestasie-oorsigte. Bate- en beskikingsbestuur: Verantwoordelik vir die lewensiklus van die Kollege se roerende bates, van verkryging tot uitfaserings. Sleuteltake: Handhawing van 'n GRAP-nakomende bateregister, verseker dat alle bates gestreepkode en oor kampusse opgespoor word, en bestuur van die beskikking van oortollige of verouderde bates deur veilings of oordragte. Prestasie-aanwyser: Suksesvolle rekonsiliasie tussen die bateregister en die algemene grootboek tydens jaarlikse oudits. Nakoming, risikobestuur en ouditondersteuning: Verseker dat die SCM-eenheid te alle tye "oudit-gereed" bly. Sleuteltake: Ontwikkeling en implementering van interne SCM-kontroles om onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende besteding te voorkom. Voorbereiding van alle nodige dokumentasie en "ouditspore" vir die Ouditeur-Generaal (AG) of interne ouditeure. Prestasie-aanwyser: Behaling van 'n "suiwer oudit"-uitslag vir die Voorraadkettingbestuur-eenheid.

zu.title: Umncedisihlalo: Umphathi Wezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yezinsiza zokuhlinzeka ehlanganisa ukuthenga, ukuphathwa kwesidingo nokuqhafuka e-Northern Cape Rural TVET College Central Office e-Upington.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zebhalazu ezifanelekile ezivunyiwe/Nesidiploma Sezwe (NQF Level 6) noma isiqu esilinganayo kokuPhathwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka noma indawo ehlobene nayo. Okungenani iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yeminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza endaweni yokuPhathwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yohlelo lokusebenza lokuqondisa nabasebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenlisa amakhompyutha nokwazi ukusebenzisa i-Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nokuzithoba okokuhamba. Izikhokelo zokusebenza: Izakhiwo zomthetho: I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izimiso ze-Treasury, ne-PPPFA. Amasu okuzuza izinsiza: Ukuphathwa kwesidingo, ukuphathwa kokuqhafuka, nokuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Ukuthenga Kwemingalo kahulumeni: Ulwazi lokusebenza lwe-Central Supplier Database (CSD) namapothali e-e-Tender. Ukuphathwa kwamafa: Ulwazi ngemigomo ye-GRAP ngokuthi nangamarekhodi wamafa nendlela yokulahla. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya: Ikono lokuchaza idatha eyinkimbinkimbi yezimali nezimo zokuthenga. Izenzo zokuxoxisana: Ikono elibonisiwe lokuphatha ama-Service Level Agreements (SLAs) nobudlelwano nabahlinzeki. Unxibelelwano: Amakhono aphezulu okubika ngomlomo nangokubhala abakamu kanye namaphrezentesheni esigaba sangaphakathi neYuniti. Ukwazi ukusebenlisa amakhompyutha: Ukuzakhudlala kwi-MS Office (Advanced Excel) nasemapulatifomu e-ERP ahlobene (njenge-COLTECH). Ukuba ngumholi: Amakhono amakhulu okuphatha iqembu nokuqonda izinkinga. Isipiliye sikhulu ekuphathweni kwekomidi yezinkomba yamabhithi (isibalo, ukuhlola, nokuphetha). Inkundla yemisebenzi ephumelelayo ekuphathweni kokulawula izinto zokugcina. Isipiliye ekuhlelweni kokuhlolwa okwangaphakathi, ikakhulukazi ukulungisa iziphetho ze-SCM. Isipiliye ekuthuthukiseni nokuphatha izimiso ze-SCM kanye namaphrosidija ajwayelekile okusebenza (SOPs). Isiqu se-postgraduate (Honours noma BCom Hons) kokuPhathwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka nasezimali. Ukugcwalisa izinga lokuzakhudlala okuncane ku-National Treasury Public SCM Municipal. Isipiliye ikakhulukazi emkhakheni we-TVET noma we-Higher Education. Ulwazi olujulile ngo-CET Act (Continuing Education and Training Act). Ukuqashelwa emzimeni wezinkalo ehlukene (njenge-CIPS).
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwesidingo kokuqhafuka: Umphathi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuthenga kwezimpahla nezinsiza zonke kuhambisana nohlelo lokuthenga olweminyaka yonke lwe-College. Imisebenzi ephambili: Ukubheka inqubo yesibalo, ukuphatha isistimu yezinani ezincane ezithengwa, futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke okuthengwa kuncintisana futhi kubiza okuncane. Isibalo sokuqina: Ukwenza ngokugcwele i-100% kwesu elivunyiwe lokuthenga ngaphakathi kwesabelomali. Ilogistics nokuphathwa kokulawula izinto zokugcina: Leli candi libheka ngqo enyakatho nasekugcineni kwezimpahla ezihamba phakathi kwezikolwa ezingabe zitholakala. Imisebenzi ephambili: Ukuphatha izitolo ezigcina izinto ezinkulu, ukubheka ukutholakala kwezincwadi ezifundwayo nezinto ezibhaliwayo kwezinye izikolwa ezincane, nokugcina izinga lokugcina into elilingene ukuze kungabi khona ukuthenga kakhulu noma ukuphela kwento. Isibalo sokuqina: Ukucacile kwerekhodi lezinto ezibekwe ngokunesibalo nokushoda ngokulahleka/isiphithiphithi sezinto zokugcina. Umabhalane wekomidi yamabhithi nokuqondisa: Umphathi we-SCM usebenza njengonozinja wenqubo yamabhithi ahleziyo. Imisebenzi ephambili: Ukubhekisa emakomidi Amabhithi isibalo, ukuhlola, nokuphetha. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amabhithi athunyelwa emaphephandabeni, avulwe, futhi anikezwa ngokulandela ngokuphelele i-PPPFA (Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act). Isibalo sokuqina: Zero isivikelo esipumelele noma ukuphikiswa ngomthetho ngokuphathwa kwamathenda ngenxa yokungazilandelwa kwemithetho yokuqonda. Ukuphathwa kokwenziwa kwabahlinzeki kwezenzo: Uma abahlinzeki befakwa igama, umphathi we-SCM kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi kutholakala ngokulingene imali. Imisebenzi ephambili: Ukubheka ngokwenza okuhle kwezinto abahlinzeki ngokwama-Service Level Agreements (SLAs), ukuphatha ukuvuselelwa/ukupheliswa kwamakonthirathi, nokugcina idathabhese eya phambili evumileko ku-Central Supplier Database (CSD). Isibalo sokuqina: Ukulethwa ngesikhathi kwezinsiza kanye nokubhaliwe okuyisikhathi esithile (kwindla ngasinye) kokubheka ukwenza kahle kwezinsiza zabahlinzeki. Ukuphathwa kwamafa nokuze kwenzeke ukulahla: Uphethe ngobomi bomthamo wamafa e-College ahambahambayo, kusukela ekutholweni ukuya ekuphetheni. Imisebenzi ephambili: Ukugcina irekhodi lamafa ngokulandela imigomo ye-GRAP, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amafa afakwe ikhodi nokulandelwa kuzo zonke izikolwa, nokuphatha ukulahla amafa angadingeki noma aseduzayo ngokuthengiswa emphakathini noma ukudluliswa. Isibalo sokuqina: Ukugqamisa ngemvama okuphumelelayo phakathi kwerekhodi lamafa nesekhulu lezabelomali phakathi nokuqina kobukhosi bamaphoyisa. Ukuvumelana nokwenziwa, ukuphathwa kwezinsangamungo, kanye nokwesekwa ukwenza isibhekephika: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inqaba ye-SCM ihlale isilungele ukwenza isibhekephika. Imisebenzi ephambili: Ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha izilawulo zangaphakathi ze-SCM ukuze kugwenywe okubiza ngokungalawuleki, okungenamthengi, kanye nokuchithwa okungalengele. Ukuhlanzela yonke imibhalo edingayo kanye nama-audit trails kwi-Auditor-General (AG) noma oboholayo. Isibalo sokuqina: Ukufinyelela kwesisiphumo se-clean audit sekuqinisekisiwe esikhundleni esibhekele izinsiza zokuhlinzeka.

xh.title: Umncedisi weQhagamshelwano: Umphathi weNqanaba lokuhambisa izinto
xh.summary: Ukuphatha imisebenzi yenqanaba lokuhambisa izito equka ukuthenga, ukulawula isidingo nokuphatha ukuthengiswa kwindawo eNgumkhakangelo oPhakamileyo we Northern Cape Rural TVET College Central Office e Upington.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zobugcisa ezifanelekileyo ezivunywe ngokusemthethweni/Nesidanga seNqanaba le-6 (NQF) okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo kwelophu lokulawula inqanaba lokuhambisa izinto okanye indawo enxulumene nalo. Ubuncinane iiminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava wokusebenza kwendawo ephatha ukuhamba kwezinto. Ubuncinane iiminyaka ezintathu (3) zamava aqhelekileyo okuba ngumphathi. Ukuqonda izinto kwindalo yamakhompyutha nokuziphatha kakuhle kwi Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni nesithembiso sokuhamba. Iakhono: Amawesethi asemthethweni: Umthetho woLawulo loMali oHlukahlukeneyo weSizwe (PFMA), Iimigaqo zeNgcwele, nge PPPFA. Amacebo okuqhumisa: Ukulawula isidingo, ukuphatha ukuthengiswa, nokuphatha iinkqubo. Ukuthenga kwilizwe lemphakathi: Ulwazi lokusebenza lweNqanaba leSiseko soluhlu lwabathengisi (CSD) namakhonkco e-e-Tender. Ukuphatha izimpahla: Ulwazi lwemigaqo ye GRATI malunga uluhlu lwempahla nendlela yokulahla. Ukucinga ngokuhlaziyo: Ikhono lokutolika idatha eyinkimbankimba yemali nendlela eziswa ukuthenga. Iinkomfutha: Ikhono elibonwayo lokuphatha Iinkqubo zoBumfananisi boQoqosho (SLAs) nokuqhubana nabathengisi. Unxibelelwano: Ikhono eliphezulu lemulume nolwelalwe ngemisebenzi ecaliweyo kuburhulumente ngenjongo yokubhengeza ngokomlomo nangokubhalwayo ngaphakathi kwesebe kwiNgqungqutha namabalu. Ukuziphatha kwiKhompyutha: Ukuziphatha kakuhle kwi MS Office (Excel elithuthukileyo) nakwezinye iinkqubo ze ERP (umzekelo, i COLTECH). Urhwebo: Ikhono elinamandya lokuphatha iqela labantu nokusombulula iingxaki. Amava amaninzi ekuphathweni kwekomiti yokuqinisekisa iinkqubo zokuqamba, ukulinganisa, nokuqamba iingxelo. Ulwazi olubonwayo lokuphatha uluhlu lwempahla. Amava kokuhlanganisa nokuqinisekisa iinkqubo zangaphakathi, ngokukodwa ekusombululeni iingxaki ze SCM. Amava ekwakheni nokuzeza iinkqubo ze SCM nemigaqo yokusebenza (SOPs). Isidanga sokutya phantsi kwamabachelor kuphela okanye i Honours okanye i BCom Hons kwelophu yokulawula ukugqithisa izinto okanye kwezimali. Igqibo leminqamlelo ye National Treasury Public SCM Municipal Minimum Competency levels. Amava ngokukodwa kwindawo ye TVET okanye yezemfundo ePhakamileyo. Ulwazi oluqhubekela phambili lwe CET Act (Continuing Education and Training Act). Ukwaziswa kwindawo ekuyiyiyo yezomthetho okanye urhwebo (umzekelo, i CIPS).
xh.duties: Ukulawula isidingo nokuphatha ukuthengiswa: Umphathi kufuneka aqinisekise ukuba ukuthengiswa kwezinto zonke nezeenkonziza kuhambisana noCedulo lokuThenga lweNyanga yonke loKholeji. Iinkqubo eziyindlela eziphambili: Ukuqinisekisa inkqubo yokucuka, ukuphatha inkqubo yamaxabiso kwizinto ezithengiswa ngexabiso eliphantsi, nokuqinisekisa ukuba ukuthengwa kuko konke kuncedisana kwaye kugcina imali. Isalathiso semisebenzi: Ukwenza ngokupheleleyo i-100% le candulo evunyiweyo lokuthenga ngaphakathi kwesabelo. Ukulawulwa kwemiba yokuhamba noluhlu lwempahla: E ndawo igxila ekunyuseni nasekugcineni izinto ngokomzimba ngamakhasi amaninzi. Iinkqubo eziyindlela eziphambili: Ukuphatha izitulo ezingaphakathi, ukuqinisekisa ukusasazwa kweencwadi ezifundwayo nezinto ezisetyenziswa kumakhasi amancinci, nokugcina inqanaba elifanelekileyo lemiphumo yokunqanda ukuthenga okugqithisileyo okanye ukuba Sekukhona okungantengiso. Isalathiso semisebenzi: Ukuchaneka koluhlu lwempahla nokunciphisa ukulahleka/ukutshatyalaliswa kwempahla. Nodwane weKomiti yoBumpompo nokulawula: Umphathi we SCM usiba ngumnikazi wenkqubo echanekileyo yokunikela iinkampani ithuba lokunqabela. Iinkqubo eziyindlela eziphambili: Ukwenza lula amaKomiti oBumpompo, ukuqinisekisa, nokuqamba iinkqubo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iimbido zithunyelwe, zivulwe, zize zikhankaswe ngokulandela ngokuchanekileyo i PPPFA (Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act). Isalathiso semisebenzi: Iziyimveliso ezinguziro eziphumeleleyo okanye iingxaki zomthetho ekuchasenenzi ngenxa yokungalandeli inkqubo. Ukuphatha iNkqubo nokuQonda ngokomthetho iNkonzo zabathengisi: Xa kumiselwa umnikazi wenkonzo, umphathi we SCM kufuneka aqinisekise ukuba imali iyahlawulelwa ngokwexabiso layo. Iinkqubo eziyindlela eziphambili: Ukuqwalasela inkqubo yabathengisi ngokulandela Iinkqubo zoBumfananisi boQoqosho (SLAs), ukuphatha ukuvuselela/ukuphelisa iinkqubo, nokugcina uluhlu oluhlaziyiweyo nolulandela umthetho kwiNqanaba leSiseko soluhlu lwabathengisi (CSD). Isalathiso semisebenzi: Ukufika kwexesha ngenkonziza nokubhaliswa kwamaxwebu okuqinisekisa inkqubo yabathengisi ngenkathana yenkathi enye. Ukuphathwa kwempahla nokulahla izinto: Uyakrwela iinkqubo ngokuphila kwempahla ezingatshatanga zangaKholeji, ukusukela ekuthengiweni ukuya ekugqibeleni. Iinkqubo eziyindlela eziphambili: Ukugcina uluhlu lwempahla olulandela imigaqo ye GRAP, ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke impahla inekhowudi yekhompyutha nokuqwalaselwa kwamakhasi, nokulawula ukulahla izinto ezingasafunekiyo okanye ezizele ngokusetyenziswa ngeenkqubo zethengiso okanyekuye ngokusetyenziswa ngokusetyenziswa ekwenzeni ulutshwalaliswe. Isalathiso semisebenzi: Ukwenza ngokuphumeleyo ukuqinisekisa ngokuhambisana koluhlu lwempahla nolwezimali ngexesha lokujongwa kwamava ngonyaka. Ukuhambelana nemithetho, ukuphatha iingozzi, noKuxhaswa kuVavanyo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iqela le SCM lihlala silungele uKuvavanywa. Iinkqubo eziyindlela eziphambili: Ekwenzeni nakuzezeni amacebo angaphakathi e SCM ukunqanda ukusetyenziswa kwemali engangalunganga, engagqithi nento, nendlala. Ukulungisa yonke imibhalo efunekayo nabanxibelelanisi bokuqinisekisa iinkqubo boLumkisi-ntloko (AG) okanye abalumkisi bangaphakathi. Isalathiso semisebenzi: Ukuphumelela ngokuphumelelayo kumava aqinisekisiweyo angenanto efanayo zeNqanaba lokuhambisa izinto.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Interne Oudit en Kwaliteitsbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir interne oudit en kwaliteitsbestuur by Randfontein-kampus, wat 'n diploma of graad in interne oudit vereis met 3-5 jaar ondervinding insluitend toesighoudende vlak.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkennde 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Interne Oudit of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3- 5 jaar tersaaklike ondervinding in die Interne Oudit-omgewing hê waarvan 2-3 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Moet rekenaarga letterd wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê. Moet ondervinding hê in die ontwikkeling van beleide en implementeringstrategieë. Bevoegdhede, kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die tersaaklike voorSkrifte, wetgewing en regulasies wat die TVET- en Openbare Diens-sektor regeer. Kennis en begrip van die Interne Oudit-omgewing. Moet goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, mensebestuur, beplanning en organisering, aanbieding, verslagskrywing, probleemoplossing, analitiese, kliëntgerigte, projekbestuur en finansiële bestuursvaardighede hê.
af.duties: Voorbereiding en uitvoering van die interne ouditplan: Voer pre-vergaderings met kollege-bestuur voor aanvang van die oudite. Kry Kollege-bestuur se goedkeuring van die oudit-omvang voor aanvang van die interne oudite. Beplanning en opstel van gedetailleerde ouditprosedures vir oudite volgens die goedgekeurde jaarlikse ouditplan. Uitvoer en verrig van oudittoetsing volgens die jaarlikse ouditplan. Vestig 'n gehalte-oudit risikobestuursfunksie en monitor assesserings om nakoming van formele stelsels te verseker. Voer geskeduleerde en reaktiewe oudite en inspeksies uit en produseer verslae oor alle oudite, inspeksies en voorvalle. Verskaffing van sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan die ouditkomitee: Doen navorsing oor beste praktyke en toepassing van standaarde. Verspreiding en versameling van ouditkliënte se opnames vir dienste gelewer. Verseker dat wetgewing en wette korrek in die kollege geïmplementeer word. Verseker dat alle ouditbevindings deur die vereiste ouditbewyse ondersteun word. Verseker dat prosesse wat vir kwaliteitsbestuurstelsels nodig is, gevestig, geïmplementeer en in stand gehou word: Ontwikkel kwaliteitsbestuurstelsel-beleide en -prosedures vir die kollege. Rapporteer aan kollege-bestuur oor die prestasie van die KBS en die behoefte aan verbetering. Verseker die bevordering van bewustheid van kliëntvereistes regdeur die kollege. Verskaf inligting en verslae aan die uitvoerende en komitees om finale besluite te neem. Skakel met eksterne assesseringsliggaam oor alle sake wat verband hou met die eksterne akkreditasieproses. Verseker dat alle verskaffers wat deur die kollege gebruik word, geselekteer, herevalueer en dat rekords van hierdie assessering gehou word. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van beleide: Vestig kantoorprosedures en bedryfstelsels. Verskaf polisie-ondersteuning, ontwikkelingsproses en onderhou bewaarplek. Voer instellingsprestasie-assesserings en evaluering van die implementering van beleide, programme en stelsels uit. Verseker dat alle rolspelers en bestuurders bewus is en regulatoriese nakomingsvereistes verstaan.

zu.title: Umkelo: Ongenelele ekuqinisekiseni ngaphakathi kanye Nenqubomgomo Yekhwalithi
zu.summary: Umongameli ongenelelayo ekulinganisweni ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuqinisekisa ezibhalwe ngaphakathi kanye nenqubomgomo yekhwalithi e-Randfontein Campus, ofuna idiploma noma iziqu sokulinganisa okubhalwe ngaphakathi aneminyaka engu-3-5 yemisebenzi ehlanganisa izinga lokuhlola abasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seMatric/Grade12 kanye nediploma yezwe izwakuphela iminyaka engu-3 noma iziqu sokulinganisa okubhalwe ngaphakathi noma iziqu ezifanele. Kumele abe nenhalavula yeminyaka engu-3-5 yemisebenzi efanele kwelabhothari yokulinganisa ngaphakathi okuyilapho iminyaka engu-2-3 kumele ibe kwizinga lokuhlola abasebenzi. Kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele abe namalayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Kumele abe nomuzwa wokwakha izinqubomgomo nokwenza zisebenze. Ulwazi, amandla namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho ephathelene nothishela beziqu zobuchwepheshe nezikhungo zabantu abakhonza umbuso. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwelabhothari yokulinganisa okubhalwe ngaphakathi. Kumele abe namakhono okukhuluma, okubhala, okuphatha abantu, okuhlela, okwenza izincomo, okubhala imibiko, okuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya ukuthuthukiswa, ukuba nomoya wokulondolozela othengiwe, okuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye namakhono okuphatha imali.
zu.duties: Ukulungiselela nokwenza ihlelo lokulinganisa okubhalwe ngaphakathi: Yenza izinkulumo ngaphambi kokuzula nokubonisana nomphathi webholani ngaphambi kokuqala ukulinganisa. Thola isimemezelo somphathi webholani sokuwina Isikalo sokulinganisa ngaphambi kokuqala ukulolonga ukuqinisekiswa. Ukuhlela nokubhala iza ukulandelana kokulinga okuningiliziwe ekubukeni iminyaka yonke yokuqinisekiswa. Ukwenza nokulolonga ukulinga ukuqhathanisa ngokohlelo lweminyaka yonke. Akha imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwesimiso sokulondoloza ubungozi ukuze kugcinwe ukulandelwa kwemithetho yesimiso. Yenza uhlelo lwangemuva kanye nezilinganiso ezibuyiswayo bese ekhiya imibiko yazo zonke izilinganiso. Ukubuyisa imininingwane yokusekela inqubomgomo ye komidi yokulinganisa: Cukumaza imibuzo engconekwe ngomdlalo kahle kanye nokubeka amaphuzu. Ukusabalalisa nokuthola imibuzo evela kubathengi bokulinganisa imisebenzi ebanzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yomphakathi ibhalwe ngokuthi ithiwebhu yomlando webholani. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkomba zokulinganisa zisekelwe ubufakela obudingekayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi inqubo efunwa yisimiso sohlelo lokulawula khwalithi yenzelwe isikhathi esithile, yamukelwe, futhi igcinwa: Akha izinhlelo zomthetho nokulandelwa kwemithetho kwe khwalithi webholani. Breza imibiko yomphathi webholani ngemisebenzi yokwazi ukuba lolu hlelo lwekhwalithi lushintshekanga, kanye ne zindlela zokuthuthukisa. Qinisekisa ukubeka ukwaziswa okwamanje kwezidingo zabathengi kulo lonke ibholani. Nikeza ulwazi kanye nemibiko ekubeni ngqondongqondo namakomidi ukwenza izinqumo. Yenza uchungechunge lwemibuzo ngesikhungo sokulinganisa saphandle kuzo zonke izinto ezihlobene nenqubo yokuhlinzwa ngemivuzo yezwe. Qiniseka ukuthi bonke abakhiqizi abakhethwa bakhethwa, baqinisekiswa kabusha ukuthi imibhalo yokulolonga imisebenzi igcinwa. Lawula ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokulolonga izinqubomgomo: Akha inqubo yendawo nezimiso zokusebenza. Inika isekelo lomthetho, inqubo yokuthuthukiswa bese igcina imibhalo. Yenza isilinganiso sokuzula nokubuka ukusetshenziswa izinqubomgomo, amaphrojekthi nezimiso. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abadlala indima kanye nabaphathi bayayazi futhi bayaqonda imithetho yokulawula umthetho.

xh.title: Umlawuli ongumncedi: Ukucofa kwangaphakathi nokulawula isoqobo
xh.summary: Umlawuli ongumncedi wokucofa kwangaphakathi nokulawula isoqobo kwindawo yokufunda eyiRandfontein Campus, efuna idiploma okanye idigri kokucofa kwangaphakathi ngonqaku loqhagamshelwano lwe-3-5 iminyaka equka inqanaba lokulawula abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric/Grade12 negqithelwa lidiploma leNational Diploma yeminyaka engu-3 evunyiwe okanye iDegree kuInternal Audit okanye ngesiqinisekiso esihambelanayo. Kufuneka kubekho olunye loqhagamshelwano olungaphantsi kweminyaka engu-3-5 ekufundeni ngakumbi kwindawo yokucofa kwangaphakathi apho iminyaka engu-2-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawula abasebenzi. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka unelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Kufuneka unamava ekuyileni iinkqubo kunye namacebo okuzisebenzisa. Iimfuno, ulwazi, namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, iziqinisekiso kunye namagunya alo lawula isector yeTVET neseze likaRhulumente. Ulwazi nokuqonda indawo yokucofa kwangaphakathi. Kufuneka ube ngamakhono amabalwa nokubhala, ongabantu, ekulawuleni abantu, ekuqwalaselweni nokuqwalasela, okubonisa, okubhala iingxelo, ekuqondisiseni iingxaki, ekuhlalutyeni, ekujolisweni kumxhasi, ekulawulweni amaprojekthi nakulawulo lemali.
xh.duties: Ilokozi kunye nokuphumeza icebo lokulinga lokulinga langaphakathi: Qhuba iindibano phambi kokuqala ukuvavanya kunye nokulawula iikholeji phambi kokuqala ukuvavanya. fumana isigqibo sokulawula iikholeji kummandla wokuvavanya phambi kokuqalisa ukuvavanywa kwangaphakathi. Ukuqwalasela kwaye udadle iinkqubo ezicatshulwayo zovavanyo kumavavanyo ngokwecebo lovavanyo lweminyaka yonke elamkelekileyo. Ukwenza kwaye uzenze uvavanyo lokuvavanya ngokwecebo lovavanyo lweminyaka yonke. Seka isikhendithi sokuqwalasela ingozi yolawulo kwaye ulawule ukuguqulwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela iinkqubo ezisemthethweni. Qhuba uluhlu kwaye uphendule ngokuvavanya kwaye utyelele kwaye wenze iingxelo ngazo zonke iindawo zokuvavanya, izityendlo nezenzo. Unika inkxaso yeenkonzo zobasekretari kwikomiti yokuqwalasela: Yenza uphando ngaphezulu kweziseko ezilungileyo nakusetyenziswa kweemigangatho. Saza kwaye uqokele iingxelo zabaxhasi bezityendlo ngenkonzo eznakhiwe. Qinisekisa ukuba umthetho namagunya asetyenziwa ngokuchanekileyo kwikholeji. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iziphumo zokuvavanya zixhaswa ngobufundi obufunekayo bokuvavanya. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ezifunekayo zoomatshini wokulawula isoqobo zisekelwe, zisetyenziiswa kwaye zigcinwe: Yenza iinkqubo nomgaqo-nkqubo wolawulo lwekholeji. Iingxelo kubaphathi bekholeji ngemveliso yeQMS ngesidingo sokuqwalasela. Qinisekisa ukuba konke ukwaziswa ngeemfuno zabathengi kusasazwe kulo lonke ikholeji. nikela ulwazi neengxelo kubaphathi nakwikomiti ukwenza isigqibo sokugqibela. Nghalana nombali wangaphandle wokuqwalasela kuzo zonke izinto ezihambelana nenkqubo yokuqinisekiswa yangaphandle. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abanikezeli abasetyenziswa yikholeji bakhethe, bakhanywe kwakhona kwaye ukhutshwe iirekhodi zolu qwalaselo. Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenzisa nokulawula iinkqubo: Seka iinkqubo zofiso kunye nolawulo lokusebenza. Nikeza inkxaso yamapolisa, inkqubo yophuhliso kwaye ugcine isikhululo seefayili. Qhuba ukuvavanywa komlinganiselo wemveliso kwikhonsithi nokuqwalasela ukusebenza kweenkqubo, iinkqubo nezixhobo. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abadlalo kwaye abaphathi bayayazi kwaye bayayiqonda iimfuno zokuthobela imigaqo-nkqubo.

af.duties: Hou toesig oor onderhoud van geboue en persele: Stel 'n onderhoudsplan op rakende masjinerie, gereedskap en toerusting. Monitor die implementering van die onderhoudsplan.
