Fasiliteer en verseker bewusmakingswerkswinkels oor beleide en prosedurehandleidings rakende fasiliteitebestuur. Identifiseer potensiële risikogevaar in die gebou. Verseker die verskaffing van skoonmaakdienste. Verseker behoorlike bordvoering (Waarskuwingsinligtingsborde) in en om die geboue van die instelling om veiligheidsrisiko te minimaliseer. Verseker nakoming van SHERQ- en OHS-Wet: Ontwikkel en implementeer beleide rakende SHERQ en OHS. Voer OHS-bewusmakingsprogramme uit. Bied hulp met inligting rakende gesondheids- en veiligheidsake. Ontwikkel die kollege se noodontruimingsplan. Voer veiligheidsoudits in al die persele uit. Identifiseer potensiële gesondheids- en veiligheidsgevare. Verseker dat die OHS-komitee gestig en aktief is. Ontwikkel gehalteversekerings- en SHERQ-beleide. Ondersoek gesondheids- en veiligheidsverwante klagtes. Verseker dat alle werkswinkels by die Kollege aan statutêre vereistes voldoen. Verseker vorming/benoemings en opleiding van veiligheidsverteenwoordigers en noodhulpverleners by alle Kollege-terreine. Rapportering en koördinering van al die IOD's. Hou toesig oor vlootbestuur: Ontwikkel en implementeer vlootbestuursbeleide. Verseker en monitor die skoonmaak en onderhoud van voertuie. Verseker beheer, toesig en magtiging van alle amptelike gebruik van alle Kollege-voertuie. Verseker waarborgebestuur, onderhoud, versekering en lisensiering van voertuie. Verseker die monitering van toepaslike lisensies van bestuurders van voertuie. Verseker monitering van logboeke. Verseker monitering van nakoming van die prosedures wat gevolg moet word in die geval van 'n ongeluk. Verseker monitering van parkeer van die voertuie. Handhaaf die fisiese sekuriteitsfunksies insluitend sleutelbeheer, personeel, dokument- en bewakingssekuriteit: Ontwikkeling, hersiening en monitering van die implementering van sekuriteitsbeleid. Verseker die verskaffing van tegniese sekuriteitsdienste. Verantwoordelik vir sekuriteit en toegangsbeheer by fasiliteite. Monitor en opgradeer die toegangsbeheerstelsel van die kollege. Voer voorlopige diefstalondersoeke uit. Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n sekuriteitsopleidingskapasiteit vir die kollege. Verseker behoorlike beheerprosedures en monitering van die elektroniese sekuriteitsstelsel. Verseker nakoming van kontrakteurs se SLA op terrein soos sekuriteit, tuindiens ens. Rekordbestuur.

zu.title: Onozime: Izindlu Eziyingqikithi Nokuphathwa Kwemibhalo
zu.summary: Kudingeka uNozime ozoqapha izindlu eziyingqikithi nokuphathwa kwemibhalo, okuhlanganisa ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo nokusetshenziswa kwesikhala, okudinga idiploma noma iziqu ezifanele kanye nokutholwa emsebenzini kweminyaka engu-3 kuya ku-5.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric/Grade12 kahle nge-Diploma Yezwe eminyakeni engu-3 ekuqashwe noma Iziqu ekuPhathweni Kwezakhiwo/IkuPhathwa KoKuphepha/IkuPhathwa KokuLungiselela noma iziqu ezifanele. Kumele abe nokutholwa emsebenzini okuncane nje kweminyaka engu-3-5 ohlelweni loKuphathwa Kwezindlu Eziyingqikithi, SHERQ kanye nomphakathi we-OHS, okuyiminyaka engu-2-3 kuyo kumele abe ngazinga lokubhekisisa. Kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono, Ulwazi, Namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho WezeNkonzo Zikahulumeni Nemithetho Edingekayo, umthetho WezeMpilo NoKuphepha Kusebenza, umthetho WokuPhathwa Kwamafa Ehamba Inhlanhla, uhlelo LokuPhathwa Icingo, uhlelo Lokulawula Nomlilo kanye nohlelo LokuPhatha Izindlu Eziyingqikithi. Kumele abe namakhono okukhuluma ngomlomo nokubhala ahle, okuhlobene nabantu, okuphatha abantu, okuhlela nokuhlela, okwenziwe izithombe, okubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, okuqondiswa kumthengi, okuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye namakhono okuphatha izimali, ukuthembeka, ukuba nobusuku bokubona ngaphambili kanye nokuzinikela.
zu.duties: Qapha ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo nezindawo: Hlela icebo lokugcina mayelana nemishini, amathuluzi namaphathi. Qapha ukuphunywa kwendawo yohlelo lokugcina. Qinisekisa inikezwa indawo yohlelo lokusebenza kanye nezenzo zokupaka. Yenza kube lula ukusetshenziswa kwesikhala ezakhiweni nasemhlabeni. Uxhumanise nokuhlela okuhle kwesikhala nokugcoba okuphelele kwezakhiwo. Sikhuthaze futhi uqinisekise imiklalo yokwazisa ngezinqamuleli zomthetho nezincwadi zendlela ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezindlu eziyingqikithi. Hlola ukuthi kukhona yini izengo ezibangelwa ubungozi ezakhiweni. Qinisekisa inikezwa kwezenzo zokusula. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kwemiyalezo efanele (Imiyalezo yesexwayiso) ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezakhiwo zesikhungo ukunciphisa ingozi yokuphepha. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana noMthetho we-SHERQ kanye nowe-OHS: Hlela futhi usebenzise imithetho ehlobene ne-SHERQ kanye ne-OHS. Yenza izinhlelo zokwazisa nge-OHS. Siza ngolwazi mayelana nezindaba ezingezempilo nokuphepha. Hlela icebo lesikhungo lokubalekela ezimo eziphuthumayo. Yenza ukuhlola ukuphepha kuzo zonke izindawo. Hlola ukuthi kukhona yini izingozi ezingezempilo nokuphepha. Qinisekisa ukuthi ikomidi ye-OHS isungulwe futhi isebenza. Hlela imithetho yokuqinisekisa izinga kanye ne-SHERQ. Phenya izikhulumo ezingezempilo nokuphepha. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkundla ekuKholiji zihambisana nemfuno yomthetho. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa/ ukumiswa nokuhleliswa kwezimele zokuphepha kanye nabasizi bokudla kwesibhaxu kuzo zonke izindawo zeKholiji. Bingela futhi uhlele konke ama-IOD. Qapha ukuphathwa kwamabhodi: Hlela futhi usebenzise imithetho yokuphatha amabhodi. Qinisekisa futhi qapha ukuhlelwa nokugcinwa kwezimoto. Qinisekisa ukulawula, ukuqapha nokuvumela ukusetshenziswa ngokusemthethweni kwayo yonke imoto yeKholiji. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwegwaranti, ukugcinwa, inshurensi nokunikezwa ilayisensi kwamoto. Qinisekisa ukuqaphwa okufanele kwelayisensi yabashayeli bamoto. Qinisekisa ukuqaphwa kwamabuku wokungena. Qinisekisa ukuqaphwa kokuvumelana nemiyalelo okumele ilandelwe uma kwenzeke isiphithiphithi. Qinisekisa ukuqaphwa kokupaka kwezimoto. Gcina imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa ngokomzimba okuhlanganisa ukulawula okhiye, abantu, imibhalo kanye nokuphepha okubukwayo: Hlela, kabusha futhi qapha ukusetshenziswa komthetho wokuphepha. Qinisekisa inikezwa kwezenzo zokuphepha zobuchwepheshe. Ungumenzi wokuphepha nokuLawula ukungena ezindaweni. Qapha futhi thuthukisa uhlelo lokulawula ukungena eKholiji. Yenza iphenyo lohulumeni lokubhaqa. Hlela futhi gcina njengobuso bokuhlela ukuphepha beKholiji. Qinisekisa izinqubo zokulawula okufanele nokuqapha kuhlelo lokuphepha lekhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwe-SLA yabakhi ohlelweni olunjengokuphepha, isevisi yesimo njll. Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: uLawulo lwezikhululo kunye nepesta zolwazi
xh.summary: Kufuneka afunekwe uMncedisi woMlawuli onakele ulawulo lwezikhululo kunye nolawulo lwepesta zolwazi, kuquka ukulondoloza izakhiwo kunye nokusebenzisa indawo, kwaye kufuneka ane-diploma okanye i-degree ethile kunye nenkokhelo yeminyaka e3 ukuya kwe5.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric/Grade12 esongezelelwe siyaziwa i-National Diploma yeminyaka emi-3 okanye i-Degree kwilawulo lezakhiwo/ilawulo lokhuseleko/ilawulo lwakhiwo-lwakho okanye ngesiqu esifanelekileyo. Kufuneka abe nenkokhelo equlekileyo yeminyaka engu-3-5 kwindawo yokusebenza ekulawulweni kwezikhululo, kumo ye-SHERQ ne-OHS apho kweminyaka engu-2-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokuba ngumlawuli. Kufuneka azi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushuka ethembekileyo. Ikhono, ulwazi, namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho weZikhululo zaLuntu kunye namagqabantshintshi, umthetho wokuQinisekisa uKhuseleko neseMpilo yoMsebenzi, umthetho woLawulo lweeNkcukacha ezingatshintshiyo, inkqubo yoLawulo lweFowuni, inkqubo yolawulo lomlilo kunye nenkqubo yolawulo lwezikhululo. Kufuneka abe nakhono okulungileyo okuthethwayo nokubhaliweyo, okuhlangenwe nakho nabantu, okulawula abantu, okucwangcisa nokuhlela, okubonisa, okubhala iingxelo, okusombulula iingxaki, okuzalathisa, okujolise kumxhasi, okulawula iiprojekthi namakhono oLawulo lweMali, alathise, aqhayise ngaphambili anikezelwe.
xh.duties: Ukunjongwa ukulondoloza izakhiwo nendawo ezikuyo: Ukulungisa icebo lokulondoloza ngokumayelana nemishini, izixhobo nendawo yokusebenza. Ukujonga ukusetyenziswa kwecebo lokulondoloza. Ukunika isigqibo sendawo yokuhlala ebhulorini nesevisi yokupaka. Ukuphucula ukusetyenziswa kwendawo ezakhiweni nasemhlabeni. Ukwakho ukuba ngumntu ophethe ukucwangcisa indawo ngokuchanekileyo nolondolozo olupheleleyo lwezakhiwo. Ukukhuthaza kuqinisekiswe iindibano ezinolwazi malunga neenqobo ezichaza iinkqubo nokuqulunqwa kweekhathhunzi ezinxulumene nokulawula izikhululo. Ukuqaphela iingozi ezingase zibe khona ezakhiweni. Ukunika isigqibo ngekhonjiso lokucoca indawo. Ukunika isigqibo malunga neempawu ezifanelekileyo (iimpawu zolwazi lwezelumkiso) ngaphakathi nakunqamlezweni kwezakhiwo zale ndawo ukuze kunciphiswe ingozi yophula. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-SHERQ nosisemo se-OHS: Ukuphuma kwaye kusetyenziswe iinkqubo nge-SHERQ ne-OHS. Ukwenza iinkqubo zolwazi lwe-OHS. Ukusika ngenkxaso ngolwazi malanga neempilo nokingo ezindabeni. Ukulungisa icebo lokubalekela kwiingxwaba kwikholeji. Ukwenza uphononongo lokhuseleko kwazo zonke iindawo ezikuyo. Ukuchonga iingozi ezingase zibe khona ngempilo nesezomzikelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba komkhwa wokuqulunqwa o-OHS kwaye usebenza. Ukulungisa iinqobo ezinjengenkqubo yokuzinika ngokukhuseleka nokuchanekileyo kunye ne-SHERQ. Ukuphonononga iingxaki ezinxulumene nempilo nokingo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iindibano kwiKholeji zithobela iimfuno ezisiqikizi. Ukuqinisekisa ukubakho/ukwaziswa nokuzinika kokhuseleko kuqeqeshwa okukhuseleko kubakho kwaye kuqeqeshwe abantu bo kukhuseleko nabanikeli beso sokuqala kukuzonke iindawo zekholeji. Iingxelo kwaye kuqhagamshelwe zonke i-IOD. Ukulawula ulawulo lokuqulunqa ibhasi: ukulungisa kwaye kusetyenziswe iinkqubo ezibeka ulawulo lwemoto. Ukuqinisekisa ukujonga ukucoca nolondolozo lweemoto. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kugqitywa ulawulo lolawulo lokungenisa iimoto zekholeji ngamagunya athile. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcina ukhuseleko, ukulondoloza, ukuqinisekisa nokunikwa iilayisensi zemoto. Ukuqinisekisa ukujonga ukuthi abashukiweyo banamalayisensi ezemoto. Ukuqinisekisa ukujonga iibhuku zamagama. Ukuqinisekisa ukujonga ukuthobela iinkqubo ezimele zilandwe kwingcamango esingeniswe ngengozi. Ukuqinisekisa ukujonga ukupaka iimoto. Ukugcina imisebenzi ekukhuselekeni ngezinto, kuquka ukulawula okugcina ngamagunya, abantu, amaphepho kunye nokujonga ubukhuseleko: ukulungisa, ukuphonononga nokujonga ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yekhuseleko. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kubonelelwa ngemisebenzi yekhuseleko ngokobuchwepheshe. Ukuqinisekisa ubukhuseleko nokulawula ukungena ezikhululweni. Ukujonga nokuyila kabusha inkqubo yolawulo lokungena kwikholeji. Ukwenza uphando olusantya ngentshontsho. Ukulungisa kwaye kukhusele isakhono soqeqesho lwebhodi yekhuseleko leKholeji. Ukuqinisekisa iinkqubo zolawulo ezifanelekileyo kwaye ukujonge inkqubo yekhuseleko ngokwezikhalazo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzinikela ngokomthetho kwindlela yokusebenza nabathengisi bemisebenzi endaweni njengangamagunya, abakho bendlu, njl. Ulawulo lwepesta zolwazi.

jobs.title: Head of Administration
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Head of Administration at Krugersdorp Central Campus overseeing academic and student administration support services.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Public Management / Administration or a relevant qualification. Must have a minimum of 3-5 years relevant work experience in Administration at an Institution of Higher Learning of which 2-3 years should be on supervisory level. Must be computer literate. Must have a valid driver’s license. competencies, knowledge, and skills: Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations. Knowledge of office administration. Knowledge of Public Service legislations and policies. Knowledge of PSET. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET Administration. Understanding cost centre budgetary, expenditure and cash flow management. Must have good verbal and written communication, inter- personal, people management, planning and organising, presentation, report writing, problem solving, analytical, client oriented, project management and financial management skills, integrity, proactive and committed.
jobs.duties: Oversee the academic and student administration support services: Administer the provision of student support services. Administer the provision of student academic support services. Administer the provision of resource centre. Manage residence services. Administer student attendance. Administer student financial support. Support the implementation of college sport, arts and cultural programme at campus level. Oversee student registration and examination administration process: Draw up a campus enrolment plan. Coordinate the student registration process. Ensure that student portfolios of evidence and student records are safely filed. Ensure that student information is correctly captured and reconciled. Ensure data exceptions and corrections. Process the details of applications for programmes and credits. Coordinate the examination process. Coordinate certification process. Oversee and coordinate human resource administration services: Coordinate Leave forms and submit to central office. Coordinate PMDS documents and submit to central office. Coordinate all conditions of services matters and submit to central office for processing. Coordinate all training and development request submit to central office. Coordinate request to advertise forms and submit to central office. Coordinate all relevant documentation pertaining to disciplinary cases and grievances and submit to central office. Follow up and resolve all human resource administration queries and issues emanating from campus staff. Maintain human resource records administration. Monitor the attendance register for staff. Support the implementation of college staff wellness programme at campus level. Oversee and coordinate financial, asset and supply chain management services: Coordinate procurement memo and requisition forms to central office for processing. Manage receive goods and services. Verify the correctness of goods and services supplied against the appropriate documentation. Coordinate and submit invoices to central office for processing. Follow-up on campus requisitions made. Coordinate asset movement forms to central office for processing. Oversee campus infrastructure, maintenance and fleet management services: Ensure the implementation of occupational health, safety and environmental management strategies and programmes at campus level. Ensure the provision of infrastructure maintenance services. Ensure the provision of fleet management services. Ensure the provision of security services. Ensure the provision of gardening and cleaning services. Provide general administration support services and maintain a proper filing system. Coordinate and gather campus information as and when requested by corporate office and department. Prepare submissions, memo, reports, presentations, and other correspondence. Arrange meetings, conferences, workshops and other gatherings as required. Provide other secretarial support services to campus management. Maintain files for all campus staff. Filing of all relevant documentation according to QMS requirements and national achieve Act. Keep record of postage received from central office and ensure that the distribution is done accordingly and the register is kept by the relevant official.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Hlatshwayo/Mr P Motai Tel No: (011) 692 4004 Ext. 1010/1061/1062
jobs.applications: Please hand deliver your application or email it to kchoa@westcol.co.za in a pdf format and as one attachment, quoting the relevant reference number to the Principal, Western TVET College, Corporate Office, 42 Johnstone Street, Randfontein, 1760.
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed NEW Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of original documents with academic records/transcripts and other relevant supporting documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR Office. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. If you have not been contacted within six months after the closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Western TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People with disability are encouraged to apply. Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified.

af.title: Hoof van Administrasie
af.summary: Hoof van Administrasie by Krugersdorp Central Campus wat akademiese en studente-administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste toesig hou.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Openbare Bestuur / Administrasie of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3-5 jaar se relevante werkervaring in Administrasie by 'n Instelling van Hoër Onderwys hê waarvan 2-3 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Kompetensies, kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Openbare Dienswet en Regulasies. Kennis van kantooradministrasie. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing en beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van TVET-administrasie. Begrip van kostesentrum begrotings, besteding en kontantvloei-bestuur. Moet oor goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, personeelsbestuurs-, beplannings- en organisasie-, aanbiedings-, verslagskryf-, probleemoplossings-, analitiese, kliëntgerigte, projekbestuurs- en finansiële bestuursvaardighede beskik; moet integriteit hê, proaktief en toegewyd wees.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die akademiese en studente-administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste: Administreer die verskaffing van studente-ondersteuningsdienste. Administreer die verskaffing van studente-akademiese ondersteuningsdienste. Administreer die verskaffing van die hulpbronsentrum. Bestuur koshuisdienste. Administreer studentebywoning. Administreer studente-finansiële ondersteuning. Ondersteun die implementering van die kollege se sport-, kuns- en kulturele program op kampussenhorn vlak. Hou toesig oor die studenteregistrasie- en eksamenadministrasieproses: Trek 'n kampus-inskrywingsplan op. Koördineer die studenteregistrasieproses. Verseker dat studente-portuurliks van getuienis en studenterekords veilig geberg word. Verseker dat studenteinligting korrek vasgelê en versoen word. Verseker data-uitsonderings en -regstellings. Verwerk die besonderhede van aansoek om programme en krediete. Koördineer die eksamenproses. Koördineer die sertifiseringsproses. Hou toesig oor en koördineer menslike hulpbronadministrasiedienste: Koördineer verlofvorms en dien by sentrale kantoor in. Koördineer PMDS-dokumente en dien by sentrale kantoor in. Koördineer alle diensvoorwaarde-aangeleenthede en dien by sentrale kantoor in vir verwerking. Koördineer alle opleidings- en ontwikkelingsversoeke en dien by sentrale kantoor in. Koördineer versoeke om advertensievorms en dien by sentrale kantoor in. Koördineer alle relevante dokumentasie rakende dissiplinêre sake en griewe en dien by sentrale kantoor in. Volg alle menslike hulpbronadministrasie-navrae en -kwessies wat vanaf kampuspersoneel spruit, op en los dit op. Onderhou menslike hulpbronrekordadministrasie. Monitor die bywoningsregister vir personeel. Ondersteun die implementering van die kollege se personeelswelstandsprogram op kampusvlak. Hou toesig oor en koördineer finansiële, bates- en voorsieningskettingbestuursdienste: Koördineer verkrygingsnotas en bestelvorms na sentrale kantoor vir verwerking. Bestuur die ontvangs van goedere en dienste. Verifieer die korrektheid van goedere en dienste verskaf teenoor die toepaslike dokumentasie. Koördineer en dien fakture by sentrale kantoor in vir verwerking. Volg op kampus-bestellings wat gemaak is. Koördineer batesbewegingsvorms na sentrale kantoor vir verwerking. Hou toesig oor kampus-infrastruktuur, onderhoud en vlootbestuursdienste: Verseker die implementering van beroepsgesondheids-, veiligheids- en omgewingsbestuursstrategieë en - programme op kampusvlak. Verseker die verskaffing van infrastruktuuronderhoudsdienste. Verseker die verskaffing van vlootbestuursdienste. Verseker die verskaffing van sekuriteitsdienste. Verseker die verskaffing van tuinmaak- en skoonmaakdienste. Verskaf algemene administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste en handhaaf 'n behoorlike argiefstelsel. Koördineer en versamel kampusinligting soos en wanneer deur korporatiewe kantoor en departement versoek. Berei voorleggings, notas, verslae, aanbiedings en ander korrespondensie voor. Reël vergaderings, konferensies, werkswinkels en ander byeenkomste soos vereis. Verskaf ander sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan kampusbestuur. Onderhou lêers vir alle kampuspersoneel. Berging van alle relevante dokumentasie volgens QMS-vereistes en die Nasioniale Argiefwet. Hou rekord van pos wat van sentrale kantoor ontvang is en verseker dat verspreiding dienooreenkomstig gedoen word en dat die register deur die relevante beampte gehou word.

zu.title: Uhlelo loMbuso
zu.summary: Uhlelo loMbuso eKrugersdorp Central Campus olubheka izinkonzo zokweseka ukuphathwa kwezemfundo nakabafundi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seMatric/Grade12 kahle nge-Diploma yezwe eyaziwa iminyaka engu-3 noma i-Degree kuPublic Management / Administration noma isibindi esihambisana nalokho. Kumele abe nokuhluliswa emsebenzini okufanele okungeminyaka engu-3-5 ekuphathweni esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme okokuba iminyaka engu-2-3 kumele ibe ngazinga lokubhekisisa. Kumele azi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele abe namalayisensi yokushayela ethi ngokusemthethweni. Amandla, ulwazi, namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Public Service Act kanye noMthetho wokuLawula. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwehhovisi. Ulwazi ngomthetho kanye namapholisi wezemisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ulwazi ngePSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET. Ukuqonda izabelo zamaphasi, ukuchitha kwemali nokuqashwa kwemali. Kumele abe nokuxhumana ngomlomo nakubhalwayo, abantu, ukuphatha abantu, ukulungisa uhlelo, ukubonisa, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukugxila kwabathengi, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi nokuqonda izimali, ubuqotho, ukuba phambili nokuzinikela.
zu.duties: Bheka izinkonzo zokweseka ukuphathwa kwezemfundo nakabafundi: Phatha ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi yokweseka abafundi. Phatha ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi yokweseka abafundi ngokwemfundo. Phatha ukunikezwa kwesikhungo sezinsiza. Phatha imisebenzi yasehlazi. Phatha ukubikhona kwabafundi. Phatha ukweseka abafundi ngezimali. Sekela ukusetshenziswa kophayonimisha yemidlalo yakolishi, bokubhala bendalo nenhlalo ezingeni lesikhungo. Bheka ukubhaliswa kwabafundi nendlela yokuphatha ukuhlolwa: Hlela iphulani yokubhaliswa esikhungweni. Hlela ukubhaliswa kwabafundi. Qiniseza ukuthi amaphothifoliyo abafundi kanye namarekhodi abafundi agcinwe ngokuphephile. Qiniseza ukuthi ulwazi ngabafundi lutholwa ngokufanele futhi luhlolisise. Qiniseza ukulungiswa nokuhlolwa kwemininingwane. Phenya imininingwane yezicelo zemiholiso ngesibopho. Hlela inqubo yokuqashwa. Hlela inqubo yesitifikedi. Bheka futhi uhlele izinkonzo zokuphatha abasebenzi: Hlela amafomu okuhlala futhi uwathumele ehhovisi elikhulu. Hlela amadokhumenti e-PMDS futhi uwathumele ehhovisi elikhulu. Hlela zonke izindaba ezihlotshaniswa nemisebenzi futhi zithunyelwe ehhovisi elikhulu ukusetshenziswa. Hlela yonke imibiko yokutholakala kwamakhono futhi yothunyelwe ehhovisi elikhulu. Hlela izicelo zemiholiso yokuthumela izindaba futhi zithunyelwe ehhovisi elikhulu. Hlela yonke imibiko ephathelene nezinkalo ezingamthetho nezikhathazayo futhi ithunyelwe ehhovisi elikhulu. Landelela futhi uxazule yonke imibuzo nemicimbi yokuphatha abasebenzi evela kubasebenzi basesikhungweni. Gcina amarekhodi okuphatha abasebenzi. Bheka irekhodi lokuzikhwebula kwabasebenzi. Sekela ukusetshenziswa kophayonimisha yokuthuthukisa impilo yabasebenzi bakolishi ezingeni lesikhungo. Bheka futhi uhlele izinkonzo zokuphathwa kwemali, izimpahla nezinsiza ezitholakalayo: Hlela imemorandamu yokuthenga kanye namafomu okucela izimpahla athunyelwe ehhovisi elikhulu ukusetshenziswa. Phatha ukuzuza impahla kanye nesebenza. Qiniseza ukuthi impahla nezinsiza ezitholakalayo zihloliwe ngokuchibiyela kwamadokhumenti. Hlela futhi uthumele imali ecelayo ehhovisi elikhulu ukusetshenziswa. Landela ukuthatha izimpahla esikhungweni. Hlela imifomu yokuhambisa impahla ehhovisi elikhulu. Bheka ubuciko bomshini wakho, ukulungiswa kanye nokuphathwa kwezimoto: Qiniseza ukusetshenziswa kwezindwangu zokuqinisekiswa ukuthi kuyi-occupational health, safety kanye nokuqondiswa kokulawula imvelo ezingeni lesikhungo. Qiniseza ukuthi unikezwa ngokulungisa izinto ezingakazisebenzi. Qiniseza ukuthi kunikezwa ngokuphathwa kwezimoto. Qiniseza ukunikezwa ngokuphathwa kwesiphephelo. Qiniseza ukuthi unikezwa ngokulungisa nokuhlanzwa indawo. Nikeza izinkonzo zokuphathwa kokuqondisa futhi ugcine ukulandelwa kwemibhalo eshiyiwe ehhovisi elikhulu futhi ngokwendlela efanele. Bheka konke okubhalwayo ngokufanele ezingeni lesikhungo futhi ehhovisi elifanele. Hlela futhi uqoqe imininingwane yesikhungo uma kucelwa yinkampani kanye nomnyango. Hlela ukuthunyelwa kwemibhalo, imemorandamu, imibiko, ukubonisa nokunye okubhaliwe. Hlela futhi ugcine imiphumulo, konke okubhaliwe, izinkomba ezibonakalayo nezingabhalwa ehhovisi elikhulu. Lole imigqamo yamafayela ehhovisi elifanele ekuphathweni kwesikhungo. Gcina izinkomba eziyisikhathi eside zabasebenzi basesikhungweni. Beka amafayela onke amadokhumenti ngokwezidingo ze-QMS kanye nalawo evela kwesikhathi eside esebenze ehhovisi elikhulu. Gcina irekhodi lezinkulungwane ezitholakala ehhovisi elifanele futhi qiniseza ukuthi ihlolisise futhi igcinwe ngomuntu ophethe.

xh.title: Intloko yoLawulo
xh.summary: Intloko yoLawulo e Krugersdorp Central Campus elawula iinkonzo zoxhaso lolawulo lwezemfundo nabalundi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric/Grade12 sityeza nidiploma yeminyaka engama-3 esemthethweni okanye idigri kuPublic Management / Administration okanye ngesiqualification esifanelekileyo. Kufuneka ube nokuqonda kokusebenza okungam nyaka angama-3-5 kokulinganayo kulawulo kwInstitution of Higher Learning apho iminyaka engama-2-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawula. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka unelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Amandla, ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngePublic Service Act neRegulations. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweofisi. Ulwazi ngezithethe namapolicy wePublic Service. Ulwazi ngePSET. Ulwazi nokutabolwa kweTVET Administration. Ukuqonda ukulawula ngemali-yemali yecost centre, ukuchithwa kwemali nolawulo lwokuqhutywa kwemali. Kufuneka ube namakhono amahlwethu awabantu, okubeka izicwangciso, amakhono okubonisa ngokuthetha nangokubhala, okulawula abantu, okucwangcisa nokuhlela, okubonisa imibhalo, okubhala iireporti, okusombulula iingxaki, okuhlola ngokungalumkiyo, okujolise kumxhasi, okulawula iiprojekthi namakhono o lawulo lwezimali, ukuzithiba, ukuba mkhulu-ntili nokuzinikela.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zoxhaso lolawulo lwezemfundo nabalundi: Lawula ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zoxhaso abalundi. Lawula ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zoxhaso lolu lwezemfundo kubafundi. Lawula ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zesizinda-solwazi. Lawula iinkonzo zasezindlwini. Lawula ukubakho kwabafundi. Lawula uxhaso lwemali kubafundi. Xhasa ukusebenziswa kwinkqubo yemidlalo, nezobugcisa nenzondo yoluntu yekholeji kwinqanaba lesiko. Lawula ukubhaliswa kwabafundi nenkqubo yolawulo loviwo: Latha icebiso leplani yoku ngeniswa kwesiko. Hlela inkqubo yokubhaliswa kwabafundi. Qinisekisa ukuba iportfoliyo yamagama obungqina bemfundi namarekhodi abafundi zigcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba inkcazelo ngamagama abafundi iqotshwa ngokuchanekileyo iphinde lungelelwaniswe. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa kweeksepsihuni namaxesha am abiweyo kwiidata. Hlela iinkcukacha zezicelo zeeprogram ngezikweletu. Hlela inkqubo yoviwo. Hlela inkqubo yeempawu zokugqiba. Lawula ukuhlela kolawulo lwabasebenzi: Hlela amafomu enkululeko uze uwathumele kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo. Hlela amaxwebhu ePMDS uze uwathumele kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo. Hlela zonke izindaba ezimalana neemfuno zekontrakthi uze zithunyelwe kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo ukuba ziqhutywe. Hlela zonke izicelo zemfundo nophuhliso uze zithunyelwe kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo. Hlela izicelo zamafomu okuquumba uze awathumele kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo. Hlela yonke imibhalo enxulumene neendaba ezimalana nokulahlekelwa ngumsebenzi nabalungisi ngokutsha isikhundla uze ithunyelwe kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo. Landa uze usombulule yonke imibuzo nendaba ezivela kubasebenzi abangesikhunda ngokulawulo lwabasebenzi. Zigcine iirekhodi zolawulo lwabasebenzi. Hlola irekhodi lokuzikhweza kubasebenzi. Xhasa ukusetyenziswa kwinkqubo yamalungelo abasebenzi yekholeji kwinqanaba lesiko. Lawula ukuhlela kwezimali, izixhobo nolonikezho: Hlela imemo yokuthenga namafomu oku ngenisa kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo ukuba iqhutywe. Lawula ukwamkela kwempahla neenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuchanekileyo kwempahla neenkonzo ezinikiweyo xa zithe zaqqathaniswa naxwebhu. Hlela uze ungenise iinvoices ekuqhuba kuyo io fisi ukuba iqhutywe. Landa izicelo ezithunyelwe kwisiko. Hlela imafomu yokuhamba kwempahla uze ithunyelwe kwiofisi ekuqhuba kuyo ukuba iqhutywe. Lawula iinfrastrakhthi zesiko, ulondolozo nolonikezho kwiinkonzo zolawulo: Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweekhampagáni ze-strategies ngezenkqubo zolawulo nolondolozo ngokwemithetho yemizi-mvelo nakwinqanaba lesiko. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zolondolozo lweinfrastrakhthi. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zolawulo lwe-fl ithi. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zolondolozo. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zokhathaza nokucoca. Nikeza iinkonzo zolawulo jikelele uze zigcine indlela efanelekileyo yokubeka iifayile. Hlela uze uqokele inkcazelo yesiko naxa kucelwa yikhabhoni ofisi nesebe. Lungiselela izibhalo, imemo, iireporti, iinkcazelo emibi naxwebhu. Hlela iindibano, iindaba, iindibano-mhlanga nezinye iindibano njengoko kufunekayo. Nikeza ezinye iinkonzo zolawulo lwesikresihri ekulawulweni kwesiko. Gcina iifayile zabasebenzi bonke besiko. Faka iifayile zamaxwebhu onke asendleleni xa kujoliswe kufunwa yiQMS nakuMthetho we-National Archive Act. Gcina irekhodi lweposi efunyaneneyo ekuqhuba kwayo io fisi uze qinisekise ukuba kwenziwa ngokulungeleyo uye igcinwe ligosa elifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Labour Relations
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Labour Relations at the Department of Higher Education and Training corporate office, advising on labour matters and managing disciplinary procedures at salary level 9.
jobs.requirements: Matric / Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Labour Relations, Employment Relations / Human Resource Management or a relevant qualification. Must a minimum of have 3-5 years relevant work experience in the Labour Relations or Human Resource Management of which 2-3 years should be on supervisory level. Must be computer literate. Must have a valid driver’s license. Competencies, knowledge, And Skills: Knowledge of Labour Relations Act, Public Services legislations and policies related to Human Resource Management. Sound knowledge of Labour Relation statutes. Sound knowledge of International Labour Organization (ILO). Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/ CET Administration. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. Knowledge of PERSAL. Must have good verbal and written communication, inter-personal, people management, planning and organising, presentation, report writing, problem solving, analytical, client oriented, conducting investigations and presentation skills. Advanced experience in interpretation, development and implementation of policies.
jobs.duties: Maintain sound Labour Relations: Render advice on labour related matters. Develop and implement Human Resource policies and manuals. Ensure proper implementation of disciplinary procedures, grievance procedures and code of conduct. Conduct investigations and disciplinary hearings. Management of strike action. Minimize Labour disputes. Facilitate and conduct labour relations training and workshops. Ensure proper implementation of the collective bargaining council resolutions.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Hlatshwayo / Mr P Motai Tel No: (011) 692 4004 Ext. 1010/1061/1062
jobs.applications: Please hand deliver your application or email it to asdlabour@westcol.co.za in a pdf format and as one attachment, quoting the relevant reference number to the Principal, Western TVET College, Corporate Office, 42 Johnstone Street, Randfontein, 1760.
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed NEW Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of original documents with academic records/transcripts and other relevant supporting documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR Office. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. If you have not been contacted within six months after the closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Western TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People with disability are encouraged to apply. Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Arbeidsverhoudinge
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Arbeidsverhoudinge by die Department of Higher Education and Training korporatiewe kantoor, wat advies gee oor arbeidsaangeleenthede en dissiplinêre prosedures bestuur op salarisvlak 9.
af.requirements: Matric / Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Arbeidsverhoudinge, Indiensneemingsverhoudinge / Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3-5 jaar se relevante werkervaring in Arbeidsverhoudinge of Menslike Hulpbronbestuur hê waarvan 2-3 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Moet rekenaargakundig wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede, kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Labour Relations Act, wetgewing en beleide van die Public Services wat verband hou met Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Deglike kennis van arbeidsverhoudingwetgewing. Deglike kennis van die International Labour Organization (ILO). Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie. Kennis en begrip van die hoëronderwyssektor. Kennis van PERSAL. Moet goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, mensebestuurs-, beplannings- en organisasie-, aanbiedings-, verslagskryf-, probleemoplossings-, analitiese, kliëntgerigte, ondersoek- en aanbiedingsvaardighede hê. Gevorderde ervaring in die interpretering, ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide.
af.duties: Handhaaf goeie arbeidsverhoudinge: Verskaf advies oor arbeidsverwante aangeleenthede. Ontwikkel en implementeer Menslike Hulpbron-beleide en handleidings. Verseker behoorlike implementering van dissiplinêre prosedures, klagteprosedures en gedragskode. Voer ondersoeke en dissiplinêre verhore uit. Bestuur van staksies. Minimaliseer arbeidsgeskille. Fasiliteer en voer arbeidsverhouding-opleiding en werkswinkels uit. Verseker behoorlike implementering van die gesamentlike bedingingsraad se besluite.

zu.title: Umsekeli Wezinguquko: Izindaba Zomsebenzi
zu.summary: Umsekeli Wezinguquko: Izindaba Zomsebenzi ehhovisi elikhulu le Department of Higher Education and Training, ekunika izeluleko ngemikhakha yomsebenzi nasekuphathweni kwezinqubo zomgomo ngesikhundla seholo izinga 9.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikuletela / Grade12 kanye nesitifiketi seziqu esaziwayo seminyaka emi-3 se-National Diploma noma i-Degree kwezindaba zomsebenzi, Izindaba Zabasebenzi / Ukuphathwa Kweziphakeme Zokusebenza noma iziqu ezifanele. Kumele abe nobuncwane beminyaka engu-3-5 yohlu lokusebenza oluhlobene nezindaba zomsebenzi noma ukuphathwa kweziphakeme zokusebenza, okuyiminyaka engu-2-3 kumele ibe ngesikhundla sokubukela. Kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Kumele abe nelayisense yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono, ulwazi, Namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho wezindaba zomsebenzi, umthetho nokuyimithetho yabe zim serve namagephu ahlobene nokuphathwa kweziphakeme zokusebenza. Ulwazi oluhle ngezomthetho wezindaba zomsebenzi. Ulwazi oluhle nge-International Labour Organization (ILO). Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET/ CET. Ulwazi nokuqonda umkhakha we-Higher Education. Ulwazi nge-PERSAL. Kumele abe nokukhuluma nokubhala kahle, ukuxhumana nabantu, ukuphatha abantu, ukulungiselela nokuhlela, ukwethula, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukugxila kumthengi, ukwenza uphenyo namakhono okwethula. Okuhle kakhulu ekuchazweni, ekwakheni nasekuqotheni imithetho.
zu.duties: Ukugcina izindaba zomsebenzi ezinhle: Nikela izeluleko ngemikhakha ehlobene nomsebenzi. Akha futhi uqothe imithetho yokuphatha abantu namapheshana. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinqubo zomgomo, izinqubo zezikhalazo kanye namakhodi yokuziphatha. Yenza uphenyo nezinkundla zomgomo. Ukuphatha isinyathelo sokushibha. Nciphisa izingxabhano zomsebenzi. Hola futhi wenze iziqu zezindaba zomsebenzi namawokishopo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinqumo zebhodi yokuxoxisana ngokubambisana.

xh.title: Isekela le Ndlela: Izenzo zokuSebenza
xh.summary: Isekela le Ndlela: Izenzo zokuSebenza kwindawo yokusebenza ye Department of Higher Education and Training, kunyulela ngenkqubo yamagosa abasebenzi nokuLawula iinkqubo zokuhanahaniswa kwabasebenzi kwinqanaba lesixa 9.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric / Grade 12 kunye ne Diploma yesiQondo ekumgangatho wamazu-3 ngokusesigqakeni okanye iDegree kwiZenzó zokuSebenza, Izenzo zokuQashwa / uLawulo lweMisebenzi yabaQashi okanye isifundo esihambelana nesi. Kufuneka ube nomVuzo wokuSebenza weMinye yamathathu ukuya kwamahlanu kwimisebenzi ePhathelene nokuQashwa okanye uLawulo lweMisebenzi yabaQashi apho kufuneka iMnye yamabini ukuya kwamathathu ibe ngaphezulu kwesiQhalo sokuLawula. Kufuneka ukuQondelela ekusebenziseni iKhompyutha. Kufuneka uQondelele ukuba nokuSebenza nokuQondisa ngokuQonda iMithetho yeZenzó zokuSebenza, iMithetho yeNkonzo zaZizwe kunye neMigaqo ephathelene noLawulo lweMisebenzi yabaQashi. UkuQonda okuQondileyo ngeMithetho yeZenzó zokuSebenza. UkuQonda okuQondileyo ngeZiko lokuQondisa izEnzo zokuSebenza kwihlabathi (ILO). Ulwazi nokuQonda nokuLawula i-TVET/CET. Ulwazi nokuQonda ngeNdwendwe leMfundo ePhezulu. Ulwazi ngePERSAL. Kufuneka uQondelele ukuba neZinto ezininzi ezibhalwayo, ezethwa ngamagama, ezilandelanayo, ezokuQondisa abantu, ezenza iNdlela, ekuQondisa iNgqungquthela, ekuBala iNgxelo, ekuPela iNgxaki, ekuHlalutya, ekuQondisela iNtshukumo, ekuQhuba iNgcango ezingazwanga ngokulinganiswa nokuziphatha ngokuQondiswa kwesigqi.
xh.duties: Londoloza izEnzo zokuSebenza ezilungileyo: Nikela ngolwazi ngezikhathi ezinxulumene nomsebenzi. Bumba luhlaziise iMigaqo nokuQondisa iNgxelo yabaQashi. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuQondileyo kweenkqubo zokuQondiswa kweZigqibo, iNgxelo ezisindayo nokuQatshelwa kokuQondisa iNkqubo. Qhuba iNgcango nokuQondiswa kweNdlela ezininzi. UkuLawula iZingxaki ezinxulumene neZigqibo. Lwazi izEnzo zokuSebenza ezingathunyelwanga. Qondise kwaye uQondise ekuQondiseni nakuQondiseni iNgqungquthela. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuQondileyo kweziGqibo zeNkqubo ethengisanwayo.

jobs.title: Senior Officer: Student Registration
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.closing_date_text: 30 November 2026 (at 12h00 sharp), all applications received after the closing date and time will not be entertained. Apply as early as possible to avoid disappointments.
jobs.summary: Coordinate student application and registration activities at Northlink TVET College, monitoring processes for efficiency and compliance with approved procedures.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma/ Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Public Administration, Business Administration, Office Management, Administration or a relevant qualification. Minimum of 3-5 years relevant experience in student administration, admissions, registration or a related higher education environment. Supervisory experience. Computer Literacy. Valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET College sector and post-school education environment. Knowledge of DHET policies, guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures relating to student enrolment. Knowledge of student admission, registration and records management processes. Understanding of student information management systems. Understanding of public sector policies, including DHET/ TVET regulatory and compliance requirements. Planning and organisational skills. Problem-solving and decision-making skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical, investigative skills. Ability to interpret legislation, policies and procedures and apply them. Professionalism, accountability and ethical conduct. Sound judgement and objectivity. Ability to maintain confidence and exercise discretion.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the implementation of student application and registration activities. Monitor application and registration processes to ensure efficiency and compliance with approved procedures. Provide support during annual, semester and trimester registration cycles. Monitor registration progress and assist in achieving institutional enrolment targets. Ensure compliance with approved admission requirements and selection processes. Coordinate the capturing, verification, maintenance and updating of student information on the Student Management System. Conduct quality assurance checks on registration information and student files. Allocate and monitor daily activities of registration administrative staff. Provide guidance and support to staff regarding registration processes and system requirements. Identify training needs and assist with capacity-building initiatives. Monitor service delivery standards and ensure continuous improvement. Coordinate responses to student registration-related enquiries. Provide accurate information regarding applications, admissions, registration processes and institutional requirements. Liaise with campuses, academic departments, student support services and external stakeholders to resolve registration matters. Implement approved policies, procedures and process improvements within the registration environment. Assist with internal and external audits by providing required student registration information and evidence. Identify operational risks and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and service delivery. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. L Mmesi / Mr. T Zangqa Tel No: (021) 970 9082/ 9069
jobs.applications: Northlink TVET College invites applicants to apply online via email: Careers7@northlink.co.za or alternatively, applications can be hand-delivered to the Central Office, 80 Voortrekker Road, Bellville, 7530.
jobs.notes: Northlink Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) College is inviting applications from suitably qualified candidates to fill the following vacancies.       Applications     can      be    submitted     via    email     to: Careers7@northlink.co.za by quoting the post applying for and the relevant reference number provided on the subject line. All documents submitted must be in a PDF Format. Applicants are advised to submit one PDF Document per application. A complete set of application documents should be submitted separately for every post you wish to apply for. Applications must be submitted on the new Z83 form which has since been in effect from 1 January 2021, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) must be in line with the requirements of the advert. Please indicate the reference number and the post description of the position you are applying for on your application form, the Z83 Form must be dated, signed and the candidate must initialise both pages of the Form. Applications submitted using the old Z83 Form will not be accepted. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident, Permit Holders will be required to submit their permit on the day of the interview. It is the applicant`s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). A separate application must be submitted for each post that you are applying for. Late Applications received after closing date and time, incomplete, and faxed applications will not be considered. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the College. It is the intention of the College to promote representativity (race, gender, and disability) in the College through the filling of these post(s). Applicants from the designated groups especially in respect of people with disabilities will receive preference. The College as the employer reserves the right not to make any appointment. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills test. Correspondence will only be limited to short-listed candidates. All short-listed candidates will be subjected to a qualification, citizen verification, criminal record and financial/asset record checks. Applicants who have not been invited for an interview within 60 days of the closing date should consider their applications unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Senior Beampte: Studenteregistrasie
af.summary: Koördineer studentaansoek- en registrasie-aktiwiteite by Northlink TVET College, en monitor prosesse vir doeltreffendheid en nakoming van goedgekeurde prosedures.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma/ Graad (NQF Level 6/7) in Publieke Administrasie, Besigheidsadministrasie, Kantoorbestuur, Administrasie of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring in studentadministrasie, toelatings, registrasie of 'n verwante hoëronderwysomgewing. Toesighoudende ervaring. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige Bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en begrip van die TVET College-sektor en die na-skoolse onderwysomgewing. Kennis van DHET-beleide, riglyne en Standaardbedryfsprosedures rakende studentinskrywing. Kennis van studenttoelatings-, registrasie- en rekordbestuursprosesse. Begrip van studentinligtingbestuurstelsels. Begrip van openbare sektor-beleide, insluitend DHET/ TVET-regulerende en nakomingsvereistes. Beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Sterke analitiese en ondersoekvaardighede. Vermoë om wetgewing, beleide en prosedures te interpreteer en toe te pas. Professionaliteit, verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Soliede oordeel en objektiwiteit. Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf en diskresie toe te pas.
af.duties: Koördineer die implementering van studentaansoek- en registrasie-aktiwiteite. Monitor aansoek- en registrasieprosesse om doeltreffendheid en nakoming van goedgekeurde prosedures te verseker. Verskaf ondersteuning tydens jaarlikse, semester- en trimester-registrasiesiklusse. Monitor registrasievoortgang en help om institusionele inskrywingsteikens te bereik. Verseker nakoming van goedgekeurde toelatingsvereistes en seleksieprosesse. Koördineer die vaslegging, verifikasie, instandhouding en opdatering van studentinligting op die Studentbestuurstelsel. Voer gehaltversekeringskontroles uit op registrasie-inligting en studentlêers. Wi daaglikse aktiwiteite van registrasie-administratiewe personeel toe en monitor dit. Verskaf leiding en ondersteuning aan personeel rakende registrasieprosesse en stelselvereistes. Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes en help met kapasiteitsbou-ineeniatiewe. Monitor diensleweringstandaarde en verseker deurlopende verbetering. Koördineer reaksies op navrae rakende studenteregistrasie. Verskaf akkurate inligting rakende aansoeke, toelatings, registrasieprosesse en institusionele vereistes. Skakel met kampusse, akademiese departemente, studentondersteuningsdienste en eksterne belanghebbendes om registrasie-aangeleenthede op te los. Implementeer goedgekeurde beleide, prosedures en prosesverbeterings binne die registrasieomgewing. Help met interne en eksterne oudits deur die vereiste studentregistrasie-inligting en bewysmateriaal te verskaf. Identifiseer operasionele risiko's en beveel verbeterings aan om doeltreffendheid en dienslewering te verbeter. N.B. Alle gekose kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: I-Senior Officer: Ukubhaliswa Kwabafundi
zu.summary: Ukuhlela imisebenzi yokuqashelwa nokubhaliswa kwabafundi e-Northlink TVET College, ukugcina amaphrocessi asebenza kahle futhi alandela izinqubo ezamukelekwe.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma/ Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Public Administration, Business Administration, Office Management, Administration noma izifundo ezifanele. Okungenani unyaka we-3-5 wokuhlolwa okufanele ekuphatweni kwabafundi, ukwamukelwa, ukubhaliswa noma endaweni ethile yokufunda ephakeme. Okuhlolwa kokuphatha abantu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi nokugonda ngomkhakha we-TVET College kanye nendawo yokufunda ngemva kwezikole. Ulwazi ngemigomo, izinkomba kanye ne-Standard Operating Procedures ze-DHET ezihlotshaniswe nokubhaliswa kwabafundi. Ulwazi ngokuqashelwa kwabafundi, ukubhaliswa kanye namaphrocessi okuphatha irekhodi. Ukuqonda amasistimu okuphatha ulwazi lwabafundi. Ukuqonda imigomo yomkhakha kahulumeni, okuhlanganisa izidingo zolawulo kanye nokuhambisana ne-DHET/ TVET. Amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Amakhono okuxazula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono ahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono amakhulu okuhlaziya nokuphenya. Ikhono lokutolikaga imithetho, imigomo kanye nezinqubo futhi uzisebenzise. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti, ukubekezela kanye nokuziphatha ngokuyiqiniso. Isibawo esihle nokungalungi. Ikhono lokugcina imfihlo kanye nokuziphathe ngokucophelela.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi yokuqashelwa nokubhaliswa kwabafundi. Ukugcina amaphrocessi okuqashelwa nokubhaliswa kuqinisekise ukusebenza kahle nokuhambisana nezinqubo ezamukelekwe. Ukunika inkxaso phakathi kwezikhumulo zokubhalisa zonyaka, zesemester nakwethrimu. Ukugcina inqubekelaphambili yokubhaliswa kanye nokusiza ekufezeni amanani okubhaliswa esikhungweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zokuqashelwa nezinqubo zokukhetha ezamukelekwe. Ukuhlela ukungena, ukuqinisekisa, ukugcina nokubuyekezwa kolwazi lwabafundi kwi-Student Management System. Ukuhlola izinga lekhwalithi kolwazi lokubhaliswa namafayili wabafundi. Ukwenza ukubaluleka kanye nokugcina imisebenzi yansuku zonke yabasebenzi bokubhaliswa. Ukunika isiqondiso kanye nenkxaso abasebenzeni ngamaphrocessi okubhaliswa nezidingo zesistimu. Ukuqaphela izidingo zokuqeqesha futhi usize nokuqeqeshwa kwamakhono. Ukugcina amazinga okuletha isevisi bese kuqinisekisa ukuthuthuka okuhamba phambili. Ukuhlela izimpendulo kumibuzo ehlobene nokubhaliswa kwabafundi. Ukunika ulwazi olunembile ngokuqashelwa, ukwamukelwa, amaphrocessi okubhaliswa kanye nezidingo zesikhungweni. Ukuxhumana namakholishi, izigaba zemfundo, izinkonzo zokusekela abafundi kanye nalabo abaphandle ukuxazula izindaba zokubhaliswa. Ukusetshenziswa kwemigomo, izinqubo kanye nokuthuthuka kwamaphrocessi avunyiwe endaweni yokubhaliswa. Ukusiza nokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokunika ulwazi lokubhaliswa kwabafundi nobufakazi obudingwayo. Ukuqaphela izingozi ezingenzeka kulezo nzuzo futhi upendulele izindlela zokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle nokuletha inkonzo. N.B. Bonke abaqashelwe baya kudingeka ukuba bakwenze umsebenzi wamakhono ofanele.

xh.title: Umntu oPhakamileyo: Ukubhalisa koMfundi
xh.summary: Ukulungelelanisa imisebenzi yoku application nakubhaliswa komfundi kwiNorthlink TVET College, ukuqwalasela iinkqubo zona ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuzalathisa ngokwemigaqo egunyaziweyo.
xh.requirements: National Diploma/ Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwelika Public Administration, Business Administration, Office Management, Administration okanye isifikifiso ezifaneleyo. Amava amabalazi amathathu ukuya kwamathathu anesihlanu emsebenzini othe gcba ekulawuleni imicwango yomfundi, kwamagama okwamkelwa, nakubhalisweni okanye kwelase mmandla wezemfundo ephakamileyo. Amava okuqhuba abantu. Ukuba lilungu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngabasekeli be-TVET College College nangommandla wemfundo ngemva kwesikolo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo, iindlela zokuqhuba iinkqubo kunye ne Standard Operating Procedures ze-DHET ezithinta ukubhaliswa komfundi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokwamkelwa kwabafundi, ukubhalisa kunye nokulawula iirekhodi. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokulawula ulwazi ngomfundi. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zoburhulumente, kuquka iimfuno zokuzalathisa nokulandela imigaqo ye-DHET/ TVET. Amakhono okuceba nokuhlela. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Amakhono amabalazi okuthetha nokuwalisa. Amakhono amaninzi okuhlola nokuphandahlola. Amandla okutolika umthetho, iimigaqo nendlela zokuqhuba iinkqubo uzisebenzise. Ubungcali, ukuzimisela nokuziphatha ngokusesikweni. Isigqibo esiluhlaziyo nokungalibali. Amandla okugcina imfihleko nokusebenza ngokucinga.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa ukusebenza kolwazi lokufaka isicelo nokubhaliswa komfundi. Ukuphanda iinkqubo zokufaka isicelo nokubhalisa kuqiniseke ukuba zisebenza kakuhle zize zilandelwe imigaqo egunyaziweyo. Ukunikela inkxaso phakathi kokubhalisa ngonyaka, ngesemester nakutrimester. Ukuqwalasela inqqubela yokubhalisa uncedise ekufikiseni amanqaku okubhalisa esikhungweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olugunyaziweyo lokwamkelwa nakwemigaqo yokuveselelwa ukwamkelwa. Ukulungelelanisa ukufaka, ukuqinisekisa, ukugcina nokuhlaziya ulwazi ngomfundi kwinkqubo yokulawula abafundi. Ukwenza ukuhlola ukhwalithi kulwazi lokubhalisa nakulawulo lwemifanekiso yomfundi. Ukwaba unqumama imisebenzi yemihla leyo abasebenzi kulawulo lokubhalisa waye ayiphande. Ukunika inkxaso nabasebenzi ngendlela yokubhalisa nangemfuneko yenkqubo. Ukuqaphela iimfuno zolwaliso unkxase ekwakheni isakhono. Ukuqwalasela amazinga okunikela inkonzo uqiniseke ukuba phezulu ngokoqhuba. Ukulungelelanisa impendulo kwimibuzo yokubhaliswa komfundi. Ukunika ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngezenzo, ukwamkelwa, iinkqubo zokubhalisa nemfuneko zesikhungo. Ukuxhumanisa namaziko, neencwadi zemfundo, iinkonzo zokuxhasa abafundi kunye namachaphaza angaphandle ukuze kusombululwe iingxaki zokubhalisa. Ukusebenzisa imigaqo, iinkqubo nokuqhuba ngcono iinkqubo ngaphakathi kokubhaliswa. Ukunceda kwi audits ezingaphakathi nangaphandle ngokunikela ulwazi nobungqina bokubhaliswa komfundi. Ukuqaphela iingozi zokuqhuba inkqubo uze uphehleze iindlela ezongeza isiseko sokusebenza kakuhle nakunikonzo. N.B. Onke abo bakhetiweyo kuya kufuneka bagqibele isenzo soqeqesho lwamakhono olufaneleyo.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Accounts Receivables
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.closing_date_text: 30 November 2026 (at 12h00 sharp), all applications received after the closing date and time will not be entertained. Apply as early as possible to avoid disappointment.
jobs.summary: Senior State Accountant managing accounts receivable at Northlink TVET College central office, requiring a diploma or degree in accounting and three years' financial experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma/ Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Accounting/Financial Management or Management Accounting or a relevant qualification. Minimum of (three) 3 years’ experience in a financial environment or related field. Experience in using Management Information System (MIS) will be highly advantageous. Knowledge and understanding of the Public Service financial legislations, processes, procedures, Treasury Regulations, Public Financial Management Act (PFMA), Income Tax laws, SARS Regulations, Financial Manual, PSA, PSR etc. Numerical aptitude with a focus on accuracy and detail in analysis and calculations. Knowledge of financial accounting procedures, methods and principles established for the processing of financial transactions. Experience in the TVET College sector will be an added advantage. Computer Literacy. Valid Driver’s Licence. Ability to supervise staff, resolve financial discrepancies, meet deadlines, maintain confidentiality and work effectively under pressure. Good understanding of debtors’ management, invoicing, receipts, allocations, reconciliations and outstanding accounts. Knowledge of financial management principles, accounting procedures, internal controls and applicable government financial requirements. Ability to monitor outstanding debts, follow up on overdue accounts, manage collections and maintain accurate debtor records. Ability to prepare, review and analyse accounts receivable reports, reconciliation and financial information. Good written and verbal communication skills.
jobs.duties: Supervise staff. Manage and monitor all accounts receivable transactions and ensure that outstanding amounts are collected on time. Maintain accurate student and other debtor accounts and ensure that balances are correctly recorded and updated. Perform monthly reconciliations of accounts receivable and prepare accurate financial reports for management. Follow up on outstanding debts, issue statements and reminders and implement approved debt recovery procedures. Ensure that all receipts and payments are correctly recorded, allocated and processed in accordance with Student debtor’s policy and procedures. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, Treasury Regulations, college policies and procedures and maintain effective internal controls over receivables. Approve all Student Refunds for payment. Provide input in the preparation and compilation of Annual Financial Statements. Ensure effective management and utilisation of allocated resources. Implement internal controls and contribute to the development of processes, procedures and policies within the management accounting portfolio. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Senior staatsrekenmeester: Debiteure
af.summary: Senior staatsrekenmeester wat debiteure by Northlink TVET College se sentrale kantoor bestuur, met 'n diploma of graad in rekenkunde en drie jaar se finansiële ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Nasionale diploma/graad (NQF-vlak 6/7) in rekenkunde/finansiële bestuur of bestuursrekenkunde of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Minimum van (drie) 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n finansiële omgewing of verwante veld. Ervaring in die gebruik van 'n bestuursinligtingstelsel (MIS) sal baie voordelig wees. Kennis en begrip van die openbare diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosesse, prosedures, Tesourie-regulasies, Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur (PFMA), inkomstebelastingwette, SARS-regulasies, Finansiële Handleiding, PSA, PSR ens. Numeriese aanleg met 'n fokus op akkuraatheid en besonderhede in ontleding en berekenings. Kennis van finansiële rekenkundige prosedures, metodes en beginsels wat vir die verwerking van finansiële transaksies vasgestel is. Ervaring in die TVET-kollegesektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vermoë om persone te onderhou, finansiële diskrepansies op te los, sperdatums na te kom, vertroulikheid te handhaaf en doeltreffend onder druk te werk. Goeie begrip van debiteurbestuur, fakturering, kwitansies, toekenning, afstemming en uitstaande rekeninge. Kennis van finansiële bestuursbeginsels, rekenkundige prosedures, interne beheer en toepaslike staatsfinansiële vereistes. Vermoë om uitstaande skuld te monitor, agterstallige rekeninge op te volg, invorderings te bestuur en akkurate debiteurrekords te handhaaf. Vermoë om debiteureverslae, afstemming en finansiële inligting voor te berei, te hersien en te ontleed. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Onderhou persone. Bestuur en monitor alle debiteuretransaksies en verseker dat uitstaande bedrae betyds ingevorder word. Handhaaf akkurate student- en ander debiteurrekeninge en verseker dat saldo's korrek aangeteken en opgedateer word. Verrig maandelikse afstemming van debiteure en berei akkurate finansiële verslae vir bestuur voor. Volg uitstaande skuld op, reik state en herinnerings uit en implementeer goedgekeurde skuldinvorderingsprosedures. Verseker dat alle kwitansies en betalings korrek aangeteken, toegeken en verwerk word ooreenkomstig die studentdebiteurbeleid en -prosedures. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, Tesourie-regulasies, kollegebeleid en -prosedures en handhaaf doeltreffende interne beheer oor debiteure. Keur alle studentterugbetalings vir betaling goed. Verskaf insette by die voorbereiding en samestelling van jaarinlikste finansiële state. Verseker doeltreffende bestuur en benutting van toegewysde hulpbronne. Implementeer interne beheer en dra by tot die ontwikkeling van prosesse, prosedures en beleide binne die bestuursrekenkunde-portefeulje. N.B. Alle kortlys-kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidsoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Omfundi Ophakeme Wezwe: Ama-Akhawunti Othelekiso
zu.summary: Umfundi Ophakeme Wezwe ohlola ama-akhawunti othelekiso ehhovisi elikhulu le-Northlink TVET College, ofuna idiploma noma idigri ebhalweni nabakwazi iminyaka emithathu yokusebenza kwezimali.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma/ Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ebhalweni/okuphathweni kwezimali noma ebhalweni okuphathweni noma iziqu ezifanelekile. Ukutholakala kokuhlola okungenani kweminyaka eyi-(three) 3endaweni yezimali noma enkundleni ehlobene. Ukutholakala kokusebenzisa i-Management Information System (MIS) kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yezimali, izinqubo, izindlela, izimiso ze-Treasury, uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali KaZwelonke (PFMA), izilinganiso zomthetho wokuqwaziswa kwemali, izimiso ze-SARS, incwadi yezimali, i-PSA, i-PSR njll. Ubunikelo bezibalo ngokugxila ekunembeni nakunembeza ekuhloleni nokuqhathanisa. Ulwazi ngemizimo yokubala izimali, izindlela nezimiso ezilungiselwe ukuqhuba izinkokhelo zezimali. Ukutholakala emkhakheni we-TVET College kuzoba yinewe elengeziwe. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi Yokushayela evumelekile. Isikhono sokuhlola abasebenzi, ukulungisa iziphakeme zemali, ukuzuza izikhathi zokuvala, ukugcina imfihlo kanye nokusebenza kahle ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ukuqonda kahle ukuphathwa kwabatshali, ukukhiqiza izibeko, ukwamukela imali, ukwabiya imali, ukuqathanisa noma amakhawunti angapheli. Ulwazi ngemigomo yezimali, izindlela zokubala izimali, ukulawula ngaphakathi nezidingo kahulumeni ezihlobene nezimali. Isikhono sokuhola izikweletu ezingapheli, ukulandela amakhawunti angamukiwe, ukuphatha imali etholwe kanye nokugcina okuqotho izibuko zabatshali. Isikhono sokulungisa, ukuphinda uhlole futhi uhlolisise amabhaphu ama-akhawunti othelekiso, ukuqathanisa nolwazi lwezimali. Amakhono amahle okubhaliwe nokukhuluma.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola abasebenzi. Ukuphatha futhi uhlole onke amaphuzu ama-akhawunti othelekiso futhi waqinisekise ukuthi imali egingile iyotholwa ngesikhathi. Ukugcina okuqotho amakhawunti abafundi nabanye abatshali bese uqinisekisa ukuthi amabalansi abhalwe ngendlela efanele bese benuywa. Ukwenza ukuqathanisa kwanyanga zonke kwama-akhawunti othelekiso bese ulungisa amabhaphu wezimali abe ngokunembile ukuphatha. Ukulandela izikweletu ezingapheli, ukukhipha izibeko nezaziso nokusebenzisa izinqubo ezivunyelwe zokususa izikweletu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali etholwe nakhokhelwa ibhalwe, yahlukaniswa futhi yahamba ngokuvumelana nenqubo nomthethosisekelo webhulu labafundi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuziphatha ngemithetho yokufanelekayo, izimiso ze-Treasury, izimiso nenqubo yekholiji bese ulondoloza ukulawula okunamandla ngaphakathi kwama-akhawunti othelekiso. Ukuvumela konke ukubuyiswa kwemali yabafundi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi ekulungiseni nokuqoqweni kwaka wonke wonke Amabhaphu Wezimali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwemithombo ebanjiwe. Ukusebenzisa ukulawula ngaphakathi kanye nokufaka isandla ekwakheni izinqubo, izindlela nezimiso ngaphakathi kophothu ebhalweni okuphathweni. N.B. Bonke abagijimi ababhaliwe kuzofuneka bagcizelele ukwenza isivivinyo somkhakha esihlobene.

xh.title: Umphathi Ohleli weSizwe: Ii-Akhawunti Eziholwayo
xh.summary: Umphathi Ohleli weSizwe ophatha ii-akhawunti eziholwayo kwiofisi eliyiyo yase Northlink TVET College, ofuna idiploma okanye isidanga kumanani kwaye anamava eminyaka emithathu kwezemali.
xh.requirements: i-National Diploma/ i-Degree (i-NQF Level 6/7) kwi-Accounting/i-Financial Management okanye i-Management Accounting okanye isimanga esifanelekileyo. Ubuncinci beminyaka elishumi (three) 3 yamava kwimeko yemali okanye kwindawo enoxanduva lokufana. Amava ekusebenziseni i-Management Information System (MIS) aya kuba lusizi olukhulu. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yemali yoLwazi kaLuntu, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zorhwebo, iTreasury Regulations, i-Public Financial Management Act (PFMA), imithetho ye-Income Tax, i-SARS Regulations, i-Financial Manual, i-PSA, i-PSR njl. Ukuziphotha kwamanani kunokugxila ekuchanekeni nangolutsha oluqonde kwindlela yokuqhutywa kumanani. Ulwazi ngeendlela, iindlela nemiqatho yokubala kwemali esekiweyo ekugqithiseni iinkqubo zemali. Amava kwicandelo le-TVET College aya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakwikhompyutha. ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukukwazi ukulawula abasebenzi, ukusombulula ukungahambelani kwemali, ukufikelela kwizicelo zexesha, ukugcina uyimfihlo nokusebenza kakuhle phantsi komthwalo. Ukuqonda kakuhle ukulawulwa kwabanamatyrityari, ukwenza iinvoyisi, ukwamkela imali, ukwaba iimali, ukulungelelanisa ngee-akhawunti ezingahlawulwayo. Ulwazi ngeengcali zolawulo lwemali, iinkqubo zokubala, izilawulo zangaphakathi neemfuno zemali karhulumente ezifanelekileyo. Ukukwazi ukujonga imali engahlawulwayo, ukulandela i-akhawunti evesele, ukulawula ukutyhutyha kwaye ugcinwe iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zabatyityari. Ukukwazi ukulungiselela, ukuphonononga nokuqondanisa iingxelo ze-akhawunti eziholwayo, ukulungelelanisa nolwazi ngemali. Amakhono amabaliseyo asebenzayo nabathethayo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula abasebenzi. Ukuphatha nokujonga zonke iinkqubo ze-akhawunti eziholwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba imali engahlawulwayo ivunyelwa ngexesha. Ukugcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zabantu abafunda nabanye abatyityari ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba amaxabiso arekhodwe kwaye agqitywe ngokuchanekileyo. Ukwenza ukulungelelanisa kwamanye ama-akhawunti eziholwayo yonyaka kwaye ulungiselele iingxelo ezichanekileyo zemali kulawulo. Ukulandela imali engahlawulwayo, ukupapasha iingxelo nokuqhubisa iindlela zokubuyiselwa imali ezivunyiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imali efakwa nokuqhashiswa kuqhutywe kwaye yawabwa ngokuchanekileyo ngokuvumelana nenkqubo namagqabantshintshi kubatyityari bafundi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzalathiswa kwemithetho esebenzayo, iTreasury Regulations, iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi kukholeji nokugcina izilawulo ezisebenzayo ngaphakathi kumatyityari. Ukuvuma ukuba yonke imali ebuyiselwa kubafundi ihlawulwe. Ukunikela ngemveliso ekulungiseleleni nokuqokelela iingxelo zemali zonyaka. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawulo okusebenzayo nokusebenzisa imithombo ebanjwayo. Ukusebenzisa izilawulo zangaphakathi kunye nokuzonela ekuphuhlisweni kweekqubo, iinkqubo neenkqubo ngaphakathi kwesikhundla sokulawula i-akhawunti. N.B. Bonke abagqithiswe kudweliso lokuqhaqhofo kuya kufuneka bagqibe le nkqubo ikhoyo yokuziphumeza.

jobs.title: Campus Administrator
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Northern Cape Rural TVET College, De Aar Campus
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Campus administrator at Northern Cape Rural TVET College, De Aar Campus, providing administrative, HR, procurement and student registration support.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate recognized Bachelor's degree/National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or equivalent qualification in Public Administration, Office Administration, Management Assistant or related field. Minimum 2/two years related experience. Digital literate and competent in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. A valid driver's license and willingness to travel. Competencies: Sound knowledge of general office administration procedures, secretarial support functions, and campus operational systems. Understanding of Public Service legislations, policies, regulations, and frameworks, including the Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Employment Equity Act, and Labour Relations Act. Broad familiarity with the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector, Higher Education sector, and TVET college administration environments. Basic understanding of corporate governance, cost centre budgetary principles, expenditure tracking, and cash flow management. Working knowledge of archiving standards, record-keeping requirements, and QMS (Quality Management Systems) compliance. Strong planning, organising, and time- management skills to coordinate campus enrolment plans, meetings, workshops, and administrative schedules. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for client-oriented service delivery, staff support, and resolving administrative queries. Proficiency in report writing, compiling management presentations, and drafting departmental correspondence and procurement memos. Problem-solving and analytical skills to verify documentation, reconcile data exceptions, and monitor all staff attendance registers. Financial and administrative skills to handle purchase requisitions, invoice coordination, and basic cost-centre expenditure tracking. 2 Years of practical experience working within a busy administrative, corporate, or public sector office environment. Practical experience in coordinating human resource administrative functions, such as leave management, Performance Management and Development System (PMDS) documents, and disciplinary or grievance record-keeping. Hands-on experience in handling procurement processes, drafting requisitions, receiving goods, and maintaining structured filing and archiving systems in line with compliance regulations. Experience in supporting student administration processes, including student registration, data capturing, document scanning, and examination coordination. Advanced qualifications (such as an Advanced Diploma or Bachelor's Degree) in Public Management, Administration, or Office Management and Technology will be an added advantage. Prior working experience within a public TVET college environment will be an added advantage. Formal training or experience in financial record-keeping, asset management, or supply chain management within the public sector will be an added advantage. Experience with electronic student management information systems (IFSS / Coltech or similar TVET MIS platforms) will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Render administrative support services. Administer and coordinate Human Resource Services. Provide procurement services. Maintain a proper filing system. Administer student registration and examination process.

It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful.
