af.title: Kampusadministrateur
af.summary: Kampusadministrateur by Northern Cape Rural TVET College, De Aar Campus, wat administratiewe, HR-, verkrygings- en studentregistrasiesteun bied.
af.requirements: Toepaslike erkende Bachelorsgraad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie in Publieke Administrasie, Kantooradministrasie, Bestuursassistent of verwante veld. Minimum 2/two jaar verwante ervaring. Digitaal geletterd en bevoeg in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Uitstekende kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, met die vermoë om doeltreffend met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes saam te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede: Deeglike kennis van algemene kantooradministrasieprosedures, sekretariële steunfunksies, en kampusbedryfstelsels. Begrip van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, beleide, regulasies, en raamwerke, insluitend die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Employment Equity Act, en Labour Relations Act. Breë bekendheid met die Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sektor, Hoër Onderwys sektor, en TVET kollege administrasie-omgewings. Basiese begrip van korporatiewe bestuur, kostesentrum-begrotingsbeginsels, bestedingopvolging, en kontantvloei-bestuur. Werkende kennis van argiveringsstandaarde, rekordhoudingvereistes, en QMS (Quality Management Systems) nakoming. Sterk beplannings-, organisasie- en tydbestuursvaardighede om kampusinskrywingsplanne, vergaderings, werkswinkels, en administratiewe skedules te koördineer. Uitstekende kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede vir kliëntgerigte dienslewering, personeelsteun, en die oplossing van administratiewe navrae. Bedrewe in verslagskrywing, die opstel van bestuursa aanbiedings, en die opstel van departementele korrespondensie en verkrygingsnotasies. Probleemoplossings- en analitiese vaardighede om dokumentasie te verifieer, data-uitsonderings te rekonsilieer, en alle personeelbywoningsregisters te monitor. Finansiële en administratiewe vaardighede om aankoopversoekings, faktuurnkoördinasie, en basiese kostesentrum-bestedingopvolging te hanteer. 2 Years praktiese ervaring in werking binne 'n besige administratiewe, korporatiewe, of openbare sektor kantooromgewing. Praktiese ervaring in die koördinering van menslike hulpbron administratiewe funksies, soos verlofbestuur, Performance Management and Development System (PMDS) dokumente, en disiplinêre of griewe-rekordhouding. Praktiese ervaring in die hanteer van verkrygingsprosesse, die opstel van versoekings, die ontvangs van goedere, en die onderhoud van gestruktureerde lêer- en argiveringstelsels in ooreenstemming met nakomingsregulasies. Ervaring in die ondersteuning van studentadministrasieprosesse, insluitend studentregistrasie, datavaslegging, dokumentskandering, en eksamenkoördinasie. Gevorderde kwalifikasies (soos 'n Advanced Diploma of Bachelorsgraad) in Publieke Bestuur, Administrasie, of Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees. Vroeëre werkservaring binne 'n openbare TVET kollege-omgewing sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees. Formele opleiding of ervaring in finansiële rekordhouding, batebestuur, of verskaffingskettingbestuur binne die openbare sektor sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees. Ervaring met elektroniese studentbestuursinligtingstelsels (IFSS / Coltech of soortgelyke TVET MIS platforms) sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe steundienste. Administreer en koördineer Menslike Hulpbron Dienste. Verskaf verkrygingsdienste. Onderhou 'n behoorlike lêerstelsel. Administreer studentregistrasie en eksamenproses.

zu.title: Umphathi Wesikhungo
zu.summary: Umphathi wesikhungo e-Northern Cape Rural TVET College, isikhungo sase-De Aar, ohlinzeka ngokusekelo kokuphathwa kolimi, abantu, thengiwe kanye nokubhalisa kwabafundi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's degree/National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ezifanelekile nezithunyiwe noma iziqu ezingalinganayo kuPublic Administration, Office Administration, Management Assistant noma indawo ehlobene. Okungenani 2/two iminyaka yothando. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha kanye nokusebenza kahle ngokuWord / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Amakhono aphezulu okuthintana nabantu nokuqhathanisa izwi, nokukwazi ukusebenza ndawonye kabanzi namaqhikiza angaphakathi nangaphandle. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nokulungele ukuhamba. Amakhono: Ukuqonda okuhle kwezindlela zokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zocwaningo, imisebenzi yokusekelwa kabhalane, nezinhlelo zokusebenza kwesikhungo. Ukuqonda izimiso zamaphuzu omutsha, izinqubomgomo, izilawula, nolwazi, okuhlanganisa inqubo yesiMulanga, izinkomba zomphakathi, iNqubo yolimi, kanye nomthetho wezikhungo. Ukuqonda okubanzi kohwebo lokulondeka kwabafundi emfundeni yasevela esikoleni (PSET), imfundo yamaholela, kanye nendawo yokuphathwa kwekolishi le-TVET. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kobuLawuli bomphakathi, izincomo zobungezulu benhlobo, ukulandela ukukhuluma kwezimali, kanye nokuphathwa kwemali efakiwe. Ulwazi lokusebenza mayelana nezizinda zokulondoloza amafayela, izidingo zokulondoloza amafayela, kanye no-Lawulwa lweMigomo yomphakathi (QMS). Amakhono aphezulu ohlelo, ukuhlela, kanye nesikhathi ukuphatha ukuze ufake uhlelo lokwamukela abafundi, izinkomfa, amakilasi, kanye nohlelo lomsebenzi. Amakhono aphezulu okukhuluma nabantu nokuqhathaniswa noma yisiphi isidingo sabathengi, ukusekela abantu basekhaya, nokuqondisa imibuzo engajwayelekile. Ukusebenza kahle ukubhala imibiko, ukuthola imibhalo yepharikhethi, kanye nokubhala amafayili womphakathi nokuthumela izincwadi zokuthenga. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kwakhiwe imibhalo, ukuqinisekisa okungalengwa ukweqa, nokuqaphela wonke umuntu ukuyokwenza imibhalo yalo mkhondo. Amakhono okuphathwa kwemali nezigaba zomsebenzi ukuze ukwazi ukufaka imibhalo yeminikelo, ukuthumela izinkomba ezinkulu, kanye nokulandela izimali ezingakaniselwe kohlelo lokuKhetha. 2 Imvelo yokusebenza emkhakheni wezinhlelo zomsebenzi, wezinkampani, noma kahulumeni ohambisana nezinhlelo eziningi zomphakathi. Isipiliyelo esikhona ekuphatheni izinhlelo zamandla abantu, njengokuphathwa kwegolo, imibhalo yokwenza nokuThuthukiswa kwemikhakha, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo yamaphuzu noma imibuzo yezinkundla. Isipiliyelo sokusebenza kanzima ekuthumeleni izinkomba zokuthenga, ukulandela ukutholwa kwemibalo, kanye nokulondoloza uhlelo oluhlelekile lokuGcinwa kwemibhalo noma kwezinye izinkomba ngokuhambisana nemithetho. Isipiliyelo esikhona ekusekeleni izinhlela zokubhalisa kwabafudi, okuhlanganisa ukubhalisa, ukufaka imininingwane esikhathini, ukuskena imibhalo, kanye nohlelo lokuqhuba izivivinyo. Iziqu eziphezulu (njenge-Advanced Diploma noma i-Bachelor's Degree) kwiPublic Management, Administration, noma i-Office Management and Technology zizoba yinzuvo. Ukusebenza ngaphambili kwe-TVET kolishi lomphakathi kuzoba yinzuvo. Ukutthenjwa okuyiyo noma isipiliyelo ekugcineni imibhalo yezimali, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla, noma ukuphathwa kweMigomo yolimi kumphakathi kuzoba yinzuvo. Isipiliyelo ngamakhompyutha okuphatha imibhalo yabafundi (IFSS / Coltech noma okufanayo kutuhlakahlwini be-TVET) kuzoba yinzuvo.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yezinhlelo zokusekelwa. Phatha futhi uhlelo abantu basekhaya imisebenzi. Nikeza inkonzo yokuthenga. Londoloza uhlelo oluhlelekileyo lokugcina amafayela. Phatha ukubhaliswa kwabafundi nenzinkomba zokuhlola.

I-Degree ye-Bachelor eyamkelekayo/National Diploma (Nqanaba le-NQF 6) okanye isifanekiselo esilinganayo kwi-Public Administration, Office Administration, Management Assistant okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Okubandakanya ubugcisa obungaphezulu kweminyaka emi-2/2 yamava onxulumene nalo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ii-digital nokuze uphumezelele kwi-Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Amaphepha-mpumliso okunyanisekileyo okuya phambili nokulungelelwaniswa ukuhamba. Ukuzinikela kakhulu ekwazini ukuba nolwazi olupheleleyo ngolawulo jikelele lezohlwayo loyiko-imephu yase-ofisi, iinkxaso ezenziwa ngummeli weentshongo ngamagama abakho, kwaye usete iinkqubo eziphuma kwimpumelelo ekwenzweni iinkqubo kwibala lamanqanaba, iinkqubo ezifuna amaphethulo, iimpawu ngokugqamileyo kwishishini kwiimeko zoluntu lweentlanga ezifuna ulungelelwaniseko lokulinganisa nokuqakula ulungelelwaniseko lweyure ngokugqamileyo. Ulwazi olupheleleyo nolunyanisekileyo kwimigiqamaba neemveliso zobungcali obubonisa ulwazi ngokuzinikela ngokusebenza iinkqubo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo, namagunya okuqoqa kubeka kuphuhliso olwenzeka ngokubeka ngokutsha ulwazi lwezakhiwo nendlela, ubuncinci bamagunya, iimpahla, kwaye ukwazi ukuba ngumyaleli wemisebenzi yamaphethulo.

I-Degree ye-Bachelor okanye i-Diploma eyamkelekayo kwinkqubo yokulawula iinkonzo ezifana nokulawula iinkqubo, okubandakanya isibini esingu-Word/Excel/PowerPoint, okuya kwangaphambili. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwabasebenzi ekubeni basebenzi, iinkqubo zokuziphatha, iinkqubo ezinkulu ngokukhethwa kwentshukumo eqoqwe ngokusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo.

Ulwazi lwee-digital nokusebenza kwamaphethulo, iinkqubo, neenkqubo ngokubeka iinkqubo zokwenza iziphakamiso nokuqhuba imisebenzi nokuqinisekisa ukwenzeka kolawulo lomsebenzi.

Iziqu ezibalulekileyo kwi-Corporate Administration, okanye ekubeni ngomunye wabanika-mvuzo ekubeni basebenzi besakhiwo.

Ulwazi kwinkqubo yokulawula, iziko lokulawula iinkqubo zoluntu, iinkqabo zoluntu.

Iziqu ezikumgangatho ophezulu ezifana ne-Advanced Diploma okanye i-Degree ye-Bachelor kwinkqubo yaseburhulumenthe, nasekulawulweni kwe-ofisi.

Ulwazi ngokusebenza kwelinye i-Tvet esemthethweni nasekuzincotsheni nasekuzincotsheni.

Amaxhosa esiNtu ebekela iinkonzo ezifana ne-Office Management, i-Asset, kunye nolawulo lwe-Supply Chain Management.

Ulwazi ngemithetho yaseburhulumenthe, i-Office Management, kunye ne-Technology yokusebenza kwindawo eqinisekisa i-IFSS / Coltech.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo iinkonzo. Lawula koze ulawule iinkonzo zaba basebenzi. Yiza nolonikezelo iinkonzo zokuthenga. Gcina inkqubo efanelekileyo yokugcina amaphepha. Lawula ubhaliso lwabafundi nokuqhuba iinkqubo zovavanyo.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Finansies
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig by Northern Cape Rural TVET College, Kathu-kampus, om ondersteuning te verleen vir die verwerking van finansiële transaksies, asook uitgawe- en inkomste-administrasie op salarisvlak 5.
af.requirements: 'n Erkende Nationale Senior Sertifikaat (Graad 12) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Sterk numeriese aanleg en noukeurigheid vir die hantering van data vaslegging, rekordhouding en herconciliasie take. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede, beide skriftelik en mondelings. Digitaal geletterd en bevoeg in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Betroubaarheid: Wees stip en afhanklik. Bevoegdhede: Begrip van openbare sektor finansiële administrasie. Bekendheid met basiese rekeningkundige beginsels. Kennis van finansiële beleide en prosedures. Basiese begrip van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en verwante finansiële bestuursvoorskrifte. Bekendheid met rekordbestuur en lêerprosedures, asook gerekeniseerde finansiële stelsels. Bevoegheid in finansiële administrasie en transaksionele verwerking. Sterk numeriese vaardighede en akkuraatheid in data vaslegging. Vermoë om finansiële en ontvangs herconciliasies uit te voer. Effektiewe rekordhouding en lêer vaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede vir die hanteer van finansiële navrae met 'n kliëntediens fokus. Geen vooraf formele ervaring word streng vereis vir 'n intreevlak aanstelling op Salarisvlak 5 nie, alhoewel praktiese blootstelling aan 'n finansiële of administratiewe omgeving as 'n sterk basis sal dien. Praktiese ervaring in algemene kantooradministrasie, data vaslegging, of die hantering van finansiële dokumente (soos fakture, eise en betalingversoeke) sal 'n voordeel wees. Ervaring in die bystand met inkomste opsporing, ontvangs, of roetine rekord onderhoud. zu.title: Inkantolo Yentengo: Izimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka inkantoli yentengo e-Northern Cape Rural TVET College, Kathu Campus, ukuze inikeze ukucutshungulwa kwezohwebo lwezimali, nokusekelwa kokuphathwa kwezimali ezishiswa nezimali ezingenayo ezingeni leholo 5.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezibonakalisiwe ze-National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) noma isiqu esilinganayo. Ikakhulu ukusebenziseka kahle ngamanani kanye nokunaka imininingwane ekuphathweni kokungenisa idatha, ukugcina irekhodi, nezinhlobo zokulinganisa ulwazi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, kokubili okubhaliwe nokuqhubekayo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngemisakazohwebo kanye nokukhona ukusebenza ngokufanele kwe-Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Ukuthembeka: Kubalulekile ukufika ngesikhathi nokuba othembekile. Izindlebe: Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali komphakathi. Ukuqonda izimiso ezisisekelo zemali. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nenqubo ezimalini. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye nemiyalo eholelayo yokuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuqonda ngokugcina irekhodi kanye nenqubo yokulungiselela amafayela, kanye nemisakazohwebo yezimali. Ukukwazi ukuphatha izimali kanye nokucutshungula izinkokhelo. Amandla angamanani kanye nokunakeka ukungenisa idatha. Ukukwazi ukwenza izilinganiso zezimali ezingenwayo. Ukukwazi ukugcina nokulungiselela amafayela kahle. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu ukuze kuhlolwe imibuzo yezimali ngokugcizelela ukukhonza amakhasimende. Akukho namhlanje ulwazi olusemthethweni oludingekayo ngokunemba kokuba nomsebenzi ngesikhathi sokuqala e-Salary Level 5, yize ukuzixhuma ngokomsebenzi kwemvelo ezingeni lemazimali noma eziphathweni kuzoba yisisekelo esinamandla. Ukuba nolwazi ngokomsebenzi ngokuphatha ofisi nangokwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile, noma ukuphatha amadokhumenti wezimali (njengamabhili, izikhalazo, nezicelo zezimali) kuzoba yinhloso. Ulwazi ekusizeni ngokuqonda ngezimali ezingenayo, ukungenisa imali, noma ukulondoloza okuvamile irekhodi. Isitifiketi, idiploma, noma isiqu esiphezulu se-Financial Management, Accounting, Public Management, noma i-Business Administration kuzongeza inqwaba. Ulwazi lwangaphambili ngokusebenza emnyangweni wezimali noma wezokuphatha kukolishi le-TVET komphakathi, isikhungo semfundo ephakeme, noma emvelweni yomphakathi kuzongeza inqwaba.
zu.duties: Nika ukucutshungulwa kwezimali kanye nokuqashwa kwezimali. Nika ukusekelwa kokuphathwa kwezimali ezishisayo. Nika ukusekelwa kokuphathwa kwezimali ezingenayo kanye nokungenisa izimali. Yenza izilinganiso zezimali kanye nokuqapha ukulondoloza irekhodi. Nika ukusekelwa kokuphathwa kwezimali ngokwezabelo kanye nokubika. Nika ukusekelwa okujwayelekile kwemali kanye nokuphathwa kweminye imisebenzi.

xh.title: Mongameli Wokulawulo: Zezimali
xh.summary: Kufuneka mongameli wolawulo kwi-Northern Cape Rural TVET College, Kathu Campus, ukuze anike inkxaso ekusebenziseni iintengiso ezimalini, ekulawuleni iindleko nenyuso kwinqanaba lomvuzo eli-5.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba eliPhezulu seNazwo (iGrade 12) esamkelweyo okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Ukuba namandla okubala kwaye unolwavo lokunaka iinkcukacha ekuphathweni kokuqokelela iingcombolo, ekugcineni amagama, nasekulungelelaniseni imisebenzi. Amabala apheleleyo okuthetha nabani na, kokubhalwe nasathethwayo. Ukuba liliso ekusebenziseni lekhompyutha anamandla kwiWord / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Ukuthembeka: Kufuneka uze ngexesha uze ongathungathanga. Ikhono: Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kwezimali kwicala lasemthethweni. Ukuqonda iimvisiswano ezingundoqo ezimali. Ulwazi ngeengcali zezimali neendlela zokuziphatha. Ukuqonda ngokubanzi uMthetho woLawulo lweZimali zeLuntu (iPFMA) nemiyalo yokuqondanisayo ekulawulweni kwezimali. Ukuqonda iindlela zokugcina amagama zokulungelelanisa, kunye nendlela zekhompyutha ezingalawula izimali. Ikhono ekulawulweni kwezimali nasekusebenziseni iintengiso. Amandla apheleleyo okubala nokuchana ekuthathweni kweengcombolo. Ikhono lokwenza ukulungelelanisa izimali nokuqokelela imali. Ikhono eliseziko ekugcineni amagama nokuwolula amafayile. Amabala apheleleyo okuthetha nabani na anamandla ozingqalweni ekuphenduleni imibuzo yezimali kwindlela ehambelana nesebe labathengi. Akukho ngcebiso esemthethweni efuneka kakhulu kumqesho kuQqamba Lomvuzo 5, nangona kunokubakho isiseko esomeleleyo ukuba uphila wolwazi kwindawo yezimali noma yokulawula. Kuza kuba luncedo ukuba unamava ekulawulweni kwe-ofisi jikelele, ekuthathweni kweengcombolo, okanye ekuphathweni kwamaxwebhu ezimali (njengeebyilithi, iimfuno, kunye neesicelo sokuhlawulela). Unamava ekuncedweni ekulandeleleni inyuso, ekwenzeni isitigi sokungenisa imali okanye ekugcineni amagama ngokwesiko. Isatifikethi, idiploma okanye isifundo esiphezulu esihambelanayo kokuLawulwa kweZimali, ukuBala, ukuLawulwa koLuntu, okanye ukuLawulwa kweShishini kuza kuba luncedo. Unamava ngaphambili ekusebenzeni kwesebe leze-mali okanye lokulawula kwi-TVET college kaLuntu, kwisikhululo semfundo ephakamileyo okanye kwindawo yomntu wonke kuza kuba luncedo. Unamava ekusebenzeni nendlela zekhompyutha ezilawula izimali (njengeBAS, iPastel, okanye iindawo zekhompyutha ezikumzebenzi) kuza kuba luncedo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekusebenziseni iintengiso ezimali nakulawulweni. Nika inkxaso ekulawulweni kweendleko. Nika inkxaso ekulawulweni kwinyuso nasekubeni nesitigi sokungenisa imali. Yenza ukulungelelanisa izimali kwaye ugcine amagama. Nika inkxaso ekulawulweni kwezimali kwakuniqamba nokuchaza. Nika inkxaso yezimali nakulawulo jikelele.

zu.title: Umsuli

zu.requirements: Ubumnunanye beNingizimu Afrika: Kumele ube ngunikazi weNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala: Ikakhulukazi ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Iziqongozwa zokuhlanza: Ukuphatha nokugcina iziqongozwa eziyisisekelo zokuhlanza, njengamashini okuhamba ngesiqa, izinto ezigeza umhlaba, namashini ombala wemiphetho. Inqubo yokuvikeleka: Imithetho yokuvikeleka kwezempilo ephathelene nokuhlanza, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezembatho zokuvikela nokulahla kabi inkunkuma. Amasiko obumsulwa: Izimiso nezindinganiso ezibanzi zobumsulwa. Amakhono okuhlela: Ikakhulukazi ukwazi ukuphatha imisebenzi ngokusebenza kahle futhi ukubeka phambili imisebenzi. Ukunaka kuminingwane: Ukunaka mininingwane ngokucophelela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlanzekile ngokugcwele. Ukuphatha isikhathi: Ikakhulukazi ukwazi ukugcwalisa imisebenzi ethunyelwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esihleliwe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga: Ikakhulukazi ukwazi ukubhekana nobunzima obungezinhlelwe ukuthi kuhlanzwe ngokusebenza kahle. Ukusebenza njengeqembu: Ikakhulukazi ikhono lokusebenza kahle nokwedwa nangaphakathi kweqembu. Okuhlangenwe nakho kokuhlanza: Okungenani unyaka owodwa ohlangenwe nakho enkomeni yokuhlanza, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokuqeqeshwa noma emaklasini. Iminikelo: Ukubonakaliswa ukuthembeka nokusebenza kahle. Imfundo: Kudingeka ube nomthwalo weGrade 10 (Standard 8) noma isitifiketi esifanayo. Ukuqeqeshwa okusemthethweni: Noma yikuphi ukuqeqeshwa okusemthethweni noma isitifiketi sokuhlanza ngesiko noma ukuba msulwa kuzoba yinzuzo ekungeziwe.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanza amaphilishi, izikhala ezinkulu, n.amakilasi. Ukuhlanza izinkambi ezingahleliwe. Ukuhlanza izindlu zokuphumela. Ukugcina nokulondoloza izinto nezibani zokuhlanza.

xh.requirements: Ubuzwe baseMzantsi Afrika: Kufuneka ube ngumzeni weMzantsi Afrika. Ukubala nokubhala: Ikholwa yokufunda nokubhala. Unxibelelwano: Izakhono ezilungileyo zoxhilelo nokusebenza nabantu. Ukuqina komzimba: Ukuqina komzimba nokuba nakho ukwenza imisebenzi yokucoca efunisisa amandla. Izithembile: Kufuneka uze ngesikhathi ube ngumntu onokuthembeka. Amandla: Iichemical zokucoca: Ukusetyenziswa okulungileyo nokuphatha ngesandla iichemical ezahlukeneyo zokucoca nedeterjenti. Iixelu zokucoca: Ukusebenza nokugcina iixelu eziqhelekileyo zokucoca, njengamavacuum cleaner, iimop, namacandelo ophulisha omagumba. Iinkqubo zokhuseleko: Iimithetho yezempilo nokuKhuseleko enxulumene nokucoca, kuquka nokusetyenziswa kweekhithi zokhuseleko nokupheliswa okukhuselekileyo kwemfele. Izinga lokuhlanzwa: Iinkqubo namazinga ajikeleleyo e-anzwa yokuhlanzwa. Izakhono zolungelelwaniso: Ikholwa yokulawula imisebenzi ngokuchanekileyo nokubeka ngaphambili imisebenzi. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha: Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha ngokucingileyo ukuze kuqiniseke ukucoca ngokupheleleyo. Ulawulo lwexesha: Ikholwa yokugqiba imisebenzi enikiweyo kwelixesha elichaziweyo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki: Ikholwa yokuphatha ngokuchanekileyo iingxaki zokucoca ezingalindelekanga. Ukusebenza njengesebe: Ikholwa yokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokuzimela nakunakusebenza njengesixa sabantu. Amaphepha okuqinisekisa ulungelelwaniso: Iqondo elingentla kwesiqingatha sobnyaka bamava kokucoca, ngokukhethekileyo kwendalo eFundo okanye eklasini. Iinkcukacha: Iqondo elingenisa uluhlu lokuthembeka kwaye lenze ngokuhamba kwexesha. Imfundo: Isidanga se-10 (Standard 8) okanye isiphakamiso esilinganayo sifuneka. Ukuzilolonga: Oonke abazilolonga okanye abakhuselayo abanokhakha ngaphakathi kokucoca okunesidima kakhulu okanye ihlanjisiso baza kuba luswela.
xh.duties: Ucoca ii-ofisi, iikhido, amaziko namaklasi. Ucoca iikhicini ajikeleleyo. Ucoca iindlu zokuhlambela. Ugcina kwaye ulondoloze izinto zokucoca nosenzo.

Izinga lokuhlanzeka: Iminqongo nemigomo yokuhlanza ngokuvamile. Amakhono eNdawo yokusebenzela: Ikhono lokulawula imisebenzi ngokusebenza kahle nokubeka imisebenzi ngokubaluleka. Ukuzwela imininingwane: Ukuzwela imininingwane ngokuqinisisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukucwamula okuphelele. Ukuphatha Isikhathi: Ikhono lokugqiba imisebenzi enikeziwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibaluliwe. Ukuxazulula Izinkinga: Ikhono lokubhekana nezinkinga zokucwamula ezingalindelekanga ngokusebenza kahle. Ukusebenza njengqembu: Ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngabanye nangaphakathi kwenqembu. IsipiliwozokuHlanza: Ubuncinane unyaka owodwa wesipiliwo ekugcineni indawo ihlanzekile, ikakhulukazi endaweni yezemfundo noma ekilasini. Abathunywa: Isibonakaliso sokuthembeka nokusebenza kahle. Imfundo: Kudingeka ibe khona i-Grade 10 (Standard 8) noma izifundo eziyisilinganiso. Ukulolongwa ngokusesikhundleni: Noma yikuphi ukulolongwa noma izitifikidi ekulolongweni ngokuhlanza ngobungcwathi kuzoba yindlela enenzuzo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanza ama-ofisi, izidorobha, amahholi namakilasi. Ukuhlanza izikhishi ezivamile. Ukuhlanza izindawo zokuphumula. Ukugcina nokugcina izinto nezingxenye zokuhlanza.

xh.title: Umcoci
xh.summary: Isithuba somcoci kwi-Northern Cape Rural TVET College Kuruman Campus sifuna ukubha kwesiNgesi okusesisekeli nempilo yomzimba egqithisileyo, sihlawula R144 024 ngonyaka kwinqanaba 02.
xh.requirements: Ubum Zhu e Mzantsi Afrika: Kufuneka ube ngumZwe wase Mzantsi Afrika. Ukubha: In ukubha nokubhala. Unxibelelwano: Izakhono eziluncedo zokunxibelelwano nabantu. Impilo yomzimba: Ukuba nomzimba oqinileyo nokwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yokucoca ebalulekileyo. Ukuthembeka: Kufuneka uze ngesixa kwaye uthembekile. Iikhompethensi: Iikhemikhali zokucoca: Ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo nokuphathwa kweekhemikhali ezahlukeneyo zokucoca nedethajenti. Izixhobo zokucoca: Ukusebenza nokugcina izixhobo ezisesisekelo zokucoca, njengamashini okucoca, iimopu, neeshini zokupolisa phantsi. Iinkqubo zokhuseleko: Iimigaqo ngokhuseleko nempilo engqamanyelwe nokucoca, kuquka ukusetyenziswa kweeprotective gear nokulahlwa ngokhuselekileyo kweziyiwo. Izinga lwezicoceko: Iimigaqo namagqabantshintshi ajikeleze ezicoceko. Izakhono zokuqulunqa: Ikho elukhuni lokulawula imisebenzi ngokusebenza kakuhle nokubeka phambili imisebenzi. Kuqwalaselwa iinkcukacha: Kuqwalaselwa iinkcukacha ngokucoka ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukucoca okuchanekileyo. Ulawulo lwesixa: Iliso elikhulu lokugqiba imisebenzi elawuliweyo kwixesha elifunekayo. Ukuzonakalisa iingxaki: Iliso elikhulu lokusingatha iingxaki ezingalindelekanga zokucoca ngokusebenza kakuhle. Ukusebenza njengotd: Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle lodwa nangaphakathi kothotho. Isamafa sokucoca: Isiseko sonyaka omnye wamava kwisithuba sokucoca, ngokukhethekileyo kwimeko yeZemfundo okanye eklassini. Iindonga ezibaliweyo: Iresi yokuqinisekisa ukuthembeka nokusebenza kakuhle. Imfundo: Kufuneka ube nesidanga se-10 (Standard 8) okanye isifanekelo esilinganayo. Uqeqesho olusesidlangalweni: Nawo nawuphi na uqeqesho okanye isatifikethi ekucoceni okusesidlangalweni okanye ezingcoceko kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Ukucoca amaejenti, iindonga, amaholo neeklasi. Ukucoca iikhicthi ezijikeleze. Ukucoca iindlu zokuphumla. Ukugcina nokulondoloza izixhobo nendawo yokucoca.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Northern Cape Rural TVET College, De Aar Campus
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Cleaner position at Northern Cape Rural TVET College De Aar Campus requiring basic literacy, physical fitness and ability to handle cleaning equipment.
jobs.requirements: South African Citizenship: Must be a South African citizen. Literacy: Ability to read and write. Communication: Good communication and interpersonal skills. Physical Fitness: Physically fit and able to perform demanding cleaning tasks. Reliability: Be punctual and dependable. Competencies: Cleaning Agents: The proper use and handling of various cleaning chemicals and detergents. Cleaning Equipment: The operation and maintenance of standard cleaning equipment, such as vacuum cleaners, mops, and floor polishers. Safety Procedures: Health and safety regulations related to cleaning, including the use of protective gear and the safe disposal of waste. Hygiene Standards: General hygiene principles and standards. Organizational Skills: The ability to manage tasks efficiently and prioritize duties. Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail to ensure thorough cleaning. Time Management: The ability to complete assigned tasks within specified timeframes. Problem-Solving: The ability to handle unexpected cleaning challenges effectively. Teamwork: The capacity to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Cleaning Experience: A minimum of one year of experience in a cleaning role, preferably in an Educational or Classroom environment. References: Proven track record of reliability and good performance. Education: A Grade 10 (Standard 8) or equivalent qualification is required. Formal Training: Any formal training or certification in professional cleaning or hygiene will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Cleaning Offices, corridors, halls and classrooms. Cleaning of general Kitchens. Cleaning of Restrooms. Keep and maintain cleaning materials and equipment.
jobs.applications: Apply online at https://ncrz83.ngnscan.co.za/
jobs.notes: Applicants are required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application and must submit a fully signed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be submitted by shortlisted candidates. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process.

af.title: Skoonmaker
af.summary: Skoonmakerpos by Northern Cape Rural TVET College De Aar Campus wat basiese geletterdheid, fisieke gesondheid en die vermoë om skoonmaaktoerusting te hanteer vereis.
af.requirements: Suid-Afrikaanse burgerskap: Moet 'n Suid-Afrikaanse burger wees. Geletterdheid: Vermoe om te lees en te skryf. Kommunikasie: Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Fisieke gesondheid: Fisieke gesond en in staat om veeleisende skoonmaaktake uit te voer. Betroubaarheid: Wees stip en betroubaar. Bevoegdhede: Skoonmaakmiddels: Die behoorlike gebruik en hantering van verskeie skoonmaakchemikalieë en wasmiddels. Skoonmaaktoerusting: Die bedrywing en onderhoud van standaard skoonmaaktoerusting, soos stofsuiers, moppe, en vloerpolitoerders. Veiligheidsprosedures: Gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies wat verband hou met skoonmaak, insluitend die gebruik van beskermende toerusting en die veilige wegdoening van afval. Higiënestandaarde: Algemene higiënebeginsels en -standaarde. Organisatoriese vaardighede: Die vermoë om take doeltreffend te bestuur en pligte te prioritiseer. Aandag aan besonderhede: Noukeurige aandag aan besonderhede om deeglike skoonmaak te verseker. Tydbestuur: Die vermoë om toegewysde take binne gespesifiseerde tydperke te voltooi. Probleemoplossing: Die vermoë om onverwagte skoonmaakuitdagings doeltreffend te hanteer. Spanwerk: Die vermoë om doeltreffend beide onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. Skoonmaakervaring: Minimum een jaar ervaring in 'n skoonmaakrol, verkieslik in 'n Opvoedkundige of Klaskameromgewing. Verwysings: Bewese rekord van betroubaarheid en goeie prestasie. Onderwys: 'n Graad 10 (Standaard 8) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie word vereis. Formele opleiding: Enige formele opleiding of sertifisering in professionele skoonmaak of higiëne sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Skoonmaak van kantore, gange, sale en klaskamers. Skoonmaak van algemene kombuisse. Skoonmaak van ruskamers. Hou en onderhou skoonmaakmateriaal en -toerusting.

zu.title: Umsuli
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsuli esikhungweni i-Northern Cape Rural TVET College De Ar Campus esidinga ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala okuyisisekelo, ukuba nomzimba ophilile kanye nokuwukwazi ukusebenzisa izinsiza zokusula.
zu.requirements: Ubobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika: Kumele ube ngumakhamuzi waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala: Ukukwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Ukuxhumana: Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu kanye nobudlelwano babantu. Ukuba nomzimba ophilile: Ukuba nomzimba ophilile nokukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi eminzima yokusula. Ukuthembeka: Ukuba nhlanzekile ngesikhathi futhi uthembekile. Amakhono: Izinsiza zokusula: Ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele kanye nokuphathwa kwamakhemikhali okuhlukahlukeneokusula kanye nodeterjenti. Izinsiza zokusula: Ukusebenzisa kanye nokugcina izinsiza zokusula ezijwayelekile, njengesidluli esonsa isithuli, amophu, kanye nezinto zokuqhosta phansi. Izinqubo zokuphepha: Imithetho yezempilo kanye nokuphepha ehlobene nokusula, okuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izembatho zokuvikela kanye nokulahla ukungcolile ngendlela ephephile. Amazinga okuhlanza: Izimiso namazinga ajwayelekile okuhlanza. Amakhono ohlelo: Ikhono lokuphatha imisebenzi ngempumelelo futhi ubize imisebenzi ngokubaluleka. Ukuqapha izinhlamvu: Ukuqapha izinhlamvu ngokucophelela ukuze kuqiniseke ukusula okuphelele. Ukuphatha isikhathi: Ikhono lokugcwalisa imisebenzi enikiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esihlotshanisiwe. Ukuxazulula izinkinga: Ikhono lokubhekana nezinkinga ezingezilindelekile zokusula ngempumelelo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu: Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo kodwa yedwa nakube ngxenye yesiqembu. Isipilinow sokusula: Okungenani unyaka oyedwa wesipilinowa enkhaleni yokusula, okuphwayonywa kakhulu kwindawo yemfundo noma ikilasi. Oqinisekiswayo: Imlando oqinisekisiwe wokuthembeka kanye nokusebenza kahle. Imfundo: Kudingeka ibe ne-Grade 10 (Standard 8) noma izifundo ezingulingana nalezi. Ukuqeqeshwa okusemthethweni: Noma yikuphi ukuqeqeshwa noma izitifiketi ezengeziwezokukhanyisa noma ukuhlanza kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Ukusula amahhovisi, izihambi, amahholi kanye namakilasi. Ukusula izikhishi ezivamile. Ukusula amabhavu. Ukugcina kanye nokuqinisekisa izinto zokusula kanye nezinsiza.

xh.title: Umcoci
xh.summary: Isithuba somcoci kwi-Northern Cape Rural TVET College De Aar Campus sifuna ukuba uyakwazi ukufunda nokubhala, ulunge ngaphezu koko ukwazi ukusebenzisa izixhobo zokucoca.
xh.requirements: Uburhalwe beSizwe eMzantsi Afrika: Makabe ngumZali weSizwe eMzantsi Afrika. Ukubhala nokuFunda: Uluntu lokwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Unxibelelwano: Iakhono ezilungileyo zoxwebhu nokudibana nabaninyani. Ukuzilolonga ngokwezilo: Uqobo ngokwakhe ukuzilolonga ngokwezilo kwaye ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yokucoca. Ukuthembeka: Makaba ngumntu oze ngexesha kwaye ethembekile. Iakhono: Izinto ezicoca: Ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo nokuphatha iikhemikhali nencedo zokucoca ezahlukeneyo. Izixhobo zokucoca: Ukusebenza nokugcina izixhobo zokucoca ezisemgangathweni, njengamavakhuamakhasi, iimopu, nokuqhelanisa amafloho. Iinkqubo zoKhuseleko: Imigaqo yokhuseleko nempilo enxulumene nokucoca, kuquka ukusetyenziswa kweekhithi zokhuseleko nokulahlwa ngokhuselekileyo kweenkunkuma. Izinga lococo: Iimvisiswano nemiqathango yococo jikelele. Iakhono zoLungeleliso: Uluntu lokulawula imisebenzi ngokusebenza kakuhle kwaye ufake ngaphezulu imisebenzi. Kuqwalaselo oluNgqi: Ukuqwalasela ngokungqilima ukuze kuqiniseke ukucoca ngokupheleleyo. Ukulawula ixesha: Uluntu lokuphela kwemisebenzi enikiweyo kwixesha elichaziweyo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki: Uluntu lokupatha iingxaki zokucoca ezingalindelekanga ngokusebenza kakuhle. Ukusebenza ngenqgrp: Uluntu lokusebenza kakuhle kodwa nomntu ngamnye nangaphakathi kwento. Iakhono zokucoca: Ixesha elinganiselweyo ngonyaka wamava kwisithuba sokucoca, ngokukhethwa kwindawo eFundiswayo naBafundi bethu. Iindululo: Isibonakaliso sokuthembeka nokusebenza kakuhle. Imfundo: Kufuneka ibe ngumGred wamashumi amabini (iwaka elinesibhozo) okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Ulwazi oluQinisekisiweyo: Naluphi na ulwazi oluQinisekisiweyo okanye isatifikethi kwiziko ekhuphela ngokucoca okuhle nempilo kuya kubangucedo.
xh.duties: Ukucoca iiofisi, iindlela, amaholo namiqopho. Ukucoca kwezikhululo zethu. Ukucoca kwezikhululo. Ukugcina nokulondoloza izinto ezihlolwe kunye nezixhobo.

jobs.title: Independent Correctional Centre Visitor (LEVEL 5 - 3/8th)
jobs.salary_text: R89 046 per annum, plus 37% in lieu of benefits.
jobs.summary: Independent Correctional Centre Visitor needed at Mdantsane Correctional Centre to conduct site visits, interview inmates and manage complaints on a database.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12/Senior Certificate. Computer literate and accurate. A recommendation or nomination as an ICCV by a community organization (not older than six (6) months). Ability to work independently and as a team. Public spirited and sound knowledge of the Batho Pele principles. Assertiveness and ability to work under pressure. Ability to communicate (verbally and in writing). Driver’s licence will be an added advantage. Preference will be given to qualifying applications received from individuals residing in communities which are in the vicinity of the correctional centre where the post needs to be filled.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for conducting site visits and reporting on urgent matters. To conduct regular interviews and consultations with inmates and DCS officials regarding complaints and mandatory matters. Receiving and capturing all complaints/requests on the database. Opening and maintenance of case files. Make follow-ups on outstanding complaints. Submission of monthly reports. Provide statistical analysis of all complaints received. Attend to enquiries. Carry out all reasonable instructions by the supervisor/ Regional Manager.
jobs.enquiries: Eastern Cape Management Region: Ms N Sifesane Tel No: (043) 722 2729
jobs.applications: Submitted online through the following link: https://forms.gle/9ErSTiF8awRQshdMA or hand delivered to East London Magistrates Court, 3rd floor, room 407, Buffalo Street, East London, 5200.
jobs.notes: All attachments for online application must include an application form Z83 and CV only, in PDF and as one (1) document or attachment and saved with surname and initials. JPEG (picture/snapshot) applications will not be accepted. Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Failure to fully complete, initial and sign the Z83 form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. All applications must reach the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services (JICS) on/or before the closing date and time. JICS cannot be held responsible for server delays. Applications submitted in any other way other than the published link or hand delivery will be treated as invalid. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached”. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part “F” must be answered and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form is required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Non- RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants      who      do    not    comply       with    the      abovementioned instructions/requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate’s suitability based on the posts’ technical and generic requirements. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used for the sole purpose of this application and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. Due to the large number of responses anticipated, correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. The JICS reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. The appointment will be made according to the Public Service Act of 1994. af.title: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoeker (VLAK 5 - 3/8e)
af.summary: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrum Besoeker benodig by Mdantsane Korrektiewe Sentrum om terreinbesoeke uit te voer, gedetineerdes te ondervooi en klagtes op 'n databasis te bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat hê. Rekenaargeletterd en akkuraat. 'n Aanbeveling of benoeming as 'n ICCV deur 'n gemeenskapsorganisasie (nie ouer as ses (6) maande nie). Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Publiekgesind en deeglike kennis van die Batho Pele-beginsels. Selfversekerdheid en vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om te kommunikeer (mondeling en skriftelik). 'n Bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kwalifiserende aansoeke ontvang van persone wat woonagtig is in gemeenskappe wat in die omgewing van die korrektiewe sentrum is waar die pos gevul moet word.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die uitvoer van terreinbesoeke en verslagdoening oor dringende aangeleenthede. Om gereelde onderhoude en konsultasies met gedetineerdes en DCS-amptenare rakende klagtes en verpligte aangeleenthede uit te voer. Ontvang en vaslegging van alle klagtes/versoeke op die databasis. Oopmaak en instandhouding van saaklêers. Opvolg van uitstaande klagtes. Indiening van maandelikse verslae. Voorsien statistiese ontleding van alle klagtes ontvang. Bystand aan navrae. Uitvoering van alle redelike opdragte deur die toesighouer/ Streeksbestuurder.

zu.title: Isivakashi Esizimele Se-Correctional Centre (LEVEL 5 - 3/8th)
zu.summary: Kudingeka isivakashi esizimele se-Correctional Centre e-Mdantsane Correctional Centre ukuze kwenziwe ukuvakashela indawo, kubuzwe iziboshwa kanye nokuphathwa kwemibiko kusetshenziswa idathabheyi.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kumele babe nesiqinisekiso se-Grade 12/Senior Certificate. Bakwazi ukusebenza ngomthombo olwazi futhi bate ngokunemba. Okulingiswa noma ukukhethwa njenge-ICCV nginhlangano yomphakathi (okungadluli izinyanga eziyisithupha (6)). Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele nangaphakathi kwethimba. Bakhathalele izindaba zomphakathi baze banelo ulwazi olunzulu ngemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Bazi ukuzethemba baze bakwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga eliphezulu lokucindezela. Ikhono lokuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ilayisensi yokushayela izoba ngconcoshe. Kuzothandwa kakhulu izicelo ezihambisana nemigomo eziytholwe kubantu abahlala emiphakathini esiseduze ne-Correctional Centre lapho isikhundla sidinga ukuvalwa khona.
zu.duties: Owayo lesekisi uzobe egxile ekwenzeni ukuvakashela izindawo nokubika ngemithombo ephuthumayo. Ukuqhuba izinkinga ezivamayo kanye nemicimbo namaphuzu abafakeli kanye nezikhulu ze-DCS ngokuphathelene nemibiko nezindaba eziyisiyalo. Ukwamukela bese ukuqamba bonke imibiko/izicelo kudathabheyi. Ukuvula kanye nokulondoloza amafayela ecala. Ukwenza ukuhlolelwa imibiko engakavalwa. Ukunikeza imibiko yanyanga zonke. Ukunikeza isilinganiso sezibalo ngazo zonke izikhalazo ezitholiwe. Ukuphathelene nemibuzo. Ukuphatha wonke umyalo ongaguquguqukiyo onikezwa umphathi/ Regional Manager.

xh.title: Umtphuli Ohlangeneyo WaseKwindla Elingalawulekiyo (INQANABA 5 - 3/8th)
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona umtphuli ohlangeneyo waseKwindla Elingalawulekiyo eMdantsane Correctional Centre ukuze enze iindwendwe kwindawo, achaze ababoshiweyo aphze abaphathe iimbogingo kwidatabase.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neGrade 12/Senior Certificate. Bakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwaye bachanile. Ukufunyaniswa okutyunjilweyo okanye ukubekwa njengoICCV sisebenziwo somphakathi (ingabi mdala kweenyanga ezithandathu (6)). Ulwazi lokusebenza eyedwa nakwindawo yenqanaba elinguluntu olulungileyo nolunolwazi oluhle ngemigaqo yeBatho Pele. Ukuzimisela nolwazi lokusebenza ngantsieke. Ulwazi lokuthetha (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba iya kuba ngowona msebenzi ongummiselo. Kuya kubakho lkhetelo kumagqabantshintshi afanelekileyo afumaniswa kubantu bahlala koomphakathi abaseduzane neKwindla Elingalawulekiyo apho isithuba kufuneka sigqitywe.
xh.duties: Umntu ofakwe kwindawo le uyakuba nomanyelwe wokwenza iindwendwe ezindawweni nokuxela ngemiba ebalulekileyo ngokukhawuleza. Ukuqhuba iintervyu ezizezonke nengxoxo nababoshiweyo nanabasebenzi beDCS ngemida yemibuzo neyemibandela ebalulekileyo. Ukufumana nokubhala yonke imibuzo/iicelo kwidatabase. Ukuvula ukugcina iifayile zemibuzo. Ukwenza umlandelo kumibuzo engagqitywanga. Ukuhambisa iingxelo zenyanga. Ukuhlinza ngokwahlulwahlula lwezibalo ngayo yonke imibuzo efunyenweyo. Ukuphendula iimibuzo. Ukuphumeza wonke imiyalelo eqqabhileyo enjengomphathi/Regional Manager.

jobs.title: Surveyor-general
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS).
jobs.summary: Surveyor-General for Mpumalanga based in Mbombela to manage approval of cadastral documents and land surveying compliance at SMS Level 14.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and Four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) or related equivalent qualifications as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5 (2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level in a Land Surveying environment. Appropriate post- registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job- related knowledge: Budget systems. Computer accounting software. Knowledge of Financial Accounting Systems. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System Knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information Knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance management and Monitoring. Public Finance Management. Government systems and structure. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Job-related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business and Communication (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Manage the approval of diagrams, general plans and sectional title plans that comply with legislation and prove tenure security and sustainable rural and urban development. Examine for approval all cadastral documents (diagrams and general plans). Examine for approval all cadastral documents (sectional plans) prepared in accordance with the Sectional Titles Act and all applicable statutory consents. Examine for approval all cadastral documents prepared in accordance with the Mining Titles Registration Act or any other law requiring the approval of the Surveyor-General. Archive, preserve and maintain the currency of all records pertaining to approved land parcels and land rights created in terms of the Land Survey Act and Sectional Titles Act and Regulations. Ensure that all approved cadastral documents are registered and housed within a secure documents vault. Ensure an electronic repository of scanned images to facilitate information provisioning. Update, endorse, re- scan and re-archive the hard copy (original approved) documents because of any lawful approval, withdrawal, cancellation or change to cadastral information. Accept and file survey records associated with cadastral surveys. Maintain correspondence files relating to cadastral surveys for research purposes. Ensure the compilation of a complete, accurate, current and correct cadastral spatial information dataset. Update the cadastral geo-spatial database through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Ensure that management information systems are created to provide timely and accurate management information constantly. Comply with the custodianship responsibility of cadastral spatial information as directed by the South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act and the Committee on Spatial Information established thereunder. Train Professional Land Surveyors, Geomatics Technologists, Survey Technicians and Geomatics Officers. Train Professional Land Surveyors, Geomatics Technologists, and Geomatics Technicians in line with the registration requirements set by the South African Geomatics Council. Provide in-house training to Geomatics Officers. Draft circulars and notices when required. Provide support to various programmes including Land and Tenure Reform and Restitution programmes and the Land Administration Institutions. Provide technical support and advice as well as information from time to time. Assist with research services. Undertake field surveys and inspections to re-identify boundaries of state land properties and resolve boundary disputes. Issue reports to court, certificates of remaining extent, closure of public places, maintenance of schedules. Ensure effective financial management, human resource management and supply chain management. Ensure effective budgeting and management of the Provincial Office. Manage the recruitment and selection. Ensure realisation of Employment Equity targets when filling vacancies. Utilise Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) to measure staff performance on an on-going basis. Manage labour relations matters. Draft and implement management action plan on audit findings. Manage supply chain processes.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 17 Van Rensburg Street, 7th Floor Bateleur Building, Mbombela, 1200 or by email to Post333@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males, and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Surveyor-general
af.summary: Surveyor-General vir Mpumalanga, gebaseer in Mbombela, om die goedkeuring van kadastrale dokumente en landmetingsgevolglikheid by SMS Level 14 te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n vierjaar B- of BSc-graad in Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken, en 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien is. Geregistreer as 'n Professional Land Surveyor by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Geregistreer as 'n Sectional Titles Practitioner kragtens Section 5 (2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar ondervinding op 'n senior bestuursvlak in 'n Land Surveying-omgewing. Toepaslike post-registrasie ondervinding in kadastrale opnames. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Begrotingsisteme. Rekenaar-rekeningkundige sagteware. Kennis van Financial Accounting Systems. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Kadastrale opnamekennis. Tegniese stelselkennis. Kadastrale ruimtelike inligtingskennis. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van vooruitgang in tegnologie nuttig vir die Cadastral Survey System. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Openbare finansiële bestuur. Regeringstelsels en -struktur. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programme-opstelproses. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Hulpbronbeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydbestuur. Besigheids- en Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Bestuur die goedkeuring van diagramme, algemene planne en sectionaliseringsplanne wat aan wetgewing voldoen en sekuriteit van eiendomsreg asook volhoubare landelike en stedelike ontwikkeling bewys. Ondersoek alle kadastrale dokumente (diagramme en algemene planne) vir goedkeuring. Ondersoek alle kadastrale dokumente (sectionaliseringsplanne) wat ooreenkomstig die Sectional Titles Act en alle toepaslike statutêre goedkeurings voorberei is, vir goedkeuring. Ondersoek alle kadastrale dokumente wat ooreenkomstig die Mining Title Registration Act of enige ander wet wat die goedkeuring van die Surveyor-General vereis, voorberei is, vir goedkeuring. Argiveer, bewaar en hou die geldeenheid van alle rekords rakende goedgekeurde grondpersele en grondregte wat kragtens die Land Survey Act en Sectional Titles Act en regulasies geskep is, op datum. Verseker dat alle goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente geregistreer en in 'n veilige dokumentkluis gehuisves word. Verseker 'n elektroniese bewaarplek van geskandeerde beelde om inligtingsverskaffing te fasiliteer. Dateer hardkopie- (oorspronklik goedgekeurde) dokumente op, ondersteun, her-skandeer en her-argiveer as gevolg van enige wettige goedkeuring, terugtrekking, kansellasie of verandering aan kadastrale inligting. Aanvaar en lê opname-rekords wat met kadastrale opnames gepaard gaan, weg. Handhaaf korrespondensie-lêers rakende kadastrale opnames vir navorsingsdoeleindes. Verseker die samestelling van 'n volledige, akkurate, huidige en korrekte kadastrale ruimtelike inligtingsdatastel. Dateer die kadastrale geo-ruimtelike databasis op deur elke goedgekeurde kadastrale grondperseel by te voeg. Verseker dat bestuursinligtingstelsel geskep word om voortdurend tydige en akkurate bestuursinligting te verskaf. Voldoen aan die bewaarderverantwoordelikheid van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting soos gelys deur die South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act en die Committee on Spatial Infrastructure wat kragtens daardie gestig is. Tree Professional Land Surveyors, Geomatics Technologists, Opname-technici en Geomatics Officers op. Tree Professional Land Surveyors, Geomatics Technologists en Geomatics Technicians op in ooreenstemming met die registrasievereistes wat deur die South African Geomatics Council gestel is. Verskaf in-huis opleiding aan Geomatics Officers. Skrif omgewende en kennissgewings wanneer vereis. Verskaf ondersteuning aan diverse programme insluitend Land- en Tenure Reform- en Restitusie-programme en die Land Administration Institutions. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies sowel as inligting van tyd tot tyd. Bied bystand met navorsingsdienste. Onderneem veldopnames en ondersoeke om grense van staatsgrond eiendomme te her-identifiseer en grensgeskille op te los. Verskaf verslae aan die hof, sertifikate van oorblywende omvang, afsluiting van openbare plekke, onderhoud van skedules. Verseker effektiewe finansiële bestuur, menslike hulpbronbestuur en voorsieningskettingbestuur. Verseker effektiewe begroting en bestuur van die Provinsiale Kantoor. Bestuur die werwing en seleksie. Verseur die bereiking van Employment Equity-doelwitte wanneer vakatures gevul word. Gebruik Employee Performance Management en Development System (EPMDS) om staftprestasie op 'n deurlopende basis te meet. Bestuur arbeidsverhoudingsaangeleenthede. Stel bestuursaksieplan op en implementeer dit rakens ouditsbevindings. Bestuur voorsieningskettingprosesse.

zu.title: Surveyor-general
zu.summary: ISurveyor-General waseMpumalanga ovela eMbombela ongabalise ukuvunywa kwemibhalo yecadastral kanye nokuziphendulela kolwazi lwemigqa yomhlaba ezingeni leSMS Level 14.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-Degree yeminyaka emine yeB noma iBSc kuGeomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) noma izifundo ezilinganayo njengoba zivunywe yiSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kanye nesitifiketi seNyukela (isitifiketi sokungena kwiSMS) esinikezwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Abhalwe njengoMhumushi weMigqa yoMhlaba ogwini neSouth African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Abhalwe njengoPractitioner weSectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5 (2) seSectional Titles Act, 1986. Ukwazisa kweminyaka engu-5 ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha emvelwaneni weLand Surveying. Ukwazisa okuhambisanayo kokusebenza ngemva kokubhaliswa kolwazi lwecadastral surveying. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Izinhlelo zebhajethi. Isofthiwe ekubhaleni izibalo ekuKHaya. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zokubhala izibalo zezimali. Izimiso ezivunyiwe jikelele zokubhala izibalo (GAAP). Ulwazi lolwazi lwecadastral. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lolwazi lwesikhala se-cadastral. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zolwazi lomhlaba, izinhlelo zokuphatha umhlaba kanye nokuphatha ulwazi lwezwe. Ulwazi ngentuthuko yobuchwepheshe oluwusizo kuhlelo lolwazi lwecadastral. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kahle kanye nokuqapha. Ukuphatha izimali zikahulumeni. Izinhlelo kanye nosakhiwo kahulumeni. Inqubo yokuthatha izinqumo zahulumeni. Inqubo yokuhlela izinhlelo. Amakhono ahambisana nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha izinhlelo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Izihlobo zabantu phakathi kwabo. Ukubikezela ibhajethi. Ukusebenzisa ikhakhombhuyitha. Ukuletha imithombo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Umabhizinisi kanye nokuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe).
zu.duties: Phatha ukuvunywa kwezindinganiso, amaphulani jikelele kanye namaphulani ezihloko zesigaba ahambisana nomthetho futhi abukeze ukuzinza kokuphathwa komhlaba kanye nentuthuko eguqukayo yasemaphandleni nasedolobheni. Hlola ukuze kuvunywe yonke imibhalo yecadastral (izindinganiso namaphulani jikelele). Hlola ukuze kuvunywe yonke imibhalo yecadastral (amaphulani ezihloko zesigaba) alungise ngesimu seSectional Titles Act kanye namavume womthetho ohambisana nawo wonke. Hlola ukuze kuvunywe yonke imibhalo yecadastral elungise ngesimu seMining Titles Registration Act noma omunye umthetho ofuna ukuvunywa kweSurveyor-General. Gcina, zibe futhi ulondoloze ukusebenza kwayo yonke imibhalo ehlobene namaphulo omhlaba avunyiwe kanye namalungelo omhlaba adalwe ngesimu seLand Survey Act kanye neSectional Titles Act kanye neziMiyalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalo yecadastral evunyiwe ibhalisiwe futhi igcinwa kusigqinsi semibhalo esivikelayo. Qinisekisa indawo yangekhompyutha yezithombe ezixoshiwe ukwenza lula ukunikezwa kolwazi. Bukela kabusha, qinisekisa, xosha kabusha futhi ulondoloze kabusha imibhalo ekhophi eqinisiwe (evunyiwe okokuqala) ngenxa yanye ukuvunwa okusemthethweni, ukususwa, ukukhanselwa noma ushintsho kulwazi lwecadastral. Yamukela futhi ugcine imibhalo yokuzisa ehlobene nokuzingela kwecadastral. Gcina amafayela ezincwadi ezihlobene nokuzingela kwecadastral ngezinjongo zocwaningo. Qinisekisa ukudalwa kwesethi yedatha ephelele, eqinisekisiwe, ejwayelekile futhi elungile yolwazi lwesikhala se-cadastral. Bukela kabusha idathabheyisi ye-cadastral geo-spatial ngokungeza inqaku ngalinye lomhlaba we-cadastral evunyiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zolwazi lokuphatha zidalwa ukuze zinikeze ulwazi lokuphatha olusheshayo futhi olungaguquki ngesikhathi sonke. Ziphendulele ekwenzeni umsebenzi wokugcina ulwazi lwesikhala se-cadastral njengoba okuyalelwe yiSouth African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act kanye neKomidi Yolwazi Lwesikhala esidalwe ngaphansi kwalo. Qeqesha abaHhumishi beMigqa yoMhlaba, abaGcini bobuChwepheshe beGeomatics, abaGcini beZingelo beGeomatics kanye nabaHoli beGeomatics. Qeqesha abaHhumishi beMigqa yoMhlaba, abaGcini bobuChwepheshe beGeomatics, kanye nabaGcini beZingelo beGeomatics ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokubhalisa ezibekwe yiSouth African Geomatics Council. Nikeza iqeqesho langaphakathi kubaHoli beGeomatics. Bhala izaziso namaphaphu lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza inkuxolo kwezinhlelo ezahlukene okuhlanganisa izinhlelo Zokulungisa umHlabu kanye nokuNikwa kwawo futhi eRestitution kanye neziNhlelo zoKuphatha uMhlaba. Nikeza inkuxolo yobuchwepheshe kanye neluleko kanye nolwazi ngesikhathi ngesikhathi. Siza ngesevisi zocwaningo. Yenza izingelo zasemhlabeni kanye nezikhwama ukuze ubone kabusha imigqa yamasu omhlaba kahulumeni futhi uxazulule izinkinga zemigqa yomhlaba. Nikeza umbiko enkantolo, izitifiketi zesabelo esisele, ukuvala kwezindawo zomphakathi, ukulondoloza izinhlelwe. Qinisekisa ukuphatha kwezimali okusebenzayo, ukuphatha kwemithombo yabantu kanye nokuphatha kwezinto ezengeziwe. Qinisekisa ukwenza ibhajethi okusebenzayo kanye nokuphatha iKantolo LeSifundazwe. Phatha ukubhalisa kanye nokukhetha. Qinisekisa ukufeza imigomo ye-Employment Equity lapho kugcwaliswa izikhala. Sebenzisa i-Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokuqhubekayo. Phatha izindaba zobudlelwane bemisebenzi. Bhala futhi usebenzise uhlelo lokwenza izenzo lokuphatha ngemithelela yokuhlola. Phatha inqubo yezinto ezengeziwe.

xh.title: Surveyor-general
xh.summary: I-Surveyor-General we-Mpumalanga ohlezi e-Mbombela ukulawula ukuvunywa kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral nokuqhathaniswa kokulinganiswa kwamahlule ezingangeni kwamagunya inqanaba lama-SMS Level 14.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12 naye-Degree yeminyaka yamine kwi-B okanye i-BSc kwi-Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezihlobene noku njengoko zivunyiwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) nesatifikethi se-Nyukela (isatifikethi sokungena ngaphambi kokuqeshwa kwi-SMS) esinikiwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Mababhataliswe njengoMlinganisi wePhakathi weProfessional Land Surveyor kwi-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Mababhataliswe njengoMntu oSebenzayo ngokwe-Sectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5 (2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Iminyaka engu-5 yamava elinganayo lokuba ngumphathi ophakamile kwimeko yokulinganiswa kwamahlule. Amafahla okusebenza ehlotyeni lokulinganisa i-cadastral emva kokubhalisa. Ilayisenisi yokuqhayisa esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Iinkqubo zebhajeti. Isiftiwea esifakela iakhawunti. Ulwazi nge-Financial Accounting Systems. I-GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles). Ulwazi nge-Cadastral Survey. Ulwazi nge-Technical System. Ulwazi nge-Cadastral Spatial Information. Ulwazi nge-Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems nokuLawulwa kwe-Geographical Information. Ulwazi ngeenteko zobuchwephesha ezinceda kwi-Cadastral Survey System. Ukulawula kwayo nokuphatha i-performance. i-Public Finance Management. Iinkqubo nolwakhiwo kurhulumente. Iinkqubo zokwenza izigqibo kurhulumente. Inqubo yokuqamanisa iinkqubo. Amap六级 ophako phantsi komsebenzi: Ukulawula iprojekthey. Ukulawula iqela. Iingxwal- zuba phakathi kwabantu. Ukuchaza ibhajeti. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqamba amacebo asetyenziswayo. Ukuzoba isixazululo nokuqamba isigqibo. Ukulawula ixesha. Ibhizinisi nokuXhamba (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo).
xh.duties: Lawula ukuvunywa kwezigram, iiplani ezijikelezayo nee-sectional title plans ezihambelana nomthetho nezigqinisekisa ukhuseleko lokuphathwa kolwandle ongazange akhutshelwe namaphakathi omda phakathi namaphakathi asendle. Phonononga ukuvuma onke amaxwebhu e-cadastral (izigram niiplani ezijikelezayo). Phonononga ukuvuma onke amaxwebhu e-cadastral (ii-sectional plans) ekulungiselelwe ngokwesi-Sectional Titles Act nazo zonke izivumelwano ezithintelwe ngumthetho. Phonononga ukuvuma onke amaxwebhu e-cadastral ekulungiselelwe ngokwe-Mining Titles Registration Act okanye naliphi na omnye umthetho ofuna ukuvunywa kwe-Surveyor-General. Gcina, zigcine zihlala zisemthethweni onke amarekhodi ahlobene namahlule e-vunyiweyo kunye namagunya omlando asekwe ngokwe-Land Survey Act noku-Athethwa ngokwe-Sectional Titles Act nemiGaqo. Qinisekisa ukuba onke amaxwebhu e-cadastral avunyiweyo abhaliswe begaze agcinwe kwithangi elikhuselekileyo lemaxwebhu. Qinisekisa isikhululo samaxwebhu amaninzi eskaniweyo ukuze kululwelise ukunikwa kolwazi. Hlaziya, qinisekisa, uze uphinde uskane uphinde ugcin onke amaxwebhu okukopaya eqinisekileyo, ajikelezwe ngalo nayiphi na ivunyo, ukhutshwa, uku-rhoxiswa okanye itshintsho kwinkcazelo e-cadastral. Yamkela ugcinise iirekhodi zokulinganisa ezihlobene nokulinganiswa kwe-cadastral. Gcina iifayile zokubhalelana rhoqo ezingxamile nokulinganiswa kwe-cadastral ngenjongo yokuphonononga. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa kolwazi lwe-cadastral spatial olupheleleyo, oluchanekileyo, oluhlala luseyona nendlela elungileyo. Hlaziya isiseko sedata yesanti yentela kwakunye nolwazi lwendawo ngokongeza wonke amahlule e-cadastral avunyiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kusenekwa inkqubo yombiko wokulawula ezobanikela umbiko wokulawula ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha. Landela iimviswano zokuba ngumgcini wolwazi nge-cadastral njengetshilo ngumthetho weSouth African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act naye-Komite yokuLwa kwendawo esekelwe kuyo. Qeqesha o-Professional Land Surveyors, iGeomatics Technologists, o-Survey Technicians nabaGeomatics Officers. Qeqesha o-Professional Land Surveyors, iGeomatics Technologists, nabaGeomatics Technicians ngokwemfuno yokubhalisa equlunye yiSouth African Geomatics Council. Thetha inxaxhi iGeomatics Officers ngenkqubo yangaphakathi. Bhala iindawo zokubhalisa nokuqwalasela nalixa kufuneka. Nikezela inkxaso kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo kuquka i-Land and Tenure Reform noku-Restitution iinkqubo kwaye nako i-Land Administration Institutions. Nikezela inkxaso ngobugcisa nobuleto kunye nolwazi nangamaxesha. Ncedisa iinkonzo zophononongo. Zenza imilinganiso nokuqwalasela emthethweni ukuze kuchazwe ngokutsha iindawo zomda welawe lesi- state usombulule iingxabano zendawo zomda. Khutsha iimbiko iya enkundla, izatifikethi zeyonke into eshiyekileyo, ukuvalwa kweendawo zabenzi, ukugcina izikceduli. Qinisekisa ukulawula imali ngokuchanekileyo, ukulawula abantu abasebenzayo nokuqhuba imiba yokusetyenziswa. Qinisekisa ukwakha ibhajeti ngokwako nokuLawula iProvincial Office. Lawula ukubhaliswa noku khethwa. Qinisekisa ukufezwa amanqwenqweni ase Employment Equity xa kuzaliswa izithuba. Sebenzisa i-EPMDS (Employee Performance Management and Development System) ukuze ulinganise ukuphumeza emsebenzini koluntu rhoqo. Lawula iingxoxo zemiba yabasebenzi. Bhala uze usebenzise icebo lokulawula kolwabiwo-ngokweendaba zokubha lilwa. Lawula iinkqubo ezinesikrwebo eziselula.

jobs.title: Surveyor-general
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Surveyor-General for the Western Cape based in Cape Town, responsible for managing approval of cadastral documents and land surveying compliance.
