Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5 (2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level in a Land Surveying environment. Appropriate post- registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job- related knowledge: Budget systems. Computer accounting software. Knowledge of Financial Accounting Systems. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System Knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information Knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance management and Monitoring. Public Finance Management. Government systems and structure. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Job-related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business and Communication (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Manage the approval of diagrams, general plans and sectional title plans that comply with legislation and prove tenure security and sustainable rural and urban development. Examine for approval all cadastral documents (diagrams and general plans). Examine for approval all cadastral documents (sectional plans) prepared in accordance with the Sectional Titles Act and all applicable statutory consents. Examine for approval all cadastral documents prepared in accordance with the Mining Titles Registration Act or any other law requiring the approval of the Surveyor-General. Archive, preserve and maintain the currency of all records pertaining to approved land parcels and land rights created in terms of the Land Survey Act and Sectional Titles Act and Regulations. Ensure that all approved cadastral documents are registered and housed within a secure documents vault. Ensure an electronic repository of scanned images to facilitate information provisioning. Update, endorse, re- scan and re-archive the hard copy (original approved) documents because of any lawful approval, withdrawal, cancellation or change to cadastral information. Accept and file survey records associated with cadastral surveys. Maintain correspondence files relating to cadastral surveys for research purposes. Ensure the compilation of a complete, accurate, current and correct cadastral spatial information dataset. Update the cadastral geo-spatial database through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Ensure that management information systems are created to provide timely and accurate management information constantly. Comply with the custodianship responsibility of cadastral spatial information as directed by the South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act and the Committee on Spatial Information established thereunder. Train Professional Land Surveyors, Geomatics Technologists, Survey Technicians and Geomatics Officers. Train Professional Land Surveyors, Geomatics Technologists, and Geomatics Technicians in line with the registration requirements set by the South African Geomatics Council. Provide in-house training to Geomatics Officers. Draft circulars and notices when required. Provide support to various programmes including Land and Tenure Reform and Restitution programmes and the Land Administration Institutions. Provide technical support and advice as well as information from time to time. Assist with research services. Undertake field surveys and inspections to re-identify boundaries of state land properties and resolve boundary disputes. Issue reports to court, certificates of remaining extent, closure of public places, maintenance of schedules. Ensure effective financial management, human resource management and supply chain management. Ensure effective budgeting and management of the Provincial Office. Manage the recruitment and selection. Ensure realisation of Employment Equity targets when filling vacancies. Utilise Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) to measure staff performance on an on-going basis. Manage labour relations matters. Draft and implement management action plan on audit findings. Manage supply chain processes.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post334@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males, and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and Persons with Disabilities. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Opmeter-generaal
af.summary: Opmeter-generaal vir die Wes-Kaap gebaseer in Cape Town, verantwoordelik vir die bestuur van die goedkeuring van kadastrale dokumente en nakoming van landopmetingsvereistes.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n vierjaar B- of BSc-graad in Geomatika / Landopmeting (NQF-vlak 7) of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) hê, asook 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (voor-toetree-sertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Landopmeter by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Geregistreer as 'n Seksionele Titels Praktisyn volgens Artikel 5 (2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in 'n landopmetingsomgewing. Toepaslike na-registrasie-ervaring in kadastrale opmeting. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werkverwante kennis: Begrotingsstelsels. Rekenaarrekenkundige sagteware. Kennis van finansiële rekenkundige stelsels. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Kadastrale opmetingskennis. Tegniese stelselkennis. Kadastrale ruimtelike inligtingskennis. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van tegnologiese vooruitgang nuttig vir die kadastrale opmetingstelsel. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Openbare finansiesbestuur. Regeringstelsels en -struktuur. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelproses. Werkverwante vaardighede: Projektbestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Hulpbronnebeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydbestuur. Besigheid en kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik).
af.duties: Bestuur die goedkeuring van diagramme, algemene planne en seksionele titelplanne wat aan wetgewing voldoen en eiendomssekuriteit asook volhoubare landelike en stedelike ontwikkeling bewys. Ondersoek vir goedkeuring alle kadastrale dokumente (diagramme en algemene planne). Ondersoek vir goedkeuring alle kadastrale dokumente (seksionele planne) wat ooreenkomstig die Sectional Titles Act en alle toepaslike statutere toestemmings voorberei is. Ondersoek vir goedkeuring alle kadastrale dokumente wat ooreenkomstig die Mining Titles Registration Act of enige ander wet wat die goedkeuring van die Opmeter-generaal vereis, voorberei is. Argiveer, bewaar en hou alle rekords met betrekking tot goedgekeurde grondpersele en grondregte wat kragtens die Land Survey Act en Sectional Titles Act en Regulasies geskep is, huidig. Verseker dat alle goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente geregistreer en binne 'n veilige dokumentkluis gehuisves word. Verseker 'n elektroniese bewaarplek van gescande beelde om inligtingsverskaffing te vergemaklik. Werk die hardkopie- (oorspronklik goedgekeurde) dokumente by, endoseer, her-skan en her-argiveer as gevolg van enige wettige goedkeuring, onttrekking, kansellasie of verandering aan kadastrale inligting. Aanvaar en lê opmetingsrekords wat met kadastrale opmetings verband hou, weg. Onderhou korrespondensielêers wat met kadastrale opmetings verband hou vir navorsingsdoeleindes. Verseker die samestelling van 'n volledige, akkurate, huidige en korrekte kadastrale ruimtelike inligtingsdatastel. Werk die kadastrale geo-ruimtelike databasis by deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale grondperceel. Verseker dat bestuursinligtingstelsels geskep word om voortdurend tydige en akkurate bestuursinligting te verskaf. Voldoen aan die bewaarderskapverantwoordelikheid van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting soos gerig deur die South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act en die Committee on Spatial Information wat kragtens daardie wet ingestel is. Lei Professionele Landopmeters, Geomatika-tegnoloë, Opmetingstegnie en Geomatika-amptenare op. Lei Professionele Landopmeters, Geomatika-tegnoloë en Geomatika-tegnici in ooreenstemming met die registrasievereistes gestel deur die South African Geomatics Council. Verskaf interne opleiding aan Geomatika-amptenare. Opstel sirkulieres en kennisgewings wanneer vereis. Verskaf ondersteuning aan verskeie programme insluitend Land and Tenure Reform en Restitution-programme en die Land Administration Institutions. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies asook inligting van tyd tot tyd. Bystand verleen met navorsingsdienste. Onderneem veldopmetings en inspeksies om grense van staatsgrondeiendomme te heridentifiseer en grensgeskille te besleg. Uitreik van verslae aan die hof, sertifikate van oorblywende omvang, sluiting van openbare plekke, onderhoud van skedules. Verseker effektiewe finansiële bestuur, menslikehulpbronnebestuur en voorsieningskettingbestuur. Verseker effektiewe begroting en bestuur van die Provinciale Kantoor. Bestuur die werwing en keuring. Verseker bereiking van Employment Equity-teikens wanneer vakatures gevul word. Gebruik die Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) om personeelprestasie op 'n deurlopende basis te meet. Bestuur arbeidsverhoudingsake. Stel bestuursaksieplan oor ouditbevindings op en implementeer dit. Bestuur voorsieningskettingprosesse.

zu.title: Surveyor-general
zu.summary: I-Surveyor-General yase-Western Cape ese-Cape Town, onobinzelwa bokuphatha ukugunyazwa kwamadokhumenti wokulinganiswa kwendlu kanye nokuhambisana nokulinganiswa kwomhlaba.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ephansi kakhulu: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree ye-B noma i-BSc eminyakeni emine kwi-Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) noma iziqu ezidingo ezimbalwa njengoba zivunyiwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kanye nesatifikathi se-Nyukela (isatifikathi sokungena ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwi-SMS) esinikwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Abhalisiwe njengo-Professional Land Surveyor ne-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Abhalisiwe njengo-Sectional Titles Practitioner ngokwesigaba 5 (2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Ukuze kube nokuhlangabezana okuphephile, kudingeka unamava eminyakeni engu-5 esimeni esiphezulu sokuphatha emkhakheni we-Land Surveying. Ukuba namava okusemva kokubhalisa ekulinganisweni kwamadokhumenti wokulinganiswa kwendlu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izinhlelo zebhajethi. Isofthiwe yokubala kumakhompyutha. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokubala ze-Financial Accounting Systems. I-Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Ulwazi lwe-Cadastral Survey. Ulwazi lwe-Technical System. Ulwazi lwe-Cadastral Spatial Information. Ulwazi lwe-Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems kanye ne-Geographical Information Management. Ulwazi ngemithuthuko yobuchwepheshe emnandi kwi-Cadastral Survey System. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kanye nokulawula. Ukuphatha imali kahulumeni. Izinhlelo nezakhiwo zahulumeni. Inqubo yokwenza izinqumo kahulumeni. Inqubo yokuhlela amaphrogramu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha iphrojekthi. Ukuphatha iqembu. Izimbangi zobuqu. Ukuqagela ibhajethi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlela izinsiza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ibhizinisi nokuKhulumisana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe).
zu.duties: Phatha ukugunyazwa kwezidayagramu, amaphulani jikelele namaphulani we-sectional title ahambisana nomthetho futhi abekezele ukuphephwa kokuba nomhlaba kanye nentuthuko ebolekile yasemaphandleni nasedolobheni. Hlola ukugunyazwa kwawo wonke amadokhumenti wokulinganiswa kwendlu (izidayagramu namaphulani jikelele). Hlola ukugunyazwa kwawo wonke amadokhumenti wokulinganiswa kwendlu (amaphulani we-sectional) alungiselwe ngokombho we-Sectional Titles Act kanye nazo zoke izivumelwano ezitholakalayo ngokomthetho. Hlola ukugunyazwa kwawo wonke amadokhumenti wokulinganiswa kwendlu alungiselwe ngokombho we-Mining Titles Registration Act noma omunye umthetho ofuna ukugunyazwa kwe-Surveyor-General. Gcina, zigcine futhi ugcine ukusha kwawo wonke amarekhodi ahlobene namaphulezi womhlaba agunyaziwe namalungelo womhlaba adalwe ngokombho we-Land Survey Act kanye ne-Sectional Titles Act kanye Nezimiso. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti wokulinganiswa kwendlu agunyaziwe abhaliswe futhi agcinwe kwindawo ephathekile yamadokhumenti. Qinisekisa isitoreji sezithombe ezibukhi ngekhompyutha ukuze kweluleke ukunikezwa kolwazi. Buyekeza, fake izimpawu, ubuyekeze futhi ugcine amadokhumenti abhaliwe (okuqediwe okugunyaziwe) ngenxa yayo yonke ukugunyazwa okusemthethweni, ukususwa, ukukhanselwa noma ushintsho kolwazi lokulinganiswa kwendlu. Yamukela futhi ugcine amarekhodi okulinganisa ahlobene nokulinganiswa kwendlu. Gcina amafayela okuxhumana ahlobene nokulinganiswa kwendlu ngenjongo yokuphenya. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa komklamo ophelele, ongaguquguquki, onesikhathi esiphilayo futhi oluleile wolwazi lwe-cadastral spatial information. Buyekeza isisekelo se-cadastral geo-spatial ngokungeza wonke amaphulezi womhlaba agunyaziwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zolwazi zokuphathwa zidalwa ukuze zihlinzeke ngolwazi oluseduze nolungaguquki. Hambisana nobuzibopho bokugcina ulwazi lwe-cadastral spatial njengokuqondiswa yi-South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act kanye ne-Committee on Spatial Information edalwe ngaphansi kwawo. Qeqesha aba-Professional Land Surveyor, aba-Geomatics Technologists, aba-Survey Technician kanye ne-Geomatics Officers. Qeqesha aba-Professional Land Surveyor, aba-Geomatics Technologists, kanye ne-Geomatics Technicians ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokubhalisa ezibekwe i-South African Geomatics Council. Hlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi kwi-Geomatics Officers. Bhala amalethi nezaziso uma kudingeka. Nikeza inkundlebo ezinhlelweni ezahlukene kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ze-Land and Tenure Reform kanye ne-Restitution nezinhlelo ze-Land Administration Institutions. Nikeza inkundlebo yobuchwepheshe kanye nenhlangano kanye nolwazi ngesikhathi ngesikhathi. Siza ngezinsiza zokuphenya. Yenza ukulinganiswa kwensimu nokuhlolwa ukuze ubuyekeze imingcele yezimpahla zomhlaba kahulumeni futhi uxazulule izingxabano zemingcele. Nikeza umbiko enkantolo, izatifikathi ezisele, ukuvala kwendawo yomphakathi, ukugcina izikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali okusebenzayo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlela zokusabalalisa. Qinisekisa ukwenza ibhajethi kahle nokuphatha i-Provincial Office. Phatha ukubhaliswa nokukhethwa. Qinisekisa ukufeza okuhloswe kwe-Employment Equity uma kugcwaliswa izikhala. Sebenzisa i-Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Phatha izindaba zokuxhumana kwabasebenzi. Bhala futhi usebenzise ihlelo lokuphatha ngenxa yezimiso zokuhlola imali. Phatha inqubo yokusabalalisa.

xh.title: Surveyor-general
xh.summary: I-Surveyor-General we-Western Cape ose-Cape Town, onoxanduva lokulawula ukuvunywa kwemibhalo yecadastral nokuthobela iimfuno zokulinganisa umhlaba.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinci: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kwaye be ne-Degree ye-B okanye i-BSc yeminyaka emine kwi-Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) okanye izifundo ezincedisayo ezinxulumene nazo njengoko zivunywa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), nokuba ne-Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) etyunjiwe phambi kokunikwa isikhundla. Kufuneka abhalwe njengo-Professional Land Surveyor kwi-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Kufuneka abhalwe njengo-Sectional Titles Practitioner ngokwesigaba 5 (2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufuneka abe neminyaka elicandelo lokulawula eliphezulu kwimeko yokuqeshwa elingentla kweminyaka eli-5 kwindawo yokulinganisa umhlaba. Kufuneka abe namava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwicadastral surveying. Kufuneba abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluxhumaniswa nomsebenzi: Iinkqubo zebhajeti. Iinkqubo zokubala ezikwi-khompyutha. Ulwazi nge-Financial Accounting Systems. I-GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles). Ulwazi lwe-Cadastral Survey. Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezingcali. Ulwazi lolwazi lwe-Cadastral Spatial Information. Ulwazi nge-Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems nokuLawula ulwazi lwe-Geographical. Ulwazi ngentuthuko kwiteknoloji enceda i-Cadastral Survey System. Ukulawula nokuqonda iinkqubo zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukulawula iimali zorhamente. Iinkqubo nolwakhiwo lorhamente. Iinkqubo zokwenza iigqibo zorhamente. Inqubo yokumisa iinkqubo. Amandla axhumaniswa nomsebenzi: Ukulawula iiprojekthi. Ukulawula iqela. Izikhokelo zokuhlobana nabantu. Ukubikezela ibhajeti. Ukusebenzisa i-khompyutha. Ukuqesha okulungele. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza iigqibo. Ukulawula ixesha. I-business nokuThetha (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo).
xh.duties: Lawula ukuvunywa kwezolwimi, iiplani ezingagqibekanga ezijelene nokuqinisekiswa kwamagama nokuqinisekisa ukuba ngabasebenzi abakweliyo elingaphaya kwihlaza kwelidolophu eziqinisekisa iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezinkqubo ezijeziso ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela ukuvunywa kwemibhalo yecadastral onke (izolwimi nezibuyekezo ezijelene nemithetho esemthethweni kwaye iqinisekise ukhuseleko ngomhlaba. Qwalasela ukuvunywa kwemibhalo yecadastral onke (iplani zicwadi ezenziwa ngokulandela umthetho we-Sectional Titles Act nazo zonke iimvume ezithile ezisesikweni. Qwalasela ukuvunywa kwemibhalo yecadastral yonke eyenziwe ngokulandela umthetho we-Mining Titles Registration Act okanye nawuphi na omnye umthetho ofuna isivumo se-Surveyor-General. Gcina, zigcine zize zithi zikwimo entsha yemibhalo yonke enxulumene namapadali omhlaba avunyiweyo namalungelo omhlaba adaliwe ngokomthetho we-Land Survey Act nakuwo we-Sectional Titles Act nemiThetho. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibhalo yecadastral evunyiweyo ibhalisiwe kwaye igcinwe kwindawo ekhuselekileyo yemibhalo. Qinisekisa isikhululo samazwi askeni ukunika ulwazi ngokulula. Hlaziya, qinisekisa, skena kwakhona uphinde ugcode imibhalo eqoshiweyo (okukuqala evunyiwe) ngenxa yayo nayiphi na isivumo esemthethweni, ukuyikhupha, ukuyirhoxisa okanye utshintsho kolwazi lwecadastral. Yamkela ugcine imibhalo yokulinganisa enxulumene nee-cadastral surveys. Gcina iifayile zonxibelelwano eziphatheleyo nee-cadastral surveys ngenjongo zokuphonononga. Qinisekisa ukuqokezelwa kolwazi olupheleleyo, oluchanekileyo, olwantsasa noluchanekileyo lolwazi lweenkcukacha zecadastral. Hlaziya isiseko sedatha ye-cadastral geo-spatial ngokongeza yonke ipadali yomhlaba yecadastral evunyiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba zenziwa iinkqubo zolwazi lolawulo ukunika rhoqo ulwazi oluchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo lawulo. Qwalasela uxanduva lokugcina ulwazi lwecadastral spatial njengoko alawulwa guqulela kumthetho we-South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act naku-Committee on Spatial Information esekelwe kuso. Qeqesha aba-Professional Land Surveyors, aba-Geomatics Technologists, aba-Survey Technicians naba-Geomatics Officers. Qeqesha aba-Professional Land Surveyors, aba-Geomatics Technologists, naba-Geomatics Technicians ngokwemfuno zokubhalisa ezimisiweyo i-South African Geomatics Council. Nikeza uqeqesho lwangaphakathi kuba-Geomatics Officers. Bhala iindaba ezingagqibekanga nezaziso xa kufuneka. Nikeza inkxaso kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo kuquka iinkqubo zoLwazi nokuqinisekiswa kweakaLondolozo nokuBuyisela kwaye nakwiZiko loLawulo loMhlaba. Nikeza inkxaso ngeempawu negcebiso nakolwazi rhoqo. Nceda ngeenkonzo zophando. Zenza iinzulu zokulinganisa iindawo ezikwimo yazo ukuvuza ngokutsha iindawo zomhlaba welo wozwe kwaye uzisombulule iingxaki zemida. Zeza iingxelo ezikundlu, iigunya okubakho kwaye kusele kungachazwanga kwakhona, ukuvala iindawo zomphakathi, ukulawula iindulam. Qinisekisa ukulawula kweemali, ukulawula abantu nokuqesha kwezikhundla eziphantsi kolawulo oluchaneke. Qinisekisa uqeqesho lokulinganisa iimali nokulawula iProvincial Office. Lawula ukumiswa khethwa ngokwenza isikhundla. Qinisekisa ukufezwa kweeenjongo zikaQoLimo xa kugcwaliswa izithuba. Sebenzisa i-EPMDS (Employee Performance Management and Development System) ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kwinto eqhubekayo. Lawula izindaba zenkqubo yolwabiwo. Bhala uphinde usebenzise isebe lokulawula eliphezulu ngenjongo yokubeka izinto ezilawulwayo. Lawula iinkqubo zokusasaza imali kwindalo yokulawula okanye isebenze ngokutsha.

jobs.title: ICT Technical Manager
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (All-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: ICT Technical Manager sought in Pretoria to lead service operations, production applications, infrastructure and service-desk functions at salary level 11.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a relevant equivalent qualification. A recognised ICT operations and technical service management professional certification such as ITIL®, COBIT®, PMP®, PRINCE2®, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle, Cisco, VMware, Red Hat, CISSP®, CCSP®, ISO 27001, ISO 22301, or equivalent. At least three (3) years junior management in, multi-site or high-availability IT operations environment. Job- related knowledge: Infrastructure or platform support. Service management. Incident and problem management. Change and release control. Supporting government, regulated, land-registry, financial, records-management or other mission-critical services. ICT operations and service management principles, including incident, request, problem, change, release, configuration, availability, capacity, continuity, service-level and knowledge management. ICT governance, internal control, risk management, audit evidence and records management. Enterprise infrastructure concepts covering networks, servers, virtualisation, storage, databases, middleware, cloud / hybrid services, monitoring and automation. Systems development and operational acceptance across the system lifecycle, including testing, deployment, rollback and early- life support. Cybersecurity operations, identity and access control, vulnerability and patch management, logging, backup, recovery and incident escalation. Supplier, contract, licence, asset and financial management within the public- sector control environment. Applicable public-service legislation, policies and governance requirements, including the PFMA, public procurement prescripts, information protection, records management, and occupational health and safety requirements. The Deeds Registration business environment, eDRS, core Deeds systems and national registry service dependencies, or the ability to acquire this knowledge rapidly. Job-related skills: Business continuity/disaster recovery. Operational risk and management reporting. Operational leadership, prioritisation and command during service disruption. Analytical thinking, systems thinking, root-cause analysis and risk-based decision-making. Service performance measurement, dashboarding, trend analysis and evidence-based reporting. Stakeholder engagement, facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution and executive communication. Project, programme, change, release and vendor coordination. Policy, standard, SOP, runbook and technical-report writing. People management, coaching, performance management and multidisciplinary team leadership. Financial, contract and procurement oversight within delegated authority. High levels of integrity, judgement, accountability and attention to detail. Willingness to travel and to participate in planned architecture reviews or production-readiness activities when required. Valid driver's licence as travel forms an inherent requirement of the post.
jobs.duties: Manage ICT service operations and operational command. Lead daily operations for production applications, databases, infrastructure, networks, hosting, end-user support and service-desk interfaces within the post’s mandate. Establish an integrated operational rhythm covering service health checks, shift or duty handovers where applicable, event monitoring, daily exceptions, weekly service reviews and monthly management reporting. Coordinate response to major incidents and high-impact outages, ensure timely business communication, executive escalation, technical recovery and documented post-incident review. Ensure incidents, service requests and operational exceptions are logged, prioritised, assigned, resolved and closed against approved service targets and escalation paths. Maintain clear operational ownership, support models, contact matrices and runbooks for all critical services. Assure service availability, performance, capacity and technical resilience. Monitor end-to-end availability and performance of critical services and identify trends, constraints, single points of failure and emerging risks before they affect service delivery. Manage capacity and demand planning for compute, storage, databases, middleware, connectivity and other operational platforms, aligned with business growth and digital transformation roadmaps. Coordinate preventative maintenance, patching, upgrades, health checks and lifecycle interventions through approved maintenance windows and change controls. Maintain accurate baseline information on supported environments, dependencies, configurations, warranties, licences and technical obsolescence. Drive remedial plans for legacy, unsupported or unstable technology and escalate investment or procurement decisions with evidence-based motivation. Manage incident, problem, request and continual service improvement practices. Implement fit-for-purpose IT service management practices for incident, request, problem, knowledge and service- level management, aligned with approved departmental policy and standards. Lead root-cause analysis for recurring and severe incidents; assign corrective and preventative actions; track implementation; and verify sustained control effectiveness. Maintain a prioritised continual-improvement register based on service data, audit findings, user feedback, risk assessments and technology trends. Develop service dashboards showing availability, responsiveness, backlog, recurring incidents, recovery performance, user-impact trends and improvement actions. Promote proactive support, knowledge reuse, automation, standardisation and measurable reduction of avoidable incidents. Control change, release, deployment and configuration across production environments. Coordinate the end-to-end operational release and deployment process, including readiness assessment, scheduling, approvals, testing evidence, implementation, validation, back-out planning and early-life support. Ensure production changes are authorised, segregated from development activities, traceable and supported by complete technical, security, business and operational documentation. Coordinate build, test, staging and production environment teams and ensure release acceptance criteria and business sign- off are obtained before deployment. Maintain configuration and release records sufficient to support auditability, troubleshooting, service restoration and asset accountability. Review change outcomes, failed changes and emergency changes and ensure lessons are converted into strengthened controls. Oversee service continuity, backup, recovery, security operations and operational risk. Coordinate operational implementation of ICT security requirements, including access control, vulnerability remediation, security patching, privileged access oversight, log monitoring and incident escalation, in collaboration with designated security functions. Ensure backup schedules, restore testing, disaster recovery plans, recovery procedures and continuity dependencies are current, tested, evidenced and aligned with approved recovery objectives. Maintain and monitor an ICT operational risk register, control action plans and treatment measures for services within the post’s scope. Ensure operational data, systems and infrastructure are protected for confidentiality, integrity, availability, authenticity and accountability. Escalate material risks, control failures and non-compliance promptly and track corrective and preventative actions to verified closure.

af.title: ICT Tegniese Bestuurder
af.summary: ICT Tegniese Bestuurder word in Pretoria gesoek om diensbedrywighede, produksietoepassings, infrastruktuur en diensbesk-funksies te lei op salarisvlak 11.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in Rekenaarwetenskap, Inligtingstelsels, Inligtingstegnologie, Sagteware-ingenieurswese of 'n tersaaklike ekwivalente kwalifikasisie hê. 'n Erkende ICT-bedryfs- en tegniese diensbestuurs-professionele sertifisering soos ITIL®, COBIT®, PMP®, PRINCE2®, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle, Cisco, VMware, Red Hat, CISSP®, CCSP®, ISO 27001, ISO 22301, of ekwivalent. Ten minste drie (3) jaar junior bestuurservaring in 'n multi-werf of hoë-beskikbaarheid IT-bedryfsomgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Infrastruktuur- of platformondersteuning. Diensbestuur. Voorval- en probleembestuur. Verandering- en vrystellingsbeheer. Ondersteuning van regering, gereguleerde, grondregister-, finansiële, rekordbestuurs- of ander missiekritieke dienste. ICT-bedryfs- en diensbestuursbeginsels, insluitend voorval-, versoek-, probleem-, verandering-, vrystellings-, konfigurasie-, beskikbaarheids-, kapasiteits-, kontinuïteits-, diensvlak- en kennisbestuur. ICT-bewind, interne beheer, risikobestuur, ouditbewyse en rekordbestuur. Ondernemingsinfrastruktuurkonsepte wat netwerke, bedieners, virtualisasie, berging, databasisse, middleware, wolk-/hibriede dienste, monitering en outomatisering dek. Stelselontwikkeling en operasionele aanvaarding dwarsdeur die stelsellewensiklus, insluitend toetsing, ontplooiing, terugrol en vroeë lewensiklusondersteuning. Kubersekuriteitsbedrywighede, identiteits- en toegangsbeheer, kwesbaarheids- en pleisterbestuur, boekstawing, rugsteun, herstel en voorvaleskalering. Verskaffer-, kontrak-, lisensie-, bates- en finansiële bestuur binne die openbare-sektor beheeromgewing. Toepaslike openbare-dienswetgewing, beleide en bewindsvereistes, insluitend die PFMA, openbare verwervingsvoorskrifte, inligtingsbeskerming, rekordbestuur, en beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes. Die Akteregistrasie-sakemgewingsomgewing, eDRS, kern-Akte-stelsels en nasionale registerdiensafhanklikhede, of die vermoë om hierdie kennis vinnig te bekom. Werksverwante vaardighede: Besigheidskontinuïteit/rampherstel. Operasionele risiko en bestuursverslaggewing. Operasionele leierskap, prioritisering en bevel tydens diensonderbreking. Analitiese denke, stelseldenke, worteloorsakanalise en risikogebaseerde besluitneming. Diensprestasiemeting, dashboarding, trendontleding en bewysgebaseerde verslaggewing. Belanghebbendebetrokkenheid, fasilitering, onderhandeling, konflikoplossing en uitvoerende kommunikasie. Projek-, program-, verandering-, vrystellings- en verskafferkoördinering. Beleid, standaard, SOP, runbook en tegniese verslag skryf. Mensebestuur, afrigting, prestasiebestuur en multidissiplinêre spanleierskap. Finansiële, kontrak- en verwweringsight binne gedelegeerde gesag. Hoë vlakke van integriteit, oordeel, aanspreeklikheid en aandag tot detail. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en om aan beplande argitektuurontledings of produksiegereedheidsaktiwiteite deel te neem wanneer vereis. Geldige bestuurderslisensie aangesien reis 'n inherente vereiste van die pos is.
af.duties: Bestuur ICT-diensbedrywighede en operasionele bevel. Lei daaglikse bedrywighede vir produksietoepassings, databasisse, infrastruktuur, netwerke, gasheer, eindgebruikersondersteuning en diensbesk-koppelvlakke binne die pos se mandaat. Stig 'n geïntegreerde operasionele ritme wat diensgesondheidkontroles, diens of skof-oorgawes waar toepaslik, gebeurtenismonitering, daaglikse uitsonderings, weeklikse diensontledings en maandelikse bestuursverslaggewing dek. Koördineer reaksie op groot voorvalle en hoë-impakonderbrekings, verseer tydige besigheidskommunikasie, uitvoerende eskalering, tegniese herstel en gedokumenteerde na-voorval-ontleding. Verseker dat voorvalle, diensversoeke en operasionele uitsonderings aangeteken, geprioritiseer, toegewys, opgelos en gesluit word teen goedgekeurde diensdoelwitte en eskaleringspaaie. Handhaaf duidelike operasionele eienaarskap, ondersteuningsmodelle, kontakmatrikse en runbooks vir alle kritieke dienste. Verseker diensbeskikbaarheid, prestasie, kapasiteit en tegniese veerkragtigheid. Monitor end-tot-end beskikbaarheid en prestasie van kritieke dienste en identifiseer tendense, beperkings, enkelingspunte van mislukking en opkomende risiko's voordat hulle dienslewering beïnvloed. Bestuur kapasiteits- en aanvraagbeplanning vir berekening, berging, databasisse, middleware, konnektiwiteit en ander operasionele platforms, in lyn met besigheidsgroei en digitale transformasie-padkaarte. Koördineer preventiewe instandhouding, pleistering, opgraderings, gesondheidkontroles en lewensiklus-ingrypings deur goedgekeurde instandhoudingsvensters en veranderingbeheer. Handhaaf akkurate basislyninligting oor ondersteunde omgewings, afhanklikhede, konfigurasies, waarborge, lisensies en tegniese veroudering. Dryf regstellende planne vir verouderde, nie-ondersteunde of onstabiele tegnologie en eskaleer belegging- of verwweringsbesluite met bewysgebaseerde motivering. Bestuur voorval-, probleem-, versoek- en deurlopende diensverbeteringspraktyke. Implementeer geskikte IT-diensbestuurspraktyke vir voorval-, versoek-, probleem-, kennis- en diensvlakbestuur, in lyn met goedgekeurde departementele beleid en standaarde. Lei worteloorsakanalise vir herhalende en ernstige voorvalle; wys korrektiewe en preventiewe aksies toe; volg implementering; en verifieer volgehoue beheerdoeltreffendheid. Handhaaf 'n geprioritiseerde deurlopende verbeteringsregister gebaseer op diensdata, ouditbevindings, gebruikerterugvoer, risiko-assessering en tegnologiëtendense. Ontwikkel diensdashboards wat beskikbaarheid, reaksievermoë, agterstand, herhalende voorvalle, herstelprestasie, gebruikerimpak-tendense en verbeteringsaksies toon. Bevorder proaktiewe ondersteuning, hersirkulasie van kennis, outomatisering, standaardisering en meetbare vermindering van vermijgbare voorvalle. Beheer verandering, vrystelling, ontplooiing en konfigurasie dwarsdeur produksieomgewings. Koördineer die end-tot-end operasionele vrstellings- en ontplooiingsproses, insluitend gereedheidsassessering, skedulering, goedkeurings, toetsbewyse, implementering, validering, teruguit-planne en vroeë lewensiklusondersteuning. Verseker dat produksieveranderings gemagtig, van ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite geskei, naspeurbaar en ondersteun deur volledige tegniese, sekuriteits-, besigheids- en operasionele dokumentasie is. Koördineer bou-, toets-, stap- en produksieomgewingspanne en verseker dat vrystellingsaanvaardingskriteria en besigheidsgetekening voor ontplooiing verkry word. Handhaaf konfigurasie- en vrstellingsrekords voldoende om ouditeerbaarheid, probleemoplossing, diensherstel en bate-aanspreeklikheid te ondersteun. Hersien verandering-uitkomste, mislukte verandering en noodverandering en verseker dat lesse in versterkte beheer omskep word. Ooorsien dienskontinuïteit, rugsteun, herstel, sekuriteitsbedrywighede en operasionele risiko. Koördineer operasionele implementering van ICT-sekuriteitsvereistes, insluitend toegangsbeheer, kwesbaarheidregstelling, sekuriteitspleistering, bevoorregde toegangoorsig, logmonitering en voorvaleskalering, in samewerking met aangewese sekuriteitsfunksies. Verseker dat rugsteunskedules, hersteltoetsing, rampsherstelplanne, herstelprosedures en kontinuïteitsafhanklikhede huidig, getoets, gedokumenteer en in lyn met goedgekeurde hersteldoelwitte is. Handhaaf en monitor 'n ICT operasionele risikoregister, beheeraksieplanne en behandelingsmaat reëls vir dienste binne die pos se omvang. Verseker dat operasionele data, stelsels en infrastruktuur beskerm word vir vertroulikheid, integriteit, beskikbaarheid, egtheid en aanspreeklikheid. Eskaleer wesenlike risiko's, beheerfoute en nie-nakoming onverwyld en volg korrektiewe en preventiewe aksies tot geverifieerde sluiting.

zu.title: Abaphathi Bezobuchwepheshe Be-ICT
zu.summary: Kufunwa Abaphathi Bezobuchwepheshe Be-ICT ePretoria ukuba baholate izinkonzo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokukhiqiza, insimbi kanye nemisebenzi yedeski lenkonzo ezingeni leholo 11.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Kumele abafaki izicelo babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwelonke (NQF Level 6) ku-Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering noma isibonakaliso esifanayo esihambisanayo. Ukwaziswa okugunyaziwe kokuqasha izobuchwepheshe be-ICT kanye namakhulu emisebenzi enjenge-ITIL®, COBIT®, PMP®, PRINCE2®, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle, Cisco, VMware, Red Hat, CISSP®, CCSP®, ISO 27001, ISO 22301, noma okulingana nalokho. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) ebuphathini bujanja kumakhompyutha kule, emawebhusayithi amaningi noma endaweni yokusebenza nge-IT enokusondela ngokuphezulu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusekela insimbi noma ithalabhulathi. Ukuphathwa kwenkonzo. Ukuphathwa kwezehlakalo nezinkinga. Ukulawula inguquko kanye nokukhishwa kokulawulwa. Ukusekela uhulumeni, izinsiza ezilawulwayo, ukuqoshwa kwamagama okuhlola izinkweli, ezomnotho, ezokuphathwa kumarekhodi noma ezinye izinkonzo eziyisisekelo esibaluleke kakhulu. Izimiso zokuqasha izinsiza ze-ICT kanye nokuphathwa kwenkonzo, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezehlakalo, izicelo, izinkinga, inguquko, ukukhishwa, ukumiswa kwezinhlelo, ukutholakala, amandla, ukuqhubeka, izinga lenkonzo kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi. Ukubusa kwe-ICT, okulawulwa ngaphakathi, ukuphathwa kengozi, ubufakazi bokuqamba kanye nokuphathwa kwamarekhodi. Amagugu ezinhlelo e-Enterprise ahlanganisa amanethiwekhi, abalulewe, ukwenza okubonakalayo, isitoreji, amadathabheji, i-middleware, amasevisi wesifunxi / esixubile, okuhlola nokuzenzakalela. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo kanye nokwamukelwa kokusebenza kulo lonke isikhathi sokuphila kohlelo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa, ukufakwa, ukubuyela umva kanye nokusekela kusenesikhathi. Izinkonzo zezokuphepha kwi-cyber, ukuqashwa nokulawulwa kokufinyelela, ukuzela kwezinkinga kanye nokuphathwa kokuqeshwa, ukuloghwa, ukulondoloza imfuyilo, ukubuyela umva kanye nokuqhubela phambili izehlakalo. Ukulawula abahlinzeki, izinkontileka, amalayisensi, izimpahla kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ngaphakathi kwendawo ekulawulwa umphakathi. Umthetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nezidingo zokubusa ezisebenzayo ezomphakathi, okuhlanganisa i-PFMA, izibhalo zokuthenga ezomphakathi, ukuvikelwa kolwazi, ukuphathwa kwamarekhodi, kanye nezidingo zezokuphepha nezempilo yomsebenzi. Indawo yebhizinisi yokubhalisa kwe-Deeds, i-eDRS, izinhlelo ezibalulekile ze-Deeds kanye nezinkonzo ezincike kuzo kumazwe ngamawonke, noma ikono lokuthola lolu lwazi ngokushesha. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi / ukubuyela emuva ngemuva kwenkinga. Ubungozi bokusebenza kanye nokubika okuphathwayo. Ukubuka phambili kokusebenza, ukubeka izintambo phambili kanye nokulawula ngesikhathi senkinga yenkonzo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukucabanga ngezinhlelo, ukuhlaziya imvelaphi yezinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo ngokusekelwe ebungozini. Ukukala imisebenzi yenkonzo, ukwenza amadashebodo, ukuhlaziya amathrendi kanye nokubika ngokusekelwe kubufakazini. Ukuxhumana nabathintekayo, ukweseka, ukuxoxisana, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuxhumana nabaphathi. Ukuhlela amaphrojekthi, amaphrohgamu, inguquko, ukukhishwa kanye nokubambisana nabathengisi. Ukubhala izinqubomgomo, izinga, i-SOP, ama-runbook kanye nokubika ngokobuchwepheshe. Ukuphatha abantu, ukwehlisa isikhuthazo, ukuphatha imisebenzi kanye nokuhola iqembu elihlukene. Ukubuka ngaphezulu kwezimali, izinkontileka kanye nezokuthenga ngaphakathi kwegunya elinikeziwe. Izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha okuhle, ukwahlulela, ukubhekana nezeluleko kanye nokunakela imininingwane. Ukuthanda ukuhamba kanye nokuthatha inxaxheba ekubukeni kwesakhiwo esihleliwe noma ezinkonzweni zokulungelelwa ukukhiqiza lapho kucelwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile njengoba ukuhamba kuyisidingo esibangelwe yisikhundla.
zu.duties: Phatha izinkonzo zokusebenza ze-ICT kanye nokubusa ukusebenza. Hola imisebenzi yansuku zonke yezinhlelo zokukhiqiza, amadathabheji, insimbi, amanethiwekhi, ukubamba kwayo, ukusekela abasebenzisi kanye nezixhumi ezinhlobonhlobo zedeski lenkonzo ngaphakathi kwesibopho sesikhundla. Saka isigqi sokusebenza esihlanganisiwe esihlolwa ngempilo yenkonzo, ukunikezana ngokushintsha isikhunti noma umsebenzi lapho kufanelekile khona, ukuhlola izehlakalo, okungajwayelekile nsuku zonke, ukubuyekeza inkonzo nsonto zonke kanye nokubika ukuphathwa nyanga zonke. Bambisana ekuphenduleni izehlakalo ezinkulu kanye nokuphela kokusebenza okunempempe, qinisekisa ukuxhumana nebhizinisi ngokwesikhathi, ukuqhubela phambili abaphathi, ukubuyela emuva ngokobuchwepheshe kanye nokubhalwe ukubuyekeza ngemuva kwezehlakalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izehlakalo, izicelo zenkonzo kanye nezinkinga zokusebenza zibhalwe, zibekwe phambili, zabelwe, sezixazululwe futhi zivalwe ngokwezinqumo ezivunyiwe zezinkonzo kanye nezindlela zokuqhubela phambili. GCina ukuba ngekuso kokusebenza okucacile, amamodeli wokusekela, amathemu okuxhumana kanye nama-runbook kuzo zonke izinkonzo eziyisisekelo. Qinisekisa ukutholakala, ukusebenza, amandla kanye nokomelela ngokobuchwepheshe. Hlola ukutholakala ngokuphelele nokusebenza kwezinkonzo eziyisisekelo futhi uhlole amathrendi, izinqandamela, amaphoyinti ayingodwa okwehluleka futhi ubone ngozi olusazo ngaphambi kokuthi luthinte ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Phatha amandla kanye nokuqashwa amathuba kwesikhathi esizayo sokubala, ukugcina, amadathabheji, i-middleware, ukuxhumana kanye nezinye izinkundla zokusebenza, ezihambisana nokukhula kwebhizinisi kanye nezinhlela ezibukhoma zokushintsha kwamanani. Bambisana ekulondolozeni, ekulungiseni, ekwenzeni uthuthuko, ekuhloleni impilo kanye nokuqashwa kwezinhlelo kule minyaka yonke kuzo zonke izinhlelo ngaphakathi kwezindlela zokugcina kanye nokuqashwa kwezinguquko ezivunyiwe. Gcina ukwazi okuqinisekile ngenhlabathi yamaphrojekthi okusekelwayo, okuncike kuyo, okumisiwe, amawaranti, amalayisensi kanye nobudala obungasebenzi ngokobuchwepheshe. Qedela izinhlela zokulungisa ubuchwepheshe obudala, obungasekelwa noma obungalawulekile bese uqhubela phambili izinqumo zokutsha imali noma ukuthenga ngokusekelwe kubufakazini. Phatha izinkonzo, izinkinga, izicelo kanye nokwenza izinhlela zokuthuthukisa inkonzo ngokuqhubeka. Setha izindlela zokuqasha izinkonzo ze-IT eziyinhlobo yazo ngezenhloso ngezehlakalo, izicelo, izinkinga, ulwazi kanye nokuphathwa kwenkonzo, kanye nokuthi zihambisane nenqubomgomo namazinga omnyango. Hola ukuhlaziya imvelaphi yezinkinga eziphindaphindwayo nezinkulu; babela izinyathelo zokulungisa nokuqamba; landela ukusetshenziswa; bese uqinisekisa ukusebenza okuqhubekayo kokulawulwa. Gcina ukubhalwa okubekwe phambili kwezinhlela zokuthuthuka ngokusekelwe kumaphoyinti wezinkonzo, okutholakele ekuqambeni, impendulo yomsebenzisi, ukuhlazwa kwengozi kanye namathrendi obuchwepheshe. Tusa izinhlelo zenkonzo ezingasekela ekubhaleni ezibonakalisa ukutholakala, ukuphendula, izinsalela ezingasakhishwa, izehlakalo eziphinda ezenzeka, ukusebenza kokuBuyela emuva, amathrendi okuthinta abasebenzisi kanye nokuqamba izenzo. Khuthaza ukusekela kwangaphambili, ukuphinda usebenzise ulwazi, ukwenza okuzenzakalelayo, ukwenza ukujwayelekile nokuncitsha izehlakalo ezingakwazi ukugwemwa. Lawula inguquko, ukukhishwa, ukufakwa kanye nokumiswa kwamaphrojekthi kuzo zonke izinkundla zokukhiqiza. Bambisana ekwenzeni izinqubo zokukhiqiza nokusakaza ngokugcwele, okuhlanganisa ukubuka ukulungelelwa, ukugqiba isikhathi, izinqumo ezivunyiwe, ubufakazi bokuqamba, ukwenza kahle, ukuqinisekisa ukubuyela emuva, ukubeka izinhlelo ngokwesikhathi nabantu abakuthintayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinguquko ezenziwayo zivunyelwe, zehlukaniswe nemisebenzi yokuqamba amaphrojekthi, zibhekane ngezikhathi futhi zisekelwe ngobuchwepheshe obuphelele, ukuphepha, ibhizinisi kanye nomsebenzi. Bambisana nabahleli bokwakha,ukuqamba nokukhiqiza amaphrojekthi kanye namaqembu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izinkambiso zokwamukela ukukhishwa kanye nesinyathelo sobhizinzi sitholakale ngaphambi kokufaka. Gcina imibhalo yokumiswa kanye nokukhishwa eyanele ukusekela ukwenzeka kokuqamba, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukubuyisa inkonzo kanye nokuqashwa izimpahla. Buyekeza imiphumela yezinguquko, okuhlulekile okuguqulayo kanye nezinguquko eziphuthuma futhi uqinisekise ukuthi okufundwayo kuguqulwa kuyilawulo oluqinisiwe. Buka ngaphezulu ukubuyela emuva kwenkonzo, ukuphathwa kwamafayela, ukubuyisa izinto, ukuphathwa kokuphepha kanye nengozi yokusebenza. Bambisana ekwenzeni kube ngokusebenza izidingo zokuphepha kwe-ICT, okuhlanganisa ukulawula ukungena, ukuxazulula izingozi, ukulungisa ngokuphepha, ukubuka okufanele ukwazi ukuphathwa kwamagunya, okuhlola lokhu kanye nokuxhumana nabaphathi bekuphepha, kuhambisana namanye amaphathi abekelwe ukuphepha. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasikhathi okugcina imfuyelo, ukuhlola ukubuyela emuva, izinhlela zokubuyela emuva, izinqubo zokubuyisa kanye nokuqhubeka okuncike kuyona kumanje, ahlohlwe, kubukeke kalula futhi ahambisane nalezozinholo ezivunyiwe. Gcina futhi uhlole ukubhalwa kwengozi yokusebenza ye-ICT, izinhlelo zokuqamba ngokuthintwa kwenkinga kanye nezinyathelo ezenziwayo ezingeminyaka yonke. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphoyinti emininingwane, izinto zokusebenza kanye namaphrojekthi avikelwe ngesikhathi sokubuka kwezinto ngokushintshwa kwazo ukuba ngaphakathi, ukulunga, ngokusebenza ngokwemvelo, nokusebenza ngamandla okuzihlukanisa. Hlola izingozi ezinkulu, ukwehluleka kokulawula nokungalawuleki futhi ulandele izenzo zokulungisa nokuqamba kuqinisekile.

xh.title: Umlawuli Wezobuchwephetshe be-ICT
xh.summary: Kufunwa umLawuli Wezobuchwephetshe be-ICT ePretoria ukuba atyhale imisebenzi yesebe, izicelo zokuvelisa, izakhiwo kunye nemisebenzi yedesika yesebe kumanqanaba omvuzo angama-11.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikhethi seGraji 12 kwaye babe neDiploma yaseLizwe (iNqanaba le-6 le-NQF) kwiComputer Science, iInformation Systems, iInformation Technology, iSoftware Engineering okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Isiqinisekiso sobungcali esaziwayo sokulawula izibheno ze-ICT kunye nonyango lobuchwephetshe njengakwi-ITIL®, COBIT®, PMP®, PRINCE2®, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle, Cisco, VMware, Red Hat, CISSP®, CCSP®, ISO 27001, ISO 22301, okanye okulinganayo. Ubuncinane iminyaka emithathu (3) ebaphatha abasebenzi abancinane kwindawo yemisebenzi ye-IT yamawebhusayithi amaninzi okanye engummandla ongaphazamiseki. Ulwazi oluchaseneyo nomsebenzi: Inkxaso yezakhiwo okanye ipulatifomu. Ulawulo lonyango. Ulawulo lweziganeko kunye neengxaki. Ulawulo lokutshintsha nokukhulula ukulawulwa. Inkxaso kurhulumente, kwimimiselo, kububhalo-bhali bomhlaba, kwezemali, ekulawulen iirekhodi okanye kwezinye iinkonzo ebalulekileyo. Iimvisiswano zoqhagamshelo kumisebenzi ye-ICT, eziquka ulawulo lweziganeko, iicelo, iingxaki, utshintsho, ukukhulula, uqwalaselo, ukufumaneka, umthamo, uqhubekiso phambili, amanqanaba enkonzo kunye nolawulo lolwazi. Urhulumente we-ICT, ulawulo langaphakathi, ulawulo loyingozi, iimbekiso zokuqinisekisa kunye nolawulo lwamarekhodi. Iinkqubo zemihlaba yawo onke amanqanaba ezakhiwo zenkampani eziquka iinethiwekhi, iiseva, i-virtualisation, indawo yokugcina iinkcukacha, i-datakeyisi, i-middleware, iinkonzo zefu / i-hybrid, ukuqwalasela ngokunyanga iingxaki nokuzenzekelayo. Ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo nokuqatshelwa kokuqaliswa kusebenza kuqobo wobomi bweenkqubo, kuquka ukuvavanya, ukubeka, ukuhoxisa kwaye uxhase kwiminyaka yokuqala. Iinkqubo zokhuseleko lwekhompyutha, ulawulo lobuni nokufikelela, ulawulo olusengozini kunye noqeqesho, ukubhalisa iinkcukacha, ukuzigcina iikhophi zokusebenza, ukubuyisela iinkqubo kunye nokuqhuba iiganeko ezikwingozi. Ulawulo labathengisi, amaqele, iilayisensi, izixhobo kunye nemali ngaphakathi kwendawo yolawulo karhulumente yomphakathi. Isixhobo esisebenzayo somthetho wekonzo karhulumente, iinkqazo kunye neemfuno zohulumente, kuquka i-PFMA, iinkqubo zokuwothula zabarhulumente babaphakathi, ukukhusa inkcazelo, ukulawula iirekhodi, kunye neemfuno zempilo yabasebenzi nokhuseleko. Indawo yoshishino lokuBhalisa kwamagama, i-eDRS, iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zokuBhalisa kunye nokuqhuba iinkonzo zerejista yelizwe, okanye ikhono lokufumana olu lwazi ngokukhawuleza. Amakhono achaseneyo nomsebenzi: Uqhubekiso phambili kobushishino/ukubuyela emva kokusilela kweenkqubo. Iingozi ezingamiselwanga ekubakho iingozi ekubhaleni ngokulawula imisebenzi. Inkonzo ebalulekileyo, ukuqwalasela izinto ngokubaluleka kwazo kunye nokuyalela nangexesha lokuphazamiseka kwenkonzo. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukucinga ngenkqubo, ukuhlalutya imvelaphi yeengxaki kunze nokwenza izigqibo ngokusekelwe kwingozi. Ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwenkonzo, ukwenza idashibhodi, ukuhlalutya iitrendi nokubhala ngokusekelwe kubungqina. Ukuzibandakanya nabathathi nxaxheba, ukulawula iinkqubo, ukuxoxisana, ukusombulula iingxabano kunze nokunxibelelana nabanini ulawulo. Ukuqamba, ukuqamba iiprogram, ukutshintsha ukukhulula kunye nokuqwalasela kweefem. Ukubhala iinkqazo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo kunye neembalo zobuchwephetshe. Ulawulo labantu, ukulunga, ukulawula ngokusebenza kwakho, kunye nokuba ngumlawuli wedlumko elingazodwa. Ukugcinwa kokutshintsha, ukulawula konke kunye nokuqwalasela ezimalini, konjululweyo kwiindawo ezinikezelweyo. Iqondo eliphezulu lokwethembeka, okuqinisekileyo, ukuziphendulela nokubaluleka kwiinkcukacha. Ukuvakatshela kubakho isakhono sokuhamba nokuthatha inxaxheba kolawulo olulungiselelweyo okanye kumsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kokuvelisa xa kufunwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni njengoko ukuhamba kuyimfuno esisiseko yesithuba.
xh.duties: Lawula imisebenzi yexesha yonke yekhompyutha (ICT) kunye nokuyalela iinkqubo. Yala imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla kwizicelo ezibhalwe ngokukhawuleza, iinkcukacha, izakhiwo, iinethiwekhi, iinkonzo zokubamba iindawo ezikwimmandla wokuvelisa, iinkonzo zokuncedisa abasebenzisi kwaye uxhase iinkonzo kwindawo efunwa kusetyenziswa isikhundla. Zise isithuba ngokunjalo kwiqondo elinye elihlanganisiweyo lokubhala iinkonzo ngemihla ngemihla, nokubalisa iinkonzo ezichaziweyo ukuba ngabasebenzi abaqhutywa ngumsebenzi othile njengoko kufuneka, ukulawula ukwenzeka kweziganeko, ukubala iintshebe ngemihla ngemihla, ukuhlalutya iinkonzo ngeveki kunye nokubhala ngokumisela ngenyanga. Hlomelanisa impendulo kwiziganeko ezinkulu kunye nokuphahlazeka kweziganeko ezinamandla, qinisekisa ukuba kukho ngxoxo elungileyo nabantu nabaphathi bevenkile, ukwenza amanqanaba abaphathi ababambe iqondo eliphezulu, ukubuyisa ngokubuchwephetshe nokubhala iingxaki ezikhangelewa emva kwesiganeko ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iziganeko, iicelo ezikhangelewa ezirekhodwe kwaye ezibhalwe ngokubaluleka kwazo, ezabelwe, ezixazululwe kwaye ezivalwe ngokuchanekileyo ngokwesiphelo esamkelekileyo senkonzo yonke. Gcina ukuphathwa kolawulo kweenkqubo esezingeniso, ukuxhaswa, ukusetyenziswa koluntu, uluhlu lwabathathi nxaxheba, kunye nolwazi lolawulo olusebenzayo kulwawulo lwazo zonke iinkonzo ezibalulekileyo. Qinisekisa ukufumaneka kwenkonzo, ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokulinganiseleka kwemisebenzi yonke nobuchule babuchwephetshe. Qwalasela ngokukhawuleza ukufumaneka nokusebenza kakuhle iinkonzo ezibalulekileyo ze-ICT ezibandakanya imiba ekulawuleni kwaye udibe iitrendi, ukungalunga kwezinto, iindawo ezikwingozi ekulawuleni kwaye uqonde iingozi ngaphambi kokuba zibe nengozi kwinkonzo. Lawula ukuqwalaselwa nokusebenza ngokulinganiseleka kweendawo zokubala, iinkcukacha, amadatha ezikwazimba, iindlela ezihamba ngazo, i-middleware ezisetyenziswa ekwaziseni, kunye nolunye ulawulo lweendawo ezisebenzayo zokulinganiseleka nokugqithiswa kwamagunya ngokwemigaqo yoshishino nokuguqulwa ngokwezasaphesheya kwamaphulo.

jobs.title: Professional Surveyor
jobs.salary_text: R791 604 per annum, (The salary will be determined in accordance with the OSD)
jobs.summary: Professional Surveyor position in Bloemfontein requiring a Bachelor's degree in Survey or Geomatics and SAGC registration, offering R791604 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a four-year Bachelor of Science or Bachelor’s Degree in Survey / Geomatics. Compulsory registration with South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as Professional Surveyor on appointment and Compulsory registration with South African Geomatics Council as Professional Land Surveyor to perform cadastral surveys. Minimum of 3 years post qualification survey experience required. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management, Survey design and analysis knowledge, Research and development, Computer-aided survey applications, Legal compliance, Technical report writing, Creating high-performance culture, Networking and Professional judgement. Job related skills: Decision making, Team leadership, Analytical, Creativity, Self–management, Financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy, Planning and organising, Conflict management, Problem solving and analysis, People management, Change management and Innovation.
jobs.duties: Plan and perform surveys to solve practical survey problems (challenges) to improve efficiency and enhance safety. Investigate applications on new and existing technologies. Plan and perform surveys of a complex nature. Develop cost effective solutions and approve surveys according to prescribed requirements/standards. Promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Provide professional advisory and support services. Develop tender specifications. Provide human capital development services. Ensure training and development of Candidate Professional Surveyors. To promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound survey principles and code of practice. Supervise the survey work and processes. Administer performance management and development. Render office administration and budget planning. Manage resources, prepare and consolidate inputs for the facilitation of resource utilisation. Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement and personnel administration. Monitor and control expenditure. Report on expenditure and service delivery. Conduct research and development. Provide continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research / literature studies on survey technology to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies / councils on survey-related matters.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 136 Charlotte Maxeke Street, SA Eagle Building, Bloemfontein, 9300 or by email to Post341@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Professionele Landmeter
af.summary: Professionele Landmeter-pos in Bloemfontein vereis 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Landmeting of Geomatika en SAGC-registrasie, bied R791604 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n vierjarige Baccalaureus in die Natuurwetenskappe of 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Landmeting / Geomatika. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as Professionele Landmeter by aanstelling en verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council as Professionele Landmeter om kadastrale opmetings uit te voer. Minimum van 3 jaar na-kwalifikasie landmetingservaring vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur, Kennis van opmetingsontwerp en -analise, Navorsing en ontwikkeling, Rekenaargesteunde opmetingstoepassings, Regsonderhouding, Tegniese verslagdoening, Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur, Netwerkbou en professionele oordeel. Werksverwante vaardighede: Besluitneming, Spanleierskap, Analities, Kreatiwiteit, Selfbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Kliëntfokus en reaksvermoë, Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid, Beplanning en organisering, Konflikbestuur, Probleemoplossing en -analise, Mensebestuur, Veranderingsbestuur en Innovasie.
af.duties: Beplan en voer opmetings uit om praktiese opmetingsprobleme (uitdagings) op te los om doeltreffendheid te verbeter en veiligheid te verhoog. Ondersoek toepassings van nuwe en bestaande tegnologieë. Beplan en voer opmetings van 'n komplekse aard uit. Ontwikkel kostedoeltreffende oplossings en keur opmetings goed volgens voorgeskrewe vereistes/standaarde. Bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatiewe vereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te lyf. Verskaf professionele advies- en bystandsdienste. Ontwikkel tender spesifikasies. Verskaf menslikekapitaalontwikkelingsdienste. Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van Kandidaat Professionele Landmeters. Bevordel vaardigheids/kennisoordrag en nakoming van gesonde opmetingsbeginsels en kode van praktyk. Hou toesig oor die opmetingswerk en -prosesse. Administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling. Lewer kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning. Bestuur hulpbronne, berei insette voor en konsolideer dit vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting. Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging en personeeladministrasie. Monitor en beheer uitgawes. Rapporteer oor uitgawes en dienslewering. Voer navorsing en ontwikkeling uit. Verskaf deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Doen navorsing / literatuurstudies oor opmetingstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met tersaaklike liggame / rade oor opmetingsverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Umsili Wekhono Lesokulinganisa
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsili wekhono lesokulinganisa eBloemfontein esidinga iziqu ze-Bachelor's degree ezifundeni zesokulinganisa noma i-Geomatics nokubhaliswa kwi-SAGC, sinikeza iholo le-R791604 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwako: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor of Science emnyaka wesine noma iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree ezifundeni zesokulinganisa / i-Geomatics. Ukubhaliswa okuyisimfuneko ku-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengomuntu osebenza ngobuchwepheshe besokulinganisa ngesikhathi sokwamukelwa nokubhaliswa okuyisimfunemo ku-South African Geomatics Council njengomlinganisi wezomhlaba osebenza ngobuchwepheshe ukwenza izokulinganisa izomhlaba. Kudingeka ungaqedile impesheni yesokulinganisa eminyakeni engu-3 ngemuva kokuthola iziqu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela nokuphatha amaprojekhi kanye nalezi zinhlelo, Ulwazi lokuqaqa nokuhlaziya isokulinganisa, Ucwaningo nentuthuko, Izinhlelo zesokulinganisa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuziphatha ngokusemthethweni, Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe, Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu, Ukuxhumana nokubeka izinqumo zobungcweti. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izinqumo, Ukuba ngumholi wethimba, Ukuhlaziya, Ubuciko, Ukuzilawula, Ukuphatha imali, Ukugxila kubahlayo nokusabela, Unxibelelwano (olwenziwayo nolubhaliwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Ukuphatha izinkinga, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, Ukuphatha abantu, Ukuphatha inguquko kanye Nentuthuko.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi wenze izokulinganisa ukuxazulula izinkinga zesokulinganisa ezibucayi ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle kokulinganisa futhi kube yikhuphuke inqwaba. Phenya izicelo zobuchwepheshe obusha kanye nalokho okuvelele. Hlela futhi wenze izokulinganisa ezinkulu. Bula izixazululo ezingabiza kakhulu futhi vuma izokulinganisa ngokulandelwa kwezidingo / izinga. Khuthaza inqwaba ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho kanye namagunya. Hlola imanuali zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, izidayegimu ezinkimbinkimbi kanye namasu ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obusha. Nikeza ngeluleko lobuchwepheshe nemisebenzi yokwesekwa. Bula izinkomba zemali ethengiswayo. Nikeza ngemisebenzi yokuthuthukisa abantu. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabafuna ukuba ngabalungisi besokulinganisa. Ukukhuthazwa kokudluliswa kolwazi/abaholi bokuqonda nokulandelwa kwezimiso okuhle zesokulinganisa kanye nomthetho wokuziphatha. Qaphela imisebenzi kanye namasu esokulinganisa. Phatha imisebenzi yokulawula ukwenza okuhle kanye nokuthuthukiswa. Nikezela ngokulawula ihhovisi nokuqamba imali. Phatha abantu, hlela futhi uhlanganise okufakwayo ukubhekisisa ukuhlobene nemisebenzi emihle. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa koomthetho namagunya ngokuthenga nokulawula izindlu zokugcina imali. Qaphela futhi ulawule imali. Yimibiko ngemali kanye namandla okwenza umsebenzi. Yenza ucwaningo nokuthuthuka. Hlola ukuthuthukiswa okuphelele ngobuchwepheshe kubuhlale oqaphele ubuchwepheshe obusha. Cwaningo / ucwaningo okushicilelwe ngesayensi yokulinganisa ukuze kube khona iziqu ezinkulu. Hlola kubaholi / kwabafaka ucwaningo ngezinto ezimalana nesokulinganisa.

xh.title: Umlinganisi weNgingqi
xh.summary: Isikhundla somMlinganisi weNgingqi esithi eBloemfontein esifuna izidanga zeBachelor kwinguquko yeSurvey okanye iGeomatics nokubhalisa kwi-SAGC, sinika umvuzo we-R791604 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Certificate yeGrade 12 kunye ne-Bachelor of Science yeminyaka emine okanye i-Bachelor's Degree kwi-Survey / Geomatics. Kubalulekile ukubhalisa kwi-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengoMlinganisi weNgingqi ochwebileyo ngelixa behlala kwisikhundla nokuba kubalulekile ukubhalisa kwi-South African Geomatics Council njengoMlinganisi weZiqa zeMhlaba ochwebileyo ukuze enze iinguquko ze-cadastral. Kufuneka kubekho amava okulinganisa emva kokuqeqeshwa okungeni ngaphezulu kweminyaka emi-3. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo, Ulwazi lokuyila nokuhlaluhlwa iinguquko, Uphononongo nentlutho, Izicelo zekhompyutha ezisiza kokuqhuba iinguquko, Ukuhambelana nomthetho, Ukubhala iingxelo ezingcali, Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngokumgangatho ophezulu, Ukwakhiwa kweeth日work kunye nokuqamba. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izigqibo, Ukuqonda iqela, Ukuhlaluhlwa, Ukudala, Ulawulo lwakho, Ulawulo lwemali, Ukuqonda abathengi nokuphendula, Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ucululo lolungiselelo, Ulawulo loonxibelelwano, Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlaluhlwa, Ulawulo labantu, Ulawulo lotshintsho noQqobo.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa ukuze wenze iinguquko ukusombulula iingxaki ezibucayi zokulinganisa (iingxaki) ukuphucula ukusebenza kakuhle nokuthuthuzeza ukhuseleko. Phonononga izicelo kwiiteknoloji ezintsha nakhona ezisele zikhona. Cwangcisa ukwenza iinguquko ezibucayi ngokwimo yazo. Phucula iisombulu ezibiza kakhulu pezu kwaye uvume iinguquko ngokwemfuno/inkqubo. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokwemfuno yomthetho nangokwemigaqo. Hlola iimanual ezikho, iizelo zokuqamba iinkqubo ukuzibandakanya iiteknoloji ezintsha. Nikeza iinkonzo ezinengcali zengcali nokuxhasa. Ziqa iinkqubo ze-tender. Nikeza iinkonzo zokuphucula abantu. Qinisekisa ukuqeqesha nentlutho kuma-Candidate Professional Surveyors. Khuthaza ukuququnjelwa kolwazi/ukudluliselwa kolwazi nokuhambelana nemigaqo engcali yolulinganiso nekhowudi yokwenza. Lawula umsebenzi wokulinganisa iingqobo. Lawula ulawulo lokusebenza kakuhle nentlutho. Nikeza olunye ulawulo kwindlu yomsebenzi nokuqamba ibheji. Lawula izixhobo, lungiselela ukuqamba iingongoma ukuncedisa ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana nemigaqo nolawulo lokuThenga nolawulo lwabantu. Qapha ulawulo lokusebenza kakuhle. Songa iinkxwabo kumsebenzi wokuhlawula iinkonzo. Qeqesha ngophononongo nentlutho. Nikeza nentlutho eqhubekayo yokugcina ulwazi lwakho ngeetecknoloji ezintsha. Phenya iitechnoloji zokulinganisa ukuphucula ukungcali. Xhumana nemiqulu / amakhomishani ngokwemiba yokulinganisa.

jobs.title: Chief Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst
jobs.summary: Chief Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst coordinating organisational performance reporting, requiring a National Diploma and three years' M&E experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Social Sciences / Development Studies / Public Administration / Public Management or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years' experience in monitoring and evaluation, research or strategic planning. A valid driver's licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the government wide monitoring and evaluation system. Knowledge of government monitoring and evaluation policies, standard operating procedures, tools, information systems, planning, research methodology and related legislation. Treasury regulations. Performance auditing. Project and programme management. Quality improvement. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Ability to present. Report writing ability. Communication (verbal and written). Interpersonal relations. Project and programme management. Information collection, analysis and interpretation. Analytical thinking. Ability to customise and package information to user requirements. Ability to travel.
jobs.duties: Coordinate organisational performance against predetermined objectives. Provide input during the department planning process. Schedule performance verifications sessions with programmes on a quarterly basis. Conduct information verification on performance information. Prepare performance verification reporting tools. Conduct feedback sessions with various programmes to reflect on performance for decision making. Assist with the development of frameworks, guidance and systems to facilitate departmental programme performance monitoring. Coordinate organisational performance reporting. Compile departmental programme performance reports (quarterly, mid-year and annual) based on verified performance. Compile strategic and ad-hoc reports. Coordinate audit requests relating to performance information. Manage branch responses to audit requests, findings and queries. Compile management responses to audit findings / queries. Capacitate branches on the fundamentals of performance auditing. Conduct capacity building / training on management of performance information. Conduct capacity building on reporting. Make presentation on the management of portfolio of evidence.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 1st Floor, 270 Jabu Ndlovu Street (formerly known as Loop Street), Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or by email to Post339@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with disabilities.

af.title: Hoofmonitering- en evalueringsontleder
af.summary: Hoofmonitering- en evalueringsontleder wat organisatoriese prestasieverslae koördineer, vereis 'n Nasionale Diploma en drie jaar se M&E-ervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur of verwante equivalent kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in monitering en evaluering, navorsing of strategiese beplanning. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis en begrip van die regeringsbrede moniterings- en evalueringsisteem. Kennis van regeringsbeleid vir monitering en evaluering, standaardbedryfsprosedures, gereedskap, inligtingstelsels, beplanning, navorsingsmetodologie en verwante wetgewing. Tesourieregulasies. Prestasie-ouditering. Projeks- en programbestuur. Kwaliteitsverbetering. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om voorleggings te doen. Verslagskryfvermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Tussenmenslike verhoudings. Projeks- en programbestuur. Inligtinginsameling, -ontleding en -interpretasie. Analitiese denke. Vermoë om inligting volgens gebruikersvereistes aan te pas en in te pak. Vermoë om te reis.
af.duties: Koördineer organisatoriese prestasie teenoor voorafbepaalde doelwitte. Verskaf insette tydens die departement se beplanningsproses.
