Sabela izidanga. Hlulahlula kwaye uhlole / linganisa izidanga ukusetyenziswa kwaye uhlela uluhlu lokusetyenziswa. Yabela izidanga ngokwemiSebenzi namaqela kuBaPandi. Lilise amatawuni / iiketshezhi / izicwangciso / ukulungiswa okuchanekileyo nezidanga ezikhawulezayo ezabelwe. Hlola iingxelo ze-DOTS ngeengxaki nezidanga ezingazelelwayo kwaye uqale izinyuzelo zolungiselelo. Sebenzisa izinyuzelo ukusombulula imisebenzi ezele.

jobs.title: Senior Examiners
jobs.summary: Senior Examiners examine deeds and documents for registrability, checking compliance with practice and legislation at the Eastern Cape office in Qonce.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB or related equivalent qualification. 3 years’ experience in first level examination of deeds and documents. Job- related knowledge: Knowledge of deeds registration processes and procedures. Interpretation of statutes. Examination of Deeds. Human Resource prescripts. Project Management. Property Law. Job-related skills: Computer literacy skills. Communication skills. Organising skills. Problem solving skills. Interpersonal skills. Report writing. Supervisory skills. People Management skills. Interpretation skills. Analytical skills. Presentation skills.
jobs.duties: Examine deeds and documents. Check that first level examination duties have been performed and initiate corrective measures where necessary. Examine deeds for registrability, advise conveyancers about non-compliance with practice, procedures and legislation then pass or reject deeds and documents. Compile quality assurance report, take appropriate interventions and submit. Update acts, manuals and circulars. Training of subordinates. Conduct person- to- person training and keep training schedule and submit. Nominate subordinates for deeds training courses. Consult with clients relating to deeds and documents. Discuss notes with Conveyancers and provide guidance. Check the deeds for compliance and remove notes. Distribute deeds. Sort and assess / value deeds for distribution and compile distribution list. Distribute deeds according to transactions and batches to Examiners. Monitor allocated townships / schemes / rosters / corrective maintenance and expedited deeds. Analyse DOTS reports on discrepancies and outstanding deeds and initiate corrective measures. Implement measures to address backlogs.
jobs.enquiries: Ms VC Bomela / Mr P Sabasaba Tel No: (043) 642 2741
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Eastern Cape Deeds Registry: Qonce at 113 Alexander Road, Qonce, 5600, Eastern Cape. Candidates are also encouraged to apply by using this link http://deedsportal.deeds.gov.za (Please separate Application Form for each post) before the closing date as no late applications will be considered
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured, and Indian Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Senior Eksamineerders
af.summary: Senior Eksamineerders ondersoek aktes en dokumente vir registrasiebaarheid en kontroleer nakoming van praktyk en wetgewing by die Eastern Cape-kantoor in Qonce.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regte / Nasionale Diploma Akteregistrasie Reg / Buri / B Proc / LLB of 'n verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasisie hê. 3 jaar se ervaring in eerste vlak ondersoek van aktes en dokumente. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van akteregistrasieprosesse en -prosedures. Interpretasie van statuut. Ondersoek van aktes. Menslike hulpbronne voorskrifte. Projekbestuur. Eiendomsreg. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Organisasievaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Toesighoudende vaardighede. Mensebestuursvaardighede. Interpretasievaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Ondersoek aktes en dokumente. Kontroleer dat eerste vlak ondersoekpligte uitgevoer is en inisieer korrektiewe maatreëls waar nodig. Ondersoek aktes vir registrasiebaarheid, stel verpligters in kennis van nie-nakoming van praktyk, prosedures en wetgewing en keur dan aktes en dokumente goed of verwerp dit. Stel gehalteversekeringsverslag op, neem toepaslike ingrypende maatreëls en dien dit in. Werk wette, handleidings en sirkulères by. Opleiding van ondergeskiktes. Voer persoon-tot-persoon opleiding uit, hou opleidingskedule by en dien dit in. Benoem ondergeskiktes vir akte-opleidingskursusse. Raadpleeg kliënte rakende aktes en dokumente. Bespreek notities met Verpligters en gee leiding. Kontroleer aktes vir nakoming en verwyder notities. Versprei aktes. Sorteer en waardeer aktes vir verspreiding en stel verspreidingslys op. Versprei aktes volgens transaksies en groepe na Eksamineerders. Monitor toegekende dorpe/skemas/roosters/korrektiewe onderhoud en versnelde aktes. Analiseer DOTS-verslae oor teenstrydighede en uitstaande aktes en inisieer korrektiewe maatreëls. Implementeer maatreëls om agterstande aan te spreek.

zu.title: Abahloli Abaphakeme
zu.summary: Abahloli Abaphakeme bahlole amadili namadokhumenti ukuze abone ukuthi angabhaliswa kanjani, baphenise ukuziphatha ngokomthetho nemikhakha e-Eastern Cape eQonce.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB noma iziqu eziyisidingo ezihlobene nalezo. Ukhulelwe eminyakeni engu-3 ohloleni amadili namadokhumenti esigaba sokuqala. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwenqubo yokubhaliswa kwamadili. Ukuhumusha umthetho. Ukuhlola amadili. Imibhalo ephathwa ngabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Umthetho wezimpahla. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okusebenza ngakomphakathi. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuhlela. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono abantu. Ukubhala imibhalo. Amakhono okulawula. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Amakhono okuhumusha. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhano okubukusa.
zu.duties: Hlola amadili namadokhumenti. Hlola ukuthi imisebenzi yokuhlola esigaba sokuqala yenziwe yini futhi qalisa izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Hlola amadili ukuzobona ukuthi angabhaliswa kanjani, elulele abadluliselayo ngokungahambisani nemikhuba, inqubo nomthetho bese udlulisa noma uwala amadili namadokhumenti. Hlanganisa umbhalo wokuqinisekisa khwalithi, thatha izinyathelo ezifanele futhi uze unikele. Buyekeza umthetho, imibhalo kanye nemiyalo. Ukuqeqesha abangaphansi kwakho. Yenza ukuqeqesha komuntu-ku-muntu ugcine uhlelo lokuqeqesha futhi unikele. Phakamisa abangaphansi kwakho ukuya kumafomu eqeqeshwa amadili. Xoxa namakhasimodi ngokuphathelene namadili namadokhumenti. Xoxa izikhumbuzi nabadayiliselayo bese unikeza isiqondiso. Hlola amadili ukuthi ahambisana yini bese ususa izikhumbuzi. Sabelisa amadili. Hlela futhi hlinza/hlola ibali lamadili ukuze asabeliswe futhi uhlanganise uhlu lokusabeliswa. Sabelisa amadili ngokwemigomo namamaphakethe kubahlole. Qaphela izakhiwo ezabelwe / izimiso / ohlelo / ukulungiswa okufanele kanye namadili ayesekaleni. Hlola umbhalo we-DOTS ngezinto ezingahambisani namadili asalele bese uqalisa izinyathelo zokulungisa. Sebenzisa izinyathelo ukulawula imisebenzi ekelele.

xh.title: Abahloli Abakhulu
xh.summary: Abahloli Abakholu bahola izidanga namaxwebhu ukujongwa kokubhaliswa, bajonge ukuzaliseka kweenkqubo nomthetho e-ofisini yase Eastern Cape e Qonce.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafakelisayo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12 kwaye benе National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nazo ezingulinganisana. 3 iminyaka yamava kwinqanaba lokuqala lokuhola izidanga namaxwebhu. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lweenkqubo nendlela zokubhaliswa kwezidanga. Ingcaciso yomthetho. Ukuholwa kwezidanga. Amagama oBuntu abambe izinto. Uqondo-Lweziprojekthi. UMthetho wePropati. Amakhono anxulumene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okusebenza nekhompyutha. Amakhono ekuThetha-njalo. Amakhono okuLunga-isa. Amakhono oKusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono phakathi kwabantu. Ukubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okuLawula. Amakhono okuLawula abantu. Amakhono ekuCacisa. Amakhono okuHlola. Amakhono okuBhentsa.
xh.duties: Hlola izidanga namaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yokuhola kwinqanaba lokuqala yenziwe kwaye uqalise izigibo zolungiso apho kufuneka khona. Hlola izidanga ukuzaliseka kokubhaliswa, uxelele ababhalisi ngokungazaliseki kwinkqubo, iinkqubo nomthetho uze udlule okanye walinge izidanga namaxwebhu. Hlaza ingxelo yokuqinisekisa umgangatho, thatha izigibo ezifanelekileyo kwaye uzinike. Hlaziya iindlela zomthetho, iimanuali namajelo. Ukulolonga abantu abangaphantsi kwakho. Yenza uqeqesho lokuqondana nemehlo nobuso, gcina ijelo leqesho kwaye lwenike. Phakamisa abantu abangaphantsi kwakho ukuba babambe iinkqubo zokuqeqeshwa kwezidanga. Phakamisa abantu abangaphantsi kwakho kwizikolo zokuqeqeshwa kwezidanga. Thetha nabathengi ngezidanga namaxwebhu. Thetha ngamagama nabaBhalisi kwaye unike isikhokelo. Hlola izidanga ukuzaliseka kwaye ususe amagama. Sabelisa izidanga. Hlela kwaye uhlole / xabisise izidanga ezisabeliswayo kwaye uhlele uluhlu lokusabelisa. Sabelisa izidanga ngokwemisebenzi namaqela kubaHloli. Qaphela amadolophu / iindawo / iirosta / ukulungisa okuchaziweyo nendlela ezisheshisiyo ezelwe izidanga. Hlala ngokucokisa iingxelo ze DOTS ngeengxaki nangezidanga ezingazange kubhalwe, uze uqalise izigibo zolungiso. Zisa izigibo zokubuyisela imisebenzi engagqitywanga.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner
jobs.summary: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner needed in Pretoria to implement SCM policies, administer bids and provide secretariat services to bid committees, requiring a diploma and 2 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Purchasing Management / Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Economics / Public Administration (Management) / Business Management (Administration) (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 2 years' experience in the demand and acquisition management environment. A valid driver's licence. Job related knowledge: Public Finance Management Act. Treasury Regulations. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) and its associated regulations. Department Supply Chain Management (SCM) procurement and policy. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Interpersonal relations. Administration ability. Communication (verbal and written). Ability to supervise. Ability to work within a team and work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Implement standard operating procedures, SCM policy and delegations of authority in bids unit. Adhere to the SCM prescripts for all bidding processed. Render advisory and secretariat services to appointed specification and bid evaluation committee meetings. Render Bids administration. Render advisory and secretariat services to appointed specification and bid evaluation committee meetings. Prepare bid documents. Partake and ensure adherence to SCM prescripts during specification meetings. Arrange and attend briefing sessions. Close and open tenders. Conduct compliance checks on bid proposals received. Arrange and attend evaluation sessions. Prepare bid evaluation reports. Present bid evaluation reports to the Bid Adjudication Committee (BAC). Prepare management information, statistics and reporting on Bids. Provide weekly reports on progress of projects. Update the bid register. Ensure effective administration and finalisation of National Bid Adjudication Committee (NBAC) processes. Prepare NBAC agendas and compile and distribute complete meeting packs at least three working days before scheduled meetings. Attend NBAC meetings and accurately record, finalise and maintain committee minutes and resolutions. Communicate approved bid decisions and submissions to all relevant stakeholders within two working days of NBAC approval.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post337@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner
af.summary: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner word in Pretoria benodig om SCM-beleid te implementeer, tenders te administreer en sekretariatsdienste aan tenderkomitees te verskaf, met 'n diploma en 2 jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Inkoopbestuur / Supply Chain Management / Logistieke Bestuur / Ekonomie / Publieke Administrasie (Bestuur) / Besigheidsbestuur (Administrasie) (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante equivalente kwalifikasie. Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in die aanvraag- en verkrygingsbestuursomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Public Finance Management Act. Treasury Regulations. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) en die geassosieerde regulasies daarvan. Departement Supply Chain Management (SCM) verkryging en beleid. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Administratiewe vermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om te toesien. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk en onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Implementeer standaard bedryfsprosedures, SCM-beleid en gesagsdelegasies in die tendereenheid. Hou by die SCM-voorskrifte vir alle tenderprosesse. Verskaf adviserings- en sekretariatsdienste aan aangestelde spesifikasie- en tenderevalueringskomiteevergaderings. Verskaf tenderadministrasie. Verskaf adviserings- en sekretariatsdienste aan aangestelde spesifikasie- en tenderevalueringskomiteevergaderings. Berei tenderdokumente voor. Neem deel en verseker nakoming van SCM-voorskrifte tydens spesifikasievergaderings. Reël en woon inligtingsessies by. Sluit en open tenders. Voer nakomingskontroles op ontvangde tender voorstelle uit. Reël en woon evalueringsessies by. Berei tenderevalueringverslae voor. Dien tenderevalueringverslae aan die Bid Adjudication Committee (BAC) voor. Berei bestuursinligting, statistieke en verslagdoening oor tenders voor. Verskaf weeklikse verslae oor die vordering van projekte. Werk die tenderregister by. Verseker effektiewe administrasie en finalisering van National Bid Adjudication Committee (NBAC) prosesse. Berei NBAC-agenda's voor en stel en versprei volledige vergaderingpakke ten minste drie werksdae voor geskeduleerde vergaderings. Woon NBAC-vergaderings by en neem, finaliseer en onderhou komitee-notules en besluite akkuraat op. Kommunikeer goedgekeurde tenderbesluite en voorleggings aan alle relevante belanghebbendes binne twee werksdae van NBAC-goedkeuring.

zu.title: Umphathi Ophakeme Wokulawula Ukutholwa Kwezimpahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Ophakeme Wokulawula Ukutholwa Kwezimpahla ePretoria ukuphatha izinqubomgomo ze-SCM, ukulawula izikweletu kanye nokunikeza izinsizakalo zokuba yenkomishani kumakomidi esikweletu, kadinga idiploma kanye namava eminyaka emi-2.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neNational Diploma ekuphathweni kokuthenga / ekuphathweni kwenqwaba yokuhlinzeka / ekuphathweni kwezokuhamba kwezimpahla / ezomnotho / ekuphathweni kazwelonke (abaphathi) / ekuphathweni kwezabhishobhoshi (izabelo) (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezingabalinganiswa ezihlobene nalokhu. Umkhathi wamava eminyaka emi-2 esimeni sokuphatha isidingo nokuqoqwa kwezimpahla. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ebhekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Umthetho Wokuphatha Izimali Zomphakathi. Izilawuli Zeqolo Lemali. Umthetho Wensimbi Yohlelo Lokuthenga Oluncintisana (PPPFA) kanye nemithetho ehambisana nawo. Inqubomgomo yokuthenga nokulawula kwenqwaba yokuhlinzeka (SCM) kuyo yonke iminyango. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukubhala nokuqonda ikhompuyutha. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ikhono lokulawula. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ikhono lokubusa. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini kanye nokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinamazwi.
zu.duties: Phatha izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza, inqubomgomo ye-SCM kanye nezinkulungwane zamandla euniti yezikweletu. Landela imiyalo ye-SCM yonke imikhuba yokucubungula izikweletu. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuweluleka kanye nokuba yenkomishani emihlanganweni yomkomidi ohlelelwe wemiyalo nokuqoqa izikweletu. Lawula izikweletu. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuweluleka kanye nokuba yenkomishani emihlanganweni yomkomidi ohlelelwe wemiyalo nokuqoqa izikweletu. Lungiselela amadokhumenti ezikweletu. Thatha inxaxheba futhi qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemiyalo ye-SCM ngesikhathi somhlangano wemiyalo. Hlela futhi thamela izinkomba zokwazisa. Vala futhi vula izikweletu. Yenza ukuhlola ukuzigcoba kumaphakamisowe ezikweletu etholwe. Hlela futhi thamela izingqungquthela zokuqoqwa. Lungiselela umbiko wokuqoqwa kwesikweletu. Yethula imibiko yokuqoqwa kwesikweletu kuKomidi Lokwahlulela Isikweletu (BAC). Lungiselela ulwazi lolawulo, izibalo kanye nokuqoqa imibiko ngesikweletu. Nikeza imibiko yamasonto onke ngomgwankoma wezinhlelo. Buyekeza ukubhaliswa kwesikweletu. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kanye nokugqitywa kwenqubo yeKomidi Likazwelonke Lokwahlulela Isikweletu (NBAC). Lungiselela ajenda ye-NBAC bese uhlanganisa futhi usabalalisa amaphakhi aqediwe okuhlangana okungenani izinsuku ezintathu zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuba kuhlelwe imihlangano. Thamela imihlangano ye-NBAC bese ubhalisa ngokunembile, uqeda futhi ulondoloze imizuzu kanye nezinqumo zomkomidi. Xhumisa izinqumo nezinkethulo ezivunyiwe zezikweletu kubo bonke abahloniphile abahlobene kungakapheli izinsuku ezimbili zokusebenza kusukela esivumweni se-NBAC.

xh.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Womsebenzi Wokusinikwa kwezinto
xh.summary: Kufunekwa Umphathi Omkhulu Womsebenzi Wokusinikwa kwezinto ePretoria ukuphumeza iinkqubo ze-SCM, ukulawula izityalo kwaye unikeze iinkonzo zesikwili kumakomiti ezityalo, kwaye kufuneka afumane idiploma aneminyaka eli-2 yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seGraji 6 kwaye beNesidiploma saseZiko eNqanaba leSizwe ekulawulweni kokuThenga / ekulawulweni kokuNikwa kwezinto ekuqhelekeni / ekulawulweni kwezinto ezingeniswa nasezithunyelwe / kwezoQoqosho / ekuLawulweni koBulungiswa ngoBube baseNyanga / ekuLawulweni kweNhlangano (NQF Level 6) okanye isifanekedana esinxulumene nako. Unyaka olungaphantsi kwe-2 bamava kwendalo yokuLawula kwamava nokuthengwa. Iilayisenisi zokuQhuba eziyiyo. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu. IzaMiso zeNgqandela. I-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) nazaMiso eziqhagamshelwe nayo. Iinkqubo zokuThenga nokusebenzisa iNqobo eseBeni (SCM). Amakhono axhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iKompyutha. Ukuziqhelanisa nabantu. Isakhono seNkonzo yolawulo. Ikhomunikheyshini (eyathethwayo nedayilibhiweyo). Isakhono sokukhokelela. Isakhono sokuSebenza phakathi kothim noKusebenza ngocinezelo.
xh.duties: Phumeza iinkqubo ezingagqibekanga njalo zisebenzayo, iNqobo ye-SCM kunye nokuNikezela igunya ekwindulweni ezityalweni. Landela imiyalelo ye-SCM kuzo zonke iinkqubo zokuthengisa. Nikeza izixhobo zokuNcedisa ngeSikwili emabandla amiselweyo iinkqubo ezikumagqabantshintshi kunye neNqanaba lokuQwalasela izityalo. Lawula iziTtyalo iSikwili. Nikeza izixhobo zokuNcedisa ngeSikwili emabandla amiselweyo iinkqubo ezikumagqabantshintshi kunye neNqanaba lokuQwalasela izityalo. Lungiselela amaxwebhu ezityalo. Thatha inxaxheba kuqinisekise ulandelelwano emiyalweni ye-SCM kwinkqubo ekumagqabantshintshi. Cwangcisa uze uye kwindlela yokuQwalasela nokuTyhila. Vala uvule izityelo. Qwalasela ulawulo kwizityelo ezifunyenweyo. Cwangcisa uye kwindlela yokuQwalasela ezityalo. Lungiselela iingxelo zeNqanaba lokuQwalasela izityalo. Chineza iingxelo zeNqanaba lokuQwalasela ezityalo kwiBhunga lokuQwalasela amaPhulo (BAC). Lungiselela ulwazi oluLawulwayo, izibalo nokuChazwa ngamaphulo. Nikeza iingxelo zamaviki ngeNkqubo eziqhubekayo. Qwalasela ubukhulu beNqanaba lokuQwalasela amaPhulo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo kwaye uQwalasele iinkqubo zeNqanaba leBhunga eliQwalasela izityalo Elikwizinga leSizwe (NBAC). Lungiselela iNhlelo ze-NBAC kwaye uqokelele waba ulwahlulele ulwamaqokobhe emiboniso engaphantsi kweentsuku ezintathu ezisebenzayo ngaphambi kweemibonanisi ezicwangiweyo. Zama iNqanaba leBhunga eliQwalasela izityalo Elikwizinga leSizwe (NBAC) kwaye uqwalasele, uqinisekise kwaye ulondoloze amanqaku ebhunga kunye nezigqibo. Yazi isaZincwadi samaQulu esamkelekileyo kwaye uze neNqanaba leBhunga kuwo onke amachaphulelawu malunga namabangelo angaphantsi kweentsuku ezimbili ezingoomSebenzi emva kokuSetyenziswa i-NBAC.

jobs.title: Principal Cadastral Officer
jobs.summary: Principal Cadastral Officer needed in Bloemfontein to capture and maintain cadastral data, requiring a Geomatics qualification and six years of survey experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 6 years geomatics post qualification experience in a geomatics or cadastral survey environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Negotiation.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of for proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principles and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated (amended, endorsed or withdrawn) cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data. Carry out operations and do quality checking to ensure that the scanned image databases are clean and accurate.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 136 Charlotte Maxeke Street, SA Eagle Building, Bloemfontein, 9300 or by email to Post336@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Hoof Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Hoof Kadastrale Beampte word in Bloemfontein benodig om kadastrale data vas te lê en te onderhou, met 'n Geomatics-kwalifikasie en ses jaar se opmetingservaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimale vereistes: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics of 'n Survey Officer-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5) beskik. Minimum van 6 jaar se geomatics-kwalifikasie-ervaring na kwalifikasie in 'n geomatics- of kadastrale opmetingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Geographical Information Systems-sagteware en -grondbeginsels. Kennis van Surveyor-General's Office se Standard Operating Procedures en prosesse. Kennis van kadastrale opmetings. Werksverwante vaardighede: Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandeling.
af.duties: Lê alfanumeriese data van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente vas, onderhou en werk dit by. Lê alfa- en numeriese inligting van nuut ingediende kadastrale dokumente (eenvoudig en kompleks) vas en onderneem wiskundige konsekwensiekontroles en dataverifikasie van voorgestelde nuwe landperkele. Werk kadastrale opmetingsdatabasisse by deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument (eenvoudig en kompleks) om 'n elektroniese alfa-numeriese bewaarplek te onderhou. Lê eenvoudige en komplekse historiese kadastrale dokumente vas en verifieer dit. Hou hom/haar besig met ingewikkelde onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse. Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit op wettige instruksie. Trek af, kanselleer en enorseer kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landperkele, huurkontrakte of servitute. Hou hom/haar besig met komplekse wysigings van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Lê alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Haal kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggekeerde kadastrale rekords in. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in 'n goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer benamings van nuut ingediende lêings. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opmetingsrekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse seksionele titelplanne uit. Werk die kantaantekenvelle by deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landperkeel. Doen navorsing en verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte. Haal kadastrale inligting vir kliënte op en verskaf dit. Verskaf lugfoto's, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van National Geospatial Information (NGI) volgens ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Voer basiese navorsing oor kadastrale opmetingsinligting met betrekking tot landperkeelgrense vir kliënte en Land Reform uit. Lê ruimtelike data met eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente vas, onderhou en werk dit by. Lê nuut ingediende dokumente vas om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg data by, werk 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting by en onderhou dit, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Doen navorsing oor moontlike bronne van foute indien oorvleuelings bespeur word en spreek foute dienooreenkomstig aan. Gebruik kadastrale opmetingsberekeningsbeginsels en ander wettige databronne om die kwaliteit van landperkeelgrensinligting te verbeter. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, enorsement of onttrekking en voer gehaltekontrole uit. Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle bygewerkte (gewysigde, geëorseerde of onttrekte) kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data. Voer bedrywighede uit en doen gehaltekontrole om te verseker dat die geskandeerde beelddatabasisse skoon en akkuraat is.

zu.title: Isikhundla Esikhulu Sesikhungo Sokuhlola Izindawo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isikhundla Esikhulu Sesikhungo Sokuhlola Izindawo eBloemfontein ukugcina nobuyekeze imininingwane yesikhungo sokuhlola izindawo, okudinga izifundo zeGeomatics kanye neminyaka eyisithuphu yokuqashelwa kokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezela: Abafaka izimemo kumele babe nesitifikedi seGrade 12 kanye neNational Certificate kwiGeomatics noma isitifikedi seSurvey Officer (NQF Level 5). Okungenani iminyaka eyi6 yokuhlola ngemuva kokuthola izifundo kwindawo yamaza noma isikhungo sokuhlola izindawo. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngesoftuwe yeGeographical Information Systems kanye nokuqonda okuyisisekelo. Ulwazi ngemigomo nokuqashelwa okujwayelekile kweStandard Operating Procedures kweSurveyor-General's Office. Ulwazi nge-Cadastral Surveys. Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukukhokela iqembu. Ukudala. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela izinto. Ukuphatha izinxatshana. Ukuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Gcina, ulondoloze futhi ubuyekeze imininingwane yamanani namagama ayisinye noma eyinkimbinkimbi yamadokhumenti we-cadastral. Gcina imininingwane yamagama namanani kumadokhumenti we-cadastral athunyelwe njalo (ayisinye noma ayinkimbinkimbi) futhi wenze ukuhlola okuhlobene nokuhlukanisa izibalo kanye nokuqinisekisa imininingwane yamasimu amtsha aphakanyiswa. Buyekeza idathabhesi yosu le-cadastral ngokwengeza noma ulungise yonke idokhumenti evunyiwe (eyisinye noma eyinkimbinkimbi) ukuze ulondoloze indawo yamagama namanani eyikhompyutha. Gcina futhi uqinisekise amadokhumenti we-cadastral okuyisiko (eyisinye noma eyinkimbinkimbi). Yeqa konke okuyinkimbinkimbi ekulondolozeni amadokhumenti we-cadastral ngokuhambisana nemigomo esemthethweni. Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanselwa kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral ngenxaso yomthetho. Khisha, khansela futhi uqinisekise amadokhumenti we-cadastral anamasimu abhalisiwe, izinkontileka noma izibopho. Yeqa konke okuyinkimbinkimbi ekulungenisweni kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral avunyiwe nabhalisiwe. Faka wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral avunyiwe amtsha kwindawo yokugcina imininingwane. Khisha futhi unikeze amarekhodi we-cadastral. Phindela kubusha amarekhodi we-cadastral abuyisiwe. Lolola futhi ugcine amarekhodi we-cadastral esimweni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlola okunobuchwepheshe kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral ayisinye noma eyinkimbinkimbi. Hlola izinkomba zamafayela athunyelwe amtsha. Yenza ukuhlola okunobuchwepheshe kwediagrams ezinkimbinkimbi nakwezinkomba ezijwayelekile. Yenza ukuhlola okunobuchwepheshe kwamarekhodi we-surveys. Yenza ukuhlola okunobuchwepheshe kumapulani we-sectional title ayisinye noma eyinkimbinkimbi. Buyekeza amasheke e-noting ngokwengeza yonke into yamasimu we-cadastral evunyiwe. Phonononda futhi unikeze imininingwane ye-cadastral kumaklayenti bangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Khisha unikeze imininingwane ye-cadastral kumaklayenti. Nikeze izithombe ezithathwe esibhakabhakeni, izithombe ezilungisiwe namaphu kusuka ku-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokuhambisana nezivumelwano esayinwe ngamazinga okusebenza. Yenza ucwaningo oluyisisekelo ngemininingwane ye-cadastral survey ehlobene namasimu amasayizi kumaklayenti naku-Land Reform. Gcina, ulondoloze futhi ubuyekeze imininingwane yesikhala ngamadokhumenti we-cadastral ayisinye noma eyinkimbinkimbi. Gcina amadokhumenti athunyelwe amtsha ukuze ubone ukuthi akukho ukugqamana kwemininingwane yesikhala ngaphambi kokuvuma. Faka imininingwane, buyekeze futhi ulondoloze idathasethi echanekile yemininingwane yesikhala we-cadastral, okuhlanganisa ukwengeza kanye nokubuyekeza imininingwane yesikhala okuyisiko. Phonononda izindlela ezingaba yizipho izimpazamo uma kutholwa ukuthi kunokugqamana futhi uzilungise ngendlela efanele. Sebenzisa imigomo yokubala i-cadastral survey kanye nezinye izinto ezingasebenza zemithombo yemininingwane ukuthuthukisa izinga lemininingwane yokuhlola imingcele yamasimu. Skena wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral uma evunyiwe, ulungiswa, uqinisekiswa noma kushiwa futhi wenze ukuhlola izinga. Skena amadokhumenti we-cadastral amtsha avunyiwe. Phinda usskena wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral abuyekeziwe (alungisiwe, aqinisekisiwe noma akhishiwe). Xhumanisa izithombe ezigcinwe neskeni kumininingwane yamagama namanani. Yenza imisebenzi futhi uhlole izinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idathabhesi yesithombe eseskeni ihlaze kanti futhi ichanekile.

xh.title: Ofisi eNqanaba eliPhezulu le-Cadastral
xh.summary: Kufunekwa i-Principal Cadastral Officer eBloemfontein ukubamba kwaye igcine idatha yekhawuntada, ifuna isatifikate kwi-Geomatics neminyaka elithandathu yamava lokuvavanya.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abagcini kufuneka babe nesatifikate seGrade 12 nesisatifikate sika-National kwi-Geomatics okanye isatifikate se-Survey Officer (NQF Level 5). Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-6 yamava obugcisa i-Geomatics emva kwesatifikate kwindawo yokuvavanya i-geomatics okanye i-cadastral. Ilayiseni yokushweshela evunyiweyo. Ulwazi oluxhumanene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwe-Geographical Information Systems Software namaphandle ayo. Ulwazi lwe-Standard Operating Procedures nendlela zokusebenza kwi-Office yomlawuli-beSurveyor. Ulwazi lwe-Cadastral Surveys. Amandla axhumanene nomsebenzi: Ukuxazula iingcinga nokuqonda. Ukwenza isigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ukuyila. Ukunakwa abathengi nokuvela. Unxibelelwano (lwerhuqo nangokubhalwa). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukwakha nokuhlela. Ukuphatha iingxabano. Ukuxhumana.
xh.duties: Bamba, gcina kwaye uhlaziye idatha yamanani-alpha yamaxwebhu akhawuntada e-lula nakuwo ala angundoqo. Bamba iinkcukacha ze-alpha namanani kwamaxwebhu akhawuntada asentylwe kutsha (e-lula nangundoqo) kwaye wenze iikhitshi zokuqinisekisa ngokwezibalo kunye nokukqinisekisa idatha yamapasi entsha eceliweyo emhlabeni. Hlaziya iisiseko sezedatha zovavanyo lwekhawuntada ngokongeza okanye ulungise nawo nawuphi na uxwebhu olugunyaziweyo (olula nangundoqo) ukugcina indawo yamakhosithi e-alpha-numeric ngqononda. Bamba kwaye uqinisekise amaxwebhu abalulekileyo akhawuntada e-lula nangundoqo. Yiba nolwazi malunga nokugcina ngokwendlela amaxwebhu akhawuntada angenisa inkinga ngokomthetho. Wenze ukuyeka okanye ukurhoxisa amaxwebhu akhawuntada kwisiluleko esemthethweni. Gqiba, rhoxisa kwaye uqinisekise amaxwebhu akhawuntada anemapasi emhlaba abhalisiweyo, iilizi okanye iinkukhu. Yiba ngolwazi malunga nokulungisa amaxwebhu akhawuntada agunyaziweyo kwaye abhalisiweyo angundoqo. Faka onke amaxwebhu akhawuntada agunyaziweyo kutsha kwindawo yogcino. Khupha kwaye unikeze amaxwebhu akhawuntada. Buyisela kwakhona imixholo akhawuntada ebuyiselwayo. Lungisa kwaye ugcine imixholo akhawuntada ibe ndawonye nokusetyenziswa. Yenza uphando lobuchwepheshe kwamaxwebhu akhawuntada e-lula nangundoqo. Qinisekisa izihloko zokuze ezi zisentylwe kutsha. Yenza uphando lobuchwepheshe kumajigramu namaphula ajikelezi e-lula nangundoqo. Yenza uphando lobuchwepheshe kwimixholo yokuvavanya. Yenza uphando lobuchwepheshe kwiiplani ezilula nangundoqo ze-c沉title. Hlaziya amaphepha okubala ngokongeza iphasi ngamnye lonke umhlaba oceliweyo khawuntada ogunyaziweyo. Phanda kwaye uze idatha yokhawuntada kumaxhasa angaphakathi nangaphandle. Khupha kwaye unikeze idatha yokhawuntada kumaxhasa. Nikeza iifoto ezisemaphezulu, iifoto ezilungisiweyo namaphu kwi-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokwesivumelwano esityhaliweyo senekhasi lenkonzo. Yenza uphando olusiseko ngenkcazolo yokuvavanya ikhawuntada malunga nemida yamapasi emhlabeni kumaxhasa nakuLwangco loMhlaba. Bamba, gcina kwaye uhlaziye idatha yendawo namaxwebhu akhawuntada e-lula nangundoqo. Bamba amaxwebhu asentylwe kutsha ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho naziphi na iindawo ezingqamanayo ngaphambi kogunyaziso. Yongeza idatha, hlaziya kwaye ugcine iseti yedata enyani yedatha yokhawuntada yendawo, kuquka ukongeza nokuhlaziya idatha yembali. Phanda iimvelaphi ezinokuba zingenisa iimposiso xa kufunyanwa iindawo ezingqamanayo kwaye uzilungise ngokufanelekileyo. Sebenzisa iingcamango ezimalunga nokubala kuvavanyo lwekhawuntada namanye amaveli okudatha ukuze ulungele ngakumbi igiphi konke ulwazi lwendawo lomhlaba. Skeni onke amaxwebhu akhawuntada naxa egunyaziswa, elungiswa, eqinisekiswa okanye eqotywa, wenze ukukqinisekisa. Skani amaxwebhu akhawuntada agunyaziweyo esetyhwa kutsha. Skani ngokutsha onke amaxwebhu akhawuntada ahlaziyiweyo (alungisiweyo, aqinisekisiweyo okanye aqhuthiweyo). Qambanisa izifanekiso eskeniweyo ezifakiweyo kwidata yamanani-alpha. Yenza iintshukumo kwaye ukqinisekise ukuqinisekisa ukuba iisiseko zedatha ezifanekiso eskeniweyo zicocekile kwaye zinyani.

jobs.title: Survey Technician (GRADE A-C)
jobs.salary_text: R407 337 – R610 131 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with the OSD requirements)
jobs.summary: Survey Technician position in Bloemfontein requiring a National Diploma in Survey or Cartography, SAGC registration, and at least three years' technical survey experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Survey or Cartography (NQF Level 6). Compulsory registration with South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as a Survey Technician / Surveyor. Minimum of 3 years post qualification technical survey experience. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management. Survey design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided survey applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high-performance culture. Job related skills: Decision-making. Team leadership. Analytical Thinking. Creativity. Self-management. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Problem solving and analysis. People management. Innovation.
jobs.duties: Provide technical survey services and support. Provide technical services in terms of examination, maintenance, archiving and information supply of survey documents and submit for evaluation / approval by the relevant authority. Perform surveys and survey computations. Promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate plans, existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Provide Geographic Information System (GIS), mapping and information supply services. Perform administrative and related functions. Provide inputs into the budgeting process as required. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide and consolidate inputs to the technical survey operational plan. Develop, implement and maintain databases. Supervise and control Candidate Survey Technicians / Officers and related personnel and assets. Conduct research and development. Render continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research / literature studies on technical survey technology or new survey techniques to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on survey related matters.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 136 Charlotte Maxeke Street, SA Eagle Building, Bloemfontein, 9300 or by email to Post335@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Opmetingskomstegnikus (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Opmetingskomstegnikuspos in Bloemfontein waarvoor 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opmeting of Kartografie, SAGC-registrasie en ten minste drie jaar se tegniese opmetingservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opmeting of Kartografie (NQF Vlak 6). Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Opmetingskomstegnikus / Opmetingskundige. Minimum van 3 jaar se na-kwalifikasie tegniese opmetingservaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van opmetingsontwerp en -ontleding. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde opmetingstoepassings. Kennis van regsvoortvordering. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Analitiese denke. Kreatiwiteit. Selfbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Probleemoplossing en -ontleding. Mensebestuur. Innovering.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese opmetingsdienste en -ondersteuning. Verskaf tegniese dienste ten opsigte van ondersoek, onderhoud, argivering en verskaffing van inligting van opmetingsdokumente en dien dit vir evaluering / goedkeuring deur die betrokke owerheid in. Voer opmetings en opmetingsberekeninge uit. Beveel veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes aan. Evalueer planne, bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verskaf Geographic Information System (GIS)-, karterings- en inligtingsverskaffingsdienste. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses soos vereis. Stel verslae op en dien dit soos vereis in. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese opmetingsoperasionele plan. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse. Hou toesig en beheer oor Kandidaat-opmetingskomstegnieke / -amptenare en verwante personeel en bates. Voer navorsing en ontwikkeling uit. Lewer deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Doen navorsing / literatuurstudies oor tegniese opmetingstegnologie of nuwe opmetingstegnieke om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor opmetingsverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Injiniyah Techinishi Yezinhloli (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Isikhundla seNjiniyah Techinishi Yezinhloli eBloemfontein esidinga iNational Diploma kwiSurvey noma iCartography, ukubhalisa kwiSAGC, kanye nocwaningo lweminye emithathu yemisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe yokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenwa: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe neGrade 12 Certificate kanye neNational Diploma kwiSurvey noma iCartography (NQF Level 6). Ukubhaliswa ngokuphothulekileko eSouth African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengeSurvey Technician / Surveyor. Okungenani eminye emithathu yemisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe yokuhlola ngemva kokuthola isiqinisekiso. Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Eziphathwayo nezinhlelo zomsebenzi. Ulwazi lokuklama nokuhlaziya ukuhlolwa. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zekhompyutha zokusiza ukwenza ukuhlolwa. Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuholwa iqembu. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukudala. Ukuzeahlulisie. Ukuqashelela imali. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nokubhaliwe). Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphatha impixano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuqasha abantu. Intuthuko.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zezobuchwepheshe zokuqasha kanye nokwesekwa. Nikeza izinsiza zobuchwepheshe maqondana nokuhlola, ukulondoloba, ukugcina emafayela kanye nokunikezelwa kolwazi lwamadokhumenti okuqashwa bese uhatshela ukuqashwa / ukugunyazwa ngumnyango ofanele. Yenza ukuhlolwa nokubala okuqashiwe. Khuthaza ukuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho nezomthetho. Hlola izinhlela, imanuali zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, okuzodiwa okujwayelekile kanye nezindlela ukwenzela ukufakaobuchwepheshe obusha. Nikeza izinsiza zeGeographic Information System (GIS), ukuklama nemephu kanye nokunikezelwa kolwazi. Yenza imisebenzi yentengo kanye neminye ehlobene nalo. Nikeza okufakiwe kuleso sinqubo sokwenza izinqema njengoba kudingwa. Hlela bese uhambela imibiko njengoba kudingwa. Nikeza bese uhlanganisa okufakiwe ohlelweni lwebhalo lobuchwepheshe. Bukela, phumeza bese ulondoloza izinsele. Qaphisa bese ulawula abaThisha Bofuzu beSurvey / Abasebenzi kanye neminye imisebenzi ehlobene namafa. Yenza ucwaningo nentuthuko. Nikeza intuthuko obungavunyelwa yokuba ulandele ubuchwepheshe bezinzingo nobusha. Yenza ucwaningo / izifundo zoxo kubuchwepheshe beSurvey noma amatechniki amusha weSurvey ukuze uthuthukise khono. Xhumana namaphoyinti/iziphathi ekuqasheni ngemicabango ekuqashiwe.

xh.title: Umchweli wokuLinganisa (GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Isithuba somchweli wokulinganisa kwiBloemfontein esifuna iNational Diploma kwiSurvey okanye iCartography, ukubhalisa kwiSAGC, namacva angazifaka phantsi emisebenzini yobuchweli wokulinganisa emva kweminyaka elithathu ubuncinane.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingunaphakade: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neGrade 12 Certificate neNational Diploma kwiSurvey okanye iCartography (NQF Level 6). Ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengomchweli wokulinganisa / umlinganisi ngumthetho. Unyaka abangeleyo ubuncinane bemisebenzi yobuchweli bokulinganisa emva kokugqiba izifundo. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlotshaniswa nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi loluhlalutyo nokuyila iimvavanyo zokulinganisa. Uphando nophuhliso. Izicelo zekhompyutha ezisetyenziswa kwimizinganiselo yokulinganisa. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yokuzalathisa ngokomthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchweli. Ukudala inkqubo yentsimo ephakamileyo. Amakhono ahlotshaniswa nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ukuqonda ngokuhlalutyo. Ukuyila. Ukuqonda nokuzilawula. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ulwazi lokusebenza nekhompyutha. Ukucazulula izicwangciso nokuqamba. Ulawulo looyakho. Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Ulawulo labantu. Izinto ezitsha.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngeenkqubo zobuchweli bokulinganisa ngenkxaso. Kubonelele ngemisebenzi yobuchweli malunga nokuqonda, ukugcina, ukulondoloza iifayile nokubonelela nolwazi lwamaxwebhu okulinganisa kwaye azithunyelwe kuqondisiso / kuvunywe ngumbi othile. Kwenze iimilinganiselo nokubala imilinganiselo yemisebenzi yokulinganisa. Kukhuthaze ukhuseleko ngokweemfuno zemithetho nakumagunya. Kuqondiswe iiplani, iimanuali zobuchweli ezikhoyo, iimelo ezingagqibekanga neenkqubo zokuzekelela iitechinoloji ezitsha. Kubonelele ngeenkqubo zeGeographic Information System (GIS), ukumapa nokubonelela ngenkxaso yolwazi. Kwenziwe imisebenzi yolawulo nokuqhotho. Kubonelele ngenkcazelo kumaxwebhu ukuqamba inkqubo emalunga namaxa imali njengoko kufuneka. Kudityanisiwe kwaye kuthunyelwe iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Kubonelele kwaye kudityanisiswe iinkcazelo kwinkqubo yomsebenzi wobuchweli bokulinganisa. Kudalwe, kusebenziswe kwaye kugcinwe iidathabheysi. Kulawulwe kwaye kuqatywe abafundi bomchweli wokulinganisa / abasebenzi abahlobene nabo nezinto. Kwenziwe uphando nophuhliso. Kubonelele ngophuhliso olungapheliyo lobuchweli ukuze kusolwe neteknoloji nantlandlelo ezitsha. Kwenziwe uphando / ukufunda iincwadi ngeteknologi yobuchweli bokulinganisa okanye iindlela ezitsha zokulinganisa ukuze kuphuculwe ulwazi. Kwenziwe unxibelelwano namabody / amakhomitye ahlobene nemiba yokulinganisa.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner
jobs.summary: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner at the Eastern Cape Deeds Registry in Qonce, requiring a National Diploma and two years' SCM experience, offering R413 001 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Supply Chain Management / Public Management / Public Administration / Logistics / Purchasing Management or a related equivalent qualification. 2 years’ experience in Supply Chain Management environment. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (PMFA). Treasury Regulations. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Preferential Procurement Regulations. Supply Chain Management Framework. Black Broad-based Economic Empowerment Act. Computer Literacy. Interpersonal skills. Administration skills. Written and verbal communication skills. Presentation skills. Supervisory skills. Time Management.
jobs.duties: Administer procurement of goods and services. Consolidate inputs and compile DMP. Preview specifications / terms of reference for goods and services. Evaluate / Review quotations and submit for adjudication. Review receipting of goods and services rendered. Review payment batch on the system. Verify invoices with purchase order and liaise with service provider with regards to discrepancies on invoices. Verify / provide comments on the outstanding requisition, purchase order and accrual report. Administer the stores. Conduct spot check to determine deficits / surpluses and redundant items and compile disposal / write-off memorandum. Verify and recommend stocks issuing and replenishment of stock. Oversee the stocktaking process and provide comments on the variances. Supervise the administration of contracts. Facilitate signing and acceptance of contracts. Monitor performance of contractors. Oversee expiry and renewal of contracts and advise. Check the updating of contract register. Administer the verification of assets. Provide assets inputs during compilation and reviewing of DMP. Provide inputs on the drafting of asset specifications / TOR. Verify quantity and quality against purchase order and countersign delivery note. Authorize updated inventory list. Compile maintenance and warranty register. Draft asset verification plan and submit Reconcile asset verification report with asset register. Investigate and provide comments on verification reports and R1 value asset. Compile disposal / write-offs register and draft memorandum. Control physical disposal of assets. Reconcile asset disposal/write-offs report with asset register. Draft report on the loss of assets. Manage government-owned vehicle. Facilitate issuing of vehicle and trip authorization. Conduct inspection of vehicles. Arrange vehicle service maintenance and repairs. Compile report of utilisation of vehicle. Submit report for accidents and loss of fuel cards/keys on vehicle.
jobs.enquiries: Ms VC Bomela / Mr P Sabasaba Tel No: (043) 642 2741
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Eastern Cape Deeds Registry: Qonce at 113 Alexander Road, Qonce, 5600, Eastern Cape. Candidates are also encouraged to apply by using this link http://deedsportal.deeds.gov.za (Please separate Application Form for each post) before the closing date as no late applications will be considered.
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and white Males, and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and Persons with Disabilities

af.title: Senior Voorsieningskettingpraktisyn
af.summary: Senior Voorsieningskettingpraktisyn by die Eastern Cape Deeds Registry in Qonce, vereis 'n Nasionale Diploma en twee jaar se VBK-ervaring, bied R413 001 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Openbare Bestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Logistiek / Aankopebestuur of 'n verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie. 2 jaar se ervaring in 'n Voorsieningskettingbestuursomgewing. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PMFA). Tesourie Regulasies. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Preferential Procurement Regulations. Supply Chain Management Framework. Black Broad-based Economic Empowerment Act. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Administratiewe vaardighede. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Voorleggingsvaardighede. Toesighoudende vaardighede. Tydbestuur.
af.duties: Administreer die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Konsolideer insette en stel DMP op. Hersien spesifikasies / verwysingsterme vir goedere en dienste. Evalueer / hersien kwotasies en dien ter beoordeling in. Hersien die ontvangs van goedere en gelewerde dienste. Hersien die betalingbondel op die stelsel. Verifieer fakture met die bestelbon en skakel met die diensverskaffer ten opsigte van teenstrydighede op fakture. Verifieer / verskaf kommentaar op die uitstaande bestelversoeke, bestelbonne en aankoopverslag. Administreer die stores. Voer steekproewe uit om tekorte / surplusse en oortollige items te bepaal en stel 'n beskikking / afskrywingmemo randum op. Verifieer en beveel die uitreiking en aanvulling van voorraad aan. Hou toesig oor die voorraadopnemingsproses en verskaf kommentaar op die afwykings. Hou toesig oor die administrasie van kontrakte. Fasiliteer die ondertekening en aanvaarding van kontrakte. Monitor die prestasie van kontrakteurs. Hou toesig oor die verval en hernuwing van kontrakte en gee advies. Kontroleer die opdatering van die kontrakregister. Administreer die verifikasie van bates. Verskaf batesinsette tydens die opstelling en hersiening van DMP. Verskaf insette oor die opstel van batspesifikasies / TOR. Verifieer hoeveelheid en kwaliteit teen bestelbon en teken afleweringsnota. Magtig opgedateerde voorraadlys. Stel onderhouds- en waarborgregister op. Stel bateverifikasieplan op en dien in. Versoen bateverifikasieverslag met bate register. Ondersoek en verskaf kommentaar op verifikasi verslae en R1-waarde bate. Stel beskikkings / afskrywingregister op en stel memorandum op. Beheer fisiese beskikking van bates. Versoen batebesikkings / afskrywingsverslag met bater register. Stel verslag op oor die verlies van bates. Bestuur staatsbesitde voertuig. Fasiliteer uitreiking van voertuig en ritmagtiging. Voer inspeksie van voertuie uit. Reël voertuigdiensonderhoud en herstelwerk. Stel verslag op oor benutting van voertuig. Dien verslag in vir ongelukke en verlies van brandstofkaarte / sleutels op voertuig.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wokusenezwa Kwentambo Yokuhlinzwa
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu Wokusenezwa Kwentambo Yokuhlinzwa e-Eastern Cape Deeds Registry e-Qonce, ofuna i-National Diploma neminyaka emibili yemisipho ye-SCM, ethola i-R413 001 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafakiswa kumele babe ne-Sathifikethi se-Grade 12 ne-National Diploma kwi-Supply Chain Management / Public Management / Public Administration / Logistics / Purchasing Management noma isiqu esihlobene esilinganelayo. Unyaka o-2 wemisipho emhlabeni we-Supply Chain Management. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PMFA). I-Treasury Regulations. I-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). I-Preferential Procurement Regulations. Isakhiwo Se-Supply Chain Management. I-Black Broad-based Economic Empowerment Act. Ukubhalisele ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuphatha. Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma. Amakhono okwethula. Amakhono okubeka abanye emsebenzini. Ukuphatha isikhathi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthenga impahla nezinsizakalo. Hlanganisa okufakiwe uhluze uDMP. Buza izici / amagama okubhekisela kubo ngempahla nezinsizakalo. Hlola / Phinda ubuke imibhalo yentengo ushayele ekwahlulelweni. Phinda ubuke ukwamukelwa kwempahla nezinsizakalo ezinikiwe. Phinda ubuke isibambeli sokukhokha esisistimeni. Qinisekisa amafomu okukhokha ngesibambelo soku-thenga uxhumane nenikeli ngesibambelo ngokwezinkinga ezisemafomu okukhokha. Qinisekisa / nikezela izikombiso ezisakele, isibambelo soku-thenga nokubika kokuhlolana. Phatha izitolo. Yenza ukuhlolwa okungazele ukuthola imali ekushodelwe / eningile nemphahla engasasebenzi uhluze imemo yokulahla / ukubhala ukungasebenzi. Qinisekisa futhi uphakamise ukukhishwa kwempahla nokugcwaliswa kwesitolo. Buka inqubo yokuqinisekisa impahla unikeze izikombiso ngokungahambisani. Beka abanye emsebenzini ekuphathweni kwezinkontileka. Yenza kube lula ukusayina nokwamukela izinkontileka. Buka ukusebenza kwabathuli. Buka ukuphela nokubuyekezwa kwezinkontileka uphakamise. Hlola ukubuyekezwa kwesibuki sezinkontileka. Phatha ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla. Nikeza okufakiwe kwempahla ngesikhathi sokuhluza nokubuyekeza i-DMP. Nikeza okufakiwe ekubhalweni kwezici zempahla / iTOR. Qinisekisa inani nobujumbo ngesibambelo soku-thenga usayine isibuki sokuhambisa. Gunyaza uhlu olusha lokugcinwa kwempahla. Hluze ukubhaliswa kokulondoloza nokwesikhathi. Hluza isu lokuqinisekisa impahla ushayele uNgqamise umbiko wokuqinisekisa impahla nesibuki sokugcinwa kwempahla. Phenya futhi unikeze izikombiso emibikweni yokuqinisekisa nase-R1 value asset. Hluza isibuki sokulahla / ukubhala ukungasebenzi uhluze imemo. Lawula ukulahwa kwempahla ngokoqobo. Ngqamisa umbiko wokulahwa kwempahla / ukungasebenzi nesibuki sokugcinwa kwempahla. Hluza umbiko ngokulahleka kwempahla. Phatha isithuthi sikahulumeni. Yenza kube lula ukukhiqizwa kwesithuthi negunya lokuhamba. Yenza ukuvivinya izithuthi. Hlela ukugcinwa nokulungiswa kwesithuthi. Hluza umbiko wokusetshenziswa kwesithuthi. Shiyela umbiko ngamacala nokulahleka kwamakhadi oku-fuel / okhiye esithuthini.

xh.title: UmPraktishani Ophakamileyo Wokuqokelela nokuHambisa iLifa
xh.summary: UmPraktishani Ophakamileyo Wokuqokelela nokuHambisa iLifa kwi-Eastern Cape Deeds Registry eQonce, efuna i-National Diploma neminyaka emi-2 yamava kwi-SCM, inika umvuzo we-R413 001 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona: Kufuneka abafaka isicelo babe ne-Satifikethi se-Grade 12 kunye ne-National Diploma kwi-Supply Chain Management / Public Management / Public Administration / Logistics / Purchasing Management okanye isifanekiso esihambelanayo. Iminyaka emi-2 yamava kwindlu yokuqokelela nokuHambisa iLifa. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PMFA). I-Treasury Regulations. I-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). I-Preferential Procurement Regulations. I-Supply Chain Management Framework. I-Black Broad-based Economic Empowerment Act. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuziphatha nabantu. Amandla okulawula. Amandla okubhala nokuthetha. Amandla okubonisa. Amandla okulawula abanye. Ukulawula ixesha.
xh.duties: Lawula izinto nezinkonzo ezithengiswa. Qhoboshela izixhobo zenkqubo kwaye udibe i-DMP. Jonga kabini izicwangciso / amagama okubhekiswa kuzo izinto nezinkonzo. Hlola / Phinda ujonge iikotyisi kwaye uzithumele ukuba zihlolywe. Hlola ukufikelelwa kwezinto nokwenziwa kwezinkonzo. Hlola iqela lemalayo yokuhlawulwa kwinkqubo. Qinisekisa iimali eziyimfaku ngempaka yokuthenga kwaye unxibelelane neMninigweezinkonzo malunga nokungahambelani kwezimali eziyimfaku. Qinisekisa / Nikela izimvo malunga nesicelo, impaka yokuthenga negxelo le-nxuszelayo ezingagqitywanga. Lawula indawo yokugcinwa kwezinto. Yenza ukukhangela ngokukhawuleza ukumisela iindleko ezingekho / ezongezelekileyo nezinto ezingasafuneki kwaye ulungise imemo yokuphela kokusetshenziswa / yokubhalwa kancinci. Qinisekisa kwaye ucele ukunikwa kwendalo ezikhundleni zemizekelo ephelileyo. Qhoboshela inkqubo yokubala izinto kwaye unike izimvo malunga nokungahambelani. Lawula ulawulo lwezontrato. Yenza isikhululo sokusayina nokwamkelwa kwezontrato. Lilisele inkqubo yabanye abathengisi. Qhoboshela ukuphela nokubhalwa kwakhona kwezontrato kwaye uxelixele. Khangela ukuhlaziwa kwegunya lezontrato. Lawula ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla. Nikela izixhobo ngexesha lokulungisa nokuqwalasela i-DMP. Nikela izimvo kwinkqubo yokulungisa iinkcukacha zempahla / TOR. Qinisekisa ukwingqale nokulungisa ngokwe-oda lokuthenga kwaye usayine edibanisayo inqaku le-ukulethwa kwempahla. Vumela uhlu oluhlaziyiweyo lweempahla. Yenza irejista yokwonga nokuqinisekisa imali kaqobo. Bhala icebo lokukhangela iimpahla kwaye ulithumele. Dibanisa igxelo lokukhangela iimpahla negunya lempahla. Phando kwaye nike izimvo kwamagxelo okuqinisekisa iimpahla ezimala yi-R1. Lungelelana igxelo lokuphela kokusetshenziswa / ukubhalwa kancinci negunya lempahla. Bhala imemo yokuphela kokusetshenziswa / ukubhalwa kancinci. Lawula ukuphela kokusetshenziswa iimpahla. Lungiselela igxelo lokuphela kokusetshenziswa iimpahla / ukubhalwa kancinci negunya lempahla. Bhala igxelo ngokulahlekelwa iimpahla. Lawula isithuthi sikarhulumente. Yenza isikhululo sokunikwa kwesithuthi nokuqinisekiswa kwendlela. Yenza ukuqwalasela kwezithuthi. Hlela inkonzo yokulungiswa nokulungiswa kwezithuthi. Yenza igxelo lokusetshenziswa kwesithuthi. Thumela igxelo ngezingozi nokulahlekelwa ngekhadi lemalifyulekhi / izitshixo kwesithuthi.

jobs.title: Junior Examiner
jobs.summary: Junior Examiner sought in Qonce to prepare and examine deeds, verify registration information, and complete endorsements, requiring a National Diploma in Law or LLB with no prior experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Law / National Diploma Deeds Registration Law / Buris / B Proc / LLB. No experience required. Job-related knowledge: Knowledge deeds registration processes and procedures. Interpretation of statutes. Examination of Deeds. Property Law. Job-related skills: Computer skills. Communication skills. Organising skills. Problem solving. Interpersonal skills. Time Management. Interpretation skills. Numerical skills.
jobs.duties: Prepare deeds for examination. Link batches, endorse deeds and complete all the endorsements. Verify registration information against data information. Complete fee endorsement, indicate exemption category and authority. Examine deeds and document. Check the correctness of the drafting of deeds. Raise notes referring to the relevant authority. Check compliance of notes on re-lodged deeds and remove notes if complied. Attend to rectification of office errors. File updated acts, manuals and circulars. Complete notification form/caveat endorsement for other sections (diagram, etc). Verify registration information. Check and interpret interdicts, and record details thereof. Check and interpret sectional titles files. Raise queries if non complied and endorse deeds. Check and interpret township files, general plan and ensure that appropriate title conditions/servitudes are brought forward. Consult with clients relating to deeds and documents. Discuss notes with Conveyancers and provide guidance. Check the deeds compliance and remove notes. Distribution of deeds and documents. Count, balance deeds with lodgements / DOTS slip and scan deeds. Sort and distribute deeds according to transactions and batches to Examiners. Distribute assignment slips to examiners. Record townships, sectional schemes, rosters, corrective maintenance and expedited deeds.
