af.title: Junior-eksamineerder
af.summary: Junior-eksamineerder gesoek in Qonce om aktes voor te berei en te eksamineer, registrasie-inligting te verifieer en endossemente te voltooi, met 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regte of LLB en geen vorige ervaring vereis nie.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Regte / Nasionale Diploma Akteregistrasiereg / Buris / B Proc / LLB hê. Geen ervaring nodig. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van akteregistrasieprosesse en prosedures. Interpretasie van wette. Eksaminering van aktes. Eiendomsreg. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Organisasievaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Tydbestuur. Interpretasievaardighede. Numeriese vaardighede.
af.duties: Berei aktes voor vir eksaminering. Skakel bondels, endosseer aktes en voltooi al die endossemente. Verifieer registrasie-inligting teen data-inligting. Voltooi fooiendossement, dui vrystellingskategorie en gesag aan. Eksamineer aktes en dokumente. Kontroleer die korrektheid van die opstel van aktes. Lig beswaare op met verwysing na die tersaaklike gesag. Kontroleer nakoming van beswaare op heringediende aktes en verwyder beswaare indien nagekom. Behou uitsluitlik regstelling van kantoorfoute. Lê opgedateerde wette, handleidings en sirkulêres. Voltooi kennigsewingsvorm/voorsorg-endossement vir ander afdelings (diagram, ens.). Verifieer registrasie-inligting. Kontroleer en interpreteer interdikte, en neem details daarvan op. Kontroleer en interpreteer seksietitel-lêers. Lig navrae op indien nie nagekom nie en endosseer aktes. Kontroleer en interpreteer dorpslêers, algemene plan en verseker dat toepaslike titelvoorwaardes/servitute oorgedra word. Raadpleeg kliënte rakende aktes en dokumente. Bespreek beswaare met transporteurs en verskaf leiding. Kontroleer die nakoming van aktes en verwyder beswaare. Verspreiding van aktes en dokumente. Tel, balanseer aktes met indienings / DOTS-bewys en skandeer aktes. Sorteer en versprei aktes volgens transaksies en bondels na eksamineerders. Versprei opdragbewyse aan eksamineerders. Neem dorpe, sekieskemas, roosters, korrigerende instandhouding en versnelde aktes op.

zu.title: Umlawlana Ohlola
zu.summary: Umlawlana Ohlola funwa eQonce ukuze alungise futhi ahole izitifiketi, aqinisekise ulwazi lokubhalisa, futhi agcibe izinkomashi, edinga i-Diploma Yezwe eMthethweni noma i-LLB ngaphandle kokutholakala kokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe eMthethweni / i-Diploma Yezwe Yokubhalisa Izitifiketi / i-Buris / i-B Proc / i-LLB. Akukho okuhlangenwe nakho okudingekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwenqubo nezindlela zokubhalisa izitifiketi. Ukuhumusha izindleko zemithetho. Ukuhlola Izitifiketi. Umthetho Wephathwa. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono wekhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuhlela. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhano abantu. Ukuphathwa Kwesikhathi. Amakhono okuhumusha. Amakhano ezinombolo.
zu.duties: Lungisa izitifiketi ukuze zihlolwe. Xhumanisa amaqembu, yenza izinkomashi kuzo zonke izitifiketi uphinde ugcibe yonke izinkomashi. Qinisekisa ulwazi lokubhalisa ngokuhlobene nolwazi lwedatha. Gciba inkomashi yefuthi, khombisa isigaba sokukhishwa negunya. Hlola izitifiketi nomaxwebhu. Hlola ukulunga kokubhalwa kwezitifiketi. Phakamisa izinkomba ezibhekise enkombeni egunyaziwe. Hlola ukuzinza kwezinkomba kuzitifiketi ezilayishwe kabusha bese ususa izinkomba uma sezizinze. Luzisa ekulungiseni amaphutha ohhovisi. Gcina izenzo ezibushiwe, izikhokelo kanye nezikhashana. Gciba ifomu lesaziso/inkomashi yesixwayiso kwezinye izingxenye (idayigramu, njl). Qinisekisa ulwazi lokubhalisa. Hlola uphinde uhumushe izilandiso, bese uligcina ulwazi ngalawo. Hlola uphinde uhumushe amafayela wezihloko ezinqamlezile. Phakamisa imibuzo uma ingazinze bese usenza izinkomashi ezitifiketini. Hlola uphude uhumushe amafayela esithili, iplenini jikelele bese uqinisekisa ukuthi izimo zesihloko ezifanele/amasimendi ahambiswe phambili. Xoxa namakhasimayidi ngemitsho yezitifiketi namaxwebhu. Xoxa izinkomba no-Abameli bezekela izitifiketi bese unika isihalo. Hlola ukuzinza kwezitifiketi bese ususa izinkomba. Ukuhamba izitifiketi namaxwebhu. Bala, linganisa izitifiketi ngokulayishwa / islipu ye-DOTS bese useskena izitifiketi. Hlela bese uhamba izitifiketi ngokwezinkundla zomthengiswa namaqembu kubahlole. Hambisa amaslipu okukabashaywe kubahlole. Qhatha imitholama, amasimu abahlakaniphile, okuhleliwe, ukulungiswa okulungisayo nezitifiketi ezisheshisiwe.

xh.title: Umhloli Ochaszayo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umhloli ochaszayo eQonce ukulungisa nokuhlola iziqulathi-zixelo, ukuqinisekisa ulwazi lwabhaliswa, nokuqedela izigqibo, kufuneka iNdiploma yesiLwanga kuMthetho okanye i-LLB ngaphandle kokugqithileyo kwamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi sama-Grade 12 nayo Ndiploma yesiLwanga kuMthetho / iNdiploma yesiLwanga ekuBhalisweni kweziQulathi-zixelo / i-Buris / i-B Proc / i-LLB. Akukho mciliza ofunekayo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kolwimi: Ulwazi ngamanyathelo nokuqhubeka kokuBhaliswa kweziQulathi-zixelo. Ukucazulula kwemithetho. Ukuhlola kweziQulathi-zixelo. uMthetho weZinto. Amakhono asebenzayo: Amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono ekuthethana. Amakhono ekulungiseleleni. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono abantu. uLawulo lwexesha. Amakhono ukucazulula. Amakhono ezibalo.
xh.duties: Lungisa iziqulathi-zixelo ukuzihlola. Qqamanisa amaqela, qinisekisa iziqulathi-zixelo uze uqedele onke amaqinisekiso. Qinisekisa ulwazi lokubhaliswa kwixesha elifanayo kolwazi. Qedela uqinisekiso lemali, khomba isigaba sokuqheshiswa nengunya. Hlola iziqulathi-zixelo namaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukulunga kokubhalwa kweziqulathi-zixelo. Phakamisa iziphawusi ezithumela kundebe egqithisayo. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kweziphawusi kweziqulathi-zixelo ezifakwe kwakhona ususe iziphawusi ukuba sezalisekile. Yenza isigqibo kwiimpazamo zofesi. Gcina ngokuhlaziyiwa imithetho yabasebenzi, iimanuals namakhesithi. Qedela ifomu yokwazisa/uqinisekiso lokhwayo kolunye iphando (umzobo, nokunye). Qinisekisa ulwazi lokubhaliswa. Khola uze ucazule iithybano, uze ulugcine ulwazi ngazo. Khola uze ucazule iifayili zezihloko. Phakamisa imibuzo ukuba ingazalisekanga uze uqinisekise iziqulathi-zixelo. Khola uze ucazule iifayili zamaphakathi, izicwangciso ezibanzi uze uqinisekisa ukuba iimeko zesihloko/iinkonzo ezifanelekileyo zisihamba phambili. Phathisana nabathengi ngokwaleminigqinisiso namaxwebhu. Thetha ngeziphawusi namaConveyancers uze unikeze inkqwelisano. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kweziqulathi-zixelo uze ususe iziphawusi. Ulwahlulo lweziqulathi-zixelo namaxwebhu. Bala, linganisa iziqulathi-zixelo ngokwefomu lokungena / i slip ye-DOTS uze uskena iziqulathi-zixelo. Hlela uze uwise iziqulathi-zixelo ngokomyalelo weemveliso nangeeqela kubahli. Wisa ama slip okwabelo kubahli. Qaphela amaphakathi, iisikimu ezingaphakathi, izikhokelo, ulungiso lokulungiselela nemveliso ezibilikayo kweziqulathi-zixelo.

jobs.title: State Accountant
jobs.summary: State Accountant at Level 07 in Kimberley processing BAS, PERSAL and LOGIS transactions, requiring a National Diploma in Finance or Accounting and at least one year of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Cost and Management Accounting / Financial Management / Commerce / Economics / BCom Accounting or related equivalent qualifications. Minimum of 1 year relevant experience in management accounting environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury or Financial Regulations of the Public Finance Act. PERSAL, Basic Accounting System (BAS) and Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Job related skills: Analytical thinking. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Report writing and problem solving.
jobs.duties: Process BAS, PERSAL and LOGIS transactions. Check, verify payment and capture on BAS. Approve PERSAL transactions. Maintain budget (shifting of funds). Compile, capture, or approve journals. Reconcile travel agency account. Ascertain invoices received. Reconcile / analyse key accounts. Accumulate synopsis report (age analysis). Compile financial reports. Compile and submit inputs and Port Folio of Evidence (POEs) on financial reports (accruals and payables reports). Provide input on invoices paid within 30 days. Compile Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) inputs. Process petty cash and revenue collections. Check and sign petty cash replenishment and balance cash on hand. Facilitate petty cash count and report. Perform daily deposit confirmations.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Magistrate Court Building, 6th floor, Knight Street, Corner of Stead Street, Kimberley, 8300 or by email to Post340@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Staatrekenmeester
af.summary: Staatrekenmeester op Vlak 07 in Kimberley wat BAS-, PERSAL- en LOGIS-transaksies verwerk, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Finansies of Rekeningkunde vereis en ten minste een jaar se relevante ondervinding.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Koste- en Bestuursrekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Handel / Ekonomie / BCom Rekeningkunde of verwante ewekwaardige kwalifikasies. Minimum van 1 jaar relevante ondervinding in 'n bestuursrekeningkundige omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Posverwante kennis: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury- of Finansiële Regulasies van die Public Finance Act. PERSAL, Basic Accounting System (BAS) en Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Posverwante vaardighede: Analitiese denke. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagskrywing en probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Verwerk BAS-, PERSAL- en LOGIS-transaksies. Kontroleer, verifieer betalings en voer dit op BAS in. Keur PERSAL-transaksies goed. Onderhou begroting (verskuiwing van fondse). Stel joernale op, voer dit in of keur dit goed. Her reconcilieer reisagentskaprekening. bepaal fakture wat ontvang is. Her reconcilieer / ontleed sleutelrekeninge. Akkumuleer sinopsisverslag (ouderdomsanise). Stel finansiële verslae op. Stel insette en Portefeulje van Getuienis (POE's) oor finansiële verslae op en dien dit in (voorsienings- en betaalbare verslae). Verskaf insette oor fakture wat binne 30 dae betaal is. Stel Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) insette op. Verwerk kleingeld en inkomsteinvorderings. Kontroleer en teken kleingeldaanvulling en balanseer kontant op hand. Fasiliteer kleingeldtelling en verslag doen. Voer daaglikse deposito-bevestigings uit.

zu.title: Isiphathimndeni Sezwe
zu.summary: Isiphathimndeni Sezwe esibekiwe ku-izinga 07 e-Kimberley esebenzisa izinkokhelo ze-BAS, ze-PERSAL neze-LOGIS, esifuna i-Diploma Yezwe kwezezezimali noma Ezobuhlengamazwi kanti futhi sifuna okungenani unyaka oyedwa wolesipiliyoni ohlobene nalokhu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane okudingekayo: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe ekubaleni izindleko nokuqashwa kwezimali / Ezokuphatha kwezezimali / Ezentengiso / Izenzululwazi kwezomnotho / I-BCom Ezobuhlengamazwi noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezihlobene nalokhu. Okungenani unyaka oyedwa wolesipiliyoni ohlobene nendawo yokuphatha izimali. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Umthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi. Umthetho Wokuphatha Izezimali Zomphakathi. Umthetho Wohlelo Lwenqubomgomo YokuThatha Okuthandwa. Imlandela Wezimali noma Imitshayelo Yezimali Yomthetho Wezezimali Zomphakathi. I-PERSAL, Isistimu Esisisiseko Sokubala Izimali (BAS) kanye Nesistimu Yolwazi Lozosebenza (LOGIS). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nokubhala). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala okubikwayo nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Sebenzisa izinkokhelo ze-BAS, ze-PERSAL neze-LOGIS. Hlola, qinisekisa ukukhokha bese ufake ku-BAS. Vumela izinkokhelo ze-PERSAL. Gcina umtholampilo (ukushintsha imali). Hlanganisa, faka, noma vumela okubhalwayo. Linganisela i-akhawunti yophetha uhambo. Qinisekisa izifakelo ezitholiwe. Linganisela / hlaziya izi-akhawunti eziyisihluthi. Qoqa umbiko wokuqukethwe (uhlalutyo lwebanga). Hlanganisa imibiko yezimali. Hlanganisa futhi uhwele okufakwayo kanye Nefayela Lesibonakaliso (POEs) kumibiko yezimali (imibiko yezimali ezofakwayo nezezimali ezikhokhekile). Nikeza okufakwayo ngalezimali eziyisifakelo ezikhokhiwe kungakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30. Hlanganisa okufakwayo kwe-Lawula Wokusebenziswa Ixaxheba Esikhathini Esiphakathi (MTEF), Okulinganisiwe Kokusebenziswa Ixaxheba Kazwelonke (ENE), Okulungisiwe Okulinganisiwe Kokusebenziswa Ixaxheba Kazwelonke (AENE). Sebenzisa imali encane kanye nokuqoqwa kwezimali ezifinyelelwayo. Hlola futhi usayine ukuze igcwaliswe imali encane bese ulinganisa imali esandleni. Qondisa ukubala imali encane buse umnikelo umbiko. Yenza konfirmatha yosuku lokufaka imali esibhange.

xh.title: I-State Accountant
xh.summary: I-State Accountant kwi-Lvel 07 e Kimberley ecwangcisa iinguqulelo ze-BAS, ze-PERSAL nazo ze-LOGIS, efunayo i-National Diploma kwi-Finance okanye i-Accounting ngenyanga unyaka wonke wobugcisa obahambelanayo nobuncinane.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafakeli kufunelikuba banayo i-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kunye ne-National Diploma kwi-Cost and Management Accounting / Financial Management / Commerce / Economics / BCom Accounting okanye izifundo ezincamelayo. Imonyaka yeminyaka engama-1 yamava afanelekileyo kwindawo yophatho lwe-akhawunti ye-mali. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlotshaniswa nomsebenzi: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury okanye i-Financial Regulations ye-Public Finance Act. I-PERSAL, Basic Accounting System (BAS) kunye ne-Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Amandla ohlotshaniswa nomsebenzi: Ukucinga ngokuhlalahlaza. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwa). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala iingxelo kunye nokusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa iinguqulelo ze-BAS, ze-PERSAL nazo ze-LOGIS. Qinisekisa, qinisekisa imahlawulelo kwaye uzigcobile kwi-BAS. Vumela iinguqulelo ze-PERSAL. Phatha umgangatho wemali (ukuhambisa imali). Qamba, zigcobile, okanye uvumele amajournal. Hambelanisa i-akhawunti ye-agenisi yokuhamba. Qinisekisa iifaktishi ezifunyenweyo. Hambelanisa / hlalahlaza i-akhawunti ezibalulekileyo. Qokelela ingxelo yeenkcazelo (uhlalutyo lweminyaka). Qamba iingxelo zemali. Qamba kwaye uzithumele iingcali kunye ne-Port Folio of Evidence (POEs) kwiingxelo zemali (iingxelo ze-accruals nabezahlawulelayo). Nikela ingxelo ngamafaktishi ahlawulweyo kwangaphakathi kwentsuku ezingama-30. Qamba iingcali ze-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE), Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE). Cwangcisa imali encinane kunye nokuqokelelwa kweemali ezityunjiweyo. Qinisekisa kwaye usayine iinzuzo zemali encinane kwaye ulinganise imali esandleni. Khokela ukubala kwemali encinane kwaye wenze ingxelo. Zenza uqinisekiso lokubeka imali usuku nezuku.

jobs.title: State Accountant: Rates and Taxes
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), (plus 37% in lieu of benefits)
jobs.summary: State Accountant needed in Pretoria to verify invoices, prepare payment submissions and manage billing and tariffs, requiring a financial qualification and one year of experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Degree or National Diploma in Financial Accounting / Management Accounting / Financial Management or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 1 year experience in financial management environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury Regulations, 2005. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Facilitation and presentation. Financial Management. Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
jobs.duties: Verify invoices and prepare payment submissions. Request invoices, statements and supporting documents from clients. Verify details, billing, tariffs, calculations and validity of charges. Prepare complete payment parcels in accordance with policies, SOPs and delegations. Submit payment parcels for review and approval and address queries. Reconcile accounts and capturing of payments. Reconcile statements with accounting records, payments and credits. Investigate discrepancies and substantiate outstanding balances. Engage clients to resolve queries. Capture payments on financial system. Monitor expenditure and payment progress. Track payment submissions and follow up outstanding payments. Communicate payment outcomes and confirm correct allocation to municipal accounts. Maintain invoice, payment and outstanding liability registers. Monitor overdue invoices and progress in reducing the payment backlog. Compile reports and support audit processes. Compile reports on expenditure, liabilities, disputed accounts and overdue invoices. Report progress on backlog reduction and municipal clearance matters. Maintain complete supporting records and audit trails. Respond to audit queries and implement assigned corrective actions.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 524 Stanza Bopape and Steve Biko Street, Suncardia Building, 6th Floor, Arcadia, 0002 or by email to Post349@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males, and African Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Koerse en Belasting
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester benodig in Pretoria om fakture te verifieer, betaling-voorleggings voor te berei en fakturering en tariewe te bestuur, met 'n finansiële kwalifikasie en een jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Rekeningkunde / Bestuursrekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur of verwante equivalente kwalifikasie. Minimum van 1 jaar ervaring in 'n finansiële bestuursomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Openbare Dienswet. Openbare Finansiële Bestuurswet. Voorkeurverkrygingsbeleid Raamwerkswet. Tesourie-regulasies, 2005. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Fasilitering en aanbieding. Finansiële Bestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
af.duties: Verifieer fakture en berei betaling-voorleggings voor. Versoek fakture, state en ondersteunende dokumente van kliënte. Verifieer besonderhede, fakturering, tariewe, berekenings en geldigheid van heffings. Berei volledige betaling-pakkette voor ooreenkomstig beleid, SOP's en delegasies. Dien betaling-pakkette vir hersiening en goedkeuring in en hanteer navrae. Rekonsilieer rekeninge en vaslegging van betalings. Rekonsilieer state met rekeningkundige rekords, betalings en krediete. Ondersoek afwykings en staaf uitstaande balanse. Skakel met kliënte om navrae op te los. Lê betalings op finansiële stelsel vas. Monitor besteding en betalingsvooruitgang. Hou betaling-voorleggings dop en volg uitstaande betalings na. Kommunikeer betalingsuitkomste en bevestig korrekte toekenning tot munisipale rekeninge. Onderhou faktuur-, betalings- en uitstaande aanspreeklikheidsregisters. Monitor agterstallige fakture en vordering in die vermindering van die betalingsagterstand. Stel verslae op en ondersteun ouditprosesse. Stel verslae op oor besteding, aanspreeklikhede, betwiste rekeninge en agterstallige fakture. Rapporteer vordering oor agterstandvermindering en munisipale slegtingsake. Onderhou volledige ondersteunende rekords en ouditspore. Reageer op ouditnavrae en implementeer toegewysde regstellende maatreëls.

zu.title: isibali kazwelonke: izinkokhelo nezintela
zu.summary: Kudingwa isibali somnuzi kazwelonke ePretoria ukuyiqinisekisa izikweletu, ukulungisa okumanzokusethywa njengentlawulo kanye nokuphatha intengo izimpahla kanye nezintela. Kudingwa ukuthole udunye ngesikole sezesimali unyaka 1 kumnyaka wezimali.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki izicelo kumelwe babenomaka-wethu we-Grade 12 noma iziqu noma iDiploma yezwe kwi-accounting yamava / Accounting yokuqapha / yamava / iziqu ezingafani noma ezifanayo. Okuncane unyaka 1 uhambe emthethweni wemali. Ibhalansi yomshayeli etholakalayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: umthetho womphakha. Umthetho wokuqapha imali yomphakha. Umthetho wokuqondisa ukuthengwa okuncanyelwayo. Imithetho yokuqapha imali, 2005. Iziqu zomsebenzi: ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ukwenziwa kokuqondisa kanye nokuthi kuthiwe noma kuboniswe. Ukuphatha imali. Ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
zu.duties: Qinisekisa izikweletu futhi ulungise izinkuletkule zokukhokha. Celu izikweletu, izitatimende nemibhalo esekelayo kubathintekayo. Qinisekisa imininingwane, ukubilisa, izintela, ukubala kanye nesiku esiphephile sempahla. Lungise amaphakethe wokukhokha aphelele ngokuvumelana nemithetho, izinqubo ezisemthethweni zamanye amaphasi nezinkululo ezinikelwe. Hambisa amaphakethe wokukhokha ukuba ahlolelwe futhi avunywe, uphendule imibuzo. Linganisa amaka-akhawunti futhi ubambe izinkokhelo. Linganisa izitatimende namarhothi ezezimali, izinkokhelo kanye namakredithi. Phenya ukungahambelani futhi uqinisekise osalolwaka abangakhokhiwe. Xhumana nabathintekayo ukuxazulula imibuzo. Bamba izinkokhelo kusistimu yezomnotho. Qapha ukuchitheka kwemali kanye nokuqhubekela phambili kokukhokha. Landa izinkuletkule zokukhokha futhi ulandele izinkokhelo ezingekelayo. Yazisa imiphumela yokukhokha futhi uqinisekise ukwabelwa ngendlela efanele kuma-akhawunti amasipala. Gcina amarejista ezikweletu, izinkokhelo nosuku olusalele. Qapha izikweletu eziphelelwe isikhathi nokuqhubeka ekuncishiseni inqwwi yokukhokha. Hlela imibiko futhi usekele izinqubo zokuhlola. Hlela imibiko ngokushelelwa, izikweletu, ama-akhawunti aphikisanayo kanye nezikweletu eziphelelwe sikhathi. Melana nokuqhubekela phambili ekuncishiseni inqwempi kanye nemicu yokuqeda ibhandi. Gcina imibhalo esekelayo ephelele kanye nothisa-lothisha. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlola futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ezinikelwe.

xh.title: IsiNgesi: State Accountant: Rates and Taxes / isiXhosa: Onozimali kaRhulumente: Iindleko neMigalelo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa Onozimali kuRhulumente ePretoria ukuqinisekisa iinvoices, ukulungisa iingeniselo zentlawulo nokulawula intlawulo kunye namaxabiso, kwaye kufuneka anesifundo sezimali kunye neminyaka enye yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nefom yesi-12 kunye neDegree okanye iDiploma yesiLwazi kwi-Akhawunti ezeMali / uLawulo lwe-Akhawunti ezeMali / uLawulo lwezeMali okanye isifundo esinxulumene neso esilinganayo. Ubuncinane bamava engama-1 kwindawo yolawulo lwezeMali. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba evumelekile. Ulwazi oluxhene nomsebenzi: uMthetho woMphiko woLuntu. uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali kaRhulumente. uMthetho weNkqubo yeNkqubo yoThengiso oKhethwayo. ILegislation yeNqanaba leNgowumba, 2005. Amakhono axhene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nokubhalwayo). Ukuqhuba nokubonisa. uLawulo lwezeMali. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iMicrosoft Word, iExcel, iPowerPoint, iProject).
xh.duties: Qinisekisa iinvoices ulungise iingeniselo zentlawulo. Celisa iinvoices, iistatements namaxwebhu axhasayo kumaxhasi. Qinisekisa iinkcukacha, intlawulo, amaxabiso, iindlela zokubala kunye nokuqinisekiswa kweefizi. Lungisa amaphakathi entlawulo apheleleyo ngokwemigaqo, iiSOPs kunye neendlela ezinikiweyo. Ngenisa amaphakathi entlawulo ukuqwalaselwa kunye nokuvamisa kwaye uphendule imibuzo. Linganisa ii-akhawunti kwaye ufake iintlawulo. Linganisa iistatements nerekhodi le-akhawunti, iintlawulo nakwikredithi. Phonononga ukungahambelani kwaye uqinisekise ibhalansi ezingekayo. Xabana namaxhasi ukusombulula imibuzo. Faka iintlawulo kwindalo yezeMali. Qaphela iindleko nokuqhubela phambili kwentlawulo. Landela iingeniselo zentlawulo kwaye ulandele iintlawulo ezingekayo. Xela iziphumo zentlawulo kwaye uqinisekise ukwabiwa okuchanekileyo kwi-akhawunti zasemasipala. Gcina ukubhaliswa kweekhonthileni, iintlawulo kunye neebhalansi ezingekayo. Qaphela iinvoices ezingekhoyo nokuqhubela phambili ekunciphiseni umva wentlawulo. Hlanganisela iingxelo kwaye uxhase iinkqubo zokuqwalasela. zu.title: Umphathi Wezimali Wesifunda: Izinhlawulo Nezintela
zu.summary: Umphathi wezimali wesifunda ohlolla ama-invoisi alungiselela futhi ahlole thumela izinkokhela zezinhlawulo nezintela eMmabatho, ofuna iziqu zemali nomnyaka oyedwa wemfundo yokusebenza.

Ubuncwane bonyaka oyedwa wemfundo yokusebenza emkhakheni wolawulo lwezimali. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury Regulations, 2005. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (olushokiwe nolubhalwayo). Ukukhuthaza nokubamba iqhaza ekwethulweni. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
zu.duties: Hlola ama-invoisi ulungiselele ukuthunyelwa kwezinkokhela. Cele ama-invoisi, izitatimende namadokhumenti okusekela kubathengi. Hlola imininingwane, ukubhaliswa kwemali, izintela, imibalo nokuqakatheka kwezimali ezihlawulwayo. Lungiselela amaphakethe okukhokha ahambisana nemigomo, ama-SOP namagunya. Thumela amaphakethe okukhokha ukuze ahlole futhi avunyelwe, uphendule imibuzo. Hlanganisa izinkokhela nokuqopha kwemali. Hlanganisa izitatimende nemibhalo yezimali, izinkokhela namakhredithi. Phenya iziphene futhi uqiniseke amasaldo abhala phandle. Xhumana nabathengi ukuxazulula imibuzo. Qopha izinkokhela esistimini yezimali. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwemali nokuqhubeka kwezinkokhela. Landa ukuthunyelwa kwezinkokhela ulandele izinkokhela ezingazange zikhokhwe. Yezisa iziphumelelo zezinkokhela ukuqinisekisa ukwahlukaniswa okulungile kuma-akhawunti zasemabusweni. Gcina irejista yama-invoisi, izinkokhela nezesibopho esingakhokhwanga. Qapha ama-invoisi asedele futhi ubheke inqubomgomo yokunciphisa isibopho sezinkokhela. Hlela imibiko usekele inqubo yokuhlola. Hlela imibiko ngokuqwashiswa kwemali, izibopho, ama-akhawunti abe imphikiswano nama-invoisi asedele. Yezisa inqubekelaphambili ekunciphiseni isibopho nezindaba zokuqinisekiswa kwemabusweni. Gcina amadokhamenti okusekela aze amabalwe ngokuphelele. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlolo ugweme izinyathelo zokuqalisa ezabelwe.

xh.summary: Isikhalondedwa karhulumente esiqinisekisa iinvoloyisi kwaye alungiselele izicelo zentlawulo zeerhethi neentaxa eMmabatho, esifuna isigaba sezimali kunye nomnye unyaka wamava.

Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury Regulations, 2005. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (lwezomlomo nolokubhalwayo). Ukulungiselela nokuzoncoma. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
xh.duties: Qinisekisa iinvoloyisi kwaye ulungiselele izicelo zentlawulo. Cel iinvoloyisi, iistatements namaxwebhu axhasayo kumaxhasi. Qinisekisa iinkcukacha, intlawulo, iitarifu, iimpilo zokubala kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza kweentlawulo. Lungiselela iipayekile ezizezantlawulo ngokwezinqobo ezimiso, i-SOPs kunye nezabelo. Hambisa iipayekile zentlawulo ukuba ziphonywe kwaye zivunywe kwaye ungapendula kumibuzo. Linganisa i-akhawunti kwaye ufake iintlawulo. Linganisa iistatements nerekhodi lezimali, iintlawulo nakwimizuzulo. Phanda ngokungahambelani kwaye uqinisekise ibhalansi ehlala ingekatshalwa. Nxibelelana namaxhasi ukusombulula iimibuzo. Faka iintlawulo kwinkqubo yezimali. Qaphela ukutshixa imali nokuqhuba phambili kwentlawulo. Landela izicelo zentlawulo kwaye ulandele iintlawulo ezingekayo. Xela iziphumo zentlawulo kwaye uqinisekise ukugcinwa ngokuchanekileyo kwi-akhawunti zomasipala. Gcina irekhodi leenvoloyisi, zentlawulo nezomthwalo ongakatshalwa. Qaphela iinvoloyisi eziphelelwe lixesha nokuqhuba phambili ekunciphiseni umva wentlawulo. Hlanganisela iimvela kwaye uxhase iinkqubo zokuhlolwa. Hlanganisela iimvela ngokutshixa imali, imithwalo, i-akhawunti ephikiswayo neenvoloyisi ezidlulileyo ilixa. Xela inqanaba lokqhuba phambili ekunciphiseni umva kunye nemiba yokuqatshulwa kumasipala. Gcina irekhodi elize ngokupheleleyo lokuxhasa nokuqhuba ukwahlolwa. Phendula kumibuzo yohlolo kwaye usebenzise iinyameko zokulungisa ezenzelweyo.

Linganisa ama-akhawunti futhi ubhale imali ehanjisiwe. Linganisa izitatimende namarekhodi ezimali, imali ehanjisiwe namakhradithi. Phenya okungahambisani futhi uqinisekise imibalomali engasekhona. Xhumana nabathintankhundla ukuze uxazulule imibuzo. Faka imali ehanjisiwe kwisistimu yezimali. Qapha ukuchithwa kwemali nokuqhubeka kokuhanjiswa kwemali. Landa izindatshana zokuhanjiswa kwemali futhi ulandele imali engahanjiswanga. Yezisa iziphumo zokuhanjiswa kwemali futhi uqinisekise ukwabiwa okulungile kuma-akhawunti omasipala. Gcina irekhodi lezikweletu, imali ehanjisiwe nemibalomali engasekhona. Qapha izikweletu ezeswelayo kanye nentuthuko ekunciphiseni amanani imali engahanjiswanga. Hlela imibiko futhi usekele izinqubo zokuhlola. Hlela imibiko mayelana nemali echithiwe, imibalomali, ama-akhawunti ephikisanayo nezikweletu ezeswelayo. Imibiko yentuthuko ekunciphiseni amanani imali engahanjiswanga namaphuzu okusula igama komasipala. Gcina amarekhodi aphelele okusekela futhi ulandelane nokuhlola. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlola futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ezabelwe kona.

xh.title: IsiXhosa: Inkalamba yeLizwe: Iirhetyhula neMithetho
xh.summary: Inkalamba yeLizwe egqiba iinvoisi nokulungisa izicelo zentlawulo kwiiofisi zesithili saseNorthern Cape, efunayo isifundo sezimali kunye nenyanga elinye yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikedi seGrade 12 kunye neDegree okanye iNational Diploma kwiFinancial Accounting / Management Accounting / Financial Management okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Amava angapheli kwisonye unyaka kwimeko yolawulo lwezimali. Ilayisenisi yokuqhayisa esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluxhomekekayo kumsebenzi: I-Public Service Act. I-Public Finance Management Act. I-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. I-Treasury Regulations, 2005. Amandla oxhomekekayo kumsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (ngemilomo kunye nokubhalisiweyo). Ukulungelelanisa nokubonisa. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ukubaluleka kokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
xh.duties: Qinisekisa iinvoisi ulungise izicelo zentlawulo. Celisa iinvoisi, iistatimenti namaxwebhu axhasayo kumaxhasi. Qinisekisa iinkcukacha, ukubhilinga, iirhetyhula, ukubala kunye nokuqinisekiswa kweentswalo. Lungisa amaphakheji entlawulo aze ngokwemigaqo, ii-SOP kunye namagunya athunyelweyo. Thumela amaphakheji entlawulo ukuze ajongwe uvunywe ukuba kuvisiswe imibuzo. Linganisa ii-akhawunti uze uqhaphe iintlawulo. Linganisa iistatimenti nerekhodi lezimali, iintlawulo namacredithi. Phanda ngeminxiwela yemali uze uqinisekise amagama osasazo angazange atshalwe. Nxibelelanisa namaxhasi ukuze uxazule iimibuzo. Qhapha iintlawulo kwinkqubo yezimali. Liluze ukuchithwa kwemali kunye nokuqhubeka kwentlawulo. Landela izicelo zentlawulo ulandele iintlawulo ezingazange zenziwe. Xelela ngeziphumo zentlawulo uze uqinisekise ukwabiwa okuchanekileyo kwi-akhawunti zasemasipala. Gcina irekhodi leenvoisi, iintlawulo kunye namagunya osasazo angazange atshalwe. Liluze iinvoisi ezingenzekanga ngenkqubo yokunciphisa isiphithiphithi sentlawulo. Hlanganisela iirekho uze uxase iinkqubo zokujonga iindleko. Hlanganisela iirekho ngokuchithwa kwemali, osasazo, ii-akhawunti ezipikisanwayo ngeenvoisi ezingenzekanga. Xela inkqubo enciphisa isiphithiphithi kwaye xela izinto ezimala nekasipala. Gcina iirekhodo ezixhasayo ezeleyo kunye neendlela zokuqinisekisa iindleko. Phendula iimibuzo yokujonga iindleko uze usebenzise izenzo ezilungisiweyo ezenyiweyo.

jobs.title: State Accountant: Rates and Taxes
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), (plus 37% in lieu of benefits)
jobs.summary: State Accountant needed to verify invoices and prepare payment parcels, requiring a finance degree and one year of financial management experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Degree or National Diploma in Financial Accounting / Management Accounting / Financial Management or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 1 year experience in financial management environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury Regulations, 2005. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Facilitation and presentation. Financial Management. Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
jobs.duties: Verify invoices and prepare payment submissions. Request invoices, statements and supporting documents from clients. Verify details, billing, tariffs, calculations and validity of charges. Prepare complete payment parcels in accordance with policies, SOPs and delegations. Submit payment parcels for review and approval and address queries. Reconcile accounts and capturing of payments. Reconcile statements with accounting records, payments and credits. Investigate discrepancies and substantiate outstanding balances. Engage clients to resolve queries. Capture payments on financial system. Monitor expenditure and payment progress. Track payment submissions and follow up outstanding payments. Communicate payment outcomes and confirm correct allocation to municipal accounts. Maintain invoice, payment and outstanding liability registers. Monitor overdue invoices and progress in reducing the payment backlog. Compile reports and support audit processes. Compile reports on expenditure, liabilities, disputed accounts and overdue invoices. Report progress on backlog reduction and municipal clearance matters. Maintain complete supporting records and audit trails. Respond to audit queries and implement assigned corrective actions.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post355@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Tariewe en Belasting
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester benodig om fakture te verifieer en betalingspakkette voor te berei, met die vereiste van 'n finansiële graad en een jaar se ervaring in finansiële bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Rekeningkunde / Bestuursrekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 1 jaar ervaring in 'n finansiële bestuursomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury Regulations, 2005. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Fasilitering en aanbieding. Finansiële bestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
af.duties: Verifieer fakture en berei betalingsvoorleggings voor. Versoek fakture, state en ondersteunende dokumente van kliënte. Verifieer besonderhede, fakturering, tariewe, berekeninge en geldigheid van heffings. Berei volledige betalingspakkette voor ooreenkomstig beleide, SOP's en delegasies. Dien betalingspakkette vir hersiening en goedkeuring in en hanteer navrae. Rekonsilieer rekeninge en vaslegging van betalings. Rekonsilieer state met rekeningkundige rekords, betalings en krediete. Ondersoek afwykings en staaf uitstaande balanse. Skakel met kliënte om navrae op te los. Lê betalings op finansiële stelsel vas. Monitor besteding en betalingsvordering. Hou betalingsvoorleggings dop en volg uitstaande betalings na. Kommunikeer betalingsuitkomste en bevestig korrekte toewysing aan munisipale rekeninge. Onderhou faktuur-, betalings- en uitstaande skuldregisters. Monitor agterstallige fakture en vordering in die vermindering van die betalingsagterstand. Stel verslae op en ondersteur ouditprosesse. Stel verslae op oor besteding, laste, betwiste rekeninge en agterstallige fakture. Rapporteer vordering oor agterstandsvermindering en munisipale wydingsake. Onderhou volledige ondersteunende rekords en ouditspore. Reageer op ouditnavrae en implementeer toegewysde regstellende maatreëls.

zu.title: IsiHlalo Sezimali Sombuso: Izintela Nezimali Zokusebenzisa
zu.summary: Kudingeka isiHlalo Sezimali Sombuso ukugcina ama-invoisi futhi alungise imigwaqo yokukhokha, kudinga idigri yezimali kanye nenyanga eyodwa yohlelo lwezimali.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane kakhulu: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-Degree noma i-National Diploma kwi-Financial Accounting / Management Accounting / Financial Management noma izifundo ezinga elifanayo. Okuncane kakhulu ukuthi kube unyaka o-1 wokuqeqeshwa kwindawo yokuphathwa kwezimali. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury Regulations, 2005. Amandla ohambisana nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuqondisa nokubamba inkhundla. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuba nelwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ama-invoisi ulungise imiyalelo yokukhokha. Cela ama-invoisi, izitatimende namadokhumenti asesekelayo kubathintekayo. Qinisekisa imininingwane, ukubhala izikweletu, izilinganiso, ukubala kanye nokuqakatheka kwezimali ezibhiyozelwe. Lungisa amaphakethe okukhokha ahele njengokuqondile nezinqumos, ama-SOP kanye nemikhuleko. Thumela amaphakethe okukhokha ukuze abuyekezwe bese vunyelwa uphendule imibuzo. Linganisa ama-akhawunti bese ufinyelela izinkokhelo. Linganisa izitatimende ngerekhodi lezimali, izinkokhelo namakhredithi. Phenya ukungahambisani bese uqinisekisa ibhalansi ezele kagesi. Xhumanisa nabathintekayo ukuxazulula imibuzo. Faka izinkokhelo kwindawo yokuphathwa kwezimali. Landa ukuchithwa kwemali kanye nenqubo yokukhokha. Landela imiyalezo yokukhokha bese ulandela izinkokhelo ezingekhokhiwe. Yezisa iziphetho zezinkokhelo bese uqinisekisa ukwabelwa ngendlela efanele kuma-akhawunti omasipala. Gcina irekhodi le-invoisi, izinkokhelo nezebhalansi ezele kagesi. Landa ama-invoisi abekiwe bese ulanda inqubo yokunciphisa ukubekiwa kwemisebenzi okuhlolakele. Hlanganisa umbiko bese uxhasa inqubo yokuqoqa. Hlanganisa imibiko ngemali echithiwe, izikweletu, ama-akhawunti aphikiswana nawo nama-invoisi abekiwe. Yezisa inqubo yokunciphisa ukubekiwa kwemisebenzi kanye nezindaba zokususwa komthetho omasipala. Gcina amarekhodi asesekelayo ahele kanye nezinkomba ezilandela ukwenziwa komsebenzi. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlola bese usebenzisa izinyathelo zokulungisa ezabelwe.

xh.title: IsiNani seLizwe: Iirheshi neMigangatho
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho isiNani seLizwe esiza kuqinisa iinvoices esize silungise iipakethe zemahlawulwe, kudingwa idigri yezemali kunye nomyaka omnye wamava oLawulo Lwemali.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 kunye neDigri okuNasional Dipholoma kwi-Financial Accounting / Management Accounting / Financial Management okanye isidanga esilinganayo esinxulumene nako. Iyure elingaphantsi konyaka o-1 yamava kwindawo yolawulo lwemali. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluxhumene nomsebenzi: Public Service Act. Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Treasury Regulations, 2005. Amakhono axhumene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukukhuthaza nokubonisa. ULawulo Lwemali. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
xh.duties: Qinisa iinvoices uze ulungise izithunyelwa zemahlawulwe. Cel iinvoices, iistatements namaxwebhu axhasayo kumaxhasi. Qinisa iinkcukacha, ukuqokelelwa kweefi, amatharifi, izibalo kunye nokuwusebenzayo kweentlawulo. Lungise iipakethe zemahlawulwe ezigqithisiweyo ngokwemigaqo, iSOPs kunye noonikezelo. Thumela iipakethe zemahlawulwe ukuze ziphonyolwe zivunywe uze uzibuze imibuzo. Linganisa ii-akhawunti nokubhala iintlawulo. Linganisa iistatements nerekhodi le-akhawuntingi, iintlawulo kunye neekredithi. Phanda ngempikiswano uze uqinisekise iibhalansi ezingazange zihlawulwe. Xhasa abaxhasi ukuze usombulule imibuzo. Bhala iintlawulo kwinkqubo yezemali. Qwalasela iindleko nonyuso wokuhlawula. Landela izithunyelwa zemahlawulwe uze ulandele iintlawulo ezingazange zihlawulwe. Xelela ngemiphumela yokuhlawula uze uqinisekise ukwenziwa kakuhle kwi-akhawunti zasemasipala. Gcina irejista yeinvoices, iintlawulo kunye neebhalansi ezingazange zihlawulwe. Qwalasela iinvoices ezingazange zihlawule kwaye kulindeleke ukuba zenze kakhulu ukunciphisa isikrweqe sokuhlawula. Hlanganisela iiripoti uze uxhase iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa. Hlanganisela iiripoti ngeendleko, iibhalansi, ii-akhawunti eziphikisanayo kunye neinvoices ezingazange zihlawule. Xela inyuso ekwenzeni okukhawulezayo ukuze kuncitshwe isikrweqe sokuhlawula kwaye kucace imicimbi yamasipala. Gcina irekhodi eligqithisiweyo lokuxhasa kunye neendlela zokuqinisekisa. Phendula imibuzo yokuphoyisa uze usebenzise izenzo zokulungisa ezabelwe zona.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk
jobs.summary: Registry Clerk sought in Pretoria to manage counter services, handle mail correspondence and perform storage and retrieval duties.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of registry duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, and operate a computer. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Understanding of the work in registry. Job related skills. Planning and organisation. Computer literacy. communication (verbal and written). Interpersonal relations. Ability to work within a team.
jobs.duties: Manage operations to achieve planned outcomes. Provide registry counter services. Attend to clients. Handle telephonic and other enquiries received. Receive and register hand delivered mail/files. Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence. Receive all mail. Sort, register and dispatch mail. Distribute notices on registry issues. Render an effective filing and record management service. Open and close files according to record classification system. Filing / storage, tracing (electronically/manually) and retrieval of documents and files. Operate office machines in relation to the registry function. Process documents for archiving an/disposal. Electronic scanning of files. Sort and package files for archives and distribution. Compile list of documents to be archived and submit to the supervisor. Keep records for archived documents.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post338@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Registerklerk
af.summary: Registerklerk gesoek in Pretoria om toonbankdienste te bestuur, poskorrespondensie te hanteer en bergings- en terughalingspligte te verrig.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Werkverwante kennis: Kennis van registerpligte en -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van bergings- en terughalingsprosedures ingevolge die werksomgewing. Begrip van die werk in die register. Werkverwante vaardighede. Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur bedrywighede om beplande uitkomste te bereik. Verskaf registertoonbankdienste. Bedien kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgeleide pos/lêers. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en stuur pos uit. Verspreid kennishouings oor registerkwessies. Lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens. Open en sluit lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Lêer/berg, opspoor (elektronies/handmatig) enhaal dokumente en lêers. Bedien kantoormasjiene in verband met die registerfunksie. Verwerk dokumente vir argivering en/of vernietiging. Elektroniese skandering van lêers. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel 'n lys op van dokumente om geargiveer te word en dien dit by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords van geargiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Clerk WeRegistry
zu.summary: Kufunwa uClerk WeRegistry ePretoria ukuphatha izinsiza zesikhashana, ukuphatha okubhaliwe okuphuma nokuqala kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokugcina nokukhipha okubhaliwe.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenani: Abafaki izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: ULwazi ngemisebenzi ye-registry, izindlela kanye nengqondo yokungenisa idatha, futhi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ULwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda ohlelo lwemithetho oluphethe Inkonzo Yomphakathi. ULwazi lwenqubo yokugcina nokukhipha okubhaliwe mayelana nendawo yokusebenza. Ukuqonda umsebenzi owenziwa e-registry. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi. Ukuhlela nokuqamba inhlelo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxoxa (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Izimo zobuntu bokuxhumana nomunye umuntu. Ikono lokusebenza ohlwini.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi ukuze kufinyelelwe emigqweni ehleliwe. Hlinzeka ngensiza zesikhashana ze-registry. Nxibelelana nothisha. Phatha imibuzo ethunyelwe ngefoni nayo. Thola ubhalise okulethwa ngesandla. Phatha okubhaliwe okungena nokuphuma. Thola yonke imayili. Hlukanisa, ubhalise ulwazi oluthunyelwa. Sazisa ngokukhulunywa okufaka izindaba ze-registry. Hlinzeka ngensiza yokuqina efanele yokuqinisekisa ukukwazi ukugcina okubhaliwe. Vula futhi uvalwe izinkomba ngokohlelo lwesigaba sochungechunge olubhaliwe. Ukugcina okubhaliwe / isitoreji, ukulandela unyaka (ngekhompyutha / ngesandla) nokukhipha okubhaliwe. Sebenzisa izimoto zofuzo ngokuhlobene nomsebenzi we-registry. Lungiselela okubhaliwe ukuze kubekwe i-archived ukugcinwa / ukulahwa. Ukuqapha okubhaliwe. Hlukanisa futhi ubhukude izinkomba ze-archived futhi ukuthumela komunye umuntu. Gcina izinkomba zobhuku bezinkomba ezibekwe yi-archive.

xh.title: Umkhukiwezo weFayile zeZigqibo
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMkhukiwezo weFayile zeZigqibo ePretoria ukulawula iinkonzo zekauntha, ukuphatha uqhagamshelwano lwemeyile nokwenza imisebenzi yokugcina nokuvelisa kabini iifayile.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinci: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeregistry, iindlela njengoko nemandla okungenisa idatha, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda ingqikithi yomthetho ephatha iKonzo Kawonke-wonke. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokugcina nokuvelisa kabini iifayile ngokomsebenzi oqheliswe kulo. Ukuqonda umsebenzi kwiregistry. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi. Ucululo lolwe nenkululo. Ukubhalisa ngekhompyutha. Unxibelelwano (ngemilombe nangokubhalwayo). Unxibelelwano nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela.
xh.duties: Lawula izinto ezisenziwa ukuze kufunyanwe iziphumo ezicwangciswe kakhulu. Zela iinkonzo zekauntha yeregistry. Zingela kumakhaya abathengi. Phatha imibuzo efunyanwa ngefowuni nasezinye. Amkele ubhalise imeyile/ iifayile eziletswe ngesandla. Phatha uqhagamshelwano olungena noluphuma. Amkela yonke imeyile. Hlela, bhalise thumela imeyile. Sazisa ngendaba zeregistry. Zela inkonzo esebenzayo yokubhalisa nokuqonda iirekhodi. Vula vala iifayile ngokwesixokeleldwa sokwahlula iirekhodi. Bhalisa / gcina, landa (ngekhompyutha / ngesandla)Velisa kabini amaxwebhu neefayile. Sebenzisa iimatshini zofisi ezihlobene nomsebenzi weregistry. Qhuba amaxwebhu okugcina isikhathi eside / ukulahla. Skena ngekhompyutha iifayile. Hlela fake iifayile kwi-archives nasezithuba. Lunda uludwe lwamaxwebhu okugcina isikhathi eside aze athunyelwe kumlawuli. Gcina iirekhodi zamaxwebhu agciniweyo.

jobs.title: Senior Inspector: Mine Health and Safety
jobs.department: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources
jobs.summary: Senior Inspector for Mine Health and Safety in Klerksdorp, requiring a Mining Engineering diploma and Mine Manager's Certificate to conduct audits and accident investigations.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Mining Engineering (NQF6), Mine Manager’s Certificate of Competency, plus a drivers license with minimum 3 years’ experience at a junior managerial level in mining, Knowledge of: Mine Health and Safety Act and Regulations and Legal Proceedings, Mining Engineering – Mine Equipment .e.g. winder, boilers, plants etc, Hazard identification and risk management, Public Service Staff Code, DMPR Policies, Skills: Ability to interpret and apply Mine Health and Safety Act, DMPR Policy and Staff Code, Management skills- Planning, Leading, Organising and Controlling, Report and Writing Formulation, Good interpersonal relations, Analyses and interpretation of accident statistics, Be able to recommend mining engineering solutions, negotiation skill, Language proficiency, computer skills Thinking demand: Innovative thinker, Analyse situations carefully, make fair and reasonable decisions, Receptive to suggestions and ideas, Be able to stay calm and collective during difficult situations.
jobs.duties: Coordinate, conduct and report on underground, shaft and surface audits and inspections on matters relating to ground stability, support, explosives, blasting operations and other matters relating to the Mine Safety. Coordinate, conduct report on investigations into mine related accidents contraventions and complaints as well as the analysis of mine accidents and trends to determine high risk mining operations and take appropriate action. Coordinate and serve on any necessary board of examiners. Coordinate the Investigation, consultation and provision of input on mine closure, prospecting rights, mining rights and permits, EMP’s, and township development. Provide managerial activities.
jobs.applications: Applicants must be submitted via DMPR E-Recruitment System accessible using the following link https://erecruitment.dmpr.gov.za Applications must create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credential on DMPR E-Recruitment System. Once registration is complete and logged in to the system, you may browse all vacant positions. Another option is to submit application by post or courier, quoting relevant reference, addressed to: The Director-General, Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources, Private Bag X59, Pretoria, 0001. Alternatively, applications may also be hand delivered to Trevenna Campus, corner Meintjies and Francis Baard Street, former Schoeman. General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Ms T Gumede Tel No: (012) 444- 3319.
jobs.notes: Indian /Coloured or white female are encouraged to apply. af.title: Inspekteur: Bedryfsgeneeskunde
af.summary: Inspekteur van Bedryfsgeneeskunde in Welkom wat verantwoordelik is vir die uitvoer van myngesondheidsoudits, mediese moniteringsinspeksies en handhawingsaksies.
af.requirements: A Bachelor of Nursing Science (B Cur)/ National Diploma, B Tech Occupational Health Nursing (NQF Level 6) valid registration with South African Nursing Council (SANC), coupled with minimum of 3 years’ experience in Occupational Medicine/ Health and valid Driver’s License PLUS the following competencies Knowledge of: Sound knowledge of both occupational Medical and Nursing discipline, understanding of MHSA & Regulations and directives. Ukuqonda izindlela zokumbila ngokujwayelekile kanye namaphuphu ezempilo abhekene nawo, ulwazi ngomhlabathangqangi wezamachembe, ukuzila kunukubheka nokumikiswa ibhodi. af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig by die Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources in Pretoria om organisatoriese ontwikkeling, veranderingsbestuur, werksevaluasie en posvestigingsfunksies te oorsien.

Kennis van: Oor 'n grondige kennis en begrip van beleide, voorskrifte, regulasies, witpapiere, openbare administrasie, ens., werkstudie en werkstudi-tegnieke, werksbeskrywings en spesifikasies, werksevaluasie, personeeltoesig, kennis van die operasionele bestuursraamwerk, kennis en begrip van projek- en veranderingsbestuur, PERSAL-posvestiging beskik. Vaardighede: Kommunikasievaardighede, rekenaarvaardighede, verslagskrywing, luister en interpretasie, analitiese vaardighede, basiese navorsingsvaardighede, organisering, koördinering en beplanningsvaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, fasiliteringsvaardighede, bestuursvaardighede, opleidings- en motiveringsvaardighede, vormontwerp, besigheidsproseskartering. Denkeise: Logies, Kreatiewe/innovatiewe denker, Objektief, Akkuraat, Diplomaties.
af.duties: Oursig hou oor die ontwikkeling van organisatoriese en posvestigingsondersoeke en bestuur in hierdie verband adviseer, insluitend die bestuur van posvestiging op PERSAL. Oursig hou oor/lei/voer werksanalise, werksevaluasie (JE) en werksbeskrywings uit. Oursig hou oor die fasilitering en implementering van die Operasionele Bestuursraamwerk. Oursig hou oor die ontwikkeling, instandhouding en implementering van beleid rakende doeltreffendheidsverwante aangeleenthede. Verskaf holistiese veranderingsbestuur en organisatoriese ontwikkelingsbeleid en -strategie vir die departement. Verseker/ontwerp vorms. Bestuur die Sub-direktoraat.

zu.title: Onobhala-Jikelele: EzeNtuthuko Yezinkampani Noshintsho
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onobhala-Jikelele eKipatemente weMineral and Petroleum Resources ePretoria ukuba aqaphele intuthuko yezinkampani, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi nemisebenzi yokuqondiswa kwamakhono.

Amakhono: Amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukubhala umbhalo, ukuzwa ukuqondisisa nokutolika, amakhono okuqondisisa, amakhono obucwaniso obuyisisekelo, ukuhlanganisa, ukuqondanisa nokuhlela, amakhono oxazululo izinkinga, amakhono okweseka inkulumo, amakhono okulawula, amakhono okuqeqesha nokukhuthaza, ukwakheka kwezifom, ukumiswa kwemigwaqo yamaphurosesi. zu.duties: Qondisa intuthuko yophando oluphathelene nezinkampani nangemisebenzi yokuqondiswa kwamakhono, unikezezelule abaphathi ngalokho kubandakanya ukuphathwa kokuqondiswa kwamakhono ku-PERSAL. Qondisa ukuthuthuka, ukugcinwa nokuqaliswa kwamapholisi kumaphuzu wokusebenza kahle. Nikeza ngokuphelele ukuphathwa koshintsho nentsimbi yokuphatha intuthuko yezinkampani komnyango. Qinisekisa / Yakhe iziFomu. Phatha i-Sub-directorate

zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor of Laws ( LLB) (NQF 8) eneminyaka eyi-8 yokuhlangana nokuqeqeshwa kwemisebenzi ehlobene nomthetho (inani leholo lizobekwa ngokwezinga lomuntu emsebenzini ngokulesi sikhathi se-OSD Legal Qualified Professionals. Nikela ngeluleko ngeziphakamiso ezithunyelwe ngokumelana nezinqumo ezithathwa ngokomthetho oqashwa umnyango. Qapha yonke imigqibelo yezinkantolo ye-Department noma iSilo ngokomthetho wekhotho kanye nomthetho ohambisana nawo. Yiba ngummeli womthetho wamnyango emihlanganweni ehlukene. Qapha ukuhambisana ne-PAIA ne-PAJA.

Qamba uze uhlole umthetho, umthetho ongaphantsi komthetho, amaxwebhu omthetho, iimemozo, iingxelo kunye nezibhalo ezimalunga nezinto ezahlukeneyo. jobs.applications: Applicants must be submitted via DMPR E-Recruitment System accessible using the following link https://erecruitment.dmpr.gov.za Applications must create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credential on DMPR E-Recruitment System. Once registration is complete and logged in to the system, you may browse all vacant positions. Another option is to submit application by post or courier, quoting relevant reference, addressed to: The Director-General, Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources, Private Bag X59, Pretoria, 0001. Alternatively, applications may also be hand delivered to Trevenna Campus, corner Meintjies and Francis Baard Street, former Schoeman. General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Ms T Gumede Tel No: (012) 444- 3319.
jobs.notes: Coloured / White male or female and persons with disability are encouraged to apply. Applications are strongly advised to complete and attach recent Z83 application form which came into effect from 01 January 2021 as issued by the Minister of Public Service Administration in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended, which is obtainable online from www.dpsa.gov.za and detailed Curriculum Vitae when submitting applications on DMPR E-Recruitment System. Applications must be submitted on the recent Z83 application form which came into effect from 01 January 2021 as issued by the Minister of Public Service Administration in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended, which is obtainable online from www.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za. All sections of the Z83 must be completed (In full, accurately, legibly, honestly, initialled, signed and dated), and accompanied by a comprehensive/ detailed Curriculum Vitae only. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be required from shortlisted candidates only on or before the day of the interview. The Curriculum Vitae must have at least three (3) reference persons and their contacts. Failure to provide accurate information on a job application as well as incomplete information will result in a disqualification. Job applicants in possession of a foreign qualification(s), must also provide an evaluation certificate obtainable from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). If an invitation for an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Requirements stated on the advertised posts are minimum inherent requirements; therefore, criteria for shortlisting will depend on the proficiency of the applications received. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Applicants must note that personnel suitability checks (PSC) will be conducted on the short-listed applicants, therefore will be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct this exercise. PSC includes security screening and vetting, qualification verification, criminal records, financial records checks. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as application received after the closing date will not be considered. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, He/ She must do so in writing. It is also important to note that the Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

Once registration is complete and logged in to the system, you may browse all vacant positions. Another option is to submit application by post or courier, quoting relevant reference, addressed to: The Director-General, Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources, Private Bag X59, Pretoria, 0001. Alternatively, applications may also be hand delivered to Trevenna Campus, corner Meintjies and Francis Baard Street, former Schoeman. General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Ms T Gumede Tel No: (012) 444- 3319.
jobs.notes: Persons with disability are encouraged to apply. Applications are strongly advised to complete and attach recent Z83 application form which came into effect from 01 January 2021 as issued by the Minister of Public Service Administration in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended, which is obtainable online from www.dpsa.gov.za and detailed Curriculum Vitae when submitting applications on DMPR E-Recruitment System. Applications must be submitted on the recent Z83 application form which came into effect from 01 January 2021 as issued by the Minister of Public Service Administration in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended, which is obtainable online from www.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za. All sections of the Z83 must be completed (In full, accurately, legibly, honestly, initialled, signed and dated), and accompanied by a comprehensive/ detailed Curriculum Vitae only. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be required from shortlisted candidates only on or before the day of the interview. The Curriculum Vitae must have at least three (3) reference persons and their contacts. Failure to provide accurate information on a job application as well as incomplete information will result in a disqualification. Job applicants in possession of a foreign qualification(s), must also provide an evaluation certificate obtainable from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Applicants must note that personnel suitability checks (PSC) will be conducted on the short-listed applicants, therefore will be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct this exercise. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as application received after the closing date will not be considered. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, He/ She must do so in writing. It is also important to note that the Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

jobs.title: Officer: Regional and Local Economic Development
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 at 16h00. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Research and data support officer for regional and local economic development initiatives within the Department of Small Business Development, based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor’s Degree (NQF 7) in Social Sciences, Economics, Development Finance, Commerce, Business Management, Business Administration, Local Economic Development, or an equivalent / related qualification as recognised by SAQA. A qualification with exposure to research methods, data analysis, public policy, entrepreneurship, MSME development or local economic development will be an added advantage. Minimum of 1-year administrative, research, coordination or programme support experience in economic development, regional or local government, small business development, development finance, public sector or stakeholder coordination environment. Job related knowledge: basic knowledge of the small business development ecosystem, including MSMEs, cooperatives and informal enterprises. Basic knowledge of Local Economic Development policy frameworks, Integrated Development Plans and the District Development Model. Basic understanding of enterprise development, development finance, business support instruments and referral mechanisms. Basic knowledge of research, data collection, monitoring, reporting and evidence-based decision-making. Awareness of digital information management, POPIA, ICT security and public sector administrative processes. Job related skills: Research and basic policy analysis. Data collection, validation, analysis and interpretation. Report writing, briefing notes and presentation preparation. Stakeholder engagement and coordination across national, provincial and local structures. Digital record keeping, electronic document management and use of reporting systems. Basic project coordination, problem solving and service delivery innovation. Job competencies: Communication, including clear written submissions and verbal presentations. Data collection, accuracy, quality assurance and attention to detail. Basic project and programme coordination. Analytical thinking, problem solving and continuous improvement. Stakeholder engagement, coordination and service orientation. Digital record keeping, information management and responsible handling of data. Adaptability, learning orientation and service delivery innovation. Additional: Computer literacy, including MS Office packages, electronic document management, spreadsheets, presentation tools and digital collaboration platforms. Driver’s licence will be considered an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Research and Data Support: Conduct desktop and primary research using digital research tools and data sources to support regional and local economic development initiatives. Capture, update and validate research data in electronic databases and digital repositories. Assist with basic data analysis and preparation of digital reports, summaries and presentations. Support the ongoing monitoring of trends, challenges and opportunities affecting MSMEs, cooperatives and local economies. Policy, Strategy and Programme Support: Contribute to the development and updating of digitally stored policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), templates and guidelines. Maintain and update electronic knowledge repositories and databases related to local government, regional development and MSME support. Assist in ensuring that information is accurate, accessible and consistently stored across systems. Coordination of Business Support Services: Assist in coordinating access to financial and non-financial business support programmes using digital tracking tools and reporting systems. Support referrals and stakeholder interactions through email, online platforms and digital communication channels. Update records of support interventions and engagements on internal digital systems. Monitoring, Reporting and Information Management: Assist with the monitoring of programme implementation using standardised digital reporting templates. Compile progress reports, status updates and submissions using electronic systems. Ensure timely capturing and updating of implementation data to support performance reporting. Communication and Stakeholder Engagement: Draft correspondence, reports, presentations and submissions using digital tools and document management systems. Support virtual and hybrid meetings, workshops and stakeholder engagements, including: Electronic distribution of documents, Digital minute-taking and record keeping, Share approved information through electronic channels to support coordination and compliance. Administrative Support: Provide administrative support using digital workflows, including electronic filing and document management. Updating digital logs and registers. Scheduling meetings using online calendars. Support the business unit in reducing paper-based processes by adhering to digital -irst administrative practices.
jobs.enquiries: Enquiries for all advertised posts should be directed to the recruitment office Tel No: (012) 394-5286/43097
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by email to the relevant email and by quoting the relevant reference number provided on the subject line. Candidates must submit applications to recruitment9@dsbd.gov.za and quote the reference number for the above-mentioned position in the subject line (email) when applying i.e. “REF NO: ORLEDC”

If you have not been contacted within 1 month of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.
