af.title: Beampte: Streeks- en Plaaslike Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling
af.summary: Navorsings- en datasteunbeampte vir streeks- en plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe binne die Department of Small Business Development, geleë in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Ekonomie, Ontwikkelingsfinansies, Handel, Besigheidsbestuur, Besigheidsadministrasie, Plaaslike Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling, of 'n ekwivalente / verwante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Kwalifikasie met blootstelling aan navorsingsmetodes, data-analise, openbare beleid, entrepreneurskap, MKMO-ontwikkeling of plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkeling sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum van 1 jaar administratiewe, navorsings-, koördinasie- of programsteunervaring in 'n omgewing van ekonomiese ontwikkeling, streeks- of plaaslike regering, kleinbesigheidsontwikkeling, ontwikkelingsfinansies, openbare sektor of belanghebbende-koördinasie. Werksverwante kennis: basiese kennis van die kleinbesigheidsontwikkeling-ekosisteem, insluitend MKMO's, koöperasies en informele ondernemings. Basiese kennis van beleidsraamwerke vir Plaaslike Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling, Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsplanne en die Distrikontwikkelingsmodel. Basiese begrip van ondernemingsontwikkeling, ontwikkelingsfinansies, besigheidsondersteuningsinstrumente en verwysingsmeganismes. Basiese kennis van navorsing, dataversameling, monitering, verslagdoening en bewysgebaseerde besluitneming. Bewustheid van digitale inligtingsbestuur, POPIA, IKR-sekuriteit en administratiewe prosesse van die openbare sektor. Werksverwante vaardighede: Navorsing en basiese beleidsanalise. Dataversameling, -validering, -analise en -interpretasie. Verslagskrywing, kortingsnotas en voorbereiding van aanbiedings. Belanghebbende-betrokking en -koördinasie oor nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike strukture. Digitale rekordhouding, elektroniese dokumentbestuur en gebruik van verslaerstelsels. Basiese projekkoördinasie, probleemoplossing en dienslewering-innovasie. Werksbevoegdhede: Kommunikasie, insluitend duidelike skriftelike voorleggings en mondelinge aanbiedings. Dataversameling, akkuraatheid, gehal versekering en aandag aan detail. Basiese projek- en programkoördinasie. Analitiese denke, probleemoplossing en deurlopende verbetering. Belanghebbende-betrokking, koördinasie en diensoriëntasie. Digitale rekordhouding, inligtingsbestuur en verantwoordelike hantering van data. Aanpasbaarheid, leeroriëntasie en dienslewering-innovasie. Bykomend: Rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend MS Office-pakkette, elektroniese dokumentbestuur, sigblaaie, aanbiedingsnutsmiddels en digitale samewerkingsplatforms. Bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word.
af.duties: Navorsing en datasteun: Voer lessenaar- en primêre navorsing uit met behulp van digitale navorsingsnutsmiddels en databronne om streeks- en plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe te ondersteun. Vang navorsingsdata in elektroniese databasisse en digitale bewaarplekke vas, werk dit by en valideer dit. Bied bystand met basiese data-analise en die voorbereiding van digitale verslae, opsommings en aanbiedings. Ondersteun die deurlopende monitering van tendense, uitdagings en geleenthede wat MKMO's, koöperasies en plaaslike ekonomieë raak. Beleids-, strategie- en programsteun: Dra by tot die ontwikkeling en bywerking van digitaal gestoorde beleide, standaardbedryfsprosedures (SBP's), sjablone en riglyne. Onderhou en werk elektroniese kennisbewaarplekke en databasisse met betrekking tot plaaslike regering, streeksontwikkeling en MKMO-ondersteuning by. Bied bystand om te verseker dat inligting akkuraat, toeganklik en konsekwent oor stelsels heen gestoor word. Koördinasie van besigheidsondersteuningsdienste: Bied bystand met die koördinasie van toegang tot finansiële en nie-finansiële besigheidsondersteuningsprogramme deur gebruik van digitale naspeuringsnutsmiddels en verslaerstelsels. Ondersteun verwysings en belanghebbende-interaksies deur e-pos, aanlyplatforms en digitale kommunikasiekanale. Werk rekords van ondersteuningsintervensies en -betrokkedomhede op interne digitale stelsels by. Monitering, verslagdoening en inligtingsbestuur: Bied bystand met die monitering van programimplementering deur gebruik van gestandaardiseerde digitale verslaersjablone. Stel vorderingsverslae, statusbywerkings en voorleggings saam deur gebruik van elektroniese stelsels. Verseker tydige vaslegging en bywerking van implementeringsdata om prestasieverslagdoening te ondersteun. Kommunikasie en belanghebbende-betrokking: Opstel korrespondensie, verslae, aanbiedings en voorleggings met behulp van digitale nutsmiddels en dokumentbestuurstelsels. Ondersteun virtuele en hibriede vergaderings, werkswinkels en belanghebbende-betrokkedomhede, insluitend: Elektroniese verspreiding van dokumente, Digitale notuletaking en rekordhouding, Deel goedgekeurde inligting deur elektroniese kanale om koördinasie en nakoming te ondersteun. Administratiewe steun: Verskaf administratiewe steun deur gebruik van digitale werkvloei, insluitend elektroniese indiening en dokumentbestuur. Bywerking van digitale logboeke en register. Skedulering van vergaderings deur gebruik van aanlynkalenders. Ondersteun die besigheidseenheid in die verminding van papiergebaseerde prosesse deur die nakoming van digitale-eerste administratiewe praktyke.

zu.title: Onjiniyela: Intuthuko Yezomnotho Yendawo Nendawo
zu.summary: Onjiniyela wocwaningo nosekelo lwemininingwane wezinhlelo zentuthuko yezomnotho yendawo nendawo ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Small Business Development, ose Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor (NQF 7) kwezSayensi Ezenhlalonhle, Izomnotho, Ezemali Zentuthuko, Ezentengiso, Eziphathelene Nokuphathwa Kwebhizinisi, Eziphathelene Nokolawula Ibhizinisi, Intuthuko Yezomnotho Yendawo, noma izifundo ezingabanjwayo / ezihlobene njengoba zivotwa ngu-SAQA. Isifundo esinolwazi ngendlela zocwaningo, ukuhlaziya imininingwane, izinqumo zomphakathi, ukuba ngumyili webhizinisi, intuthuko ye-MSME noma intuthuko yezomnotho yendawo sizoba yinikhasi. Okungenani unyaka owodwa wamava kokuphathwa kwezindaba, ocwaningo, ukuhlanganisa noma ukusekela izinhlelo kwindawo yentuthuko yezomnotho, kahulumeni wendawo noma wedolobha, intuthuko yamabhizinisi amancane, ezemali zentuthuko, kwikhaladi yomphakathi noma ezindaweni zokuququ nthelana namalungu abantu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: ulwazi oluyisiseko ngohlelo lwentuthuko yamabhizinisi amancane, okuhlanganisa ama-MSME, amakho-ophasheni namabhizinisi angakahlelekile. Ulwazi oluyisiseko ngesakhiwo sezinqumo zomthetho ze-Local Economic Development, Izinhlelo Zentuthuko Ezihlanganisiwe kanye ne-District Development Model. Ukuqonda okuyisiseko ngentuthuko yamabhizinisi, ezemali zentuthuko, izinto zokusekela ibhizinisi kanye nendlela zokuqondisa. Ulwazi oluyisiseko ngocwaningo, ukuqoqa imininingwane, ukulandelela, ukubika kanye nokuqondiswa ngemininingwane ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuqonda ngokuphathwa kwemininingwane yedijithali, i-POPIA, ukuvikeleka kwe-ICT kanye nendlela zokuphathwa kwezindaba zikahulumeni. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ucwaningo kanye nokuhlaziya izinqumo zomthetho okuyisiseko. Ukuqoqa, ukuqinisekisa, ukuhlaziya kanye nokutolika imininingwane. Ukubhala imibiko, okwaziyo izincazelo nokulungiselela okokubukisa. Ukuhlanganyela nokuhlanganisa abahlanganyeli kuzakhiwo zesifunda, ezifundazwe nasezindaweni. Ukugcina imibhalo yedijithali, ukuphatha amadokhumenti abhaliwe ngamageshe kanye nokusebenzisa izindlela zokubika. Ukuhlanganisa amaphrojekthi okuyisiseko, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nentuthuko entsha yokwethula izinsizakalo. Amandla wokwenza umsebenzi: Ukuxhumana, okuhlanganisa izinhlinzo ezibhalwe kahle nezethulo ezikhulumwayo. Ukuqoqa imininingwane, ukunemba, ukuqinisekisa izinga kanye nokuqaphela izinto ezincane. Ukuhlanganisa amaphrojekthi kanye nezinhlelo okuyisiseko. Ukucabanga ngekuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuthuthuka ngokungapheli. Ukuhlanganyela abahlanganyeli, ukuhlanganisa kanye nokuqondiswa ezinsizakalweni. Ukugcina imibhalo yedijithali, ukuphatha imininingwane kanye nokuphatha imininingwane ngokuba nembe. Ukuzivikela, ukufunda kanye nentuthuko entsha ezinsizakalweni. Okungeziwe: Ukubuka ngokwekhompyutha, okuhlanganisa amaphakheji we-MS Office, ukuphatha amadokhumenti abhaliwe ngamageshe, ama-spreadsheet, izinto zokubukisa namapulatifomu wokusebenza ngokudijithali. Ilayisensi yokushayela izothathwa njengenikhasi.
zu.duties: Ucwaningo Nosekelo Lwemininingwane: Yenza ucwaningo ngedeskithophu noma ngqo usebenzisa izinto zocwaningo zedijithali kanye nemithombo yemininingwane ukuze usekele izinhlelo zentuthuko yezomnotho yendawo nendawo. Bhala, uvuselele futhi uqinisekise imininingwane yocwaningo kuzibasekhedini zedijithali nasezindaweni zokugcina imininingwane. Siza ukuhlaziya imininingwane okuyisiseko nokulungiselela imibiko yedijithali, izifinyezo nezethulo. Sekela ukulandelela njalo izinto ezenzeka, izinkinga namathuba ahlangabezana nama-MSME, amakho-ophasheni kanye nomnotho wendawo. Izenqumo Zomthetho, Isu Nosekelo Lwezinhlelo: Yisela ekwakheni nokuvuselela izinqumo zomthetho ezigcinwa ngokudijithali, izingqikithi zokusebenza ezivamile (SOPs), amathempleythi kanye nezinqondiso. Gcina futhi uvuselele izindawo zokugcina ulwazi zedijithali kanye nezibasekhedini eziphathelene kahulumeni wendawo, intuthuko yendawo kanye nosekelo lwe-MSME. Siza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane inembile, ifinyeleleka futhi igcinwe ngendlela efanayo kuzo zizonke izindlela. Ukuhlanganisa Izinsiza Zokusekela Ibhizinisi: Siza ukuhlanganisa ukufinyelela kuzinhlelo zokusekela ibhiziniso ngemali nangaphandle kwemali usebenzisa izinto zokulandelela ngokudijithali nezindlela zokubika. Sekela ukuqondisa abahlanganyeli kanye nokuxhumana nabo nge-imeyili, amapulatifomu kwi-inthanethi nangezinye izindlela zokuxhumana zedijithali. Vuselela imibhalo yezinto zokusekela kanye namabhuku kuzindlela zangaphakathi zedijithali. Ukulandelela, Ukubika Nokuphatha Imininingwane: Siza ukulandelela ukuqaliswa kwezinhlelo usebenzisa amathempleythi okubika abhalwe ngendlela efanayo ngokudijithali. Qamba imibiko yentuthuko, okokuvuselela kanye nezinhlangothi ezithunyelwa kubhaqwe usebenzisa izindlela zedijithali. Qinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yokwenza umsebenzi ibhalwa futhi ivuselelwa esikhathini ukuze kusekelwe ukubika ngemisebenzi. Ukuxhumana Nokuxhumana Nabahlanganyeli: Bhala izinhlangothi, imibiko, okokubukisa nezinto ezithunyelwa kubhaqwe usebenzisa izinto zedijithali nezindlela zokuphatha amadokhumenti. Sekela izinkathi eziqondene nabahlanganyeli kwi-inthanethi noma eziyinhlanganisela, amawokishophu kanye nokuhlangana nabahlanganyeli, okuhlanganisa: Ukusabalalisa amadokhumenti ngokudijithali, ukuthatha amaminithi kanye nokugcina imibhalo ngokudijithali, ukwabelana ngemininingwane egunyaziwe ngezindlela zedijithali ukuze kusekelwe ukuhlanganisa nokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukusekela Eziphathelene Nolawulo: Nikeza ukusekela okuphathelene nolawulo usebenzisa izindlela zokusebenza zedijithali, okuhlanganisa ukugcina amafayela kanye nokuphatha amadokhumenti ngokudijithali. Ukuvuselela amalogi namarejista wedijithali. Ukulungiselela izonke izinkathi ngokusebenzisa ikhalenda ye-inthanethi. Sekela ihlelo lobhizinisi ekwehliseni izindlela ezisebenzisa amaphaphusha ngokulandela izindlela zokuqala zokuphatha izindaba ngokudijithali.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise administrative and clerical support services, including personnel and financial administration, within the SAPS Publication and Broadcast Section in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must display competency in the core functions of the post. Be proficient in at least English and one other official language. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of Grade 12/ Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 or equivalent qualification (NQF Level 4 as recognized by SAQA). At least four (4) years’ experience in the field of the post. An applicable three (3) year Diploma / Degree (NQF level 6 or higher as recognized by SAQA) as well as relevant training courses in the field of the post will serve as an added advantage, A valid driver’s license for at least a light motor vehicle will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of relevant prescripts applicable to the Public Service. Good verbal and written communication skills. General Computer literacy (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Outlook). Demonstrate competency in acting independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Report writing. Presentation Skills, Problem Solving, Sound Planning, Organising and Administration Skills, Strong Analytical Skills and Facilitation Skills. Be willing to work under pressure and extended hours.
jobs.duties: Provide administrative support to the Section Head: Publication and Broadcast. Provide personnel administration and general clerical and logistical support services within the Section. Oversee and provide financial administration support and monitoring of the Section’s budget allocation and expenditure. Planning, controlling and administration of procurement, human resource support and supply chain management clerical services. Gathering, drafting, and compiling strategic documents and assisting in implementing Section’s operational plans.
jobs.enquiries: Capt NM Pretorius / W/O TB Tshabalala at: 082 778 3708 / 082 906 7372
jobs.applications: E-mailed to TshabalalaBeauty@saps.gov.za Applications may be hand-delivered, as follows: 152 Johannes Ramakhoase Street, Telkom Towers North, Pretoria. Application must be deposited into the box available at the reception area. Applications forwarded by post to be addressed to The Section Head: Corporate Support, (Attention: Captain Pretorius / W/O Tshabalala), Corporate Support, South African Police Service, Private Bag X94, Pretoria, 0001.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for, must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. UkuCwangcisa, ukuLawula nokuLawula inkcitho, uLundo lwabasebenzi nokuLawulwa koluntu nokuLungelelaniswa kwamakhono eNkonzo yemicimbi yokuhamba isixhobo. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir ten minste 'n ligte motorvoertuig sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Bokulawula
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wabasebenzi bokulawula e-South African Police Service e-Pretoria, sidinga ibanga le-12 namava okuxhumana namabezindaba, sinikeza i-R338106 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babonise ukukwazi kumisebenzi eyinhloko yesikhundla. kube bahle kakhulu ngokulalela futhi kungenani esiNgisini nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni. kube ngabakhamuzi beRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika okufanele bazokuletha ubufakazi obushicilelwe ngosuku lokuxoxisana. Babe nobanga le-12/ Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu/ I-NCV Level 4 noma isiqu esilinganayo (I-NQF Level 4 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA). Bibe namava okungenani eminyakeni emine (4) emkhakheni wesikhundla. I-diploma/ I-degree (izinga le-NQF 6 noma ngaphezulu njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA) yeminyaka emithathu (3) ehambisana nakho kanye nemiklalo yolwazi ehambisana nemkhakha wesikhundla izokuba yinzwelo engeziwe. I-licence yokushayela evumelekile yokeneNgimoto elula izokuba yinzwelo engeziwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono nokukwazi: Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambisana nomphakathi kazwelonke. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana ngomlomo nokuqamba amagama. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuvamile (i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, i-MS Office, i-MS Power Point, i-MS Outlook). Kubonise ukukwazi ukusebenza kozimele, ngobungcweti, ngobophezelo nangokuzethemba. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ukubhala imibiko. Amakhono okubhukuda, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela okusemthethweni, ukuhlanganisa nokulawula kanye namakhono okulawula kahle, amakhono amakhulu okuhlaziya namakhonookuqondisa. kube besaba ngokusebenzisa inkani nangamahora anwetshisiwe.
zu.duties: Siza ekuphenduleni imibuzo yabezindaba kanye nezicelo zolwazi. Xhumana nabezindaba, Izigungu kahulumeni, abaphathi bokuxhumana kanye nalabo abahlobene nomsebenzi. Qoqa, qinisekisa futhi uhlanganise ulwazi kumasiteshi ePhoyisa, Ehhovisi leSifunda nezoHlelo. Dlulisela imibuzo yabezindaba eyinkimbinkimbi noma ebandlana nobhophi ohambelanayo noma somlomo ovunyelwe. Gcina idatha eyaBha yoxhumano namabezindaba nalabo abahlobene nomsebenzi. Bumba okuqukethwe kumapulatifomu e-SAPS omlando osemthethweni namawebhusayithi asemthethweni. Layisha futhi ushicilele okuqukethwe okuvunyelwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho yomnyango. Hlola amapulatifomu ohlelo lokusebenza bese ukhomba izinkinga zokuxhumana ezidinga ukunakwa. Qinisekisa ulwazi izithombe ngaphambi kokushicilelwa. Siza ekulandelweni ukuzibandakanya kwabalandeli bese ubhalaimibiko ngemisebenzi yokuxhumana ohlelweni lokusebenza.

xh.title: Ifuthe lokugcina amatyala eNdlela yokwenza imisebenzi yabantu ngokusesikweni seNqanaba lesiXhesha saseNtlane yeSizwe ngokusesikweni
xh.summary: Indima yeNkundla yoBukhulu beNgxoxo yamaphoyisa ePretoria, eNgingqi yaseBurharha Afrika, efuneka ibe Grade 12 kwaye igqibe ukubakho kwinkqubo yasekhaya eyinkulungwane kwinkqubo ekujoliswe kuyo eluntshu lwamaza.
xh.requirements: Iingxoxo zokuxhasa amasebe aze ahlengwe ngenkqubo yokunika inqanaba lokulungiselelwa kwesaziso somanyano iSAPS ekuqwalaselweni kwipropathi yendlu edolophini, ezidolophu ziyakwazi ukuqinisekisa nokukhulisa ulwazi olunxulumene nemisebenzi yesithuba. Njengomgaqo, abafuna ukuba kwindima banokuxhomekeke kwiprofayile yokutyikityo okanye kwindlela yokusetyenziswa kolwazi, abamelana namava ezidolophu kwinkqubo yaseMzantsi Afrika ekhankqanya oku kutyikitywe kwipropathi yesaziso sosapho.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuphenduleni imibuzo yabezidolophu nokufuna kolwazi. Hamba nomdibano nabalobi bendaba, amasebe oRhulumente, abaqeqeshi bokunxibelelwana nabaninxeba abamqamileyo. Qokele, qinisekisa ukuze udibanise ulwazi kwiZiko loKhotelo leeNkonzo zeSikolo samapolisa, iiZiko zeNgingqi namaQela. Thumela imibuzo eqambele okanye evuseleyo yabezidolophu kumnikelo wolwazi ochanekileyo okanye kumnqweli oxelwayo. Gcina uluhlu oluhlaziwayo lwabanxiba nemoxa kwezidolophu nabaninxeba. Yila okuqwalaselwayo kumaza kwangaphakathi amakhuselwa isaziso somanyano iSAPS namawebhsayithi ezisemthethweni. Layisha upapaishe okuqinisekisiweyo ngokwemigaqo yesabe. Qinisekisa izinkqubo zamaza nakuthotho ukubonisa imiba yokunxibelelwana efuneka ingqalelo. Qinisekisa ulwazi nemifanekiso phambi kokupapashwa. Nceda ekulandeleni unxibelelwano lwabaphulaphuli nasekuqokelelweni ngemiyalezo nge nkqubo yonxibelelwano namaza osesikweni zasekhaya eziseziko eligqibeleleyo zesaziso.

zu.title: Clerk Wezokuphathwa
zu.summary: I-clerk wezokuphathwa ethela inkxaso yezokuphathwa nezokuhlelwa kwabashayeli kumnyango wezokusebenza ngendlela evunyelwe kwa-SAPS ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kumele baveze ikhono emisebenzini eyinhloko yesikhundla. Bazi kahulu ukusebenza ngesiNgisi futhi besinye isilimi esisemthethweni. Babe ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, okufanele kubekho ubufakazi ababubhukweni ngosuku lokubonisana. Babe nesatifakethi se-Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 noma isitifikethi esilingana (i-NQF level 4 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA). Izifundo ezihambisana nendawo yesikhundla zizokuba yinkxaso ekhulu. Ulwazi, amakhono kanye namakhono okusebenza: Amakhono ajwayelekile okusebenza ngekhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, i-MS Office, i-MS PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook). Bonise ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele, ngokungathathi hlangothi, ngokuphendula ngemisebenzi nangokwethembeka. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ukuqamba amaphuzu, izokuphathwa kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ukugxila kumakhaya kanye nokuphendula. Kubekulungile ukusebenza ngokucindezelwa okukhulu nangamahora amade.
zu.duties: Nikela inkxaso ezokuphathwa futhi uphathe izindaba ezihambisana nezokuhlelwa kwabashayeli. Gcina amarekhodi wokushiya noma ukulibala, amarejista kanye namafayela. Phendula futhi uhlolo wonke amakholi angena kwindawo yokusebenza yesigaba. Bhala izibalo, amaleti, amaminithi, amagenda, phatha amadokhumenti ayingomfihlo, ugcine irekhodi lamaminithi futhi ulawule ukugeleza kwamadokhumenti angena futhi aphuma kwindawo yokusebenza. Gcina ukugcina amarekhodi kahle, ukufaka kwamafayela kanye nendlela yokuhambisa phambili. Sebenzisa izinsiza ezijwayelekile (umshini wokushaja, ucingo, amakhompyutha). Lawula imali yesabelo kanye nezindaba zokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali iyasebenza ngendlela elungile. Nikela izibalo ngamasonto onke. Lawula onke abantu kanye nezinsiza ezingokwemvelo endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana ne-Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury, emiThetho kanye nemigomo.

xh.title: Clerk weqela loqoqosho
xh.summary: U-Clerk woqoqosho ohlinzela ngokuxhasa ngokweqela loqoqosho nangokwezinto ezingeniso ecaleni kolwandle kwisebe le-SAPS Corporate Communication and Liaison ePretoria.

Abameme owenza isikhundla esisembathweni kuwo onke amagama abo kumazwe aphesheya, kwaye abe nomtsalane ongagqithiswanga ngokubakho kwakho nakwisiphithiphithi kusuku lokudibana. Abongama nemvume yobudlelwane obuphezulu kakhulu / iceder yobudlelwane / i-NCV Level 4 okanye isidingo esilinganayo (i-NQF level 4 njengoko evunywe yi-SAQA). Iindidi ezizele ngokwale ndawo yemisebenzi ziya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi, izakhono namakhono: Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha ngokubanzi (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint kunye ne-MS Outlook). Bonisa ukuziphatha ngokuzimele ngokweqela ngokwaseburhabeleni, ngokuzibophelela kwaye ngokuthembeka. Isakhono esihle sokuzithethela nokubhala. Ulwazi oluphezulu lokulungiselela, ukuhamba ngokulungele, uqoqosho kunye nokuqondisa iingxaki. Isakhono esiphezulu sokudibana nabantu. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Kufuneka alungele ukusebenza ngokucinezela iinkalo ezongezelelwe.
xh.duties: Zenza imisebenzi yokuxhasa eqoqosho uluntu eqondisa nengqiqo yezinto ezingeniso ecaleni kolwandle. Igcina amagama engxamisele ezenziweyo, iindlela ezithile namagunya. Phendula kwaye uhlale ngqo onke amacebiso amaninzi angena kwiofisi yecandelo. Bhala iingxelo, iileta, imizuzu, izihloko, qhatha amaxwebhu aqotho, gcina amagama emizuzu, kwaye ulawule ukungena nokuphuma kwamaxwebhu kwiofisi. Gcina ukwenza ubukhulu bekhaya obupheleleyo, ukulungisa amagunya, kwaye uze ulethe inkqubo yokuziphatha eqhuba phambili. Sebenzisa izixhobo eziqhelekileyo (umyalezo wefowuni, ikhompyutha, ifowuni). Lawula imali yokutya kwaye ulawule iingxelo ezibangelwa ukutengiswa. Qinisekisa ukuba ukutyibilika kwemali kuyilo ngokuchanekileyo. Nikeza ngeengxelo ngeveki. Lawula onke amaxhoma obomi bomntu namaxhoma ezinto ezingeniso kwiofisi eqondisa kwelinye igunya. Qinisekisa ukuziphatha ngokutsho kwemithetho ye-Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) kunye noLawulo lwesigqeba semali, iMithetho yeSizwe kunye namagunya alawulayo.

af.title: Sekretaresse
af.summary: Sekretaresse wat administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuning aan die Korporatiewe Kommunikasie en Skakeling-komponent by die South African Police Service in Pretoria verskaf.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Wees vaardig in ten minste English en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republic of South Africa waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. Beskik oor Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF level 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Relevante kursusse op die gebied van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Algemene rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint en MS Outlook). Toon bevoegdheid in onafhanklike, professionele, aanspreeklike en geloofwaardige optrede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Sterk beplannings-, organisasie-, administratiewe en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Sterke interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kliëntegerigtheid en reaksievermoë. Wees bereid om onder druk en gedurende uitgebreide ure te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die Kantoor van die Komponenthoof: Korporatiewe Kommunikasie en Skakeling. Beantwoord en filtreer inkomende telefoonoproepe en navrae. Tik verslae, korrespondensie, notules, agenda's en ander amptelike dokumente. Hanteer vertroulike dokumente en inligting. Hou notules aan en monitor die vloei van dokumente binne die kantoor. Skakel met interne Komponente, Afdelings en eksterne belanghebbendes oor aangeleenthede wat verband hou met die Kantoor; Bestuur die dagboek, afsprake en skedules van die Komponenthoof. Ontvang en hanteer besoekers op 'n professionele wyse; Herinner die Komponenthoof aan geskeduleerde vergaderings, afsprake en sperdatums. Verseker die aanskaffing en bediening van verfrisings tydens vergaderings. Reël en bespreek plekke vir vergaderings, werkswinkels en konferensies. Maak reis- en akkommodasiereëlings en verwerk verwante eise. Onderhou 'n doeltreffende stelsel vir rekordhouding, lêerwerk en bring-vorentoe. Bedryf standaardkantoortoerusting soos telefoone, rekenaars en fotostaatmasjiene. Verskaf algemene ontfangsdiense.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Unobhala ohlinzela ngokusekelwa kokuphatha kwezindaba nokubhala ohlelweni lwe-Corporate Communication and Liaison e-South African Police Service e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babonise ikhono kumisebenzi eyisisekelo yesikhundla. Babe bulezi ngesiNgisi okungenani kolunye ulimi olusemthethweni. Babe ngabakwaRepublic of South Africa, okufanele kufakwe isibonakaliso sedokhumenti ngosuku lolulwazvo. Babe nobungqangi be-Grade 12 / Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 noma isitifiketi esilinganayo (i-NQF level 4 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA). Oocamp abahlobene nendawo yesikhundla bazoba yinzululwazi eengezwayo. Ulwazi, amakhono nobukh obubuchasene: Amandla ejwayelekile wokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook). Bonise ukuba nakwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcotshwa, ngobophezelo, ngokwethembeke. Amandla amahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nakubhala. Amandla okuhlela uqobo, ukuhlela abantu nabasebenzi, ukuphatha izindaba nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana nothile. Ukuqondisisa imfuneko yomthengi nokuphendula. Babe ukulungele ukusebenza ngocinelo nangamahora enwele.
zu.duties: Hlinzela ngokusekelwa okubhalayo nokuphatha izindaba ehhovisi likaHla uHlelo be-Corporate Communication and Liaison. Phendula uhlule amacala ezocingo ezifakwayo nemibuzo. Thayipha imibiko, izincwadi, ishiti lomhlangano, izinhlelo zemihlangano namanye amadokhumenti ahlobene nendawo yokusebenza. Phathisisa amadokhumenti alondolozako ulwazi olufihlile. Gcina irekhod ecwashisa ngokuhamba kwamadokhumenti ngaphakathi kwehhovisi. Xhumanisa ngaphakathi ngemiyalo, kusigaba bese uyaxhumanisa nezigaba, iziqohoxa nabaqaphi bangaphandle ngendaba ezihlobene nehhovisi. Phatha ihhoho, ukugqoka izinkomba nezinhlelo zoHla uHlelo. Bamukele aphathe ngokobungcotshwa izivakashi. Khumbuza uHla uHlelo ngemihlangano ehleliwe, izinhlelo zokugqoka izinguquko. Qinisekisa ukutholwa ukudla kwaseminthambo ngenkathi kunemihlangano. Hlela ugcine izindawo zemihlangano, imihlangano, amawokhoshapha kanye nama-conference. Yenza izinhlela zokuhamba nokulala futhi ucubungule izinkomba ezihlobene. Gcina isistimu esebenzayo yokugcina amarekhodi, ukuhlela amafayela kanye nesistimu e-vela phambili. Sebenzisa okufanele amahhovisi anjengezingcingo, izikhompyutha namashishino amakhophi. Hlinzela ngokwamukelela izivakashi.

xh.title: Unobhala
xh.summary: Unobhala onika inkxaso yolawulo nobhalo kwinxalenye ye-Corporate Communication and Liaison kwi-South African Police Service ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo mababonise ukwazi kwimisebenzi eyintsengotsi yesi sithuba. Masibe balulekile okungenani ngesiNgesi nolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni. Mabe ngabemi baseRiphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika apho usicwanguniso lubhalwe lweenkcukacha makuze kungangomhla wokuqondiswa. Mabenabo ibhasiki yeqatha le-12 / I-Senior Certificate / NCV Level 4 okanye isifundo esilinganayo (NQF level 4 njengokuqatywa yi-SAQA). Iikhosi ezifanelekileyo kwinkalo yesi sithuba ziya kubakho nzuzo eyongeziweyo. Ulwazi, amakhono nokwazi: Amakhono jikelele okusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint ne-MS Outlook). Mabonise ukwazi ukuziphatha ezimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngexabiso nangokuzinika. Amakhono amabalwa abhalwayo nokuThetha alungileyo. Ukuceba okulungileyo, ukuqamba, imisebenzi yolawulo nokusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono amaninzi okuzibandakanya nabantu. Ugqalelo kumthengi nokuPhendula. Mabe wulungele ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwegxabo nexesha elide.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolawulo nobhali kwiNkokheli yeNxalenye: Corporate Communication and Liaison. Phendula kwaye uhlole iingcingo ezize nezibuzo ezize. Thayipha iingxelo, iincwadana, imizuzu, iindaba ezibalulekileyo namanye amaxwebhu asemthethweni. Lawula amaxwebhu axokiweyo nolwazi. Gcina irekhodi yemizuzu uze ulawule ukuhamba kwamaxwebhu ngaphakathi kwe-ofisi. Qhagamshelana neenxalenye ezingaphakathi, Icandelo namahlakahlaka angaphandle kumacala axhwele kuMnye weNkokheli; Lawula idayari, iindibano nemizila yeNkokheli yeNxalenye. Yamkela uphathise ababhenyi ngendlela ebonisa ubungcali; Khumbuza iNkokheli yeNxalenye ngeendibano ezicwangiweyo, iindibano namaxesha awavaliweyo. Qinisekisa ukuthengwa nokuziswa kwesnaksi naxesha lweendibano. Lungiselela uze ubhale iindawo zokuqokelela iindibano, iindibano zoluntu namanyathelo okuzimisela. Yenza izicwangciso zokuhamba nokuhlala uze ulawule izikhalazo ezinxulumene nazo. Gcina inkqubo esebenzayo yokugcina iirekhodi, ukubhala iifayile nokuZisa-phambili. Sebenzisa izixhobo zohlahlo lwabasebenzi ezingundoqo njengamacingo, ikhompyutha neziguquli-mifanekiso. Yenza iinkonzo ezijikeleze zokwamkela ababhenyi.

jobs.title: Secretary
jobs.centre: HQ: Pretoria – Section Head: Physical Protection
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial support including meetings, minutes, call screening and record keeping at SAPS HQ in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must display competency in the core functions of the post. Be proficient in at least English and one other official language. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa, of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of Grade 12/ Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 or equivalent qualification (NQF level 4 as recognised by SAQA). Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Relevant courses in the field of the post will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: General computer literacy skills (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint and MS Outlook). Demonstrate competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good verbal and written communication skills. Sound planning, organizing, administrative and problem-solving skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Customer focus and responsiveness. Be willing to work under pressure and extended hours.
jobs.duties: To provide secretarial support functions such as to arrange and prepare meetings, agendas, typing and taking minutes. Answer and screen all incoming calls. Liaise with all sections and regions on matters relating to the Component. Maintain good record keeping, filling system and brought forward system. Process and submit financial claims. Make travel and accommodation arrangements. Manage the diary, receive and host visitors for the office. Operate standard equipment (fax, photocopy machine, telephone, computers etc.). Serving of refreshments to visitors during meetings. Manage office inventory. Uphold the confidentiality of all classified documents as per the MISS. Manage and exercise control over human, physical and financial resources allocated to the post.
jobs.enquiries: Warrant Officer Mnyalatyho Tel No: (012) 400 5105/ AC Sekwape Tel No: (012) 400 5137/ AC Modiha/ HRC Sibande Tel No: (012) 400 5147
jobs.applications: Please e-mail: MnyalatyhoLL@saps.gov.za / SekwapeND@saps.gov.za / SibandeK@saps.gov.za / ModihaI@saps.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for, must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Short-listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. People who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.

af.title: Sekretaris
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning insluitend vergaderings, notule, oproepfiltering en rekordhouding by SAPS HQ in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Wees vaardig in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud voorsien moet word. Beskik oor Graad 12/ Senior Sertifikaat/ NCV Vlak 4 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud voorsien moet word. Relevante kursusse op die gebied van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Algemene rekenaargeletterdheidvaardighede (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint en MS Outlook). Toon bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Degelike beplannings-, organisasie-, administratiewe en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Sterke interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kliëntefokus en responseerheid. Wees bereid om onder druk en gedurende uitgebreide ure te werk.
af.duties: Om sekretariële ondersteuningsfunksies te verskaf soos om vergaderings, agenda's te reël en voor te berei, tik en notule neem. Beantwoord en filter alle inkomende oproepe. Skakel met alle afdelings en streke oor aangeleenthede rakende die Komponent. Handhaaf goeie rekordhouding, lêerstelsel en vooruitskuiwingsstelsel. Verwerk en dien finansiële eise in. Maak reis- en akkommodasie-reëlings. Bestuur die dagboek, ontvang en gasheer besoekers vir die kantoor. Bedryf standaardtoerusting (faks, fotokopieermasjien, telefoon, rekenaars ens.). Bedien van verfrisings aan besoekers tydens vergaderings. Bestuur kantoorvoorraad. Handhaaf die vertroulikheid van alle geklassifiseerde dokumente volgens die MISS. Bestuur en oefen beheer uit oor menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne wat aan die pos toegewys is.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Nikela ngokusekelwa okusemnyameni okuhlanganisa izinkomfa, amaminithi, ukuhlunga amakhol kugcinwemafa e-SAPS HQ e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babonise ukuba basakhono kumisebenzi eyisisekelo yesikhundla. Babe nobuqhawe okungenani esiNgisini nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni. Babe ngabakhazimulaki beRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, okufanele kuboniswe ubufakazi bakhumbule ngosuku lokuxoxwa nabo. Babe nesiKlasi 12/ Isitifikedi Sezinkulisa/ I-NCV Level 4 noma izifundo ezingabalinganiswa (I-NQF level 4 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA). Babe ngabakhazimulaki beRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika okufanele kuboniswe ubufakazi bakhumbule ngosuku lokuxoxwa nabo. Amakilasi ahambisana nomkhakha wesikhundla azoba yinzuzoengeziwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono nobuqhawe: Amandla ojantshi ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (I-MS Word, I-MS Excel, I-MS Office, I-MS PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook). Bonisa ukuba nakho ukuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuqotho nangokwethemba. Amandla amahle okukhulumana ngomlomo nokubhala. Amandla amahle okucubungula, ukuhlela, okwezobulungiswa kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amandla amakhulu okuhlobana nabantu. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula kalula. Bezele ukusebenza ngaphezu kwanoma yikuphi esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Ukwethula imisebenzi yokusekela unobhala efana nokuhlela futhi kulungiselelwe izinkomfa, izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuthayipha nokubhala amaminithi. Phendula ukuhlufe wonke amakholi angena. Xhumana nazo zonke izingxenye namaphesheya ngemayelana ne-Component. Gcina kahle ukugcinwa kwarekhodi, indlela yokugcwayiza kanye nesistimu yokuhamba phambili. Thumela futhi qinisekisa izimangalo zemali. Hlela izinhlelo zokuhamba nokuhlala. Phatha idayari, wamukele futhi wathole abavakashi bethu. Sebenzisa izekwazi zangasese (i-fax, i-photocopier, ucingo, ikhompyutha, njll.). Phatha isitoko esikhundleni. Qinisekisa ukubaluleka kokuthula kokuqinisekisiwe ngendlela ebose kakhulu njengokuhlangene nokuqinisekiswa kwe-MLS emthethweni.

xh.title: Unobhala
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolusekretofane olubandakunya iintlanganiso, amaminithi, ukuhlolwa kweefowuni nokugcina iirekhodi e SAPS HQ e Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufunke babonise ukwazi kumisebenzi engundoqo yesithuba. Kufunke bakwazi ukuluncedo ulwimi lwesiNgesi nolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni. Kufunke babe ngabazali boRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, abo baya kusoloko kufuneka bazise ubungqina ngemibhalo ngosuku lokudityaniswa. Kufunke kugcinwe ibhashe leGqweshe 12/ Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo/ NCV Level 4 okanye isifundo esilinganayo (NQF level 4 njengoko samkelwe yi SAQA). Kufunke babe ngabazali boRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika abo baya kusoloko kufuneka bazise ubungqina ngemibhalo ngosuku lokudityaniswa. Iifundiso ezahlobene nendawo yesithuba ziya kubakho nzuzo ekongezelelweni. Ulwazi, Amakhono nobuNako: Amakhono jikelele ekusebenziseni khompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint ne MS Outlook). Bonisa ukwazi ukuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokubambekayo nangokwesigqeba. Amakhono amabalise asemlonyeni nasekubhalweni okulungileyo. Amakhono alungelelwaniso, ukuqamba, olulawulo nolwelweziwa. Amakhono angaphakathi amandla. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuvela. Kufunke bazimisele ukusebenza ngxweme nangamaxa amade.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yonobhala njengokuqamba nokulungiselela iintlanganiso, iindaba, ukuthayipha nokubhala amaminithi. Phendula ukuze uhlolo zonke iifowuni ezingeziwe. Qhagamshelana nazo zonke iicandelo nakummandla kumaphakathi ngokumalunga neNgcuva. Gcina iirekhodi ezilungileyo, inkqubo yokugcina iifayili nenkqabo yokushicilelwa phambili. Qhubeka uze unike iimalambo zemali. Yenza iindlela zokuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Lawula idayari, wamkele abasindile bengenile kwindawo yolusekretofane. Sebenzisa izixhobo eziqhelekileyo (ifeksi, imovana yokutsala, ifowuni, khompyutha, nokunye). Konike abasindile kwindawo yolusekretofane ngexesha leentlanganiso. Lawula izinto ezingangeniswa kulusekretofane. Gcina iimfihlelo zonke iifayili ezibalulekileyo njengoko kuchazwe kwi MISS. Lawula uzibe nokusingatha ngaphezulu amalambo abantu, abalawuliweyo nemali anikelwa kusithuba.

af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Wees bedrywig in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Besit 'n Graad 12/ Senior Sertifikaat/ NCV Vlak 4 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. Relevante kursusse in die veld van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Algemene rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint en MS Outlook). Toon bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Klank beplanning, organisasie, administratiewe en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Wees bereid om onder druk en gedurende uitgebreide ure te werk.
af.duties: Om sekretariële ondersteuningsfunksies te verskaf soos om vergaderings, agenda's reël en voor te berei, tik en notule neem. Beantwoord en syfer alle inkomende oproepe. Skakel met alle afdelings en streke oor aangeleenthede rakende die Komponent. Onderhou goeie rekordhouding, lêerstelsel en vooruitskuiwende stelsel. Prosesseer en dien finansiële eise in. Maak reëlings vir reis en akkommodasie. Bestuur die dagboek, ontvang en huisves besoekers vir die kantoor. Bedryf standaardtoerusting (faks, fotostaatmasjien, telefoon, rekenaars ens.). zu.title: Umbhali-jikelele
zu.summary: Ukubonelela ngesekelayo eqenjini Counter Assault Team e SAPS Headquarters e Pretoria, ukuphatha izinkulumompikiswano, amakholi kanye nokugcina imibhalo.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izifundo kumele babonise ubuchwepheshe kwimisebenzi eyisiseko yalesi sikhundla. Bakhonze ngokuphelele ngeNgisi kanti nakolunye ulimi olusemthethweni. Bengabasebenzeli beRiphabhuliki yase Ningizimu Afrika okumele kulethwe ubufakazi obubhalwe ngosuku lokubuzwa imibuzo. Babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12/ NCV Level 4 noma elingana nalo (NQF level 4 njengoba kuqashwa yi SAQA). Bengabasebenzeli beRiphabhuliki yase Ningizimu Afrika okumele kulethwe ubufakazi obubhalwe ngosuku lokubuzwa imibuzo. Amakilasi ahlobene nomkhamba walesi sikhundla azoba yinsetshenziswa eenge. Ulwazi, Amakhono nobuchwepheshe: Amakhono abhalo-jikelele ekhompyutheni (MS Word, MS Excel, neMS Office, neMS PowerPoint kanye ne MS Outlook). Khombisa ubuchwepheshe ekuziphatheni ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobophezelo futhi ngesithunzi. Amakhono abalulekile wokukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono abalulekile wokuhlela, ukuhlela, okuphathwayo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono abalulekile wokuxhumana nabantu. Ukugxila kumthengi futhi baphendule. Babe readiness yokusebenza ngaphezulu kwamandla futhi ngamahora amakhulu.
zu.duties: Ukubonelela ngemisebenzi yobhalo-jikelele efana nokuhlela futhi kulungiswe izinkulumompikiswano, amagaxa amabalazwe, ukuthayipha kanye nokubhala imizuzu. Phendula futhi uhlole onke amakholi angena. Xhumana nazo zonke izingxenye nomasifundile ngemikhwaba ehlobene naleziYingqi. Gcina ukubhalwa kwemibono okuhle, indlela yokugcwalisa imibhalo kanye nenhlelelo yokuletha phambili. Yenza futhi uhlole izimangalo zemali. Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Phatha idayari, wamukele futhi ubambe abanye ababukeli bholiki isikhundla. Sebenzisa izinsiza ezijwayelekile (ifeksi, umshini wokukopisha, ucingo, amakhompyutha, njll.). Phathwa ababukeli bhadi ngesiphuzo phakathi nezinkulumompikiswano. Phatha izinto ezibhalwayo zesikhundla. Gcina imfihlo yayo yonke imibhalo ebalulekile ngokuka MISS. Phatha futhi ulawule izinsiza zabantu, eziyizinto nangomdlandla abekelwe lesi sikhundla.

xh.title: Unobozana
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yenkonzo yenobozana kwisebe le-Counter Assault Team kwiSikhululo esiNgcwele seSAPS ePretoria, uphathwe iindibano, amacingo kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka abonise ukuzipatha kakuhle kumisebenzi esemqoka yesithuba. Babe nobuchule kuncedana ngeelwimi ezisukela kwiNgesi nanye iyanto yaseburhulumente. Babe ngamakwabo kurhulumente weRiphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika apho kuya kufuneka kubekho ilifa ngelixeli lemibhalo ngosuku lokudibana nabasebenzi kwi-interview. Babe nesiQinisekiso seKhosi 10/ isiQinisekiso seKholeji/ NCV Level 4 okanye isifundo esilinganayo (NQF level 4 njengakuqatshwa yi-SAQA). Babe ngamakwabo kurhulumente weRiphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika apho kuya kufuneka kubekho ilifa ngelixeli lemibhalo ngosuku lokudibana nabasebenzi kwi-interview. Iindlela zokugqitha ezinengowiso kwindlela yesithuba ziya kubakho nzuzo ehezwayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono ekuziphatha: Amakhono jikelele ekusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint ne-MS Outlook). Bonisa ubuchule ekuziphatha kodwa, ngokuchanekileyo, ngenkathalo kwaye ngenkambuleko. Amakhono alungileyo okunxibelelana ngelivi nangokubhaliweyo. Amakhono alungileyo echwela zicwangciso, ukuqamba, olawulweni kwaye neyokuzalisa iingxaki. Amakhono amakhulu okuhlobana ngenani. Uqwalaselo kumthengi kwaye uphendule. Azibe wazama ukusebenza ngocinezelo nangamawela owoyilo.
xh.duties: Kunikeza inkxaso yemisebenzi yenobozana enjengokuhlela nokulungiselela iindibano, iinkqubela phambili, ukuthayipha nokubala imizuzu. Phendula kwaye uhlole onke amacingo angaphakathi. Qhagamshelana nazo onke iindlela neendawo kumacala ahlobene neQela. Londoloza ukugcina izixa ezilungileyo, inkqubo yokugcwalisa kwaye unike inkqubo yokuthumela phambili. Sebenza kwaye ufake iifomu zemali ezinkimbinkimbi. Yenza iicwangciso zokuhamba neendawo zokuhlala. Lawula irekhodi, wamkele kwaye uhlaziye iindwendwe zehhovisi. Sebenzisa isixhobo esiqhelekileyo (ifax, imashini yokukopa, ucingo, ikhompyutha njl). Pha okusela iindwendwe ngexesha leendibano. Lawula izinto zehhovisi. Zingisela inkumbulelo yemfihlelo yonke imibhalo ekhankanyiweyo njengoko kuzaliswa kwi-MISS. Lawula kwaye ulawule izixhobo zabantu, ezoqobo nezemali ezabeliwe kule sithuba.

jobs.title: Driver
jobs.centre: Western Cape: Supply Chain Management Ref No: PPS 19/2026 (X2 Posts) HQ: Pretoria - Supply Chain Management Ref No: PPS 20/2026 (X2 Posts) KwaZulu-Natal: Durban - Supply Chain Management Ref No: PPS 21/2026 (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: The South African Police Service seeks drivers at Level 3 to transport personnel and equipment, maintain state vehicles, and complete log sheets across multiple provinces.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must display competency in the core functions of the post. Be proficient in at least English and one other official language. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of Grade 10/ Standard 8/ NCV Level 2 or certificate/ report (NQF 2 Level as recognized by SAQA) of which documentary proof can be produced when required. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. At least two (2) years’ relevant experience in the field of the post. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Good verbal and written communication skills. Be fluent in at least two official languages one of which must be English. Be in possession of at least a light motor vehicle license and Public Driving Permit (PDP). Be willing to work extended hours when necessary. High levels of integrity, reliability and punctuality.
jobs.duties: Transport equipment, vehicles and personnel at the province. Ensure maintenance of allocated state vehicles. Completion of log sheets and monthly returns. Book vehicles at the garage for service and repairs. Uphold the confidentiality of all classified documents as per the MISS.
jobs.enquiries: HQ: Pretoria: Lt Col Kganyago Tel No: (012) 400 5310 / Captain Sithebe Tel No: (012) 400 5186 /Warrant Officer Mnyalatyho Tel No: (012) 400 5105/ AC Sekwape Tel No: (012) 400 5137/AC Modiha /HRC Sibande Tel No: (012) 400 5147. KwaZulu-Natal (Durban): Lieutenant Colonel Mkhize / Lieutenant Colonel Malinga/ AC Msani / AC Zondo / Secretary Sithole Tel No: (031) 203 7328 Western Cape (Cape Town): Lieutenant Colonel Kamana / Captain Teyise / AC Sofika/AC Sylvester Tel No: (021) 467 6485/6499
jobs.applications: HQ: Pretoria: Applications can be posted / hand delivered to the following address: Private Bag X272, Pretoria, 0002 or 3 Troye and Park Street, Presidential Protection Service, Maupa Naga Building Sunnyside, 0002. KwaZulu-Natal (Durban): Applications can be posted / hand delivered to the following address: 446 Vusi Mzimela Road Cato Manor, 4058. Western Cape (Cape Town): Applications must be posted / hand delivered to the following address:121 Garmour House Plein Street Cape Town, 8001. Applications may be hand-delivered, as follows: 152 Johannes Ramakhoase Street, Telkom Towers North, Pretoria. Application must be deposited into the box available at the reception area. Applications forwarded by post to be addressed to The Section Head: Corporate Support, (Attention: Captain Pretorius / W/O Tshabalala), Corporate Support, South African Police Service, Private Bag X94, Pretoria, 0001.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for, must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Short-listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. People who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.

af.title: Bestuurder
af.summary: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens soek bestuurders op Vlak 3 om personeel en toerusting te vervoer, staatsvoertuie in stand te hou, en logblaaie oor verskeie provinsies voltooi.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Bevoeg wees in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. 'n Burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika wees waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. In besit wees van Graad 10/ Standaard 8/ NCV Vlak 2 of sertifikaat/ verslag (NQF 2 Vlak soos deur SAQA erken) waarvan dokumentêre bewys voorgelê kan word wanneer vereis. 'n Burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika wees waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. Ten minste twee (2) jaar se relevante ervaring in die veld van die pos. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vloeiend wees in ten minste twee amptelike tale waarvan een Engels moet wees. In besit wees van ten minste 'n ligte motorvoertuiglisensie en 'n Openbare Bestuurspermit (PDP). Bereid wees om verlengde ure te werk wanneer nodig. Hoë vlakke van integriteit, betroubaarheid en stiptheid.
af.duties: Vervoer toerusting, voertuie en personeel by die provinsie. Verseker onderhoud van toegekende staatsvoertuie. Voltooiing van logblaaie en maandelikse opgawes. Bespreek voertuie by die garage vir diens en herstelwerk. Handhaaf die vertroulikheid van alle geklassifiseerde dokumente soos per die MISS.

zu.title: Umshayeli
zu.summary: I-South African Police Service ifuna abashayeli abangesika Leliya 3 ukuze bahamble abantu basebenzi nemishini, bagcine izimoto zikahulumeni, bazedele amafomu okulandela amakilomitha kumazanga ahlukene.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babonise ukuba bakwazi imisebenzi eyisiseko yesikhundla. Bazi kahulu okungenani isiNgisi nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni. Babe ngabakhiwo besiNgosi iNingizimu Afrika okufanele kuhlolwe ngokubhala ngosuku oluhlelwe kulo ivingco. Babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 10/ Standard 8/ NCV Level 2 noma isitifiketi/ umbiko (NQF 2 Level njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA) okungakwazi ukulethwa uma kudingwa. Babe ngabakhiwo besiNgosi iNingizimu Afrika okufanele kuhlolwe ngokubhala ngosuku oluhlelwe kulo ivingco. Okungenani amawaka amabili (2) iminyaka yemisebenzi ehambisana nesoLwazi yesikhundla. Ulwazi, Amakhono Nokukwazi: Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Bakwazi ukukhuluma okungenani ngamalimi amabili asemtgethweni omunye wawo kumele abe ngisiNgisi. Babe nokungenani ilayisensi yesimoto elula nesivumelwano sokuqhuba esidlangalweni (PDP). Babe vulivulekile ukusebenza amahora amaningi uma kunesidingo. Azinga eliphezulu lokuqothoza, ukuthembeka nokufika ngesikhathi.
zu.duties: Bambe izimoto abantu basebenzi nemishini esifundazweni. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemoto zikahulumeni ezabelwe wona. Qedela amafomu okulandela amakilomitha nembiko yanyanga zonke. Bhalela izimoto kweziguqulo nasekwenzeni imishini ukuze zihlaziywe. Hlabezela ukungavezi kolwazi oluyimfihlo kanye yonke imibhalo ekhutshaziwe njengokuhleziwe yi-MISS.

xh.title: Umqhubi
xh.summary: Isebe loPhatho lwePolisi lase South Africa lifuna abaqhubi kwinqanaba le-3 ukuze bahamise abantu nemishini, bagcine iimoto zikarhulumente, kwaye bagcwalise amaphepha eerefeksi kumaphondo ahlukeneyo.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babonise ukwazi kumisebenzi engundoqo yesithuba. Bakwazi ukusebenzisa ulwimi ngesiNgesi nolunye ulwimi olusesikhundleni obungenisa. Bibe ngabazingeli baseMzantsi Afrika, ngenxa yoko kufuneka benze isatifikedi qinisekiso ngomhla wokuqhudelwa. Bibe nesiQinisekiso seGraji 10/ Isitata 8/ NCV Level 2 okanye isatifiketi/ ingxelo (NQF 2 Level njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA) ngenxa yoko kufuneka bakwazi ukuzisa isatifikedi xa kufuneka. Bibe ngabazingeli baseMzantsi Afrika, ngenxa yoko kufuneka benze isatifikedi qinisekiso ngomhla wokuqhudelwa. Bibe nayo emva kweminyaka emininzi engu-(2) yamava ohambelana nolwazi kwicala lesithuba. Ulwazi, Amapuso nokuQonda: Ukuzithethela nokubhala kakuhle. Bakwazi ukuthetha ulwimi olusemqoka ngokuthe ngamabini olunye kufuneka lulunye kwindalo yesiNgesi. Bibe nalayisensi yokushukuma kwimoto esisindo nokuba ne-Permiti yoQhubo lwesixokeleledwa (PDP). Bemise ukuba basebenze iiveki ezongezelelweyo xaku kusetyenziswa. Babengabo bantu abanobuzwe obunyulu, abathembekayo kwaye bahlale bengangenanga.
xh.duties: Bahamise imishini, iimoto nabantu kwiphondo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kweekoto ezabelwe urhulumente. Ukugqiba amaphepo eerefeksi nesityelo esinyenyemnyaka. Faka iimoto kwigaredi ukuba kwenzike usenzeko nokulungiswa. Gcina imfihlelo yamaphepo abhaliweyo afihliweyo njengoko kumiselwa yi-MISS.

af.title: Algemene Werker
af.summary: Algemene Werker-pos by die South African Police Service in Pretoria wat dokumentaflewering, voertuigbestuur en registdienste behels, en 'n Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Wees vaardig in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud voorsien moet word. In besit wees van 'n Graad 10/ Standaard 8/ NCV vlak 2-sertifikaat/ verslag (NQF vlak 2 soos deur SAQA erken), waarvoor dokumentêre bewys voorsien kan word wanneer vereis. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Basiese administratiewe vaardighede vir die bestuur van aflewering van items, voorraad- en insamelingsitems, ondertekening van dokumente, en bystand met die reël van lêers/ insamelingsitems. Hoë vlakke van integriteit, betroubaarheid en stiptelikheid. Wees bereid om indien nodig verlengde ure te werk.
af.duties: Versamel, sorteer en lewer dokumente, lêers en pakkies aan geadresseerdes, ander departemente en die Poskantoor. Voer voor-rit-inspeksies uit, bestuur brandstofkaarte/bonnnne, handhaaf logboeke en bestuur departementele voertuie veilig. Bied bystand met kopiëring, vernietiging, lêerwerk en die bestuur van registdienste. Volg die Public Service Act, Batho Pele-beginsels en departementele beleide. Goeie kommunikasie, tydbestuur en basiese rekenaarvaardigheid.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi jikelele ku-South African Police Service e-Pretoria esibandakanya ukulethwa kwamadokhumenti, ukuphathwa kwezimoto, kanye nezinkonzo zesibuyekezo, esidinga isiqu se-Grade 10 noma esilinganayo.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babonise ikhono emisebenzini eyisisekelo yesikhundla. Babe nobuchule ohlwini olungenankinga ngesiNgisi nakolunye ulimi olusemthethweni okungenani. Babe ngabakhiwebomhlaba baseningizimu ye-Afrika okufanele kunikwe ubufakazi obubhalwe phansi nsuku yokuxoxisana. Babe nesitifikedi/umbiko we-Grade 10/ Standard 8/ NCV level 2 (NQF level 2 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA), okungakhiqizwa ubufakazi obubhalwe phansi lapho kudingeka. Akukho ngokuhlelekile okudingwa. Ulwazi, Amakhono nobuchule: Amakhono amahle okuxhumana abhalwayo nokuqoshiwe. Amakhono abhalayo okuphatha ukulethwa kwemikhiqizo, izitoki namathumbi okuqoqa, ukusayina amadokhumenti, ukusiza ukulungiselela amafayela/amathumbi okuqoqa. Amazinga aphakeme wokwethembeka, ukuzethemba nokufika ngesikhathi. Bezelwe ukusebenza amahora amude, lapho kudingeka.
zu.duties: Qoqa, hlela, futhi lethela amadokhumenti, amafayela, namaphakela kubayiphikiswa, kumanye umnyango, nase-Post Office. Yenza ukuhlola ngaphambi kokuqaliswa kwesibhakabhaka, phatha amakhadi ama-fuel/amavawusha, gcina amabhuku okuqopha, futhi qhuba izimoto zomnyango ngokuphepha. Siza nokukopisha, ukushoba amadokhumenti, ukufaka kumafayela, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkonzo zesibuyekezo. Landela umthetho we-Public Service Act, izimiso ze-Batho Pele, kanye nezinqubomgomo zomnyango. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nobulwazi oluyisisekelo bekhompuyutha.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
xh.summary: Isithuba somSebenzi Jikelele e South African Police Service e Pretoria esiqhathaniswa nokunikela amaxwebhu, ulawulo lwezithuthi, nezenzo zeregistry, kufuneka kubekho isiqinisekiso se-Grade 10 okanye esilinganayo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka abonise ukuziphatha kakhulu kumisebenzi engundoqo yesithuba. Bathathe ngcono ulwimi lwesiNgesi nolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni ubuncinane. Babe ngabemi beRiphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika abo baya kubonakalisa ngamaxwebhu ngemini yoxibhaxo. Babe nokugqitha isatifikethi/ireyitha ye-Grade 10/ Standard 8/ NCV level 2 (NQF level 2 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA), enokubonwa ngamaxwebhu xa kufuneka. Akukho mfundo yomsebenzi efunekayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono namakhono okusebenza: Amakhono amabalwe ebhalwe noku-theetha. Amakhonyo abalawulo okuzenzela ukunikela izinto, ukulonga izinto, ukusayina amaxwebhu, nokuncedisa ekulungiseni iifayile. Kukho inqanaba eliphakamileyo lokuzithoba, ukuzithembela, nokufika ngexesha. Zibe nokulungele ukuze basebenze iiyure ezongezelelweyo, xa kuyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Qokelela, hlela, nikezela amaxwebhu, iifayile, neziphako kubanikelo, kumanye amasebe, nakwi-Post Office. jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 by 16:30 (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Director of Non-capital Incentives in the Department of Tourism, Pretoria, offering R1,317,384 per annum at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: A minimum SAQA recognised qualification at NQF level 7 in Accounting / Business Management / Economics / Business Administration / Development Finance or equivalent. A minimum of 5 years’ experience in an appropriate field in a Middle / Senior Management position and experience in the provision of support for small enterprises. Essential knowledge: A good understanding of the PFMA, National Treasury Regulations, relevant Public Sector Regulations, the Tourism Act and relevant Tourism policy documents (e.g. National Tourism Sector Strategy, Tourism Growth Partnership Plan, etc.). Knowledge of the structure and functioning of the Tourism sector. Understanding and experience in Project Management. Knowledge of the role and functioning of government incentive and financial support programmes will be an added advantage. Skills requirement: Strategic thinking skills (analytical, conceptual, problem solving); Policy formulation and implementation skills; Leadership and management skills (incl. Project Management, Financial Management, Human Resource Management, Risk Management and Stakeholder Management); Strong communication skills (verbal, written, presentation); and a high-level of Computer Literacy. Possession of a valid driver’s license and willingness to travel. One of the minimum entry requirements for an SMS-level post is the pre-entry certificate. For more details on the pre-entry course, visit: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate must complete the SMS pre-entry certificate prior to any appointment.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for: Providing strategic direction for the directorate through the formulation of business plans aligned to Departmental objectives. Overseeing the development of operational plans to guide implementation of functional responsibilities. Monitoring implementation of programmes and projects to ensure alignment with developed plans and strategic departmental objectives. Compiling quarterly implementation and management reports. Design and refining of new and existing programmes. Managing the ongoing implementation and administration of programmes to facilitate growth and development. Ensuring that programmes are accessible to eligible enterprises and are effective in achieving the intended impact. Ensuring effective internal and external stakeholder management. Developing operating standards and procedures for the receipt, processing, evaluation and adjudication of applications to programmes Developing and applying effective internal controls to mitigate risks in the implementation of programmes. Ensuring fair assessment and evaluation of applications in line with programme guidelines. Providing relevant support to adjudication committees. Ensuring that budget preparation is in line with strategic plans and Departmental objectives and expenditure is correctly projected, monitored and reported on. Managing Human Resources. Monitoring and reporting on the utilisation of equipment. Co-ordinating and monitoring the implementation of memoranda of understanding, service level agreements and expenditure reviews. Managing the processing of claims and payments to service providers. Developing and review payment process documentation. Reviewing and approving project payments.
