af.title: Direkteur: Nie-kapitale Aansporings
af.summary: Direkteur van Nie-kapitale Aansporings in die Department of Tourism, Pretoria, teen R1,317,384 per jaar op SMS-vlak 13.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum SAQA-erkende kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 in Rekenkunde / Besigheidsbestuur / Ekonomie / Besigheidsadministrasie / Ontwikkelingsfinansiering of gelykwaardig. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n toepaslike veld in 'n Midde- / Seniorbestuursposisie en ervaring in die verskaffing van ondersteuning vir klein ondernemings. Essensiële kennis: 'n Goeie begrip van die PFMA, National Treasury Regulations, toepaslike Public Sector Regulations, die Tourism Act en toepaslike toerismebeleiddokumente (bv. National Tourism Sector Strategy, Tourism Growth Partnership Plan, ens.). Kennis van die struktuur en werking van die toerismesektor. Begrip en ervaring in Projekbestuur. Kennis van die rol en werking van regeringsaansporings- en finansiële ondersteuningsprogramme sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees. Vaardigheidsvereiste: Strategiese denkvaardighede (analities, konseptueel, probleemoplossing); Beleidsformulering- en implementeringsvaardighede; Leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede (insluitend Projekbestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Risikobestuur en Belanghebbende Bestuur); Sterk kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings, skriftelik, aanbieding); en 'n hoë vlak van rekenaargeletterdheid. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Een van die minimum toetredevereistes vir 'n SMS-vlak pos is die voor-toetrede-sertifikaat. Vir meer besonderhede oor die voor-toetrede-kursus, besoek: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Die kandidaat moet die SMS-voor-toetrede-sertifikaat voltooi voor enige aanstelling.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir: Verskaffing van strategiese rigting aan die direktoraat deur die formulering van besigheidsplanne wat bely is met departementele doelwitte. Toesig oor die ontwikkeling van operasionele planne om implementering van funksionele verantwoordelikhede te lei. Monitering van implementering van programme en projekte om belyning met ontwikkelde planne en strategiese departementele doelwitte te verseker. Samestelling van kwartaallikse implementerings- en bestuursverslae. Ontwerp en verfyning van nuwe en bestaande programme. Bestuur van die voortdurende implementering en administrasie van programme om groei en ontwikkeling te fasiliteer. Verseker dat programme toeganklik is vir in aanmerking komende ondernemings en effektief is om die beoogde impak te bereik. Verseker van effektiewe interne en eksterne bestuur van belanghebbendes. Ontwikkeling van bedryfsstandaarde en prosedures vir die ontvangs, verwerking, evaluering en adjudikasie van aansoeke tot programme. Ontwikkeling en toepassing van effektiewe interne beheermaatreëls om risiko's in die implementering van programme te beperk. Verseker van billike assessering en evaluering van aansoeke in ooreenstemming met programriglyne. Verskaffing van relevante ondersteuning aan adjudikasiekomitees. Verseker dat begrotingsvoorbereiding in lyn is met strategiese planne en departementele doelwitte en besteding korrek voorspel, gemonitor en gerapporteer word. Bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne. Monitering en verslagdoening oor die benutting van toerusting. Koördinering en monitering van die implementering van memorandums van ooreenkoms, diensvlakooreenkomste en bestedings hersienings. Bestuur van die verwerking van eise en betalings aan diensverskaffers. Ontwikkeling en hersiening van betalingsprosesdokumentasie. Hersiening en goedkeuring van projekbetalings.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Izinzuzo ezingezona ezinzimali
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wezinzuzo Ezingezona Ezinzimali oKuMnyango Wezokuvakasha, ePretoria, onikeza R1,317,384 ngonyaka ezingeni le-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezivunyiwe yi-SAQA ezinganini le-NQF level 7 kwi-Accounting / Business Management / Economics / Business Administration / Development Finance noma okulingana nalezi. Ukube ungakaze uthole okuncedile, kudingeka ube neminyaka engu-5 ohleweni olufanele ohlelweni lokuphatha iMiddle / Senior Management futhi ube nokuhlongakwalela ukusekela izinkampani ezincane. Ulwazi olubalulekile: Ukuqonda kahle i-PFMA, Izimiso ze-National Treasury, Izimiso Zomphakathi Ezihlobene, uMthetho Wezokuvakasha namadokhumenti wezinqubomgomo Wezokuvakasha ahlobene (isb. National Tourism Sector Strategy, Tourism Growth Partnership Plan, njll.). Ulwazi ngohlelo lokusebenza lomkhakha Wezokuvakasha. Ukuqonda nokuhlelwa kwe-Project Management. Ulwazi ngendima yohlelelo lukahulumu lokusingathwa ngenzuzo kuzobe yinzuzo. Izidingo zamakhono: Amakhono okucabanga ngokuqonda ngokwenhlalo (ukucazulula, ukwakha imibono, ukuxazulula izinkinga); Amakhono wokwakha futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo; Amakhano okuphatha futhi abeke ihlelokusebenza (kuhlanganise i-Project Management, Financial Management, Human Resource Management, Risk Management kanye ne-Stakeholder Management); Amakhano okuxhumana anamandla (okuqamba, ukubhala, okwenziwa phambi kwentuthwano); kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nokuzithoba ukuhamba. Esinye isidingo sokuqala ngesikhundla esisingeni le-SMS yisatifikhethi yokuqala ngaphambi kokungena. Ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nesifundo sokuqala ngaphambi kokungena, vakashela: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Umqashi kumelwe aqede isatifikhethi se-SMS sokuqala ngaphambi kokungena ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumelele uzobe nesibopho sokwenza okulandelayo: Ukunikeza isiqondiso esinjengamanjiniyela ohlelweni ngokwakhe amapulani amahle azohambisana nenhloso zikaMnyango. Ukubuka ngqo ukuthuthukiswa kwamapulani okusebenza ukubeka indlela yokuphatha imisebenzi efanayo. Ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwahlelo namaphrojekthi ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana namapulani okwakhiwe nenhloso eziphathelene noMnyango. Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yokuqembuka futhi aphathe iminyaka yonke. Ukuyila futhi acasule amahlelo amasha futhi asekhona. Ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa ngokuzinza kanye nokulawulwa kwamahlelo ukukhuthaza ukukhula nokuthuthuka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amahlelo afinyeleleka kalula kuzinkampani ezifanele futhi asebenze kahle ekufezeni umthelela ohlosiwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwabanikazi bahlelo bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezindinganiso zokusebenza kanye nezindlela zokucomba, ukuqashwa kanye nokwehlulelwa izicelo kumahlelo. Ukuthuthukisa futhi asetshenzise izilawulo zangaphakathi eziqinile ukunciphisa izinkinga ekusetshenzisweni kwahlelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlolwa okubululekile kanye nokwehlulelwa izicelo ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zohlelo. Ukucomba ngokufanele amakomidi wehlulelwa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlelwa kwesabelo kuhambisana namapulani abekwe isinqubomgomo kanye nenhloso zikaMnyango futhi ukuchithwa kuhlelelwe, kuqashwe futhi kubikwe ngokufanele. Ukuphatha izinsizakusebenza zabantu. Ukuqapha futhi abike ngokusetshenziswa kwamaseshizi. Ukubumbana futhi ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwesivumelwano soqonda, izivumelwano zezinkamba zokusebenza nokubuyekezwa kokuchithwa. Ukuphatha ukuqashwa kwamaphrojekthi futhi kwezimali ezibhadelwa abakho. Ukuthuthukisa futhi abuyekeze imibhalo yokuqashwa kwezimali. Ukubuyekeza futhi avume izimali zamaphrojekthi.

xh.title: Ulawuliwo-kakhulu: Iinkcukacha ezingeyonye yemali-yimali
xh.summary: Ulawuliwo-kakhulu weNkcukacha ezingeyonye yemali-yimali kwiSebe leTourism, ePretoria, inikela ngo R1,317,384 ngonyaka kwinxaxheba le-SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esincinane esivunyelwe yiSAQA kwinxaxheba leNQF 7 kwi-Accounting / Business Management / Economics / Business Administration / Development Finance okanye esingathandathu. Isipilingo esingxengeni kweminyaka elingu-5 kwinkalo efanelekileyo kwisithuba sokuLawula esiPhakathi / esiPhezulu ngesipilingo esikunika inkxaso kumashishini amancinane. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo: Ukuqonda kakuhle i-PFMA, iNational Treasury Regulations, iziNgqungqutha zoluntu ezifanelekileyo, uMthetho weTourism namaxwebhu entsimbi yeTourism (umz. National Tourism Sector Strategy, Tourism Growth Partnership Plan, njl.). Ulwazi ngokwakhiwa nokusebenza kwenkalo ye-Tourism. Ukuqonda nokuva kokusebenza kweProject Management. Ulwazi lwendima nendlela yokusebenza kweenkqubo zenkxaso-mali zikarhulumente kunye neenkcukacha zokhuseleko-ntlawulo kuya kuba nzuzo. Iimfuno zamakhono: Amakhona okucinga ngokwendlela (okuhlalutyo, okuqonda, okusombulula iingxaki); amakhona okuyila nokusebenzisa iindawo-zalathiso; amakhona okukhokela nokulawula (aquka i-Project Management, i-Financial Management, i-Human Resource Management, i-Risk Management, kunye nokulawula abathinteli-bucala); amakhona okunxibelelwana amandla (okuwathetha, okubhaliweyo, okubonisa); nokuba nokuqonda okuphezulu kweComputer Literacy. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushukuma evunyelweyo kwaye uzibeke isinqwenelo sokuhamba. Enye yezifuneko zokungena kwisithuba se-SMS kukuba kubekho isatifikedi sangaphambili. Ukufumana iinkcukacha ezininzi ngesifundo sangaphambili, ndingakuva: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Umangaliswa kufuneka agqibe isatifikedi sangaphambili se-SMS phambi kokuba anvunyelwe.
xh.duties: Owavunyelweyo uya kuba nesibopho sokulawula ukunika isalathiso ngokwemo-strategi kwidirectional ngokwenza iinkqubo ezilungelelaniswe neenjongo zeSebe. Ukulawula ukwakhiwa kweenkqubo zokusebenza ukuyalela ukusetyenziswa kweenkonzo ezifunekayo. Ukuqonda ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ngeendawo ezakhiwe ukwenza isiqinisekiso sokuba zilungelelaniswe neenkqubo ezakhiwe neenjongo ezilungelelanise iSebe. Ukwenza iingxelo zokuphumeza nokulawula ngenyanga ezinthathu. Ukuqamba nokulungisa iinkqubo ezintsha nezikhoyo. Ukulawula ukuphumeza nokulawula iinkqubo ngokuya kuqhuba ukukhula nentluko. Ukwenza isiqinisekiso sokuba iinkqubo zifikeleleka kumashishini anelisiwe kwaye zisebenza ukufeza eyona njiko iphumelelwe. Ukwenza isiqinisekiso sokulawula abathinteli bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukukhula iindlela ezisemgangathweni nezentla ezifuna xa kwamkelwa, kuqutywa, kuqondwa kwaye kugqitywa izicelo kwiinkqubo. Ukukha kunye nokusetyenziswa iindlela ezilawulayo ezisebenzayo ukunciphisa iingozi ekuphumezeni iinkqubo. Ukwenza isiqinisekiso sokuba kuye kubekho ukulingana kwesilinganiso nokuqonda izicelo ngokulandela iziqondiso zeenkqubo. Ukunikela inkxaso efunekayo kumagqabi okugqiba izicelo. Ukwenza isiqinisekiso sokulungiselelwa kwesithuba-simali sibambe ngokwenkqubo ezisemgangathweni neenjongo zeSebe kwaye imali-yimali icace njengoko kucetywayo, iqondwe kwaye kwenziwe ingxelo ngayo. Ukulawula iNgcivelakwemisebenzi. Ukubeka iingxelo ngesetyenziswa kwemishini.okuqhweba nokubuka isisetyenziswa kwezivumelwano-magqabhuko, iinkqubo-ndlela zolawulo lwenkonzo nokuqwalasela imali-yimali. Ukulawula ukuqhuba iindaba zokuzelela nentlawulo kubanikezeli-bucala. Ukwenza kunye nokuhlola amaxwebhu oqhuba-lonto lentlawulo. Ukuhlola kunye nokuvuma imali-yimali yeenkqubo ezikhoyo.

Bestuur van nutsrekenings; Verseer tydige betaling van die huur en munisipale dienste; Verseker tydige betaling vir TV-verbindings en lisensies; Opstel en monitor kantoorakkommodasie-uitgawerverslag; Bestuur van kantoorruimte en kantoortoewysing; Voer kantoorruimte-oudit uit om gebruik te bepaal; Voorberei liggingsplanne; Fasiliteer die verskuiwingsprojekte na nuwe kantore en nuutverkrygde kantore; Fasiliteer die installering van telefoon- en IT-verbindings; Bestuur van ondersteunende dienste; Verseker dat skoonmaakdienste in die gebou voorsien word; Verseker dat voedseldienste in die gebou voorsien word; Verseker dat telekommunikasie ten volle operasioneel en goed onderhou word; Monitor telefoonrekenings en gebruik daarvan; Bestuur van boodskapperdienste; Bestuur van produksiedienste; Monitor implementering van energie-doeltreffendheid en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid (OHS) in alle departementele geboue; Opstel van energieverbruiksverslae op 'n maandelikse basis; Voer energie-bewustheidsprogramme uit; skakel met DPWI en Eskom oor die energiesbesparingsmeganismes; Fasiliteer implementering van OHS in alle geboue; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuxhumana kuyasebenza futhi kugcinwe kahle; Ukuqaphela ama-akhawunti kanye nokusetshenziswa kwocingo; Ukuphathwa kwamasevisi okuthumela izindaba; Ukuphathwa kwamasevisi okukhiqiza; Ukuqaphela ukusebenza kwezindlela zokulondoloza amandla kanye noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezempilo Nokuvikela (OHS) kuzo zonke izakhiwo ze-Department; Ukuqoqa imibiko yokusetshenziswa kwamandla nyanga zonke; Ukuphathwa kwamavesi wezinsiza kanye nezivumelwano namakhontrathi; Ukubuyekeza zonke izivumelwano namakhontrathi; Ukubamba izinkomfa zokuqeqesha ezinye zangaphezulu kwesikhashana nabahlinzeki; Ukuhlola nokuthumela izincwadi abahlinzeki abangazilandanga imiyalo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Change Management and Service Delivery
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package consisting of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to the MMS dispensation)
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 by 16:30 (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director position at the Department of Tourism in Pretoria responsible for change management and service delivery improvement initiatives.
jobs.requirements: A recognised NQF level 7 qualification in Work Study / Management Services / Operations Management / Organisational Development / Change Management / Industrial Psychology / Human Resource Management or related field. 5 years’ experience in change management, organisational development, service delivery improvement, Batho Pele and/or operations management environment, of which three (3) years must be at supervisory level. Legislative and Regulatory Framework: Public Service Act of 1994 as amended. Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended. Public Finance Management Act, 1999 as amended (PFMA). Treasury Regulations of 2005 as amended. The white Paper on Transforming Public Service Delivery (Batho Pele) (WPTPSD), 1997. Public Service Charter Directive. Operational Management Framework. Complaints and Compliments Management Framework (CCMF), 2013.All applicable directives from relevant authorities). Knowledge of: Policy development, analysis and implementation. Change Management. Project Management. Customer Focus and Responsiveness. Service Delivery Innovation. Programme and Project Management. People management and empowerment. Organisational, planning and co-ordination skills. Good communication skills (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Interpersonal skills. Analytical skills. Problem solving skills. Team Leadership. Research skills. Facilitation and presentation skills. Ability to work individually and in a team. Innovative. Conflict Resolution. Articulate. Initiative. Impact and Influence. A valid driver’s licence (Persons with disabilities that prevent them from driving will still be considered).
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and implement Change Management initiatives; Developing, review and monitor the implementation of the departmental change management framework; Developing and implement change management strategies in response to change initiative projects in the department; Conducting culture surveys and audits to assess the Departmental change requirements; Determining change requirements aligned to changes in systems and processes (including IT processes and systems); Collaborating with and influence stakeholders on change requirements, as the custodian of change in the Department; Developing interventions to address change requirements; Networking, influence, and liaise with operational managers and staff to ensure change buy- in and implementation; Identifying and develop relevant communique and supporting change management material; Identifying change agents within the Department and ensure their effective onboarding; Facilitating the development of training to capacitate the Departmental change agents; Continuously measure and evaluate results and progress; Coordinating the development and implementation of Departmental service delivery improvement planning; Coordinating the planning, development , implementation , monitoring, reporting and evaluation of continuous service delivery improvement within the department; Designing and co-ordinate implementation of client orientation strategy and policy; Ensuring that the department has developed a functioning, well-managed complaints and compliments management system that informs critical service delivery and citizen satisfaction areas of improvement as outlined in the Complaints and Compliments Management Framework; (CCMF), 2013; Establishing and maintain correspondence with clients and stakeholders and respond queries; Designing, implement, and maintain suggestion system to improve customer service; Conduct customer service improvement surveys (internal and external); Participating in the National service delivery and innovation fora; Developing and review service standards delivery charter in the department; Coordinating the development, review and implementation of the minimum standards for the level and quality of services the department will provide; Developing and review the departmental service Delivery Charter; Monitoring departmental performance against standards and produce annual reports; Implementing Operational Management Framework (OMF) in collaboration with the Organizational Development unit; Coordinating and monitor the implementation of the Batho Pele Programmes; Managing the customer service improvement programmes; Developing, review and monitor the implementation of Batho Pele Plan; Managing the Batho Pele Programmes in the department; Ensuring continuous reporting on Batho Pele compliance; Representing the Department at all functions of Batho Pele meetings and forums; Facilitating the departmental Know Your Rights campaigns and the Service Excellence Awards in the department; Establishing Departmental Batho Pele Forum and co-ordinate its programmes; Ensuring improved client satisfaction, customer relations and customer care plans.
jobs.applications: Email application: Recruitment6226@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a new Z83 form and CV only. Electronic applications must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (i.e. old Z83 form) will not be considered. Each post’s advertisement must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Sections A, B, C, and D of the new Z83 form must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the new Z83 form, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or indicate “see attached” in respect of Sections E, F and G. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resource Management, and such qualifications and other related documents will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, or whose applications were received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and attainment of a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Department of Tourism processing your personal information, subject to POPIA. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Veranderingsbestuur en Dienslewering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteurpos by die Department of Tourism in Pretoria verantwoordelik vir veranderingsbestuur en inisiatiewe ter verbetering van dienslewering.
af.requirements: 'n Erkende NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Work Study / Management Services / Operations Management / Organisational Development / Change Management / Industrial Psychology / Human Resource Management of 'n verwante veld. 5 jaar se ervaring in veranderingsbestuur, organisatoriese ontwikkeling, diensleweringsverbetering, Batho Pele en/of bedryfsbestuursomgewing, waarvan drie (3) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Wetgewende en Regulerende Raamwerk: Public Service Act of 1994 soos gewysig. Public Service Regulations, 2016 soos gewysig. Public Finance Management Act, 1999 soos gewysig (PFMA). Treasury Regulations of 2005 soos gewysig. The white Paper on Transforming Public Service Delivery (Batho Pele) (WPTPSD), 1997. Public Service Charter Directive. Operational Management Framework. Complaints and Compliments Management Framework (CCMF), 2013. Alle toepaslike richtlyne van relevante owerhede. Kennis van: Beleidontwikkeling, ontleding en implementering. Change Management. Project Management. Customer Focus and Responsiveness. Service Delivery Innovation. Programme and Project Management. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Organisatoriese, beplannings- en koördineringsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaargeletterdheid. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Spanleierskap. Navorsingsvaardighede. Fasiliterings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Innovatief. Konflikoplossing. Eloquent. Inisiatief. Impak en invloed. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Persone met gestremdhede wat hulle verhinder om te bestuur, sal steeds oorweeg word).
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die ontwerp en implementering van Change Management-inisiatiewe; Ontwikkeling, hersiening en monitering van die implementering van die departementele veranderingsbestuursraamwerk; Ontwikkeling en implementering van veranderingsbestuursstrategieë in reaksie op veranderingsinisiatiefprojekte in die departement; Uitvoer van kultuursurveys en oudits om die departementele veranderingsvereistes te beoordeel; Bepaling van veranderingsvereistes in ooreenstemming met veranderinge in stelsels en prosesse (insluitend IT-prosesse en -stelsels); Samewerking met en beïnvloeding van belanghebbendes oor veranderingsvereistes, as die bewaarder van verandering in die departement; Ontwikkeling van ingrepe om veranderingsvereistes aan te spreek; Netwerk bou, beïnvloed en skakel met operasionele bestuurders en personeel om veranderingsaanvaarding en -implementering te verseker; Identifisering en ontwikkeling van relevante kommunikasie en ondersteunende veranderingsbestuursmateriaal; Identifisering van veranderingsagente binne die departement en verseker van hul effektiewe inlywing; Fasilitering van die ontwikkeling van opleiding om die departementele veranderingsagente te bemagtig; Deurlopende meting en evaluering van resultate en vordering; Koördinering van die ontwikkeling en implementering van departementele diensleweringsverbeteringsbeplanning; Koördinering van die beplanning, ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering, verslagdoening en evaluering van deurlopende diensleweringsverbetering binne die departement; Ontwerp en koördinering van implementering van kliëntoriëntasiestrategie en -beleid; Versekering dat die departement 'n funksionerende, goedbestuurde klagte- en komplimentbestuurstelsel ontwikkel het wat kritieke dienslewering en burgersbevredigingsverbeteringsgebiede soos uiteengesit in die Complaints and Compliments Management Framework; (CCMF), 2013, inlig; Vestiging en handhawing van korrespondensie met kliënte en belanghebbendes en reaksie op navrae; Ontwerp, implementering en handhawing van voorstelstelsel om kliëntediens te verbeter; Uitvoer van kliëntediensverbeteringsopnames (intern en ekstern); Deelname aan die nasionale dienslewering en innovasie-fora; Ontwikkeling en hersiening van diensstandaardleweringhandves in die departement; Koördinering van die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van die minimum standaarde vir die vlak en kwaliteit van dienste wat die departement sal verskaf; Ontwikkeling en hersiening van die departementele diensleweringhandves; Monitering van departementele prestasie teen standaarde en opstel van jaarlikse verslae; Implementering van Operational Management Framework (OMF) in samewerking met die Organizational Development-eenheid; Koördinering en monitering van die implementering van die Batho Pele-programme; Bestuur van die kliëntediensverbeteringsprogramme; Ontwikkeling, hersiening en monitering van die implementering van die Batho Pele-plan; Bestuur van die Batho Pele-programme in die departement; Versekering van deurlopende verslagdoening oor Batho Pele-nakoming; Verteenwoordiging van die departement by alle funksies van Batho Pele-vergaderings en forums; Fasilitering van die departementele Know Your Rights-veldtogte en die Service Excellence Awards in die departement; Vestiging van departementele Batho Pele-forum en koördinering van sy programme; Versekering van verbeterde kliëntbevrediging, kliëntverhoudinge en kliëntsorgplanne.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaPhini Mkhulu: Ekuqondiseni Izinguquko Nokuhanjiswa Kwezinsizakalo

Unyaka be-5 wamava kokuqondiseni izinguquko, ukuthuthuka kohlukaniso lwezinhlangano, ukuphucula ukuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo, Batho Pele kanye/noma emoyeni walawulo peminye imisebenzi, okukhomba ukuthi eminye iminyaka eyi-three (3) kumele ibe ezingeni lokuqondisa abanye. Isakhiwo somthetho nesilawuzo: Public Service Act of 1994 njengokulungisiwe. Public Service Regulations, 2016 njengokulungisiwe. Public Finance Management Act, 1999 njengokulungisiwe (PFMA). Treasury Regulations of 2005 njengokulungisiwe. The white Paper on Transforming Public Service Delivery (Batho Pele) (WPTPSD), 1997. Public Service Charter Directive. Operational Management Framework. Complaints and Compliments Management Framework (CCMF), 2013.All applicable directives from relevant authorities). Ukuqondiswa Kwemiklamo Namaphrojekthi. Ukuqondiswa kwabantu nokunikelwa amandla. Ikhono loluhlelo, ukuhlela nokuhambisana. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (okuthiwa nokubhalwayo). Amakhono okwenza kuhlale kuhamba nokuhamba kahle imihlangano. Ukukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nas eqenjini. Ukuba nomthelela omutsha. Ukuzezelwa Izinkinga. Ukukhuluma kucace. Ukuzethemba. Amava wobukhosi beNkqubo, iNkqubo yokuhlela nokuhlanganisa. Amapabilidady eNkqubo yokuthetha (ethethwayo nesibhalwayo). Ulwazi lweKhompyutha. Amapabilidady eNkqubo yokuhlobana. Amapabilidady eNkqubo yokusebenza ngokwakhe nakwijery. Inkqubo yokuQumba. uQqwasho lweNkqubo yoQumba. uNcedo lokuQala. uNcedo lokuQqhoza. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Abantu abanokukhawulela abangakwazi ukushayela bayakwazi ukuthathwa ngqongqo).

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Security Management Services
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package consisting of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to the MMS dispensation)
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 by 16:30 (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role overseeing security operations, physical security, and contingency planning for the Department of Tourism in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A recognized NQF 7 qualification in in Security Management / Safety Management or other related qualifications. 5 years relevant experience in a security management environment, of which 3 years must be at a supervisory level. Practical experience in the implementation Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS). Minimum Physical Security Standards (MPSS). Security Managers Course will be an added advantage. Administrative procedures. Security-related policies and procedures. Minimum physical Security Standards. Control of Access to Public Premises Act. National Key Points Act. POPIA. Public Financial Management (PFMA). Supply Chain Management. Occupational Health and Safety Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service act and Regulations. Good communication skills. Computer Literacy. Organising and Planning. Report writing skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Occupational Health and Safety. Project Management. Financial Management. Listening skills. Analytical skills. Investigation skills. A valid driver’s licence (Persons with disabilities that prevent them from driving will still be considered).
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for managing operations, physical security, and the implementation of the contingency plan in the department; Reviewing and update the security operations manual; Ensuring that physical security is delivered in line with Departmental Security policy; Maintaining an updated security plan for the department; Ensuring provision of reception services; Conducting security inspections on all security points; Creating security registers to ensure proper record-keeping; Inspecting security personnel on duty; Maintaining an updated Security Operational Plan; Monitoring security personnel overtime and submit claims for overtime and shift allowances for approval; Reviewing security policy; Reviewing and assess security services rendered; Evaluating performance of all subordinates; Maintaining and update the contingency plan; Providing input to the development and updating of the Business Continuity Plan; Conducting regular tests on all security equipment; Identifying training needs for operational security personnel; Identifying risks and threats to the security of the department as well as the department’s capability to counter security threats; Conducting physical appraisals in compliance with MISS and MPSS; Conducting threat and risk assessments; Conducting key audits and ensure that registers are maintained; Coordinating implementation of security contingency plan; Managing the execution of fieldwork investigations and conduct preliminary investigations into all reported security breaches within the department; Establishing, develop system and processes that will ensure compliance in relation to the relevant legislation, policies, prescripts and procedures of personnel security; Managing and provide a security vetting capacity in accordance with the National Vetting Legislative Framework; Managing and co-ordinate the execution of security vetting practices in accordance with, and in consultation with, the State Security Agency (SSA); Managing supportive administrative systems, channels and infrastructure to comply with vetting requirements; Conducting security preliminary investigations; Compiling report on security breaches; Submitting investigation reports for inspection; Reporting breaches to the South African Police Service; Managing Information Security in the Department in accordance with prescribed security procedures, rules and regulations; Managing Information Security in the Department; Monitoring Communication and IT security in the Department; Developing and implementation of security risk management programmes within the Department; Managing document security in the Department; Assisting in managing the Personnel Suitability checks; Information security awareness programmes within the Department; Managing and inspection of outsourced security service to ensure compliance with departmental standards and contractual requirements; Supervising and monitor private security service providers, ensuring effective deployment and performance of security personnel; Conducting monthly performance meetings with security service providers and prepare and submit accurate meeting minutes and report to management; Ensuring effective contract management of outsourced security guard service in accordance with the Service Level Agreement (SLA); Monitoring service provider performance, identify non- compliance or operational gaps, and facilitate corrective actions where required; Verifying that contracted security service are delivered efficiently, Consistently, and in line with agreed service standards and contractual obligations.
jobs.applications: Email application: Recruitment6326@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a new Z83 form and CV only. Electronic applications must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (i.e. old Z83 form) will not be considered. Each post’s advertisement must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Sections A, B, C, and D of the new Z83 form must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the new Z83 form, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or indicate “see attached” in respect of Sections E, F and G. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resource Management, and such qualifications and other related documents will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, or whose applications were received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and attainment of a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Department of Tourism processing your personal information, subject to POPIA. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Sekuriteitsbestuursdienste
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos wat toesig hou oor sekuriteitsbedrywighede, fisiese sekuriteit en noodbeplanning vir die Departement van Toerisme in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Erkende NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Sekuriteitsbestuur / Veiligheidsbestuur of ander verwante kwalifikasies. 5 jaar relevante ervaring in 'n sekuriteitsbestuursomgewing, waarvan 3 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Praktiese ervaring in die implementering van Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS). Minimum Physical Security Standards (MPSS). Sekuriteitsbestuurderskursus sal 'n voordeel wees. Administratiewe prosedures. Sekuriteitsverwante beleide en prosedures. Minimum Physical Security Standards. Control of Access to Public Premises Act. National Key Points Act. POPIA. Public Financial Management (PFMA). Supply Chain Management. Occupational Health and Safety Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service act and Regulations. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Organisering en beplanning. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Projektbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Luistervaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Ondersoekvaardighede. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Persone met gestremdhede wat hulle verhoed om te bestuur, sal steeds oorweeg word).
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur van bedrywighede, fisiese sekuriteit en die implementering van die noodplan in die departement; Hersiening en opdatering van die sekuriteitsbedrywighedehandboek; Verseker dat fisiese sekuriteit in ooreenstemming met die departementele sekuriteitsbeleid gelewer word; Onderhou 'n opgedateerde sekuriteitsplan vir die departement; Verseker die voorsiening van ontfangsdienste; Voer sekuriteitsinspeksies by alle sekuriteitspunte uit; Skep sekuriteitsregisters om behoorlike rekordhouding te verseker; Inspekteer sekuriteitspersoneel dienspligtig; Onderhou 'n opgedateerde SekuriteitsOperasionele Plan; Monitor sekuriteitspersoneel se oortyd en dien eise vir oortyd- en skoftoelaes vir goedkeuring in; Hersien sekuriteitsbeleid; Hersien en beoordeel gelewerde sekuriteitsdienste; Evalueer prestasie van alle ondergeskiktes; Onderhou en dateer die noodplan op; Verskaf insette tot die ontwikkeling en opdatering van die Besigheidskontinuïteitsplan; Voer gereelde toetse op alle sekuriteitsuitrusting uit; Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes vir operasionele sekuriteitspersoneel; Identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings vir die sekuriteit van die departement asook die departement se vermoë om sekuriteitsbedreigings te weerstaan; Voer fisieke assessments uit in ooreenstemming met MISS en MPSS; Voer bedreigings- en risiko-assessments uit; Voer sleuteloudits uit en verseker dat registers gehou word; Koördineer implementering van sekuriteitsnoodplan; Bestuur die uitvoering van veldwerkondersoeke en voer voorlopige ondersoeke na alle aangemelde sekuriteitskendings binne die departement uit; Vestig, ontwikkel stelsels en prosesse wat nakoming ten opsigte van die tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide, voorskrifte en prosedures van personeelsekuriteit sal verseker; Bestuur en verskaf 'n sekuriteitsondersoekkapasiteit in ooreenstemming met die National Vetting Legislative Framework; Bestuur en koördineer die uitvoering van sekuriteitsondersoekpraktyke in ooreenstemming met, en in oorleg met, die State Security Agency (SSA); Bestuur ondersteunende administratiewe stelsels, kanale en infrastruktuur om aan ondersoekvereistes te voldoen; Voer sekuriteitsvoorlopige ondersoeke uit; Stel verslae oor sekuriteitskendings op; Dien ondersoekverslae vir inspeksie in; Rapporteer kendings aan die South African Police Service; Bestuur inligtingssekuriteit in die departement in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe sekuriteitsprosedures, reëls en regulasies; Bestuur inligtingssekuriteit in die departement; Monitor kommunikasie- en IT-sekuriteit in die departement; Ontwikkel en implementeer sekuriteitsrisikobestuursprogramme binne die departement; Bestuur dokumentsekuriteit in die departement; Bystand verleen by die bestuur van personeelgeskiktheidskontroles; Inligtingsekuriteitsbewusmakingsprogramme binne die departement; Bestuur en inspeksie van uitbesteedde sekuriteitsdienste om nakoming van departementele standaarde en kontraktuele vereistes te verseker; Ouloer en monitor private sekuriteitsdiensverskaffers, en verseker effektiewe ontplooiing en prestasie van sekuriteitspersoneel; Voer maandelikse prestasievergaderings met sekuriteitsdiensverskaffers uit en berei en dien akkurate notules en verslae aan bestuur voor; Verseker effektiewe kontrakbestuur van uitbesteedde sekuriteitswagdiens in ooreenstemming met die Service Level Agreement (SLA); Monitor diensverskafferprestasie, identifiseer nie-nakoming of operasionele gapings, en fasiliteer korrigerende maatreëls waar nodig; Verifieer dat gekontrakteerde sekuriteitsdienste doeltreffend, konsekwent en in ooreenstemming met ooreengekome diensstandaarde en kontraktuele verpligtinge gelewer word.

zu.title: Sekela-Mqondisi: Izinsizakalo Zokulawula Ukuvikela
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela-Mqondisi sibheka izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukuvikela ngokomzimba, nokuhlela amaphulani ezimo ezingavamile ku-Department of Tourism e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isimangaziso esemthethweni se-NQF 7 ekuPhathweni koKuvikela / ekuPhathweni koKuphepha noma ezinye izimangaziso ezihlobene. 5 iminyaka yotholakalo oluhlobene endaweni yokuphathwa kokuvikela, lapho kuyadingeka khona iminyaka engu-3 ibheke izinga lokubheka. Ukutholwa ngokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kokuvikela kolwazi okuncane. Amazinga okuqinisekisa okuncane okuvikela ngokomzimba. Isifundo sabaphathi bokuvikela sizobe lisizo elengeziwe. Izinqubo zolawulo. Inqubomgomo mayelana nokuvikela kanye nezinqubo. Amazinga okuncane okuvikela ngokomzimba. Umthetho Wokulawula Ukungena Kwindawo Yoluntu. Umthetho Wamaphoyinti Abarule Kuyawonke. I-POPIA. Iphathwa Lemali Yomphakathi (PFMA). Iphathwa Lohlelo Lokuqasha. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Komsebenzi. Umthetho Wezimo Eziyisisekelo Zomsebenzi. Umthetho nemiyalo yomsebenzi womphakathi. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakumbi. Ukuhlela nokuhlela amaphulani. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono abuhlobo lobuntu oluhle. Izempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi. Iphathwa Lephulo. Iphathwa Lemali. Amakhono okulalela. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okuphenya. Ilayisensi yomshayeli esemthethweni (abantu abasabile abakwazi ukushaywa kuzobe kubhekwa futhi).
zu.duties: Umkhethi ophumelelayo uzoba nobuncweti bokulawula izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuvikela indawo ngokomzimba, kanye nokuphatha iphulani lezimo ezingajabulile kumnyango; Ukuhlola futhi abuyekeze incwadi yokuqhuba izinhlelo zokuvikela; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuvikela ngokomzimba kunikezwa ngokuvumelana nenqubomgomo yokuvikela yomnyango; Ukugcina ibuyekeziwe iphulani yokuvikela yomnyango; Ukuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokwamukela; Ukuhlola izinhlelo zokuvikela kuzo zonke izingxenye zokuvikela; Ukudala izibuyekezo zokuvikela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugcina irekhodi ngendlela efanele; Ukuhlola abasebenzi bokuvikela abasebenzayo; Ukugcina ibuyekeziwe Iphulani Yokusebenza Yokuvikela; Ukuqaphela amahora amaningi abasebenzi bokuvikela futhi uhambise izicelo zemalahlebo nemali yokushintshashintsha ama-shifti ukuze zivunyelwe; Ukuhlola futhi uhlolisise izinsizakalo zokuvikela ezinikezwayo; Ukubuyekeza ukusebenza kwabo bonke ababhekezi; Ukugcina futhi ubuyekeze iphulani lezimo ezingajabulile; Ukunikela izigqozi ekuthuthukisweni nasekubuyekezeni Iphulani Loqobo Lwezabhizinisi; Ukuqhuba ukuhlolwa njalo kwazo zonke izingxenye zokuvikela; Ukuhlola izidingo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi bokuvikela; Ukuhlola izengozi nezinsongo ekuvikenweni komnyango kanye nethonya lomnyango lokubhekana nezinsongo zokuvikela; Ukuqhuba ukuhlola ngokomzimba ngokuvumelana ne-MISS kanye ne-MPSS; Ukuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwezinsongo nezengozi; Ukuqhuba ukuhlolwa okubalulekile futhi aqinisekise ukuthi izibuyekezo zigcinwa; Ukulungiselela ukuphathwa kwekudalwa iphulani lezimo ezingajabulile zokuvikela; Ukuphatha ukuqhubwa kwezinhlela zokuphenya ezinkundleni futhi kuqhubwe iziphenyo ezingunhlangothi kuyo yonke imikhuba yokuvikela echawiweyo ngaphakathi komnyango; Ukuseka,uthuthukise izimiso nezindlela ezoqinisekisa ukuvumelana ngokomthetho ophathelene, inqubomgomo, imiyalo kanye nokuqhubeka kokuvikela komsebenzi; Ukuphatha futhi uhlinze ngamandla okuhlola ukuvikela ngokuvumelana nezinhlelo zomthetho zokuhlola kazwelonke; Ukuphatha futhi uhlanganise ukwenza izinqubo zokuhlola ukuvikela ngokuvumelana, futhi ngokubonisana ne-State Security Agency (SSA); Ukuphatha izimiso zokweseka izinhlelo zolawulo, izindlela nempahla ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zokuhlola; Ukuqhuba iziphenyo zokuqala zokuvikela; Ukuqamba umbiko ngemikhuba yokuvikela egwadluliwe; Ukuhambisa imibiko yeziphenyo ukuze ihlolelwe; Ukubika imikhuba egwadluliwe ku-South African Police Service; Ukuphatha ukuvikela kolwazi kumnyango ngokuvumelana nemiyalo yokuvikela, imithetho nemikhakha ecaiwe; Ukuphatha ukuvikela kolwazi emnyangweni; Ukuqaphela ukuxhumana nokuvikela kwe-IT kumnyango; Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuphatha izinhlela zokuphathwa kwezengozi zokuvikela ngaphakathi komnyango; Ukuphatha ukuvikela kwamadokhumenti emnyangweni; Ukusiza ekuphathweni kokuhlola ulungele olwabasebenzi; Izinhlela zokwazisa ngokuvikela kolwazi ngaphakathi komnyango; Ukuphatha kanye nokuhlola insizakalo zokuvikela ezithengiswe kuwo kube ngokuvumelana namazinga omnyango nezidingo zesivumelwano; Ukubheka futhi uqaphele abanikeli bezinsizakalo zokuvikela bangaqondile, ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa ngokusebenza nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bokuvikela; Ukuqhuba izingqungqulu zeminyuzi yenyanga zonke nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zokuvikela, aze alungiselele futhi ahambise iminithi yegqunga eliqinisekisiwe kanye nembiko kubaphathi; Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo kwesivumelwano senkonzo yabagadi bakude ngokuvumelana ne-Service Level Agreement (SLA); Ukuqaphela ukusebenza komnikeli wenkonzo, aze ahlole ukungahambisani noma izikhala ezingasebenza, aze alungiselele izinyathelo zokuqondisa lapho kudingeka khona; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi insizakalo yokuvikela esivunyelwe ihlinzekwa ngempumelelo, ngokuqiniseka, ngokuvumelana namazinga okuhlinzekwa esivunyelwe kanye nezibopho zesivumelwano.

xh.title: Isebe Leliqela elibhekisa kumakhulu: Iinkonzo zoLawulo loKhuseleko
xh.summary: Indima yesikhulu esibhekisa kumakhulu ekuqwalaselweni kweenkonzo zokhuseleko, ukhuseleko olubonakalayo, kunye nokuqwalaselwa kwezicwangciso zexesha elizayo kwisebe lezeMpumelelo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esivunyelwe seNQF 7 kwiLawulo loKhuseleko / iLawulo loKhuseleko okunye nokuquka iziqinisekiso ezinxulumene nalesi. Unyaka bola-5 Wohlumileyo emkhankathweni wokhuseleko olunomyalezo, apho kweminyaka yaya kuthi ga yimiso-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba elihamba phambili ekubhekisekeni. Isipili sokusebenza ngokusesikweni kwiMigangatho ecuncathiswa yeNkcazelo yoKhuseleko (MISS). iMigangatho ecuncathiswa yoKhuseleko olubonakalayo (MPSS). Ikhosi yoKumanyano jikelele koLawulo boKhuseleko iya kuba ngaphezu kokuqinisekisa. Iinkqubo zolawulo. Iinkqubo nemithetho yolawulo exhutshwe kwindawo yokhuseleko. Imigangatho ecuncathiswa yokhuseleko olubonakalayo. iMithetho yoLawulo ngolondolozo loNgeno kwindawo zoluntu. uMthetho waMazwe aBalulekileyo (National Key Points Act). iPOPIA. iNtengiso ePhilayo yoLawulo lwamaCandavo kaRhulumente (PFMA). iLawulo leNkonzo eNcenyiweyo. uMthetho woKhuseleko lweNtengiso nokuQinisekiswa koBomi babaSebenzi. iMigaqo yoBungcali bokusebenza eYilwayo. uMthetho woBuntu namagunya awo. Isakhono esihle sokunxibelelwana. Isakhono sokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. uLungiselelo lweNkqubo neZicwangciso. Isakhono sokubhala iingxelo. Isakhono esihle sokuziqhelanisa nabanye. uKhuseleko lweNtengiso nokuQinisekiswa koBomi babaSebenzi. iNkqubo yoLawulo lweNkqubo yoLawulo. iLawulo leeMali. Isakhono sokumamela. Isakhono sokwahlula-hlula. Isakhono sokuphonononga. Ilayisenisi esemthethweni yokuqhuba (Abantu abanokuphazima okokubakhwecisa ekushiyweni ngaphandle kokuba batshatwe ngokuchasene nokuqhuba baya kusapho nakwenziwa ngenkqubo).
xh.duties: Umgangatho opheleleyo wokuqwalaselwa kweziphumo ezikwindawo ekuphila khona, ukhuseleko olubonakalayo, kunye nokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yokuhamba ixesha elizayo kwisebe; uKuqwalasela nokuvuselela isikhokelo seemisebenzi yokhuseleko; ukuQinisekisa ukuba ukhuseleko olubonakalayo lunikelwa ngokwemigaqo kaKhuseleko leSikhosi; ukuGcina isicwangciso sokhuseleko esivuselelekileyo kwisebe; ukuQinisekisa ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokwamkela abantu; ukuQhuba iintlobo zokuhlolwa kwakhuseleko kuzo zonke iindawo zokhuseleko; ukuZisa iirejista zokhuseleko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugcina iirekhodi ezifanelekileyo; ukuHlola abasebenzi bakhuseleko basesihlotsheni; ukuGcina iNkqubo yeNkqubo yoKhuseleko esivuselelekileyo; ukuQwalasela amahora okugqitha ibanga elithileyo omsebenzi yabasebenzi bakhuseleko kwaye ungenise izicelo zemali yokugqitha ixesha elithileyo nezimali ezongezwa kwiSikhundla esize ngokomthetho; ukuQwalasela imigaqo yokhuseleko; ukuQwalasela ukuze kuhlolwe iinkonzo zokhuseleko ezinikezwayo; ukuLinganisa ukusebenza kolawulo lwawo onke abasebenzi abangaphantsi; ukuGcina nokuvuselela isicwangciso sokuhamba ixesha elizayo; ukuNika iingcinga ekwenziweni nasemkhankathweni weNkqubo eQhubekayo yokuQhuba iNtengiso; ukuQhuba iindibaniselwana ezizezijovu kwihlabathi jikelele lonke malunga nophawu lokulinga ukhuseleko; ukuQaphela iimfuno zokuzinikela ngamandla abasebenzi bokhuseleko beQumrhu; ukuQaphela iingozi nezoyiko ekukhuselekeni kwesebe nasekuqwalaseleni amandla esebe kumelana neengozi zokhuseleko; ukuQhuba iziphonso ezibonakalayo ngokuvumelana neMISS neMPSS; ukuQhuba ukulinganiselwa kweengozi neengozi ezinokubakho; ukuQhuba ukuhlolwa kweqhosha kuqinisekise ukuba iirejista zihlali zibonakalisa isimo; ukuHlela ukusetyenziswa kwesicwangciso sokuhamba ixesha elizayo sokhuseleko; ukuLawula ukuphumeza iindwendwe zokuphonononga kwindawo ngaphandle kweyure nokuqhuba iziphonso zamanyange kuwo onke amaxenye avela ngaphakathi ngokuchasene nokungabikho komthetho wokhuseleko ngaphakathi kwesebe; ukuMisa inkqubo yokulungiselela iinkqubo neenkcukacha eziza kuqinisekisa ukuhamba ngemithetho, iinkqubo, iimigaqo nemiqathango yamalunga abasebenzi abakhuselekileyo; ukuLawula kwaye anikeze isakhono sokuhlolwa komthetho wokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yeNkqubo yeMithetho yokuQinisekisa ukhuseleko; ukuLawula kwaye ahlele ukwenziwa kweenkqubo zokuQinisekisa ukhuseleko ngokuvumelana, kwaye ngokuvumelana, neNkqubo yeNkosi yokuQinisekisa (SSA); ukuLawula iinkqubo zolawulo zokuxhasa, iindlela nokuqhagamshelana eziza kwenza isikhundla ngokwemigaqo yokuQinisekisa; ukuQhuba iindwendwe zokuphonononga ngokungenisa amathuba; ukuHlola iingxelo ngokungalunganga komthetho; ukuNgenisa iingxelo zokuphonononga ukuze zihlolwe; ukuBika ngokungalunganga komthetho kwinkonzo kaMaphakade kaMzantsi Afrika; ukuLawula uKhuseleko loNgeniso lwamanyathelo kwisebe ngokwemigaqo yokuQinisekisa ukhuseleko, imithetho yobulumko nokuqwalaselwa; ukuLawula uKhuseleko loNgeniso lwamanyathelo kwisebe; ukuQwalasela uNxibelelwano nokuQinisekisa iNtengiso eKhuselekileyo kwisebe; ukuMisa nokwenza iinkqubo zokuQinisekisa iNkqubo yoLawulo lweengozi ezikwindawo ekuphila khona; ukuLawula uKhuseleko lweMixholo kwisebe; ukuNceda ekulawulweni kokuhlolwa kokuQwalasela abantu abakhethwe; iinkqubo zobulumko bokukhuseleka ngokwemanyathelo kwisebe; ukuLawula kwaye ahlole iinkonzo zokukhuseleka ezinyuliweyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzivumelanisa nemitshato yesebe nokuqwalasela ukuvumelana nemitshato; ukuQwalasela kwaye alawule ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokukhuseleka, ukuqinisekisa ukuba setyenziswa ngokulingana okusesikweni nesakhono sabasebenzi bakhuseleko; ukuQhuba iindibano zenyanga zonke zokulinganisa ukusebenza neenkonzo zokunikwa amathuba kwaye alungise kwaye angenise iirekhodi ezifanelekileyo zendibano iingxelo ngokulawulwa; ukuQinisekisa ukuba kukho olona lawulo lusebenzayo lweenkonzo zokukhuseleka ezinyuliweyo ngokuvumelana nokuVumelana ngoQhinga lweNqanaba leNkonzo (SLA); ukuQwalasela ukusebenza kweenkonzo zokunikwa amathuba, ukuqaphela ukungavunyelwa ukwenza into ethile okanye amathuba akekho kwiNkqubo, kwaye uhlele izinto ezifanelekileyo zokwenza isigwegwenda apho kuyimfuno khona; ukuQinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zokukhuseleka ezivunyiweyo zinikelwa ngokusebenza okusebenzayo, ngesitayile esihambelana nokuqwalaselwa okuvunyelweyo kwiNkqubo nemitshato.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Administration Officer MR6
jobs.salary_text: R610 434 – R1 442 451 per annum, (Suitable salary will be determined in accordance with the OSD determination), (Notch and All-Inclusive remuneration package consisting of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within a framework)
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 by 16:30 (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Senior Legal Administration Officer position requiring an LLB and eight years of legal experience, providing legal opinions and research in the Department of Tourism.
jobs.requirements: An LLB qualification. At least 8 years appropriate post qualification legal experience. Knowledge of the Constitution. Knowledge of the PFMA. Knowledge of Civil Procedure (high court and magistrate court rules). Knowledge of PAJA & PAIA, Computer Literacy, Analytical thinking, Legal Drafting, Dispute Resolution, Legal Research, Good verbal & Written Communication Skills, and Project & contract management Skills.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for Legal Advices/ Opinions; Supervising and providing legal advices/ opinions in the Department by: Researching the applicability of legal principles on egal opinions; Higher legal position of the Opinions; Conducting research on applicable policy, legislation or regulations and legal principles with legal Opinions; Formulating questions to be answered on legal Opinions; Studying and cite relevant cases on aspects related to legal Opinions; Providing recommendations and conclusions within permissible legal prescripts; Consulting client to verify request for legal opinions and contents of the legal opinions upon finalisation; Policy and Legal development; Ascertaining whether legislation is in accordance with principle of drafting and interpretation of statutes; Ascertaining that the intention of Department and entities are reflected in the said proposed bill or amendment bill; Reviewing existing legislation to explore opportunities for its amendment and improvement; Perusing and study draft of proposed bill or amendment bill; Facilitating with the drafting of cabinet memorandum; Piloting legislation through the parliamentary process; Making necessary submissions and presentations on draft legislation; Responding to legal opinion aspects that arise during public hearing and parliamentary sessions; Consulting with and getting instructions from the relevant line function; Litigation management; Collecting and providing evidence in regard to possible settlements and negotiate settlements with opponents; Preparing instructions to State Attorneys and make recommendations for appointment of suitable Advocates, if necessary; Monitoring court cases from inception to its finality; Liaising with State Attorney in managing court cases; Determining factual and legal situation on cases brought forward; Establishing if the Department should litigate or defend matter; Reviewing all pleadings at all stages for the court cases as per court rules; Consulting with the relevant line function at each stage of the pleadings; Exploring alternative dispute resolution options for each court cases and prepare an opinion on same; Ensuring that the briefings are prepared and court orders are implemented effectively; Preparing brief advising the relevant authority seeking authority to institute or defend the Departmental legal position; Preparing brief advising the relevant Authority seeking authorisation to institute or defend the Departmental legal position; Conducting research on applicable policy, legislation or regulation to be followed; Drafting legal documents and advices on hand or mentor juniors on drafting of legal documents that provide clear motivation/ justification for a particular position pertaining to the case; Ensuring that there is consistency when applying the legal principles; Liaising with Stakeholders on legal interventions; Drafting and/ or edit legal correspondence on all legal administrative enquiries; Conducting awareness on the legal interventions; Providing inputs into the strategic planning of the Directorate/Chief Directorate and execution of the operational plan; Providing supervision of the Legal Administration Officers and Interns in the Sub-Directorate; Submit monthly and quarterly report to the Director
jobs.applications: Email application: Recruitment6426@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a new Z83 form and CV only. Electronic applications must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (i.e. old Z83 form) will not be considered. Each post’s advertisement must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Sections A, B, C, and D of the new Z83 form must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the new Z83 form, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or indicate “see attached” in respect of Sections E, F and G. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resource Management, and such qualifications and other related documents will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, or whose applications were received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and attainment of a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Department of Tourism processing your personal information, subject to POPIA. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Regsadministratiewe Beampte MR6
af.summary: Senior Regsadministratiewe Beampte-pos wat 'n LLB en agt jaar regsonderwind vereis, en regsmenings en navorsing in die Department of Tourism verskaf.
af.requirements: An LLB-kwalifikasie. Ten minste 8 jaar toepaslike postkwalifikasie-regsonderwind. Kennis van die Grondwet. Kennis van die PFMA. Kennis van Burgerlike Proses (hooggeregshof en landdrosghofreëls). Kennis van PAJA & PAIA, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Analitiese denke, Regsopstel, Geskilbeslegting, Regsnavorsing, Goeie mondelinge & Skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede, en Projekte- & Kontrakbestuurvaardighede.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir Regsadvies/ Menings; Toesig hou en regsadvies/ menings in die Departement verskaf deur: Navorsing oor die toepaslikheid van regsbeginsels op regsmenings; Hoër regsposisie van die Menings; Navorsing doen oor toepaslike beleid, wetgewing of regulasies en regsbeginsele met regsmenings; Vrae formuleer om op regsmenings beantwoord te word; Bestudeer en haal relevante sake aan oor aspekte wat verband hou met regsmenings; Aanbevelings en gevolgtrekkings binne toelaatbare regsvoorskrifte verskaf; Kliënt raadpleeg om versoek vir regsmenings en inhoud van die regsmenings na afloop te verifieer; Beleids- en Regsonwikkeling; Bepaal of wetgewing in ooreenstemming is met die beginsel van opstel en interpretasie van statuut; Bepaal dat die intensie van die Departement en entiteite in die genoemde voorgestelde wetsontwerp of wysigingswetsontwerp weerspieël word; Bestaande wetgewing hersien om geleenthede vir die wysiging en verbetering daarvan te ondersoek; Konsep van voorgestelde wetsontwerp of wysigingswetsontwerp deurlees en bestudeer; Fasiliteer met die opstel van kabinetsmemorandum; Wetgewing deur die parlementêre proses loods; Noodsaaklike voorleggings en aanbiedings oor konsepwetgewing doen; Reageer op regsasiere wat gedurende openbare verhore en parlementêre sessies na vore kom; Raadpleeg en kry instruksies vanaf die tersaaklike lynfunksie; Regsgedingbestuur; Bewyse insake moontlike skikking versamel en verskaf en skikkings met teenstanders onderhandel; Instruksies aan State Attorneys voorberei en aanbevelings maak vir die aanstelling van geskikte Advokate, indien nodig; Hof sake vanaf aanvang tot voltooiing monitor; Skakel met State Attorney in die bestuur van hofsake; Bepaal feitelike en regstoestand op sake wat na vore gebring word; Bepaal of die Departement die saak moet litigeer of verdedig; Alle pleitstukke op alle stadiums vir die hofsake volgens hofreëls hersien; Raadpleeg die tersaaklike lynfunksie op elke stadium van die pleitstukke; Alternatiewe geskilbeslegtingsopsies vir elke hofsaak ondersoek en 'n mening daaroor voorberei; Verseker dat die briefwisselings voorberei word en hofbevele doeltreffend geïmplementeer word; Brief voorberei wat die tersaaklike gesag adviseer en gesag soek om die Departementele regsposisie in te stel of te verdedig; Brief voorberei wat die tersaaklike Gesag adviseer en magtiging soek om die Departementele regsposisie in te stel of te verdedig; Navorsing doen oor toepaslike beleid, wetgewing of regulasie wat gevolg moet word; Regsdokumente en advies opstel of junior beamptes mentoreer oor die opstel van regsdokumente wat duidelike motivering/ regverdiging vir 'n spesifieke posisie rakende die saak verskaf; Verseker dat daar konsekwentheid is wanneer die regsbeginsele toegepas word; Skakel met Belanghebbendes oor regsintervensies; Regskorrespondensie oor alle regsadministratiewe navrae opstel en/ of redigeer; Bewustheid oor die regsintervensies skep; Invoere voorsien in die strategiese beplanning van die Direktoraat/Hoofdirektoraat en uitvoering van die operasionele plan; Toesig hou oor die Regsadministratiewe Beamptes en Intekenaars in die Subdirektoraat; Maandelikse en kwartaalverslag aan die Direkteur voorlê

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomthetho Ophakemei MR6
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wezomthetho ophakemei esidinga i-LLB futhi uneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yohlelo olusebenzayo lomthetho, okunikeza izincomo zomthetho futhi kwenze uphando kwi-Department of Tourism.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Security Operations
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), excludes service benefits.
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 by 16:30 (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Security Operations at the Department of Tourism in Pretoria, managing physical security, access control and surveillance systems at Level 09.
jobs.requirements: A recognized NQF Level 6 qualification in Security Management / Safety Management or other related qualifications. Minimum of 3 years in a Security Management environment, of which 2 years must be at senior practitioner level. Experience in Security / SAPS / SSA / Private Security. Experience in Access Control. Investigations Experience. Ability to interpret Security legislation such as MISS and MPSS. Knowledge of security-related legislation and prescripts. Ability to interpret and apply security policies, directives, procedures and prescripts. Administrative procedures. Financial management. Public Service Act and Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Occupational Health and Safety Act. Criminal Procedures Act. Access to Public Premises and Vehicles Act. Access Control Procedures. Minimum Physical Security Standards. Minimum Information Security Standards. Good communication skills. Computer Literacy. Organising and Planning. Report writing skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Occupational Health and Safety. Project Management. Listening skills. Writing skills. Problem-solving. Technical skills. Security management. Observations skills. Investigations skills. Customer relations. A valid driver’s.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for Managing physical security and monitor the surveillance system; Ensuring that access control is monitored; Monitoring security control room operations; Conducting control room inspections; Monitoring electronic detection systems; Inspecting systems and ensure effective control; Inspecting all security registers; Ensuring professional dress code standards is maintained; Conducting after-hours inspections; Monitoring outsourced security service; Managing and control keys for the Department; Ensuring keys are kept in line with prescripts; Keeping and control safe keys and combination; Ensuring that keys are issued as per policies and prescripts; Inspecting key storage cabinets; Identifying risks and threats to the security of the department and vulnerability of the department’s capability to counter security threats; Conducting physical security inspections and patrols; Verifying effectiveness of security system; Ensuring that security officers patrol the building; Conducting investigations and compile report in case of physical security incidents/breaches; Investigating and report security breaches; Managing duty shift for security personnel; Ensuring availability of monthly shift rosters; Preparing shift allowance claims; Managing and plan leave; Checking shift registers; Compiling shift allowance claims; Managing of Reception Services; Monitoring reception operations; Inspecting visitor registers; Compiling visitor statistics; Ensuring professional dress code; Supervising human resources; Ensuring quality of work; Ensuring personnel development; Assessing staff performance.
jobs.applications: Email application: Recruitment6526@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a new Z83 form and CV only. Electronic applications must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (i.e. old Z83 form) will not be considered. Each post’s advertisement must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Sections A, B, C, and D of the new Z83 form must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the new Z83 form, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or indicate “see attached” in respect of Sections E, F and G. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resource Management, and such qualifications and other related documents will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, or whose applications were received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and attainment of a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Department of Tourism processing your personal information, subject to POPIA. MANAGEMENT ECHELON
