jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Administration
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 by 16:30 (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Administration at the Department of Tourism in Pretoria, requiring an NQF Level 6 qualification and five years' HR experience.
jobs.requirements: A recognised NQF Level 6 qualification in Human Resource Management / Human Resource Development / Public Administration / Public Management or related equivalent qualification. Five years’ working experience in Human Resource Management / Administration of which 3 years’ must be at supervisory level. Experience in Recruitment, Selection and Appointments and Conditions of Service. Applicants must be in possession of the Introduction to PERSAL, the PERSAL Administration and the Administration of Leave certificates. Knowledge of relevant Acts, Policies and Prescripts. Knowledge of relevant HR practices in the Public Service and in the Department. Knowledge of relevant HR formulas. Knowledge of interdependencies in other areas. Knowledge of the mandate and objectives of the department. PERSAL knowledge. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Salary Structuring. DPSA Directives. Employment Equity Act. Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC) resolutions. Rules and procedures related to conditions of service, HR compliance and reporting. Leadership skills. Project management. Stakeholder management. Verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy (MS Office, PERSAL and any electronic workflow system). Ability to work under pressure. Customer focus. Interpersonal skills. Ability to work individually and in a team. Problem solving skills. Analytical skills. Financial and number skills. Supervisory and management leadership. Presentation. Change Management. Highly flexible. A valid driver’s license (Persons with disabilities that prevent them from driving will still be considered)
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting effective recruitment, selection and appointment processes through policy development and the implementation of such policy; Reduction of vacancy rate in line with the target in the strategic plan; Compiling and advertising of posts; Provisioning of advice to line managers on recruitment matters in line with the relevant legislative framework and internal policies; Making written follow-ups with line managers on delayed recruitment activities to ensure that Posts are filled within time frames; Ensuring proper recording of applications and submission of applications to line managers within agreed upon standards; Writing quality recruitment submissions in respect of transfers and secondments etc; Arranging competency assessments; Conducting personnel suitability checks and verification of qualifications; Attending to any other recruitment related activities in the end to end process; Supporting the administration and application of conditions of service and benefits; Quality control of leave administration; Quality control of completed pension forms destined to GEPF/GPAA; Providing advice to employees on pension related matters; Providing advice to employees regarding medical aid administration (GEMS); Processing of resettlement of employees on transfers, appointments and retirement; Processing of long service recognition and arrange payments and hand out letters and certificates; Managing housing allowance and state guarantee scheme applications; Facilitating the process of resignations, retirements, deaths and dismissals; Giving advice , provide relevant forms and recommend/ approve leave gratuity payouts; Co-ordinating the PILIR process between the department and the Health Risk Manager, including writing submissions; Attending to any other service conditions and benefits related activities; Providing administrative support and supervisory duties; Logistical arrangements for meetings; Obtaining monthly PERSAL and Establishment reports in order to ensure alignment between recruitment processes and funded vacant posts; Taking minutes during meetings in which secretariat duties are required (e.g. interviews), and prepare where applicable action lists; Following-up on outstanding actions lists; Input during the review of HR systems, policies and processes; Auditing files; Maintaining various databases and HR related information on EDMS; Overseeing the performance of subordinates and manage their inputs, discipline and wellbeing; Structuring MMS/SMS packages and approve PERSAL transactions; Administer Injury of Duty cases; Administering probations; Presenting and conducting information sharing session on topical issues related to the job; Conducting various written reports and or submission; Participating in specialised projects; Supervising, manage and do quality control of the work of others; Implementing and approve various PERSAL transactions
jobs.applications: Email application: Recruitment6626@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a new Z83 form and CV only. Electronic applications must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (i.e. old Z83 form) will not be considered. Each post’s advertisement must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Sections A, B, C, and D of the new Z83 form must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the new Z83 form, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or indicate “see attached” in respect of Sections E, F and G. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resource Management, and such qualifications and other related documents will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, or whose applications were received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and attainment of a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Department of Tourism processing your personal information, subject to POPIA. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

Ukunciphisa iNqanaba lokuTyhaliwa kwabasemSebenzini ngokwalingana nexabiso kwinkqubo yokuQamba iNtshukumo; UkuQaqaqa iindawo zeCandale kwiDlu yaseMandulo ePretoria; ukunika iNkcazelo kubaphathi bokumkqoka balawo mayelana nezeQiso kuhambelana naNkqubo nam yoMthetho iNkqubo zeQizo nelungelo zangamkqoKqazza; ukuBhala iziKwazi-siZathu kubaphathi bemiGqo nasekuHlelwa iNkqubo yokuQesha ukuQinisekisa ukuba kumkqoza indawo kaMqokeleli phakathi kweMithwalo yeseBemthethweni eCandzel' elakwesiBamthethweni ekuKhusela komSebenzi; uQinisekisa ukugcinwa kolwle LweSicelo nesethunyelwa kolwle kubapHathi bobuMqoka phantsi kwezoQoqo zintlobo-miZizo ezivunywe; ukufaka kuyo nayiphi na imiSebenzi ehlobo kwiNkqubo yoQeqeswa ekuPhelelweni wenkqubo ezuKelyo; uxasumelwa lugcino olulungileni lwabaSebenzi wemiSebenzi nezeMeko-miSebenzi ekuQoqwana; uLawulo lokuKhusela umSebenzisi kunye neQhina eligqibeleleyo lokuKhuselwa kwakhe ekuQeqesweni; ukuNika iNkcazelo ngeQhina kwakhona ngapantsi kweNkqubo iQhina leGazette likaRhumente ebaPhephanga lomQondiso ukusuka ekuQwalaselweni komQondiso ukuya ekuQwalaselweni komSebenzisi weQhina lomQondiso; jobs.title: Assistant Director: Driving Licence Standards
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role overseeing driving licence testing standards and examiner evaluation at licence centres in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF Level 6 as recognized by SAQA in Road Traffic Management/ Traffic Management and Municipal Police/Licensing Practice/ Monitoring and Evaluation/ Transport and Logistics Management/ Public and Logistics Management/Public Management. Certificate: Grade A examiner for driving license’s. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of NRTA-National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, NATIS-National Traffic Information System, Knowledge of Government Gazette no 28446 dates 7 April 2006, Communication/ written, Computer literacy, Knowledge of PFMA, Treasury Regulations and Instructions, Knowledge of Travel Policy for Department, understanding of prescripts within government and Report writing and negotiating skills.
jobs.duties: Inspect standards and evaluate examiners for driving licenses at driving license centers. Evaluate facilities for compliance with minimum requirements in the Government Gazette and compliance with administrative procedures by all stakeholders. Evaluate the standards of testing of all available examiners for driving licenses during inspection. Advise management representative examiners for driving licenses on correct procedures to be applied when executing learner’s license and driving license tests where shortcomings are identified during evaluations. Compile preliminary inspection reports on findings during inspection at the DLTCs that will be signed by Management Representative. Recommend to the MEC of the relevant Provinces regarding actions be taken where non-compliance of facilities, incompetence of examiners for driving licenses to execute testing duties and procedure identified during inspections. Advise all stakeholders regarding the correct procedures to be adhered to where shortcomings are identified during inspections. Analyse inspection reports on the implementation of recommendations. Attend to all driving licenses queries (locally and internationally) and render assistance accordingly. Clarify uncertainties with regards to all driving licence related matters and/ or queries. Liaise with RSA citizens who happen to be in other countries and wanting to convert their South African driving licence issued in their respective country. Assist DOT and other Department officials with driving license related matters. Prepare driving license related response letters to the public, stakeholders and other interested parties. Liaise with DLTCs and Provincial monitoring units. Prepare driving license related response letters to the public, stakeholders and other interested parties. Analyse inspectorate reports on the implementation of recommendation. Conduct preliminary investigations on suspected fraudulent activities at Driving License Testing Centre’s. Identify irregular conduct in terms of the legislation (NRTA). Conduct preliminary investigation. Liaise timeously with different law enforcement agencies. Give evidence during disciplinary hearings and or court sessions. Conduct analysis of NaTIS reports. Analyse Natis activity reports on driving license transactions per DLTC per province to ensure that all active DLTCs are scheduled for inspection. Analyse examiners for driving licenses linked to DLTCs and optimal use of time of examiners. Prepare information based on the analysis of Natis reports to support the inspectorate during inspection. Analyse inspectorate reports on the implementation pf recommendation. Manage the resources of the section. Provide the necessary guidance and supervision to subordinates. Ensure training and development of subordinates. Monitor asset and stationery management. Manage the administration of leaves in the section. Provide input in the compilation of the strategic and annual reports of the Directorate. Provide input in the development of project plans, administration and management reports. Ensure submission of performance agreements, half yearly reviews and annual assessments of subordinates. Ensure compliance to all relevant public service prescripts and policies. Provide secretariat services during Driving Standards related meetings.
jobs.applications: Department of Transport, Private Bag X193, Pretoria, 0001 or hand deliver at the 159 Forum Building, Cnr Struben and Bosman Street, Pretoria for attention Recruitment Unit. Room 4034 or email to: Recruitment@dot.gov.za or at e- recruitment system: erecruit.transport.gov.za. Note: email applications must be sent as one attachment to avoid non-delivery of the email and only quotes the name of the post you are applying for on the Subject Line as directed on the post note.
jobs.notes: Applications must be accompanied by a completed new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department, (or obtainable at). Applicants must fill in full new Z83 form part A, B, C, and D. A recent updated comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and dates). Applicants will submit certified copies of all qualifications and ID document on the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process; the logistics will be communicated to candidates prior to the interviews. Note that National School of Governance (NGS) has introduce compulsory SMS pre- entry certificate with effect from 01 April 2020 as Minimum Entry Requirements for Senior Management Services (submitted prior to appointment) and can be accessed through the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. The successful candidate must disclose to the Director-General particulars of all registrable financial interests, sign a performance agreement and employment contract with the Director-General within three months from the date of assumption of duty. The successful candidate must be willing to sign an oath of secrecy with the Department. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and assessments at a time, date and place as determined by the Department. An offer letter will only be issued to the successful candidate once the following has been verified educational qualifications, previous experience, citizenship, reference checks and security vetting. Please note: Correspondence will only be entered into with short-listed candidates. OTHER POST

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Standarde vir Bestuurslisensies
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur-pos wat toesig hou oor toetsstandarde vir bestuurslisensies en die evaluering van ondersoekers by lisensiesentra in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 soos erken deur SAQA in Padverkeersbestuur/ Verkeersbestuur en Munisipale Polisie/Lisensiepraktyk/ Monitering en Evaluering/ Vervoer en Logistieke Bestuur/ Openbare en Logistieke Bestuur/ Openbare Bestuur. Sertifikaat: Graad A-ondersoeker vir bestuurslisensies. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van NRTA-National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, NATIS-National Traffic Information System, kennis van Government Gazette no 28446 dates 7 April 2006, Kommunikasie/ skriftelik, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Kennis van PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en -instruksies, Kennis van Reisbeleid vir die Departement, begrip van voorskrifte binne regering en verslagskryf- en onderhandelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Ondersoek standarde en evalueer ondersoekers vir bestuurslisensies by bestuurslisensiesentrums. Evalueer fasiliteite vir nakoming van minimum vereistes in die Government Gazette en nakoming van administratiewe prosedures deur alle belanghebbendes. Evalueer die toetsstandaarde van alle beskikbare ondersoekers vir bestuurslisensies tydens inspeksie. Adviseer bestuursverteenwoordiger-ondersoekers vir bestuurslisensies oor die korrekte prosedures wat toegepas moet word by die uitvoering van leerlisensie- en bestuurslisensietoetse waar tekortkomings tydens evaluering geïdentifiseer word. Stel voorlopige inspeksieverslae op oor bevindinge tydens inspeksie by die DLTC's wat deur die Bestuursverteenwoordiger onderteken sal word. Beveel aan die MEC van die betrokke Provinsies aan aangaande optrede wat geneem moet word waar daar nie-nakoming van fasiliteite is, onbevoegdheid van ondersoekers vir bestuurslisensies om toetspligte uit te voer en prosedures wat tydens inspeksies geïdentifiseer word. Adviseer alle belanghebbendes aangaande die korrekte prosedures waaraan voldoen moet word waar tekortkomings tydens inspeksies geïdentifiseer word. Analiseer inspeksieverslae oor die implementering van aanbevelings. Behartig alle navrae oor bestuurslisensies (plaaslik en internasionaal) en verskaf dienooreenkomstige bystand. Verduidelik onsekerhede met betrekking tot alle bestuurslisensie-verwante aangeleenthede en/ of navrae. Skakel met RSA-burgers wat toevallig in ander lande is en hul Suid-Afrikaanse bestuurslisensie wat in hul onderskeie land uitgereik is, wil omskakel. Help DOT- en ander Departementele amptenare met bestuurslisensie-verwante aangeleenthede. Stel bestuurslisensie-verwante antwoordbriewe aan die publiek, belanghebbendes en ander geïnteresseerde partye op. Skakel met DLTC's en Provinciale moniteringseenhede. Stel bestuurslisensie-verwante antwoordbriewe aan die publiek, belanghebbendes en ander geïnteresseerde partye op. Analiseer inspektoraatverslae oor die implementering van aanbevelings. Voer voorlopige ondersoeke uit na verdagte bedrywigheid by Driving License Testing Centre's. Identifiseer onreëlmatige gedrag in terme van die wetgewing (NRTA). Voer voorlopige ondersoek uit. Skakel betyds met verskeie regshandhawingsagentskappe. Lewer getuienis tydens dissiplinêre verhore en/ of hofsessies. Voer ontleding van NaTIS-verslae uit. Analiseer Natis-aktiwiteitsverslae oor bestuurslisensie-transaksies per DLTC per provinsie om te verseker dat alle aktiewe DLTC's vir inspeksie geskeduleer word. Analiseer ondersoekers vir bestuurslisensies wat aan DLTC's gekoppel is en optimale benutting van tyd van ondersoekers. Stel inligting op grond van die ontleding van Natis-verslae op om die inspektoraat tydens inspeksie te ondersteun. Analiseer inspektoraatverslae oor die implementering van aanbevelings. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die afdeling. Verskaf die nodige leiding en toesig aan ondergeskiktes. Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes. Monitor bates en stasiebestuur. Bestuur die administrasie van verlof in die afdeling. Verskaf insette by die opstel van die strategiese en jaarverslae van die Direktoraat. Verskaf insette by die ontwikkeling van projekteplanne, administrasie- en bestuursverslae. Verseker indiening van prestasieooreenkomste, halfjaarlikse hersienings en jaarlikse assesserings van ondergeskiktes. Verseker nakoming van alle tersaaklike openbare diens voorskrifte en beleide. Verskaf sekretariële dienste tydens byeenkomste rakende Bestuursstandaarde.

zu.title: Umncedisi weNkosi: Izindinganiso Zezilayisensi Zokushayela
zu.summary: Indima yenkombiwekazi ehlola izindinganiso zokuhlola izilayisensi zokushayela nokuhlola abahloli ezikhungweni zamalayisensi ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaNQF Level 6 njengoba zithathwa ngabu-SAQA kwi-Road Traffic Management/ Traffic Management kanye no-Municipal Police/Licensing Practice/ Monitoring and Evaluation/ Transport and Logistics Management/ Public and Logistics Management/Public Management. Isitifikedi: Umhloli we-Grade A wezilayisensi zokushayela. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-NRTA-National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, i-NATIS-National Traffic Information System, ulwazi nge-Government Gazette no 28446 yosuku 7 April 2006, Ukuxhumana/kubhaliwe, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulwazi nge-PFMA, kanye ne-Treasury Regulations and Instructions, ulwazi nge-Travel Policy yesiNyango, ukuqonda imithetho kahulumeni kanye namakhono okubhala izibali nokuqonda ekuqhathaniseni.
zu.duties: Hlola izindinganiso futhi uhlole abahloli bezilayisensi zokushayela ezikhungweni zamalayisensi zokushayela. Hlola izinto zokwakha ukuze zihambisane nezidingo ezingaphansi kwe-Government Gazette kanye nokuhambisana nemizuzu yabaphathi abo bonke abahlole abanyenzekile. Hlola izindinganiso zokuhlola bonke abahloli bezilayisensi zokushayela abatholakalayo ngesikhathi sokuhlola. Luleta abameli bomphathi abahloli bezilayisensi zokushayela ngemiyalo elandelwayo uma kwenziwa izivivinyo zamalayisensi zokushayela nemalayisensi ezifundo lapho kutholakala izinkinga ngesikhathi kuhlolwa. Hlola okuthunyelwe kwesibali sokuqala sokuhlola ngemibiko etholakale esikhungweni samalayisensi okuzosayinwa ngumeli wokuphatha. Phakamisela i-MEC yezifundazwe ezihambisanayo ngemizamo elandelwayo lapho kungahambisani kwezinto zokwakha, nobungekho ulwazi kwabahloli bezilayisensi zokushayela ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuhlola nendlela etholakale ngesikhathi kuhlolwa. Luleta bonke abahlole abahlobene ngendlela okufanele ilandelwe lapho kutholakala izinkinga ngesikhathi kuhlolwa. Hlaziya imibiko yokuhlola ngokusetshenziswa okwenzekayo. Phendula yonke imibuzo mayelana namalayisensi zokushayela (ngaphakathi nasemazweni angaphandle) futhi unikeze usizo ngokufanele. Cacisa okungaqondakaliyo mayelana namalayisensi zokushayela nemibuzo ehlobene nazo. Xhumana nezakhamuzi ze-RSA esezweni elingaphandle ezifuna ukushintsha izilayisensi zokushayela eznika izwe labo. Siza i-DOT kanye namanye amaphathi eNyango ngemibuzo mayelana namalayisensi zokushayela. Lungelela imibuzo mayelana namalayisensi zokushayela ukuyiphendula kwimiphakathi, abahlole nabanomdla. Xhumana ne-DLTCs kanye namayunithi okuhlola ezesifundazweni. Lungelela imibuzo mayelana namalayisensi zokushayela ukuyiphendula kwimiphakathi, abahlole nabanomdla. Hlaziya imibiko yokuhlola ngokusetshenziswa okuphakamisiwe. Yenza iziphicotho ngemisebenzi engase ibe ngiyooboshwa esikhungweni sokuqeqesha amalayisensi okushayela. Hlola izenzo ezingezandlela ngokomthetho (NRTA). Yenza isiphicotho. Xhumana ngesikhathi esifanele namahlehlango womthetho ahlukene. Nikeza ubufakazi ngesikhathi kubanjwe izinkululeko zomthetho kanye nasenkantolo. Yenza isixhoxho samaNaTIS reports. Hlaziya imibiko yeNatis ngemisebenzi yamalayisensi okushayela kwi-DLTC ngasenyunivesi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi onke ama-DLTC asebenzayo ahlelwe ukuholwa. Hlaziya abahloli bezilayisensi zokushayela ahlotshanisiwe nama-DLTC kanye nokusetshenziswa kwesikhathi sabahloli. Lungelela ulwazi olusukela kulwazi lweNatis ukweseka abahloli ngesikhathi bahlola. Hlaziya imibiko yokuhlola ngokusetshenziswa okuphakamisiwe. Phatha izinsiza zesigaba. Nikeza inhlaya nezikhombo kwabahle. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nentuthuko yabahle. Hlola ukuphathwa kwempahla nezimpahla zokubhala. Phatha ukuphathwa kweholo kulesigaba. Faka isandla ekwakheni imibiko yokuqamba kanye neminyuzo yonyaka kwezinto ezenziwayo. Faka isandla ekuthuthukiseni amapulani amaphrojekthi, imiphatho nemibiko yokuphatha. Qinisekisa ukuthumela izivumelana ngemisebenzi, ukubuka okwenziwa eminyakeni yonke kanye nokuqashwa kwabahle. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nayonke imithetho namapholisi ohulumeni abalulekile. Nikeza amakhono ohlelo ngesikhathi kwibhali izinkomfa ezihlobene nezindinganiso zokushayela.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Amalungiselelo eelayisensi zokuQhuba
xh.summary: Indima yoMncedisi woMlawuli yokuhlola amalungiselelo okuvavanya iilayisensi zokuqhuba nokuqwalasela abavavanyi kwiziko leelayisensi ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Ifomali ngeNqanaba le-6 lase-NQF njengokuqatywa yi-SAQA kwi-Road Traffic Management/ Traffic Management and Municipal Police/Licensing Practice/ Monitoring and Evaluation/ Transport and Logistics Management/ Public and Logistics Management/Public Management. Isatifikethi: Umvavanyi we-Grade A wamalayisensi okuqhuba. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ulwazi nge-NRTA-National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, i-NATIS-National Traffic Information System, ulwazi nge-Government Gazette no 28446 yomhla 7 April 2006, Unxibelelwano/ okubhaliweyo, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulwazi nge-PFMA, nge-Treasury Regulations and Instructions, ulwazi ngeNkqubo yokuHamba kwisebe, ukuqonda imigaqo kurhulumente nokuBhala iingxelo nokuThetha-thetha.
xh.duties: Kuhlola amalungiselelo kuqwalaselwe abavavanyi belayisensi zokuqhuba kumaziko eelayisensi zokuqhuba. Kuqwalaselwa iziseko zokuvumelana nemfuno encinane kwi-Government Gazette nokuvisisana nemigaqo yolawulo ngabo bonke abanxulumene nayo. Kuqwalaselwa amalungiselelo okuvavanya bonke abavavanyi abafumanekayo belayisensi zokuqhuba ngelixa lokuhlola. Kunikelwa isalathiso kumelwe bobuphathi abavavanyi belayisensi zokuqhuba malunga nemigaqo elungileyo yokusetyenziswa xa kusetyenziswa kuvavanyo lwelayisensi yomfundi nelayisensi yokuqhuba apho kubonakala iziphene ngelixa kusenziwa uqwalaselo. Kwenziwa iingxelo zokuqaliswa zokuqwalasela ngeziphumo ezifunyenwe ngelixa lokuhlola kwi-DLTCs eza kutyikitywa ngumelwe wobuphathi. Kunconywa ku-MEC wePhondo ezithintekayo malunga nezenzo eziza kuthathwa apho kungekho visiswano kweziseko, nangongenelo kubavavanyi belayisensi zokuqhuba okwenza imisebenzi yokuvavanya nemigaqo efunyenwe ngelixa lokuhlola. Kunikelwa isalathiso kuwo onke abanxulumene nayo malunga nemigaqo elungileyo ekufuneka ilandelwe apho kubonakala iziphene ngelixa lokuhlola. Kucocwa iingxelo zokuqwalasela ngokuqaliswa kweenkonzo. Kunikelwa ingxaki zayo onke iilayisensi zokuqhuba (ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwelilize) kunye nencedo ngokwemfuno. Kucaciswa ukungaqondi malunga nayo yonke imiba ezinxulumene nelayisensi yokuqhuba kwaye okanye iingxaki. Unxibelelwano nabathi bebengawo abantu base-RSA abasekunye namazwe bafuna ukutshintsha iilayisensi zabo zokuqhuba zaseMzantsi Afrika ezinikiwe elawulweni lwelabo. Kuncedwa i-DOT kwanabasebenzi balawulo abanye ngemiba ezinxulumene nelayisensi yokuqhuba. Kulungishwa iileta zempendulo ezinxulumene nelayisensi yokuqhuba kummandla wesixhotyhiswa kwilungu esinomdla, kwabanxulumene nayo nakulawula. Unxibelelwano ne-DLTCs namanqanaba olawulo wePhondo. Kulungishwa iileta zempendulo ezinxulumene nelayisensi yokuqhuba kummandla wesixhotyhiswa kwilungu esinomdwa, kwabanxulumene nayo nakulawula. Kucocwa iingxelo zokuqwalasela ngokuqaliswa kweenkonzo. Kwenziwa uphando oluqalelwesiyo malunga nezenzo ezibonakalisa ukukhohlakala kumaziko okuvavanya iilayisensi zokuqhuba. Kubonwa imigaqo engalunganga ngokomthetho we-NRTA. Kwenziwa uphando oluqalelwesiyo. Kunxibelelwano ngexesha elifanelekileyo namagunyazwe womthetho ahlukene. Kunikelwa ubungqina ngelixa lokuva okanye kwiinkqubo zesikhundla esenziwayo. Kusenziwa uhlalutyo lweengxelo ze-NaTIS. Kucocwa iingxelo zenkqubo ye-Natis ngokutshintshiselwana kweelayisensi zokuqhuba nge-DLTC nganye ngesiqonga senkcukacha ngqo kwindalo ekunye ukuyisebenzisa. Kucocwa iingxelo zokuqwalasela ngokuqaliswa kweenkonzo. Kulawulwa izixhobo zesebe. Kunikelwa isikhokelo esibalulekileyo nolawulo abangaphansi kwakhe. Kuqinisekiswa uqeqesho nophuhliso abangaphansi kwakhe. Kugqotywa ulawulo lwezixa zemali zengwenxa kwisebe. Kumenzelelwa inkqubo yamakhevesimba kwisebe. Kuqaliswa konke nasekudwe ngesicwangciso ngeeminyaka nemibiko yonyaka woM-lawuli. Kuqaliswa konke ekubakhiweni kwezicwangciso zemisebenzi, ekulawulweni nasekubungamele nasekubhaleni iingxelo zeenkonzo ezilawulwa. Kuqinisekiswa ukwethiswa kwezivumelwano zenkqubo, iingxelo ezithi ngamnyaka ezenza iinkcukacha ngeenkqubo ngokuphindaphindwe kabini ngamnyaka kunye nokuqwalasela kwabangaphantsi. Kuqinisekiswa isivumelwano ngayo yonke imigaqo nezicwangciso zorhulumente. Kuqinisekiswa imigaqo yomthetho yorhulumente nokwamkelwa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo nangamanye amaxwebhu ezisettyenziselwa imisebenzi ye-Directorate nokuqinisekiswa kweempawu zangaphantsi. Kusetyenziswa amaceba ebhodi ngelixa lokuva amaxwebhu eelayisensi ezidlulwa kubakho uphando olwenziwa ngexesha le-Directorate njengoko kuchazwe kumaxwebhu eelayisensi zokuqhuba nangezinye iinkqubo ezingahoywa ngelixa kusetyenziswa i-NaTIS.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Internal Control & Compliance
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role at National Treasury in Pretoria overseeing internal control, compliance, and audit coordination, requiring a diploma or degree with four years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) or Bachelor's degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Financial Management, Accounting, Auditing, Internal Control, Public Finance. A minimum of four years' relevant experience, of which at least two years must be at Assistant Director level or equivalent, in an accounting, auditing, internal control, compliance or financial-governance environment. Knowledge and experience in Public Finance Management Act, Public-sector accounting and financial reporting requirements, Internal control, compliance monitoring, risk assessment and audit coordination, Assessment and reporting of unauthorised, irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure and departmental losses, Interpretation of financial statements, policies, delegations and audit findings, Supervisory, report-writing, presentation and stakeholder- management experience.
jobs.duties: Audit and assurance coordination: Coordinate the annual external audit and relevant internal assurance processes, including planning, requests for information, management responses, technical engagements and the submission of supporting evidence. Maintain audit request, finding and action- plan registers; follow up outstanding information and monitor the implementation and closure of agreed corrective actions. Review draft audit findings, management reports and audit reports; facilitate engagements with assurance providers and affected business units; and escalate significant unresolved matters. Financial reporting oversight and technical assurance: Coordinate and quality-assure the preparation, review, adjustment and submission of interim and annual financial statements in accordance with the applicable public-sector reporting framework. Review financial information and supporting evidence for completeness, accuracy and compliance; coordinate the resolution of reporting queries and provide technical advice on accounting and disclosure matters. Non-compliant expenditure and loss control: Oversee the identification, assessment, determination, recording and reporting of unauthorised, irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure, including maintenance of relevant registers and audit trails. Oversee departmental loss cases, liability assessments, recoveries, write-offs and referrals for financial recovery, disciplinary action, criminal or forensic investigation and control improvement, where applicable. Internal control, governance, policy and advisory services: Plan and oversee risk-based reviews of financial management, procurement, contract management and related processes to identify non-compliance, control weaknesses and emerging risks. Assess the design and operation of preventative, detective and corrective controls; communicate findings and recommendations; and monitor implementation by responsible business units. Advise the Chief Financial Officer and management on internal control, financial governance, delegations, compliance, audit, financial reporting and the interpretation of applicable prescripts. Support reporting to executive and governance structures by consolidating finance and control information, monitoring matters arising and tracking agreed actions. Develop, review and maintain financial policies, procedures, delegations, control frameworks, registers and standard operating procedures, and monitor adherence to approved requirements. Coordinate consultation, approval, communication and implementation of policies and controls, and provide awareness sessions, guidance and technical support to stakeholders. Systems, records, stakeholder and unit management: Oversee governance of transversal financial systems, including user access, segregation of duties, entity maintenance, budget-manager appointments, exception reporting and supporting documentation. Ensure that financial, audit and compliance records are complete, safeguarded, accessible and maintained in accordance with applicable record-management and audit-trail requirements. Manage stakeholder queries, turnaround times, escalations and resolution trends, and maintain effective working relationships with assurance providers and relevant internal and external stakeholders. Develop operational plans, allocate and quality-assure work, manage staff performance and development, monitor delivery against targets, and manage the resources and business-continuity requirements of the unit.
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on        https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short- listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. NOTE: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. Kindly note that all National Treasury adverts published/LIVE on the eRecruitment System have a closing date listed and closing time of 12h00 (Midday) on that closing date. The system is designed to automatically remove the advert from public view at exactly 12h00 (Midday) of the said closing date for that post. There are no other means to submit applications post the closing date and time, if you have missed or delayed in submitting on time. OTHER POSTS

zu.title: Deputy Director: Internal Control & Compliance
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika Deputy Director e National Treasury e Pretoria esibhekele ukulawula okungaphakathi, ukuhambisana nomthetho, nokuqinisa ukuhlanganiswa kokuhlola, esidinga diploma noma iziqu eminyakeni emine yesipiliyoni esifanele.
zu.requirements: Ifunikwa isitifiketi seGrade 12 esihambisanana nediploma yezwe (elinganiswa ngegciwane le-NQF level 6) noma iziqu zeBachelor's (elinganiswa ngegciwane le-NQF level 7) ekuPhathweni Kwezimali, ekuBhalweni kwamakhadi, ekuHlolweni, ekuLawulweni Okungaphakathi, noma ezezimali Zomphakathi. Kutholwa ubuniningi beminyaka emine yesipiliyoni, okuhlanganisa ukuthi okungenani iminyaka emi-2 kumele kubengongazinga likaAssistant Director noma okulingana nayo, emkhakheni wezimali, ukuhlola, ukulawula okungaphakathi, ukuhambisana nomthetho noma imithetho yokuphathwa kwezimali emmangweni. Kutholwa ukuqonda kanye nesipiliyoni emthethweni wokuPhathwa Kwezimali Kahulumeni, ekuBhalweni kwezimali kahulumeni nasezidingweni zokubika ngemali, ekuLawulweni okungaphakathi, ukuqapha ukuhambisana nomthetho, ukuhlolwa komngozi nasekuHlelweni kokuqinisa, ekuHlolweni nasekuBikeni mayelana nemali engavunyelwe, engahambisana nomthetho, engazuzuziyo neyayiveza imali engayidingekile nasekuwohlokeni kwezimali komnyango, ekuHumusheni imibiko yemali, izinqubomgomo, izimvume nokutholakala okuyisizinga, kanye nesipiliyoni sokuphatha, ukubhala imibiko, ukubamba izinkulumo nokuphatha abahlobene nedividendi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganiswa kokuqinisa nokuhlolwa: Hlela ukuqiniswa kwangaphandle kwonyaka kanye namasu okuqinisa angaphakathi ahlobene, okuhlanganisa ukuletha izidingo, ukucela ulwazi, impendulo yabaphathi, ukuhlanganyela kwezobuchwepheshe nokuhambisana izibonakaliso ezisekelayo. Londoloza ukubhaliswa kwezinto eziyisidingo zokuhlola, izinkinga eziyitholakalayo kanye neziyisidingo zokuqinisa; gijima ulwazi olungakafakiwe bese ulawula ukusetshenziswa nokugcinwa kwezinyathelo ezamukelekwe zokulungisa. Buka kabusha okutholakalile ngokuhlola izinkinga, imibiko yabaphathi kanye nemibiko yokuhlola; lenyuse izinkinga ezinkulu ezingaxazululanga. Ukuqondiswa okuphelele kokubika ngemali kanye nokuqiniswa kobuchwepheshe: Hlela futhi uqinise amandla okulungiselela, ukuhlola, ukulungisa nokuhambisana imibiko yemali yesikhathi phakathi kanye naleyomnyaka ohambisana nomqulu wokubika ngemali wommandla kahulumeni. Pheqa ulwazi ngemali kanye nezibonakaliso ezisekelayo ukuze qinisekiswe ukuthi kuqediwe, kuqinisekile futhi kuhambisana nemithetho; hlela ukuxazulula imibuzo yokubika bese unika izeluleko zobuchwepheshe mayelana namayithi enani nemali kanye nokuvulwa kolwazi. Ukulawula imali engashwayekiwe yokuhayiza nenkontileka, ukuhola izimfanelo, ukwenza kudalwe amacala ekuwohlokeni komnyango, amacala okuyilahleko, ukuhlolwa kwemithwalo, ukubuyisa imali, ukukhipha emalini, ukulethwa kwezindaba zobuciko bokubuyisa imali, izinyathelo zokuqediswa inqubo, ukuphenya ubugebengu noma imibhalo, kanye nokuhlanganisa ngobuchwepheshe, uma kunesidingo. Ukuqiniswa kokuqondisa, ukubuyiselwa kolwazi nemibono, kanye namaphoyisa ashiwo ngaphambilini, ukuqinisekiswa, kanye nokuqinisa imali ebhalwe emibukweni, kokuphothulwa okugcwele kokuhlelwa kwemibiko yemali, imibhalo yokubika mayelana nobuphofu bokubika ngemali ihlanganisa nezinye izinhlelo zokuphothula imali evela kumnyango, ukulungiswa kwemithelela yehlazo, kanye nokwenza izinsimbi emgodini, nenhlelo yokubika ngemali ngayinye. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, yila, uhlolo, bese ulondoloza amaphoyisa ezezimali, inqubo, izinhlelo zokwabelana amandla, izinhlelo zokuqinisa, izibalo ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nekhodi ehlelekile yokwenza, futhi uqaphe ukuthi izidingo ezivunyiwe zilandelwa kanjani. Hlanganisa, mayelana nokuqinisa imali, ukwamukelwa, ukuthunyelwa komyalezo kanye nokwenziwa kwezinyathelo, nokunika izinkulumo ezibuyisa ulwazi, umhlahlandlela kanye nokweseka ngobuchwepheshe abahlobene nalolu daba. Amaphoyisa aqondene nokuphathwa kwenhlangano abahlinzeki, ukuphathwa kwamaphaphu, izibalo, ulwazi kanye nokulawulwa kwegatsha: Hlela ukuphathwa kwezinsimbi ezingeni eliphezulu ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, ukulawula imvume yokuphuma kokwamukelwa kwemali, ihlazo elingekho emthethweni, ukuwohloka kwezinsimbi, ukuxazulula izinkinga ezenzeka ngokungahlosile, ukubika ngokungalungile nokuhlehlisa okungalungile, nokusekela imibhalo enesibonakaliso. Qinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo yemali, yokuhlolwa nokuqinisa igcwele, iphathwa ngokuphepha kway idonswa ngokuzayo ngaphakathi kwamaphoyisa, nokulawula ukubhaliswa kwezimali noma ukubhala izinkomba mayelana nokubika ngokweqiniso. Mayelana nesikhundla, lungiselela bese uhlinzeka ngohlelo lokuhlela imisebenzi yonkana, kwesobuchwepheshe nabahlinzeki bokuhlela izinto ezithintekayo. Sika isikhathi ngaphakathi, sabakho bese uhumusha amaphoyisa abhangayo nabasebenza ngaphandle, bese ulawula, mayelana nokubika, ukubika kwemali, ukuxhumana kwezomthetho nokuqiniswa, kanye nokuba nendima ekulawuleni imisebenzi, ukuthola abantu, ukuphathwa komphakathi, ukusebenza ngokupheleleyo kwemikhiqizo namaphoyisa aphathwayo. Qhuba ukubonisana mayelana nokuqiniswa kwemisebenzi yokulawula imali, izingadi zokuthenga, ukuphathwa kwenkontileka nezinye izinhlela ezihlobene ukuze kubonakale ukungahambisani nomthetho, ukuwohloka kokulawula kanye nobungozi ekuqhubekayo. Buka ukulethwa nokusebenza kwezilawuli ezingena ngaphambilini, ezingaboni nalokubuyisa okulungile; lokhu kuthumela izincazelo mayelana nokulawula, nezithakazelo ezingangeni ngemvume yokungangena kumsebenzi ongaziwa, bese ulawula izenzo mayelana nokubekiwe kumaphoyisa amakhulu anenzuzo. Nikeza ngeluleko iNkosi yaseNyakatho neNkosi yamaphoyisa ukubika ngokubekiwe, ukubikiwe kwemali, ukubika ngomthetho, nokubika ngamaphoyisa ashiwo ngaphambilini, nokubika ngokuxhumana nokubika ngokubekwa ngemigomo yamaphoyisa ashiwo ngaphambilini. Sekela ukubika mayelana nezinhlangano ezimphatho kubhalwe emaphoyiseni, ukubhaliswa ngemali, nokuqinisa, kanye nokubhaka izenzo eziqediwe.

xh.title: IGosa eliPhambili: Ulawulo Langaphakathi nokuZithobela
xh.summary: Isithuba segosa eliphambili kwiNational Treasury ePretoria elibukeza ulawulo langaphakathi, ukuzithobela, nokuhlola ngokubambisana, sidinga idiploma okanye isidanga kwaye neminyaka emi-4 yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi seGrade 12 ekwayinyani kunye neNational Diploma (elingangomgangatho weNQF level 6) okanye isidanga seBachelor's (elingangomgangatho weNQF level 7) kwiFinancial Management, Accounting, Auditing, Internal Control, Public Finance. Kufuneka kubekho iminyaka emi-4 ubuncinane yamava ahambelanayo, apho iminyaka engaphezulu kwe-2 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba likaAssistant Director okanye elinganayo, kwindawo ye-akhawuntingi, ohlolyo, ulawulo langaphakathi, ukuzithobela okanye ulawulo lweemali. Ulwazi namava kuPublic Finance Management Act, kwiimfuno zekhawunti yommandla womphakathi nokubika kwemali, ulawulo langaphakathi, ukujonga ukuzithobela, inkqubo yokulinganisa ingozi nokubambisana koluhlolo, ukulinganisa nokubika ngemali engavunyelwanga, engaqeqeshanga, engazuzisa nento edluleka iyonke kunye nokulahleko kwisebe, inxulumaniso lwezitatimende zemali, iinkqubo, izabelo nokutsholwa koluhlolo, ulawulo, ukubhala iingxelo, izentlalo kunye namava ekulawuleni abahlobo.
xh.duties: Ukubambisana koluhlolo nokuqinisekisa: Lungisa uhlolo lwangaphandle olwenziwa ngonyaka nezinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ngaphakathi ezihambelanayo, kuquka uqweqwe, iimfuno zolwazi, iimpendulo zolawulo, iintlangano zobugcisa kunye nokuhambisa izibizo ezigxilayo. Gcina iimfuno zohlolo, izifundo ezifunyenweyo kunye namagama oqweqwe lomsebenzi ongafezekiswanga; landela ulwazi olungaluselelanga kwaye uqonde ukusebenza nokubetha imiba emayelene nemisebenzi ekuvunyelwe ukuba ilungiswe. Phengula iingxelo ezingathandabuzekiyo zohlolo, iingxelo zolawulo kunye neengxelo zohlolo; yenza iintlangano nabahanjiswa boluhlolo namaqela abantu abashukumiswayo; kwaye ukhuphe izigqibo kwimiba ebalulekileyo engaziswa sisiphelo. Ukukhanya ngokubika kwemali nokuqinisekisa ngobugcisa: Lungisa kwaye uqinisekise ukulungiselelwa, ukuqondisisa, ukulungiswa nokuhambiswa kwezitatimende zemali ezingaphakathi nezangonyaka ngokwesakhiwo sokubika sommandla womphakathi esisebenzayo. Phengula ulwazi lwemali nezibizo ezigxilayo zokuqinisa ukuzalisekiswa, ukuchaneka nokuzithobela; lungisa ukusombulula iimbuzo zokubika kwaye unikeze izigqibo zobugcisa ngemayelana ne-akhawuntingi nokuvezwa kweenkcukacha. Ulawulo lwemali engahambelaniyo nokulawula ukulahleka: Bukela ikuqondwa, ukulinganiswa, ukumiswa, ukubhalwa nokubikwa kwemali engavunyelwanga, engaqeqeshanga, engazuzisa iyonke edluleka, kuquka nokugcina amagama oqweqwe ahambelanayo namagama oqweqwe. Bukela iimeko zokulahleka kwisebe, ukulinganisa ixtaxheba, iziqebelano, ukubhalwa njengonilelayo kunye nokuthumela ukusetyenziswa kwindlela yokuziqhelanisa yemali, izigqibo ezingajoliswanga kwindlela ekuthintelwa yona, ucandelo loluvi okanye ovi olubhaqabhaka kwaye kusandulwe kukuba kukho ukusandula kolawulo, apho kufanelekileyo. Ulawulo langaphakathi, urhulumente, iinkqubo kwaye onike izigqibo kubantu: Cwangcisa kwaye ubuke iinkqubo ezijoliswe kwingozi zolawulo lwemali, ezokuthenga, ulawulo lweenkonzo ezidityaniswe kwindawo ethile kunye namaxesha ezinkqubo ezinxulumene nazo ukumisela ezingahambelaniyo, amandla angaphakathi angakulungeanga kwinkqubo nasingozi ezisanda zivela. Linganisa inkqubo nendlela abasebenzisa ngayo iindlela ezithintela umlingiswa, ezibhaqa nobubi ezilungisa imiba; yaziisa iimfuno ezifunyenweyo kunye neengxelo eziphakamiswayo; kwaye uqonde ukusebenza ngawo ngamaqela abantu abashukumisayo abanobumdla. Nikela izigqibo kuChief Financial Officer nakulawulo malunga nolawulo langaphakathi, urhulumente wemali, izabelo, ukuzithobela, uhlolo, ukubikwa kwemali nokuqondisisa iinkqubo ezisebenzayo. Xhasa ukubikwa kumagunya karhulumente kunye namagunya okulawula ngokudibanisa ulwazi ngemali nolawulo, ukulandelela imiba ezivelayo nokulandelela izigqibo ezivunyelwe. Yenza, phengula kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zemali, iindlela zokusebenza, izabelo, iinkqubo zolawulo, amagama oqweqwe kwaye nezindlela ezingatshatyalaliswa ezikumgangatho osezantsi, kwaye ujonge ukuzigcina kwezinye izigqibo ezigqityiweyo. Lungisa ukubonisisana, ukuvunyelwa, ukuvakalashwa nokusebenza kweenkqubo nolawulo, kwaye unike iindlela zolwazi, isikhokelo nokuxhaswa kobugcisa kwabanomdla. Iinkqubo, iirekhodi, abanomdla nolawulo lwesiqemo: Bukela urhulumente wamandla amaninzi eenkqubo zommandla wolawulo lwemali, kuquka ukungena kwabasebenzisi, ukwahlulelana kwemisebenzi, ukugcina iinkonzo ezithintela imiba, ukumiswa kweentsapho zolawulo, iingxelo ezingaze zibe khona nokuvela kolwazi oluxhaswayo. Qinisekisa ukuba iirekhodi zemali, zohlolo nezokuzithobela zigqityiwe, zikhuselekile, zifikeleleka kwaye zigcinwe ngokwemfuno yomthetho we-akhawuntingi nokuvela kolwazi oluxhaswayo. Lawula iimbuzo yabathintekayo, iintsuku ezingamaqondo phambili, ukuzisela izigqibo kumagunya kunye nokusuka izigqibo ukuya kwizinto ezingabakho, kwaye gcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabanikwa inqaba yoluhlolo kwaye kwabathintekayo bangaphakathi nangaphandle abanomdla. Yiza neenkqubo ezingamathandabuzo kumsebenzi wemini, misela kwaye uqinisekise umsebenzi, lawula imisebenzi eyinkqubo abantu kwaye ekwakhayo ukuqonda, bukela ukwaneliseka ngokumgama oqondiweyo, kwaye ulawule amandla neenkqubo ezibambe iqhaza ekubeni kusasazwa koluntu lwesebe.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Facilities Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Facilities Management at National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma and four years of experience with a salary of R932292 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A grade 12 is required coupled with National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6). A qualification equivalent to NQF level 7 in Facilities Management, Property Management, the Built Environment, Public Administration, Construction or Engineering or Quantity Surveying, Project Management or a related field will be an added advantage. A minimum 4 years’ experience of which 2 years should be on an Assistant Director level or equivalent in facilities, property, building maintenance or infrastructure and project management. Demonstrated responsibility for supervising staff and managing technical service providers, contracts, budgets and complex accommodation, maintenance or refurbishment projects. Experience in planned maintenance, property and accommodation management, SLA performance and digital facilities systems.
jobs.duties: Technical Facilities and Asset Lifecycle Management: Develop integrated preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance plans for building fabric and critical systems, including HVAC, electrical supply, standby power, lifts, fire systems, water and plumbing. Maintain accurate asset registers, condition assessments, lifecycle and replacement plans, maintenance schedules, service histories, warranties and statutory certificates. Monitor work orders, plant availability, energy and water performance, recurring defects and root causes through CAFM/IWMS, BMS, IoT sensors and other approved digital platforms. Coordinate inspections, emergency repairs, commissioning, snagging and close-out, and verify that defects are resolved without compromising safety or business continuity. Property and Accommodation Management: Conduct accommodation needs, space-utilisation and property- condition assessments and compile property and accommodation plans aligned with approved business requirements. Manage the technical performance of leased and state-owned accommodation, including landlord and DPWI liaison, occupancy, utilities and municipal services. Provide technical inputs into leases and renewals and monitor property obligations, compliance certificates, handover, relocation and exit requirements. Monitor occupancy, building condition, recurring defects and remedial actions and escalate unresolved landlord or custodian obligations. Capital Projects, Fit- outs and Relocations: Scope and manage fit-outs, refurbishments, relocations and facilities projects from feasibility and planning through execution, commissioning, handover and close-out. Develop technical requirements, cost estimates, implementation schedules, risk controls and procurement inputs in consultation with relevant stakeholders. Coordinate consultants and contractors, verify workmanship and quality, and manage commissioning, snagging, as-built information and O&M documentation. Monitor delivery against time, cost, quality and safety requirements; control variations and escalate blocked decisions or material deviations. Contract, SLA and Financial Management: Develop clear technical specifications, scopes of work, service levels and performance indicators and support compliant procurement processes with SCM and Legal. Manage mobilisation and service-provider performance, verify deliverables, address under-performance, variations and disputes, and implement corrective action. Plan and monitor allocated budgets, commitments, forecasts and expenditure; assess cost drivers and value for money and report financial or service-continuity risks. Certify completed work and valid invoices against contractual evidence, support payment within prescribed periods, and monitor contract expiry, renewal and transition. Governance, Risk, Digital Systems and Stakeholder Leadership: Ensure compliance with GIAMA, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, OHS, building and fire requirements and applicable procurement prescripts. Maintain facilities risk registers, audit and compliance evidence, continuity and emergency plans, and close findings and corrective actions. Lead work-order governance and use CAFM/IWMS, BMS, IoT monitoring, dashboards and trend analysis to automate controls and improve performance. Lead staff and coordinate Finance, SCM, Legal, ICT, Security, DPWI, landlords, service providers and clients, with timely management and executive reporting.
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on        https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short- listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. NOTE: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. Kindly note that all National Treasury adverts published/LIVE on the eRecruitment System have a closing date listed and closing time of 12h00 (Midday) on that closing date. The system is designed to automatically remove the advert from public view at exactly 12h00 (Midday) of the said closing date for that post. There are no other means to submit applications post the closing date and time, if you have missed or delayed in submitting on time. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Fasiliteitebestuur
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Fasiliteitebestuur by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma en vier jaar se ervaring vereis met 'n salaris van R932292 per annum.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n Nasionale Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 6). 'n Kwalifikasie gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 7 in Fasiliteitebestuur, Eiendomsbestuur, die Bou-omgewing, Openbare Administrasie, Konstruksie of Ingenieurswese of Hoeveelheidsopmeting, Projekbestuur of 'n verwante veld sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring waarvan 2 jaar op 'n Assistent-direkteur vlak of gelykstaande in fasiliteite, eiendom, gebouonderhoud of infrastruktuur en projekbestuur moet wees. Getoonde verantwoordelikheid vir die toesig van personeel en die bestuur van tegniese diensverskaffers, kontrakte, begrotings en komplekse akkommodasie-, onderhouds- of opknappingsprojekte. Ervaring in beplande onderhoud, eiendom- en akkommodasiebestuur, SLA-prestasie en digitale fasiliteite-stelsels.
af.duties: Tegniese Fasiliteite- en Batelewensiklusbestuur: Ontwikkel geïntegreerde preventiewe, voorspellende en korrigerende onderhoudsplanne vir geboustrukture en kritieke stelsels, insluitend HVAC, kragtoevoer, noodkrag, hyser, brandstelsels, water en loodgieterswerk. Onderhou akkurate bateregisters, toestandevaluerings, lewensiklus- en vervangingsplanne, onderhoudskedules, diensgeskiedenisse, waarborge en statutêre sertifikate. Monitor werkbevele, aanlegbeskikbaarheid, energie- en waterprestasie, terugkerende defekte en oorsake deur CAFM/IWMS, BMS, IoT-sensors en ander goedgekeurde digitale platforms. Koördineer inspeksies, noodherstel, inbedryfstelling, foutlyste en afsluiting, en verifieer dat defekte opgelos word sonder om veiligheid of besigheidskontinuïteit in gevaar te stel. Eiendom- en Akkommodasiebestuur: Voer akkommodasiebehoeftes, ruimtebenutting en eiendomtoestandevaluerings uit en stel eiendom- en akkommodasieplanne op in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde besigheidsvereistes. Bestuur die tegniese prestasie van gehuurde en staatsbesit-akkommodasie, insluitend verhuurder- en DPWI-skakeling, bewoning, nutsdienste en munisipale dienste. Verskaf tegniese insette vir huurkontrakte en hernuwings en monitor eiendomsverpligtinge, nakomingsertifikate, oorhandiging, hervestiging en uittrekkingsvereistes. Monitor bewoning, geboutoestand, terugkerende defekte en regstellende maatreëls en eskaleer onopgeloste verhuurder- of bewaarderverpligtinge. Kapitale Projekte, Inrigting en Hervestiging: Bepaal en bestuur inrigtings, opknappings, hervestigings en fasiliteiteprojekte van haalbaarheid en beplanning deur uitvoering, inbedryfstelling, oorhandiging en afsluiting. Ontwikkel tegniese vereistes, kosteskattings, implementeringskedules, risikokontroles en verkrygingsinsette in oorleg met tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Koördineer konsultante en kontrakteurs, verifieer vakmanskap en gehalte, en bestuur inbedryfstelling, foutlyste, as-built-inligting en O&M-dokumentasie. Monitor lewering teenoor tyd-, koste-, gehalte- en veiligheidsvereistes; beheer variasies en eskaleer geblokkeerde besluite of materiaalafwykings. Kontrak-, SLA- en Finansiële Bestuur: Ontwikkel duidelike tegniese spesifikasies, werkverbande, diensvlakke en prestasie-aanwysers en ondersteun nakomingsverkrygingsprosesse met SCM en Regte. Bestuur mobilisering en diensverskafferprestasie, verifieer lewerings, hanteer onderprestasie, variasies en dispute, en implementeer regstellende maatreëls. Beplan en monitor toegekende begrotings, verbintenis, vooruitskattings en besteding; assesser kostedrywers en waarde vir geld en rapporteer finansiële of dienskontinuïteitsrisiko's. Sertifiseer voltooide werk en geldige fakture teen kontrakgetuienis, ondersteun betaling binne voorgeskrewe periodes, en monitor kontrakverval, hernuwing en oorgang. Bestuur, Risiko, Digitale Stelsels en Belanghebbendeleierskap: Verseker nakoming van GIAMA, PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, OHS, gebou- en brandvereistes en toepaslike verkrygingsvoorskrifte. Onderhou fasiliteite-risikoregisters, oudit- en nakomingsgetuienis, kontinuïteits- en noodplanne, en sluit bevindings en regstellende maatreëls af. Lei werkbevelbestuur en gebruik CAFM/IWMS, BMS, IoT-monitering, kontroleskerm en neigingsanalise om kontroles outomaties te maak en prestasie te verbeter. Lei personeel en koördineer Finansies, SCM, Regte, ICT, Sekuriteit, DPWI, verhuurders, diensverskaffers en kliënte, met tydige bestuurs- en uitvoerende verslagdoening.

zu.title: Isiphathi Sithulu: Ukuphatwa Kwezinsiza
zu.summary: Isiphathi Sithulu Sokuphatwa Kwezinsiza e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, esidinga i-National Diploma neminyaka emine yohlelo ngeholo le-R932292 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibe ne-grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma (elingana nenqanaba le-NQF level 6). Ithifikethi elingana nenqanaba le-NQF level 7 kwi-Facilities Management, Property Management, the Built Environment, Public Administration, Construction noma Engineering noma Quantity Surveying, Project Management noma olimini oluhlobene nalo lizoba yinzuzo ephethwe yiqiniso. Kudingeka abe nolwazi oluncane lweminyaka emine lapho kweminyaka emi-2 kufanele kube ngazinga lakwa-Assistant Director noma okulingana nalo ezinsizeni, izindlu, ukulungiswa kwezakhiwo noma ezokwakhiwa kanye nokuphatwa kwezinhlelo. Kumele abe nobufakazi bokuba ube nezibopho zokulawula abasebenzi nokuqasha abanikezeli ngezinsimboni, izinkontileka, amabhajethi kanye nezinhlelo eziphikisana nazo zokwakhiwa, ukulungiswa noma ukubuyekeza izindlu. Kulingene ukuba nolwazi ekulungisweni okuhleliwe, ekuphathweni kwesindlu kanye nezinsiza, ekuhambeni kwe-SLA kanye nezinhlelo ezezikhalazo ezinkundleni zedijithi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatwa Kwezinsiza Ezesimboni Nalemisebenzi Esetshenziswa Ixesha Eside: Yakha izinhlelo ezihlangene zokulungiswa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, zokuqaphela kanye nezokulungisa izakhiwo kanye nezinhlela eziyisisekelo, okuhlanganisa i-HVAC, amandla kagesi, amandla okulondoloza, izindlula, izinhlela zomlilo, amanzi kanye nobutho. Gcina okufakiwe kwezimpahla ezingashiywa, okuqashelwe ngokwesimo, izinhlelo zokushintsha kanye nezoshintsho, igoqo lokulungiswa, umlando wenkonzo, iziqinisekiso kanye namatifikhethi okusemthethweni. Qapha imiyalo yokusebenza, ukutholakala kwezinto, ukusebenza kwamandla namanzi, iziphazamiso eziphindaphindwayo kanye nezimbangela ezenza lezi ziphazamiso nge-CAFM/IWMS, BMS, abayiziwo I-sensor kanye nezinye izinkundla zedijithi ezivunyiwe. Hlela ukubuyekeza, ukulungisa kwesimo sezimo, ukugqitshwa, ukutholwa kwezinkinga nokuphothulwa, futhi qiniseka ukuthi iziphazamiso zixazululwa ngaphandle kokubeka engozini ukuphepha noma ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Ukuphatwa Kwesindlu Kwezinsiza: Yenza ukubuyekeza kwezidingo zezindlu, ukusetshenziswa kwesikhala kanye nokuqashelwa kwezesimo sesindlu bese uhlanganisa izinhlelo zesindlu kanye nezinsiza ngokuvumelana nezidingo zebhizinisi ezivunyiwe. Phatha ukusebenza kwezobuchwepheshe kwezindlu eziqashwe noma ezimpini kanye nezenzelwe umbuso, okuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nomnikazi zendlu nabe-DPWI, abahlali, izinsiza zedijithi kanye nesevisi yomasipala. Nikeza izinketho ezisesimboni ema-lease nakunqazweni kabusha bese uqapha izibopho zesindlu, amatifikhethi okuvumelana nomthetho, ukuhamba ndawonye, ukushintsha izindawo kanye nezidingo zokuphuma. Qapha abahlali, isimo sezakhiwo, iziphazamiso eziphindaphindwayo kanye nenzuzo yokulungisa bese ukhuphula izibopho ezingaxazululwa komnikazi noma komlawuli. Amaphulo Ekhaya, Ukuhambisa Nokushintsha Izindawo: Hlela bese uphatha ukuhambiswa kwamasundu, ukulungiswa, ukushintshwa kwezindawo kanye namaphulo wezinsiza kusukela ekulingweni ukuze kuhlelwe kuqede kuhlolwe busebenza, adluliswe bese kuphothulwa. Yakha izidingo zobuchwepheshe, izilinganisela zentengo, igoqo lokuphumelelisa, izinhlelo zokulawula ubungozi kanye nezinketho zokuthenga ngokubonisana nabahlanganyelayo. Hlela abacephuli nabathengisi, qinisekisa ubuchwepheshe kanye nisimo, futhi phatha ukuqiniswa, ukutholwa kwezinkinga, ulwazi olwakhiwe kanye nomchazawokusebenza kanye no-O&M. Qapha ukufeza ngokuhambiswa kwesikhathi, entengweni, kakhwalithi nasezidingweni zokuphepha; lawula izinguquko bese ukhuphula izinqumo ezehliswayo noma izinketho ezingabambekiyo. Ukuphatwa Kwezinkontileka, I-SLA Nezezimali: Yakha izinkomba ezicacile zobuchwepheshe, imisebenzi okufanele yenziwe, izinga lesevisi kanye nabakali bokusebenza bese uxhasa inqubo yokuthenga ehambisana nomthetho kanye ne-SCM kanye neLegal. Phatha ukungena ngokusebenza nokusebenza kwabanikeli besevisi, qinisekisa okufeziwe, lungele izinkinga zokungasebenzi kahle, izinguquko kanye nezingxabano, bese uphumelelisa izinyathelo zokulungisa. Hlela bese uqapha amabhajethi ababelwe, izibopho, izibikezelo kanye nezimali ezichithiwe; hlola okushibiza kanye nenani lemali bese ubika izingozi zezimali noma zokuqhubeka kokusebenza. Qinisekisa imisebenzi eqediwe kanye namafomu okukhokha okumele abe khona ngokufanele, xhasa ukukhokhelwa phakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo, bese uqapha ukuphela kwezinkontileka, ukubuyiswa kanye noshintsho. Ukuphathwa Koluntu, Ubungozi, Izinhlela Zedijitha Nokuholwa Abahlanganyeli: Qiniseka ukuvumelana ne-GIAMA, PFMA, Izinqumo ze-Treasury, OHS, izidingo zezakhiwo kanye nomlilo kanye nezinhlelo zokuthenga ezifanelekile. Gcina izinkomba zengozi kwezinsiza, ubufakazi bokuhlolwa nokuvumelana nomthetho, izinhlelo zokuqhubeka nangaleso sikhathi kanye nezinhlelo zezimo eziphuthumayo, bese uvala izinto ezitholakele kanye nenzuzo yokulungisa. Hola imiyalo yokusebenza bese usebenzisa i-CAFM/IWMS, BMS, I-IoT monitoring, amadashibhodi kanye nokuqashela izimo ukuze ulawule izinto ngokuzenzakalela bese uthuthukisa ukusebenza. Hola abasebenzi bese uhlelana ne-Finance, SCM, Legal, ICT, Security, DPWI, abanikazi bezindlu, abanikezeli besevisi kanye nabaklayenti, nokubika ngokuphathwa okusheshayo nakubaphathi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongamaba: Ulawulo Lweziseko
xh.summary: Isekela Mongamaba wokuLawula iziSeko kwiNational Treasury ePretoria, kufuneka kubekho iNational Diploma neminyaka emine yamava ngomvuzo we-R932292 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibekho i-grade 12 ekunye neNational Diploma (elingana naniqanaba le-NQF 6). Izidanga ezilingana naniqanaba le-NQF 7 kwi-Facilities Management, Property Management, Built Environment, Public Administration, Construction okanye Engineering okanye Quantity Surveying, Project Management okanye omnye wamabala ahambelanayo kuya kuba lusizo olungangenwa lutho. Iminyaka emit (4) yamava apho kweminyaka emi-2 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lakaMongamaba oMncinci okanye elilingana nalo kulawulo lweziseko, iimpahla, ukugcinwa kweenzululwazi okanye iziseko nokulawulwa kweephrojekthi. Kubonwe urhwebo lokulawula abasebenzi nokuLawula abahanjisi beenkonzo ezobuchwepheshe, iinkontileka, amabhajeti neephrojekthi ezindzin' ezingathathi nthswi ezindaweni zokuhlala, ukulungiswa okanye ukutsha kwezinto ezikhona. Amava ekwakhiwa okulungiswa okucwangcisweyo, ukulawula iimpahla nendawo yokuhlala, ukusebenza kwe-SLA kunye neesiseko zentsimo yamandla ezedijithali.
xh.duties: Iziseko zobuChwepheshe nokulawula iNqanaba loMobo woMsebenzi wamaSiseko: Yakha iindlela ezahlonelanayo zokuthintela, zokuqikelela nokulungisa ukwakhiwa kwezinto zakuqala neziseko ezingangangathanga-hlathi, kuquka i-HVAC, amandla ombane, amandla okulunga xa kungekho, iilifti, iinkqubo zomlilo, amanzi nokuTshefwa kwamanzi. Zigcine ngokuchanekileyo iirekhodi zamacebo, ukuvavanywa kwemimeko, iindlela zokuqala nokutshintsha iintlobo zamaSiseko, iinkqubo zokwakhiwa, iimbali zeenkonzo, iigaranthi nezatifikethi ezichanekileyo ngokomthetho. Lilise iiodolo zomsebenzi, ukufumaneka kweziseko, ukusebenza kwamandla namanzi, iimpazamo eziphindaphindwayo neentloko zazo nge-CAFM/IWMS, i-BMS, i-IoT sensors nazinye iinkqubo zedijithali ezamkelekileyo. Hlela ukuvavanywa, ukulungiswa okungalindanga, ukuqalisa, ukulungisa iimpazamo kwaye uqiniseke ukuba iimpazamo zisolulwe ngaphandle kokubeka ingqondo okanye ukuphela komsebenzi kwingozi. Ulawulo Lwezimpahla nendawo yokuhlala: Yenza izifundo ezahlonelanayo ngeemfuno zendawo yokuhlala, ukusetyenziswa kwendawo nokuvavanywa kwemimeko yempahla kwaye uqokelele iindlela zokulawula iimpahla nendawo yokuhlala ngokweemfuno zoshishino ezamkelekileyo. Lawula ukusebenza ngobugcisa bendawo ethengiweyo nethengiswa ngokurhuqo, kuquka ukunxibelelana namachibi nabaDPWI, abahlali, amandla nesebe zikawonke-wonke. Nikezela iingcebiso zobugcisa kwiintshisho nokuziswa kwazo kutsha kwaye ulise iimfanelo zempahla, izatifikethi zokuthobela, ukunikelwa, ukutshintshelwa nokuRhoyiswa. Lilisa ukubakho kwabathengi, imeko yokuwakhiwa, iimpazamo eziphindaphindwayo nokulungiswa kwaye uphakamise izigqibo ezingaziswa mntu zikamchibi okanye zobatshilo. Oovimba basekhaya, ukwenziwa okutsha kweendawo nokutshintshwa kweendawo: Cacisa ulawulo lokwenza okutsha kwendawo, ukulungisa, ukutshintsha iindawo neephrojekthi kwiziseko ukusuka kokunokwenzeka nokuCwangcisa ukuya ekubeni zisenziwa, ziqaliswe, zinkikelwe kwaye zivalwe. Yakha iimfuno zobugcisa, ukulinganiswa kwamaxabiso, iinkqubo zokwenza, ulawulo lwengozi nezongezo zokuthenga ngokuvumelana nabantu abanomdla. Hlela abacebisi nabaqambi bezentengiso, qinisekisa isigqibo somsebenzi kwaye ulawule ukuqaliswa, ukulungiswa kweempazamo, iinkcukacha ezifuneka kwaye zelungile nokuLungelelanisa ulondolozo nokulawula i-ICT. Lilisa ukuyiswa ngokexeshana, ixabiso, isigqibo nokuqinisekiswa; lawula iitshintsho kwaye uphakamise izigqibo ezibekiweyo okanye iinguquko ezinkulu. Iinkontileka, i-SLA noLawulo lweVimba: Yakha iingcamango ezicacileyo zobugcisha, iindawo zomsebenzi, iinqanaba neenqanaba zokusebenza kwaye uxhase iinkqubo zokuthenga ezithobela i-SCM nesiGqagqamkela seMthetho. Lawula ukuqaliswa nokusebenza ngokugqibelekayo kweenkonzo, qinisekisa izinto ezenziweyo, ziba iimfuno ezingafezekanga, iitshintsho neengxabano, kwaye usebenzise izigqibo zokuLungisa. Cwangcisa kwaye ulise amabhajeti abekelwe ngokulawulo, izibophelelo, ukubikelela nokuchithwa; qonda izinto ezingasela ixabiso nentlawulo-bemi echanekileyo kwaye ubeke kwaye uchaze iingozi ezinokubakela urhwebo nokuPheliswa kweenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukugqitywa komsebenzi kwaye izixhobo ezikhutshwe zibe ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemithetho yekhontrakthi, xhasa intlawulo ngexeshana nendawo elifunekayo, kwaye ulise ukuphela, ukubuyiswa nokutshintshwa kweziseko nasekutshintshweni kolawulo. Ulawulo, iNgozi, Iinkqubo zeDidijithali nokuLawula abahlulu-nqaba: Qinisekisa ukuthobela i-GIAMA, i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, i-OHS, iimfuno zokwakhiwa nomlilo nezinye iinkqubo ezithintela ukuthengwa. Sigcine iirekhodi zeengozi zeziseko, ubungqina bokuhlohwa nokuthobela, iinkqubo zokuqhubela phambili nokuLunga ixeshana ezibalulekileyo, kwaye uvale iingcaphepho nezigqibo zokuLungisa. Yiba ngumlawuli ohamba phambili kwiinkqubo zolawulo kwaye usebenzise i-CAFM/IWMS, i-BMS, i-IoT monitoring, i-dashboard nokusetyenziswa kweesampulu zokusetyenziswa ngokweemeko zokulawula ngenkqubo yokuphucula ukusebenza. Phatha abasebenzi kwaye uhlelanise i-Finance, i-SCM, i-Legal, i-ICT, i-Security, i-DPWI, amachibi, abanika iinkonzo nabathengi, nokuNika iimvubo ekungeni kwexeshana ngokuchanekileyo kubaphathi nabagxeki abaphakamileyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Corporate Governance
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Corporate Governance at National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring a diploma or degree in Law, Commerce, Accounting or Finance with three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) or Bachelor’s Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Law or Commerce or Accounting or Finance. A minimum 3 years’ working experience is required. Working experience obtained in public entities corporate governance oversight environment. Knowledge of the PFMA, Companies Act, King Code and other relevant prescripts. Knowledge of government frameworks governing public entities.

Review and provide inputs on the reviewing of the public entities enabling legislation, memorandum of incorporation, dividend policies, and remuneration policies. Promote Good Corporate Governance: Provide recommendations on appointment of members of boards and executive management in compliance with entities enabling legislations or memorandum of incorporations. Provide recommendations on remuneration of executive and non-executive directors of public entities in compliance with remuneration guidelines, policies and applicable legislations. Provide recommendations on the performance evaluations of members of boards. Coordinate annual general meetings and provide advice on matters to be executed at the annual general meetings. Public Entities Compliance Monitoring: Maintain a database of annual performance plans, corporate plans, strategic plans, shareholder compacts, and annual reports. Monitor compliance of PFMA, Companies Act, King Code and other relevant prescripts through the review the corporate governance aspects of the annual performance plans, corporate plans, strategic plans, shareholder compacts, and annual reports. Review and process applications in terms of applicable sections of the PFMA pertaining to public entities. Provide inputs on the tabling of annual performance plans, corporate plans, strategic plans, shareholder compacts, and annual reports. Maintain a database on dividends declared and received by government emanating from the SOE’s projected dividends within a particular MTEF period. Provide governance services to all other schedule 2 and SBs entities. Coordination of Contingent Liability: Provide secretariat services to the Fiscal Liability Committee.
