af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Korporatiewe Bestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Korporatiewe Bestuur by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat 'n diploma of graad in Regte, Handel, Rekeningkunde of Finansies met drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: A Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 6) of Baccalaureusgraad (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 7) in Regte of Handel of Rekeningkunde of Finansies. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se werkservaring word vereis. Werkservaring verkry in die omgewing van korporatiewe bestuurstoesig van openbare entiteite. Kennis van die PFMA, Companies Act, King Code en ander relevante voorskrifte. Kennis van regeringsraamwerke wat openbare entiteite regeer.
af.duties: Hersiening van openbare entiteitvoorskrifte: Ontwikkel en hersien die raamwerk vir toesig oor openbare entiteite van National Treasury, goederenreëls en nakomingsmatriks. Hersien en verskaf insetsels oor die hersiening van die openbare entiteite se beforderende wetgewing, memorandum van inkorporasie, dividendbeleid en vergoedingsbeleid. Bevordering van goeie korporatiewe bestuur: Verskaf aanbevelings oor die aanstelling van lede van rade en uitvoerende bestuur in ooreenstemming met entiteite se beforderende wetgewing of memorandum van inkorporasie. Verskaf aanbevelings oor vergoeding van uitvoerende en nie-uitvoerende direkteurs van openbare entiteite in ooreenstemming met vergoedingsriglyne, beleide en toepaslike wetgewing. Verskaf aanbevelings oor die prestasie-evaluerings van radelede. Koördineer jaarlike algemene vergaderings en verskaf advies oor sake wat by die jaarlike algemene vergaderings uitgevoer moet word. Monitering van nakoming deur openbare entiteite: Onderhou 'n databasis van jaarlike prestasieplanne, korporatiewe planne, strategiese planne, aandeelhouerskompakte en jaarverslae. Monitor nakoming van PFMA, Companies Act, King Code en ander relevante voorskrifte deur die hersiening van die korporatiewe bestuuraspekte van die jaarlike prestasieplanne, korporatiewe planne, strategiese planne, aandeelhouerskompakte en jaarverslae. Hersien en verwerk aansoeke ingevolge toepaslike seksies van die PFMA met betrekking tot openbare entiteite. Verskaf insetsels oor die voorlegging van jaarlike prestasieplanne, korporatiewe planne, strategiese planne, aandeelhouerskompakte en jaarverslae. Onderhou 'n databasis van dividende verklaar en ontvang deur die regering voortspruitend uit die SOE se verwagte dividende binne 'n spesifieke MTEF-periode. Verskaf bestuursdienste aan alle ander schedule 2 en SBs-entiteite. Koördinering van kontingente aanspreeklikheid: Verskaf sekretariaatsdienste aan die Fiscal Liability Committee.

zu.title: Umncedisidi: Ubulungiswa Bezinkampani
zu.summary: Umncedisidi: Ubulungiswa Bezinkampani e National Treasury e Pretoria, ofuna idiploma noma idigri kuMthetho, uTshala, ukuBhalisa nemiFino ngeminyaka emithathu yohlavo oluhambisanayo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 iyadingeka kanye nehamba phambili i-National Diploma (elingana ne-NQF level 6) noma i-Bachelor's Degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kuMthetho nokuTshala nokubhalisa nokuFina. Uhlavo oluncane eminyakeni emi-3 luyadingeka. Uhlavo olutholwe emkhakheni wolawulo lokulungiswa kwezinkampani kumithakomeli kahulumeni. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-Companies Act, i-King Code kanye neminye imithetho elandelayo ehambisana. Ulwazi ngemigomo kahulumeni ephatha imithakomeli kahulumeni.
zu.duties: Ukubuyeza imithetho yemithakomeli: Ukuthuthukisa nokubuyeza umthelela wolawulo lwe-National Treasury emithakamelini, imithetho yezelamani, kanye namakhesitri ezingaphakathi kwemithetho. Ukubuyeza nokunikela ngeminikelo ekubuyezweni komthetho osebenza kumathakomeli, isikhumbuzo sokuhlanganiswa, imigomo yokuhlawula izabelo, kanye nemigomo yokuhlinzeka ngemivuzo. Ukukhuthaza ukulungiswa okuhle kwezinkampani: Ukunikela ngeminikelo ngecelwa kwamalungu amabhodi kanye nobaphathi abaphezulu ngokuhambisana nomthetho osebenza emathakomeleni noma izikhumbuzo zokuhlanganiswa. Ukunikela ngeminikelo ngemivuzo yamaphathi abaphezulu nalabo abangeyona abaphathi bamathakomeli ngokuhambisana nemigomo, umgomo, nomthetho osebenzayo. Ukunikela ngeminikelo ngokuqathaniswa kokusebenza kwamalungu amabhodi. Ukuhlanganisa izingqungquthela zeminyaka yonke nokunikela ngeluleko ngezindaba ezizokwenziwa emhlanganweni womnyaka wonke. Ukugcina ukubuka ngokushelelayo kokulandela imithetho emathakomeleni: Ukugcina isisekelo sedatha yemigomo yokusebenza yeminyaka yonke, imigomo yamabhodi, imigomo yokuhlela ngokubanzi, isivumelwano sabanikazi bezabelo, kanye nokuCwaziswa kwezinsuku zomnyaka. Ukulawula ukuthi kwenziwe imithetho ye-PFMA, i-Companies Act, i-King Code, neminye imithetho ngaphakathi kokubuyeza izindaba zokulawula ukulunga kwezinkampani kwemigomo yokusebenza yeminyaka yonke, imigomo yamabhodi, imigomo yokuhlela ngokubanzi, isivumelwano sabanikazi bezabelo, kanye nokuCwaziswa kwezinsuku zomnyaka. Ukubuyeza futhi ukuphathwa kwemibhalo nangokwemigomo efanele ye-PFMA ekhuluma ngemithakomeli kahulumeni. Ukunikela ngeminikelo ngokusethulwa komgomo wokusebenza ngomnyaka, imigomo yamabhodi, imigomo yokuhlela ngokubanzi, isivumelwano sabanikazi bezabelo, kanye nokuCwaziswa kweminyaka yonke. Ukugcina isisekelo sedatha ngamabelo acushiwe futhi atholwe uhulumene avela emabhujetingweni amakhulu ayisibonelo wezigaba zemali etholakala kuleso sikhathi se-MTEF. Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokulawula kokuqakathe kwayo yonke eminye imithakomeli esibalo 2 ne-SBs. Ukuhlanganisa kwezibopho ezingahlela ngokweqisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yomabhalane kuKomidide Yemibopho Yemali.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Urhulumente weNkampani
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Urhulumente weNkampani e National Treasury e Pretoria, efuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwiMthetho, uTshisho, i-Accounting okanye ezeMali enamava amathathu ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Kufunelwa i-Grade 12 ekwedityaniswe kunye ne-National Directive (elingana ne-NQF level 6) okanye i-Bachelor's Degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kwiMthetho okanye uTshisho okanye i-Accounting okanye ezeMali. Kufunelwa ubuncinane unyaka omtatu wamava okusebenza. Amava okusebenza afunyenwe kwimeko yokulawula urhulumente wenkampani kumagunya aurhulumente. Ulwazi malunga ne-PFMA, i-Companies Act, i-King Code namanye emagunya ahambelanayo. Ulwazi lwemigaqo karhulumente ebalawula amagunya aurhulumente.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela amagunya amagunya aurhulumente: Ukuphucula nokuphinda uqwalasele imeko yokulawula amagunya aurhulumente e National Treasury, imigaqo yokulawula, kunye ne-matriksi yokuzithoba. Qwalasela unike iingcali ekuphindiweni kwemithetho esekela amagunya aurhulumente, imemorandam yoshicilelo, iindlela zevidendi, kunye neendlela zorhwebo. Ukukhuthaza iUrhulumente wenkampani oluhle: Nikela izindululo kwabizelwa kubalawuli abantu baseboard namalungu abaphathi abakhulu ngokuthobela imithetho esekela urhulumente wenkampani. Nikela izindululo ngokurhweba kwabalawuli abakhulu kunye nalabo abangabhali abangengabo baseboard kwamagunya aurhulumente ngokuthobela iindlela zorhweba, iindaba nemithetho esebenzayo. Nikela izindululo ngokuphangisa kwabalawuli baseboard. Linganisela iintlanganiso zonyaka zonke unike icebiso malunga nezinto eziza kwenziwa kwiintlanganiso zonyaka zonke. Ukuqaphela ukuzithoba kwamagunya aurhulumente: Zigcine idatabase yeendlela zokusabela zonyaka, iindaba zenkampani, iindlela ezingundoqo, iinkqubela zabatyali-mali, kunye neengxelo zonyaka. Qaphela ukuzithoba kwe-PFMA, i-Companies Act, i-King Code namanye emagunya ahambelanayo ngokuqwalasela izinto zenkqubo yamagunya aurhulumente kwindlela zokusabela zonyaka, iindaba zenkampani, iindlela ezingundoqo, iinkqubelo zabatyali-mali, kunye neengxelo zonyaka. Qwalasela uphuhlise izicelo ngokwemigaqo esebenzayo ye-PFMA ehambene namagunya aurhulumente. Nikela iingcali ekubekweni kweendlela zokusabela zonyaka, iindaba zenkampani, iindlela ezingundoqo, iinkqubela zabatyali-mali, kunye neengxelo zonyaka. Gcina idatabase yevidendi ezithunyelwe nifumene ngurhulumente evela kumaxesha e-SOE okuqikelela amaxesha e-videndi ngaphakathi kwexesha elithile le-MTEF. Nikezela iinkonzo zorhulumente wonke amanye amagunya escheduled 2 naba-SBs. Ulawulo lweContingent Liability: Nikela iinkonzo zesikrobhothi kwi-Fiscal Liability Committee.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.summary: Business Analyst at National Treasury in Pretoria requiring a diploma or degree in IT or Business Administration with three years of analysis experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) or Bachelor’s degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Information Technology or Business Administration. A minimum 3 years’ experience obtained within the fields of business or systems analysis environment. Knowledge and experience in the utilisation of the Unified Modelling Language (UML), Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN), and the Integrated Definition Language (IDEF0) standards, Cobit5, and Togaf9.
jobs.duties: Business Analysis and Requirements Management: Plan and conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, document analysis, surveys, questionnaires, brainstorming and observation activities. Elicit, analyse, validate and prioritise business requirements in alignment with National Treasury’s operational needs and strategic objectives. Document functional and non-functional requirements through business requirements specifications, functional specifications, use cases and other appropriate business analysis artefacts. Develop and maintain requirements traceability matrices to ensure that requirements are addressed throughout the project lifecycle. Manage, assess and document changes to approved requirements throughout the project lifecycle. Business Process Analysis and Improvement: Analyse and document current-state, or As-Is, business processes using appropriate business analysis and process-modelling methods. Identify process inefficiencies, risk, control gaps and improvement opportunities. Design and document future-state, or To-Be, business processes, workflows and business models. Review and map ICT standards operating procedures. Solution Evaluation, Testing and Implementation Support: Collaborate with architects, application developers and subject-matter experts to define solution requirements and translate business needs into appropriate solution specifications. Evaluate proposed business and technology solutions to ensure alignment with approved requirements, business processes and National Treasury’s objectives. Recommend appropriate process and technology solutions to address identified business needs. Develop or contribute to test plans, test scenarios and test cases, and support quality-assurance activities and User Acceptance Testing. Validate delivered solutions against approved requirements and facilitate the resolution of defects and requirements-related queries. Support solution implementation, organisational change, user training and adoption activities, including preparing or reviewing user guides and training materials. ICT Governance Documentation and Reporting: Compile, review and maintain business analysis, ICT project and Corporate Governance of ICT reports and documentation. Monitor the completeness, quality, consistency and traceability of business analysis and project deliverables. Assess relevant business analysis and project documentation for alignment with approved ICT governance requirements, standards and procedures. Maintain an organised repository of approved requirements, process models, specifications, traceability records and supporting documentation. Provide accurate business analysis information, findings and recommendations to support ICT governance oversight, reporting and decision-making.

af.title: Besigheidsontleder
af.summary: Besigheidsontleder by National Treasury in Pretoria wat 'n diploma of graad in IT of Besigheidsadministrasie vereis met drie jaar se ontledingservaring.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 6) of Baccalaureusgraad (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 7) in Inligtingstegnologie of Besigheidsadministrasie. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring verkry binne die omgewing van besigheids- of stelselontleding. Kennis en ervaring in die gebruik van die Unified Modelling Language (UML), Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN), en die Integrated Definition Language (IDEF0) standaarde, Cobit5, en Togaf9.
af.duties: Besigheidsontleding en Vereistebeheer: Beplan en voer onderhoudhouder-onderhoude, werkswinkels, dokumentontleding, opnames, vraelyste, breinstorming en waarnemingsaktiwiteite uit. Ontlok, ontleed, valideer en prioriteer besigheidsvereistes in ooreenstemming met National Treasury se operasionele behoeftes en strategiese doelwitte. Dokumenteer funksionele en nie-funksionele vereistes deur middel van besigheidsvereistespesifikasies, funksionele spesifikasies, gebruikgevalle en ander toepaslike besigheidsontledingsartefakte. Ontwikkel en onderhou vereistes-naspeurbaarheidsmatrices om te verseker dat vereistes dwarsdeur die projeklewensiklus aangespreek word. Bestuur, assesseer en dokumenteer veranderinge aan goedgekeurde vereistes dwarsdeur die projeklewensiklus. Besigheidsprosesontleding en -verbetering: Ontleed en dokumenteer huidige-toestand, of As-Is, besigheidsprosesse deur toepaslike besigheidsontledings- en prosesmodelleringsmetodes te gebruik. Identifiseer prosesoneffektiwiteit, risiko's, beheerleemtes en verbeteringsgeleenthede. Ontwerp en dokumenteer toekoms-toestand, of To-Be, besigheidsprosesse, werkvloeie en besigheidsmodelle. Hersien en karter ICT-standaarde bedryfsprosedures. Oplossingevaluering, Toetsing en Implementeringondersteuning: Werk saam met argitekte, toepassingsontwikkelaars en vak Kundiges om oplossingsvereistes te definieer en besigheidsbehoeftes in toepaslike oplossingspesifikasies te vertaal. Evalueer voorgestelde besigheids- en tegnologie-oplossings om ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde vereistes, besigheidsprosesse en National Treasury se doelwitte te verseker. Beveel toepaslike proses- en tegnologie-oplossings aan om geïdentifiseerde besigheidsbehoeftes aan te spreek. Ontwikkel of dra by tot toetsplanne, toetssenario's en toetsgevalle, en onderhou kwaliteitsversekeringsaktiwiteite en Gebruiker-aanvaardingstoetsing. Valideer afgelewerde oplossings teen goedgekeurde vereistes en fassiliteer die oplossing van gebreke en vereiste-verwante navrae. Ondersteun oplossing-implementering, organisatoriese verandering, gebruikersopleiding en aanvaardingsaktiwiteite, insluitend die voorbereiding of hersiening van gebruikersgidse en opleidingsmateriaal. ICT-besturende Dokumentasie en Verslagdoening: Stel besigheidsontleding, ICT-projek en Korporatiewe Bestuur van ICT-verslae en -dokumentasie saam, hersien en onderhou dit. Monitor die volledigheid, gehalte, konsekwentheid en naspeurbaarheid van besigheidsontledings- en projeklewerings. zu.title: Umhloli Wezoshishino
zu.summary: Umhloli Wezoshishino e-National Treasury e-Pretoria ofuna idiploma noma iziqu kwi-IT noma ezokuqondisa Izoshishino, ohunye ungeminyaka emithathu yobuchule bokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibanga le-Grade 12 kahambisana ne-National Diploma (elingana ne-NQF level 6) noma iziqu ze-Bachelor (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kwi-Information Technology noma ezokuqondisa Izoshishino. Kudingeka ubuchule obungaphansi kweminyaka eyi-3 obutholwe emkhakheni wezoshishino noma kokuhlola izimiso. Ulwazi nobuchule ekusetshenzisweni kwemithetho ye-Unified Modelling Language (UML), i-Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN), kanye ne-Integrated Definition Language (IDEF0), i-Cobit5, ne-Togaf9.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola Izoshishino Nokuphathwa Kwezidingo: Hlela futhi wenze izingxoxo nabangenayo isikhundla, izikhungo zokusebenza, ukuhlola amadokhumenti, iziphakamedo, imibuzo, ukucabanga ngokushesha nemisebenzi yokubuka. Kholeka, hlola, qinisekisa futhi uhlole ngokubaluleka izidingo zezoshishino ngokuvumelana nezidingo zokusebenza zika-National Treasury nemigomo eyisiphetho. Qamba amadokhumenti wezidingo ezisebenzayo nangezingasebenziyo ngokulandela izici ezichazayo zezidingo zezoshishino, izici ezisebenzayo, izimo zokusebenza nokunye okuhlobene nomhlolo wezoshishino. Yakha futhi ulondoloze izinhlobo zokuvela kwezidingo ukuze qinisekisa ukuthi izidingo ziphathwe kuwo wonke umkhakha wephrojekthi. Phatha, hlola futhi qamba amadokhumenti woshintsho kwezidingo ezamukelwe kuwo wonke umkhakha wephrojekthi. Ukuhlola Nokuthuthukisa Inqubo Yezoshishino: Hlola futhi qamba amadokhumenti wezimo-yesikhathi esijwayelekile, noma i-As-Is, zenqubo yezoshishino ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zokuhlola izoshishino nokuqamba imodeli yenqubo. Thola izimo ezingasebenzi kahle zenqubo, ingozi, amasikwebeke angavulekile namathuba okuthuthukisa. Hlela futhi qamba amadokhumenti wezimo-yesikhathi esizayo, noma i-To-Be, zenqubo yezoshishino, ukugeleza kwemisebenzi namamodeli wezoshishino. Buka futhi umape izinqubo zokusebenza zemithetho ye-ICT. Ukuhlola Isixazululo, Ukuhlolwa Kwenza Nokwesekwa Kokufakwa: Sebenzisana nabakhiwo bamamodeli, abakhi bakohlelo lwamanani nabayindida ekubeni bacacise izidingo zesixazululo futhi humusela izidingo zezoshishino ezifanele ezicazweni zesixazululo. Hlola izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zezoshishino nobuchwepheshe ukuze qinisekisa ukuvumelana nezidingo ezamukelwe, inqubo yezoshishino nemigomo ka-National Treasury. Phakamisa izixazululo ezifanele zenqubo nobuchwepheshe ukuzohlulela izidingo zezoshishino ezitholiwe. Yakha noma ufake isandla ekwakheni amaphulani okuhola, izimo zokuqashwa kanye namacala okuhola, futhi useke izinkambu zokuqinisekisa inani kanye nokuHlolwa Kokwamukela Abasebenzisi. Qinisekisa izixazululo ezifakwe ngokuvumelana nezidingo ezamukelwe futhi siza ekuxazululeni izinkinga nemibuzo ehlobene nezidingo. Seka ukufakwa kwesixazululo, ushintsho lwezinhlangano, uqeqesho labasebenzisi nemisebenzi yokuamukela, okuhlanganisa ukulungisa noma ukubuka amagidi abasebenzisi nezinto zokuqeqesha. Amadokhentu Wezibusiso Ze-ICT Nokubika: Qamba, buka futhi ulondoloze amadokhumenti nokubikelwa komhlolo wezoshishino, iphrojekthi ye-ICT kanye Nezibusiso ze-Corporate Governance of ICT. Qaphela ukugqamuka, inani, ukuhambisana kanye nokuvela kwezidingo komhlolo wezoshishino nezinto ezikhiqizwe kumphrojekthi. Hlola amadokhumenti ohlelo wezoshishino nephrojekthi ahlobene ukuzwana nezidingo zamazwebusiso e-ICT, imithetho kanye nezinqubo ezamukelwe. Guligile indawo yokugcina izidingo ezamukelwe, imodeli zenqubo, izici, izinkomba zokuvela kwezidingo namadokhumenti okusekela. Nikeza ulwazi olunembile lomhlolo wezoshishino, izinto ezitholakele nemitshingo yokuqinisekisa ukusekelwa ngokuphathwa kwe-ICT, ukubikelwa kanye nokwenza izinqumo.

xh.title: Umlinganisi Weshishino
xh.summary: Umlinganisi Weshishino kwi-National Treasury ePretoria ofuna idiploma okanye inqanaba lemfundo ephakamileyo kwi-IT okanye kuLawulo Loshishino onamava eminyaka mithathu yokuqhathanisa.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibekho i-Grade 12 kwaye iphathwe ngokufanayo nedi-ploma yaseburhulweni (elingana nelinganisa le-NQF level 6) okanye inqanaba lesidanga se-Bachelor's (elingana nelinganisa le-NQF level 7) kwiNgcakulelo yoloLwulo okanye kuLawulo Loshishino. Kufuneka kube kho amava angaphantsi kweminyaka emi-3 atholwe kwindawo ekulawulwa ushishino okanye oovimba beefasiteyitileyo. Ulwazi namava ekusebenziseni i-standards ezinjengesi-Settyenziswa Kolwimi Oqhathaniswayo (UML), i-Model yamanyathelo ashishino kunye neSalathiso (BPMN), nolwimi lokuchaza oludityaniswe kunye (IDEF0), i-Cobit5, ne-Togaf9.
xh.duties: Ukuthelekisa ushishino nokulawula iimfuno: Cwangcisa uze ubambe iintevyu zabantu abahlo, iinkqubo zomsebenzi womsitho, ukuhlaziya amaxwebhu, iingxelo zophando, iimpendulo zemibuzo, ukucinga ngokubakho ngokutsha nokwalamula iindwendwe ngokwenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqonda. Khupha, hlaziya, qinisekisa uze uqwalasele iimfuno zoshishino ngokuhambelana nezidingo zoshishino ezingamashishini azayo kunye neemigqibelo eziyindlela eziphambili ze-National Treasury. Qamba amaxwebhu angeemfuno ezenzwayo nokungangeni kumashishini ngezityhila ngokwemfuno, izityhila ezenzwayo, iindlela ezisetyenziswayo namanye amaxwebhu afanelekileyo oqhathaniso. Phuhlisa uze ulondoloze imveliso eza kubonisa iimfuno kunye nendlela ezisetyenziswayo ukuze kuqinisekiswa ukuba iimfuno zenziwa kuyo nayiphi na inkqubo yomsebenzi. Lawula, qinisekisa uze uqwalasele iinguquko kwiimfuno ezivunyiweyo kuyo nayiphi na inkqubo yomsebenzi. Ukuqhathanisa nokuphucula inkqubo yamashishino: Cinga ngokutsha uhlaziye iindlela eziphila kunye zoshishino, okanye ezikho njengangoku ngokusetyenziswa kolwimi olufanelekileyo lokuthelekisa ushishino nokuqamba iindlela entsha. Qaphela iindlela ezingasebenzi kakuhle, iingozxi ingozi, iindlela ezingakhuselekanga nemiba ekulungisekeni okuqhawula ibumba. Qamba uze uhlaziye iindlela ezizakuqhawula ibumba ezingakaqiniswanga, iindlela zokuqhuba ushishino iindlela ezintsha ezikulungele ukusetyenziswa. Phinda uhlole kwaye ulungise iindlela ezikulungele uLAWULO oluqinileyo Iindlela ezikulungele uLAWULO eziyimigaqo. Ukupanda izisombululo, ukuzama nokuyilwa kwenkqubo ukuze incedise ngokuzisebenzisa: Sebenzana nabakhi beendlela, abaqambi iindlela zoshishino nabantu abagqithisileyo ekubeni ngabanye abantu abanolwazi malunga nalawo mmandla ukuyila izisombululo kwiimfuno okuzisebenzise kubandakanye nokuguqula iimfuno zoshishino zibe ngemigaqo echanekileyo. Qwalasela izisombululo eziphakamisiweyo kushishino nakwizixhobo ze-ICT ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulungelelwanayo neemfuno ezivunyiweyo kwaye uqinisekise ukuzinisekisa kwazo. Gqiba izisombululo ezifanelekileyo kumashishino nakwizixhobo ze-ICT ukuze zisombulule iimfuno ezitholwe kushishino. Phuhlisa okube negalelo ekuyileni iindlela ezizakusetyenziswa kuzama izisombululo ezilungele ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngokoqiniso izisombululo ezenziweyo ziyimfuno. Xhasa inkqubo yokumisela ulungelelwaniso, ushintsho ngokwendalo yabantu, ukulungiselela ukuzonceda abasebenzisi kwaye bathathe inxaxheba, kuquka nokulungiselela okanye ukuhlola isikhokelo seNkqubo yokuzonceda abasebenzisi. Umlando we-ICT nokubhala iingxelo: Qamba uhlaziye ulondoloze ulwazi lokuthelekisa ushishino, amaxwebhu kunye namagqabantshintshi e-ICT mayela nalawulo lawo welungelo lokuzimela, nokwenza iingxelo ezichanekileyo ngokuhambelana kwemigaqo yegunya elibekiweyo. Qaphela ukuphela kokuchanekileyo ngokwemigaqo efanelekileyo nengaxabekanga nakwiyoo naluphi na ushicilelo lwamaxwebhu. Nika ulwazi oluchanekileyo malunga nokuqhathanisa ushishino okuzo kuncedisa ekubeni izigqibo ezichanekileyo zithathwe ngokukhuseleka okupheleleyo kwelungelo elinganamkeli nkqubo ephantsi kunye namagunya alo.

jobs.title: Director: Water Resource Planning and Management
jobs.summary: Director position in Water Resource Planning and Management at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 7 qualification in Engineering, Hydrology, Geohydrology, Natural Sciences, Environmental Sciences or a related water resource field. Five (5) years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Five (5) years' functional experience in catchment management strategy, programmes and planning. Successful completion of the Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) as endorsed by the National School of Government. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge of Treasury Rules and Regulations for procurement. Knowledge of financial management. Knowledge of water resource management disciplines, including water quality, water quantity, groundwater and aquatic ecosystem monitoring. Knowledge of project management. Knowledge of hydrological science. Problem solving and analysis. Strategic capability and leadership. Understanding of programme and project management.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for developing the catchment strategy, programmes and planning. Provide strategic direction on the development of the catchment management strategy, including ensuring the development and updating of the Catchment Management Strategy, providing input into the planning documents of other relevant institutions, participating in the planning processes of LOCMA, coordinating the water allocation reform programme from a LOCMA perspective, and ensuring that specialist comments are made on biomonitoring reports and water use license applications (WULA) submitted by water users. Manage the implementation of measures for the protection and conservation of water resources within the catchment area, including developing a catchment-level water resource protection and conservation plan, conducting catchment condition and water resource risk assessments, establishing partnerships and catchment management forums, escalating serious or persistent non-compliance to the appropriate enforcement authority, and implementing pollution prevention and control measures. Manage and monitor water quality and quantity within LOCMA, including developing and implementing the Water Quality Monitoring Plan and the River Eco-status Monitoring Programme (REMP) in the water management area, ensuring the development, access and implementation of applicable information management systems, ensuring the operation of decision support systems (computer modelling) that provide information to inform river systems planning and operations, and partaking in trans-boundary water management matters to ensure the implementation of LOCMA's responsibilities in terms of treaties. Monitor the implementation of resource quality objectives, including ensuring the collection, management, archiving and dissemination of all hydrological, geohydrological, water quality and biota-related information by relevant components, reviewing reports based on the collected and collated data, participating in reserve determination studies, ensuring the assessment of compliance with resource quality objectives, the ecological reserve and international obligations, and ensuring the production and dissemination of quarterly and annual water resource quality status reports (integrating quality, quantity and aquatic biota). Provide strategic leadership and business planning, including operational, finance, supply chain and human resource planning and reporting, as well as human resource development and performance management.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions to those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Waterbronbeplanning en -bestuur
af.summary: Direkteurspos in Waterbronbeplanning en -bestuur by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Ingenieurswese, Hidrologie, Geohidrologie, Natuurwetenskappe, Omgigingswetenskappe of 'n verwante waterbronveld. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Vyf (5) jaar se funksionele ervaring in opvangsgebiedbestuursstrategie, programme en beplanning. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Kennis van Tesouriereëls en -regulasies vir verkryging. Kennis van finansiële bestuur. Kennis van waterbronbestuursdissiplines, insluitend waterkwaliteit, waterkwantiteit, grondwater en monitering van water-ekosisteme. Kennis van projeksbestuur. Kennis van hidrologiese wetenskap. Probleemoplossing en analise. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Begrip van program- en projekbestuur.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die ontwikkeling van die opvangsgebiedstrategie, programme en beplanning. Verskaf strategiese rigting oor die ontwikkeling van die opvangsgebiedbestuursstrategie, insluitend die versekering van die ontwikkeling en opdatering van die Catchment Management Strategy, die voorsiening van insette in die beplanningsdokumente van ander tersaaklike instellings, deelname aan die beplanningsprosesse van LOCMA, die koördinering van die watertoekenningshervormingsprogram vanuit 'n LOCMA-perspektief, en die versekering dat spesialis kommentaar gelewer word op biomoniteringsverslae en watergebruiklisensie-aansoeke (WULA) wat deur watergebruikers ingedien word. Bestuur die implementering van maatreëls vir die beskerming en bewaring van waterbronne binne die opvangsgebied, insluitend die ontwikkeling van 'n opvangsgebiedvlak-waterbronbeskermings- en bewaringsplan, die uitvoer van opvangsgebiedtoestand- en waterbronrisiko-assessmente, die vestig van vennootskappe en opvangsgebiedbestuursforums, die eskalering van ernstige of volgehoue nie-nakoming na die gepaste handhawingsowerheid, en die implementering van besoedelingsvoorkoming- en beheermaatreëls. Bestuur en monitor waterkwaliteit en -kwantiteit binne LOCMA, insluitend die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Water Quality Monitoring Plan en die River Eco-status Monitoring Programme (REMP) in die waterbestuursgebied, die versekering van die ontwikkeling, toegang tot en implementering van toepaslike inligtingsbestuurstelsels, die versekering van die werking van besluitondersteunende stelsels (rekenaarmodellering) wat inligting verskaf om rivierstelselbeplanning en -bedrywighede in te lig, en deelname aan transgrens-waterbestuursaangeleenthede om die implementering van LOCMA se verantwoordelikhede ingevolge verdrae te verseker. Monitor die implementering van hulpbronkwaliteitsdoelwitte, insluitend die versekering van die versameling, bestuur, argivering en verspreiding van alle hidrologiese, geohidrologiese, waterkwaliteits- en biota-verwante inligting deur tersaaklike komponente, die hersiening van verslae gebaseer op die versamelde en saamgestelde data, deelname aan reserwebepalingsstudies, die versekering van die assessering van nakoming van hulpbronkwaliteitsdoelwitte, die ekologiese reserwe en internasionale verpligtinge, en die versekering van die vervaardiging en verspreiding van kwartaal- en jaarlikse waterbronkwaliteitstatusverslae (wat kwaliteit, kwantiteit en waterbiota integreer). Verskaf strategiese leierskap en besigheidsbeplanning, insluitend operasionele, finansiële, voorsieningsketting- en menslike hulpbronbeplanning en -verslagdoening, asook menslike hulpbronontwikkeling en prestasiebestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuhlela nokuphathwa kwamathokheni wamanzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi kokuHlela nokuphathwa kwamathokheni wamanzi eMnyangweni Wamanzi nokuThuthukisa endaweni yasePolokwane, esidinga iziqu ze-NQF 7 nemfundo yokuba ngumphathi ohlelweni oluphakeme.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo zezinga le-NQF 7 kwizifundo ezinjengobuchwepheshe, izifundo zamaza, izifundo zamaza ophansi komhlaba, izayensi yemvelo, izifundo zokuhlinzekwa kwemvelo noma noma yisiphi esinye isifundo esihlotshaniswe namathokheni wamanzi. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yemfundo ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi/ophakeme. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yemfundo ekwenzeni uhlelo lokuqondisa nokuqamba amacebo okuphatha imikhobo, izinhlelo kanye nokuhlela. Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kweSithifikethi sokuNgena ngaphambilini somSebenzi woMphathi oPhakeme (SMS) njengokuqashiwe yiSikolo sikaHulumeni weSizwe. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo wokuCheza kwezeMali zikaZwe. Ulwazi ngezoMthetho neziMiso zeNqalasihlalo zokuthenga. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezimali. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yokuphathwa kwamathokheni wamanzi, okuhlanganisa ukubheka ukuthuthwa kwamanzi, inani lamanzi, amanzi ophansi komhlaba kanye nokuqaphela izinto eziphilayo emanzini. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ulwazi ngesayensi yamaza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokubumba isu nokuba ngumholi. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Umntu okhethiwe uyobe egxile ekwakheni isu lokuphatha imikhobo, izinhlelo nokuhlela. Ukunikeza isu lokuhamba embilini ekwakheni isu lokuphatha imikhobo, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukwakhiwa nokubuyekezwa kweSu lokuphatha iMikhobo, ukunikela ngeminikelo kwamadokhumenti okuhlela kolunye izikhungo ezihlobene, ukuthatha inxaxheba kumahlela okuhlela e-LOCMA, ukuhlanganisa uhlelo lokulungisa ukwabiwa kwamanzi ngokubuka i-LOCMA, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziphetho zezingcia zenzelwe imibiko yokuqaphela izinto eziphilayo futhi izicelo zokusebenzisa amanzi (WULA) ezithunywe abasebenzisi amanzi zibuyekeziwe. Ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokuvikela nokugcina amathokheni wamanzi ngaphakathi kwesifunda semikhobo, okuhlanganisa ukwakha uhlelo lokuvikela nokugcina amathokheni wamanzi ezingeni lemikhobo, ukwenza isilinganisi sesimo semikhobo nengozi yamathokheni wamanzi, ukwakha ubudlelwano namaphora wokuphatha imikhobo, ukudlulisela ukungahambisani okubi noma okuphindaphindiwe esikhundleni esifanele somgcinimthetho, nokusebenzisa izinyathelo zokuvikela nokulawula ukungcoliswa. Ukuphatha futhi ukuqaphela ukuthuthwa kwamanzi kanye nenani lamanzi ngaphakathi kwe-LOCMA, okuhlanganisa ukwakha nokusebenzisa iHlela lokuQaphela ukuthuthwa kweZinto eziyinhlobo kweAmanzi, nokuQaphela iNani le-Amanzi eNdaweni yokuLawula Amanzi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukufinyelela nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ulwazi ezifanelekileyo, ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokusiza ukwenza izinqumo (ukumodela ngekhompyutha) ezinikeza ulwazi oluqondene nokuhlela nokusebenza kwemikhobhonisa emanzini, nokubamba iqhaza kwezindaba zokuphathwa kwamathokheni amanzi kumanyuze nakuNtela ukuze kugcinwe ukusetshenziswa kwezibopho zika-LOCMA. Ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhloso zezinga lezinto zemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuqoqwa, ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokusakazwa kwawo wonke ulwazi ngamaza, izifundo zamaza ophansi, izinto ezingcolile namaphesenti e-LOCMA, ukuqinisekisa ukuhlelwa nokusetshenziswa kweNani le-Amanzi emakhapha esimo semikhobo, nokuthatha inxaxheba emigqweni yokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinhloso zezinga lezinto zemvelo, izeswe lemvelo kanye nezibopho zamazwe ngamazwe, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukukhiqizwa nokusakazwa kwemibiko yeqakethe futhi yonyaka yesimo sezinto zokulinganiselwa kwamanzi (okuhlanganisa ukuthuthwa kwamanzi, inani kanye nezinto eziphilayo emanzini). Ukunikeza ubuholi obucacile kanye nokuhlela isu lezimali nezinsizakusebenza, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela futhi ukwenza imibiko yemisebenzi yansuku zonke, yezimali, yohlelo lokuthenga, nokuqasha abantu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu nokuqinisekisa imigqaqo yokusebenza.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Uqeqesho Lwamanzi kunye noLawulo
xh.summary: Isikhundla som lawuli kuQeqesho Lwamanzi kunye noLawulo kwiSebe leManzi kunye nokuQhwamisa ePolokwane, sifuna isidanga se-NQF 7 namanqanaba aphakamileyo obunkokeli.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF 7 esifanelekileyo kwiNzululwazi yeMpuxa, iHydrology, iGeohydrology, iNatural Sciences, iEnvironmental Sciences okanye indawo enxulumene namanzi. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/laphezulu lobunkokeli. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava okusebenza kwinkqubo yolawulo lwemilambo, iinkqubo nokuceba. Ukuphumelela ukugqiba iPre-entry Certificate ye-Senior Management Service (SMS) njengoko kuvunyiwe yi-National School of Government. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo leeMali kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngeGolden Rules kunye namagunya eTreasury ekuthengeni. Ulwazi nolawulo lweemali. Ulwazi ngamagatya olawulo lwamanzi, kuquka umgangatho wamanzi, inani lamanzi, amanzi aphansi komhlaba nokuqokelela iinkcukacha ngokubhalwa kolwandle. Ulwazi nolawulo lweprojekthi. Ulwazi lwesayensi yehydrology. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda. Ikhono lokuba nokuhlola phambili nokuziphatha njengenkokeli. Ukuqonda iinkqubo nolawulo lweprojekthi.
xh.duties: Umntu oza kugqibelelwa kule ndawo uza kubizwa ngokuphuhlisa inkqubo yolawulo lwemilambo, iinkqubo nokuceba. Kufuneka anike isikhokelo esibonisayo ekuphuhliseni inkqubo yolawulo lwemilambo, kuquka ukuqinisekisa ukuphuhliswa nokuhlaziya iNkqubo yoLawulo lwemiLambo, ukunikela izimvo kumaxwebhu okuceba eminye iintlangano, ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuceba kwi-LOCMA, ukuququzelela inkqubo yokulungiselela ulawulo lwaso sonke isixa samanzi ukusuka emgangingweni we-LOCMA, kwaye ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iimvo ezichaza ngobugcisa ezavezwa kwii-report ze-biomonitoring ngezigqibo zokusetyenziswa kwamanzi (WULA) ezithunyelwe ngabasebenzisi amanzi. UkuLawula ukusebenza kweendlela zokhusela nokugcina amanzi endlwini yomlambo, kuquka ukuphuhlisa iplani yokhusela nokuqhakamshela amanzi kwinqanaba lomlambo, ukuqokelela iinkcukacha ngemilinganisyo yolwandle nokulinganisa ingozi yamanz' emilambo, ukwakhiwa kweenkululeko nokudibana ngenkxaso yolawulo lwemilambo, ukudlulisa engxakini ngenqanaba elingenamva okwenzeka rhoqo kolawulo ngenye iNkqubo eNikwe iNguqulelo yokuLawula ngoBunkokeli, nakwindawo ekufuneka kusetyenziswe kona. UkuLawula kuqondise ukuphila kwamanzi kwaye abe naye inani lawo ngaphakathi kwindawo yolawulo, ukuba ngumntu ongumboniso weendlela ezahlukeneyo. Ukwenza izicwangciso ezahlukeneyo ezibonelela ngolwazi ngokuLawula kunye noQeqesho lobuLawuli beMali, ukuba ngumntu oqeqeshiweyo ogqibele kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo ezifunwayo ekudibaniseni ulwazi nakwindawo yokulawula efunwa ngumntu. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokukhetha ezahlukeneyo, ukusetyenziswa kolwazi nakwindawo yokulawula, kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezifuna ulwazi, nokwakha ulwazi oluza kusetyenziswa kwii-systems ezahlukeneyo. Ukulawula nokulawula ukusetyenziswa kweSango namagunya amanzi aphakathi kwendawo yolawulo lwamanzi, ukulungiselela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezikwalula ulwazi ngamanzi nakwindawo efunwa ngumntu. Ukubeka iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ngexesha nelizwe ngokulawula, ukulungiselela nokulawula amanzi, ukulawula iinkqubo zokusebenza ezinokusetyenziswa kwii-SMS, ukulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinokusetyenziswa kwii-SMS, nokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinokusetyenziswa kwii-SMS, nokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinokusetyenziswa kwii-SMS, nokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinokusetyenziswa kwii-SMS, nokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinokusetyenziswa kwii-SMS. Ukubeka ngokutsha iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolwazi ngamanzi, nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolwazi ngamanzi nakwindawo yolawulo.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.summary: Chief Financial Officer position at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, requiring a CA(SA) qualification and five years of senior finance management experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 (bachelor’s degree) in a relevant field. Registration as a Chartered Accountant (CA(SA) with the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA). A minimum of five (5) years of experience at middle/senior managerial level in Finance. Successful completion of the Pre- entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) as endorsed by the National School of Government. Extensive knowledge of financial management, the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP). Knowledge of the local government sector, and of the Public Service Act and Regulations. Strategic capability and leadership, programme and project management, financial management, change management, knowledge management and service delivery innovation (SDI) skills. Problem solving and analysis, people management and empowerment, and client orientation and customer focus skills. Attention to detail. Good verbal and written communication skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for strategic oversight of financial management services within LOCMA. Assume overall responsibility for general financial and management accounting activities, budget preparation and compliance, revenue collection, supply chain management, asset management, payroll and banking functions, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation, prescripts, policies and agreements. Establish, implement and enhance accounting and internal control systems, policies and procedures in compliance with GRAP, the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and other legislation. Develop and implement a cost management strategy through effective accounting controls and financial management techniques. Ensure compliance with policies, provide guidance, and assess the risks and financial viability of existing and new policies, projects and customer agreements. Direct the financial strategy of the organisation to ensure the availability of adequate financial resources. Provide strategic financial advice to executive management and the Board. Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting to all internal and external governance structures. Set parameters for cash flow management and for the operations of finance personnel. Ensure the integrity of financial data in terms of timeliness, accuracy and reliability. Oversee and provide assistance during the annual audit, respond to audit findings and implement recommendations as required. Keep abreast of new trends in accounting, financial management and budgeting. Provide strategic direction in the implementation of human resource policies, prescripts and strategies. Ensure the provision of information technology (IT) services and the effective mitigation of associated risks. Ensure the provision of office support services, including facilities management. Establish appropriate service and staffing levels, monitor and evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of service delivery methods and procedures, and allocate resources accordingly to meet LOCMA’s strategic priorities. Take responsibility for the related sections of the Annual Performance Plan (APP), Shareholder Compact and Annual Report.

af.title: Hoof Finansiële Beampte
af.summary: Hoof Finansiële Beampte-pos by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, waarvoor 'n CA(SA)-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring in senior finansies vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7 (baccalaureusgraad) in 'n relevante veld. Registrasie as 'n Geoktrooieerde Rekenmeester (CA(SA)) by die South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA). 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op middel-/senior bestuursvlak in Finansies. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Toelatingsertifikaat vir die Senior Management Service (SMS) soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur. Uitgebreide kennis van finansiële bestuur, die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP). Kennis van die plaaslike regeringssektor, asook van die Public Service Act en Regulasies. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, veranderingsbestuur, kennisbestuur en dienslewering-innovasie (SDI) vaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise, mensbestuur en bemagtiging, asook kliëntgerigtheid en klantediens vaardighede. Aandag aan besonderhede. Goed mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir strategiese toesig van finansiële bestuursdienste binne LOCMA. Neem algehele verantwoordelikheid vir algemene finansiële en bestuursrekenkunde-aktiwiteite, begrotingvoorbereiding en nakoming, inkomstesinsameling, voorsieningskettingbestuur, batesbestuur, salarisrol en bankfunksies, om nakoming van relevante wetgewing, voorskrifte, beleide en ooreenkomste te verseker. Stel rekenkundige en interne beheerstelsels, beleide en prosedures op, implementeer en verbeter dit in ooreenstemming met GRAP, die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en ander wetgewing. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n kostebestuursstrategie deur doeltreffende rekenkundige beheermaatreëls en finansiële bestuurstegnieke. Verseker nakoming van beleide, verskaf leiding, en assesser die risiko's en finansiële lewensvatbaarheid van bestaande en nuwe beleide, projekte en kliëntooreenkomste. Stuur die finansiële strategie van die organisasie om die beskikbaarheid van voldoende finansiële hulpbronne te verseker. Verskaf strategiese finansiële advies aan uitvoerende bestuur en die Raad. Verseker tydike en akkurate finansiële verslagdoening aan alle interne en eksterne bestuursstrukture. Stel parameters vir kontantvloei-bestuur en vir die werksaamhede van finansiespersoneel. Verseker die integriteit van finansiële data ten opsigte van tydigheid, akkuraatheid en betroubaarheid. Hou toesig en verskaf bystand tydens die jaarlikse oudit, reageer op ouditbevindings en implementeer aanbevelings soos vereis. Bly op hoogte van nuwe tendense in rekenkunde, finansiële bestuur en begroting. Verskaf strategiese rigting by die implementering van menslike hulpbronbeleide, voorskrifte en strategieë. Verseker die verskaffing van inligtingstegnologie (IT)-dienste en die doeltreffende mitigering van gepaardgaande risiko's. Verseker die verskaffing van kantoorondersteuningsdienste, insluitend fasiliteitsbestuur. Stel toepaslike diens- en personeelsvlakke vas, monitor en evalueer die doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit van diensleweringmetodes en prosedures, en allocateer hulpbronne dienooreenkomstig om LOCMA se strategiese prioriteite te bereik. Neem verantwoordelikheid vir die verwante afdelings van die Annual Performance Plan (APP), Aandeelhouersverdrag en Jaarrapport.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sezimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sezimali e-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Polokwane, esifuna izifundo ze-CA(SA) nokuhlola kweminye emihlanu e-omothwe uphathi ophezulu wezimali.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 7 (iziqu ze-bachelor) esikhundleni esifanele. Ukubhaliswa njengoChartered Accountant (CA(SA) ku-South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA). Ukuhlola okuncane kweminye yeshumi (5) emkhakheni womothi ophakathi/ophakeme ekuqashweni kwezimali. Ukuphothula ngempumelelo i-Pre- entry Certificate ye-Senior Management Service (SMS) njengokuvunyelwe yi-National School of Government. Ulwazi olubanzi lokuphathwa kwezimali, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP). Ulwazi ngomkhakha kahulumeni wendawo, kanye noMthetho Nezimiso Zomphakathi. Ikhono lokubheka phambili nokuqamba amasu, ukuphatha izinhlelo namaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuphathwa kolwazi kanye ne-service delivery innovation (SDI). Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphatha abantu nokunika amandla, kanye nokuqondiswa kwebhasikidi nelokusinikelwa ngokusimama. Ukuqonda izinkomba ngokucophelela. Ikhono elihle lokuthetha nokubhala. Ukubeka izibalo kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzinza.
zu.duties: Oqashiwe uzobe nesibopho sokubuka phambili ngokobuchule ekuphathweni kwezinkonzo zezimali ngaphakathi kwa-LOCMA. Ukuthatha isibopho sonke ekuphathweni kwezimali jikelele nemisebenzi yezimali yomphathi, ukulungiselela umthethosiko woholo kanye nokuthobela, ukuqoqa imali engenayo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza eziyi-chain, ukuphathwa kwamasheya, ukuhola kanye nemisebenzi yezibanki, kuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho, izimiso, izinqubomgomo kanye nezivumelwano ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukusungula, ukusebenzisa futhi ukuthuthukisa izimiso zokubala nezokulawula ngaphakathi, izinqubomgomo nezimiso ngokuthobela i-GRAP, i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations nomunye umthetho. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa isu lokuphatha izindleko ngokulawula ukubala ngokusebenza kanye namasu okuphatha izimali. Ukuthobela izinqubomgomo, ukunika isiqondiso, kanye nekuhlola ubungozi nokuza kwezimali kwezinqubomgomo ezikhona nezintsha, amaphrojekthi nezivumelwano zebasikeli. Ukweqa isu lezimali lenhlangano ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwezinsiza zezimali ezele. Ukunika izeluleko ezimali ezibheke phambili kubaphathi abaphakeme naseBhodini. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba khona okusheshise nokuhlakulekile kokubika ngemali kuzo zonke izakhiwo zokubusa ezingaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukubeka imingcele yokuphatha ukugeleza kwemali kanye nemisebenzi yabasebenzi bezimali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza kwemininingwane yezimali mayelana nesikhathi, ukuqiniseka nokuthembeka. Ukubuka phambili nokunika usizo ekuhloleni ngonyaka, ukuphendula iziphetho zokuhlola nokusebenzisa izincomo njengoko kudingeka. Ukuhlala usezindeni ngezinto ezintsha ezenzeka ekubaleni, ekuphathweni kwezimali nasekulungiseleleni umthethosiko woholo. Ukunika isiqondiso esibheke phambili ekusebenziseni izinqubomgomo zokuphatha abantu, izimiso kanye namasu. Ukuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokwaziswa ngekhompyutha (IT) kanye nokunciphisa ubungozi obuhlobene nalokho ngokusebenzayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokusekela ofisi, okubandakanya ukuphathwa kwesikhungo. Ukusungula izinga elifanele lezinkonzo nabasebenzi, ukulawula futhi ukuhlola ukusebenza nokuphumelela kwezindlela nezimiso zokunikeza izinkonzo, bese uhabelana izinsiza ngokufanele ukuze kuhambisane nobaluleke obubheke phambili be-LOCMA. Ukuthatha isibopho ngemiqulu ethize ye-Annual Performance Plan (APP), i-Shareholder Compact kanye ne-Annual Report.

xh.title: Nompempe weeMali
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wezeMali kwisebe lezeManzi nokuQhoboshela iindlwana ePolokwane, sifuna isigqibo se-CA(SA) kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava abaphathi abaphezulu kobuhlola bemali.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF level 7 (izidanga ze-bachelor) kwicala elicafungele kakhulu. Ubhaliso njengomchweli wee-akhawunti (CA(SA)) eSouth African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA). Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwinqanaba lomphathi ophakathi/ophezulu kwiMali. Ukuqhuba ngempumelelo isatifikethi sokuNgena ngaphambili sePre- entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) njengokuqinisekiswa yiNational School of Government. Ulwazi olubanzi lokulawula imali, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izikqubela ze Treasury Regulations nakuQqononqotha ngeendlela ezivunywe ngokubanzi (Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP)). Ulwazi ngabaphathi basekuhlaleni, nakwi-Public Service Act neZikqubela. Amandla okuzama nokuqhobosa iindaba, ulawulwezo lweenkqubo namaphulo, ulawulo lwemali, ulawulwezo lotshintsho, ulawulo lolwazi nakhono lokwenza izinto ezintsha ekulekeleleni abantu (SDI). Ulawulwezo lokusombulula iingxaki nohlolojlobo, ulawulo lomntu kanye nokuqinisekisa amandla abantu, nakhono lokuqwalasela abathengi nokubagxila kubo. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Izakhono ezilula zothetha nokuwvavanya. Ukuzekelela izenzo ezithile nokuziphatha ngokuzithobile.
xh.duties: Omlibeleli uyakuba ngumphathi wokulawula iinkqubo zeMali ngokweemvisiswano kwisebe i-LOCMA. Wamkele inyanisakho ngokubanzi lokuphathwa kwe-akhawunti zeeMali nokuLawulwa kweendleko, ulungiselelo lwesabelo semali nokuhambelana, ukuqokelelwa kweemali ezivela, ulawulwezo lokuqoka izinto, ulawulo lwempahla, ukuhlawulela abasebenzi nemisebenzi yeebhanki, kuqinisekiswa ukuhambelana nomthethonqobo, izalathiso, iinkqubo kunye neenkonzo. Misile, zisebenzise ziphucule iindlela ze-akhawunti nolawulwezo lwangaphakathi, iinkqubo kunye nemigaqo ngokuhambelana noQqononqotha (GRAP), i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations kunye nomnye umthetho. Yakha wizebenzise isicwangciso sokulawula iindleko ngokusetyenziswa kolawulo olusebenzayo lwe-akhawunti nokuSebenzisa iindlela zoLawulo lweMali. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana kwemigaqo, phathe ingxoxo, aze aqwalasele iingcatsho zemali kubakho aze athi ngasentla, iindaba ezintsha zomgaqo, iinkqubo namazwi abathengi. Qamba umthetho wolawulo lweMali kwintlangano ukwenzela ukuba luvekwe amathuba okufikelela imali ngokulula. Phatha iingcebiso zoMphathi weMali kwabaphathi ngokuphezulu kulo nakuBaphathi. Qinisekisa ukunikwa iingxelo ngeMali ngexesha elifanelekileyo ngokuchanekileyo kuzo zonke iindonga zolawulo ezikule nkqubo nangaphandle. Misela imida yokulawula imali ekhoyo nokumisebenzi yabasebenzi bemali. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kolwazi lweemali ngokwexesha, ukuchanekileyo nokuqinisekileyo. Phatha wizebonelele ngexesha lemvavanyo yonyaka, phendula iingcamu ezivunyiweyo uze uzisebenzise njengoko kufunekayo. Zibe utshatile ngeendleba ezintsha ze-akhawunti, ukulawulwa kweMali nokwabiwo-mali. Phethe iNdlela ngokulawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo zobuNtu, izalathiso nokuQhuba iindaba ezintsha. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweenkonzo ze-Information Technology (IT) kunye nokunciphisa ngokusebenzayo amathuba amakhulu. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweenkqubo zokuncedisa eofisi, kuquka nokulawulwa kweendawo ezikuso. Misela iinqanaba zolwazi kwabasebenzi nasezikhundleni, uqwalasele wovavabe ulusebenza-usebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangamandla iindlela zokuNika inkonzo, uze wabelwe izixhobo ngokufaneleyo ukuze uhlangabezane neenjongo ezibalulekileyo ze-LOCMA. Thathe inyanisakho ngamacandelo ahambelana no-Cwaka loPhumelelo lonyaka (Annual Performance Plan (APP)), uShareholder Compact neNgxelo yonyaka.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Institutional and Stakeholder
jobs.centre: Polokwane Ref No: LOCMA 27 Hartbeespoort Ref No: LOCMA 28
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for institutional and stakeholder engagement at the Department of Water and Sanitation, requiring five years of management experience in stakeholder development.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 6 qualification (National Diploma) in Social Sciences, Development Studies, Public Administration or a related field. Five (5) years’ management experience in stakeholder engagement or stakeholder development. Relevant experience in public participation and stakeholder management. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Understanding of the legislative and policy frameworks governing the water sector, including the National Water Act, 1998 (Act No. 36 of 1998). Understanding of the legislative and policy frameworks governing the public sector. Knowledge of policy development and implementation. Knowledge of financial management. Knowledge of programme and project management. Knowledge of conflict management tools and methodologies. Good communication, presentation, report writing and networking skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that Water Management Institutions are established, that stakeholders are empowered, and that stakeholder relationships and credibility are fostered within the Water Management Area. Lead and build the implementation of integrated stakeholder engagement programmes and initiatives, including developing and ensuring the implementation of the Stakeholder Engagement Plan. Plan and coordinate quarterly Catchment Management Forums, the annual Forum of Forums and ad hoc stakeholder engagement requests. Identify key projects, ensure that budget requests are made and Terms of Reference are developed, and oversee project implementation and overall project management. Coordinate consultation on the Catchment Management Strategy and link the CMA with water users. Establish and maintain stakeholder consultation forums and mechanisms. Coordinate stakeholder engagement processes for all projects and initiatives requiring stakeholder participation, including tariff consultations, Catchment Management Strategy (CMS) development and policy consultations by the National Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS), among others. Facilitate and support the transformation of irrigation boards into Water User Associations (WUAs). Identify, develop and implement capacity building and empowerment programmes for water management institutions and stakeholders, including traditional authorities, Historically Disadvantaged Individuals (HDIs), emerging farmers and irrigation boards. Promote knowledge generation and dissemination, and identify, develop and ensure the implementation of education and awareness programmes and campaigns for the benefit of water resources, stakeholders, the CMA, the water sector and communities. Manage cooperative governance and strategic partnership relations, including developing policies, procedures and service level agreements in line with mandates. Identify and lead initiatives to secure funding and strategic partnerships that support the CMA’s mission and sustainability objectives. Mobilise and engage stakeholders who will benefit from project interventions, identify key stakeholders to be consulted during the design phase, and define partnership requirements for support and co-funding at various levels. Facilitate and support government negotiations and consultations on project-related issues, and link key personnel with relevant CMA personnel within the water sector, government departments, stakeholder organisations and communities. Collaborate and coordinate Integrated Water Resource Management (IWRM) for socio-economic and environmental development, and lead LOCMA’s participation in engagements with Water Management Institutions. Define the roles and responsibilities of implementing partners and reporting arrangements and develop gender- and social- vulnerability-sensitive work plans with detailed roles, responsibilities and timelines. Develop and conduct stakeholder satisfaction surveys and manage the integrated stakeholder database and stakeholder matrix for the CMA. Define a strategic results framework and monitoring and evaluation system with quantifiable and verifiable impact indicators and elaborate a sustainability strategy to ensure that project benefits are replicated beyond project life. Manage the resources of the sub-directorate, including work allocation, discipline and performance management of employees, and the recommendation and allocation of equipment. Provide support on policies and directives.
