All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Institutioneel en Belanghebbendes
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir institutionele en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid by die Department of Water and Sanitation, wat vyf jaar se bestuurservaring in belanghebbende-ontwikkeling vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Terugvoerende NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma) in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Ontwikkelingsstudies, Publieke Administrasie of 'n verwante veld. Vyf (5) jaar se bestuurservaring in belanghebbende-betrokkenheid of belanghebbende-ontwikkeling. Terugvoerende ervaring in openbare deelname en belanghebbende-bestuur. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Begrip van die wetgewende en beleidraamwerke wat die watersektor regeer, insluitend die National Water Act, 1998 (Act No. 36 of 1998). Begrip van die wetgewende en beleidraamwerke wat die openbare sektor regeer. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Kennis van finansiële bestuur. Kennis van program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van konflikbestuursinstrumente en -metodologieë. Goeie kommunikasie-, voorleggings-, verslagskrywings- en netwerkvaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampseienaar sal verantwoordelik wees daarvoor om te verseker dat Waterbestuursinstellings tot stand gebring word, dat belanghebbendes bemagtig word, en dat belanghebbende-verhoudinge en geloofwaardigheid binne die Waterbestuursgebied bevorder word. Lei en bou die implementering van geïntegreerde belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsprogramme en -inisiatiewe, insluitend die ontwikkeling en versekering van die implementering van die Belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsplan. Beplan en koördineer kwartaallikse Opvanggebiedbestuursforums, die jaarlikse Forum van Forums en ad hoc-belanhebbende-betrokkenheidsversoeke. Identifiseer sleutelprojekte, verseker dat begrotingsversoeke gedoen en aanvoeringsverwysings ontwikkel word, en hou toesig oor projekimplementering en algehele projekbestuur. Koördineer raadpleging oor die Opvanggebiedbestuurstrategie en skakel die CMA met watergebruikers. Vestig en handhaaf belanghebbende-raadplegingsforums en -meganismes. Koördineer belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsprosesse vir alle projekte en inisiatiewe wat belanghebbende-deelname vereis, insluitend tarieforaadleggings, Opvanggebiedbestuurstrategie (CMS)-ontwikkeling en beleidsraadleggings deur die National Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS), onder andere. Fasiliteer en ondersteun die transformasie van besproeiingsrade na Watergebruikersverenigings (WUAs). Identifiseer, ontwikkel en implementeer kapasiteitsbou- en bemagtigingsprogramme vir waterbestuursinstellings en belanghebbendes, insluitend tradisionele owerhede, Histories Benadeelde Individue (HBI's), opkomende boere en besproeiingsrade. Bevorder kennisgenerering en -verspreiding, en identifiseer, ontwikkel en verseker die implementering van opvoedings- en bewustheidsprogramme en -veldtogte tot voordeel van waterhulpbronne, belanghebbendes, die CMA, die watersektor en gemeenskappe. Bestuur samewerkende regering en strategiese vennootskapverhoudings, insluitend die ontwikkeling van beleide, prosedures en diensvlakooreenkomste in ooreenstemming met mandate. Identifiseer en lei inisiatiewe om befondsing en strategiese vennootskappe te bekom wat die CMA se missie en volhoubaarheidsdoelwitte ondersteun. Mobiliseer en betrek belanghebbendes wat van projekintervensies sal voordeel trek, identifiseer sleutelbelanghebbendes wat tydens die ontwerpfase geraadpleeg moet word, en definieer vennootskapvereistes vir ondersteuning en medebefondsing op verskeie vlakke. Fasiliteer en ondersteun regeringsonderhandelinge en -raadlegings oor projekteverwante kwessies, en skakel sleutelpersoneel met tersaaklike CMA-personeel binne die watersektor, regeringsdepartemente, belanghebbende-organisasies en gemeenskappe. Werk saam en koördineer Geïntegreerde Waterhulpbronbestuur (IWRM) vir sosio-ekonomiese en omgewingsontwikkeling, en lei LOCMA se deelname in betrekkinge met Waterbestuursinstellings. Definieer die rolle en verantwoordelikhede van implementerende vennote en verslagdoeningsreëlings, en ontwikkel geslags- en sosiale-kwesbaarheid-sensitiewe werksplanne met gedetailleerde rolle, verantwoordelikhede en tydlyne. Ontwikkel en voer belanghebbende-tevredenheidsopnames uit en bestuur die geïntegreerde belanghebbende-databasis en belanghebbende-matriks vir die CMA. Definieer 'n strategiese resultaatraamwerk en moniterings- en evalueringstelsel met kwantifiseerbare en verifieerbare impak-aanwysers, en brei 'n volhoubaarheidsstrategie uit om te verseker dat projekvoordele buite projeklewe herhaal word. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die subdirektoraat, insluitend werksverdeling, dissipline en prestasiebestuur van werknemers, en die aanbeveling en toekenning van toerusting. Verskaf ondersteuning oor beleide en richtlyne.

zu.title: Omesi weNqophamlando: Ezelwe izikhungo nabahloniphwe
zu.summary: Omesi weNqophamlando wokuzibandakanya nezikhungo nabahloniphwe eDepartment of Water and Sanitation, ofuna iminyaka emihlanu yohluleko lokuphatha ekuthuthukisweni kwabahloniphwe.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezinga le-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) kwezikaZesayensi Ezentando yabantu, izifundo zokuthuthukiswa, uCandulo loluhleloluntu noma inkundla ehlobene. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yohluleko lokuphatha ekuzibandakanyeni abahloniphwe noma ekuthuthukisweni kwabahloniphwe. Uhluleko oluhlobene nentanyana yomphakathi nokuphathwa kwabahloniphwe. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokuqasha enyuzileyo engazange iphelelwe yisikhathi. Ukuqonda izakhiwo zomthetho namapholisi abephatha umkhakazi wamanzi, okuhlanganisa i-National Water Act, 1998 (Act No. 36 of 1998). Ukuqonda izakhiwo zomthetho namapholisi abephatha umkhakazi womphakathi. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa nokuphunyulwa kwamapholisi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezimali. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi ngamathuluzi nezindlela zokuphatha ingxabano. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, okubhala imibiko, okwenza izethulo nokwakha ugxuba-lwazi. Ubunye nemikhuba engcono.
zu.duties: Omulandeli uzobe ngumuntu ophethe ukuthi izikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zisungulwe, ukuthi abahloniphwe bakha amandla, futhi ukuthi ubudlelwano nobugqoqelelo babahloniphwe basekelwe ngaphakathi kwesifunda sokuphathwa kwamanzi. Ukuba ngumholi nokwakha ukuphunyulwa kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo zokuzibandakanya abahloniphwe ohlanganyelweni, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuqinisekiswa ukuphunyulwa kohlaka lokuzibandakanya abahloniphwe. Ukucubungula futhi uhuquze izinkumbi zokuqoqwa kwemibuzo ze-Catchment Management Forums ezikuthathu ngonyaka, i-forum yamawhola yonyaka nezicelo zokuzibandakanya abahloniphwe ezingajewayelekile. Ukuqapha amaphrojekthi abalulekile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izicelo zebhajethi zenziwe futhi i-Terms of Reference zithuthukiswe, futhi uqaphele ukuphunyulwa kwephrojekthi nokuphathwa kwephrojekthi jikelele. Ukuhuquza inxulumano ngemibuzo mayelana nomkhuba wokuqoqwa kwemibuzo we-Catchment Management Strategy uxhume i-CMA nabasebenzisi bamanzi. Ukusungula futhi ukugcina izinkundla zokuxhumana nabahloniphwe nezindlela ezahlukene. Ukuhuquza inqubo yokuzibandakanya abahloniphwe kuzo zonke izinhlelo nezinhlela ezidinga ukuzibandakanya kwabahloniphwe, okuhlanganisa ukuxoxwa ngamathelifu, ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Catchment Management Strategy (CMS) nezixoxwi zamapholisi eNational Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS), phakathi kwabanye. Ukweseka futhi ukwenza kube lula ukuguqulwa kwezinkampani zokuhlinzela ngamanzi zaba ngama-Water User Associations (WUAs). Ukuqapha, ukuthuthukisa futhi kuphunyulwe izinhlelo zokwakha amandla nokweseka izikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi nabahloniphwe, okuhlanganisa iziphathimandla zendabuko, abantu ababenge benelungelo ngokomlando (Historically Disadvantaged Individuals (HDIs)), abalimi abaphuma abafundwe izikhungo nezinkampani zokuhlinzela ngamanzi. Ukukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwanulwazi nokusabalalisa kwalo, futhi ukuqapha, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuphunyulwa kwezinhlelo namakhasimende emfundo nokuqaphisa okuzuzisa amanzi, abahloniphwe, i-CMA, umkhakazi wamanzi futhi izehlakalo eziningi. Ukuphatha ugxuba-lwazi ngokuphathwa kwezimali nokuphathwa kobuhlobo ngokulinganisela izinhloso, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamapholisi, izinqubo nezivumelwano zenqanaba lenkonzo ngokusebenzisa imithetho yomkhakazi. Ukuqapha futhi uhule izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuxhaswa ngemali nobuhlobo obulinganisela okusekela umnyaka nezinhloso zokugcina amandla i-CMA. Ukubutha futhi uxhumanise nabahloniphwe abozuzisa ukungenelela amaphrojekthi, ukuqapha abahloniphwe abalulekile okuzoxoxwa nabo esigabeni sokumisa inqubo, futhi ucacise izidingo zobuhlobo zokusekela nokuxhaswa ngemabi kumakhulu amanye. Ukweseka futhi ukwenza kube lula izingxoxo zikahulumbe nemibuzo mayelana nezinkinga ezihlobene namaphrojekthi, futhi uxhume abantu abaphethe nabahlobene nezisebenzi i-CMA ngaphakathi komkhakazi wamanzi, izikhungo kahulumbe, izinhlangano zabahloniphwe futhi izehlakalo eziningi. Ukuxhumanisa futhi uhuquze i-Integrated Water Resource Management (IWRM) mayelana nentuthuko yezomnotho nemmango, futhi uhule ukuzibandakanya kwe-LOCMA ezinkulumweni ngezikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi. Ukuqapha futhi ucacise izigaba nezibopho zezinyanga eziphoqwe izinhlelo futhi uthuthukise amaphulani abuka ngokobulili bemithelela iyonke nangokwengozi eyisimo esibi ngaphakathi komphakathi anezigaba ezicacile, izibopho futhi amakhele wethemba. Ukuthuthukisa futhi enze izivivinyo ezibuka ukwaneliseka kwabahloniphwe futhi aphathe idethabhesi ebandakanya abahloniphwe bonke kanye namathuluzi wokuqoqa imininingwane we-CMA. Ukuqamba inqubo yezinzipho zokubukwa futhi uhlelo lokubuka futhi uqagule imiphumela ngokulinganisa imiphumada engenakutholakala ngokulinganisa futhi wenze inqubo eqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yephrojekthi iphindwe ngemva kwesikhathi sephrojekthi. Ukuphatha amandla zesikhungo esingaphansi kwegunya, okuhlanganisa ukwabiwa kwebhalaza, isibopho nokuphathwa kwezimbalwa zabasebenzi, futhi ukuphakamisa futhi ukwabiwa kwemishini yokusebenza. Ukunika ukusekela ngezinhlinzo namapholisi.

xh.title: Isebe leNdibano kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba: Umongameli wamaNqanaba
xh.summary: Umongameli wokuqhuba iindibano zoluntu kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba kwiSebe lezeManzi nokuQhoboshwa, efuna eminyaka mihlanu yamava okulawula ekuphuhlisweni kubathathi-nxaxheba.
xh.requirements: Izifyezo ezifanelekileyo zesigaba se-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) kwiZocial Sciences, Development Studies, Public Administration okwenzinye inkalo ephathelene nayo. Eminyaka mihlanu (5) yamava okulawula ekunxibelelaneni nabathathi-nxaxheba okanye ekuphuhliseni abathathi-nxaxheba. Amava afanelekileyo ekuthatheni inxaxheba komntu wonke nakulawulweni abathathi-nxaxheba. Ukuzisa irayisense yokushayela esebenzayo nengazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zomthetho nezenzo-mthetho ezilawula inqanaba lemanzi, kuquka noMthetho weSizwe wokuManzi, 1998 (Act No. 36 of 1998). Ukuqonda iinkqubo zomthetho nezenzo-mthetho ezilawula inkqubo yoluntu. Ulwazi ngokuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo-zabakho. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweemali. Ulwazi ngokulawula iinkqubo neeprojekthi. Ulwazi ngezixhobo neendlela zokulawula ingxabano. Amakhono amabalulekileyo ekunxibelelaneni, okubonisa ngokubhalwayo, kokubhala iiripoti nasekuzakhiweni kweenxibelelwano. Ixabiso lokuziphatha ngokunyanzelekileyo nokuthembeka.
xh.duties: Umntu oze kule sithuba uya kuba nogakulo lokwenza iqinisekiso ukuba amaNqanaba oLawulo loManzi asekelwe, ukuba abathathi-nxaxheba banamandla, nasekukhulisweni kweenxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba nentsheniso ekuNdaweni yoLawulo loManzi. Ukulawula nasekwakheni ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokunxibelelana nabathathi-nxaxheba, kuquka nokuphuhliswa nokwenziwa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoNxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba. Ukucwangcisa ukuqamba iindlela zokudibana ngenyanga yamakhulu (quarterly) iCatchment Management Forums, iForum yamakhulu ngamnye (annual Forum of Forums) nezicelo ezingezizo ezisoloko zenzeka zokunxibelelana nabathathi-nxaxheba. Ukuqonda iiprojekthi ezingundoqo, kuqinisekiswa ukuba kwenziwa izicelo ze-bajeti nezalathiso zemiqathango (Terms of Reference), nokuqonda nokuphatha iiprojekthi jikelele. Ukulawula ingxoxo ngoBucwangciso boLawulo lwamajelo amanzi (Catchment Management Strategy) nokudibanisa i-CMA nabasebenzisi bamanzi. Ukuseka nokuqhuba amagunya onxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba. Ukulawula iinkqubo zokunxibelelana nabathathi-nxaxheba zonke iiprojekthi neenkqubo ezifuna uxaxhwebo lwabathathi-nxaxheba, kuquka nengxoxo ngezimali ezihlawulwayo (tariff consultations), ukuphuhlisa iCatchment Management Strategy (CMS) nengxoxo ngeenkqubo-zabakho yiSebe leSizwe leManzi nokuQhoboshwa (National Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS)), nakwezinye iindawo. Ukukhuthaza nokuqhuba ukuguqulwa kwee-irrigation boards zaba ziqumrhu zabaSebenzisi bamanzi (Water User Associations (WUAs)). Ukuqonda, ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokwakha amandla nokunika amandla amaqumrhu oLawulo lwamanzi kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba, kuquka nabalawuli besiNtsatsa (traditional authorities), abantu abangachazwanga ngokutsha nangokwezembali (Historically Disadvantaged Individuals (HDIs)), abalimi abasakhulayo (emerging farmers) kumava bamanzi (irrigation boards). Ukukhuthaza ukudalwa kolwazi nokuhanjiswa kwako, ukuqonda ukuyiphuhlisa nekuqinisekisa ukusetbenziswa kweenkqubo kunye namashishini okufundisa nokwenza izaziso ngokuzalathisa ngeenjongo eziphuhliswa amanzi, abathathi-nxaxheba, i-CMA, inqanaba lemanzi nasekuqhubeni iindawo. Ukulawula ukulawulwa ngokubambisana koluntu nokuhamba kunye nobudlelwane ngokuseta iinkqubo, iinkqubo-zabakho nezivumelwano zenqanaba lokonwabelelwano ngokwemithetho esemthethweni. Ukuqonda nokuqamba iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa imali nendlela yokuhamba ngokubambisana ezixhasa i-CMA ekwenzini umsebenzi wayo nakuqinisekiseni ukuzinza. Ukubutha nokudibana nabathathi-nxaxheba abaya kuzuza kwiinkqubo zokungenelela, ukuqonda abathathi-nxaxheba abangundoqo abakufuneka kumathongo ingxoxo ngexesha lesigaba sokuzoba, nokuqamba iinkqubo zohambo lokuxhasa nasekunikelweni imali kwisixa kwamanye amanqanaba. Ukukhuthaza nokuqhuba iingxoxo zeluluntu ngingqungqutha ezibangelwa iiprojekthi, nokudibanisa abantu abangundoqo kw-i-CMA kuluntu lonke ngokuseta iinkqubo kwilwandle lwamanzi, iindawo zeluntu, abathathi-nxaxheba nasekuqhubeni iindawo. Ukusebenza kunye nokulawula ukulawulwa kokubambisana amanzi kwimpilo yetyhenthe (Integrated Water Resource Management (IWRM)) ekuzonwabeni ngokwamachokochwe ngokwendalo, nokuqamba ukuzanywa kwe-LOCMA ekudibeni ngokubambisana kwamagunya oLawulo loManzi. Ukuqamba iindlela kunye nabathathi abalawula nokwenza iinkqubo ngendlela yokwazisa ukuba ngubani othini nakuba ngubani onika ingxelo ngokobudlelwane bobulungisa nobungakanani balo kwakunye nokuqamba iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa ezibandakanya ukubeka kwindawo esecweni iindidi zokutsha kwakunye nokubandakanyeka kwendalo ezinokubakho ngokubukhali balo, nasekwaziseni indlela egqithisela ukwenza okungalawulwa (socially-vulnerable). Ukuphuhliswa nokwenziwa kwesiphithiphithi sabathathi-nxaxheba kumava abo nokulawulwa kweqembu lemiba eyahlukeneyo yabathathi-nxaxheba ngokubanzi nakule-requbhe yothe-abathathi-nxaxheba kwakunye nokusetyenziswa iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezingundoqo zokulawula iindidi ezahlukeneyo zabathathi-nxaxheba kwandawo yokubakhulisa nokubakhusela kwindalo ngokwakha amandla abo nakwezinye iinkqubo ezikwakhulisa amandla abathathi-nxaxheba bakwindawo nasekuqhubeni kwamagunya esiNtsatsa nakumakhaya nokubakwazise ekubakhuseleni nakwamanye amagunya aphathelene nawo nokubakwazi ekunxibelelaneni nabathathi-nxaxheba ngokubakhusela nokubakwazi ukubamba inqanaba ngokubakhusela kwizinto ezinokubakho ngokungakhuseliwa kokusesikweni kwesini nokuhlangabezana kwengqondo zokutsha nokukhuliswa kwemimiselo yenqanaba elifanelekileyo nokubakhusela kwindawo ekufuneka kusetyenziswe ngokukhuthele iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokulawula nokuxhasa amagunya nokuqinisekisa ukuba ngowonke wonke umntu unelungelo lokuphila ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo ukuzalathisa ngokubakhusela ekutshintshweni kwemozulu nokusetenziswa kwethamsanqa. Ukuphuhlisa nokwenza izinto ngokukhutheleyo ngokusebenzisa amathamsanqa ahambe phambili ekusebenziseni okusemthethweni iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikwazisa ukuba ngowonke umntu usebenzisa ngokukhuthele iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikwazisa ukuba ngowonke umntu unelungelo lokuphila ngokukhuthele ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikwazisa ukuba ngowonke umntu unelungelo lokuzinza nokuzimela kwendlela ezahlukeneyo ezikwazisa ukuba ngowonke umntu unelungelo lokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikwazisa ukuba ngowonke umntu unelungelo lokuphila kwendlela ezahlukeneyo ezikwazisa ukuba ngowonke umntu unelungelo lokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Administration Officer (MR-6)
jobs.summary: Senior Legal Administration Officer in Polokwane at the Department of Water and Sanitation, requiring an LLB and eight years of legal experience.
jobs.requirements: An LLB degree or equivalent qualification. At least eight (8) years' appropriate post-qualification legal experience. Knowledge of policy development and implementation. Knowledge of government legal processes, legislation and contracts. Knowledge of the Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (PAIA), the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 (PAJA), the Constitution and all relevant legislation, including the Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ability to negotiate and draft contracts and international instruments. Ability to interpret specific environmental legislation and issues affecting the environment, as well as general environmental law. Legal research and interpretation. Analytical and report-writing skills. Programme and project management. Computer literacy. Good planning and decision-making skills. Language proficiency. Confidentiality. Excellent communication skills (written and verbal). Strategic capability and leadership skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for providing legal advisory services to LOCMA and its functionaries. Conduct, analyse, interpret, advise and mentor juniors on research that will provide information and case law relevant to the legal matter at hand, including providing legal support to ensure compliance with relevant legislation, collecting and analysing data and information for planning, decision-making and management reporting, analysing current policies and strategic objectives, developing standard operating procedures, and compiling research memoranda. Draft legal documents and advise and mentor juniors on legal drafting, including drafting legal documents, memoranda, reports and submissions, drafting, vetting and reviewing contracts on behalf of LOCMA, drafting legal opinions and documents to support criminal prosecutions for contraventions of the National Water Act, negotiating and drafting multilateral and bilateral agreements, ensuring compliance with the Constitution and domestic and international legal obligations, rendering legal support in all litigation matters, and obtaining outstanding information and initiating the recovery process, including issuing letters of demand. Present on and advise and mentor juniors on proposals on how specific cases should be approached, including receiving, recording and assessing new matters, advising clients on possible courses of action during consultation, and drafting legal opinions on behalf of LOCMA. Conduct interviews to determine clients' goals and objectives, including handling litigation matters and appeals, including National Water Tribunal appeals, on behalf of LOCMA, monitoring court cases from inception to final stage, liaising with the Office of the State Attorney on litigation matters, and keeping the litigation register updated. Document interviews and all legal advice given during legal consultation in writing, including monitoring the implementation of PAIA and PAJA, ensuring compliance and handling PAIA and PAJA matters on behalf of LOCMA, and submitting recommendations, queries and comments to clients. Develop and coach others and constructively review their work in order to improve and advance the skills, knowledge and performance levels of those who report to them, including providing advice and guidance to lower-level production employees on advanced interview techniques to address sensitive or complicated issues, providing sound legal advice that serves the interests of LOCMA, monitoring performance and service delivery targets, and measuring and improving work methods, procedures and systems.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. af.title: Senior Regsadministrasiebeampte (MR-6)
af.summary: Senior Regsadministrasiebeampte in Polokwane by die Department of Water and Sanitation, wat 'n LLB en agt jaar se regservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n LLB-graad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Ten minste agt (8) jaar se toepaslike post-kwalifikasie regservaring. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en implementering. Kennis van regeringsregslitigasieprosesse, wetgewing en kontrakte. Kennis van die Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (PAIA), die Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 (PAJA), die Grondwet en alle ter sake wetgewing, insluitend die Tesourieregulasies. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Vermoe om te onderhandel en kontrakte en internasionale instrumente op te stel. Vermoe om spesifieke omgewingswetgewing en kwessies wat die omgewing raak, asook algemene omgewingsreg te interpreteer. Regsnavorsing en interpretasie. Analitiese en verslagdoeningvaardighede. Program- en projekbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goed.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van regsp adviesdienste aan LOCMA en sy funksionarisse. Voer ondersoek uit, ontleed, interpreteer, gee advies en mentork junior oor navorsing wat inligting en gevalregsal wat ter sake is by die huidige regsaak, insluitend die verskaffing van regsteun om nakoming van ter sake wetgewing te verseker, die versameling en ontleding van data en inligting vir beplanning, besluitneming en bestuursverslagdoening, die ontleding van huidige beleide en strategiese oogmerke, die ontwikkeling van standaard bedryfsprosedures, en die samestelling van navorsingsmemoranda. Stel regsdokumente op en gee advies en mentork junior oor regsdienstopstel, insluitend die opstel van regsdokumente, memoranda, verslae en voorleggings, die opstel, deurlees en hersiening van kontrakte namens LOCMA, die opstel van regsmenings en dokumente ter ondersteuning van strafregtelike vervolging vir oortredings van die National Water Act, die onderhandel en opstel van multilaterale en bilaterale ooreenkomste, die verseker van nakoming van die Grondwet en binnelandse en internasionale regverpligtinge, die lewer van regsteun in alle litigasiesake, en die verkryg van uitstaande inligting en die inisieer van die herstelproses, insluitend die uitreik van eisbriewe. Verrig voordragte oor en gee advies en mentork junior oor voorstelle oor hoe spesifieke sake benader behoort te word, insluitend die ontvangs, optekening en assessering van nuwe sake, die advisering van kliënte oor moontlike optredes gedurende konsultasie, en die opstel van regsmenings namens LOCMA. Voer onderhoude om kliënte se doelwitte en oogmerke te bepaal, insluitend die hantering van litigasiesake en appèlle, insluitend National Water Tribunal-appèlle, namens LOCMA, die monitering van hofsake vanaf aanvang tot finale fase, die skakeling met die Office of the State Attorney oor litigasiesake, en die opdatum-hou van die litigasieregister. Teken onderhoude en alle regsadvies tydens regskonsultasie skriftelik aan, insluitend die monitering van die implementering van PAIA en PAJA, die verseker van nakoming en die hantering van PAIA- en PAJA-sake namens LOCMA, en die voorlê van aanbevelings, navrae en kommentaar aan kliënte. Ontwikkel en afrig ander en hersien hul werk konstruktief om die vaardighede, kennis en prestasievlakke van diegene wat aan hulle verslag doen, te verbeter en te bevorder, insluitend die verskaffing van advies en leiding aan laer-vlak produksiewerknemers oor gevorderde onderhoudtegnieke om sensitiewe of ingewikkelde kwessies aan te spreek, die verskaffing van goeie regsadvies wat die belange van LOCMA dien, die monitering van prestasie- en diensleweringsteikens, en die meet en verbeter van werkmetodes, prosedures en stelsels.

zu.title: Onogqoza Wezomthetho Abaphezulu Bombuso (MR-6)
zu.summary: Onogqoza Wezomthetho Abaphezulu Bombuso ePolokwane eDepartment of Water and Sanitation, edinga i-LLB neminyaka yisishiyagalombili yesipiliyoni sezomthetho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-LLB noma iziqu ezingefaniyo. Ubuncane beminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (8) yesipiliyoni esifanele somthetho emva kweziqu. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa nokuphunyuliswa kwezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi ngalezo zinqubo zomthetho zikahulumende, umthetho namasivumelwano. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo sokufinyelela kolwazi, 2000 (PAIA), ukuthuthukiswa komthetho wobulungiswa obuphathwayo, 2000 (PAJA), uMthethosisekelo nalo wonke umthetho ohambisanayo, okuhlanganisa nemiyalo yeTreasury. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuqapha imali yomphakathi (PFMA). Ikono lokuxoxisana nokubhala amasivumelwano nezinsimamahle zamazwe ngamazwe. Ikono lokutolikha umthetho ohlezelwe indawo nemibuzo ethinta indawo, kanye nomthetho jikelele wezemvelo. Ucwaningo nokutolikwa komthetho. Amandla okuhlaziya nokubhala umbiko. Ulawulwemisebenzi nemiklamo yohlelo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amandla okucubungula kahle nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukukhuluma/kubhala izilimi kahle. Ukugcina imfihlo. Amandla aphezulu okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Ikono elikhulu lokubumba ikusasa nobuholi. Ubunjalo nobuziphathamthetho.
zu.duties: Umntu ozoba kulesi sikhundla uzobe egxile ekunikezeni izeluleko ezomthetho kwi-LOCMA nabasebenzi bayo. Ukwenza, ukuhlaziya, ukutolikha, ukweluleka nokuyala abasha ngocwaningo oluzohlinzeka ngolwazi kanye nemithetho yamacala ehambisana naleso sibalo somthetho okuthintwe sona, okuhlanganisa nokunika inkxaso yomthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuziphathwa kocingo lomthetho ohambisanayo, ukuqoqa ukuhlaziya idatha nolwazi lokuqamba izinhlelo, ukuthatha izinqumo nokubika kokuqonda, ukuhlaziya izinqubomgomo zamanje nemigomo enkulu yokubamba iqhaza, ukuthuthukisa izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza, kanye nokubhala amamoranda ocwaningo. Ukubhala amadokhumenta omthetho nokweluleka nokuyala abasha ngokubhala ngomthetho, okuhlanganisa nokubhala amadokhumenta omthetho, amamoranda, amaberhiwe nokungenisa kwabanye, ukubhala, ukuhlola nokubuka kabusha amasivumelwano ngesikhundla se-LOCMA, ukubhala izinhliziyo zomthetho namadokhumenta ukusekela ukushwabadela ngokungalawuleki kweNational Water Act, ukuxoxisana nokubhala izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe eziyinkimbinkimbi kanye nezibili, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela uMthethosisekelo namanye amazwe ngokomthetho okumele awuhloniphe, ukunikela inkxaso yomthetho kunoma yisiphi isimo somthetho, kanye nokuqoqa ulwaze olungalungile nokuqala inqubo yokubuyisana, okuhlanganisa nokuthumela amagama besebenzisa amaphepha. Kunikeza izincomo, ukweluleka nokuyala abasha ngokuthi izimo ezithize zingasingathwa kanjani, okuhlanganisa nokwamukela, ukuqamba nokuhlaziya izinto ezintsha, ukweluleka abathengi ngamanye amathuba ekuyophiwa kuwo ngesikhathi kubizwa, nokubhala amagama ngokomthetho ngesikhundla se-LOCMA. Kubize abantu izingxoxo ukuthola ukuthi abathengi bafuna ukufinyelela okumele bakufinyelele, okuhlanganisa nokusingatha izimo ezimali nomthetho kanye nezinye izibhalo zalokho, kanye nezinye izibhalo ze-National Water Tribunal, ngesikhundla se-LOCMA, ukuqapha amacala othintana nawo enkantolo kusukela ekuqaleni kuye kwagcina, ukuxhumana ne-Office of the State Attorney ngezimali zenkantolo, nokugcina isibhalo sezimali sibuyekezwe. Ubhale zonke izingxoxo nayo yonke izeluleko ezomthetho ezinikiwe ngesikhathi kubizwa ngokomthetho, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola iphini ngokugxilwe ekuphunyulweni kwe-PAIA ne-PAJA, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela nokusingata izimali ezimali ze-PAIA ne-PAJA ngesikhundla se-LOCMA, nokuthumela izincomo, imibuzo namanothi kwabathengi. Thuthukisa futhi ucoche abanye ubuyekeze umsebenzi wabo ngokwakha ukuze ukhulise uthuthukise amandla, ulwazi izinga lokusebenza labo ababikhubekile, okuhlanganisa ukunika izincomo noholo kulabo abasebenza ngaphansi ukuze bathuthukise amandla awo, ngamandla okuhlola izinto ezibucayi noma ezinzima ukuziqonda, ukunika izeluleko ezinhle ngomthetho ezikhonzela izinkomba ze-LOCMA, ukuhlola ukusebenza futhi abeke izinhloso zokulethwa kwenkonzo, futhi ukanqume futhi akhulise izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi, izinqubo kanye nezimiso.

xh.summary: Isikhulu Esinemvuzo oPhakamileyo Sokulawula Izomthetho kwiPolokwane kwiSebe leZamanzi nokuQhotyoshelwa, lifuna i-LLB nenyanga ezisixho (8) zemfundo yezomthetho.
xh.requirements: I degree ye-LLB okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Inyanga ezisixho (8) ubuncinane zemfundo yezomthetho edibana nezinto ezifanelekileyo emva kokuqesha. Ulwazi ngokusungula nokusebenzisa iinkqubomgomo. Ulwazi ngokusesikweni kwamagqabantshi amthetho karhulumente, urhulumente kunye namagqabantshi. Ulwazi loMthetho wokuPhakamisa iNkqazo kwiNkcazelo, 2000 (i-PAIA), uMthetho wokuPhakamisa uBulungisa kwiBhalo, 2000 (i-PAJA), uMthethosiseko nayo yonke imithetho edibana nayo, kuquka noMthetho weQela leMali. Ulawulo lokutolika imithetho edibana nendalo nemiplumbo ekuthintela indalo, kunye namthetho wendalo jikelele. Uphando nomthetho nokutolika. Iimpawu zokuhlalutywa ngebalo nokuBhala iNgingxoxo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo nemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwamakompyutha. Amaboni amnandi eplani nokuthatha iinkqubo. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolwimi. Ukubekwa iinkxalabo ezingaziwa. Amaboni amnandi ekunxibelelwano (ngebhalo nangomlomo). Iimpawu zokuqonda iinkqubo zangaphambili kunye no Bukhosi. Ubuni nendlela yokwenza iinkqubo ngokuzithoba.

Ukwenza, ukuhlalutya, ukutolika, ukunika ingcebiso nokufundisa abasebenzi abangatshatanga ngophando oluya kubonelela ngenkcazelo nangemithetho yokugqibela edibana nomthetho osekuyo, kuquka nokubonelela ngenkxaso yomthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzithoba kwemithetho edibana nayo, ukuyiqonga nokuhlalutya iinkcukacha neenkcazelo zeplani, ukuthatha iinkqubo nokubika ngokulawula, ukuhlalutya iinkqubomgomo zangoku kunye nemigangatho eqambwayo, ukusungula iinkqubo zokuqhuba ngokwesiko, nokubhala iingxoxo zophando. Ukubhala amaxwebhu ezoMthetho nokunika ingcebiso nokufundisa abasebenzi abangatshatanga ngokubhala ngomthetho, kuquka nokubhala amaxwebhu ezoMthetho, iingxoxo, iingxoxo nokuBhalisa, ukubhala, ukuqinisekisa nokuphefa amagqabantshi ngenkxaso ye-LOCMA, ukubhala iingxoxo ezoMthetho namaxwebhu ukuxhasa izityholo ezingummthetho ngokuchasana noMthetho weZamanzi kazwelonke, ukuxoxa nokubhala izivumelwano ezibini nangaphezulu, ukuqinisekisa ukuzithoba kuMthethosiseko nokuThobela imithetho yangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukubonelela ngenkxaso yomthetho kuzo zonke iingxoxo zomthetho, nokuthola iinkcazelo ezingekwayo kuqalise inkqubo yokubuyisa, kuquka nokuthumela iileta zokuFuna. Okokubonisa kwaye kunike ingcebiso nokufundisa abasebenzi abangatshatanga ngemiqulu engathunyelwa ngokwendlela ekufuneka iqhoqwe ngayo imicimbi ethile, kuquka nokwamkela, ukubhala nokulinganisa imicimbi entsha, ukunika abathengi ingcebiso ngamagama angathathwa ngexesha lokubonisana, nokubhala iingcebiso zomthetho ngenkxaso ye-LOCMA. Ukwenza iingxoxo ukuze kugqitywe iinjongo nemiqulu yabathengi, kuquka nokusingatha iingxoxo zomthetho nezinyanzelelwa, kuquka iinyanzelelwa zeNkqubo yokuGqiba iMali kazwelonke, ngenkxaso ye-LOCMA, ukuqonda iindweba zengxoxo zomthetho ukusuka ekuqaliseni de kufike kwisigaba sokuQhela, ukuqhagamshelana neQela loGqirha woLuntu kwiindweba zengxoxo zomthetho, nokugcina iNkcazelo yokubhalisa ngokwethamshelelwa. Ukubhala iingxoxo zonke iingcebiso ezomthetho ezinikiwe ngexesha lokuboniselana ngebalo, kuquka nokuqonda ukusebenzisa i-PAIA ne-PAJA, ukuqinisekisa ukuzithoba nokusingatha imicimbi ye-PAIA ne-PAJA ngenkxaso ye-LOCMA, nokuthumela iingcebiso, imibuzo nemiqulu kubathengi. Ukuphucula nokufundisa abanye ukuba bagqibe ngokwakho umsebenzi wabo ukuze kuphuculwe kuze kuchazeke amabali, ulwazi nangamagangatho abo abo bavela kubo, kuquka nokubonelela ngenkxaso yomthetho enkqityiweyo enika ingcebiso nezixhobo abasebenzi abangesi qondo lokukhupha iindlela ezintsha zokuboniselana ukuba kusiwe kwizinto ezinzima okanye ezingaqondwa kalula, ukubonelela ngenkxaso yomthetho ezomthetho eqondene nemiqulu ye-LOCMA, ukuqonda ukusebenza kolawulo nokuFikelela kwiNkxaso, nokulinganisa nokuphucula iindlela, iinkqubo nongundo.

Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye neTreasury Regulations. Ulwazi lwezinqubo nezinhlela zokuphatha nokubhala ngezinsiza. Ulwazi lwezinqubo nezinhlela zomnyango. Ulwazi lwezinhlela zezimali zahulumeni. Ukuzibophezela kwizinga eliphezulu lokulawula izinga. Ulwazi ngokuphatha izinqubo ze-Performance Management and Development System (PMDS). Amakhono abumba iqembu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu nokulawula inkimbinkimbi. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Unxibelelwano. Ukuzelelana nokuziphatha ngokulondolozo.
zu.duties: Ozahlule ngesikhundla sokuphatha izinsiza zokwesekwa ezilawulweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza ngempumelelo, ukuzelelana nezinqubo nendawo yokusebenza esebenza kahle. Ukuphatha izinhlela zokuhamba zezinkampani, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukubhuka uhambo (amabhantshi, izindawo zokuhlala kanye nezokuthutha), ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo nezinhlela zokuhamba zilandelwa, ukusebenza nama-ejensi okuhamba nabahlinzeki besevisi, ukucubungula izimango zokuhamba neziyekelelo, kanye nokulawula nokubika ngemali eyahamba. Ukuphatha izindawo kanye nezinsiza zokwesekwa, okuhlanganisa ukugada ukugcinwa kwehhofisi, ifanitsha namasehlukisezi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukucushwa kanye nezinsiza ezijwayelekile zokweseka ehhofisi zihamba kahle, ukuphatha izinkontatho nabahlinzeki besevisi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile, ihlanzekile igcinwe kahle, kanye nokuphatha inqubo yokuza izimpahla zokubhalela ehhofisi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho yokuphepha nokuvikeleka, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha nokulawula izinqubo zokuphepha nokuvikeleka endaweni yokusebenza, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo zokuvikeleka ezifana nokulawula ukungena nokubukeka zitholakala, kanye nokuphendula kuzehlo zokuvikeleka nokuphepha. Ukuphatha irekhodi namadokhumenti, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukufakwa, ukugcinwa nokukhishwa kwamarekhodi, ukuphatha izimiso zokuphathwa nokulahlwa kwamarekhodi, ukugcina amarekhodi ezenzakalo nakwezobuchwepheshe ngokuphepha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho yokuvikelwa kwemininingwana, kanye nokwenza ukubuyekeza okujwayelekile nokuhlaziya amarekhodi. Ukuphatha abantu abasebenzayo kanye nokusebenza ngempumelelo, okuhlanganisa ukulawula kanye nokweseka abasebenzi bezinsiza, ukumisa izinhloso zokusebenza kanye nokubukelela inqubo, ukuhlela ukuqeqeshwa kanye nokuqhuba umsebenzi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela izinqubo ze-HR kanye nemithetho yokusebenza, kanye nokuphatha ukuphumula kwabasebenzi, ukubukwa kokungena esikhundleni nokuhlonishwa kokusebenza.

xh.title: Umncedisi weSikhululu: Iinkonzo eziLuncedo
xh.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi weSikhululu: Iinkonzo eziLuncedo sasilawula inkxaso yolawulo, ukuhamba ngeshishini lenkampani nokuthobela imigaqo kwindawo ezintathu zeSebe lamanzi nezoKuhlamba.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo kwinqanaba le-NQF 6. Iiminyaka elithandathu (6) yamava kwindawo yolawulo. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA) nakuMthetho woQoqosho. Ulwazi lweenkqubo nezendlela zolawulo nezesikrawu. Ulwazi leemigaqo nendlela zomsebenzi wesebe. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zemali kurhulumente. Ukuqinisekisa ngangona kunokwenzeka ukulawula ngobuchule. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iimigaqo zeNkqubo yoLawulo noPhuhliso loMsebenzi (PMDS). Amakhono abaqhubi-baqhathanisi. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokwahlulela. Ukulawula abantu nokwahlukahluka kwabo. Ukujolisa kumaxwebhu kunye nokugxila kumthengi. Unxibelelwano. Ixabiso negalelo nokuwohloka ngokuyiloya.
xh.duties: Umamkeli waba nomsebenzi wokulawula iinkonzo zenkxaso yolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ukuthobela iimigaqo nendawo yokusebenza esebenza kakuhle. Ukulawula ulungelelwaniso lokuhamba ngeshishini lenkampani, kuqukuqela ukulungiselela ukuhamba (iindawo zokunduluka, iindawo zokuhlala nezoku hamba), ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iimigaqo nendlela zokuhamba, ukusebenza nee-agensi zokuhamba nabanikezeli benkonzo, ukugqibezela iimfuno zokuhamba noku buyisela imali, nokuhlolwa okubhalwa ngayo iindleko zokuhamba. Ukulawula iindawo zenkxaso nenzeko, kuqukuqela ukulawula ukwakhiwa kweendawo zokusebenza, ihlathi nezixhobo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zokucoza nokunika inkxazo kwiziko zisebenza ngokutafila, ukulawula iinkqubo nabanikezeli besebenza ngazo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba indawo yokusebenza ikhuselekile, icoziwe igcinwe kakuhle, nokulawula inkqubo yokuqokelela izixhobo zendawo yokusebenza. Ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko nokhuseleko oluthathwa ngokomthetho, kuqukuqela ukusebenzisa nokujolisa iimigaqo zokhuseleko loluntu kwindawo yokusebenza, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iindlela zokhuseleko ezinjengokulawula ukungena nokuhlolwa, nokuphendula kwiimeko zokhuseleko nokhuseleko. Ukulawula iirekhodi namaxwebhu, kuqukuqela ukuqinisekisa ukuqhutywa kakuhle koku bulala iincwadi, ukugcina nokukhupha iirekhodi, ukusebenzisa iimigaqo zokusingatha nokuphalaza iirekhodi, ukugcina iirekhodi zamandla nezangaphakathi ngokukhuselekileyo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimigaqo zokukhusela iingcombolo, nokwenza uvavovo lweerekhodi zize zihlaziywe. Ukulawula abantu bomsebenzi nentsebenziswano, kuqukuqela ukulawula inkxazo kuqhuba abasebenzi bolawulo, ukumisela iinjongo zomsebenzi nokuhlolisa ukuba zihamba njani, ukuqamba iinjongo zokuzimisela ukuphuhlisa isakhono, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimigaqo zabantu bomsebenzi neyomthetho wabasebenzi, nokulawula ukushiya abantu bomsebenzi, ukubakho kwabo nokuqina kwemisebenzi yabo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Risk Management
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Risk Management at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, requiring a bachelor's degree and three years' supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 (bachelor’s degree or Advanced Diploma) in Risk Management or a relevant tertiary qualification. Three (3) years’ relevant experience at supervisory level. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management legislation, policies, practices and procedures. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and guidelines. Knowledge of the Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy and anti-corruption and fraud prevention measures. Knowledge of equal opportunities and affirmative action guidelines and laws. Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems. Knowledge of institutional policies and procedures. Knowledge of governmental financial systems. Knowledge of the principles and practice of financial accounting. Knowledge of the framework for managing performance information. Business strategy translation and alignment, problem solving and analysis, people and diversity management, and client orientation and customer focus skills. Good communication skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for supervising and undertaking activities to develop and implement the risk management framework. Supervise and implement the risk management framework in the organisation, including participating in the development of the risk management framework and implementing the risk management plan. Support the establishment of the risk management philosophy and culture in the organisation by advocating and promoting risk management through awareness activities, reviewing risk maturity through data gathering and quality review, building capacity through training and development, and developing and maintaining stakeholder and client relationships. Continuously monitor the risk environment by collecting statistical information on indicators of risks and detecting changes in the internal and external risk environment. Supervise the capturing of data and the maintenance of databases on risk management information. Supervise and undertake studies and analysis for identifying risks to establish the internal and external organisational context and analyse risk mitigation plans. Supervise, facilitate and advise on the risk management assessment process, including facilitating the identification, analysis and evaluation of risks and risk responses, compiling and maintaining the risk profile (risk register), and compiling risk management assessment reports as required. Monitor and review identified risk response activities by monitoring the progress of the implementation of activities to address risks as agreed and revising risk response activities. Supervise employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on work delivered by supervisors, advise and lead supervisors with regard to all aspects of the work, and ensure that supervisors are trained and developed to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively. Manage the performance, conduct and discipline of supervisees.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions to those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Risikobestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Risikobestuur by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, wat 'n bachelorsgraad en drie jaar se toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7 (bachelorsgraad of gevorderde diploma) in Risikobestuur of 'n tersiêre kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring op toesigvlak. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en begrip van Wetgewing, beleide, praktyke en prosedures vir Menslikehulpbronbestuur. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en riglyne. Kennis van die Publieke Diens se korrupsievoorkomingsstrategie en maatreëls vir die voorkoming van korrupsie en bedrog. Kennis van gelykegeleenthede- en regstellende-aksie-riglyne en wette. Kennis van administratiewe en klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Kennis van instellingsbeleid en -prosedures. Kennis van staatsfinansiële stelsels. Kennis van die beginsels en praktyk van finansiële rekeningkunde. Kennis van die raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Vaardighede in besigheidsstrategie-vertaling en -belyning, probleemoplossing en analise, menslike- en diversiteitsbestuur, asook kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die toesig hou en die uitvoer van aktiwiteite om die risikobestuursraamwerk te ontwikkel en te implementeer. Hou toesig oor en implementeer die risikobestuursraamwerk in die organisasie, insluitend deelname aan die ontwikkeling van die risikobestuursraamwerk en die implementering van die risikobestuursplan. Ondersteun die vestiging van die risikobestuursfilosofie en -kultuur in die organisasie deur risikobestuur te bevorder en te ondersteun deur bewustheidsaktiwiteite, die hersiening van risikovolwassenheid deur dataversameling en gehaltehersiening, die opbou van kapasiteit deur opleiding en ontwikkeling, en die ontwikkeling en handhawing van belanghebbende- en kliëntverhoudings. Monitor die risiko-omgewing deurlopend deur statistiese inligting oor risiko-aanwysers in te samel en veranderinge in die interne en eksterne risiko-omgewing op te spoor. Hou toesig oor die vaslegging van data en die instandhouding van databasisse oor risikobestuursinligting. Hou toesig oor en onderneem studies en ontleding om risiko's te identifiseer ten einde die interne en eksterne organisatoriese konteks te vestig en planne vir risikobeperking te ontleed. Hou toesig oor, fasiliteer en gee advies oor die risikobestuur-assesseringsproses, insluitend die fasilitering van die identifikasie, analise en evaluering van risiko's en risikoresponsies, die opstel en instandhouding van die risikoprofiel (risikoregister), en die opstel van risikobestuur-assesseringsverslae soos vereis. Monitor en hersien geïdentifiseerde risikorespons-aktiwiteite deur die vordering van die implementering van aktiwiteite om risiko's soos ooreengekom aan te spreek, te monitor en risikorespons-aktiwiteite te hersien. Hou toesig oor werknemers, wijs pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op werk wat deur toesighouers gelewer word, gee advies en lei toesighouers met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk, en verseker dat toesighouers opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer. Bestuur die prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van personeel onder toesig.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezikhulu: Ukuphathwa Kwengozi
zu.summary: Umncedi Wezikhulu: Ukuphathwa Kwengozi e-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Polokwane, edinga iziqu ze-bachelor kanye namakhulu eminyaka amathathu abesebenza njengesikhulumi.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 7 (iziqu ze-bachelor noma i-Advanced Diploma) ekuphathweni kwengozi noma iziqu ezifanele ze-tertiary. Amakhulu eminyaka amathathu (3) okuhlobene nokusebenza ezingeni lokubaphathi. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engakapheli. Ulwazi nokuziqondisa ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo, izindlela nemigomo ye-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imigomo ye-Treasury namacebo okuhola. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukungalunga nolwengekho. Ulwazi ngemigomo nomthetho wamathuba alinganayo nesenzo sokuthuthukisa abantu abancane. Ulwazi ngezenqubo nezinhlelo zokuphatha nokubhala. Ulwazi ngezingqikithi zemigomo nokuqhuba. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zezimali kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngezimiso kanye nokwenza isibaluli semali. Ulwazi ngesakhiwo sokuphatha ukwaziswa ngemiklamo. Ukuguqula futhi ulinganise usuqoqowebhizinisi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphatha abantu namahlukahluka, namakhono abhekele abathengi. Amakhono okuthintana ahle. Imani nokuziphatha ngokuziphatha okuhle.
zu.duties: Omunye uzobe egosithe futhi enza imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa isakhiwo sokuphathwa kwengozi. Ugosithe futhi usebenzise isakhiwo sokuphathwa kwengozi enkampanini, okuhlanganisa ukubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni isakhiwo sokuphathwa kwengozi futhi usebenzise icebo lokuphathwa kwengozi. Usekela ukumiswa kwejulu nokwesiko lokuphathwa kwengozi enkampanini ngokuqinisekisa futhi ukhuthaze ukuphathwa kwengozi ngemikhakha yokuvula amehlo, ukubuyekeza ukukhula kwengozi ngokuqoqa ulwazi futhi uhlolela izinga, ukwakha amandla ngokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa, kanye nokuthuthukisa nokugcina ubuhlobo nabathengi. Uqaphele ngokwesikhathi eside imvelaphi yengozi ngokuqoqa ulwazi olubalwa ngezinkomba zezingozi futhi uthola izehlakalo ezingaphakathi nangaphandle komphakathi wengozi. Ugosithe ukungena kolwazi kanye nokugcina iziqu ngolwazi lokuphathwa kwengozi. Ugosithe futhi enze izifundo nehlazo ukuze athole amaphuzu ezingozini ukuze amise isimo sangaphakathi nangaphandle senkampani futhi ahlaze amacebo okunciphisa amaphuzu ezingozi. Ugosithe, usize futhi yethe ngezenqubo yokuhlolwa kwengozi, okuhlanganisa ukusiza ukutholwa, ukuhlaziywa kanye nokuhlolwa kwamaphuzu ezingozi neziphendulo kusho ukuthi, ukwenza kanye nokugcina incazelo yengozi (irejista yengozi), kanye nokwenza imibiko yokuholo yokuphathwa kwengozi njengoba kudingeka. Uqaphele futhi abuyekeze imisebenzi ephendula phakathi kwezigozi ngekuqaphela inqubo yokwenza imisebenzi okumelwe nayo kanti futhi abekezele imisebenzi ephendula kungozi. Ugosithe abasebenzi, ababe imisebenzi futhi enze ukuholo lwezinga kumsebenzi ohanjwe abaphathi, yethe futhi ahole abaphathi ngakho konke okuhlobene nomsebenzi, kanti futhi aqiniseke ukuthi abaphathi betholwe ukuqeqesha bese bedlondlobala balethe umsebenzi ozingeni elidingekayo kahle futhi kafanele. Uphatha imiklamo, ukuziphatha nobudisi bezikhulumi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weQhankqalazi: uLawulo loMngcipheko
xh.summary: Umncedisi weQhankqalazi: uLawulo loMngcipheko kwiSebe leManzi nokuKhusela endlwini kaRhulumente ePolokwane, kufuneka abe nengqeqesho yebachelor's degree aneminyaka mitatu yamava obukhoki.
xh.requirements: I-NQF level 7 (ibachelor's degree okanye i-Advanced Diploma) kuLawulo loMngcipheko okanye ngesi fundamasto esifanelekileyo. Iminyaka elithathu (3) yamava afanelekileyo kwinqanaba lokuziphatha njengomphathi. Ukuvula ilayisenisi yokushaya etyhalala esezisebenzayo nengazange iphelelwe lixesha. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthetho, iinkqubo, izindlela namacebo oLawulo lweMisebenzi yokuSebenzisa iBantu. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA), iZiqulathi-mthetho zeNgcexa yezimali nemikhombandlela. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yokulwa nokukrwada kuSebenza kuRhulumente nangendlela zokulwa nokukrwada nokuthintela ukurhoxiswa. Ulwazi ngemikhombandlela yamathuba alinganayo nemithetho yentlalo-ntle. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nendlela zokwenza imisebenzi yohangelo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo namacebo esikhuthazo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ezikumaziko apho sisebenza kuzo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zezimali kurhulumente. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela yokuqamba iindlela zokulawula imali. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yokulawula ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Amakhono okuguqula iindlela zeshishini nokuzenzela ngokulungelelanisa iindlela, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda izinto, ukulawula abantu nolwahluko, nokukhathalele abathengi. Amakhono amabalawuni okuthetha nabantu. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuziphatha ngendlela ethe nkqo kwaye ulwaze ngokuziphatha ngokutsha.
xh.duties: Lowo umntu uya kubekwa yedwa ngokulawula nokuqhutywa kwemisebenzi eya kwakhwa nokuqutywa inkqubo yokulawula umngcipheko. Ukulawula nokuqhuba inkqubo yokulawula umngcipheko kwishishini, kuquka nokuqatywa kunye nokusebenzisa inkqubo yokulawula umngcipheko nokuqhuba iplani yokulawula umngcipheko. Ukuxhasa ukusekwa kwekamusicali yomngcipheko nolwazi kwishishini ngokubeka ngasemva nokuqhutyiswa phambili ngokulawula umngcipheko ngeenkqubo zokwazisa, ukuphonononga ukukhula kwamava ngokuqokelela iingcombolo nokuphonononga ngokobungangamsha bakho, ukwakha amandla ngokuqeqesha nokuqhuba iinkqubo zolwazi, nokuqamba nokuqhuba iindlela ezihamba nobudlelwane nabathengi nabo bavela kwindalo yelizwe jikelele. Ukugcina iliso ngokuqhubekayo kwendalo yomngcipheko ngokuqokelela iingxelo ngezinto eziboniswa ngomngcipheko nokuqaphela iinguqu ezikwindalo yomngcipheko yaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukulawula ukuqokelelwa kweengcombolo nokugcinwa kwezinto ezibhaliweyo ngolwazi bokulawula umngcipheko. Ukulawula nokuqhutywa kophando nokuqonda izinto ukuqonda umngcipheko ngokumiswa kwendalo yomngcipheko weshishini ngaphakathi nangaphandle nokwahlula iiplani zokunciphisa umngcipheko. Ukulawula, ukukhuthaza nokubonelela ngolwazi ngenkqubo yokuqikelela ukulawula umngcipheko, kuquka nokukhuthaza ukuqondwa, ukuhlaziywa nokubaluleka komngcipheko nezindlela ezisabela kuwo, ukubhala nokugcina iplani yokusebenza komngcipheko (izinombolo zomngcipheko), nokubhala iingxelo ngokuqikelela ukulawula umngcipheko njengoko kufuneka. Ukulawula nokuqhutyiswa kwezinto ezisabela kumngcipheko oqikelelweyo ngokugcina iliso kuqhubeke phambili izinto ezibaliweyo ukusombulula umngcipheko njengoko kuvunyelwene nokulungisa izinto ezisabela kumngcipheko. Ukulawula basebenzi, ukubamisela imisebenzi nokwenza oluqhakamsho lwemisebenzi eveliswa ngabaphathi, ukubonelela ngolwazi nokubaqamba phambili abaphathi ngayo yonke imiba ekusebenzeni, nokuqinisekisa ukuba abaphathi baqeqeshwe bakhuliswe ukunika umsebenzi oqinisekileyo obalulekileyo ngokufanelekileyo nangokusebenza. Ukulawula ukusebenza, indlela nokuziphatha kwabo abalawulwayo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Corporate Communication
jobs.summary: Manage corporate communication services for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, developing communication strategies, plans and policies at salary level 9.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 6 (National Diploma) in Communication, Journalism, Public Relations or a relevant tertiary qualification. Five (5) years’ experience in a communications environment. Relevant experience in stakeholder engagement. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Understanding of the legislative and policy frameworks governing the sector and the public sector. Knowledge of financial management. Knowledge of programme and project management. Knowledge of policy development and implementation. Knowledge of conflict management tools and methodologies. Good communication, presentation, report writing and networking skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for managing the provision of communication services. Develop and Implement communication plans and strategies in support of communication campaigns, analyse LOCMA’s strategic objectives, and develop communication and publication policies, procedures and guidelines for interactive media and multimedia content. Develop action plans for media coverage and ensure compliance with government communication guidelines and regulations. Implement media production, issue publications, organise press conferences and secure media coverage for LOCMA. Develop implementation plans for communication, plan exhibitions and implement the media strategy. Ensure that written and visual communication materials are timeous and accurate, and create content for the website, social media, newsletters and other platforms. Maintain the LOCMA website, ensuring that all materials and reports are uploaded and that the website is kept up to date. Manage web design and the corporate identity of LOCMA, including logos, letterheads and other branding material. Liaise with the media, including arranging and conducting radio, print and television interviews. Disseminate information to managers and stakeholders, track media coverage, analyse feedback and adjust communication strategies accordingly. Provide production of content for publication, including coordinating the design, layout and style of publications, implementing or improving concepts, theories and operational methods, and conducting research in aid of content development. Establish and maintain stakeholder relations with communities and the media, disseminate knowledge relating to LOCMA, and support public participation initiatives such as Imbizo, including feedback and follow-up on the recommended communication interventions. Manage resources, including work allocation, discipline and performance management of staff, and the recommendation and allocation of equipment.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Korporatiewe Kommunikasie
af.summary: Bestuur korporatiewe kommunikasiedienste vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, en ontwikkel kommunikasie strategieë, planne en beleide op salarisvlak 9.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 6 (Nasionale Diploma) in Kommunikasie, Joernalistiek, Publieke Verhoudings of 'n relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in 'n kommunikasie-omgewing. Relevante ervaring in belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Begrip van die wetgewende en beleidsraamwerke wat die sektor en die openbare sektor regeer. Kennis van finansiële bestuur. Kennis van program- en projektebestuur. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Kennis van konflikbestuursnutsgoedere en -metodologieë. Goeie kommunikasie-, aanbiedings-, verslagskryf- en netwerkvaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur van die verskaffing van kommunikasiedienste. Ontwikkel en implementeer kommunikasieplanne en -strategieë ter ondersteuning van kommunikasieveldtogte, ontleed LOCMA se strategiese doelwitte, en ontwikkel kommunikasie- en publikasiebeleide, prosedures en riglyne vir interaktiewe media en multimedia-inhoud. Ontwikkel aksieplanne vir mediadekking en verseker nakoming van regeringskommunikasieriglyne en -regulasies. Implementeer mediaproduksie, uitgee publikasies, reël perskonferensies en verseker mediadekking vir LOCMA. Ontwikkel implementeringsplanne vir kommunikasie, beplan uitstallings en implementeer die mediastrategie. Verseker dat geskrewe en visuele kommunikasiemateriale tydig en akkuraat is, en skep inhoud vir die webwerf, sosiale media, nuusbriewe en ander platforms. Onderhou die LOCMA-webwerf en verseker dat alle materiaal en verslae opgelaai word en dat die webwerf op datum gehou word. Bestuur webontwerp en die korporatiewe identiteit van LOCMA, insluitend logo's, briefhoofde en ander handelsmerkmateriaal. Skakel met die media, insluitend die reël en voer van radio-, druk- en televisie-onderhoude. Versprei inligting aan bestuurders en belanghebbendes, monitor mediadekking, ontleed terugvoer en pas kommunikasie strategieë dienooreenkomstig aan. Verskaf die produksie van inhoud vir publikasie, insluitend die koördinering van die ontwerp, uitleg en styl van publikasies, die implementering of verbetering van konsepte, teorieë en operasionele metodes, en die uitvoer van navorsing ter ondersteuning van inhoudontwikkeling. Vestig en onderhou belanghebberedelings met gemeenskappe en die media, versprei kennis rakende LOCMA, en ondersteun openbare deelname-inisiatiewe soos Imbizo, insluitend terugvoer en opvolging oor die aanbevole kommunikasie-intervensies. Bestuur hulpbronne, insluitend werktoewysing, dissipline en prestasiebestuur van personeel, en die aanbeveling en toewysing van toerusting.

zu.title: Umndidi weNduna: Ukuxhumana koBuhle
zu.summary: Phatha izinkonzo zokuxhumana kobuhle kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation ePolokwane, ngokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokuxhumana, izinhlelo kanye namaphoyisi ezingeni leholo 9.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) kokuXhumana, uBuzobe, Ubudlelwano neliXuku noma izifundo eziphakeme ezifanele. Ukwaziswa kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) ngokulinganisela isipiliyoni kwindawo yokuxhumana. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekubambeleleni kubathintanayo. Ukwaziswa ngedayi lefayizi elingekadluli. Ukuqonda amasimu omtsetfo kanye namaphoyisi abusa indiza kanye nendikimba yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngokuphatha izimali. Ulwazi ngokuphatha ohlelo kanye nemiqondo. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa kanye nokusebenzisa amaphoyisi. Ulwazi ngamathuluzi kanye nezindlela zokuphatha ingxabano. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, okubukhonisa, ukubhala imibiko kanye nokuqhagamishelana. Ubuncwethe kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba.
zu.duties: Omiswe yena uzobe ngumbekephili ekuphatweni kokunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokuxhumana. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokuxhumana kanye nezindlela ukusekela imikhankaso yokuxhumana, hlaziya izinhloso ezibambe iqhaza kwi-LOCMA, bese uthuthukisa amaphoyisi okuxhumana kanye nokushicilela, inqubo kanye nezinkomba zemithombo yokuxhumana kanye nemithombo engezansi. Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokwenza isikhathi esithile kumithondo yokuxhumana bese uqinisekisa ukuvumelana kanye nezinkomba kahulumede zokuxhumana kanye namasimu. Sebenzisa ukukhiqizwa kwemithondo, khishela okushicilelwayo, hlela imihlangano yabezindaba bese uqinisekisa isikhathi esithile kwi-LOCMA. Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ukuxhumana, hlela imiboniso bese usebenzisa umkhankaso wemithondo. Qinisekisa ukuba okubhaliwe kanye nezinto ezingabonakalayo zokuxhumana zisikhathini futhi ziqinisekisiwe, bese udala okufakwayo kwi-website, kumithombo yokuxhumana, emaphephandabeni kanye kwezinye izinkalo. Gcina i-website ye-LOCMA, uqinisekisa ukuba yonke imibhalo kanye nemibiko ifakwe bese i-website igcinwe ibuyekeziwe. Phatha ukwakheka kwi-website kanye nobunikazi be-LOCMA, okuhlanganisa phakathi kwayo njengamalogo, amaphaphoshi kanye nezinye izinto zokuqinisekisa igama le-LOCMA. Xhumana nabezindaba, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela kanye nokwenza amaxoxo e-radio, eshicilelweni nasesikrini sehlelo. Sazisa abaphathi kanye nabathintanayo ngolwazi, landa isikhathi esithile kumithondo yokuxhumana, hlaziya impendulo bese ulungisa izindlela zokuxhumana. Hlinzeka ngokukhiqizwa kwezinto ezizoshicilelwa, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukwakheka, isigaba kanye nesimbo sezinto ezishicilelwayo, ukusebenzisa noma ukuthuthukisa imiqondo, izindlela zokwenza kanye nendlela yokusebenza, kanye nokwenza ucwaningo ukuze kuthuthukiswe okufakwayo. Saka futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano nabathintanayo emiphakathini kanye nabezindaba, sasaza ulwazi nge-LOCMA, bese usekela imikhankaso yomphakathi njenge-Imbizo, okuhlanganisa impendulo kanye nekesi elilandela ukwelulekwa kokungenelela ukuxhumana. Phatha amandla, okuhlanganisa ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi, isithunzi kanye nokuphatha ukwenza kwebasebenzi, kanye nokukhombisa noma ukwaba imishini.

xh.title: Umncedi weNdlela yoKuxhumana yoBuchwepheshe
xh.summary: Phatha iinkonzo zindlela zoxhumana ze-Department of Water and Sanitation ePolokwane, zisa amaqondo oxhumana, iiplani neenqaeli kwinqanaba lemvuzo lesi-9.
xh.requirements: NQF level 6 (National Diploma) kwiNkundla yoXhumana, iBhlogi, uQuquzelelo lweMikhaya okanye isifundo esihambelana nesi sentlalo. Amashumi amabalahlan (5) eminyaka yamava kwindlu yokuxhumana. Amava ahambelana nokuzibandakanya kwabathathi nxaxheba. Inkcazelo yelayisenisi ekusebenzayo engaze iphela. Ukuqonda amasakhiwo amagunya kweenqanaba ezilawula le candelo nesebe likarhulumente. Ulwazi ngolawulo lemali. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi ngokusika nokuseka iinqaeli. Ulwazi ngezixhobo neendlela zokulawula ingxabano. Amakhono amabalawuli oxhumana, okubonisa ngokubhalwe, ngokuqamba iingxelo nokuqhagamshelana ngenxaxheba. Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngenyaniso.
xh.duties: Umntu oze kulesi sithuba uza kubizeka ekuphathweni kweenkonzo zoxhumana. Seka kwaye usebenzise iiplani neendlela zoxhumana ukuxhasa iikhaphukhaphu zoxhumana, hlalutya iinjongo zentsimbi ze-LOCMA, kwaye useke iinqaeli zoxhumana noshicilelo, iindlela zokusetyenziswa neenkqubo ngomxholo wemida esebenzisayo nezixhobo ezininzi. Seka iiplani zokuqikelela inkcaso yamajonwathi kuze kuqinisekise ukuthobela kolawulo luka-rhulumente ngeendlela zoxhumana. Sebenzisa ukusika iindaba ezingayi kwiphephandaba, shicilela izihlokwana, hlela iindibano zamajonwathi kuze uqinisekise inkcaso yamajonwathi nge-LOCMA. Seka iiplani zokusebenzisa iindlela zoxhumana, hlela imiboniso yezixhobo kuze usebenzise isakhiwo samajonwathi. Qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zoxhumana ezibhaliweyo nezibonakalayo zizesa ngeexesha, ngokuchanekileyo, kwaye udale umxholo kwi-webhusayithi, kumajoni asewayali, kwawo nawuphi na omnye wemimandla. Yenza ukugcina i-webhusayithi ye-LOCMA ngokuchanekileyo, ngokuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imixholo neengxelo zingeniswe kutshanje kunokuba isahlaziya ngamaxesha. Phatha ukudizayina kwenkundla ye-LOCMA neyayo i-fayida yechwepheshe, kuquka iimbhalu, amaphepha ombhalo nolandelo. Qhagamshelana namajonwathi, kuquka ukuhlela nokwenza iindibano kwisixhobo sakamagama, abashicileli bosasazo nakumajonwathi onyontlola. Saza ulwazi kubaphathi kwakunye namathathi nxaxheba, landela inkcaso yamajonwathi, hlalutya ulwazi olutshiwo ulungelelanise iindlela zoxhumana ngokomthetho. Yenza umxholo usasazo kushicilelo, kuquka ukulungelelanisa idizayini, isimo nesimbo sabashicileli, ukusebenzisa okanye ukupucuka iingcinga, iindlela zokusebenza ezikumgangatho, nokwenza uphando lokuxhasa ukuqamba komxholo. Seka kulungelelanise ubudlelwane namathathi nxaxheba kumakhaya nakumajonwathi, saza ulwazi olusamkelo kwi-LOCMA, kuze uxhase iindibano zokuzibandakanya koluntu ezinjenge-Imbizo, kuquka izimvo nokuqhubela phambadi okusikwa iindlela zoxhumana ngezicelo. Phatha izixhobo ezahlukeneyo, kuquka ulwahlulo lomsebenzi, ulawulo ngokuziphatha kwakunye nokwenza isimo ngabasebenzi, nokuqamba izicelo zokuseka izixhobo ezingahlukeneyo.

jobs.requirements: An NQF level 6 (National Diploma) in Office Management, Public Administration or a relevant tertiary qualification. Five (5) years’ experience in a general administration or office management environment. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Extensive knowledge and understanding of public service policies and administrative procedures. Basic financial management and knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Knowledge of administrative procedures and secretarial duties. Knowledge of the dispute resolution process. Knowledge of project management and administration. Knowledge of monitoring and evaluation and the framework for managing programme performance information. Understanding social and economic development issues. Understanding of the legislative and policy frameworks governing the sector. Computer literacy. Sound organisational skills, good people skills and a high level of reliability. Good communication, presentation and report writing skills. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for managing the office administration to improve the efficiency of the CEO. Manage and coordinate the flow of information within the office, including scrutinising all incoming correspondence (emails, letters, reports and telephone messages), drafting abbreviated notes highlighting key details, and appending preliminary advice or recommendations on the CEO’s actions. Implement and maintain a records management system. Render administrative support services, including researching, developing and preparing presentations for the Manager’s final approval. Coordinate and consolidate inputs on progress, monthly and management reports. Coordinate monitoring and evaluation, including the submission of quarterly and annual performance reports from the various directorates and the development of the Annual Performance Plan (APP). Liaise with DWS Corporate Planning and Institutional Establishment on planning, performance reporting and organisational establishment matters. Quality assures documentation and remains up to date with the prescripts, policies and procedures applicable to the work terrain to ensure efficient support to the office. Arrange and organise workshops and meetings, including determining delegates, facilitation, secretarial services, venues, subsistence and travel arrangements and claims, compiling agendas and programmes, and making financial arrangements. Prioritise and schedule meetings and workshops. Represent the CEO at meetings and workshops, deliver presentations on the CEO’s behalf, take notes and provide detailed feedback reports to the CEO. Manage queries by monitoring deadlines to ensure prompt responses and coordinate and monitor projects. Manage the budget, including compiling the budget in line with the MTEF and PFMA, authorising payments, controlling expenditure in line with the budget, monitoring spending trends in accordance with early warning systems, and advising on and facilitating budget projections with project managers. Establish processes for routine information collection, consolidate information into abbreviated reports, make recommendations where applicable and develop statistics as required by the CEO. Manage and supervise human resources, including performance evaluation, leave and relief arrangements, on-the-job training and identification of areas for further career development. Manage the procurement of stationery, including determining overall stock levels and managing the ordering and issuing of stationery.
