af.title: Kantoorbestuurder
af.summary: Kantoorbestuurder-posisie binne die Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, wat 'n NQF-vlak 6 diploma en vyf jaar se administrasie-ervaring vereis, teen R487,197 per jaar.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 6 (National Diploma) in Kantoorbestuur, Publieke Administrasie of 'n tersaaklike teriêre kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in 'n algemene administrasie- of kantoorbestuursomgewing. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Uitgebreide kennis en begrip van openbare diensbeleid en administratiewe prosedures. Basiese finansiële bestuur en kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Kennis van administratiewe prosedures en sekretariële pligte. Kennis van die geskilbeslegtingsproses. Kennis van projekbestuur en administrasie. Kennis van monitering en evaluering en die raamwerk vir die bestuur van programmeprestasie-inligting. Begrip van sosiale en ekonomiese ontwikkelingskwessies. Begrip van die wetgewende en beleidsraamwerke wat die sektor regeer. Geletterdheid in rekenaargebruik. Soliede organisatoriese vaardighede, goeie mensevaardighede en 'n hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Goeie kommunikasie-, voorleggings- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur van die kantooradministrasie om die doeltreffendheid van die CEO te verbeter. Bestuur en koördineer die vloei van inligting binne die kantoor, insluitend die ondersoek van alle inkomende korrespondensie (e-posse, briewe, verslae en telefoonboodskappe), die opstel van verkorte notas wat kernbesonderhede uitlig, en die byvoeging van voorlopige advies of aanbevelings oor die CEO se optrede. Implementeer en onderhou 'n rekordbestuurstelsel. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend die navorsing, ontwikkeling en voorbereiding van voorleggings vir die bestuurder se finale goedkeuring. Koördineer en konsolideer insette oor vordering-, maandelikse en bestuursverslae. Koördineer monitering en evaluering, insluitend die indiening van kwartaal- en jaarlikse prestasieverslae vanuit die verskillende direktorate en die ontwikkeling van die Annual Performance Plan (APP). Skakel met DWS Corporate Planning and Institutional Establishment oor beplanning, prestasierapportering en organisasievestigingsake. Verseker die gehalte van dokumentasie en bly op hoogte van die voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures van toepassing op die werksterrein om doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die kantoor te verseker. Reël en organiseer werkswinkels en vergaderings, insluitend die bepaling van afgevaardigdes, fasilitering, sekretariële dienste, plekke, bestaans- en reëreëlings en eise, die opstel van agenda's en programme, en die maak van finansiële reëlings. Prioritiseer en skeduleer vergaderings en werkswinkels. Verteenwoordig die CEO by vergaderings en werkswinkels, lewer voorleggings namens die CEO, neem notas en verskaf gedetailleerde terugvoerverslae aan die CEO. Bestuur navrae deur sperdatums te monitor om tydige response te verseker en koördineer en monitor projekte. Bestuur die begroting, insluitend die opstel van die begroting in ooreenstemming met die MTEF en PFMA, die magtiging van betalings, die beheer van bestedings in ooreenstemming met die begroting, die monitering van bestedingstendense in ooreenstemming met vroeë waarskuwingstelsels, en die advisering van en fasilitering van begrotingsprojeksies met projbestuurders. Vestig prosesse vir roetine-inligtinginsameling, konsolideer inligting in verkorte verslae, maak aanbevelings waar van toepassing en ontwikkel statistiek soos deur die CEO vereis. Bestuur en hou toesig oor menslike hulpbronne, insluitend prestasie-evaluerings, verlof- en ontlasreëlings, indiensopleiding en die identifisering van areas vir verdere loopbaanontwikkeling. Bestuur die aankoop van stasie, insluitend die bepaling van algehele voorraadvlakke en die bestuur van die bestelling en uitreiking van stasie.

zu.title: Umphathi Wehhovisi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumphathi wehhovisi ku-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Polokwane, esidinga idiploma elinganqangi le-NQF level 6 nokutholakala kokuba unamava eminyakeni eyisihlanu kokuqashwa komsebenzi, sinikeza i-R487,197 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Idiploma le-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) kokuqashwa kwehhovisi, kuqashwa koluzulu kahulumeni noma izifundo ezihambisana nalezo. Unamava eminyakeni eyisihlanu (5) kokwenza umsebenzi wokuqashwa komsebenzi jikelele noma kokuqashwa kwehhovisi. Ukuzivulukela ngelayisensi yokushayela ephumelelayo engakaqedi isikhathi. Ukuqonda ngokujulile nokuzu kochwepheshe kwemigomo yesevisi kahulumeni nemiso yokusebenza. Ukuphatha izimali ngokuyisisekelo nokwazi i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ukuqonda imiso yokusebenza nomsebenzi wokuba ummeli. Ukuqonda inqubo yokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuqonda ukuphatha amaphrojekthi nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuqonda ukuqaphela nokuhlolisisa ohlelo lokuphatha ulwazi ngemisebenzi yohlelo. Ukuqonda izinkinga zentuthuko yomphakathi nabezomnotho. Ukuqonda umthetho nemigomo elawula lo mkhakha. Ukubuka ikhompyutha. Ubuhlakani bokuhlela izinto, amakhono okusebenza nabantu nobuthembekile okuyisisekelo. Amakhono afanele okukhuluma, okubukhonisa nokubhala imibiko. Ikakhono lokuziphat ngobuhlakani kanye nokugwema okungafuneki. Ukubekezela ngokuziphendula nokuziphatha ngokuyiqiniso.
zu.duties: Lowo othathiwe uzobe nokuthwalekelwa ukuphatha ukuqashwa kwehhovisi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kuka-CEO. Uphathe futhi uhlole ukugeleza kolwazi ngaphakathi kwehhovisi, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola wonke umbhalo ongenayo (i-imeyili, izincwadi, imibiko nemiyalezo yocingo), ukuhlanganisa iziphuzo ezifushanisa imininingwane ebalulekile, nokufaka izelulezo noma izincomo eziyisisekelo ngokwemisebenzi ka-CEO. Asuse futhi agcine uhlelo lokuphatha irekhodi. Nikeza imisebenzi yokusekela kokuqashwa komsebenzi, okuhlanganisa ukucwaninga, ukuthuthukisa nokulungiselela izibonakaliso zokubukhonisa ngemvume yokugcina komphathi. Hlanganisa futhi uhlanganise izimpendulo ngokuqhubeka, imibiko yenyanga nakuleyo yokuphatha. Hlanganisa ukuhlolwa nokuhlolisiswa, okuhlanganisa ukungenisa imibiko yesimo sokusebenza ngesikhashana nangonyaka ezikwanini ezahlukene kanye nenqubo yokulungiselela i-Annual Performance Plan (APP). Xhumana ne-DWS Corporate Planning and Institutional Establishment ngokulungiselela, ukubika ngemisebenzi nezinto eziphathelene nokwakheka kwezikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuthi umbhalo uyaswela futhi uhlale ukuthola imibhalo, imigomo nemiso esebenza kulo mkhakha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwesekwa okusebenzayo kwehhovisi. Hlela futhi ulungiselele izikhungo zokuqeqesha kanye nezinkundla, okuhlanganisa ukuthola abathunjwe, ukwenza amandla, imisebenzi yomunyenti, izindawo, izinkokelo ezihambisana nokuhamba kanye nezimangalezo, ukuhlanganisa izinhlelo kanye nemiyalelo, kanye nokulungiselela izimali. Qinisa futhi uhlele izinkundla nezikhungo zokuqeqesha. Mela i-CEO ezinkundleni kanye nasemikhosini, yenza izibonakaliso ngokwakhe i-CEO, bhala iziphuzo futhi nikeze imibiko enemininingwane ku-CEO. Phatha imibuzo ngokuqaphela izingemuva ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kulengezwa ngokushesha futhi uhlole futhi uqaphe amaphrojekthi. Phatha imali, okuhlanganisa nokuhlanganisa isabelo ngokusho kwe-MTEF kanye ne-PFMA, ukugunyaza izinkokelo, ukulawula ukuchithwa kwemali ngokusho kwesabelo, ukuqaphela ukuthi imali ichithwa kanjani ngokusho kwezinhlelo zokulaya ngasese, kanye nokuweluleza futhi usize ekubeni kwenziwe ummino wemali kubaphathi bamaphrojekthi. Misela inqubo yokuqoqwa kolwazi lwansuku zonke, hlanganisa ulwazi abe ngemibiko emifushanise, nikeza izincomo lapho kufanele khona futhi ukhiye izibalo njengoba kudingwa i-CEO. Phatha futhi ulawule abasebenzi, okuhlanganisa nokuhlola ukusebenza, ukubeka ilayisensi kanye nezinhlelo zokusiza, ukuqeqesha emsebenzini kanye nokuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Phatha ukuthengwa kwezinto zokubhala, okuhlanganisa nokuthola amazinga wezinkambu jikelele nokuphatha ukuthenga nokuphiwa kwezinto zokubhala.

xh.title: Umphathi-we-ofisi
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi-we-ofisi kwisebe leZoManzi nokuCoca iNdlela eziko iPolokwane, sifuna idiploma yenqanaba le-6 le-NQF namava eminyaka yamathandathu ekulawuleni izindaba, sinika umvuzo ongama-R487,197 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Idiploma yenqanaba le-6 le-NQF (iNational Diploma) kulawulo lofisi, kulawulo koluntu, okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo saseyunivesithi. Amava eminyaka emihlanu (5) kwishishini lokulawula izindaba jikelele okanye kwishishini lolawulo lofisi. Ukwazisa ngelayisense yokushayela esebenzayo engakaqwalaselwa. Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda iinkqubo namacebiso alomacandalo karhulumente neendlela zokulawula izindaba. Ulawulo lwezimali olusiseko nolwazi ngeMthetho woLawulo lweZimali zoRhulumente (i-PFMA). Ulwazi ngeendleba zokulawula izindaba nezisebenzi zomabhalo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yoxezo-lwazi yokusombulula iingxabano. Ulwazi ngokulawula neyokuphatha iiprojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuqaphela nokuqwalasela nendlela yokulawula ulwazi ngemvelaphi yenkqubo. Ukuqonda imiba zentlalo nentlaseseko. Ukuqonda iinkqubo ezisemthethweni nezamacandelo alo abeka umthetho kule candelo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono elilulo lokuhlela izinto, amakhono amabenindi abantu nenqanaba eliphezulu lokuzithemba. Amakhono amabenindi okunxibelelwana, okubonisa noku bhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobuqhetseba nangobumfama. Ixabiso nendlela yokuziphatha ngokuzinikela.
xh.duties: Omiswe kulesi sithuba uya kuba nogunya lokulawula ulawulo lofisi ukuphucula isixhobo sokusebenza se-CEO. Lawula uze ulawule ukuhamba kolwazi ngaphakathi kwofisi, kuquka nokujonga wonke unxibelelwano olungena (ii-email, amagama, iingxelo namagama omxhumanisi), ukubhala iingxelo ezimfutshane ezichaza iinkcukacha ezibalulekileyo, nokuqamba iingcebiso okanye izindululo ngaphandle kwazo ngezenzo ze-CEO. Yenza uze ugcine inkqubo yolawulo lamagama. Nikela iinkonzo zolawulo, kuquka nokuphanda, ukuphuhlelwa nokulungiselela iinkonzo zokubonisa kulawulo olupheleleyo. Lawula uze udibanise izimvo ngokuqhubela phambili, iingxelo nyanga zonke neelawulo. Lawula ukuqaphela nokuqwalasela, kuquka nokuzisa iingxelo zokusebenza kwithuba lemihla yamnyaka ngeenyanga ezintathu nakuyo yonke imihla ezivela kumagunyazwe ahlukeneyo kunye nophuhliso woCwangciso lokuQhubela phambili lomYaka weNyanga (i-APP). Thintana noCwangciso lweShishini le-DWS nokusekwa kweziko malunga noCwangciso, ukuvela ngeengxelo zokusebenza nezindaba zokusekwa koluntu. Qinisekisa ukungabikho kwemiba kumagama ahlawulwayo uze uhlale umntu oqondileyo namacebiso, iinkqubo nendlela ezisebenza kwalo lonke ixesha ukuqinisekisa inkonzo ekulawulelweni ofisi. Cwangcisa uze ulungelelanise iindidi zemifundiso kwakunye neminyhadala, kuquka nokuqamba abathunjwa, ukwenza lula iinkonzo, iinkonzo zokubhala iingxelo, iindawo, ukulungiselela nokuhlala kwezinyikima, indlela yokuhamba, izimali eziceliweyo, ukwenza izihlwele nezinkqubo nokulungiselela izimali. Phawula uze ulungelelanise iminyhadala neendidi zemifundiso. Mela i-CEO kwiminyhadala nakwezinye iindidi zemifundiso, nikela iinkonzo ngokubonisa ngokubakho be-CEO, bhala amagama unike iingxelo eze ngobuninzi kwi-CEO. Lawula imibuzo ngokujonga amaxesha okuphela ukwenza isiphinde ngokukhawuleza, uze ulawule uze ulawule iiprojekthi. Lawula izilinganisela, kuquka nokubhala izimali ngokuhambisana ne-MTEF ne-PFMA, ukuvuma izimali ezihlawulwayo, ukulawula iindleko ngokuhambisana nesesilinganisela, ukujonga indlela yokuchithwa kwemali ngokwemigaqo yokhangelo olukhawulezileyo, kunye nokuba ngumcebisi kunye nokwenza lula inkqubo yokulinganisela imali abaphathi beprojekthi. Misela iinkqubo zokuqokelela ulwazi olusoloko lusetyenziswa, uze udibanise ulwazi kwiingxelo ezimfutshane, unike izindululo apho kufanelekileyo, uze uphuhlele iindleko ezifunwa yi-CEO. Lawula uze ulawule amathuba abasebenzi, kuquka nokuqwalasela indlela abasebenza ngayo, ukuhamba kwamaxa-eshe neendlela zokuzalisekisa, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi kumsebenzi wabo kwaye ubhekise kumaphepha amakhulu amathuba okuphuhlisa umsebenzi. Lawula ukuthengwa kwamaphepha okubhala, kuquka nokuqamba inqanaba elingagqithiswa lamaphepha okubhala alawulo kunye nokuphatha ukuthengiswa nokunikezwa kwamaphepha okubhala.

jobs.title: Legal Administration Officer (MR-5)
jobs.summary: Provide legal advisory services and conduct research for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane, requiring an LLB and eight years' legal experience.
jobs.requirements: An LLB degree or equivalent qualification. At least eight (8) years' appropriate post-qualification legal experience. Knowledge of policy development and implementation. Knowledge of government legal processes, legislation and contracts. Knowledge of the Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (PAIA), the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 (PAJA), the Constitution and all relevant legislation, including the Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ability to negotiate and draft contracts and international instruments. Ability to interpret specific environmental legislation and issues affecting the environment, as well as general environmental law. Legal research and interpretation. Analytical and report-writing skills. Programme and project management. Computer literacy. Good planning and decision-making skills. Language proficiency. Confidentiality. Excellent communication skills (written and verbal). Strategic capability and leadership skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for providing legal advisory services to LOCMA and its functionaries. Conduct, analyse, interpret, advise and mentor juniors on research that will provide information and case law relevant to the legal matter at hand, including providing legal support to ensure compliance with relevant legislation, collecting and analysing data and information for planning, decision-making and management reporting, analysing current policies and strategic objectives, developing standard operating procedures, and compiling research memoranda. Draft legal documents and advise and mentor juniors on legal drafting, including drafting legal documents, memoranda, reports and submissions, drafting, vetting and reviewing contracts on behalf of LOCMA, drafting legal opinions and documents to support criminal prosecutions for contraventions of the National Water Act, negotiating and drafting multilateral and bilateral agreements, ensuring compliance with the Constitution and domestic and international legal obligations, rendering legal support in all litigation matters, and obtaining outstanding information and initiating the recovery process, including issuing letters of demand. Present on and advise and mentor juniors on proposals on how specific cases should be approached, including receiving, recording and assessing new matters, advising clients on possible courses of action during consultation, and drafting legal opinions on behalf of LOCMA. Conduct interviews to determine clients' goals and objectives, including handling litigation matters and appeals, including National Water Tribunal appeals, on behalf of LOCMA, monitoring court cases from inception to final stage, liaising with the Office of the State Attorney on litigation matters, and keeping the litigation register updated. Document interviews and all legal advice given during legal consultation in writing, including monitoring the implementation of PAIA and PAJA, ensuring compliance and handling PAIA and PAJA matters on behalf of LOCMA, and submitting recommendations, queries and comments to clients. Provide advice and guidance to lower-level production employees on advanced interview techniques to address sensitive or complicated issues, and guide employees on the advice to be rendered to clients, including monitoring performance and service delivery targets, measuring and improving work methods, procedures and systems, and researching new methodologies and best practices.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Regsadministratiewe beampte (MR-5)
af.summary: Verskaf regsadviesdienste en doen navorsing vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Polokwane; vereis 'n LLB en agt jaar se regsonder ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n LLB-graad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Ten minste agt (8) jaar se toepaslike postkwalifikasie regsonder ervaring. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Kennis van staatsreg prosesse, wetgewing en kontrakte. Kennis van die Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (PAIA), die Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 (PAJA), die Grondwet en alle tersaaklike wetgewing, insluitend die Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Vermoë om te onderhandel en kontrakte en internasionale instrumente op te stel. Vermoë om spesifieke omgewingswetgewing en kwessies wat die omgewing raak, asook algemene omgewingsreg te interpreteer. Regsnavorsing en interpretasie. Analitiese en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Program- en projekbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie beplannings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Taalvaardigheid. Konfidensialiteit. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees daarvoor om regsadviesdienste aan LOCMA en sy funksionarisse te verskaf. Voer navorsing uit, ontleed, interpreteer, gee advies en mentor junior personeel oor navorsing wat inligting en regspraak sal verskaf wat relevant is tot die regsaak ter sprake, insluitend die verskaffing van regssteun om nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing te verseker, die versameling en ontleding van data en inligting vir beplanning, besluitneming en bestuursverslagdoening, die ontleding van huidige beleide en strategiese doelwitte, die ontwikkeling van standaard bedryfsprosedures en die opstel van navorsingsmemoranda. Stel regsdocumente op en gee advies en mentor junior personeel oor regsdraft, insluitend die opstel van regsdocumente, memoranda, verslae en voorleggings, die opstel, ondersoek en hersien van kontrakte namens LOCMA, die opstel van regsmenings en documente om strafregvervolgings vir oortredings van die National Water Act te steun, die onderhandel en opstel van multilaterale en bilaterale ooreenkomste, die verseker van nakoming van die Grondwet en binnelandse en internasionale regverpligtinge, die lewer van regssteun in alle litigasiesake, en die verkryging van uitstaande inligting en inisieering van die terugwiningsproses, insluitend die uitreik van vorderingbriewe. Hou voorleggings en gee advies en mentor junior personeel oor voorstelle oor hoe spesifieke sake benader behoort te word, insluitend die ontvangs, optekening en assessering van nuwe sake, die advisering van kliënte oor moontlike handelingswyse tydens konsultasie en die opstel van regsmenings namens LOCMA. Voer onderhoude om kliënte se doelwitte en oogmerke te bepaal, insluitend die hantering van litigasiesake en appèlle, insluitend National Water Tribunal-appèlle, namens LOCMA, die monitering van hofsake vanaf aanvang tot finale stadium, die skakeling met die Office of the State Attorney oor litigasiesake en die byhou van die litigasieregister. Teken onderhoude en alle regsadvies wat tydens regsondersoek gegee is, skriftelik op, insluitend die monitering van die implementering van PAIA en PAJA, die verseker van nakoming en die hantering van PAIA- en PAJA-sake namens LOCMA, en die voorlê van aanbevelings, navrae en kommentaar aan kliënte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan laevlak-produksiewerknemers oor gevorderde ondtegtechnieke om sensitiewe of ingewikkelde kwessies aan te spreek en gee werknemers leiding oor die advies wat aan kliënte gelewer behoort te word, insluitend die monitering van prestasie en diensleweringsteikens, die meet en verbeter van werkmetodes, prosedures en stelsels en die navorsing van nuwe metodologieë en beste praktyke.

zu.title: I-ofisa Lolawulo Lomthetho (MR-5)
zu.summary: Nikeza izinsiza zokweluleka ngomthetho futhi uenze ucwaningo ku-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Polokwane, okudinga i-LLB naneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yohlu olusemthethweni.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-LLB noma isiqu esilinganayo. Okungenani eminyakeni eyisishiyagalombili (8) yohlu olufanele emthethweni emva kokuthola isiqu. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa nokuphoqelelwa kwezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi ngemikhuba kahulumeni emthethweni, umthetho nezinkontileka. Ulwazi ngo-Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (PAIA), i-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 (PAJA), uMthethosisekelo nawo wonke umthetho ofanele, okuhlanganisa nama-Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi ngo-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ikono lokuxoxisana nokubhala izinkontileka nezinto zomhlaba jikeleile. Ikono lokutolikwa komthetho ohlukile wezemvelo kanye nezinkinga ezithinta izemvelo, kanye nomthetho jikelele wezemvelo. Ucwaningo nokutolikwa komthetho. Amakhono okuhlaziya nokubhala imibiko. Ukuqondisa kwaye kuphathwe imihelangqondo kanye namaphulo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okucubungula kanye nokuthatha izinqumbo. Ukukhuluma nokubhala ulimi kahle. Ukugcina imfihlo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Amakhono obuholo kanye namandla okuphatha ngokuhlangenwe nakho. Ukubekezelele kanye nokuziphatha ngokuyisesikhathi.
zu.duties: Umntu othathwe esikhundleni sizobe enomsebenzi wokunikeza izinsiza zokweluleka ngomthetho ku-LOCMA nasezikhundleni zabo. Ukwenza, ukuhlaziya, ukutolika, ukweluleka futhi uhola abasha kucwaningo oluzohlinzeka ngolwazi kanye nemithetho yamacala ephathelene nendaba yomthetho ekhona, okuhlanganisa nokunikeza inkundla yomthetho ukuze kwenziwe ukulandelana nomthetho ofanele, ukuqoqa nokuhlaziya idatha nolwazele ukucubungula, ukuthatha izinqumbo nokubika okuphathelene nobuphathi, ukuhlaziya izinqubomgomo zamanje kanye nemigomo ebaluleke kakhulu, ukuthuthukisa izingqophamcolo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza, kanye nokubhala okubhalwayo ngocwaningo. Ukubhala amafayela omthetho, ukweluleka futhi uhole abasha ekubhaleni kwomthetho, okuhlanganisa nokubhala amafayela omthetho, okubhaliwe, imibiko nezincomo, ukubhala, ukuhlola kanye nokubuka izinkontileka ngokomumo ka-LOCMA, ukubhala izinkinobho zomthetho kanye namafayela okusekela ukushwebelwa kwamacala ngokwe-National Water Act, ukuxoxisana nokubhala izivumelwano eziningi nezivumelwano phakathi kwamakilombe amabili, ukuqinisekisa ukulandelana uMthethosisekelo kanye nezibopho zomthetho zangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukunikeza inkundla yomthetho kuyo yonke imicimbi yamacala, nokuthola ulwazi olungeziwe kanye nokuqalisa inqubo yokubuyiswa, okuhlanganisa nokukhipha amagwabaza. Ukuyethula futhi ukweluleka nohola abasha ngezincomo ngendlela amacala athile okufanele aphathwe ngayo, okuhlanganisa nokuthola, ukubhala nokuhlola imicimbi emisha, ukweluleza abathintekayo ngamaphuzu anokuthi asetshenziswe ngesikhathi sekwelulekwa, nokubhala izinkinobho zomthetho ngokomumo ka-LOCMA. Ukwenza izingxoxo ukuze kutholwe izinjongo nemithelela yabathintekayo, okuhlanganisa nokuphatha imicimbi yamacala kanye nezinsongo zamacala, okuhlanganisa nezinsongo ze-National Water Tribunal, ngokomumo ka-LOCMA, ukuqapha amacha esigcawukusukela ekuqaleni kuye kwaphela, ukuxhumana ne-Office of the State Attorney ngemicimbi yamacala, nokugcina ukubhalwa kwesibuko secala. Ukubhala izingxoxo yonke imibuzo etholakele yeseluleko somthetho, okuhlanganisa ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kuka-PAIA ne-PAJA, ukuqinisekisa ukulandelana nokuphatha imicimbi ye-PAIA ne-PAJA ngokomumo ka-LOCMA, nokuthumela izincomo, imibuzo kanye nezimpendulo zabathintekayo. Ukunikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa abasebenzi abasezingeni elincane obukhiqizo kumakhono aphantsi wokucinga phambili ekubuzeni imibuzo ngokuzwela okuzama ukukhomba izindaba eziyingozi, futhi uqondise abasebenzi ngokuseluleza okufanele kunikezwe abathintekayo, okuhlanganisa ukuqapha ukusebenza imigomo yokwaziswa nezinhloso, ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwaye kwethule izindlela, izingqophamcolo kanye namasistimu okusebenza, futhi wenze ucwaningo lwamasu amasha kanye namasu okusebenza ngokuqondile.

xh.title: Iofisa Woqoqosho Lomthetho (MR-5)
xh.summary: Nika iinkonzo zengcebiso yomthetho uze wenze uphononongo kwiSebe leZoManzi nokuQhutywa kweNdalo ePolokwane, kufuneka kubekho LLB kunye neminyaka yamthetho eyisibhozo.
xh.requirements: I-degree ye-LLB okanye nelifanele kwaloo qualification. Ubuncinane yiminyaka eyisibhozo (8) esemthethweni yamava emthethweni emva kokufumana i-qualification. Ulwazi ngophuhliso nokusebenzisa iinkqubomgomo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomthetho karhulumente, umthetho nakwiinkonzo. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wokuPhakamisa uFikelelo lwakulwazi, 2000 (PAIA), uMthetho wokuPhakamisa uBulungisa koLawulo, 2000 (PAJA), uMgaqo-siseko nayo yonke imithetho echetywayo, kuquka nezicwangciso zeTreasury. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Isakhono sokuxhumana nokubhala iinkonzo nakwisixhobo samazwe ngamazwe. Isakhono sokutolika imithetho ehlukeneyo yendalo nangemiba echaphazela indalo, kunye nomthetho jikelele wendalo. Uphononongo kunye nentoliko yomthetho. Isakhono sokuhlola nokusibhala iingxelo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ukuba nolwazi lwekhompyutha. Isakhono esililo sokuceba nokuthatha iigqibo. Ukuba bulele kwiilwimi. Ukugcina iyimfihlo. Isakhono esililo sokunxibelelwana (esibhalwayo nesithethwayo). Isakhono sobuqu bokubonelela ngokusesikweni nokuqhatha. Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokusesikweni.
xh.duties: Umntu oze kule nxaxheba kuya kuba nawo nxaxheba lokunika iinkonzo zengcebiso yomthetho kwi-LOCMA nakubasebenzi bayo. Yenza, hlola, tolika, yala uze ululele abasebenzi abasezantsi ngophando oluya kunikisa ulwazi namarhalwe amacala ahambelana nomthetho ophangwayo, kuquka nokunika inkxaso yomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuzithobela kumthetho otheyithiweyo,okuqokelela nokuhlola iingcombolo nolwazi malunga nokucwangcisa, nokuthatha iigqibo nakwingxelo yolawulo, ukuhlola iinkqubomgomo zangoku nemiqulu yesicwangciso, ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezizesikweni zokusebenza, nokubhala iimemo zophando. Bhala amaxwebhu omthetho uze ululele abasebenzi abasezantsi ngokubhala umthetho, kuquka nokubhala amaxwebhu omthetho, iimemo, iingxelo nokuza kuthi ga kubhalwe, ukubhala, ukujonga nokuhlola iinkonzo nengxebo, ukubhala iingcebiso zamaxwebhu omthetho nokuququzelela izifundo ezingagunyaziswanga ephula uMthetho wamanzi weSizwe, ukuxhumana nokubhala izivumelwano ezibhozo nangaphandle komzila, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela uMgaqo-siseko naxanduva lamazwe angaphakathi namazwe ngamazwe, ukunika inkxaso yomthetho kuzo zonke izinto ezithintela urhulumente, nokuqokelela ulwazi olungalinganga ukuze kuqaliswe inkqubo yokubuyisa okulahlekileyo, kuquka nokuthumela amagama asetyenziswa ukufuna. Yaza ngayo uze ululele abasebenzi abasezantsi ngendlela ezithileyo ezingaqhatywa ngayo amacala, kuquka nokwamkela, ukugcina nokuqikelela imiba emitsha, ukulela abaxhasi ngezindlela ezinokuthi zithathwe ngexesha lokubonisana, nokubhala iingcebiso zamaxwebhu ngokulingene. Yenza iinterviwu ukuze kumiswe iigqibo nemigqinqo yabaxhasi, kuquka nokusebenza izinto ezithintela urhulumente nezedemokhrasi, kuquke nezemvo zoBulungisa bamaza amanzi, nangokulingene, ukulandelela iicala zivenkile ukusuka ekuqaleni kokugqibela ukugqiba, ukunxibelelana neOfisi yomGqwetha weSizwe kumacala, nokugcina ibhuku lamacala eligqibiweyo. Bhala iinterviwu zonke iingcebiso ezinikiweyo ngexesha lokubonisana komthetho ngobhalo, kuquke nokuqaphela ukusebenza kwe-PAIA ne-PAJA, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela nokuphatha i-PAIA ne-PAJA emzantsi nangokulingene, nokuthumela izindulululelo, iingxelo namagama abaxhasi. Nikela ingcebiso nokuqonda kubasebenzi abasezantsi bobungakanani bezixa ezinamava ngobugcisa bokuxoxa iingxelo ezibukhali okanye ezinzima, uze umqhathe abaxhasi ngonika ngemiba ekubakho iingcebiso ezikufuneka zithathwe ngokulingene, ukuqaphela imisebenzi yokwenza iinkqubo neenkqubo ezingako ukwenza iinkqubo, ukuqaphela nokuphucula iindlela zokusebenza, iinkqubo namajelo, nokuvela iindlela ezingako nokusebenza ezizeko ngemiyalezo entsha.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer (CORPORATE Support
jobs.centre: Polokwane Ref No: LOCMA 37 Bronkhorstspruit Ref No: LOCMA 38 Hartbeespoort Ref No: LOCMA 39
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer positions providing corporate support, travel coordination and facilities management for water and sanitation LOCMA operations across three centres.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 6 qualification as recognised by SAQA. Three (3) years' experience in administration. Knowledge of administrative procedures. Disciplinary knowledge of labour law. Knowledge of the dispute resolution process. Knowledge of labour relations policies. Understanding of social and economic development issues. Basic financial management and knowledge of the PFMA. Knowledge management. Problem solving and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Communication, accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for providing effective administrative, corporate travel and facilities support services for LOCMA operations. Coordinate pool vehicle usage, including processing trip authorisations and allocating vehicles to officials, conducting pre- and post-trip inspections of pool vehicles, monitoring vehicle servicing and ensuring that maintenance follows the service schedule, assigning drivers to support officials when needed, updating and maintaining an accurate pool vehicle register, and coordinating Transport Advisory Committee meetings and serving as secretariat. Coordinate corporate travel and short-term vehicle rentals, including arranging official travel bookings with the travel agency in line with policy, following departmental cost containment guidelines when processing bookings, obtaining and distributing monthly invoices to officials for trip acknowledgement, compiling and submitting monthly travel expenditure reports to Finance, verifying travel claims and processing reimbursements, processing requests for short-term vehicle rentals for official travel, and managing trip authorisation forms and handling emergency and after-hours bookings. Administer the subsidised vehicle scheme, including overseeing the administration of subsidised vehicles (Scheme A and B) in the region, processing travel claims and facilitating reimbursements, conducting quarterly inspections before and after trips, organising Advisory Committee meetings for the schemes, keeping updated records and spreadsheets for subsidised vehicles, conducting spot checks to ensure compliance with scheme guidelines, and monitoring Scheme A mileage and ensuring correct entry into Mela. Perform facilities and office services operations, including coordinating maintenance for offices and state houses, providing effective cleaning and general support services to facilitate smooth and efficient operations, facilitating corporate and auxiliary service meetings, supervising daily reception operations, ensuring that the work environment is safe, clean and well maintained, performing monthly inspections of office buildings and state houses, managing office space allocation and booking in the region, and scheduling and preparing boardrooms for meetings. Process telephone and data services requests, including administering the ordering, delivery and payment of telephone and data accounts in line with policy, distributing PIN codes for outgoing calls and ensuring that Wi-Fi is operational, responding to public and stakeholder complaints regarding telecommunication services, distributing and processing monthly phone accounts for payment, and managing departmental mobile phones within the region. Provide procurement support, including managing procurement processes within the component, processing and tracking payments for goods and services acquired, reviewing invoices and claims from service providers to ensure alignment with contractual terms, and keeping accurate procurement records and ensuring proper filing.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte (KORPORATIEWE Ondersteuning)
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte-posisies wat korporatiewe ondersteuning, reiskoördinering en fasiliteitsbestuur vir water- en sanitasie-LOCMA-bewerkings oor drie sentrums bied.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se ondervinding in administrasie. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Dissiplinêre kennis van arbeidsreg. Kennis van die geskilbeslegtingsproses. Kennis van arbeidsverhoudingsbeleid. Begrip van sosiale en ekonomiese ontwikkelingskwessies. Basiese finansiële bestuur en kennis van die PFMA. Kennisbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Menslike en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en klienfokus. Kommunikasie, aanspreeklikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampseienaar sal verantwoordelik wees daarvoor om doeltreffende administratiewe, korporatiewe reis- en fasiliteite-ondersteuningsdienste vir LOCMA-bewerkings te verskaf. Koördineer die gebruik van poelvoertuie, insluitend die verwerking van reisgemagtigings en die toekenning van voertuie aan amptenare, die uitvoer van voor- en na-reeksondersoeke van poelvoertuie, die monitering van voertuigonderhoud en die verseker dat onderhoud volg op die diensrooster, die toewys van bestuurders om amptenare te ondersteun wanneer nodig, die opdatering en byhou van 'n akkurate poelvoertuigregister, en die koördineer van Vervoer Adviserende Komitee-vergaderings en om as sekretariaat te dien. Koördineer korporatiewe reis en korttermynvoertuigverhurings, insluitend die reël van amptelike reisbesprekings met die reisagentskap in ooreenstemming met beleid, die volg van departementele kostebeperkingsriglyne tydens die verwerking van besprekings, die verkry en versprei van maandelikse fakture aan amptenare vir reisbevestiging, die opstel en voorlê van maandelikse reisbestedingsverslae aan Finansies, die verifieer van reiseise en die verwerking van terugbetalings, die verwerking van versoeke vir korttermynvoertuigverhurings vir amptelike reis, en die bestuur van reisgemagtigingsvorms en die hantering van nood- en buite-kantoorure-besprekings. Administreer die gesubsidieerde voertuigskema, insluitend die oorsien van die administrasie van gesubsidieerde voertuie (Skema A en B) in die streek, die verwerking van reiseise en die fasiliteer van terugbetalings, die uitvoer van kwartaallikse ondersoeke voor en na reise, die organiseer van Adviserende Komitee-vergaderings vir die skemas, die byhou van opgedateerde rekords en sigblaaie vir gesubsidieerde voertuie, die uitvoer van steekproefkontroles om te verseker dat aan skemariglyne voldoen word, en die monitering van Skema A-kilometerstand en die verseker van korrekte invoer in Mela. Voer fasiliteits- en kantoorbedrywighede uit, insluitend die koördineer van onderhoud vir kantore en staatshuise, die verskaffing van doeltreffende skoonmaak- en algemene ondersteuningsdienste om gladde en doeltreffende bedrywighede te fasiliteer, die fasiliteer van korporatiewe en hulpdienste-vergaderings, die toesig hou oor daaglike ontvangsbedrywighede, die verseker dat die werksomgewing veilig, skoon en goed onderhou is, die uitvoer van maandelikse ondersoeke van kantoorgeboue en staatshuise, die bestuur van kantoorruimtetoekenning en -bespreking in die streek, en die skeduleer en voorberei van raadsale vir vergaderings. Verwerk telefoon- en datadiensversoeke, insluitend die administrasie van die bestelling, aflewering en betaling van telefoon- en datarekeninge in ooreenstemming met beleid, die versprei van PIN-kodes vir uitgaande oproepe en die verseker dat Wi-Fi werkend is, die reageer op openbare en belanghebbende klagtes rakende telekommunikasiedienste, die versprei en verwerk van maandelikse telefoonrekeninge vir betaling, en die bestuur van departementele selfone binne die streek. Verskaf verkrygingsondersteuning, insluitend die bestuur van verkrygingsprosesse binne die komponent, die verwerking en naspoor van betalings vir verworwe goedere en dienste, die hersien van fakture en eise van diensverskaffers om te verseker dat dit met kontraktuele terme ooreenstem, en die byhou van akkurate verkrygingsrekords en die verseker van behoorlike liasseering.

zu.title: Ofisa Omkhulu Wezokuphathwa (ISEKELA LEMIQONDO
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Ofisa Omkhulu Wezokuphathla ezinikeza usekelo lwemiqondo, ukuhlela ukuhamba kwezinsizakalo kanye nokuphathwa kwezimpahla zemisebenzi yamasebe LOCMA kuzo zonke izikhungo ezintathu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-NQF izinga 6 njengoba ziyabonwa yi-SAQA. Usuku lwe-Three (3) iminyaka yohlelo lwezokuphathwa. Ulwazi ngezendlela zokuphathwa. Ulwazi lwesimiso sokuphathwa ngemithetho yabasebenzi. Ulwazi nge nkqubo yokusombulula izingxabano. Ulwazi nge zimiso ezibhekene nokusebenzana nabasebenzi. Ukuqonda izinkinga zentuthuko yomphakathi nezomnotho. Ukuphathwa okuyisisekelo kwezimali nolwazi nge-PFMA. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya imininingwane. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuxhasa ukwehlukana kwabo. Ukuqondisa abathengi kanye nogxile kubathengi. Ukuthetha, ukubekekile kanye nokuziphatha ngezinjongo.
zu.duties: Lowo okhethiwe uzobophakathi wokunikeza izinsiza ezisebenzayo zokuphathwa, ukuhamba ngemiqondo yamabhizinisi kanye nezinsizakulo zezimpahla zemisebenzi yamasebe LOCMA. Ukuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwemoto yamaplasi, okubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemvume yokuhamba nokwabelwa ngemoto abasebenzi, ukwenza ukuhlolwa kwangaphambili nangemuva kokuhamba imoto, ukugcina ukukhonza kwemoto futhi waqiniseka ukuthi ukulungiswa kulandela ishedi, ukwabela abashayeli ukuxhasa abasebenzi uma kudingeka, ukubuyekeza nokugcina irekhidi ehleliwe lemoto, kanye nokuhlanganisa izinkundla zomnyango wezokuhamba ukubuyelelana kanye nokuba nguMongameli weZncwadi. Ukuhlanganisa ukuhamba ngemqondo nezimoto ezithengiswa isikhashana, okubandakanya ukuhlela izibhambo ezisemthethweni zokuhamba ne-olwazi ngokuhamba ngesimiso, ukulandelana imigomqaba emyango yokugcina izindleko uma kunikezelwa izibhambo, ukuthola nokwabelana ngezibhambo zenyanga nabasebenzi ukuze bathole imvume yokuhamba, ukulungisa futhi ungenise ngezwitshi lezindleko zokuhamba ezinyanga zonke ezezezimali, ukuqinisekisa izinsizakulo zokuhamba ukwenza imvume yokukhokha, ukwenza izinsizakulo ezifakiwe ezimoto ezikhuliswa isikhashana zokuhamba, futhi uphathe imibhalo yemvume yokuhamba nokugcina izibhambo eziphuthumayo nasemva kwamahora. Ukuphathwa kwesimiso senothulusi yemoto, okubandakanya ukubuka ukuphathwa kwezimoto eziphathekayo emadolobheni, ukulungisa izinsizakulo zokuhamba kanye nokuqinisekisa imvume yokukhokha, ukwenza ukuhlolwa kwesikhashana kwangaphambili nasemuva kwamaviki, ukwenzela izinkundla zomnyango, ukugcina amafayili ahleziwe ngezitayela ezahlukene zezimoto eziphathekayo, ukwenza ukuhlola okusheshayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandelana kwemixholi yesimiso, futhi wagcina imayela ye-Scheme A futhi waqinisekisa ukungena okulungile kwi-Mela. Ukwenza izisebenzi zezokwakha kanye nezinsizakulo zofisi, okubandakanya ukuhlanganisa ukulungiswa kwezikhungo namakhaya abeNkosi, ukunikeza izinsiza ezisebenzayo zokucwaha kanye nokezo olunjalo lokuxhasa imisebenzi ehleliwe, ukunika amandla amagatsha amakhulu abethwe ngaphandle, ukulawula ukusebenza kwangempumelelo kwangaphambilini, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile, ihlanzekile futhi ihleliwe, ukwenza ukuhlola kwamagatsha kwezindlu zofisi namakhaya abeNkosi, ukuphathwa kokwabelwa ngendawo yokusebenza esifundazweni, kanye nokuhlela ukuhlela izindlu zamagosa amakhulu ezinkundla. Ukwenza izinsizakulo ze-telefone kanye nezinsizakolo zamawebhusayithi, okubandakanya ukulawula ukulethwa, ukuletkwa nokukhokhelwa kwamakhonthwe e-telefone kanye nezinsizakolo zamawebhusayithi ngokwemigomqaba, ukwabelana ngamakhodi PIN wamakholi abalele emakhaya futhi waqinisekisa ukuthi i-Wi-Fi isebenza, ukuphendula izinkinga zabantu nasezinsizakolo ezithintwe nabashaywe ngezensizakolo zokuxhumana, ukwabelana kanye nokulungisa izinsizakolo zekhonthwe yenyanga zokukhokhelwa, futhi waphatha ama-telefone e-_departmental phakathi kwesifunda. Ukunika inkxaso yokuthengwa kwempahla, okubandakanya ukuphathwa kokuthengwa kwempahla endaweni, ukulungisa nokulandela izinsizakolo ezihambisana nemitolo yempahla ezitholiwe, ukubuyekeza izinsizakolo nezinsizakolo abanikeza abasebenzi ngomthetho wekhonthuluzo, kanye nokugcina amafayili ohleliwe wezokuthenga ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa okuhle.

xh.title: Ofisi elawulayo oMkhulu (Inkxaso yoBuhlanga)
xh.summary: Izithuba ze-Ofisi elawulayo oMkhulu ezinika inkxaso yobuhlanga, ukucothiswa koluhlelo lokuhamba nokulawulwa kwezindlu zokusebenzela kumisebenzi ye-LOCMA yamanzi nokusingqongileyo kumaziko amathathu.
xh.requirements: Iqualification efanayo yendlela elingana ne-NQF level 6 njengokuqatshiweyo yi-SAQA. Iiminyaka emithathu (3) yamava Kulawulo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zolawulo. Ulwazi lokuziphatha malunga nomthetho wabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yokusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi ngamagunya obudlelwane babasebenzi. Ukuqonda iingxaki zentlvelo nentlalo nokuphuhlisa ezomathetho. Ulawulo lweemali olusisiseko nolwazi nge-PFMA. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ulawulo labantu nobunyulu. Ukuqhelana nabathengi nogxile kubathengi. Unxibelelwano, uninzi lokwenza izinto nendlela yokuziphatha ngokwenene.
xh.duties: Umntu oze kulesi sithuba uya kuba negunya lokunika inkxaso yemisebenzi elawulayo, yokuhamba kobuhlanga nendlu yokusebenzela kumisebenzi ye-LOCMA. Ukucothisa ukusetyenziswa kwezimoto zoluntu, kuquki ukudlulisa iimvume zokuqhuba iindawo ezithile, ukwabelisa izimoto kubasebenzi bengcaphephe, ukuqhuba iingqwalasela ngaphambi nangemva kokwenza iindawo zithile zezeimoto zoluntu, ukuqaphela ukukhonza kwezimoto nokuqinisekisa ukuba ukugcinwa kulandela njenge nkqubo yokukhonza, ukwabelisa abaqhubi ukuxhasa abasebenzi xa kufuneka, ukuhlaziya nokugcina ugqibo oluqinisekileyo woluntu lwezimoto zoluntu, nokugcina iindibano zeKomiti yeZokuhamba njengabakwibala lababali. Ukulungelelisa ukuhamba kobuhlanga nokuqeshwa kwamashort term kwizimoto, kuquki ukuhlela izikhulu zokuhamba ngenkampani yokuhamba ngokwenene ngokwamagunya, ukulandela iinkqubo zasebe ngokugcina iindleko xa kusetyenziswa iziphu, ukufumana nokusasaza i-accounts nyanga zonke kubasebenzi ngenjongo yokumiswa kwemivume yezokuqhuba iindawo ezithile, ukuhlanganisa nokuhambisa iingxelo zokuqhuba iindleko nyanga zonke kwiZimali, ukuqinisekisa izimangalo zokuhamba nokugcina iindleko zokuqhuba iindleko, ukudlulisa izicelo zokuqeshwa kwamashort term kwizimoto zokuhamba ngenjongo yokwenza izinto ngokwenene, nokuphatha iifomu zemivume yokuhamba nokwenza iindawo ezithile ngokukhawuleza ngemini yangaphandle kwiyure ezithile. Ukulawula inkqubo yemoto efunyanwa ngemali yophando, kuquki ukujongwa kolawulo lwemoto efunyanwa ngemali yophando (Inkqubo A no-B) kwingingqi, ukugcina iindleko ezithile zokuhamba nokwenza lula inkcitho yemali ebuyiselwa ngemiva, ukuqhuba iingqwalasela ezinyanga ngaphambi nangemva kokwenza iindawo ezithile, ukuhlela iindibano zeKomiti yamagunya efunyanwa ngemali yophando emacaleni, ukugcina iirekhodi ezahlaziyiweyo namaspredshithi abazima bamashort term, ukuqhuba iingqwalasela ezingahoyiyo ukuyinika isakhono sokwamkela amagunya, nokulawula imayileji yeSchematic A nokuqinisekisa ukungenwa kolwazi oluchanekileyo kwiMela. Ukuqhuba imisebenzi yeindlu yokusebenzela nesebe lezinkonzo zofisi, kuquki ukulungelelisa ukugcinwa kweofisi namazwe okuhlala, ukunika inkxaso yolwazi nolwandlalo ngokubanzi ukuze kusikelelwe ukusebenza okukhululekileyo nokuqinisekileyo, ukulungelelisa iindibano zobuhlanga nezinkonzo ezongezelelweyo, ukulawula imisebenzi yokuqhaqhamfunda yosuku, ukuyinika isakhono sokuba indawo yokusebenzela ikhuselekile, ihlanzekile igcinwe kakuhle, ukwenza iingqwalasela nyanga zonke kwindlu zofisi namaroom abantu baseburhulumente, ukulawula indawo yofisi kunye nokuqeshwa kuyo kwingingqi, nokulungelelisa ukulungelelisa iindibano kumagumbi abaluli. Ukwenza isicelo sefowuni kunye nemisebenzi yedatha, kuquki ukulawula ukuodlwa, ukunikwa nokuhlawula i-accounts zefowuni nedatha ngokwamagunya, ukusasaza amakhodi ePIN ezicelweni zokufowuna kwaye kuqinisekiswe ukuba iWi-Fi isebenza, ukuphendula iingxaki zentlalo namatyala angathethwa ukuphathelene nkonzo yothathwayo nentlalo yophando, ukusasaza nokuphatha i-accounts zefowuni nyanga zonke ngokwenene ukuze zihlawulwe, kunye nokulawula izixhobo zobuhlanga zofisi ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ngokungathi ngokwendalo. jobs.title: Occupational Health and Safety Officer
jobs.summary: Occupational Health and Safety Officer needed in Polokwane to implement OHS policies, conduct safety inspections and report hazards at the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 6 qualification in Occupational Health and Safety. One (1) to two (2) years' experience in an occupational health and safety environment. Disciplinary knowledge of occupational health and safety. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act No. 85 of 1993). Disciplinary knowledge of public administration. Knowledge of design principles, techniques and tools. Understanding of government legislation. Knowledge of equal opportunities and affirmative action guidelines and laws. Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems. Knowledge of departmental policies and procedures. Knowledge of government financial systems. Knowledge of learning and teaching procedures and techniques. Knowledge of the framework for managing performance information. Problem solving and analysis. Organising and planning skills. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Communication. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for implementing occupational health and safety (OHS) policies, programmes and procedures. Support the conducting of occupational health and safety inspections, including participating in scheduled workplace safety inspections, recording and reporting identified hazards to the Senior Occupational Health and Safety Officer, confirming that inspection checklists and documentation are completed accurately, and following up on basic corrective actions. Support the coordination of emergency drills, including communicating the plan and scheduling emergency drills, helping to communicate evacuation procedures to employees, distributing emergency materials, and collecting the attendance register and feedback during drills. Provide administrative support for occupational health and safety training activities, including helping to schedule training sessions for managers and OHS representatives, maintaining attendance registers and training records, distributing training materials and certificates, and following up on incomplete or missed training sessions. Support incident reporting and investigation processes, including recording incidents in the incident register, assisting in gathering basic incident details, filing and maintaining investigation reports and related documents, and tracking progress on recommended corrective actions. Maintain occupational health and safety documentation and records, including keeping files for inspections, incidents, training and risk assessments up to date, checking that OHS posters and notices are current and visible in the workplace, compiling statistics for internal reporting, and maintaining the inventory of first aid kits and safety equipment. Ensure the procurement and maintenance of personal protective equipment (PPE), including identifying the PPE requirements of field workers and other qualifying officials such as cleaners, facilitating the timely procurement and issuing of PPE, maintaining a register of PPE issued, and monitoring the condition of PPE and arranging for its repair or replacement when required.

af.title: Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte benodig in Polokwane om OHS-beleid te implementeer, veiligheidsinspeksies uit te voer en gevare te rapporteer by die Department of Water and Sanitation.
af.requirements: 'n Terwylike NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Een (1) tot twee (2) jaar se ervaring in 'n beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsomgewing. Dissiplinêre kennis van beroepsgesondheid en veiligheid. Kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, 1993 (Wet No. 85 van 1993). Dissiplinêre kennis van openbare administrasie. Kennis van ontwerpsbeginsels, tegnieke en gereedskap. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Kennis van gelyke geleenthede en regstellende aksie-riglyne en wette. Kennis van administratiewe en klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Kennis van departementele beleide en prosedures. Kennis van regeringsfinansiële stelsels. Kennis van leer- en onderrigprosedures en tegnieke. Kennis van die raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en klienst fokus. Kommunikasie. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die implementering van beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsbeleid, programme en prosedures. Ondersteun die uitvoering van beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsinspeksies, insluitend deelname aan geskeduleerde werkplekveiligheidsinspeksies, die opneem en rapporteer van geïdentifiseerde gevare aan die Senior Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte, bevestiging dat inspeksiekontrolelyste en dokumentasie akkuraat voltooi is, en opvolg van basiese korrektiewe maatreëls. Ondersteun die koördinering van noodoefeninge, insluitend die kommunikasie van die plan en skedulering van noodoefeninge, hulp met die kommunikasie van ontruimingsprosedures aan werknemers, verspreiding van noodmateriaal, en die versameling van die aanwesigheidsregister en terugvoer tydens oefeninge. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning vir beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsopleidingsaktiwiteite, insluitend hulp met die skedulering van opleidingsessies vir bestuurders en OHS-verteeenwoordigers, die handhawing van aanwesigheidsregisters en opleidingsrekords, verspreiding van opleidingsmateriaal en sertifikate, en opvolg van onvoltooide of gemiste opleidingsessies. Ondersteun insidentrapporterings- en ondersoekprosesse, insluitend die opneem van insidente in die insidentregister, hulp met die versameling van basiese insidentbesonderhede, indiening en handhawing van ondersoekverslae en verwante dokumente, en die opvolg van vordering aanbevole korrektiewe maatreëls. Onderhou beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsdokumentasie en rekords, insluitend die op datum hou van lêers vir inspeksies, insidente, opleiding en risikobeurdelings, kontroleer dat OHS-posters en kennissgewings aktueel en sigbaar in die werkplek is, samestelling van statistieke vir interne verslagdoening, en handhawing van die voorraad van noodhulpkissies en veiligheidsuitrusting. Verseker die verkryging en onderhoud van persoonlike beskermende uitrusting (PPE), insluitend die identifisering van die PPE-benodighede van veldwerkers en ander kwalifiserende amptenare soos skoonmakers, fasilitering van die tydige verkryging en uitreiking van PPE, handhawing van 'n register van uitgereikte PPE, en monitering van die toestand van PPE en reëling van die herstel of vervanging daarvan wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Umphasela Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezomsebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphasela Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezomsebenzi ePolokwane ukuphoqa izinqubomgomo ze-OHS, ukwenza ukuhlola ukuphepha kanye nokubika izingozi eDepartment of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezihambisanayo ezisingatheni 6 se-NQF kwezokuzivikela komsebenzi kanye nezempilo. Uholo lonyaka owodwa (1) kuya kwemibili (2) emvelweni wezokuzivikela komsebenzi kanye nezempilo. Ulwazi lomkhakha mayelana nezempilo kanye nokuphepha komsebenzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezomsebenzi, 1993 (Act No. 85 of 1993). Ulwazi lomkhakha mayelana nezenzululwazi kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokwakha, izindlela namathuluzi. Ukuqonda umthetho kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngamathuba alinganayo kanye nemihlahlandlela nemithetho yentando yeningi. Ulwazi ngezenzo nezinqubo zokuphatwa kwezokubhalisa nokweseka. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo zomnyango. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zezimali kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngezenzo kanye nezindlela zokufundisa nokufunda. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuphatha ulwazi ngemiphumela. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubaluleka kwezinhlobo-hlobo. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokunaka izidingo zabathengi. Ukuxhumana. Ukubekezelela kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba.
zu.duties: Owayenamsebenzi uzobe egwazwe ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo nezinqubo zezempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi (OHS). Ukusekela ukwenza izivivinyo zezempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi, kuhlanganise ukuthatha inxaxheba ezivivinyweni ezihleliwe zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza, ukurekhoda nokubika izingozi ezitholakele kumphansele Omkhulu Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezomsebenzi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlu lokuhlola namadokhumenti okuhlola agcwaliswe ngokuchanekile, kanye nokulandela izinyathelo ezisemthethweni zokulungisa. Ukusekela ukuhlanganisa ukuzivocavoca kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kuhlanganise ukwazisa iplani kanye nokuhlela ukuzivocavoca kwezimo eziphuthumayo, ukusiza ukwazisa izinqubo zoku疏散 abasebenzi, ukusatshalalisa izinto zezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nokuthatha uhlu lokubhalisa lokuhamba kanye nempendulo ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca. Ukunika inkxaso yomphathi kumansebenzi okudlulisela ulwazi ngempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi, kuhlanganise ukusiza ukuhlela izikhathi zokudlulisa ulwazi kubaphathi kanye nabamele i-OHS, ukugcina okubhaliwe ukubhalisa kwabathathi ngenxaxheba kanye namarekhodi okudlulisela ulwazi, ukusatshalalisa izinto zokudlulisela ulwazi namafithikheti, kanye nokulandela izikhathi ezingagcwalisiwe noma ezenyukelwe zokudlulisela ulwazi. Ukusekela izinqubo zokubika kanye nokuphenya ngomhlehlambamu, kuhlanganise ukurekhoda izenzakalo kwisi he lokubhala ngamasenzakalo, ukusiza ukuqoqa imininingwane yomsenzakalo,okuqoqwa nokugcina okubhaliwe ngokuphenya kanye namadokhenti ahlobene, kanye nokulandela inqubekela phambili kwezinyathelo ezenziwayo zokulungisa. Ukugcina ukuqashwa kwamadokhumenti namarekhodi ezempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amafayela okuhlola, izenzakalo, ukuqeqesha kanye nokuqashwa kwezingozi asanda ngolwazi, ukuhlola ukuthi amaphositha nezaziso ze-OHS awasanda futhi abonakala endaweni yokusebenza, ukuqoqa izibalo zokubingelela ngaphakathi, kanye nokugcina inothi yamakithi okusamathongo namaphakethe okuphepha. Ukugcina ukuthengwa nokunakekelwa kwegiyo yokuzivikela nomuntu (PPE), kuhlanganise ukuthola izidingo ze-PPE zabasebenzi basemasimini kanye nezikhulu ezifanele njengabahlezi, ukwenza lula ukuthengwa nokunikezwa kwe-PPE ngesikhathi esifanele, ukugcina uhlu lwe-PPE enikiwe, kanye nokuhlola isimo se-PPE futhi alungise noma ashintshe uma kudingeka.

xh.title: Mfundi wezoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka
xh.summary: Kufuneka ibe nguMfundi wezoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka ePolokwane ukuyisebenzisa iinkqubo ze-OHS, ukwenza iingxelo zokuqhanga ukhuseleko nokuxela iingozi kwiSebe leManzi nokuTshatyalaliswa.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo zenqanaba le-NQF 6 kwizoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka. Unyaka omnye (1) ukuya kwawamabini (2) amava kwimeko yezoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka. Ulwazi olubanzi ngazo zoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wezoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka, 1993 (Act No. 85 of 1993). Ulwazi olubanzi lolawulo loluntu. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokwakha, iindlela nezixhobo. Ukuqonda ngomthetho karhulumente. Ulwazi ngamathuba alinganayo namagqabantshintshi kumava nemigaqo yomthetho. Ulwazi ngeendlela zinze namaphuluwo olawulo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo namagqabagqaba esebe. Ulwazi ngeenkqabo zemali karhulumente. Ulwazi ngeendlela namagama okufundisa nokuzifundisa. Ulwazi ngesakhiwo sokulawula ulwazi ngokusebenza. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwadlulisa. Amandlaokuquka ohlelo nokuceba. Ukulawula abantu kunye nolwahluko. Uqwalaselo kumthengi kunye nokugxila kumthengi. Unxibelelwano. Ixabiso lokuphendula nendlela ethe nkqo.
xh.duties: Umntu ofakwe kule sithuba uza kuba nesibopho sokusebenzisa iinkqubo, iinkqaso nendlela zoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka (OHS). Ukuxhasa ukwenza iingxelo zokuqhanga zoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka, kuquka nokuqhatha kwiingxelo ezijadulwewe zokuqhanga ukhuseleko kwizikhululo zomsebenzi, ukurekhoda nokuxela iingozi ezifunyaniweyo kuMfundi oPhakamileyo wezoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka, ukuqinisekisa ukuba uluhlu lokujonga iingxelo nemiteto yopelo igqityiwe ngokuchanekileyo, noku landela izinyathelo ezisisiseko zokulungisa. Ukuxhasa ulungelelwaniso lamasiko omhalo, kuquka ukuxela icebo nokuqwalasela amasiko omhalo, ukuncedisa ukuxela iinkqubo zokushiywa koluntu kumsebenzi, ukusasaza iimpahla zomhalo, nokuthabatha uludwe lokubakho nokuva ngezwi ngexesha lamasiko. Ukunika inkxaso yolawulo kwiishishini zokufundisa zoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka, kuquka ukuncedisa ukulungiselela iinkqubo zokufundisa abaphathi nabameli be-OHS, ukugcina uludwe lokubakho nerekhodo lokufundisa, ukusasaza iimpahla zokufundisa namangqina, noku landela iinkqubo ezingagqitywanga okanye ezingafundiwanga. Ukuxhasa iinkqubo zokuxela nophando ngeenkwetho, kuquka ukurekhoda iinkwetho kwirekhodi yeenkwetho, ukuncedisa kuqokelela iinkcukacha ezingundoqo zeenkwetho, ukugcina nokuyigcina iingxelo zophando namaxwebhu ahlobene nazo, noku landela inkqundo kwizinyathelo ezicebiswayo zokulungisa. Ukugcina uxinzelelo nerekhodo lwezoPhilo lweSebenza nokuKhuseleka, kuquka ukugcina iifayili zokuqhanga iingxelo, iinkwetho, ukufundisa nokuqwalasela iingozi zibuye zibe ngenxanxangeli, ukuqinisekisa ukuba iiposta nezaziso ze-OHS zikhangeleka ngokuqhelekileyo zivele kwizikhululo zomsebenzi, ukuqamba izibalo ngeenjongo zokuxela ngaphakathi, nokugcina uludwe lweekithi zokonyanzela nempahla yokhuseleko. Ukusika inqinisiswa ukuba kuthengwa kwaye kugcinwa iimpahla zokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko komntu (PPE), kuquka nokuqonda iimfuno ze-PPE zabasebenzi basesithubeni kunye nabanye abaphatheleleko abafanelekileyo njengabaqushi, ukwenza lula ukuthengwa nokunikelwa kwe-PPE ngexesha, ukugcina uludwe lwe-PPE ezelwe, nokuqwalasela imeko ye-PPE nalungeniso lokuyilungisa okanye ukuyitshintsha xa kudingeka.
