Kulturele bewustheid. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die amptenaar sal verantwoordelik wees vir hulp met die implementering van gekoördineerde byeenkomste, kommunikasieveldtogte en strategiese planne wat daarop gemik is om begrip te bevorder, bewustheid op te bou en 'n gunstige persepsie van LOCMA onder interne en eksterne belanghebbendes te skep. Koördineer LOCMA-byeenkomste, insluitend die ontwikkeling en implementering van kommunikasieplanne ter ondersteuning van veldtogte, die ontleding van strategiese doelwitte en die dienooreenkomstige belyning van kommunikasie-pogings, en die voorstel van wysigings aan bestaande beleide om kommunikasie-effektiwiteit te verbeter. Skakel met sleutelrolspelers om belyning en samewerking te verseker en skep uitvoerbare planne vir die versekering van mediadekking van byeenkomste en inisiatiewe. Verseker die tydige en akkurate verspreiding van geskrewe en visuele kommunikasiemateriaal aan belanghebbendes. Stel geskrewe uitnodigings aan belanghebbendes vir LOCMA-byeenkomste op en stuur dit. Tree as 'n sleuteldeelnemer in die strategiese plan van die watersektor op, help met die opstel van die strategiese plan en begrotingsbestuur vir die kommunikasie-afdeling, en bevorder en handhaaf positiewe belanghebbende verhoudings. Hanteer byeenkomslogistiek en plekbestuur, insluitend die versekering van geskikte plekke, die inligting van werknemers en belanghebbendes oor byeenkomslokasies en -besonderhede, en die publikasie en verspreiding van inligting rakende byeenkomste. Help met die opstel en onderhoud van gaslyste, stuur uitnodigings tydig aan tersaaklike belanghebbendes, onderhou 'n opgedateerde gaslys-databasis, en hou kalenders huidig en in lyn met beplande aktiwiteite. Stel interne kommunikasie op en skryf die interne nuusbrief, insluitend die skryf en samestelling van artikels, die voorsiening van logistieke ondersteuning vir die kommunikasiekomponent, die versekering dat publisiteitsprojekte en -byeenkomste aan gestelde doelwitte en verwagtinge voldoen, die skakeling met belanghebbendes om bydraes tot die nuusbrief te koördineer, en die vestiging van sterk belanghebbende verhoudings ter ondersteuning van interne kommunikasie.

zu.title: Inkonzakuliqiniseko Yokuxhumana
zu.summary: Isikhundla senkonzakuliqiniseko yokuxhumana ePolokwane eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nokuhlanzwa, sinikeza R338,106 ngonyaka ezingeni 7.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingeni 6 le-NQF (National Diploma) ezibhekene Nokuxhumana, Izifundo Zabezindaba, Ukuhlobana Nomphakathi noma indlela ehlobene nakho njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Unyaka (1) weminyaka yohlelo oluhambisana. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokuqasha evakalayo ezeke ihora noma ngaphansi kokuba isiphephile. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuxhumana kanye nezifundo zabezindaba, isayensi yezombusazwe namapholisi, kanye nolawulwa kombuso. Ulwazi ngemigomo yokwakha, amasu namathuluzi. Ulwazi ngaphequlula, ukuhlola nokulungisa amaphutha emibhalo. Ukuqonda umthetho ophathelene nesekhethi yamanzi. Ukuqondisa imali nokwazi umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi (PFMA). Ulwazi ngamasu nangqikithi zokuhlela nokusebenza kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngokuqondisa amaphrogrami namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokwengqondo ezahlukene, ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukudala nokuba nokwazi, ukuthuthuka ngobuchwepheshe, kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ukwazi ngamasiko. Ukubeka izibulo nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba.
zu.duties: Lowo othweswe isikhundla uzobe nesibopho sokusiza ekuphumeleiseni imicimbi ehleliwe, amaphrojekthi okuxhumana namapholisi ahleliwe ahlose ukuthuthukisa ukuqonda, ukwakha ulwazi nokwakha umbono omuhle nge-LOCMA kubaphathi bakuleminingi nangaphandle. Ukuhlanganisa imicimbi ye-LOCMA, okufaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa nokuphumelelisa amapholisi okuxhumana okusekela amaphrojekthi, ukuhlaziya imigomo ebalulekile bese kulungisanwa imizamo yokuxhumana ngokufanele, nokuphakamisa izinguqulo kumapholisi okwamanje ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kokuxhumana. Ukuhlobana nabaphathi ababalulekile ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhambisana nokusebenza ndawonye, futhi kudalwe amapholisi asebenzayo okufika kumaphuzu abezindaba mayelana nemicimbi namaphrojekthi. Ukuqinisekisa ukusakazwa ngokushesha futhi ngokuqondile kwemithombo emibhalonasezithombeni ebalulekile kubaphathi. Ukubhala nokuthumela izimemo ezibhalwe kubaphathi ngenhloso yemicimbi ye-LOCMA. Ukubamba iqhaza elibalulekile ohlelweni lucwaningi lombhalo weSekhethi yamanzi, ukusiza ekudaleni uhlelo lucwaningi nokuphathwa kwebhajethi ohlelweni lokuxhumana, kanye nokugcina futhi ukuthuthukisa ubuhlobo obuhle nabaphathi. Ukuphathwa kwezidingo zemicimbi namasimu, okuhlanganisa ukufuna amasimu afanele, ukwazisa abasebenzi nabaphathi mayelana nezindawo kanye nemininingwane yemicimbi, nokushicilela nokusakaza ulwazi oluhlobene nemicimbi. Ukusiza ekuqotheni nokugcina izinkulungwane, ukuthumela izimemo kubaphathi abahambisayo ngokushesha, ukugcina okwamanisekile idathabhesi yohlu lwabantu, nokulandela amakhalenda manje bese ehambisana nemisebenzi ehleliwe. Ukuqotha imiyalezo yangaphakathi kanye nokubhala incwadi yemiyalezo yangaphakathi, okufaka phakathi ukubhala kanye nokuqotha izindatshana, ukunikeza inkosazo yokuxhasa ingxenye yokuxhumana, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi okukhuthazwa kanye nemicimbi ehlangabezana nemigumo kanye nezethemba, ukuhlobana nabaphathi ukuze kuhlanganiswe okufakwe kwincwadi yemiyalezo yangaphakathi, nokwakha ubuhlobo obuhle nabaphathi ukuze kusekelwe imiyalezo yangaphakathi.

xh.title: Iofisa WokuQhuba Izenzo
xh.summary: Isithuba sofisa wokuqhuba izenzo ePolokwane kwiSebe leManzi nokuCoca amanzi, sinika umvuzo weR338,106 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-7.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezikumanqanaba we-6 we-NQF (iDiploma yesiLungu) ekuQhubeni iZinto phambili, ekuFunda ngeMidia, ekuQhuba uBudlelwane boLuntu okanye indawo ekufana nayo njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava ahambelanayo. Ukuvezwa kwelayisensi yokushayela egqithisiweyo ngesixa esisezinyeni. Ulwazi ngokuQhuba iZinto phambili nokuFunda ngeMidia, nzululwazi yezopolitiko nengcaciso leenkcukacha, nolawulo lwabaphathi bokawonke-wonke. Ulwazi ngamagama oqondo wokwakha, iindlela nezixhobo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yokubhala, ukuhlola nokulungisa amaphutha. Ukuqonda ngomthetho ophatha candulo lwamanzi. Ukulawula iimali nolwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweeMali zoRhululo (i-PFMA). Ulwazi ngeendlela nendlela yokwenza izicwangciso nokuQhuba izigqibo. Ulwazi ngokuLawula iinkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuLawula ubudlelwane. Amandla okuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukulawula abantu nolwahluko, unxibelelwano, ukulawula iingxabano, ukuzala ngemiba kunye nokuqonda okujoliswe kumxhasi. Ukuqonda ngenkcubeko. Ixabiso nolawulo ngokuziphatha kakuhle.
xh.duties: Owayo kule sihlandlo ungomntu ozakubizwa ngokuba yinkxaso ekuphothweni kweenkqubo ezihambelanayo, amajelo wokunxibelelanisa neenjongo ezicwangcisiweyo ngenjongo yokukhuthaza ukuqonda, ukwakha ulwazi nokudala umbono omhle ngo-LOCMA kubantu abachaphazelekayo ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukulungelelanisa iinkqubo ze-LOCMA, kuquka nokuphucula nokuphothula iinkqubo zokunxibelelanisa ukuxhasa amajelo, ukuhlalutya iinjongo ezicwangcisiweyo nokuzibekisa ngokwale nxibelelwano, kunye nokusengayo iinguquko kumagunya angoku ukuze kulungiseke ukusebenza kokunxibelelana. Ukunxibelelana nabantu abalulekileyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambelana nokusebenzisana kwaye kudalwe iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zase midia zithi xa kukho iinkqubo nokuqaliswa kwezinto. Ukuzinikezela ngexesha elifanelekileyo nolunye ulwazi ngemigca yabachaphazelekayo. Ukubhala nokuthumela imibuzo ebhalwe ngabachaphazelekayo ngeenkqubo ze-LOCMA. Ukubakho njengomntu othatha inxaxheba ekucwangcisweni kwezicwangciso ezibalulekileyo kwiNkcukacha zoLawulo lwamaza, ukuncedisa ekubhalekeni isicwangciso esibalulekileyo nokulawula imali yecandelo lonxibelelwano, nasekukhuliseni nokugcinweni kobudlelwane obuhle nabachaphazelekayo. Ukujongana nokuqhelaniswa kweenkqubo nolawulo lweendawo zeenkqubo, kuquka nokuqinisekisa iindawo ezifanelekileyo, ukwazisa abaqeshi nabachaphazelekayo ngezindawo zeenkqubo nolunye ulwazi, kunye nokushicilela nokusasaza ulwazi malunga neenkqubo. Ukuncedisa ekubhaliweni nokugciniweni koludwe lwamagxabi, ukuthumela iimvobo kubachaphazelekayo ngexesha elifanelekileyo, ukugcina uludwe olutsha lwamagxabi kwesakhulu samanani, nokuza konke nokugcina amakhalenda ahambelana nokuqhelana neenkqubo ezicwangcisiweyo. Ukuqokelela ulwazi lokunxibelelana ngaphakathi nokubhala iphepha-ndaba langaphakathi, kuquka ukubhala nokuqokelela iindaba, ukunika inkxaso yokuqhelaniswa kwecandelo lonxibelelwano, ukuqinisekisa ukuba amaphrojekthi okuqhayisa nantsebenziso efezisa iinjongo ezicwangcisiweyo nokuqinisekiswa kwezinto, ukunxibelelana nabachaphazelekayo ukuze kuhambelaniswe imibuzo kule phepha-ndaba, nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinileyo nabachaphazelekayo ukuxhasa ulwazi lokunxibelelana ngaphakathi.

jobs.title: Community Development Officer
jobs.centre: Polokwane Ref No: LOCMA 42 Hartbeespoort Ref No: LOCMA 43 (X2 Posts) Bronkhorstspruit Ref No: LOCMA 44 (X3 Posts)
jobs.summary: Facilitate planning and implementation of integrated social development programmes across multiple centres to empower communities through a community development approach.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 6 (National Diploma or N Diploma) in Social Sciences. One (1) to two (2) years’ experience in a community development environment. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge of community development work, skills, attitudes and values of communities. Knowledge and understanding of human behaviour and social systems, and of legislation, to assist with interventions at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote self-empowerment. Knowledge and understanding of basic financial management. The ability and competence to coordinate community development structures and to manage projects. The ability to influence individuals and groups to participate in their own self- empowerment ventures. Understanding of the social dynamics of communities Presentation, problem solving, computer, facilitation and research skills. Good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for facilitating the identification, planning and implementation of integrated and transformative social development programmes in partnership with key stakeholders, for the effective empowerment of human and social capital through a community development approach towards sustainable livelihoods. Identify and facilitate the implementation of integrated community development interventions in partnership with communities and other relevant stakeholders, including establishing social relationships and scoping communities to understand current community services, service delivery blockages, resources and needs. Compile community profiles and facilitate planning and prioritisation by formulating goals and objectives, assessing available resources, setting time frames and compiling budgets. Facilitate the implementation of integrated development activities, monitor and evaluate implementation, and give feedback to communities and other relevant stakeholders. Liaise and coordinate with all relevant role players and internal and external stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and establish partnerships that ensure the sustainability of development actions within communities. Create structures and platforms that entrench sector collaboration and promote coherent and integrated planning and promote and strengthen intergovernmental relations. Support communities and perform administrative support on community development and related activities, including providing input into policy development and maintaining relevant records. Monitor and evaluate projects and other community development ventures and report on progress. Facilitate the registration of emerging local structures, such as Non-Profit Organisations (NPOs), and monitor their compliance with the Nonprofit Organisations Act and the PFMA. Facilitate, coordinate and participate in awareness campaigns and public appearances aimed at educating communities and other stakeholders on self-empowerment. Develop, maintain and update databases, and ensure that financial measures are adhered to by beneficiary organisations. Keep up to date with new developments in the community development field to enhance service delivery. Provide institutional support and social facilitation for infrastructure development, including participating in conceptualisation, design, implementation and commissioning of water and sanitation bulk projects to ensure that social and human aspects are catered for. Ensure capacity building, training and knowledge resource facilitation for project steering committees, and contribute towards a culture of accountability and compliance with prescripts through social facilitation.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions to those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeampte
af.summary: Fasiliteer beplanning en implementering van geïntegreerde maatskaplike ontwikkelingsprogramme oor verskeie sentrums om gemeenskappe te bemagtig deur middel van 'n gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbenadering.
af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 6 (Nasionale Diploma of N Diploma) in Sosiale Wetenskappe. Een (1) tot twee (2) jaar se ervaring in 'n gemeenskapsontwikkelingsomgewing. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, ongebruikte bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk, vaardighede, houdings en waardes van gemeenskappe. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en maatskaplike stelsels, en van wetgewing, om bystand te verleen by ingrypings op die punte waar mense met hul omgewings in wisselwerking tree om selfbemagtiging te bevorder. Kennis en begrip van basiese finansiële bestuur. Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture te koördineer en projekte te bestuur. Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om aan hul eie selfbemagtigingsondernemings deel te neem. Begrip van die maatskaplike dinamika van gemeenskappe. Voorlegging-, probleemoplossings-, rekenaar-, fasiliterings- en navorsingsvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die fasilitering van die identifisering, beplanning en implementering van geïntegreerde en transformerende maatskaplike ontwikkelingsprogramme in vennootskap met sleutelbelanghebbendes, vir die effektiewe bemagtiging van menslike en maatskaplike kapitaal deur 'n gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbenadering tot volhoubare bestaan. Identifiseer en fasiliteer die implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsingrypings in vennootskap met gemeenskappe en ander relevante belanghebbendes, insluitend die vestiging van maatskaplike verhoudings en die ondersoek van gemeenskappe om huidige gemeenskapsdienste, diensleweringsblokkades, hulpbronne en behoeftes te verstaan. Stel gemeenskapsprofiele op en fasiliteer beplanning en prioritisering deur doelwitte en oogmerke te formuleer, beskikbare hulpbronne te assesseer, tydraames te stel en begrotings op te stel. Fasiliteer die implementering van geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite, monitor en evalueer implementering, en gee terugvoer aan gemeenskappe en ander relevante belanghebbendes. Skakel en koördineer met alle relevante rolspelers en interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om samewerking te fasiliteer en vennootskappe te vestig wat die volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaksies binne gemeenskappe verseker. Skep strukture en platforms wat sektorsamewerking vestig en_samehangende en geïntegreerde beplanning bevorder, en bevorder en versterk intergoewermentele verhoudings. Ondersteun gemeenskappe en verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning rondom gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite, insluitend die verskaffing van insette in beleidsontwikkeling en die onderhoud van relevante rekords. Monitor en evalueer projekte en ander gemeenskapsontwikkelingsondernemings en rapporteer oor vordering. Fasiliteer die registrasie van opkomende plaaslike strukture, soos Nie-Winsgewende Organisasies (NPO's), en monitor hul nakoming van die Wet op Nie-Winsgewende Organisasies en die PFMA. Fasiliteer, koördineer en neem deel aan bewusmakingsveldtogte en openbare verskynings wat daarop gemik is om gemeenskappe en ander belanghebbendes oor selfbemagtiging op te voed. Ontwikkel, onderhou en werk databasisse by, en verseker dat finansiële maatreëls deur begunstigde organisasies nagekom word. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld om dienslewering te verbeter. Verskaf institusionele ondersteuning en maatskaplike fasilitering vir infrastruktuurontwikkeling, insluitend deelname aan konseptualisering, ontwerp, implementering en inbedryfstelling van water- en sanitasie-bulkprojekte om te verseker dat maatskaplike en menslike aspekte voorsien word. Verseker kapasiteitsbou, opleiding en kennisbronfasilitering vir projekteer-stuurkomitees, en dra by tot 'n kultuur van verantwoordbaarheid en nakoming van voorskrifte deur maatskaplike fasilitering.

zu.title: Inkantsha YoPhuhliso Lomphakathi
zu.summary: Qhuba ukuhlela nokuphumezisa izinhlelo zophuhliso lwezenhlalo eziyisodwa kuzo zonke izikhungo ukunika amandla imiphakathi ngendlela yophuhliso lomphakathi.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 6 (National Diploma noma i-N Diploma) kwezeSayensi Zezenhlalo. Uholo lweyunyazi lokuqashwa komunye (1) kuye kwamabili (2) iminyaka kumazinga ephuhliso lomphakathi. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nengakapheli. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi wophuhliso lomphakathi, amakhono, izinkundla zokuziphatha kanye namagugu womphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda indlela okuziphatha ngayo abantu kanye nezinhlelo zezenhlalo, kanye nomthetho, ukusize ekungenisweni kwemizamo lapho abantu bethintana nemvelo yabo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzinikela amandla. Ulwazi nokuqonda izisekelo zokuqasha imali. Ikhono nesisindo sokuhlanganisa izakhiwo zophuhliso lomphakathi nokulawula amaphrojekthi. Ikhono lokutshefa abantu nabaqenqshi ukuthi babambe iqhaza kumahlelo abo okuzinikela amandla. Ukuqonda ukujikeleka kwezenhlalo komphakathi. Amakhono okwethula, okuxazulula izinkinga, komkhaya wamakhompyutha, okuqhuba kanye nocwaningo. Amakhono amahlela okukhuluma nokubhala.
zu.duties: Othishiwe uzobe nesibopho sokuhola ukuhlukaniswa, ukuhlela nokuphumezisa izinhlelo zophuhliso lwezenhlalo eziyisodwa nezedlulisayo ohlelweni lokusebenza nabaphathi ababalulekile, ukuze kube nokuqinisekiswa okusebenzayo kokuzinikela amandla ekuphathelene nabantu kanye nekhaphethi yezenhlalo ngendlela yophuhliso lomphakathi okuyona imiprotho ehlala isikhathi eside. Hlukanisa futhi uqube ukuphumeziswa kokungena kokuhleleka komphakathi ngokusizakala nomphakathi kanye nabanye abaphathi abafanele, okuhlanganisa nokwakhiwa kwezihlobo zezenhlalo nokuhlola imiphakathi ukuze kuqondeke izinsiza zomphakathi ezikhathmayo, izivalo zokulethwa kwezinsiza, amathuluzi kanye nezidingo. Hlela imibhalo yomphakathi uze uqube ukuhlela nokubeka izinto ezibalulekile ngokuhlenga amagugu kanye namagomo, kokuthola amathuluzi akhona, ukubeka amabanga wobungako kanye nokuhlela izimali. Qhuba ukuphumeziswa kwezinhlela zophuhliso oluyisodwa, uqaphe futhi uhlolisise ukuphumeziswa, unikeze imiphakathi kanye nabanye abaphathi abafanele imibiko yemiphumela. Xhumanisa futhi uhlanganise nabaphathi abafanele bonke abadlala indima kanye nabaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqhubwe ukusebenza kwezinsiza nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano eziqinisekisa ukuba kokuhlala isikhathi eside kwezenzo zophuhliso emiphakathini. Yakha izakhiwo nezinkundla eziqinisa ukusebenza kwamanye amaqembu futhi ukhuthaze ukuhlelwa okuhlangeneyo nangaphandle kokuxubana, futhi ukhuthaze kuqinise ukuthi kube nokuhlelizwa okuhle phakathi kwezinhlangano kahulumeni. Sekela imiphakathi futhi uenze ukusekelwa okuphathelene nemibhalo kophuhliso lomphakathi kanye neminye imisebenzi ehlobene, okuhlanganisa nokunika izimangalo ekuthakalazeni kwezinhlelo zemithetho kanye nokugcina imibhalo ephathelene nakho. Qaphe futhi uhlolisise amaphrojekthi nanye imihlela yophuhliso lomphakathi bese umbika ngokuqhubeka kwayo. Qhuba ukubhaliswa kwezakhiwo ezintsha zaseduze, njengamahlelo e-Non-Profit Organisations (NPOs), futhi uqaphe ukuthi akeze emthethweni i-Nonprofit Organisations Act kanye ne-PFMA. Qhuba, hlanganisa futhi uthathe inxaxheba kumahlela okwazisa kanye nokubonakala kolwonga ukuhola ukufundisa imiphakathi kanye nabanye abaphathi ngokuzinikela amandla. Yakha, ulondoloze futhi uvuse izinhlelo zemininingwane, futhi uqinise ukulandelwa kwezinyawo zemali izinhlelo ezibonekayo. Hlala ulwazi ngalokhu okusha okuphathelene nophuhliso lomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Nikeza ukusekelwa ngenhlalo kwezikhungo kanye nokuholela emtshatweni wemibhalo yophuhliso lomphakathi, okuhlanganisa nokubamba iqhaza ekuyizeni, esikweni, ekuqhubekeni nasekuqedisweni kwamaphrojekthi amakhulu amanzi kanye nezandle ezithuthukisa imiphakathi, ukuqinisekisa amaphoyinti omphakathi kanye nabahlinzeki emtshatweni. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa kwekhono, ukuqeqesha nokuholela kolwazi ukuze kusetshenziswa abayini bamaphrojekthi, kanye nokuba yisabelo esikhundleni sobuhlobo bokuziphendulela nokuhambisana nemiyalo ngeqiniso ngokuhola emtshatweni wezenhlalo.

xh.title: IOfisi yoPhuhliso lweNdalo
xh.summary: Qhoboshela uqulunqo nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezidityanisiweyo zophuhliso lwezentlalo kumaziko amaninzi ukuzincedisa iindlu ngokusebenzisa indlela yophuhliso lwendalo.
xh.requirements: I-NQF level 6 (National Diploma okanye i-N Diploma) kwi-Social Sciences. Unyaka omnye (1) kuye kwamawodwa (2) wamava kwindawo yophuhliso lwendalo. Ukuchaza ilayisenisi yokushuka esebenzayo engazange iphele. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi wophuhliso lwendalo, amakhono, imiqondo kunye namaxabiso ezindlu. Ulwazi nokuqonda indlela yokuziphatha kabantu kunye neenkqubo zeentlalo, nangomthetho, ukunceda nokinikelo apho abantu baphathana namajondo abo ukuze bakhuthaze ukuzincedisa. Ulwazi nokuqonda embonakaliso wokuqaliswa kwemali. Ikhono nakho ukulungelelanisa iisakhiwo zophuhliso lwendalo nokulawula iiprojekthi. Ikhono lokumela abantu ababini kunye namaqela ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuzincedisa. Ukuqonda ukujikeleza kweentlalo kwezindlu. Amakhono okubonisa, ukusombulula iingxaki, ekhompyutheni, okuqhoboshelayo nokuphonononga. Amakhono amabalawuni afunekayo okuthetha nokubhala.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi unomthwalo wokuqhoboshela ukuchonga, uqulunqo nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezidityanisiweyo nokuguquguqukayo zophuhliso lwezentlalo ngokusebenzisana nabaphathi ababalulekileyo, ukuzincedisa ngokusebenzayo onke amathambo abantu nentlalo ngendlela yophuhliso lwendalo ekujolisweni kwimpilo ezelweyo. Chonga ukuze uqhoboshele ukusebenzisa ukunikelwa ngokudityanisiweyo kophuhliso lwendalo ngokusebenzisana ngezindlu nabo baye balandela kwindawo abalulekileyo, kuquka ukusekela iindibaniselwano zeentlalo nokuhlola iindlu ukuba uqonde iinkonzo zangoku, iingozi ezibambe inkonzo, amathuba namadinga. Qulunqa iinkcazelo ngezindlu uze uqhoboshele uqulunqo nokubeka ngokuqaliswa iinjongo namagelo, ukuqonda amathuba akhoyo, ukumisela amaxesha nokwenza amabhajeti. Qhobosha ukusebenziswa kokudityaniswa kweentsholo zophuhliso, qwalasela ukuze uhlole ukusebenza, uze unike iindlu nabo bangabalandeli abalulekileyo izimvo. Qhagamshelana ulungelelanise nabo bonke abathathi nxaxheba kunye nabalandeli abangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze uqhoboshele ukusebenzisana uze useke izivumelwano eziqinisekisa ukusuka kude ukugcinwa kwezenzo zophuhliso ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Sakhe iisakhiwo ngezixhobo ezifaka isiseko esiqinileyo ukuqalisana kwemiqulu nokukhuthaza uqulunqo oludityanisiweyo, lukhuthaze lome ngamandla iindibaniselwano phakathi kolwiso. Nceda iindlu uzenze imisebenzi yolawulo ngophuhliso lwendalo nokuqhuba okanye ukunxulumene noko, kuquka ukunikela ngemiba kulawulo lomthetho wokulondoloza iirekhodi ezifunekayo. Qwalasela uze uhlole iiprojekthi nolunye uhlobo lwophuhliso lwendalo uze uchaze ngokuqhubeka. Qhobosha ukubhalisa iisakhiwo ezanda kwindawo, njenge-NPOs, uze uhlole ingqinelano nabo ngomthetho we-Nonprofit Organisations Act ne-PFMA. Qhobosha, lungelelanise uthathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo zokwazisa nasekuveleni esidlangalaleni ukuba kufundiswe iindlu nolunye uluntu ngokuzincedisa. Qulunqa, zigcine uze uzihlaziye i-data, uze uqinisekise ukuba iindlela zeemali zilandwa ziinkqubo ezincedwayo. Zigcine ulwazi ngokuqhubeka kwamahla amaninzi kwindawo yophuhliso lwendalo ukuphucula inkonzo. Nikeza inkxaso yoluntu nokqhoboshela kwezentlalo nakuqaliswa kophuhliso lwemizi-mveliso, kuquka ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuyileni, ekuyilweni, ekusebenziseni nasekuqalisweni kweeprojekthi zangentsini nxo lemanzi namathambo ukwenza ukuba izinto zokwentsalo namathambo omntu zihlengiwe. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa kwamandla, ukolula ukulungele ulwazi nokuqhoboshela ngolwazi kwiqela elilawula iiprojekthi, uze unike umba kwenkqubo yokwazisa amandla okuziphendulela nokulandelwa komthetho ngokuziphatha okungathathi nxaxheba.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk (PRODUCTION)
jobs.centre: Polokwane Ref No: LOCMA 45 (X2 Posts) Bronkhorstspruit Ref No: LOCMA 46 (X2 Posts) Hartbeespoort Ref No: LOCMA 47 (X2 Posts)
jobs.summary: Administrative clerks needed at multiple centres to provide general clerical support including data capture, record management and routine enquiries, requiring a Grade 12 certificate.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or relevant qualification. Knowledge of clerical functions and practices, as well as the ability to capture data, operate a computer and collate administrative statistics. Basic knowledge and insight of Human Resource prescripts. Knowledge of basic financial operating systems (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, etc.). Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment. Interpersonal relations, flexibility and teamwork. Basic knowledge of problem solving and analysis. People and diversity management, client orientation and customer focus. Computer literacy, planning and organising, and language skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for rendering administrative support services. Render general clerical support services, including recording, organising, storing, capturing and retrieving correspondence and data, updating registers and statistics, and handling routine enquiries. Make photocopies, receive and send facsimiles, distribute documents and packages to various stakeholders as required, and keep and maintain the filing system and the incoming and outgoing document register of the component. Type letters and other correspondence when required. Provide supply chain management support services, including liaising with internal and external stakeholders on the procurement of goods and services, obtaining quotations and completing procurement forms for the purchasing of standard office items. Exercise stock control of office stationery and keep and maintain the asset register of the component. Provide personnel administration clerical support services, including maintaining the leave register, personnel records and attendance register of the component, and arranging travelling and accommodation. Provide financial administration support services, including capturing and updating expenditure, checking the correctness of subsistence and travel claims of officials and submitting them to the manager for approval, and handling telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: The Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions to those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Administrasieklerk (PRODUKSIE)
af.summary: Administrasieklerke word by verskeie sentrums benodig om algemene klerklike ondersteuning te bied, insluitend datavaslegging, rekordbestuur en roetine-navrae. 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat word vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Senior-/Graad 12-sertifikaat of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Kennis van klerklike funksies en gebruike, asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en administratiewe statistiek bymekaar te maak. Basiese kennis en insig van Menslike Hulpbronvoorskrifte. Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, ens.). Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Tussenmenslike verhoudings, buigsaamheid en spanwerk. Basiese kennis van probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur, kliëntgerigtheid en kundige fokus. Rekenaarvaardigheid, beplanning en organisasie, en taalvaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die lewer van administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Lewer algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend die opteken, organiseer, stoor, vaslê en terugkry van korrespondensie en data, die bywerk van registries en statistieke, en die hanteer van roetine-navrae. Maak fotostate, ontvang en stuur faksimiles, versprei dokumente en pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis, en hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel en die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Tik briewe en ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Verskaf toeleweringskettingbestuursondersteuningsdienste, insluitend skakeling met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes oor die verkryging van goedere en dienste, die verkryging van kwotasies en die invul van verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaardkantoorartikels. Oefen voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie uit en hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent. Verskaf personeeladministratiewe klerklike ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend die onderhou van die verlofregister, personeelrekords en bywoningsregister van die komponent, en die reël van reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend die vaslê en bywerk van besteding, die nagaan van die korrektheid van bestuurs- en reis-aansoeke van amptenare en die voorlê daarvan aan die bestuurder vir goedkeuring, en die hanteer van telefoonrekeninge en klein kontant vir die komponent.

zu.title: ISikhundla sokuphatha izincwadi (PRODUCTION)
zu.summary: Kudingwa abaphathi bezincwadi emasikhungini amaningi ukuze banikele inkuseleko yansuku zonke yokuphatha izincwadi okuhlanganisa ukugcinwa kwemininingwane, ukuphatwa kwezinkomba kanye nemibuzo evamile, okudinga isitifiketi se-Grade 12.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma izifundo ezihambisana nalo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi nokuhamba kwezincwadi, kanye nenkono lokugcina imininingwane, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo zokuphatha. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngemithetho ehlobene nabasebenzi. Ulwazi mayelana namasistimu ezimali eziyisisekelo (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, okunye). Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho ohlolwayo ophatha Isevisi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngokuqhathaniswa kwemisebenzi ngokusebenza kwindawo yokusebenza. Ubudlelwano nabantu, ukuguquguquka kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nokuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nobuhlukahluka, ukuqondiswe kumthengi kanye nokuqala komthengi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuhlelela, kanye namakhono abalimi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukuzekelela nokuziphatha ngokuyiqondwisiso.
zu.duties: Lowo wayekela isikhundla sobekile uzobe ohlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokweseka ukuphathwa kwezincwadi. Unikele inkuseleko evamile yokuphatha izincwadi, okuhlanganisa ukurekhoda, ukuhlelela, ukugcina, ukuthatha nokulondolozwa kwemininingwane, ukwenza izibalo nokuqoqa imininingwane, nokubhekana nemibuzo evamile. Akenise izikopishI, wamukele wathumele ifeksi, abeke izincwadi emakethe abahlukene njengokuqondiwe, agcine alondoloze uhlelo lokugcina izincwadi kanye nerejista yezincwadi ezitholakala kanye nezithunyelwa lesigaba. Athayiphe izincwadi nezinye izithumeli ngenkathi kudingwa. Anikele inkuseleko mayelana nokuphathwa kwentengiso yezimpahla, okuhlanganisa nokuxhumana namanye abahlukile baphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuthenga impahla kanye nezinkonzo, ukuthola izilinganiso kanye nokuqedela amafomu okuthenga izimpahla zansofini. Ahlole ukweseka izimpahla zensihlahla zobuchwepheshe, agcine alondoloze irejista yezimpahla lesigaba. Anikele inkuseleko yokuphatha izincwadi zabasebenzi, okuhlanganisa ukugcina irejista yeziguqulo, izinkomba zabasebenzi kanye nerejista yobungenelelo lesigaba, ahlele ukuhamba kanye nendawo yokulala. Anikele inkuseleko mayelana nokuphathwa kwezimali, okuhlanganisa ukugcina nokuhlaziya izimali ezikhishiwe, ukuhlola ukulunga kwezinsiza kwezimali zabahamba ezinkundleni zabasebenzi baze abathumele kumengameli ukugunyazwa, kanye nokubheka izikikidi zocingo nemali ephydhana lesigaba.

xh.title: Ilisebe Lezenkonzo Ezingowonke (UMVELISO)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ababhalisi benkonzo ezowonke kwiziko eziliqela ukunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yobhaliso ehlangabezayo kuquka nokuthatha iinkcukacha zedata, ulawulo lweenkqubo namarekhodi, namava ajolise kumisebenzi yamaxesha angenayo, kufunekele ifestile yesitshixo seGrade 12.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior/Grade 12 okanye isiqinisekiso esihambelanayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yobhaliso nendlela yokuyenza, nakho nokuqamba idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa iinomba zenkonzo ezowonke. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo nokuqonda iimilaqumbo zobuNini bendalo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo ezisezantsi eziphathelene nezimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, njl.). Ulwazi nokuqonda ingqungquthela yomthetho elawula iNkonzo zoLuntu. Ulwazi lwamasimi okusebenza ngokulingana nendalo yokwenza umsebenzi. Iimviswano phakathi kwabantu, ukuguquguquka nokusebenza ngqo. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo lokusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda iinamba. Ulawulo lwabantu nelweentsapho, ukuzinikela kumthengi nogqitho kumthengi. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela, namakhono oolwimi. Amakhono amabalolu olwimi asebenzayo nangokubhalayo. Ixabiso lesibini somntu kwaye ethembekileyo.
xh.duties: Owuze kuya kumiselwa ukuba anike inkxaso kumsebenzi wezenkonzo. Unike inkxaso yemisebenzi yobhaliso ehambelanayo, kuquka nokubhala, ukuqamba, ukugcina, ukuthatha nokubuyisa idatha namaxwebhu ezothunyelwa nakuvela, wahlazile iifayili zeentsapho namaxwebhu angangenayo, wancede kumsebenzi wamaxesha angangenayo ngeemfundo eziqhelekileyo. Uyenze iikopi zokushicilelwa, wamkele wathumele iimfacsimile, wahlulahanise amaxwebhu namaphakethe abavela kubantu ngabahlukileyo ngokufunekayo, wagcine wahlazile inkqubo yokugcina iifayili neregista yamaxwebhu angenayo naphumayo kwelisebe. Uthayiphe amagama namaxwebhu axabekileyo xa kufuneka. Unike inkxazo kumsebenzi wokulawula inkqubo yokunikezelwa kwamagama, kuquka nokuqhathaniswa nabakwindalo ngenkqubo engaphandle nesezantsi malunga nokuthengiswa kwempahla nenkozo, ukufumana iinqampu nokugqibezela iifomu zokuthengiswa ukubha iimpahla zehovisi eziqhelekileyo. Ulawule imfuno yempahla yehovisi wagcine wahlazile iregista yempepha yamaphakathi kwelisebe. Unike inkxazo kumsebenzi wobhaliso bolawulo lwabantu, kuquka nokulondoloza iregista yamaxesha ephantsi, amarekhodo abantu kunye neregista yokungabikho kwelisebe, ahluze kwangaphambili ngenkqubo yohambo lwakho nendlula yendlalo. Unike inkxazo kulawulo lwemali, kuquke nokuqamba nokuhlaziya indlela echithwayo, aqinise ukuba ngokwenene iinkqubo zentsini yokuhamwa nokwenza inkqubo yohambo lwabantu abangamahlulela ngokwenene, azinikele kumlawuli ukuze avume, ajoze kwiinkcitha ezincinci ngezimali zocingo kwelisebe.

jobs.title: Director: Evaluation
jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), fully inclusive remuneration package
jobs.summary: Director of Evaluation to coordinate gender, youth and disability-responsive government evaluation policies and plans in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF level 7) qualifications in Monitoring and Evaluation, Social Science, Development Sciences, Economics or relevant NQF 7 qualification. Certificate of successful completion of National School of the Government’s SMS Pre-Entry programme prior appointment. A minimum of 5 years’ experience in monitoring and evaluation at middle management / senior management level; proven experience in gender, youth and disability programming in an economic Intimate knowledge of; advanced monitoring and evaluation theory and practice, including government outcomes planning, monitoring and evaluation policies, procedures and guidelines; evaluation science, including evaluation typologies and theory-based evaluation; Advanced research methods including qualitative and quantitative research; application of Intergovernmental initiatives and interventions on gender, youth and disability mainstreaming, development and empowerment including socio- economic empowerment programmes; government-wide monitoring and evaluation systems; International, Regional, Continental and national commitments on women’s empowerment, gender equality, youth development and disability rights.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate development and implementation of gender, youth and persons with disabilities responsive government evaluation policies and plans, including government-wide Gender Evaluation Plan, Consult on, develop, review and coordinate implementation of gender-, youth- and disability- responsive evaluation policies, guidelines and the annual evaluation plan, within the National Evaluation System and relevant national, provincial and departmental evaluation plans. Analyse evaluation concept notes, policy priorities and programme evidence to identify evaluation priorities and recommend appropriate entries into departmental and government-wide evaluation plans. Develop and coordinate appropriate mechanisms and institutional arrangements for responsive evaluations and the evaluation-led institutionalisation of the GRPBMEAF, in collaboration with mandated planning, budgeting, monitoring and auditing structures. Coordinate agreed GRPBMEAF implementation-support arrangements, cross-pillar engagement plans and periodic refinement of self-assessment tools and implementation guidance, within the Department’s approved coordination mandate. Facilitate the use of evaluation evidence and GRPBMEAF findings to inform the National Development Plan, Medium-Term Development Plan, departmental Strategic Plans and APPs, provincial planning processes and relevant municipal planning instruments. Commission, undertake, coordinate and/or facilitate the evaluation of policies, programmes and institutions to improve performance on gender, youth and disability development and empowerment including rapid evaluations to improve results and programme outcomes in key areas, Undertake, commission and document thematic case studies, including examples of effective practice, implementation barriers and institutional change arising from GRPBMEAF application across spheres and sectors. Prepare and quality assure evaluation reports, case-study reports, evidence syntheses and concise, evidence-based policy briefs identifying findings, implications, policy options and actionable recommendations for decision-makers. Provide technical support and advice on evaluations, particularly in relation to gender, youth and disability mainstreaming within the national evaluation policy and systems and development of gender-responsive improvement plans; Provide technical advice to departments and other mandated institutions on gender-, youth- and disability-responsive evaluations, departmental evaluation plans, evaluation concept notes, terms of reference and improvement plans. Coordinate structured technical support and implementation guidance for GRPBMEAF institutionalisation across its ten pillars, including responsiveness of planning, budgeting, monitoring, evaluation and auditing arrangements, without assuming the statutory functions of responsible institutions. Support departments, provinces, public entities and relevant local-government structures with GRPBMEAF self-assessment methodologies, evidence requirements, institutional improvement plans and technical follow-up. Facilitate technical inputs on the integration of GRPBMEAF evidence into institutional Strategic Plans, APPs, relevant budget and performance processes, and applicable national and provincial planning instruments. Develop and coordinate capacity-building materials, technical workshops, peer-learning sessions and case-study exchanges on evaluation methods, evidence use and the GRPBMEAF, in collaboration with relevant training and institutional partners. Monitor and report on the implementation of key evaluation recommendations aimed at advancing gender equality, women’s empowerment, youth development and promotion of the rights of persons with disabilities. Coordinate the technical consolidation and analysis of GRPBMEAF self-assessment and implementation submissions, including the biannual cycle, and refer material findings to the responsible monitoring and coordination structures. Track agreed corrective actions emerging from evaluations, institutional assessments and case studies; assess implementation progress and identify recurring barriers, risks and unresolved accountability gaps. Prepare consolidated evaluation follow-up reports, implementation briefs and decision-oriented policy briefs highlighting evidence, institutional implications and recommended executive interventions. Table evaluation findings, case-study lessons and recommended interventions at appropriate strategic and intergovernmental forums, and facilitate documented follow-up with responsible institutions. Develop gender evaluation database and systems to improve the evaluability of key programmes impacting on gender equality and women’s empowerment; Coordinate the identification, mapping and quality review of relevant national and departmental evaluations, and maintain accessible evaluation records and inventories. Oversee development and maintenance of a gender-, youth- and disability-responsive evaluation database and an integrated evidence repository, linking evaluations, self-assessments, case studies, policy briefs and institutional improvement actions. Assess and improve the evaluability of priority transformative programmes, including the adequacy of theories of change, indicators, baselines, administrative data and evaluation-ready evidence. Develop and quality assure evidence and reporting standards, consistent definitions, verification protocols and data-sharing arrangements in cooperation with relevant data custodians. Analyse and synthesise evaluation and institutional responsiveness evidence to identify systemic constraints, emerging results and questions requiring further evaluation, case studies or policy analysis. Maintain an accessible register of evaluation knowledge products, including case-study reports, policy briefs, lessons learnt and recommendations, to facilitate evidence uptake and future evaluation design.
jobs.applications: Recruitment02@dwypd.gov.za
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to African women, Coloured Females, Youth and Persons with disabilities All fields in the Z83 application form on https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ must be completed in full, in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. It is therefore prudent that fields be completed by applicants and signed, noting the importance of the declaration. South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. Candidate must respond “Yes “or “No “to the question whether you are conducting business with the state. If “Yes”, details thereof only shortlisted candidates will submit Declaration form for conducting business with the state when shortlisted to the application. It is acceptable for applicant to indicate “not applicable” or leave a blank to the question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?” Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents but must submit the completed and signed Z83 and detailed Curricula Vitae. The communication from HR of the Department regarding the requirement for certified document will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidate for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. Applications received after the closing date will NOT be considered or accepted. Correspondence is limited to short-listed candidates only; should you not hear from us within six weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Non-RSA citizens/permanent resident permit holders must submit a copy only when shortlisted. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Should you not hear from the Department within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Further, personnel suitability checks, including security vetting, competency assessment will be conducted, as such transfer/promotion/appointment will made subject to positive outcomes of personnel suitability checks. Successful candidates shall be required to enter into performance agreement within three (3) months of assuming their duties in the Department, and within one (1) month of the date of their appointment conclude the prescribed contract of employment. Designated employees shall be required to disclose their financial interest within 30 days after assumption of duty. Appointments will only be made on the first notch of the advertised salary level. Note that in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2021, the Department will ensure the protection of applicants ‘personal information and only collect, use and retain applicants’ personal information for the purposes of recruitment and selection processes. The Department shall safeguard such personal information against access by unauthorised persons, unlawful disclosure, or breaches. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, it is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of this position and the candidature of persons whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Evaluering
af.summary: Direkteur van Evaluering om geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheids-reaktiewe regeringsevalueringsbeleide en -planne in Pretoria te koördineer.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF level 7) kwalifikasies in Monitering en Evaluering, Sosiale Wetenskappe, Ontwikkelingswetenskappe, Ekonomie of toepaslike NQF 7 kwalifikasie; Sertifikaat van suksesvolle voltooiing van die National School of the Government se SMS Pre-Entry-program voor aanstelling; 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring in monitering en evaluering op middelbestuurs- / seniorbestuursvlak; bewese ervaring in geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheidsprogrammering in 'n ekonomiese; Intieme kennis van; gevorderde moniterings- en evalueringsteorie en -praktyk, insluitend regeringuitkomsbeplanning, moniterings- en evalueringsbeleide, prosedures en riglyne; evalueringswetenskap, insluitend evaluerings-tipologieë en teoriegebaseerde evaluering; Gevorderde navorsingsmetodes insluitend kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe navorsing; toepassing van intergovernmentele inisiatiewe en ingrypings oor geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheids-hoofstroombinnebring, ontwikkeling en bemagtiging insluitend sosio-ekonomiese bemagtigingsprogramme; regeringsbreë moniterings- en evalueringstelsels; Internasionale, streeks-, kontinentale en nasionale verbintenis oor vrouebemagtiging, geslagsgelykheid, jeugontwikkeling en gestremdheidsregte.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer die ontwikkeling en implementering van geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheids-reaktiewe regeringsevalueringsbeleide en -planne, insluitend 'n regeringsbreed Geslagte-evalueringsplan; Raadpleeg oor, ontwikkel, hersien en koördineer die implementering van geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheids-reaktiewe evalueringsbeleide, riglyne en die jaarlikse evalueringsplan, binne die Nasionale Evalueringsisteem en toepaslike nasionale, provinsiale en departementele evalueringsplanne; Analiseer evalueringskonsepnotas, beleidsprioriteite en programbewyse om evalueringsprioriteite te identifiseer en toepaslike inskrywings in departementele en regeringsbreë evalueringsplanne voor te stel; ontwikkel en koördineer geskikte meganismes en institusionele reëlings vir reaktiewe evaluerings en die evalueringgeleide institusionalisering van die GRPBMEAF, in samewerking met gemagtigde beplannings-, begrotings-, moniterings- en ouditstrukture; Koördineer ooreengekome GRPBMEAF-implementeringsondersteuningsreëlings, kruispilaar-betrokkenheidsplanne en periodieke verfyning van selfassesseringsinstrumente en implementeringsriglyne, binne die Departement se goedgekeurde koördinasie-mandaat; Fasiliteer die gebruik van evalueringsbewyse en GRPBMEAF-bevindinge om die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, Mediumtermyn-Ontwikkelingsplan, departementele Strategiese Planne en APP's, provinsiale beplanningsprosesse en toepaslike munisipale beplanningsinstrumente in te lig; Ligte, onderneem, koördineer en/of fasiliteer die evaluering van beleide, programme en instellings om prestasie aangaande geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheidsontwikkeling en -bemagtiging te verbeter, insluitend vinnige evaluerings om resultate en programuitkomste in sleutelgebiede te verbeter; Onderneem, ligte en dokumenteer tematiese gevallestudies, insluitend voorbeelde van doeltreffende praktyk, implementeringshindernisse en institusionele verandering wat voortspruit uit GRPBMEAF-toepassing oor sfere en sektore; Berei voor en verseker die gehalte van evalueringsverslae, gevallestudieverslae, bewyssinteses en bondige, bewysgebaseerde beleifsnotas wat bevindinge, implikasies, beleidopsies en uitvoerbare aanbevelings vir besluitnemers identifiseer; Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies oor evaluerings, veral met betrekking tot geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheids-hoofstroombinnebring binne die nasionale evalueringsbeleid en -stelsels en die ontwikkeling van geslag-reaktiewe verbeteringsplanne; Verskaf tegniese advies aan departemente en ander gemagtigde instellings oor geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheids-reaktiewe evaluerings, departementele evalueringsplanne, evalueringskonsepnotas, terme van verwysing en verbeteringsplanne; Koördineer gestruktureerde tegniese ondersteuning en implementeringsriglyne vir GRPBMEAF-institusionalisering oor sy tien pilare, insluitend die reaktiwiteit van beplannings-, begrotings-, moniterings-, evaluerings- en ouditreëlings, sonder om die statutêre funksies van verantwoordelike instellings oor te neem; Ondersteun departemente, provinsies, openbare entiteite en toepaslike plaaslike regeringsstrukture met GRPBMEAF-selfassesseringsmetodologieë, bewysvereistes, institusionele verbeteringsplanne en tegniese opvolg; Fasiliteer tegniese insette oor die integrasie van GRPBMEAF-bewyse in institusionele Strategiese Planne, APP's, toepaslike begrotings- en prestasieprosesse, en toepaslike nasionale en provinsiale beplanningsinstrumente; ontwikkel en koördineer kapasiteitsboumateriaal, tegniese werkswinkels, portuurleersessies en gevallestudie-uitruilings oor evalueringsmetodes, bewysgebruik en die GRPBMEAF, in samewerking met toepaslike opleidings- en institusionele vennote; Moniteer en rapporteer oor die implementering van sleutelevalueringsaanbevelings wat daarop gemik is om geslagsgelykheid, vrouebemagtiging, jeugontwikkeling en die bevordering van die regte van persone met gestremdhede te bevorder; Koördineer die tegniese konsolidasie en analise van GRPBMEAF-selfassesserings- en implementeringsvoorleggings, insluitend die halfjaarlikse siklus, en verwys belangrike bevindinge na die verantwoordelike moniterings- en koördineringsstrukture; Spoor ooreengekome korrigerende optrede wat uit evaluerings, institusionele assesserings en gevallestudies voortspruit, na; beoordeel implementeringsvordering en identifiseer herhalende hindernisse, risiko's en onopgeloste aanspreeklikheidsgapings; Berei gekonsolideerde evalueringsopvolgverslae, implementeringsnotas en besluitgerigte beleifsnotas voor wat bewyse, institusionele implikasies en aanbevole uitvoerende ingrypings uitlig; Lê evalueringsbevindinge, gevallestudie-lesse en aanbevole ingrypings by toepaslike strategiese en intergovernmentele forums voor, en fasiliteer gedokumenteerde opvolg met verantwoordelike instellings; ontwikkel 'n geslagte-evalueringsdatabasis en -stelsels om die evalueerbaarheid van sleutelprogramme wat geslagsgelykheid en vrouebemagtiging beïnvloed, te verbeter; Koördineer die identifikasie, kartering en gehaltehersiening van toepaslike nasionale en departementele evaluerings, en handhaaf toeganklike evalueringsrekords en -voorrade; Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van 'n geslag-, jeug- en gestremdheids-reaktiewe evalueringsdatabasis en 'n geïntegreerde bewysbewaarplek, wat evaluerings, selfassessering, gevallestudies, beleifsnotas en institusionele verbeteringsaksies verbind; beoordeel en verbeter die evalueerbaarheid van prioriteits-transformerende programme, insluitend die toereikendheid van veranderings-teorieë, aanwysers, basislyne, administratiewe data en evalueringsgereed-bewyse; ontwikkel en verseker die gehalte van bewys- en verslagdoeningsstandaarde, konsekwente definisies, verifikasieprotokolle en data-delingreëlings in samewerking met toepaslike databewaarders; Analiseer en sintetiseer evaluerings- en institusionele reaktiwiteitsbewyse om sistemiese beperkings, opkomende resultate en vrae wat verdere evaluering, gevallestudies of beleidsanalise vereis, te identifiseer; Handhaaf 'n toeganklike register van evalueringskennisprodukte, insluitend gevallestudieverslae, beleifsnotas, geleerde lesse en aanbevelings, om bewysopname en toekomstige evalueringsontwerp te fasiliteer.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukubhekezwa
zu.summary: Umphathi Wokubhekezwa ukuhlanganisa izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zokubhekezwa kahulumani ezibhekiswe kubulili, intsha nokukhubazeka ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-Bachelor's Degree (NQF level 7) ekuBhekezweni nokuQapha, ezenzululwazi Ngokomthethonqondo, ezenzululwazi Zentuthuko, Ezozoqoqosho noma iziqu ezifanele ze-NQF 7. Isitifikedi sokugqamile ukwenza uhlelo lwesikolo Sezikahulumane Samazwe Ngamazwe Se-SMS Pre-Entry ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Okungenani unyaka lama-5 wamava ekuqapheni nokubhekezweni ezingeni laphathwa ngaphakathi / ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphathwa; ubufakazi bokuhlelelwa kwezinhlelo zobulili, intsha nokukhubazeka kwezomnotho Ulwazi olujulile lweziqu; ithiyori nokusebenza okuthuthukisiwe ekubhekezweni nokuqapheni, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela okumisa iziphumo kahulumani, izinqubomgomo, izinqubo nezinhlelo zokubhekezwa nokuqapha; isayensi yokubhekezwa, okuhlanganisa izinhlobo zokubhekezwa nokubhekezwa okusekelwe kuthiyori; izindlela zocwaningo oluthuthukisiwe okuhlanganisa ocwaningo lwekhwalithi nolwamanani; ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo kanye nokungenelela kwezinhlangano ezingene ezinkundleni zokulinganisela kubulili, intsha nokukhubazeka, intuthuko nakho kuleyo yokuhlakaniphwa okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlakaniphwa komphakathi nangezomnotho; amasistemu kahulumani wonke aokuqapheni nokubhekezweni; izibopho zamazwe ngamazwe, ezifundeni, esiqhingi nasezweni ekugcineni ekuphuculweni kolwelwane lwabesifazane, ukulingana kubulili, intuthuko yentsha namalungelo abantu abakhubazekile.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlanganise intuthuko nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zokubhekezwa kahulumani ezibhekiswe kubulili, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile, okuhlanganisa ihlelo lokubhekezwa kobulili kahulumani wonke. Bonisana, uthuthukise, ubuyekeze futhi uhlanganise ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, izinhlelo zolwazi kanye nehlelo lokubhekezwa lonyaka ngokubhekezwa kubulili, intsha nokukhubazeka, ngaphakathi kwesistimu yokubhekezwa yezwe kanye nezinhlelo ezifanele zezwe, izifundazwe nomnyango zokubhekezwa. Hlaziya amanothi okuqonda okubhekezelwayo, izilinganiso zezinqubomgomo kanye nobufakazi beznqubo ukuze kutholwe izilinganiso ezibalulekile zokubhekezwa futhi kuphakanyiswe okufanele kungeniswe ezinhlelweni zomnyango kanye nalezo kahulumani wonke zokubhekezwa. uthuthukise futhi uhlanganise izindlela ezifanele kanye nezinhlelo zamasistemu zokubhekeza nokuqondiswa zamasistimu ukubhekezelwa, ngokubhekezwa kolwazi lwemithetho ye-GRPBMEAF, ngokubambisana nezakhiwo ezinesimandla zokuqamba izinhlelo, ukwabiwa kwemali, ukuqapha nokubhala ngemibhalo. Hlanganisa izinhlelo ezincengelene zokusiza ukuphunyuka kwe-GRPBMEAF, izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwamasaka kanye nokuqeda okwenziwa ngamavesi izithiyo ukuzihlola kanye nezinhlelo zokubhekeza ukusetshenziswa, ngaphakathi kwesimandla sokuhlanganisa esamukelekwe somnyango. Qedela ukusetshenziswa kobufakazi bokubhekezwa kanye nokuqonda izimangalo ze-GRPBMEAF nangokubamba iqhaza ekuqaphelelweni izinhlelo ze-National Development Plan, Medium-Term Development Plan, izinhlelo zezenzuzo zomnyango nama-APP, imikhuba yokuhlela esifundazweni nasezinhlelweni zasezindaweni ezingaba khona. Myale, wenze, uhlanganyele futhi/noma uthuthukise izinhlelo zokubhekezwa kwezinqubomgomo, kwezinhlelo kanye nasezinhlelelweni ukuthi kuthuthukele kubulili, intsha nokukhubazeka nakho ekuthuthukisweni nokuphuculweni amalungelo okuhlanganisa izibhekezo zokushesha ukuthi kuthuthukeke kulezi ndawo eziyisihluthulelo. Zama, myala futhi uthi ochibideli abayizibonelo abashukunisayo, okuhlanganisa izibonelo zemikhuba ephumelelayo, okubekiwe ekuqedweni kwezinhlelo kanye nokushintshwa kwamasistimu okubangelwa ukusetshenziswa kwe-GRPBMEAF kuzo zonke izigaba kanye namasaka. Lungiselela futhi uhlolise ngokobuhle imibhalo yamaphuphu, imibhalo yesibonelo eshicilelwayo, isihlanganisi sebufakazi nemibhalo yezinqubomgomo emfushane esekelwe kubufakazi evezayo izimangalo, imiphumela, okukhethwa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela ezingenzeka kubantu abathatha izinqumbo. Nikeza ngokwesekwa ngezensimbi kanye kanye kanye neluleko ngezibhekezo, ngokukhethekile ngokubhekezelwa kwesithundla kwizinqubomgomo nokuqapha nasekuqondisweni izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa ngokwabo kubulili. Nikeza ngeluleko ngocwaningo kumiminyango kwezinye izikhungo ezinesimandla ngosibo ngokwemithetho ezibhekezelwa ngokubulili, intsha nakubantu abakhubazekile, ezinhlelweni zomnyango zokubhekezwa, imibhalo yokuqonda okubhekezelwayo, izinhlaka zemibandela kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa. Hlanganisa ukusekelwa ngobuchwepheshe bokuhleleka kanye nezindlela ezibekiwe zokusebenzisa ukuqedela kwamasistimu kwe-GRPBMEAF kuzo zonke izigaba ezishumi zalokho, okuhlanganisa ukuzwela kwezinhlelo, ukwabiwa kwemali, ukuqapha, ukubhekezwa kanye nokubhalwa ngemibhalo, ngaphandle kokukwazi ukuthatha imisebenzi yezomthetho yezikhungo ezibhekele kuyo. Sekela amaminjangi, izifundazwe, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nezinhlelo ezifanele zahulumeni wasekhaya ngezindlela ze-GRPBMEAF zokuzihlola, izidingo zobufakazi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwamasistimu nokulandelwa ngobuchwepheshe. Qedela okuqondisa ngobuchwepheshe ngokuhlanganiswa kwezimangalo ze-GRPBMEAF ezinhlelweni zamasistimu zezenzuzo, ama-APP, izinqubo ezibalulekile zokwabiwa kwemali nokuhamba kwezinhlelo, kanye namathuluzi wokuqondisa ezingasebenza ezweni nas esifundazweni. uthuthukise futhi uhlanganise izinto zokwakha amandla, izingxoxo ngocwaningo, izikhathi zokufunda ngokubambana kanye nokushintshwa kwesibonelo eshicilelwayo ngezindlela zokubhekezwa, ukusetshenziswa kobufakazi kanye ne-GRPBMEAF, ngokubambisana nabalingani bokugadama nezikhungo ezingene ezinkundleni. Qapha futhi ungikelele ngokuqedwa kwezindlela eziyisihluthulelo eziveza izinqumbo zokubhekezwa eziqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni ukulingana ngokobulili, ukuphuculwa kwamandla abesifazane, intuthuko yentsha kanye nokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu abakhubazekile. Hlanganisa ukudidiyaza ngocwaningo nokuhlaziya ngocwaningo okuzoqondisa nokusikwa ngokubheka ukuqina kobuqotho besikhashana ngokuzihlula i-GRPBMEAF kanye nezithiyo zokuqedwa, okuhlanganisa isikhathi esibhalwe ngokuhalfu unyaka, bize imigqomo kubantu ababhekele ukubhala kanye nezakhiwo ezibhekele ukubhala. Landela izindlela zokulungisa ezivunyiwe ezivezwa kubuhlobo bokubhekezwa, ukuqapha ukuthi kwenziwe kahle ini, futhi bheka izikhashana eziphindaphindwayo, amaningi amathuba nobuthibe lokuziphendulela ezingakenzeki. Lungiselela imibhalo eqondene nokubhekezwa kwezinhlelo ezihlangene kubandakanya imibhalo emfushane yokwazisa ezibhaliwe ngokubheka ukulandelwa, iziphatho ngemicimbi ebiyisinqumo kanye nomubhalo kwezinqubomgomo ohlolwe nangokunaka kubandakanya kwi-GRPBMEAF, iziphetho ezingabuzwa kubantu abenza izinqumbo. Beka izimangalo zokubhekezwa, izifundo ezivela kubanothi abayisibonelo kanye nezinhlelo zokuqedwa kwezinhlelo ukuya ezinkundleni ezifanele zamakhandamnada kanye nezinkundla zenhlangano ezingene ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi ukwesekwa abakelayo kubhale ngokulandelwa kubashekelayo nezakhiwo. uthuthukise idethabhesi yokubhekeza kobulili kanye nokuqedela kwezinsiza ukuze kube nokwaziswa okungcono kokubheka kwemikhakha ebalulekile enomthelela ohlelweni lokulingana ngokobulili nasekuphuculweni kwamandla abesifazane. Hlanganisa ukuqashwa kokubhekeza, ukuqonda izimo kanye nokubheka ngokwemigomo ebalulekile kazwelonke kanye namaminjangi ukubheka, futhi ugcine imibhalo ekuqondeni ukubhekeza. Hlola ukuthi izibhekezo zikwazi ukubhekeza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokushintsha izimo, kuhlanganise ukwanelela kwezinsimbi zokushintsha imikhuba, izibalo, imininingwane yethiyori, idethabhhezi engezwa ngomumo namalungu ebalulekile okuhlelelwa kokuthi idethabhensi ibe ziqondise ngqo ekuqaphweni kubufakazi obubhekezelwa okuhlanganisa izibhekezo, okuzihlola, okufakwayo, izimemulo zezinqubo kanye nemibhalo esekela ngemibhalo ethile enenkqubo ukuze kulandelwe kobuqotho nezezinhlelo ezizohlakanywa ngaphambili okubhekezelwa.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ulweliso
xh.summary: Umongameli Wolweliso ukucofa amacebo nemigqatho yolwelisokahulumani ephendula ngobulumi, intlalontle nokuqhwabela ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo zebachelor's Degree (NQF level 7) kwiMonitoring and Evaluation, Social Science, Development Sciences, Economics okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo seNQF 7. Ifestile yesatifikethi egqithisayo leNational School of the Government SMS Pre-Entry programme ngaphambi kokuba kukhethwe. Isipho sedangatya seminyaka engama-5 kwi-monitoring and evaluation kwinqanaba lolawulo laphakathi / lolawulo oluphezulu; isipho esibonwayo ekwenziweni kwezinto ezindala ngephendlo, intlalontle nokuqhwabela kwizixhobo ezimalini; ulwazi olusondeleyo lwe-theori nentlalasetya yokungenisa nokuhlatywa, kuquka uqhagamshelwano lolwazi-bovu, iimpolisa, iindlela nemiqathango yomonitada nokutolikwa; isayensi yokuhlatywa, kuquka iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuhlatywa noku-theori esekelwe kukuhlatywa; iindlela zophando ezithuthuzelweyo kuquka uphando ngokobunjalo nangokubalwa; ukusetbenziswa kweekhaya ezongameleyo ukujongana nezikhunjalo kumzantsi nangaphezulu kwephendlo, intlalontle nokuqhwabela kubemi basekuhlaleni, iinttha zophuhliso namandla kuquka iiprogram zedivayithi zentlalo-temali; iinkqubo zomonitada nokutolikwa kahulumani onke; izithembiso zabamelwano, bengingqi, bentlalo nengingqi ekukhuliseni abafazi, ekulinganiseni amabala, ekuphuhliseni intlalontle namagunya abaqhwabela.
xh.duties: Lawula ukucofa ukudalwa nokusetyenziswa kweempolisa zolweliso kahulumani eziphendula ngobulumi, intlalontle nokuqhwabela nezigqibo, kuquka neGender Evaluation Plan yohulumani onke. Zimisela, phuhlisa, hlola ukucofa ukusetyenziswa kweempolisa zolweliso eziphendula ngobulumi, ngentlalontle nangokuqhwabela, iindlela nendlela yonyaka yolweliso, ngaphakathi kweNational Evaluation System neempolisa zolweliso ezifanelekileyo zengingqi, yephondo nesebe. Hlaziya amanqaku okucinga ngolweliso, izinto eziphambili zeempolisa nembeko yenkqubo ukuze uzibe izinto eziphambili zolweliso uze achaze ngokufanelekileyo ukungena kwiimpolisa zesebe nabezohulumani onke. Phuhlisa ukucofa iindlela ezifanelekileyo nezohlwayo zeempangki eziphendulayo nokubeka esweni iinkqubo ngolweliso ezibangela isiseko seGRPBMEAF, ngokusebenzisana neempangki ezigunyazisiweyo zokucwangcisa, ukulinganisa, ukulawula nothotho. Cofa izimiso eziyivumileyo zokuncedisa ukusetyenziswa kweGRPBMEAF, amacebo okudibana phakathi kweentsika, uhlengahlengiso ngexeshana lezixhobo zokuzihlola noyilo lokusetyenziswa, ngaphakathi kwemandla ogunyazwe isebi sokucufoza. Yenza ukuba kusetyenziswe umbeko wolweliso neziphumo zeGRPBMEAF ukuze kwazike ukuya kwiNational Development Plan, iMedium-Term Development Plan, amacebo eStrategic Plan esebe kwaye namakhupha ohume, iinkqubo zokucwangcisa kwiphondo nasezixhobo ezifanelekileyo zokucwangcisa kwibhalwe. Faka iso, yenza, cofa nokubancedisa ukusetyenziswa kolweliso lweempolisa, iiprogram neziseko ukuze kuphuculwe isiphumo kwintsha, ntlalontle, nobomi obudala bobuqhwabela ukulawula uphuhliso namagunya, kuquka nokusetyenziswa kolweliso ngokutsha ukuba kuphuculwe iziphumo neziphumo zenkqubo kummandla ophambili. Hlola, faka iso kwaye ugqibe iikheyi zethematic, kuquka iizeyibhli zemisebenzi echanekileyo ephiwe, iikheyi ezingangeniswa iso kwaye izityhalelo zokutshintsha isiseko esiphumayo kusetyenziswa iGRPBMEAF kumagunya nasemakadebhe. Lokiqa ngokubonelela ingxowa-mali yolwazi lweempolisa, iikheyi zokubala, iinkcazelo ezigqityiweyo zeempolisa ezifutshane kwaye eziyichaphazela, ngokusekela kwizinto ezitholakeleyo eziphathe ngaloo ndlela zokwenza iinketho zokwenza izigqibo. Nikezela inkxaso nengcali kulweliso, ngokukodwa ngokumayelana nokulinganisa ngokwobomi obudala, iintfana nabathile abangakwaziyo kummandla wolweliso nabaqoqankulu babo, nezigqibo zophuhliso oluphendula ngokubulimi bobomi obuqhwabela; Nikela nengcali kumasebe nakwezinye iinkqubo ezingunyaziweyo ngolweliso oluphendula ngobulumi, ngokwentlalontle ngokwaqhwabela, iinkqubo zolweliso lomsebenzi, amanqaku amanqaku ocango, amagama abantu abathunyelwa kwaye uphuhlise amacebo. Cofa ukunikwa kwengcali nokuqhagamshelwa kolwazi kwinkqubo yeGRPBMEAF ukuba kwangaphakathi nayiyona iintsika alishumi, ukubandakanya ukuphendula kwokucwangcisa, ukulinganisa, ukuqwalasela nokusetyenziswa kolwazi, ngaphandle kokulibala ukuba ngawona amagunya abalulekileyo abaseko. Xhasa amasebe, amaphondo, izikhulu zabantu boluntu kunye neziseko ezifanelekileyo zegunya lasekhaya ngezithuba zokulinganisa zeGRPBMEAF, imfuno yombeko, amacebo okuphucula isiseko nokulandelwa kobuchwepheshe. Yenza izinto eziguquguqukayo ngeziqhagamshelwano ezisebenzayo zeGRPBMEAF kwiiStrategic Plans, ii-APP eziseko, iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zemali ezingunyazisiweyo nakuqhagamshela kumandla ommandla nakwephondo olugunyazisiweyo. Phuhlisa ukucofwa kwezinto ezakha isakhono, iinkqubo eziguqukayo ngokobuchwepheshe bokusebenza, iintlanganiso eziguqukayo ezisesidlangaleni ngabanye noyilo lwekheyi kwizihloko ezisetyenziswa kwindlela yocango, ukusetyenziswa kolwazi nasekuphuculweni kweGRPBMEAF, ngokusebenzisana nabaqeqeshi abayiyo kunye nabalawuli bokuqonda. Qwalasela ukuze kubikwe malunga nokusetyenziswa kwezi celo zolweliso eziphambili ezijoliswe ekuphuculeni ukulingana ngokwabafazi, amagunya abantu abadala, iintfana ekuphuhliseni nasekugcineni kwamagunya abathetha ngokomoya nabathethe kakhulu. Cofa ukuqwalelwa kolwazi nokuqwalaselwa kokuqhwabela nokugqitywa kweGRPBMEAF ngokwayo ngokujongeka kwamayiga, kuquka i-cycle yonyaka ukuya kowonyaka, uze ugqithe iziphumo ezibalulekileyo kubagcini bokulawula ukuba baphendule. Landela iinyathelo ezizamileyo ezivela kulweliso, ukuqwalaselwa kweziko nasezikhekeni zokulinganisa iqabakufa; qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwindlela yokulinganisa ukuqhubela phambili kwaye uchaze iziqalelo eziphindaphindayo, iingozi nangeendawo ezingagqitywa ngokumelana neziphango. Lungelelanisa iingxowa-mali zolwazi oluthintelweyo lwezigqibo, ingxowa-mali yesigqibo esifutshane kwaye ezinomfuno ezijonge kwinxaxheba yocango kwaye uchaze imiphumana, iingozi ekujoliswe kuzo nokuqwalaselwa okunconwayo ngokomsebenzi ohlolwayo. Bonisa iziphumo zolweliso, iimfundo ezitholwe kwiikheyi kunye neesgqibo ezinconyiweyo kwindibano ezahlukeneyo zengingqi nabezohulumani, uze ubancedise abasebenzisa ingxowa-mali abanoxanduva. Phuhlisa isiseko sedata yegama losapho nendlela yokulinganisa iqabakufa ukuze kuphuculwe ukulingana ngokwabafazi nokusetyenziswa kwamagunya ngokomphakathi; Cofa ukubonakalisa, ukumapa noqhagamshelwano kolwazi olucwangcisiweyo ngokwengingqi nangokwakarhulumente, uze ulondoloze irekhodi yeempolisa nezinto ezikulawulweni. Lawula ukwenza nokulondoloza idatha eguqukayo yolweliso lwezilumkisiweyo, nendlela elungelelanisiweyo yokulondoloza imveliso, ngokudibanisa ulweliso, ukuzihlola, amacala okubala, iinkcazelo ezimfutshane zeempolisa kwaye uphucule izenzo ngokommandla. Hlaziya uze uphucule ukuguquguquka kwezinto ezibalulekileyo zokuguquguquka, ukubandakanya ukusetyenziswa kolwazi lolwandlalo, izalathisi, i-data base, idatha yommandla kunye nolwazi olugqibiweyo. Phuhlisa uze ulawule ukulondoloza izimemi zombeko, iinkcazelo ezingangqalanga, iindlela zokuqinisekisa ulwazi ngokusebenzisana nabalawuli bedatha. Hlaziya iimpawu ezisetyenziselwa ukubonisa ukusabela kwecandelo lommandla ukuze ubone izintsonkotha zoluntu, iziphumo ezisanda kwaye izinto ezifuna ukuhlola, iikheyi okanye unyazo olupolisi.

Izinhlelo zolawulo kwiseNhlaka Yomphakathi. Inqubo yokwakha izinqumo ngaphakathi kukaHulumeni. Izindlela, amathuluzi namacebo okuhlola nokuhlolisisa. Uphatho lweMisebenzi.

Ukudala Izindlela Zomsebenzi Wonyaka (AOP). Ukuhlaziya amathrendi nokubika ngokuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuhola nokubhala izindinganiso ezihlolisiswa ngobungcali. Ukuphatha isistimu ye-PMDS online. Ukuphatha izinkinga, izingxabano namaphutha ahlobene nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuqhuba futhi ukuhlanganise izikhungo zemfundo ye-PMDS. Ukuphatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi ukunikeza ithuba lokuzilolonga nokuthola imfundo abayidingayo. xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli oncedisayo kuLawulo LoMsebenzi kwiThe Presidency ePretoria, kufuneka afumane isigqibo seNQF level 6 aze abe neminyaka engama-3-4 yamava kwisebe le-HR.

Ukulungelelanisa ukusebenza kweziphumo ezisuka kulawulo lokusebenza. Ukudala IiCwangciso eZiSebenzayo eziNgoNyakeni (AOP). Ukuhlalutya iindlela ezichazwe kulawulo lokusebenza neemeko ezibalwayo. Ukuphatha iingxaki, ukungavumelani, kunye namaswela axabisekileyo anengqondo ngenkqubo yokulawula inkqabo yokusebenza. Ukuqhuba nokulungelelanisa iindlela zokuzilolonga nokuqeqeswa kwe-PMDS. Ukugcina iingxelo ezithunyelwa kwisebe ekuhlalweni lokuzinika igalelo elizinzileyo, nokuzinika isakhono ngokuphuhlisa umsebenzi oqeqeshiweyo wokuzilolonga. Ukuncedisa ekuphuhliseni neRiphoti yeNkqubo eLungelelanisa ngoMsebenzi weze-Create nokuqwalaselwa iNkqubo yoBuncwane ekuhlalweni lokulawula i-Create Staff kunye nokuqwalaselwa kweCreate. Ukulawula iinkqubo zokuzinika amandla. Ukulawula izisebenzi.
