Opstel en opdateer van standaardbedryfsprosedures vir netwerkinfrastruktuur en netwerkkonfigurasiedokumentasie. Verskaf 3de-lyn-ondersteuning aan The Presidency se personeel, insluitend die prinispale. Ondersteun ook die prinispale met videokonferensiefasiliteite tydens virtuele vergaderings. Bystand verleen by die implementering en toetsing van netwerksekuriteitsmaatreëls en die Rampherstelplan. Implementeer rekenaar- en bedienernetwerkbeleide en ander projekte. Opstel en onderhou van netwerkkonfigurasie- en ramphersteldokumentasie. Verseker opdaterings van antivirusagteware en sekuriteitspleisters vir bedieners. Hou tennismee met bediener- en netwerktegnologie. Verseker maksimum bedryfstyd van netwerktoerusting deur akkurate en vroeë reaksie. Wees bereid om te reis en buite kantoorure te werk, insluitend Saterdae, Sondae en openbare vakansiedae wanneer vereis. Moet bereid wees om wag te staan.

zu.title: Chief Network Controller
zu.summary: I-Chief Network Controller kwi-The Presidency, e-Pretoria, idinga idiploma kwi-IT kanye neminyaka engu-3-4 yamava e-ICT ene-Windows Server kanye ne-WAN/LAN infrastructure.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate ehambisana ne-National Diploma/Advanced Certificate in Information Technology noma isiqu esilinganayo e-NQF level 6. Okungenani ungamu weminyaka engu-3 kuya kwayi-4 wemfundo yamava ngqo kwi-ICT. Izindlela eziyisisekelo zokusebenza: Ulwazi nge-LAN/WAN infrastructure, Windows Server, Microsoft Exchange; izinhlelo eziyindidi eyahlukene zokuqondana nomphakathi noma ezilandelanayo kwezinhlelo, ukulondoloza, nokubuyisela. Amakhono aphezulu okuxazulula izinkinga nokuqwashisa iziphazamisi; ukuxhumana, kokukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo. Ukubhekise kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ukwethembeka nokuba nokuzithoba. Ukusungula izindlela ezintsha zokulethwa kwenkonzo. Ukuqondisa ulwazi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga ukuze uzihlolye. Ukuqondisa amaphrojekthi. Isakhiwo somthetho esibusayo se-Public Service. Inqubo yokubeka izinqubomgomo kahulumeni. Izindlela, izithiyo, namakhono okuhlola bese buhlola.
zu.duties: Ukumisa Windows Server operating system (Microsoft) nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okuphezulu kakhulu kokulondoloza nokubuyisela idatha/ulwazi. Ukugcina futhi kusekele WAN/LAN infrastructure. Ukugcina futhi kusekele Microsoft Exchange Servers. Ukugcina futhi kusekele amateknoloji ekhompyutha ngesofthiwe ekhizekile (isb. VMware, Dell VXRail storage). Ukugcina futhi kusekele Cisco infrastructure (isb. Routers, Core switches, Access Switches and Call Managers). Ukugcina futhi kusekele i-Transversal system (BAS, PERSAL, Logis). Ukubhala futhi kubeke izinqamuleli eziyisisekelo zokusebenza zomhlaba jikelele wenethiwekhi nedokhumenti yomiso wenethiwekhi. Ukunika isekelo lesigaba sesi-3 abasebenzi be-The Presidency, kubandakanya nama-principals. Futhi, ukusekela ama-principals ngezindawo zevidiyo konfrensi ngesikhathi semihlangano ebonakalayo. Ukusiza ekusebenziseni nokuhlola izinyathelo zokuvikeleka kwenethiwekhi kanye nesu lokubuyisela ngemva kokuba kwenzeke isiculo. Ukusebenzisa amapholisi othungatho lwekhompyutha namaseva kanye namanye amaphrojekthi. Ukulungisa futhi kugcine idokhumenti yokumisa kwenethiwekhi nokubuyisela ngemva kweziculo. Ukuqinisekisa ukubuyekezwa kwesofthiwe yokuvikela amagciwane kanye nokulungiswa kokuvikeleka kwamaseva. Ukuhlala unolwazi olusha mayelana namaseva nenateknoloji yenethiwekhi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amasesebense wenethiwekhi ahlale esebenza isikhathi eside ngokuba nempendulo eqonde nesheshayo. Ukuba ulungele ukuhamba futhi usebenze ngemva kwamahora, kubandakanya ama-Saturday, ama-Sunday, namaholide omphakathi uma kudingeka. Kumele ulungele ukuba ku-standby.

xh.title: Ilawuli Elikhulu Lomthungo
xh.summary: Ilawuli Elikhulu Lomthungo kwiSekela likaMongameli, Pretoria, elifuna isidanga kwi-IT kwaye nolwazi lweminyaka emi-3 ukuya kwe-4 kwi-ICT nge-Windows Server kunye nokwakhiwa kwe-WAN/LAN.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi SeNganga kwanga kunye neDiploma YeSizwe Ehambelana/I satifikethi Esiphakamileyo kwiNqanaba leTekhnoloji yolwazi okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-6 le-NQF. Okona mvuzo uphantsi kweminyaka eyi-3 ukuya kwe-4 yamava ahambelana ne-ICT. Ikhompethensi eziphambili: Ulwazi ngokwakhiwa kwe-LAN/WAN, Windows Server, Microsoft Exchange; iinkqubo eziphithizela, ukhongozelo, kunye nokubuyiswa. Amakhono aphezulu okuzibuza nokufumana iimposiso; unxibelelwano, ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo. Ukuqonda umthengi kwaye ugqameke kumthengi. Inyaniselo nokuzithembisa. Inqanaba elisha lokuphumeza inkonzo. Ulawulo lolwazi: Ukuzalisa iingxaki nokuqonda. Ulawulo lweprojekthi. Isakhiwo Esilawulayo SeNkonzo Yoluntu. Inqanaba lenkqubo yokwenza iindulumba ngaphakathi kurhulumente. Iindlela, izixhobo, namakhono okuphanda nokuguqula.
xh.duties: Ukuhlelwa kwenkqubo yokusebenza ye-Windows Server (Microsoft) nokuqinisekisa ukuphumeza ngokuphezulu okugcinwa kobungakanani bolwazi/ulwazi nokubuyiswa. Ukugcinwa nokuxhaswa kokwakhiwa kwe-WAN/LAN. Ukugcinwa nokuxhaswa kweSeva ze-Microsoft Exchange. Ukugcinwa nokuxhaswa kwetekhnoloji yohare ngesoftwe ekhethekileyo (umz. i-VMware, i-Dell VXRail egcinwayo). Ukugcinwa nokuxhaswa kokwakhiwa kwe-Cisco (umz. Iza-ndlela, izikrwele eziphambili, izikrwele zoNgeno nabaphathi BeMibizo). Ukugcinwa nokuxhaswa kwenkqubo ePhithizelayo (BAS, PERSAL, Logis). Ukulunga nokuhlaziya iinkqubo zokusebenza ezimiswe zokwakhiwa komthungo nexesha lokuhlelwa komthungo. Ukunika inkxaso yesi-3 umgca kubasebenzi beSekela likaMongameli, kuquka nabaphambili. Kanjalo, ukuxhasa abaphambili ngesixhobo sokudibana ngesi video ngexesha leemboniso ezingabonwanga. Ukuncedisa ekuqatweni kwaye uvavise iindlela zokhuseleko lomthungo kunye neNdlela yokubuyela Emva koMngeniso. Ukusebenzisa iindulumba zenkqubo yekhompyutha neseva zomthungo kunye nezinye iiprojekthi. Ukuqamba kwaye zigcine ixesha lokuhlelwa komthungo nokuqamba amaxwebhu okubuyela emva kolahleko. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlaziya kwesoftware ekhusela iintsholongwane namanqaku okhuseleko kwiiseva. Ukugcina uxhaxha kolwazi lwamva ngeseva, nangotekhnoloji yomthungo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba umthungo uvulekile ngokwaneleyo ngenxa yempendulo eqondo nangokukhawuleza. Ukuba ulungele ukuhamba kwaye usebenze emva kweeveki ezixhaphakileyo, kuquka nangamavo, ngeCawa, namhla kangangoko kufunekayo. Kufuneka ulungele ukuba kwilungelo lokulindela

jobs.title: Supervisor Housekeeping
jobs.closing_date_text: 20 November 2026 (16:30 walk ins and 00:00 on email)
jobs.summary: Supervise housekeeping staff and cleaning activities at a presidential residence in Durban, requiring an NQF level 6 diploma and 1-2 years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus a minimum NQF level 6 (Diploma/Advanced Certificate) with 1-2 years of Supervisory experience in a high-profile organisation/ environment. Competencies: Communication both oral and writing. Client orientation and customer focus. Honesty and integrity. Service delivery innovation. Willing to work extended/irregular hours, when necessary. Knowledge Management: Problem solving and analysis. Public Service Regulatory Framework. Monitoring and evaluation methods, tools and techniques. Knowledge of the relevant general public service-wide legislation. Knowledge and understanding of all phases of Protocol Ceremonial and Guesthouses. Comprehensive knowledge of policies and practices related to hospitality industry. Knowledge of sanitation practices. Knowledge of basic cleaning. Knowledge of cleaning equipment and machine operating procedure. Conformity to health and safety standards.
jobs.duties: Supervise the Housekeeping subordinates: Allocate responsibilities to subordinates; supervise and assist, when necessary, with the day-to-day cleaning activities of the residence, paying particular attention to hygiene directives. Supervise and assist, when necessary, with all valet and laundry requirements on a daily basis. Responsible for key control and proper handovers between different shifts in laundry and general cleaning areas of the residence. Ensure teamwork within the housekeeping department. Monitor the attendance register and advice on leave credits. Ensure personal and subordinates’ uniform and dress code to approved standards and regulation. Implement disciplinary processes and procedures where necessary. Conduct performance reviews with subordinates. Assist with banquets and all functions including service of the principals and guests when required. Assist with training of stuff and advice on training needs in collaboration with the household management. Provide cleaning services in the official residence: Schedule and assign rooms to be cleaned to the housekeepers, Supervise the day-to-day cleaning by inspecting each room to review the work, Ensure that ail furniture and Interior items are correctly maintained and cared for, Issue cleaning supplies on hand and ensure enough cleaning supplies are provided and that waste is minimised for cleaning the residence, Report defects in the residence management, Register and keep track of any personal items and belongings of residents and guests, Ensure that store rooms are kept clean and tidy at all times, Ensure all housekeeping equipment is clean, Implement and maintain health and safety standards In accordance with relevant standards, Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance to health and safety regulations, Adhere to Hazard Analysis Critical Point (HACCP), and Maintain tidiness in the residence compliance to health and safety regulations. Provide laundry services In the Official Residence: Conduct routine checks in the rooms, Check cleanliness of all linen, Ensure safe-keeping the linen, Compile laundry inventory list and conduct routine audit, Conduct stock level verification as per list on departure of the guest and maintain records of such, Record and report losses and damages, Compile a list of worn-out linen for disposals and replenishment purposes, Establish and maintain optimum stock level as per determined room ratio, Facilitate dry-cleaning and ironing services for the residents and guest, Provide Valet services for the residents and guest, Ensure the residents and guest laundry is safe and care of, Ensure the staff uniforms are maintained, laundered and issued correctly. Perform administration duties in respect of household and maintenance services: Ensure Performance Agreements are developed, signed and submitted to the Housekeeping Manager, Order, store and issue amenities, materials and linen, Liaise closely with catering and household management regarding functions and day-to-day at the residence in order to ensure relevant linen requirements are met, Conduct stock taking of cleaning equipment and linen and ensure stock is readily available, Liaise with suppliers of cleaning equipment, Conduct stocktaking of all bed-linen, table-linen and towelling, and Conduct regular stock taking of all furniture, artworks within the residence and assist with the update of asset reports, Ensure that health and safety standards are maintained in the Residence, Attend to residents, guest's personal requests and advise accordingly i.e. ironing of shirt etc., Report equipment malfunctions to the Housekeeping Manager, Produce periodic reports, Safe-keep and household stores and store rooms, Assist management with compiling and maintaining of standards (accommodations/services), Assist in compiling of monthly overtime reports, and Assist Housekeeping Manager to compile monthly shift rosters.
jobs.applications: The Presidency, Private Bag X1000, Pretoria, 0001 or Hand deliver at Government Avenue, Union Buildings, Pretoria or by email: applications@presidency.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Malele
jobs.notes: NB: Email applications must on the subject line state only the Reference number: SH/PRES/2026 (with no spaces) Applications must include only Two (2) documents (a fully completed and signed new Z83 Form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) website link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a detailed Curriculum Vitae). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of Identity Document, Grade 12 Certificate and the highest required qualifications as well as a Driver’ s licence where necessary, to Human Resources on or before the day of the interview. Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). It is the applicant’ s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report when requested. Please ensure that your application reaches the Department before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. Due to the large number of applications expected, correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only, applications will however be acknowledged by auto response. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department be affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: The Department reserves the right not to fill a position. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, which may include social media profiles of the shortlisted candidates and pre-employment screening to determine the suitability of a person for employment. Applicants must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered during / after the interview took place, the application will not be considered and in the unlikely event that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Failure to submit the requested two (2) documents on application, will result in your not being considered. In addition, the successful candidates will be required to disclose their financial interests. The successful candidate will be subjected to reference checks and a security clearance up to the level of “Top Secret” as well as enter into a performance agreement. In addition, the successful candidates may be required to disclose their financial interests depending on their job. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Toesighoud Huishoudelike Dienste
af.summary: Toesig hou oor huishoudelike personeel en skoonmaakaktiwiteite by 'n presidensiële woning in Durban, waarvoor 'n NQF vlak 6 diploma en 1-2 jaar toesigervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: A Senior Certificate plus a minimum NQF vlak 6 (Diploma/Advanced Certificate) with 1-2 years of Supervisory experience in a high-profile organisation/ environment. Bevoegdhede: Kommunikasie beide mondelings en skriftelik. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Diensleweringinnovering. Bereid om buitengewone/ongereelde ure te werk wanneer nodig. Kennisbestuur: Probleemoplossing en analise. Openbare Diens Regulerende Raamwerk. Moniterings- en evaluasie-metodes, instrumente en tegnieke. Kennis van die relevante algemene wetgewing vir die openbare diens. Kennis en begrip van alle fases van Protokol Seremonies en Gastehuise. Omvattende kennis van beleide en praktyke wat verband hou met die gasvryheidsbedryf. Kennis van sanitasiepraktyke. Kennis van basiese skoonmaak. Kennis van skoonmaaktoerusting en masjienbedryfsprosedures. Voldoening aan gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde.
af.duties: Toesig hou oor die Huishoudelike ondergeskiktes: Deel verantwoordelikhede aan ondergeskiktes toe; hou toesig en help wanneer nodig met die daaglikse skoonmaakaktiwiteite van die woning, met spesiale aandag aan higiëneriglyne. Hou toesig en help wanneer nodig met alle valet- en wasgoedvereistes op 'n daaglikse basis. Verantwoordelik vir sleutelbeheer en behoorlike oorplasings tussen verskillende skofte in die was- en algemene skoonmaakareas van die woning. Verseker spanwerk binne die huishoudelike departement. Monitor die bywoningsregister en adviseer oor verlofkrediete. Verseker persoonlike en ondergesiktes se uniform en dragkode volgens goedgekeurde standaarde en regulasies. Implementeer dissiplinêre prosesse en prosedures waar nodig. Voer prestasie-evaluerings met ondergeskiktes uit. BANQUETS HELP MET ALLE FUNKSIES INSLUITEND DIENS VAN DIE PRINSIPALE EN GASTE WANNEER BENODIG. HULP MET OPLEIDING VAN PERSONEEL EN ADVISEER OOR OPLEIDINGSBEHOEFTES IN SAMIEWERKING MET DIE HUISHOUDINGBESTUUR. Verskaf skoonmaakdienste in die amptelike woning: Skeduleer en wys kamers toe wat skoongemaak moet word aan die huishoudelike werkers, Hou toesig oor die daaglikse skoonmaak deur elke kamer te inspekteer om die werk te hersien, Verseker dat alle meubels en binne-items behoorlik onderhou en versorg word, Reik skoonmaakbenodigdhede uit wat op hande is en verseker dat genoeg skoonmaakbenodigdhede voorsien word en dat afval geminimeer word vir die skoonmaak van die woning, Rapporteer defekte aan die bestuur van die woning, Registreer en hou tredes met persoonlike items en besittings van inwoners en gaste, Verseker dat stoorkamers te alle tye skoon en netjies gehou word, Verseker dat alle huishoudelike toerusting skoon is, Implementeer en handhaaf gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde in ooreenstemming met relevante standaarde, Voer gereelde inspeksies uit om voldoening aan gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies te verseker, Voldoen aan Hazard Analysis Critical Point (HACCP), en Handhaaf netheid in die woning in ooreenstemming met gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies. Verskaf wasdienste in die Amptelike Woning: Voer roetine-kontroles in die kamers uit, Kontroleer netheid van alle linne, Verseker veilige bewaring van linne, Stel 'n wasgoed-inventarislys op en voer roetine-oudit uit, Voer voorraadvlakverifikasie volgens lys uit by vertrek van die gas en handhaaf rekords daarvan, Rekord en rapporteer verliese en skade, Stel 'n lys van uitgediende linne op vir beskikking en aanvulling, Stel en handhaaf optimum voorraadvlak volgens bepaalde kamer Verhouding, Fasiliteer droogskoonmaak en strykdienste vir die inwoners en gaste, Verskaf Valetdienste vir die inwoners en gaste, Verseker dat die inwoners en gaste se was veilig bewaar word, Verseker dat die personeel se uniforms onderhou, gewas en korrek uitgereik word. Voer administratiewe pligte uit ten opsigte van huishoudelike en instandhoudingsdienste: Verseker dat Prestasie-ooreenkomste ontwikkel, onderteken en aan die Huishoudelike Bestuurder voorgelê word, Bestel, stoor en reik geriewe, materiaal en linne uit, Skakel nou saam met die catering- en huishoudingbestuur aangaande funksies en daaglikse bedrywighede by die woning om te verseker dat relevante linnevereistes nagekom word, Voer voorraadopname van skoonmaaktoerusting en linne uit en verseker dat voorraad geredelik beskikbaar is, Skakel met verskaffers van skoonmaaktoerusting, Voer voorraadopname van alle bedlinne, tafellin-nen en handdoeke uit, en Voer gereelde voorraadopname van alle meubels, kunswerke binne die woning uit en help met die opdatering van bateverslae, Verseker dat gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde in die Woning gehandhaaf word, Skenk aandag aan inwoners, gaste se persoonlike versoeke en adviseer dienooreenkomstig d.w.s. stryk van hemp ens., Rapporteer toerusting wanfunksies aan die Huishoudelike Bestuurder, Produseer periodieke verslae, Bewaar huishoudelike winkels en stoorkamers, Help bestuur met die opstel en handhawing van standaarde (akkommodasie/dienste), Help met die opstel van maandelikse oortydverslae, en Help Huishoudelike Bestuurder om maandelikse skofroosters op te stel.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokugcina Indlu Ihlanzekile
zu.summary: Qapha abasebenzi bokugcina indlu ihlanzekile nemisebenzi yokuhlanzeka endlini yakomongameli e-Durban, okudinga i-NQF level 6 diploma nokuba namava eminyaka eyi-1-2 ekubeni umphathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior Certificate sibe sekube nokuba noma ngaphansi kwe-NQF level 6 (Diploma/Advanced Certificate) nokuba namava eminyaka eyi-1-2 ekubeni umphathi enkampanini esendaweni enkulu. Ikhono: Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuzethembeka nokuba nokuzipatha kahle. Into entsha ekulethweni kwesevisi. Ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza masikhathi esingajwayelekile noma esinde uma kunesidingo. Ukuqonda ukulawula izinkinga nokuwahlukanisa. Uqango Lokuqondisa Kwesevisi Yomphakathi. Izindlela zokuqapha nokuhlola, amathuluzi namakhono. Ukwazi nge-mithetho evamile yomphakathi ehlobene nalokhu. Ulwazi lokuqonda zonke izingqikithi zomqondo wokuziphatha ocwaningweni nasezindlini zabakhwezi. Ulwazi olubanzi ngemigomo namasiko ahlobene noshintsho lwezikhungo. Ulwazi ngezenzo zokuhlanza. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokuhlanzeka. Ulwazi ngezimoto zokuhlanza nenqubo yokusebenzisa izimoto. Ukuziphatha ngokuvumelana nemigomo yokwengculusi nokuphila kuphephile.
zu.duties: Qapha abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho bokugcina indlu ihlanzekile: Nikeza imisebenzi abasebenzini abangaphansi kwakho; qapha futhi usize, uma kunesidingo, emisebenzini yansuku zonke yokuhlanza indlu, ukuqaphisisa imiyalo yokwengculusi. Qapha futhi usize, uma kunesidingo, ngazo zonke izidingo zokugeza izingubo nsuku zonke. Uxolise nokuqaphela okhiye nokuhamba kahle kwesandla phakathi kamasikhathi ahlukene ekugezeni izingubo nasendaweni evamise ukuhlanzeka endlini. Qinisekisa ukusebenza njengeqembu phakathi komnyango wokugcina indlu ihlanzekile. Qapha ibhuku lokubhalisa futhi unikeze izeluleko ngezikweletu zeholide. Qinisekisa ukuba ukwethulula nokuhamba ngokomthetho wemfanelo komunye nomunye emhlabeni wokugcina indlu ihlanzekile. Phatha izinkundla zokuqapha futhi usebenzise izindlela ezifanele uma kunesidingo. Yenza izinhlola ze-NQF level 6 nabasebenzini abangaphansi kwakho. Siza ngemicimbi yamabhanqa nemine yonke imikhosi ohlotsheni abakhokhi nabafundi uma kunesidingo. Siza ukulolongwa kwabasebenzi futhi unikeze izeluleko ngezidingo zokulolongwa kuhlanganyele nokuphathwa kwekhaya. Nikeza inkonzo yokuhlanza endlini esemthethweni: Hlela futhi abeke amakamelo ahlanzwe kubagcina indlu, Qapha ukuhlanza kwansuku zonke ngokuqamba kwekhaya ukubuka umsebenzi, Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto zobuhle nezesihlangu zithathwa ngokufanele, Nikeza izinto zokuhlanza ezitholakalayo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izinto ezanele zokuhlanza zikhona, kanti inqubo yokuphela izinto encane kakhulu ukuze kuhlanzwe indlu, Bika izinkinga ezitholakala ekuphathweni kwekhaya, Bhalise futhi ulandele izinto zabahlali nabashadikazi, Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zokugcina zihlanzwe futhi zibekwe kahle njalo, Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto ezisetshenziswa ekugcineni indlu zihlanzekile, Yenzela futhi ulondoloze imigomo yokuphila kuphephile ngokuvumelana nemigomo efanayo, Qamba izinhlola njalo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlatshiwa ngemigomo yezokuphila kuphephile, Landela i-Hazard Analysis Critical Point (HACCP), futhi Lonke ukuba indlu ihlanzekile ngokuvumelana nemigomo yezokuphila kuphephile. Nikeza inkonzo yokufula endlini esemthethweni: Qamba izinhlola ezivamile emakamelweni, Hlola ukuthi zinhlanzekile na zonke izihlangu, Qinisekisa ukuthi izihlangu zilondolozwa kahle, Hlela uhlu lwezinhlanu zokufula futhi wenze ukubuyiswa kwazo, Yenza inhlola yalelo ngohla ngokohlu ekugcineni isikhathi somgubasi futhi ugcine izibhalo ngakho, Bala futhi ubike ukulahleka nokulimala, Hlela uhlu lwezihlangu ezigqilaziwe ngenhlobokulahlwa nokubuyiswa, Saka futhi ulondoloze amazinga okwelin ngokobuhlobo bekamelo elifanayo, Hlinzeka ngenkonzo yokuqumba nokugqoka izimfanela abahlali nabashadikazi, Hlinzeka ngenkonzo yokuqumba ngokwabahlali nabashadikazi, Qinisekisa ukuthi izingubo zokufula zabahamuki nabagcini zigcinwa kahle, Futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zabasebenzi zimalunge ngokwemigomo nezinhlinzwa. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha ibhodi lezinsiza zekhaya nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi: Qinisekisa ukuthi izivumelwano mayelana nokusebenza kwakho zakhiwa, zesayiniwe futhi zithunyelwe kumphathi wokugcina indlu ihlanzekile, Oda, ulondoloze futhi unikeze izimpahla, izinto nezihlangu, Xhumana kakhulu nokuphathwa kokudla nekhaya ngezinsiza zangonaphakade nokuphathwa kwezinsuku ezingakwesikhathi esingajwayelekile ekhaya ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfuneko yezihlangu ihlanganiswe, Yenza inhlola yezinkinobho ezihlanza namakhepha amaningi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ezidingwayo ziyatholakala, Xhumana nabanikezela izinto zokuhlanza, Yenza isibalo sezinto zokuhlanza ezifana nezihlangu zebeds, namakhepha okutafuna, namakhepha okugeza, futhi, Qamba isibalo sezinto ezahlukene ezihamba ngokususa izimpahla namakhamagi emakamelweni ekhaya, futhi usize ngokubuyisa izibalo sokuhlaziya, Qinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yezokuphila kuphephile ilondolozwa ekhaya, Phendula izikhalo zabahamuki nabagcini futhi unikeze izeluleko, isb. ukuqumba ibhulukwe, Bika ukuphahluka kwezinsiza kumphathi wokugcina indlu ihlanzekile, Tumela imibiko yesikhathi esithile, Gcina insiza zekhaya nezindlu zokulondoloza, Siza ekuphathweni ngokususwa kwezinto ngokuhlangenwe ngesikhathi ekhaya (ezokuhlala/ezokuphathwa kwemikhosi), Siza ekususweni kwemibiko yeholide eyedlule ngenyanga, futhi Siza umphathi wokugcina indlu ihlanzekile ekususeni kohlu lwamasikhathi enyanga yonke.

xh.title: Mphathi Wezendlu
xh.summary: Ukuphatha abasebenzi bezendlu nemisebenzi yokucoca endlwini yomongameli eDurban, kufuneka idiploma yenqanaba le-6 le-NQF kunye neminyaka eliy-1 ukuya kweyi-2 yamava okuphatha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Senior kunye nenqanaba le-6 le-NQF elingenamva (idiploma/isatifikethi esiphakamileyo) nayo 1-2 yeminyaka yamava okuphatha kwindawo/ishishini elikhulu. Ikhono: Unxibelelwano ngomlomo nangokubhalwa. Ukumisela iinxaxheba kumthengi kunene nomxholo. Inyaniso nokuzithembisa. Intsingiselo yohoyolisezulu. Ukulungelelani ukusebenza iiyure ezingemiwa/ngeendlu, xa kuyimfuneko. Ulawulo lolwazi: Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda. Isiseko solawulo soLuntu luzeLuntu. Iindlela, izixhobo neziqendu zokuqaphela nokuqikelela. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohambelanayo wonke woluntu. Ulwazi nokuqonda zonke iinkqubo zeProtocol Ceremonial nazoKhaya lezihambi. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeenkqazo nemisebenzi ehambelana noshishino lokwamkela iindwendwe. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuhamba kwendalo. Ulwazi ngokucoca okusesiqukwini. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokusebenza ngemishini yokuqamba indlu. Ukuvumelana nemigaqo yokuqinisekiswa impilo nakho konke ukhuseleko.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha abasebenzi bezendlu: Ukwaba iimsebenzi kwabasebenzi; ukuphatha kunye nokunceda, xa kuyimfuneko, nemisebenzi yamaxesha onke yokucoca indlu, kubandakanya ingqalelo enkulu kumalungiselelo oguso. Ukuphatha kunye nokunceda, xa kuyimfuneko, zonke iimfuno zokuqamba namashishini ngosuku. Ukunakekelwa kwezitsixo nokugqithisa ngokuchanekileyo phakathi kweeshifthi ezahlukeneyo kumashishini nakuwo onke amacandela okucoca indlu. Kuqinisekise ukusebenza ngokubanzi ngokwemimiselo phakathi kwabasebenzi bezendlu. Ukuqaphela irekhodi lokubikhona kunye nokunika izigqibo malunga namagunya eholide. Kuqinisekise ukuzipha nokwamkela ngokwemigaqo nezitifikethi ezamkelekileyo kumzila wokuziphatha nokwamkela kwabasebenzi. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo nendlela zolawulo xa kuyimfuneko. Ukuqamba ngokusebenza ngokwemigaqo kunye namaxhoba. Ukuphatha iinkqubo zokudlulisela ilwazi. Ukuphatha iinkqubo zokuhamba kwabantu. Ukubonelela ngeenkcenye zemali kubakho namathuba okuqinisekisa imali ngokwemigaqo yendawo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukugcinwa kolwazi kubakho kwizinto ezahlukeneyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukulungelelanisa amacandelo oluntu nokugcinwa kolwazi ehamba phambili. Ukubonelela ngesixhobo sokulinganisa nokucoca indlu. Ukubonelela ngendlela yokulinganisa nokuhamba kwamabala. Ukulawula ukuphathwa koluntu ngokomthetho ophatha iindwendwe ezikwindlu. Ukugcina iinkqubo zokucoca nemigaqo. Ukugcina amashishini nobugcisa obubonelela ukulungelelana. Ukugcina ukuphathwa koluntu nokuqwalasela imigaqo ngokusuka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngaphantsi komgaqo wezoluntu nezemali ngokomthetho. Ukumisela ukulungelelana ngokomthetho wentshiso kwiindwendwe. Ukunikezelwa ukugqiba kwezinto ezithileyo eziqwalaselwa ngumgaqo woluntu. Ukuqwalasela ukubakho kolwazi ngabasebenzi. Ukuphatha iinkqubo zokuqamba ngokomthetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba konke ukugcinwa kwendalo kulungile. Ukubonelela ngokugcinwa kolwazi ngokwemigaqo yoluntu. Ukuphatha iinkqubo zokwamkela ngokusemthethweni.

jobs.title: Director: Library Information Services and Provincial
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts, Culture and Recreation
jobs.summary: Director of Library Information Services and Provincial Archives at Gauteng Head Office, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: The successful candidate should have a Grade 12 Certificate plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Archival Studies / Libraries & Information Science or relevant qualification. A minimum of 5 years’ experience in middle/ senior Managerial level (or Deputy Director) in the relevant field. A compulsory Pre-Entry Senior Management Certificate will be required before the assumption of duty. A valid driver’s license. Skills: Decision making. Management of projects. Technical Analytic skills. Financial Management. Strategic and operational. Planning and organizing. Problem solving. Conflict management. Verbal and written communication. Leadership. Computer literacy. Report writing. Knowledge of: The Constitution of 1996. PFMA. Promotion of access to information act. Promotion of administration justice act. Electronic communication and transaction act. National archives and records services act. Change Management, Programme and Project Management, Conflict Management, Financial, People Management and empowerment.
jobs.duties: Oversee the development and implementation of archives and library policies. Oversee and manage the preservation of public and non-public records and ensure accessibility to the public. Manage the development, transformation, promotion and modernization of libraries and information services. Manage financial support to municipal library services by providing earmarked transferred allocation. Oversee the implementation of reading and library programs to inculcate the culture of reading. Identify the needs for library and archives infrastructure.

af.title: Direkteur: Biblioteekinligtingsdienste en Provinciale
af.summary: Direkteur van Biblioteekinligtingsdienste en Provinciale Argiewe by Gauteng Hoofkantoor, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Argiefwese / Biblioteek- en Inligtingswetenskap of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie hê. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel- / seniorbestuursvlak (of Adjunkdirekteur) in die tersaaklike veld. 'n Verpligte voortoelating-seniorbestuursertifikaat sal voor die aanvaarding van plig benodig word. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vaardighede: Besluitneming. Bestuur van projekte. Tegniese analitiese vaardighede. Finansiële bestuur. Strategies en operasioneel. Beplanning en organisering. Probleemoplossing. Konflikbestuur. Verbale en skriftelike kommunikasie. Leierskap. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagskrywing. Kennis van: Die Grondwet van 1996. PFMA. Bevordering van toegang tot inligting-wet. Bevordering van administratiewe geregtigheid-wet. Elektroniese kommunikasie en transaksie-wet. Nasionale argief- en rekorddienste-wet. Veranderingsbestuur, Program- en Projekbestuur, Konflikbestuur, Finansiële, Personeelsbestuur en bemagtiging.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en implementering van argief- en biblioteekbeleid. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die bewaring van openbare en nie-openbare rekords en verseker toeganklikheid vir die publiek. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, transformasie, bevordering en modernisering van biblioteke en inligtingsdienste. Bestuur finansiële ondersteuning aan munisipale biblioteekdienste deur oormerkte oordragtoekenning te verskaf. Hou toesig oor die implementering van lees- en biblioteekprogramme om die leeskultuur te vestig. Identifiseer die behoeftes vir biblioteek- en argiefinfrastruktuur.

af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Landbou-ingenieurswese of Siviele Ingenieurswese (NQF level 6), verpligte registrasie by ECSA as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Program- en projektbestuur, ingenieursontwerp en analise-kennis, navorsing en ontwikkeling, rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings, regsooreenstemming, tegniese verslagskrywing, Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidsstandaarde, National Water Act, Wetgewing in terme van Water Act, Conservation of Agricultural Resources Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Act, Public Administration Management Act, Public Service Regulations, Directive on Human Resources Management and Development for Public Service Professionalisation, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Departementele HRM- en HRD-beleide, RSA-grondwet. Isiphephelo: Six (06) iminyaka yokusebenza ngesimo sobuchwepheshe ezolimo noma ubunjiniyela bamasayivili emva kokuthola isiqu. Ulwazi: Ulawulwemphakathi namaphrojekthi, ulwazi lokwakhiwa nokuhlaziya kobunjiniyela, ucwaningo nentuthuko, izinhlelo zokusebenza kobuchwepheshe ezingxenyeni zekhompyutha, ukuhambisana nomthetho, ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, iziminganiso ze-Occupational Health and Safety, i-National Water Act, umthetho ngokwentela ye-Water Act, i-Conservation of Agricultural Resources Act, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Administration Management Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Directive on Human Resources Management and Development for Public Service Professionalisation, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, namapholisi oMnyango we-HRM ne-HRD, uMthethosisekelo we-RSA. Amakhono: Ukuhlelwa kolawulelo lwamaphrojekthi, ukwakhiwa nokuhlaziya kobuchwepheshe, okwethulwayo, ucwaningo nentuthuko, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukudala, ukuphatha izimali, ukugxila kubathbegi kanye nokuphendula, ukuxhumana, ukusebenza nekhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuqamba, ukuphatha abantu, okwethulwayo, ukuphatha imincintiswano, ukuphatha i-HR, ukufunda nokubhala, ulimi, ukulalela, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, izinhlobo zokuxhumana nabantu, ucwaningo nolawulelo lwesikhathi, ukuzithiba kanye nokuzidlaya ngokugqugquzelwa kwakho ngenkani yokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkuleko ngaphandle kokubukiwa.
zu.duties: Phatha nalawula ukuhlelwa nokwakhiwa kwezokwakhiwa, ukufakela amanzi kanye nokuqashwa kwezinsiza. Phatha inkxaso yobuchwepheshe yamaphrojekthi ezokwakhiwa, ukufakela amanzi kanye nokuqashwa kwezinsiza. Nikeza izinsiza zokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe. Qaphela futhi uhlole amaphrojekthi obunjiniyela esifundeni. Phatha izinsiza zesigaba.

xh.title: Itekhnishani yokulawula ubugcisa inqanaba le-A
xh.summary: Kufuneka itekhnishani yokulawula ubugcisa kwisiGNU sika-eThekwini ukulawula iiprojekthi zezakhiwo, ezokunxibelelwana ngenxweme nezokusebenza ngezixhobo, kwaye kufuneka idiploma yelinqanaba le-NQF level 6 kunye nokubhaliswa kwi-ECSA.
xh.requirements: Idiploma yaseNasionali kubugcisa bokulima okanye ubugcisa bolwelwazi lwezakhiwo (NQF level 6), ukubhalisa ngokuyimfuneko kwi-ECSA njengentekhnishani yobugcisa kunye nelayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Isiphiwo: Amashumi amathandathu (06) eminyaka yamava obuchwepheshe bokulima okanye ubugcisa bolwelwazi lwezakhiwo emva kokuqwalaselwa. Ulwazi: Ulawulo lwenkqubo neprojekthi, ulwazi lokwakha nokuhlola ubugcisa, uphando nophuhliso, izicelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenziswa khompyutha, ukuzithobela ngokomthetho, ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, iimigangatho yokuGcina ukuze kuPhile ngokusemzimbeni nakuKhuseleke emsebenzini, uMthetho weAmanzi weNasionali, uMthetho ngokwakawoMthetho weAmanzi, uMthetho woKugcinwa kweeSizidunu kwiZolimo, uMthetho weeNgxamankomo zoMsebenzi, uMthetho woBurendulu yoQoqosho, uMthetho woLawulo lwoBuphengululi koQoqosho, iMigaqo yoBurendulu yoQoqosho, uMyalelo woLawulo nokuPhuhliso lweZinto eziZintlwana zeNtaba zokuBurendulu kuBukhulu bezifo eziNasionali, uMthetho woBungakanisi beMilinganiselo yoMsebenzi, iMigaqo yeSebe le-HRM ne-HRD, uMthethosiseko weRiphabhuliki yaseMzantsi Afrika. Amandla: Ucwangco lwayo nayiphi na iprojekthi nokulawulwa kwayo, ukwakhiwa nokwahlulwa phantsi kobugcisa, okubonakalisa, uphando nophuhliso, ukucebiswa ngobugcisa, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwahlula phantsi, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenza njengesiqhoba, ukuyila izinto ezintsha, ukulawula izimali, ukuzinika umdla kwizicwangciso zabathengi nokwabela ngokukhawuleza ekuhloveni, unxibelelwano, ukusebenza ngokwemimiselo yekhompyutha, ukucwangcisa nokuqamba, ukulawula abantu, ukubonakalisa, ukulawula iingxabano, ukulawula iNtaba yeZinto eziZintlwana zokuBukhosi, ukubhala nokuqonda ulwimi, okuva, okucetyisa ngokuchanekileyo, iingxelo phakathi kwabantu, ukuphangela phantsi kolwandle nokuhlela ixesha, ukuzinika umngeni kwaye uzalise ngokwakho ngamandla okusebenza phantsi komthwalo ongabinayo iindzima ezingundoqo.
xh.duties: Lawula konke okutsha noko kusentsimbi kwaye ulawule na nokuyila iiprojekthi zezakhiwo, ezokuhlakulela ngenxweme nangaphezu kolwandle nezesixhobo esisigqoki. Lawula inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwiiprojekthi zezakhiwo, ezokuhlakulela ngenxweme nangaphezu kolwandle nangezesixhobo esisigqoki. Zeza ngenkxaso yobuchwephesha. Qaphela ngokukhulu ukuqwalaselwa kweentsimi ezingoziyo ezindawoni ezikumngcipheko womsebenzi weengcali zolimo nazo zonke iiprojekthi ezikwindawo ethile. Lawula izinto zommandla ezisebenzela umbutho othile ochukumisa izinto.

jobs.summary: Deputy Director position in Risk and Integrity Management at the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: The ideal candidate must have: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree / Three-year National Diploma in Risk Management / Ethics Management at NQF Level 6/7 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3 years of junior management experience in a Risk Management / Integrity Management environment. Professional certification in Risk Management/Ethics or a postgraduate qualification or active registration with a Risk or Ethics Professional Body or demonstrable relevant experience within an environmental management and nature conservation environment will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s License.
jobs.duties: Develop risk, business continuity and integrity management strategies, systems (methodologies, models and tools etc.), policies and annual plans; Manage, implement, review and improve the risk, business continuity and integrity management framework; Facilitate institutionalisation of risk, business continuity and integrity management; Establish and maintain good relationships with relevant stakeholders such as Risk Management Committee/ Audit Committee/ Ethics Committees/ Forums. Knowledge of Integrity Management Policies and Framework. Sound knowledge and understanding of the Public Service Regulatory Framework, e.g., Public Service Act, PFMA, Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employee Performance Management System, Skills Development Act, Promotion of Access to Information Act, National Development Plan, Project Management Principles, Service Delivery Frameworks (Batho Pele Principles). Skills: Problem-solving and analysis, people and diversity management, accountability and ethical conduct, commitment to a high level of quality control, organisational skills, report writing skills, good communication skills, facilitation and presentation skills, strong project management and planning skills, computer skills, Communication skills (verbal and written), presentation skills, report writing, planning and organising skills, basic financial and supply chain management skills, good interpersonal skills, good research and analytical skills, time management skills, relationship management skills. Attributes such as integrity and sound judgement, ability to work under pressure and maintain, leadership and stakeholder engagement, ability to handle sensitive information and complex governance matters objectively, professionalism, respect, honesty, teamwork, vision, transparency, commitment, and confidentiality.

zu.title: Isikhundla Somkhwenyana: Ukuqashwa kwe-Nature
zu.summary: Isikhundla somkhwenyana kwi-Risk and Integrity Management e-KwaZulu-Natal Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs e-Pietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Umphakeli okhethekile kumele abe: Nodiploma le-Bachelor esifanele / National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu kwi-Risk Management / Ethics Management kwizinga le-NQF Level 6/7 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Uluhlu lweminyaka eyi-3 yemisebenzi yokuphatha ezingeni elingezansi emnomatho we-Risk Management / Integrity Management. Ukuqashwa ngokulawula i-Risk Management/Ethics noma iziqu zesikhundla esiphezulu noma ukubhalisa kwi-Risk noma i-Ethics Professional Body noma uluvo olubonakalayo oluhambisana nomnomatho wokuphatha indawo nokugcina i-nature kuzobe yinehlazo elikhulu. I-License yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Baka amasu, izinhlelo zokuqhubeka komnomatho nezinhlelo zokuziphatha, izinhlelo (izindlela, izibalo, namathuluzi, njl.), izinqulumo namaphulani eminyaka yonke; Lawula, fakela, phinda ubuke futhi uthuthuke isakhiwo sokulawula i-risk, business continuity kanye nezinhlelo zokuziphatha; Siza ekwakhiweni kolwazi lwe-risk, business continuity kanye nokulawula ukuziphatha; Saka futhi ugcine ubuhlobo obuhle namalungu abahlanganyeli njenge-Risk Management Committee/ Audit Committee/ Ethics Committees/ Forums. Amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa, Namandla: Umphakeli ophumelelayo kumele abe nolwazi olunengqondo nokuqonda izinhlobonhlobo zezinto, kuhlanganise izinqumo namasakhiwo e-risk management, izinqumo namasakhiwo we-Integrity Management, Izinhloso namasiko e-Risk Management, izinhlelo zahuluminti, kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury. Ulwazi lwe-Integrity Management Policies kanye ne-Framework. Ulwazi olunengqondo nokuqonda i-Public Service Regulatory Framework, njll., i-Public Service Act, PFMA, i-Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, i-Employee Performance Management System, i-Skills Development Act, i-Promotion of Access to Information Act, i-National Development Plan, Izinhloso ze-Project Management, izinhlelo zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo (Izinhloso ze-Batho Pele). Amakhono: Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukulawula abantu namasiko ahlukene, ukubekezela kanye nokuziphatha ngokulunga, ukuzibophezela kwizinga eliphezulu lokulawula izinga, amakhono okuhlelwa, amakhono okubhala izibalo, amakhono okukhuluma kahle, amakhono okukhuthaza nokubhukuda, amakhono amakhulu okulawula amaphulo nokuhlela, amakhono wekhompyutha, amakhono okukhuluma (okuthiwa futhi okubhaliwe), amakhono okubhukuda, amakhono okubhala izibalo, ukuhlela nokuhlelisa, amakhono amsulwa wezimali kanye nokulawula i-supply chain, amakhono abantu kahle, amakhono okucwaninga futhi ahlaziye, amakhono okulawula isikhathi, amakhono okulawula ubuhlobo. Izici ezinjengokuziphatha okuhle nokwenza izinqumo ezinhle, ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokucindezeleka futhi ugcine, ukuba ngumholi kanye nokuxhumana namalungu abahlanganyeli, ukukwazi ukuphatha ulwazi oluzwelayo kanye nezindaba ezinkulu zolawulo ngokungabakhethi, ukuziphatha ngobungcweti, inhlonipho, ukuqiniseka, ukusebenza njengosizo, inhlakanipho, ukubonakala, ukuzibophezela, kanye nokugcina imfihlo.

Iimpawu ezinjengobulungisa nokuqamba ngokuyiyo, ikho elokusetyenziswa ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuqina, ukulawula nentabakomnye, ikho elokupegula iindaba ezibucali nezendlela zolawulo ezindala ngokuchanekileyo, ukuziphatha ngokungatshitshi, inhlonipho, inyaniso, ukusebenza njengohmga, iimbona, ukucaca, uqinisekiso, nokuwugqitha usuku.

Skills, Training, and Competencies: The successful candidate must have: In-depth knowledge of a variety of aspects such as Public Sector Risk Management Framework, Public Sector Integrity Management, Business Continuity Management Framework/ Standards, Code of Conduct for Public Servants, Protected Disclosures Act, Prevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act (PRECCA), Anti-corruption initiatives in the Public Services, Professional Ethics infrastructure in the Public Services, Public Service Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and Public Service Regulations. Knowledge of Risk Management principles and practices. Government systems. Knowledge of the Integrity Management Framework. Skills: Excellent skills in Problem Solving and risk analysis, Accountability and Ethical Conduct, Analytical skills, Planning, coordination and organising skills. Good communication skills, Computer literacy, time management, report writing, presentation and facilitation, Committee administration and minute-taking, conflict management. Attributes: Ability to work independently, integrity and honesty, professionalism, respect, teamwork and innovation.

af.title: Risiko- en Integriteitsbestuursbeoefenaar
af.summary: Implementering van risiko-, besigheidskontinuiteits- en integriteitsbestuursraamwerke by die KwaZulu-Natal Hoofkantoor, wat 'n NQF 6/7-kwalifikasie en 1-2 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Die ideale kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: 'n Toepaslike NQF 6/7 Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Risikobestuur of 'n Professionele Etiek-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 1-2 jaar se ervaring in 'n Risikobestuur-, Etiek- / Integriteitsbestuursomgewing. Besigheidskontinuiteitsbestuur, Bedrog-risikobestuur. Aktiewe registrasie by 'n risiko- / etiekprofessionele liggaam sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die implementering en ondersteuning van die ontwikkeling van risiko-, besigheidskontinuiteits- en integriteitsbestuursraamwerke, beleide en planne; Reël en neem deel aan bewusmaking, opleiding en belanghebbende-ondersteuning; Verskaf ondersteuning by die fasilitering van risiko-, integriteits-, besigheidskontinuiteits- en integriteitsbestuursassesserings; Implementeer risiko-, integriteits- en besigheidskontinuiteitsmonitering, evaluering en verslaermeganismes; en Verrig sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning vir die betrokke Komitees. Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: Diepgaande kennis van 'n verskeidenheid aspekte soos die Openbare Sektor Risikobestuursraamwerk, Openbare Sektor Integriteitsbestuur, Besigheidskontinuiteitsbestuursraamwerk/Standaarde, Gedragskode vir Openbare Dienare, Wet op Beskermde Vrywelling, Wet op die Voorkoming en Bekamping van Korrupsie-aktiwiteite (PRECCA), Antikorrupsie-inisiatiewe in die Openbare Diens, Professionele Etiek-infrastruktuur in die Openbare Diens, Openbare Dienswet, Openbare Finansiesbestuuringswet (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en Openbare Diensregulasies. Kennis van Risikobestuursbeginsels en -praktyke. Regeringstelsels. Kennis van die Integriteitsbestuursraamwerk. Vaardighede: Voortreflike vaardighede in probleemoplossing en risiko-anise, Verantwoordelikheid en Etiese Gedrag, Analitiese vaardighede, Beplanning, koördinering en organisasievaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid, tydbestuur, verslagskrywing, aanbieding en fasilitering, Komitee-administrasie en notuleringskonflikbestuur. Eienskappe: Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, integriteit en eerlikheid, professionaliteit, respek, spanwerk en innovasie.

zu.title: Umuntu osebenza kokuqashwa kokusiphathwa kengozi nokuziphatha
zu.summary: Ukusebenzisa izakhiwo zokuqashwa kokusiphathwa kengozi, ukuqhubeka kobuzwe nokuziphatha eKwaZulu-Natal Head Office, okudinga izifundo ze-NQF 6/7 kanye neminyaka engu-1-2 yemfundo ephathelene nalokhu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: Umuntu ofanelekileyo kufanele abenalezi zinto: Isidiploma sezwe esifanelekileyo se-NQF 6/7 noma iziqu ezingeni le-Risk Management noma iziqu ze-Professional Ethics njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Okungezi amaphesenti angu-1-2 iminyaka yemfundo yokusebenza kwindawo ye-Risk Management, Ethics / Integrity Management. Business Continuity Management, Fraud Risk Management. Ukwesemwa emthethweni kumzimba we-Risk / Ethics kuzoba ngumnikelo ongeziwe. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumeleleyo uzodingwa ukuthi asebenzise axhase ukuthuthukiswa kwezakhiwo, izinqumo nezinhlelo zokuqashwa kokusiphathwa kengozi, ukuqhubeka kobuzwe kanye nokuziphatha; Ahlele aphinde athathe inxaxheba ekwaziseni, ekuqeqesheni nasekuxhaseni abathintekayo; Anikeze uxhaso ekuqashweni kokusiphathwa kengozi, ukuziphatha, ukuqhubeka kobuzwe kanye nokuhlolwa kokuziphatha; Asebenzise izindlela zokuqapha, ukuhlola nokubika ezibuqashwa bengozi, ukuziphatha kanye nokuqhubeka kobuzwe; futhi Enze uxhaso lobungunyawo nololulawulo emakomidi ahambisanayo. Ikhono, Iqeqesho, Namakhono omuntu: Umuntu ophumeleleyo kufanele abenalezi zinto: Ulwazi olujulile ezintweni eziningana njengesakhiwo sokuqashwa kokusiphathwa kengozi kolawulo loluntu, ukuziphatha kolawulo loluntu, isakhiwo/amasiza okuqhubeka kobuzwe, ikhodi yokuziphatha yabezwe, umthetho wezindaba ezivikelwe, umthetho wokuthibela nokulwa nzenzo zokukhohlakala (PRECCA), izinhlela zokulwa nokukhohlakala ezikhungweni zoluntu, isakhiwo sokuziphatha obukhona ezikhungweni zoluntu, umthetho wesevisi loluntu, umthetho wezimali zikahulumeni (PFMA), izinqumo ze-Treasury kanye nazo ezisevisi yoluntu. Ulwazi ngamaphuzu nokuqashwa kokusiphathwa kengozi. Izindlela kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngosakhiwo lokuziphatha. Alikhono: Ilikhono elihle ekuxazululeni izinkinga nasekuhlaziyeni ubungozi, Ukuziphendulela nokuziphatha ngokumnyama, Amakhono ekuhlaziyeni, ukuhlela, ukubambisana nokuhlela. Amakhono okuthumela imiyalezo ahle, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukubhala umbiko, ukubukusa nokubusa iqhaza, ukulawula komabhoki nokubhala amaminithi, ukuphatha izinkinga. Iimpawu: Ukukwazi ukusebenza eyedwa, ukuziphatha nokuba nesibindi, ukuziphatha ngobungcweti, inhlonipho, ukusebenza njengeqembu kanye nokuba nobuchule bokwakha okusha.

xh.title: Umpractitioner woLawulo loMngeni nokuZinikela
xh.summary: Ukuze kusetyenziswe iinkqubo zolawulo lomngeni, ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi nolawulo lokuZinikela kwindlu enkulu yeKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka kubekho isifundo seNQF 6/7 kunye neminyaka elingunqamlezio 1-2 yamava ahambelana nalomsebenzi.
xh.requirements: Umzobi ofanelekileyo makabenayo: Isidanga sangowonke wonke seNQF 6/7 noma iDiploma yoLwazi eNgcwele kwiNqanaba leSizwe kulawulo loMngeni okanye isidanga sokuzinikela ngobuchwepheshe njengokoqatshwa yiSAQA. Amava angancinci kwaye angaphezulu kweminyaka 1-2 kwindawo yokulawula uMngeni, amaNga / ulawulo lokuZinikela. Ulawulo lokuQhubeka kwebhizinisi, ulawulo loMngeni wokuKhohlisa. Ukuqatshelwa njengelungu elisebenzayo kumbutho wabachwepheshe bolawulo loMngeni / amaNga kuya kuba lusizi olongezelelweyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Umzobi opumeleleyo uya kufuneka aze asebenzise axhase ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zolawulo lomngeni, ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi nolawulo lokuZinikela, iinkqubo nokuqaliswa kwenkqubo; Ahlole athabathe inxaxheba ekwaziseni, ekuqeqesheni nakuxhaseni abanjiniyeli; Axhase ekulawuleni ukuqalwa kolawulo lomngeni, lokuZinikela, lokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi nolawulo lokuZinikela; Asebenzise izixhobo zokulawula, ukuqaphela nokuvela ngeengxelo ngomngeni, ukuZinikela nokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi; kwaye Aze anikeze inkxaso ngokubengumfonyuli nengowolulo kolawulo kwiKomiti ezifanelekileyo. Amakhono, uQeqesho, nokuBa namandla: Umzobi opumeleleyo makabenayo: Ulwazi olujulileyo ngezihlobo ezahlukeneyo njengakuNqaku-nqaku wolawulo loMngeni kwiQumrhu kuLuntu, Ulawulo lokuZinikela kuLuntu, iNkqubo nemiqathango yolawulo lokuQhubeka kwebhizinisi / ngokwemigaqo, iKhodhi yokuziphatha kubasebenzi kaRhulumente, uMthetho wokuVela ngezoFihlo, uMthetho wokuThintela nokulwa nezenzo zoKhukho (PRECCA), iNkxaso zokuThintela ukhukho eziSebenziswa kuLuntu, iNkqubo yolwazi lokuZinikela ngobuchwepheshe eziSebenziswa kuLuntu, uMthetho kaRhulumente, uMthetho wolawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA), imiQathango yeQela leMali nemiQathango kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngeengcamango nokuqaliswa kweenkqubo zolawulo loMngeni. Iinkqubo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yolawulo lokuZinikela. Amakhono: Amakhono amaninzi ekuXazulula iingxaki nokuhlola umngeni, ekuPhatha iNxaxheba nokuZiphatha ngokuzinikela, amakhono oLwazi oluPhelele, eCwangciseni, ukuHlanganisa nokuBumba. Amakhono amaninzi ekuXelela, ekuSebenziseni iKhompyutha, ekuLawuleni ixesha, ekuBhaleni iingxelo, ekuBoniseni nokuQeqesha, ekuLawuleni iKomiti nokubhala iinkumbulo, ekuLawuleni iingxabano. Iimpawu: Ulwazi lokusebenza eyedwa, ukuZinikela nokuQinisekisa inyaniso, ubuchwepheshe, inhlonipho, ukusebenza njengeqela nokuQamba.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1/2/3 (PSYCHIATRY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1844 151 per annum Other benefits: 13th cheque, medical aid (optional), housing allowance (employee must meet requirements) Commuted overtime, 22% rural allowance
jobs.summary: Medical specialist psychiatrist sought for Umzimkhulu Psychiatric Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal to provide clinical psychiatric services, supervise staff and support continuing medical education.
jobs.requirements: Senior certificate or equivalent plus, MBCHB or equivalent plus FC Psych or MMED Psychiatry Current registration with HPCSA as Specialist Psychiatrist. Grade 1: 0-5 years’ experience post specialist qualification. Grade 2: 6-10 years’ experience post specialist qualification. Grade 3: 10+ years’ experience post specialist qualification. Knowledge, skills, training, and competencies required: Sound knowledge and clinical skills in the management of adult and child psychiatry patients. Ability to supervise and teach junior and senior members of staff. Good communication and interpersonal and management skills. Sound professional and ethical values and a concern for excellence. Ability to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.
jobs.duties: To provide safe, ethical and high quality psychiatric services within the hospital. Undertake and support Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Continuing Professional Development activities. Supervise and mentor medical officer, community service officers and nursing staff. Provide expert advice and clinical support to hospitals referring to Umzimkhulu Psychiatric Hospital. Active participation in quality improvement programs including clinical audits. Attend to administrative matters as it pertains to the running of the unit. Co-ordinate multidisciplinary team activities. Attend meetings and workshops as directed. Co-ordinate and support the mental health outreach programme within Harry Gwala District. Comply with all legal prescripts, Acts, legislation, policies, circulars, procedures, guidelines and code of conduct for public service. Adhere to correct channels of communication as per hospital organogram. Maintain clinical, professional and ethical standards. Assist the hospital management with the development and implementation of guidelines, protocols and clinical audits, revising as needed to optimise patient care in wards and outpatients departments.
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to Chief Executive Office, Umzimkhulu Hospital, Private Bag X514, Umzimkhulu, 3297 or Drop Off in the application Box, Umzimkhulu Hospital, 3297 or email: Umzimkhulu.E- Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M Titi
jobs.notes: Directions to candidates: The following documents must be submitted: Application for employment form (Z83 fully completed), which is obtained at any Government Department OR from the website: www.kznhealth.gov.za and curriculum vitae. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents, proof of experience and proof of current registration with the respective council on or before the date of interview following communication with HR. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Certified copies should not be older than three months, not copies of certified copies & faxed applications will not be considered. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. UMZ 01/2026. Failure to comply with the above instruction will lead to disqualification of applicants. Please note that due to the large number of applications, we anticipate to receive applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraints no S&T and resettlement claims will be considered for payment to candidates that are invited to interviews. Please note that pre-employment screening and verification process, including CIPC, criminal records verification will be undertaken. Non-RSA Citizens / Permanent Residents/ Work Permit holders must submit documentary proof when the applicant is shortlisted) This department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote respectively in all levels of all occupational categories in the department. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1/2/3 (PSIGIATRIE)
af.summary: Mediese spesialis-psigiater gesoek vir Umzimkhulu Psigiatriese Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal om kliniese psigiatriese dienste te lewer, personeel te superviseer en voortgesette mediese opvoeding te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Senior certificate of gelykwaardig plus, MBCHB of gelykwaardig plus FC Psych of MMED Psychiatry. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as Spesialis-Psigiater. Graad 1: 0-5 jaar se ervaring na spesialis-kwalifikasie. Graad 2: 6-10 jaar se ervaring na spesialis-kwalifikasie. Graad 3: 10+ jaar se ervaring na spesialis-kwalifikasie. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede wat vereis word: Deeglike kennis en kliniese vaardighede in die bestuur van volwasse en kinderpsigiatriepasiënte. Vermoë om junior en senior personeellede te superviseer en onderrig. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike en bestuursvaardighede. Deeglike professionele en etiese waardes en 'n strewe na uitmuntendheid. Vermoë om as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk.
af.duties: Om veilige, etiese en hoëgehalte psigiatriese dienste binne die hospitaal te lewer. Ondernem en ondersteun Voortgesette Mediese Opvoeding (CME) en Voortgesette Professionele Ontwikkeling-aktiwiteite. Superviseer en mentoreer mediese beamptes, gemeenskapsdiensbeamptes en verpleegpersoneel. Verskaf kundige advies en kliniese ondersteuning aan hospitale wat na Umzimkhulu Psigiatriese Hospitaal verwys. Aktiewe deelname aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme insluitend kliniese oudits. Begaan administratiewe aangeleenthede soos dit betrekking het op die bestuur van die eenheid. Koördineer multidissiplinêre spanaktiwiteite. Woon vergaderings en werkswinkels by soos aangewys. Koördineer en ondersteun die geestesgesondheids-uitreikprogram binne Harry Gwala Distrik. Voldoen aan alle regsvoorskrifte, Wette, wetgewing, beleide, sirkulêres, prosedures, riglyne en gedragskode vir die publieke diens. Hou aan die korrekte kommunikasiekanale soos per hospitaal-organogram. Handhaaf kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde. Bied bystand aan hospitaalbestuur met die ontwikkeling en implementering van riglyne, protokolle en kliniese oudits, en hersien soos nodig om pasiëntsorg in saale en buitepasiëntafdelings te optimaliseer.

zu.title: Iziquezobuchwepheshe Ezezokwelapha Ezinga 1/2/3 (Izifo Bengqondo)
zu.summary: Kufunwa ugqitshwe iziqu ezikumkhakha wezifo bengqondo ogcotshiwe iziqu zezezokwelapha wase Umzimkhulu Psychiatric Hospital e KwaZulu-Natal ukuze ahlinze ngemisebenzi yezokwelapha yezifo bengqondo, alawule abasebenzi futhi axhasa imfundo ephakanyayo yezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Senior certificate noma okulinganayo kanye ne MBCHB noma okulinganayo kanye ne FC Psych noma MMED Psychiatry Ubhalo lwamanje ne HPCSA njengogqitshwe iziqu ezikumkhakha wezifo bengqondo. Izinga 1: 0-5 unyaka wamava emva kokuthola iziqu zabuchwepheshe. Izinga 2: 6-10 unyaka wamava emva kokuthola iziqu zabuchwepheshe. Izinga 3: 10+ unyaka wamava emva kokuthola iziqu zabuchwepheshe. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuqeqesheka okudingekayo: Ulwazi olunjulile namakhono okwelapha ekuphateni abagulayo abadala nabaningane abanesifo sengqondo. Ikhono lokulawula nokufundisa abasebenzi abancane nabadala. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, okusebenza nabantu kanye nokulawula. Amaxabiso anzima omsebenzi ngekhono ngesiko nokukhathalele ukuphumelela okukhulu. Ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlangene emikhakheni eminingi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ephephile, ngokomoya kanye nengxenye enhle kakhulu yezifo bengqondo esibhedlela. Ukwenza nokuxhasa imfundo ephakanyayo yezokwelapha (CME) kanye nemisebenzi yokuthuthukisa iziqu bengqondo. Ukulawula nokuhola abahlinzi bezomzimba, abahlinzi abakhonzwe umbuso kanye nabahlengikazi. Ukuhlinzela ngeluleko lobuchwepheshe nokuxhasa kokwelapha amasibhedlela athumela e Umzimkhulu Psychiatric Hospital. Ukubambezela okusebenzayo emuhleleni wokuthuthukisa izinga okuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinto zokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezindaba zolawulo njengokuqondene nokuphatha kwesigaba. Ukuqondanisa imisebenzi yeqembu elihlangene emikhakheni eminingi. Ukubhada imihlangano kanye nezinkundla njengokuqondiwe. Ukuqondanisa nokuxhasa ohlelo lokunyuka emakhaya lwezempilo bengqondo engxenyeni ye Harry Gwala District. Ukuhambisana nayo yonke imigomo yomthetho, ama-Acts, umthetho, izinqubo, emabhulethi, izindlela, izinkomba kanye neshadi yokuziphatha komnyango wasezikhundleni. Ukubambelela kumikhondo ehlelekile yokuxhumana njengakuwo wonke amaphuzu esibhedlela. Ukugcina izinga lezinto zokwelapha, zomsebenzi kanye nezomoya. Ukusiza abaphathi besibhedlela ngokuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinkomba, izinqubo nokuhlola izinto zokwelapha, ukulungisa njengokudingekayo ukuze kube ngcono ukunakekelwa kwesiguli emawadeni nasemagumbini okuhlola.

xh.title: Isiphakamisi sezonyango Inqanaba 1/2/3 (I-PSYCHIATRY)
xh.summary: Kufunwa isiphakamisi sezonyango ngengqondo kwi-Umzimkhulu Psychiatric Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukunika iinkonzo ezibonelela ngengqondo, ukulawula abasebenzi nokuxhasa imfundo ephelayo yezonyango.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphananga okanye esilinganayo ngaphezulu, MBCHB okanye esilinganayo ngaphezulu kwaye ngaphezulu kwe-FC Psych okanye MMED Psychiatry. Ukgciniswe njengamanzi kwi-HPCSA njengesiphakamisi sezonyango ngengqondo. Inqanaba 1: 0-5 yiminyaka yamava emva kwesidanga esiphakamileyo. Inqanaba 2: 6-10 yiminyaka yamava emva kwesidanga esiphakamileyo. Inqanaba 3: 10+ yiminyaka yamava emva kwesidanga esiphakamileyo. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho, namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi olunzulu namakhono okubonelela ekuphathweni kwabaguli abadala nabantwana abanengqondo. Amandla okulawula nokufundisa abasebenzi abasezantsi naphezulu. Amakhono obuncwane obuhle nokusebenza nabantu nakulawula. Iimveliso zokwaziyo nezokuziphatha ezilungileyo nendlalo yempumelelo. Amandla okusebenza njengelinye iqela labasebenzi abanamakhono amaninzi.
xh.duties: Ukunika iinkonzo ezikhuselekileyo, ezizezokuziphatha nezelona zingangamso kwezonyango ngengqondo ezibonelela kule dsibhedlele. Ukwenza nokuxhasa imfundo ephelayo yezonyango (CME) nemisebenzi yokuphuhlisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukulawula nokukhokela ogqirha bezonyango, abasebenzi beenkonzo zomphakathi nogqirha bokhathalelo lwabaguli. Ukunika ingcebiso yamakhono nokuxhasa ngokubonelela kwezonyango iibhedlele ezithumela kwi-Umzimkhulu Psychiatric Hospital. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqazo yokuphucula umgangatho kubandakanya izitshixo zokuhlolwa kwezonyango. Ukunakela imicimbi yolawulo njengoko kumalene nokusebenza kweyuniti. Ukulungelelanisa imisebenzi yeqela labasebenzi abanamakhono amaninzi. Ukubamba iindibano namaworkshop njengoko kuvelwayo. Ukulungelelanisa nokuxhasa inkqubo yokufikelela kwezonyango lwengqondo ngaphakathi kwe-Harry Gwala District. Ukumelana nayo yonke imigaqo yomthetho, iMithetho, umthetho, iinkqubo, ipepha-mthetho, iinkqubo, izikhokelo namagama okuziphatha abasebenzi bemiphakathi. Ukulandela iziqhagamshelwani ezichanekileyo zokunxibelelanana njengoko kubhalwe kumapu wesibhedlele. Ukugcina umgangatho wezonyango, owaziyo nezokuziphatha. Ukuncedisa ulawulo lesibhedlele ekwenzeni nokusebenziseni izikhokelo, iinkqubo nezitshixo zokuhlolwa kwezonyango, zilungiswe njengoko kuyimfuneko ukuphucula ukhathalelo lwabagulu kwii-wards nakumagumbi abaguli ababuyayo.

jobs.requirements: Tertiary qualification (MBCHB) or equivalent (Medical). Registration certificate for Independent Practice with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Practitioner; Current Annual Practicing Certificate from Health Professions Council of South Africa; Twelve (12) months post Community Service experience as a Medical Officer as at closing date of this advert; Valid driver’s license; Relevant Discipline Specific Minimum Requirements below (depending on the Discipline): Cardiothoracic Surgery: FCS Intermediates and minimum 12 months experience in General Surgery post community service; Internal Medicine: Minimum 12 months of experience in Internal Medicine and FCP Part I and Diploma in Internal Medicine qualification; Nuclear Medicine: Minimum 2 weeks experience in Nuclear Medicine at a recognized training institution; Otorhinolaryngology (ENT): FCORL(SA) or FCS(SA) Primary exams and minimum 6 months experience in General Surgery and/or surgical specialties (e.g. ENT, neurosurgery, etc.) and minimum 3 months ICU and FCORL(SA) or FCS(SA) Intermediate Exams; Ophthalmology: Minimum 6 months experience in Ophthalmology post- Community Service and FC Ophthalmology (SA) Part I. af.title: Registrateur: Medies (Diverse)
af.summary: Registrateurposisies in vyf mediese dissiplines, insluitend kardiothorakale chirurgie, interne geneeskunde, nukleêre geneeskunde, KNO en oftalmologie regdeur KwaZulu-Natal.

KNO, neurochirurgie, ens.) en minimum 3 maande ICU en FCORL(SA) of FCS(SA) Intermediêre Eksamens; Oftalmologie: Minimum 6 maande ervaring in Oftalmologie na Gemeenskapsdiens en FC Ophthalmology (SA) Deel I; Basiese kennis van Mediese Praktyketiek, vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik te bestuur, vermoë om te leer, te innoveer en bereid wees om oortyd te werk, goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, 'n belangstelling in die uitvoer van navorsing, kennis van en respek vir die Handves vir Pasiënte se Regte en Batho Pele-beginsels.
