Buitepasiënte, Saale, Teaters, ICU's ens; bestuur van pasiënte onder toesig; bywoning van saalrondtes en/of tutoriale; toesig en onderrig van voorgraadse studente; verskaffing van buite-ure sorg vir nooddienste; klerkwerk en hou van omvattende rekords van pasiënte in die hospitaallêer; uitreikaktiwiteite soos deur die Kliniese Toesighouder nodig geag; Persoonlike ontwikkeling tot die vlak van onafhanklike spesialispraktyk in die gekose veld; Die departement behou die reg voor om nie hierdie pos(te) in te vul nie.

zu.title: Umphathi Wamagugu: Amanyathelo
zu.summary: Amasu abhalisi ezigabeni ezinhlanu okuhlanganisa ibhomu elincane lokuhlinza kwenhliziyo, ukwelapha ngaphakathi, ukuphathwa kwenhliziyo, izindlela zokuphathwa kwezifo zomzimba kanye nokukhanya amehlo KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphezhu (MBCHB) noma okulingana nazo (Ezokwelapha). Isitifikathi sokubhalisa kolawulo oluzimele ngaphansi kwe-HPCSA njengodokotela; Isitifikathi sokusebenza sonyaka samajeji ngu-HPCSA; Amajeji (12) unyaka unyaka ohlala enkantolo ngayinye ukuze asize abantu ngemisebenzi yezempilo yomphakathi; Isitifikathi sokushayela okuvunyelwe; Ezinye izinkomba ezithize ezihlotshaniswa nobugcisa obuthile ngezansi (ngokuncika kulimi oluthize): Ubugcisa bemifino: I-FCS Intermediates noma ubugcisa obungu-12 unyaka ohlalwe enkantolo ngeminye imisebenzi ngaphansi kobugcisa bezokwelapha; Ugogo: Iminyaka engu-12 ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngemisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwabantu ngasekhaya nge-FCP Part I noma iziqu ezingu-Diploma Internal Medicine; Uwelwa njalo esibhedlela: Iminyaka engu-2 evunyelwe ukuyisebenzisa ngaphansi kwesibhedlela esaziwayo sokufundela; Ukukhula: I-FCORL(SA) noma i-FCS(SA) Primary exams ukudlula emabhodini, ubugcisa obungu-6 unyaka ngenkathi kubhukuda kwezinja ezinkulu nakwezinye izilwane, okuncane ngaphezu kwengu-3 ekubhukudweni kwezinja eziyisibankalana kwi-ICU, kanti i-FCORL(SA) noma i-FCS(SA) Intermediate Exams kufanele kudlule; I-Klinikhaji: Ubugcisa obungu-6 unyaka ohlala enkantolo mayelana nokukhanya amehlo, ukuba kubhalwe ngeminye imisebenzi yabantu basekhaya ne-FC Ophthalmology (SA) Part I. Ukwazi okuyisisekelo mayelana nezindlela zokwenza izinto ngokuhloniphekileko emsebenzini wokwelapha, ukuba nokho ekubekeni izinto, nokuba nokho ekutholeni izindlela ezingcono ngokushesha, ukuba nokho ekusebenzeni ngokwedlula isikhathi, ukuba nokho emabuhleni abantu nokubakholelwa, ukuthanda ukuhola okubaluleke kakhulu ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi yokwelapha namalungelo abantu, nokwazi nokuhlonipha amakhosi abantu.
zu.duties: Ukubamba iqhaza kumuhlelobhalo nezinhlelo zokufundisa namhlangano Kumaqoqo ahambisanayo, ukumatheka ngokunakekelwa kweguli emazingeni/emasitesini abekiwe, isb, Amaguli alawayo osuku, Amawadi, Amalabhulabhulu, I-ICU njll; ukuphathwa kwamagabi ngaphansi kolawulo, ukubakhona emahlanganweni emawadi futhi noma izifundo ezincane, ukulawula nokufundisa abafundi abangakqambi iziqu, ukunikeza ukunakekelwa ngemuva kwezinsuku ezwenza izinkonzo zezinsuku ezingu998 ngesimo esiphuthumayo, ukubhalisa nokugcina imibhalo enemininingwane yamagabi efayela lesibhedlela, imisebenzi yokunyuka emazingeni njengoba kucatshangelwa ngumlawuli wezokwelapha, ukuzithuthukisa ngokwakho ize kufinyelele kwizinga lomkhakha othize ekufundweni kolimi lwesiZulu olubhekene. Umnyango ulondoloza ilungelo lokuthi angagcwalisi lezi zikhundla. Emisebenzini, ukutholwa kwentenga enkulu kwadingeka ukuba kusetshenziswe izinkomba ezithize ukuze kutholwe isikhundla. Izinkomba zokuqinisekisa iziqu kulezi zikhundla kufanele zitholwe ezikhungweni ezithize. Isikhundla sakho singagqamisa imisebenzi yakho. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkomba zokufundisa zitholwa ngokubhala ngemibuzo. Emhlanganweni wamagugu, ukuze kutholwe isikhundla, kubalulekile ukuba kubhalwe izindaba ezithize ngolimi lwesiZulu. Kulesi sikhundla, imibuzo ethile ihlotshaniswa nemisebenzi ekudingeka enziwe. Ngokusho kwesikhundla, imisebenzi ehlotshaniswa nokubhalisa iguli ihlanganisa imisebenzi emitsha futhi imisebenzi ebanzi. Umsebenzi wokubhalisa kufanele wenziwe ngendlela efanayo. Emisebenzini yonke, izinkomba ezithize zisetshenziselwa ukuthola ukulalela. Imibuzo ethile ihlotshaniswa nemisebenzi. Imisebenzi ethile ehlotshaniswa nalesi sikhundla, emva kokubhaliswa, ihlotshaniswa nemibuzo ethize. Izinkomba ezithize emhlanganweni zitholwe ngokubhala imibuzo. Ekuzoleni imisebenzi ethize ehlotshaniswa nalezi zikhundla, imibuzo ihlotshaniswa nemisebenzi ekudingeka enziwe ngokunakekelwa kwabantu.

xh.title: Umlobi wezokwelapha (EZAHLUKENEO)
xh.summary: Izithuba zabalobi bezokwelapha kumagatya amah aandululwa kubuchule bobuhlelobuchophha, unyazo lwezempilo, unyazo lwezinzulu, i-ENT kwaye ne-ophthalmology kuwo onke amagatya e-KwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Izidanga eziphakamileyo (MBCHB) okanye ezahlukeneyo (Ezokwelapha). Isatifikethi sokubhalisa kokwenza umsebenzi wodwa ne-Heshi Professional Council yaseMzantsi Afrika njengogqirha; Isatifikethi soNyaka wokuQhuba iSebenzo Esixhobo sokuqhuba iSebenzo ngokuqhuba kwesixhobo esingenangomso esingenisa kwiSebe lezokuQhuba iSebenzo ngokuqhuba kwesixhobo sokwenza umsebenzi wodwa; I Nyanga eziliw (12) zokwenza umsebenzi woQeqesho loQeqesho njengomsebenzi woQeqesho ngomhla wokuQhuba iSebenzo ngokuqhuba kulo nyaka; ilayisenisi yokusebenza egunyazisiweyo; iimfuno ezingagqibekanga ezahlukeneyo ezihambelana neQoqo loQeqesho (ngokuxhomekeke kwiQoqo): I-Ngoelo yeSurgery: i-FCS Intermediates nenyanga ezili-12 zokwenza umsebenzi kwi-General Surgery emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi; i-Internal Medicine: inyanga ezili-12 zokwenza umsebenzi kwi-Internal Medicine naku-FCP Part I kwaye neDiploma kwi-Internal Medicine; i-Nuclear Medicine: Ivehiki ezili-2 zokwenza umsebenzi kwi-Nuclear Medicine kwindalo ebonakalisiweyo yoQeqesho; i-Otorhinolaryngology (ENT): i-FCORL(SA) okanye i-FCS(SA) Primary exams nenyanga ezili-6 zokwenza umsebenzi kwi-General Surgery kwaye nobuchule bokwenza izigulane (umz. ENT, i-neurosurgery, njl.njl.) nenyanga ezili-3 ze-ICU naku-FCORL(SA) okanye i-FCS(SA) Intermediate Exams; i-Ophthalmology: inyanga ezili-6 zokwenza umsebenzi kwi-Ophthalmology emva koQeqesho loQeqesho kwaye ne-FC Ophthalmology (SA) Part I. Ulwazi olusesichengeni ngokumalunga neQoqo leeThics zokuQhuba iSebenzo, ukwazi ukulawula izigulane ngokuzodwa, ukwazi ukuqonda, ukutsha kwaye ukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ongekhoyo, amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, isabelo sokwenza ugqitho-hlola, ulwazi nokuzithoba kwiQoqo leeNguMthetho wezeSazigulane neNkqubo yeSazigulane i-Batho Pele.
xh.duties: Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumagatya eQoqo loQeqesho kwaye nakwindalo ekunye namagatya apho, kwisithuba sokukhathalela izigulane kumagatya okanye iindawo ezahlukeneyo, umz. iNguSebenzo zeNgaphandle, iSebe, iTheatre, i-ICU, njl; ukulawula izigulane ngokusesikweni, ukubakho kwindalo zokuqhuba iSebenzo kwaye nobuchule bokufundisa abafundi abangangenanga, ukunika inkonzo yokukhathalela ngemiva yemini ngemini yezigulane ezingngenwa kwiMojula yeziGulane, ukubhala nokugcina iNani eligqibeleleyo leminyaka eFayile yeSixhobo seGulane kwindlu yokwenza iSebenzo, ukwenza izenzo ezahlukeneyo eziya kuQeqesho njengoko kuqatshelwe nguQeqesho wezeGulane, uQeqesho loQeqesho ngokusesikweni ukuze kufikelele kwisixhobo seQeqesho ekukhoyo uQeqesho ngokusesikweni. ISebe sigcina ilungelo lokungazenzi esi sithuba.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty- Occupational Health
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum Other benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) and Housing allowance:(Employee to meet the prescribed requirements) and 8% Inhospitable/Rural allowance
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse specialising in Occupational Health at Dannhauser CHC, KwaZulu-Natal, coordinating HIV, AIDS and TB management programmes for personnel.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12(Senior Certificate), Standard 10 / or National Certificate plus basic R 425 qualification i.e. Degree/Diploma in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Post Basic qualification with the duration of at least 1 year in Occupational Health Nursing Science accredited with the SANC. Occupational Health Nurse Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Occupational Health Nurse Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing, of which at least 10 years must be appropriate / recognisable experience after obtaining the one year Post Basic qualification in Occupational Health Nursing Science accredited with SANC. Registration certificate with South African Nursing Council (SANC). Current SANC receipt (2026). Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required for the post: Knowledge of nursing care process and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant Legal framework. Sound knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Act, Compensation Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA) and the latest Employee Health and Wellness Framework for the public service. Sound knowledge of the National Core Standards (OHSC) and Data Management. Knowledge of basic human resource and financial management. Ability to formulate occupational health related policies and procedures. Ability to demonstrate good insight of policies and procedures pertaining to occupational and employee health and wellness. Problem solving, leadership and communication skills. Co-ordination and planning skills Computer Literacy. Knowledge of all applicable legislation guidelines and policies related to nursing Principles. Good interpersonal relationship and listening skills.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate HIV, AIDS and TB Management Sub-programme in context of prevention, treatment care and support for personnel. Work as part of the multi- disciplinary team to ensure quality of care, including working cooperatively with all employees of diverse social, religious and cultural backgrounds on the development of orientation and induction programme. Champion, promote and advocate proper treatment and care, including employee health and wellness campaigns to respond to the need of employees. Conduct disease profiles amongst the employees and develop quality improvement plan, policies and procedures and ensure timeous implementation. Co-ordinate healthy lifestyle promotion, medical surveillance (baseline, periodical and exit) and occupational health programmes. Conduct occupational health audits in line with the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 and relevant legislation and protocols. Co-ordinate establishment of multi- disciplinary HIV, AIDS, TB, Health and productivity. Management sub-committee as a platform for reflecting on the employee health and wellness issues. Maintain accurate staff records, identify and investigate occupational health diseases and compile statistics and submit report to the CHC management and District Office. Develop occupational health business plan in line with institutional plans, manage, plan, monitor, evaluate and review the utilisation of resources as an acting employee health and wellness programme co-ordinator / manager.
jobs.applications: All applications should be forwarded to Assistant Director: HRM; KZN: Department of Health, Hand delivery to: Dannhauser Community Health Centre; No 7 Durnacol Road; Dannhauser, 3080. Email address: DannhauserCHC.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za or www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs
jobs.notes: (This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representativity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department.) Applications must be submitted on the prescribed application for employment form (Z83-fully completed) and Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents and proof of current registration with the respective council on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Reference Number must be indicated in the column (Part A) provided thereof on the Z83 form. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. Faxed applications will not be accepted. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records and citizenship, verification of educational qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. NB: Preference will be given to African Male

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit- Beroepsgesondheid
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in Beroepsgesondheid by Dannhauser CHC, KwaZulu-Natal, wat HIV-, VIGS- en TB-bestuursprogramme vir personeel koördineer.
af.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), Standard 10 / of National Certificate plus basiese R 425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. Graad/Diploma in verpleegkunde of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie met SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Post Basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Beroepsgesondheidsverpleegkunde geakkrediteer met die SANC. Beroepsgesondheidsverpleegkundige Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige met SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Beroepsgesondheidsverpleegkundige Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige met SANC in Algemene Verpleging, waarvan ten minste 10 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring moet wees na verkryging van die een jaar Post Basiese kwalifikasie in Beroepsgesondheidsverpleegkunde geakkrediteer met SANC. Registrasiesertifikaat met South African Nursing Council (SANC). Huidige SANC-kwitansie (2026). Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis vir die pos: Kennis van verpleegsorgproses en prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander relevante regsraamwerk. Deeglike kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act, Compensation Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA) en die nuutste Employee Health and Wellness Framework vir die openbare diens. Deeglike kennis van die National Core Standards (OHSC) en Data Management. Kennis van basiese menslike hulpbron- en finansiële bestuur. Vermoë om beroepsgesondheidsverwante beleide en prosedures te formuleer. Vermoë om goeie insig te toon in beleide en prosedures rakende beroeps- en werknemergesondheid en welsyn. Probleemoplossing, leierskap en kommunikasievaardighede. Koördinasie- en beplanningsvaardighede Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewingsriglyne en beleide verwant aan verpleegbeginsels. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en luistervaardighede.
af.duties: Koördineer HIV-, VIGS- en TB-bestuurssubprogram in die konteks van voorkoming, behandeling, sorg en ondersteuning vir personeel. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om gehalte van sorg te verseker, insluitend om saam te werk met alle werknemers van uiteenlopende sosiale, godsdienstige en kulturele agtergronde oor die ontwikkeling van oriëntasie- en inlywingsprogram. Kampioen, bevorder en beywer vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend werknemergesondheids- en welsynsveldtogte om te reageer op die behoefte van werknemers. Voer siekteprofiele onder die werknemers uit en ontwikkel gehalteleweringsplan, beleide en prosedures en verseker tydige implementering. Koördineer bevordering van gesonde leefstyl, mediese waarneming (basis, periodiek en uitgang) en beroepsgesondheidsprogramme. Voer beroepsgesondheidsoudits uit in ooreenstemming met die Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 van 1993 en relevante wetgewing en protokolle. Koördineer die vestiging van multidissiplinêre HIV, VIGS, TB, Gesondheid en Produktiwiteit. Bestuur subkomitee as 'n platform vir besinning oor die werknemergesondheids- en welsynsaangeleenthede. Onderhou akkurate personeelrekords, identifiseer en ondersoek beroepsgesondheidsiektes en stel statistieke op en dien verslag in by die CHC-bestuur en Distrikskantoor. Ontwikkel beroepsgesondheidsbesigheidsplan in ooreenstemming met institusionele planne, bestuur, beplan, monitor, evalueer en hersien die benutting van hulpbronne as waarnemende werknemergesondheids- en welsynsprogramkoördineerder / bestuurder.

zu.title: Unesi Ohwesimfundo Ekhokhelwe- Empilo Yezokwakha
zu.summary: Unesi ohwesimfundo ekhokhelwe ohlinzeka nge-Empilo Yezokwakha eDannhauser CHC, KwaZulu-Natal, ohlela izinhlela zokuphathwa kwe-HIV, i-AIDS kanye ne-TB zabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12(Senior Certificate), i-Standard 10 / noma i-National Certificate okanye ngaphezulu kakhulu isiqu se-R 425 okungukuthi i-Degree/Diploma kwesibhedlela noma isiqu esingokulingana esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengenesi Ohwesimfundo. Isiqu sokuthuthuka esibukiwe nesikhathi esingokungenani unyaka we-1 ekuSizeni nge-Empilo Yezokwakha esemthethweni nge-SANC. INesi ye-Empilo Yezokwakha Izinga 1: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-4 yomuhla obonwayo / ovunyelwe kokusebenza esibhedlela emva kokubhalisa njengenesi Ohwesimfundo ku-SANC ekuSizeni nge-Empilo Yesikhathi Esijwayelekile. INesi ye-Empilo Yezokwakha Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-14 yomuhla obonwayo / ovunyelwe kokusebenza esibhedlela emva kokubhalisa njengenesi Ohwesimfundo ku-SANC ekuSizeni nge-Empilo Yesikhathi Esijewayelekile, okuyokuthi okungenani eminyaka eyi-10 kumele ibe ngumuhla obonwayo / ovunyelwe emva kokuthola isiqu sokuthuthuka esinyakeni we-1 ekuSizeni nge-Empilo Yezokwakha esemthethweni nge-SANC. Isitifiketi sokubhalisa ne-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Ukuqinisekiswa kwamanje kwe-SANC (2026). Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha kanye namandla ayingqalasizinda afunekayo kulesi sikhundla: Ulwazi ngqo ngesimo kanye nokuqondiswa kokunakekelwa kwesibhedlela, izimiso zesibhedlela kanye nezinye izikhungo zomthetho ezihlobene. Ulwazi oluzothile nge-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Compensation Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA) kanye ne-Framework yesimanje yoKuphila Nobuhle Basebenzi kuqoqo lolwazi lwethisho. Ulwazi oluzothile nge-National Core Standards (OHSC) kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu kanye nezimali. Ikono lokudala izinqumbo kanye nezinqubo ezihlobene nempilo yezokwakha. Ikono lokubonisa ukuqonda okuhle kwezinqumbo kanye nezinqubo ezihlobene nempilo yezokwakha kanye nokuphila nobuhle basebenzi. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukuba ngumholi kanye nokuxhumana. Amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuqondisa. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngazo zonke izimiso zomthetho, iziqondiso kanye nezinqumbo ezihlobene nokuqondiswa kwesibhedlela. Ukuxhumana kahle nabantu kanye namakhono okuzwa.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa uhlelo lokuphathwa kwe-HIV, i-AIDS kanye ne-TB ngokuvikela, ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa kanye nokusekela abasebenzi. Ukusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlukene izikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle, okubandakanya ukusebenza ngokubambisene nabo bonke abasebenzi bezizinda ezihlukene zomphakathi, zenkolo kanye namasiko ekutheni kohlelo lwesikhondlo nokuqalisa. Ukuba ngumpetha, ukukhuthaza kanye nokuvikela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele, okubandakanya imikhankaso yokuphila nobuhle basebenzi ukuphendla imfuneko yabasebenzi. Ukuqoqa izibalo ezihlobene nezifo phakathi kwabasebenzi kanye nokuthuthukisa uhlelo lokuthuthukisa ukunaka, izinqumbo kanye nezinqubo bese kuqinisekiswa ukusetshenziswa ngokushesha. Ukuqondisa ukukhuthazwa kokuphila ngokuhle, ukuqashelwa kwemithi (okokuqala, okwamanye amalanga kanye nokuphuma) kanye nezinhlela zempilo yezokwakha. Ukuqoqa izibalo zempilo yezokwakha ngokuvumelana ne-Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 kanye nomthetho ohlobene kanye nezinqubo. Ukuqondisa ukusungulwa kwekomidi elihlukene izikhathi le-HIV, i-AIDS, i-TB, Impilo kanye nokuqoqwa kwemisebenzi. Loluhlelo lwezindikimba njengesikhungo sokubuka izindaba zokuphila nobuhle basebenzi. Ukugcina izibalo ezinembile zabasebenzi, ukuthola kanye nokuphenya izifo zempilo yezokwakha kanye nokuqamba izibalo bese kuthunyelwa umbiko kubaphathi be-CHC kanye ne-District Office. Ukuthuthukisa ihlela lokusebenza lempilo yezokwakha ngokuvumelana nezinhlela zesikhungo, ukuphatha, ukuhlela, ukubuka, ukuhlola kanye nokubuyekeza ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza njengomqondisi / umphathi ohlewayo wohlelo lokuphila nobuhle basebenzi.

xh.title: INkosi yoNyango elungisiweyo - uKusebenza ngokusesikweni nokuLawulwa kwendlu
xh.summary: INkosi yeNkqubo yeNyango ethe ngqo kwindawo yokusebenza egqithiswe kwiDannhauser CHC, eKwaZulu-Natal, ilawula iinkqubo zokuLawula i-HIV, i-AIDS nayo i-TB kwabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: I Grade 12 (iSatifikethi esiPhezima), u Standard 10 okanye iQhosha eliLizwe eliya kuleli elicela nesisindo esisesikhundleni se Grade esikulungele ukubhalisa phantsi kweSikolo se-Aphalaphala (SANC) njengesiGqala seNkqubo yeMpilo eYilwayo eNtlobonlantloni. IZakhiwo eziqhelanayo zokuqwalaselwa kwexesha elingathi ngama-1 kwiNkqubo yeMpilo yeZisebenzi kwiminyaka emitsha efunwa kukugqibelela eSikolo seSizwe se Nyanga eAfrika (SANC). INkqubo yoBasebenzi eYilwayo iGebu 1: Iminyaka engu-4 ngokuchanekileyo efana neNkqubo yokusebenza njengesiGqala esenziweyo seNkqubo emihle nemitisha yeziBalo ekufunyenwe e SANC. INkqubo yoBasebenzi eYilwayo iGebu 2: Iminyaka engama-14 ngokuchanekileyo efana neNkqubo yokusebenza njengesiGqala esenziweyo seNkqubo emihle nemitisha yeziBalo ekufunyenwe e SANC, apho kufuneka kube naminjaka angama-10 ngokuchanekileyo okubakho esiQinisekiso seNkqubo esisesikhundleni se-1 seNkqubo yeMpilo yeZisebenzi ePhakamileyo esemthethweni e SANC. Isatifikethi sokubhalisa ngokwesiko esivunyelwe ngumthetho eAfrika (SANC). Iresiti yesiKhundla seSikhululo se Nyanga e-Afrika (SANC) (2026). Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namaQinisekiso afunwa kulesi sikhundla: Ukuba lulwazi ngemisebenzi yokunyanga nemiQaqo yoNyango, kumthetho weNyango nemiQaqo ekhoyo ngokwemithetho. Ukuba nolwazi oluzekileyo ngomthetho woLawulo lokuQinisekisa uLawulo lweNdalo yoBasebenzi, noLawulo lweMiba nokuGqabhuka kumthetho i COIDA, nesiQinisekiso seNdalo soBomi baseBenzi beZizwe. Ulwazi oluzekileyo ngokuqonda ngokwamagunya esiZwe (OHSC) nokuLawulwa kweDatha. Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa kweNqanaba nokuLawulwa kwemali namanani. Ukuba namakhono okwenzela amagunya abasebenzi ngokwemigaqo nemiQaqo. Ukuba namakhono okubonisa ukuqonda ngemigaqo nemiQaqo ngokuphatheleyo ngeNdalo noBomi baseBenzi nokuQina. Amakhono okuSombulula iingxaki, aze akhuthaze kukwanga nanokuxhumana. Amakhono oQhutywa noMiso. Amakhono oKwaziswa koKhompyutha. Ulwazi ngawo onke amathuba ngomthetho ngemigaqo nemiQaqo ephathelene neNkqubo yokuNyanga. Ukuba namakhono olwazi lwezabelo zentsapho zoluntu, namakhono okuzingelwa iindaba.
xh.duties: Yoba ngumlawuli wengqikithi ohlawulayo wesebe ngaphantsi leNkqubo ye-HIV, i-AIDS kunye ne-TB kwindima yokuthintela, kwelungelo lokunyanga, lokunakekela nokuNxhoma abasebenzi. Usebenze njengenxalenye yeqela elisingathiyo iindidi ezahlukeneyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga lenkathalo, kuquka nokusebenza ngokwemfanelo nabasebenzi bonke abavela kumvelo wezintsapho, inkolo namasiko ahlukahlukeneyo ekwakheni inkqubo yokwamkela nokungenisa abasebenzi basebenza. Yiba ngumthathi-ndaba, kulonde kwaye ude uthethelele ngokuchanekileyo ukunyanya nokunakekela, kuqokelelwe ngamakhaya aphakathi kwabasebenzi nangemikhankulo yokwanceda ukuphendula iimfuno zabasebenzi. Yenze iinkcazelo ngezifo ezikwindalo kubasebenzi aze athibe ngokuchanekileyo urhwado, neenkqubo zeempahla azisebenziswe ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Lawule inkuthazwe sempilo yentsapho ngokusebenzisa iidatha ezikulungele ukuqokelelwa kwiimvumelwano ezikulo mmandla kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lwezonyango. Yenza iphulo lemfihlo lokulawula izifo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho weMigaqo yokuLawula nokuQinisekisa uKhuseleko kwiNdawo zoBasebenzi uMthetho ka-1993, namanye amathuba nepali yamagunya ebe ibhalwe kumthetho namaziko abasebenzi beNdalo yeMpilo yeZimbabwe. Yiba ngumlawuli weNkqubo ezimbiwa iingqangqa kwiNkqubo yeHIV, iAIDS, iTB, Imfihlo nokuSebenzela ukuze kube yindawo ethile ekuboniswana ngamacebo akhululekileyo. Yondulule ngokubeka zonke iingxoxo, uphando ngenkcazela izifo ngokutsha okugqibeleleyo, ungenise idatha ngokulandela iSikhululo, uzibandakanye nophando, unike nengxelo ekhawulezileyo ekubeni abasebenzi belawulo leNkqubo yeziguli ephuma kumaziko amakhulu neSikhululo seNdalo. Zenze iNkqubo yamagunya wakho ekuqwalaselweni ngokwemigaqo yolawulo, ulawule, uqwalasele, ugxile ekubeni ikomishoni yokuLawula inkqubo yolawulo lokuBekwa ngokwemigaqo yeMpilo yeSizwe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 - R573 897 per annum. Plus: Other Benefits: 13th cheque, Medical Aid and Housing Allowance Optional (Employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Management at Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, overseeing HR practices, planning and labour relations.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent. Degree/ National Diploma in Human Resource Management / Public Management / Administration Plus. At least 3-5 years appropriate supervisory experience in Human Resource component. Valid driver’s licence. PERSAL certificates. Computer Literacy (word processing and spreadsheet packages). Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Working knowledge of health policies and current public service and health related legislation. Broad knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management. Sound knowledge of Human Resource Practices, Staff Relations, Employee Wellness and Human Resource Development. Ability of strategic planning, execution, monitoring and evaluation. Sound knowledge of PERSAL, Project management and Financial Management. Ability to liaise with management. Knowledge of EPMDS. Computer literacy in word processing and spreadsheet packages. High level of information presentation.
jobs.duties: Manage day to day functioning of the human resource management component to ensure that high-quality human resource management services are provided. Oversee HR practices, HR planning and Development, Labour Relations, Occupational Health and Employee Wellness. Responsible for development, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of Human resource standard operating procedures and guidelines. Implement National Core Standards and all other quality improvements initiatives. Develop Human Resource Plan for the hospital which includes HR Plan, Employment Equity Plan, Operational Plan, Skills Development Plan, Annual in-service Education Plan etc. and ensure that all stakeholders are represented as the guidelines stipulates. Maintain functional HR Committees which include Employment Equity Committee, IHRDC (Institutional Human Resource Development Committee), Institutional Management and Labour Committee, Occupational Health and Safety Committee and other relevant committees. Monitor and control budget allocated to Human Resource component and clearing of suspense accounts. Ensure effective performance management in line with Employee Performance Management and other relevant prescripts. Maintain good/sound labour peace. Ensure establishment of fully functional employee health and wellness programmes. Timeous submission of statistics, reports, returns and any other information from HR. Represent HR in various committees within the institution and at district level.
jobs.enquiries: Mr V.M Mvelase: CEO: Tel No: (033) 330 6146
jobs.applications: Applications should be directed to: Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital, Private Bag X23, Howick, 3290 / Hand Delivered / Corriere To: Human Resources Department, Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital, Old Main Road, Howick. Email to: UmgeniHospital.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : HR department
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) obtainable at any government department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za which must be originally signed, initialled and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV only (with detailed experience). Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Please take note that due financial constraints no S & T will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. No late applications will be considered. Please take note that due to the large number of applications received, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. UMgeni Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all occupational categories in the institution.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat HR-praktyke, beplanning en arbeidsverhoudinge oorsien.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 of gelykwaardig. Degree/ National Diploma in Human Resource Management / Public Management / Administration Plus. Ten minste 3-5 jaar toepaslike toesigervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbron-komponent. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. PERSAL-sertifikate. Rekenaarvaardigheid (woordverwerking en sigbladpakkette). Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Werkende kennis van gesondheidsbeleid en huidige openbare diens- en gesondheidsverwante wetgewing. Breë kennis en begrip van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Deeglike kennis van Menslike Hulpbronpraktyke, Personeelsverhoudinge, Werknemerswelstand en Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling. Vermoë tot strategiese beplanning, uitvoering, monitering en evaluering. Deeglike kennis van PERSAL, projekbestuur en finansiële bestuur. Vermoë om met bestuur te skakel. Kennis van EPMDS. Rekenaarvaardigheid in woordverwerking en sigbladpakkette. Hoë vlak van inligtingsaanhouding.
af.duties: Bestuur die daaglikse funksionering van die menslike hulpbronbestuur-komponent om te verseker dat hoë-gehalte menslike hulpbronbestuursdienste verskaf word. Oorsien HR-praktyke, HR-beplanning en Ontwikkeling, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Beroepsgesondheid en Werknemerswelstand. Verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en evaluering van menslike hulpbron-standaard bedryfsprosedures en riglyne. Implementeer Nasionale Kerntandards en alle ander gehalte-verbeteringsinisiatiewe. Ontwikkel 'n Menslike Hulpbronplan vir die hospitaal wat HR-plan, Indiensnemingsgelykheidsplan, Operasionele plan, Vaardigheidsontwikkelingsplan, Jaarlikse in-diens Onderwysplan ens. insluit en verseker dat alle belanghebbendes verteenwoordig word soos die riglyne voorskryf. Onderhou funksionele HR-komitees wat Indiensnemingsgelykheidskomitee, IHRDC (Institutional Human Resource Development Committee), Institutionele Bestuurs- en Arbeidskomitee, Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidskomitee en ander relevante komitees insluit. Monitor en beheer begroting wat aan Menslike Hulpbron-komponent toegeken is en die skakel van staande rekeninge. Verseker doeltreffende prestasiebestuur in ooreenstemming met Werknemersprestasiebestuur en ander relevante voorskryfte. Onderhou goeie/deeglike arbeidsvrede. Verseker die instelling van ten volle funksionele werknemergesondheids- en welstandsprogramme. Tydige indiening van statistieke, verslae, opgawes en enige ander inligting vanaf HR. Verteenwoordig HR in verskeie komitees binne die instelling en op distrikvlak.

zu.title: Onozweba: ukuphatha abantu
zu.summary: Onozweba osekela ukuqashwa koluse e-Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, aqapha izindlela zokuphatha abantu, ukuhlelwa kanye nobudlelwano bomsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphakeme / ibanga le-12 noma okulinganayo. I-Degree/ National Diploma Human Resource Management / Public Management / Administration Plus. Okungenani unyaka we-3-5 wemfundo yokuhola abasebenzi ohambisana nengxenye yabaphathi abantu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Izitifiketi ze-PERSAL. Ukuba lilwazi ngemikhondo ye-computer (amaphakheji wokuqamba amagama kanye namaspredishidi). Ulwazi, amakhono kanye namandla: Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngemithetho yezempilo kanye nomthetho osanda kuphuma wesevisi yomphakathi nohlobene nezempilo. Ulwizi olubanzi kanye nekuqonda kokuphatha abantu. Ulwazi oluzwilayo ngendlela zokuphatha abantu, izinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi, impilo kahle yomsebenzi kanye nokuqashwa koluse. Ikhono lokuhlela amasu, ukuphatha, ukulawula kanye nokuqonda. Ulwazi oluzwilayo ngakwe-PERSAL, kuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali. Ikhono lokuxhumana nabaphathi. Ulwazi nge-EPMDS. Ulwazi ngemikhondo ye-computer ekwazi ukulungisa amagama kanye namaspredishidi. Izinga eliphezulu lokubeka ulwazi.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke yengxenye yabaphathi babantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kunikezwa izinsiza ezinhle zokuphatha abantu. Qapha izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi wokuphatha abantu, ukuhlelwa kanye nokuqashwa koluse, izinhlobonhlobo zomsebenzi kanye nesimpilo sabasebenzi. Uxanduva lokuthuthukisa, ukuqalisa, ukulawula kanye nokuhlola izinqamuleli ezisesilinganisweni nezinqubo zokusebenza zabaphathi abantu. Qalisa Izindinganiso Zesizinda Zesifunda kanye nayo yonke eminye imizamo yokuthuthukisa izinga. Hlela uhlelo lokuqashwa koluse lwesibhedlela oluhlanganisa uhlelo loluse, uhlelo lobulungiswa bokusebenza, uhlelo lokusebenza, uhlemo lokuthuthukisa amakhono, uhlemo lemfundoyonyaka yangaphakathi njll. Futhi uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abahlanganyelayo bamelelwa njengoba izinqamuleli zibekayo. Gcina amakomidi asebenzayo wokuphatha abantu ahlanganisa ikomidi lobulungiswa bokusebenza, i-IHRDC (Institutional Human Resource Development Committee), ikomidi lokuphatha isikhungo nomsebenzi, ikomidi lezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini kanye namanye amakomidi ahambisana nalokho. Qapha futhi ulawule imali yokusebenza enikezwe ingxenye yabaphathi abantu kanye nokusula izikhwama ezibambezele. Qinisekisa ukuphatha ukusebenza okusebenzayo ngokuhambisana nokuphatha ukusebenza komsebenzi kanye namanye amagunya ahambisana nalokho. Gcina kuthule okuhle kuluse. Qinisekisa ukusungulwa kwezinhlela ezisebenzayo ngokuphelele zezempilo nempilo kahle kokusebenza. Ukuze ithunyelwe ngesikhathi izibalo, imibiko, imiphumela kanye nanoma yisiphi esinye ulwazi olusuka kubaphathi abantu. Mela abaphathi abantu kumakomidi ahlukene ngaphakathi kwesikhungo futhi ezinganeni lesifunda.

xh.title: Umncedisi weSikhululi: uLawulo Lwamabele abasebenzi
xh.summary: Umncedisi weSikhululi wolawulo lwamabele abasebenzi e-Umgeni Specialised Psychiatric Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, olawula iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi wamabele abasebenzi, uqeqesho kunye nothethwano ngabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 okanye esinengqondo. I-Degree/ National Diploma kulawulo lwamabele abasebenzi / ulawulo lukawonke-wonke / i-Administration Plus. Ubuncinane 3-5 iminyaka yamava obukhosi abafanelekileyo kumzimba wamabele abasebenzi. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Iifestile ze-PERSAL. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iinkqubo zokucwangcisa amagama kunye namaspredshithi). Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla okusebenza: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngeenqobo zempilo yomntu kunye namagatya abukhali bommyili wamabele abasebenzi namathetha ahambelana nempilo. Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda ukulawula amabele abasebenzi. Ulwazi olusisigxina ngeendlela zokwenza umsebenzi wamabele abasebenzi, uquduselo lwabasebenzi, impilo yomsebenzi nentlalo yabasebenzi nokuphuhliswa kwamabele abasebenzi. Isakhono sokucwangcisa ngokoqobo, ukuze kwenziwe, ukujonga nokuqokelela iinkcukacha. Ulwazi olusisigxina nge-PERSAL, ulawulo lweprojekthi nolawulo lweemali. Isakhono sokuba nxaxheba nokulawulana nabaphathi. Ulwazi nge-EPMDS. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngeendlela zokucwangcisa amagama namaspredshithi. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokubeka iinkcukacha phambili.
xh.duties: Lawula imisebenzi yamabele abasebenzi yemihla ngemihla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kunikezelwa iinkonzo zamabele abasebenzi ezilumkileyo. Qwalasela iindlela zamabele abasebenzi, uqeqesho nolwandiso, uquduselo olusemthethweni, impilo yakwasebenza nempilo yabasebenzi. Umrwelelokulawula ngokuphuhliswa, ukwenziwa, ukuqatshelwa nokuqokelela iinkcukacha zamabele abasebenzi ezisebenza ngendlela eqedwa nokuqwalaselwa. Zisebenzisa i-National Core Standards nakwezinye iindlela zokuphucula inkqubo. Yakha icebo lokuqwalasela amabele abasebenzi esibhedlele elibandakanya i-icebo lokuqwalasela amabele abasebenzi, i-icebo le-Employment Equity, i-icebo lokuqhuba imisebenzi, i-icebo lokuqeqesha amakhono, i-icebo leminyaka yeqeqesho langaphakathi njl. ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba bonke abathathi nxaxheba bamele njengoko kumisela imigaqo. Yugcine iinkomfa zamabele abasebenzi ezisebenzayo ezibandakanya i-Employment Equity Committee, i-IHRDC (Institutional Human Resource Development Committee), i-Institutional Management and Labour Committee, i-Occupational Health and Safety Committee nakwezinye iinkomfa ezibalulekileyo. Qwalasela ulawulo lweemabi ezinikelwe kumzimba wamabele abasebenzi nokucoca iiafawunti ezikrobad. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngempumelelo imisebenzi ngokulandelwa kweliso kulawulo lokwenza imisebenzi yomsebenzi nakwezinye iziqendu ezibalulekileyo. Zigcine izithintana ezilungileyo ekusebenzeni. Qinisekisa ukumiselwa kweenkqubo zempilo namaphakathi abasebenzi ezisebenzayo ngokupheleleyo. Ukuhamba ngenkqubo yokuzisa iisitathisistiki, iingxelo, iingcelisa nakwezinye iinkcukacha evela kumabele abasebenzi ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Mela amabele abasebenzi kwiinkomfa ezahlukeneyo ngaphakathi kwesikhululo nakumabandla emithetho.

jobs.title: Director: Specialized Advosory Support Services
jobs.summary: Director of Specialised Advisory Support Services at KZN Provincial Treasury, managing reporting frameworks for public entities. Requires NQF Level 7 qualification and five years' managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A 3 year recognized NQF Level 7 Qualification in Public Finance or Economics, Accounting, Financial Management. SMS Pre-Entry Certificate submitted prior to appointment. 5 years’ Middle or senior Managerial experience in Public Finance or Budget Management field (e.g. Financial Management, Revenue and Expenditure Management and Budgeting Systems). A Valid Driver’s Licence-Persons with disabilities who are unable to drive themselves will be assisted to meet work related travel commitments. Skills, Knowledge and Competencies: Knowledge of the Constitution (as amended). PFMA and Treasury Regulations. PSRF (Public Service Regulatory Framework). Provincial Procurement Act and Regulations. Provincial Internal Audit Act. PGDS (Provincial Growth and Development Strategy). PSEDS (Provincial Spatial Economic Development Strategy). National Treasury guideline documents. Financial Management systems (including BAS). In year monitoring and National Treasury Returns. Performance Measurement systems. Asset Management. Public finance management. Problem-solving. Analytical and numeracy. Verbal communication and presentation. Good interpersonal relations. Computer skills: Spreadsheets (MS Excel), word processing (MS Word). Economic modelling, research, and analysis. Report writing and general writing. Monitoring and forecasting. Project management. Contract management. Budgeting and budgeting systems. Performance budgeting and strategic planning. Change management. Statistical and quantitative analysis. Financial management. Strategic planning and management. People management. High level statistical and numeracy skills (ability to work with complex, linked spreadsheets). Language.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of a Management Reporting Framework for public entities with respect to budgeting. Manage the implementation of a Management Reporting Framework for public entities with respect to reporting. Manage the implementation of a Management Reporting Framework for public entities with respect to compliance with the PFMA by public entities. Provide inputs regarding vertical and horizontal division of revenue and contribute to discussions on DORA and participate in the review of the equitable share formula. Manage the development, review and implementation of policies, procedures and guidelines pertaining to provincial public entities and evaluate intergovernmental systems and provide recommendations to the Budget Council. Manage the resources of the Directorate.
jobs.applications: KwaZulu-Natal Provincial Treasury, P O Box 3613, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or 145 Chief Albert Luthuli Road, Pietermaritzburg, 3200. Applications can also be submitted via the e-services system please assess this site on (eservices.gov.za) FOR ATTENTION : Ms L Mthimunye
jobs.notes: Preferences: Females and people with disabilities who meet the requirements. The new Z83 form must be used effective 1 January 2021 and can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. The Z83 Must Be Completed In Full. Application must be accompanied by a detailed CV Only the provisionally shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit supporting documents (certified copies of qualifications, driver’s license etc.) All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake to pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants need to ensure that they obtain and submit their foreign qualifications verified with SAQA if shortlisted or provisionally shortlisted. Non-South African citizens or permanent residency holders, if provisionally shortlisted, will be required to submit proof of citizenship All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity The Department will also conduct reference checks with HR of current /previous employer(s) beside the references provided on CV. Candidates will be subjected to security screening and a technical assessment. Under no circumstances will be faxed, emailed and late applications be accepted. The Department discourages applications that are registered and will not be held responsible for applications sent via registered mail which are not collected from the post office. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application reaches the Department timeously. Regrettably, due to excessive budget cuts, the department is not in a position to meet any travel subsistence costs relating to recruitment processes, or relocation and resettlement costs for successful candidates. Should you not hear from the Department within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Candidates who do not comply with the above mentioned will not be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Gespesialiseerde Adviserende Ondersteuningsdienste
af.summary: Direkteur van Gespesialiseerde Adviserende Ondersteuningsdienste by KZN Provincial Treasury, wat verslagdoeningsraamwerke vir openbare entiteite bestuur. Vereis 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurlike ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n 3-jaar erkende NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie in Public Finance of Economics, Accounting, Financial Management. SMS Pre-Entry-sertifikaat voor indiensneming ingedien. 5 jaar se middel- of senior bestuurservaring in die Public Finance- of Budget Management-veld (bv. Financial Management, Revenue and Expenditure Management and Budgeting Systems). 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie-Persone met gestremdhede wat self nie kan bestuur nie, sal bygestaan word om werkverwante reisverpligtinge na te kom. Vaardighede, kennis en bevoegdhede: Kennis van die Grondwet (soos gewysig). PFMA en Treasury Regulations. PSRF (Public Service Regulatory Framework). Provincial Procurement Act and Regulations. Provincial Internal Audit Act. PGDS (Provincial Growth and Development Strategy). PSEDS (Provincial Spatial Economic Development Strategy). National Treasury-sriglyndokumente. Financial Management-stelsels (insluitend BAS). In year monitoring en National Treasury Returns. Performance Measurement-stelsels. Asset Management. Public finance management. Probleemoplossing. Analitiese en syfvaardighede. Verbale kommunikasie en voorlegging. Goedehuwelikverhoudinge. Rekenaarvaardighede: Sigblaaie (MS Excel), woordverwerking (MS Word). Ekonomiese modellering, navorsing en analise. Verslagskrywing en algemene skryfwerk. Monitering en voorspelling. Projekbestuur. Kontrakbestuur. Begroting en begrotingsstelsels. Prestasiebegroting en strategiese beplanning. Veranderingsbestuur. Statistiese en kwantitatiewe analise. Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese beplanning en bestuur. Menslikebestuur. Hoëvlak-statistiese en syfvaardighede (vermoë om met komplekse, gekoppelde sigblaaie te werk). Taal.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van 'n Management Reporting Framework vir openbare entiteite ten opsigte van begroting. Bestuur die implementering van 'n Management Reporting Framework vir openbare entiteite ten opsigte van verslagdoening. Bestuur die implementering van 'n Management Reporting Framework vir openbare entiteite ten opsigte van nakoming van die PFMA deur openbare entiteite. Verskaf insette rakende vertikale en horisontale verdeling van inkomste en dra by tot besprekings oor DORA en neem deel aan die hersiening van die billike aandeel-formule. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van beleide, prosedures en riglyne rakende provinsiale openbare entiteite en evalueer intergovernmental-stelsels en verskaf aanbevelings aan die Budget Council. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: Amasevisi Okuxhasa Okweluleka Okukhethekile
zu.summary: Umphathi wamasevisi okuxhasa okweluleka okukhethekile e KZN Provincial Treasury, ophatha izakhiwo zokuqinisekisa ukubika ezinhlanganweni zomphakathi. Kudingeka abe nelayisensi yeziqu ezinga le-NQF Level 7 futhi abe neminyaka emihlanu yokuhola.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyisikhombisa ze-NQF Level 7 eziqinisekisiwe ezithatha iminyaka emithathu ku-Public Finance noma i-Economics, i-Accounting, noma i-Financial Management. Isitifiketi se-SMS Pre-Entry kufanele sithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukuhola okweminyaka emihlanu ohlelweni oluphakathi noma oluphezulu ku-Public Finance noma enkabeni yokuphatha ibhajethi (isb. i-Financial Management, ukuphatha impahla nezimali ezikhishwa kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza ibhajethi). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni-Abantu abasizakulumbe abangakwazi ukuzishayela bazosizakala ukugcwalisa izibopho zokuhamba okuhlobene nomsebenzi. Amakhono, Ulwazi namandla: Ulwazi ngoMthethosisekelo (njengoba ulungisiwe). I-PFMA kanye noMthetho Wezesikhwama. I-PSRF (Public Service Regulatory Framework). Umyango WezokuThenga weSifunda kanye noMthetho. Umyango Wokuhlola Ngaphakathi weSifunda. I-PGDS (Provincial Growth and Development Strategy). I-PSEDS (Provincial Spatial Economic Development Strategy). Amadokhumenti okuhola e-National Treasury. Izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali (okuhlanganisa i-BAS). Ukwengamela unyaka kanye nokubuyisela i-National Treasury. Izinhlelo zokulinganisa ukusebenza. Ukuphatha impahla. Ukuphatha imali yomphakathi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlaziya kanye nobuncwane bezibalo. Ukukhuluma ngomlomo kanye nokubonisa. Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Amakholo ekhompyutha: Amaspredshithi (i-MS Excel), ukucubungula amagama (i-MS Word). Ukuqamba amamodeli ezomnotho, ucwaningo, kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukubhala izibalo kanye nokubhala okuvamile. Ukubuka kanye nokubikezela. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha izinkontileka. Ukwenza ibhajethi kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza ibhajethi. Ibhajethi yokusebenza kanye neplani yokuhlela. Ukuphatha inguquko. Ukuhlaziya izibalo kanye nobuningi. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuhlela ohlwini kanye nokuphatha. Ukuphatha abantu. Amakhono aphakeme okubala izibalo kanye nobuncwane (ikholo lokusebenza ngamaspredshithi anezinga eziyinkimbinkimbi ahlobene). Ulimi.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuphunyazwa kwezakhiwo zokuqinisekisa ukubika ukuphatha kwezinhlangano zomphakathi ngokomthetho webhajethi. Qondisa ukuphunyazwa kwezakhiwo zokuqinisekisa ukubika ukuphatha kwezinhlangano zomphakathi ngokokubika. Qondisa ukuphunyazwa kwezakhiwo zokuqinisekisa ukubika ukuphatha kwezinhlangano zomphakathi ngokohlelo loku-hambisana ne-PFMA ngamahlelo womphakathi. Nikeza okufakwayo ngokohlelo lokuqoqa imali ngokuqondile nangokuqondile kanti futhi ube negalelo emibikweni ye-DORA ubambe iqhaza ekuhloleni ifomula yokwabelana ngokulingana. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlola nokuphunyazwa kwezinqobo, izindlela nokuhlela okumayelana namahlelo omphakathi esifunda, uhlole izinhlelo zikahulumende oyingqayizivele unikeze izincomo ku-Budget Council. Qondisa amaphakhiwo eDirectorate.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Iinkonzo Zokuxhasa Ezinobuchule
xh.summary: Umlawuli weNkonzo Zokuxhasa Ezinobuchule eKZN Provincial Treasury, elawula iindlela zokubika zezinto zikawonke-wonke. Kufuneka ube nesidanga saseNQF Level 7 kunye namava eminyaka emihlanu yokulawula.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esaziwayo seNQF Level 7 kwiminyaka emithathu kwiPublic Finance okanye iEconomics, Accounting, Financial Management. Isatifikethi se-SMS Pre-Entry kufuneka singeniswe ngaphambi kokwenziwa isikhuthaleli. Iminyaka emi-5 yamava okulawula aphakathi okanye aphezulu kwicala lePublic Finance okanye iBudget Management (umzekelo iFinancial Management, Revenue and Expenditure Management kunye neBudgeting Systems). Iliyense yeTrawler enokusebenza - abantu abakhubekileyo abakwazi ukuzisa nabakhona baza kuncedwa ukuba bakwazi ukuhamba kwimisebenzi enxulumeneyo. Amakhono, ulwazi kunye neakhono: Ulwazi loMthethosiseko (njengoko ulungisiwe). PFMA kunye neTreasury Regulations. PSRF (Public Service Regulatory Framework). Provincial Procurement Act kunye neRegulations. Provincial Internal Audit Act. PGDS (Provincial Growth and Development Strategy). PSEDS (Provincial Spatial Economic Development Strategy). Amaxwebhu enkhokhelo kaNational Treasury. Iindonga zokuLawula iMali (kubandakanya iBAS). Ukwengamela ngonyaka kunye neNational Treasury Returns. Iindonga zoku Linganisa ukuSebenza. Ulawulo lweAssets. Ulawulo lemali zikawonke-wonke. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukwahlula-hlula nokubala. Unxibelelwano ngomlomo kunye nezentlondo. Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Amakhono ekhompyutha: Spreadsheets (MS Excel), ukucwangcisa amagama (MS Word). Ukwakha imodeli yezoqoqosho, uphando, kunye nokuwahlula-hlula. Ukubhala iingxelo kunye nokubhala ngokubanzi. Ukwengamela nokuchaza. Ulawulo lweeprojekthi. Ulawulo lweentlawulo. Ukwenza ibhajeti kunye neendonga zokwenza ibhajeti. Ukwenza ibhajeti ngokusebenza kunye noqwalaselo olunzulu. Ulawulo lokutshintsha. Ukuwahlula-hlula ngeestatistics nangokubala. Ulawulo lemali. Uqwalaselo olunzulu kunye nolawulo. Ulawulo labantu. Amakhona aphezulu ezibalo nokubala (ukwazi ukusebenza neebhodi ezinxulumeneyo ezingundoqo). Ulwimi.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lokusebenzisa iSakhathi Sohlalutyo Lolawulo lwezinto zikawonke-wonke malunga nokwenza ibhajeti. Ulawulo lokusebenzisa iSakhathi Sohlalutyo Lolawulo lwezinto zikawonke-wonke malunga nokubika. Ulawulo lokusebenzisa iSakhathi Sohlalutyo Lolawulo lwezinto zikawonke-wonke malunga nokuthobela iPFMA zezi nto zikawonke-wonke. Ukunikela ngeengcinga malunga neahlukaniso lemali elungileyo ngokuthe nkqo nangokuthe tyaba, ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiintetho malunga neDORA, kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwiqela elihlolwa indlela yokuwabela ngokufanele. Ulawulo lokuphuhliswa, lokuhlolwa kunye lokusebenzisa iindonga, iindlela kunye neenkhokhelo ezinxulumene nezentaba zikawonke-wonke zesiPROVINCE, kunye nokuhlolwa kweendonga zolwalamano phakathi kurhulumente nokunikela ngamacebo kuBudge Council. Ulawulo lwamacebo eDirectorate.

jobs.title: Chartered Accountancy Trainee
jobs.summary: Chartered Accountancy trainee position at Limpopo Provincial Treasury requiring a CTA or Postgraduate Diploma in Accounting to gain practical financial management experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of CTA or Postgraduate Diploma qualification in Accounting. The qualification graduates with keen interest in establishing a career in the Public Sector. The qualification should not older than 2 years. Applicants currently studying towards completing the said qualifications that will enable them to write SAICA’s Assessment of Initial Competence in January 2027 are encouraged to apply.
jobs.duties: The successful candidates will have access to diverse practical financial management, decision making and control experience and an opportunity to apply their knowledge in wide ranging financial reporting frameworks, Companies Act, Public Finance Management Act and Regulations with targeted exposure to multiple industry sectors in which our entities operate. Limpopo Treasury is the provincial allocator of financial resources to departments and entities. The wide variety of sectoral focus by departments and entities that Limpopo Treasury supports, and monitors makes for a challenging and fulfilling training environment for prospective trainee Chartered Accountants in the Public Sector.
jobs.enquiries: Messrs. Kenneth Ugoda at (079) 893 8115 and Shepard Matsebe CA(SA) at (079) 744 1961
jobs.applications: If you believe you meet the requirements and have the aspiration to succeed, please complete in full and send the new Z83 Form and the TE008 (CAA Selection Form) available on www.limtreasury.gov.za to caa@treasury.limpopo.gov.za. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of South African ID and full official academic certificate/s and transcript/s. Alternatively, applications may be sent by post to: The Head of Department, Limpopo Provincial Treasury, Private Bag X9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR hand delivered at Ismini Towers, Office No. G002 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Rensburg Street, Polokwane, 0699.
jobs.notes: Candidates already having a training contract with another training office will not be considered. This is an equal opportunity appointment available for applicants / graduates from Limpopo or with links to Limpopo. Provincial Treasury reserves the right to not fill all or some of the positions. Limpopo Provincial Treasury hereby invites applications for candidates to be considered for appointment to the Limpopo Provincial Treasury Chartered Accountancy Academy in the Public Sector (2027 intake). Limpopo Provincial Treasury is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and is committed to the promotion of equity in terms of the race, gender and disability through filling of post(s) with candidates whose transfer / promotion / appointment will promote representativity in line with numerical targets as contained in the Employment Equity Plan. OTHER POST

af.title: Geoktroonneerde Rekenmeesterskap-Trainee
af.summary: Geoktroonneerde rekenmeesterskap-trainee-pos by Limpopo Provincial Treasury wat 'n CTA of Nagraadse Diploma in Rekeningkunde vereis om praktiese finansiële bestuurservaring op te doen.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n CTA- of Nagraadse Diploma-kwalifikasie in Rekeningkunde beskik. Die kwalifikasie se gegradueerdes met 'n geesdriftige belangstelling om 'n loopbaan in die Publieke Sektor te vestig. Die kwalifikasie mag nie ouer as 2 jaar wees nie. Aansoekers wat tans studeer om die genoemde kwalifikasies te voltooi wat hulle in staat sal stel om SAICA se Assessment of Initial Competence in Januarie 2027 te skryf, word aangemoedig om aansoek te doen.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidate sal toegang hê tot uiteenlopende praktiese finansiële bestuurs-, besluitnemings- en beheervaring en 'n geleentheid om hul kennis toe te pas in 'n wye verskeidenheid finansiële verslagraamwerke, die Companies Act, die Public Finance Management Act en Regulasies met die doelgerigte blootstelling aan veelvuldige bedryfsektore waarin ons entiteite bedrywig is. Limpopo Treasury is die provinsiale toewysaar van finansiële bronne aan departemente en entiteite. Die wye verskeidenheid sektorale fokus deur departemente en entiteite wat Limpopo Treasury ondersteun en monitor, maak dit 'n uitdagende en vervullende opleidingsomgewing vir voornemende trainee-geoktroonneerde rekenmeesters in die Publieke Sektor.

zu.title: Umtholeli weziqu we-Chartered Accountancy
zu.summary: Isikhundla somtholeli weziqu we-Chartered Accountancy e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury esidinga i-CTA noma i-Postgraduate Diploma in Accounting ukuze uthole ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezimali ngokusebenzisana.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kufanele babe ne-CTA noma isiqu se-Postgraduate Diploma in Accounting. Laba ngeziqu abathanda kakhulu ukwakha umsebenzi kwilungu Likahulumeni. Isiqu asifanele kudlule iminyaka eyi-2. Abafakelayo ababhalise ekufundeni leyo ziqu ukuze bakwazi ukubhala ukuhlolwa kuka-SAICA kokutholakala kobuhlakani bokuzalwa ngo-January 2027 banxuswa ukuba bafake izicelo.
zu.duties: Oqobe njalo baya kuba nethuba lokuthola ulwazi oluhlukahlukene lokuphathwa kwezimali, ukwenza izinqumo nolawulo kanye nethuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwabo kumazwe omhlaba ahlukene okubika ngemali, i-Companies Act, i-Public Finance Management Act kanye nezinqumo ngokunikezelwa okuhlosiwe kumagatsha ahlukene emikhakha lapho izikhungo zethu zisebenza khona. I-Limpopo Treasury iyiqoqo lesifundazwe sababeli bezinsiza zemali kumanyango nasezikhungweni. Ukuhlukahluka kwezinhloso zomkhakha ngamanyango nangezikhungo okusekela kulona futhi kuqaphele i-Limpopo Treasury, kuyakha indawo yesikhathi esinzima futhi esigcwalisayo yokuqeqeshwa labathandekayo abaqeqeshiwe njengaba-Chartered Accountants kwilungu Likahulumeni.

xh.title: Umgangatho we-Chartered Accountancy
xh.summary: Isithuba somgangatho we-Chartered Accountancy kwi-Limpopo Provincial Treasury esifuna i-CTA okanye i-Postgraduate Diploma kwi-Accounting ukuze kufunyanwe isipili sond practical financial management experience.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe ne-CTA okanye i-Postgraduate Diploma qualification kwi-Accounting. Obugqwaliselwe be-qualification kufuneka benomdla wokuqinisekisa ukuba benze umsebenzi kwi-Public Sector. I-qualification akufuneka ibe mdala kuno-2 years. Abafakeli ababhala ngoku ukuya phambili ekugqwaliseni le qualifications ezakubavumela ukuba babhale i-SAICA Assessment of Initial Competence ngo-January 2027 bayakhuthazwa ukuba bafake isicelo.
xh.duties: Abaphumeleleyo baya kuba nento yokufikelela kwi-diverse practical financial management, decision making and control experience nethamsanqa lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwabo kwi-wide ranging financial reporting frameworks, i-Companies Act, i-Public Finance Management Act and Regulations nge-targeted exposure kumaza ngamaza wezicatshulwa apho amashishini ethu asebenza. I-Limpopo Treasury yiprovincial allocator yemali kumasebe namage entity. Iintsangano ngeentsangano ngokwemisebenzi ekwenzwa ngamasebe namage entity ezixhasa, iphinda ilawule i-Limpopo Treasury, iyadala indalo ebuzayo nethamsanqa efanelekileyo yefundo engaziwa ingozi abafuna ukuba ngabasebenzisi abangabasebenzi be-Chartered Accountants kwi-Public Sector.

jobs.title: Director: Corporate Service
jobs.summary: Director of Corporate Services at Nkangala District Office, managing HR, auxiliary services and transformation programmes for the Department of Health in Emalahleni.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Public Administration / Public Management. jobs.summary: Head the Internal Medicine clinical unit at Witbank Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Specialist with five years' post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine (2026). A minimum of five (5) years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Inherent requirement of the job: It will be expected of the successful Head: Clinical Unit to work commuted overtime, limited to 12 hours, if operational requirements so demand. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of the relevant statutory and policy frameworks, including Healthcare 2030, the Ideal Hospital framework, the Regulated Norms and Standards, EDL, Standard Treatment Guidelines and evidence-based clinical care. Clinical service delivery in accordance with the Level 2 & 3 package of care for Internal Medicine, and experience in driving continuous quality improvement, clinical risk identification and mitigation, and managing medico-legal matters. Proven experience with supervising staff, training junior doctors, and managing financial and other resources, with the ability to develop staff of quality and provide leadership with regards to issues of diversity, transformation and equity. Track record in training of both under-graduate and post-graduate healthcare personnel. Computer literate in MS package.
jobs.duties: Fulfil the role and duties of Head of the Internal Medicine Department in rendering an efficient and cost-effective specialized Internal Medicine service to patients managed by the Witbank Tertiary Hospital, including the delivery of outreach and support services. Ensure clinical governance and quality management for the Internal Medicine Service at Witbank Tertiary Hospital and respond to medical and legal incidents as they arise. Ensure the rational use of resources (including laboratory investigations, medication, consumables and equipment) and manage human, financial and capital resources in the Internal Medicine y Department. Deliver effective and efficient management of the Internal Medicine Department, and provide strategic leadership, planning and decision-making as a member of the Hospital Executive Management. Plan and partake in the training of staff including Registrars, Medical Officers, Community Service Medical Officers and Interns.

af.title: Hoof: Kliniese Eenheid (MEDIES) Graad 1: Interne Geneeskunde
af.summary: Bestuur die kliniese eenheid vir Interne Geneeskunde by Witbank Hospital, waarvoor HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Spesialis met vyf jaar se ervaring na registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde moontlik maak (2026). 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Daar sal van die suksesvolle Hoof: Kliniese Eenheid verwag word om commuted-oortydwerk te doen, beperk tot 12 uur, indien operasionele vereistes dit noodsaak. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die tersaaklike statutêre en beleidsraamwerke, insluitend Healthcare 2030, die Ideal Hospital-raamwerk, die Regulated Norms and Standards, EDL, Standard Treatment Guidelines en bewysgebaseerde kliniese sorg. Kliniese dienslewering in ooreenstemming met die vlak 2 & 3 sorgpaket vir Interne Geneeskunde, en ervaring in die bevordering van deurlopende kwaliteitsverbetering, kliniese risiko-identifikasie en -mitigasie, en die bestuur van medies-regtelike aangeleenthede. Bewese ervaring in die toesig hou oor personeel, die opleiding van junior dokters, en die bestuur van finansiële en ander hulpbronne, met die vermoë om gehalte-personeel te ontwikkel en leierskap te toon met betrekking tot diversiteit, transformasie en gelykheid. Erfenisspoor in die opleiding van beide voor- en nagraadse gesondheidsorgpersoneel. Rekenaarvaardig in MS-pakket.
af.duties: Vervul die rol en pligte van Hoof van die Departement Interne Geneeskunde in die lewer van 'n doeltreffende en kostedoeltreffende gespesialiseerde Interne Geneeskunde-diens aan pasiënte wat deur die Witbank Tertiary Hospital bestuur word, insluitend die lewer van uitreik- en ondersteuningsdienste. Verseker kliniese bestuur en gehaltebestuur vir die Interne Geneeskunde-diens by Witbank Tertiary Hospital en reageer op mediese en regtelike voorvalle soos wat hulle ontstaan. Verseker die rasionele gebruik van hulpbronne (insluitend laboratoriumondersoeke, medikasie, verbruiksgoedere en toerusting) en bestuur menslike, finansiële en kapitaalhulpbronne in die Departement Interne Geneeskunde. Lewer doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuur van die Departement Interne Geneeskunde, en verskaf strategiese leierskap, beplanning en besluitneming as lid van die Hospital Executive Management. Beplan en neem deel aan die opleiding van personeel insluitend Registrars, Medical Officers, Community Service Medical Officers en Interns.

zu.title: Hlola: Iyunithi Yezokwelapha (EYOKUDOKOTELA) Izinga 1: I-Internal Medicine
zu.summary: Ukuhola iyunithi yezokwelapha ye-Internal Medicine e-Witbank Hospital, okudinga ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoDokotela Owelaphayo oneminyaka emihlanu yesiphefundo sakamuva kokuqashwa.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoDokotela Owelaphayo kwi-Internal Medicine (2026). Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yesiphefundo esifanele njengoDokotela Owelaphayo emuva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njengoDokotela Owelaphayo kwi-Internal Medicine. Isidingo esibalele emsebenzini: Kulindeleke ukuthi uHloli: Iyunithi Yezokwelapha ophumelelayo asebenze amahora amaningi okuzikhethela, okulinganiswe emahoreni angu-12, uma izidingo zokusebenla zifuna njalo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasakhizi): Ulwazi ngemigomo namaphoyinti ahlobene nawo emthethweni nakwezinqubomgomo, okubandakanya i-Healthcare 2030, umthethosisekelo we-Ideal Hospital, i-Regulated Norms and Standards, i-EDL, i-Standard Treatment Guidelines kanye nenkonzo yezokwelapha esekelwe kubufakazi. Ukulethwa kwenkonzo yezokwelapha ngokuhambisana nempahla yezokunakekelwa kwezinga 2 & 3 ye-Internal Medicine, nolwazi ekukhuthazeni ukuthuthuka okuqhuthekayo kokulingana, ekuqapheleni nokwehliselela ingozi yezokwelapha, nokuphathwa kwezomthetho nezokudokotela. Ulwazi oluqinisekisiwe lokuphatha abasebenzi, ukuqeqesha abadokotela abasha, nokuphatha izimali nezinye izinsiza, nenhlanhla yokuphuhlisa abantu abanokuphila nokunikeza ubuholi ngokwezinkinga zokuhlukahluka kubantu, ukuguqulwa kwenhlobo nokulingana. Isikhwama sokuphumelela ekuqeqesheni abasebenzi bezempilo abafunda nakuqeqeshwa kwesikhundla. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngokufanele ohlelweni lwe-MS package.
zu.duties: Ukwenza indima nemisebenzi yoHloli Wesebe le-Internal Medicine ekunikezeni inkonzo ye-Internal Medicine ehle kahle futhi ethengisa kancane kubasizi bakhishwe e-Witbank Tertiary Hospital, okubandakanya ukulethwa kwenkonz yokunakekela kanye nezinsiza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlongakhalu okusemgqeni kanye nokuphathwa kobuhle besebe le-Internal Medicine e-Witbank Tertiary Hospital bese uphendula izehloko zezokwelapha nezomthetho uma zivela. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okukahle kwezinsiza (okubandakanya imibiko yegciwane, imithi, izinto okusetshenziswayo nemishini) bese uphatha izinsiza zabantu, zemali nezinkomba zomnikelo ohlelweni le-Internal Medicine. Ukuletha okuhle nokushibhile ekuphathweni kweSebe le-Internal Medicine, bese unikeza ubuholi obusesikhundleni, ukuhlela nokwenza izinqumo njengelungu le-Hospital Executive Management. Ukuhlela futhi ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuqeqeshweni kwabasebenzi okubandakanya oRegistra, oMedical Officers, oCommunity Service Medical Officers kanye no-Interns.

xh.title: Isikhululi: Icandelo lezonyango (MEDICAL) Inqanaba 1: I-Internal Medicine
xh.summary: Kuphatha icandelo lezonyango le-Internal Medicine eWitbank Hospital, kufuneka kubekho ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha weNgcali kunye neminyaka emihlanu yokugqiba kokubhalisa kwemisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Higher Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha weNgcali kwi-Internal Medicine (2026). Kufuneka kube khona iminyaka engu-5 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo njengoGqirha weNgcali emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha weNgcali kwi-Internal Medicine. Imfuno engenakuthintwa yomsebenzi: Kuya kulindeleke kwi-Head: Clinical Unit opumeleleyo ukuba asebenze isixa esengeziweyo esixutyiweyo somsebenzi, esimiselwe kwiiyure ezingama-12, ukuba iimfuno zokuqhuba zidinwa ngalo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lwezakhiwo zomthetho namacebo ahambelanayo, kuquka i-Healthcare 2030, isakhulu se-Ideal Hospital, i-Regulated Norms and Standards, i-EDL, i-Standard Treatment Guidelines nikoncomingo yonyango olusekelwe kwimiqondo. Ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zonyango ngokwemesipaka ye-Level 2 & 3 yonyango kwi-Internal Medicine, namava ekukhululekeni kukhuthazele ukuphucula ngokoqobo, ukuqaphela nokunciphisa ingozi yonyango, nokulawula izinto ezithintela umthetho wogqirha. Amava abonwayo ekulawulweni abasebenzi, ekufundiseni oogqirha abasebunzimeni, nasekulawulweni izixhobo zemali nezinye, unako ukuphucula abasebenzi bamangakanana nokunika inkokeli malunga nezindaba zentshanxadirhuwa, ukuguqulwa nokulingana. Isikolo esibonakalisayo ekufundiseni abantu bemithi yamabanga asezantsi nangaphezulu. Ukuziqhelanisa nekhompyutha kwindlebe yedilesi yakwa-MS.
xh.duties: Kuzuza indima nomsebenzi we-Head of the Internal Medicine Department ekuhanjiseni inkonzo ye-Internal Medicine egqwesileyo nengagcwalisekayo kumagqirha abekelwe ngumtsetfo kwi-Witbank Tertiary Hospital, kuquka nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zokulungisa inkxaso ngenjongo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lonyango nolawulo lomgangatho wale nkinkonzo ye-Internal Medicine eWitbank Tertiary Hospitaliphendula iinselo zonyango nomthetho njengoko zibakho. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa izixhabo ngokweenzuzo (kuquka iindlela zovavado lwegumbi, amayeza, izinto ezisetyenziswa nezixhobo) kulawula izinto, imali nezixhobo zolawulo kwi-Internal Medicine Department. Hamba ngokusebenza ngokusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo nokusebenza kakuhle kwaye ulawule i-Internal Medicine Department, unike inkokelo iindlela zokuqamba iindlela nokuwisa isigqibo njengolilungu le-Hospital Executive Management. Cwangcisa uthathe inxaxheba ekufundiseni abasebenzi kuquka aba-Registrars, aba-Medical Officers, aba-Community Service Medical Officers naba-Interns.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 3: Internal Medicine
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 3 in Internal Medicine sought for Witbank Hospital in Mpumalanga, requiring HPCSA registration and relevant clinical experience.
jobs.requirements: MBChB degree (qualification) that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner n Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Additional experience in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology and ENT will serve as recommendation. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 3: A minimum of ten (10) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). A minimum of eleven (11) years relevant experience after registration with a recognised foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice) for foreign qualified employees. Sound clinical knowledge, competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work under supervision as an efficient team member. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and supervisory skills. Ability to manage patients independently, diligently, responsibility and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programmes and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach, guide and junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.

Accept responsibility for the management of patients admitted in a level 2/3 package of service facility. Assist in the preparation and implementation of guidelines and protocols. Participate in academic and training programmes. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services is maintained.
