af.title: Mediese Beampte Graad 3: Interne Geneeskunde
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Graad 3 in Interne Geneeskunde gesoek vir Witbank-hospitaal in Mpumalanga, met HPCSA-registrasie en tersaaklike kliniese ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad (kwalifikasie) wat registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Beoefenaar moontlik maak n Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diensregulasies en -beleide. Bykomende ervaring in Verloskunde & Ginekologie, Neurochirurgie, Narkose, Urologie en KNO sal as aanbeveling dien. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Beoefenaar (Independent Practice). 'n Minimum van elf (11) jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsberoepsraad en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Beoefenaar (Independent Practice) vir buitlands gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis, bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onder toesig as 'n doeltreffende spanlid te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en toesigvaardighede. Vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik, ywerig en verantwoordelik te bestuur en in te skakel wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleid, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te lei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die Instelling te ondersteun wat in ooreenstemming is met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Verantwoordelikheid aanvaar vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspaketfasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur om 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en -dienste te handhaaf.

zu.title: Umofisa Wezokwelapha Izinga 3: Izokwelapha Zangaphakathi
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umofisa Wezokwelapha Izinga 3 kwezokwelapha zangaphakathi esibhedlela iWitbank Hospital eMpumalanga, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA nokuba nocwaningo oluhambisana nezokwelapha ezilandelayo.
zu.requirements: Idegree yeMBChB (isiqu) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengompraktisi wezokwelapha ekuHlokeni lwabakwelapha eNingizimu Afrika (HPCSA) njengompraktisi wezokwelapha (2026) (okuzimele). Kuzodingeka ivumelwano esemthethweni lokusebenza kubantu abangebona amaNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwemingcolo eyahlukahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu nalokho kube nolunye ucwaningo kwephilimu yokwelapha ehambisanayo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigomo yezempilo okwamanelayo kanye nesezinkampani. Ulunye ucwaningo kwezokuHlola kwabesifazane nezokubeletha, iNeurosurgery, iAnaesthesiology, iUrology neENT kuzoba yincongo. Amakhono ohlelweni lokubonisana, ukuthatha umlando wogula, ukuhlolwa, ukubukeka kwezempilo kanye nokuphathwa kwezempilo. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yocwaningo ngemva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengompraktisi wezokwelapha (okuzimele). Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi nanye (11) yocwaningo oluhambisanayo ngemva kokubhaliswa ekuHlokeni lwabakwelapha bangaphandle elivunyiwe kanye noma iHPCSA njengompraktisi wezokwelapha (okuzimele) kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe bangaphandle. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho kanye Namakhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwemingcolo eyahlukahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu nalokho kube nolunye ucwaningo kwephilimu yokwelapha ehambisanayo. Ulwazi kwezempilo oluhle, amandla namakhono kumakhono jikelele wezempilo. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi kokuhlola njengilungu elisebenza kahle leqembu. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana, okuhola, okwabantu, kanye nokuhlola. Isikhathi sokuphatha iziguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzigqajisa, ngobeki kanye nokuxhumana ngesikhathi esidingekayo. Ulwazi ngemigomo yezempilo okwamanelayo, umthetho, ohlelweni kanye nezinto eziphambili kuleso sikhundla. Isikhathi sokufundisa, ukuhola abasebenzi abasha kumnyango. Izinto Eziyimfanelo: Ukubekezela ekuqineni, ukusebenza eqhweni, ukuzethemba kanye nesikhathi sokwakha kanye nokuqhuba ubudlelwane obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngokukhululeka, ukusekela imigomo nezinhloso zesikhungo ekuhambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukubeke owakho ubeki ekuphathweni kwesiguli esingeniswa esikhungweni selevel 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni nokuqalisweni kwemigomo kanye namaphrothokholi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwezohlelo lokufunda kanye nokuqeqeshwa. Ukusiza kokuqamba izihloko zezempilo nokuthatha inxaxheba ngokuzifumela ekuthuthukisweni ocwaningweni. Ukunika ilunga elisebenza kahle ekuqoqweni okubhekiswe ekuhananisweni kochungechunge lwezempilo ukugcina izinga elihle lokunakekelwa kweziguli kanye namasevisi.

xh.title: IOfisi Yezesemtholislelo Ezinga 3: IInternal Medicine
xh.summary: Kufunekiqeshwe iOfisi Yezesemtholislelo Ezinga 3 kwiInternal Medicine kwiWitbank Hospital eMpumalanga, kufunelwe ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA nolunye uhlolojiso oluhambelana nezemveliso.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seMBChB (isifundo) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengomPrakthikhali weZesemtholislelo eHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomPrakthikhali weZesemtholislelo (2026) (Independent Practice). Ipermiti yomsebenzi esemthethweni izakufuneka kwabangabaseMzantsi Afrika. ulwazi olululo ngokuziphatha kwesemtholislelo. Ulawulo lwabangesabano ngamabala neziqhagamsheli qelembu kwaye noluhambelana nendlela ekukhethiweyo ekulawuleni inkqubo elungileyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nenguqulelo yamagosa karhulumente kwezempilo nakwinkonzo. Isipili sokunye kwezobugcisa bokubeletha nokuqaliswa kwezinyawo, ukuxiliselwa kwentsimi, isifundo sokubulala inhlithwa kwaye nolunye uhlolojiso kwiObstetrics & Gynaecology, iNeurosurgery, iAnaesthesiology, iUrology neENT kuzakubakho isindululo. Amakhono ngakumbi ekuqoqweni lwengxoxo, iisazisi zembali, ukuhlolwa, ukuhlolwa kweeklinikhi kwaye ulawulo lweeklinikhi. Ezinga 3: Isipili esingaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi (10) emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengomPrakthikhali weZesemtholislelo (Independent Practice). Isipili esingaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi elinethoba (11) ehambelana nayo emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA eqaqiswayo yolunye uluntu lukarhululelo kumtholislelo kwaye ukuba noma iHPCSA njengomPrakthikhali weZesemtholislelo (Independent Practice) kubasebenzi abagqitye eMzantsi. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho kwaye namaphulo afunekayo: ulwazi olululo ngokuziphatha kwesemtholislelo. Ulawulo lwabangesabano ngamabala nesebe kwaye noluhambelana nendlela ekukhethiweyo ekulawulweni inkqubo. ulwazi olululo lweklinikhi, ikhono nakakhono kwindawo ezingqinisana nezemitholislelo yonke. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Isakhono sokuziphatha, sokulawula, sikwabantu, kwaye nokuqwalasela abantu. Isakhono sokulawula abaguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzinikela, ngomthwalo kwaye axaxe ngokufanelekileyo. ulwazi ngamagosa karhululumente ezemihla ngemihla, imithetho, iinkqubo kwaye nezinto ezibalulekileyo kwindawo ekuyo. Isakhono sokuqeqesha, sokukhokelela abasebenzi abasekhaya kwisebe. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: ukuqina ngxaxheba, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela, uqina-hliziyo kwaye nothando lokwakha kwaye ulamle ubuhlobo obulungileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi nalomsebenzi ngokuzinikela, uxhaso iinjongo neenjongo zeSiseko ezihambelana namazinga okunyanga abaguli. Ukwenza umthwalo wokulawula abaguli abangenwe kwindawo enqanaba lesi 2/3 yesebe lenkonzo. Ukuncedisa kulungiselelo nokusetyenziwa kwemigaqo nokuqaliswa kweenjongo. Ukuqhaxa kwiinkqubo zesikolo nokuqeqeshwa. Ukuncedisa ngokuqwalasela kwamagosa e clinical kwaye ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokusebenza kwakhona ngokuzinikela ngokubhaliswa. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lwesibhedlele ngokujikelela emazinga apheleleyo okunyanga abaguli kwaye inkonzo igcinwe.

af.title: Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (PN-A9): PHC
af.summary: Bestuur en evalueer primêre gesondheidsorgdienslewering, insluitend klinieke en mobiele klinieke, by Steve Tshwete Sub-distrik in Mpumalanga.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer met SANC ooreenkomstig Regeringskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026) moontlik maak. 'n Tersiêre kwalifikasie in Gesondheidswetenskappe, by voorkeur in Openbare Gesondheid. 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar gepaste / herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Aantoonbare begrip van die PFMA en Tesourie Regulasies, Finansiële Bestuur, Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntesorg. Vaardighede: Leierskap, Uitstekende Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik), Probleemoplossing, Rekenaarvaardigheid en Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. af.duties: Bestuur en evalueer die implementering van beleidramewerke vir dienslewering deur Primêre Gesondheidsorgfasiliteite. Koördineer en bestuur NPO's wat PHC-dienste lewer. Monitor optimale funksionering van kliniekkomitees. Monitor en evalueer die norms en standaarde vir verpleegkundepraktyk in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Bevorder professionaliteit in Primêre Gesondheidsorg.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme / I-Grade 12 kanye nesiqu esisisekelo esamukelwe yi-SANC ngokusho kukaHulumeni Ohumusha uR425 (okungukuthi iDiploma / i-Degree eZokwelapha) noma isiqu esilingana esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengogqokezeli Wezokwelapha (2026). Ukuze ube nokuhlolwa okuncane kweminyaka yeshumi (10 years) yokuhlolwa okuhambelana / okwaziwayo ezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa njengogqokezeli Wezokwelapha. Izindlela: Ulwazi mayelana ne-District Health System, i-District Health Planning, i-District Health Expenditure Reviews. Ukuqonda okubonakalayo kwe-PFMA kanye Nezimiso Ze-Treasury, Ukuphatha Izimali, Ukuphatha Abasebenzi Nokunikeza Amandla, Ukwakheka Koluntu Nokunakekelwa Kwabathengi. Hlanganisa futhi uhlole ukusetshenziswa kwamagatsha amahola ekungenisa amandla ohlelo lwezempilo. Siza ukuguqulwa kolawulo lwezokwelapha. Hlanganisa futhi uphathe ama-NPO anikeza izinsiza ze-PHC. af.title: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1 gesoek by Rob Ferreira Hospitaal in Mpumalanga om pasiënte te bestuur en kliniese pligte uit te voer onder skofrotasie.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad (kwalifikasie) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn (2026) (Onafhanklike Praktyk). NB: Die aangestelde Mediese Beampte moet in staat wees om skofte te werk. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diens-regulasies en -beleid. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Vlak 1: Geen ervaring vereis na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Minimum van 1-jarige tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende Buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessie en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk) vir buitlands gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis, bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onder toesig as 'n doeltreffende spanlid te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en toesighoudende vaardighede. Vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik, ywerig, verantwoordelik te bestuur en in te skakel wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleid, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te lei. Deeglike kliniese kennis ten opsigte van geneeskunde. Vermoë om alle mediese noodgevalle te hanteer. Kennis van etiese mediese praktyk. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer, om die doelstellings en oogmerke van die Instelling te ondersteun wat in ooreenstemming is met standaarde van pasiëntversorging. Aanspreeklikheid aanvaar vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspakketfasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntversorging en -dienste gehandhaaf word.

zu.title: Iphasela Lezokwelapha Elilinga 1
zu.summary: Kufunwa Iphasela Lezokwelapha Elilinga 1 esibhedlela i-Rob Ferreira Hospital e-Mpumalanga ukuphatha iziguli nokwenza imisebenzi yezokwelapha ngaphansi kokujikeleza kushifti.
zu.requirements: Isiqu se-MBChB (izifundo) esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengesidakamsebenzi Wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ku-HPCSA njengesidakamsebenzi Wezokwelapha (2026) (Independent Practice). NB: Iphasela Lezokwelapha eliyiyo kumele likwazi ukusebenza amashifti. Isivumelwano esisebenzayo sokusebenza sizodingwa kubantu ababuyela ema-South Africans. Ulwazi oluhle ngezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphatha okuhlanganisa izinhlanga ezahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye noluhlelo emkhakheni wezokwelapha ohambisanayo. Ulwazi ngemithesho namapholisi ajejwayo ezezoMpilo Nakomnyango Wonke. Amakhono ohleini lokubonisana, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezokwelapha nokuphathwa ngokwezokwelapha. Izinga 1: Akukho wazi oludingeka ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoDokotela Wezokwelapha (Independent Practice). Okungenani unyaka o-1 woluhlelo oluhambisanayo ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-Foreign Health Professions evunyiwe noma i-HPCSA njengoDokotela Wezokwelapha (Independent Practice) kubasebenzi abaqeqeshwe kunye namazwe aphesheya. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa namakhono aye afuneka: Ulwazi oluhle ngezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphatha okuhlanganisa izinhlanga ezahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye noluhlelo emkhakheni wezokwelapha ohambisanayo. Ulwazi oluhle lwangaphakathi nezokwelapha, ikhono namakhano emikhakheni ejwayelekile yezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulo njengilungu elisebenzayo leqembu. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, ukubusa, abantu, kanye nokuhlola. Ikhono lokuphatha iziguli ngokuzimele, ngokunakekelwa ngokuziphethe, nangobumnini, nokuxhumana lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi ngamapholisi ajejwayo ezezoMpilo, umthetho, amaphroghremu futhi abalulekile kuleyo ndawo. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuqondisa kanye nothisha abasha emkhakheni. Ulwazi oluhle oluzungezile ngemithi. Ikhono lokubhekana nazo zonke izimo eziphuthumayo zezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngokwenza ngokwezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Izici zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela ekucasulweni, ukusebenza endlini eqembu, ukuzethemba, kanye nenhlonipho yokwakha ukuya ukugcina ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngokuphumelela, ukweseka amagulu kanye nenhloso Zesikhungo ezihambisana namazinga enakekelwe iziguli. Ukumemukela inkinga yokulawula iziguli ezingeniswe esibhedlela kwiphakethe elilinga 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni nokubhaliseni kumazinga nemithetho. Ukubambe iqhaza emaphroghremeni ezemfundo nokuqeqeshwa. Ukusiza ngokuhlolwa kwezokwelapha ngokusesekelwa kwaye uphatheke ngokusibhukuda emisebenzini yokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi. Ukunikezela isisekelo ekuphathweni kwesibhedlela aze asize ukugcina izinga elenza nakekelwa ngokuphumelela nangcono iziguli.

xh.title: Isekela leMprofu yezoNtsika inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufunwa iSekela leMprofu yezoNtsika inqanaba 1 kwiRob Ferreira Hospital eMpumalanga ukulawula abaguli nokwenza imisebenzi yezonzulwini ngokujikeleza kwabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seMBChB (nazimali) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo. Ukubhalisa ngoku kwiHPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo (2026) (Inkonzo ezimeleyo). NB: ISekela leMprofu yezoNtsika esikhethiweyo kufuneka sikwazi ukusebenza ngokujikeleza. Ipemiti yokuSebenza esemthethweni iya kufuneka kubantu abangeyoMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngobugcisa bokwenza ugqirha. Ulawulo lwebandla elininzi nokusebenza njengesiqhanga noluntshulvo kwilungu lezempilo elichaziweyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nayimimiselo yezempilo yamaninokuwoyo nezabasebenzi boluntu. Amakhono ngokwemibuzo yokuxoxa, ukubamba imbali, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezinzulwini nolawulo ngokwezinzulwini. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nqanaba loluntshulvo lufunekayo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Inkonzo ezimeleyo). Kufuneka kube khona unyaka wamva woluntshulvo oluchaziweyo emva kokubhalisa kwiForeign Health Professions namkanya iHPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Inkonzo ezimeleyo) kubasebenzi abangaphandle abagqibiliswe isidanga. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi olulungileyo ngobugcisa bokwenza ugqirha. Ulawulo lwebandla elininzi nokusebenza njengesiqhanga noluntshulvo kwilungu lezempilo elichaziweyo. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngokwezinzulwini, amakhono nakhono kwizithuba ezidibene nezinzulwini. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Amakhono obuqhankqalazi bokuthetha, bokulawula, bokuhlangana nabantu, nabolawulo. Ikhono lokulawula abaguli ngokuzimeleyo, ngokuzimisela, ngoxanduva nokungena xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yezempilo yamaninokuwoyo, umthetho, iinkqubo nemigangatho kule ndawo. Ikhono lokufundisa, nokukhokela osebenza ngeqondo elingagqibekanga kwisebe. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngokwezinzulwini malunga naye nemithi. Ikhono lokusingatha zonke izigameko ezingxamileyo zezempilo. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha okusesikhweni sezempilo. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukumelana nengxaki, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwamaqela, ukuzethemba nokwakha nokugcina ubudlelwane obulungileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuze kusetyenziswe imisebenzi nemitimiso ngokuchanekileyo, ukuxhasa iinjongo neenjongo zeSiseko ezidibaniswe nemiqathango yokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ukubam uxanduva lokulawula abaguli bakhethe kwindawo yenkonzo kwizinga 2/3. Ukuncedisa kulungiselelo nokusebenzisa iinkqaborho nezithethantonye. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqabo zokufunda nokuqeqesha. Ukuncedisa ngokulawulwa kweenkqubo zezemiqu ezinzulwini nokuthatha inxaxheba ngokudluliselela koluntu kwinkqubo yobugcisa. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ngokwemigangatho esebenzayo yokunakekelwa kwabaguli nolondolzwe iinkonzo.

Knowledge of relevant legal framework such as Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operational Management Skills. af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (PN-B3): PHC
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde-pos by Rietkuil-kliniek in Mpumalanga wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige-kwalifikasie met SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer met die South African Nursing Council volgens Government Notice 425, (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde) wat registrasie met die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026) moontlik maak plus 'n post-basiese verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer met die SANC volgens Government Notice No R212 in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. 'n Minimum van nege (09) jaar gepaste/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met die South African Nursing Council (SANC) in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste vyf (05) jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet gepas / herkenbaar wees in die spesifieke spesialiteit na verkryging van die een (01) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg-verpleegkundige-wetenskap. 'n Post-basiese kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-administrasie/Gesondheidsdiensbestuur. Ervaring en kennis van die Distrik-gesondheidstelsel. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegkunde-wetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegkunde-praktyke en hoe dit dienslewering beïnvloed. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR en finansiële praktyke. Kennis van die relevante regsraamwerk soos die Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele-beginsels, Operasionele bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossings-, beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Word verwag om onder druk en nagdiens te werk. Leierskap. Toesighoudende, probleemoplossings-, konflikoplossings-, interpersoonlike en kommunikasie- en kommunikasievaardighede. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van wetgewing en verwante etiese verpleegkunde-praktyke en hoe dit dienslewering beïnvloed. Rekenaarvaardigheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf PHC-fasiliteitstoesig in ooreenstemming met die PHC-toesigriglyne. zu.requirements: Ithifikhezhi yesibalo samabanga / ibanga lesi-12 noma iziqu ezinganayo kanye neziqu zesisiseko ezamukelekwe ku-South African Nursing Council ngokuya kumyalozo kahulumeni 425, (okungukuthi i-Diploma / i-Degree e-Nursing) ovumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengengikazi ohloliwe (2026) kanye nendlela yokugcina iziqu ngemva kokuba ngumongikazi ohloliwe, evela isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka owodwa, ekuqinisekiswe yi-SANC ngokuya kumyalozo kahulumeni ongu R212 ekunakekelweni kwezempilo yomphakathi. Uzovamele okungenani iminyaka yeshumi nanye (09) yomphumela wokuqeqeshwa ngemva kokuba ngumongikazi ohloliwe ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Okungenani eminyakeni eyihlanu (05) ngesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele kube yimphumela/okwayo esikhundleni esithize ngemva kokuthola indlela yokugcina iziqu ngemva kokuba ngumongikazi ohloliwe ngesikhathi esiyisikhathi esingaphezu konyaka owodwa ekunakekelweni kwezempilo yomphakathi. Indlela yokugcina iziqu ngemva kokuba ngumongikazi eNursing Administration/Health service management. Uluhlelo nokwazi ngemiso yezempilo yendawo. Ukubonisa ukuqonda okujulile ngemithetho ehlobene nokunakekelwa kwamagula kanye nezindlela ezithintekayo ekunakekelweni kweziguli kanye nenomphumela wayo ekulethweni kwensebenzo. Ukubonisa ukuqonda okuyisiseko nge-HR kanye nezimali kanye nezindlela zokwenza umsebenzi. Ulwazi ngemigango yomthetho edingekayo njengokuthi i-Nursing Act, i-Health Occupational and Safety Act, i-Patients Right Charter, Izimiso zika-Batho Pele, Amakhono oBuciko Bokuqondisa inkinga. Amakhono okuxazulula inkinga, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela izinto. Kulindeleke ukuba usebenze ngaphansi kwengcindezi kanye nasebusuku. Ubunkosi. Amakhono okuqondisa, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuxazulula izingxabano, okuhlobana nabantu kanye nokuxhumana kanye namakhono okuxhumana. Ukubonisa ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho kanye nezinqubo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuzelwe imigaqo kanye nenomphumela wayo ekulethweni kwensebenzo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha luzoba yinzuzo (i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint ne-Outlook). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi unikeze ukulawula kwesikhungo se-PHC ngokuya kwemihlahlandlela yokulawula i-PHC. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwamagula okwenziwa iqembu lamagula esikhungweni ngokuhambisana nomkhakaba kanye nendlela yokwenza umsebenzi kanye nemiqulu yokunakekelwa njengokuqinisekisiwe isikhungo sezempilo esithintekayo. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa kwamagula kwezinga eliphezulu njengokuqondiswa umbhalo wokusebenza webanga eliphakeme kanye nesignali ngokuhambisana nephakheji yokulethwa kwe-PHC. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemiqulo ye-National Core Norms and Standards kuhlanganise nezindawo eziyisikhombisi ezibalulekileyo. Suka uthethelele abaguli ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bayalandela izimiso zika-Batho Pele. Hlela ukuthathana kwendawo yokuhlala kanye nokubamba iqhaza komphakathi. Qondisa kanye nokulawula ukusetshenziswa okuyinyanga kanye nokugcinwa kwempahla kanye nokwakhiwa kwesikhungo. Lawula ukuphathwa kolwazi kanye namadokhumenti.

xh.title: Umlawuli woMsebenzi woQonyobhoLwazi (PN-B3): PHC
xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli woMsebenzi woQonyobhoLwazi eRietkuil Clinic eMpumalanga esifuna isimangalo soGqathiswa beBoyi nokuBhaliswa kwi-SANC kunye nesimangalo sokuba nguNesi ngemva kwesifundo esisisiseko.
xh.requirements: I-Certificate yesiNgqwangqwa / isiQaphelana 12 okanye isimangalo esilinganayo ngokudityaniswa nesimangalo esisisiseko esamkelwe yi-South African Nursing Council ngokweGovernment Notice 425, (o.k.t. iDiploma / iDegree eNursing) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengoNesi oYile (2026) ngokudityaniswa nesimangalo sokuba nguNesi ngemva kwesifundo esisisiseko, esithatha ubuncinane nyaka om-1, esamkelwe yi-South African Nursing Council ngokweGovernment Notice No R212 kwi-Primary Health Care. Uqeqesho oluncinane lweenyanga ezingama-9 (09) zemivuzo efanelekileyo/eqaqableyo ekunyiseni emva kokubhaliswa njengoNesi oYile e-South African Nursing Council (SANC) kwijelo le-General Nursing. Ubuncinane beeNyanga ezi-5 (05) kwelo xesha elicushiweyo ngenhla kufuneka zibe zifanelekile/eqaqableyo kwelo jelo elithile emva kokufumana isimangalo sokuba nguNesi ngemva kwesifundo esisisiseko kwijelo le-Primary Health Care Nursing Science. Isimangalo sokuba nguNesi ngemva kwesifundo esisisiseko kwi-Nursing Administration/Health service management. Uqeqesho nolwazi nge-District Health System. Bonisa ukuqonda ngokujulileyo ngomthetho weqonyobholwazi kunye nemisebenzi yamathetho nelungelo eliqonyobholwazi nendlela echanekileyo enegalelo ekuletkweni kwenkonzo. Bonisa ukuqonda okusesantloko nge-HR kunye ne-financial practices. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yamathetho axelwayo njengakwi-Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operational Management Skills. Ulwazi lwokusombulula iingxaki, uqokelelo nokuhlela izinto. Kulindelwe ukusebenza ngentshukumo eqatha nakwisikhathi sobusuku. Ukuzenza ngokome. Ulwazi lokuzengisa, ukuqeqesha abo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuyibamba inxeba, ubudlelwane bakowo namntu wonke nokuthetha nabathini ngendlela echanekileyo elungele nendlela elungele ukuthetha nabathini. Bonisa ukuqonda ngokujulileyo ngomthetho nangamasiko weqonyobholwazi achanekileyo nendlela enegalelo ekuletkweni kwenkonzo. Ukuqonda ukusetyenziswa kolwazi kwesixhobo elekhalipha sididi olumbi (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint nelungiselelo). Ulwazi lwesixhobo sekhalipha.
xh.duties: Lawula unikezele ngokumqondisi wesiFedyo naseMbonisweni (PHC facility) ngokweMganga yokuLawulwa nokuQondisa (PHC Supervision Guideline). Qinisekisa imisebenzi yeqonyobholwazi yeqela labanesi kwesi siphileledzi ngakumbi ixesha njengoko kucetyisiwe ngakumbi isiphileledzi ngakumbi ixesha elizodwa ngokomthetho ojikeleziweyo. Khuthaza ukhatho olukhawulezayo lweqonyobholwazi ngokomyalelo wobuchwepheshe obuzodwa nobugqirha obuzodwa ngokomthetho we-PHC delivery package. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwe-National Core Norms and Standards ngakumbi indawo eziphambili (Six Priority Areas). Lithwele iziguli ngokuphumeza iBatho Pele Principles. Lawula unikezele ngolwazi lweekhompyutha nokuqamba iindaba.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 (PN-B1): PHC
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 needed at Rietkuil Clinic in Mpumalanga to provide primary health care services and manage resources effectively.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 qualification or equivalent plus Basic qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R425 (i.e. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse and Midwifery (2026), a post-basic nursing qualification, with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R212 specialty in Primary Health Care Science. Minimum of four (4) years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC. Ability to function independently and to prioritize work. Leadership and sound interpersonal skills, problem solving and decision-making skills. Good supervisory and teaching skills.
jobs.duties: Provision of optimal, holistic specialized nursing care with set standards and within a professional / legal framework. Provide comprehensive health care services in the Primary Health Care Unit. Ensure effective and efficient management of resources. Provide quality patient care, follow norms and standards. Participate in quality improvement programs. Supervise and implement patient care standards. Implement and practice nursing health care in accordance with the statutory laws governing the nursing profession, labour and health care. Implement constructive working relations with nurses and other stake holders. Ensure compliance of Infection Prevention and Control policies. Ensure that the equipment is functional and ready all the time. Ability to prioritize, coordinate activities of patient management according to protocols. Able to plan and organize your own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Participate in staff development and performance management. Report patient safety incidence, challenges and deficiencies within the unit. Work effectively, co-operatively amicably with people of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Ensure adherence to Batho - Pele Principles and Patient’s Right Charter.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Glory Mokone Tel No: (013) 766 3340 / Ms. Gugu Nkosi Tel No: (013) 766 3103 / Mr. Mxolisi Maseko Tel No: (013) 766 3351 / Mr. Samson Nyoni Tel No: (013) 766 3087 and IT related queries: Help desk Tel No: (013) 766 3018.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 (PN-B1): PHC
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 benodig by Rietkuil-kliniek in Mpumalanga om primêre gesondheidsorgdienste te verskaf en hulpbronne doeltreffend te bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12-kwalifikasie of gelykwaardig plus basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC volgens Staatskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Verloskunde (2026) toelaat, 'n post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC volgens Staatskennisgewing R212 spesialiteit in Primêre Gesondheidsorgwetenskap. Minimum van vier (4) jaar gepaste /herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en gesonde interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingvaardighede. Goeie toesighoudende en onderrigvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaffing van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg met vasgestelde standaarde en binne 'n professionele / regsraamwerk. Verskaf omvattende gesondheidsorgdienste in die Primêre Gesondheidsorgeenheid. Verseker doeltreffende en doeltijnende bestuur van hulpbronne. Verskaf gehalte pasiëntsorg, volg norme en standaarde. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Oorsig en implementeer pasiëntsorgstandaarde. Implementeer en beoefen verpleeggesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die statutêre wette wat die verpleegprofessie, arbeid en gesondheidsorg regeer. Implementeer konstruktiewe werksverhoudings met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van Infeksievoorkoming en Beheer-beleide. Verseker dat toerusting funksioneel en te alle tye gereed is. Vermoë om te prioritiseer, koördineer aktiwiteite van pasiëntbestuur volgens protokolle. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Neem deel aan personeelontwikkeling en prestasiebestuur. Rapporteer pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle, uitdagings en tekortkominge binne die eenheid. Werk doeltreffend, saamwerkend en bevordelik met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rassige of godsdienstige verskille. Verseker nakoming van Batho-Pele-beginsels en die Pasiente se Regte-handves.

zu.title: Umsebenzisi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Othweswe Isikhundla 1 (PN-B1): PHC
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umsebenzisi Wezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Othweswe Isikhundla 1 eRietkuil Clinic eMpumalanga ukunikeza izinsizakalo eziyisisekelo zezokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nokuphatha izinsiza ngokusebenza kahle.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphakeme / ithificheleti le-Grade 12 noma okulingana naso kanye nethifikheleti yesisisekelo evunyiwe yi-SANC ngokomyalo kaHulumeni R425 (okungukuthi i-Diploma / I-Degree eZokunakekela Ukugula Ngokujwayelekile) noma izifundo ezilingana nalezi ezivumela ukubhaliswa e-SANC njengogogwane ophathekayo kanye nezokubelethiswa (2026), isifundo sokunakekela ukugula esingesisisekelo, esithatha okungenani unyaka we-1, esivunyelwe yi-SANC ngokomyalo kaHulumeni R212 enkoleni eYisayensi Yezokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Esiyisisekelo. Kudingeka kube nokuhlangabezana neminyaka eminingana engu- four (4) yohlelo olufanele / oluvelele lwezokunakekela ukugula emva kokubhalisa njengogogwane ophathekayo e-SANC. Ikono lokusebenza kodwa nokubeka phezulu izinhloso zomsebenzi. Izindlela zokuhlakanipha ekuhola abantu nezindlela ezinhle zokuxhumana nalabo abangomunye umuntu, izikhathi ezingcolile kanye nezinkomba zokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Amakhono amahle okuhlola nokufundisa.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuhle kakhulu, okujulile ngesikhathi esibekiwe nangaphakathi kohlaka olusemthethweni / lwemisebenzi ehlonitshiweyo. Ukunikeza izinsizakalo eziphelele zezokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwesikhungo sezokunakekelwa kwezempilo esiyisisekelo.okuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngokusebenza kahle nangokunyakazisana. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesiguli okuhle kakhulu, ukulandela izindinganiso kanye namagugu. Ukuthatha inhlalo kumuhle wokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo. Ukuphatha kanye nokusebenzisa izindinganiso zokunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukusebenzisa kanye nokwenza izinsizakalo zezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho elawula umsebenzi wezokunakekela, abasebenzi nezokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukusekela ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bezokunakekela kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzibandakanya kwemigomo yokuvikelwa kokuthelelelana nokulawula. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ziyasebenza futhi zilungele ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ikono lokubeka phezulu, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwesiguli ngokwezinhlelo ezimisiwe. Ukuba nengikono yokuhlela futhi ulungiselele umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasebenzi abakusizayo ukuze uqinisekise ukunakekelwa okuhle. Ukuthatha inhlalo kumkhakha wokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza. Ukubika izenzakalo ezinga kuphathwa kahle ngokuphepha kweziguli, izinselelo kanye nezinsizakalo ezingesabi kahle ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Ukusebenza kahle, ngokubambisana futhi ngokuzwana nabantu abahlukene ngokwezemfundo,amasiko, uhlelo lobulili noma inkolo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulandela izimiso ze-Batho - Pele kanye noMthethosisekelo Wezamalungelo Esiguli.

xh.title: Umongameli Wezophelo Wogqo Lwezempilo Isigaba 1 (PN-B1): PHC
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umongameli wezophelo wogqo lwezempilo isigaba 1 kwindawo yokwamba iRietkuil Clinic eMpumalanga ukunika iinkonzo ezizonke zeliso lempilo ekuqaleni nokulawula izixhobo ngokusebenza kakuhle.
xh.requirements: Isebe Sokugqiba uMatric / Isidanga 12 okanye eselifana naso kanjalo nesiqu esisiseko esamkelwe yiSANC ngokwentetho yoGqo lukaRhulumente R425 (oko kukuthi iDiploma / iDegree kuGqo lweZophelo jikelele) okanye isiqu eselifana nalo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengesiGqiji soGqo lweZophelo nelesiSo kwezokuZalwa (2026), isiqu sogqo lwezophelo ngemva kokuqeqesha eliyona nonyaka ungamzinye, esamkelwe yiSANC ngokwentetho yoGqo lukaRhulumente R212 kwinkalo yezoBuchwephetshe bokwamba impilo ekuqaleni. Kubangokwa obuncinci beminyaka emine (4) yamava afanelekileyo / aqondakalayo kugqo lwezophelo emva kokubhalisa njengesiGqiji soGqo lwezophelo kwiSANC. Ulawulo lokusebenza nokuzinceda uqobo nokuqamba ngokubaluleka komsebenzi. Ulawulo loluqhawule olucothayo, amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokuNcuma iigqibo. Amakhono amakhulu okulawula abanye nokufundisa.
xh.duties: Unikezelo lwezophelo eliphezulu, elichanekileyo nelibucala nangaphezu koko elinamagunya apho kwaye ngaphakathi kwesakhelo esisemthethweni / ngokomthetho. Unikezelo lwezempilo ezizezonke kwiziko lemfilo yeZoBuphilo ekuqaleni. Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nolunamandla ngokuchanekileyo. Unikezelo lezophelo ezichanekileyo kumchereki, ulandela imimiselo nezinga. Ungezelela kwinkqubo yokuphucula iigqibo. Ukuqala nokusebenzisa imilinganiselo yokunika izondlo. Ukusebenzisa nokusetyenziswa kwezempilo zokugqoka unyanzelekileyo ngezomthetho ngokomthetho okulawula igosa lenkosi, iNdembe nolawu lomfuyo. Ukuqamba ukulungelelanisa ubudlelwane bokusebenza, iingcinga, izithili zomhlaba nezinye iinkalo ezibalulekileyo. Ukuqinisekisa ngokucothiswa koluntu oluvela koluntu nenkqubo yoluntu. Ukuqinisekisa amasheke ukuba anamandla ayaqhutywa njalo eqinisileyo. Isipili sokubekela kuqalwe, ukuqhubekelela inkqubo yomchereki yoluntu ngokomthetho. Ukuqhelisela umbono, ukulungelelanisa, ukudibanisa, ukulungiselela umbono oqondileyo nowasekelayo.

af.title: Aptekerassistent (POST-BASIC) Graad 1
af.summary: Post-basis aptekerassistent gesoek by Rietkuil Clinic in Mpumalanga om die ontvangs, berging, samestelling en veilige pasiëntgebruik van medisyne te bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus geregistreer as Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026). 'n Geldige werkvergunning sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies. Kennis van huidige gesondheids- en openbare dienste-wetgewing, regulasies en beleide. Goeie kommunikasie-, probleemoplossings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Professionaliteit, akkuraatheid, buigsaamheid, onafhanklikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Verseker behoorlike opname van ontvangs en berging van alle medisyne en verbruiksgoedere volgens standaard bedryfsprosedures wat hanteer word in die area van bedrywighede. Verseker verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid vir veilige pasiëntmedisynegebruik. Samestelling en voorbereiding van enige medisyne soos gedelegeer. Bevorder korrekte evaluering van voorskrifte en wettige verwerking van medisynevoorskrifte, voorraadopname en verspreiding van voorrade aan die kliënt. Bevordering van Openbare Gesondheid. Verseker akkurate optekening van statistieke en administratiewe vereistes soos deur beleid vereis.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezamaphilisi (POST-BASIC) Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Umsizi wezamaphilisi wesigaba se-post ubekwe e-Rietkuil Clinic e-Mpumalanga ukuphatha ukwamukelwa, ukugcinwa, ukuxuba nokusetshenziswa okuphephile kwamaphilisisi abaguli.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 okanye ukubhalisa njengo-Sizo Lwezamaphilisi Lokwesigaba se-Post e-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) (2026). Kuzodingeka i-permit yomsebenzi evumelekile kubantu abangengabo ama-South African. Amakhono okubhekana namakonsathi. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izimiso namapholisi amanje ezempilo nkonzo yomphakathi. Amakhono ohlelo lokuxhumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha imikhombe. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti, ukucophelela, ukuguquguquka, ukuzimela nokuziphatha ngokusesikweni.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukurekhodwa ngendlela efanele ukwamukelwa nokugcinwa kwamaphilisi namakhonsamuli wonke ngokwezinqubo eziyisisekelo zokusebenza eziphathwe endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukubophezela nokuiba nezikweletu ekusetshenzisweni okuphephile kwamaphilisi abaguli. Ukuxuba nokupeyela nanhlonhlo yamaphilisi njengoba kunikezwe isibopho. Khuthaza ukuhlola izikripshini ngokufanele nokucubungula ngokomthetho izikripshini zamaphilisi, ukubala izitoku nokwabiwa kokulethwa kumthengi. Ukukhuthaza Izempilo Zomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukurekhodwa ngokucophelela kwezibalo nezidingo zokuphatha njengoba kudingwa isiqondiso.

xh.title: Umntwana woMncedi (POST-BASIC) Isigaba 1
xh.summary: Kufuneka umncedi wepilisi wengangamva eRietkuil Clinic eMpumalanga ukulawula ukufumana iimpiliso, ukuzigcina, ukuhlanganisa nokusetyenziswa okukhuselekileyo ngumjoni.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo / Isigaba se-12 ngaphezulu nokubhaliswa njengoMncedi wePilisi weNgangamva kwiBhunga lePilisi leMzantsi Afrika (SAPC) (2026). Ipermiti yomsebenzi esemthethweni iya kufuneka kubantu abangeyoMzantsi Afrika. Amabala ngokweziguquguquko. Ulwazi ngomthetho osebenzayo wezempilo kunye nolwaborho lommandla, iimigaqo namagebe. Amabala mahle okuququzelela, okusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela ukuphathwa kweencinga. Ubugcisa bemisebenzi, ukuchaneka, ukuguquguquka, uzimele nobuzo bokwenza okusesikweni.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokufanelekileye nokugcinwa kwazo zonke iziyobolwelwa nemitsho ngokwezinqubo ezisesikweni zokusebenza ezisetyenziswayo kwindawo yokuqhuba imisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba nobuchule nokuxhomekeka kwakho ekusebenziseni ngokhuselekileyo iziyobolwelwa kumajoni. Ukuhlanganisa nokuvelisa naziphi na iziyobolwelwa njengoko kukhethwe. Khuthaza ukuhlolwa okuchanekileyo kwezicwangciso kunye nokugqithwa ngokomthetho kwezicwangciso zeziyobolwelwa, ukuqhutywa kwesisikweni nokusasazwa kwezibonelelo kumxhasi. Ukukhuthaza izeMfundo yoLuntu ngeMpiLentshu. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokuchanekileyo kwezibalo neemfuno zolawulo njengoko kufunwa ngumthetho wokuqulunqa.

jobs.title: Artisan (PRODUCTION) Grade A: Plumber
jobs.centre: Gert Sibande District Office, Ermelo REQUIREMENT               :      Minimum of Grade 10-12 or equivalent qualifications plus an appropriate completed apprenticeship and trade test certificate in Plumbing. Valid driver’s Licence. Willingness to work irregular hours and attend to emergencies when required. Ability to communicate in two of the three official languages of the Mpumalanga Province (read & write) Ability to work under pressure Must be willing to work in adverse weather conditions in physical sound and healthy condition Prepared to perform overtime and standby duties, including weekends and public as well as over peak periods, as and when needed.
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Ermelo seeks a Plumber Artisan Grade A to produce designs, perform production work and maintain facilities across the Gert Sibande District.
jobs.duties: Produce designs according to client specification and within limits of production capacity. Production: Produce objects with material and equipment according to job specification and recognized standards. (c) Maintenance: Inspect equipment and/or facilities for technical faults, Repair equipment and facilities according to standards, Test repaired equipment and/or facilities against specifications, Service equipment and/or facilities according to schedule. Perform administrative and related functions: Provide inputs on the compilation of technical reports,) Keep and maintain job records and other registers, Adhere to agreed development plan.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Glory Mokone Tel No: (013) 766 3340 / Ms. Gugu Nkosi Tel No: (013) 766 3103 / Mr. Mxolisi Maseko Tel No: (013) 766 3351 / Mr. Samson Nyoni Tel No: (013) 766 3087 and IT related queries: Help desk Tel No: (013) 766 3018.
jobs.applications: Departmental Online Application System: www.mpuhealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: N.B. Applicants are advised to apply as early as possible to avoid disappointments. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. In order to alleviate administration burden on HR Sections as well as considering the cost for applicants, Departments are encouraged to request certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview following communication from the relevant HR section of the Department. All posts health/engineering posts that are advertised within the Department professional registration will be required from various statutory council for shortlisted candidates. A complete set of application documents should be submitted separately for every post that you wish to apply for. Please ensure that you clearly state the full post description and the relevant Post Reference Number on your application. No fax applications will be considered. Applicants must ensure that they fully complete and sign form Z 83, even if they are attaching a CV. Incomplete and/or unsigned applications will not be considered. If you are currently in service, please indicate your PERSAL number at the top of form Z83. Due to ongoing internal processes, the Department reserves the right to withdraw any post at any time. The Department reserves the right to verify the qualifications of every recommended candidate prior to the issuing of an offer of appointment. All short listed candidates will be subject to a vetting process prior to appointment. If no response is received from Mpumalanga Department of Health within 90 days after the closing date of the advertisement, applicants must assume that their application was not successful. Please quote the correct references when applying and where possible the station / centre where the post is. www.mpuhealth.gov.za Only Online Applications will be accepted. NB: Candidates who are not contacted within 90 days after the closing date must consider their applications as having been unsuccessful. Please Note: The Department reserves the right to amend / review / withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (People with disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications) All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Ambagsman (PRODUKSIE) Graad A: Loodgieter
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Ermelo soek 'n Loodgieter Ambagsman Graad A om ontwerpe te skep, produksiewerk te verrig en fasilititeite regdeur die Gert Sibande-distrik te onderhou.
af.duties: Produceer ontwerpe volgens kliëntspesifikasie en binne die perke van produksiekapasiteit. Produksie: Produceer voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspesifikasie en erkende standaarde. (c) Onderhoud: Inspekteer toerusting en/of fasilititeite vir tegniese foute, Herstel toerusting en fasilititeite volgens standaarde, Toets herstelde toerusting en/of fasilititeite teen spesifikasies, Onderhou toerusting en/of fasilititeite volgens skedule. Verrig administratiewe en verwante funksies: Verskaf insette oor die opstel van tegniese verslae,) Hou en onderhou werksrekords en ander registers, Hou by die ooreengekome ontwikkelingsplan.

zu.title: Umlobi wezandla (UKUKHIQIZA) Izinga A: Umhlinzeki wamanzi
zu.summary: I-Department of Health e-Ermelo ifuna u-Umhlinzeki wamanazi olingumlobi wezandla Izinga A ukukhiqiza amadizayini, ukwenza umsebenzi wokukhiqiza kanye nokugcina izindlela eziseduze ku-Gert Sibande District.
zu.duties: Khiqiza amadizayini ngokwesimo sokuhamba somthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwezikhathi zokukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Khiqiza izinto ngezinto zokwakha nangesishebo ngokwesimo somsebenzi futhi ngokwezindinganiso ezaziwayo. (c) Ukugcina: Hlola isisetshenziswa kanye nezindawo ukuthi zikona iziphokoqo ezingenangqondo; Lungisa isisetshenziswa nezindawo ngokwezindinganiso; Hlola futhi uhlolisise isisetshenziswa esilungisiwe nezindawo ekuqhathaniswa nezinkomba; Phathela isisetshenziswa nezindawo ngokweshejuli. Yenza imisebenzi yentengiso nezinye imisebenzi ehlobene: Nikeza okufakwe kumabhalo wokuhlanganisa imibhalo yobuchwepheshe,); Gcina futhi ulondoloze imiphumela yomsebenzi kanye nezinye izibhalo; Landela isu lokuthuthukisa esivunyelwe.

xh.title: Umzobi (PRODUCTION) Inqanaba A: Umdatyana wamanzi
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo e Ermelo lifuna uMdatyana wamanzi Umzobi Inqanaba A ukuba adize, enze umsebenzi wokuvelisa azalisekulungelelanise izinto kulo lonke u Gert Sibande District.
xh.duties: Diza ngokwemigaqo yomthengi nangaphakathi kwemigamatho yamandla okuvelisa. UKUVELISA: Velisa izinto ngematerial nengqalaselo ngokwemigaqo yomsebenzi nangokwemigangatho ekuqatshiweyo. (c) Ukulungelelanisa: Phenya ingqalaselo nakwizinto ngeziphene zobuchwepheshe, Lungisa ingqalaselo nezinto ngokwemigangatho, Vavanya ingqalaselo elungisiweyo nakwizinto ngokumiselweyo, Yonke ingqalaselo nakwizinto ngokwejadula. Zenza imisebenzi yabaphathi nengathunyelweyo: Nikeza izimvo ekubhalweni kweenkcazelo zobuchwepheshe,) Gcina uludwe lomsebenzi nabayinyani abanye, Landela icebo lokuphuhlisa elivunyelweyo.

jobs.title: Head of Department (HOD): Provincial Treasury
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum (Level 15), (all-inclusive package). In addition, a 10% Allowance is payable as Head of Department
jobs.summary: Lead the Provincial Treasury as Accounting Officer, overseeing financial management, budget processes and governance in Mpumalanga.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate postgraduate qualification (NQF level 8), as recognized by SAQA. 10 years’ experience at a senior management level. Core and Process Competencies include: Strategic Capability and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Programme Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Change Management, Knowledge Management, Service Delivery Innovations, Client Orientation and Customer Focus and Communication. In addition, the incumbent will have to be sensitive to the political and strategic objectives of government. The ideal candidate should have the following qualities: Strong thinking capability. Ability to lead and align teams of senior professionals and analysts. Strong research, sound networking and interpersonal skills. Sound people management capabilities. Good exposure to knowledge management ethos and practices. Proven record of honesty and integrity as a professional / manager. Good exposure to project management practices and systems. Sensitivity to the political-administrative interface, and appreciation of the policy support role within a politically led executive decision-making process.
jobs.duties: As an Accounting Officer for the Provincial Treasury, the incumbent will be responsible to perform the following functions: Establish and oversee the provision of sound financial management practices in relation to credible budget processes, financial reporting, financial governance, liabilities control and accounting services, (PFMA). Establish and oversee the implementation of sound financial management practices (in relation to credible budget processes, financial reporting, financial governance, liabilities control and accounting services MFMA). Develop and oversee the implementation of viable and sound Supply Chain Management, Asset and Liabilities Management. Establish and oversee the provision of credible, effective financial governance and support services to provincial departments, public entities and Municipalities (PFMA, MFMA). Oversee the institutionalising and implementation of effective corporate management and administration services. Oversee the management of departmental sound financial management services. Oversee the implementation and provision of Internal Audit services. Oversee the implementation of risk, ethics and integrity management services. Oversee the provision of administrative support services. This is a contract post and the successful candidate will be required to enter into a five-years’ employment contract and a performance agreement with the Executive Authority. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a competency assessment and security clearance.
jobs.enquiries: should be directed to the Deputy Director: Internal HRM & D: Ms. SS Monareng Tel No: (013) 766 2004.
jobs.applications: should only be submitted online through the link: erecruitment.mpg.gov.za on the new Z83 form and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV.
jobs.notes: Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications. If no correspondence is received within two months of the closing date, applicants must accept that their applications have been unsuccessful. The minimum entry requirement for these posts, i.e. Senior Management Services (SMS) posts is a Pre-entry Certificate that is obtainable through a course named Certificate for entry into SMS submitted prior to appointment – and the full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.            All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The appointment of the successful candidates is subject to security clearance, security vetting, employment reference checks, qualifications’ verification and signing of performance agreements. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidates will be required to disclose their financial interests. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoof van Departement (HOD): Provincial Treasury
af.summary: Loods die Provincial Treasury as rekenpligtige beampte en hou toesig oor finansiële bestuur, begrotingsprosesse en goewerance in Mpumalanga.
af.requirements: ’n Toepaslike nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 8), soos deur SAQA erken. 10 jaar se ervaring op ’n seniorbestuursvlak. Kern- en prosesbevoegdhede sluit in: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, programbestuur en bemagtiging, finansiële bestuur, veranderingbestuur, kennisbestuur, diensleweringsinnovasies, kliëntgerigtheid en klienfokus, en kommunikasie. Daarbenewens sal die ampsdraer sensitief moet wees vir die politieke en strategiese doelwitte van die regering. Die ideale kandidaat behoort die volgende eienskappe te hê: Sterk dinkvermoë. Vermoë om spanne senior professionele persone en ontleders te lei en in lyn te bring. Sterk navorsings-, goeie netwerk- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie mensebestuursbevoegdhede. Goeie blootstelling aan kennisbestuurstos en -praktyke. Bewese rekord van eerlikheid en integriteit as ’n professionele persoon / bestuurder. Goeie blootstelling aan projekbestuurspraktyke en -stelsels. Sensitiwiteit vir die politiek-administratiewe koppelvlak, en waardering van die beleidsondersteuningsrol binne ’n politiek geleide uitvoerende besluitnemingsproses.
af.duties: As ’n rekenpligtige beampte vir die Provincial Treasury sal die ampsdraer verantwoordelik wees om die volgende funksies uit te voer: Vestig en hou toesig oor die voorsiening van goeie finansiële bestuurspraktyke met betrekking tot geloofwaardige begrotingsprosesse, finansiële verslagdoening, finansiële goewerance, aanspreeklikhedebeheer en rekenkundige dienste, (PFMA). Vestig en hou toesig oor die implementering van goeie finansiële bestuurspraktyke (met betrekking tot geloofwaardige begrotingsprosesse, finansiële verslagdoening, finansiële goewerance, aanspreeklikhedebeheer en rekenkundige dienste MFMA). Ontwikkel en hou toesig oor die implementering van lewensvatbare en gesonde Supply Chain Management, Asset and Liabilities Management. Vestig en hou toesig oor die voorsiening van geloofwaardige, effektiewe finansiële goewerance en ondersteuningsdienste aan provinsiale departemente, openbare entiteite en Munisipaliteite (PFMA, MFMA). Hou toesig oor die institusionalisering en implementering van effektiewe korporatiewe bestuur en administrasiedienste. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van die departement se goeie finansiële bestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor die implementering en voorsiening van Interne Ouditdienste. Hou toesig oor die implementering van risiko-, etiek- en integriteitsbestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor die voorsiening van administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Dit is ’n kontrakpos en die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verplig word om ’n vyfjaar-werkkontrak en ’n prestasieooreenkoms met die Uitvoerende Gesag aan te gaan. Kandidate wat op die kortlys geplaas is, sal aan ’n bevoegdheidsassessering en veiligheidsklarering onderwerp word.

zu.title: Umhola weNyango (HOD): i-Provincial Treasury
zu.summary: Qondisa i-Provincial Treasury njengoba ngumNikazi wama-Akhawunti, ulawula ukuphathwa kwezimali, inqubo yebhajethi nokubusa kwempilo eMpumalanga.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zesiqu sokuthuthuka (izinga le-NQF 8), njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Unyaka wokuqina ngokubambisana 10 osemzinganweni wabaphathi abaphezulu. Amandla okusebenza ngokususelwa kwizindingo eziphikiswano kanye nesinqumo sokuqhubekela phambili bahlanganisa: Amandla okucabanga nokuholwa, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokunikelwa amandla, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nokunikelwa amandla, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kolwazi, izinto ezintsha zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo, ukugxila kwabathile kanye nobunakekeli babathengi kanye nokuqhathaniswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lowo othathwe esikhundleni kuzofanele azibe ezwelwa izinjongo ezibekiwe zombuso ngokwezombusazwe nezothuthuko. Umuntu othandwa kufanele abe nezici eziyisiseko ezilandelayo: Amandla aphezulu okucabanga. Amandla okuhola nokumisana amaqembu abaphathi abaphezulu nabanhloliye. Amandla aphezulu ekuphenya, ukuhlobana okuhle kanye namandla okuxhumana nabantu. Amandle aphezulu okuphatha abantu. Isixhuman esihle kwizinkambiso zokuphathwa kolwazi. Isibonakaliso esiqinisekile sokuzithoba nokuba nentokozo njengomuntu osebenzayo / umphathi. Isixhuman esihle kwizinkambiso kanye namasistimu okuphatha izinhlelo. Ukuzelela ngokukhululeka ukugxila kwezombusazwe kanye nokuqonda indima yosizo lwezinqumo emphakathini ophethwe ngabasombusazwe, futhi kubone imigomo yokuqonda indima ekuthathweni kwezinqumo ngabaphathi.
zu.duties: Njengoba ngumNikazi wama-Akhawunti we-Provincial Treasury, lowo othathwe esikhundleni uzobe nesibopho sokwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Misela futhi ulawule ukubakho kwezinkambiso ezinhle zokuphathwa kwezimali ngokuya ngemikhuba ethembekile yokuqamba ibhajethi, ukubika ngemali, ukubuswa kwezimali, ukulawula izikweletu kanye nezenzo zokubala izimali, (PFMA). Misela futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinkambiso ezinhle zokuphathwa kwezimali (ngokuya ngemikhuba ethembekile yokuqamba ibhajethi, ukubika ngemali, ukubuswa kwezimali, ukulawula izikweletu kanye nezenzo zokubala izimali MFMA). Qamba futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kokuphathwa kwe-Chain yokuhlinzeka, ukuphathwa kwempahla nezikweletu. Misela futhi ulawule ukubakho kokubuswa kwezimali okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle kanye nokunikeza izinsiza zokusekela kumnyango, kubalingisi bomphakathi kanye nezikole (PFMA, MFMA). Lawula ukutholakala kokuqinisekiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa nenzuzo yekampani nokwenzeka kwayo. Lawula ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokuphathwa kwezimali ezinhle komnyango. Lawula ukusebenza nokunikela ngokuphathwa kokuqopha inani langaphakathi. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kokuphathwa kokungalindeleki, izimilo nokuzithoba. Lawula ukubakho kwezinsiza zokusekela ezenzelwe ukulawula. Lesi yisikhundla senkomishini futhi lowo ophumelele uzofuneka asayine isivumelwano sokusebenza seminyaka eyisihlanu nenhlangano yokwenza kanye nobuzwe nenhloko yombuso. Abantu abakhethiwe bazohlolwa ngokuhlola amandla okusebenza kanye nokusulwa kwezinsizakalo zokuvikela.

xh.title: Intloko yeSebe (HOD): iProvincial Treasury
xh.summary: Yenza inkqubo ebambele kwiProvincial Treasury njengonobhalisi wemali, ulawule ulawulo lwemali, iinkqubo zebhajethi nolawulo kwiMpumalanga.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo se-postgraduate (inqanaba le-NQF 8), njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. 10 years’ experience at a senior management level. Amandla angundoqo nokuSebenzela iinkqubo aquka: iNkokeli yoNoyilo loMthetho weSaziso, uLawulo lwabaNTu noMfuziselo, uLawulo lweNkqubo noMfuziselo, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lwezinguqu, uLawulo lolwazi, iziNkcubeko zokuZisa iNkonzo, uQwalaselo lweXhaswa nokuQwalasela iXhaswa nokuxhumana. Ngaphezu koko, umntu oza kuthatha lo mzi wesithuba kuya kufuneka azivelele ngokuziphepha ngokweemvo zezopolitiko nangokweemgangatho ezibalulekileyo kurhulumente. Umntu ofanelekileyo kuya kufuneka abeneempawu ezilandelayo: Amandla amaninzi okucinga. Amandla okuba ngumntu ongundoqo wamagunya elungelelanisa amaqela abantu abangenamva kunye nabahlalutyi. Amandla amaninzi okuphanda, amandla amaninzi okudibanisa nabantu nendlela yokuziphatha. Amandla amaninzi okulawula abantu. Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo yokulawula ulwazi nendlela entsoniyo. Igreebe evezwe ngokuthembeka nokuzithoba njengomchweli / umphathi. Ulwazi olululo ngendlela entsoniyo yokulawula iinkqubo zeprojekthi. Ukuqonda ngokuzithoba nokuziphepha kwendlela entsoniyo ekudityaneni kwezopolitiko nolawulo, nokuxabisa indima yexhaso lweenkqubo ezintsonkotshi zonyulo ekuxhasweni kweenkqubo ngaphantsi koburhulumente.
xh.duties: Njengomlawuli wemali weProvincial Treasury, umntu oza kuthatha lo mzi wesithuba kuya kufuneka alawule ukwenziwa kwezinkqubo ezilandelayo: Ukuyila nokulawula ukunikela ngendlela entsoniyo yokulawula imali ngokulawuleka kweinkqubo zebhajethi, iinkqubo zokubika ngemali, ukulawulwa kwe-mali izigqibo, ukulawula izikrethi neenkonzo zokubala, (PFMA). Ukuyila nokulawula ukusebenzisa indlela entsoniyo yokulawula imali (ngokulawuleka kweinkqubo zebhajethi, iinkqubo zokubika ngemali, ukulawulwa kwe-mali izigqibo, ukulawula izikrethi neenkonzo zokubala MFMA). Ukuphuhelisa nokulawula ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokulawula i-Supply Chain, ukulawula iMpahla neZikrethi. Ukuyila nokulawula ukunikela ngenkqubo yokulawula imali ezithembekileyo, nezithiliyo nezisebenzayo zolawulo lwemali neenkonzo zoxhaso kumasebe eburhulumente, kumaziko azimeleyo kurhulumente nakumaMunicipality (PFMA, MFMA). Ukulawula ukuzinza nokuqaliswa kweenkqubo zolawulo lweshishini nokuqaliswa kweenkonzo zolawulo. Ukulawula ulawulo lweenkonzo zolawulo lwemali kwesebe. Ukulawula ukusebenziswa nokunikwa kweenkonzo zoqwalaselo lwangaphakathi. Ukulawula ukusebenziswa kweenkonzo zokulawula iingozi, imigaqo yokuziphatha nokuzinza. Ukulawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zoxhaso lolawulo. Le yisithuba senkonzo yethembana kwaye umntu ophumeleleyo kuya kufuneka apha izithembiso zenkonzo zeminyaka emihlanu nengqinisekiso yokuphumeza izigqibo noGunya eliphambili. Aba bantu abakhethiweyo kuya kwenziwa uqwalaselo lwamandla nococo lwesikhuseleko.

jobs.title: Risk Management Committee (CHAIRPERSON)
jobs.salary_text: An appointed member will be remunerated according to the scales approved by the National Treasury, determined on an hourly or daily basis. All other refundable expenses are based on the National Treasury Guidelines.
jobs.summary: The Department of Social Development in Mpumalanga seeks a Risk Management Committee Chairperson with a postgraduate qualification and five years' public sector risk committee experience.
jobs.requirements: A postgraduate qualification in risk management, auditing, accounting-related, or any relevant qualification rated at NQF level 8 by the South African Qualifications Authority. Membership in good standing with the Institute of Risk Management South Africa (IRMSA). Must have a minimum of 5 years' experience serving as Chairperson or member of a Risk Management or Audit Committee in the Public Sector. A minimum of 5 years of managerial experience in risk management, auditing, ethics and integrity management, anti-corruption or related fields. Demonstrable understanding of the public sector risk management framework and relevant legislation, including the Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, ISO31000, King V report on corporate governance and the COSO Framework, ISO 22301 on Business continuity management.
jobs.duties: Chair the Risk Management Committee meetings and guide the Committee in conducting its activities in accordance with the Public Sector Risk Management Framework, and relevant Legislations. Provide oversight on the review and monitoring of the implementation of the Risk Management Strategy, Policy, Charter and Framework. Provide proper and timely reports to the Accounting Officer and to the Audit Committee on the implementation and effectiveness of risk management within the Department, with aspects requiring improvement accompanied by the Committee’s recommendations to address such aspects. Provide advice/guidance on setting of risk appetite and tolerance levels. Provide oversight on the review and monitoring of anti-corruption strategy, policy and implementation plan. Provide oversight on the review and monitoring of the ethics management strategy, policy and implementation plan. Provide oversight and guidance on the development of the business continuity management systems.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Jane Nhlabathi Tel No: (013) 766 3606 / Ms Pretty Sibinde Tel No: (013) 766 3320

jobs.notes: to applicants: Applicants are advised to apply as early as possible to avoid disappointments. All attachments for online application must include an application form Z83 and CV only, in PDF and as one (1) document or attachment and saved with surname and initials. JPEG (picture/snapshot) applications will not be accepted. Applicants must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. In order to alleviate administration burden on HR Sections as well as considering the cost for applicants, Departments are encouraged to request certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview following communication from the relevant HR section of the Department. All Health / Social / Engineering posts that are advertised within the Department professional registration will be required from various statutory council for shortlisted candidates. A complete set of application documents should be submitted separately for every post that you wish to apply for. Please ensure that you clearly state the full post description and the relevant Post reference number on your application. Applicants must ensure that they fully complete and sign form Z83, even if they are attaching a CV. Applications submitted in any other way other than the published link or hand delivery will be treated as invalid. Incomplete and/or unsigned applications will not be considered. The Department of Social Development will not be responsible for server delays. Due to ongoing internal processes, the Department reserves the right to withdraw any post at any time. Suitable candidate/s will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. If no response is received from Mpumalanga Department of Social Development within 90 days after the closing date of the advertisement, applicants must assume that their application was not successful. af.title: Risikobestuurkomitee (VOORSITTER)
af.summary: Die Department of Social Development in Mpumalanga soek 'n voorsitter van die Risikobestuurkomitee met 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se ervaring in openbare-sektor risikokomitees.
af.requirements: 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in risikobestuur, oudit, rekeningkunde-verwante velde, of enige relevante kwalifikasie wat op NQF-vlak 8 deur die South African Qualifications Authority geag word. Lidmaatskap in goeie standing by die Institute of Risk Management South Africa (IRMSA). Moet 'n minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring hê as voorsitter of lid van 'n Risikobestuur- of Ouditeerkomitee in die Public Sector. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se bestuurservaring in risikobestuur, oudit, etiek- en integriteitsbestuur, korrupsiebestryding of verwante velde. Aantoonbare begrip van die openbare-sektor risikobestuursaamwerk en relevante wetgewing, insluitend die Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, ISO31000, King V-verslag oor korporatiewe bestuur en die COSO-raamwerk, ISO 22301 oor besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur.
af.duties: Beklee die voorsitterskap van die Risikobestuurkomitee se vergaderings en lei die Komitee in die uitvoering van sy bedrywighede in ooreenstemming met die Public Sector Risk Management Framework en relevante wetgewing. Verskaf toesig oor die hersiening en monitering van die implementering van die Risikobestuurstrategie, -beleid, -handves en -raamwerk. Verskaf behoorlike en tydige verslae aan die Accounting Officer en aan die Ouditeerkomitee oor die implementering en doeltreffendheid van risikobestuur binne die departement, met aspekte wat verbetering vereis vergesel van die Komitee se aanbevelings om sulke aspekte aan te spreek. Verskaf advies/leiding oor die bepaling van risiko-aptyt- en verdraagsaamheidsvlakke. Verskaf toesig oor die hersiening en monitering van die korrupsiebestrydingstrategie, -beleid en implementeringsplan. Verskaf toesig oor die hersiening en monitering van die etiekbestuurstrategie, -beleid en implementeringsplan. Verskaf toesig en leiding oor die ontwikkeling van die besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuurstelsels.

zu.title: Ikomidi LaPhathwa Ngengozi (USIHLOKO)
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi oMpumalanga ufuna uSihloko SeKomidi LaPhathwa Ngengozi onemfundo yesiqu esiphakeme nangeminyaka emihlanu yokuqashwa enkomeni likahulumeni kwikomidi eliphathwa ngengozi.
zu.requirements: Ifundo yesiqu esiphakeme ekuphathweni kengozi, ukuhlola, noma ezihlobene ne-akhawunting, noma noma yimuphi umthwalo ongunye ongaphakathi kwelinga le-NQF 8 ngokwe-South African Qualifications Authority. Ukuba yilungu elihamba kahle ku-Institute of Risk Management South Africa (IRMSA). Kumele kube nokubakho okungenani kweminyaka eyi-5 yokuqashwa njengoSihloko noma ilungu leKomidi LaPhathwa Ngengozi noma leKomidi Lokuhlola eMkhakheni Kahulumeni. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yokuqashwa enkomeni lokuphatha ekuphathweni kengozi, ukuhlola, ukuphatha bobuhlakani bokuziphatha nokuzinza, ukulwa nokungalungi noma emikhakheni ephathelene. Ukuqonda okubonakalayo komiso wokuphathwa kengozi emkhakheni kahulumeni nomthetho ohlobene, okuhlanganisa u-Mthetho Wokuphatha Imali Yomphakathi, Izimiso ze-Treasury, i-ISO31000, umbiko we-King V kokuphathwa kwezinkampani kanye Ne-Khulu elokhuqela we-COSO, i-ISO 22301 ekuphathweni kokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi.
zu.duties: Ukuholela izinkomphana zeKomidi LaPhathwa Ngengozi nokuhola iKomidi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yayo ngokomiso wokuphathwa kengozi eMkhakheni Kahulumeni, nangokomthetho ohlobene. Ukunika okubonakalayo ekubukeni nasekulawulweni kokusebenzisa inqubomgomo yokuphathwa kengozi, umthetho wombhiso, kanye nomiso. Ukunikeza okushaywe isikhathi okuyilunga emibikweni echanekileyo kuPhathi we-Akhawunting kanye naseKomidini Lokuhlola ngokuqashwa nokusebenza kokuqashwa kengozi eMnyangweni, lapho okudinga ukuthuthukiswa kuhambisana nezincomo zeKomidi zokulungisa lezo zindaba. Ukunika izeluleko/iziqondiso ekubekeni izinga lokubekezelwa nokuthatheka kengozi. Ukunika okubonakalayo ekubukeni nasekulawulweni inqubomgomo yokulwa nokungalungi, umthetho kanye nenhlelo yokuqashwa. Ukunika okubonakalayo ekubukeni nasekulawulweni inqubomgomo yokuphathwa bobuhlakani bokuziphatha, umthetho kanye nenhlelo yokuqashwa. Ukunika okubonakalayo neziqondiso ekuthuthukisweni kwamasistimu okuphatha ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi.

xh.title: Ikomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko (USIHLOKO)
xh.summary: Isebe loPhuhliso loLuntu kwaMpumalanga lifuna uSihloko seKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko onesifundo esiphezulu kwaye eneminyaka emihlanu yamava kwikomiti yomngcipheko woluntu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esiphezulu kwilawulo lomngcipheko, ukuhlola, izinto ezinxulumene ne-akhawunti, noma naliphi na isifundo elifana nalo elithathwa njengelinomlinganiselo we-NQF level 8 yi-South African Qualifications Authority. Ukuba lilungu elilungileyo kwi-Institute of Risk Management South Africa (IRMSA). Kufunke ubene mava engu-5 yeminyaka enk nini njengoSihloko okanye ilungu leKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko okanye yeKomti ye-Akhwonti kwisebe loLuntu. Ukuze nibe nemava engu-5 yeminyaka yempilo yomlawuli ekulawuleni umngcipheko, ukuhlola, ukuqonda izinto ngokungenisa amathambo ekonakeleyo, ukulwa nokcoliso okanye kumabala ahambelana nayo. Ukuqonda ngokucacileyo isakheko wolawulo lomngcipheko woluntu nomthetho oseyelweyo, kuquka i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, i-ISO31000, ingxelo ye-King V ngokulawulwa kwentsebenziswano, kunye ne-COSO Framework, i-ISO 22301 ngokulawulwa koqhagamshelo lwebhizinisi.
xh.duties: Nika isikhokelo kwiindaba zeKomiti yoLawulo loMngcipheko kwaye uqokele iKomiti ekuphenjeni imisebenzi yayo ngokwesiSakheko soLawulo loMngcipheko ngokwesebe loLuntu, nangokomthetho osekelayo. Nikezela nokuqwalasela nokulawula ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoLawulo loMngcipheko, iNkqubela, iMvumelaniso esiZaku neSakheko. Nikezela iingxelo ezifanelekileyo ngesixa-nyana kumLawuli wee-Akhawunti nakwiKomiti ye-Akhounti ngokuqhuba nokusebenza kobulawulo bomngcipheko ngaphakathi kwesebe, nezinto ezifuna ukuphuculwa zihambisana neengcamu zeKomiti ezingaziswa ukulungisa ezo zinto. Vula ingcamu ngokumisela kwizinga lokumuncipheko nokwamkeleka kwawo. Nikezela nokuqwalasela nokulawula ukugxilwa kwesakheko sokulwa nokholiso, inqubela inkqubela nendlela yokuyisebenzisa. Nikezela nokuqwalasela nokulawula inkqubo yolawulo lwamandla obomi, inkqubela indlela nendlela yokuyisebenzisa. Nikezela nokuqwalasela nokuqwalasela kwesakheko sezindlela ezikulawulo koqhagamshelo lwebhizinisi.

zu.summary: Qapha imisebenzi yokubhalisa ehlanganisa ukuzinikela kwe-HRM, izinsizakalo zezimali, kanye nokuthenga ezinsimini e-SAPS Klerksdorp.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kumele babonise ukukwazi kumisebenzi eyisiseko yesikhundla. Kumele bakwazi ukukhulwa okuhle ngesiNgisi kanye kolunye ulimi olusemthethweni njalo. Kumele babe ngabakwa-Republic of South Africa okuyinto izifundo ezibukhoma kumele zethulwe ngosuku lokungiwa. Kumele babe ne-Grade 12/ Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 noma iziqu ezilinganayo (NQF Level 4 njengokuhlonishwa yi-SAQA). Kumele babe nosoku olungu-four (4) lwayo lweminyaka yokuqashwa kulokhu kukhomba isikhundla. I-Diploma/ Degree (NQF level 6 noma ngaphezulu njengokuhlonishwa yi-SAQA) ethathwa iminyaka emithathu (3) kanye nezifundo ezihambisana nezinto ezidinga isikhundla kuzoba lusizo olwengeziwe. I-license yokushayela evumelekile yemoto engavuthayo kuzoba lusizo olwengeziwe. Ulwazi, Amasimi, kanye Nokuzinikela Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambisana nezenzo ezithinta Isevisi Yomphakathi. Ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngokuvamileko (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Outlook). Kubonise ukuzinikela ngokuzenzela, Ngokusemsebenzini, Ngokubhekwa njalo Ngokwethembeka. Ukukwazi ukuxhumanisa nabantu ngokuhle. Ukubhala amarephothi. Amasimi Okwethula, Okuxazulula Izinkinga, Okuhlela, Kokuhlela nokubhalisa, Ukuhlaziya ngokuhle, kanye namasimi okuxhumana. Kubeneenthembiso yokusebenza ngokucindezeleka futhi
zu.duties: Phatha ukusebenziswa kohlelo lwe-Human Resource Management (HRM) nokuzinikela kwayo. Phatha ukusekelwa kwe-Financial Service kanye nokuphathwa kwemali. Phatha imisebenzi ye-SCM ngokusebenza kakhulu. Phatha imisebenzi ehlobene nokuthenga emkhakweni. Nikeza ukusekelwa okusebenza kahle kohlelo lokubhalisa. Phatha ukulahleka kwezinto.

xh.summary: Ukuqonda imisebenzi yohengamelo kubandakanya ukuthobela iimfuno ze-HRM, iinkonzo zeemali, nokuthengwa kwezinto kwi-SAPS Klerksdorp.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka abonise ukuziphatha kahle kwimisebenzi eyinhloko yesithuba. Kufuneka bakwazi ukusebenzisa ulwimi ngokubane ngesiNgesi nolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni. Ilayisense yokuqamba isiqhagamshelwano esebenzayo yemoto yokuhamba kwelinye iya kuba ngumohlombe. Ulwazi, Amandla, Nokuziphatha Ulwazi ngezixhobo ezithintela umsebenzi ezisebenza kumsebenzi kaWonke-wonke. Amandla amde apha Athetha kwaye abhale kakuhle ngesandla. Amandla amde okudibana nabantu. Ukubhala iingxelo. Amandla okubonisa, Amandla okusombulula iingxaki, uCwangciso oluLungele, uMisa nokuhamba-Hengamelo, Amandla amde okuHlola iingxaki kunye noMhla wokuhamba.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo zoLawulo lweeMisebenzi eZoBomi (HRM) nokuzeza kumthetho. Lawula inkxaso yeNkonzo yeMali nolawulo lokuhambisa imali. Lawula imisebenzi ye-SCM eyisebenziseyo nesebenzayo. Lawula imisebenzi ethintelwa ukuthengwa kwezinto kwicandelo. Nikeza inkxabo yokwenzela iNkonzo yoHengamelo eyisebenziseyo. Lawula uLawulo lokulahlekelwa.

Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud gelewer moet word. xh.summary: Kufunekwa i-Clerk wezokulawula kwi-SAPS eMmabatho ukunikeza inkxaso yezokulawula, yezomthuthwamsi,yezemali nabanini basebenzi kwinqanaba lomvuzo 5.

af.title: Arbeider
af.summary: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens soek 'n arbeider in Phokeng om skoonmaak en higiëne van SAPS persele te handhaaf, waarvoor 'n ABET Level 4- of Grade 9-sertifisat vereis word.

Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvoor dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud voorsien moet word. Wees in staat om te lees en te skryf. Vermoë om op 'n professionele wyse met ander amptenare om te gaan. Die vermoë om elementêre masjiene en toerusting te bedryf. Gewillig om wanneer nodig oorure te werk.
af.duties: Handhaaf 'n hoë vlak van higiëne in en om die werkplek met die skoonmaak van die SAPS persele toegewys aan, wat enersyds of beide binne- en buite-parameters kan insluit. Voer take van 'n roetine-aard uit, soos stofwis. Meubels en vloere opsny. Stofsuig matte, vloerteëls dweil en vullis verwyder. Voer instandhoudingstake in en om die toegewysde persele uit.
