zu.title: Umsebenzi wesandla
zu.summary: I-South African Police Service ifuna umsebenzi wesandla e-Phokeng ukugcina izindawo ze-SAPS zicoce kwaye ziphile kahle, kudinga isitifiketi se-ABET Level 4 noma i-Grade 9.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babonise ukuba khona kumisebenzi eyinhloko yesikhundla. Babe nobuhlakani ngokulandelana okungenani ngesiNgisi nolunye ulimi olusemthethweni. Babe ngabakhi bokuvela eRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika okufaka umbhalo ochazayo okumele unikezwe ngosuku olwenziwa khona ingxoxo. Babe nesitifiketi/sesiko se-ABET Level 4 / i-Grade 9 / i-Standard 7 (i-NQF level 1 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA), okufaka umbhalo ochazayo okungakhiqizwa uma kudingeka. Ulwazi, Amakhono namaKhono okuqonda: Ukuqonda indlela yokusebenzisa izinsimbi zasensimu. Amasiko okuqinisekisa ukuphila nokuphepha emsebenzini. Amakhono abalayo, ukubala nokuxoxa abakhulu. Ukukwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Isikhathi sokuxoxa nabanye abaphathi ngendlela ehloniphekile. Isikhathi sokusebenzisa izinsimbi nolunye uhlangothi uma kudingeka. Ukuzinikela ukusebenza amahora amakhulu uma kudingeka.
zu.duties: Gcina izinga elikhulu lokuhlanzwa endaweni yokusebenza nakuzona zonke izindawo ngekucocekisa izindawo ze-SAPS, okungaba ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle noma kokubili. Yenza imisebenzi yamalanga onke, njengokucofa. Coca izinto zasekhaya nezansi. Cocoza amakhavini, phuza amatayili ekhaya bese ususa izinkohliso. Yenza imisebenzi yokugcina endaweni yokusebenza nakuzo zonke izindawo. Hlanza izindlu zokuwasha nasekhikhini. Gcina futhi uphathe izinsiza eziningi ekunihlanzweni kwesikhungo. Hlanza futhi ucoce izinsimbi zekhishi nemikhiqizo.

xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babonise ukuziphatha kahle kumisebenzi esemqoka wesithuba. Babe lubugcisa kuncedo ngesiNgesi nolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni ngesinye. Babe ngabemi basaHlasele le Afrika abanobungqina bamafayile abuziswa kumhla wemvume. Babe nephepha le ABET Level 4 / Grade 9 / Standard 7 / ingxelo (NQF level 1 njengokuqatshwa yi SAQA), ekufuneka abanobungqina obuziswa xa kufunwa. Ulwazi, Amafundo nezakhono: Ukuqonda indlela yokuphatha izixhobo zesitiya. Iinkqubo zoLondolozo loMsebenzi nokuKhuseleko. Amandla abo bokufunda, ukubala nokunxibelelane. Bakwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Amandla okunxibelelana nabanye abasebenzi ngenkqubo ehloniphekileyo. Amandla okusebenzisa izixhobo ezilula namashini. Bakhululekile ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo xa kuyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Kugcinwe inqanaba eliphezulu lococo nzuzo kwindawo yokusebenza ngokucoca izakhiwo ze SAPS ezabelwe kuzo, ekunokubangwa ibe ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Kwenziwe imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla, efana nokutyhuda. Kucocwe iifenyitheka namaza. Kusindwe iindwana, kucocwe amaza abhotile kususwe undilima. Kwenziwe imisebenzi yolungiselelo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezakhiwo ezabelwe kuzo. Kucocwe iindlu zangasese ngeziko lokupheka. Kugcinwe kuphathwe izixhobo ezahlukeneyo zokucoca izakhiwo. Kutshatshwe kucocwe izixhobo zekhicini nezitya.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Production Economics (ELSENBURG)
jobs.centre: Department of Agriculture, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Production Economics at the Department of Agriculture in Elsenburg, requiring an NQF level 8 qualification in Economics or Agricultural Economics with six years of experience.

NB: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities, but who have reasonable access to transport, may also apply. Competencies: Working knowledge and understanding of the following: Agricultural sector; and working experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions; Information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function; Project management; Operational management practices; Procurement and tendering processes; Policy development, and operational management, monitoring and review processes; Modern systems of governance and administration; Public service procedures, processes and systems; Regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape; Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector; Public finance, human resources and discourse management processes; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements; Functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments/related functional areas; Policies of the government of the day; Labour Relations legislation and regulations; Performance management in general. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Produksie-ekonomie by die Departement of Agriculture in Elsenburg, wat 'n NQF vlak 8-kwalifikasie in Ekonomie of Landbou-ekonomie met ses jaar se ervaring vereis.

zu.title: Osobala: I-Economics YokuKhiqiza (ELSENBURG)

zu.requirements: Isifundo esifanele se-NQF level 8 noma esilinganayo ne-Economics kanye/noma i-Agricultural Economics njengezifundo ezinkulu; Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-6 yokuqashwa okuhambisana lapho kungeyona eminyakeni eyi-3 yokuqashwa kubuse; Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B noma ephezulu) esevela. NB: Abantu abanaso isikhathi sokuziphatha okubavimbele ekushayeleni, kodwa abanendlela ethembekile yokuhamba, bangafaka futhi isicelo. Ikhono: ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda okulandelayo: Isimo sezolimo; kanye nokuqashwa kokusebenza nomthetho, izakhiwo zokulawula, izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili ezithinta imisebenzi yomugqa; Izimiso ezinceda ekuphathweni kolwazi kanye nenfokathi ethinta umsebenzi womugqa; Ukuphatha amaphrojekhi; Izindlela zokuphatha izinhlelo; Inqubo yokuthenga kanye nokwenza izinkombiso; Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, kanye nokuphatha, ukubuka kanye nokuhlola izinhlelo; Izimiso zanamuhla zobuzi kanye nokuphatha; Izindlela, izinqubo neziiso zomphakathi; Izindaba zasedolobheni nasemakhaya ezezombusazwe, ezoqoqosho kanye nenzalo ezingena enkundleni kahulumeni wesifundazwe i-Western Cape; Izibuyaziso zomthetho, izomthetho kanye nezinhlelo ezilawula ummandla womphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika; Izezimali zomphakathi, abasebenzi kanye nezingqungqulu zokuphatha izinqubo; I-Public Finance Management Act, i-National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ezinye izinqubomgomo zezimali, imiyalo, izinhloso kanye nalezinkambiso; Ukusebenza kwesifundazwe kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango ekahle/izindawo ezihlobene nayo; Izinqubomgomo kahulumeni osengunaphakade; Umthetho kanye nemiyalo yezokuhambisana nomsebenzi; Ukuphatha ukusebenza ngokuvamile. Ikhono lokulandelayo: Ukubala; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ikhono lolimi; Ukuphatha Amaprojekhi; I-Accounting/ I-Finance/ I-Audit; Ikhono lokuphatha ngokobuchwepheshe nokuba ngumholi; Ikhono elikhulu lokuxhumana (elibhaliwe noma elikhulumayo/okuboniswe); Ikhono lokucinga (elikhulu); Ikhono elivezile ukwenza ucwaningo; Ikhono lokuhlaziya nokuba nezenzo ezihlonga ngomqondo wezinqubomgomo; Ikhono lokuwakha isixhumanisi.
zu.duties: Ucwaningo oluzayo nokujulile ngokuqhubeka kwemikhondo/gama/kwezinye izindawo ezithize zezolimo (isb. amathuluzi, ukukhiqizwa, ukuthengiswa, uguqulo, i-macro-economics, ukuphatha insimu, izinhlel zabantu bezolimo, unguvimbanzi wamazwe kanye nokuwakha, ukweseka amabhizinisi, ukuthuthukiswa kwemimango, ukuqoqwa kwezolimo/inhlathi yamandla); Ukuphatha ukuhlola/ukubona imibuzo/izinselelo ezoqoqosho endaweni/isimweni esithize (izifunda/izindawo ezithize, izimboni ezithize, izikhathi/izimo ezithize) ezithinta umthetho/isu/ inqubomgomo/inqubo yokungenisa/uvo lwezinsizakalo; Ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa, ukuguqulwa kanye/noma ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ukuze kubonakale isimo sanamuhla kanye/noma ukubikezela/ukukhangela izimo ezingaba khona; Ukucubungula kanye nokuphatha umsebenzi kanye nokuwavula wonke amaphuzu ukusebenza okuhle kwe-Sub-directorate; Ukuphatha Abantu.

Ikhono: Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda oku kulandelayo: Ummandla wezolimo; namava okusebenza ngomthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo zemigaqo nezithethe ezilungileyo ezinomdla kumisebenzi yemigca; Iinkqubo zelwazi ezisiza ekulawuleni ulwazi nolwazi malunga nomsebenzi womgca; Ukuqaliswa kweendaba; Iinkqubo zolawulo lokuqhuba; Inkcetho yokuqasha nokuqaliswa kweentengiso; Ukuphuhliswa kwezicwangciso, nolawulo lokuqhuba, ukulawula nokuqwalasela iinkqubo; Iinkqubo zangoku zolawulo noburhoxiswa; Iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezixhobo zesebe likarhulumente; Izinto ezengoxoxo yemida nezomnozo ezithintelwe urhulumente ophakathi weSiphakathi sase-Western Cape; Iinkqubo zomthetho somthetho, zomthetho ngeziko ezilawula urhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika; Iimali zikarhulumente, imithombo yabantu nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zoxoxo; UMthetho weNkcitho mali yikarhulumente, Iinkqubo zeNqila yelizwe neseSiphakathi, ezinye iinkqubo zeemali, imiyalelo, imigaqo nokuvumelwana; Ukusebenza kwephondo nemisebenzi yamaphanga ohlobene/iiqondo ezinxulumene nayo; Iinkqubo zikarhulumente wasemzantsi; Umthetho noMthetho weeNhlobo-bantu; Ukuqwalasela ukusebenza jikelele. Amandla okwenza oku kulandelayo: Ukubala; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Amandla eelwimi; Ukuqaliswa kweendaba; Ukuqwalasela iiMali/uQwalaselo; Amandla afanelekileyo obulungisa nokuqhutywa; Amandla ekuthetheni (okubhaliweyo nokuqhutywa/okubonwayo); Amandla okuxoxisana (aphezulu); Amandla abonakalisiweyo okwenza uphando; Amandla okuhlalutya nokuqamba iinkqubo; Amandla okudibanisa.
xh.duties: Uphononongo olujulileyo lonke/ophando lophuhliso/iinkqubo/ezikwelangoku kwemotho yezolimo ethile (umz. iindawo, ukuphuhliswa, ukuthengisa, ukulungiswa, iNzulu-mlando yomzimba, ulawulo lwesifama, ishishini lezolimo, urhwebo lwamanye amazwe nokutyalwa inkxaso-mali, inkxaso yoshishino, uphuhliso lwemiphakathi, ukucubungula iZolimo/umgca wolwabiyo-lwabiyo); Lawula ukuhlalutya/ukuchonga iimbuzo/iingxaki zezohlwayo kwimo/imeko ethile (iithemplete/iindawo ezithile, izhishini ezithile, iiganeko/imeko ezithile) ezithintelwe umthetho/isicwangciso/inkqubo/izithethe/iingxamiseko; Lawula ukusetyenziswa, ukulungiswa nokanye ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo ukwenzela ukubonisa imeko yangoku nokanye ukubikezela/ukubeka iinkqubo ezinokwenzeka; Cwangcisa ulawule umsebenzi kwaye ube nolwazi ngenkqubo jikelele yokusebenza koMqonde oNgezantsi; UkuLawula Abantu.

jobs.title: Candidate Scientist: Plant Sciences (3-YEAR Contract
jobs.centre: Department of Agriculture, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: R687 036 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (OSD as prescribed).
jobs.summary: Candidate Scientist in Plant Sciences sought by the Western Cape Department of Agriculture on a three-year contract to support research, compliance, and agri-processing advisory services.

jobs.duties: Assist in the implementation of methodologies, policies, systems and procedures; To assist in the facilitation of compliance; Provide advice to internal & external clients/stakeholders on Agri-processing for decision-making, initiatives and/or interventions within a specific environment; Provide capacity building.

jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. jobs.title: Chief Supply Chain Management Clerk: Payments and System
jobs.centre: Department of Agriculture, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Chief Supply Chain Management Clerk handling payments and system administration for the Western Cape Department of Agriculture.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate (Grade 12 or equivalent qualification); A minimum of 6 years’ experience in public sector supply chain management financial background. Let wel: Mense met gestremdhede wat bestuursvermoë beperk maar redelike toegang tot vervoer het, mag ook aansoek doen. Qaphela: Abantu abasimweni sokungalali esibawalela amandla okushayela kodwa benomthelela othile kwezokuthutha bangaphinda bafake isicelo. Amandla: Ulwazi ngakulesi simo: Ukusebenzisa umthetho wesimo sezulu; ukuhumusha uMthethosisekelo weRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika noMthethosisekelo wase Western Cape ohlobene nokuphathwa kwesimo sezulu; ukusebenzisa izimiso zokuphathwa kwesimo sezulu; ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo namashadi oMnyango weQoqo loMnyango; ukugcina ukubhalisa ngobungcweti kwi-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP); ukuqeda ukuqeqeshwa okukhethekile kwe-botanical namakilasi kwi-Fynbos; ukusebenzisa ulwazi namasu e-botanical ekuphathweni kwesimo sezulu, ngokubhekise kukho okukhethekileko esifundazweni se Western Cape; ukuhumusha futhi usebenzise umthetho ohlobene nesimo sezulu eNingizimu Afrika; ukuqhuba imisebenzi yokwandisa ulwazi ngamasu e-botanical; ukuqhuba ucwaningo futhi uhlole imibiko yobuchwepheshe; ukusebenzisa ulwazi olusukela esigabeni esisisa kuye koluhlukile mayelana nezitshalo namafilosi ezomhlabathi futhi/noma amanzi amsulwa, ukusebenza kwazo nokuhlangana kwazo ndawonye nendawo yamaphili e Western Cape.
zu.duties: Nikela ngentuthuko yezimiso (okuhlanganisa izimiso zokuphathwa kolwazi), inqubo yokuthatha izinqumo, izinqubomgomo namaphrotokholi ukukhuthaza futhi zigcine izimiso ezingapheli, izindawo eziphilile kanye nezimo zendawo (okuhlanganisa isimo sesikhungo sesidolobha) kanye nendawo ezingapheli esifundazweni se Western Cape; Yenza imisebenzi yokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, yokulawula kanye nokuQamba imibiko futhi uthumele imibilo eyayiniwe e ephathelene ephathelene nokunidululwa futhi; e e ekuquandwa kwimipakathi empephahle e e ekqandise imibilo ngaleso ukumatlfile kwenhlose kwenkobakanya ngokweza, kumatlile atholakile emkhakheni we Western Cape. Yenza ngemiphumela eyolula kwisidumbu esingalawulwa emhlabeni namakhemikhali eziphuma ezohlolweni okuthole kwaba esemthethweni ukwahola ngesikhathi inkinga ekuquandweni yamakhosi eseyuka ukwemisebenzi yezimeko ezenzeko zingakagcinwanga emthethweni wekhasitini inilifu ngokuthi kule ndawo kadingeki ukuthi ahudule imibuzo yabantu e ekhisho i Western Cape kumakhelwane ephumayo kubuza imidazo yokungeza umkhakaba we imidazo.

xh.title: ISIKHULU Sokulawula Iimeko Zendalo Inqanaba A: Phuhliswa
xh.summary: Kufuneka isikhulu sokulawula iimeko zendelo ezakha iinkqubo, iinkqubomphambano neenqobo ezikhuthaza iimojula ezihlala ngonaphakade kunye neendawo eziphilile ezingokwemvelo kulo onke amazwe ase Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seminyaka eli-4 (okanye isifaniso sokugqiba kwamafundwe) kwilawulo lemeleko zendalo, ISayensi Yemvelo okanye ISayensi Yendalo okanye indawo enomdla ongafaniyo nayo inoxhathisaathi yiBotany njengesihloko esingunaphakade; Ubuncinane leminyaka engama-6 yamava ahambelana nokugqiba kwamafundwe; Ilayisenisi yokuqeshela enyani (iKhowudi B okanye ngaphezulu). Qaphela: Abantu abanokuphathwa kokungakwazi ukurhoxa abanjalo bakaqondwa kwelawulo kodwa bafikelele kalula kwiindawo zokuhamba banganako nakwenza isicelo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuqhuba okulandelayo: Qhuba umthetho wendalo; tlhaga uMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika nakuMgaqo-siseko wase Western Cape ngokwela lawulo lemeleko zendalo; sebenzisa iinkqubomphambano zolawulo lwendalo; qhuba iinkqubomphambano neenqobo zeNkundla kunye neSebe; gcina udatshiso wokuqesheswa eNtsimbi i South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP); thatha isikhokelo sethalamxholo ngokukhethekileyo kwiiFynbos nakumakhosi apho ukubonwa okukhethiwe kwakho kurunyuzwe; dlulisa ulwazi ngamakhosi aye aqwale ukwenza ulawulo lwemeleko zendalo, oko kukho ngokukhomba ngokukhethekileko iNgingqi ye Western Cape Province; tlhaga kwaye ulusebenzise umthetho othe ngqo wendalo ngokweliGunya lokwakha iNgingqi ye Western Cape; sebenzisa iinkqubo zokwenza olu lwazi lwe botanical lufikelele kwazwi nabantu ngokubanzi; qhuba uphando lwaye uqhube iinkcazelo ngokubhalisa nge botanical.
xh.duties: Nceda ekwakheni iinkqubo (kuquka iinkqubo zokuphatha ulwazi), iinkqubo zokugqiba ngokomyalelo, iinkqubomphambano neenqobo ukwazi ukukhusela nokusingatha iimojula ezintle zendalo, endaweni apho abantu bahlala khona (ehlotyeni lwebala elingokwasemithi yezidumbu), nendalo ehlala ngokonakeleyo kwiNgingqi ye Western Cape Province; Sebenza ngokubonelela ngegqiqqo elinesayensi, elinalawulo nemisebenzi yokuxhumanisa ekunokubakho kwaye ulandela ngeshishikiswa okanye iinkcazelo ngokuhlukana kobomi; Qalisa okanye ungenele kumajoni aphakathi kwelinye na elinye ukwakha isakhono sokusingatha okuthe ngqo ngokunika iinkcazelo ngokubala ngesiNtu; Sebenzisa iinkqubo zokukhangela ngenkalo zentshukumo ngokubakwa kwendalo ekukhutshiwe kwaye wenze uqhanqeela iimfuno zokwenza umthetho wezilumkiso ekunzimeni.

jobs.title: Environmental Officer (SPECIALISED Production): Response
jobs.department: Department of Environmental Affairs and Development Planning
jobs.salary_text: R518 769 - R717 846 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Environmental officer role in the Western Cape supporting climate change research, project proposal development and awareness-raising for the Department of Environmental Affairs.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 4 Year Honours Degree in Natural, Physical or Environmental Sciences or relevant Engineering qualification or equivalent; A valid Code B (or higher) driving license. Note: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities but have reasonable access to transport may also apply. Competencies: Working knowledge of the following: Climate Change research and implementation activities; Strategic thinking and passionate about environmental issues; Development and or the implementation of policies, legislation, strategies, action plans, guidelines and environmental norms and standards; Mainstreaming and capacity building climate change programmes; Development and rollout of budgeting, financing and funding models. Skills in the following: Excellent communications (written, verbal and presentation) skills; Computer literacy in MS Office Packages (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Internet use skills including research and appropriate ethical use of Artificial Intelligence; Project Management; Research and Report Writing; Strategic Planning; Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Provide support to / lead on research projects (e.g. Climate Change Adaptation and Gender Mainstreaming); Making technical contributions to the development of concept notes and project proposals; Assist with communication and awareness-raising for the unit (i.e. website updates, awareness materials, case studies, presentations); Maintain and keep up to date climate change response projects database; Develop presentations on climate change responses & deliver them to government, civil society and business; Organise meetings, climate change awareness events, seminars and conferences; Participate in Strategic planning and programmes at the Chief Directorate and Directorate level; Supporting the Climate Change Municipal Support Programme, Municipal IDP reviews, the departmental municipal support programme reporting requirements, SIME, TIME and ad-hoc engagements; Respond to ad-hoc climate change matters arising within the Departmental (i.e. Attend, provide input and report back of relevant forums and events, inputs into minister’s monthly report, sub directorate meetings); Compile the Westen Cape Climate Change Response Biennial M&E Report (Data acquisition); Undertake Pilot Climate Budget Tagging for the municipalities for the purpose of project data collection and climate related finance determination for the financial year; Support the integration of climate change into sector and stakeholder group strategies and programmes; Provide support on the development, implementation and review of the Western Cape Climate Change Adaptation Pathway project; Assist in commenting on the policy, legislation and ministerial queries relating to adaptation and climate resilience; Support with research and knowledge management; Contribute to sourcing additional funding for climate change projects and explore financing mechanisms and opportunities with other stakeholders in the climate change space; Project Management.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Gerard van Weele Tel No: (021) 483 2791
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte (GESPECIALISEERDE Produksie): Response
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte-rol in die Western Cape wat klimaatsverandering-navorsing, die ontwikkeling van projekvoorstelle en bewusmaking vir die Department of Environmental Affairs ondersteun.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 4 Year Honours Degree in Natuur-, Fisiese- of Omgingswetenskappe of 'n tersyde Ingenieurskwalifikasie of gelykwaardig; 'n Geldige Code B (of hoër) bestuurslisensie. Let wel: Mense met gestremdhede wat bestuursvermoëns beperk, maar redelike toegang tot vervoer het, kan ook aansoek doen. Bevoegdhede: Werkkennis van die volgende: Klimaatverandering-navorsing en implementeringsaktiwiteite; Strategiese dink en passie vir omgewingsake; Ontwikkeling en of die implementering van beleide, wetgewing, strategieë, aksieplanne, riglyne en omgewingsnorme en -standaarde; Hoofstrooming en kapasiteitsbou van klimaatsveranderingsprogramme; Ontwikkeling en uitrol van begrotings-, finansierings- en befondsingsmodelle. Vaardighede in die volgende: Uitstekende kommunikasie (skriftelik, mondelings en aanbieding) vaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office-pakkette (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Internetgebruikvaardighede insluitend navorsing en toepaslike etiese gebruik van Kunsmatige Intelligentie; Projekbestuur; Navorsing en verslagskrywing; Strategiese beplanning; Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning aan / lei navorsingsprojekte (bv. Klimaatsverandering-aanpassing en Geslagshoofstrooming); Maak tegniese bydraes tot die ontwikkeling van konsepnotas en projekvoorstelle; Bied hulp met kommunikasie en bewusmaking vir die eenheid (d.w.s. webwerf-opdaterings, bewusmakingsmateriaal, gevallestudies, aanbiedings); Onderhou en hou die databasis van klimaatsveranderingsreaksieprojekte op datum; Ontwikkel aanbiedings oor klimaatsveranderingsreaksies en lewer dit aan regering, burgerlike samelewing en besigheid; Reël vergaderings, klimaatsveranderings-bewusmakingsgeleenthede, seminare en konferensies; Neem deel aan strategiese beplanning en programme op Hoofdirektoraat- en Direktoraatvlak; Ondersteun die Klimaatsverandering Munisipale Ondersteuningsprogram, Munisipale IDP-hersienings, die departementele munisipale ondersteuningsprogram se verslagdoeningsvereistes, SIME, TIME en ad hoc-betrokkenhede; Reageer op ad hoc-klimaatsveranderingsake wat binne die Departementele ontstaan (d.w.s. Bywoon, insette lewer en terugvoer gee van relevante forums en geleenthede, insette tot minister se maandelikse verslag, subdirektoraatvergaderings); Stel die Westen Cape Klimaatsverandering Respons Tweejaarlikse M&E-verslag op (Data verkryging); Onderneem Loods-Klimaat Begrotingsmerking vir die munisipaliteite vir die doeleindes van projekdata-insameling en klimaatverwante finansiebepaling vir die boekjaar; Ondersteun die integrasie van klimaatsverandering in sektor- en belanghebbende groepstrategieë en programme; Verskaf ondersteuning met die ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van die Western Cape Klimaatsverandering-aanpassingsroete projek; Bied hulp met kommentaar op beleid, wetgewing en ministeriële navrae rakende aanpassing en klimaatweerbaarheid; Ondersteun met navorsing en kennisbestuur; Dra by tot die verkryging van bykomende befondsing vir klimaatsveranderingsprojekte en verken finanseringsmeganismes en geleenthede met ander belanghebbendes in die klimaatsveranderingsruimte; Projektbestuur.

zu.title: Iphethuhi Lemvelo (Okukhethekile Ukukhiqizwa): Impendulo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sophethuhi bemvelo eWestern Cape esekela ucwaningo loshintsho lwesimo sezulu, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zephrojekthi kanye nokwandisa ulwazi ngomnyango Wezabantu Nemvelo.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Honours eyanele yeminyaka emi-4 kwezEzemvelo, eZomzimba noma eZesayensi Yemvelo noma iziqu zokujula ezingokwezobunjini noma okulinganayo; Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code B (noma ngaphezulu) evumelekile. Qaphela: Abantu abanesimo sokuba khona okusibophezela amandla okushayela kodwa banokufinyelela okuhambisana kwezokuthutha bangafaka futhi izicelo. Ikhono: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwalokhu okulandelayo: ucwaningo lwoshintsho lwesimo sezulu kanye nemisebenzi yokuphatha ukwesekwa kwemithetho; ukucabanga ngokobuchule nokuba nokuzibophezela kwezindaba zemvelo; ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuphatha ukwesekwa kwemithetho, izinqamuli, izu zokusetshenziswa, amaphulani okwenza izinto, imiqondo ohlelo kanye nezindinganiso nemigomo yemvelo; ukufaka ezinhleleni eziyisiseko kanye nokwakha ikhono ukuze kunqotshwe ukushintshwa kwesimo sezulu kwamaphulo; ukuthuthukiswa nokusakaza kwamasheke wokuhlela imali, ukuxhaswa ngemali nokuhlola izindlela zokuxhaswa. Amandla kulokhu okulandelayo: amandla aphathwa kahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe, okuthethwayo nokwethula); ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kumaphakheji we-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); amandla okusebenzisa i-intanethi kuhlanganise ucwaningo nokusetshenziswa okuhambisana nomthetho we-Artificial Intelligence; ukuphatha amaphrojekthi; ucwaningo kanye nokubhala imibiko; ukuhlela ngokobuchule; ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimela kanye nokuba yingxenye yethimu.
zu.duties: Nika inkethulo / yiba ngumholi kuphrojekthi zocwaningo (isb. Ukuzivumela koshintsho lwesimo sezulu kanye nokufaka ubulili ezinhlelweni eziyisiseko); Yenza izinhlayiya zezobuchule ekuthuthukisweni kwezinkomba zombono kanye nezinhlelo zephrojekthi; Siza ngokuxhumana kanye nokwandisa ulwazi kuleyunith (okungukuthi, ukubuyekeza iwebhusayithi, izinto zokwandisa ulwazi, izifundo ezivezwa izimo, izinkulumo zokwethula); Gcina ubuhlalu bemininingwane begazi ngaphambili futhi usize ushintsho lwesimo sezulu kumaphrojekthi okusekelwe ezimeni eziphendulayo; Thutha izinkulumo zokwethula ngemipendulo yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu kanye nokuzethula kuhulumeni, emphakathini wabantu kanye kwezabhizinisi; Hlela izinkomishini, izehlakalo zokwandisa ulwazi ngoshintsho lwesimo sezulu, amaseminari kanye nenganekwane; Thatha inhlangothi ekuhlelweni ngokobuchule nakumaphulo ezingeni le-Chief Directorate kanye ne-Directorate; Ukusekela i-Climate Change Municipal Support Programme, ukubuyekeza i-Municipal IDP, izidingo zokubika iphrograbhu yokusekela amasipala yomnyango, i-SIME, i-TIME kanye nokuhlanganyela okungenwe okungenziwe; Phendula izinto ezingenzeka ngokushintshwa kwesimo sezulu eziphakelayo ngaphakathi komnyango (okungukuthi zihlale, nikeza imibono kanye nibikele emhlanganweni ohambisanayo nasezehlakalweni, imibono embikweni wezonyanga ngenyanga, izinkomishini zesob-direktorethi); Hlela umbiko we-Western Cape Climate Change Response Biennial M&E (Ukuqoqwa kwemininingwane); Yenza ukuzama okukhombiswa ukubeka igeji yemali yamasipala ukwenzela ukutholwa kwemininingwane yephrojekthi kanye nokunquma ukwesekwa ngemali okuhlobene noshintsho lwesimo sezulu ngonyaka wezimali; Sekela ukufakwa koshintsho lwesimo sezulu ezinhlelweni zamasemu kanye namaphulo amaqembu abanomdaka; Nikeza inkethulo ekuthuthukisweni, ukuphatha ukwesekwa kanye nokubuyekeza iphrojekthi ye-Western Cape Climate Change Adaptation Pathway; Siza ukuphawula ngenqubo, imithetho kanye nemibuzo yomnyango ephathelene nokuzivumela nokumelana noshintsho lwesimo sezulu; Sekela ngocwaningo kanye nolawulo lolwazi; Yisela ekutholeni ukwesekwa okwengeziwe kwemali yamaphrojekthi oshintsho lwesimo sezulu futhi uhlola izindlela namathuba okuxhaswa ngemali kanye nabanye abantu ababambe iqhaza enkundleni yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu; ukuphatha amaphrojekthi.

xh.title: Isoqa Isebe lezendalo (UMSEBENZI OQEQESWE NGAKAKUBI Production): Impendulo
xh.summary: Indima yesoqa ibe le zendalo kwi-Western Cape exhasa ucando lokuphonononga utshintsho lwesimo sezulu, ukuqulunqwa kweengcamango zamaphulo eprojekthi nokwandisa ulwazi malunga nesebe lezeendalo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Honours seminyaka eli-4 elifanelekileyo kwiZayensi eZemvelo, eZoBuchule okanye eZendlalo, okanye isigaba sobugcisa obuziinzunzo obuhambelana nalo okanye esilinganayo; Ilayisenisi yokushayela ye-Code B (okanye ephezimo). Qaphela: Abantu abanokuvala okubakhawuleza ukukwazi ukushayela kodwa abanokufikelela kwizithuthi ngendlela efanayo banako nabo ukusebenzisa. Iimfuno zakhono: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngalolu hlobo lulandelayo: Uphononongo kotshintsho lwesimo sezulu nemisebenzi yokuqaliswa kwayo; Ukucinga ngenqanaba eliphezulu noku zithanda iindaba ezimalunga nendalo; Ukuqulunqa nokuyisebenzisa iindlela zolawulo, umthetho, iindlela ezahlukeneyo, iplani zenyuso, iingqondo ezalathayo namagunya nezitathaga emthethweni zeendalo; Ukuqhubela phambili nokwakha amandla emisebenzi yotshintsho lwesimo sezulu; Ukuqulunqa nokusebenzisa iindlela zokulinganisa imali, ukufumaniswa kwayo nokuyixhasa. Ulwazi ngalolu hlobo lulandelayo: Ulwazi olugqithisileyo lokunxibelelwana (elubhalwe ngelo, elothethwayo nelomboniso); Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwiinkqubo ze-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Ukusebenzisa i-intanethi kuquka uphononongo nokusebenzisa uBokoloko obuqeleliswe ngesigqi ngoBugcisa obungenamntu; Ulawulo lweProjekthi; Uphononongo nokubhala iingxelo; Ukuqulunqa iindlela ezahlukeneyo; Amandla okusebenza wedwa nangaphakathi kweqela.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso / yiba ngumthelela weprojekthi zophononongo (umz. ukuqwalasela ukutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu nokuqhubela phambili amabunga abantu); Wela ngaphezulu isandla esinobugcisa ekulungelelweni kweengcamango zemibono namaphulo eprojekthi; Nceda kwindlela yokunxibelelana nokwandisa ulwazi kwicandelo (oko kukuthi, ukuvuselelwa kwebhusayithi, izinto zokwandisa ulwazi, iingxelo zemodeli, iinkcukacha zemiboniso); Hlala uqinisekisa uvuselela ugcinwe iqhosha isiseko sedata yonsebenzi wokuqwalasela ukutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu; Qamba iinkcukacha zemiboniso ngokuqwalasela ukutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu uzithwalele kumalunga karhulumente, kwisixeko nasemabhizinini; Hlela iindibano, iinkqubo zokwazisa ngokutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu, amanqanaba nemigqibo; Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuhlela iindlela nezicwangciso kumqondiso oyiNkundla kunye nesebe ngokwalelo; Nxibelelanisa inkxaso kwiNkqubo yeNkxaso yaseWestern Cape kumasebe esiNganganya kundlu, ukuphononongwa kwe-IDP, iimfuno zokuvelisa iingxelo zenkxaso yamasipala kwesebe, i-SIME, i-TIME nokuvela kwiindibano ezingachwatezisiyo; Phendula izinto eziphuthumayo ngokutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu ezibakho kwisebe (oko kukuthi, khangela, ngenisa ingqumbo uze uchaze iingxelo kumabunga anelwe kukhoyo neendibano, ngenisa iingxelo kumbhalo weyure ka-Nduna yenyanga, iindibano zommandla ongaphantsi); Qulunqa iNgxelo yeM&E yeBiennial yokuzisela impendulo kwi-Western Cape ngokutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu (ukulandelwa kwedatha); Yenza uwohloko lokuqaqambisa imali yemali yokutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu kwimasipala ngenjongo yokuthuthwa kweedata zeprojekthi nokugqithiswa kwemali ehambelana nokutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu kule minyaka yemali; Yiba ngenxaxheba kokubizwa ngokutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu kwindlela namacebo amanqanaba eqela labantu basekelwa ngawo; Nika inkxaso ekulungelelweni, ekusebenziseni nasekuguqulweni kweProjekthi yoNdlela yokuzisela impendulo kwi-Western Cape ekutshintshweni kwesimo sezulu; Nceda ngengqumbo ngeendleba ngumthetho, imithetho nangemibuzo ka-Nduna malunga nokuziqhelanisa nokumisela ukungena ukutshintshwa kwesimo sezulu; Yiba ngenxaxheba ekuphuhindweni kwedatha nasekulawuleni ulwazi; Yila ngaphezulu isandla ekufumaneni imali engeyiyo ezingakaniselwa kumapulo okutshintsha isimo sezulu uze ujonge iindlela namathuba okuyixhasa namanye amalunga eqela lobusela ekwindawo yotshintsho lwesimo sezulu; ULawulo lweProjekthi.

jobs.reference_number: EADP 28/2026 Department of Environmental Affairs and Development Planning
jobs.title: Environmental Officer Specialised Production
jobs.department: Department of Environmental Affairs and Development Planning
jobs.summary: Environmental officer sought to administer contaminated land sites, providing specialist technical advice on pollution and chemical matters under NEMA and NEMWA.
jobs.requirements: Honours level degree (NQF 8) with majors in Natural / Physical Sciences or Environmental Management or Engineering (an appropriate equivalent qualification). Competencies: Knowledge: Apply the National Environmental Management Act (NEMA) and the National Environmental Management: Waste Act (NEMWA), particularly Part 8 on contaminated land; implement the Environmental Management Inspectorate (EMI) framework; manage pollution incidents; implement environmental compliance and enforcement processes; conduct environmental risk assessments; apply remediation technologies and contaminated land management principles; manage chemicals and hazardous substances in accordance with applicable requirements; implement relevant international conventions and agreements relating to pollution and chemicals management; implement Public Service legislation, policies and procedures; apply project and stakeholder management principles; Skills: perform numeracy and literacy functions; drive vehicles; use computer systems effectively; communicate effectively in the required language; manage projects; perform basic financial tasks; compile and write reports; manage time effectively.
jobs.duties: Process and provide specialist input on the administration of contamination land sites, including assessment, management and monitoring of remediation of contaminated sites; Provide specialist technical advice and guidance on environmental reports and submissions (relating to pollution and chemicals management) to organs of state and other stakeholders, ensuring compliance with environmental legislation; Coordinate and provide specialist scientific, technical and regulatory support for the management of pollution-related complaints and section 30 of NEMA incidents; Assist with general administration, quality assurance, reporting and project support within the unit.

jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology wanted at Groote Schuur Hospital to manage specialist anaesthetic patients and provide academic leadership across several related hospitals.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Anaesthesiology. Inherent requirements of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Proven record of effective leadership and organisational ability in clinical Anaesthesia and Perioperative Medicine. Comprehensive skills and experience in leadership, administration and management related to anaesthesia and peri-operative medicine. Computer literacy, good communication, analytic and problem-solving skills. Insight into challenges in Health Care in South Africa and Africa, and diversity, transformation and equity. Ability to function well in a team environment and a team player, with good inter-personal skills. Strong moral and ethical record in anaesthetic practice. Strong educational or teaching experience background in both the under and post-graduate domains. Willingness to participate in the CMSA exams. Research experience.
jobs.duties: (key result areas/outputs): The management of specialist anaesthetic patients within the Department and at related hospitals to Groote Schuur, Red Cross War Memorial Children's, New Somerset and Mowbray Maternity Hospitals. Provide academic leadership in the areas of under - and postgraduate teaching, training and research. Provide comprehensive clinical services. Organise and contribute to the anaesthetic skills training courses. Manage and provide leadership to colleagues and contribute significantly to the administrative duties of the combined department including, assessments and performance management. Contribute to the administration and management of the department and provide outreach and support to referring institutions. Build and maintain Departmental team spirit and development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. Groote Schuur Hospital has adopted the department’s ecosystem framing of its training platform. Accordingly, all medical specialist appointments may be called upon to work across this platform and may include rotations at Metro West and Rural East hospitals. This includes Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, New Somerset Hospital, Mitchells Plein District Hospital, Victoria Hospital and George Provincial Hospital. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. zu.title: Iziqu ze-Dokotela Wezokwelapha Ezinga 1 kuye kwe-3 (AMA-ANESTHETICS)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Iziqu ze-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur Hospital ukuphatha abaguli ababamba iqhaza kwi-anaesthetic kanye nokunikeza ubuqhawe bezemfundo kulo lonke uchungechunge lwezibhedlela ezihlobene.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingavunyelwe ngaphansi: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengewe-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Ukubhaliswa emkhandlwini oyi-professional: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengewe-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Isiphiwo: Inkinga 1: Akukho okulindelekile emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengewe-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Inkinga 2: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-5 yempilo yomuntu ngamunye njengewe-Dokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA (noma emkhandlwini we-Foreign Health Professional Council oqashwa kubasebenzi abafunde emaphandaleni) njengewe-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Inkinga 3: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-10 yempilo yomuntu ngamunye njengewe-Dokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA (noma emkhandlwini we-Foreign Health Professional Council oqashwa kubasebenzi abafunde emaphandaleni) njengewe-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Izingidingo ezikhuleke emsebenzini: Ukusebenza ngemvama yokuhlola kuyadingeka ngokumthetho. Amakhono (olwazi/iziqu): I-recycle yesithombe esikhona sokulawula kanye nethonya leqhawe ekwelapheni i-Anaesthesia kanye ne-Perioperative Medicine. Amakhono aphelele kanye nalolwazi ekulawuleni, ekuphatheni naseqaphelweni kwindawo ye-anaesthesia kanye ne-peri-operative medicine. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana, ukuhlaziya kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuqonda izinselelo ekwelapheni impilo eNingizimu Afrika nase-Afrika, kanye nokuahlukahluka, ukuguqula kanye nokulingana. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle emkhakheni weqembu kanye nokuba yilungu leqembu elihamba phambili, ngamakhono aphelele abantu. I-recycle eqinile yemfundo kanye nendlela yokuziphatha ekwelapheni i-anaesthetic. Isiphiwo esiqinile semfundo noma ukufundisa kokufunda kokuthuthuka kweziqu ezingaphansi kwaye nangaphezulu kwamabanga. Ukuzithoba ukuthatha inxaxheba kuzivivinyo ze-CMSA. Isiphiwo sokucwaninga.
zu.duties: (izindawo eziyisiphetho/izinkomba): Ukuphatha abaguli ababamba iqhaza kwi-anaesthetic ngaphakathi komnyango nasezibhedlela ezihlobene njenge-Groote Schuur, Red Cross War Memorial Children's, New Somerset kanye ne-Mowbray Maternity Hospitals. Ukunikeza ubuqhawe bezemfundo kumaphuphu okufundisa, okuqeqesha kanye nokucwaninga kokuthuthuka kweziqu ezingaphansi kwaye nangaphezulu. Ukunikeza izinsiza eziphelele zokwelapha. Ukuhlela kanye nokugalela ekufundiseni amakhono we-anaesthetic. Ukuphatha kanye nokunikeza ubuqhawe obuhamba phambili abantu abahlobene kwaye ube negalelo elibalulekile kumaphuphu okuphatha ohlangene womnyango okubandakanya, okuqashwa kanye nokuphatha ukusebenza. Ukugalela ekuphatheni naseqaphelweni komnyango kanye nokunikeza ithuba lokuqhuba kwaye uxhase izikhungo eziyathumela. Ukwakha kwaye ulondoloze umoya weqembu kumnyango kanye nentluko.

xh.title: Igcisa lezonyanga Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (I-ANAESTHETICS)

Ukubhalisa kunye nenkundla yamagcisa abangcali: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogcisa wezonyanga kwi-Anaesthesiology. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogcisa wezonyanga kwi-Anaesthesiology. Inqanaba 2: Ukuze kube nkqo eminye yeminyaka eli-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengogcisa wezonyanga emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye i-Health Professional Council yamanye amazanga ekuqatshelwa kubasebenzi abangamagq athengiswe ngaphandle) njengogcisa wezonyanga kwi-Anaesthesiology. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: I-overtime ecutshwa ngokuthe ngqo iyinyaniso. Iakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Irekhodi eqinisiweyo yoninkokhelo elisebenzayo nokuzoba kwi-clinical Anaesthesia nase-Perioperative Medicine. Ii-akhono ezibandakanyekayo nolwazi ekuninkhelo, ekulawuleni nasekuphathweni ngokuhambelana ne-anaesthesia naye i-peri-operative medicine. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, isaziba sokuziba ukunyanzelwa, ukwahlulela nokusombulula iingxaki. Iqondo elingagungqiyo kwiingxaki ezoNyango lwezeempilo eMzantsi Afrika nase-Afrika, nakunzinzo, iinguqulelo nokulingana. Ukwazi ukusebenza kakuhle kwendalo yeqela kwaye ube ngumdlali weqela, ngee-akhono ezilulo kumntu nomntu. Ireyikodi eqinileyo yomoya nemiqathango kumsebenzi we-anaesthetic. Isiphiwo esomeleleyo semfundo okanye yokufundisa kokubu kokwamabanga asezantsi nawaphezulu kwesikolo. Ukulungelelanisa ukuthatha inxaxheba kwi-putsede ze-CMSA. Ulwazi kuphandolwiso.
xh.duties: (iindawo eziphumelelayo eziyimiphumo/okuphumayo): Ukulawula abaguli abangcwele be-anaesthetic ngaphakathi kwiSebe nakumabhedlela ahambelana nayo i-Groote Schuur, i-Red Cross War Memorial Children's, i-New Somerset nase-Mowbray Maternity Hospitals. Kunika inkokhelo yezemfundo kummandla wokufundisa kolwamabanga asezantsi nawaphezulu, ukuqeqesha nokuphanda. Kunika iinkonzo ezingagungqiyo ze-clinical. Ukuqamba kanjalo nokusingatha iindonga zokuqeqesha i-akhono ze-anaesthetic. Ukulawula kanjalo nokunika inkokhelo kubahlobo bangaphandle kwaye ungene ngamandla kumsebenzi wolawulo wesebe ehlangene, kuquka nezahluzo nolawulo lokusebenza. ungene ekulawuleni nasekuphathweni kwesebe kanjalo unike inkonzo yokunyuka ngenkxaso kwindawo ezithumela abaguli. Yakha kwaye ulondoloze umoya wesiqu kwisebe kanjalo nophuhliso.

Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Anestesiologie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om as deel van die uitbreidingsprogram te reis. Bereidwilligheid om buite-ure te werk om aan operasionele vereistes te voldoen. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Bewys van multidissiplinêre spanwerk en uitstekende interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Bewys van beplanning en uitvoering van klinies relevante en impakvolle navorsingsprojekte as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Anestesiologie. Bewys van vermoë om registrateurs in Anestesiologie te superviseer, insluitend voorbereiding vir hul Fellowship-eksamen in Anestesiologie. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf perioperatiewe pasiëntsorg in die teaters en kritieke sorgeenhede teen die standaarde wat van 'n Spesialis Anestesioloog vereis word. Onderrig en voordragte in Anestesiologie en Kritieke Sorg aan voorgraadse studente, nagraadse studente en porture. Evaluasie van studente en porture. Bly op hoogte van die jongste ontwikkelings in die veld van Anestesiologie en Kritieke Sorg. Administrasie: Hospitaal- en universiteitsverwante administratiewe take. Navorsing verwant aan Anestesiologie en Kritieke sorg, en verwante onderwerpe, wat behels die fasilitering van die navorsingskomponent wat deur registrateurs by die HPCSA vir spesialiteitsregistrasie vereis word, en publisering in portuur-ge-evalueerde, geakkrediteerde joernale.

zu.title: Izazi sezokwelapha Ezikhundleni sezinga 1 kuya ku-3 (I-ANAESTHESIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Kufunwa iNkulu Yezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology eTygerberg Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesikhathi esiphakathi kokuqalwa kokwelashwa kanye nokufundisa abafundi abangenamazinga nabanamazinga.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezenzakalelayo: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukuqanjwa kwamagama ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Ukuqanjwa kwamagama kumkhandlu wezobungcweti: Ukuqanjwa kwamagama ku-HPCSA njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho esidingwa ngemuva kokuqanjwa kwamagama ku-HPCSA njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha ngemuva kokuqanjwa kwamagama ku-HPCSA (noma umkhandlu wezempilo wamazwe ngaphandle ovunyiwe mayelana nomsebenzisi othole iziqu kwezinye izwe) njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha ngemuva kokuqanjwa kwamagama ku-HPCSA (noma umkhandlu wezempilo wamazwe ngaphandle ovunyiwe mayelana nomsebenzisi othole iziqu kwezinye izwe) njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Isidingo esingokoqobo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nokulungele ukuhamba njengengxenye ohlelweni lokuxhumanisa nabantu. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngemva kwezinsuku zomsebenzi ukuze kuhlangabezwe nezidingo zokusebenza. Izikhozenzo (ulwazi/amasu): Ubufakazi bokusebenza ndawonye kuleyo minyakazo yezikhathi ezahlukene nokuba nobudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ubufakazi bokuhlela kanye nokuphumeza imiphakamiswa yocwaningo enamathelayo ahambisana nezokwelapha enomthelela njengeNkulu Yezokwelapha kwi-Anaesthesiology. Ubufakazi bokukwazi ukulawla ababhalisiwe ezinhlelweni zobudokotela abaqeqeshwa kwi-Anaesthesiology, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela ukuhlolelwa ibhidlalo leFellowship kwi-Anaesthesiology. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa kwesikhathi esiphakathi kokuqalwa kokwelashwa kwesiguli kumanethi wokusebenza kanye nezinye izinto ezinakekelwa ngokuyisibalo ezidingweni zezazi ezingabhekisisi abagula ngeso. Ukufundisa nokuveza izinkulumo nge-Anaesthesiology kanye nokunakekelwa ngokuyisibalo abafundi abangenamazinga, abafundi abanamazinga kanye nabalingani. Ukuhlola abafundi nabalingani. Ukuhlala usegameni lokuthuthuka kwamuva nje emkhakheni we-Anaesthesiology kanye nokunakekelwa ngokuyisibalo. Ukuphatha: Imisebenzi yokuphatha ehlotshaniswa neSibhedlela neNyuvesi. Ucwaningo oluhlotshaniswa ne-Anaesthesiology kanye nokunakekelwa ngokuyisibalo, kanye nezihloko ezihlotshaniswa, okuhlanganisa ukweseka ingxenye yocwaningo edingwa bababhalisiwe ezinhlelweni zobudokotela yi-HPCSA ukuze bazingelwe kuleyo minyakazo futhi kushicilelwe kwamajenali ahlolelwa abalingani avunyiwe.

xh.title: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (ANAESTHESIOLOGY)
xh.summary: Kufunwa uchwepheshe wezokwelapha kwinkompho ye-Anaesthesiology eTygerberg Hospital ukunika konakezima kwangaphambi kwesigwebo, phakathi kwesigwebo nangemva kwesigwebo kwaye afundise abafundi abangenayo nabaphuma kwindawo yemfundo ephakamileyo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isifanekele esivumela ukuvoyila kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwinkompho ye-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Ukuvoyila kwikhabhoni yamabanga: Ukuvoyila kwiHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwinkompho ye-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Amava: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nalunye emva kokuvojwula kwiHPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwinkompho ye-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka engu-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha emva kokuvojwula kwiHPCSA (okanye ikhabhoni yamazwe ngamazwe ezo buzophulo begunjweleyo kwabasebenzi bakhe bazalwa kumazwe ngamazwe) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwinkompho ye-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka engu-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha emva kokuvojwula kwiHPCSA (okanye ikhabhoni yamazwe ngamazwe ezo buzophulo begunjweleyo kwabasebenzi bakhe bazalwa kumazwe ngamazwe) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwinkompho ye-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo nentlumko yokuhamba njengenxalenye yenkqubo yokunyuka komntu. Intlumko yokusebenza ngemihla yakude ngeyure zangaphandle ukwanelisa iimfuno zokusebenza. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ibisengqiqo lokusebenza njengesithulu xa kunjalo namagqabantshintshi amahle phakathi kwabantu. Ibisengqiqo lokuqwalasela nokuqhuba izifundo ngokwamagqabantshintshi ezingqiqo ezifana nezochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwinkompho ye-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Ibisengqiqo lokukwazi ukulawula abavoyjulwa kwi-ANAESTHESIOLOGY, kuquka nokulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwabo kwe-Fellowship kwi-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Amakhono mahle okunxibelela.
xh.duties: Nika konakezima kwangaphambi kwesigwebo, phakathi kwesigwebo nangemva kwesigwebo kwabaguli kwindawo yokuqhuba neyokusingatha kwiTygerberg Hospital ngemilinganiselo efunwa kochwepheshe we-ANAESTHESIOLOGY. Ukufundisa nokunika iinkululeko kwi-ANAESTHESIOLOGY nokusingatha kwabafundi abangenayo, abaphuma kwindawo yemfundo ephakamileyo nabanntsonjantshi. Ukuqwalasela abafudi nabanntsonjantshi. Ukuhlala utshilo ngezinto ezintsha ezikwindawo ye-ANAESTHESIOLOGY nokuSingatha. Urhulumente: Iinkqubo zokulawula ezidityaniswa nesiGxelega naseYunivesithi. Izifundo ezidityaniswa ne-ANAESTHESIOLOGY nokusingatha, nendawo ezikufutshane nayo, kuquka nokwenza lula inxalenye yezifundo efunwa ngabavoyjulwa yi-HPCSA ukuze bayofole ukuvoyjulwa kwamakhono okusingatha kokuchwepheshe nokushicilela kwizindlu ezibaliswe ngabantu abakufutshane nezo buphulo.

jobs.title: Senior Registrar (MEDICAL) (HEPATOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: R1 395 528 per annum, A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Senior Registrar in Hepatology at Groote Schuur Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine with compulsory commuted overtime.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualifications: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Registration with the Professional Council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice) in Internal Medicine. Communication including report generation, letter writing, consultation. Effective and efficient administration. Facilitation of management system. MMED and FCP (SA) Qualification.

Participate in the teaching programmes of the Department at a level appropriate to training and experience. -Initiate and complete appropriate research project for MPhil in advanced Hepatology and Liver Transplantation. Effective and efficient administration of clinical records and patient reports. Clinical Service Provision. Clinical Governance and Administration. Assessment, diagnosis and treatment of inpatients and outpatients with acute and chronic liver diseases as well as liver transplant patients at a level appropriate for training and experience. Assessment, diagnosis and treatment of inpatients and outpatients with acute and chronic gastrointestinal diseases, including core endoscopy skills.
jobs.enquiries: Dr M Sonderup Tel No: (021) 404-6422 or mark.sonderup@uct.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. Appointment as Senior Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 3 years. Senior Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as Senior Registrar will be on contract. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Senior Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Medical Sub-Specialist positions. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Senior Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Senior Registrars will be required to register as post-graduates with Stellenbosch University/ University of Cape Town according to the yearbook and guidelines. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. Kommunikasie insluitend verslagopstelling, briefskrywing, konsultasie. Doeltreffende en effektiewe administrasie. Fasilitering van bestuurstelsel. MMED en FCP (SA) Kwalifikasie.

Unxibelelwano okuhlanganisa ukwenza imibiko, ukubhala izincwadi, kanye nokuqashwa. Ukuqondiswa nokulawula okusebenzayo nangempumelelo. Ukwenableda uhlelo lolawulo. Isiqu se-MMED ne-FCP (SA).

Ukubuyekeza, ukuyivula indwangu, nokwelapha abagulayo ababhaliselwe kanye nabanomgomo nangesikhathi esibuhlungu kanye nokuqothulwa kwesisu ezingeni elihambelana nokukhothama nokuhlangen nakho. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo zokufundisa zeSebe kwinqanaba elifanelekile ekufundiseni nasesipholweni. -Ukuqala kuze kuqede iprojekthi yophando olufanelekileyo yoMPhil kwiHepatology ethuthukisiweyo nokuTshajwa kweIsibindi. U lulawulo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lweerekhodi zokwelapha neeripothi zabaguli. Inikezelo lomsebenzi wokwelapha. Ulawulo oluQinisekisiweyo nokuLulwa. Ukuqeqesha, ukuyazi isifo nokunyanga abaguli abangenayo nabanaphandle abanesifo sesibindi esibuhlungu nesorhofo nabanaguli abatshajwe isibindi kwinqanaba elifanelekile ekufundiseni nasesipholweni. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yezokwelapha yamahora ngemuva. Amandla (ulwazi/iziqu): Isiqu i-FCPath (Haematology) (SA) noma i-FC Physicians (SA) noma esilinganayo. Ikono lokusebenza ngempumelelo kumaqembu ahlangene emikhakheni eminingi. Amandla aphezulu okuxoxa nobudlelwano nosobo. Ikono ekulawuleni kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga. Ikhono ekulawulweni kolawulo lwezonye nasekuphuculeni umgangatho. Ikhono lokufundisa nokuqhatha. Uzinikezelo kúnako lomntu oqwalaselwa kakhulu.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager: Medical Physics
jobs.salary_text: R1 295 388 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager of Medical Physics at Tygerberg Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration and three years' post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Physicist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Physicist. Experience: A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Physicist. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Skills pertaining to the scope of the profession of medical physicists. Understand the physics of radiotherapy-, diagnostic x-ray and nuclear medicine equipment, computers and software. Knowledge of the statutory regulations regarding the medical use of ionising radiation. Good communication, interpersonal relationship, research, development and teaching skills. Capable of using initiative for problem solving, recognising the need for action, consider possible risks and taking responsibility for results. Capable of managing a team of medical physicists and other staff to deliver medical physics services in an academic hospital. Be a highly motivated and methodical individual who pays attention to detail with exceptional standards for accuracy and the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
jobs.duties: Managing medical physics operations in radiotherapy, radiology and nuclear medicine, including dosimetry, quality assurance and radiation protection functions, as well as the writing of bid specifications for equipment. Managing medical physics staff. Active participation in the routine execution of clinically related medical physics tasks as required. Responsible for commissioning and optimisation of new equipment and techniques. Managing the academic teaching and clinical training programmes in the Medical Physics Division. Management of and active participation in the research and development programme of the Medical Physics Division. Managing the radiation protection services in the hospital.
jobs.enquiries: Prof C Trauernicht Tel No: (021) 938-6027, email: cjt@sun.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder: Mediese Fisika
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder van Mediese Fisika by Tygerberg Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring na registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Fisikus moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Fisikus. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Fisikus. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vaardighede met betrekking tot die omvang van die beroep van mediese fisici. Begrip van die fisika van radioterapie-, diagnostiese x-straal- en nukleere geneeskunde-toerusting, rekenaars en sagteware. Kennis van die statutêre regulasies rakende die mediese gebruik van ioniserende straling. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike verhoudings-, navorsings-, ontwikkelings- en onderrigvaardighede. In staat om inisiatief te gebruik vir probleemoplossing, die behoefte aan optrede te herken, moontlike risiko's te oorweeg en verantwoordelikheid te aanvaar vir resultate. In staat om 'n span mediese fisici en ander personeel te bestuur om mediese fisikadienste in 'n akademiese hospitaal te lewer. 'n Hoogs gemotiveerde en metodiese individu wat aandag aan detail gee met uitsonderlike standaarde vir akkuraatheid en die vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Bestuur van mediese fisika-bedrywighede in radioterapie, radiologie en nukleere geneeskunde, insluitend dosimetrie, gehalteversekering en stralingsbeskermingsfunksies, asook die skryf van bodspesifikasies vir toerusting. Bestuur van mediese fisika-personeel. Aktiewe deelname aan die roetine-uitvoering van kliniesverwante mediese fisikatakke soos vereis. Verantwoordelik vir instelling en optimalisering van nuwe toerusting en tegnieke. Bestuur van die akademiese onderrig- en kliniese opleidingsprogramme in die Afdeling Mediese Fisika. Bestuur van en aktiewe deelname aan die navorsings- en ontwikkelingsprogram van die Afdeling Mediese Fisika. Bestuur van die stralingsbeskermingsdienste in die hospitaal.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohambisana Nayo: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezokwelapha
zu.summary: Umphathi Ohambisana Nayo Wezokuhlaziywa Kwezokwelapha esibhedlela i-Tygerberg, ofuna ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA namava eminyaka emithathu emva kokubhalisa.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo eziphansi kakhulu: Ithuba lemfundo elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomhlaziyi wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kumbhuduleo wabanye: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomhlaziyi wezokwelapha. Iminyaka yemisebenzi: Okungenani unyaka 1 wokuhlaziywa kwezokwelapha, kubandakanya kwenza izibalo ezihlobene nokuwelwa komchamo, ukweluleka kwesigaxa se-cervix, kanye nokudluliswa kwesigaxa esithathwe kumuntu ongumama esibhedlela. Ukuqonda ukusetshenziswa okungavumelekile kwe-Radiotherapy kanye ne-pelvic irradiation.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlaziywa kwezokwelapha kwe-Radiotherapy, Radiology kanye ne-Nuclear Medicine, okubandakanya ukulinganisa umchamo, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kanye nemithelela yezokuvikela ukushiswa kumchamo, kanye nokubhala izinkomba zokuthengiswa kwezinto zokusebenza. Ukuphatha abasebenzi boku hlaziywa kwezokwelapha. Ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni ngokuvamile imisebenzi ephathene nezokwelapha ecelenkony ngokufuneka. Ukubeke ukulungiselela nokulinganisa ezinto ezintsha zokusebenza kanye nendlela ezintsha zokwenza. Ukuphatha izinhlelo zokufundisa nokuqeqesha ezokwelapha. Ukuphatha ukwenza nokuhlola izinhlelo zocwaningo nokuthuthukisa kolunye uphiko. Ukuphatha imisebenzi yokuvikela umchamo.

xh.title: Umphathiswa Ohambela: I-Physics Yezozo
xh.summary: Umphathiswa Ohambela we-Physics Yezozo e-Tygerberg Hospital, efuna ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kunye namava eminyaka mitatu emva kokubhalisa.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esisezantsi esifunekayo: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogciniwe nge-Physics Yezozo. Ukubhalisa kwikomkhulu labo bugcisa: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogciniwe nge-Physics Yezozo. Amava: Amava amnye angazibambi ngaphantsi konyaka we-3 esifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogciniwe nge-Physics Yezozo. Iimpawu zokwazisa (ulwazi/amakhono): Amandla afanelekileyo kummandla webugcisa bobugcisa be-physics yezozo. Ukuqonda i-physics yezixhobo zoradiyotherepa, ze-radiology kunye ne-medicine yenyukliya, iikhompyutha nesoftwea. Ulwazi ngemigaqo esemthethweni malunga nokusetyenziswa kwe-radiation yenyukliya kwezonyanga. Amandla alo ngxelo oluhle, ubudlelwane obumi phakathi kwabantu, uphando, nophuhliso nokufundisa. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa isigqibo kwisixazululo seengxaki, ukuqonda isidingo sinto entshiwo, ukucinga iingozi ezinokubakho kwaye wazithathela inkathazo iziphumo. Ukwazi ukulawula iqela labagciniwe be-physics yezozo nabasebenzi abanye ukunikela iinkonzo ze-physics yezozo esibhedlele sezifundo. Ukuba ngumntu onesipho sokuzifumana okunamandla kwaye olungelelwanisayo onqakileleyo kwiinkcukacha ezinamagqabantshintshi kumaxwebhu acaca gca bakhulu kwaye anomsebenzi onzima othe prag wakho kwaye akwazi ukugqiba ngexesha.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinkonzo ze-physics yezozo kwi-radiyotherepa, i-radiology kunye ne-medicine yenyukliya, kuquka i-dosimetry, ukuqinisekisa ubunyulu neenkonzo zokhuselo lwe-radiation, nangokubhalisa iipezulu zokuthenga izixhobo. Ukulawula abasebenzi be-physics yezozo. Ukuzibandakanya ngokuchanileyo kumisebenzi ye-physics yezozo ehlotshaneyo nezifo njengoko kufuneka. Ukuba uyakhalipha kwaye ulungelelanise izixhobo ezintsha iindlela ezintsha. Ukulawula izikolo zokufundisa ezifundo ezifundo iinkqubo kwiSebe le-Physics Yezozo. Ulawulo nokuzibandakanya ngokuchanileyo kwenkqubo yophando nophuhliso kwiSebe le-Physics Yezozo. Ukulawula iinkonzo zokhuselo lwe-radiation kwisibhedlele.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (INTERNAL Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 in Internal Medicine sought at Paarl Hospital, Western Cape, requiring HPCSA registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Officer. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Officer. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA-qualified employees. - One (1) year’s relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign- qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of Five (5) appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA-qualified employees. A minimum of six (6) relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign-qualified employees, of whom required to perform community service required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver's licence, willingness, and ability to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate experience in Internal Medicine. Proven experience in procedural skills, appropriate to the field of Internal Medicine. Proven knowledge of public health policies, guidelines and related prescript to manage resources effectively. Good professional attitude. Communication skills.
jobs.duties: Provide efficient and affordable high-quality Internal Medicine care to patients served by the hospital and the Rural West Ecosystem, ensuring both productivity and excellence. Provide service professionally and ethically. To serve as role model and clinical mentor to junior doctors and associated clinical staff by setting an example of an exemplary medical practitioner. Establish a supportive learning environment for junior staff and students at undergraduate level. Provide Outreach and Support services to the Rural West Ecosystem. Maintain positive and collaborative relationships with patients, nursing staff, colleagues, and referral services at both district and tertiary levels. Prepare and submit all necessary medical reports and documentation to fulfil legal and administrative requirements. Undertake the necessary Continuing Professional Development (CPD) activities to uphold your registration status with the HPCSA.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).

Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.summary: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 in Interne Geneeskunde gesoek by Paarl Hospital, Western Cape, wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis.

Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende en bekostigbare hoëgehalte-sorg in Interne Geneeskunde aan pasiënte wat deur die hospital en die Rural West Ecosystem bedien word, en verseker beide produktiwiteit en uitnemendheid. Verskaf diens professioneel en eties. Tree as rolmodel en kliniese mentor vir junior dokters en geassosieerde kliniese personeel deur 'n voorbeeld van 'n voorbeeldige mediese praktisyn te stel. Skep 'n ondersteunende leeromgewing vir junior personeel en studente op voorgraadse vlak. Verskaf inligting- en ondersteuningsdienste aan die Rural West Ecosystem. Onderhou positiewe en samewerkende verhoudings met pasiënte, verpleegpersoneel, kollegas en verwysingsdienste op beide distrik- en tersiêre vlak. Berei alle nodige mediese verslae en dokumentasie voor en dien dit in om aan regs- en administratiewe vereistes te voldoen. Onderneem die nodige Continuing Professional Development (CPD)-aktiwiteite om u registrasiestatus by die HPCSA te handhaaf.

zu.title: Isikhundla SoMhlekazi Wezempilo Ikhaya 1 kuya ku-3 (INTERNAL Medicine)

zu.requirements: Imininingo yokomfundo okungenwa ngaphakathi: Imininingo engokomfundo ewusizo yokuvumela ukubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha. Sula indawo yokufunda exhasa abasebenzi abancane nabafundi abangabangingeni emazingeni aphansi. Nikeza ngezenzo zokuxhasa nokuhamba i-Rural West Ecosystem. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle obusebenzayo namagciabe, abantu abanakekela iziguli, abantu abakini, kanye nenhlangano ekulumeni kobudokotela emazingeni aphakeme kanye nasemakhaya. Hlela futhi ulondoloze zonke izibalo ezingezansi kwamalungelo amele lawa lomthetho nemindandu. Phakamisa izenzo ezifanele ezindaweni zokuphila abantu kuhle ukwenza isiko lemiqulu yokuqinisekisa ukuthi uyazenza kahle ukuvuselela ukubhalisa kwakho kuma-HPCSA.

Amava ayiminyaka elishumi elinesikhosi efanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezokwelapha koluntu oluchaziweyo lwangaphandle e-HPCSA kumasebenzi asebenzela ngaphandle, abangekho mfuno yokuvela inkonzo yomanyano njengoko kulindelekwa e-South Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqesha (Code B/EB) esemthethweni, isazela nemfanelwa yokuhanjiswa iindawo. Iimpawu (ulwazi/amakhono): Amaxabo afanelekileyo kwi-Internal Medicine. Amava obonwe kakhulu kwamakhono okusebenza, afanelekile kwindawo ye-Internal Medicine. Ulwazi olubonwe ngokusebenza kwemigaqo yoluntu lwamagunyazwe emphilo, iinkqubo zemigaqo nemigaqo ngokubanzi, efunekayo ukuze ulawule imisebenzi ngokusebenza. Imo yamasebe angcondo. Amakhono okuthetha nabantu.
xh.duties: Nikeza ngoncedo olusebenzayo nelingenamafutha lwe-Internal Medicine ngenqanaba eliphezulu kubaphiwe i-South African abakhonzwa yisibhedlele i-Paarl Hospital, kuqinisekiswa ukuba kuqhubekwe ngezenzo ezilungileyo. Nikela ngoncedo ngokungenamkhumsha nangokungakhathazeki. Ukubakhethwa njengomzekelo nomqeqeshi wezokwelapha kumadokhota abafundi namasebe ahambelana nokuqeqeshwa kwezokwelapha, ngokuzenzela umzekelo wothando lokubakhokhela imisebenzi yasebuhlanti. Misa ukusingathwa okubakhuthaza abafundi abasha abanegalelo ekwazeni okungangagqithi kwamathafa. Nikela ngamakhono okuthumela inkonzo nokuxhaswa koluntu lwasemaphandlal kwi-Paarl Hospital. Gcina imiba elungileyo nelungenza imisebenzi ngokudityaniswa nendalo yokuphila ngaphakathi kwamasebe anzima kwakunye namajoni amakhulu. Lungiselela unikezelo ngamaphepha omtshotsha namaxwebhu omtshotsha onke afunekayo ukuze ugqibe ukwaziswa kwamagunya ekwasekunyameni nasekubhaliseni. Phatha iimpawu ezifunekayo zophuhliso olukhululekileyo lwezokwelapha (CPD) ukuze ugcine isikhundla sakho sokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA.

Participate in training and educational programs for healthcare professionals. Complete and submit required medical reports and documentation for legal and administrative purposes. Uphold the reputation and integrity of the medical profession.

Een (1) jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Medical Practitioner by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buitelands-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Medical Practitioner na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Medical Practitioner ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Medical Practitioner by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Council ten opsigte van buitelands-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Community Service te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Medical Practitioner na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Medical Practitioner ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. af.duties: Verskaf omvattende nood mediese sorg aan pasiënte deur siektes en ander gesondheidstoestande te diagnoseer en te behandel. Skryf behandelingsplanne voor en bestuur dit, insluitend medikasie en terapieë. Onderhou akkurate en gedetailleerde pasiëntrekords. Verwys pasiënte na spesialiste of ander gesondheidsorgverskaffers wanneer nodig. Finansiële bestuur deur doeltreffende en doeltrewe gebruik van hulpbronne. Voltooi die vereiste VGO-aktiwiteite om registrasie by die HPCSA te handhaaf. Neem deel aan opleidings- en opvoedingsprogramme vir gesondheidsorgprofessionals. Voltooi en dien vereiste mediese verslae en dokumentasie vir regsdooeleindes en administratiewe doeleindes in. Handhaaf die reputasie en integriteit van die mediese beroep.

zu.title: I- Medical Officer Izinga 1 kuya ku- 3 (i-EMERGENCY Medicine)

zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoba yi- Medical Officer.
