Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqashwa njengomba dokotela ku-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathole iziqu e-South Africa. Unyaka owodwa (1) wesipiliyoni esihambisana nekhono emva kokuqashwa njengomba dokotela kwi-Health Professional Council evezwa ngaphandle kwezwe mayelana nabasebenzi abathole iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izinga 2: Isibalo esingaphansi kokuhamba kweminyaka eyi-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoba ungum dokotela emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njengomba dokotela mayelana nabasebenzi abathole iziqu e-South Africa. Isibalo esingaphansi kokuhamba kweminyaka eyi-6 yesipiliyoni esihambisana nekhono emva kokuqashwa njengomba dokotela kwi-Health Council evezwa ngaphandle kwesizwe mayelana nabasebenzi abathole iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izinga 3: Isibalo esingaphansi kokuhamba kweminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoba ungum dokotela emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njengomba dokotela mayelana nabasebenzi abathole iziqu e-South Africa. Isibalo esingaphansi kokuhamba kweminyaka eyi-11 yesipiliyoni esihambisana nekhono emva kokuqashwa njengomba dokotela kwi-Health Professional Council evezwa ngaphandle kwesizwe mayelana nabasebenzi abathole iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izidingo ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayisa evumelekile (i-Code B/EB), ukuthanda nokuba namicabango, kanye nenkundla okuhamba kuyo. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele kwi-Emergency Medicine. Isipiliyoni esivezwe ngamakhono okwenza izinqubo ahambisana nendawo ye-Emergency Medicine. Ulwazi oluveziwe ngezinkambiso zezempilo yomphakathi, imihlahlandlela nemiyalelo ehlobene yokuphatha izibozulu ngempumelelo. Bono bokuba ngumuntu ophathekalo kahle ngobudokotela. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngakezilungiselelo ezijulile zokunakekelwa kwesimo esiphuthumayo kubaguli ngokuqapha futhi ukwelapha izifo kanye nezinye izimo zezempilo. Qamba futhi ulawule izinkundla zokwelashwa, kuhlanganise nemithi nokwelashwa. Gcina kusobala futhi kubhalwe ngokuningi imibhalo yomuntu ofuywe. Qedela abantu abakhululekile ekubhekisiseni kubangazi ekunakekelweni kwezempilo lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuphathwa kwezimali ngokusebenzisa ngokuphumelelayo futhi ngokusebenza kwezibozulu. Qedela imisebenzi ye-CPD efinyelelwe ukuze ulondoloze ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA. Thatha inhlathi kumaphroghremu zokuhlatshwayo zemfundo kubasebenzi ekunakekelweni kwezempilo. Qedela futhi uhthele imibhalo yezifo efinyelelwe kanye neyemibhalo yokulawula ngezizathu ezesethembiso. Phakamisa isibuko negunya lenhloso yomuntu ofuywe ngokuthi abe ngumuntu okhululekile.

Iminyaka eyi-14 yesipiliyoni ehlobene ngemva kokuqinisekiswa njengoThishela Wezamathi nomasiko ohloniphekile wezempilo wesifunda ngokuhlobene nabasebenzi abathola iziqu nabesinye izwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza njengoThishela Wezamathi kule phathi enezigaba ezahlukene. Izindawo zokusebenza (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluhle ngokuziphatha kanye nenqubo yezamathi esikhungweni, okuhlanganisa okuziphatha okuphathelene nokugcina izinthombe ezibandayo. Amakhono amanani ahle/ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngezinsimulo zokuphatha ukulethwa kwezamathi. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha okuhle kwamathisha wezamathi. Ulwazi olujulile nge-EML. Ulwazi ngendlela yokuhlinza ngamakhethelo ye-JAC/WellSky. Ukucophelela nokunaka imininingwane. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uyayikhuluma kahle ulimi. Ukuletha izinhlelo zokuhlolwa kanye nokuhlela imisebenzi. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukuphatha abantu kahle namosiko phakathi kwabantu, ukukhathalela iqembu. Ingqando yezinhlelo zokuletha isevisi. Ukukhathalela abakhasino kakhulu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Amakhono okuhlola kanye nokufundisa abanye. Isikhono sokubhala ama-SOP. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel ne-Outlook).
zu.duties: Isu kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukuphatha ukulethwa kwezamathi kule-Swartland Sub-District. Ukugcina izinga kanye nobulungiswa ekukhetheleni. Ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ezithi, okuhlanganisa i-CDU ne-DMOC. Izimali kanye nokuphatha intambo yokuletha izimpahla. Ukuphatha abantu (njengoko uyiphoqoMqondisi Wabaphathi Wezamathi). Ukugcina izinga ngokuhlobene ne-Ideal Clinic kanye nokuhlolwa kolwazwe, ukuqoqa izibalo kanye nokubika.

xh.title: Umngcali wezeNhlahlela inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3

xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesigqibo: Isifundo esisiseko esigunyaziswe ngeSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela. Ukbhaliso koluntu ngamagunyaziso: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela. Isiphiwo senkonzo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuno yamava emva kokubhaliswa njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela kwi-SAPC kubasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika abanemfundo efanelekileyo. Unyaka o-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela koluntu ngamagunyaziso langaphandle labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanemfundo efanelekileyo, ekungalulangeni kubo ukwenza Inkonzo yaseLokishini njengoko kufuneka eNingizimu Afrika. Inqanaba 2: Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-5 emva kokubhaliswa njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela kwi-SAPC kubasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika abanemfundo efanelekileyo. Amava afanelekileyo eminyakeni engama-6 emva kokubhaliswa njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela koluntu ngamagunyaziso langaphandle labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanemfundo efanelekileyo, ekungalulangeni kubo ukwenza Inkonzo yaseLokishini njengoko kufuneka eNingizimu Afrika. Inqanaba 3: Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-13 emva kokubhaliswa njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela kwi-SAPC kubasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika abanemfundo efanelekileyo. Amava afanelekileyo eminyakeni engama-14 emva kokubhaliswa njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela koluntu ngamagunyaziso langaphandle labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanemfundo efanelekileyo, ekungalulangene kubo ukwenza Inkonzo yaseLokishini njengoko kufuneka eNingizimu Afrika. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza njengomngcali wezeNhlahlela ngaphakathi kwenqubo yokusebenza njengeqela elenziwa ngabongcali bakwamanye amabango. Ikhono (ulwazi/amabakho): Ulwazi olululo malunga neenkqubo nezicwangciso zomsebenzi weNhlahlela kweziko, kuquka iinkqubo zogqitho lomkhenkce. Amabakho amanani amanani/ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi malunga neMathongo eLawulo loNikezelo lwezaMayeza. Ulwazi lweZigqibo eziZizo zoMsebenzi wezeNhlahlela. Ulwazi olusisigxina lwe-EML. Ulwazi ngesixhobo sokunikwa kwamayeza i-JAC/WellSky. Ukuchitha umsebenzi ngononelo lokhetho ukunyanga imiba ngokweenkcukacha. Amabakho okunxibelelwana olululo nokuqhuba kakuhle. Umcwangcisi woBumomo kwaye uleke izicwangciso zomsebenzi. ULawulo lweMali. ULawulo lweNtsapho yoluntu nolunxibelelwano, ukuzinika kwinkqubo yokusebenza njengeqela. Uvavabyo lokunika imbuyekezo ngeNkonzo. Ukuqwalasela ngumthengi kwaye ugqamile ngemfuno yakho. Ukuqwalasela nokusombulula iingxaki. Amabakho okukhokela nokufundisa. Ukuba nakho ukubhala ii-SOP. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kunye ne-Outlook).
xh.duties: Icinga ngakumbi nokuqwalasela iNdlela yokwenza. ULawulo lokuNikwa kwezaMayeza ngaphakathi kwalo lonke ilali ecingelwe ngaphantsi yaseSwartland. Ukuqinisekiswa koBungangcala kwaye kungqina ukwenza koluntu. Ukwenza kube lula ukufikelela kumayeza, kuquka i-CDU kunye ne-DMOC. Imali nokuLawulwa kwokuNikwa kwezaMayeza ngokulandelelana. ULawulo loBantu (njengoko ugcwalise njengomongcali oqonde phambi komnye oqondisayo). Ukuqinisekiswa koBungangcala ngokumayela neKliniki eGqibeleleyo kunye nokukhangwa koluntu ngokubukhali nokuthathwa kwamaxa ngeSizwe, ukuqokelelwa ngenkcazelo nokuvelisa iinguqu.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing: Specialty (WOMEN and Child
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing position in Women and Child Health at Khayelitsha District Hospital, requiring a Professional Nursing qualification with Advanced Midwifery specialisation.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. -A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science, Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Child or Child Nursing Science (R212) OR a 4-year Bachelor's degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A postgraduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Midwifery or Critical Care Nursing (Child) or Child Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC. At least 6 years of the above period must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the post-basic qualification or a post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. At least 3 years of the above period must be appropriate/recognisable experience at nurse management level. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Will be required to do standby cover, after hours, weekends and public holidays. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy in Word, and Excel. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policy related to this nursing specialty.
jobs.duties: Responsible for management and co-ordination of clinical nursing care in the Women and Child Health Department of the hospital. Effective management and utilization of Human and Financial Resources to ensure optimal clinical and operational function in the area. Manage training, orientation, learning, professional growth & development and participation in research within the clinical environment. Support/ deputise for the deputy manager nursing and support the Nursing department and the institution.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde: Spesialiteit (VROUE en Kind
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde-posisie in Vroue- en Kindgesondheid by Khayelitsha Distrikshospitaal, wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkwalifikasie met Gevorderde Vroedvrouenspesialisasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. -'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science, Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Child of Child Nursing Science (R212) OF 'n 4-jarige Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Midwifery of Critical Care Nursing (Child) of Child Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC. Ten minste 6 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na die verkryging van die post-basiese kwalifikasie of 'n nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit wees. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op verpleegbestuursvlak wees. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Sal vereis word om standby-dekking te doen, na ure, naweke en openbare vakansiedae. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid in Word en Excel. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleid wat verband hou met hierdie verpleegspesialiteit.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir bestuur en koördinering van kliniese verpleegsorg in die Vroue- en Kindgesondheidsdepartement van die hospitaal. Doeltreffende bestuur en benutting van Menslike en Finansiële Hulpbronne om optimale kliniese en operasionele funksionering in die area te verseker. Bestuur van opleiding, oriëntering, leer, professionele groei en ontwikkeling en deelname aan navorsing binne die kliniese omgewing. Ondersteun/waarnem vir die adjunkbestuurder verpleegkunde en ondersteun die Verpleegkundedepartement en die instelling.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohambisana Nosezelo: Inhlanga (ABESIMAME NeNhlangano
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi ohambisana Nosezelo ezeZempilo zABESIMAME nenhlangano esibhedlela iKhayelitsha District, esidinga iziqu zobusosi bezelo ezinobuchwepheshe obuthuthukile bokuqeqesha abalandeli bezalo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi: Ikhwalifayikhethi yeR425 esisisekelo (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ezonweselweni) noma ikhwalifayikhethi elinganayo (R683 kanye noR254) evumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGuli sezelo sabuchwepheshe. -Ikhwalifayikhethi yamva kokuqeqeshwa kweselo ngaphandle kokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo ebude bonyaka ungamunye egunyaziwe yiSANC ekuqeqesheni okuthuthukile kwabaLandelwa bezalo kanye nesayensi yokuNakekelwa kweSilo esanda kuzalwa, isayensi yokuNakekelwa kweSilo: ukuNakekelwa kobuchopho obucinene: inHlangano noma isayensi yokuNakekelwa kweNhlangano (R212) Noma idigri yeminyaka emi-4 eYunivesithi (R174) noma ikhwalifayikhethi elinganayo (R683 kanye noR1497 noma uR171 kanye noR1497) evumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengesiGuli sezelo sabuchwepheshe. Idiploma yamva kokuqeqeshwa okuphezulu (R635) egunyaziwe yiSANC ekuqeqesheni abaLandelwa bezalo noma ukuNakekelwa kobuchopho obucinene (inhlangano) noma ukuNakekelwa kweNhlangano. Ukubhalisa kwiBhungana labochwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengesiGuli sezelo sabuchwepheshe. Isipiliyoni: Ucingo lweminyaka engu-10 ngenani elifanele/eligunyazwe ekuNakekelweni kweSilo ngemva kokubhalisa njengesiGuli sezelo sabuchwepheshe kwiSANC. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 kuleso sikhathi kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/eligunyaziwe ngemva kokuthola ikhwalifayikhethi yamva kokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo noma idiploma yamva kokuqeqeshwa okuphezulu kuleyo nhlanga ethile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 kuleso sikhathi kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/eligunyaziwe ezingeni labaphathi beshelo. Isidingo esingokwemisebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile (iKhowudi B/EB). Uzodingeka ukuba ungumgcini wesikhathi sokuLalela, ngemva kwezikhathi zokusebenza, nangamaphetha bviki nangamaholide. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha kuWord, kanye neExcel. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nenqubomgomo mayelana nale nhlanga yezelo.
zu.duties: Ubazwa ngegunya lokuphatha kanye nokuHlela ukuNakekelwa ngeselo ezikweni ezeZempilo zABESIMAME nenhlangano esibhedlela. Ukuphatha ngempumelelo kanye nokuSetshenziswa kwabantu kanye nezinsiza eziMali ukuze kuQinisekiswe umsebenzi wezelo kanye nowokusebenza endaweni. Ukuphatha ukuqeqeshwa, ukuQondiswa, ukuFunda, ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe nokuThuthuka kanye nokuHlanganyela ekuCwaningweni endaweni yonakekelwa lwezelo. Ukusekela/ukuba yisikhundla somphathi ohambisana nozele kanye nokusekela umnyango wezelo nenhlangano.

Ukulawula okusebenzayo nokusebenzisa izeMveliso ezomLimo nezeeMali ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusebenza kakuhle ngokwekliniki nangokwemisebenzi kule ndawo. Ukulawula uqeqesho, ukuqalisa, uku Funda, ukukhula ngamazinga obugcisa nokuziphakamisa kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kuphando phakathi kwendawo yekliniki. Ukwakha uxhaso/ukumela umphathiswa wekliniki yamakhosithiwo kunye noxhaso kwisebe lenkathazo zokhathalelo lwesibhedlele nakwisikhungo.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing (HEAD Nursing)
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing position at the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office in Cape Town, responsible for coordinating and evaluating provincial nursing practice programmes.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 3 year Diploma in Nursing (R171) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a General Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse or General Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 8 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 3 years of the period referred to above be appropriate/recognisable experience at management level. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid Driver’s Licence and willingness to travel to support assigned provincial engagements and facility support activities. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Thorough knowledge of nursing legislation, regulations and prescripts, including scopes and standards of practice and SANC and National Department of Health (NDoH) requirements. Appropriate knowledge of provincial nursing practice frameworks, Clinical Nurse Practitioner (CNP) authorisation requirements, Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and the National Nursing Leadership Competency Framework. Appropriate knowledge of community service nursing processes, including placement, registration, commencement, completion and absorption. Relevant knowledge of public service governance, including the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and departmental Human Resources, procurement and financial policies. Sound knowledge of workforce planning, nursing practice management, professional governance, quality improvement and patient safety. Strong operational planning, programme coordination, monitoring and evaluation, information management, reporting and data analysis skills. Sound interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, negotiation and communication skills. (written and verbal). Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and data management systems).
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation of assigned provincial Nursing Practice programmes, including operational planning, progress reporting and risk and corrective-action tracking. Coordinate the review and implementation of nursing policies and practice standards, coordinate the nursing peer review programme and monitor patient safety and the quality of nursing care. Provide workforce planning and scope of practice inputs, coordinate community service nursing processes and monitor CNP authorisation. Coordinate nursing leadership, CPD and stakeholder governance activities, including assigned forums, and liaise with healthcare facilities, Nursing Education Institutions, Higher Education Institutions and all relevant stakeholders. Manage assigned staff, resources and records and ensure operational continuity in accordance with relevant legislation and directives. Provide support and advice to the Manager Nursing Practice and senior management on nursing practice matters.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS
