Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Deeglike kennis van verpleegwetgewing, regulasies en voorskrifte, insluitend omskrywings en standaarde van praktyk en SANC- en National Department of Health (NDoH)-vereistes. Toepaslike kennis van provinsiale verpleegpraktykraamwerke, Clinical Nurse Practitioner (CNP)-magtigingsvereistes, Continuing Professional Development (CPD) en die National Nursing Leadership Competency Framework. Toepaslike kennis van gemeenskapsdiensverpleegprosesse, insluitend plasings, registrasie, aanvang, voltooiing en absorpsie. Relevante kennis van openbare diensbestuur, insluitend die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en departementele Menslike Hulpbronne, verkryging en finansiële beleide. Deeglike kennis van mannekragbeplanning, verpleegpraktykbestuur, professionele bestuur, gehalteverbetering en pasiëntveiligheid. Sterk operasionele beplanning, programkoördinasie, monitering en evaluering, inligtingsbestuur, verslagdoening en data-ontledingsvaardighede. Deeglike interpersoonlike, belanghebbende-betrokkenheids-, onderhandelings- en kommunikasievaardighede. (skriftelik en mondelings). Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams en databestuurstelsels).
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering, koördinasie, monitering en evaluering van toegewysde provinsiale Verpleegpraktykprogramme, insluitend operasionele beplanning, vorderingverslagdoening en risiko- en korrigerende-aksie-opvolging. Koördineer die hersiening en implementering van verpleegbeleide en praktykstandaarde, koördineer die verpleeg-peer-review-program en monitor pasiëntveiligheid en die gehalte van verpleegsorg. Verskaf mannekragbeplannings- en omvang-van-praktyk-invoere, koördineer gemeenskapsdiensverpleegprosesse en monitor CNP-magtiging. Koördineer verpleegleierskap, CPD- en belanghebbende-bestuursaktiwiteite, insluitend toegewysde forums, en skakel met gesondheidsorgfasiliteite, Nursing Education Institutions, Higher Education Institutions en alle relevante belanghebbendes. Bestuur toegewysde personeel, hulpbronne en rekords en verseker operasionele kontinuiteit ooreenkomstig relevante wetgewing en direktiewe. Verskaf ondersteuning en advies aan die Bestuurder Verpleegpraktyk en seniorbestuur oor verpleegpraktykaangeleenthede.

zu.title: Umphathi ongewenye weZokunakekelwa (IPHUQELA Zokunakekelwa)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi ongewenye weZokunakekelwa eNqolweni yoMnyango wezeMpilo neZempilisisekelo weWestern Cape eCape Town, ongumuntu oqokwe ukuhlela futhi ahlulele izinhlelo zomsebenzi wokunakekela obekelwe isifundazwe.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zokuqala zemfundo: Iklasikhifayeshini yomsukelagogo ye-Basic R425 (okukuthi idiploma/idigri ekuqoqweni kwabonakekeli) noma ikwalasikhifayeshini (R683) evumela ukubhaliswa eSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNhlanganabonakekeli noma Idigri yeminyaka emine (R174) evumela ukubhaliswa eSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNhlanganabonakekeli noma Idiploma yeminyaka emithathu ekuqoqweni kwabonakekeli (R171) evumela ukubhaliswa eSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiHloko abonakekeli. Ukubhaliswa enyunywaneni yezobungqandi: Ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengesiNhlanganabonakekeli noma njengesiHloko abonakekeli. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esingangeminyaka engu-8 esifanelekile/esiqashelwa kwimisebenzi yokuqoqa emva kokubhaliswa njengesiNhlanganabonakekeli eSANC kuHlaqqo lokuNakekela. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 kohlelo okushiwo ngenhla kufanele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanelekile/esiqashelwa kwizinga lobuhlakani bukaMqondisi. Izidingo ezingenakugwema kuleminsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nokuzikhethela ukwenzela ukuxhasa imisebenzi esinikeziwe isifundazwe kanye nemisebenzi yokuqashwa kwezindawo. Amandla okuqashwa (ulwazi/izinduku): Ukuqonda okuphelele komthetho wezokuNakekela, imigomo nemibhalo, okubandakanya izinhlangothi nemiqondo yomsebenzi kanye nezidingo zeSANC neNyuvesi yeSizwe yezeMpilo (NDoH). Ulwazi olufanelekile mayelana nezinhlobonhlobo zemisebenzi yokuNakekela yesifundazwe, izidingo zokuqashwa kwebhehhukile lesiNhlanganabonakekeli, iQoqo leNqubo eliqhubekayo (CPD) kanye noHlelo lwamakhono oBuhlakanalni bokuHlolwa nokuHlongozwa kweNyuvesi yokuNakekela. Ulwazi olufanelekile mayelana nokuqashwa komsebenzi wokwakhikitha phakathi komphakathi, okubandakanya ukubhaliswa, ukubhalisa, ukuqaliswa, ukuphumelellisa nokwamukelwa. Ulwazi oluhlobene nokuBusa komsebenzi wokuPhakathi, okuhlanganisa uMthetho woMphathi wezeMali (PFMA), uHlelo lweMali lweNyuvesi kanye nomthetho oHlelo lwabaBantu, wokuThengisa nezeMali womnyango. Ukuqonda okuhle mayelana nohlelo lokuMisa abantu, ukuHlolwa komsebenzi wokuNakekela, ukuBusa ngobungqandi, ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi kanye nokuphepha kwesiguli. Amandla amakhulu ekuHlela imisebenzi, ukuQashwa kuhlelo, ukuHlolwa kanye nokuQoqa ulwazi, umbiko kanye noKuhlaziya idatha. Amandla ahle kuxhumano lwabantu, ukuxhunyaniswa nabantu, ukungqonyelwa nokukhuluma. (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywa). Ukufunda nokuSebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams kanye nenhlelo zoKuphathwa kwedatha).
zu.duties: Phatha umsebenzi wokubeka ohlelweni, ukuhlela, ukuhlola kanye nokuhlulela izinhlelo ezenikeziwe zaBantu baseNakekeli, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela imisebenzi, ukubika inqubo kanye nokulandela amango nezinyathelo ezilungisayo. Hlela ukuHlolwa kokuSetshenziswa kwemigomo yokuNakekela kanye nemigomo yomsebenzi, hlela uhlelo lokuhlola abangane kubonakekeli bese uhlola ukuphepha kwesiguli noma yini ekuqoqweni kwesiguli. Nikeza ukubhaliswa ngokwabantu kanye nokuHlolwa okuzinhlangothini mayelana namagunya, hlela imisebenzi yokuNakekela ngokwakhiwa komphakathi bese uqaphela isigqibo seCNP. Hlela ukubusa ngokunakekela, iCPD kanye nomsebenzi wokuBusa ngokuxhunyaniswa nabantu, okubandakanya amaphula ezenikeziwe, futhi uxhume nezindawo zokuPhathwa kweZezempilo, izikhungo zeMfundo yokuNakekela, izikhungo zeMfundo ePhakeme kanye nabantu bonke abahambisana nabo. Phatha abantu abanikiwe, amagunya kanye namaphayipi bese uqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi ihamba ngaphambili ngesikhathi ngokwezifiso somthetho kanye nemiyalo. Nikeza inkxaso kanye neseluleko kuMphathi oHlela iNqubo kaBukekeli kanye noMphathi oHlela abeMnyangweni wezokuPhathwa kwezeMina mayelana nezindlu zeMina.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedisayo wokuNursing (INTLOKO yokuNursing)
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMphathi oncedisa kokuNursing kwiNtshatsheli yeeSebe leWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness eNtloko eCape Town, unexhaxha lokulungelelanisa nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokuqhuba esiNesi kwiphondo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowasemgangathweni owphantsi: Isifundo seR425 esisisiseko (oko kukuthi idiploma/udidi lokufunda ngokwesiNesi) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengeNesi yobungcali OKANE I-Degree yeminyaka eyi-4 eNesingi (R174) evumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengeNesi yobungcali OKANE iDiploma yeminyaka eyi-3 eNesingi (R171) evumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengeNesi jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kolawulo lwabangcali: Ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengeNesi yobungcali okanye iNesi jikelele. Ikwenzeko: Amava angengasela phantsi kweminyaka eyi-8 efanelekileyo/engaqondwa emsebenzini wokuNesingi emva kokubhaliswa njengeNesi yobungcali kwiSANC kwiNesingi jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 kule minyaka ethe ngasentla ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/engaqondwa kwinqanaba lolawulo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kumsebenzi: Ilayisensi yeQhagamshelwano egqithiswe ngumgaqo-nkqubo kwaye ukhululekile ukuhamba ngenjongo zoxhaso kwimpumelelo ephondo ebelweyo nakwiinkqubo zoxhaso kwiziko. Ulwazi/ngabukhosi (ulwazi/ezakhono): Ulwazi oluthe tyaba lomthetho weNesingi, iimigaqo-nkqobo neenkqubo zolawulo nemiqulu, kuquka nemiqathacho yomsebenzi kunye namagunya kwaye ukubhaliswa kwiSANC naseNDoH. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lweNkqubo zokusetyenziswa kweNesi kwiphondo, iimfuno zogunya lweCNP, ukuya phambili kolwazi lobungcali (CPD) kunye nendlela kaLolawulo lweNesi yolwazi. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lweenkqubo zokukhonza komphakathi njengonotshaba, kuquka ukubekwa kwindawo, ukubhaliswa, ukuqala, ukugqibela nokuwela. Ulwazi oluhlobene nolawulo lwesebe likarhulumonte, kuquka iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iimigaqo yeTreasury kunye neNkqubo zeHuman Resources, zokuthenga nzoommuzo wemali. Ulwazi oluthe tyaba loqhagamshelwano lwamandla omlilo, ulawulo lwenkqubo yokuNesingi, ulawulo lolwazi lobungcali, ukuphucula umgangatho nokhuseleko lwegulana. Amakhono aqinileyo ohlelo lokusebenza, ukuqhwayimbana kweenkqubo, ukulandelela nokuqwalasela, ulawulo lwexabiso, ukuxela imibiko nokuqwalasela iinxalenye zolwazi. Amakhono aqinileyo obudlelwane nabantu, uqhagamshelwano nabantu abaqonda phambili, ukuthengisa nokuqhatha ingxoxo. (okubhaliweyo nokuTHethwayo). Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, iTeams nolawulo lweenkqubo zolwazi).
xh.duties: Phatha ukupunyweziwa, ukuqhwayimbana, ukulandelela kunye nokuqwalasela kweenkqubo ezabelweyo ezisezantsi komsebenzi wokuLunga kweNesi ephondo, kuquka ukuhlelwa kwezendalo, ukuxela ngemigaqo nokuqhatha iingozi kunye nokulandelela izinyuzo ezilungisayo. Qhwayimbana ukuphonononga kunye nokupunyweza iindlela zolawulo ezimali nenguwo-mthetho zokuLunga kweNesi nemiqathango yokwenza umsebenzi, qhwayimbana inkqubo yokuqhwaywa ngabahlobo kweNesi ulandelele ukhuseleko lomptshe kunye nomgangatho wonakelemo yeNesi. Yalela ulwangqwele kweNesi nokuveliswa kwezinto ukuze zisetyenziswe kwinkqubo, qhwayimbana iinkqubo zokukhonza komphakathi njengonotshaba nize nilandelele igunya leCNP. Qhwayimbana iNesi ekuyinhloko, i-CPD nemitshato yolawulo, kuquka naba kwindawo ababelweyo, nudibanise neziko lokunyanga iigulane, neziko lemfundo yabaNesi, neziko lemfundo ephakamileyo nabo bonke abantu abaqonde phambili. Phatha abantu ababelweyo, izixhobo nemiqulu qinisekisa ukuba kuqhubeka phantsi komsebenzi ngokwemithetho nemiqathacho ephathelene nayo. Nikezela ngenkxaso kunye nengcebiso kuMphathi weNqubo kaNesi kulawulo oluphezulu malunga nezinto ezithinta inqubo kaNesi.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY Area: Theatre)
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing position in Theatre at Tygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley, requiring a nursing diploma and post-basic theatre nursing qualification, paying R720,819 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre Nursing. OR a 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Peri- operative Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 9 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience in the specific speciality after obtaining the 1 year post-basic qualification in the relevant speciality or post-graduate diploma in the relevant speciality. Inherent requirement of the job: Ability and willingness to assist with shifts and after- hours hospital cover including weekends, public holidays, night duty relief and overtime as the need arises. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Basic computer literacy. Ability to function independently as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Effective communication, interpersonal, leadership, decision-making and conflict resolution skills. Good organisational skills and the ability to function under pressure. Knowledge and insight of relevant legislation and policy related to this nursing speciality within the public sector. Ability to promote quality patient care through the setting, implementation and monitoring of standards. Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Good written and verbal communication skills.
jobs.duties: The candidate will be responsible for planning, managing, co-ordinating and maintaining an optimal, specialized Nursing service as an Operational Manager. Participative management and utilization of Human and Financial Resources to ensure optimal operational function in the area. Initiate and participate in training, development and research within the nursing department. Deliver a support service to the nursing service and the institution. To maintain ethical standards and promote professional growth and self- development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical / competency assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging (SPESIALITEITSGebied: Teater)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging-posisie in Teater by Tygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley, vereis 'n verpleegdiploma en nagraadse teaterverpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n salaris van R720,819 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleging) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre Nursing. OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleging (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Peri-operative Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 9 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 5 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar nagraadse kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Innewoonde vereiste van die werk: Vermoe en bereidwilligheid om te help met skofte en buite-ure hospitaaldekking insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae, nagdiensverligting en oortyd soos die behoefte ontstaan. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoe om onafhanklik sowel as deel van 'n multidissiplinere span te funksioneer. Effektiewe kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en die vermoe om onder druk te funksioneer. Kennis en insig van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleid verbonde aan hierdie verpleegspesialiteit binne die publieke sektor. Vermoe om gehalte pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die vasstelling, implementering en monitering van standaarde. Sterk leierskaps- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Die kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die beplanning, bestuur, koordinering en handhawing van 'n optimale, gespesialiseerde Verpleegdiens as 'n Operasionele Bestuurder. Deelnemende bestuur en benutting van Menslike en Finansiele Hulpbronne om optimale operasionele funksionering in die gebied te verseker. Inisieer en neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing binne die verpleegdepartement. Lewer 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan die verpleegdiens en die instelling. Om etiese standaarde te handhaai en professionele groei en selfontwikkeling te bevorder.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokunakekelwa Kweziguli Osebe Lokwelashwa (Indawo Yobuchwepheshe: I-Theatre)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wemisebenzi yokunakekelwa kweziguli kwi-Theatre esibhedlela i-Tygerberg Hospital, e-Parow Valley, sidinga idiploma yokunakekela kanye nelifundo lokwelashwa lokuthomba i-theatre ngesikhathi sokungena emsebenzini, kuhola R720,819 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izinga eliphansi kakhulu lemfuno yezifundo: I-Qualification ye-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ezenyukeni) noma efana nayo (R683 okanye R254) evumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesayi Ochwepheshe. Ifundo lokunakekela ngesikhathi sokungena emsebenzini ngesikhathi esingaphansi kwesikhathi esingunyaka oyi-1, esamkelwe yi-SANC kwISayensi Yokunakekela Kwezokwelapha Nokuhlinzwa: Ukunakekela Okwenziwa Kwi-Theatre. Noma iziqu ze-Bachelor Degree ezenyukeni eminyakeni engu-4 (R174) noma efana nazo (R683 okanye R1497 noma R171 okanye R1497) ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesayi Ochwepheshe. I-diploma yokufunda ngemva kweziqu ezenyukeni (R635) esamkelwe yi-SANC ekunakekelweni kwabahlinzwa. Ukubhaliswa kubhodi yabachwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoNesayi Ochwepheshe. Okuhlolwayo: Ukuhlolwa okuncane kakhulu kwezikhathi ezingu-9 ezifanele/ezivelele kokunakekela ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoNesayi Ochwepheshe ku-SANC ekunakekelweni Okuvamile. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 kuleso sikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele kube kokuhlolwa okufanele/okovelele kuleyo ndawo yobuchwepheshe ngemva kokuthola ifundo lokunakekela ngesikhathi sokungena emsebenzini esithatha unyaka oyi-1 kuleyo ndawo yobuchwepheshe noma i-diploma yokufunda ngemva kweziqu ezenyukeni kuleyo ndawo yobuchwepheshe. Izindlela ezingeyinhloko zokwenza umsebenzi: Ikhono nentando yokusiza kumashifi nokugqamela kusebenzi esibhedlela ngemva kwezikhathi ezivamile okuhlanganisa amasonto, iziholide zikawonke-wonke, ukulalela emsebenzini ebusuku nokuqhuba ihora elingaphezu kwesikhathi esijwayelekile njengoba kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lokusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela kanye nokuba yingxenye yeqembu elinabochwepheshe abahlukahlukene. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, okuba ngumholi, okuthatha izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono ahle yokuhlela nokusebenza ngaphansi kwegesi. Ulwazi nekuqonda izindlela zomthetho nezinqumo ezihlobene nendawo yobuchwepheshe lokunakekela emkhakheni womphakathi. Ikhono lokukhuthaza ikhwalithi yokunakekela iziguli ngokumisa, ukuphatha nokubheka izinga. Amakhono aqinile okuba ngumholi nokuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethwe kuzobe nesibopho sokuhlela, ukuphatha, ukuqondanisa nokugcina inkonzo yokunakekelwa kweziguli ehle, echwepheshe njengoMphathi Wemisebenzi. Ukuphatha ngokubamba iqhaza nokusebenzisa izinsiza zomuntu nemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle endaweni leyo. Ukuqala nokubamba iqhatha ekuqeqeshweni, ekuthuthukiseni nakocwaningweni emkhakheni wokunakekela. Ukunikeza inkonzo yokweseka inkonzo yokunakekela nesisetjeni. Ukugcina izinga zokuziphatha ngokomthetho futhi ukukhuthaza ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe nokuzithuthukisa.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi yoQhagamshelo lweZolunyango (Indawo yeNqanaba eliPhakamileyo: iTeyitha)
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi weMisebenzi yoQhagamshelo lweZolunyango kwiTeyitha eTygerberg Hospital, eParow Valley, esifuna idiploma yolunyango nesiFundo seTeyitha seNqanaba eliPhezu koBungokuqala, esihlawuliswa iR720,819 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi esifunekayo: Isifundo seBasic R425 (okt. idiploma/idigri yolunyango) okt. isifundo esilinganayo (iR683 ngeR254) esivumela ukubhalisa kunyango lweSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqirha weZolunyango. Isifundo seNqanaba eliPhezu koBungokuqala ngexesha elingangaphezu kwemonye unyaka, esigunyaziswe kwiSANC kwiMedical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre Nursing. OKT idigri yeBachelor yeminyaka eyi-4 kuNursing (iR174) okt. isifundo esilinganayo (iR683 ngeR1497 okt. iR171 ngeR1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kunyango lweSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqirha weZolunyango. Idiploma yeNqanaba eliPhezu kweZifundo (iR635) esigunyaziswe kwiSANC kwiPeri-operative Nursing. Ukubhalisa kwikomkhulu elingunwe: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqirha weZolunyango. Uluvo: Iminyaka engu-9 nangaphezulu yolvo olufanelekileyo/olunako ukuqatshelwa kuZolunyango emva kokuBhaliswa njengoGqirha weZolunyango kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 kule mikhondo ingentla kufuneka ibe yiluvo olufanelekileyo/olunako ukuqatshelwa kwinqanaba elithe ngqo eliPhezulu emva kokuFumana isifundo seNqanaba eliPhezu koBungokuqala kweli qondo okt. idiploma yeNqanaba eliPhezu kweZifundo kweli qondo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ikhono nento yokuzimisela nokuncedisa ngeshaphathi namaxesha angengawo emva kweyure zomsebenzi ezibandakanya amawekendi, iintsuku ezilikho izikhululo, ukukhululeka kumsebenzi wasebusuku nokuqhuba phantsi kwexesha elingaphezulu kokuqhelekileyo xa kumiwo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikrilla): Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo ngekhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nako nokuBakha iqela elinabantu abaninzi. Isikhokelo esisebenzayo, ukuzichazana, ukukhokela, ukuthatha izigqibo nokusombulula iingxabano. Isikrilla esilungileyo seNqanaba lokuhlela nekhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kogxalathelo. Ulwazi nokuQonda ngemithetho neyopolisi enxulumene neli qondo lolunyango kwisebe likarhulumente. Ikhono lokuPhakamisa inqanaba eliphezulu lenkonzo kuguli ngokumisela, nokusebenzisa nokuQwalasela imigangatho. Isikhokela esinamandla nokuzichazana. Isikrilla esilungileyo yokubhala nokuThetha.
xh.duties: Umama okhethiweyo uyakuba ngowokuCwangcisa,okuLawula, ukuQamba nokuGcina inkonzo ePhezulu neseMthethweni yoLunyango njengoMphathi weMisebenzi yoQhagamshelo lweZolunyango. UkuLawula ngokubandakanyeka nokusebenzisa iSabelo mali namaVimba abantu ukuQinisekisa isiphithiphithi esisebenzayo kwendawo leyo. UkuQala nokubandakanyeka ekulungiseleleni, ekuphuhliseni nakuPhandweni ngaphakathi kwesebe loLunyango. UkuNika inkonzo yoxhaso kwenkonzo yoLunyango naseNdaweni. UkuGcina imigangatho yokuziphatha nokukhuthaza ukukhula okusesikweni nokuZiphuhlisa.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (SPECIALTY: Paediatric
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing specialising in Paediatric care at Tygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley, requiring a professional nursing qualification with post-basic critical care child nursing accreditation.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Child Nursing (R212). OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A Post Graduate Diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Critical Care Nursing (Child). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 9 years appropriate / recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirement of the job: Ability and willingness to assist with shifts and after-hours hospital cover including weekends, public holidays, night duty relief and overtime as the need arises. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Basic computer literacy. Ability to function independently as well as part of a multi- disciplinary team. Effective communication, interpersonal, leadership, decision-making and conflict resolution skills. Good organisational skills and the ability to function under pressure. Knowledge and insight of relevant legislation and policy related to this nursing speciality within the public sector. Ability to promote quality patient care through the setting, implementation and monitoring of standards. Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Good written and verbal communication skills.
jobs.duties: The candidate will be responsible for planning, managing, co-ordinating and maintaining an optimal, specialized Nursing service as an Operational Manager. Participative management and utilization of Human and Financial Resources to ensure optimal operational function in the area. Initiate and participate in training, development and research within the nursing department. Deliver a support service to the nursing service and the institution. To maintain ethical standards and promote professional growth and self- development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical / competency assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (SPESIALITEIT: Pediatriese)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde wat spesialiseer in pediatriese sorg by Tygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley, wat 'n professionele verpleegkwalifikasie met nagraadse kritiese-sorg kinderverpleegkunde-akkreditasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Child Nursing (R212). OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse Diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Critical Care Nursing (Child). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 5 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die eenjarige nagraadse basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om met skofte en buite-ure hospitaaldeksel, insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae, nagdiensverligting en oortyd, by te staan soos die behoefte ontstaan. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om onafhanklik asook as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Effektiewe kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en die vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer. Kennis en insig van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleid wat verband hou met hierdie verpleegspesialiteit binne die openbare sektor. Vermoë om gehalte pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die instelling, implementering en monitering van standaarde. Sterk leierskaps- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Die kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die beplanning, bestuur, koördinering en handhawing van 'n optimale, gespesialiseerde verpleegdiens as Operasionele Bestuurder. Deelnemende bestuur en benutting van menslike en finansiële hulpbronne om optimale operasionele funksionering in die area te verseker. Inisiëer en neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing binne die verpleegdepartement. Lewer 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan die verpleegdiens en die instelling. Handhaaf etiese standaarde en bevorder professionele groei en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza Wokuhlinzwa (ISIKHUNZI: Izesulu Sabantwana
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezokusebenza Wokuhlinzwa ohlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwezesulu lezabantwana eTygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley, ofuna izifundo zokuhlinza ezingqalasindiswa ezineqiniso lokwamukelwa lokuhlinza izingane ezisemngcupheni ngemva kwesifundo esiyisisekelo.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esiyisisekelo esidingekayo: Isifundo se-Basic R425 (okoke i-diploma/degree yokuhlinza) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqaji wezokuhlinza. Isifundo sokuhlinza semva kwesisekelo, esibude bonyaka unyaka owodwa ubhaliswe kwi-SANC kwi-Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Child Nursing (R212). Noma i-degree yobudokotela eminyaka emi-4 yokuhlinza (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqaji wezokuhlinza. I-Post Graduate Diploma (R635) ebhaliswe kwi-SANC kwi-Critical Care Nursing (Child). Ukubhalisa kwabengowethembe lomthetho wokuhlinza: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoGqaji Wezokuhlinza. Isipiliyoni: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-9 yesipiliyoni esifanele / esaziwayo sokuhlinza emva kokubhalisa njengoGqaji Wezokuhlinza kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ubuncane beminyaka engu-5 yokuhlinza kuleminyaka okushiwo ngentla kumele kubeyisipiliyoni esifanele/esiyingqalasindiswa emva kokuthola isifundo semva kwesisekelo isikhathi unyaka owodwa noma i-post-graduate diploma kuleso zesulu. Isidingo esifakwe emsebenzini: Ikhono nesinqumo sokusiza ngokushintshana kumashifthi nasekuvikelweni isibhedlela ngemva kwamahora okuhlanganisa amawekendi, amaholide omphakathi, ukuphatha ibhululu ebusuku nokwenza ihora elingeziwe njengoba kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/iziqu): Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lokusebenza ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela kanye nokuqokelwa eqenjini elisebenza ngamakhono ahlukene. Amakhono obuholo, bokuthatha izinqumo, bokuxazulula izinkinga, bokukhuluma kanye nobudlelwano babantu. Amakhono ahleliwe okuhlela kanye nnekhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho nemigomo enohlobene nalesi zesulu sokuhlinza kundwendwe lomphakathi. Ikhono lokukhuthaza ukunakekelwa kwegula okunengqondo ngesimo esihle kuleso sezokuhlinza, nokugcina izinga eliphezulu. Amakhono obuholo namakhono okukhuluma kanye nobudlelwano nabantu. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokukhuluma.
zu.duties: Umhumusha uzobe unobhungu bokuhlela, ukuphatha, ukulawulisisa nokugcina inkonzo yokuhlinza eqqokile ngesikhathi esifanele njengoMphathi Wezokusebenza. Ukuphatha ngokubambisene nokusebenzisa izinsizakusebenza zomuntu nemali ukuze kugqinywe ukuthi inkonzo isebenza kahle endaweni. Ukuqalisa nokubamba iqhaza ekuletheni izifundo, ekuthuthukiseni kanye nokuphenya ngaphakathi komnyango wezokuhlinza. Ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo yokweseka inkonzo yokuhlinza nendawo yesibhedlela. Ukugcina amazinga wobuGqaji kanye nokukhuthaza ukukhula kwobuGqaji nokuzithuthukisa.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi woQhatho lweZempilo (ISIKOLO: Ukunyanga abantwana
xh.summary: Umphathi weMisebenzi woQhatho lweZempilo ogqithiswe kakhulu ekunyatheni abantwana eTygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley, ofuna isityhelifo seqhatho lezempilo elungileyo nengunye namagunya okunyanya ekunyangeni abantwana abasemngciphekeni kokunyathelwa kokufa.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezisezantsi: Isityhelifo esisisiseko sika-R425 (okt. diploma/idyimu kwinkqubo yokunyanga) okt. isityhelifo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa koluntu lweSANC njengogqirha weNurse. Isityhelifo sokunyanga semfundo ephakamileyo, nenyanga yokufunda engu-1 ubude evunywa yiSANC kwinkqubo yokunyanga iNtshontsho nobuhle: Ukunyanya ukunyathelwa kokufa: Ukunyanya abantwana (R212). OKT Idyimu yeminyaka emi-4 kwinkqubo yokunyanya (R174) okt. isityhelifo esilinganayo (R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa koluntu lweSANC njengogqirha weNurse. IPost Graduate Diploma (R635) evunywe yiSANC kwinkqubo yokunyanya ukunyathelwa kokufa (Ukwakha abantwana). Ukubhalisa koluntu lweqhawe: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqirha weNurse. Iphelo yamava: Iminyaka engu-9 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwinkqubo yokunyanya emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha weNurse kwiSANC kwinkqubo yokunyanya iJenerali. Iminyaka engu-5 yexesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka ibengamava afanelekileyo/aqatyiweyo emva kokufumana isityhelifo sokunyanga semfundo ephakamileyo kwinkqubo yokunyanya okt. isityhelifo semfundo ephakamileyo kwinkqubo ethile. Iimfuno zomsebenzi ngokwemvelo: Ulwazi lokuba namandla nokulungele ukuncedisa kumashifti nakwikhaveva yasemva kwamahela ehospithali kuquka iwekendi, imini zethanga, indlela yokuncedisa ebusuku nakwikhaveva yokusebenza ngaphezu kwesixa xa kufuneka. Amagunya (ulwazi/izikrwele): Ulwazi olusisiseko lwekhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza kodwa nokuba ngamnye njengelinye iqela lemisebenzi ebandakanya abantu abaninzi. Ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ekunxibelelaneni, nokuba nobudlelwane nabantu, nokuba ngamagunya okukhokela, okuthatha iigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi loluhlelo lokusebenza nokuba mandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iMithetho nemigaqo eqondene nesi sikolo sokunyanga ngaphakathi koluntu lwabeziko. Amandla okukhuthaza ukunyathwa kwezempilo ezingcono kumagqabi, ngokumisela, nokwenza okulandela imilinganiselo. Amandla okukhokela abantu nokuba nobudlelwane nabo. Ulwazi lokuzalisa nokuthetha kakuhle.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi womthunywa kuya kuba kukhangelo, kulawulo, lokuqamba nokugcina inkonzo yokuqamba ebalulekileyo, efana nokulawula iNkonzo yokunyanya njengoQhawe. Ulawulo ngokubandakanya nokusebenzisa oovoo abantu nemiGalelo yemiVuzo ukugqiba ukwenza kwaye ibengentlanzi, ukuze isebenze ngokugqibeleleyo kwindawo. Ukuqala nokwenza inkonzo yokuzalisa kubaphathi abaninzi kunye nomcimbi wolwazi nokuphanda kwinkqubo yokunyanya. Ukunika inkonzo yokuncedisa iNurse kwaye kwindawo. Ukuhlala urhuqo kwemithetho yokuzelisa nokukhuthaza inkqubo yokukhula ngamandla njengomntu okuzithuthela phambili.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.summary: Manage quality improvement systems and coordinate Ideal Clinic and Ideal Hospital implementation across the Garden Route District.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: A health-related qualification at NQF level 7 that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) or South African Nursing Council (SANC) or South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Experience: Appropriate experience in quality assurance, risk management, OHS and infection prevention control (IPC) in a health service setting program. Appropriate experience in managing quality assurance. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) drivers license and willingness to travel within the district. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer Literacy (MS Office: MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Advance managerial and communication skills (verbal and written. Ability to analyze and interpret Health Systems Information and compile and present reports. Good leadership and project management skills.
jobs.duties: Effectively coordinate and manage Quality Improvement Systems in the District. Support Health Establishment staff and Quality Assurance coordinators with the implementation of the Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance (ICRM) and Ideal Hospital requirements in preparation for the Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC). Coordination and Management of Quality Assurance training needs within the district. Ensure the maintenance of the Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) and Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards within the district. Ensure the quality of Quality Assurance data in the Garden Route District.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a competency test. This post does not form part of the OSD Categories. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Kwaliteitsversekeringsbestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur kwaliteitsverbeteringstelsels en koordineer die implementering van Ideaal Kliniek en Ideaal Hospitaal regdeur die Garden Route Distrik.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Gesondheidsverwante kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) of South African Nursing Council (SANC) of South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) toelaat. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in kwaliteitsversekering, risikobestuur, OHS en infeksievoorkomingsbeheer (IPC) in 'n gesondheidsdiens omgewingsprogram. Toepaslike ervaring in die bestuur van kwaliteitsversekering. Inherent vereiste van die pos: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om binne die distrik te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office: MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Gevorderde bestuurs- en kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik. Vermoë om Gesondheidstelselinligting te ontleed en te interpreteer en verslae op te stel en voor te lê. Goeie leierskap- en projekbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Koordineer en bestuur effektief Kwaliteitsverbeteringstelsels in die Distrik. Ondersteun Gesondheidsinstelling personeel en Kwaliteitsversekeringskoördineerders met die implementering van die Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance (ICRM) en Ideal Hospital vereistes ter voorbereiding op die Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC). Koördinasie en bestuur van Kwaliteitsversekering opleidingsbehoeftes binne die distrik. Verseker die handhawing van die Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) en Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standaarde binne die distrik. Verseker die gehalte van Kwaliteitsversekeringsdata in die Garden Route Distrik.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinsizakalo Ezingapheli Eqinisekisa Ikhwalithi
zu.summary: Phatha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi futhi uhlele ukusetshenziswa kwe Ideal Clinic ne Ideal Hospital kuyo yonke i Garden Route District.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo okubekiwe: Iziqu ezihlobene nezempilo ezingeni le-NQF level 7 ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) noma i-South African Nursing Council (SANC) noma i-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Isipiliwu: Isipiliwu esifanele ekubhekaneni nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, ekuqondanisweni nengozi, kwi-OHS nasekuqondanisweni nokuvikela ukutheleleka (IPC) ohlelweni lwenzeke izinsizakulo zempilo. Isipiliwu esifanele ekuphathweni kokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Isidingo esibonakalayo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) evumelekile nokuthanda ukuhamba endaweni. Ikhono (ulwazi/iziqu): Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office: MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook). Ikhono eliphezulu lezimculo kanye nokuqondana nokuqalisa imisebenzi (elisho neliyabhalwa. Ikhono lokuhlaziya futhi ukuhumusha ulwazi lwezinhlelo zezempilo, ukuqamba futhi ukwethula imibiko. Ikhono elihle kwinkokhoboya nokuqondanisa imigomo yomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa ngempumelelo nokuphatha izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ikhwalithi Kule District. Ukusekela abasebenzi bezinsizakulo zezempilo nabaphathi bokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi ekusetshenzisweni kwe-Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance (ICRM) futhi nezidingo ze-Ideal Hospital ekuhlelweni nge-Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC). Ukuqondaniswa nokuphathwa kwezidingo zeqeqesho le Quality Assurance ngaphakathi kwedolobha. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemigomo ye-Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) ne-Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) endaweni. Ukugcina ikhwalithi ye-data yokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi kule Garden Route District.

xh.title: Mlawuli woQinisekiso lomgangatho
xh.summary: Phatha iinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho kwaye ulungelelanise ukusetyenziswa kwe-Ideal Clinic ne-Ideal Hospital kuwo onke amazwe aGarden Route District.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona: Isifundo esinengxolo ngezempilo esimngangathweni we-NQF level 7 esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) okanye i-South African Nursing Council (SANC) okanye i-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo kuwo qinisekiso lomgangatho, ulawulo lomngcipheko, i-OHS nokuthintela ukutshintshwa ngokubakho kwezifo (IPC) kwinkqubo yesebe lempilo. Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo ekuphathweni kweqinisekiso lomgangatho. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kulesi sithuba: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo nokuqonda ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwesi sihlavo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amashebe): Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office: i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook). Ikhono eliphezulu lokulawula nokuqhathanisa (elinye nelithiwa. Ikhono lokuhlola kunye nokutolika iNkcazelo yeNkqubo yeZempilo nokubhala nokubonezela iiripoti. Ikhono elihle bokukhokela nolawulo amaprojekthi.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa kakuhle uphatha iinkqubo zoQuculo lomgangatho kwisi sihlavo. Nceda abasebenzi beZenzo zeZempilo kunye nabalungiseleli boQinisekiso lomgangatho ngokusetyenziswa kwezimfuno ze-Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance (ICRM) ne-Ideal Hospital kwilungiselelo le-Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC). Ulungelelaniso noLawulo lweemfuno zokufundela uQinisekiso lomgangatho ngaphakathi kwesi sihlavo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemigangatho yoThintelo lokuSasazwa kwezifo (IPC) noLawulo loMzimba woKhuseleko nokuKhuseleka emsebenzini (OHS) ngaphakathi kwesi sihlavo. Qinisekisa umgangatho weenkcukacha zoQinisekiso lomgangatho kwi-Garden Route District.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Coordinator Grade 1 (COMPREHENSIVE
jobs.centre: Central Karoo District Office (stationed in Beaufort West)
jobs.salary_text: R571 161 per annum, (Plus non pensionable rural allowance of 12% of your annual basic salary).
jobs.summary: Coordinate and monitor district child health, HIV/AIDS, STI and TB services in the Central Karoo District Office based in Beaufort West.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/Degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. (This dispensation is only applicable for posts of Clinical Programme Coordinator where it is an inherent requirement of the post, incumbent to maintain registration with the SANC). Registration with a professional council: Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (code B/EB) driver’s licence and a willingness to travel in the district as well as in the province. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good psychosocial, health assessment, interpersonal, planning, organisational and training skills. Good interpersonal relations, leadership and communication skills (verbal and written). Appropriate knowledge of the Maternal-Child- Women’s-Health, HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, and Chronic Conditions and must be computer literate (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary team.
jobs.duties: Ensure implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation of the District Child health services and strategies. Support the implementation of the HIV/AIDS/STI/TB services, establish linkages with integrated management of chronic conditions, Maternal Women, Youth and Men’s Health and the 1st 1000 day’s strategies within the Laingsburg and Prince Albert sub districts and the Beaufort West Sub District. Support the internal and external interface strengthening with the focus on the COPC Model. Monitor and evaluate programme goals and targets including the collection, validation and interpretation of statistical data. Support the Laingsburg and Prince Albert Sub Districts and the Beaufort West Sub District to achieve and maintain Ideal Health status (PHC facilities and District Hospitals). Support the Laingsburg and Prince Albert Sub Districts and the Beaufort West Sub District to with all other quality related services.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/written assessment and competency test. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder Graad 1 (OMVATTEND)
af.summary: Koördineer en monitor distriksgesondheidsdienste vir kinders, MIV/VIGS, SOI en TB in die Sentraal-Karoo Distrikkantoor gevestig in Beaufort West.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma/Graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SAVR) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 4-jarige Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SAVR) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. (Hierdie disposisie is slegs van toepassing op posse van Kliniese Programkoördineerder waar dit 'n inherente vereiste van die pos is dat die ampsdraer by die SAVR geregistreer bly). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by SAVR as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SAVR in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en 'n bereidwilligheid om in die distrik sowel as in die provinsie te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie psigososiale, gesondheidsassesserings, interpersoonlike, beplannings, organisatoriese en opleidingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, leierskap en kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Toepaslike kennis van Moeder-kind- Vroue-gesondheid, MIV/VIGS/SOI/TB en Chroniese Toestande en moet rekenaargeletterd wees (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk.
af.duties: Verseker implementering, koördinering, monitering en evaluering van die Distriksgesondheidsdienste vir kinders en strategieë. Ondersteun die implementering van die MIV/VIGS/SOI/TB-dienste, vestig skakel met geïntegreerde bestuur van chroniese toestande, Moeder-, Vroue-, Jeug- en Mansgesondheid en die 1st 1000 day's-strategieë binne die Laingsburg en Prince Albert subdistrikte en die Beaufort West Subdistrik. Ondersteun die interne en eksterne koppelvlakversterking met die fokus op die COPC-model. Monitor en evalueer programdoelwitte en teikens insluitend die versameling, validering en interpretasie van statistiese data. Ondersteun die Laingsburg en Prince Albert Subdistrikte en die Beaufort West Subdistrik om Ideale Gesondheidsstatus (PHC-fasiliteite en Distrikshospitale) te bereik en te handhaaf. Ondersteun die Laingsburg en Prince Albert Subdistrikte en die Beaufort West Subdistrik met alle ander gehalteverwante dienste.

zu.title: UMqhumenti Wohlelo Lweklinikhi Izinga 1 (COMPREHENSIVE
zu.summary: Qondanisa futhi ulawule izinsizakalo zezempilo zezingane zesifunda, i-HIV/AIDS, i-STI ne-TB eNdiweni Yesifunda i-Central Karoo esikhundleni esiku-Beaufort West.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Ikhwalifikheshini ye-Basic R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma/IDigri ekun esemplilo) noma ikhwalifikheshini efana nayo (R683 kanye no-R254) evumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogugiwe ogunyaziwe. Noma IDigri yeminyaka eyi-4 eNursing (R174) noma ikhwalifikheshini efana nayo (R683 kanye no-R1497 noma i-R171 kanye no-R1497) evumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogugiwe ogunyaziwe. (Lolu hlelo lusebenza kuphela kumaphosi eClinical Programme Coordinator lapho kuyisidingo esingaphakathi kwesikhundla ukuthi umuntu oseqhingini ahlale ebuyelele ebalweni ku-SANC). Uku bhaleka ebhodini labakhongiwe: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogugiwe ogunyaziwe. Isipiliyoni: Ugcino oluncane olweminyaka engu-7 isipiliyoni esihambisana nesibonakalayo ekun esempilo ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengogugiwe ogunyaziwe ku-SANC e-General Nursing. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile (ikhowudi i-B/EB) nokuzithoba ukuhamba esifundeni nakulo lonke isifundazwe. Iziqu eziyingqayizivele (ulwazi/izikhali): Amakhono amahle okuhlola inhlalo yengqondo, impilo, ubudlelwanoabantu, ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa nokuxhumana. Amakhono amahle obudlelwanoabantu, abakhokeli nokuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ulwazi oluhambisana ne-Maternal-Child-Women's-Health, i-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, nezimo ezingapheli kanti kufanele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint). Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa nasethimini elinobunjiniyela obuningi.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa, ukuqhwebuka, ukulawula nokuhlolwa kwesimiso sezinsizakalo zezempilo zezingane zesifunda. Sekela ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo ze-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, misa izinhlobonhlobo nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezingeni elinzima, isimo esingapheli kanye ne-Maternal Women, Youth and Men's Health, izinhlelo zokuqala izinsuku ezingama-1000 ngaphakathi kwendawo engaphansi kwesifunda i-Laingsburg ne-Prince Albert kanti futhi e-Beaufort West Sub District. Sekela ukuxhumana ngaphakathi nangaphandle okuqiniswa okugxile kwimodeli ye-COPC. Lawula futhi uhlole izinhloso nezinhlelo zenhlaka kohlelo okubalwa kuhle imininingwane eqinisekisiwe ehlelwa ngolwazi. Sekela ama-Laingsburg ne-Prince Albert Sub Districts kanye ne-Beaufort West Sub District ukufeza futhi ahlale esimweni se-Ideal Health (izinsizakalo ze-PHC namaspitali aesifundeni). Sekela ama-Laingsburg ne-Prince Albert Sub Districts kanye ne-Beaufort West Sub District ngazo zonke ezinye izinsizakalo ezihlobene nenhla.

xh.title: Umxhasi wenkqubo yezempilo esebenza ngobulumko inqanaba 1 (EQULWELIWEYO
xh.summary: Ukuqamba ngokuhambelana nokulawula iinkonzo ezithintela impilo yabantwana kwilizwe, i-HIV/AIDS, i-STI, nethofu kwiofice yedolophu yase-Central Karoo District eBeaufort West.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi kwemigangatho: Isigaba se-R425 esisisiseko (okt. I-Diploma/I-Degree kwabongqondi) okanye isigaba esilinganayo (i-R683 nge-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqitha wokhathalelo lwempilo. OKT I-Degree yamashumi amane eminyaka kwakhona (i-R174) okanye isigaba esilinganayo (i-R683 nge-R1497 okt i-R171 nge-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqitha wokhathalelo lwempilo. (Le ndlela isebenza kuphela kwezithuba zikaMxhasi wenkqubo yezempilo apho kuyimfuno engapheleleyo yesithuba, ukuba umntu osebenzayo agcine ukubhalisa kwi-SANC). Ukubhalisa kwikhonsolo yemisebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoGqitha wokhathalelo lwempilo. Isiphaluka: Iminyaka eyi-7 ubuncinane yesiphaluka esifanelekileyo/esiqondekayo kwikhathalelo lweempilo emva kokubhalisa njengoGqitha wokhathalelo lwempilo kwi-SANC kwikhathalelo lwezempilo ngokubanzi. Imfuno engapheleleyo yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (code B/EB) esebenzayo nolungelelwaniso lokuhamba kwidolophu nakwiphondo. Iikhomphethensi (ulwazi/amakhono): I-counselling ngokwasempilo, isilingo semisebenzi yoluntu, ukubhekisa phakathi kwabantu, ukuqamba, ukuqamba iibhodi, nezicwangciso zokufundisa. Iqhinga lokubhekisa phakathi kwabantu, abasebenzi njengamakhaka, nokuqhathanisa amanani (ngelivi nangokubhalwayo). Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokunyanga ukhathalelo lwabazali-abantwana-basabhinqa-basemzimbeni, i-HIV/AIDS, i-STI, i-TB, nokuqwalasela iimeko eziphila ngokunyuka ixesha elide kwaye kubekho lolwazi ngokwasekhaya nasebunxwameni kakhulu (i-MS Word, i-Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint). Ulwazi lokusebenzela ngokwakhe nangakumbi kwiqela elinemisebenzi ehlukene.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukusebenza, ukuqamba, ukulawula nokulinganisa iinkonzo nezicwangciso zokwazi impilo yabantwana kwilizwe. Xhasa ukusebenza kweenkonzo ze-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, misela iindlela ezidityaniswe neyoMkhangelo olukhawulezayo weemeko ezilawulayo ezinzima ngaphandle kwexesha elide, Eempilo zokuqala ze-1000 kwabafazi, iintsuku, iintsana, kunye neentsapho kwilali yase-Laingsburg nase-Prince Albert Sub Districts nakwindawo yase-Beaufort West Sub District. Xhasa ukomelela ngaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuzinikela ngokukhawuleza kumthetho othiwo yi-COPC Model. Qwalasela kwaye ulinganise iinjongo ngokuchaneka kunye namaxabiso eziqinisekisiweyo ngokutolikwa izibalo ezingazanywa. Xhasa iinguqu ezingabangelwa zi-Sub Districts zase-Laingsburg nase-Prince Albert, kunye ne-Beaufort West Sub District ukuze kugqitywe kugcine isixeko sezempilo nangokwemilinganiselo yokumathela (kwezikhululo zokuqala zempilo nasezibhedlele zentsapho). Xhasa iinkalo ezingenziwa kwindawo yase-Laingsburg nase-Prince Albert Sub Districts, nase-Beaufort West Sub District, ngazo naziphi na ezinye iinkonzo ezingqinelana nobuchule bokwenza imisebenzi yamandla igqibe ngokupheleleyo.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1 (GENERAL Unitil)
jobs.summary: Manage nursing operations at Lentegeur Hospital in the Western Cape, supervising client care and coordinating multidisciplinary teamwork.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid code (B/EB) drivers licence. Willingness to work shifts, after hours, public holidays, day or night and standby duties. Willingness to assist in other wards when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent verbal and written communication skills in at least two of the three official languages of the Western Cape. Ability to promote quality patient care through the setting, implementation and monitoring of standards. Effective interpersonal, leadership, organisational skills, decision making and conflict resolution skills. Computer literacy in the MS package (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Ensure that clinical nursing practice rendered by the nursing team and promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards. Ability to manage the hospital after-hours and rotate on night duty. Demonstrate a good understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Knowledge of FBU functions and management (ability to work collaboratively within FBUs). Appropriate/recognisable experience working within the Psychiatric and Intellectual Disability services. Appropriate experience working with in the Acute Psychiatric Services.
jobs.duties: Supervise, co-ordinate and delegate the provision of effective and efficient client care through adequate excellent quality care. Maintain constructive working relationships with nursing and other stakeholders (i.e. inter- professional, inter-sectoral and multi- disciplinary teamwork). Effective and efficient management of all resources. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of nursing care plan and evaluation thereof. Ensure that participation in research related activities are evident in the nursing practice. Maintain professional growth and ethical standards and promote quality of nursing care.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging Graad 1 (ALGEMEEN Unitil)
af.summary: Bestuur verplegingsbedrywighede by Lentegeur Hospitaal in die Western Cape, hou toesig oor kliëntsorg en koördineer multidissiplinêre spanwerk.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. diploma/graad in verpleging) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Geldige kode (B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, na ure, openbare vakansiedae, dag of nag en bystandspligte. Bereidwilligheid om in ander sale te help wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die drie amptelike tale van die Western Cape. Vermoë om gehalte-pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die instelling, implementering en monitering van standaarde. Effektiewe interpersoonlike, leierskaps-, organisatoriese vaardighede, besluitneming en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in die MS-pakket (Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Verseker dat kliniese verplegingspraktyk deur die verplegingsspan gelewer word en bevorder die gehalte van verplegingsore soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde. Vermoë om die hospitaal na ure te bestuur en nagdiens te roteer. Toon 'n goeie begrip van HR- en finansiëlebeleide en -praktyke. Kennis van FBU-funksies en -bestuur (vermoë om saam te werk binne FBUs). Toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in die werk binne die Psigiatriese en Intellektuele Gestremdheidsdienste. Toepaslike ervaring in die werk binne die Akute Psigiatriese Dienste.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor, koördineer en delegasie van die voorsiening van effektiewe en doeltreffende kliëntsorg deur voldoende uitstekende gehaltesorg. Onderhou konstruktiewe werksverhoudings met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes (d.i. interprofessionele, intersektorale en multidissiplinêre spanwerk). Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van alle hulpbronne. Koördineer en monitor die implementering van die verplegingsorgplan en die evaluering daarvan. Verseker dat deelname aan navorsingsverwante aktiwiteite in die verplegingspraktyk duidelik is. Onderhou professionele groei en etiese standaarde en bevorder die gehalte van verplegingsorg.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomsebenzi Wokuhluza Abagulayo Ezingeni 1 (GENERAL Unitil)
zu.summary: Phatha izomsebenzi zokuhluza abagulayo esibhedlela i-Lentegeur Hospital e-Western Cape, uqaphele ukunakekelwa kwebhenti futhi uhlanganise umsebenzi weqembu labantu abaphuma kumagatsha ahlukene.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Ikhwalifayikheshini ye-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekuhluzeni abagulayo) noma ikhwalifayikheshini elinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R880) evumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenesi ehloniphekile. Ukubhalisa kubhalane labo mgogo: Ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengenesi ehloniphekile. Isipiliyense: Ubufakazi bekhulu leminyaka e-7 bokuhluza abagulayo emumva kokubhalisa njengenesi ehloniphekile ku-SANC ekuhluzeni kwonke. Isidingo esibangelwa umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile (code (B/EB)). Ukuzithoba ukusebenza kumashifu, ngemva kwamahora, ngezikhathi zomphakathi, nsuku noma ebusuku kanye nemisebenzi yokulindela. Ukuzithoba ukusiza kwezinye izigula uma kudingeka. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Amandla aphezulu okukhuluma nokubhala ngobuhlakani kuleliyiNgilizi nezinye izilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni e-Western Cape. Amandla okuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwemigogofela ebunjini ngokusetha, ukusebenzisa nokuhlola izindinganiso. Amandla aphezulu okuxhumana nabantu, okuba ngumholi, wokuhlela, wokuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha kule-MS package (Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhluza kwabagulayo okwenziwa yiqembu labahluzi kuthuthukiswe futhi kukhuthaze ikhwalithi yokuhluza njengokuqondiswa umkhakha wezomsebenzi kanye nezindinganiso. Amandla okuphatha isibhedlela ngemva kwamahora kanye nokujika ebusuku. Bonisa ukuqonda okuhle kwezinqubomgomo kanye nezobuchwepheshe zamandla abantu nezimali. Ulwazi lwezomsebenzi ze-FBU kanye nokuphatha (amandla okusebenza ndawonye kuma-FBU). Ubufakazi obufanele bokusebenza emumva kwamasevisi we-Psychiatric ne-Intellectual Disability. Ubufakazi obufanele bokusebenza kumasevisi we-Acute Psychiatric.
zu.duties: Qaphela, hlanganisa futhi ulothe ukunakekelwa kwemigogofela ngempumelelo nangokushesha ukubonelela ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabahluzi kanye nabo bonke abanye (okungukuthi- ukuhlangenwe ndawonye ngomsebenzi phakathi kwamagatsha ahlukene, phakathi kwezinkimba kanye neqembu labantu abaphuma kumagatsha ahlukene). Uphathe ngempumelelo nangokushesha wonke amalebula. Hlanganisa futhi uqaphele ukusebenziswa koluhlelo lokunakekelwa nokuhlola imvelaphqondo kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuthathana kwezomlando kubonakala ekwenzeni isomsebenzi sokuhluza. Gcina ukukhula ngomsebenzi kanye nezindinganiso zokuziphatha futhi uthuthukise ikhwalithi yokuhluza abagulayo.

xh.title: Umphathi wokuSebenza weNtengiso zeMpilo inqanaba le-1 (GENERAL Unitil)
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yokunengiso kwamanye amaxepha eNsixeba yeLentegeur eWestern Cape, elawula inkcumbela yabathengi kwaye uqwalaselelana nomsebenzi omanyeneyo wamabanga amaninzi.
xh.requirements: Isigaba sokugqibela emfundo: Isigaba esisisiseko se-R425 (oko ngamagama athi idiploma/degree kwinengiso) okanye isigaba esilinganayo (R683 ngokudityaniswa ne-R880) esivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqithi weNtengiso zeMpilo. Ukubhaliswa kwiNkunzi ephathwayo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqithi weNtengiso zeMpilo. Iminyaka yomsebenzi: Ukuba kubukho iminyaka engaphezu kwe-7 yokuhlala kwamanye amaxesha yokumanyelwa emsebenzini okhoyo onke kwiNtengiso zeMpilo emva kokubhaliswa njengogqithi weNtengiso zeMpilo kwi-SANC kwiNtengiso yeZemihla ngemihla. Isiphithiphithi sokumanyelwa kwesithuba: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba ikhodi (B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ngokutshintsha iishifti, emva kweyure ezichaziweyo, kwiiholide zoluntu, emini okanye ebusuku kwaye ukwazi ukuhlala kwimisebenzi yokulindela. Ukuzithanda ukuncedisa kwezinye izigcina xa kufuneka. Iindlela ezisebenzayo (ulwazi/obuchwepheshe): Ukuba nobuchule bokuchazwa ngemilomo nepepela phantsi kolwimi olusemthethweni ngamnye kwezintathu zolwimi zasemthethweni zaseWestern Cape. Ukuba nolwazi lokuqhuba inkcumbela yamagqabi eqondo lomntu ekubekiweni, ukuphunyezelweni nasekuqwalaselweni kweenqanaba zemigqatsela. Iindlela ezisebenzayo ezityhila ukuziphatha ngokubakho kwaye nengqondo yokuzimisela ngokwengqondo nengcamango, elungiselela, ukwazi ukuziba ngengcinga nokulawula imizobo ephikisana nemisebenzi. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha ngokusetyenziswa kweMS package (i-Word, i-Excel, ne-PowerPoint). Qinisekisa ukuba inzame yeNtengiso zeMpilo yamagqabi eqondo lomntu ibonelelwa ligqitha leNtengiso zeMpilo elihamba phambili kwaye kukhuthaze ulwazi lokuqhuba ukhuseleko lomntu njengoko kuchaziwe ngummandla wolwazi oqwalaselwa ngabachwepheshe kwezo nqanaba.
