zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwegulane okukhulu ngokuqondene nokuhlonza izidingo zokunakekela, ukuhlela nokuphatha izinhlelo zokunakekela kanye nokufundisa abasebenzi bokunakekela njengonesi Ohlotshanwe Ngobuchwepheshe enkilasweni ethize yokunakekelwa. Nikeza futhi uqaphele ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okukhethekile futhi uxhase abasebenzi bezokwelapha ngezinqubo ngaphakathi kwenkinobho yokwelapha enkilasini ethize. Sebenzisa izibulali-muntu, izinto kanye nezinsiza ezingokwemvelo kanye nentuthuko yakho nabaninye.

xh.title: Umongikazi weNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (ISEPEYELITI: i-Orthopaedics)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi weNqanaba eliphezulu (i-Orthopaedics) eTygerberg Hospital ukunika kunye nokulawula ukhatho olusemthethweni lokunyanga oluchanekileyo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingokugqibela: Isifundo esiyisisiseko seR425 (okt. idiploma/ideshi kwindyubo yokunyanya) okt isifundo esilinganayo (iR683) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi weNqanaba eliphezulu. Isifundo sokunyanga sobuchule sokwazisa kwelinye inqanaba esiba neithuba lesinye isikhosi esinganomyaka oyi-1 ubude, esivunyelwe yiSANC kwiMedical and Surgical Nursing Science: Orthopaedic Nursing. (iR212). OKT Idegree yeminyaka emi-4 yobugcisa bokunyanya (iR174) okt isifundo esilinganayo (iR171 ngeR1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi weNqanaba eliphezulu. Idiploma yesiphaluka sokuqhubela phambili (iR635) esivunyelwe yiSANC kwi-Orthopaedic Nursing. Ukubhalisa kwiBhungo lomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi weNqanaba eliphezulu. Isiphaluka: Inqanaba 1: Okungaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-4 yamava ahambelana nayo/awaziwayo ekunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi weNqanaba eliphezulu kwiSANC ekunyanganweni i-General Nursing. Inqanaba 2: Okungaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-14 yamava ahambelana nayo/awaziwayo ekunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi weNqanaba eliphezulu kwiSANC ekunyanganweni i-General Nursing. Apho kunomnyaka weshumi kuphela kweli xesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava ahambelana nayo/awaziwayo kulawo nkqo welisepeyelite emva kokufumana isifundo sekwazisa kwelinye inqanaba esiba neithuba lesinye isikhosi okt idiploma yesiphaluka eza kwelinye inqanaba kwelisepeyelite ekufuneka kuyo. Iminesento yomsebenzi ngokwemvelaphi: Kuya kufuneka usebenze ngokutshintsha amatyala, ngama-weekend nakwiintsuku zihlobo. Ukulungelelana ukujikeleza ngaphakathi kwesimmo se-Orthopaedics. Ikhompyutha (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi olusesantloko lokusebenzana nekhompyutha. Izakhono ezilungileyo zokubhala nokuthetha. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigaqo ehambelana nolusepeyelite lokunyanya. Izakhono ezomeleleyo zokukhokela nokwazi ukusebenza nabantu. Izakhono ezilungileyo zolawulo nokuqonda ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwexesha nokuchazeka ngokusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo. Ukubonisa ixabiso lesimmo seDepartment of Health and Wellness (WCG) ekuphumezeleleni imisebenzi ngenkathi usebenza ngaphakathi kwemithetho, iimigaqo nemithetho yokuqhuba ehambelana nesebe lokarhulumente.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukhatho olungangangcwatho kumaguli malunga nokuchonga iimfuno zokhatho, iplani nokusetyenziswa kweplani zokhatho kwaye kufundise abantu abanika ukhatho njengomongikazi weNqanaba eliphezulu kulawo nkqo wesebe lokuhlinza ngobuchule. Nikela kunye nokuqhuba ukhatho olusemthethweni oluchanekileyo lokunyanya kwaye uxhase abasebenzi besebe lokuhlinza ngeenkqubo ngaphakathi kwesebe elithile lelinye iclinical speciality unit. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto ezingabonwayo nendalo enjalo, kunye nophuhliso lwakho nabalwelwa bakho.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Oncology)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Oncology) sought at Tygerberg Hospital in Parow Valley to render and supervise specialised clinical nursing care in oncology.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Oncology (R212). OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A postgraduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Oncology Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A Minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification or Post Graduate Diploma in the relevant speciality. Inherent requirement of the job: Will be required to work shifts, weekends and public holidays. Willingness to rotate between Oncology departments. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Basic computer literacy. Good written and verbal communication skills. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policy related to the nursing speciality. Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Good organisational skills and the ability to function under pressure. Display core values of the Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) on the execution of duties while practicing within the legislation, regulations and protocols applicable to the public service.
jobs.duties: Ensure quality patient care regarding the identification of nursing care needs, the planning and implementation of nursing care plans and the education of the nursing personnel as a Professional Nurse in the specific speciality clinical area. Render and supervise specialised clinical nursing care and support clinical staff with procedures within the specific clinical speciality unit. Utilize human, material and physical resources and development of self and others.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the required qualification will be appointed into the general stream, and they will be required to obtain the necessary qualification within the predetermined period of time. Candidates who are not in possession of stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time registration in the post- basic qualification or Post Graduate Diploma accredited with the SANC in the relevant speciality. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Onkologie)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Onkologie) gesoek by Tygerberg Hospital in Parow Valley om gespesialiseerde kliniese verpleegsorg in onkologie te lewer en te toesig te hou.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Oncology (R212). OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Oncology Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die eenjarige post-basiese kwalifikasie of Nagraadse Diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Sal verplig wees om skofte, naweke en openbare vakansiedae te werk. Bereidwilligheid om tussen Onkologie-departemente te roteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleid verbonde aan die verpleegspesialiteit. Sterke leierskaps- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en die vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer. Toon kernwaardes van die Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) by die uitvoering van pligte terwyl daar binne die wetgewing, regulasies en protokolle van toepassing op die openbare diens gepraktyk word.
af.duties: Verseker gehalte pasiëntesorg met betrekking tot die identifisering van verpleegsorgbehoeftes, die beplanning en implementering van verpleegsorgplanne en die opleiding van verpleegpersoneel as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in die spesifieke spesialiteitskliniese area. Lewer en hou toesig oor gespesialiseerde kliniese verpleegsorg en ondersteun kliniese personeel met prosedures binne die spesifieke kliniese spesialiteiteenheid. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne en ontwikkeling van self en ander.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Othile Isigaba 1 kuya ku-2 (ISKWENGEZELWE: I-Oncology)
zu.summary: Kufunwa uMhlengikazi Othile (I-Oncology) eTygerberg Hospital eParow Valley ukunikeza futhi alawule ukunakekelwa kwezokuhlengwa kwezokwelapha okukhethekile kokuhlinzwa kwezifo ezibanga umhlaza.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Isigungu se-R425 esiyisisekelo (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ekuhlengweni) noma isibuyekezo esihambisanayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomHlengikazi Othile. Isibuyekezo sokuhlenga emva kweqophe eliyisisekelo esithatha isikhathi esingaphansi konyaka owodwa, esigunyaziwe yi-SANC e-Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Oncology (R212). Noma kungenzwa iziqu ezingohlaza lonyaka o-4 ekuhlengweni (R174) noma isibuyekezo esihambisanayo (R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomHlengikazi Othile. Idiploma yeziqu eziphakeme (R635) esigunyaziwe yi-SANC e-Oncology Nursing. Ukwemukelwa kwiPhikili elisebenza kaluhlelo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomHlengikazi Othile. Isipiliya: Isigaba 1: Usuku olungaphansi konyaka o-4 isipiliya sokuhlenga esihambisanayo/okungaqondakala kalula emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomHlengikazi Othile e-General Nursing. Isigaba 2: Isikhathi esingaphansi konyaka o-14 isipiliya sokuhlenga esihambisanayo/okungaqondakala kalula emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomHlengikazi Othile e-General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesikhathi esikhunjulwe ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliya esihambisanayo/okungaqondakala kalula emva kokuqeda isibuyekezo sonyaka owodwa emva kweqophe eliyisisekelo noma i-Post Graduate Diploma enkundleni ebalulekile ehlukene. Isidingo sokusebenza esibheke phambili: Uzocelwa ukuba asebenze ngokushintshana kwabasebenzi nangamaphoyinti emisitho yesikhathi namaholide. Ukuzethemba ukushintshiselwa phakathi kwamasigaba e-Oncology. Izikabili (ulwazi/iziqu): Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lwekhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokukhuluma. Ulwazi ngomthetho kanye nomthethosisekelo ohlobene nesigaba sokuhlengwa okukhethekile. Amakhono aphambili okuhola nokuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono amahle okuhlela kanye nethemba lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwexesha elinzima. Kubonise amaxabiso aqavile e-Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) ekwenzeni imisebenzi ngokuhambisa imisebenzi ngaphantsi komthetho, imimiselo namaprotokholo aseyahlayona kumconventi wezempilo kanye noTshilo yohlelo lwezomnotho.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa izinto ezibalulekile ngokunakekelwa kwesiguli mayelana nokubona izidingo zokunakekelwa, ukuphendula kwaye ufake ukugxila ekwenzeni iinkqubo ezinjalo nokufundisa abasebenzi bezokuhlolwa njengomHlengikazi Othile kwesikhundla okukhethekile kwezokuhlolwa. Yidla ngokuhlinza kwaye ulawule ukunakekelwa kwesiguli ngokukhethekile kakhulu kwaye uxhase abasebenzi ngeenkqubo kwicala elithile lokwelapha. Phefumlelana ngokwakha amandla ezantsi ngokwemveliso yekhaya elisebenziseka ngokomsebenzi kwaye ulungelelanise ukusetyenziswa kwemithi eqqiweyo.

xh.title: Umongikazi Ochwepheshe Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (ISEBELOKHODI: i-Oncology)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi ochwepheshe (i-Oncology) kwiTygerberg Hospital eParow Valley ukunika ukhathalelo oluchwepheshe lweklinikhi kwaye aluhlalele kwinkqubo yongongikazi kwi-Oncology.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingapheli koko: Isifanekiso esisisiseko seR425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/izidanga kongongikazi) okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ochwepheshe. Isifanekiso sokongongikazi sokwangemva kwesidanga esingenamfuno sonyaka omnye ubude obhephileyo kwiSANC kwisoSebenzisolentsimbi nobuGqirha: i-Oncology (R212). OKANYE Izidanga ezine ezidangayo kongongikazi (R174) okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo (R171 negama neR1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ochwepheshe. Idiploma yamangemva kwesidanga (R635) ehephile kwiSANC kongongikazi kwi-Oncology. Ukubhalisa kwiqhinga lichwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ochwepheshe. Isiphaluka: Inqanaba 1: Isiphaluka esingapheli kweminyaka emi-4 esifanelekileyo/esiqondekayo kongongikazi emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ochwepheshe kongongikazi jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Isiphaluka esingapheli kweminyaka eli-14 esifanelekileyo/ esiqondekayo kongongikazi emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi ochwepheshe kongongikazi jikelele. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 kwelixa elithintelwe ngasentla kufuneka kube ngumzekelo ongapheli kwesifanekiso somnyaka wongongikazi osalandela isidanga okanye idiploma yamangemva kwesidanga kwisoSebe esibalulekileyo. Iimfuno ezingaphezu kokuzelelelwa komsebenzi: Uzakudinga ukusebenza kumashifthi, iimpelaveki namaholide zoluntu. Ukuzithanda ukujikeleza phakathi kweendawo ze-Oncology. Iimpawu (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olusisiseko lwekhompyutha. Amakhono amabalise abhalwayo nethethwayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomthetho namapholisi ahambelana nesebe longongikazi. Khondo enamandla kwaye kubakho abantu abasondeleyo. Amakhono alungiselelwe kahle nokuqikelela ngaphantsi komrhuzo. Ukubonisa amaxabiso aphakathi kwisebe leNyuso nokuPilisa (WCG) ekwenziweni kwemisebenzi ngelixa ulandela imigaqo yomthetho, iimigcaqo nemiqathango yonyezo lwentlangano.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukhathalelo lwezigulane olulinganayo ngokumayela nokujonga iimfuno zokhathalelo lomngikazi, iplani nokuphumeza iiplani zokhathalelo lomngikazi nokuqonda abasebenzi besebe longongikazi njengomongikazi ochwepheshe kwendawo yeclining igqwetha. Nikela oluqondileyo lweklinikhi yongongikazi ochwepheshe nokusika igxalaba labasebenzi be-clinical ngenkqubo ngaphakathi kwindawo egqwetha yamakhlinikh. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto nemisebenzi yendalo nophuhliso lwakho nabanye.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 tot 2 (PRIMÊRE Gesondheid
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn gesoek vir Saldanha Bay-kliniek om genesende en kindergesondheidsprogramme binne die bestek van praktyk te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar diploma in Kliniese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap: Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg, geakkrediteer by die SANC (R48). OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorgverpleging. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie OF 'n nagraadse diploma in die relevante spesialiteit. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B/EB) en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die Verpleegwet en relevante regulasies. Kennis van die Medicines Control Act, Mental Health Care Act, Child Health Act en ander relevante wetgewing. Kennis en toepassing van Ideal Clinic en National Core Standards. Kennis van Community Orientated Primary Care.
af.duties: Effektiewe uitvoering en assisteer met die bestuur van relevante genesende programme binne die bestek van praktyk en wees 'n voorstander vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Effektiewe uitvoering en assisteer met die bestuur van relevante kindergesondheid binne die bestek van praktyk en wees 'n voorstander vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Effektiewe uitvoering en assisteer met die bestuur van relevante vrouegesondheid binne die bestek van praktyk en wees 'n voorstander vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Effektiewe uitvoering en assisteer met die bestuur van relevante HAST-programme binne die bestek van praktyk en wees 'n voorstander vir die pasiënt om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gesondheidsorg te verseker. Die effektiewe voorsiening van hoëgehaltedienste gemeet aan die uitkomste van al die gehalteversekeringsaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezokwelapha Obungaziwa Buhle Ngesikhundla Sokuqala kuya Kwesibili (EZOKUNEMBA
zu.summary: Kufunwa umsebenzi wezokwelapha obungaziwa buhle ohloleni i-Saldanha Bay ukuphatha izinhlela zokwelapha kanye nezesiguli sabantwana ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isibili se-R425 (okuwidiploma/iziqu kwezokunemba) noma isibili esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli wezokunemba ohlelekile. Isibili sokunemba ngemva kwesisekelo esithatha okungenani unyaka o-1 widiploma kwezokunemba bokwelapha: Ukulinganisela, Ukukhulelwa kanye nokukhulisa, esivunyelwe yi-SANC (R48). Noma I-Njalo yeziqu ze-4 (R174) noma esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma i-R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli wezokunemba ohlelekile. I-PhD (R635) eholiswe yi-SANC kwezokunemba bokuqala. Ukubhaliswa kwabomakadebona: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoguli wezokunemba ohlelekile. Isipiliyoni: Isikhundla 1: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/okubonakalayo kwezokunemba ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoguli wezokunemba ohlelekile ku-SANC kwezokunemba jikelele. Isikhundla 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-14 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/okubonakalayo kwezokunemba ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoguli wezokunemba ohlelekile ku-SANC kwezokunemba jikelele. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-10 yesikhathi esibhalwe ngenhla kufanele kube yisipiliyoni esifanelekile/okubonakalayo ohlelweni oluthize ngemva kokuqeda idiploma yokunemba ngemva kwesisekelo unyaka o-1 Noma idiploma ngemva kwamashadu ohlelweni oluthize. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni (Ikhodi B/EB) kanye nokuzethemba ukuhamba. Izikhali (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi ngomthetho Wezokunemba kanye nemithetho ehlobene. Ulwazi ngomthetho Wokulawula Amayeza, umthetho Wezokunemba Komqondo, umthetho Wezempilo zabantwana kanye nalawo abanye abahlobene. Ulwazi kanye nokusebenzisa amasu akhethiwe ohlelweni nangezindinganiso zombuso. Ulwazi ngezokunemba bokutholakala kwindawo yokuhlala.
zu.duties: Ukuhlelwa okuhle kakhulu nokwesekwa ukuphathwa kwezinhlela zokwelapha eziyimfihlo ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza nokuba ngumagqugquzeli wesiguli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwezempilo eziyadingeka. Ukuhlelwa okuhle kakhulu nokwesekwa ukuphathwa kwezokunemba zabantwana eziyimfihlo ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza nokuba ngumagqugquzeli wesiguli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwezempilo eziyadingeka. Ukuhlelwa okuhle kakhulu nokwesekwa ukuphathwa kwezokunemba zabesifazane eziyimfihlo ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza nokuba ngumagqugquzeli wesiguli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwezempilo eziyadingeka. Ukuhlelwa okuhle kakhulu nokwesekwa ukuphathwa kwezinhlela ze-HAST eziyimfihlo ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza nokuba ngumagqugquzeli wesiguli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwezempilo eziyadingeka. Ukutholakala okuhle kakhulu kwezinsiza zekhwalithi ephezulu okulinganiswa ngemiphumela yamagajeti wokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi konke.

xh.title: Umngcali weziguli oqhelisayo weGredy 1 ukuya kwi-2 (Ezempilo ezoqwalaselo)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umngcali weziguli oqhelisayo weKliniki yaseSaldanha Bay ukulawula iinkqobo zokwelapha nezempilo zabantwana ngaphakathi kwendlela yokusebenza.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo sokugqibela esincinci: Isigqibo se-R425 esisekelo (okt. idiploma/idigri kwizokhunjiswa) okt isigqibo esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqithiswa weziguli. Isigqibo sokuba ngumngcali weziguli ngemva kwesiseko esinonyaka osingoyi-1 idiploma kwizenzezo zokukhunjwa kweziguli: Iqwalaselo lempilo, Unyango neNkathazo, esemthethweni kwiSANC (R48). OKT Idigri yeBachelor yeminyaka e-4 ekukhunjweni kweziguli (R174) okt isigqibo esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 okt R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqithiswa weziguli. Idiploma yangemva kwesigqibo (R635) esemthethweni kwiSANC kwikhunjwa lempilo ezoqwalaselo. Ukubhaliswa kwiBhungo laboqeqeshi: Ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengogqithiswa weziguli. Isiphaluka: IGredy 1: Uqeqesho olufaneleyo/oluvunyiweyo lweminyaka esingaphantsi kwe-4 kwizokhunjwa kweziguli emva kokubhaliswa njengogqithiswa weziguli kwiSANC ekukhunjweni kweziguli jikelele. IGredy 2: Uqeqesho olufaneleyo/oluvunyiweyo lweminyaka esingaphantsi kwe-14 kwizokhunjwa kweziguli emva kokubhaliswa njengogqithiswa weziguli kwiSANC ekukhunjweni kweziguli jikelele. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-10 kwelixesha elishiwo ngasentla kufuneka libe ngokuqeqesho okufaneleyo/okuvunyiweyo kwindawo ethile yokugqithiswa emva kokufumana isigqibo sangemva kwesiseko senyaka elinye OKT idiploma yangemva kwezigqibo kwindawo ethize yokugqithiswa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwensebenzo: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (iKhowudi B/EB) nentwilliso yokuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngomthetho weZokhunjwa kweZiguli nolawulo oluhambelana nawo. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lweyezithi, uMthetho weNkathazo yeMpilo yoQondo, uMthetho weMpilo yabaNtwana nomthetho wamanye ahambelana naye. Ulwazi nokuqwalasela iKliniki eNqabileyo neZilinganiso zeNqanaba leSizwe. Ulwazi lweNkathazo yoQwalaselo eZenziwa ngumPhakathi.
xh.duties: Ukuphumeza ngempumelelo kwaye uncede ngokolawulo lweekqobo zokuWelapha ezihambelana nendlela yokusebenza kwaye ube ngummeli wesiguli ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukuphumeza ngempumelelo kwaye uncede ngokolawulo lweMpilo yabaNtwana ezihambelana nendlela yokusebenza kwaye ube ngummele wesiguli ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukuphumeza ngempumelelo kwaye uncede ngokolawulo lweMpilo yabaFazi ezihambelana nendlela yokusebenza kwaye ube ngummele wesiguli ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukuphumeza ngempumelelo kwaye uncede ngokolawulo lweekqobo zeHAST ezihambelana nendlela yokusebenza kwaye ube ngummele wesiguli ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kwezempilo eziyimfuno. Ukubonelelwa ngempumelelo ngeenkonzo zobuchule obuphezulu ezilinganiswa ngeziphumo zobonke iinkqubo ziqinisekisoithuba sikhwalithi.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Occupational
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 specialising in occupational health at Paarl Hospital, responsible for occupational medical surveillance, clinical services and risk mitigation for staff.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science (R212) OR A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R 1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Midwifery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in Occupational Health Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification as mentioned above. Or a post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Occupational Health Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies of the Department of Health Western Cape. Ability to communicate effectively (both written and verbal). Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Skills to plan, organise and coordinate the service by analysing, problem solving and decision making. Ability to function independently, as well as in a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good patient care.
jobs.duties: Develop, manage and implement an effective Occupational Medical Surveillance Programme in the hospital. Coordinate and manage an effective Occupational Health (OH) Clinical Service for staff. Identification and Mitigation of Occupational Risks in the hospital. Governance, compliance and management of Occupational Health Services Training, Capacity Building and Occupational Health Awareness.
jobs.enquiries: Email: Mr F Van der Watt at Francois.vanderWatt@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Arbeidsgesondheid)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 wat spesialiseer in arbeidsgesondheid by Paarl Hospital, verantwoordelik vir arbeidsgeneeskundige waarneming, kliniese dienste en risikobeperking vir personeel.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science (R212) OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R 1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Midwifery. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Occupational Health Nursing. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na behaling van die 1-jarige post-basiese kwalifikasie soos hierbo genoem. Of 'n nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Occupational Health Nursing. Inherente vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en beleide van die Department of Health Western Cape. Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Vaardighede om die diens te beplan, te organiseer en te koördineer deur analise, probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer, sowel as in 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie pasiëntversorging te verseker.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, bestuur en implementeer 'n doeltreffende Arbeidsgeneeskundige Waarnemingsprogram in die hospital. Koördineer en bestuur 'n doeltreffende Arbeidsgesondheids- (OH) Kliniese Diens vir personeel. Identifikasie en beperking van Arbeidsrisiko's in die hospital. Bestuur, nakoming en bestuur van Arbeidsgesondheidsdienste, Opleiding, Kapasiteitsbou en Arbeidsgesondheidsbewustheid.

zu.title: I-Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Occupational
zu.summary: I-Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 ehule idiploma ye-Occupational Health e-Paarl Hospital, ebekelwe ukuphatha okokuqapha ukugula kwabantu, amasu ezokusiza kubasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isifundo se-Basic R425 (okt. idiploma/iziqu eZolimo) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenesiyesikhathi. Isifundo se-post-basic eZolimo ngeminyaka engu-1 ubude esemthethweni ne-registered ne-registered ne-SANC kwicwaka se-Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science (R212) noma idiploma yeminyaka engu-4 eZolimo (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R 1497 noma R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenokwethulwa kwesibili. Isiqu se-post graduate (R635) esemthethweni kwi-SANC kwi-Midwifery. Ukubhalisa kumkhandelu weziqu: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengenokwethulwa kwesibili. Isipiliyoni: I-Grade 1: Ukuze kube ukumbiwa kobudala benesiyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengenokwethulwa kwesibili ngokuqondene ne-Gerontological Nursing. I-Grade 2: Ukumbiwa kobudala benesiyo emva kokubhalisa njengenokwethulwa kwesibili kwi-SANC ngokuqondene ne-Occupational Health Nursing. Kubakhona iminyaka engu-10 leyo ibalwa ngaphezu kweyokuthi kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza kwesigaxa se-post-basic ngeminyaka engu-1 njengoba kushiwo ngaphezu kwezi. Idiploma yesibili (R635) esemthethweni kwi-SANC kwi-Occupational Health Nursing. Izidingo eziyisusuku yokwaziswa: Amalayisensi asemthethweni we-(Code B/EB). Isiko (olwazi/isebenzi): Ukukwazi imithetho nezesiNtatheli nge-Department of Health Western Cape. Isikhathi sokubhala (ngokubhaliweyo nangokuthethwayo).
zu.duties: Yakha, uphathe futhi usebenzise ohlelo olusebenzayo lokuqaphela iziguli eziphathelene ne-Occupational Medical Surveillance esibhedlela. Hlanganisa futhi uphathe isevisi yezempilo ye-Occupational Health (OH) esebenzayo kubasebenzi. Ukuqashelwa nokunciphisa amaphuphuwane e-Occupational Risks esibhedlela. Ukuphathwa kolawu, ukuthobela kanye nokuphathwa kwe-Occupational Health Services Training, Capacity Building kanye nesaziwa ngoku-Occupational Health.

xh.title: Umongikazi ophumeleyo inqanaba 1 ukuya kwi-2 (ISIKWALITY: i-Occupational
xh.summary: Umongikazi ophumeleyo inqanaba 1 ukuya kwi-2 ogquinisekiswe kumthetho wempilo yabasebenzi kwiPaarl Hospital, unoxanduva lokugcina iliso lokwaqaphela iimeko zempilo zabasebenzi, iinkonzo zezenzo kunye nokucutha iingozi kubasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kweemfuno: Isifundo se-R425 esiseko (oko kukuthi idiploma/idigri kwinkonzo yokhathalelo) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 njengoko kunye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ophumeleyo. Isifundo sokhathalelo emva kwesiseko ngesixa sonyaka esingengaphantsi kwesinye isifundo esiqinisekiswe kwi-SANC ekukhathalelo ikhondo elipheleleyo nasenzulwini sokhathalelo lokuzalwa (R212) OKUWA Idigri yonyaka we-4 yabafundi bokhathalelo (R174) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 njengoko kunye ne-R 1497 okanye i-R171 njengoko kunye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ophumeleyo. Idiploma yabanye abafundi (R635) ekuqinisekiswe kwi-SANC ekukhathalelo ukuzalwa. Ukubhalisa kwikhonsele yabangcali: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ophumeleyo. Ikwakhulule: Inqanaba 1: Isixa esingaphantsi kweminyaka eli-4 yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo enkonzweni yokhathalelo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ophumeleyo kwikhondo elibanzi. Inqanaba 2: Isixa esingaphantsi kweminyaka eli-14 yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo enkonzweni yokhathalelo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ophumeleyo kwi-SANC kumthetho wempilo yabasebenzi. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 yexesha elithunyelwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo kwesi songa esithile emva kokufumana isifundo seminyaka emi-1 sokhathalelo emva kwesiseko esithintelwe ngasentla. Okanye idiploma yabanye abafundi (R635) ekuqinisekiswe kwi-SANC kumthetho wempilo yabasebenzi. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yomqhubi (i-Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi ngemithetho kunye neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zeDepartment of Health Western Cape. Ikakhulu ukuphila kakuhle ngokubhala nangokuthetha. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook). Izakhono zokuqamba, ukuhlohla nokuhlanganisa inkonzo ngokuhlalutya, ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Ikakhulu ukusebenza kodwa naseqeleni lenqawe ebanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalelo oluhle lwesigulane.
xh.duties: Qamba, ulawule unikeze isityhulu esisebenzayo sokuqaphela iimeko zempilo zabasebenzi kwithempila. Hlanganisa ulawule inkonzo yezenzo zempilo yabasebenzi (OH) ebalulekileyo zabasebenzi. Ukuqamba nokucutha iingozi zomsebenzi kwithempila. Urhwebe, ukuthobela noyilo lweenkonzo zempilo yabasebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa, ukwakhiwa kwakhona namava wolwazi wempilo yabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Industrial Technician: Unit Head (INSTRUMENT Unit) (CLINICAL
jobs.summary: Lead the Instrument Unit at Tygerberg Hospital, maintaining and repairing medical equipment while supervising junior technicians.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: National Diploma in Electronics, Mechanical or Mechatronic Engineering (T; S or N stream or similar). Experience: Appropriate practical experience in medical equipment and repairs. Appropriate experience of operating tables and lights, surgical instruments etc. and a basic understanding of medical terms. Appropriate supervisory experience. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver's license to perform standby and call-out duties if and when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Proven knowledge of health technology principles. Ability to compile technical specifications for medical equipment, especially Theatre Equipment. Excellent ability to do fault finding on equipment. Good written and verbal communication skills. Proven experience computer literacy (i.e. MS Word, Excel). Product specific technical training. Advanced knowledge of managing, planning and organizing maintenance schedules.
jobs.duties: Carry out advanced maintenance, repairs, calibration, modifications and installations of medical equipment. Train junior technicians and users on equipment. Ensuring that the equipment meets legal and safety requirements of the manufacturers and statutory bodies. Perform all administrative functions as required by the Clinical Engineering Department, managers and health Technology prescripts while ensuring compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993. Liaison with hospital and private sector staff while reporting to the Control Technician in charge of the Clinical Engineering Department at Tygerberg Hospital. Manage the Instrument workshop, including contract covering medical equipment and be willing to work within all Clinical Engineering disciplines.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical/ competency assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Nywerheidstegnikus: Eenheidshoof (INSTRUMENT-eenheid) (CLINICAL
af.summary: Lei die INSTRUMENT-eenheid by Tygerberg Hospital, onderhou en herstel mediese toerusting terwyl junior tegnici gehou word toesig oor.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Nasionale Diploma in Elektronika, Meganiese of Megatroniese Ingenieurswese (T; S of N stroom of soortgelyk). Ervaring: Toepaslike praktiese ervaring in mediese toerusting en herstelwerk. Toepaslike ervaring van operasietafels en ligte, chirurgiese instrumente ens. en 'n basiese begrip van mediese terme. Toepaslike toesigervaring. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie om bystand- en oproepligte uit te voer indien en wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Bewese kennis van gesondheidstegnologie-beginsels. Vermoë om tegniese spesifikasies vir mediese toerusting op te stel, veral Teatertoerusting. Uitstekende vermoë om foutopsporing op toerusting te doen. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Bewese ervaring in rekenaargeletterdheid (d.w.s. MS Word, Excel). Produkspesifieke tegniese opleiding. Gevorderde kennis van bestuur, beplanning en organisering van instandhoudingskedules.
af.duties: Voer gevorderde instandhouding, herstelwerk, kalibrering, wysigings en installasies van mediese toerusting uit. Lei junior tegnici en gebruikers in toerusting. Verseker dat die toerusting aan die wettige en veiligheidsvereistes van die vervaardigers en statutêre liggame voldoen. Voer alle administratiewe funksies uit soos vereis deur die Clinical Engineering Department, bestuurders en gesondheidstegnologie-voorskrifte terwyl aan die Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 voldoen word. Skakel met hospitaal- en privaatsektorpersoneel terwyl aan die Control Technician in charge of the Clinical Engineering Department by Tygerberg Hospital gerapporteer word. Bestuur die Instrument-werkswinkel, insluitend kontrak wat mediese toerusting dek en wees bereid om binne alle Clinical Engineering-dissiplines te werk.

zu.title: Ubuchwepheshe bemboni: Umphathi weYunithi (iYunithi ye-INSTRUMENT) (CLINICAL
zu.summary: Buka phambili iYunithi ye-Instrument esibhedlela i-Tygerberg, ulondoloze futhi ulungise izinto zokwelapha ngenkathi uphethe abachwepheshe abancane.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezijwayelekile: i-National Diploma kwe-Electronics, i-Mechanical noma i-Mechatronic Engineering (T; S noma N stream noma okufanayo). Isiphande: Isiphande esifanele sokusebenza ngokubamba kwamathuluzi okwelapha nokulungisa. Isiphande esifanele samatafula nokukhanyisa okusetshenziswa ezingcalini, amathuluzi okuhlinza njll. kanye nokuqonda okuyisisekelo gamagama okwelapha. Isiphande esifanele sokuphatha. Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile ukwenza imisebenzi yokuqasha nokuqashwa uma kunesidingo. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhombisi): Ulwazi oluboniswe lwezigaba zetheknoloji yezempilo. Isikhono sokubhala izinkomba zobuchwepheshe zamathuluzi okwelapha, ikakhulukazi amathuluzi e-Theatre. Isikhono esihle sokuthola iziphazamiso emathuluzini. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana okubhaliwe nokuKhuluma. Isiphande esiboniswe sokubamba ikhompyutha (okungukuthi i-MS Word, i-Excel). Ukuqeqeswa kobuchwepheshe okukhethekile ngemikhiqizo. Ulwazi oluthuthukile sokuphatha, ukwelula futhi uhlele izinhlela zokugcina.
zu.duties: Yenza ukugcinwa okuthuthukile, ukulungiswa, ukulungiswa, izinguquko kanye nokufakwa kwamathuluzi okwelapha. Qeqesha abachwepheshe abancane nabasebenzisi ngamathuluzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amathuluzi ahambisana nezidingo zomthetho nezokuphepha zabakhiqizi namasiko. Yenza wonke umsebenzi wezokulawula njengoba kudingwa umnyango we-Clinical Engineering, abaphathi kanye nezigaba zetheknoloji yezempilo ngenkathi uqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana noMthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act ka-1993. Xhumana nabasebenzi besibhedlela kanye nabo bengxenye yangasese ngenkathi ubika kwi-Control Engineering ephethe i-Clinical Engineering esibhedlela i-Tygerberg. Phatha i-Instrument workshop, okuhlanganisa nokuqukatha amathuluzi okwelapha futhi ube ulungele ukusebenza kuyo yonke imikhakha ye-Clinical Engineering.

xh.title: Industrial Technician: I-Candululi leNyanga (INSTRUMENT Unit) (CLINICAL
xh.summary: Qamba i-Instrument Unit e-Tygerberg Hospital, ulungisa kwaye ulungise imixhobo yonyango ngelixa ulawula oobuchwepheshe abasezantsi.
xh.requirements: Ileveli yokugqiba isikolo esingaphantsi: i-National Diploma kwi-Electronics, i-Mechanical okanye i-Mechatronic Engineering (i-T; i-S okanye i-N stream okanye efanayo). Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo nangokwemisebenzi kwimixhobo yezonyango nakuqwalaselo. Isipili esifanelekileyo sokusebenza namatafile emisebenzi namaphipha, izixhobo zochirurgie njl. nakuqonda okuyintsika kwamagama ezonyango. Isipili esifanelekileyo sobulawuli. Imonyada yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba egqityiweyo yokwenza imisebenzi yokuqesha nokubizwa xa kudityaniswa. Iimpawu (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi olugqithiswe ngamagazethi eempelo ekolwazi ngemigaqo yamathempuni. Isakhono sokulunga iinkcukacha zobuchwepheshe zemixhobo yonyango, ngakumbi i-Theatre Equipment. Isakhono esihle sokufumana iimpazamo kwimixhobo. Izakhono ezahlukeneyo zokubhala nokuthetha. Isipili egqithiswe ngolwazi lwamakhompyutha (okt. i-MS Word, i-Excel). Iqeqesho elithile ngobuchwepheshe lemveliso. Ulwazi olugqithiswe ngolawulo, ulungelelwaniso nokuhlela iindululo zolungiselelo.
xh.duties: Zenza izigqibo eziphakamileyo zolungiselelo, zolungisa, zokulinganisa, zokutshintsha nokufakela izixhobo zezonyango. Qeqesha oobuchwepheshe abasezantsi nabasebenzisi ngemixhobo. Qinisekisa ukuba imixhobo ihambelana neemfuno zamagazethi ezimali nenkathazo zabenzi bexhobo nabalawuli basesigqini. Zenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo njengoko kufunwa ngumnye we-Clinical Engineering Department, abaphathi namagazethi e-Health Technology ngelixa uqinisekisa ukuzilandela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act ka-1993. Unxibelelwano nabanini basibhedlele nabasebenzi balawulo lwangasese ngelixa uchaza kwi-Control Technician ephethe i-Clinical Engineering Department kwi-Tygerberg Hospital. Lawula inkonzo yemixhobo yezandla, kuquka nesigneshi ephatha imixhobo zonyango kwaye ube lukhululekile ukusebenza kuzo zonke iindawo ze-Clinical Engineering.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource and Facility
jobs.centre: Stellenbosch Hospital, Stellenbosch Sub-district REQUIRMENTS    :   Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent. Experience: Extensive experience in managing of staff in a health facility. Appropriate experience in people management and facility management. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Sound knowledge of HR management, labour relations, performance management, staff development and related HR administration processes. Knowledge of relevant government and departmental policies, prescripts and legislation. Knowledge of support services, facility management and maintenance. Contract management knowledge and skills, including specification development, service-provider monitoring, expenditure control and successor-contract planning. Good supervisory, leadership, planning, coordination, problem-solving and conflict- management skills. Ability to compile clear reports, submissions, registers, minutes, action plans and management feedback. Good written and verbal communication. Computer literacy, including MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint and PERSAL.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource and Facility management at Stellenbosch Hospital, overseeing HR planning, recruitment, labour relations, and hospital support services.
jobs.duties: Facilitate, coordinate and manage HR planning, recruitment and selection, HR administration, human resource development, performance management, labour relations and related compliance processes within the Sub-district. Manage and monitor hospital and Sub-district support services, including food services, porter services, transport, linen, telecommunications, staff accommodation, facility management and maintenance. Manage support- services contracts, including security, cleaning, gardening, pest control, courier, medical waste, sanitary bins, removal of bodies and pauper burials, with appropriate planning, specifications, monitoring, expenditure control, corrective action and successor-contract planning. Provide effective leadership, supervision and support to staff and supervisors within the relevant components, including performance management, staff development, leave and attendance management, discipline, communication and service- continuity arrangements. Provide management support, helping with projects, problem-solving and implementation of improved administrative and digital systems.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a competency assessment as part of the interview process. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronne en Fasiliteite
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir menslike-hulpbron- en fasiliteitebestuur by Stellenbosch Hospital, wat beheer hou oor HR-beplanning, werwing, arbeidsverhoudinge en hospitaalondersteuningsdienste.
af.duties: Fasiliteer, koördineer en bestuur HR-beplanning, werwing en keuring, HR-administrasie, menslike-hulpbron-ontwikkeling, prestasiebestuur, arbeidsverhoudinge en verwante nakomingsprosesse binne die Subdistrik. Bestuur en monitor hospitaal- en Subdistrik-ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend voedseldienste, draerdienste, vervoer, linne, telekommunikasie, personeelakkommodasie, fasiliteitebestuur en instandhouding. Bestuur ondersteuningsdienste-kontrakte, insluitend sekuriteit, skoonmaak, tuinmaak, plaagbeheer, koerier, mediese afval, sanitêre blikke, verwydering van lyke en armlUIsbegrafnisse, met toepaslike beplanning, spesifikasies, monitering, bestuurbegroting, korrektiewe optrede en opvolgkontrakbeplanning. Verskaf doeltreffende leierskap, toesig en ondersteuning aan personeel en toesighouers binne die relevante komponente, insluitend prestasiebestuur, personeelontwikkeling, verlof- en bywoningsbestuur, dissipline, kommunikasie en dienskontinuïteitsreëlings. Verskaf bestuursondersteuning deur te help met projekte, probleemoplossing en die implementering van verbeterde administratiewe en digitale stelsels.

zu.title: Ongezwayo: Abasebenzi Nemithombo Yezimali
zu.summary: Ongezwayo ongumqondisi wemisebenzi yabasebenzi nemithombo yezimali kwaStellenbosch Hospital, obhekene nenhlelo yabasebenzi, ukubungaza, ubudlelwano bemisebenzi, kanye nesevisi yokusiza esibhedlela.
zu.duties: Qondisa, hlanganisa uphathe inhlelelelo yabasebenzi, ukubungaza nokukhethwa kwabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwemithombo yabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwentengo, ubudlelwano bemisebenzi kanye nezenzo ezihlobene nokuhambisana nomthetho ngaphakathi kweSub-district. Phatha ubheke imisebenzi yokusiza esibhedlela naseSub-district, okuhlanganisa nesevisi yokudla, isevisi yabathwali, okuthunywa, izigqoko ezibhalwe, ukuxhumana, indawo yokuhlala yabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwemithombo yezimali kanye nokulondolozwa. Phatha izinkontileka zemisebenzi yokweseka, okuhlanganisa ukuvikela, ukuhlanzwa, ukulima, ukulawula izinsele, abathunyi bezinto, ukulahlekelwa yizinto ezingingini zezokwelapha, iziqhingi ezingcolile, ukususwa kwamadoda nokungcwaba kwabangenamali, ngohlelo olufanele, izinkomba, ukubheka, ukulawula ukuchithwa kwemali, ukulungisa izinto ezingafanele kanye nenhlelo yezinkontileka ezilandelayo. Nikeza ubuqhawe obusebenzayo, ukubheka nokusekela abasebenzi kanye nabaphathi ngaphakathi kwamagamu ahlobene, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwentengo, ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, ukuphatha iholo nokuza kwabasebenzi, isiyalo, ukuxhumana kanye nenhlelo yokuphila kwisevisi. Nikeza ukusekela ukuphathwa, usize nemitapo yemisebenzi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuphatha kanye nezokusebenza ngekhompyutha.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNdlela: Umthetho wokuZinza nokuLawula iziCwangciso
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMthetho wokuZinza nokuLawula iziCwangciso eStellenbosch Hospital, elawula ukuqhelanisa kwabaNtu, okuBanjwa kwabantu, iimiba zolusebenzisano, nemiSebenzi yokuNxibelelanisa ngeSibhedlele.
xh.duties: Qhubeza, lungisa ulwabiwo kwaye ulawule ukuqhelanisa kwabaNtu, okuBanjwa nokuKhethwa, iNgxathelo zoMthetho wabaNtu, nkcubeko yoMthetho wabaNtu, ukuLawulwa kokuSebenza, iimiba zolusebenzisano nokuHambelana nemiThetho ngaphakathi kweNgxowa eNgezantsi. Lawula kwaye ulilandele imiSebenzi yokuNxibelelanisa neSibhedlele nengxowa eNgezantsi, kuquka imiSebenzi yokutya, imiSebenzi yokuKhupha abaNtu, iThutho, iimpahla ezimhlophe, unxibelelwano ngomnxeba, indawo yokuhlala yabasebenzi, ukuLawulwa kweziCwangciso nokulungisa. Lawula iinkontraxa zokuNceda imiSebenzi, kuquka ukhuseleko, ukuCocwa, ukulima iNtshona, ukuLawula izinambuzane, iThutho lezipho, iinkqubo zokulahla izifo, iindonga ezilungele ukulahwa, ukuSusa amathambo, nokuGcinwa ngendlela eziLahla abantu abangenamali, ngokuQhelanisa okufanelekileyo, iNkcazelo ngokweNtsusa, ukuLandela, ukuLawula imali eHlawulwayo, ukuLungisa kwaye uqhelanise iinkontraxa ezizakulandela. Nikela nokuBa kolawulo, ukuZinza nokuxhasa abantu nabaLawuli kwaye ulawule uluntu kwikhompyutha, kuquka ukuLawulwa kokuSebenza, nkcubeko yabaNtu, iNqumamiso nokuZinza, isiNde, uNxibelelwano noBuqu bokuhamba rhoqo. Nikela nokuLawula ukuxhasa, ukuncedisa ngeeProjekthi, ukuzonwabisa iingxaki nokuzisebenzisa iinkqubo ezilungileyo zoLawulo nezeRhwebo lezoBungcali.
