zu.title: Umsekeli weNhloko: Izimali
zu.summary: Phatha intengiselweyano yohlelo lokuhlinzeka, ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwemali kanye nenzuzo yegula languMzala eMossel Bay Hospital ngaphansi kwe-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokufunda okuncane: Isatifikethi se-National Diploma esifanele (NQF Level 6 noma okulinganayo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele kokuPhatha Izimali nokuPhatha uHlelo lokuhlinzeka. Isidingo sasemsebenzini: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemahora emva kwesikhathi lapho kudingeka. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) eqinisekisiwe nokuzithoba ukuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaxhaga): Ikhono lokuhambelana nezidingo nokubona kanye nokuphendula izinto ezinkingayo. Amaxhaga aphezulu ekhompyutha ku-MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Amaxhaga okuphatha nokubeka abantu abangaphansi kahle kanye nekhono lokusebenza kodwa nakuba yingxenye yeqembu. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lokusebenza ngalo i-Logis ne-BAS. Ukuphatha izimali ngendlela eqinile ngaphansi kohlaka olulawulayo.
zu.duties: Bumba futhi ugcinise ukuphathwa kokwamkeleka kwentengiselweyano yohlelo lokuhlinzeka nesevisi okusebenza kahle, okunentengo elifanele. Phatha ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwemali ngokuhambisana nenani elamukelekwe lesikhungo. Bumba futhi ugcinise ukuphathwa kwegula, inzuzo nesevisi yamarekhodi egula okusebenza kahle, okunentengo elifanele. Phatha abantu abangaphansi kwakho ngaphakathi kwamaqembu. Nikeza inkuselela ngokuphatha izinkontilaka kuwo onke amaqembu.

xh.title: Umcedisi weSikhokelo: Izimali
xh.summary: Phatha ulawulo lwenani lemisebenzi, ulawulo lokuchithwa kwemali nemali engenayo yabagula eMossel Bay Hospital phantsi kweWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi kwenani elithile: I-National Diploma efanelekileyo (NQF Level 6 okanye ekuhambelanayo). Imfundo: Isipilo sokusebenza esifanelekileyo ekuphathweni kwezimali nakulawulo lwenani lemisebenzi. Imfuno engaphakathi komsebenzi: Kulungelelaniswa ukusebenza emva wesixa sokuqhuba xa kufuneka. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo nolungelelaniswa ukuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amehlo): Ikholo lokuhlangabezana nemfuno nokuvakatela nokuphendula iingxaki. Amandla aphakamileyo ekhompyutha kwi-MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook). Amando amakhulu okulawula noyipilisa nokuba nokholo lokusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kwethimba. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwe-Logis ne-BAS. Ulawulo oluhle lwezimali ngaphakathi kolwablo lomthetho.
xh.duties: Yakha zigcine ulawulo lwenani lemisebenzi olusebenzayo, oluyavakatyelwa noluchitha kancinane nolonikezelo lwenzo. Phatha ulawulo olusebenzayo lokuchithwa kwemali ngokwemigqa ethethwe sisapho esamkelekileyo sekholeji. Yakha zigcine ulawulo olusebenzayo, oluyavakatyelwa noluchitha kancinane labagula, imali engenayo nolwazi lwemvelaphi yomgula. Lawula abangaphantsi ngaphakathi kwezahluko. Nikeza inkxaso ngokuphatwa kweenkonzo kwisiqhingi esingaphantsi kwesithili.

jobs.title: Audiologist Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Audiologist Grade 1 to 3 at Tygerberg Hospital providing diagnostic and rehabilitative audiological services, requiring HPCSA registration as an Audiologist.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Audiologist or Speech Therapist and Audiologist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as an Audiologist or Speech Therapist and Audiologist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology (where applicable in respect of RSA qualified employees). 1-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of SA qualified employees. A Minimum of 11 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years' relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Audiology or Speech Therapy and Audiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service, as required in South Africa. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Proven clinical skills in the areas of paediatric and adult diagnostic and rehabilitative audiology, including but not limited to: newborn hearing screening; diagnostic ABR; paediatric behavioural testing (VRA and CPA); management of paediatric hearing loss including hearing aid fitting, verification and early intervention pathways; adult diagnostic testing; management of adult hearing loss including hearing aid fitting, verification, and basic repairs. Excellent communication skills. Good report writing, interpersonal, organising, leadership and planning skills, as well as computer literacy. Ability to work independently as well as in a multi-disciplinary team. Ability to cope with the demands of a high pressure, fast-paced working environment.
jobs.duties: Render tertiary-level diagnostic and rehabilitative audiological services to children and adults in accordance with patient needs and professional standards. Perform, analyse and interpret specialised assessments including diagnostic ABR for infants and children. Appropriately assess and manage difficult-to-test populations. Manage resources optimally and effectively. Participate in the multi-disciplinary team environment both within and outside hospital. Participate and present In-service training and Continuing Education. Perform administrative tasks related to the audiology service within the hospital. Assist in clinical teaching /supervision of undergraduate students.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Audiologist or Speech Therapist and Audiologist with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Audioloog Graad 1 tot 3
af.summary: Audioloog Graad 1 tot 3 by Tygerberg Hospital wat diagnostiese en rehabilitatiewe audiologiese dienste lewer, met HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Audioloog as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Audioloog of Spraakterapeut en Audioloog moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Audioloog of Spraakterapeut en Audioloog. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA in die tersaaklike beroep in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie (waar van toepassing ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers). 1-jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verlang word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verlang word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Audiologie of Spraakterapie en Audiologie ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verlang word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Bewese kliniese vaardighede in die areas van pediatriese en volwasse diagnostiese en rehabilitatiewe audiologie, insluitend maar nie beperk tot: pasgebore gehoorsifting; diagnostiese ABR; pediatriese gedragstoetsing (VRA en CPA); bestuur van pediatriese gehoorverlies insluitend gehoorapparaatpassing, -verifikasie en vroeë ingrypingsroetes; volwasse diagnostiese toetsing; bestuur van volwasse gehoorverlies insluitend gehoorapparaatpassing, -verifikasie en basiese herstelwerk. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede. Goede verslagskryf-, interpersoonlike, organisatoriese, leierskaps- en beplanningsvaardighede, asook rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om onafhanklik sowel as in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Vermoë om die eise van 'n hoëdruk, vinnige werkomgewing die hoof te bied.
af.duties: Lewer tersiêre-vlak diagnostiese en rehabilitatiewe audiologiese dienste aan kinders en volwassenes ooreenkomstig pasientbehoeftes en professionele standaarde. Voer gespesialiseerde assesserings uit, ontleed en interpreteer dit, insluitend diagnostiese ABR vir suigelinge en kinders. Beoordeel en bestuur moeilik-toets-populasies toepaslik. Bestuur hulpbronne optimaal en effektief. Neem deel aan die multidissiplinêre spanomgewing beide binne en buite die hospitaal. Neem deel aan en bied in-diensopleiding en voortgesette opleiding aan. Voer administratiewe take uit wat verband hou met die audiologiese diens binne die hospitaal. Bied bystand by kliniese onderrig/toesig van voorgraadse studente.

zu.title: Onjiniyela-wezokuzwa izinga 1 kuya ku-3
zu.summary: Onjiniyela-wezokuzwa izinga 1 kuya ku-3 eTygerberg Hospital ethula izinkonzo zokuhlola nokubuyisela isiho ekuccadeni, kudingeka ukubhalisa kuHPCSA njengenjiniyela-wezokuzwa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemininingwane yemfundo: Imininingwane efanelekile evumela ukubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengenjiniyela-wezokuzwa noma Onjiniyela-wezokukhuluma kanye nenjiniyela-wezokuzwa. Ukubhalisa kumkhandlu wemisebenzi: Ukubhalisa kuHPCSA njengenjiniyela-wezokuzwa noma Onjiniyela-wezokukhuluma kanye nenjiniyela-wezokuzwa. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuqashiwa kuHPCSA emsebenzini ofanele ekuccadeni noma ekuqondiseni ukukhuluma kanye nokuzwa (lapho kusebenza ngokwabasebenzi abaqeqeshwe ku-RSA). Ukuthola unyaka we-1 wamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhaliswa kuHPCSA ekuccadeni noma ekuqondiseni ukukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngokwabasebenzi basemaphandleni abaqeqeshiwe, abadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA ekuccadeni noma ekuqondiseni ukukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngokwabasebenzi base-South Africa abaqeqeshiwe. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-11 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA ekuccadeni noma ekuqondiseni ukukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngokwabasebenzi basemaphandleni abaqeqeshiwe, abadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA ekuccadeni noma ekuqondiseni ukukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngokwabasebenzi base-South Africa abaqeqeshiwe. Okungenani iminyaka engu-21 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA ekuccadeni noma ekuqondiseni ukukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngokwabasebenzi basemaphandleni abaqeqeshiwe, abadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhombisi): Ikhono lokuhlinza elivezweleko ezindaweni zokuqondisa nokubuyisela isiho sokuzwa kubantwana nabantu abadala, okuhlanganisa kodwa esingabinakho: ukuvivinywa ukuzwa kwezinsizwa ezingakazalwa; i-ABR yokuqondisa; ukuhlolwa kwabasha kwesimilo (i-VRA ne-CPA); ukuphathwa kokulahlekelwa isiho kwezinsizwa okuhlanganisa ukufakwa, ukuqinisekisa kanye nezindlela zokusobela ngokuqhubekayo; ukulololwa ekwabanzi abadala; ukuphathwa kokulahlekelwa isiho kabadala okuhlanganisa ukufakwa, ukuqinisekisa, kanye nokulungisa okuyisisekelo. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana. Ikhono elihle lokubhala imibiko, lokuxhumana nabantu, lokuhlela, lokuba nogqozi kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo, kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa futhi nangaphakathi kwethimba elihlangene. Ikhono lokumelana nezidingo zendawo yokusebenza enenkinga enkulu futhi ephuma isinqindi.
zu.duties: Hlinza izinkonzo zokuqondisa nokubuyisela isiho ezingeni eliphezulu ezingane nabadala ngokuvumelana nezidingo zabagulayo kanye namazingu okuhlonza. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uchasisa ukuvivinywa okukhethekile okuhlanganisa i-ABR yokuqondisa kubantwana basemabhedeni nasengcondvweni. Hlolisisa futhi uphathe ngokufanele abantu ababucayi ukubahola. Phatha amathuluzi ngokusebenzisa ngokugcwele futhi ngempumelelo. Thatha inxaxheba emvelweni yethimba elihlangene ngaphakathi nangaphandle kesibhedlela. Thatha inxaxheba futhi uwethule ukuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi nokuqhubela izifundo phambili. Yenza imisebenzi yokuqondisa ehlobene nenkonzo yokuzwa ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Siza ekufundiseni /nokuqondisa abafundi abazofunda iziqu.

xh.title: Ungqingi weNtlaso yolalelo Grade 1 to 3
xh.summary: Ungqingi weNtlaso yolalelo Grade 1 to 3 eTygerberg Hospital enika iinkonzo zokuxilisa nokuphinda kunyuse impilo zentlaso yolalelo, kufuneka abhalwe kwiHPCSA njengengqingi yentlaso yolalelo.
xh.requirements: Iminikelo yemfundo esemgangathweni: Iminikelo efanelekileyo evumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengengqingi yentlaso yolalelo okanye Ngonyazi lentethu kwaye ngengqingi yentlaso yolalelo. Ukubhalisa koluntu lwamagqabantshintshi: Ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengengqingi yentlaso yolalelo okanye ngonyazi lentethu kwaye ngengqingi yentlaso yolalelo. Imfundo ngokubakho: Grade 1: Akukho mfuno emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA kwishishini elichwayiweyo kwiAudiology okanye Speech Therapy and Audiology (apho kusemthethweni ngabasebenzi abagqitywe eRSA). Unyaka-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA kwiAudiology okanye Speech Therapy and Audiology mayela nabasebenzi bangaphandle abagqitywe kwamanye amazwe, abayingafunekiyo ukwenza Inkonzo Yoluntu, njengoko kufunwa eSouth Africa. Grade 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA kwiAudiology okanye Speech Therapy and Audiology mayela nabasebenzi baseSouth Africa abagqityiweyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-11 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA kwiAudiology okanye Speech Therapy and Audiology mayela nabasebenzi bangaphandle abagqitywe kwamanye amazwe, abayingafunekiyo ukwenza inkonzo yoluntu, njengoko kufunwa eSouth Africa. Grade 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-20 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA kwiAudiology okanye Speech Therapy and Audiology mayela nabasebenzi baseSouth Africa abagqityiweyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-21 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA kwiAudiology okanye Speech Therapy and Audiology mayela nabasebenzi bangaphandle abagqitywe kwamanye amazwe, abayingafunekiyo ukwenza inkonzo yoluntu, njengoko kufunwa eSouth Africa. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono obugqirha obuchwyiweyo kumacandwe okuxilisa nokuphinda kunyuse impilo entlaso yolalelo yabantwana nabadala, kuquka kodwa ingagqitywa kumagunya: ukuhlolwa kokuva kwabasentshweni; ukuhlolwa kweABR; ukuhlolwa kokuziphatha kwabantswana (VRA and CPA); ulawulo lokulahlekelwa kukuziva kwabantswana kuquka ukufakelwa, ukuqinisekisa kwaye kuqondwe iindlela zokungena kakhulu ekuxiliseni; ukuhlolwa kokuxilisa kwabadala; ulawulo lokulahlekelwa kukuziva kwabadala kuquka ukufakelwa, ukuqinisekisa, kwaye kulungiswe ngokusesikweni. Amakhono aphambili ekunxibelelaneni. Amakhono amabalulu ngeengxelo, ekunxibelelaneni nabantu, ekulungiseni, ekuqhutywa kwemibhiyozane kwaye ekuqhathanisa imicimbi, nangokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba ngamandla ukusebenza kodwa nakwindalo yeqela elinabochwephesha abahlukene. Ukuba ngamandla ukujamelana neemfuno zendalo yokusebenza egcwele umfutho kwaye ishukumayo.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zokuxilisa nokuphinda kunyuse impilo zentlaso yolalelo kwelinye inqanaba kwabantwana nabadala ngokuvumelana neemfuno zabagulayo nangokwesigqibo sabochwephesha. Yenza, hlaziya kwaye uchaze ikuhlolwa okukhulu kuquka ukuhlolwa kweABR kwabasentshweni nabantwana. Xilisa kwaye ulawule ngokufanelekileyo oomele ukuba bagqitywe ukuhlolwa. Lawula izixhobo ngokusemthethweni nangokusebenza kakuhle. Thatha inxaxheba kwimeko yeqela elinabochwephesha abahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweasibedele. Thatha inxaxheba kwaye ubonise isikolo sangaphakathi nakwimfundo ephilayo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo edibene nenkonzo yentlaso yolalelo ngaphakathi kweasibedele. Ncedisa ekufundiseni kulwazi / ulawulo lwabafundi abangenayo ebanga lezazinzulu.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Finance
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer position in Finance at the Department of Health and Wellness in Khayelitsha, requiring a National Diploma and financial management experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate National Diploma (NQF6) or equivalent. Experience: Appropriate experience in Financial Management and Financial Accounting. Appropriate experience in Expenditure control and completion of BMIs. Appropriate supervisory experience. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid drivers’ licence. Willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Organizational, managerial, leadership skills and an aptitude for working with financial figures. Strong people management and supervisory skills, ability to work in a team context and motivate team members. Computer literacy in Microsoft Office. Knowledge of PFMA, Finance instructions, Provincial and National Treasury regulations, as well as Accounting Officer System. Good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Effective and efficient support to the ASD to manage the Budgetary Function within the Sub-structure. Effective and efficient support to the ASD to manage budget, revenue & expenditure monitoring and control within the Chief Directorate: KESS Sector. Effective and efficient support to the ASD in Financial accounting, including compliance and risk management within the Chief Directorate: KESS Sector. Effective support to the ASD in the management of Human Resources in the component. Monthly processing of transfer payments. Monthly financial reporting and reconciliation. Administer interdepartmental claims.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Finansies
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte-pos in Finansies by die Department of Health and Wellness in Khayelitsha, wat 'n National Diploma en ervaring in finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike National Diploma (NQF6) of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Financial Management en Financial Accounting. Toepaslike ervaring in beheer oor besteding en voltooiing van BMI's. Toepaslike toesigervaring. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Organisasie-, bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede en 'n aanleg om met finansiële syfers te werk. Sterk mensebestuurs- en toesigvaardighede, vermoë om in 'n spankonteks te werk en spanlede te motiveer. Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office. Kennis van PFMA, finansieële instruksies, Provincial en National Treasury-regulasies, asook die Accounting Officer System. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Doeltreffende en doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die ASD om die Begrotingsfunksie binne die Sub-struktuur te bestuur. Doeltreffende en doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die ASD om begroting, inkomste en bestedingsmonitering en -beheer binne die Chief Directorate: KESS Sector te bestuur. Doeltreffende en doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die ASD in Financial accounting, insluitend nakoming en risikobestuur binne die Chief Directorate: KESS Sector. Effektiewe ondersteuning aan die ASD in die bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne in die komponent. Maandelikse verwerking van oordragbetalings. Maandelikse finansiële verslagdoening en afstemming. Administreer interdepartementele eise.

zu.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Finance
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobu-baguli obukhulu kwisimo sezimali e-Department of Health and Wellness Khayelitsha, esidinga i-National Diploma ngesipiliyongo ekuphatheni imali.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi: Appropriate National Diploma (NQF6) noma okulinganayo. Isipiliyongo: Isipiliyongo esifanele kwisimo sezimali nesikolo semali. Isipiliyongo esifanele ekulawulen amafa nasekweniweni kwa-BMIs. Isipiliyongo esifanele sobu-nejili. Izidingo zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Amalayisensi wokushayela asebenzayo. Ukuthanda ukuhamba. Izindingo (ulwazi/ izindlela): Izindlela zokuphatha, zokuba nodumo, zokuba ngumphathi kanye nobuhlakani bokusebenzela namanani ezimali. Izindlela zokuphatha abantu ezinkulu nezobu-baguli, ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nokukhuthaza amalungu eqembu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-Microsoft Office. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA, izilayiza zemali, izimiso ze-Provincial kanye ne-National Treasury, kanye nesinqumo sika-Accounting Officer System. Izindlela ezinkulu zokuthetha nokubhala.
zu.duties: Ukusekela ngempumelelo nangcono i-ASD ekuphatheni i-Budgetary Function ngaphakathi kwe-Sub-structure. Ukusekela ngempumelelo nangcono i-ASD ekuphatheni umthamo wezimali, amafa kanye nomatshini wokuqapha nokulawula ukuchithwa kwemali ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate: KESS Sector. Ukusekela ngempumelelo nangcono i-ASD kwaku-accounting yezimali, okuhlanganisa ukuzilandelayo nokuphatha ingozi ngaphakathi kwe-Chief Directorate: KESS Sector. Ukusekela ngempumelelo i-ASD ekuphatheni abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwale ngxenye. Ukucutshungula ngenyanga izinkokhelo zokudlulisela. Okubikwa ngenyanga ngemali nokuhambisaniswa. Ukuphatha izifundo ezingaphakathi kumnyango.

xh.title: I-Selebe Lezoburhulumente Ezingangathanga: Izimali
xh.summary: Isithuba sesiSelebe Lezoburhulumente Ezingangathanga kwizimali kwiSebe lezeMpilo neLonwabo eKhayelitsha, esifuna iNazhonalidiploma kunye namava olawulo lwezimali.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso semfundo esingaphantsi kwamaxabiso: iNazhonalidiploma (NQF6) efanelekileyo okanye okulinganayo nayo. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kuLawulo lweZimali nokuBhaliswa kweZimali. Amava afanelekileyo kuLawulo lweNkcitho nokugqibezela i-BMIs. Amava afanelekileyo okuba yintloko abantu basebenzela kuye. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Iilayisenensi zokushukuma ezisebenzayo. Ukulungelelanisa ukuhamba. Iakhono (ulwazi/ubuchule): Amanye ukulawula, ulawulo, amakhono okuba ngumntu othembekileyo kunye nesakhono sokusebenza neziwinjini kwezimali. Amanye amakhonyo okulawula abantu nokuba yintloko abantu basebenzela kuye, isakhono sokusebenza kwiqela kunye nokunconiswa kwiilali. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kuMicrosoft Office. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA, iimfundo zeZimali, iimthetho yeTreasury yoMbuso nakwiprovinsi, njengokunokuba nendlela yokulawula zeSekela iNtloko yeZimali. Amanye amakhonyo okuthetha nokubhala.
xh.duties: Iinkxaso eziphumelelayo nezisebenzayo kwi-ASD ukulawula umsebenzi weeBhajethi kwiSub-structure. Iinkxaso eziphumelelayo nezisebenzayo kwi-ASD ukulawula ibhajethi, iindledana & unkcitho kunye nokulawula kwiChief Directorate: KESS Sector. Iinkxaso eziphumelelayo nezisebenzayo kwi-ASD kubhaliswa kwezimali, kuquka ukuthobela imithetho kulawulo lwengozi kwiChief Directorate: KESS Sector. Iinkxaso eziphumelelayo kwi-ASD kulawulo lweZachery ezisebenzelayo kwingxowa. Unkcitho wemali yonyiso nyanga zonke. Iingxelo zemali kunye nokulinganisa nyanga zonke. Ukulawula iklame zangaphakathi kwiisebe.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Labour Relations
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer managing labour relations, grievances, disputes and collective bargaining support at the Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-structure office in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent. Experience: Appropriate experience in Labour Relations. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB). Willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Ensuring the promotion of sound labour relations, pertaining to grievances, disputes & labour forums. Compilation of accurate statistical reports on labour issues. Provisioning of an effective and efficient collective bargaining support and maintenance function. Facilitating the training & development of staff in respect of Labour Relations. Provisioning of efficient support to the Assistant Director, Director and facilities.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical, and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Arbeidsverhoudinge
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte wat arbeidsverhoudinge, griewe, geskille en kollektiewe bedingingsondersteuning by die Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain-substruktekantoor in die Western Cape bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Arbeidsverhoudinge. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB). Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verseker die bevordering van goeie arbeidsverhoudinge met betrekking tot griewe, geskille & arbeidsforums. Samestelling van akkurate statistiese verslae oor arbeidsake. Voorsiening van 'n doeltreffende en doeltreffende kollektiewe bedingingsondersteunings- en instandhoudingsfunksie. Fasilitering van die opleiding & ontwikkeling van personeel ten opsigte van Arbeidsverhoudinge. Voorsiening van doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die Adjunkdirekteur, Direkteur en fasiliteite.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sokuphathwa Kwezommo: Ukuhlotshaniswa Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sokuphathwa Kwezommo esiphatha ukuhlotshaniswa kwabasebenzi, izikhalazo, izingxabano kanye nenkxaso yokuxoxisana ngokuhlangenwe ndlela ehhovisi le-Klipfontein/Mitchells Plain sub-structure e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi: National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekile noma okulingana nayo. Isiphalu: Isiphalu esifanelekileko kwezokuHlotshaniswa kwabasebenzi. Isidingo ngokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (Code B/EB). Ukuzithoba ukuhamba. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ikono elokuqasha iphuzu lenhlangano lapho ihlukaniswe khona phantsi kwamagxidu okulungiselwa kubalo mabhali.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuHlotshaniswa kwabasebenzi okulungile, mayelana nezikhalazo, izingxabano kanye namabhodi oHlotshaniswa kwabasebenzi. Ukulungiswa kwemibiko yenani eliqinisekisiweko ngoHlotshaniswa kwabasebenzi. Ukubonelela ngokuxhaswa ngokuhlangenwe ndlela ngokusetyenziswa kwezokuxoxa kwaye kusebenze kakuhle. Ukuxhaswa kwabasebenzi efakiniwa kumkhakha oHlotshaniswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Omkhulu Wolawulo: Iindaba Zokusebenza
xh.summary: Umsebenzi Omkhulu Wolawulo ophatha iindaba zokusebenza, iingxaki, iingxabano kunye nentloneliseko kwiofisi yengqiqo-phantsi yeKlipfontein/Mitchells Plain eWestern Cape.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphantsi ezidingekayo: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekileyo okanye ezeleyo. Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo kwiindaba Zokusebenza. Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba evakalayo (Code B/EB). Ukulungelelana ukuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Izakhono ezibalaseleyo zokuxoxa ngesandla nasemlonyeni. Izakhono ezomeleleyo zokuqhathanisa nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza lodwa nangxweme. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukukhuthaza iindaba zokusebenwa ezilungileyo, ngeengxaki, iingxabano & amajelo okusebenza. Ukuqokelela iingxelo ezichanekileyo zemiganeko ngeendaba zokusebenza. Ukunikela ngenkxaso ekusebenzeleni kolwaneliseko ngokwexabiso kunye nomsebenzi wokugcina. Ukuqhutywa kokugcinwa & kokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi malunga neendaba Zokusebenza. Ukunikela ngenkxaso ephumelelayo kumlawuli okekunye, uMlawuli kunye neendawo.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.summary: Case Manager position at Paarl Hospital requiring an NQF level 7 qualification with HPCSA, SANC or SAPC registration and three years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: A qualification at NQF level 7 or equivalent that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) and/or South African Nursing Council (SANC) and/or South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Experience: 3 Year’s relevant experience. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of the Medical Schemes Act 131 of 1998, regulations and annexures as amended and basic knowledge of the uniform patient fees schedule and patient billing. Knowledge of prescribed minimum benefits i.e. the chronic disease list and diagnostic treatment pairs and knowledge of and experience in ICD 10 Codes assignment, the ability to link patient diagnosis with procedure codes and knowledge of Clinicom and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Ability to work with Excel spread sheets, Microsoft Word and web-based programs (medical aids). Good communication, conflict management, interpersonal and leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Maintain efficient and effective communication with all role players to ensure full settlement of accounts. Evaluate and monitor ICD 10 coding for externally funded patients. Interpret and implement Case Management policies, protocols and procedures efficiently and effectively. Coordinate the workflow processes between clinical and admin personnel. Managerial/Supervisory functions.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Gevallebestuurder
af.summary: Gevallebestuurder-pos by Paarl Hospital vereis 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie met HPCSA-, SANC- of SAPC-registrasie en drie jaar se relevante ervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 7 of gelykwaardig wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) en/of South African Nursing Council (SANC) en/of South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) toelaat. Ervaring: 3 jaar se relevante ervaring. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die Medical Schemes Act 131 van 1998, regulasies en bylaes soos gewysig en basiese kennis van die skedule van eenvormige pasientfooie en pasientfakturering. Kennis van voorgeskryfde minimum voordele d.w.s. die chroniese siektelys en diagnostiese behandelingspare en kennis van en ervaring in die toekenning van ICD 10-kodes, die vermoë om pasientdiagnoses met prosedurekodes te koppel en kennis van Clinicom en EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Vermoë om met Excel-sigblaaie, Microsoft Word en webgebaseerde programme (mediese fondse) te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, konflikbestuur-, interpersoonlike en leierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Onderhou doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie met alle rolspelers om volledige skikking van rekenings te verseker. Evalueer en monitor ICD 10-kodering vir ekstern gefinansierde pasiënte. Interpreteer en implementeer Gevallebestuur-beleide, protokolle en prosedures doeltreffend en effektief. Koördineer die werkvloeiprosesse tussen kliniese en administratiewe personeel. Bestuurlike/Toesighoudende funksies.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezehluleko
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wezehluleko esibhedlela i-Paarl Hospital esidinga iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 7 nokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA, i-SANC noma i-SAPC kanye namakhulu eminyaka emithathu okuhlotshaniswa nempilo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zezemfundo ezingaphansi kwesibalo: Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 7 noma okulinganayo okuvumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kanye/noma i-South African Nursing Council (SANC) kanye/noma i-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Isipiliyoni: 3 Year's relevant experience. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi ngo-Medical Schemes Act 131 of 1998, imithetho kanye nezihlomisi njengoba kulungisiwe kanye nolwazi oluyisiseko lweshejuli yemali efanayo yabagulayo kanye nokufaka izikweletu zabagulayo. Ulwazi ngemikhuba emincane ezelwe ngumthetho okungukuthi uhlu lwesifo esihlala isikhathi eside kanye namaphathi okwelashwa nokuhwetshwa kanye nolwazi nesipiliyoni ekubhaliseni amakhodi e-ICD 10, ikhono lokuhumusha ukwelashwa komuntu oygulayo ngamakhodi wokwenza izinto nokwenza izidingo kanye nolwazi nge-Clinicom ne-EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Ikhono lokusebenza nge-Excel spread sheets, i-Microsoft Word kanye namaphroharamu wezinhlelaphathe ngokugqamile (izinkokhelo zokwelashwa). Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, okuphatha izingxabano, okusebenza nabantu kanye nokuba ngumholi.
zu.duties: Gcina ukuxhumana okusebenzayo naye yonke imikhakha egema ohlelweni kuqinisekise ukuthi izikweletu ziyagezwa ngokuphelele. Hlola kanye nokulawula amakhodi e-ICD 10 oygulayo abaxhaswa ngemithungo yasemzinyathweni. Humusha kanye nokusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo nokuphumelelayo izinkambiso zamapholisi okuphata izehluleko, izindlela ezilandelwayo kanye nezinqubo. Hlela izinqubo zokusakaza kabusha phakathi kwabasebenzi bezokwelapha nabasebenzi bokuqasha. Imisebenzi yokuphathwa/kokusikwa.

xh.title: Umphathi weziithuba
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi weziithuba kwiPaarl Hospital esifuna isifundo seNQF level 7 kunye nokubhalisa kwiHPCSA, iSANC okanye iSAPC neminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingunaphakathi: Isifundo kwiNQF level 7 okanye esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) nokanye iSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) nokanye iSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Amava: I3 Year’s relevant experience. Iikhompethensi (ulwazi/amazimvo): Ulwazi ngeMedical Schemes Act 131 of 1998, iirhaguqo kunye nezihlomelo njengoko zilungisiweyo kunye nolwazi olusisiseko lweshejuli yemirhumo egqithisweyo kwabaguli nokuqwalasela i-akhawunti yabaguli. Ulwazi ngezibonelelo ezincinci ezelwe ngumthetho ewonke uluhlu lwezifo ezihlala ixesha elide kunye namaphezu ezinika unyango lwenxaxheba kwaye ulwazi nolwahlulelo lokunikela iICD 10 Codes, isakhono sokudibanisa isifo somguli namakhodi ezinqubo, ulwazi lweClinicom neEDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Isakhono sokusebenza ngeeExcel spread sheets, iMicrosoft Word kunye nanenkqubo ezisekwe kwi-web (iinxilimbela zonyango). Iakhono ezilumko zokunxibelelwana, ulawulo lwezingxungumbela, ekuhambelaneni nabanye nakuziphatha.
xh.duties: Gcina inxibelelwano esebenzayo nesebenzayo bonke abadlali indima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlawula ngokupheleleyo kwee-akhawunti. Qwalasa kwaye ulandele iICD 10 coding yabaguli abaxhaswa ngaphandle. Tolika kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo, amacebo okusebenza namanyathelo omphathi weziithuba ngokusebenzayo nangokusebenzayo. Linganisa iinkqubo zokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi bezonyango nabalawuli. Imisebenzi yokulawula/okokuqonda.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician Production Grade a to C
jobs.centre: Professional Engineering Services (Location on the Karl Bremer Hospital estate)
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R407 337 per annum Grade B: R460 086 per annum Grade C: R518 769 per annum
jobs.summary: Engineering Technician in Electrical production for the Department of Health and Wellness at Karl Bremer Hospital estate, requiring ECSA registration and an National Diploma in Engineering.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma in Engineering (Electrical) or equivalent, Registration with a professional council: Registration with ECSA as a Professional Engineering Technician (Electrical). Experience: Grade A: 3-years post qualification experience. Grade B: At least 14 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in the area after obtaining the qualification. Grade C: At least 26 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in the area after obtaining the qualification. Inherent requirement of the job: Willing to work overtime, stay away and travel throughout the Western Cape Province, often at short notice. Willing to assist in other institutions and directorates. Physically fit and able to inspect buildings and related engineering infrastructure and machinery. Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge in the compilation of specifications and tender documentation. Contracts and quality management skills. Knowledge of risk analysis and risk mitigation strategies and prioritisation. Conversant with OHSA and regulations pertaining to Electrical and Electronic installations. Conversant with legal compliance such as SANS 10142-1, SANS 60439, SANS 10139, etc. Conversant with NEC contracts especially the Short-, Term service- and Framework agreement forms of contracts. Computer literate (MS Word. Auto CAD and Excel). Knowledge and experience in computer aided design of engineering infrastructure in the health care environment. Sound interpersonal and good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Compile specifications and tender documentation within prescribed timeframes. Manage and deliver projects from inception through to completion and close-out. Liaise with stakeholders regarding project requirements, information, progress and deliverables. Ensure continuity of maintenance schedules by prioritising work in accordance with operational requirements. Ensure that engineering infrastructure, plant and equipment comply with the Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and its relevant regulation, built- environment legislation, regulations, standards and prescripts within the healthcare environment.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. A practical/competency test may form part of the shortlisting and/or interview process, a full job description is available upon request. Candidates may be subjected to a competency test. As directed by the Department of Public Service and Administration, applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, qualification verification, criminal records and previous employment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Ingenieurstegnikus Produksie Graad a tot C
af.summary: Ingenieurstegnikus in elektriese produksie vir die Department of Health and Wellness by Karl Bremer Hospital landgoed, wat ECSA-registrasie en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Ingenieurswese vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma in Ingenieurswese (Elektries) of gelykwaardig. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by ECSA as 'n Professionele Ingenieurstegnikus (Elektries). Ervaring: Vlak A: 3-jaar na kwalifikasie ervaring. Vlak B: Ten minste 14 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die area na die verkryging van die kwalifikasie. Vlak C: Ten minste 26 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die area na die verkryging van die kwalifikasie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereid om oortyd te werk, weg te bly en dwarsdeur die Wes-Kaap Provinsie te reis, dikwels op kort kennisgewing. Bereid om in ander instellings en direktorate behulpsaam te wees. Fisies geskik en in staat om geboue en verwante ingenieursinfrastruktuur en masjinerie te ondersoek. Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die opstel van spesifikasies en tendersdokumentasie. Kontrakte en gehaltebestuursvaardighede. Kennis van risiko-analise en risikobeperkingsstrategieë en prioritisering. Vertroud met OHSA en regulasies wat op elektriese en elektroniese installasies betrekking het. Vertroud met wetlike nakoming soos SANS 10142-1, SANS 60439, SANS 10139, ens. Vertroud met NEC-kontrakte veral die Short-, Term service- en Framework agreement vorme van kontrakte. Rekenaargeletterd (MS Word. Auto CAD en Excel). Kennis en ervaring in rekenaargesteunde ontwerp van ingenieursinfrastruktuur in die gesondheidsorgomgewing. Sterk interpersoonlike en goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Stel spesifikasies en tendersdokumentasie binne die voorgeskrewe tydsraamwerke op. Bestuur en lewer projekte vanaf aanvang tot voltooiing en afsluiting. Skakel met belanghebbendes rakende projekvereistes, inligting, vordering en lewerbaarhede. Verseker kontinuïteit van instandhoudingskedules deur werk volgens bedryfsvereistes te prioritiseer. Verseker dat ingenieursinfrastruktuur, aanleg en toerusting voldoen aan die Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidswet van 1993 en sy tersaaklike regulasies, bou-omgewingswetgewing, regulasies, standaarde en voorskrifte binne die gesondheidsorgomgewing.

zu.title: Injiniya Yobuchwepheshe Ekukhiqizweni Izinga A kuye Ku-C
zu.summary: Injiniya Yobuchwepheshe ekukhiqizeni kagesi kuMnyango Wezempilo Nezempilakho endaweni yesibhedlela i-Karl Bremer, edinga ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe ku-Injiniya.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zezemfundo ezingaphansi kakhulu: I-Diploma Yezwe ehambelana neyobuchwepheshe (Kagesi) noma okulingana nayo; Ukubhaliswa kubhalwe lwezangamabhalo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA njengo-Injiniya Yobuchwepheshe Obhalisiwe (Kagesi). Isiphepho: Izinga A: Ukuthola isiphepho seminyaka engu-3 ngemva kokuthola iziqu. Izinga B: Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 yesiphepho esihambelanayo/esivezwayo kule ndawo ngemva kokuthola iziqu. Izinga C: Okungenani iminyaka engu-26 yesiphepho esihambelanayo/okuyiziphepho ezingabaliwa kuleyo ndawo emva kokuthola iziqu. Isidingo esingaphakathi kwemisebenzi: Ukuzikhitikela ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi, ukuhlala kude kanye nokuhamba endaweni yonke i-Western Cape Province, ngokuvamile ngesikhashana. Ukuze ukwaze ukusiza kwezinye izikhungo kanye neziqondiso. Ukuba negidi futhi ukwazi ukuhlola izakhiwo kanye nezokuhambisana nokwakheka kwemisebenzi yezokuhlinzwa kanye nemishini. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Izindlela ezaziwa kakhulu (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi ekwakheni izindingo kanye nemiqulu yethenda. Izakhono zokuphathwa kwezinkontzisi kanye nokulawula izinga. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izingozi kanye nokuqoqwa kwezindlela zokuzivikela kanye nokubeka okubaluleke kakhulu. Ukuqonda i-OHSA kanye nemithetho ehlobene nokufakwa kwemishini yagesi nge-elekthronikhi. Ukuvakatshela ukuqonda ulwazi lolimi lomthetho njengoba kuyimithetho ehlangene nalawa: i-SANS 10142-1, i-SANS 60439, i-SANS 10139, njll. Ukuqonda i-NEC namakhontrathi ikakhulu izindlela ze-Short-, Term service- kanye nezivumelwano ze-Framework agreement. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (i-MS Word, i-Auto CAD kanye ne-Excel). Ulwazi kanye nesiphepho ekusebenzeni ngezikrini zekhompyutha ekwakhekeni okuhlobene nezokwelashwa emkhakheni wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Izakhono ezihle zokuxhumana namanye abantu kanye nezokukhuluma nokubhala kahle.
zu.duties: Bhala izindingo kanye nemiqulu yethenda phakathi kwamathambo ohlelo. Lawula futhi ufake imiklamo phakathi kokwenza isu kugcine kuqedwe ngokuzenzakalela ngaphezu kwesikhathi. Xhumana nabantu abathe gefu ulwazi ngemiklamo, ulwazi, ukuba yisixhaso kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinto eziya phambili. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokugcina luyaqhubeka ngokubaluleka kwemisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yezokwakha, imishini yamandla kanye nobuchwepheshe ihambisana nomthetho wezempilo nakho konke okuphephile ka-1993 kanye nemitheho yayo, umthetho wokwakha, imithetho, okumiswa kolwazi kanye nezimiso emkhakheni wezempilo.

xh.title: Injiniya Yobuchwephexhe Ekwenziweni Kwezinto Inqanaba A ukuya Ku-C
xh.summary: Injiniya Yobuchwephexhe Ekwenziweni kwezinto zabugcisa kwisebe lezempilo nolonwabo kwisithili sasibhedlele i-Karl Bremer, ifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA kunye ne-National Diploma kwiNjiniya.
xh.requirements: Isiganga esincinane semfundo: i-National diploma efanelekileyo kwiNjiniya (Esingqayini) okanye eleyantlukwano. Ukbhaliswa koluntu olubekekileyo: ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA njengenjiniya yobuchwephexhe ekubhalisiweyo (Esingqayini). Uluhlu lwezonyango: Inqanaba A: i-3-years ukugqiba iziganga kwimisebenzi. Inqanaba B: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka elingu-14 uluhlu olufanelekileyo/lolunakwayo kwindawo emva kokugqiba isiganga. Inqanaba C: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka elingu-26 uluhlu olufanelekileyo/lolunakwayo kwindawo emva kokugqiba isiganga. Isimfuno esinzima somsebenzi: Uyakuvuma ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha, uhlale kude aze ahambe e-Provinsi yase-Western Cape ngamaxesha onke ngexesha elifutshane. Uyakuvuma ukuncedisa kwizinyanya ezinye iintlangano. Ulungele ngokomzimba ukwazi ukutyhila izakhiwo nolwakhiwo lobuchwephexhe ngokubheka ne-machini. Ilayisensi evakalweyo (i-Code B/EB). Iimfuno (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi ekwakheni iingcombolo ezichaza ngokweenkcukacha namaxwebhe okuthenga. Isakhono sokulawula iinkontraxi kunye nolwakhiwo. Ulwazi ngokuhlolelwa ubungozi kunye nezicwangciso zokunciphisa ubungozi nokuziphathe. Ulwazi nge-OHSA nangomthetho ohlongezele iintlobo ezibangelwa ngamandla nabakho obugcisa. Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho njengakwi-SANS 10142-1, SANS 60439, SANS 10139, nokunye. Ulwazi ngamaxwebhe e-NEC ngokukodwa ngamadebe e-Short-, Term service- kwaye namaxwebhe e-Framework agreement. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (i-MS Word. Auto CAD ne-Excel). Ulwazi noluhlu lokusebenza ngokwakhiwa ngekhompyutha kolwakhiwo lobuchwephexhe kwindawo yezonyango. Isakhono esinzima sokuhamba nabantu sokuthetha nokubhala.
xh.duties: Yakha iingcombolo ezichaza ngokweenkcukacha namaxwebhe okuthenga ngaphakathi kwamaxesha achaziweyo. Lawula unikeze iiprojekthi ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuze ugqibe ukufakwa nokuvala. Thetha nabadlali beprojekthi ngokomfuno weeprojekthi, iinkcukacha, intshukubakada kwaye unike iinkonzo. Qinisekisa ukwenzeka koluhlu lopopayi wokuyila ngokubaluleka umsebenzi ngokwesimfuno sokuqhuba. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwakhiwo lobuchwephexhe, isityalo nokuya kumathuba athengisa kuhambelana no-Mthetho woPhuhliso nokuKhuseleko koNyaka ka-1993 kunye nomthetho ohlongezele, umthetho wakwaNdalwazi, oqwalaselwa imigaqo ngaphakathi kwendawo yezonyango.

jobs.title: Social Worker Grade 1
jobs.summary: Social Worker Grade 1 at Tygerberg Hospital in Parow Valley providing comprehensive psychosocial services, counselling and child protection support to patients and families.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Social Worker. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Social Worker. Experience: None. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of social work legislation, policies, ethical standards and case management process, including psychosocial assessment, crisis intervention, child protection, discharge planning and services to vulnerable groups, strong communication, counselling interview and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with patients, families, multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. Good administration skills. Ability to function under pressure and computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provision of comprehensive, client centered social work services to adults and children through psychosocial assessments, counselling, crisis intervention, child protection services and discharge planning for patients and families. Participate in multidisciplinary team processes and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate services, advocate for patients and address barriers to care and discharge. Maintain accurate and compliant records, reports and statistics in accordance with professional legal and organizational requirements. Render social work services in any department as required. Ensure professional governance and compliance through adherence to legislation, ethical standards, departmental policies, continuous development, and performance management requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Dr N Frans / Mr A Lindoor Tel No: (021) 938-5684/4164
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointments on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Social Worker with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Maatskaplike Werker Graad 1
af.summary: Maatskaplike Werker Graad 1 by Tygerberg Hospital in Parow Valley wat omvattende psigososiale dienste, berading en kinderbeskermingsondersteuning aan pasiënte en gesinne bied.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Dienste-professies (SACSSP) as Maatskaplike Werker moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Dienste-professies (SACSSP) as Maatskaplike Werker. Ervaring: Geen. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van maatskaplike werkwetgewing, beleide, etiese standaarde en saakbestuursprosesse, insluitend psigososiale assessering, krisisintervensie, kinderbeskerming, ontslagbeplanning en dienste aan kwesbare groepe, sterk kommunikasie-, onderhoud- en interpersoonlike vaardighede met die vermoë om doeltreffend met pasiënte, gesinne, multidissiplinêre spanne en eksterne belanghebbendes te skakel. Goed administratiewe vaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer en rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Verskaffing van omvattende, kliëntgesentreerde maatskaplike werkdienste aan volwassenes en kinders deur psigososiale assesserings, berading, krisisintervensie, kinderbeskermingsdienste en ontslagbeplanning vir pasiënte en gesinne. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre spanprosesse en werk saam met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om dienste te koördineer, vir pasiënte op te tree en hindernisse vir sorg en ontslag aan te spreek. Onderhou akkurate en voldoenende rekords, verslae en statistieke in ooreenstemming met professionele, wetlike en organisatoriese vereistes. Lewer maatskaplike werkdienste in enige departement soos vereis. Verseker professionele bestuur en nakoming deur gehoorsaamheid aan wetgewing, etiese standaarde, departementele beleide, deurlopende ontwikkeling en prestasiebestuursvereistes.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezempilo Yokomculo Wezinga 1
zu.summary: Umsebenzi Wezempilo Yokomculo Wezinga 1 eTygerberg Hospital eParow Valley ohlinzela ngemisebenzi eqondene nobuhlakani bezengqondo nempilo yomphakathi, usuleleke nokwesekwa abantwana kubasebenzisi nemindeni.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Ithuluzi elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wezempilo yokomculo. Ukubhalisa kubhalwe leso sikhashana: Ukubhalisa kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wezempilo yokomculo. Isipiliyoni: Akukho. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi ngemithetho, imigomo, ngemuva kwalo mzuzu, kanye nesenzo sokuphatha isiqu, okuhlanganisa ukulinganisa kwezobuhlakani, ukungenelela esibusweni, ukwesekwa abantwana, ukulungiselela ukuphuma kwebhedi kanye nezinsiza kumacandla abuthathaka, ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukuphatha imibuzo yokweluleka kanye nobudlelwano obuhle bokwazi ukuthintana ngempumelelo nabasebenzisi, imindeni, amaqembu okusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene kanye nalabo abanganabantu. Amandla okulawula kahle. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzela ngokwenza imisebenzi eqondene nempilo yokomculo kubantu abadala nabantwana ngokushegeswa ukuthola ulwazi, ukweluleka, ukungenelela esibusweni, imisebenzi yokwesekwa abantwana kanye nokulungiselela ukuphuma kwebhedi kubasebenzisi nemindeni. Ukubambe iqhaza emaphoyintini amaqembu okusebenza ngokwendlela ezahlukene futhi ukusebenzisana nabangaphakathi nabangaphandle ukumatanisa imisebenzi, ukuzikhethela abasebenzisi nokulungisa izithiyo zokunakekelwa nokuphuma. Ukugcina izinsiza eziyiqiniso, izinsiza ezingemthetho kanye nezibalo ngokusho imithetho, ngemuva kwalo mzuzu, kanye nemiqondo yomnyango. Ukukhiqiza imisebenzi yesempilo yokomculo kunoma yimuphi umnyango njengoba kudingekile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa ngemithetho kanye nokuhambisana ngokulandela imithetho, ngemuva kwalo mzuzu, imigomo yomnyango, ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo, nezidingo zokuphatha ukusebenza.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wentsapho Elikwizinga 1
xh.summary: Umsebenzi Wentsapho Elikwizinga 1 eTygerberg Hospital eParow Valley unika iinkonzo ezibandakanya zonke iindawo zentsapho nengqondo, inceba neyinkxaso yokhuselo lwabantwana kumagula neentsapho.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezisezantsi: Iqualifying efanelekile evumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengoMsebenzi Wentsapho. Ukubhalisa kwindlu yamagunya abasebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengoMsebenzi Wentsapho. Isipho: Akukho. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngemithetho yomsebenzi wentsapho, iinkqubo zemigaqo, iingcinga zokuziphatha nendlela yokulawula iicala, kuquka ukulinganisa kwentsapho nengqondo, ukungenelela ekuhlaseni, ukukhusela abantwana, ukulungiselela ukuphuma kwesibhedlele neenkonzo kumacandu angathathi hlola, amakhono obuqhawekuli obunamandla, wokudibana nentsapho nabantu ngokubanzi nokuqukumbela ngendlela ekumhlabeni, nethamsanqa lokusebenzisana ngempumelelo nomagula, neentsapho, amaqela osebenzi bamabini angathathi hlabo babambe iqondo nabanikeli abangaphandle. Amandla alungelelienyo lokulawula izinto. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinenzi nokuba nelwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Ukuqulunqa iinkonzo zomsebenzi wentsapho ezibandakanya zonke iindawo, ezigxile kumthengi kubadala nabantwana ngokulinganisa iimeko zentsapho nengqondo, ukwenza inceba, ukungenelela ekuhlaseni, iinkonzo zokukhusela abantwana nokulungiselela ukuphuma kwesibhedlele kumagula neentsapho. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zeqela elisebenza ngamabini angathathi hlaba nokusebenzisana nabathile bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ukulawula iinkonzo, ukuzimela kumagula nokusombulula iithintelo ezikwindlela yokunyamekela nokuphuma kwesibhedlele. Ukugcina izinto ezichanekileyo nezilandela imigaqo, iingxelo namanani ngokuthobela iimfuno zomsebenzi, zomthetho nengqiqo. Ukunikela iinkonzo zomsebenzi wentsapho kuyo nayiphi na isebe njengoko kufunekayo. Kuqinisekisa ulawulo lomsebenzi nokuzelelwa ngokuthobela imithetho, iingcinga zokuziphatha, iinkqubo zesebe, ukuziphucela ngokuyaqhubeka, nokuzelelwa kokulawula ukusebenza.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Supply Chain Management
jobs.summary: Administrative officer in supply chain management at Mossel Bay Hospital, handling inventory control, LOGIS system functions and audit compliance, requiring a senior certificate with SCM experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics and/or Accounting as a passed subject and/or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas (KPA’s) of the post. Experience: Appropriate experience in Supply Chain Management (warehouse and asset management) and Finance processes. Appropriate Supervisor Experience. Appropriate experience in LOGIS system & EPS. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B) driver’s licence and willingness to drive. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel and Power point). Appropriate knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury Regulations, Provincial Treasury Instructions, Accounting Officer System and Delegations. Good leadership abilities. Good communication skills (verbal and written). The ability to meet deadlines and complete tasks under extreme pressure.
jobs.duties: Inventory control and warehouse management. Perform LOGIS system controller functions. Ensure that all transactions comply with legislative requirements (audit compliance) and handle audit queries with regards to SCM. Manage the LOGIS system and the approval of transactions and drawing of related reports. Assist with financial procedures and reporting on Annual and Interim Financial Statements. Asset management of the Mossel bay sub- district and demand and requisition management.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/ oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte in voorsieningskettingbestuur by Mossel Bay Hospitaal, wat voorraadbeheer, LOGIS-stelselfunksies en oudit-nakoming hanteer, wat 'n senior sertifikaat met SCM-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat fokus op die Kernprestasie-areas (KPA's) van die pos. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Voorsieningskettingbestuur (pakhuis- en batebestuur) en Finansies prosesse. Toepaslike toesighouer-ervaring. Toepaslike ervaring in LOGIS-stelsel & EPS. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te bestuur. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel en Power point). Toepaslike kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury Regulations, Provincial Treasury Instructions, Accounting Officer System and Delegations. Goeie leierskapsvermoëns. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Die vermoë om sperdatums na te kom en take onder uiterste druk te voltooi.
af.duties: Voorraadbeheer en pakhuisbestuur. Verrig LOGIS-stelselbeheerfunksies. Verseker dat alle transaksies voldoen aan wetgewende vereistes (oudit-nakoming) en hanteer oudit-navrae met betrekking tot SCM. Bestuur die LOGIS-stelsel en die goedkeuring van transaksies en die opstel van verwante verslae. Bystand verleen met finansiële prosedures en verslagdoening oor Jaarlikse en Tussentydse Finansiële State. Batebestuur van die Mossel Bay sub-distrik en aanvraag- en bestelbestuur.

zu.title: Iofisa Lokuphatha: Supply Chain Management
zu.summary: Iofisa oluphatha izokwengqondo e-Supply Chain Management e-Mossel Bay Hospital, elibhekene nokulawula izinto ezigcinwayo, imisebenzi yesistimu ye-LOGIS kanye nokuhambisana nokuhlola, elidinga i-Senior Certificate enemava ye-SCM.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okungenani: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) ene-Mathematics kanye/noma i-Accounting njengesifundo esidlulile kanye/noma i-Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) enemava/ikholono ezibheke kwindawo Zokusebenza Eziphambili (KPA) zaleso sikhundla. Imava: Imefanele e-Supply Chain Management (ukuphathwa kwendawo yokugcina impahla kanye nezimpahla) nasezinqubweni ze-Finance. Imefanele yomphathi. Imefanele kulesistimu ye-LOGIS ne-EPS. Isidingo esizalwa naleso sikhundla: Lesensi yokushayela (Code B) evumelekile kanye nokuthanda ukuqhuba. Izikholono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukubhalisa kwekhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel kanye ne-Power point). Ulwazi olufanele lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-National Treasury Regulations, i-Provincial Treasury Instructions, i-Accounting Officer System kanye nama-Delegations. Amakhono amahle okuba ngumholi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ikhono lokuhlana izinqiniso egcwaliseza imisebenzi ngaphansi kwegcindezi elikhulu.
zu.duties: Ukulawula izinto ezigcinwayo nokuphathwa kwezindawo zokugcina impahla. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokulawula isistimu ye-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zivumelana nezidingo zomthetho (ukuhambisana nokuhlola) uphathe imibuzo yokuhlola ngokuphathelene ne-SCM. Phatha isistimu ye-LOGIS kanye nokugunyaza izinkokhelo nokukhipha okusho mayelana nazo. Siza ngezinqubo zezimali nokubika ngokwezinkulumo zeSimo Sezimali Zonyaka nasePhakathi. Ukuphathwa kwempahla kwe-Mossel Bay sub-district kanye nokuphathwa kwesidingo nezinkokhelo.

xh.title: IOfisi yokulawula: ulawulo lweenkcwelo zoluhlu lwezinto
xh.summary: Iofisi yolawulo kulawulo lweenkcwedo zoluhlu lwezinto eMossel Bay Hospital, elawulayo ulawulo lwezinto ezikhoyo, imisebenzi yenkqubo ye-LOGIS nokuhambelana nokuphononongwa, kufuneka ifane ne-senior certificate enomculo wokusebenza kwi-SCM.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingangenwa ngaphantsi: Senior Certificate (okanye esilinganayo) ethatha i-Mathematics nakwaya i-Accounting njengenxaxha ephumelelweyo, okanye Senior Certificate (okanye esilinganayo) enamava/amakhono agqitha kumacanduwo emisebenzi (KPA's) esithuba. Imiba: Amava afanelekileyo kulawulo lweenkcwedo zoluhlu lwezinto (iindlu ezithengiswayo kwaye lulawulwa) kwaye kukwindlela zeemali. Amava afanelekileyo njengalomphathiswa. Amava afanelekileyo kunkqubo ye-LOGIS & EPS. Isimfuno sokwenza: ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B) esemthethweni nokuthanda ukuqhuba. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukubhala nokuqonda ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kwaye Power point). Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-National Treasury Regulations, i-Provincial Treasury Instructions, i-Accounting Officer System kwaye i-Delegations. Ukuzinza ngokuphatha. Amakhono ethetho aluncedo (ethethwayo nobhalwayo). Ikhono lokuphela kwelixesha nokuphela amashishini phantsi komthwalo omkhulu.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lwezinto ezikhoyo nolawulo lwezinto ezifakwa kwindlu. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo inkqubo ye-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukuba konke ukunyenyisa kuhambelana nemiqathango yomthetho (ukuhambelana nokuphononongwa) uphathe imibuzo yokuphononongwa nge-SCM. Phatha inkqubo ye-LOGIS nokuvuma ukunyenyisa nokutsala iiripoti ezinxulumene. Siza kumanyathelo eemali nokubika kumaphepha eMali yonyaka nakumaphepha apha kwindlela. Ulawulo lwezinto ezikhoyo kwisiithili se-Mossel bay nolawulo lokufuna nokukhulisa izinto.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and administrative support to the CEO at Eerste River Hospital, requiring a secretarial diploma and relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An accredited secretarial diploma and/or administrative qualification on the level of NQF level 5 (a certificate of completion should be provided). Qualification on a higher NQF level may also be accepted on condition that the subjects of the qualification align to the functions as per the attached job description. Experience: Appropriate experience in rendering a support service to Middle and or Senior Management. Appropriate experience in office administration and or management, which includes financial management, asset management, logistical support. Inherent requirements of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) drivers’ licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer skills- intermediate to advance (MS Office). Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Excellent interpersonal, time management, office management and organisational skills.
jobs.duties: Render a secretarial service to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Provide a receptionist support service to the office of the CEO including answering and directing telephone calls as well as visitors and proper scheduling of meetings. Ensure adequate, timeous preparation for meetings. Render administrative support to the Office of the CEO including typing of minutes in meetings and certain documents when required and ensure accuracy of documents and ensuring good record keeping including effective and efficient filling system. Effectively and efficiently manage the diary of the CE++O and ensure prioritizing of important meetings. Assist the CEO with People Management documents and related administration. Ensure responsible co-ordination of the CEO’s meetings i.e., logistics arrangements, venues etc. Support the CEO with the administration of the Budget and Supply chain including maintenance of Equipment and ensuring office equipment is operational.
jobs.enquiries: Mr D Binza Tel No: (021) 902-8070 or Email: David.Binza@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. The pool of applicants will be considered for similar vacant posts within the Chief Directorate: Metro Health Services, for a period of 3 months from date of advert. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die CEO by Eerste River Hospital, wat 'n sekretariële diploma en relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Geakkrediteerde sekretariële diploma en/of administratiewe kwalifikasie op die vlak van NQF level 5 ('n sertifikaat van voltooiing moet verskaf word). 'n Kwalifikasie op 'n hoër NQF level kan ook aanvaar word op voorwaarde dat die vakke van die kwalifikasie ooreenstem met die funksies soos uiteengesit in die aangehegde posbeskrywing. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in die lewer van 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan Middel- en/of Senior Bestuur. Toepaslike ervaring in kantoormadministrasie en/of bestuur, wat finansiële bestuur, batesbestuur en logistieke ondersteuning insluit. Inherente vereistes van die pos: 'n Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardighede - intermediêr tot gevorderd (MS Office). Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Uitstekende interpersoonlike, tydbestuur-, kantoorbestuur- en organisasievaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer 'n sekretariële diens aan die Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Verskaf 'n receptions-ondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor van die CEO insluitend die beantwoording en deurstuur van telefoonoproepe asook besoekers en die behoorlike skedulering van vergaderings. Verseker voldoende, tydige voorbereiding vir vergaderings. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Kantoor van die CEO insluitend die tik van notule in vergaderings en sekere dokumente wanneer vereis en verseker die akkuraatheid van dokumente en verseker goeie rekordhouding insluitend 'n effektiewe en doeltreffende lêerstelsel. Bestuur die dagboek van die CEO effektief en doeltreffend en verseker die prioritisering van belangrike vergaderings. Help die CEO met People Management-dokumente en verwante administrasie. Verseker verantwoordelike koördinering van die CEO se vergaderings d.w.s., logistieke reëlings, plekke ens. Ondersteun die CEO met die administrasie van die Begroting en Supply chain insluitend die onderhoud van Toerusting en verseker dat kantoortoerusting in werkende toestand is.

zu.title: Umsekeli wezinsizakalo
zu.summary: Umsebenzi wokunikeza inkonzo yolawu olusekela i-CEO kwa-Eerste River Hospital, okudinga i-diploma yokuba ngumqashi kanye nesipiliyoni esifanele.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesibalo esithile: I-diploma esemthethweni yokuba ngumqashi kanye/noma iziqu zolawu ezingeni le-NQF level 5 (kufanele kuhlolwe isitifiketi sokugqitshwa). Iziqu ezisingathini esiphezulu se-NQF zingamukelwa ngesikhathi sokuthi izihloko seziqu zihambisana nemisebenzi njengokuchaziwe kwengxoxo yomsebenzi. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ekunikeni inkonzo yonkexheghezo eNdunankulu noma eNkulunkulweni Esemthethweni. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuphathweni kwehhovisi kanye noma ekuqaphuini, okuhlanganisa ukulawula izimali, ukulawula izimpahla, nokunikezwa kokuxhakavukwazi. Izidingo ezenza bumphathi bomsebenzi: ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikati): Ikhono lokusebenzela isigaxa sekhompyutha ukusuka kwabangu-1 kuya kwabangu-5. Ikhono elikhulu lokukhuluma nokubhala. Ikhono elibucayi lokubaluleka kwabantu, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukuphatha ihhovisi, nokuqamba izinkulumo.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yobungqashi kuMongameli Ophethe (CEO). Nikela ngenkonzo yokusekela komamukeli ehhovisi lika-CEO okuhlanganisa ukuphendula futhi uqondise amakholi efoni kanye nabavakashi nokuhlela kahle izinkumunyamo. Qinisekisa ukulungiselela okwanele nangesikhathi kwemihlangano. Nikela ngenkxaso yolawu ehhovisi lika-CEO okuhlanganisa ukuthayipha imizuzu emihlanganweni nalawo mathwemu athize lapho kudingeka khona, futhi qinisekise ukunemba kwamathwemu futhi ugcine amarekhodi kahle okuhlanganisa indlela efanele futhi esebenza kahle yokugcina amafayela. Phatha kaluleke futhi ngokusebenza kahle idayari ka-CEO futhi qinisekisa ukubekwa phambili kwemihlangano ebalulekile. Siza u-CEO ngamathwemu okuPhatha Abantu nolawu ohlobene nawo. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa okunobuxhakavamathwemthethweni kwemihlangano ka-CEO okuyilawu-mthetho. Siza u-CEO ngenkxaso yolawu engqikithini wezimali, nokuhlanganisa ukulondolozwa kwemishini kanye nokunikezwa kwayo, kanye noqinisekiso lokuthi izinto zenhle zisebenza kahle.

xh.title: Umncedisi wabucala
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yobugcisa bokwenzela amanani namasebe ekuqwalaselweni kunye nokuqulunqwa kweenkonzo kumlawuli omkhulu kwisibhedlele i-Eerste River Hospital, kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi yobugcisa bokwenzela amanani namasebe kunye namava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Iznqubo zemfundo esezantsi: Isidiploma esamkelekileyo sobugcisa bokwenzela amanani namasebe nokuphinda ibe ngumgangatho walawulo kumqondo ongangingaphezulu kuka NQF level 5 (kufuneka kubekho isatifikethi sokugqiba). Ithobele ekwamkelweni kwemfundo ngaphezulu kumqondo ka NQF level kwaye nangaphezulu naxa izifundo zemfundo zihambelana nemisebenzi njengoko kuchazwe kwinkcazelo yomsebenzi othunyelweyo. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo ekunikezeni inkxaso yeenkonzo kubaphathi bobuqiyo bucali nobunyulu kumgangatho ukwenzela ulawulo lwabaqiyo bucali nabaphezulu. Amava afanelekileyo kulawulo lweofisi okanye ulawulo, aquka ulawulo lwezezimali, ulawulo lweempahla, inkxaso yezinto eziyiyo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo (Code B/EB). Ukuzazi/izikhashana: Izikhashana zekhompyutha - ukusuka kwinqanaba eliphakathi siye kweliphezulu (MS Office). Izikhashana ezimhle zokuthetha ngesithethe sokubhala nangomlomo. Izikhashana ezimhle zokusebenza nabantu, ukulawula ixesha, ukulawula iofisi nokuhlelwa kwabantu.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yobugcisa bokwenzela amanani namasebe kumlawuli omkhulu (CEO). Nikela ngenkxaso yekhuselo lefowuni ofisini ka CEO aquka ukuphendula nokukhokela iingxoxo ngefowuni nangabashiyiweyo, nokucwangcisa iintlangano ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulungiselela okwaneleyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo iintlangano. Nikela ngenkxaso yolawulo ofisini ka CEO aquka ukuchwetheza amaminithi iintlangano namaxwebhu athile xa kudingeka, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchanekileyo kwamaxwebhu, kwaye ulugcine uludwe oluhle lweenkcazelo ngokudibeneyo nangokusetyenziswa kakuhle kwenkqubo yokugcina iifayile. Lawula ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo idayari ka CEO ukuze uqinisekise ukubekwa phambili kweentlangano ezibalulekileyo. Nceda u CEO ngamaxwebhu olawuloabantu nolawulo oluhambelanayo. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa ngokwakunye nokubulela kweentlangano zika CEO, ukuziingqalelo ngokwezinto ezingeniswayo, izindlu zokubaleka njl. Nikela ngenkxaso kumlawuli womntu ophatha iSixhobo sabucala samandla ezezimali kwindalo ekuphathweni kwamandla enkonzo ngenkqubo yokutshintshelana kweempahla kunye nokugcina iimpahla zokuqinisekisa ukuba iimpahla zofisi zisebenza.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL: Neonatal,

Ability to function/make decisions independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Knowledge of Nursing Care protocols and Nursing Act.

Provision of Support to Nursing Services. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development.

Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview.
