jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL: Wellness,
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Grade 1 to 3) needed for wellness initiatives and community-orientated primary care at Clanwilliam CDC in the Cederberg Sub-district, Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A Minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 3: A Minimum of 20 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s license (Code B/EB Manual) and willingness to travel in the district. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of district health services, primary health care and district hospital package of services Good interpersonal relations, leadership and communication skills (verbal and written) The ability to interpret, analyze, and implement clinical policies, guidelines. Knowledge of development of protocols and guidelines, standard operating procedures. Good report writing and facilitation skills. Ability to function independently without the direct supervision of supervisor Experience and ability to transfer knowledge and skill in a group as well as individual setting. Must be computer literate (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Excellent typing and writing skills inclusive to spelling and grammatical errors.

Intersectoral interface management with strong organisational linkages and partnerships with outside stakeholders, sector, departments, NGO’s and community structures. Lead and co-ordinate scheduled wellness activities for men, women, adolescents and youth with the focus on the 1st 1000 Days initiative towards building healthy communities. Co-ordinate wellness activities in the specific communities with the focus on Western Cape Wellness (WoW!) to support an integrated approach in managing chronic conditions e.g. Diabetes, Hypertension, TB, HIV and Mental Health. Coordinate and support collection, collation, interpreting of health data for reporting, monitoring and evaluation purposes.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3 (ALGEMEEN: Welstand,
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Graad 1 tot 3) benodig vir welstandsinitiatiewe en gemeenskapsgerigte primêre gesondheidsorg by Clanwilliam CDC in die Cederberg Subdistrik, Western Cape.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB Handrat) en bereidwilligheid om in die distrik te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van distriksgesondheidsdienste, primêre gesondheidsorg en distriksziekenhuispakket van dienste. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, leierskap en kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Die vermoë om klinieke beleide en riglyne te interpreteer, ontleed en te implementeer. Kennis van die ontwikkeling van protokolle en riglyne, standaardbedryfsprosedures. Goeie verslagskryf- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer sonder die direkte toesig van 'n toesighouer. Ervaring en vermoë om kennis en vaardighede oor te dra in 'n groep- sowel as individuele omgewing. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Uitstekende tik- en skryfvaardighede, insluitend spelling en grammatikale foute.
af.duties: Bestuur van eksterne koppelvlak: beplanning, koördinering en implementering van welstandsinitiatiewe en -intervensies met steun van interne belanghebbendes om gemeenskapsgerigte primêre gesondheidsorg te implementeer. Intersektorale koppelvlakbestuur met sterk organisatoriese skakelings en vennootskappe met eksterne belanghebbendes, sektor, departemente, NGO's en gemeenskapsstrukture. Lei en koördineer geskeduleerde welstandsaktiwiteite vir mans, vroue, adolessente en jeug met die fokus op die 1st 1000 Days-initiatief om gesonde gemeenskappe te bou. Koördineer welstandsaktiwiteite in die spesifieke gemeenskappe met die fokus op Western Cape Wellness (WoW!) om 'n geïntegreerde benadering te ondersteun in die bestuur van chroniese toestande bv. Diabetes, Hipertensie, TB, HIV en Geestesgesondheid. Koördineer en ondersteun die versameling, samestelling en interpretasie van gesondheidsdata vir verslagdoening, monitering en evalueringsdoeleindes.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Othwebekile Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (OKUJWAYELEKILE: Ukuphila okuhle,
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhlengikazi othwebekile (Izinga 1 kuye ku-3) ozoqhuba izinhlelo zokuphila okuhle kanye nenakekelo okuqondiswa emphakathini esikhungweni se-Clanwilliam CDC esifundeni sase-Cederberg Sub-district, e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Ithifikethi le-R425 okuyisisekelo (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekunakekelweni) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 okuhambisana no-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi othwebekile noma Idigri yeminyaka emine ekunakekelweni (R174) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 okuhambisana no-R1497 noma R171 okuhambisana no-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi othwebekile. Ukubhalisa komkhandlu wezithwebuli: Ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi othwebekile. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/esiyaziwayo ekunakekelweni emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi othwebekile ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-20 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/esiyaziwayo ekunakekelweni emva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi othwebekile ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Izidingo zendalo zomsebenzi: Ilayisense lesiqondisi esivumelekile (i-Code B/EB Manual) kanye nokuthanda ukuhamba endaweni. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngamasevisi ezempilo esifundeni, inakekelo yezempilo okuyisisekelo kanye nephakheji yamasevisi esibhedlela sendawo Ubudlelwane obuhleabantu, ubuholo namakhono okuxhumana (abakhulumayo nokubhaliwe) Ikhono lokuhumusha, ukuhlaziya, futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo zokwelapha, imihlahlandlela. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho yokuhamba kanye nemihlahlandlela, izingqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Amakhono amahle okubhala imibiko kanye nokweseka. Ikhono lokusebenza kwodwa ngaphandle kokuphathwa kwesikhulu esikhokhe Isipiliyoni nasekhonweni lokudlulisa ulwazi nakhono eqenjini kanye nasendaweni yomuntu ngamunye. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Power Point). Amakhono amahle okuthayipha nokubhala ahlanganisa ukubhala okungalungile nani ngokuhlelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela ukuphathwa kophahla langaphandle, ukuhlanganiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphila okuhle kanye nokungenelela ngokwesekwa abahlangothi abangaphakathi ukusetshenziswa kwenakekelo okuqondiswa emphakathini. Ukuphathwa kophahla phakathi kwezinhlela ngobuhle bokuhleleka kwezinhlangano kanye nezinhlangano nomabhalane nabahlangothi bangaphandle, isikhungo, eminyangweni, i-NGO kanye nezakhiwo zomphakathi. Ukubusa futhi uhlanganise izinkambiso zokuphila okuhle zabadoda, abesifazane, abasha abasesigabeni sokuvuka kanye nabasha okugxile esinhlelweni se-1st 1000 Days ekwakheni izimpilo ezinhle zomphakathi. Ukuhlanganisa izinkambiso zokuphila okuhle emphakathini othize okugxile kwi-Western Cape Wellness (WoW!) ukuze useke indlela ehlangene ekunakekelweni kwezimo ezibuhlungu isikhathi eside njengokuthi u-Gestational Diabetes, i-Hypertension, i-TB, i-HIV kanye neMental Health. Ukuhlanganisa kanye nokusekela ukuqoqwa, ukuqondiswa, nokuhumushwa kwemininingwane yezempilo ukuze kubhalwe, kuqashelwe futhi kuqaniswe.

Ikhono elihle lokuchwetheza nongxolo ngokubhalwa kwamagama nemposiso ezimali.
xh.duties: Ukulawulwa ngaphandle kwe ndlela yokuqeshiswa, ukulungelelanisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezinempilo nongenelelo ngoncedo lwabazibanzi bangaphakathi ukuze kusebenziswe ungcino lokuqala lweqela lomphakathi. Ukuqeshwa kolawulo olunamanxibelelwano amakhulu namarhabe amakhulu kwibakhi bangaphandle, iqela, amasebe, i-NGO kunye neenkcubeko zomphakathi. Ukuba ngumanyano nolungelelanisa imisebenzi ezijolise kweempilo kumadoda, abantu bomakhosikazi, iintsaba nabafana kubandakanya ukugqithiswa kwe-1st 1000 Days initiative ukwakha iindawo ezinempilo zomphakathi. Ukulungelelanisa imisebenzi ezijolise kwezempilo kumaphakathi athile ngokugxila kwi-Western Cape Wellness (WoW!) ukuxhasa iindlela ezibhalwe kunye ekulawuleni iimeko ezihlala ixesha elide njenge-Diabetes, Hypertension, TB, HIV nengqondo. Ukulungelelanisa kunye noncedo lokuthathwa, ukuqoqwa, ukuhlalutywa kolwazi lwezempilo ukwenzela ukubika, ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela inkqubo.

Ohlelwe 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yesipili esifanele/ esiveleleke ekuhlengikweni emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengommeliwekaHlengikazi kuKuhlengikwa Okuvamile. Sisa nenkambiso elandelwe yokugoma (i-EPI) ngezifo ezingavikelwa ngemvaccine nasezinkambisweni zokufinyelela emphakathini. Zisebenzisa ukuhlengikwa nokunakekelwa kwempilo ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemithetho elawula ukuhlengikwa nokunakekelwa kwempilo. Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele okungquality ekuhlengikweni ngaphakathi kweqoqo le-Primary Health Care lapho kungekho ukuqubuka kwezifo kulo wonke i-Sub-structure. jobs.summary: Professional Nurse positions across Knysna, Bitou, George and Central Karoo sub-districts to coordinate HPV vaccination campaigns, requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. In collaboration with the permanently appointed Integrated School Health Nurse, coordinate and implement HPV vaccination campaigns in public, private, independent and special schools in accordance with approved protocols. Deliver routine and catch-up immunisations and Influenza vaccinations in line with the Expanded Programme on Immunisation schedule and relevant clinical guidelines and support with data collection within these program activities. Coordinate, delegate and monitor tasks assigned to subordinate staff to ensure effective implementation of immunisation and child health activities. -Participate in outreach activities that improve access to preventive child health and immunisation services, including support to high- risk communities, poor-performing areas and areas with known access barriers. Collaborate with Educators, Parents, School Governing Bodies to improve uptake of HPV vaccinations and school health services and reduce the misinformation circulating within these structures.

Werk saam met opvoeders, ouers, School Governing Bodies om die inname van HPV-entstowwe en skoolgesondheidsdienste te verbeter en desinformasie wat binne hierdie strukture sirkuleer te verminder.

Kulindelwe kumuntu oqokiwe ukuba athintane nabesiguli kumaziko ahlukene kulo Phasi-Distrikhi. Izakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Izakhono zokuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ehlanganyweni nomhlengikazi oqashiwe ngokugcwele we-Integrated School Health, hlela futhi ufake imikhankaso yokugatsha i-HPV ezikoleni zikawonke-wonke, ezizimele, ezimele nakwezikole ezikhethekile ngokuvumelana namaphrothokholi avunyiwe. Yela imigatsha ejwayelekile nokuthi ubuyelele kuyo ukugatsha nokugatsha i-Influenza ngokuvumelana neshejuli ye-Expanded Programme on Immunisation nezindlela zokwelapha ezihambisana nalokho, futhi useke ngokuqoqwa kwemininingwane kulmicimbi yale minikhi yezinhlelo. Hlela, yabelu futhi ulawule imisebenzi enikwa abasebenzi abangaphansi kuwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezenzo zokugatsha nezempilo zabantwana. -Thatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yokunyuka ukutholakala kwezinsiza zokuvikela izempilo zabantwana nokugatsha, okuhlanganisa ukweseka imiphakathi engengozi enkulu, izindawo ezingasebenzi kahle kanye nezindawo ezaziwa nokuvinjelwa ukutholakala. Sebenzisana nabafundisi, abezali, nabaholi bezikole ukuze kwenyuke ukwamukelwa kokugatsha i-HPV kanye nezinhlaka zokuhlinzwa kwezempilo ezikoleni futhi kuncishwe imininingwane engamanga ephila phakathi kwalezo zinhlelo.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Ondersteuning (COMPREHENSIVE Gesondheid
af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuning aan gesondheidsprogrambestuurders, insluitend data vaslegging, verkryging en logistiek, by 'n Western Cape sub-struktuurkantoor.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike administratiewe ervaring in 'n Gesondheidsdienste-omgewing. Ervaring as 'n ondersteuningsklerk vir 'n bestuurder. Ervaring in gesondheidsprogramme of primêre gesondheidsorg of hospitaalgesondheidsdienste. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige Kode (B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook en MS Teams. Deklike beplannings-, organisasie- en tydbestuursvaardighede. Kennis en ervaring in dataversameling, vaslegging, monitering, verslagdoening en gesondheidsinligtingstelsels. Sterk administratiewe, rekordbestuurs- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Kennis van gesondheidsprogramme/dienste, insluitend Maternal, Women and Child Health, HIV/TB en Community-Based Services. Goeie interpersoonlike en belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvaardighede, met die vermoë om professionele verhoudings met gesondheidsfasiliteite, regeringsdepartemente, VGO's, NPO's en private verskaffers te handhaaf.
af.duties: Lewer doeltreffende administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuning aan Gesondheidsprogrambestuurders en programspanne. Versamel, vang vas, onderhou en rapporteer programinligting en gesondheidsdata om monitering en evaluering te ondersteun. Ondersteun verkrygings-, logistieke-, voorraadbeheer-, bestel- en uitreikingsprosesse vir hulpbronne. Koördineer fasiliteits- en belanghebbende-/NPO-betrokkenheid om dienslewering te ondersteun. Onderhou professionele verhoudings met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning tydens welstands-, uitreik- en gesondheidsbevorderingsaktiwiteite. Ondersteun gehalteverbetering, oudit-, nakomingsprosesse en opleidingsintervensies.

zu.title: Clerk wezengqalashezo: Ukusekela (Izenzwe wonke eYedwa eZempilo
zu.summary: Nikela ngesekelo lezengqalashezo nlobu bongikazi kubaphathi bahlelo lokwempilo, okuhlanganisa ukuthwebula imininingwane, ukuthenga nokuhlela ukuhamba kwempahla, esikhundleni sobunjiniyela be-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo eyingcosana: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele sezengqalashezo esikhundleni sezinsebenzo zeZempilo. Isipiliyono njengenkulu yesekelo kumphathi. Isipiliyono kuhlelo lokwempilo noma ukunakekelwa kwempilo okuyisisekelo noma izinkonzo zempilo zesibhedlela. Izidingo ezibhalwe ngaphakathi kwaleso sikhundla: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo ye-Code (B/EB). Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook ne-MS Teams. Amakhono okuhlela, ukuhlela nokuqamba isikhathi angcono. Ulwazi nesipiliyono ekutholeni imininingwane, ukuyithwebula, ukulilondoloza, ukubika nasezinhlelweni zolwazi ngempilo. Amakhono aphakeme okwazisa, okuphatha amarekhodi nokubhala imibiko. Ulwazi ngohlelo/izinkonzo zempilo, okuhlanganisa i-Maternal, Women and Child Health, HIV/TB nezinkonzo ezisuselwa emphakathini. Amakhono aphakeme okusebenza nabantu kanye nokubamba amabhuku nabasharekhodi bangaphandle, anelikhono lokugcina ubudlelwano obuhloniphekile nezikhungo zempilo, eminyangweni kahulumeni, ama-NGO, ama-NPO kubaphathi bangesikhundla.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngesekelo lezengqalashezo kanye nolobungikazi ku-Health Programme Managers nakuqeqesha uqeqeshe loluhlelo. Qoqa, thwebula, gcina ubeke imininingwane yoluhlelo idatha yempilo ukuze usekele ukubuka nokuhlola. Sekela ukuthenga, ukuhlela ukuhamba kwempahla, ukulawula izitoko, ukuyifuna nokukhiqiza izinto ezidingekayo zokusabela. Hlelanisa ubudlelwane nezikhungo nabasharekhodi be-NPO ukuze usekele ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhloniphekile nabasharekhodi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikeza ngesekelo sezengqalashezo ngesikhathi kuhlelwa imikhankaso yokuqasha abasebenzi, ukukhwabanisa imiphakathi nokukhuthaza impilo. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlolwa, ukuhambisana namazinga okuqeqesha.

xh.title: iklerku yolawulo: Inkxaso (ISIPHELO seMpilo
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo neselekelwe kubaphathi beenkqubo zempilo, kuqukuqa ukubamba iingcombolo, ukuthenga nokuhamba kwemisebenzi, kwiofisi yendalo engaphantsi kwa Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezincinane ezi funekayo: Isatifiketh se-Senior (okanye esilinganayo). Iimvelaphi: Iimvelaphi ezifanelekileyo zolawulo kwindawo yeSebe lempiIa. Iimvelaphi njengomncedisi weklerku kumphathi. Iimvelaphi kule nkqubo yempilo okunyanga yempilo yokuqala okanye iinkonzo zempilo zesibhedlele. Iimfuno zomsebenzi ngokwasebenzakalweni: ilayiseni ye-Code (B/EB) esemthethweni. Ulwazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha kwi-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, i-Outlook naye-MS Teams. Amakhono ahleliweyo eceba lulwimi, lweziko nolawulo lexesha. Ulwazi namava ekuthatheni iingcombolo, ekuzingeniseni, ekuphahleni, ekubaleni nasezikhululo zolwazi ngempilo. Amakhono amandla e-olawulo, ekulawulweni iirekhodi nakubhalweni ngexesha. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo/iinkonzo zempilo, kuquka ukuzelelelwa kwabafazi nabantwana, i-HIV/ I-TB nasezikhululo ezingamashishini. Amakhono amandla abantu nokubhangiswa kwentsebenziswano, anamandla okugcina ukubhangiswa ngesimo esemthethweni nezibhedlele zempilo, iisebe zalawulo, i-NGO, i-NPO, neenkampani zangasese.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo neselekelwe ngempumelelo kubaphathi beenkqubo zempilo neqela leenkqubo. Khupha, thatha, zigcine uze ubale ulwazi lwenkqubo nangempilo ukuze uxhase ukubeka nokuqonda. Nceda ekuthengeni, ekugqibeleni kwemisebenzi, ekulawulweni iinkunzi, ekuthengiseni nokupha iinkqubo ezizixhobo. Langazelela izibhedlele, iimbangi/ i-NPO ekusebenzeni ukuze kuxhaswe ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo. Gcina ubudlelwane obusesemthethweni nabantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nika inkxaso yolawulo ngexesha lokuqinisekiswa komzimba, kokukhula komthambo nakunyusa ulwazi ngempilo. Xhasa ukuphuculwa kwangoko, i-odit, iinkqubo zokulandela imithetho nemisebenzi yolungiselelo.

jobs.title: Personnel Officer (TRANSVERSAL Employment and Coid
jobs.centre: Head Office, Cape Town Asla CC, Mossel Bay Sub-district
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum R237 453 per annum
jobs.summary: Personnel Officer needed at the Western Cape Department of Health to administer COIDA claims, maintain databases, and process compensation matters.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in COIDA and Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Appropriate experience in BAS sundry payment processing. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of the Public Service Act and Collective Agreements. Sound knowledge of Compensation for Occupational and Diseases Act, (COIDA). Sound knowledge of the administration of the COIDA systems. Ability to deal with high volumes of work and to work under pressure. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy (PERSAL, Microsoft Office (Word & Excel), Outlook). Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate administrative and data capturing experience. Appropriate experience in data management and systems management: Sinjani, Ideal Clinic, SPV and PHCIS systems. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license and willingness to drive. Willingness to work overtime and after hours. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good interpersonal and communication skills. Computer literate (Windows, Excel) Appropriate knowledge of Basic Routine Health Information System for Data Capturers.
jobs.duties: Administer compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases claims and liaise with all the relevant stake holders (Compensation Commissioner, private doctors and hospitals, etc). Maintain COIDA database and provide statistical analysis thereof. Processing of COIDA claims on the Department of Labour’s online system. Process various allowances and deductions on PERSAL including standby, fuel, normal overtime and commuted overtime, relocation costs, parking, and travel concessions. Deal with telephonic and written enquiries. Capturing all data according system programs (Ideal Clinic, SPV, Sinjani, PHCIS, Healthnet etc.) Responsible for allocated services points data compiling and reports on all programs. Administration functions and all components of reception management. Register patients on the Patient Administration System (PHCIS) and Healthnet bookings. Responsible for folder Hygiene in reception (i.e., file, retrieve, archive, and dispose folders).
jobs.enquiries: Mr TJ Kwatala Tel No: (021) 483-5711 Ms A Lamprecht Tel No: (044) 604-6106
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. POST 40/235    ;   ADMINISTRATION CLERK: ADMISSIONS Garden Route District No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/written assessment. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution / Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. af.title: Personeelbeampte (TRANSVERSAL indiensneming en Coid
af.summary: Personeelbeampte benodig by die Western Cape Department of Health om COIDA-eise te administreer, databasisse te onderhou en vergoedingsake te prosesseer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in COIDA en die Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Toepaslike ervaring in BAS diverse betalingsverwerking. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die Public Service Act en Kollektiewe Ooreenkomste. Deeglike kennis van die Compensation for Occupational and Diseases Act, (COIDA). Deeglike kennis van die administrasie van die COIDA-stelsels. Vermoë om hoë volumes werk te hanteer en onder druk te werk. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (PERSAL, Microsoft Office (Word & Excel), Outlook). Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike administratiewe en datavasleggingservaring. Toepaslike ervaring in databestuur en stelselbestuur: Sinjani, Ideal Clinic, SPV en PHCIS-stelsels. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te bestuur. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd en na ure te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goed tussenmenslike en kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardig (Windows, Excel) Toepaslike kennis van Basic Routine Health Information System vir datavasleggers.
af.duties: Administreer vergoeding vir beroepsbeserings en -siektes-eise en skakel met alle relevante belanghebbendes (Compensation Commissioner, privaatdokters en hospitale, ens). Onderhou COIDA-databasis en verskaf statistiese ontleding daarvan. Verwerking van COIDA-eise op die Department of Labour se aanlynstelsel. Prosesseer verschillende toelaes en aftrekkings op PERSAL insluitend wagdienst, brandstof, normale oortyd en omgeskakelde oortyd, hervestigingskoste, parkeerplek en reisgeriewe. Hanteer telefoon- en skriftelike navrae. Vaslegging van alle data volgens stelselprogramme (Ideal Clinic, SPV, Sinjani, PHCIS, Healthnet ens.) Verantwoordelik vir saamgestelde data van toegekende dienspunte en verslae oor alle programme. Administratiewe funksies en alle komponente van ontvangsbestuur. Registreer pasiënte op die Patient Administration System (PHCIS) en Healthnet-besprekings. Verantwoordelik vir lêerhigiëne in ontvangs (d.w.s. lêers invoe, onttrek, argiveer en vernietig).

zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi (Umsebenzi We-TRANSVERSAL ne-Coid
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wabasebenzi e-Western Cape Department of Health ukuphatha izikhalazo ze-COIDA, ukugcina amadatabhesi, nokuphatha izindaba zokuhanjiswa kwemali yenhlawulo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isitifiketi se-Senior (noma esilinganayo). Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele kwi-COIDA ne-Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Isiphephelo esifanele ekucutshungeni kokukhokhelwa kwe-BAS sundry. Ikhono (ulwazi/amazimilo): Ulwazi loMthetho wabeNkonzo kahulumeni nama-Agreement aQoqwayo. Ulwazi oluhle ngoMthetho we-Compensation for Occupational and Diseases Act, (COIDA). Ulwazi oluhle ngokuphatha izinhlelo ze-COIDA. Ikhono lokubhekana nenani elikhulu lomsebenzi nangokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezelo. Amakhono aphawulelekwe okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (PERSAL, Microsoft Office (Word & Excel), Outlook). Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isitifiketi se-Senior (noma esilinganayo). Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele sokuphatha nokubhaliswa kwemininingwane. Isiphephelo esifanele ekuphathweni kwemininingwane nezinhlelo: izinhlelo ze-Sinjani, Ideal Clinic, SPV ne-PHCIS. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile (Code B/EB) nenkululeko yokushayela. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemva kwezikhathi ezivunyelwe. Ikhono (ulwazi/amazimilo): Amakhono aphawulelekwe okuhlobana nabantu nokuxhumana. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Windows, Excel) Ulwazi olufanele lwe-Basic Routine Health Information System for Data Capturers.
zu.duties: Phatha izikhalazo ze-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases uze uxhume nabo bonke abahlanganyeli abahlobene (Compensation Commissioner, odokotela abayingcosolo nezibhedlela, njll). Gcina idatabhesi ye-COIDA uze unikeze ukuhlaziya kwezibalo ngayo. Qamba izikhalazo ze-COIDA kule nhlelo ye-Department of Labour ehlayizi. Qamba izimali ezahlukene zokwenziswa nokukhishwa kwe-PERSAL kuhlanganise ukuma kolindile, imoto, ihlelo lokugibela ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esijwayelekile nangokushintshaniswa kwesikhathi, izindleko zokushintsha indawo, ukupaka, kanye nezinsiza zokuhamba. Bhekana nemibuzo ngocingo nangezibhalo. Bhala yonke imininingwane ngokwezinhlelo zesistimu (Ideal Clinic, SPV, Sinjani, PHCIS, Healthnet njll.) Yonelule ekwenzeni imininingwane yendawo yamasevisi abekiwe nokubika kuzo zonke izinhlelo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha nazo zonke izingxenye zokuphathwa kwesikhungo sokwamukela. Bhalisa abagulayo kwi-Patient Administration System (PHCIS) nokubhukuda kwi-Healthnet. Yonelule ekugcineni iziqu ezinhle eziveni lokwamukela (okungukuthi, ugcine, ulande, ugene kumbhalo wezomlando, ususe iziqu).

xh.title: Isikhulu Sabasebenzi (Ukuqeshwa kokuQhubela phambili kanye ne-Coid
xh.summary: Kufuneka isikhulu sabasebenzi kwi Western Cape Department of Health ukulawula iinkqubo zezigqi zika-COIDA, ukugcina iisiseko zeenkcukacha, nokusingatha izinto ezithintela intlawulo.
xh.requirements: Isidingo esincinci semfundo: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo). Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo kwi-COIDA nakwi-Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo kukusingatha iintlawulo ezahlukeneyo kwi-BAS. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nge-Public Service Act nama-Collective Agreements. Ulwazi olusembathweni nge-Compensation for Occupational and Diseases Act, (COIDA). Ulwazi olusembathweni ngolawulo lweenkqubo ze-COIDA. Ikhono lokusingatha umsebenzi mningi nolokuqhuba phantsi kwengxaki. Amakhono aphambili okunxibelelwana ngemile neentetho ezibhalwayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha (PERSAL, Microsoft Office (Word & Excel), Outlook). Isidingo esincinci semfundo: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo). Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileko sokulawula iinkcukacha nokuqamba idatha. Isiphiwo esifanelekileko ekulawulweni idatha naye nkqubo: iinkqubo ze-Sinjani, Ideal Clinic, SPV kunye ne-PHCIS. Isidingo esisedlelaneni lomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi (Code B/EB) eseyasebenza kwaye ulungele ukuqhuba. Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ngaphezu kweyure kwaye nangemini xa kugqityiwe. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amabalwe okunxibelelwana nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha (Windows, Excel) Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lwe-Basic Routine Health Information System yabaqambi beData.
xh.duties: Lawula izigqi zolawulo kwi-Nickle zamaQhalqhalo nayigulo, ukunxibelelana nabo bonke ooboximi abanenxaxheba (Compensation Commissioner, oogqirha abangamkho nathi, izibhedlele, naxa). Gcina isiseko sedatha se-COIDA kunye nokunikela inkqubo yamaxabiso yepropati. Ukwenza iinkqubo zezigqi ezinganiswe kwi-COIDA kwikhaso eliditshwele leLabour eliza kwi-i-online system. Yenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwiintlawulo zezifundo ezahlukeneyo kwi-PERSAL, kuquka i-standby, iimpahla, i-overtime, i-commuted overtime, iindleko zokutyibilika, i-parking, kunye nobuvuzo bokuhamba. Axha imibuzo ekuthiwa ngenithuba neyebali. Xela idatha yonke ngokweenkqubo ze-system programs (Ideal Clinic, SPV, Sinjani, PHCIS, Healthnet etc.) Ngenwe ukulungiselela iinkqubo zemibuzo yemiyalelo kwiinkonzo ezahlukeneyo neenkqubo zokubhalwa kwazo. Iimpawu zolawulo nazo naziphi na iinkqubo zokulawula iindawo zamagama. Bhalisa abaguli kwi-System of Patient Administration (PHCIS) nezibhalo e-Hnet. Lawula impilo yamafayile kwindawo yokwamkela (ukt., faka, khupha, zigcine, zityhilize).

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Toevoerkettingbestuur (BATES)
af.summary: Administrasieklerkpos in toevoerketting- en batebestuur by Metro TB Hospital Complex, wat 'n senior sertifikaat met wiskunde of rekenkunde vereis, asook tersaaklike LOGIS-ervaring.

Toepaslike kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), nasionale provinsiale tesourieregulasies en -beleid. Sterk analitiese vaardighede en probleemoplossingsvermoëns. zu.title: Ifofisa Kolawulo: Ukuphathwa Kwenxuba Yemigogo (ASSET
zu.summary: Isikhundla sofisa kolawulo ekuphathweni kwenxuba yemigogo kanye nokuphathwa kwamafa e-Metro TB Hospital Complex, esidinga isitifikedi somatiwula esinohatshwa lwezibalo noma i-akhawunti kanye namava ahambisanayo e-LOGIS.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi: Isitifikedi Somatiwula (noma esilinganayo) esinezibalo noma i-Akhawunti njengesifundo esidlule futhi/noma Isitifikedi Somatiwula (noma esilinganayo) esinamava/ikakhono egxile kwizindawo Zokusebenza Eziyinhloko (KRA) zesikhundla. Amava: Amava afanele ekuphathweni kwenxuba yemigogo kanye nokuphathwa kwamafa. Amava okusebenza afanele esistimini ye-LOGIS. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile (i-Code B/EB). Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhombi): Ulwizi & amava epolocekweni likahulumeni kanye nezingxoxo zokuthenga kanye nemicimbo yokuphathwa kwenxuba yemigogo. Ulwazi olufanele lomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho yesikhwameni lesifundazwe nesizwe kanye namapholisi. Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziya nendlela yokuxazulula izinkinga. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ube namava okusebenza kusistimu yokuthenga ehambisana naleyo.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezidingo kanye nokuthengiswa kwamafa. Ukwenza izinqubo zokuqinisekisa amafa ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa kwezempumelelo nangempumelelo kwamafa endaweni yokusebenza nakumagumbi e-PHC. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela kohlolimboniso kanye nokusiza ngemibuzo yohlolimboniso wamafa yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa izinqubo ezifanele zolawulo olungaphakathi ngokuphathelene nokulahla kwamafa, ukweba nokulahleka. Ukusekela umphathi kanye nekompokentsha yokuphathwa kwamafa kanye nabusiso ekubikweni.

xh.title: Clerk wezolawulo: Uqeqesho lweHlathi lweeNkonzo (IASI
xh.summary: Indima yomsekikari wolawulo kuqeqesho lwehlanzi nezempahla eMetro TB Hospital Complex, efunisa isatifikethi esiphakamileyo ngesibalo okanye izibalo nolwazi oluhambelanayo lwe-LOGIS.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo) esinesibalo okanye izibalo njengesigaba esidlulileyo kwaye/okanye isatifikethi esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo) esinolwazi/amakhono agqitha kumacandu oMsebenzi oBalulekileyo (KRA) esithuba. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluhambelanayo kuqeqesho lweHlathi lweeNkonzo nokuLawulwa kweNtengiso. Ulwazi oluhambelanayo lokusebenza ngeNkqubo ye-LOGIS. Iminyanya esemthethweni yomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqhubi (iKhowudi B/EB) esemthethweni. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nolwazi ngoBuchule bokuThenga bkaRhulu nemiQathango yeQeqesho lweHlathi lweeNkonzo. Ulwazi oluhambelanayo ngeMthetho woLawulo weeMali kaRhulu (PFMA), neMigaqo neMiQathango yeSikolo seQondo ngokweLwazi lwePhondo. Amakhono anamandla okuhlalutya nokuqonda indlela yokusombulula iingxaki. Kufuneka abe nokwazi ukusebenzela iikhompyutha abe nolwazi lokusebenza kwindlebo ezithengiswanayo ezahambelanayo.
xh.duties: UkuLawula uFuna nokufuna kweNtengiso. Ukuqhuba iinkqubo zokuQinisekisa iNtengiso ukuze kuqinisekiswe uLawulo olusebenzayo nolunamandla kweNtengiso ngaphakathi kwesikhululo kunye neziBonelela zePHC. Ukuqinisekisa ukuze kuhambelana neNkqubo yokuGqiba kwaye uncedise ngemibuzo yeNkqubo yokuGqiba ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulandelwa iinkqubo zolawulo olusebenzayo ngokwemigaqo yokuLahla iNtengiso nokuPhefongela nokulahleka. Ukuxhasa umphathi weNkqubo yokuLawula iNtengiso nouncedo ngokubika.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Wards
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed at Alan Blyth Hospital in the Western Cape to support nursing management with ward administrative duties, record keeping and stock control.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in electronic administration. (Word, Excel, Powerpoint and Outlook). Appropriate administrative experience in a health environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to relieve other ward clerks / admin clerks in the office of the Nursing Manager. Willingness to work overtime, shifts, flexi hours and weekends, when needed. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer skills in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook. Ability to work under pressure and in a team environment. Committed to the highest possible standards of professional conduct and competency. Good communication, interpersonal, organising, report-writing, and problem- solving skills. The ability to exercise good judgment in safeguarding confidential or sensitive information.
jobs.duties: Support the Nursing Management and Department by providing additional administrative relief to colleagues, organising meetings, and taking and typing minutes and agendas. Order and control stock and equipment to provide a safe environment and prevent safety hazards. Ensure effective record keeping and folder management. Operate and ensure the office equipment is in good working order, e.g., fax machine, copiers and projectors. Admission, discharge and transfer of patients in Clinicom.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a competency assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Sale
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig by Alan Blyth Hospital in die Western Cape om verpleegbestuur te ondersteun met saladministratiewe take, rekordhouding en voorraadbeheer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in elektroniese administrasie. (Word, Excel, Powerpoint en Outlook). Toepaslike administratiewe ervaring in 'n gesondheidsomgewing. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om ander salklerke / adminklerke in die kantoor van die Nursing Manager te ontlast. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd, skofte, buigbare ure en naweke te werk wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardighede in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook. Vermoë om onder druk en in 'n spanomgewing te werk. Toegewyd aan die hoogste moontlike standaarde van professionele gedrag en bevoegdheid. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike, organisasie-, verslagskryf- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Die vermoë om goeie oordeel te gebruik in die beskerming van vertroulike of sensitiewe inligting.
af.duties: Ondersteun die verpleegbestuur en departement deur addisionele administratiewe verligting aan kollegas te bied, vergaderings te organiseer, en notule en agenda's op te neem en te tik. Bestel en beheer voorraad en toerusting om 'n veilige omgewing te bied en veiligheidsgevare te voorkom. Verseker doeltreffende rekordhouding en lêerbestuur. Bedryf en verseker dat die kantoortoerusting in goeie werkende toestand is, bv. faksmasjien, kopieerders en projektors. Toelating, ontslag en oordrag van pasiënte in Clinicom.

zu.title: Clerk Wezokuphathwa: Amawadi
zu.summary: Kudingeka clerk wezokuphathwa esibhedlela i-Alan Blyth Hospital e-Western Cape ukuxhasa abaphathi bokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yezokuphathwa yamawadi, ukugcina amarekhodi nokuqinisekisa izitokhwe.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanelekile ekuphathweni kwezinto kagesi. (Word, Excel, Powerpoint kanye ne-Outlook). Isipiliyono esifanelekile sokuphathwa kwezinto esimweni sezempilo. Isidingo esibonakalayo somsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ekusizeni abanye abakleki bamawadi / abakleki bezokuphathwa enkantolo yomphathi wezokuhlinzeka. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemahora engeziwe, kumashifu, mahora ahlukahlukene nangamasonic, lapho kudingeka. Amandla (ulwazi/amaswiphu): Amandla okusebenza ngokwesikrini kwi-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinuhlazo nakwindawo yeqembu. Ukuqobelela ezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu lokuziphatha nokwazisebenza ngobungcweti. Amawu okuxhumana, axhumana nokuhlela nobhale amabhuluwe, kanye namandla okuxazulula izinkinga. Ikono lokwenza isinqumo esihle ekuvikeleni ulwanga olumfihlo noma oluzwelayo.
zu.duties: Ukuxhasa ukuphathwa kokuhlinzeka nomnyango ngokunikeza inkxaso ezengeziwe yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi ngabanye, ukuhlela izinkomisho, nokuthatha nokuthayipha amaminithi kanye nezinhlelo zomhlangano. Uku-oda futhi ulawule izitokhwe namadivaysi ukuze kuhlinzekwe indawo ephephile futhi kuqinisekiswe kuthintelwe izingozi ezibeka inkinga. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcina amarekhodi nokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwamafolda. Ukusebenzisa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amadivaysi ehhofisi asebenza kahle, njengakuthi, umshini wefaxi, abakopiyi namaprojektha. Ukungena, ukuphuma nokudlulisela abesiguli kwi-Clinicom.

xh.title: Clerk yolawulo: Iiwadi
xh.summary: Kufuneka clerk yolawulo kwi-Alan Blyth Hospital kwi-Western Cape ukuze axhase ulawulo lokhuhlobo ngemisebenzi yolawulo yawawadi, ukugcina iirekhodi nokulawula izinto.
xh.requirements: Iminyanya yemfundo eqinisekisiweyo: Isatifikethi esasemva (okanye esilinganayo). Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo kulawulo lekhompyutha. (I-Word, i-Excel, i-Powerpoint ne-Outlook). Isiphaluka solawulo esifanelekileyo kwindawo yezempilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwesithuba: Ukulungele ukuthomba abanye clerk bawadi / clerk bolawulo kwindawo kaNogqirha weZiko lokhuhlobo. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngeyure ezongezelelweyo, ngokutshintsha ishifthi, ngeeyure eziguqukayo nangeentsuku zeeveki, xa kudityanwe. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono ekhompyutha kwi-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo nakwindawo yeqela. Ukuqinisekiswa kumazinga aphezulu ahlobene nokuziphatha nokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe. Amakhono alula ethu ethu, okuhamba phakathi kwabantu, okulungiselela, okubhala iingxelo, nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukuba nakho ukwenza isigqibo esilungileyo ekukhuseleni iinkcukacha ezifihliweyo okungezizo.
xh.duties: Xhasa Ulawulo lokhuhlobo neSebe ngokunika inkxaso yolawulo engezelelweyo kumntwini oqabileyo, ekuqoqweni kweemihlangano, nakuthabatheni nokuchazeni iinqobo namagqabantshintshi. Funa ulawule izinto nemishini ukunika indawo ekhuselekileyo nokuthintela iingozi zokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukugcina iirekhodi nokulawula iifolda ngokusebenzayo. Sebenzisa uze uqinisekise ukuba imishini yendawo yolawulo isebenza kakuhle, umz., ifax, iikopi kunye nababambe imifanekiso. Ukungena, ukuphuma nokudlulisela abaguli kwi-Clinicom.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Support (PRIMARY Health Care)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed at Ladismith Clinic to provide reception, records management and data capture services within primary health care.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (Grade 12) or equivalent. Experience: Appropriate administrative/clerical experience, preferably in a health care environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB) and willingness to travel between facilities in the Kannaland Sub- District. Willingness to work overtime when needed. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Good communication skills (written and verbal). Appropriate knowledge of filing and records management. Good interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: Render reception and front-desk services, including patient registration and appointment administration. Create, file, retrieve and safe-keep patient folders in accordance with records management prescripts. Capture patient and service data accurately on the relevant health information systems. Provide relief reception and administrative support at the clinics and Alan Blyth Hospital during staff absences and vacancies. Assist with the ordering, receiving and control of stationery and consumables. Maintain confidentiality of patient information in line with POPIA and the Patients’ Rights Charter.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates could be subjected to a practical test. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Ondersteuning (PRIMÊRE Gesondheidsorg)
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig by Ladismith Kliniek om receptie, rekordbestuur en data vaslegging binne primêre gesondheidsorg te bied.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (Graad 12) of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike administratiewe/klereklike ervaring, verkieslik in 'n gesondheidsorgomgewing. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B/EB) en bereidwilligheid om tussen fasiliteite in die Kannaland Sub- Distrik te reis. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en Outlook). Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Toepaslike kennis van lêerwerk en rekordbestuur. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede en die vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Lewer receptie en voorontvangsdienste, insluitend pasiëntregistrasie en afspraakadministrasie. Skep, lêer, haal op en bewaar pasiëntlêers in ooreenstemming met rekordbestuurvoorskrifte. Lë pasiënt- en diensdata akkuraat op die tersaaklike gesondheidsinligtingstelsels vas. Verskaf tydelike receptie en administratiewe ondersteuning by die klinieke en Alan Blyth Hospitaal tydens personeelafwesighede en vakatures. Bied hulp met die bestelling, ontvangs en beheer van skryfbehoeftes en verbruiksgoedere. Handhaaf vertroulikheid van pasiëntinligting in ooreenstemming met POPIA en die Handves vir Pasiënte se Regte.

zu.title: Izinhloli Zolawulo: Ukusekelwa (PRIMARY Health Care)
zu.summary: Kudingeka izinhloli zolawulo e-Ladismith Clinic ukuze kubekho izikhungo zokwamukula abantu, ukuphathwa kwemibhalo kanye nezinsizakalo zokuqopha idatha ngaphakathi kwezokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesibopho: Senior Certificate (Grade 12) noma okulingana nakho. Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele sokulawula/ezabahlibhobhi, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (Code B/EB) kanye nokuzithoba ukuhamba phakathi kweziteshi e-Kannaland Sub- District. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemahora engeziwe uma kudingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhombisa): Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-Outlook). Amakhono okuxhumana ahle kahle (okubhaliwe nokuvezwayo). Ulwazi olufanele lokugcina izincwadi kanye nokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Amakhono ahle okuziphathisa nabanye kanye namandla okusebenza ohlakenini.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinsizakalo zokwamukula abantu kanye nesesikhundla esingaphambili, okuhlanganisa ukubhaliswa kwabeziguli kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsuku zokubonisana. Dala, gcina, thola kabusha futhi ugcophile ngokuphepha kwezibhalo ezabekezela iziguli ngokuya ngemithetho yokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Qopha idatha yabeziguli kanye nezinsizakalo ngokunembile kumayistemu olwazi lwabezempilo ahlobene. Nikeza ngokusekelwa ngesikhathi esizelelwe kwezokwamukula abantu kanye nolawulo ema-clinics naso-Alan Blyth Hospital ngesikhathi kungekhona abasebenzi nasezikhundleni ezingaziwa. Siza ekuthumelweni, ekwamukeleni nasekolweni lwemathuluzi okubhala namadayelasizinga aphathwayo. Gcina ukuyifihla idatha yabeziguli ngokuhambisana ne-POPIA kanye ne-Patients’ Rights Charter.

xh.title: Clerk woLulawulo: Inkxaso (INKQUBO eYiyo yeMPILO)
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-clerk yolulawulo kwiLadismith Clinic ukuze kubekho iinkonzo zokwamkela abantu, ukulawula amarekhodi nokubhalisa iinkcukacha ngaphakathi kwenkqubo yempilo eyiyo.
xh.requirements: Isiquali esincinci semfundo: Senior Certificate (Grade 12) okanye esingangayo. Isiphalangundo: Isiphalangundo esifanelekileyo solawulo/olwesikwerhadi, ngokukhetha kwindawo yempilo. Iimfuno ezibakho kumsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqeshela elisebenzayo (Code B/EB) nokuzithanda ukuhamba phakathi kweziko ezahlukileyo kwiKannaland Sub-District. Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwexesha xa kusetyenziswa. Iimpawu zokulingana (ulwazi/iziklidi): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Amakhono amde wokunxibelelana (okubhaliweyo nokuThethwayo). Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokugcina iifayile nokulawula amarekhodi. Amakhono amde okuhamba nabantu nendlela yokusebenza ngaphakathi kothim.
xh.duties: Kubhalwe iinkonzo zokwamkela nabantu begodu kubekho iinkonzo zokuqala, kuquka ukubhaliswa kwesiguli nolawulo lo mamatisele. Kudalwe, kugcinwe, kutsalwe begodu kusindwe izikhwama zesiguli ngokulandela imigaqo yokulawula amarekhodi. Kubhalwe ngokuchanekileyo iinkcukacha zesiguli nazo nkqubo ezifunekayo kwizikrobo zolwazi ngempilo. Kubekho iinkonzo zokuqasha indawo yolwamkelo nokuxhasa ngolawulo kwiLadismith Clinic nase Alan Blyth Hospital xa bekungekho nabasebenzi nasekho iimfuno. Kuncedwe nokutya kutsalwe ukutya kutsalwe ukulawulwa kwemifuno emise kusetyenziswa ezindwaneni ezisebenzayo.

zu.summary: Kudingeka umkleli wokuphathwa kwezokubhaliswa eSonstraal Hospital ukuphatha ukuphathwa kwamawadi, ukulawula izitoko, ukuphathwa kwezokubhaliswa kweguli kanye namasevisi wokusekela jikelele.

xh.summary: Kufunekwa clerk wezolawulo e Sonstraal Hospital ukuphatha izolawulo zamawadi, ulawulo lwemibhalo egcinwayo, ulawulo lwabagula kunye neenkonzo ezingowonke zoxhaso.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Voorsieningskettingbestuur (BATES
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig vir voorsieningsketting- en batesbestuur by Victoria Hospital in die Western Cape, wat 'n Senior Certificate en relevante VKB-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekeningkunde as geslaagde vak en/of Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat op die Sleutelprestasieareas (KPA's) van die pos fokus. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Voorsieningskettingbestuur en Batesbestuur. Toepaslike ervaring van die Logis-stelsel, BAS en EPS (Electronic Purchasing System). Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis & Ervaring van Openbare Sektor Aankope en Voorsieningskettingbestuur Prosesse en Prosedures. Toepaslike kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Nasionale Provinciale Tesourie Regulasies en Beleide. Sterk analitiese vaardighede en probleemoplossingsvermoëns. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees en kennis van verwante aankoopstelsels hê. Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Vraag en verkryging van Bates vir Victoria Hospital as 'n Hub, Primêre Gesondheidsorg-fasiliteite en SWSS-kantoor. Voer Batesverifikasieprosesse en batesbeskikking uit om doeltreffende en effektiewe batesbestuur te verseker. Verseker Oudit-nakoming en interne beheerprosesse verbonde aan batesbestuur. Verseker deeglike verslagdoening van maandelikse verslae, IFS/AFS vir batesbestuur. Ondersteuning aan toesighouer en Batesbestuur-komponent.

zu.title: Iclerki Yeziphathimandla: Ukuphathwa Kwechani Yokuhlinzeka (IMPahLA
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklerki yeziphathimandla yokuphathwa kwechani yokuhlinzeka nokuphathwa kwempahla esibhedlela iVictoria Hospital eWestern Cape, kudingwa iSenior Certificate namava ahambisana ne-SCM.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphansi kwezinga elidingekayo: iSenior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) ngokuba isiFundo sezibalo kanye/noma isiBhalo njengenyunyana edlule kanye/noma iSenior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) ongamava/ukuzakhala okugxila kwimikhakha Yokwenza Okuphambili (iKPA's) yesikhundla. Amava: Amava afanelekile ekuphathweni kweChani Yokuhlinzeka nokuPhathwa kweMpahla. Amava afanelekile kwesistimu yeLogis, iBAS ne-EPS (Electronic Purchasing System). Izidingo ezingaphakathi emsebenzini: ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (i-Code B/EB). Ukuzakhala (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi & amawa eNqubo yokuthenga nokuphathwa kwechani yokuhlinzeka kwisikhungo sikahulumeni. Ulwazi olufanelekile ngoMthetho wokuPhathwa kweMali eKahulumeni (iPFMA), imiThetho kanye nezinqumela ezisemthethweni yeNational Provincial Treasury. Amasu obuhlakani obunamandla nokuthatha isinqumo. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha futhi ube lolwazi ngamasistimu okuthenga ahlobene. Ikhono lokuxhumana ngokusebenzayo (ngomlomo nokubhaliwe).
zu.duties: Ukucela nokuthola iMpahla yeVictoria Hospital njengesikhungo, izikhungo eziphathwa kwezezempilo ezingunhlaka kanye ne-Office yeSWSS. Ukwenza inqubo yokuhlolwa kweMpahla nokulahla impahla ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphathwa kwempahla okusebenzayo nokusebenza kahle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuziphendulela okuhlotshaniswe nokuhlola kanye nokuqondiswa kwangaphakathi okuhlotshaniswa nokuphathwa kwempahla. Ukuqinisekisa ukubika okuhle kwezinsuku zinyanga zonke, ama-IFS/AFS okuphathwa kwempahla. Ukusekela umphathi kanye neqoqo lokuPhathwa kweMpahla.

xh.title: Iclerk yolawulo: uLawulo lweNxaxheba yokunikezela (IASSET
xh.summary: Kufuneka iklerk yolawulo yolawulo lwenxaxheba yokunikezela nolawulo lwamafa eVictoria Hospital eWestern Cape, kufuneka kubekho iSenior Certificate nemfundo ngokomsebenzi weSCM.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi kwamaxa: iSenior Certificate (okanye into elinganayo) eneMathematics nakwi-Accountancy njengoko zizinto zedlalwe nayo i-Senior Certificate (okanye into elinganayo) enemfundo/ikhalathi ezinikele kumajoni oMsebenzi oBalulekileyo (i-KPA) sesithuba. Imfundo: Imfundo efanelekileyo kuLawulo lweNxaxheba yokunikezela nokuLawula ama-Asset. Imfundo efanelekileyo yeLogis System, BAS neEPS (Electronic Purchasing System). Iimfuno zendalo yomsebenzi: iLayisenisi yokuQhatha evakalayo (iCode B/EB). Ukuzazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi namava kuPublic Sector Procurement nakuLawulo lweNxaxheba yokunikezela iinkqubo neenkqubo. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lwePublic Finance Management Act (iPFMA), iNational Provincial Treasury Regulations neenkqubo. Ukuziphatha ngokuchanekileyo nokusombulula iingxaki. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ube nolwazi ngeenkqubo zokuthenga. Ikhalathi yokunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo).
xh.duties: Ukuqonda nokuzoba ama-Assets eVictoria Hospital njengeHub, iPrimary Healthcare Facilities kwi-Office iSWSS. Ukuqhuba iinkqubo zokuQinisekisa ama-Assets nokupheliswa kwe-asset ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawulwa kwamafa ngokusebenza ngokusebenzisekileyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuHambelana ne-Audit nokuqhuba iinkqubo zolawulo lwangaphakathi ezinxulumene nokuLawulwa kwamafa. Ukuqinisekisa ukubika okusemthethweni ngeepyipp zenyanga, iIFS/AFS yokuLawulwa kwamafa. Inkxaso ekhusini nakwi-Asset Management Component.

jobs.title: Staff Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (NEONATAL)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R229 440 per annum Grade 2: R272 778 per annum Grade 3: R319 071 per annum
jobs.summary: Staff nurse positions in neonatal care at New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, requiring SANC registration as an enrolled nurse with graded experience levels.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with the SANC as an Enrolled Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as an Enrolled Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as an Enrolled Nurse. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as an Enrolled Nurse. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, and public holidays to meet the operational requirements. Must be prepared to assist in all departments according to operational requirements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Effective communication skills Practical knowledge and experience of basic nursing care in a hospital setting. Interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Provide basic clinical nursing care. Development and implementation of basic patient care plans. Facilitate the provision of health care and education according to individual needs of patients, family and community. Effective utilization of resources. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development. Reporting on patient safety and adverse incidents. Effective record keeping.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview.” This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status) It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Staatsverpleegster Graad 1 tot 3 (NEONATAAL)
af.summary: Staatsverpleegster-poste in neonatale sorg by New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, wat SANC-registrasie as 'n ingeskryfde verpleegkundige met gegradueerde ervaringsvlakke vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n ingeskryfde verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n ingeskryfde verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n ingeskryfde verpleegkundige. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n ingeskryfde verpleegkundige. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke en openbare vakansiedae om aan die operasionele vereistes te voldoen. Moet bereid wees om in alle departemente te help volgens operasionele vereistes. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Praktiese kennis en ervaring van basiese verpleegsorg in 'n hospitaalomgewing. Interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf basiese kliniese verpleegsorg. Ontwikkeling en implementering van basiese pasiëntsorgplanne. Fasiliteer die verskaffing van gesondheidsorg en opvoeding volgens individuele behoeftes van pasiënte, familie en gemeenskap. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Verslagdoening oor pasiëntveiligheid en nadelige voorvalle. Effektiewe rekordhouding.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi wesikhundla 1 kuya ku-3 (NEONATAL)
zu.summary: Izikhundla somhlengikazi ezinakekelweni yonathanayi eNew Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, ezidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi obhalisiwe ngezizinga ezahlukene zeminyaka yokuqashwa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo elinganiselwe: Isitifikhathi esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi obhalisiwe. Ukubhaliswa kolwazi olunamakhono: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi obhalisiwe. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho. Izinga 2: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele/esivelewayo ekunakekelweni kulesibhedlela emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi obhalisiwe. Izinga 3: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-20 yesipiliyoni esifanele/ esivelewayo ekunakekelweni kulesibhedlela emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi obhalisiwe. Izidingo ezingaphakathi emsebenzini: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintshelela, umsebenzi yasemini nasebusuku, ngeempelasonto, nanosuku olungumhlolva wokuhlangana ukuze uhambisane nezidingo zokusebenza. Kumele ube ulungele ukusiza kuyo yonke iminyango ngokwezidingo zokusebenza. Izakhono (ulwazi/akhono): Izakhono zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuhlolwa kokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo esibhedlela. Izakhono zokuxhumana nabantu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa kulesibhedlela okuyisisekelo. Ukuthuthukisa nokuphehla izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwesiguli eziyisisekelo. Sikwenza inikelele ngokunakekelwa kokempilo nemfundo ngokwezidingo zamunye umuntu wesiguli, umndeni nomphakathi. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza. Ukugcina ukukhula okunamakhono/ amazinga okuziphatha nokuzithuthukisa. Ukubika ngokuphepha kwesiguli nezehlakalo ezingemihle. Ukugcina izinkomba ezisebenzayo.

xh.title: Umongikazi ongenaziqendu Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (NEONATAL)
xh.summary: Izithuba zomongikazi ongenaziqendu ekunyonge kwabantu abasakhulileyo kwiNew Somerset Hospital, eNtshona Koloni, ezifuna ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo namanqanaba amava abekiweyo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Ifanele ibe nalifaqululwazi elivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo. Ukubhaliswa kwiKhomishoni yezobuchwephesha: Ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo. Amandulo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka engu-10 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/abonwayo ekunyongeni emva kokubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka engu-20 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/abonwayo ekunyongeni emva kokubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukuzithandela ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishifi, umsebenzi wemini nabanbusuku, iimpelaveki, namaholide arhamanayo ukuze afane neemfuno zokuqhuba. Kufuneka ulungise ukuncedisa kuzo zonke iisebe ngokwemfuno zokuqhuba. Amandla (ulwazi/amazilolise): Amandla othungelwano alusebenzayo. Ulwazi lokwenza kunye namava anokuzilolisa ekunyongeni okusesiqu ngokwesiko esibhedlele. Amandla okusebenzisana nabantu.
xh.duties: Nika unyango lwezempilo olusesiqu. Uphuhliso nokusebenzisa iiplani zokhathalelo lwesiguli ezesiqu. Qhankqathaza ukunika unyango lwezempilo nemfundo ngokwemfuno ngayunyana yesiguli, usapho nommango. Ukusebenzisa izibonelelo ngokusebenzayo. Zigcine iindlela zomsebenzi ezingaphakathi/iindinganiso zokuziphatha nokuziphuhlisa. Ukuvelisa ingxelo ngokhuseleko lweziguli nemithefuleko engemihle. Ukugcina irekhodi ngokusebenzayo.

jobs.title: Health Promoter
jobs.summary: Health Promoter position at Bishop Lavis CDC in the Western Cape, requiring a Senior Certificate and community experience, offering R201,093 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in working in communities and informal settlements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint).
jobs.duties: Render a high standard of health education and support service to clients. Plan and implement health projects in facilities, schools, and communities to meet health objectives. Assist and strengthen COPC in the community. Liaise with community’s health co-ordinating structures, departments, local government and other stakeholders to promote integrated approach to health care. Monitor, evaluate, develop and implement service delivery programmes. Ensure effective and efficient utilisation of all available resources. Keep effective record of activities and consumables. Ensure a purposeful integration of health education and promotion service provision with services provided (health facility, stakeholders and other community-based services). Support to Manager at Facility.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Gesondheidsbevorderaar
af.summary: Gesondheidsbevorderaar-pos by Bishop Lavis CDC in die Western Cape, vereis 'n Senior Sertifikaat en gemeenskapservaring, bied R201,093 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in werk in gemeenskappe en informele nedersettings. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint).
af.duties: Lewer 'n hoë standaard van gesondheidsvoorligting en ondersteuningsdiens aan kliënte. Beplan en implementeer gesondheidsprojekte in fasiliteite, skole en gemeenskappe om gesondheidsdoelwitte te bereik. Bystand en versterking van COPC in die gemeenskap. Skakel met die gemeenskap se gesondheidskoördinerende strukture, departemente, plaaslike regering en ander belanghebbendes om 'n geïntegreerde benadering tot gesondheidsorg te bevorder. Monitor, evalueer, ontwikkel en implementeer diensleweringsprogramme. Verseker doeltreffende en doeltroue benutting van alle beskikbare hulpbronne. Hou doeltreffende rekord van aktiwiteite en verbruiksgoedere. Verseker 'n doelgerige integrasie van gesondheidsvoorligting en bevorderingsdienslewering met dienste wat verskaf word (gesondheidsfasiliteit, belanghebbendes en ander gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste). Ondersteuning aan Bestuurder by Fasiliteit.

zu.title: Umqhubi Wezempilo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somqhubi wezempilo eBishop Lavis CDC eWestern Cape, sifuna iSenior Certificate naloluvo lwemiphakathi, sinikeza iholo le-R201,093 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: iSenior certificate (okulinganayo). Uluvo: Uluvo olufanele lokusebenza emiphakathini nasemazweni abantu abahlala kwaso. Ikhono (ulwazi/amazwana): Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Nikela ngengxenye yokufundisa ngempilo nesevisi yokusekela abathinti ngezinga eliphezulu. Hlela futhi ufake amaphrojekthi ezempilo ezikhungweni, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini ukuze kufezezwe izinhloso ezempilweni. Siza futhi uqinise iCOPC emphakathini. Xhumana nezakhiwo eziyinhloko ezihlela izempilo zomphakathi, neminyango, kahulumeni wendawo namanye abahlanganyeli ukukhuthaza indlela ehlangene yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Qaphela, hlaziya, bese usungula futhi wfake amaphrojekthi asekela ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nokuphumelelayo kwawo wonke amabhuloho atholakalayo. Gcina irekhodi elisebenzayo lemisebenzi nokuthengiswa. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa okunenhloso kokufundisa ngempilo nesevisi yokukhuthaza ukwaziswa ngempilo nokunikezwa kwenkonzo kanye nesevisi ezenziwayo (isikhungo sezempilo, abahlanganyeli namanye amasevisi asuselwa emphakathini). Nikela ngokwesekela umphathi Esikhungweni.

xh.title: Mmenzi weMpilo
xh.summary: Isithuba sommenzi wempilo kwi-Bishop Lavis CDC e-Western Cape, sifuna i-Senior Certificate nolwazi lobasebenzini, sinika i-R201,093 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso sokufunda esincinane: Senior certificate (okwa silinganayo). Imfundo: Ifanele ulwazi lokusebenza kumanxweme nakumaphakathi. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint).
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yemfundo yempilo nenceku kwabaxhasi ngomgangatho ophezulu. Cwangcisa ukuze usebenzise iiprojekthi zempilo kwifasilithi, kumaziko ezemfundo, nakumanxweme ukuzalisa iinjongo zempilo. Nceda uze uqinisekise i-COPC kumanxweme. Qhagamshelana neendawo ezihlawuliseziko iinkqubo zempilo, namasebe, kurhululumente wasedawoni ngezinye iindawo ukukhuthaza indlela egqithiselayo yonke ekunakekelweni kwempilo. Qwalasela, hlola, phucula uze usebenzise iinkqubo zenkonzonikezelo. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle kwalo onke amacebo afumanekayo. Gcina irekhodi elisebenzayo nemisebenzi nemitsho. Qinisekisa ukudibanisa ngemigama inkonzo yemfundo yempilo nokuqhubela phambili ngenkonzo efunyanwa (ifasilithi yempilo, ababambi nxaxheba nezinye iinkonzo ezisezulwini). Nikela inkxaso kuMphathi weFasilithi.

jobs.title: Housekeeping Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise housekeeping staff at Alan Blyth Hospital in Kannaland to maintain cleanliness, hygiene and infection control standards.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Experience: Appropriate housekeeping experience in a health environment. Appropriate administrative and supervisory experience in the health sector. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work overtime, on weekends and on public holidays. Willingness to relieve in other support service areas of the hospital when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate knowledge of infection prevention and control, cleaning standards, and linen and stock control. Ability to supervise staff and to maintain good interpersonal relations. Good communication skills (verbal and written). Computer literacy (MS Word and Excel). Ability to work under pressure, perform physically demanding tasks and handle heavy objects.
jobs.duties: Supervise Household Aids to ensure a high standard of cleanliness and hygiene in the hospital, to prevent the spread of infection and safety hazards. Attend in-service training and keep staff informed of relevant policies, notices and changes.
