jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/written assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Huishoudelike toesighouer
af.summary: Superviseer huishoudelike personeel by Alan Blyth Hospital in Kannaland om standaarde van netheid, higiëne en infeksiebeheer te handhaaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Ervaring: Toepaslike huishoudelike ervaring in 'n gesondheidsomgewing. Toepaslike administratiewe en toesigervaring in die gesondheidssektor. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om oortyd, oor naweke en op openbare vakansiedae te werk. Bereidwilligheid om in ander ondersteuningsdiensareas van die hospitaal waar te neem wanneer dit vereis word. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike kennis van infeksievoorkoming en -beheer, skoonmaakstandaarde, en linne- en voorraadbeheer. Vermoë om personeel te superviseer en goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings te handhaaf. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word en Excel). Vermoë om onder druk te werk, fisies veeleisende take uit te voer en swaar voorwerpe te hanteer.
af.duties: Hou Huishoudelike Hulpers toes om 'n hoë standaard van netheid en higiëne in die hospitaal te handhaaf, om die verspreiding van infeksie en veiligheidsgevare te voorkom. Verseker dat pasiënte die korrekte dieet volgens hul toestand bedien word, en dat saalkombuisse higiënies gehou word. Beheer linne om te verseker dat saale 'n voldoende voorraad skoon linne het. Beheer voorraad, toerusting en inventaris, en verseker dat hulpbronne kostedoeltreffend gebruik word. Voer die administratiewe en personalbestuurspligte wat met toesig gepaard gaan, uit. Woon in-diensopleiding by en hou personeel ingelig oor relevante beleide, kennissgewings en veranderinge.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokuhlanzwa Kwendawo
zu.summary: Qaphela abasebenzi bokuhlanzwa kwendawo e Alan Blyth Hospital e Kannaland ukuze kugcinwe amazinga okuhlanzwa, okuhlanza umzimba nokulawula izifo ezithelayanayo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo esingaphansi: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Isipilingo: Isipilingo esifanele sokuhlanzwa kwendawo emazingeni ezempilo. Isipilingo esifanele sobuqhikithi bolawulo kanye nokuphatha abantu emkhakheni wezempilo. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi, namageja nangemihla yomphakathi. Ukuzithoba ukusiza eminye imikhakha yesevisi yesekelo esibhedlela lapho kucelwa khona. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi olufanele ngokuvinjelwa kokuthelelana kokuhamba kwesifo kanye nalawulo, amazinga okuhlanzwa, kanye nolawulo lwempahla kanye nezitoko. Ikhono lokuphatha abasebenzi nasekugcineni ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Amandla okuxhumana kahle (okuthiwa nokubhalwa). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word kanye ne Excel). Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinga, ukwenza imisebenzi edinga amandla omzimba kanye nokuphatha izinto ezisindayo.
zu.duties: Qaphela abasizi bokuhlanzwa kwendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga eliphezulu lokuhlanzwa kanye nokuhlanza umzimba esibhedlela, ukuze kuthintelwe ukusabalala kokuthelelana kokuhamba kwesifo kanye nezingozi ezibangelwa ukungaphephile. Qinisekisa ukuthi abaguli banikwa ukudla okulungile ngokwesimo sabo, futhi ukuthi izikhishi zamawadi zigcinwa zihlanzekile. Lawula impahla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amawadi anenani elanele lempahla ehlanzekile. Lawula izitoko, izisetshenziswa kanye nemiholo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela eguqula imali ngokwezemfundo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo kanye nokuphatha abantu ehlotshaniswa nokuphatha. Zibandakanya ekugadweni kwezisevisi futhi ugcine abasebenzi bazi ngezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nawo, izaziso kanye noshintsho.

xh.title: Sommina wonyulo lwezikhundla zokucoca
xh.summary: Qondisa abasebenzi bokucoca kwindawo yokwelapha iAlan Blyth Hospital eKannaland ukugcina iimpawu zokucoca, ukhuseleko lokungaluleki nolawulo lotyalazo.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo esincitshiswa sokugqiba isikolo: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Imfundo: Okufanelekileyo yokucoca kwimeko yezempilo. Okufanelekileyo kolawulo nokuqondisa kwicala lezempilo. Isimfuno esingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngaphezulu kweyure, ngeentsuku zangamasonto nakwezalahloko. Ukuzimisela ukubasha kwezinye iindawo zeinkonzo zokuxhasa esibhedlele xa kufuneka. Iimbonakaliso (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokuthintela ukutyalaza nolawulo, iinkqubo zokucoca, kunye nolawulo lwegazi elityhiwayo nezinto ezikhoyo. Ikholo lokulawula abasebenzi negosa ukuze kugcinwe ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono amabalawuli okuthetha nokuwubhala. Ukuba nalwazi lokusebenza kwikhompyutha (MS Word and Excel). Ikholo lokusebenza ngcinxeba, ukwenza imisebenzi edinga amandla omzimba nokuphatha izinto ezisindayo.
xh.duties: Qondisa abancedisi bakho ukwenzela ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokucoca nokhuseleko esibhedlele, ukuthintela ukusasaza kunye neengozi zokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukuba abaguli bafumana ukutya okuchanekileyo ngokwemeko yabo, nokuba izikhashana zemibengo zigcinwa zicocekile. Lawula igazi elityhiwayo ukwenzela ukuba iimibego zibe nentsengo ngokwaneleyo yegazi elityhiwayo elicocekileyo. Lawula izinto ezikhoyo, izixhobo nemiba ezikhoyo, ukuze kuthi izibonelelo zisetyenziswe ngokugcinayo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo nolawulo lwabantu nokuqondisa. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkonzo yokuzilolonga ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi iziqendu, izaziso nolutshintsho.

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R181 230 per annum Grade 2: R211 401 per annum Grade 3: R249 141 per annum
jobs.summary: Nursing Assistant position at Lapa Munnik Hospital in the Western Cape, requiring SANC registration as a Nursing Assistant, with three grade levels based on experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Nursing Assistant. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Nursing Assistant. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Nursing Assistant. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Nursing Assistant. Inherent requirements of the job: Working shifts and after-hours including weekends, public holidays and night duty. Willingness to rotate within all wards/departments within the hospital according to operational needs.
jobs.duties: Assist patient with activities of daily living (physical care). Provide elementary clinical nursing care. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self- development. Effective functioning within multidisciplinary team. Effective utilisation of resources.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T J Fredericks Tel No: (022) 814-0462
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Verpleegassistens Vlak 1 tot 3
af.summary: Verpleegassistenspos by Lapa Munnik Hospitaal in die Western Cape, waarvoor SANC-registrasie as 'n Verpleegassistens vereis word, met drie vlakke gebaseer op ondervinding.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Verpleegassistens moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Verpleegassistens. Ondervinding: Vlak 1: Geen. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkende ondervinding in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Verpleegassistens. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkende ondervinding in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Verpleegassistens. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Werk skofte en na ure insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae en nagdienste. Bereidwilligheid om binne alle sale/afdelings in die hospitaal te roteer volgens operasionele behoeftes.
af.duties: Assisteer pasiënt met aktiwiteite van daaglikse lewe (fisiese versorging). Verskaf elementêre kliniese verpleegsorg. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Effektiewe funksionering binne multidissiplinêre span. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne.

zu.title: Usizo Lwezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sosizo lwezokwelapha esibhedlela i-Lapa Munnik Hospital e-Western Cape, esidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengosizo lwezokwelapha, ngamazinga amathathu athathwe njengesipiliyoni.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi: Ithuluzi elivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengosizo lwezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kubungelewani bunjulwane: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengosizo lwezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho. Izinga 2: Umcimbi ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-10 yezokwelapha okuhambisana/nokwaziwayu emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengosizo lwezokwelapha. Izinga 3: Umcimbi ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 yezokwelapha okuhambisana/nokwaziwayu emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengosizo lwezokwelapha. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukusebenza ọṣu naseyure ezingemva kwesikhathi okuhlanganisa amasonto, amaholide omozomnyaka kanye neshifti ebusuku. Ukuza ngokuvolontiya ukujikeleza kuzo zonke ịzibe/iziqaphamikhakha ngaphakathi kulesibhedlela ngokwezidingo zokusebenza.
zu.duties: Siza umuntu ophathwayo nemitshovo yansuku zonke (ukunakekelwa komzimba). Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo kwezokwelapha. Gcina ukukhula konjulwane/nokumisa okuhle futhi uzingisele ukuziphucela. Ukusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwethimba elihlangene. Ukusetshenziswa okuhle kokuphathwayo.

xh.title: Umncedi wezempilo wesigaba 1 ukuya kwesi-3
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedi wezempilo esibhedlele iLapa Munnik Hospital eWestern Cape, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezempilo, kwaye sinamanqanaba amathathu esigaba esithe ngqo kwesiphiwo esisekelwe kwiminyaka yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isiphiwo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomncedi wezempilo. Ukubhaliswa kwiBhunga labo bachwi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezempilo. Abasebenzi abanamava: Isigaba 1: Akukho. Isigaba 2: Iminyaka elingaphantsi kwe-10 yamava afanelekileyo/ajongekayo kwinkonzo yempilo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezempilo. Isigaba 3: Iminyaka elingaphantsi kwe-20 yamava afanelekileyo/ajongekayo kwinkonzo yempilo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezempilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukusebenza kumashifti nangemiyavo yemihla kubandakanya iweekends, iholide zikawonke-wonke nomsebenzi wasebusuku. Ukuzimisela ukujikeleza kuzo zonke izigqithi/ngeendawo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele ngokweenkqubo ezifuneka ngokwemisebenzi.
xh.duties: Kuncede isigulane nemiSebenzi yobomi yemihla ngemihla (ukhatho lomzimba). Kunikwa inkonzo yempilo yokuchwetheza. Kugcinwa ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe/izingqikithi zokuziphatha nokuziphucela. Ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo ngaphakathi kwenqanaba elinabasebenzi abanobukho bahamba behlula-hlula. Ukusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo amacebo abalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Linen Stores Assistant
jobs.summary: Linen Stores Assistant at Ceres Hospital responsible for collecting, sorting and delivering linen between wards and the linen bank, requiring basic literacy and physical fitness.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic numeracy and literacy. Experience: Appropriate experience in general laundry functions. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work overtime, e.g. after- working hours, weekends and public holidays when operational needs require. Perform hard physical tasks, e.g. pushing heavy linen trolleys to and from the linen bank and wards. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Physically fit and be able to hear and speak clearly. Perform basic routine tasks in the linen bank under supervision. Ability to sort, sluice and count linen of dirty and fouled linen. Knowledge of stock and infection control.
jobs.duties: Maintain a high standard of cleanliness, hygienic and safe environment. Provide a supporting service to the supervisor. Daily collection of dirty, fouled and infected linen (in bags) from wards to the linen bank. Delivering of clean linen to the wards. Daily sorting, counting and sluicing of dirty linen prior to transfer of linen to Central Laundry. Daily issuing, unpacking and checking of clean linen.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Linenbergassistent
af.summary: Linenbergassistent by Ceres Hospital verantwoordelik vir die versameling, sortering en afleweriging van linne tussen sale en die lynbank, wat basiese geletterdheid en fisieke gesondheid vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese syfer- en leesvaardigheid. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in algemene wasfunksies. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk, bv. na werkure, naweke en openbare vakansiedae wanneer operasionele behoeftes dit vereis. Uitvoer van swaar fisieke take, bv. stoot van swaar lynwaens na en vanaf die lynbank en sale. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Fisieke gesond en in staat om duidelik te hoor en te praat. Uitvoer van basiese roetine take in die lynbank onder toesig. Vermoë om linne van vuil en besoedelde linne te sorteer, spoel en tel. Kennis van voorraad- en infeksiebeheer.
af.duties: Onderhou 'n hoë standaard van skoonheid, higiëniese en veilige omgewing. Verskaf 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan die toesighouer. Daaglikse versameling van vuil, besoedelde en geïnfekteerde linne (in sakke) van sale na die lynbank. Afleweriging van skoon linne na die sale. Daaglikse sortering, telling en spoeling van vuil linne voor oordrag van linne na Sentrale Wasserig. Daaglikse uitreiking, uitpak en nagaan van skoon linne.

zu.title: Umncedisi Wesitolo Segqoki
zu.summary: Umncedisi Wesitolo Segqoki e Ceres Hospital onenzele ukuthola, ukuhlela nokuletha igqoki phakathi kwamawadi nesisetho segqoki, kufuneka ulwazi olulula lokufunda nokubala kanye nokuba namandla emzimbeni.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezenza emfundo ephansi: Ulwazi olulula lokubala nokufunda. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele emisebenzini yokuwasha impahla ngokuvamileyo. Izidingo ezidalwa umsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza amahora angaphezu kwesikhathi, isb. ngemva kwamahora okusebenza, nangasontini nangamaholide aphandle lapho kudingwa khona izidingo zokusebenza. Ukwenza imisebenzi enkulu emzimbeni, isb. ukuhudula amathrolleye anosindayo egqoki phakathi kosisetho segqoki namawardi. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhashazi): Ukuba nomzimba oqinile nokukwazi ukuzwa nokukhulwa kucace. Ukwenza imisebenzi evamile elula esisethwini segqoki ngaphansi kolawulo. Ikhono lokuhlela, ukuhlambula nokubala igqoki elingcolile nelingcoliswe. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwesishevi nokulawula ukutheleleka.
zu.duties: Ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokuhlanza, ukuthambeka nokuphepha endaweni. Ukunika inkonzo yesekela umphathi. Ukuthola nsuku zonke igqoki elingcolile, elingcoliswe nelingathelelwe (emasakeni) kumawardi usiyise esisethwini segqoki. Ukuletha igqoki ehlanziwe kumawardi. Ukuhlela, ukubala nokukuhlambula igqoki elingcolile nsuku zonke ngaphambi kokudlulisela igqoki e Central Laundry. Ukuphiya, ukukhupha emasakeni nokuhlolwa kwegqoki ehlanziwe nsuku zonke.

xh.title: Umncedisi Wezitoro Zeempahla Zendlu
xh.summary: Umncedisi Wezitoro Zeempahla Zendlu e Ceres Hospital uxanduva lokuthwala, ukuhlela nokunikezela iimpahla zendlu phakathi kweewardi nethala leempahla zendlu, kufuneka abe nobuchwepheshe bokufunda nokubhala nokuba namandla emzimbeni.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowoqobo: Ulwazi olusesentlweni lokubala nokubhala. Imfundo: Isipilingo esifanelekileyo kumsebenzi jikelele wokuhlamba iimpahla. Iimfuno ezisesantlhini somsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesixa sexesha, umzekelo emva kwesixa sexesha, ngeekwezi nangeentsuku zethamsanqa xa kufuneka ngemfuno yomsebenzi. Ukwenza imisebenzi emzimbeni enzima, umzekelo ukuqhoqhoqa iitroli ezinzima zeempahla zendlu ziya ezithaleni naseewardini nokubuya. Amakhono (ulwazi/amandla): Ukuba namandla emzimbeni nokuba nakho ukuziva nokuthetha kakuhle. Ukwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo elula ethaleni leempahla zendlu phantsi kolawulo. Ikhono lokwahlula, ukutshiza nokubala iimpahla zendlu ezityileyo nengcolileyo. Ulwazi ngempahla nolawulo lolwalayo.
xh.duties: Ukugcina umgangatho ophezulu wococo,cohlo nokhuseleko. Ukunika inkxaso kumlawuli. Ukuqokelela rhoqo iimpahla zendlu ezityileyo, engcolileyo negulamayo (kumthambo) eewardini ukuze zithwelwe ethaleni leempahla zendlu. Ukunikela iimpahla zendlu ezicocekileyo eewardini. Ukuhlela, ukubala nokutshiza rhoqo iimpahla zendlu ezityileyo phambi kokuba zithunyelwe kwilawundri ePhakathi. Ukunikela, ukuvula nokujonga rhoqo iimpahla zendlu ezicocekileyo.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (SESSIONAL) (PLASTIC
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R 671 per hour Grade 2: R 766 per hour Grade 3: R 887 per hour
jobs.summary: Sessional medical specialist in plastic surgery sought for Groote Schuur Hospital, offering comprehensive operative services including head and neck oncology reconstruction.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (SESSIE) (PLASTIES
af.summary: Sessie-mediese spesialis in plastiese chirurgie gesoek vir Groote Schuur Hospital, wat omvattende operatiewe dienste aanbied, insluitend hoof- en nekonkologie-rekonstruksie.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie toelaat. Ervaring: Grade 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Plastiese Chirurgie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Toewyding aan die verkryging van gevorderde chirurgiese vaardighede, veral in Mikrochirurgie. Rekenaarvaardigheid, die vermoë om databasisse te ontwikkel en daarmee te werk. Ervaring in vrye-lap mikrovaskulêre chirurgie in hoof- en nekonkologie-chirurgie.
af.duties: Verseker, as deel van 'n span, deurlopende verbeterings in die gehalte, doeltreffendheid en uitkomste van plastiese chirurgie-pasiënte. Bied omvattende operatiewe dienste op 'n gereelde basis vir hoof- en nekonkologie-chirurgie-rekonstruksie saam met die Otorhinolaryngology (ENT Surgery)-span by Groote Schuur Hospital.

zu.title: Izindlebe zobugcotshiwe Ezinhle kakhulu izinga 1 kuye kwezinga 3 (SESSIONAL) (PLASTIC
zu.summary: Sefuna isikhundla semishanguqu ehlukaniswe ngamavesikhundla phesheya kwezokweliswa ngemishanguqu e-Groote Schuur Hospital, okunikeza amaswe emisebenzi eyisikhathi eside efaka izinkulumo zomdlavuza wehlo nesesifuba somoya nakwakhiwa kabusha kwemithambo yegazi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sobugesi obuncane: Isifundo esifanelekayo esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeskhaleni ezingeni eliphezulu kwezokweliswa ngemishanguqu. Isipiliyoni: izinga 1: Akukho okuthiwa kudingeka ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeskhaleni ezingeni eliphezulu kwezokweliswa ngemishanguqu. izinga 2: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-5 isipiliyoni esifanelekile njengeskhaleni ezingeni eliphezulu emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma ku-(or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) njengeskhaleni ezingeni eliphezulu kwezokweliswa ngemishanguqu. izinga 3: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-10 isipiliyoni esifanelekile njengeskhaleni ezingeni eliphezulu emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma ku-HPCSA (noma ubuholi bezempilo besifundazwe esibonwayo mayelana nomsebenzelwa oqeqeswe kwamanye amazwe) njengeskhaleni ezingeni eliphezulu kwezokweliswa ngemishanguqu. Ukubhalisa esikhunyini somsebenzi wezokwaziswa: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengeskhaleni ezingeni eliphezulu kwezokweliswa ngemishanguqu. Izakhiwo ezidingekayo (ulwazi/izindlebe): Isidingo sokuhle kobuhlakani bokuthula (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Isidingo sokusebenza eqenjini. Ukuzinikezela ekufinyeleleni izindlebe ezingaba nephuphu nangaphezulu ikakhulu kumdlapo wezokweliswa ngezinto ezincane. Isidingo sokusebenzisa khompyutha, nokwazi ukuthuthukisa kanye nokusebenza namaphhavu wezinsizakalo.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa, njengengxenye yeqembu, ukuphucuka okuyinkambiso ekwaneni, ukusebenza ngempumelelo nasekumphumeni wabesiguli basenkwenza wezokweliswa. Ukunikeza izinsiza ezenze umsebenzi ongokoqobo ngesikhathi esijwayelekile sokwakhiwa kabusha kwezinkulumo zomdlavuza wehlo nesesifuba somoya (ENT Surgery) eqembu elise-Groote Schuur Hospital.

xh.title: Isebe lezonyango - iSpesiali eqondo eliphezulu ukusuka kwinqanaba 1 ukuya kwinqanaba 3 (ORELA OLUTHILE) (I-PLASTIKI)
xh.summary: Sifuna ugqirha ozilungiseleyo osebenza ngeqela lotshe ethabatha ixesha elithile ngesihlobo sama plastiki ukwenzela i-Groote Schuur Hospital, anika iinkonzo ezilungelelanisiweyo zokuqhuba amathuba eqela elisebenzayo afaka indalo entsha entlokweni nasekunxwameni kwinkqubo yomhlaza.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezi funekayo njengesiseko: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwi-South African Health Professions Council (HPCSA) njengoGqirha oGqithisileyo woVuko lweSetyhula. Isiphiwo-Ntlalo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuno emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oGqithisileyo woVuko lweSetyhula. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-5 yamava ake afanelekileyo njengoGqirha oGqithisileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kwi-Health Professional Council ekwaziwayo yamazwe ngamazwe malunga nesebenzi esivelise isidanga kwamanye amazwe) njengoGqirha oGqithisileyo woVuko lweSetyhula. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava ake afanelekileyo njengoGqirha oGqithisileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kwi-Health Professional Council ekwaziwayo yamazwe ngamazwe malunga nesebenzi esivelise isidanga kwamanye amazwe) njengoGqirha oGqithisileyo woVuko lweSetyhula. Ukwazisa iqela labaqeqeshi bemizi-miso: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oGqithisileyo woVuko lweSetyhula. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba nethamsanqa lokuthetha elisebenzayo (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ikhono lokusebenza eqeleni. Iziqalelo zokuqonda ulwazi olutsha kwinkqubo esetyhulweni ngokukodwa kwimicrosurgery. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa iikhompyutha nokuba nethamsanqa lokuvelisa nokusebenza nedata ekuqokelelwe ndawonye. Akuqinisekiswa amava asebenzayo kulonke oku nkqubo ye-microvascular surgery kwindalo yenkqubo yomhlaza wentloko nentambo.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa, njengenxalenye yeqela, ukuphucuka ngokuqhubekayo kwizinga lobuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kakuhle nemithelela kumaguli bolunyango lwesetyhula. Ukunika iinkonzo zobugqirha obuzilungiseleyo ngokoqobo ngenkathi eqhubekayo yonke imihla yoVuko lweNtloko neNthambo lomhlaza kunye neliqela le-Otorhinolaryngology (ENT Surgery) esibhedlele i-Groote Schuur Hospital.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (10 Sessions PER Week)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R501 per hour Grade 2: R572 per hour Grade 3: R662 per hour
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 sought for Ladismith CDC, Kannaland Sub-district, requiring HPCSA registration, offering hourly rates from R501 to R662 for 10 sessions per week.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of who is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a medical practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years relevant experience after registration as a medical practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of who is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a medical practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration as a medical practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of who is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB). Willingness to travel throughout the Kannaland Sub-district. Availability to work sessions as per contract, including schedule changes at short notice. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written). Ability to work in integrated multi-disciplinary teams across all platforms. Computer literacy in MS Office is mandatory. Sound clinical knowledge of medical, emergency, obstetric and paediatric care appropriate to a district hospital and PHC setting. Surgical and anaesthetic skills applicable in a rural setting, in line with experience and competence.
jobs.duties: Quality clinical, non-clinical and medico-legal patient care as required by the various programmes of the Department of Health. Supervise, Support, transfer of knowledge to, training- and mentoring of the clinical staff and auxiliary staff. Appropriate Communication and up and down referral to CNP/Dr's/specialist and Allied Health Professions Provide and efficient administration service regarding all clinical and non-clinical matters and medico-legal work. Provide guidance and leadership towards the realisation of strategic goals and objectives of the division. Ensure a cost-efficient service at clinical level with regards to laboratory services, blood, medicine, consumables and equipment.
jobs.enquiries: Dr LH de V Poggenpoel Tel No: (028) 551 – 1010
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 (10 Sessies PER Week)
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 gesoek vir Ladismith CDC, Kannaland Sub-distrik, wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met uurlikse tariewe vanaf R501 tot R662 vir 10 sessies per week.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis, te verrig nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n mediese praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n mediese praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis, te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n mediese praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n mediese praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis, te verrig nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB). Bereidwilligheid om deur die hele Kannaland Sub-distrik te reis. Beskikbaarheid om sessies volgens kontrak te werk, insluitend skeduleveranderinge met kort kennisgewing. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoe om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoe om in geïntegreerde multidissiplinêre spanne oor alle platforme te werk. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office is verpligtend. Soliede kliniese kennis van mediese, nood-, obstriese en pediatriese sorg toepaslik vir 'n distrikshospital en PHC-omgewing. Chirurgiese en narkosevaardighede toepaslik in 'n landelike omgewing, in ooreenstemming met ervaring en bevoegdheid.
af.duties: Kwaliteit kliniese, nie-kliniese en medies-regtelike pasiëntsorg soos vereis deur die verskeie programme van die Department of Health. Superveiseer, ondersteun, oordrag van kennis aan, opleiding- en mentorskap van die kliniese personeel en hulppersoneel. Toepaslike kommunikasie en op- en afverwysing na CNP/Dr's/spesialis en Allied Health Professions. Verskaf 'n doeltreffende administrasiediens ten opsigte van alle kliniese en nie-kliniese aangeleenthede en medies-regtelike werk. Verskaf leiding en leierskap tot die verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die afdeling. Verseker 'n kostedoeltreffende diens op kliniese vlak ten opsigte van laboratoriumdienste, bloed, medisyne, verbruiksgoedere en toerusting.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokwelapha Sezinga 1 kuya ku-3 (10 Amaseshini NGESONTO)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Isikhundla Sokwelapha Sezinga 1 kuya ku-3 se-Ladismith CDC, Kannaland Sub-district, sidinga ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA, sinikeza amanani ahorakusuka ku-R501 kuya ku-R662 izinkathi eziyiseshini eziyishumi ngesonto.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesidingo esithile: Isidingo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengogqatsha wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kubhaliswe komkhakha wemisebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqatsha wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Asikho ngemuva kokubhalisa njengogqatsha wezokwelapha kwi-HPCSA ngokuphathelene nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esifanele somnyaka we-1 ngemuva kokubhalisa njengogqatsha wezokwelapha kubhaliswe komkhakha wabagqatsha bezempilo basemaphandle oqashwe ngokuphathelene nabasebenzi abathole izifundo emaphandle, ongadingeki ukuba enze Umsebenzi Womphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Umyikelelo weminyaka eyi-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengogqatsha wezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqatsha wezokwelapha ngokuphathelene nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Umyikelelo weminyaka eyi-6 yesipiliyoni esifanele ngemuva kokubhalisa njengogqatsha wezokwelapha kubhaliswe komkhakha wabagqatsha bezempilo basemaphandle oqashwe ngokuphathelene nabasebenzi abathole izifundo emaphandle, ongadingeki ukuba enze Umsebenzi Womphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Umyikelezo weminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengogqatsha wezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqatsha wezokwelapha ngokuphathelene nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Umyikelezo weminyaka eyi-11 yesipiliyoni esifanele ngemuva kokubhalisa njengogqatsha wezokwelapha kubhaliswe komkhakha wabagqatsha bezempilo basemaphandle oqashwe ngokuphathelene nabasebenzi abathole izifundo emaphandle, ongadingeki ukuba enze Umsebenzi Womphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibhakiwe somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehlezi (IKhodi B/EB). Ukuzethemba ukuhamba lonke i-Kannaland Sub-district. Ukutholakala ukusebenza amaseshini njengesivumelwano, okuhlanganisa ushintsho lwesikhathi sendlela ngokushesha. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ikono lokuxhumana ngempumelelo (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ikono lokusebenza ohlelweni lwamaqembu ahlukene ahlangene kuyo yonke izinhlelo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office kuyisidingo. Ulwazi oluhle lokwelapha emkhakheni wezokwelapha, ekuceleni usizo, kwezokubeletha kanye nokunakekelwa kwezinkingana ezincane okufanele esibhedlela sesifunda kanye nendawo yokunakekelwa kwempilo yokuqala. Amafomu amakhulu ukwelapha ngesibhaxu kanye nezindlela zokucindezela okufanele endaweni yasemaphakathi, ngokuvumelana nalesipiliyoni nakhono.
zu.duties: Ukunakekelwa kwesiguli okukhulu kwangempela, okungokwelapha, okungangokwelapha kanye nokomthetho njengoba kudingwa yizinhlelo ezahlukene ze-Department of Health. Ukuphathisa, ukusekela, ukudlulisa ulwazi, ukuqeqesha nokweseka abasebenzi bokwelapha kanye nabasebenzi abolunye. Ukuxhumana okufanele kanye nokuqondisa ukudluliselwa komphakathi nangasese kubadokotela/balaboratorium/ochwepheshe kanye nomkhakha Wezempilo Ohlobene. Ukunikeza isevisi yokuphatha esebenzayo ngokuphathelene zonke izindaba ezokwelapha kanye nezingangokwelapha nomsebenzi wokomthetho. Ukunikeza inhlahla kanye nobuholi ngokuqondisa ekufezeni izinjongo ezibalulekile nezinhloso zawo wonke amaqembu. Ukuqinisekisa isevisi entshontsho kwezinga lokwelapha ngokuphathelene namasevisi okulolonga, igazi, imishanguzo, okusetshenziswa kanye nezinto zokusebenza.

xh.requirements: Ubungangobho obuncinane: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoko yi-Medical Practitioner. Unyaka omnye wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njenge-Medical Practitioner kunqanaba lobuchwepheshe bamazwe ngamazwe obuchwepheshebempilo obaziwayo ngokumayelana nabasebenzi bakwamanye amazwe abafumene izifundo kwamanye amazwe, ongafuneki ukwenza i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka e-South Africa. Grade 2: Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yamava afanelekileyo njenge-Medical Practitioner emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomganga kwimayelana nabasebenzi abakhule apho e-South Africa. Okungenani eminyaka emi-6 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomganga kunqanaba lobuchwepheshe bamazwe ngamazwe obuchwepheshebeempilo obaziwayo ngokumayelana nabasebenzi bakwamanye amazwe abafumene izifundo kwamanye amazwe, ongafuneki ukwenza i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka e-South Africa. Grade 3: Okungenani eminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njenge-Medical Practitioner emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomganga kwimayelana nabasebenzi abakhule apho e-South Africa. Okungenani eminyaka eli-11 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomganga kunqanaba lobuchwepheshe bamazwe ngamazwe obuchwepheshebeempilo obaziwayo ngokumayelana nabasebenzi bakwamanye amazwe abafumene izifundo kwamanye amazwe, ongafuneki ukwenza i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka e-South Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo (Code B/EB). Ukuzimisela okuhamba ihlane nayo yonke i-Kannaland Sub-district. Ukufumaneka ukusebenza iiseshoni njengoko kubekiwe kwisivumelwano, kuquka noshintsho lwesikhedule ngexesha elifutshane. Ikhono (ulwazi/amazimhlola): Ikholwa lokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo (ngemilomo nangokubhalwayo). Ikholwa lokusebenza kumathimba ahlanganisene amanyangamanyanga kuwo onke amanqanaba. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office liyaphothulwa. Ulwazi olululo lwezempilo lemizimba, ezingozi, kwezabelekazi nabezantwana ngokuhambelana nesibhedlele sendawo nendawo ye-PHC. Ikhono lokusebenza iindlulo zendalo nokubathethela endaweni yasemaphandleni, ngokuhambelana namava nokuzelelwa kukakhono.
xh.duties: Ukhatho lokhathalelo lwesiguli olungangcolanga, olungangabikho ngokwezempilo nangokomthetho njengoko kufunwa ziinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ze-Department of Health. Ukulawula, ukuxhasa, ukudlulisa ulwazi ku, ukuqeqesha- nokufundisa abasebenzi bengangogqirha kunye nabasebenzi abancedisayo. Unxibelelwano olufanelekileyo nokuthunyelwa phezulu nasezansi kwi-CNP/Dr's/specialist kunye ne-Allied Health Professions. Ukunika inkonzo yolawulo esebenzayo ngokumayelana nayo yonke imicimbi engangabikho ngokwezempilo nangomthetho. Ukunika isikhokelo nokuqhuba ngokuhambelana nokufezekela iinjongo nezinto ezibalulekileyo kwicandelo. Kuqinisekise inkonzo efikelela ngokweexabiso kwinqanaba lezempilo ngokumayelana neenkonzo zegumbi lovavanyo, igazi, amayeza, izinto ezisetyenziswa nakwisixhobo.

af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Een (1) jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional council ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van ses (6) jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional council ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van gekwalifiseerde SA-werknemers. 'n Minimum van elf (11) jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional council ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereistes van die pos: 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B/EB). Diploma in Anaesthesia (DA)SA van die Colleges of Medicine of South Africa (CMSA). 'n Geldige Basic Life Support-sertifikaat en Advance Cardiac Life Support-sertifikaat. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Belangstelling in die ontwikkeling van 'n akademiese loopbaan. Goed rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en Outlook). Toepaslike ervaring in Anestesie.
af.duties: Onderrig en opleiding van mediese studente/opleiding van junior personeel, nagraadse en voorgraadse tandheelkundige studente. Navorsing en professionele ontwikkeling. Verskaf kliniese diens oor die Mondgesondheidsplatform.

zu.title: I Nhloko Yezokwelapha Ezingeni 1 kuye Ku-3 (OKWESIKHATHI ESITHILE) (I-ANESTHESIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Inhloko yezokwelapha okwesikhathi esithile kwi-anesthesiology e-Oral Health Centre, Tygerberg, ehlinzeka ngesevisi yezokwelapha, ukufundisa nokulungiselela, kanti kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Izifundo ezifanele ezikuvumela ukuthi ubhalise kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodokotela. Ukubhaliswa kubhaliswa lezomthetho wesikhungo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa HPCSA njengodokotela. Isiphiwo: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuqashwa njengodokotela kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathola iziqu e-South Africa. Unyaka owodwa (1) wokuhlangabezana kokuqondile emva kokuqashwa njengodokotela kubhaliswa lezempilo lasemazwe aphesheya elaziwayo mayelana nabasebenzi abathola iziqu kwamanye amazwe, ongadingeki ukuthi aze ahlabele umphakathi njengoba kudingekwa e-South Africa. Izinga 2: Okuncane eminyakeni eyisihlanu (5) yokuhlangabezana okufanele emva kokuqashwa njengodokotela kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathola iziqu e-South Africa. Okuncane eminyakeni ayisithupha (6) wokuhlangabezana kokuqondile emva kokuqashwa njengodokotela kubhaliswa lezempilo lasemazwe aphesheya elaziwayo mayelana nabasebenzi abathola iziqu kwamanye amazwe, ongadingeki ukuthi aze ahlabele umphakathi njengoba kudingekwa e-South Africa. Izinga 3: Okuncane eminyakeni eyishumi (10) yokuhlangabezana njengodokotela kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathola iziqu e-South Africa. Okuncane eminyakeni eyishumi nanye (11) wokuhlangabezana okufanele emva kokuqashwa njengodokotela kubhaliswa lezempilo lasemazwe aphesheya elaziwayo mayelana nabasebenzi abathola iziqu kwamanye amazwe, ongadingeki ukuthi aze ahlabele umphakathi njengoba kudingekwa e-South Africa. Izidingo eziyisisekelo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (Code B/EB). Isitifikati se-Diploma in Anaesthesia (DA)SA esivela kwi-Colleges of Medicine of South Africa (CMSA). Isitifikati se-Basic Life Support esivumelekile nesisitifikati se-Advance Cardiac Life Support. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa nakwiqembu elinezikhondo ezahlukene. Ukuthanda ukuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezemfundo. Ukubhaliseka kahle kakhulu kwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-Outlook). Isiphiwo esifanele kwi-Anaesthesia.
zu.duties: Ukufundisa nokulungiselela abadingi bezokwelapha/ukulungiselela abasebenzi abancane, abadingi beziqu zaphezulu kanye nabadingi beziqu zaphansi abafunda izinyo. Ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko yomsebenzi. Ukunikeza isevisi yezokwelapha kulo lonke i-Oral Health Platform.

xh.title: Isebe lokwesa Kwezempilo inqanaba 1 ukuya koku-3 (SESSIONAL) (ANESTHESIOLOGY)
xh.summary: Isebe lokwesa kwezempilo esebenza ngokweseshoni kwi-anesthesiology eKwindla ezeZempilo zomlomo, Tygerberg, linikeza inkonzo yezokwelapha, ukufundisa nokuzilolonga, kwaye kufuneka kubhalwe kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isidanga esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Health Professions Council (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kubungqangi obunesimo: Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Health Professions Council HPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo. Ulwazi: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezempilo kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi ababhalisele kwi-SA. Unyaka omnye (1) wolwazi olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezempilo kwiqonga elamkelekileyo langaphandle le-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi ababhalisele kwingaphandle, ongafunekiyo ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 2: Unyaka wokuqala (1) wolwazi olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezempilo kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi ababhalisele kwi-SA. Iminyaka yeshumi (10) yolwazi emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezempilo kwiqonga elamkelekileyo langaphandle le-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi ababhalisele kwingaphandle, ongafunekiyo ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka elishumi (10) yolwazi njengogqirha wezempilo kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi ababhalisele kwi-SA. Iminyaka elishumi elinye (11) yolwazi olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezempilo kwiqonga elamkelekileyo langaphandle le-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi ababhalisele kwingaphandle, ongafunekiyo ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Iimfuno ezisesiphithini somsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushumba esebenzayo (Inqanaba B/EB). Isidanga sokwelapha ngokudalila (DA)SA esuka kwi-Colleges of Medicine of South Africa (CMSA). Isatifikethi sokuxhasa ukuphila kwiimeko ezingezizo ezinobungozi kwaye sisebenza nesatifikethi sokuxhasa intliziyo ekwingozi. Ikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngodidi nakuqembu olunamasebe amaninana. Ukukhethwa ekuphuhliseni udidi lokwenza imfundiso. Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngakompyutha (MS Word, Excel ne-Outlook). Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokudalila ngokudalila ngokweseshoni.
xh.duties: Ukufundisa nokuzilolonga abafundi basezempilo/ukuzilolonga abasebenzi abasezantsi, abafundibezandulo nabafundi abangakwegqoki kwezendinyana. Uphando nokuphuhlisa ngobuchule. Unikezela inkonzo yezempilo kwi-Oral Health Platform.

jobs.title: Chief Architect: Health Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (OSD as prescribed
jobs.summary: Chief Architect needed to lead health infrastructure design and project management for the Western Cape Government, requiring a B-Degree, SACAP registration and six years' experience.
jobs.requirements: B-Degree in Architecture or relevant qualification; Six years post qualification architectural experience required; Compulsory registration with SACAP as a Professional Architect; A valid driving licence (Code B or higher). Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Technical: Programme and project management; Architectural legal and operational compliance; Architectural operational communication; Process knowledge and skills; Maintenance skills and knowledge; Mobile equipment operating skills; Architectural principles; Research and development; Computer-aided engineering applications; Creating high performance culture; Technical consulting; Professional judgment' Generic: 'Strategic capability and leadership; Financial management Conflict management Negotiation skills Problem solving and analysis; Decision making; Team leadership; Creativity; Customer focus and responsiveness; Communication; Computer skills; People Management; Planning and Organising; Change Management; Good analytical, problem solving, interpersonal and organisational skills; Good verbal and written communication skills; Computer literacy (MS Project, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
jobs.duties: Architectural design and analysis effectiveness will entail the following: Perform final review and approvals or audits on architectural designs according to design principles or theory; Co-ordinate design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology. Maintaining architectural operational effectiveness; Manage the execution of architectural strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources; Set architectural standards, specifications and service levels according to organizational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability; Monitor and maintain efficiencies according to organizational goals to direct or redirect architectural services for the attainment of organisational objectives. Financial Management will entail the following: Ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the budgeted MTEF objectives within the architectural environment/services; Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organizational needs and objectives; Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects; Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organisational principles; Allocate, monitor, control expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Governance will entail the following: Allocate, monitor and control resources; Compile risk logs and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organisational requirements; Provide technical consulting services for the operation of architectural related matters to minimize possible architectural risks; Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment; Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals. People Management will entail the following: Manage the development motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of architectural services according to organisational needs and requirements; Manage subordinates' key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct the deviations to achieve departmental objectives.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofargitek: Gesondheidsinfrastruktuur
af.summary: Hoofargitek nodig om gesondheidsinfrastruktuurontwerp en projekbestuur vir die Western Cape Government te lei, met 'n B-graad, SACAP-registrasie en ses jaar se ervaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: B-Degree in Argitektuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie; Ses jaar se argitektoniese ervaring na kwalifikasie word vereis; Verpligte registrasie by SACAP as 'n Professionele Argitek; 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B of hoër). Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Tegnies: Program- en projekbestuur; Argitektoniese regte en operasionele nakoming; Argitektoniese operasionele kommunikasie; Proseskennis en -vaardighede; Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis; Mobiele toerustingbedryfvaardighede; Argitektoniese beginsels; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings; Skep van hoëprestasiekultuur; Tegniese konsultasie; Professionele oordeel; Generies: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Finansiële bestuur; Konflikbestuur; Onderhandelingsvaardighede; Probleemoplossing en analise; Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Kreatiwiteit; Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë; Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardighede; Menslike hulpbronbestuur; Beplanning en organisering; Veranderingsbestuur; Goeie analitiese, probleemoplossende, interpersoonlike en organisatoriese vaardighede; Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Project, Word, Excel, en PowerPoint).
af.duties: Argitektoniese ontwerp en analise-doeltreffendheid sal die volgende behels: Voer finale hersiening en goedkeurings of oudits op argitektoniese ontwerpe uit volgens ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie; Koördineer ontwerppogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Onderhoud van argitektoniese operasionele doeltreffendheid; Bestuur die uitvoering van argitektoniese strategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne; Stel argitektoniese standaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker; Monitor en handhaaf doeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om argitektoniese dienste te stuur of te herstuur vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Finansiële bestuur sal die volgende behels: Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die begrote MTEF-doelwitte binne die argitektoniese omgewing/dienste te bereik; Bestuur die operasionele kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbrontoekenning volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker; Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte; Fasiliteer die opstel van innove-eringsvoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker; Ken toe, monitor en beheer uitgawes volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur sal die volgende behels: Ken toe, monitor en beheer hulpbronne; Stel risikologboeke op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes; Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie van argitektonies-verwante sake om moontlike argitektoniese risiko's te minimaliseer; Bestuur en implementeer kennisoordrag-inisiatiewe bv. korttermyn-opdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies heen, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging; Monitor voortdurend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue. Menslike hulpbronbestuur sal die volgende behels: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van argitektoniese dienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker; Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en aksies te neem om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Umakhi Oyinhloko: Isisekelo Senhlalo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umakhi oyinhloko ohole ukwakheka kwezisekelo zenhlalo kanye nokuphathwa kwephrojekthi kuhulumende wase-Western Cape, kudingeka i-B-Degree, ukubhaliswa kwi-SACAP kanye namaphuzu eminyaka eyisithupha yomsebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-B-Degree ku-Architecture noma iziqu ezifanele; Kudingeka amaphuzu eminyaka eyisithupha emumva kokuthola iziqu ohlelweni lokwakha; Ukubhaliswa okuyisinyathelo esiqinisekile ku-SACAP njengomakhi osebenza ngobungcali; Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile (i-Code B noma ngaphezulu). Izindlela zokusebenza: Ulwazi ngakho okulandelayo: Okubuchwepheshe: Ukuphathwa kwenqubomgomo kanye nephrojekthi; Ukuziphatha kokuqondene nomthetho kanye nokuqondene nokusebenza ezokwakheni; Ukuxhumana okuqondene nokusebenza ezokwakheni; Ulwazi kanye namakhono enqubo; Amakhono kanye nolwazi lokugcina; Amakhono okuphatha izinguxa eziphathwayo; Izimiso zokwakha; Ucwaningo nentuthuko; Izinhlelo zokusebenza zokwakha ngosizo lwekhompyutha; Ukudala amasiko okusebenza ngemvelo ephezulu; Ukubonisana ngobuchwepheshe; Isibaxo sobuchwepheshe; Okuvamile: Ikhono elihambisana nezinhloso kanye nokuholwa; Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga; Amakhono okuxoxisana ngezenzo; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda okujulile; Ukwenza izinqumo; Ukuholwa kwethimba; Ubuciko; Ukuqinisekisa ukugxila kwabathinti kanye nokusabela; Ukuxhumana; Amakhono ekhompyutha; Ukuphathwa kwabantu; Ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela; Ukuphathwa izinguquko; Amakhono ohlelo lokuhlaziya izinkinga, okuhlanganisa nabantu, nokuqamba izinhlelo; Amakhono okukhuluma kanye nokubhala kahle; Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha (i-MS Project, Word, Excel, kanye ne-PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Ukusebenza kahle kokwakha kanye nokuqonda okuyingxenye kokwakha kuzohlanganisa okulandelayo: Yenza ukubuyekeza okugcwele futhi uvume noma uhlole izinhlela zokwakha ngokusekelwe ezimisweni zokwakha noma kumthetho wokwakha; Hlanganisa imizamo yokwakha kanye nokuhlanganisa kuzo zonke izinga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganiswa okungabuyeki nobuchwepheshe bamanje. Ukugcina ukusebenza kahle kokwakha; Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yokwakha ngokusikezela izakhiwo ezifanele, izinhlelo kanye nezinsiza; Hlela izindinganiso zokwakha, izinkomba kanye namazinga okusebenza ngokwezinjongo zenhlangano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala okulinganiselwe ekusebenzeni; Qapha futhi ulondoloze ukusebenza kahle ngokwezinjongo zenhlangano ukuze uqondise noma uqonde kabusha izinsiza zokwakha ukuze kufinyelelwe izinjongo zenhlangano. Ukuphathwa kwezimali kuzohlanganisa okulandelayo: Qinisekisa ukutholakala kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ukuze kuhambisane nezinja zokuqinisekisa i-MTEF ngaphakathi kwenhlalo/izinsiza zokwakha; Phatha ithimba lephrojekthi yemali enikela kusetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwabiwa kwemithombo ngokwezidingo kanye nezinja zenhlangano; Phatha inani lokungeza okuhamba kahle kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi ahlobene nomkhakha; Sekela ukweluleka izingxoxo zentuthuko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kokuqamba kanye nokuhambisana nezimiso zenhlangano;abel, qapha, lawula ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ngokwe-mthetho wemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kweqembu lemali elisebenzayo. Ukuphathwa kwezomthetho kuzohlanganisa okulandelayo: Yabel, qapha futhi ulawule imithombo; Qamba amafayela ezingozi ulawule izingozi ezibalulekile ngokuhambisana nenqubo eyisiseko yokuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nezidingo zenhlangano; Nikeza izinsiza zokubonisana ngobuchwepheshe ukuze kugcinwe ukusebenza ezindabeni eziqondene nokwakha ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi ezingaba khona zokwakha; Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi izibonelo. ukwabelana ngesikhashana futhi abelwe izikhundla ngaphakathi kanye nakwezinye izindawo zokusebenza, ekusekeleni amapulani entuthuko yomuntu, izidingo zokusebenza kanye nentengo ebuyiswa yitshalo; Qapha ngokungalokothi ukushintshaniswa kanye nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kwezindawo zokusebenza kanye nabantu. Ukuphathwa kwabantu kuzohlanganisa okulandelayo: Phatha entuthuko yomoya wokusebenza kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yabantu ohlelweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwaziswa okusebenzayo ngokulandelwa kokuphumelela izinsiza zokwakha ngokwezidingo kanye nezidingo zenhlangano; Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza kwabaphansi ngokusika futhi uqaphele izindinganiso zokusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa okungahambi kahle ukuze kufinyelelwe izinja zomnyango.

xh.title: Umphathi weZakhiwo: Isiseko sezeMpi lo yeZeempilo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa uMphathi weZakhiwo ongoyile ekulawuleni ukuyila kwiseko sezeMpi lo yeZeempilo nokulawula iiprojekthi kurhulumente we Western Cape, kufuneka abe ne-Degree ye-B, abe nabhalise kwiSACAP anamashumi amathandathu eminyaka yamava.

zu.title: Umcoordinator Wesikhungo Sokuhlola: Ukuhlola Kwesifundazwe
zu.summary: Ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yesikhungo sokuhlola kwesifundazwe, kunikeza inkxaso yolawulo nenhlelo kahle ngaphakathi kwe Department of the Premier, Western Cape.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma yeminyaka engu-3/ i-B-Degree (iziqu ezilinganayo noma eziphezulu). Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-1 yohluvo olufanelekileko endaweni ephathelene nabantu/OD noma ehloleneyo. Isitifiketi sokushayela ukulingana ne-code B noma esiphezulu. NB: Abantu abasikhohlakaleni ababambelekisa ukushayela, kodwa abanokufinyelela okulungile kwezokuthutha bangafaka isicelo. Amandla: Ulwazi ngokuqondene nalokhu: Ibhetri elibanzi yokuhlolwa kwezinkinga nokuhlola ngokwengqondo; Health Professions Act, 1974; Inqubomgomo yokuhlola ikhono; Ulawulo nosimanzi wezofisi; Isistimu eyisisekelo yezezimali; Isistimu yokuThenga i-LOGIS; Uphathwe kwemivumelwano; Umthetho wobungqangi wokubhaliswa nezindawo zokulondoloza imibhalo. Amandi abadingekayo: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; Ukunaka imininingwane (ukuzwakalisa); Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nokuba seduze ekusetshenziseni amasofthiwe njengakuyo i-MS Office Package (Word, Excel, Power-point, Outlook); Ukuhlanganisa nokubeka phambili; Ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle; Ubudlelwano nabantu nokwakha ubuhlobo; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ukubhala izincomo; Uphathwe kwesikhathi; Ukuqamba futhi uqonde abanye; Ukufezwa izempumelelo nokugcwaliswa izethembe likamthengi; Ukulandela imiyalo nezinqubo; Ukuzinikezela emigqweni nasekulungeni; Ukubhala nokubika; Ukusebenza nabantu; Ukucabangisise nokusungula ekwenzeni; Ukufeza izinjongo nezihloko zomuntu siqu.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso evamile yolawulo nokusebenza kwe-PAC. Ukuhlela uhhlelo kanye nokuqondanisa ngolwazi nabantu ngamathuba abathintene nawo noma izinkampani ezingaba khona. Ukuphathwa kwezincwadi zokungena nokuphuma (okungahleliwe ukuhlolwa): Phatha zonke izincwadi ezinyukelayo nezehlayo. Inqubo yolawulo ye-PAC kanye nenkxaso yokuhlelwa kohlelo: Nina igalelo ekuthuthukisweni, ekuqiniseni nasekuqedeni inqubo yolawulo ye-PAC (isb. ukuhamba kwesikhathi sokubhuka, ukugqamiswa kwabahlanganyelayo, uhlu lwesihlalo sokuhlola). Hola futhi uxhase abasebenzisi ekulandelweni kwenqubo entsha yolawulo. Hlela uhambo lwezidingo njengakuqanjwe (izimoto ze-GG, ukukhweshela, ukundiza, izibonelelo zokuhamba, njll.). Hlanganisa ngokugcwele izinsiza zokuhlolwa kwebhaladi. Izinsiza zokuhlola ukugcwaliselela izibonakaliso zokuhlolwa ngokwamanani. Ukutholakala kwethimba le-PAC nokulinganisela izinsiza. Phatha okuhlangene nokuphathwa kolwazi, imininingwane kanye namaphothokholo e-PAC. Nina igalelo ekuthuthukiseni nasekuqiniseni okuhlangene nokuphathwa kwesistimu yolwazi le-PAC, imininingwane kanye nezakhiwo zamaphothokholo. Qamba ukufanisa izinsiza ngokuqhubekayo ezinngweni ezingenisiwe ukuze kuqiniseke ukuzwakalisa, ukuphumelelisa nokuzinza kolwazi. Qoqa futhi uhlaziye izibalo ezintsanu nje ngomthelela ngaphakathi nakaphandle ngemikhiqizo (isb. izingxube zemifanekiso yangenyanga, izifinyezo zokusebenza). Yazi abathintene nabo kumiklombo yezexwayiso ngosuku lokuphela nokungenisa ulwazi (isb. amabhodo eminyaka yonke, izibalo zemifanekiso yangenyanga). Nina inkxaso yezimali kanye nabokulawula nokuThola kwa-PAC. Inkxaso yokuThola nokuthola izinto, i-PAC nokuhlolwa ngokulandelwa kwemithetho esemthethweni. Ukuphathwa kwemali nokuhlawula. Uphathwe kwezivumelwano ngabakini nokulethwa kwezidingo. Uphathwa kwesitoko, amafa kanye nokulawula izinsiza. Qaphela abasebenzi be-PAC ngokulawula kwezofisi nokuqhuba imisebenzi. Hlanganyela ekubhenyweni nasekukhetweni abantu. Khuthaza, qeqesha futhi hole abasebenzi. Lawula imisebenzi, ukulinganisa futhi umphathe ngokumklomela umuntu. Qaphela ukukhulisa ngolwazi okuyisisekelo. Khuthaza ubudlelwano bezomhlaba okuhle. Gcina isimo esihle. Nika umhlahlandela bese uyilawula ngokuxhumene nengxabano ngokuhambisana nemisebenzi eyenziwa ngaphansi kwakhe. Hlukanisa imisebenzi kubantu, uqaphele ukuphumelelwa bese ufaka izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokulungisa ukuphumelelisa okungalungile kokugqama nezindinganiso.
