af.title: Sosiale Werker: PIC
af.summary: Sosiale Werker-pos by die Western Cape Department of Social Development wat sorg, ondersteuning en beskerming aan kwesbare individue, gesinne en gemeenskappe oor verskeie graadvlakke bied.
af.requirements: 'n Terverwante tersiêre kwalifikasie in Sosiale Werk (Bachelor of Social Work) wat professionele registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as Sosiale Werker toelaat; Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as 'n Sosiale Werker; Graad 1: Geen ervaring; Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Sosiale Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiale Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Sosiale Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiale Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Sosiale Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiale Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toesigraamwerk vir Sosiale Werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings in wisselwerking tree om sosiale welstand te bevorder; Sosiale werksteorie en intervensies; Inligting- en kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Terverwante wetgewing, beleide en voorskifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en -beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van andere. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Verslagdoening; Selfbestuur; Motivering; Goedbeplande en georganiseerde werk; Probleemoplossing en analitiese vermoë; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntgerigtheid en klie fokus; Vermoë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle op te tree en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en hul probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter; Vermoë om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, voor te staan en te verbeter deur hulle in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoë om sosiale werkdienste te lewer ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, tot risiko blootgestel en onin staat is om hulself te beskerm; Vermoë om Sosiale Werkers Graad 1 te mentor en te afrig.
af.duties: Lewer 'n sosiale werkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die tersaaklike programme (Gevallewerk, groepswerk en Gemeenskapswerk); Spreek enige ander aangeleenthede aan wat tot, of voortvloei uit, sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei; Hou toesig oor en ondersteun Sosiale Auxiliêre Werkers; Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelinge in die sosiale werk- en sosiale welsynsvelde; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat van die werk vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokwengamele: PIC
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi Wokwengamele kuWestern Cape Department of Social Development sokunikeza ukunakekelwa, ukwesekwa nokuvikela abantu abasengozini, amaphakathi nemiphakathi ngamazinga ahlukene amagreyidi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhungo samekhaya ezingqinizweni zeSocial Work (Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa ngobuchwepheshe kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi Wokwengamele; Ukubhalisa kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi Wokwengamele; Grade 1: Akukho njinjo; Grade 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-10 yamava afanelekile kuSocial Work emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi Wokwengamele kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-20 yamava afanelekile kuSocial Work emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi Wokwengamele kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Okungenani eminyaka engu-30 yamava afanelekile kuSocial Work emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi Wokwengamele kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Ukuziphatha komuntu kanye namasistimu omphakathi kanye nezikhono zokungenelela kumaphuzu lapho abantu bathintana khona namaphakathi wabo ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi; Itheori yomsebenzi Wokwengamele kanye nezokungenelela; Ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi; Iphrothokholo kanye nokuziphatha komsebenzi ngobuchwepheshe; Umthetho ohlobene, izinqubomgomo kanye namaphrisikipthi (amaphuzu namazinga); Ukwakheka komphakathi, amagugu omsebenzi kanye nemigomgo; Ukuthuthukisa kanye nokuqinisa abanye. Izikhono kulokhu okulandelayo: Ukubhekana nezimbangela ezingakanisi zezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nendlala, ukungalingani, ukucindezelwa, ukubandlulula nokukhishwa emphakathini; Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nokukhulunywa; Ukubhala umbiko; Ukuzilawula; Ukugqugquzela; Ukuhlela futhi kuhlele kahle; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuyimitha kanye nokuhola; Ukuqondiswa kukhasimende kanye nokugxila kumakhasimende; Ikhono nokuqinisekiswa ekunikeleni usizo, ekuthuthukiseni, ukumelana no-, kanye nookuqinisa abantu, amaphakathi, amaqembu, izinkampani nemiphakathi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwawo komphakathi kanye nokuqamba izixazululi zazo; Ikhono lokuthuthukisa, lokubuyisela, lokugcina, ukumelana no- kanye nokuqinisa ukusebenza kwabantu, amaphakathi, amaqembu kanye nemiphakathi ngokubanikeza amandla okufeza imisebenzi, yokuvikela futhi enze buthakuzisa ubuhlungu kanye nokusebenzisa izinsiza ngempumelelo; Ukuqonda kanye nokuqinisekiswa ukunikela izinsiza zomsebenzi Wokwengamele ngokuphathelene nokuvikela abantu abasengozini, abasesikingeni futhi abangeke bakwazi ukuzivikela; Ikhono lokuyimitha nokuhola abasebenzi Wokwengamele Grade 1.
zu.duties: Nikela isevisi yomsebenzi Wokwengamele ngokuphathelene nokunakekelwa, ukwesekwa, ukuvikela kanye nophuhliso wabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, amaphakathi nemiphakathi ngokusezinhlelweni ezihlobene (Ukusebenza ngekesi, ukusebenza ngeqembu kanye nokusebenza nomphakathi); Ukuhola yonke eminye imicabango engadala, noma evela ku-; ukungazinzile komphakathi nganoma imuphi uhlobo; Ukuyimitha kanye nokusekela abasebenzi abasiza kuSocial Auxiliary Workers; Ukuthuthukisa njalo ubuchwepheshe bomsebenzi; Ukugcina ukuya phambili ngokuthuthukiswa okusha emsebenzini Wokwengamele nasemkhakheni wentutukelo yomphakathi; Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo edingekile yalomsebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wentlalo: PIC
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wentlalo nesebe leZophulo nathiPhuhliso laseWestern Cape esinika inkathalo, inkxaso nokhuseleko kumabantu abasemngciphekweni, iintsapho namaphakathi kwakunye namanqanaba amaninzi emfundo.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zesidanga eliphezulu ezifanelekileyo kumsebenzi wentlalo (I-Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo ogqithiswe ngamabhaliso e-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wentlalo; Inqanaba 1: Akukho naphezu konyaka wolwazi; Inqanaba 2: Ukungabinazigqibo kweenyanga ezingama-10 zolwazi olufanelekileyo kumsebenzi wentlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Inqanaba 3: Ukungabinazigqibo kweenyanga ezingama-20 zolwazi olufanelekileyo kumsebenzi wentlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Inqanaba 4: Ukungabinazigqibo kweenyanga ezingama-30 zolwazi olufanelekileyo kumsebenzi wentlalo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wentlalo kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ikhono nesiphendulo: Ulwazi ngaloku landelayo: Isakhelo sokulawula abasebenzi bentlalo; Ukuziphatha kwabantu nendlela yokusebenza kweenkqubo zentlalo, namakhono okungena phakathi kwendawo abantu bahlangana namaphakathi abo, ukuze bakhuthaze impilo yentlalo; I-theori nomsebenzi wentlalo; Ukuqulwa kolwazi; I-Protocol namaxanduva omsebenzi; Imigaqo-nkqubo namazomfutho angqinelana (iinorms neestandard); Ukujikeleza kwentlalo, amaxabiso nomisebenzi; Ukuphucula nokuqinisekisa abanye. Amakhona ngaloku landelayo: Ukuphakamisa iindziba ezingundoqo zoswini,engalingananga,ndlulweni,ukwahlukanisa kunye nokukhatywa; Inguqulo yesibhengez kunye nolwimi lokuwaxelela; Ukwabhala iirephathi; Ukuzilawula; Ukuqhutywa; Ukuhlela nokuqamba ngokulungileyo; Ukuqonda ngxaki nokuwahlula ngeengqondo; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngalwekhompyutha; I-prezentsh kunye nokuqhuba; Umonakaliso kumaxhala kwaye ugqamise iinkxaso; Ukuba nakhono nokuqinisekiswa ngokuseta, kuphucule, ugqatseke kwaye uqinisekise abantu, iintsapho, amaqela, iindzima kunye namaphakathi kubuncwane bamakhondo abo bokuziphatha nokuqonda ngxaki; Ukuba nakhono ukukhuthaza, ukubuyela,ugcina,ugqatse kwaye uphucule ukuqonda ngabanye, iintsapho,amaqela namaphakathi ngokuqinisekisa ukuba benze imisebenzi yabo, bagwente bahlale kumonde besebenzisa imiganu ngenjongo; Ukuqonda nokuqinisekisa ukubonelela ngokulawula umsebenzi wentlalo ngokhuselo kubantu abakwindawo yesichitho, bengozini kwaye bengakwazi ukuqinisekisa; Ukuba nakhono okulungiselela ukunika isakhono sabo abasebenzi bentlalo abakwiInqanaba 1.
xh.duties: Bonelela ngomsebenzi wentlalo ngokunxulumene n Inkathalo, inkxaso, ukhuselo nophuhliso labantu abakwindawo yesichitho, amaqela, iintsapho namaphakathi ngenkqubo ezifanelekileyo (Ukusebenza ngomatyalitsha, ukusebenza ngamaqela nomsebenzi womphakathi); Nika ingqalelo kumamva onke anokuvela okanye aphuma kumonakaliso wentlalo ngalo naliphi na inxaxheba; Lawula nokuqinisekisa abasebenzi abalawulayo baze bancedisane; Ukuqhubela phambili ukuqeqesheka kwakhona; Hlala uvuselelwa ngokuphuhliswa kwangoku kwiZinto ezintsha kumsebenzi wentlalo nasebalweni lentlalo; Yenza onke amaxanduva olawulo afunyanwa kumsebenzi.

jobs.title: Social Worker: PIC
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 208 - R397 668 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 2: R413 004 - R478 395 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 3: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 4: R608 859 - R754 785 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Social Worker position offering care and support to vulnerable individuals and communities across multiple salary grades, requiring a Social Work degree and professional registration.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as Social Worker; Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a Social Worker; Grade 1: No experience; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviour and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination and exclusion; Written and verbal communication; Report-writing; Self- management; Motivation; Good planning and organizing; Problem solving and analytical; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes (Case work, group work and Community work); Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Supervise and Support Social Auxiliary Workers; Continuous Professional Development; Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields; Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Imelda April at Tel No: (021) 763 6217.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department by applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Maatskaplike werker: PIC
af.summary: Maatskaplike werker-posisie wat sorg en ondersteuning bied aan kwesbare individue en gemeenskappe oor verskeie salarisgrade, met 'n Maatskaplikewerk-graad en professionele registrasie as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Baccalaureus in Maatskaplike Werk) wat professionele registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Diensteprofessies as maatskaplike werker moontlik maak; Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Diensteprofessies as maatskaplike werker; Graad 1: Geen ervaring; Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar gepaste ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as maatskaplike werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Diensteprofessies; Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar gepaste ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as maatskaplike werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Diensteprofessies; Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar gepaste ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as maatskaplike werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Diensteprofessies. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toesigraam vir maatskaplike werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings in wisselwerking tree om sosiale welsyn te bevorder; Maatskaplikewerk-teorie en -ingrypings; Inligting- en kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Ter sake wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en -beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Verslagskrywing; Selfbestuur; Motivering; Goed beplan en organiseer; Probleemoplossing en analities; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntgerigtheid en klienisfokus; Vermoe en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle op te tree en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en probleemoplossingsvermoë te verbeter; Vermoe om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, daarvoor op te tree en te verbeter deur hulle in staat te stel om take te voltooi, lyding te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoe om maatskaplikewerkdienste te lever ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, in gevaar en onbekwaam is om hulself te beskerm; Vermoe om maatskaplike werkers van Graad 1 te mentoor en af te rig.
af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die tersaaklike programme (Gevallewerk, groepswerk en gemeenskapswerk); Hanteer enige ander aangeleenthede wat tot sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of daaruit kan voortspruit; Hou toesig oor en ondersteun maatskaplike hulpwerkers; Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings op die gebiede van maatskaplike werk en maatskaplike welsyn; Voer alle administratiewe funksies uit wat by die pos vereis word.

zu.title: Inkosikazi/Inkosi Yomsebenzi Womphakathi: PIC
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi womphakathi esinakekelo nezinkundla kubantu abasengozini nasezinhlanganweni kuma-grade aholo amaningi, esidinga idigri yomsebenzi womphakathi nokubhalisa ngobunjira.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole esiphezulu ezihambisana nomsebenzi womphakathi (Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa ngobunjira ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengenkosikazi/inkosi yomsebenzi womphakathi; Ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengenkosikazi/inkosi yomsebenzi womphakathi; Grade 1: Akukho okuhlangenwe nakho; Grade 2: Okuncane kakhulu eminyakeni engu-10 okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nomsebenzi womphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengenkosikazi/inkosi yomsebenzi womphakathi ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Okuncane kakhulu eminyakeni engu-20 okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nomsebenzi womphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengenkosikazi/inkosi yomsebenzi womphakathi ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Okuncane kakhulu eminyakeni engu-30 okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nomsebenzi womphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengenkosikazi/inkosi yomsebenzi womphakathi ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Amakhono: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Isakhiwo sokuhlakanipha sabasebenzi bomphakathi; Ukuziphatha komuntu kwezinhlelo zomphakathi namakhono okungenelela lapho abantu bethintana namaphilo abo ukuze kukhuliswe impilo yomphakathi; Inqubo yomsebenzi womphakathi nokungenelela; Ukulawulwa kolwazi nolwazi; Iziphetho nezimiso zomsebenzi; Umthetho, izinhlelo namapheshana ahambisana (amazinga nezindinganiso); Ukujikeleza komphakathi, amagugu nomisebenzi; Ukuthuthukisa futhi sikhulise abanye. Amakhono kulokhu okulandelayo: Ukuphikisana nezimbangela zokungabi nabuphakathi ezingunhlaka, ukungalingani, ukucindezelwa, ukwahlukaniswa nokukhishwa; Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangomlomo; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuzilawula; Ukwesekwa; Ukucabanga okuhle nokuhlela; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Okuhlelokubungakhoni nokupehula; Ukugxila kumthengi nokuqashekwa kwabathengi; Ikhono nolwazi lokusiza, ukuthuthukisa, ukumela, futhi sikhulise abantu, izindlu, amaqembu, izinhlangano nezinhlanganeni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza komphakathi namandla okuxazulula izinkinga; Ikhono lokuthuthukisa, ukubuyisa, ukugcina, ukumela futhi ukwethula ukusebenza komphakathi kwabantu, izindlu, amaqembu nezinhlanganeni ngokubasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi, ekuvikeleni futhi ekuphulukiseni ukuqhoshwa nokusebenzisa izinsiza ngokusebenza kahle; Ukuqonda nakhono lokunikezela ngemisebenzi yomphakathi ngokuvikela abantu abasengozini, abalimele abangeke bakwazi ukuzivikela; Ikhono lokuyala futhi ukufundisa abasebenzi bomphakathi abangabo Grade 1.
zu.duties: Nikela ngomsebenzi womphakathi ngokwaleyo inakekelo, inkundla, ukuvikelwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, izindlu nezinhlanganeni ngamaphrokharihamu ahambisana (umsebenzi wesikhashana, umsebenzi weqembu nomsebenzi womphakathi); Ukunakela nanoma yiziphi ezinye izindaba ezingabanga noma ezibuyela endaweni yokungalangazelelwa komphakathi nanoma yisiphi isimo; Ukuyala futhi ukusekela abasebenzi bomphakathi abangosizo; Ukuthuthukiswa ngobunjira okungapheli; Ukuhlala usegqwalini ngezinto ezintsha ekuhambisweni nomsebenzi wokwakheka; Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yopoli eyidingwa umsebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wezemizimulo: PIC
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wezemizimulo esinika inkathazo nentlxaso abantu abasemngciphekweni nakumazwe ngamabala amaninzi emilinganisweni yomvuzo, sifuna isidanga kumsebenzi wezemizimulo nokubhalisa njengomcali.
xh.requirements: Ifundo efanayo ephakamileyo kumsebenzi wezemizimulo (Isidanga kumsebenzi wezemizimulo) ekuvumela ukubhalisa ngobuchwepheshe kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wezemizimulo; Ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wezemizimulo; Grade 1: Akukho mphathi; Grade 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wezemizimulo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezemizimulo kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-20 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wezemizimulo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezemizimulo kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-30 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wezemizimulo emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezemizimulo kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions. Iimfuno zokwazi: Ulwazi ngalwalu: Ulwazi kwinkqubo yokulawula abasebenzi bezemizimulo; Ukuziphatha kwabantu nemiqathango yentlalo namakhono okungena kumathafa apho abantu basebenzisana nemizekelo yabo ukuze bakhuthaze impilo yentlalo; Ithiyori kunye neendlela zokungena kumsebenzi wezemizimulo; Ulwazi oluphathwayo nolulawulwayo; Iinkqubo zobugcisa obuzima nengcebo; Imithetho, iinkqubo namagunya ahambelanayo (imigangatho namazinga); Iinkqubo zentlalo, amaxabiso omsebenzi nemiqathayo; Ukuphucula nokwakhisa abanye. jobs.summary: Social Worker position within the Western Cape Department of Social Development providing care, support and protection to vulnerable individuals and communities across multiple grade levels.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as Social Worker; Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a Social Worker; Grade 1: No experience; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviours and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination and exclusion; Written and verbal communication; Report-writing; Self- management; Motivation; Good planning and organizing; Problem solving and analytical; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes (Case work, group work and Community work); Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Supervise and Support Social Auxiliary Workers; Continuous Professional Development; Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields; Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.

af.title: Sosiale Werker: PIC
af.summary: Sosiale Werker-posisie binne die Western Cape Department of Social Development wat sorg, ondersteuning en beskerming aan kwesbare individue en gemeenskappe verskaf oor verskeie graadvlakke heen.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Bachelor of Social Work) wat professionele registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as Sosiale Werker moontlik maak; Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as 'n Sosiale Werker; Grade 1: Geen ervaring; Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiale Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiale Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Sosiale Werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toesigraamwerk vir Sosiale Werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings interaksie het ten einde sosiale welsyn te bevorder; Maatskaplike werksteorie en ingrywings; Inligting- en kennisbestuur; Protokol en beroepsetiek; Toepaslike wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Verslagdoening; Selfbestuur; Motivering; Goed beplanning en organisering; Probleemoplossing en analities; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntoriëntasie en klante fokus; Vermoeë en bevoegdheid om individue, families, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle te pleit en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter; Vermoeë om die funksionering van individue, families, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, voor te pleit en te verbeter deur hulle in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoë om maatskaplike werksdienste te verskaf ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, blootgestel aan risiko en onin staat is om hulself te beskerm; Vermoeë om Sosiale Werkers Grade 1 te mentorskap en af te rig.
af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplike werksdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, families en gemeenskappe deur middel van die toepaslike programme (Gevalle werk, groepswerk en Gemeenskaps werk); Skenk aandag aan enige ander aangeleenthede wat tot sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of daaruit kan voortspruit; Hou toesig oor en ondersteun Sosiale Hulpwerkers; Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die maatskaplike werk- en maatskaplike welsynvelde; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat deur die werk vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezenhlalakahle: PIC
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wezenhlalakahle kumnyango we-Western Cape Department of Social Development esinikeza ukunakekelwa, ukusekela nokuvikela abantu abangasindiswa kanye namaphakathi kwabaningi emazingeni ahlukene.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphathelene neziqu eziphakeme ezenzele ukusebenza komphakathi i-Bachelor of Social Work ezivumela ukubhalisa ngokusemthethweni ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle; Ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle; Grade 1: Alikho amava; Grade 2: Ubuncane eminyakeni eyi-10 yamava afanele kumsebenzi wezenhlalakahle emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Ubuncane eminyakeni eyi-20 yamava afanele kumsebenzi wezenhlalakahle emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Ubuncane eminyakeni eyi-30 yamava afanele kumsebenzi wezenhlalakahle emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngakulesi: Umhlaka wokuhlakanipha koMsebenzi bakhona bezenhlalakahle; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi kanye namakhono okungena ezindaweni lapho abantu besebenzisana khona nemvelo yabo ukuze bakhiqize impilo enhle yomphakathi; Inqubo yomsebenzi wezenhlalakahle kanye nokungenelela; Ukuphathwa kolwazi; Iziphatho namagugu emisebenzi; Izigaba ezithintekayo, izinqubomgomo kanye nemiyalo; Ukuphila kwomphakathi, amagugu kanye nemigomo yomsebenzi; Ukuthuthukisa futhi nikuze abanye. Iimfuno: Ulwazi ngokuvela kwezi: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kunye nezitho zenani, namakhono okungena kumaphi apho abantu bahlangana nendalo yabo ukuze bakhuthaze impilo yenten还不错 zo bentlalo; Itheory yomsebenzi bentlalo nokinikela; Ulawulo lolwazi; Protokol nemigaqo yomsebenzi; Izigaqo ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo nokulawula (iinkqubo namazinga); Iintshukumo bentlalo, amaxabiso omsebenzi nemigaqo; Ukuphuhliswa nokuzinikela kwabanye. Amakhono kokuvela kwezi: Ukupela imithombo yomonakalo wengcamango, engalinganiyo, ngokucinezela nokwahlukanisa; Ukuthetha ngokubhalweyo nangomlomo; Ukubhala iingxelo; Ukuzilawula; Ukuzimisela; Ulungiselwe oluhle kunye nokuqamba; Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlola; Ulwazi lweekhompyutha; Ukubonisa nokuququzelela; Ukujolisa Kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi; Ikhono nokuqonda ukunceda, ukuphuhliswa, ukuchaswa, nokuquiniswa kwabantu, iintsapho, amaqela, iindalo namathanga ukuze kuphuhliswe imisebenzi yabo yentlalo namakhono abo okusombulula iingxaki; Ikhono lokukhuthaza, ukubuyisela, ukugcina, ukuchasa nokuphucula ukusebenza kwabantu, iintsapho, amaela namathanga ngokubanika isakhono sokwenza imisebenzi, ukuthintela nokunciphisa intlupheko nokusebenzisa izixhobo ngokusebenzisekileyo; Ukuqonda nokukwazi ukunikela iinkonzo zomsebenzi bentlalo ekuw khuselekeni abantu abasengozini, abasengozini futhi abangekho nasikhonweni sokuzikhusela; Ikhono lokuba ngumelwedi nokuqeqesha abaSebenzi bentlalo be-Grade 1.
xh.duties: Nikela inkonzo yomsebenzi bentlalo malunga nenkathalo, inkxaso, ukhuselo nokuphuhliswa kwabantu abasengozini, amaqela, iintsapho namathanga ngenkqubo ezifanelekileyo (Icase work, group work kwi Community work); Kuqwalaselwe nasiphi na esinye isigaba esingadala okanye esivela kuyo intlupheko yentlalo ngalo nawuphi na uhlobo; Qeqesha nokuNxumkela abasebenzi bentlalo Auxiliary; Ukuphuhliswa ngokuqhubekayo ngobuchwepheshe; Gcina uqeqesho lokuphuhliswa okutsha kumsebenzi bentlalo nezenzo zentlalo; Zenza zonke iinkqubo zolawulo ezifunwa sisithuba.

jobs.title: Social Worker: PIC
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 208 - R397 668 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 2: R413 004 - R478 395 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 3: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 4: R608 859 - R754 785 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Social Worker position in the Western Cape providing care, support and protection to vulnerable individuals and communities across multiple salary grades.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as Social Worker; Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a Social Worker; Grade 1: No experience; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviours and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination and exclusion; Written and verbal communication; Report-writing; Self- management; Motivation; Good planning and organizing; Problem solving and analytical; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant programmes (Case work, group work and Community work); Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Supervise and Support Social Auxiliary Workers; Continuous Professional Development; Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields; Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A van Reenen Tel No: (021) 483 3996
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department by applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

jobs.summary: Social Worker position focused on substance abuse within the Western Cape Department of Social Development, requiring professional registration and offering OSD-grade salaries.

Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act 70 of 2008 and related legislative frameworks; National Drug Master Plan and relevant policy guidelines; Minimum Standards for In- patient and Out-patient substance abuse treatment and rehabilitation services; Key national and provincial mandates for substance abuse prevention, early intervention, and community-based treatment; Drug Master Plan 2019 – 2024, Norms & Standards for Substance Abuse Programmes. Competent and Knowledgeable in various M&E frameworks; Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviour and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination and exclusion; Written and verbal communication; Report-writing; Self- management; Motivation; Good planning and organizing; Problem solving and analytical; Computer literacy; Presentation and facilitation; Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organisations and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families, communities and organisations through the relevant programmes; Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; This would include the following actions; New application (Pre funding):On-Site Monitoring; Monitoring NPOs compliance against signed Transfer Payment Agreement (TPA); Evaluate NPOs compliance against Legislative, Programme Specific and Generic Norms and Standards; Case Work, Telephonic, Ministerial complaints process; Rapid response following complaint/enquiries about NPOs, or a concern raised by a programme; Ensure compliance with registration requirements of NPO’s (regulatory frameworks); Ensure compliance in terms of the Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act 70 of 2008; Continuous Professional Development; Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields; Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. af.title: Maatskaplike Werker: Middelmisbruik
af.summary: Maatskaplike Werker-pos wat op middelmisbruik binne die Western Cape Department of Social Development fokus, wat professionele registrasie vereis en OSD-graad salarisse aanbied.
af.requirements: 'n Reisende tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Baccalaureus in Maatskaplike Werk) wat professionele registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Dienste Beroepe as Maatskaplike Werker toelaat; Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Dienste Beroepe as 'n Maatskaplike Werker; Graad 1: Geen ondervinding nie; Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Dienste Beroepe; Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Dienste Beroepe; Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Sosiale Dienste Beroepe. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act 70 of 2008 en verwante wetgewingsraamwerke; Nasionale Dwelmmeesterplan en relevante beleidsriglyne; Minimumstandaarde vir in-pasiënt en uit-pasiënt middelmisbruikbehandeling en rehabilitasiedienste; Sleutel nasionale en provinsiale mandate vir middelmisbruikvoorkoming, vroeë ingryping, en gemeenskapsgebaseerde behandeling; Drug Master Plan 2019 – 2024, Norme & Standaarde vir Middelmisbruikprogramme. Bevoeg en kundig in diverse M&O-raamwerke; Toesighoudende Raamwerk vir Maatskaplike Werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings interakteer ten einde sosiale welsyn te bevorder; Maatskaplike werksteorie en ingrypings; Inligting en Kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Relevante wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en -beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Geskrewe en verbale kommunikasie; Verslagskrywing; Selfbestuur; Motivering; Goeie beplanning en organisering; Probleemoplossing en analities; Rekenvaardigheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus; Vermoë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle op te tree en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter; Vermoë om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, daarvoor op te tree en te verbeter deur hulle in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoë om maatskaplike werkdiensste te lewer ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, blootgestel aan risiko en onbekwaam is om hulself te beskerm; Vermoë om Maatskaplike Werkers Graad 1 te mentor en te afrig.
af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplike werkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne, gemeenskappe en organisasies deur die relevante programme; Handhaaf enige ander aangeleenthede wat tot sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of daaruit kan voortvloei; Dit sal die volgende aksies insluit; Nuwe aansoek (Voor befondsing): Terreine monitering; Monitering van NPO-nakoming teenoor ondertekende Transfer Payment Agreement (TPA); Evalueer NPO-nakoming teenoor Wetgewende, Programspesifieke en Generiese Norme en Standaarde; Gevallewerk, Telefoniese, Ministeriële klagteproses; Vinnige reaksie na aanleiding van 'n klagte/navrae oor NPO's, of 'n kommer wat deur 'n program geuiter is; Verseker nakoming van registrasievereistes van NPO's (regulerende raamwerke); Verseker nakoming in terme van die Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act 70 of 2008; Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die maatskaplike werk- en sosiale welsynsvelde; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat deur die werk vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezomphakathi: Ukwandiswa Kwezidakamizwa
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wezomphakathi esigxile ekwandisweni kwezidakamizwa ngaphakathi kweWestern Cape Department of Social Development, esifuna ukubhalisa ngobungcweti futhi sinikeza amaholo ohlelwe nge-OSD-grade.
zu.requirements: Ithifikheyithi yesikhungo esifanele emsebenzini wezomphakathi (Bachelor of Social Work) esivumela ukubhalisa ngobungcweti kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wezomphakathi; Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wezomphakathi; Grade 1: Akukho mbangela; Grade 2: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-10 yokuhlomeleka okufanelekileyo emsebenzini wezomphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-20 yokuhlomeleka okufanelekileyo emsebenzini wezomphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-30 yokuhlomeleka okufanelekileyo emsebenzini wezomphakathi emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wezomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ikhono nokwazi okulandelayo: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act 70 of 2008 namanye ohlelo lokusebenza ngomthetho; National Drug Master Plan nezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nalezo; Minimum Standards for In- patient and Out-patient substance abuse treatment and rehabilitation services; Izibopho eziyinhloko zesifunda nasenhlokweni zokuthwala izidakamizwa, ukungenelela kwasekuqaleni, kanye nokuwelashwa ngaphakathi komphakathi; Drug Master Plan 2019 – 2024, Norms & Standards for Substance Abuse Programmes. Ukwazi futhi ukuba nodwa kumahlelo ahlukahlukene e-M&E; Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Ukuziphatha kwabantu namasystem ezomphakathi namakhono okungenelela kumaphuzu lapho abantu bahlangana khana nomhlaba wabo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa impilo enhle yomphakathi; Isayensi nomsebenzi wezomphakathi; Ukuphathwa kolwazi nokwazi; Iphrothokholi nokuziphatha ngobungcweti; Umthetho, izinqubomgomo namaphreskriphiti ahlobene (amaphuzu namazinga); Ukuphila komphakathi, amagugu kanye nemigidingo; Ukuphuhlisa futhi sikhusela abanye. Amakhono okulandelayo: Ukubhekana nobunzima bokungalungi, ukungalunga, ukucindezela, ukubandlulula nokukhishwa emphakathini; Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangokuthethwayo; Umbhalo wezibika; Iqiniso lokuqondisa; Ukuzikhusela; Ukukhuthaza; Ukulungisa nokuhlela kahle; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukubonisa futhi kubambe iqhaza; Ukuzinikela kumthengi; Ikhono lokwala, ukuphuhlisa, ukumela, nokuqinisekisa amandla komuntu, omndeni, ohlelweni, kulezo zinhlangano nasemphakathini ukuphucula impilo yabo; Ikhono lokuphakamisa, ukubuyisa, ukugcina, ukumela, nokuphucula ukusebenza komuntu, umndeni, amaqembu, kanye nomphakathi ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo, nokuthi bavikele futhi bathole usizo, basebenzise izinsiza ngokugcwele; Ukuqonda nokuba nakhono lokunika abantu abasengozini, abangenayo ithemba futhi abangeke bakwazi ukuqinisekisa; Ikhono lokuba ngumhola ongumuntu we-Social Workers Grade 1.
zu.duties: Nika isikhundla somsebenzi wezomphakathi mayelana nokunakekelwa, ukwesekwa, ukuvikela, nokuphuculiswa kwabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, imindeni, kanye namaphakathi namahlelo ngamahlelo ahambisana; Dlula zonke ezinye izindaba ezingabanga, noma eziyimvelaphi yezinkinga zomphakathi nganoma iyiphi indlela; Lokhu kuhlanganisa okulandelayo; Isicelo esisha (Pre funding):On-Site Monitoring; Okokubukeka ukuthi i-NPO ihambisana yini ne-Transfer Payment Agreement (TPA) ebhalwe ngokwayo; Ukuhlola ukuthi i-NPO ihambisana yini nomthetho, amaphuzu abalulekile namaNorms and Standards avamileyo; Case Work, Telephonic, Ministerial complaints process; Ukuphendula ngokushesha ngemva kwesikhalazo/imibuzo nge-NPOs, noma inkathi ephakanyiswe uhlelo; Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo zokubhalisa kwe-NPOs; Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nokuthiwa yi-Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act 70 of 2008; Ukuphuculwa kakhulu kwekhono eliqinisekisiwe; Hlala ukwazi okusha emkhakheni wemisebenzi yomphakathi nezinsizakalo ezingumphakathi; Yenza yonke imisebenzi yesikhundla ehlelekileko.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokunceda Ngokwentlalo: Ukusetyenziswa Kwezizendolo
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wokunceda ngokwentlalo esimayele ekusetyenzisweni kwezizendolo ngaphakathi kwiNgingqi yeWestern Cape kwisebe leZentondayo Zokuhlala, esifuna ukubhaliswa ngobuchwepheshe kwaye sibonezela umvuzo onqanaba lwe-OSD.

Ikhono kule minye: Ukuba noxanduva lwemiXhobo yokwenza iindawo ezibangela urhutyana, ukungalulwanga, ukudityaniswa kwamandla, ukuhlukumeza nokudityaniswa kwemixhoba yentlalo; Ukwenza imibhalo nokuthetha ngomlomo; Ukwabhala iinkcazelo; UkuLawula iQabane; Ukwenza ngokuzimisela; Ukucwangcisa nokuqamba ngokulungileyo; Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya; Ulwazi ngekhompyutha; Ukubonezela nokuQamba inkcazelo; Ukuqwalasela umxhasi wakho nokuqwalasela iimpilo zomthengi; Ikhwazi nokuqonda ngokuncedisa, apha khupha khulisa, thetha ngakumbi ngenkxaso, kwaye ukhuthaze abantu, iintsapho, amaqela, oorhwebo namaphakathi jikelele ukuba baPhucule imisebenzi yawo yentlalo nekhono laso lokusombulula iingxaki; Ikhwazi lokuphucula, nika isikhokelo, bhlala ngokunjalo, thetha ngakumbi ngokuzisa inkxaso kwaye uphucule ukusebenza kwabantu, iintsapho, amaqela, namaphakathi jikelele ngokubakhuthaza ukuba bagqibezele imithobo yemisebenzi, athintele kwaye aqonde urhutyana, aze asebenzise izixhobo ngokulungileyo; Ukuqonda nokuQondisa ukunika inkonzo yomsebenzi wokuNcedo Ngokwentlalo ngokukhusela abantu abasengozini, abangalwileyo kwaye abangakhuselekanga; Ikhwazi lokunikela isikhokelo nokuQondisa abasebenzi bokuNcedo Ngokwentlalo Grade 1.
xh.duties: Kunikela inkonzo yomsebenzi wokuNcedo Ngokwentlalo ngokusingathwa, inkxaso, ukukhusela nokuphucula abantu ababuthathaka, amaqela, iintsapho, imiphakathi, norhwebo ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo; Ukubhekana nawo onke amanye amacandelo angabangela, okanye avela, kungakumbi kungalunganga ngokwabo; Oku kubandakanya izinto ezilandelayo; Isicelo esitsha (Isixhobo seNkrete yemali): Okubonakalayo ngokulandelela nokuTyhila; Ukulandelela ukuvumelana ne-NPO ngokuya kwi-Transfer Payment Agreement (TPA) eseTyhilweyo; Ukutyhila ukuvumelana neNPO ngokuya ngokuLungelelaniswa kwemiThetho, iinkqubo ezithileyo namacebo abe mthetho; Icandelo lomncedisi, ngesicelo seNkrete, umgcobo wezikhwele zeNyamezela; Isiphendulelo ngokutsha emva kokuva isikhunkulwa okanye imibuzo malunga ne-NPOs, okanye inkxwelo ephakamileyo ngumthobo; Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nezigqibo zokubhalisa ze-NPO (amacebo olawulo); Qinisekisa ukuvumelana ngokwe-Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act 70 of 2008; Ukuphucula ngokudlulayo ukwaziswa ngomsebenzi wokuNcedo Ngokwentlalo; Zigcine uqaphele kwinkqubo entsha kummandla wokuNcedo Ngokwentlalo namacebo abe Ncedo Lwemiphakathi; Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo efunwa ngumsebenzi.

af.title: Inligtingsbestuursbeampte: Inligtingsbestuur
af.summary: Inligtingsbestuursbeampte gesoek deur die Western Cape Department of Social Development om streek-inligtingsbestuurstelsels te ontwikkel en in stand te hou en IKD-dienste te koördineer.
af.requirements: N 'n kwalifikasie op NQF level 6 (ekwivalent of hoër); N minimum van 1-jarige relevante ervaring. Bevoegdhede: Werkende kennis en begrip van die volgende: Wetgewing, reguleringsraamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat 'n uitwerking het op die lynfunksies; Inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie; Projekbestuur; Operasionele bestuurspraktyke; Verkrygings en tendeerprosesse; Beleidsontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; Moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; Openbare diens prosedures, prosesse en stelsels; Streek- en plaaslike politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale sake wat 'n uitwerking het op die provinsiale regering van die Western Cape; Konstitusionele, regs- en institutionele reëlings wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer; Openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne en diskoersbestuursprosesse; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, richtlyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; Funksionering van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Beleide van die regering van die dag; Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en regulasies; Prestasiebestuur in die algemeen; Kennisbestuur en inligtingstelsels. zu.title: Inhlokodada yokuphatha ulwazi: Ukuphatha ulwazi

Izindlela: Ulwazi nenkambiso eyisisekelo yale mininingwane engezulandelayo: Ukuziphatha kwabantu, isistimu yezibopho nezinkinga zezenhlalakahle; Imo yezenhlalakahle eNingizimu Afrika, inqubomgomo namasu okwenza izinsiza zezenhlalakahle eziyisisekelo; Isistimu yezentengo eNingizimu Afrika nomthetho ophatha noma ongcola umsebenzi ongezansi ohlinzelayo wezenhlalakahale; Ukusebenzisa izindlela nobuchule obuhle bomsebenzi ongezansi ohlinzelayo wezenhlalakahale ukwelapha izidingo zezenhlalakahle ze-abatholi bezenzo; Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemali mayelana nomsebenzi ongezansi ohlinzelayo wezenhlalakahale; Ukusebenzisa ngobuhlakani obude abatholi bezenzo ekunikezeni insiza; Ukuqoqwa nolawulwa kolwazi (Ukugcina okushicilelwe kakhulu nokubhala imibiko enembile ngezidingo zezenhlalakahle nangemisebenzi engazansi ephathelene nokuhlinzela, bese uyibeka endaweni efoluleke kahle); I-vimba kanye nendlela ekufanele abayiyo osebenza ngokungafani. Ubuchule kule mininingwane engezansi: Ukuthumela imilayezo kahle (okubhaliwe nokukhulunwayo); Ukusebenza ngokuhamba kahla ngekhompyutha okungaqinisekiswa; Ukulungisa nokuqamba ukwakheka kwenqubo; Ukwethula futhi ukuqondisa inqubo yokufunda; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya okufundekile; Ukuqondiswa kumthengi ukuzinaka futhi unake abathengi; Ukusebenza kahle nabasebenzi bezenhlalakahle nalabo abayingxenye yeemiba ezixubene ekuhlinzekeni izinkonzo zezenhlalakahle.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkathalo nokuqinisekisa abasebenzi bezenhlalakahale ekwenzeni umsebenzi wezenhlalakahale ngokuphathelene nokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa iziqu zabantu, amaqembu, imindeni namaphiko ahlala engozini ngokuhambisana nemithelela yale minwebo; Sekela abasebenzi bezenhlalakahale ukubhekana nanoma yikuphi okunye okungabanga, noma okuvela kule minwebo, ukungalawuleki nganoma isiphi isimo sezenhlalakahle; Ukuthuthuka ngomsebenzi ngokwakhona ngokungaphezulu; Wenze imisebenzi engozini eqinisekisela abasebenzi bezenhlalakahle njengoba kudingwa umsebenzi.

xh.summary: Isithuba se Social Auxiliary Worker sokuxhasa abasebenzi bentlalo-ngqo kwimisebenzi yenkathalo, kokukhuselwa nentuthuko kwimilambo ephikiswayo, abantu nimaphakathi kwindawo ye Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Isiga 1: Isiga 10 okanye kugqitywe i SAW learnership ukuvumela ukubhalisa kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengakwa Social Auxiliary Worker; Ukubhalisa kwi SACSSP njengakwa Social Auxiliary Worker. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi oluqhelekileyo nokuqonda oku landelayo: Ukuziphatha kwabantu, inkqubo yobudlelwane neendaba zentlalo; Imbonakaliso yamazwe ngamanye eNtlalo eNingi (Western Cape); Inkqubo yamacebo eNingi ngenkqubo yentsapho ekwi Western Cape; Ulwazi ngemithetho ekhokela, umthetho nentsapho ngenkqubo yamacebo eNingi; Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo nemigaqo yokusebenza njengakwi Social Auxiliary Work ngokulingana neemfuno zoluntu; Ulwazi oluphangaleleyo ngemigaqo yamacebo eNingi kwimisebenzi yamacebo eNingi; Ulwazi nokuqonda ukubhaliswa kwamacebo eNingi nakumava okudlula koluntu kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo; Ukuyiqonda inkqubo yokusebenza ngokusemthethweni ngokwesiXhosa; Ulwazi oluphangaleleyo ngenkqubo ekwi Western Cape ye Social Auxiliary Work.

Iindlela eziphumelelayo zokubhalisa nokubhala iinkcukacha ngokusemthethweni; Ukubhaliswa kolwazi ngokusemthethweni ekulawulweni koluntu nokuziphatha.

jobs.title: Social Auxiliary Worker: PIC
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R200 691 - Grade 3: R353 016 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD)
jobs.summary: Social Auxiliary Worker position providing support to social workers in the care and protection of vulnerable individuals, families and communities in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Grade 10 plus completion of the SAW learnership to allow registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Social Auxiliary Worker; Registration with the SACSSP as Social Auxiliary Worker. Competencies: Knowledge and basic understanding of the following: Human behaviour, relationship system and social issues; South African Social Welfare context the policy and practice of developmental social welfare services; South African judicial system and the legislation governing and impacting of social auxiliary work; Implement appropriate social auxiliary work methods and techniques to address the social needs of client systems; Basic knowledge of financial matters related to social auxiliary work; Uses appropriate resources in service delivery to client systems; Information and Knowledge Management (Keep precise records and compile accurate reports on social needs and social auxiliary work activities and file them appropriately); Protocol and professional ethics. Skills in the following: Good communication (written and verbal); Proven computer literacy; Organising and planning; Presentation and facilitation; Report writing; Problem solving and analytical; Client orientation and customer focus; Work effectively with social workers and members of multi-sectoral teams in social service delivery.
jobs.duties: Provide assistance and support to social workers with the rendering of a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant departmental programmes; Assist social workers to attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Continuous professional development; Perform administrative support functions in support of social workers as required of the job.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and will be required to submit duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the timeframe communicated by the WCG and prior to the interview date. Failure to provide the required duly completed and signed vetting and supporting documentation within the prescribed timeframe, without reasonable justification, may result in the shortlisted candidate not being considered further in the current recruitment and selection process. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department by applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Sosiale Hulpwerker: PIC
af.summary: Sosiale Hulpwerker-posisie wat ondersteuning bied aan maatskaplike werkers in die sorg en beskerming van kwesbare individue, gesinne en gemeenskappe in die Western Cape.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Graad 10 plus voltooiing van die SAW-leerderskap om registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Sosiale Hulpwerker moontlik te maak; Registrasie by die SACSSP as Sosiale Hulpwerker. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en basiese begrip van die volgende: Menslike gedrag, verwantskapstelsel en sosiale kwessies; Suid-Afrikaanse maatskaplike welsynskonteks die beleid en praktyk van ontwikkelende maatskaplike welsynsdienste; Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel en die wetgewing wat sosiale hulpwerk regeer en beïnvloed; Toepaslike sosiale hulpwerkmetodes en -tegnieke implementeer om die sosiale behoeftes van kliëntstelsels aan te spreek; Basiese kennis van finansiese aangeleenthede wat verband hou met sosiale hulpwerk; Toepaslike hulpbronne in dienslewering aan kliëntstelsels gebruik; Inligting- en kennisbestuur (Hou noukeurige rekords en stel akkurate verslae oor sosiale behoeftes en sosiale hulpwerkaktiwiteite op en lê dit toepaslik weg); Protokol en professionele etiek. Vaardighede in die volgende: Goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings); Bewese rekenaargeletterdheid; Organisering en beplanning; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Verslagskryf; Probleemoplossing en analities; Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus; Doeltreffend saam met maatskaplike werkers en lede van multisektorale spanne in maatskaplike dienslewering werk.
af.duties: Bied bystand en ondersteuning aan maatskaplike werkers met die lewer van 'n maatskaplike werksdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die toepaslike departementele programme; Bystand aan maatskaplike werkers om enige ander aangeleenthede aan te spreek wat kan lei tot, of voortspruit uit, sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm; Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling; Verrig administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies ter ondersteuning van maatskaplike werkers soos deur die pos vereis.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Womsizi Wezemfundo Yokwelapha Ngokomthetho: PIC
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi womsizi wezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho esinikeza ukwesekela abasebenzibezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho ekunakekelweni nasekuvikeleni abantu abasengozini, imindeni nomphakathi Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: I-Grade 10 kanye nokugcina kufunde i-SAW learnership ukuze kuvunyelwe ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi womsizi wezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho; Ukubhalisa ku-SACSSP njengomsebenzi womsizi wezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho. Izikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda okuyisisekelo kokuqhubekayo: Ukuziphatha komuntu, indlela yokuhlobana nezeinkinga zomphakathi; Isimo sezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika umthetho-nqubo nesezimpilo yemisebenzi yemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho; Isimiso somthetho saseNingizimu Afrika kanye nomthetho ohola futhi onomthelela kumsebenzi womsizi wezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho; Ukusebenzisa izindlela nobuchule obuhambisanayo bomsebenzi womsizi wezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho ukwenzela ukuphendula izidingo zomphakathi kumaklayenti; Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemayelana nezimali kumsebenzi womsizi wezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho; Ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele ekunikezweni konikezwe abaklayenti; Ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi (Ukugcina izinkomba ezinembile kanye nekuphinda umbhalo onembile ngezeinkinga zomphakathi futhi zigcinwe zifakwe kahle); Iyinkomba kanye nomthetho ngokwemisebenzi yobungcweti. Amakhono okuqhubekayo: Ukuxhumana okuhle (okubhaliwe nokuveziwe); Ukuthwasa ikhono kwekhompyutha okuzuziwe; Ukuhlela nekuhlela; Okuthunyelwe nokukhonzisa; Ukuhunyushwa kwemibiko; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda; Ukumomothelwa ngokumaklayenti kanye nokuhlangenwe ngokugqamile; Ukusebenza kahle nomsebenzi wezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho kanye namalungu emiyalo yamakhono amaningi ekunikezweni kwezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho.
zu.duties: Nika usizo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kubasebenzibezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho ngokunikeza inkonzo yemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho ngokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela nokukula kwabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, imindeni nomphakathi kulo mkhankaso onezemfundo; Siza abasebenzi bezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho ukunaka noma yimuphi umunye umsebenzi ongabangela, noma osuka kona, ukungalunga nganoma iyiphi indlela; Ukuthuthuka ngokulandelana ngomsebenzi; Wenza imisebenzi yokweseka ngokomthetho ngokweseka abasebenzi bezemfundo yokwelapha ngokomthetho njengoko kudingwa umsebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokuncedela Ongcali: PIC
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wokuncedela ongcali sibonelela ngenkxaso abasebenzi bengcali kwindlela yokunikela ngomso nomkhuselo abantu, usapho namaphakathi angenamandla e Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Inqanaba lesi-10 lokugqiba kwaye kuqediwe isiseko seziko le SAW ukuze kubhengezwe kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wokuncedela ongcali; Kubhalwe kwi SACSSP njengomsebenzi wokuncedela ongcali. Iimfuno: Ulwazi nokuqonda okusesiseko ngezinto ezilandelayo: Ukuziphatha komntu, inkqubo yobudlelwane nemiba emphakathini; Imiba yoNxubelelwano loMzabalazo woNxaxheba eMzantsi Afrika umgaqo-nkqubo nokuqhuba iinkonzo zomzabalazo wophuhliso; Inkqubo yamagunya eMzantsi Afrika namagunya alo aphatha nabanomthelela kumsebenzi wokuncedela ongcali; Ukusebenzisa iindlela namakhono obuncedela obungcali afanelekileyo ukubanjwa kwemiba yezidingo zabantu kwezodlwalo; Ulwazi olusesiseko ngeemali ezinxulumene nomsebenzi wokuncedela ongcali; Ukusebenzisa izibonelelo ezifanelekileyo ekunikezeleni ngenkonzo kubantu; Ulwazi oluBambekileyo oluQondwayo (Ukugcina amarekhod acaca ngokuchanekileyo nokubhala iingxelo ezicaba ngeemiba zomphakathi nangemisebenzi yencedelo engcali nokuwazisa ngendlela efanelekileyo); Imigaqo yomsebenzi nengonde lomsebenzi. Amakhono kwizinto ezilandelayo: Unxibelelwano oluhle (elibhalwayo nokuTHethwayo); Isidanga esiqinisekileyo sokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ulungiselelo nokuhlela; Okubonakalayo kokuvelisa; Ukubhala iingxelo; Ukusombulula iingxaki kwakunye nokuqonda iintlungu; Ukuziphatheka kumthengi kwaye unikezele ngomnqweno wabo; Ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo nabasebenzi bengcali kunye nabahlali beetim ezingabalini ngeendlela zokunikezela ngenkonzo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxazo ngenkxaso abasebenzi bengcali ngokunikezela ngenkonzo yomsebenzi wengcali ngokumalunga noniko, inkxazo, umkhuselo nophuhliso labantu, amaqela, usapho namaphakathi angenamandla ngenkqubo ezithile zesebe; Uncede abasebenzi bengcali ukubanjwa nako nayiphi na into enokubangela okanye iphumo kungalungelelani kwezomphakathi naluphi na uhlobo; Intshukumbo eqhubekayo ngokuphucula ulwazi ngomsebenzi; Yenza imisebenzi esekayo ngokuqhuba imisebenzi engcali njengoko kufunwa sisithuba.
